namespace Web::HTML {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(ClassicScript);

static void register_source(ClassicScript& script, ScriptRegistry::IsInlineSource is_inline_source, size_t source_line_number)
{
    auto script_record = script.script_record();
    if (!script_record)
        return;

    auto source_code = JS::top_level_source_code(*script_record);
    if (!source_code)
        return;

    register_javascript_source(script, source_code.release_nonnull(), ScriptRegistry::JavaScriptSource::Type::Script, is_inline_source, source_line_number);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#creating-a-classic-script
GC::Ref<ClassicScript> ClassicScript::create(ByteString filename, Utf16String source, EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings, URL::URL base_url, size_t source_line_number, MutedErrors muted_errors, ScriptRegistry::IsInlineSource is_inline_source)
{
    // 1. If mutedErrors is true, then set baseURL to about:blank.
    if (muted_errors == MutedErrors::Yes)
        base_url = URL::about_blank();

    // FIXME: 2. If scripting is disabled for settings and bypassDisabledScripting is false, then set source to the empty string.
    if (is_scripting_disabled(settings))
        source = {};

    // 3. Let script be a new classic script that this algorithm will subsequently initialize.
    // 4. Set script's settings object to settings.
    // 5. Set script's base URL to baseURL.
    auto script = GC::Heap::the().allocate<ClassicScript>(move(base_url), move(filename), settings);

    // 6. Set script's fetch options to options.
    // NB: Callers set the script's fetch options once it has been created.

    // 7. Set script's muted errors to mutedErrors.
    script->m_muted_errors = muted_errors;

    // 8. Set script's parse error and error to rethrow to null.
    script->set_parse_error(JS::js_null());
    script->set_error_to_rethrow(JS::js_null());

    // FIXME: 9. Record classic script creation time given script and sourceURLForWindowScripts.

    // 10. Let result be ParseScript(source, settings's realm, script).
    // Note: Passing script as the last parameter here ensures result.[[HostDefined]] will be script.
    auto parse_timer = Core::ElapsedTimer::start_new();
    auto source_code = JS::SourceCode::create(script->display_filename(), source);
    auto parsed = JS::ParsedProgram::parse(move(source), JS::ProgramType::Script, source_line_number);
    auto result = JS::create_script(move(parsed), move(source_code), settings.realm(), script->filename(), script.ptr());
    dbgln_if(HTML_SCRIPT_DEBUG, "ClassicScript: Parsed {} in {}ms", script->filename(), parse_timer.elapsed_milliseconds());

    // 11. If result is a list of errors:
    if (result.is_error()) {
        auto& parse_error = result.error().first();
        dbgln_if(HTML_SCRIPT_DEBUG, "ClassicScript: Failed to parse: {}", parse_error.to_utf16_string());

        // 1. Set script's parse error and its error to rethrow to result[0].
        script->set_parse_error(JS::SyntaxError::create(settings.realm(), parse_error.to_utf16_string()), parse_error.position);
        script->set_error_to_rethrow(script->parse_error());

        // 2. Return script.
        return script;
    }

    // 12. Set script's record to result.
    script->m_script_record = *result.release_value();
    register_source(*script, is_inline_source, source_line_number);

    // 13. Return script.
    return script;
}

GC::Ref<ClassicScript> ClassicScript::create_from_pre_parsed(ByteString filename, NonnullRefPtr<JS::SourceCode const> source_code, EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings, URL::URL base_url, JS::ParsedProgram parsed, MutedErrors muted_errors)
{
    auto& realm = settings.realm();

    if (muted_errors == MutedErrors::Yes)
        base_url = URL::about_blank();

    auto script = GC::Heap::the().allocate<ClassicScript>(move(base_url), move(filename), settings);

    script->m_muted_errors = muted_errors;
    script->set_parse_error(JS::js_null());
    script->set_error_to_rethrow(JS::js_null());

    auto parse_timer = Core::ElapsedTimer::start_new();
    auto result = JS::create_script(move(parsed), move(source_code), realm, script->filename(), script.ptr());
    dbgln_if(HTML_SCRIPT_DEBUG, "ClassicScript: Compiled pre-parsed {} in {}ms", script->filename(), parse_timer.elapsed_milliseconds());

    if (result.is_error()) {
        auto& parse_error = result.error().first();
        dbgln_if(HTML_SCRIPT_DEBUG, "ClassicScript: Failed to compile: {}", parse_error.to_utf16_string());

        script->set_parse_error(JS::SyntaxError::create(realm, parse_error.to_utf16_string()), parse_error.position);
        script->set_error_to_rethrow(script->parse_error());

        return script;
    }

    script->m_script_record = *result.release_value();
    register_source(*script, ScriptRegistry::IsInlineSource::No, 1);

    return script;
}

GC::Ref<ClassicScript> ClassicScript::create_from_pre_compiled(ByteString filename, NonnullRefPtr<JS::SourceCode const> source_code, EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings, URL::URL base_url, JS::CompiledProgram compiled, MutedErrors muted_errors)
{
    auto& realm = settings.realm();

    if (muted_errors == MutedErrors::Yes)
        base_url = URL::about_blank();

    auto script = GC::Heap::the().allocate<ClassicScript>(move(base_url), move(filename), settings);

    script->m_muted_errors = muted_errors;
    script->set_parse_error(JS::js_null());
    script->set_error_to_rethrow(JS::js_null());

    auto parse_timer = Core::ElapsedTimer::start_new();
    auto result = JS::create_script(move(compiled), move(source_code), realm, script->filename(), script.ptr());
    dbgln_if(HTML_SCRIPT_DEBUG, "ClassicScript: Materialized pre-compiled {} in {}ms", script->filename(), parse_timer.elapsed_milliseconds());

    if (result.is_error()) {
        auto& parse_error = result.error().first();
        dbgln_if(HTML_SCRIPT_DEBUG, "ClassicScript: Failed to materialize: {}", parse_error.to_utf16_string());

        script->set_parse_error(JS::SyntaxError::create(realm, parse_error.to_utf16_string()), parse_error.position);
        script->set_error_to_rethrow(script->parse_error());

        return script;
    }

    script->m_script_record = *result.release_value();
    register_source(*script, ScriptRegistry::IsInlineSource::No, 1);

    return script;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#run-a-classic-script
JS::Completion ClassicScript::run(RethrowErrors rethrow_errors, GC::Ptr<JS::Environment> lexical_environment_override)
{
    // 1. Let settings be the settings object of script.
    auto& settings = this->settings_object();
    auto& realm = settings.realm();

    // 2. Check if we can run script with settings. If this returns "do not run", then return NormalCompletion(empty).
    if (can_run_script(settings) == RunScriptDecision::DoNotRun)
        return JS::normal_completion(JS::js_undefined());

    // FIXME: 3. Record classic script execution start time given script.

    // 4. Prepare to run script given settings.
    prepare_to_run_script(settings);

    // 5. Let evaluationStatus be null.
    JS::Completion evaluation_status;

    // 6. If script's error to rethrow is not null, then set evaluationStatus to ThrowCompletion(script's error to rethrow).
    if (!error_to_rethrow().is_null()) {
        evaluation_status = JS::throw_completion(error_to_rethrow());
    }
    // 7. Otherwise, set evaluationStatus to ScriptEvaluation(script's record).
    else {
        auto timer = Core::ElapsedTimer::start_new();

        evaluation_status = vm().run(*m_script_record, lexical_environment_override);

        // FIXME: If ScriptEvaluation does not complete because the user agent has aborted the running script, leave evaluationStatus as null.

        dbgln_if(HTML_SCRIPT_DEBUG, "ClassicScript: Finished running script {}, Duration: {}ms", filename(), timer.elapsed_milliseconds());
    }

    // 8. If evaluationStatus is an abrupt completion, then:
    if (evaluation_status.is_abrupt()) {
        // 1. If rethrow errors is true and script's muted errors is false, then:
        if (rethrow_errors == RethrowErrors::Yes && m_muted_errors == MutedErrors::No) {
            // 1. Clean up after running script with settings.
            clean_up_after_running_script(settings);

            // 2. Rethrow evaluationStatus.[[Value]].
            return JS::throw_completion(evaluation_status.value());
        }

        // 2. If rethrow errors is true and script's muted errors is true, then:
        if (rethrow_errors == RethrowErrors::Yes && m_muted_errors == MutedErrors::Yes) {
            // 1. Clean up after running script with settings.
            clean_up_after_running_script(settings);

            // 2. Throw a "NetworkError" DOMException.
            return throw_completion(realm, WebIDL::NetworkError::create("Script error."_utf16));
        }

        // 3. Otherwise, rethrow errors is false. Perform the following steps:
        VERIFY(rethrow_errors == RethrowErrors::No);

        // 1. Report an exception given by evaluationStatus.[[Value]] for script's settings object's global object.
        report_an_exception(settings.global_object(), evaluation_status.value(), OmitError::No, this);

        // 2. Clean up after running script with settings.
        clean_up_after_running_script(settings);

        // 3. Return evaluationStatus.
        return evaluation_status;
    }

    // 9. Clean up after running script with settings.
    clean_up_after_running_script(settings);

    // 10. If evaluationStatus is a normal completion, then return evaluationStatus.
    VERIFY(!evaluation_status.is_abrupt());
    return evaluation_status;

    // FIXME: 11. If we've reached this point, evaluationStatus was left as null because the script was aborted prematurely during evaluation.
    //            Return ThrowCompletion(a new "QuotaExceededError" DOMException).
}

ClassicScript::ClassicScript(URL::URL base_url, ByteString filename, EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings)
    : Script(move(base_url), move(filename), settings)
{
}

ClassicScript::ClassicScript(URL::URL base_url, ByteString filename, Utf16String display_filename, EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings)
    : Script(move(base_url), move(filename), move(display_filename), settings)
{
}

ClassicScript::~ClassicScript() = default;

    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_script_record);
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/CompiledScriptCache.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <LibCrypto/Hash/Hash.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/CompiledScriptCache.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

static constexpr size_t compiled_script_cache_size_limit = 16 * MiB;

CompiledScriptFingerprint CompiledScriptFingerprint::of(Utf16String const& source_text)
{
    // NB: The storage width is part of what is hashed, so the same text in another width only misses the cache.
    auto view = source_text.utf16_view();
    u8 is_wide = view.has_latin1_storage() ? 0 : 1;
    Crypto::Hash::Hasher hasher { Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256 };
    hasher.update(ReadonlyBytes { &is_wide, sizeof(is_wide) });
    if (is_wide) {
        auto units = view.utf16_span();
        hasher.update(ReadonlyBytes { reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(units.data()), units.size() * sizeof(char16_t) });
    } else {
        hasher.update(view.latin1_span());
    }
    auto digest = hasher.finish();

    CompiledScriptFingerprint fingerprint;
    VERIFY(digest.size == fingerprint.sha256_digest.size());
    digest.bytes().copy_to(fingerprint.sha256_digest);
    fingerprint.length_in_code_units = source_text.length_in_code_units();
    return fingerprint;
}

CompiledScriptCache& CompiledScriptCache::the()
{
    static thread_local NeverDestroyed<CompiledScriptCache> cache;
    return *cache;
}

Optional<CompiledScriptCache::Hit> CompiledScriptCache::find(CompiledScriptCacheKey const& key, CompiledScriptFingerprint const& fingerprint)
{
    auto entry = m_entries.get(key);
    if (!entry.has_value() || entry->fingerprint != fingerprint)
        return {};

    entry->touch_serial = ++m_next_touch_serial;
    Hit hit { entry->program.clone(), nullptr };
    // NB: Loads of one script share one text, which LibJS parks for all of them at once.
    for (auto const& linked : entry->linked_source_codes) {
        if (auto source_code = linked.strong_ref()) {
            hit.source_code_to_share = move(source_code);
            break;
        }
    }

    // NB: Entries grow as their functions compile, which no store sees.
    evict_until_within_limit(key);
    return hit;
}

void CompiledScriptCache::store(CompiledScriptCacheKey key, CompiledScriptFingerprint const& fingerprint, JS::CompiledProgram const& program)
{
    if (auto entry = m_entries.take(key); entry.has_value())
        release(*entry);

    // NB: However large the program is, it costs nothing while a document runs it, which the one that stores it is about
    //     to, and goes once none does.
    program.set_retains_compiled_functions(true);
    m_entries.set(key, Entry { fingerprint, program.clone(), ++m_next_touch_serial, {} });
    evict_until_within_limit(key);
}

void CompiledScriptCache::note_linked(CompiledScriptCacheKey const& key, JS::SourceCode const& source_code)
{
    auto entry = m_entries.get(key);
    if (!entry.has_value())
        return;
    entry->linked_source_codes.remove_all_matching([](auto const& linked) { return !linked.is_alive(); });
    entry->linked_source_codes.append(JS::WeakSourceCode { source_code });
    evict_until_within_limit();
}

void CompiledScriptCache::clear()
{
    for (auto& it : m_entries)
        release(it.value);
    m_entries.clear();
}

void CompiledScriptCache::release(Entry& entry)
{
    // NB: Realms that still run the program have no use for keeping the functions they compile from here on.
    entry.program.set_retains_compiled_functions(false);
}

bool CompiledScriptCache::is_linked(Entry& entry)
{
    entry.linked_source_codes.remove_all_matching([](auto const& linked) { return !linked.is_alive(); });
    return !entry.linked_source_codes.is_empty();
}

void CompiledScriptCache::evict_until_within_limit(Optional<CompiledScriptCacheKey const&> about_to_be_linked)
{
    auto counts_against_limit = [&](auto& it) {
        if (about_to_be_linked.has_value() && it.key == *about_to_be_linked)
            return false;
        return !is_linked(it.value);
    };

    size_t size = 0;
    for (auto& it : m_entries) {
        if (counts_against_limit(it))
            size += it.value.program.memory_size();
    }

    while (size > compiled_script_cache_size_limit) {
        Optional<CompiledScriptCacheKey const&> least_recently_used_key;
        u64 least_recently_used_serial = NumericLimits<u64>::max();
        for (auto& it : m_entries) {
            if (it.value.touch_serial >= least_recently_used_serial || !counts_against_limit(it))
                continue;
            least_recently_used_key = it.key;
            least_recently_used_serial = it.value.touch_serial;
        }
        VERIFY(least_recently_used_key.has_value());

        auto entry = m_entries.take(*least_recently_used_key);
        size -= entry->program.memory_size();
        release(*entry);
    }
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/CompiledScriptCache.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Traits.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibJS/ScriptCompilation.h>
#include <LibJS/SourceCode.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

// What tells the source text of an entry apart from other text, without keeping the text.
struct WEB_API CompiledScriptFingerprint {
    static CompiledScriptFingerprint of(Utf16String const& source_text);

    Array<u8, 32> sha256_digest {};
    size_t length_in_code_units { 0 };

    bool operator==(CompiledScriptFingerprint const&) const = default;
};

// What a compiled script is stored under. The filename, base URL and muted errors of a script belong to one load of it
// and are not part of its compiled code.
struct CompiledScriptCacheKey {
    Utf16String partition;
    String url_without_fragment;
    JS::ProgramType program_type { JS::ProgramType::Script };
    size_t line_number_offset { 0 };

    bool operator==(CompiledScriptCacheKey const&) const = default;
};

// The compiled scripts of this agent, which a script that loads again links into its own realm instead of being
// parsed and compiled again. Entries are found after a fetch completed, by the decoded source text the fetch came up
// with, so they answer nothing that the checks of a fetch decide, and can not stand in for different source text.
// Entries hold a SHA-256 digest of the text and not the text itself, so that the text goes once LibJS parks it.
//
// The size limit is for the programs that only the cache keeps alive. A program that a live document runs stays in
// memory with or without its entry, so it counts for nothing until no document runs it anymore, and an entry that the
// limit evicts is the one that no document runs and that was used the longest time ago.
class WEB_API CompiledScriptCache {
public:
    struct Hit {
        JS::CompiledProgram program;
        // A live source code that the program was linked into, whose code a new load shares, if there is one.
        RefPtr<JS::SourceCode const> source_code_to_share;
    };

    static CompiledScriptCache& the();

    Optional<Hit> find(CompiledScriptCacheKey const&, CompiledScriptFingerprint const&);

    // From here on, the program keeps the functions that get compiled for it. Replaces what the key held before.
    void store(CompiledScriptCacheKey, CompiledScriptFingerprint const&, JS::CompiledProgram const&);

    // The program of the key is linked into a record of the source code, which keeps the entry from counting against
    // the limit for as long as anything holds the source code.
    void note_linked(CompiledScriptCacheKey const&, JS::SourceCode const&);

    bool contains(CompiledScriptCacheKey const& key) const { return m_entries.contains(key); }

    void clear();

private:
    struct Entry {
        CompiledScriptFingerprint fingerprint;
        JS::CompiledProgram program;
        u64 touch_serial { 0 };
        // The source code of the records that the program was linked into.
        Vector<JS::WeakSourceCode> linked_source_codes;
    };

    static void release(Entry&);
    static bool is_linked(Entry&);

    // An entry that is about to be linked, which no record holds the source code of yet, counts as linked.
    void evict_until_within_limit(Optional<CompiledScriptCacheKey const&> about_to_be_linked = {});

    HashMap<CompiledScriptCacheKey, Entry> m_entries;
    u64 m_next_touch_serial { 0 };
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Traits<Web::HTML::CompiledScriptCacheKey> : public AK::DefaultTraits<Web::HTML::CompiledScriptCacheKey> {
    static unsigned hash(Web::HTML::CompiledScriptCacheKey const& key)
    {
        auto hash = pair_int_hash(key.partition.hash(), key.url_without_fragment.hash());
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, to_underlying(key.program_type));
        return pair_int_hash(hash, u64_hash(key.line_number_offset));
    }
};

// Enough for any list someone reads through, and a bound on the work for an object with a huge number of properties.
static constexpr size_t MAX_MATCHES = 1500;
static constexpr size_t MAX_PROPERTIES_EXAMINED = 100000;

// https://tc39.es/ecma262/#prod-ReservedWord
static constexpr Array RESERVED_WORDS = {
    "await"sv, "break"sv, "case"sv, "catch"sv, "class"sv, "const"sv, "continue"sv, "debugger"sv, "default"sv,
    "delete"sv, "do"sv, "else"sv, "enum"sv, "export"sv, "extends"sv, "false"sv, "finally"sv, "for"sv, "function"sv,
    "if"sv, "import"sv, "in"sv, "instanceof"sv, "new"sv, "null"sv, "return"sv, "super"sv, "switch"sv, "this"sv,
    "throw"sv, "true"sv, "try"sv, "typeof"sv, "var"sv, "void"sv, "while"sv, "with"sv, "yield"sv
};

static bool is_identifier_code_point(u32 code_point)
{
    return is_ascii_alphanumeric(code_point) || code_point == '_' || code_point == '$' || code_point >= 0x80;
}

static String string_from_code_points(ReadonlySpan<u32> code_points)
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    for (auto code_point : code_points)
        builder.append_code_point(code_point);
    return builder.to_string_without_validation();
}

// Whether the input ends inside a string, a template, or a comment, where what's typed isn't a name.
static bool ends_inside_literal_or_comment(ReadonlySpan<u32> code_points)
{
    enum class State : u8 {
        Code,
        SingleQuotedString,
        DoubleQuotedString,
        Template,
        LineComment,
        BlockComment,
    };

    auto state = State::Code;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < code_points.size(); ++i) {
        auto code_point = code_points[i];
        auto next = i + 1 < code_points.size() ? code_points[i + 1] : 0;

        switch (state) {
        case State::Code:
            if (code_point == '\'')
                state = State::SingleQuotedString;
            else if (code_point == '"')
                state = State::DoubleQuotedString;
            else if (code_point == '`')
                state = State::Template;
            else if (code_point == '/' && next == '/')
                state = State::LineComment;
            else if (code_point == '/' && next == '*') {
                state = State::BlockComment;
                ++i;
            }
            break;
        case State::SingleQuotedString:
        case State::DoubleQuotedString:
        case State::Template:
            if (code_point == '\\')
                ++i;
            else if ((state == State::SingleQuotedString && code_point == '\'') || (state == State::DoubleQuotedString && code_point == '"') || (state == State::Template && code_point == '`'))
                state = State::Code;
            break;
        case State::LineComment:
            if (code_point == '\n')
                state = State::Code;
            break;
        case State::BlockComment:
            if (code_point == '*' && next == '/') {
                state = State::Code;
                ++i;
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    return state != State::Code;
}

// The value of the property of `base` named `name`, as reading it would produce, without running any page script: A
// getter defined in script, or a proxy anywhere along the prototype chain, leaves the property unread.
static Optional<JS::Value> read_property_without_running_script(JS::VM& vm, JS::Value base, String const& name)
{
    if (base.is_nullish())
        return {};

    auto object = base.to_object(vm);
    if (object.is_error())
        return {};

    JS::PropertyKey key { Utf16FlyString::from_utf8(name) };
    for (GC::Ptr<JS::Object> holder = object.value(); holder;) {
        if (holder->is_proxy())
            return {};

        auto descriptor = holder->internal_get_own_property(key);
        if (descriptor.is_error())
            return {};

        if (descriptor.value().has_value()) {
            auto const& property = *descriptor.value();
            if (property.is_data_descriptor())
                return property.value.value_or(JS::js_undefined());

            auto getter = property.get.value_or(nullptr);
            if (!getter || !is<JS::NativeFunction>(*getter))
                return {};

            auto value = JS::call(vm, *getter, base);
            if (value.is_error())
                return {};
            return value.value();
        }

        auto prototype = holder->internal_get_prototype_of();
        if (prototype.is_error())
            return {};
        holder = prototype.value();
    }

    return {};
}

// The value of the global named `name`, read without running any page script.
static Optional<JS::Value> read_global_without_running_script(JS::VM& vm, JS::Realm& realm, String const& name)
{
    auto& declarative_record = realm.global_environment().declarative_record();
    auto binding_name = Utf16FlyString::from_utf8(name);
    if (declarative_record.bindings().contains_slow(binding_name)) {
        auto value = declarative_record.get_binding_value(vm, binding_name, false);
        if (value.is_error())
            return {};
        return value.value();
    }

    return read_property_without_running_script(vm, &realm.global_object(), name);
}

// The length of an object whose own keys include one per index, which listing its own keys would make every one of.
static Optional<double> indexed_key_count(JS::VM& vm, JS::Object& object)
{
    auto lists_index_keys = is<JS::Array>(object) || is<JS::TypedArrayBase>(object) || is<JS::StringObject>(object)
        || Bindings::impl_from<DOM::NodeList>(&object) || Bindings::impl_from<DOM::HTMLCollection>(&object);
    if (!lists_index_keys)
        return {};

    auto length = read_property_without_running_script(vm, &object, "length"_string);
    if (!length.has_value() || !length->is_number())
        return {};
    return length->as_double();
}

static bool is_array_index(StringView name)
{
    return !name.is_empty() && all_of(name, is_ascii_digit);
}

Optional<ConsoleInputCompletion> complete_console_input(JS::Realm& realm, StringView input)
{
    auto& vm = realm.vm();
    TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };

    Vector<u32> code_points;
    for (auto code_point : Utf8View { input })
        code_points.append(code_point);

    if (ends_inside_literal_or_comment(code_points))
        return {};

    // The input ends with the name being typed, perhaps empty after a period, and before it, any names that lead to the
    // object whose properties complete it: "document.body.cla", e.g.
    auto start = code_points.size();
    while (start > 0 && is_identifier_code_point(code_points[start - 1]))
        --start;
    auto match_prop = string_from_code_points(code_points.span().slice(start));

    // Exactly three periods before a name are a spread, as in "[...doc", which the name starts after.
    auto follows_spread = [&](size_t position) {
        return position >= 3 && code_points[position - 1] == '.' && code_points[position - 2] == '.' && code_points[position - 3] == '.'
            && (position == 3 || code_points[position - 4] != '.');
    };

    Vector<String> chain;
    while (start > 0 && code_points[start - 1] == '.' && !follows_spread(start)) {
        auto name_end = start - 1;
        auto name_start = name_end;
        while (name_start > 0 && is_identifier_code_point(code_points[name_start - 1]))
            --name_start;

        // A period after anything but a name, as in "f().x" or "a[0].x", follows a value that only evaluating the input
        // can produce.
        if (name_start == name_end)
            return {};

        chain.prepend(string_from_code_points(code_points.span().slice(name_start, name_end - name_start)));
        start = name_start;
    }

    if (chain.is_empty() && match_prop.is_empty())
        return {};

    auto const& first_name = chain.is_empty() ? match_prop : chain.first();
    if (is_ascii_digit(first_name.bytes_as_string_view()[0]))
        return {};

    JS::Value object = &realm.global_object();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < chain.size(); ++i) {
        auto value = i == 0 ? read_global_without_running_script(vm, realm, chain[i]) : read_property_without_running_script(vm, object, chain[i]);
        if (!value.has_value() || value->is_nullish())
            return {};
        object = *value;
    }

    // A name typed starting in lowercase matches without regard to case, so "doc" finds "Document" as well.
    auto matches_case_insensitively = is_ascii_lower_alpha(match_prop.bytes_as_string_view().is_empty() ? 0 : match_prop.bytes_as_string_view()[0]);
    auto lowercase_match_prop = match_prop.to_ascii_lowercase();
    auto matches_prop = [&](String const& name) {
        if (matches_case_insensitively)
            return name.to_ascii_lowercase().starts_with_bytes(lowercase_match_prop);
        return name.starts_with_bytes(match_prop);
    };

    Vector<String> matches;
    HashTable<String> seen;
    auto add_match = [&](String name) {
        if (matches.size() < MAX_MATCHES && seen.set(name) == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
            matches.append(move(name));
    };

    auto holder_or_error = object.to_object(vm);
    if (holder_or_error.is_error())
        return {};

    size_t properties_examined = 0;
    for (GC::Ptr<JS::Object> holder = holder_or_error.value(); holder && matches.size() < MAX_MATCHES;) {
        if (holder->is_proxy())
            break;

        // Listing the own keys of an object with more indices than the limit would make a key for each one first, and
        // an index never completes anyway, so its own keys are skipped. Its prototype still offers length.
        if (auto count = indexed_key_count(vm, *holder); count.has_value() && *count > MAX_PROPERTIES_EXAMINED) {
            auto prototype = holder->internal_get_prototype_of();
            if (prototype.is_error())
                break;
            holder = prototype.value();
            continue;
        }

        auto keys = holder->internal_own_property_keys();
        if (keys.is_error())
            break;

        properties_examined += keys.value().size();
        if (properties_examined > MAX_PROPERTIES_EXAMINED)
            break;

        for (auto key : keys.value()) {
            if (!key.is_string())
                continue;
            // An empty name completes nothing.
            auto name = key.as_string().utf16_string_view().to_utf8_but_should_be_ported_to_utf16();
            if (!name.is_empty() && !is_array_index(name) && matches_prop(name))
                add_match(move(name));
        }

        auto prototype = holder->internal_get_prototype_of();
        if (prototype.is_error())
            break;
        holder = prototype.value();
    }

    if (chain.is_empty()) {
        for (auto const& binding : realm.global_environment().declarative_record().bindings()) {
            auto name = binding.view().to_utf8_but_should_be_ported_to_utf16();
            if (matches_prop(name))
                add_match(move(name));
        }

        for (auto reserved_word : RESERVED_WORDS) {
            if (reserved_word.starts_with(match_prop))
                add_match(MUST(String::from_utf8(reserved_word)));
        }
    }

    // Names that start in lowercase come first, then the typed name itself, then the rest without regard to case.
    auto starts_in_uppercase = [](String const& name) { return is_ascii_upper_alpha(name.bytes_as_string_view()[0]); };
    quick_sort(matches, [&](String const& a, String const& b) {
        if (starts_in_uppercase(a) != starts_in_uppercase(b))
            return !starts_in_uppercase(a);
        if ((a == match_prop) != (b == match_prop))
            return a == match_prop;
        auto lowercase_a = a.to_ascii_lowercase();
        auto lowercase_b = b.to_ascii_lowercase();
        if (lowercase_a != lowercase_b)
            return lowercase_a.bytes_as_string_view() < lowercase_b.bytes_as_string_view();
        return a.bytes_as_string_view() > b.bytes_as_string_view();
    });

    return ConsoleInputCompletion { move(matches), move(match_prop) };
}

}

#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Object.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/PropertyDescriptor.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Value.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/DevToolsLoggedObjects.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

void DevToolsLoggedObjects::start_message()
{
    if (m_messages_in_current_table == MESSAGES_PER_TABLE) {
        swap(m_current_table, m_previous_table);
        m_current_table.clear();
        m_messages_in_current_table = 0;
    }
    ++m_messages_in_current_table;
}

Vector<JsonValue> DevToolsLoggedObjects::serialize_message_arguments(ReadonlySpan<JS::Value> arguments)
{
    start_message();

    Vector<JsonValue> serialized_arguments;
    auto preview_arguments = arguments.slice(0, min(arguments.size(), 100uz));
    serialized_arguments.ensure_capacity(preview_arguments.size());
    for (auto argument : preview_arguments)
        serialized_arguments.unchecked_append(m_current_table.serialize_value_as_grip(argument));
    if (preview_arguments.size() < arguments.size())
        serialized_arguments.append("..."_string);
    return serialized_arguments;
}

// The value of an own data property, read without running any script.
static Optional<JS::Value> own_data_property(JS::Object& object, JS::PropertyKey const& key)
{
    auto descriptor = object.internal_get_own_property(key);
    if (descriptor.is_error() || !descriptor.value().has_value() || !descriptor.value()->is_data_descriptor())
        return {};
    return descriptor.value()->value.value_or(JS::js_undefined());
}

// The arguments of a console.table() message, in the shape a client builds its table from: The console's rows go in an
// ownProperties field of the first argument's grip, keyed by each row's index, with each row's own cells in an
// ownProperties field of its grip.
// https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#table
Vector<JsonValue> DevToolsLoggedObjects::serialize_console_table_arguments(JS::VM& vm, JS::Object& table_data)
{
    start_message();

    auto rows_value = own_data_property(table_data, JS::PropertyKey { "rows"_utf16_fly_string });
    if (!rows_value.has_value() || !rows_value->is_object())
        return {};
    auto& rows = rows_value->as_object();

    JsonObject table_rows;
    for (size_t row_index = 0; row_index < MAX_CONSOLE_TABLE_ROWS; ++row_index) {
        auto row_value = own_data_property(rows, JS::PropertyKey { row_index });
        if (!row_value.has_value() || !row_value->is_object())
            break;
        auto& row = row_value->as_object();

        auto keys = row.internal_own_property_keys();
        if (keys.is_error())
            continue;

        JsonObject cells;
        String index;
        for (auto key_value : keys.value()) {
            auto key = JS::PropertyKey::from_value(vm, key_value);
            if (key.is_error())
                continue;
            auto cell = own_data_property(row, key.value());
            if (!cell.has_value())
                continue;

            auto name = key_value.to_utf16_string_without_side_effects().to_utf8();
            if (name == "(index)"sv) {
                index = cell->to_utf16_string_without_side_effects().to_utf8();
                continue;
            }

            JsonObject descriptor;
            descriptor.set("value"sv, m_current_table.serialize_value_as_grip(*cell));
            cells.set(name, move(descriptor));
        }

        // A row's preview would repeat its cells, along with its index.
        auto row_grip = m_current_table.serialize_value_as_grip(&row);
        row_grip.as_object().remove("preview"sv);
        row_grip.as_object().set("ownPropertyLength"sv, cells.size());
        row_grip.as_object().set("ownProperties"sv, move(cells));

        JsonObject descriptor;
        descriptor.set("value"sv, move(row_grip));
        table_rows.set(index, move(descriptor));
    }

    auto table_grip = m_current_table.serialize_value_as_grip(&rows);
    table_grip.as_object().set("ownProperties"sv, move(table_rows));
    table_grip.as_object().set("preview"sv, JsonValue {});

    Vector<JsonValue> arguments;
    arguments.append(move(table_grip));
    return arguments;
}

bool DevToolsLoggedObjects::contains(u64 object_id) const
{
    return m_current_table.contains(object_id) || m_previous_table.contains(object_id);
}

ErrorOr<WebView::DebuggerObjectProperties> DevToolsLoggedObjects::properties_for_object(u64 object_id)
{
    if (m_previous_table.contains(object_id))
        return m_previous_table.properties_for_object(object_id);
    return m_current_table.properties_for_object(object_id);
}

void DevToolsLoggedObjects::clear()
{
    m_current_table.clear();
    m_previous_table.clear();
    m_messages_in_current_table = 0;
}

void DevToolsLoggedObjects::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    m_current_table.visit_edges(visitor);
    m_previous_table.visit_edges(visitor);
}

}

#pragma once

namespace Web::HTML {

// The objects of the messages that a page logs to its console, which DevTools may expand. Only the latest messages keep
// theirs, so a page that logs in a loop doesn't keep alive everything it ever logged: A message's objects go into the
// current table, and once that holds MESSAGES_PER_TABLE messages, it replaces the previous table.
class WEB_API DevToolsLoggedObjects {
public:
    static constexpr size_t MESSAGES_PER_TABLE = 500;
    static constexpr size_t MAX_CONSOLE_TABLE_ROWS = 1000;

    Vector<JsonValue> serialize_message_arguments(ReadonlySpan<JS::Value>);
    Vector<JsonValue> serialize_console_table_arguments(JS::VM&, JS::Object& table_data);
    bool contains(u64 object_id) const;
    ErrorOr<WebView::DebuggerObjectProperties> properties_for_object(u64 object_id);
    void clear();
    void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&);

private:
    void start_message();

    DevToolsObjectTable m_current_table { DevToolsObjectTable::RootObjects::No };
    DevToolsObjectTable m_previous_table { DevToolsObjectTable::RootObjects::No };
    size_t m_messages_in_current_table { 0 };
};

}

// How many items, entries, or properties a preview lists, which is all a console shows of an object before it's expanded.
static constexpr size_t PREVIEW_ITEM_COUNT = 10;

// A preview lists what its object holds only for the object a value is, and not for those it holds, so a preview stays
// one level deep: An array of elements shows each element's name, but an array of arrays shows only their lengths.
static constexpr u8 MAX_PREVIEW_DEPTH = 1;

static String preview_text(Utf16View text)
{
    constexpr size_t limit = 1024;
    auto prefix = text.substring_view(0, min(text.length_in_code_units(), limit)).to_utf8_but_should_be_ported_to_utf16();
    if (text.length_in_code_units() > limit)
        return MUST(String::formatted("{}...", prefix));
    return prefix;
}

WebView::DebuggerValue DevToolsObjectTable::serialize_value(JS::Value value)
{
    return serialize_value(value, 0);
}

JsonValue DevToolsObjectTable::serialize_value_as_grip(JS::Value value)
{
    return grip_value(value, 0);
}

// Every table in the process takes its IDs from one count, so an ID never names a different object: The table of a
// document's console starts over when the next document replaces it, and DevTools may still hold IDs from the last.
static u64 s_next_object_id = 1;

u64 DevToolsObjectTable::id_for_object(JS::Object& object)
{
    if (auto existing_id = m_object_ids.get(&object); existing_id.has_value())
        return *existing_id;

    auto object_id = s_next_object_id++;
    m_object_ids.set(&object, object_id);
    m_objects.set(object_id, object);
    if (m_root_objects == RootObjects::Yes)
        m_roots.append(GC::make_root(object));
    return object_id;
}

// The class that a client shows for an object: the one JS knows it by, rather than the name of the engine's class for it.
static String class_name_of(JS::Object const& object)
{
    if (object.is_function())
        return "Function"_string;

    auto class_name = object.class_name();
    if (is<JS::RegExpObject>(object))
        return "RegExp"_string;
    if (object.is_proxy())
        return "Proxy"_string;
    for (auto wrapper : { "BigIntObject"sv, "BooleanObject"sv, "NumberObject"sv, "StringObject"sv, "SymbolObject"sv }) {
        if (class_name == wrapper)
            return MUST(String::from_utf8(class_name.substring_view(0, class_name.length() - "Object"sv.length())));
    }
    if (class_name.ends_with("Prototype"sv)) {
        // Of the built-in prototypes, only Array.prototype is an array, and Function.prototype a function.
        if (class_name == "ArrayPrototype"sv)
            return "Array"_string;
        return "Object"_string;
    }
    return MUST(String::from_utf8(class_name));
}

WebView::DebuggerValue DevToolsObjectTable::serialize_value(JS::Value value, u8 depth)
{
    WebView::DebuggerValue result;
    if (value.is_special_empty_value()) {
        result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::Uninitialized;
        return result;
    }
    if (value.is_undefined())
        return result;
    if (value.is_null()) {
        result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::Null;
        return result;
    }
    if (value.is_boolean()) {
        result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::Boolean;
        result.boolean_value = value.as_bool();
        return result;
    }
    if (value.is_number()) {
        result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::Number;
        result.number_value = value.as_double();
        return result;
    }
    if (value.is_string()) {
        result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::String;
        result.text = value.as_string().utf16_string();
        return result;
    }
    if (value.is_bigint()) {
        result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::BigInt;
        result.text = value.as_bigint().to_utf16_string();
        return result;
    }
    if (value.is_symbol()) {
        // FIXME: Represent symbols with dedicated SymbolActors instead of converting them to strings.
        result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::String;
        result.text = value.to_utf16_string_without_side_effects();
        return result;
    }

    VERIFY(value.is_object());
    auto& object = value.as_object();
    result.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::Object;
    result.object_id = id_for_object(object);
    result.object_class = class_name_of(object);
    if (depth <= MAX_PREVIEW_DEPTH)
        result.grip_fields = grip_fields_for_object(object, depth);
    return result;
}

// A value as a grip inside another grip's fields. An object is named by its ID, which the DevTools server swaps for an
// object actor.
JsonValue DevToolsObjectTable::grip_value(JS::Value value, u8 depth)
{
    if (value.is_bigint() || value.is_symbol()) {
        auto& vm = value.is_bigint() ? value.as_bigint().vm() : value.as_symbol().vm();
        AllocatingMemoryStream stream;
        JS::PrintContext context { .vm = vm, .stream = &stream, .strip_ansi = true, .compact = true };
        MUST(JS::print(value, context));
        auto text = MUST(String::from_stream(stream, stream.used_buffer_size()));
        if (value.is_symbol())
            return text;
        JsonObject grip;
        grip.set("type"sv, "BigInt"sv);
        grip.set("text"sv, move(text));
        return grip;
    }

    auto serialized = serialize_value(value, depth);

    JsonObject grip;
    switch (serialized.type) {
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::Undefined:
        grip.set("type"sv, "undefined"sv);
        return grip;
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::Null:
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::Uninitialized:
        grip.set("type"sv, "null"sv);
        return grip;
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::Boolean:
        return serialized.boolean_value;
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::Number:
        if (isnan(serialized.number_value)) {
            grip.set("type"sv, "NaN"sv);
            return grip;
        }
        if (isinf(serialized.number_value)) {
            grip.set("type"sv, serialized.number_value < 0 ? "-Infinity"sv : "Infinity"sv);
            return grip;
        }
        if (serialized.number_value == 0 && signbit(serialized.number_value)) {
            grip.set("type"sv, "-0"sv);
            return grip;
        }
        return serialized.number_value;
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::String:
        return preview_text(serialized.text);
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::BigInt:
        grip.set("type"sv, "BigInt"sv);
        grip.set("text"sv, serialized.text.to_utf8());
        return grip;
    case WebView::DebuggerValueType::Object:
        if (serialized.grip_fields.is_object())
            grip = serialized.grip_fields.as_object();
        grip.set("type"sv, "object"sv);
        grip.set("objectId"sv, serialized.object_id);
        grip.set("class"sv, serialized.object_class);
        return grip;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

// The value of a property as reading it produces, but without running any script: A getter written in script, or a
// proxy along the way, leaves the property unread.
static Optional<JS::Value> read_property_without_running_script(JS::Object& object, JS::PropertyKey const& key)
{
    for (GC::Ptr<JS::Object> holder = &object; holder;) {
        if (holder->is_proxy())
            return {};

        auto descriptor = holder->internal_get_own_property(key);
        if (descriptor.is_error())
            return {};

        if (descriptor.value().has_value()) {
            auto const& property = *descriptor.value();
            if (property.is_data_descriptor())
                return property.value.value_or(JS::js_undefined());

            auto getter = property.get.value_or(nullptr);
            if (!getter || !is<JS::NativeFunction>(*getter))
                return {};

            auto value = JS::call(object.vm(), *getter, &object);
            if (value.is_error())
                return {};
            return value.value();
        }

        auto prototype = holder->internal_get_prototype_of();
        if (prototype.is_error())
            return {};
        holder = prototype.value();
    }

    return JS::js_undefined();
}

static Optional<JS::Value> read_property_without_running_script(JS::Object& object, StringView name)
{
    return read_property_without_running_script(object, JS::PropertyKey { Utf16FlyString::from_utf8(name) });
}

// The length of an array, or of a list of nodes, whose items a preview lists by index.
static Optional<u32> array_like_length(JS::Object& object)
{
    if (!is<JS::Array>(object) && !Bindings::impl_from<DOM::NodeList>(&object) && !Bindings::impl_from<DOM::HTMLCollection>(&object))
        return {};

    auto length = read_property_without_running_script(object, "length"sv);
    if (!length.has_value() || !length->is_number())
        return {};
    return static_cast<u32>(length->as_double());
}

JsonObject DevToolsObjectTable::grip_fields_for_object(JS::Object& object, u8 depth)
{
    JsonObject fields;
    JsonObject preview;
    auto lists_contents = depth < MAX_PREVIEW_DEPTH;

    if (auto const* node = Bindings::impl_from<DOM::Node>(&object)) {
        preview.set("kind"sv, "DOMNode"sv);
        preview.set("nodeType"sv, node->node_type());
        preview.set("isConnected"sv, node->is_connected());

        auto node_name = preview_text(node->node_name().view());
        if (auto const* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(*node)) {
            // The nodeName of an HTML element is its tag name in uppercase, but a console writes the tag the way the
            // markup does.
            if (element->namespace_uri() == Namespace::HTML)
                node_name = node_name.to_ascii_lowercase();

            JsonObject attributes;
            for (auto const& attribute : element->attribute_list().slice(0, min(element->attribute_list_size(), PREVIEW_ITEM_COUNT))) {
                attributes.set(preview_text(attribute.name.as_string().view()), preview_text(attribute.value));
            }
            preview.set("attributes"sv, move(attributes));
            preview.set("attributesLength"sv, element->attribute_list_size());
        } else if (auto const* character_data = as_if<DOM::CharacterData>(*node)) {
            preview.set("textContent"sv, preview_text(character_data->data()));
        } else if (auto const* document = as_if<DOM::Document>(*node)) {
            preview.set("location"sv, document->url().serialize());
        }
        preview.set("nodeName"sv, move(node_name));

        // The DevTools server completes this with the browsing context, so a client can select the node in its
        // inspector.
        JsonObject content_dom_reference;
        content_dom_reference.set("id"sv, node->unique_id().value());
        fields.set("contentDomReference"sv, move(content_dom_reference));
        fields.set("preview"sv, move(preview));
        return fields;
    }

    if (auto length = array_like_length(object); length.has_value()) {
        preview.set("kind"sv, "ArrayLike"sv);
        preview.set("length"sv, *length);
        if (lists_contents) {
            JsonArray items;
            for (u32 index = 0; index < min<u32>(*length, PREVIEW_ITEM_COUNT); ++index) {
                auto item = read_property_without_running_script(object, JS::PropertyKey { index });
                items.must_append(grip_value(item.value_or(JS::js_undefined()), depth + 1));
            }
            preview.set("items"sv, move(items));
        }
        fields.set("preview"sv, move(preview));
        return fields;
    }

    if (auto* set = as_if<JS::Set>(object)) {
        preview.set("kind"sv, "ArrayLike"sv);
        preview.set("length"sv, set->set_size());
        if (lists_contents) {
            JsonArray items;
            (void)set->for_each_value([&](JS::Value value) -> JS::ThrowCompletionOr<void> {
                if (items.size() < PREVIEW_ITEM_COUNT)
                    items.must_append(grip_value(value, depth + 1));
                return {};
            });
            preview.set("items"sv, move(items));
        }
        fields.set("preview"sv, move(preview));
        return fields;
    }

    if (auto* map = as_if<JS::Map>(object)) {
        preview.set("kind"sv, "MapLike"sv);
        preview.set("size"sv, map->map_size());
        if (lists_contents) {
            JsonArray entries;
            (void)map->for_each_entry([&](JS::Value key, JS::Value value) -> JS::ThrowCompletionOr<void> {
                if (entries.size() < PREVIEW_ITEM_COUNT) {
                    JsonArray entry;
                    entry.must_append(grip_value(key, depth + 1));
                    entry.must_append(grip_value(value, depth + 1));
                    entries.must_append(move(entry));
                }
                return {};
            });
            preview.set("entries"sv, move(entries));
        }
        fields.set("preview"sv, move(preview));
        return fields;
    }

    if (object.is_function()) {
        auto name = read_property_without_running_script(object, "name"sv);
        if (name.has_value() && name->is_string()) {
            auto function_name = preview_text(name->as_string().utf16_string_view());
            fields.set("name"sv, function_name);
            fields.set("displayName"sv, move(function_name));
        }
        return fields;
    }

    if (auto* date = as_if<JS::Date>(object)) {
        preview.set("timestamp"sv, date->date_value());
        fields.set("preview"sv, move(preview));
        return fields;
    }

    if (auto* regexp = as_if<JS::RegExpObject>(object)) {
        fields.set("displayString"sv, MUST(String::formatted("/{}/{}", preview_text(regexp->pattern()), regexp->flags())));
        return fields;
    }

    if (is<JS::Error>(object)) {
        preview.set("kind"sv, "Error"sv);
        for (auto name : { "name"sv, "message"sv, "stack"sv, "fileName"sv, "lineNumber"sv, "columnNumber"sv }) {
            auto value = read_property_without_running_script(object, name);
            preview.set(name, grip_value(value.value_or(JS::js_undefined()), depth + 1));
        }
        fields.set("preview"sv, move(preview));
        return fields;
    }

    if (object.is_proxy())
        return fields;

    auto keys = object.internal_own_property_keys();
    if (keys.is_error())
        return fields;

    JsonObject own_properties;
    size_t own_properties_length = 0;
    size_t previewed_properties = 0;
    for (auto const& key : keys.value()) {
        if (!key.is_string())
            continue;
        ++own_properties_length;
        if (!lists_contents || previewed_properties >= PREVIEW_ITEM_COUNT)
            continue;
        ++previewed_properties;

        auto name = key.as_string().utf16_string();
        auto descriptor = object.internal_get_own_property(JS::PropertyKey { name });
        if (descriptor.is_error() || !descriptor.value().has_value())
            continue;

        auto const& property = *descriptor.value();
        JsonObject serialized;
        if (property.value.has_value()) {
            serialized.set("value"sv, grip_value(*property.value, depth + 1));
            serialized.set("writable"sv, property.writable.value_or(false));
        } else {
            serialized.set("get"sv, grip_value(property.get->ptr() ? JS::Value { property.get->ptr() } : JS::js_undefined(), depth + 1));
            serialized.set("set"sv, grip_value(property.set.has_value() && property.set->ptr() ? JS::Value { property.set->ptr() } : JS::js_undefined(), depth + 1));
        }
        serialized.set("configurable"sv, property.configurable.value_or(false));
        serialized.set("enumerable"sv, property.enumerable.value_or(false));
        own_properties.set(preview_text(name), move(serialized));
    }

    preview.set("kind"sv, "Object"sv);
    preview.set("ownPropertiesLength"sv, own_properties_length);
    if (lists_contents) {
        preview.set("ownProperties"sv, move(own_properties));
        preview.set("ownSymbols"sv, JsonArray {});
        preview.set("ownSymbolsLength"sv, 0);
        preview.set("safeGetterValues"sv, JsonObject {});
    }
    fields.set("ownPropertyLength"sv, own_properties_length);
    fields.set("preview"sv, move(preview));
    return fields;
}

ErrorOr<WebView::DebuggerObjectProperties> DevToolsObjectTable::properties_for_object(u64 object_id)
{
    auto object_iterator = m_objects.find(object_id);
    if (object_iterator == m_objects.end())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to locate object");
    // serialize_value() may add entries to m_objects, so keep a reference independent of the map's storage.
    auto object = object_iterator->value;

    WebView::DebuggerObjectProperties result;

    // Reading the prototype or the properties of a proxy runs its traps, which can be page script.
    if (object->is_proxy())
        return result;

    auto prototype = object->internal_get_prototype_of();
    if (prototype.is_error())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to inspect object prototype");
    if (auto* prototype_object = prototype.release_value()) {
        result.prototype = serialize_value(prototype_object);
    } else {
        WebView::DebuggerValue null_prototype;
        null_prototype.type = WebView::DebuggerValueType::Null;
        result.prototype = move(null_prototype);
    }

    auto own_property_keys = object->internal_own_property_keys();
    if (own_property_keys.is_error())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to inspect object properties");

    for (auto const& key_value : own_property_keys.release_value()) {
        // FIXME: Expose symbol properties through a symbol iterator actor.
        if (!key_value.is_string())
            continue;

        auto name = key_value.as_string().utf16_string();
        auto descriptor = object->internal_get_own_property(JS::PropertyKey { name });
        if (descriptor.is_error())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to inspect object property");
        if (!descriptor.value().has_value())
            continue;

        auto const& property_descriptor = descriptor.value().value();
        WebView::DebuggerProperty property;
        property.name = move(name);
        property.writable = property_descriptor.writable.value_or(false);
        property.enumerable = property_descriptor.enumerable.value_or(false);
        property.configurable = property_descriptor.configurable.value_or(false);
        if (property_descriptor.value.has_value()) {
            property.value = serialize_value(*property_descriptor.value);
        } else {
            if (property_descriptor.get.has_value())
                property.getter = serialize_value(property_descriptor.get->ptr() ? JS::Value { property_descriptor.get->ptr() } : JS::js_undefined());
            if (property_descriptor.set.has_value())
                property.setter = serialize_value(property_descriptor.set->ptr() ? JS::Value { property_descriptor.set->ptr() } : JS::js_undefined());
        }
        result.properties.append(move(property));
    }

    return result;
}

void DevToolsObjectTable::clear()
{
    m_objects.clear();
    m_object_ids.clear();
    m_roots.clear();
}

void DevToolsObjectTable::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    visitor.visit(m_objects);
    visitor.visit(m_object_ids);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGC/Cell.h>
#include <LibGC/Root.h>
#include <LibJS/Forward.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/WebView/Debugger.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

// The objects that DevTools refers to by ID, along with the previews it shows of them. The objects stay for as long as
// DevTools may ask about them: The table either roots them, or leaves them for its owner to visit.
class WEB_API DevToolsObjectTable {
public:
    enum class RootObjects : u8 {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    explicit DevToolsObjectTable(RootObjects root_objects)
        : m_root_objects(root_objects)
    {
    }

    WebView::DebuggerValue serialize_value(JS::Value);
    JsonValue serialize_value_as_grip(JS::Value);
    ErrorOr<WebView::DebuggerObjectProperties> properties_for_object(u64 object_id);
    bool contains(u64 object_id) const { return m_objects.contains(object_id); }
    void clear();
    void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&);

private:
    WebView::DebuggerValue serialize_value(JS::Value, u8 depth);
    u64 id_for_object(JS::Object&);
    JsonValue grip_value(JS::Value, u8 depth);
    JsonObject grip_fields_for_object(JS::Object&, u8 depth);

    RootObjects m_root_objects { RootObjects::No };
    HashMap<u64, GC::Ref<JS::Object>> m_objects;
    HashMap<GC::Ptr<JS::Object>, u64> m_object_ids;
    Vector<GC::Root<JS::Object>> m_roots;
};

}

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(Environment);

GC::Ref<Environment> Environment::create(EnvironmentId id, URL::URL creation_url, Optional<URL::URL> top_level_creation_url,
    Optional<URL::Origin> top_level_origin, GC::Ptr<BrowsingContext> target_browsing_context)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<Environment>(move(id), move(creation_url), move(top_level_creation_url), move(top_level_origin), move(target_browsing_context));
}

Environment::Environment(EnvironmentId id, URL::URL creation_url, Optional<URL::URL> top_level_creation_url, Optional<URL::Origin> top_level_origin, GC::Ptr<BrowsingContext> target_browsing_context)
    : id(move(id))
    , creation_url(move(creation_url))
    , top_level_creation_url(move(top_level_creation_url))
    , top_level_origin(move(top_level_origin))
    , target_browsing_context(target_browsing_context)
{
}

Environment::~Environment() = default;

static EnvironmentSettingsObjectAddress allocate_an_address()
{
    static Atomic<u64> s_next_address { 1 };
    return EnvironmentSettingsObjectAddress { s_next_address.fetch_add(1) };
}

EnvironmentSettingsObject::EnvironmentSettingsObject(NonnullOwnPtr<JS::ExecutionContext> realm_execution_context)
    : m_realm_execution_context(move(realm_execution_context))
    , m_address(allocate_an_address())
    , m_keepalive_quota_accountant(Fetch::Infrastructure::KeepaliveQuotaAccountant::create())
{
    m_module_map = GC::Heap::the().allocate<ModuleMap>();

    // Register with the responsible event loop so we can perform step 4 of "perform a microtask checkpoint".
    responsible_event_loop().register_environment_settings_object({}, *this);
}

void EnvironmentSettingsObject::finalize()
{
    responsible_event_loop().unregister_environment_settings_object({}, *this);
    Base::finalize();
}

void EnvironmentSettingsObject::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_responsible_event_loop);
    visitor.visit(m_module_map);
    m_realm_execution_context->visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_storage_manager);
    visitor.visit(m_lock_manager);
    visitor.visit(m_service_worker_registration_object_map);
    visitor.visit(m_service_worker_object_map);
    visitor.visit(m_owned_worker_agents);

    // Keep the fetch records of the fetches that are still under way, since aborting the document or terminating its
    // fetch group has to reach them. A record whose fetch is over is left to the collector, and leaves the group as
    // it's finalized.
    for (auto& fetch_record : m_fetch_group) {
        auto controller = fetch_record.fetch_controller();
        if (fetch_record.request().done())
            continue;
        if (controller && controller->state() != Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchController::State::Ongoing)
            continue;
        visitor.visit(fetch_record);
    }
}

void EnvironmentSettingsObject::discard_environment()
{
    // https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#ref-for-environment-discarding-steps
    // Each service worker client has the following environment discarding steps:

    // 1. Set client’s discarded flag.
    set_discarded(true);
}

void EnvironmentSettingsObject::add_owned_worker_agent(WorkerAgentParent& worker_agent)
{
    m_owned_worker_agents.append(worker_agent);
}

void EnvironmentSettingsObject::remove_owned_worker_agent(WorkerAgentParent& worker_agent)
{
    m_owned_worker_agents.remove_first_matching([&](auto& agent) {
        return agent.ptr() == &worker_agent;
    });
}

void EnvironmentSettingsObject::release_owned_worker_agents()
{
    GC::RootVector owned_worker_agents { move(m_owned_worker_agents) };
    for (auto& worker_agent : owned_worker_agents)
        worker_agent->terminate();
}

JS::ExecutionContext& EnvironmentSettingsObject::realm_execution_context()
{
    // NOTE: All environment settings objects are created with a realm execution context, so it's stored and returned here in the base class.
    return *m_realm_execution_context;
}

JS::ExecutionContext const& EnvironmentSettingsObject::realm_execution_context() const
{
    // NOTE: All environment settings objects are created with a realm execution context, so it's stored and returned here in the base class.
    return *m_realm_execution_context;
}

ModuleMap& EnvironmentSettingsObject::module_map()
{
    return *m_module_map;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#environment-settings-object%27s-realm
JS::Realm& EnvironmentSettingsObject::realm()
{
    // An environment settings object's realm execution context's Realm component is the environment settings object's Realm.
    return *realm_execution_context().realm();
}

JS::Realm const& EnvironmentSettingsObject::realm() const
{
    return *realm_execution_context().realm();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-settings-object-global
JS::Object& EnvironmentSettingsObject::global_object()
{
    // An environment settings object's Realm then has a [[GlobalObject]] field, which contains the environment settings object's global object.
    return realm().global_object();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#responsible-event-loop
EventLoop& EnvironmentSettingsObject::responsible_event_loop()
{
    // An environment settings object's responsible event loop is its global object's relevant agent's event loop.
    // This is here in case the realm that is holding onto this ESO is destroyed before the ESO is. The responsible event loop pointer is needed in the ESO destructor to deregister from the event loop.
    // FIXME: Figure out why the realm can be destroyed before the ESO, as the realm is holding onto this with an OwnPtr, but the heap block deallocator calls the ESO destructor directly instead of through the realm destructor.
    if (m_responsible_event_loop)
        return *m_responsible_event_loop;

    m_responsible_event_loop = relevant_agent(global_object()).event_loop;
    return *m_responsible_event_loop;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#check-if-we-can-run-script
RunScriptDecision can_run_script(EnvironmentSettingsObject const& settings)
{
    // 1. If the global object specified by settings is a Window object whose Document object is not fully active,
    //     then return "do not run".
    if (auto const* window = window_from_global_object(settings.global_object())) {
        if (!window->associated_document().is_fully_active())
            return RunScriptDecision::DoNotRun;
    }

    // 2. If scripting is disabled for settings, then return "do not run".
    if (is_scripting_disabled(settings))
        return RunScriptDecision::DoNotRun;

    // 3. Return "run".
    return RunScriptDecision::Run;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#prepare-to-run-script
void prepare_to_run_script(EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings)
{
    // 1. Push settings's realm execution context onto the JavaScript execution context stack; it is now the running JavaScript execution context.
    settings.realm().vm().push_execution_context(settings.realm_execution_context());

    // FIXME: 2. Add settings to the surrounding agent's event loop's currently running task's script evaluation environment settings object set.
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#clean-up-after-running-script
void clean_up_after_running_script(EnvironmentSettingsObject const& settings)
{
    auto& vm = settings.global_object().vm();

    // 1. Assert: settings's realm execution context is the running JavaScript execution context.
    VERIFY(&settings.realm_execution_context() == &vm.running_execution_context());

    // 2. Remove settings's realm execution context from the JavaScript execution context stack.
    vm.pop_execution_context();

    // 3. If the JavaScript execution context stack is now empty, perform a microtask checkpoint. (If this runs scripts, these algorithms will be invoked reentrantly.)
    if (!vm.has_running_execution_context())
        current_event_loop().perform_a_microtask_checkpoint();
}

static JS::ExecutionContext* top_most_script_having_execution_context(JS::VM& vm)
{
    // Here, the topmost script-having execution context is the topmost entry of the JavaScript execution context stack that has a non-null ScriptOrModule component,
    // or null if there is no such entry in the JavaScript execution context stack.
    auto execution_context = vm.last_execution_context_matching([&](JS::ExecutionContext* context) {
        return !context->script_or_module().has<Empty>();
    });

    if (!execution_context.has_value())
        return nullptr;

    return execution_context.value();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#prepare-to-run-a-callback
void prepare_to_run_callback(EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings)
{
    auto& vm = settings.global_object().vm();

    // 1. Push settings onto the backup incumbent settings object stack.
    // NOTE: The spec doesn't say which event loop's stack to put this on. However, all the examples of the incumbent settings object use iframes and cross browsing context communication to demonstrate the concept.
    //       This means that it must rely on some global state that can be accessed by all browsing contexts, which is the event loop of their agent.
    HTML::current_event_loop().push_onto_backup_incumbent_realm_stack(settings);

    // 2. Let context be the topmost script-having execution context.
    auto* context = top_most_script_having_execution_context(vm);

    // 3. If context is not null, increment context's skip-when-determining-incumbent counter.
    if (context) {
        HTML::current_event_loop().increment_skip_when_determining_incumbent_counter(*context);
    }
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#parse-a-url
Optional<URL::URL> EnvironmentSettingsObject::parse_url(Utf16View url)
{
    // 1. Let baseURL be environment's base URL, if environment is a Document object; otherwise environment's API base URL.
    auto base_url = api_base_url();

    // 2. Return the result of applying the URL parser to url, with baseURL.
    return DOMURL::parse(url, base_url);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#encoding-parsing-a-url
Optional<URL::URL> EnvironmentSettingsObject::encoding_parse_url(Utf16View url)
{
    // 1. Let encoding be UTF-8.
    auto encoding = "UTF-8"_utf16;

    // 2. If environment is a Document object, then set encoding to environment's character encoding.

    // 3. Otherwise, if environment's relevant global object is a Window object, set encoding to environment's relevant
    //    global object's associated Document's character encoding.
    if (auto const* window = window_from_global_object(global_object()))
        encoding = window->associated_document().encoding_or_default();

    // 4. Let baseURL be environment's base URL, if environment is a Document object; otherwise environment's API base URL.
    auto base_url = api_base_url();

    // 5. Return the result of applying the URL parser to url, with baseURL and encoding.
    return DOMURL::parse(url, base_url, encoding.utf16_view());
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url
Optional<Utf16String> EnvironmentSettingsObject::encoding_parse_and_serialize_url(Utf16View url)
{
    // 1. Let url be the result of encoding-parsing a URL given url, relative to environment.
    auto parsed_url = encoding_parse_url(url);

    // 2. If url is failure, then return failure.
    if (!parsed_url.has_value())
        return {};

    // 3. Return the result of applying the URL serializer to url.
    return utf16_string_from_url_ascii(parsed_url->serialize());
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#clean-up-after-running-a-callback
void clean_up_after_running_callback(EnvironmentSettingsObject const& settings)
{
    auto& vm = settings.global_object().vm();

    // 1. Let context be the topmost script-having execution context.
    auto* context = top_most_script_having_execution_context(vm);

    // 2. If context is not null, decrement context's skip-when-determining-incumbent counter.
    if (context) {
        HTML::current_event_loop().decrement_skip_when_determining_incumbent_counter(*context);
    }

    // 3. Assert: the topmost entry of the backup incumbent realm stack is settings.
    auto& event_loop = HTML::current_event_loop();
    VERIFY(&event_loop.top_of_backup_incumbent_realm_stack() == &settings);

    // 4. Remove settings from the backup incumbent realm stack.
    event_loop.pop_backup_incumbent_realm_stack();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-environment-script
bool is_scripting_enabled(EnvironmentSettingsObject const& settings)
{
    // Scripting is enabled for an environment settings object settings when all of the following conditions are true:
    // The user agent supports scripting.
    // NOTE: This is always true in LibWeb :^)

    // FIXME: Do the right thing for workers.
    auto const* window = window_from_global_object(settings.global_object());
    if (!window)
        return true;

    // The user has not disabled scripting for realm at this time. (User agents may provide users with the option to disable scripting globally, or in a finer-grained manner, e.g., on a per-origin basis, down to the level of individual realms.)
    auto const& document = window->associated_document();

    // NB: WebUI pages are internal pages requiring javascript, so we do not consider user configuration for these.
    if (!document.page().is_scripting_enabled() && !URL::is_webui_url(document.url()))
        return false;

    // Either settings's global object is not a Window object, or settings's global object's associated Document's active sandboxing flag set does not have its sandboxed scripts browsing context flag set.
    if (has_flag(document.active_sandboxing_flag_set(), SandboxingFlagSet::SandboxedScripts))
        return false;

    return true;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-environment-noscript
bool is_scripting_disabled(EnvironmentSettingsObject const& settings)
{
    // Scripting is disabled for an environment settings object when scripting is not enabled for it, i.e., when any of the above conditions are false.
    return !is_scripting_enabled(settings);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#module-type-allowed
bool module_type_allowed(EnvironmentSettingsObject const& settings, Utf16View module_type)
{
    // 1. If moduleType is not "javascript-or-wasm", "css", "json", or "text", then return false.
    if (module_type != "javascript-or-wasm"sv && module_type != "css"sv && module_type != "json"sv && module_type != "text"sv)
        return false;

    // 2. If moduleType is "css" and the CSSStyleSheet interface is not exposed in settings's realm, then return false.
    if (module_type == "css"sv && !Bindings::is_exposed(Bindings::InterfaceName::CSSStyleSheet, settings.realm()))
        return false;

    // 3. Return true.
    return true;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#add-module-to-resolved-module-set
void add_module_to_resolved_module_set(EnvironmentSettingsObject& settings_object, Utf16View serialized_base_url, Utf16View normalized_specifier, Optional<URL::URL> const& as_url)
{
    // 1. Let global be settingsObject's global object.
    auto& global = settings_object.global_object();

    // 2. If global does not implement Window, then return.
    auto* window = window_from_global_object(global);
    if (!window)
        return;

    // 3. Let record be a new specifier resolution record, with serialized base URL set to serializedBaseURL,
    //    specifier set to normalizedSpecifier, and specifier as a URL set to asURL.
    //
    // NOTE: We set 'specifier as a URL set to asURL' as a bool to simplify logic when merging import maps.
    SpecifierResolution resolution {
        .serialized_base_url = Utf16String::from_utf16(serialized_base_url),
        .specifier = Utf16String::from_utf16(normalized_specifier),
        .specifier_is_null_or_url_like_that_is_special = !as_url.has_value() || as_url->is_special(),
    };

    // 4. Append record to global's resolved module set.
    window->append_resolved_module(move(resolution));
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-incumbent-realm
JS::Realm& incumbent_realm()
{
    // Then, the incumbent realm is the realm of the incumbent settings object.
    return incumbent_settings_object().realm();
}

GC::Ptr<EnvironmentSettingsObject> environment_settings_object_at(EnvironmentSettingsObjectAddress address)
{
    return current_event_loop().environment_settings_object_at(address);
}

GC::Ptr<EnvironmentSettingsObject> environment_settings_object_with_id(EnvironmentId const& id)

    return current_event_loop().environment_settings_object_with_id(id);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#incumbent-settings-object
EnvironmentSettingsObject& incumbent_settings_object()
{
    auto& event_loop = HTML::current_event_loop();
    auto& vm = event_loop.vm();

    // 1. Let context be the topmost script-having execution context.
    auto* context = top_most_script_having_execution_context(vm);

    // 2. If context is null, or if context's skip-when-determining-incumbent counter is greater than zero, then:
    if (!context || event_loop.skip_when_determining_incumbent_counter(*context) > 0) {
        // 1. Assert: the backup incumbent settings object stack is not empty.
        // 1. Assert: the backup incumbent realm stack is not empty.
        // NOTE: If this assertion fails, it's because the incumbent realm was used with no involvement of JavaScript.
        VERIFY(!event_loop.is_backup_incumbent_realm_stack_empty());

        // 2. Return the topmost entry of the backup incumbent realm stack.
        return event_loop.top_of_backup_incumbent_realm_stack();
    }

    // 3. Return context's Realm component's settings object.
    return principal_realm_settings_object(*context->realm());
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-incumbent-global
JS::Object& incumbent_global_object()
{
    // Similarly, the incumbent global object is the global object of the incumbent settings object.
    return incumbent_settings_object().global_object();
}

Window& incumbent_window()
{
    auto* window = window_from_global_object(incumbent_global_object());
    VERIFY(window);
    return *window;
}

// https://whatpr.org/html/9893/webappapis.html#concept-realm-settings-object
EnvironmentSettingsObject& principal_realm_settings_object(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    // A principal realm has a [[HostDefined]] field, which contains the principal realm's settings object.
    auto& host_defined = Bindings::host_defined_of(realm);
    if (host_defined.is_principal_host_defined())
        return Bindings::principal_host_defined_environment_settings_object(realm);

    return Bindings::principal_host_defined_environment_settings_object(*host_defined.principal_realm);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#current-settings-object

{
    // Then, the current settings object is the environment settings object of the current realm.
    return principal_realm_settings_object(*JS::VM::the().current_realm());
}

        return window->principal_realm();

    VERIFY(worker_global_scope);
