Utf16String Internals::take_style_trace()
{
    // A script reads the render state, which waits for a frame in flight.
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { window().associated_document() };
    auto& document = window().associated_document();
    auto& style_computer = document.style_computer();
    auto host = style_computer.style_engine().host();
    auto* root = document.document_element();
    auto root_id = root ? root->style_node_id() : CSS::StyleNodeID {};
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    HashMap<Utf16String, u32> occurrences_in_pass;
    auto size = CSS::StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_style_trace_size(host, read, root_id);
    for (u32 index = 0; index < size; ++index) {
        auto entry = CSS::StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_style_trace_entry(host, read, root_id, index);
        auto kind = (entry >> 32) & 0xff;
        if (kind == 7) {
            static constexpr Array event_names {
                "rule index built"sv,
                "rule index updated"sv,
                "user agent rule index built"sv,
                "selectors compiled"sv,
                "style rules compiled"sv,
                "sheet declarations interned"sv,
                "sheet declarations shared"sv,
            };
            auto event = (entry >> 40) & 0xff;
            auto times = entry & 0xffffffff;
            builder.appendff("  {}", event_names[event - 1]);
            if (times > 1)
                builder.appendff(" x{}", times);
            builder.append_ascii('\n');
            continue;
        }
        if (kind != 4) {
            occurrences_in_pass.clear();
            static constexpr Array pass_names { "FULL"sv, "PARTIAL"sv, "COLD"sv, ""sv, "ANIMATION"sv, "PROGRAM"sv };
            builder.appendff("style {}\n", pass_names[kind - 1]);
            continue;
        }
        auto element = style_computer.element_for_style_node(CSS::StyleNodeID { static_cast<u32>(entry) });
        if (!element)
            continue;
        auto description = element->debug_description();
        auto occurrence = ++occurrences_in_pass.ensure(description, [] { return 0u; });
        builder.appendff("  {}", description);
        if (occurrence > 1)
            builder.appendff("@{}", occurrence);
        Vector<StringView, 2> notes;
        switch ((entry >> 40) & 0xff) {
        case 1:
            notes.append("computed"sv);
            break;
        case 2:
            notes.append("shared"sv);
            break;
        case 3:
            notes.append("reused"sv);
            break;
        case 4:
            notes.append("declined"sv);
            break;
        case 5:
            notes.append("kept"sv);
            break;
        case 6:
            notes.append("sampled"sv);
            break;
        case 7:
            notes.append("sampled every group"sv);
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }
        if (entry & (1ull << 48))
            notes.append("changed"sv);
        if (!notes.is_empty())
            builder.appendff(" ({})", MUST(String::join(", "sv, notes)));
        builder.append_ascii('\n');
    }
    (void)CSS::StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_end_style_trace(host, read);
    return builder.to_string();
}

// Names every rule identity StyleEngine was given, so a disagreement can be reported as the selector
// that caused it rather than as a number.
static void collect_style_engine_rule_names(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSS::StyleComputer const& style_computer, CSS::CSSRule const& rule, HashMap<CSS::StyleEngineRuleID, Utf16String>& names, HashMap<CSS::StyleEngineRuleID, Utf16String>& places, Utf16String const& place)
{
    if (auto rule_id = style_computer.style_engine_rule_id_for(read, rule.native_rule()); rule_id != 0) {
        places.set(rule_id, place);
        if (auto const* style_rule = as_if<CSS::CSSStyleRule>(rule)) {
            names.set(rule_id, style_rule->selector_text());
        } else if (auto const* nested = as_if<CSS::CSSNestedDeclarations>(rule)) {
            names.set(rule_id, Utf16String::formatted("{} (nested declarations)", nested->parent_style_rule().selector_text()));
        } else {
            names.set(rule_id, Utf16String::formatted("<rule {}>", rule_id.value()));
        }
    }
    if (auto const* group = as_if<CSS::CSSGroupingRule>(rule)) {
        for (size_t index = 0; index < group->css_rules().length(); ++index)
            collect_style_engine_rule_names(read, style_computer, *group->css_rules().item(index), names, places, place);
    }
    // An imported sheet's rules are the importing sheet's rules as far as the cascade is concerned,
    // and they are not in any style sheet list of their own, so nothing else would reach them.
    if (auto const* import_rule = as_if<CSS::CSSImportRule>(rule)) {
        if (auto const* imported = import_rule->loaded_style_sheet()) {
            for (size_t index = 0; index < imported->css_rules()->length(); ++index)
                collect_style_engine_rule_names(read, style_computer, *imported->css_rules()->item(index), names, places, place);
        }
    }
}

// What the style engine matches, element by element, in the order the cascade applies it.
//
// This is a snapshot of the engine's own answer rather than a comparison against a second matcher:
// a shape whose matching changes shows up as a diff, and the expectation is readable enough to say
// whether the change was meant.
Utf16String Internals::style_engine_matched_rules()
{
    // A script reads the render state, which waits for a frame in flight.
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { window().associated_document() };
    auto& document = window().associated_document();
    document.update_style();

    auto& style_computer = document.style_computer();
    // The page's own rules are what a test is about, so the engine leaves user-agent rules out and
    // only the page's are named.
    HashMap<CSS::StyleEngineRuleID, Utf16String> rule_names;
    HashMap<CSS::StyleEngineRuleID, Utf16String> rule_places;
    auto name_sheet = [&](CSS::StyleSheetState& source_sheet, StringView place) {
        auto& sheet = source_sheet.shared_compiled_style_sheet() ? source_sheet.shared_compiled_style_sheet()->contents() : source_sheet;
        for (size_t index = 0; index < sheet.css_rules()->length(); ++index)
            collect_style_engine_rule_names(read, style_computer, *sheet.css_rules()->item(index), rule_names, rule_places, Utf16String::from_utf8(place));
    };
    document.style_scope().for_each_stylesheet(CSS::CascadeOrigin::User, [&](CSS::StyleSheetState& sheet) { name_sheet(sheet, "user"sv); });
    document.style_scope().for_each_stylesheet(CSS::CascadeOrigin::Author, [&](CSS::StyleSheetState& sheet) { name_sheet(sheet, "author"sv); });
    for (auto& sheet : document.style_scope().style_sheets())
        name_sheet(*sheet, "author"sv);
    document.for_each_shadow_root([&](DOM::ShadowRoot& shadow_root) {
        shadow_root.style_scope().for_each_stylesheet(CSS::CascadeOrigin::Author, [&](CSS::StyleSheetState& sheet) { name_sheet(sheet, "shadow"sv); });
        for (auto& sheet : shadow_root.style_scope().style_sheets())
            name_sheet(*sheet, "shadow"sv);
    });

    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<DOM::Element>> elements;
    Vector<u32> nodes;
    document.for_each_shadow_including_descendant([&](DOM::Node& node) {
        if (auto* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(node); element && element->style_node_id() != 0) {
            elements.append(*element);
            nodes.append(element->style_node_id().value());
        }
        return TraversalDecision::Continue;
    });

    auto host = style_computer.style_engine().host();
    Vector<CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiMatchedRule> matches;
    matches.resize(max(nodes.size() * 4, 16uz));
    auto count = CSS::StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_matched_rules(host, read, nodes.span(), matches.span(), false);
    if (count > matches.size()) {
        // Nothing was written, so grow and ask again.
        matches.resize(count);
        count = CSS::StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_matched_rules(host, read, nodes.span(), matches.span(), false);
        VERIFY(count <= matches.size());
    }
    matches.shrink(count);

    auto describe = [&](DOM::Element const& element) {
        Utf16StringBuilder description;
        description.append(element.local_name());
        if (auto id = element.id(); id.has_value())
            description.appendff("#{}", *id);
        for (auto const& class_name : element.class_names())
            description.appendff(".{}", class_name);
        return description.to_string();
    };

    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    size_t next_match = 0;
    for (u32 position = 0; position < elements.size(); ++position) {
        auto const& element = *elements[position];
        Utf16StringBuilder line;
        bool answered = true;
        for (; next_match < matches.size() && matches[next_match].node == position; ++next_match) {
            auto const& match = matches[next_match];
            if (match.rule == 0) {
                answered = false;
                continue;
            }
            auto name = rule_names.get(CSS::StyleEngineRuleID { match.rule }).value_or(Utf16String::formatted("<rule {}>", match.rule));
            line.appendff(" {}", name);
            if (match.pseudo_element != NumericLimits<u32>::max())
                line.appendff("[pseudo {}]", match.pseudo_element);
        }
        if (!answered) {
            builder.appendff("{}: the engine could not answer\n", describe(element));
            continue;
        }
        if (line.is_empty())
            continue;
        builder.append(describe(element));
        builder.append(":"sv);
        builder.append(line.to_string());
        builder.append("\n"sv);
    }
    return builder.to_string();
}

Utf16String Internals::dump_style_records(GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> root, Bindings::StyleRecordsDumpOptions const& options)
{
    auto& document = window().associated_document();
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document };
    if (options.layout)
        document.update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::Debugging);
    else
        document.update_style();
    HashMap<u64, size_t> record_numbers;
    HashMap<u64, size_t> environment_numbers;
    HashMap<void const*, size_t> payload_numbers;
    auto number = [](auto& numbers, auto key) { return numbers.ensure(key, [&] { return numbers.size() + 1; }); };
    StringBuilder builder;
    Function<void(DOM::Node const&, size_t)> dump = [&](DOM::Node const& node, size_t depth) {
        auto const* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(node);
        if (element) {
            builder.append_repeated("  "sv, depth);
            builder.appendff("{}", element->debug_description());
            auto record = element->style_record_identity().value();
            if (record == 0)
                builder.append(" no record"sv);
            else
                builder.appendff(" record {}", number(record_numbers, record));
            if (options.custom_property_environments && record != 0) {
                auto environment = element->installed_style().custom_property_environment();
                builder.appendff(" environment {}", environment ? number(environment_numbers, environment) : 0);
            }
            if (options.layout) {
                auto const* layout_node = element->layout_node(read);
                if (!layout_node)
                    builder.append(", no box"sv);
                else if (auto layout_record = layout_node->style_record_identity().value())
                    builder.appendff(", box record {}", number(record_numbers, layout_record));
                else
                    builder.append(", box holds no record"sv);
            }
            if (options.groups) {
                if (auto computed_values = element->computed_style()) {
                    auto parent = element->parent_element();
                    auto parent_values = parent ? parent->computed_style() : CSS::ComputedStyleRecordView {};
                    size_t group_index = 0;
                    computed_values->for_each_style_group_sharing_state(parent_values ? &*parent_values : nullptr, [&](StringView name, bool shared_with_parent, bool is_default) {
                        auto const* payload = computed_values->style_group_payload(static_cast<CSS::StyleGroupIndex>(group_index++));
                        if (shared_with_parent)
                            builder.appendff(" {}=parent", name);
                        else if (is_default)
                            builder.appendff(" {}=default", name);
                        else
                            builder.appendff(" {}={}", name, number(payload_numbers, payload));
                    });
                }
            }
            builder.append('\n');
            if (auto shadow_root = element->shadow_root())
                dump(*shadow_root, depth + 1);
        }
        for (auto const* child = node.first_child(); child; child = child->next_sibling())
            dump(*child, element ? depth + 1 : depth);
    };
    dump(root ? *root : static_cast<DOM::Node const&>(document), 0);
    return Utf16String::from_utf8_without_validation(builder.string_view());
}

void Internals::set_preferred_color_scheme(Utf16String const& color_scheme)
{
    auto preferred_color_scheme = CSS::preferred_color_scheme_from_string(color_scheme.utf16_view());

    Optional<CSS::PreferredColorScheme> preferred_color_scheme_override;
    if (preferred_color_scheme != CSS::PreferredColorScheme::Auto)
        preferred_color_scheme_override = preferred_color_scheme;
    page().set_preferred_color_scheme_override_for_testing(preferred_color_scheme_override);
    page().invalidate_style_for_preference_change();
}

}

Vector<String> Internals::image_request_urls(DOM::Document const& document) const
{
    Vector<String> urls;
    for (auto const& request : document.shared_resource_requests())
        urls.append(request.key.url.serialize());
    quick_sort(urls);
    return urls;
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<JS::Object>> Internals::image_animation_state_for_url(Utf16String const& url)
{
    auto& document = window().associated_document();
    auto parsed_url = document.encoding_parse_url(url);
    auto url_utf8 = TRY_OR_THROW_OOM(vm(), url.utf16_view().to_utf8());
    if (!parsed_url.has_value())
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { .type = WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, .message = Utf16String::formatted("Invalid URL: '{}'", url_utf8) };

    auto& shared_resource_requests = document.shared_resource_requests();
    auto it = find_if(shared_resource_requests.begin(), shared_resource_requests.end(), [&](auto const& entry) { return entry.key.url == *parsed_url; });
    if (it == shared_resource_requests.end())
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { .type = WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, .message = Utf16String::formatted("URL doesn't have any associated shared resource requests: '{}'", url_utf8) };

    auto image_data = it->value->image_data();

    if (!image_data)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { .type = WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, .message = Utf16String::formatted("URL's shared resource request doesn't have any associated image data: '{}'", url_utf8) };

    auto const* animated_bitmap_data = as_if<HTML::AnimatedBitmapDecodedImageData>(*image_data);

    if (!animated_bitmap_data)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { .type = WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, .message = Utf16String::formatted("URL's associated image is not an animated bitmap: '{}'", url_utf8) };

    auto object = JS::Object::create(window().principal_realm(), nullptr);

    auto state = animated_bitmap_data->state_for_testing();
    object->define_direct_property("isAnimating"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(state.is_animating), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("sessionID"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(static_cast<double>(animated_bitmap_data->m_session_id)), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("frameIndex"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(state.frame_index), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("shownFrameIndex"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(state.shown_frame_index), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("frameCount"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(animated_bitmap_data->m_frame_count), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("loopsCompleted"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(state.loops_completed), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("loopCount"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(animated_bitmap_data->m_loop_count), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("clientCount"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(image_data->m_clients.size()), JS::default_attributes);

    return object;
}

String Internals::viewport_overflow_x()
{
    auto& document = window().associated_document();
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document };
    document.update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::Debugging);
    auto overflow = document.layout_node(read)->overflow_x();
    switch (overflow) {
    case CSS::Overflow::Auto:
        return "auto"_string;
    case CSS::Overflow::Clip:
        return "clip"_string;
    case CSS::Overflow::Hidden:
        return "hidden"_string;
    case CSS::Overflow::Scroll:
        return "scroll"_string;
    case CSS::Overflow::Visible:
        return "visible"_string;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

namespace {

// The bytes of a stream from create_stream_pulling_from_bytes() that it has not pulled yet.
struct UnpulledBytes final : public RefCounted<UnpulledBytes> {
    GC_HOLDS_NO_CELL_EDGES;

    explicit UnpulledBytes(ByteBuffer bytes)
        : bytes(move(bytes))
    {
    }

    ByteBuffer bytes;
};

}

GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> Internals::create_stream_pulling_from_bytes(String const& bytes, WebIDL::UnsignedLong pull_size)
{
    auto& realm = window().principal_realm();
    auto stream = Streams::ReadableStream::create(realm);
    auto unpulled = make_ref_counted<UnpulledBytes>(MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(bytes.bytes())));

    auto pull_algorithm = GC::create_function(realm.heap(), GC::captures(GC::Ref { realm }, stream, unpulled, pull_size), [](auto& realm, auto& stream, auto& unpulled, auto& pull_size) {
        auto& remaining = unpulled->bytes;
        auto size = min(remaining.size(), static_cast<size_t>(pull_size));
        if (auto view_byte_length = stream->current_byob_request_view_byte_length(); view_byte_length.has_value())
            size = min(size, static_cast<size_t>(*view_byte_length));

        if (size > 0) {
            MUST(stream->pull_from_bytes(remaining.bytes().trim(size)));
            remaining = MUST(remaining.slice(size, remaining.size() - size));
        }
        if (remaining.is_empty())
            stream->close();
        return WebIDL::create_resolved_promise(*realm, JS::js_undefined());
    });

    stream->set_up_with_byte_reading_support(realm, pull_algorithm);
    return stream;
}

static GC::Ref<JS::Object> create_hit_testing_result(JS::Realm& realm, Painting::HitTestResult& result)
{
    auto hit_testing_result = JS::Object::create(realm, nullptr);
    hit_testing_result->define_direct_property("node"_utf16_fly_string, Bindings::wrap(Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, GC::Ref { *result.dom_node() }), JS::default_attributes);
    hit_testing_result->define_direct_property("indexInNode"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(result.index_in_node), JS::default_attributes);
    return hit_testing_result;
}

static Utf16String context_menu_kind_to_string(Page::ContextMenuRequest::Kind kind)
{
    switch (kind) {
    case Page::ContextMenuRequest::Kind::Page:
        return "page"_utf16;
    case Page::ContextMenuRequest::Kind::Image:
        return "image"_utf16;
    case Page::ContextMenuRequest::Kind::Link:
        return "link"_utf16;
    case Page::ContextMenuRequest::Kind::Media:
        return "media"_utf16;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

GC::Ptr<JS::Object> Internals::take_context_menu_request()
{
    auto request = page().take_context_menu_request();
    if (!request.has_value())
        return nullptr;

    auto& realm = HTML::relevant_realm(window());
    auto object = JS::Object::create(realm, nullptr);
    object->define_direct_property("kind"_utf16_fly_string, JS::PrimitiveString::create(vm(), context_menu_kind_to_string(request->kind)), JS::default_attributes);
    auto target = Bindings::wrap(Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, request->target);
    object->define_direct_property("target"_utf16_fly_string, target, JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("x"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(request->position.x().to_double()), JS::default_attributes);
    object->define_direct_property("y"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(request->position.y().to_double()), JS::default_attributes);
    if (request->link_url.has_value())
        object->define_direct_property("linkURL"_utf16_fly_string, JS::PrimitiveString::create(vm(), utf16_string_from_url_ascii(request->link_url->serialize())), JS::default_attributes);
    if (request->image_mime_type.has_value())
        object->define_direct_property("imageMimeType"_utf16_fly_string, JS::PrimitiveString::create(vm(), Utf16String::from_utf8(*request->image_mime_type)), JS::default_attributes);
    if (request->media.has_value()) {
        object->define_direct_property("isPictureInPicture"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(request->media->is_picture_in_picture), JS::default_attributes);
        object->define_direct_property("canEnterPictureInPicture"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(request->media->can_enter_picture_in_picture), JS::default_attributes);
    }
    return object;
}

// The text node a spellchecking test names: the node itself, or the inner text node of a text control.
static GC::Ptr<DOM::Text> spelling_test_text_node(DOM::Node& node)
{
    if (auto* text = as_if<DOM::Text>(node))
        return text;
    if (auto* text_control = as_if<HTML::FormAssociatedTextControlElement>(node))
        return text_control->form_associated_element_to_text_node();
    return nullptr;
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> Internals::add_spelling_error_for_testing(GC::Ref<DOM::Node> node, WebIDL::UnsignedLong start, WebIDL::UnsignedLong end)
{
    auto text = spelling_test_text_node(node);
    if (!text || start >= end || end > text->length_in_utf16_code_units())
        return WebIDL::IndexSizeError::create("No text to flag in that range"_utf16);
    text->document().spelling_markers().add(*text, start, end);
    return {};
}

Utf16String Internals::spelling_error_ranges(GC::Ref<DOM::Node> node)
{
    auto text = spelling_test_text_node(node);
    if (!text)
        return {};
    StringBuilder builder;
    for (auto const& marker : text->document().spelling_markers().markers_for(*text)) {
        if (!builder.is_empty())
            builder.append(' ');
        builder.appendff("{}-{}", marker.start, marker.end);
    }
    return Utf16String::from_utf8(builder.string_view());
}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> Internals::check_spelling_for_testing(Utf16String const& text)
{
    auto& realm = window().principal_realm();
    auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise_for(window());
    auto& page = this->page();
    if (!page.spell_checking_available()) {
        WebIDL::reject_promise(realm, promise, JS::PrimitiveString::create(vm(), "Spellchecking is unavailable"_utf16));
        return promise;
    }
    page.request_spell_check(text, GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(realm, promise), [](auto& realm, auto& promise, Vector<SpellingError> errors) {
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };
        StringBuilder builder;
        for (auto const& error : errors) {
            if (!builder.is_empty())
                builder.append(' ');
            builder.appendff("{}-{}", error.offset, error.offset + error.length);
        }
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(realm, promise, JS::PrimitiveString::create(realm.vm(), Utf16String::from_utf8(builder.string_view())));
    }));
    return promise;
}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> Internals::spell_check_settled()
{
    auto& realm = window().principal_realm();
    auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise_for(window());
    page().when_spell_checking_settled(GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(realm, promise), [](auto& realm, auto& promise) {
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(promise);
    }));
    return promise;
}

}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> Internals::request_writing_suggestion_for_testing(Utf16String const& text, WebIDL::UnsignedLong caret_offset)
{
    auto& realm = window().principal_realm();
    auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise_for(window());
    auto& page = this->page();
    if (!page.writing_suggestions_available()) {
        WebIDL::reject_promise(realm, promise, JS::PrimitiveString::create(vm(), "Writing suggestions are unavailable"_utf16));
        return promise;
    }
    page.request_writing_suggestion(text, caret_offset, GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(realm, promise), [](auto& realm, auto& promise, Optional<WritingSuggestion> suggestion) {
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };
        auto result = suggestion.has_value()
            ? Utf16String::formatted("{}-{}:{}", suggestion->replacement_start, suggestion->replacement_length, suggestion->text)
            : "(none)"_utf16;
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(realm, promise, JS::PrimitiveString::create(realm.vm(), move(result)));
    }));
    return promise;
}

// The writing suggestion showing in any document of the page.
Utf16String Internals::writing_suggestion()
{
    for (auto const& navigable : page().hosted_navigables()) {
        auto* local_navigable = as_if<HTML::LocalNavigable>(*navigable);
        if (!local_navigable || !local_navigable->active_document())
            continue;
        auto document = local_navigable->active_document();
        if (auto* controller = document->writing_suggestion_controller_if_exists(); controller && controller->showing().has_value())
            return controller->showing()->remainder;
    }
    return "(none)"_utf16;
}

{
    auto& realm = window().principal_realm();
    auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise_for(window());
    page().when_writing_suggestions_settled(GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(realm, promise), [](auto& realm, auto& promise) {
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(promise);
    }));
    return promise;
}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> Internals::activate_spelling_menu_item(Bindings::SpellingMenuItem item, WebIDL::UnsignedLong guess_index)
{
    auto& realm = window().principal_realm();
    auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise_for(window());
    auto action = [&] {
        switch (item) {
        case Bindings::SpellingMenuItem::None:
            return SpellingMenuActionForTesting::None;
        case Bindings::SpellingMenuItem::Guess:
            return SpellingMenuActionForTesting::Guess;
        case Bindings::SpellingMenuItem::Ignore:
            return SpellingMenuActionForTesting::IgnoreSpelling;
        case Bindings::SpellingMenuItem::Learn:
            return SpellingMenuActionForTesting::LearnSpelling;
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }();
    page().request_spelling_menu_action_for_testing(action, guess_index, GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(realm, promise), [](auto& realm, auto& promise, String menu) {
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(realm, promise, JS::PrimitiveString::create(realm.vm(), Utf16String::from_utf8(menu)));
    }));
    return promise;
}

GC::Ref<JS::Object> Internals::recorded_async_scrolling_state_object()
{
    auto& document = window().associated_document();
    String json;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_recorded_async_scrolling_state_json(document.layout_node_arena().host(), &json, [](void* receiver, u8 const* bytes, size_t byte_count) {
        *static_cast<String*>(receiver) = MUST(String::from_utf8(StringView { bytes, byte_count }));
    });
    auto report = MUST(JsonValue::from_string(json));
    return scrolling_state_report_to_object(window(), report.as_object());
}

    // Whether the UI process shows this window's tab as playing audio: while the AudioServer has recently heard the tab,
    // and for a while after.
    boolean tabIsPlayingAudio();
    // Whether the AudioServer has recently heard this window's tab, whatever the tab shows.
    boolean tabIsHeardPlayingAudio();
    // Whether the UI process shows this window's tab as using the microphone: while the AudioServer holds a capture stream
    // for the tab, and for a while after.
    boolean tabIsUsingMicrophone();
    // Whether the AudioServer holds a capture stream for this window's tab, whatever the tab shows.
    boolean tabIsCapturingAudio();
    // Has the UI process hear of a capture stream of this process whose label names none of its pages.
    undefined reportAudioCaptureOfUnknownPage(boolean capturing);
    // The ID of the page that shows this page's Picture-in-Picture window.
    unsigned long long pictureInPictureWindowPageId();
    // Has the UI process hear of a capture stream of this process labelled for the page, as this process chose to.
    undefined reportAudioCaptureOfPage(unsigned long long pageId, boolean capturing);
    // Has the UI process retire this page's Picture-in-Picture window, as if this process went on to ignore that.
    undefined retirePictureInPictureWindow();
    // How many streams this process's tracks hold of the capture sources it has open.
    unsigned long long audioCaptureStreamCount();
    // Each change of whether the UI process shows this window's tab as playing audio, in order: "shown" or "hidden".
    sequence<DOMString> tabAudibilityTransitions();
    boolean mediaElementVideoSinkIsTicking(HTMLMediaElement element);
    undefined setMediaElementReadyState(HTMLMediaElement element, unsigned short readyState);
    undefined setMediaElementPaused(HTMLMediaElement element, boolean paused);
    undefined setMediaElementSeeking(HTMLMediaElement element, boolean seeking);
    // Closes this process's connection to its media server, which is what a media server crash looks like from here.
    undefined disconnectMediaServer();
    // Closes this process's connection to its AudioServer, which is what an AudioServer crash looks like from here.
    undefined disconnectAudioServer();

    DOMString viewportOverflowX();

    // A byte stream that pulls at most pullSize of the bytes at a time through
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-pull-from-bytes, and closes once it has pulled them all.
    ReadableStream createStreamPullingFromBytes(ByteString bytes, unsigned long pullSize);

};

namespace Web::IntersectionObserver {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(IntersectionObserver);

GC::Ref<WebIDL::CallbackType> create_lazy_load_intersection_observer_callback(DOM::Document& document)
{
    auto& realm = document.relevant_settings_object().realm();
    auto callback = JS::NativeFunction::create(realm, Utf16FlyString {}, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(document), [](DOM::Document& document, JS::VM& vm) -> JS::ThrowCompletionOr<JS::Value> {
        auto& entries = as<JS::Array>(vm.argument(0).as_object());
        auto entries_length = MUST(MUST(entries.get(vm.names.length)).to_length(vm));

        GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<IntersectionObserverEntry>> intersection_observer_entries;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < entries_length; ++i) {
            auto property_key = JS::PropertyKey { i };
            auto& entry_object = entries.get_without_side_effects(property_key).as_object();
            auto* entry = Bindings::impl_from<IntersectionObserverEntry>(&entry_object);
            VERIFY(entry);
            intersection_observer_entries.append(*entry);
        }

        document.process_lazy_load_intersection_observer_entries(intersection_observer_entries);
        return JS::js_undefined();
    }));

    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<WebIDL::CallbackType>(callback, realm);
}

void invoke_intersection_observer_callback(IntersectionObserver& observer, Vector<GC::Root<IntersectionObserverEntry>>& queue)
{
    auto& callback = observer.callback();
    auto& callback_realm = callback.callback_context->realm();

    auto wrapped_queue = MUST(JS::Array::create(callback_realm, 0));
    auto& wrapper_world = Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(callback_realm);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < queue.size(); ++i) {
        auto& record = queue.at(i);
        auto property_index = JS::PropertyKey { i };
        MUST(wrapped_queue->create_data_property(property_index, Bindings::wrap(wrapper_world, callback_realm, GC::Ref { *record })));
    }

    // NOTE: This does not follow the spec as written precisely, but this is the
    // same thing we do elsewhere and there is a WPT test that relies on this.
    auto wrapped_observer = Bindings::wrap(wrapper_world, callback_realm, GC::Ref { observer });
    (void)WebIDL::invoke_callback(callback, wrapped_observer, WebIDL::ExceptionBehavior::Report, { { wrapped_queue, wrapped_observer } });
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<IntersectionObserver>> IntersectionObserver::create_with_implicit_root_document(GC::Ptr<WebIDL::CallbackType> callback, IntersectionObserverOptions options, DOM::Document& implicit_root_document)
{
    // https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#initialize-a-new-intersectionobserver
    // 1. Let this be a new IntersectionObserver object
    // 2. Set this’s internal [[callback]] slot to callback.
    // NOTE: Steps 1 and 2 are handled by creating the IntersectionObserver at the very end of this function.

    // 3. Attempt to parse a margin from options.rootMargin. If a list is returned, set this’s internal [[rootMargin]] slot to that. Otherwise, throw a SyntaxError exception.
    auto root_margin = parse_a_margin(move(options.root_margin).to_utf8());
    if (!root_margin.has_value()) {
        return WebIDL::SyntaxError::create("IntersectionObserver: Cannot parse root margin as a margin."_utf16);
    }

    // 4. Attempt to parse a margin from options.scrollMargin. If a list is returned, set this’s internal [[scrollMargin]] slot to that. Otherwise, throw a SyntaxError exception.
    auto scroll_margin = parse_a_margin(move(options.scroll_margin).to_utf8());
    if (!scroll_margin.has_value()) {
        return WebIDL::SyntaxError::create("IntersectionObserver: Cannot parse scroll margin as a margin."_utf16);
    }

    // 5. Let thresholds be a list equal to options.threshold.
    Vector<double> thresholds;
    if (options.threshold.has<double>()) {
        thresholds.append(options.threshold.get<double>());
    } else {
        VERIFY(options.threshold.has<Vector<double>>());
        thresholds = move(options.threshold.get<Vector<double>>());
    }

    // 6. If any value in thresholds is less than 0.0 or greater than 1.0, throw a RangeError exception.
    for (auto value : thresholds) {
        if (value < 0.0 || value > 1.0)
            return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::RangeError, "Threshold values must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive"_utf16 };
    }

    // 7. Sort thresholds in ascending order.
    quick_sort(thresholds, [](double left, double right) {
        return left < right;
    });

    // 8. If thresholds is empty, append 0 to thresholds.
    if (thresholds.is_empty()) {
        thresholds.append(0);
    }

    // 9. The thresholds attribute getter will return this sorted thresholds list.
    // NOTE: Handled implicitly by passing it into the constructor at the end of this function

    // 10. Let delay be the value of options.delay.
    auto delay = options.delay;

    // 11. If options.trackVisibility is true and delay is less than 100, set delay to 100.
    if (options.track_visibility && delay < 100) {
        delay = 100;
    }

    // 12. Set this’s internal [[delay]] slot to options.delay to delay.
    // 13. Set this’s internal [[trackVisibility]] slot to options.trackVisibility.
    // 14. Return this.
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<IntersectionObserver>(callback, options.root, implicit_root_document, move(root_margin.value()), move(scroll_margin.value()), move(thresholds), move(delay), options.track_visibility);
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<IntersectionObserver>> IntersectionObserver::create_for_constructor(JS::Object& relevant_global_object, GC::Ptr<WebIDL::CallbackType> callback, IntersectionObserverOptions options)
{
    auto& window = HTML::relevant_window(relevant_global_object);
    // The implicit root is the top-level browsing context's document.
    // FIXME: Where another process hosts that document, the document rooting this process's part of the tree stands
    //        in, so intersections are not clipped by the viewports of the ancestors hosted there.
    // A window whose browsing context is gone (a removed iframe's) has no top-level browsing context either, so its own
    // document stands in. Nothing updates its observations.
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> implicit_root_document = window.associated_document();
    if (auto navigable = window.navigable())
        implicit_root_document = navigable->local_root()->active_document();
    VERIFY(implicit_root_document);
    return create_with_implicit_root_document(callback, options, *implicit_root_document);
}

IntersectionObserver::IntersectionObserver(GC::Ptr<WebIDL::CallbackType> callback, IntersectionObserverRoot const& root, GC::Ref<DOM::Document> implicit_root_document, Vector<CSS::LengthPercentage> root_margin, Vector<CSS::LengthPercentage> scroll_margin, Vector<double>&& thresholds, double delay, bool track_visibility)
    : m_callback(callback)
    , m_root_margin(root_margin)
    , m_scroll_margin(scroll_margin)
    , m_thresholds(move(thresholds))
    , m_delay(delay)
    , m_track_visibility(track_visibility)
{
    m_root = root.has<Empty>() ? nullptr : root.visit([](GC::Ref<DOM::Element> const& value) -> GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> { return value; }, [](GC::Ref<DOM::Document> const& value) -> GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> { return value; }, [](Empty) -> GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> { return nullptr; });

    if (m_root)
        m_document = m_root->document();
    else
        m_document = implicit_root_document;

    VERIFY(m_document);
    m_document->register_intersection_observer({}, *this);
}

IntersectionObserver::~IntersectionObserver() = default;

void IntersectionObserver::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_root);
    visitor.visit(m_callback);
    visitor.visit(m_queued_entries);
}

void IntersectionObserver::remove_dead_observation_targets()
{
    m_observation_targets.remove_all_matching([](auto const& observed_target) {
        return !observed_target.target;
    });
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#dom-intersectionobserver-observe
void IntersectionObserver::observe(DOM::Element& target)
{
    // Run the observe a target Element algorithm, providing this and target.
    // https://www.w3.org/TR/intersection-observer/#observe-a-target-element
    // 1. If target is in observer’s internal [[ObservationTargets]] slot, return.
    auto observed_target = m_observation_targets.find_if([&target](auto const& entry) {
        return entry.target == &target;
    });
    if (!observed_target.is_end())
        return;

    // 2. Let intersectionObserverRegistration be an IntersectionObserverRegistration record with an observer
    //    property set to observer, a previousThresholdIndex property set to -1, and a previousIsIntersecting
    //    property set to false.
    // NB: This implementation deviates from the spec's storage model. target's
    //     [[RegisteredIntersectionObservers]] only keeps a strong reference to the observer for lifetime
    //     management, while the mutable registration fields live in the observer-side observation target below.
    target.register_intersection_observer({}, *this);

    // 3. Append intersectionObserverRegistration to target’s internal [[RegisteredIntersectionObservers]] slot.
    // NB: Keeping previousThresholdIndex and previousIsIntersecting on the observer-side observation target lets
    //     the update loop read and write them without a second lookup through target’s registered observers.
    //
    // 4. Add target to observer’s internal [[ObservationTargets]] slot.
    m_observation_targets.append(ObservationTarget {
        .target = target,
        .previous_threshold_index = OptionalNone {},
        .previous_is_intersecting = false,
    });

    // AD-HOC: Registering an observation changes whether transforms can remain compositor driven. Bring any pending
    //         throttled animation state to a point where compositor eligibility can be updated by the requested frame.
    target.document().flush_throttled_animation_style_update_for_node(target);
    set_rendering_pending(*m_document, RenderingPendingReason::NeedsRenderingUpdate, 1);
    m_document->page().client().request_frame();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#dom-intersectionobserver-unobserve
void IntersectionObserver::unobserve(DOM::Element& target)
{
    // Run the unobserve a target Element algorithm, providing this and target.
    // https://www.w3.org/TR/intersection-observer/#unobserve-a-target-element
    // 1. Remove the IntersectionObserverRegistration record whose observer property is equal to this from target’s internal [[RegisteredIntersectionObservers]] slot, if present.
    target.unregister_intersection_observer({}, *this);

    // 2. Remove target from this’s internal [[ObservationTargets]] slot, if present
    m_observation_targets.remove_first_matching([&target](ObservationTarget const& entry) {
        return entry.target == &target;
    });
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#dom-intersectionobserver-disconnect
void IntersectionObserver::disconnect()
{
    // For each target in this’s internal [[ObservationTargets]] slot:
    // 1. Remove the IntersectionObserverRegistration record whose observer property is equal to this from target’s internal
    //    [[RegisteredIntersectionObservers]] slot.
    // 2. Remove target from this’s internal [[ObservationTargets]] slot.
    for (auto& observed_target : m_observation_targets) {
        if (auto target = observed_target.target.ptr())
            target->unregister_intersection_observer({}, *this);
    }
    m_observation_targets.clear();
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/intersection-observer/#dom-intersectionobserver-takerecords
Vector<GC::Root<IntersectionObserverEntry>> IntersectionObserver::take_records()
{
    // 1. Let queue be a copy of this’s internal [[QueuedEntries]] slot.
    Vector<GC::Root<IntersectionObserverEntry>> queue;
    for (auto& entry : m_queued_entries)
        queue.append(*entry);

    // 2. Clear this’s internal [[QueuedEntries]] slot.
    m_queued_entries.clear();

    // 3. Return queue.
    return queue;
}

NullableIntersectionObserverRoot IntersectionObserver::root() const
{
    if (!m_root)
        return Empty {};
    if (m_root->is_element())
        return GC::Ref { static_cast<DOM::Element&>(*m_root) };
    if (m_root->is_document())
        return GC::Ref { static_cast<DOM::Document&>(*m_root) };
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static void append_margin_value(Utf16StringBuilder& builder, CSS::LengthPercentage const& value)
{
    auto serialized = value.to_string(CSS::SerializationMode::ResolvedValue);
    builder.append_ascii(serialized.bytes_as_string_view());
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#dom-intersectionobserver-rootmargin
Utf16String IntersectionObserver::root_margin() const
{
    // On getting, return the result of serializing the elements of [[rootMargin]] space-separated, where pixel
    // lengths serialize as the numeric value followed by "px", and percentages serialize as the numeric value
    // followed by "%". Note that this is not guaranteed to be identical to the options.rootMargin passed to the
    // IntersectionObserver constructor. If no rootMargin was passed to the IntersectionObserver
    // constructor, the value of this attribute is "0px 0px 0px 0px".
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    append_margin_value(builder, m_root_margin[0]);
    builder.append_ascii(' ');
    append_margin_value(builder, m_root_margin[1]);
    builder.append_ascii(' ');
    append_margin_value(builder, m_root_margin[2]);
    builder.append_ascii(' ');
    append_margin_value(builder, m_root_margin[3]);
    return builder.to_string();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#dom-intersectionobserver-scrollmargin
Utf16String IntersectionObserver::scroll_margin() const
{
    // On getting, return the result of serializing the elements of [[scrollMargin]] space-separated, where pixel
    // lengths serialize as the numeric value followed by "px", and percentages serialize as the numeric value
    // followed by "%". Note that this is not guaranteed to be identical to the options.scrollMargin passed to the
    // IntersectionObserver constructor. If no scrollMargin was passed to the IntersectionObserver
    // constructor, the value of this attribute is "0px 0px 0px 0px".
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    append_margin_value(builder, m_scroll_margin[0]);
    builder.append_ascii(' ');
    append_margin_value(builder, m_scroll_margin[1]);
    builder.append_ascii(' ');
    append_margin_value(builder, m_scroll_margin[2]);
    builder.append_ascii(' ');
    append_margin_value(builder, m_scroll_margin[3]);
    return builder.to_string();
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/intersection-observer/#intersectionobserver-intersection-root
Variant<GC::Ref<DOM::Element>, GC::Ref<DOM::Document>> IntersectionObserver::intersection_root() const
{
    auto root_node = intersection_root_node();
    if (root_node->is_element())
        return GC::Ref { static_cast<DOM::Element&>(*root_node) };
    return GC::Ref { static_cast<DOM::Document&>(*root_node) };
}

GC::Ref<DOM::Node> IntersectionObserver::intersection_root_node() const
{
    if (m_root)
        return *m_root;

    // The implicit root is the top-level browsing context’s document node.
    // FIXME: See create_for_constructor(): the document rooting this process's part of the tree stands in.
    // A document that has lost its navigable stands in for itself, as in create_for_constructor().
    VERIFY(m_document);
    auto navigable = m_document->navigable();
    if (!navigable)
        return *m_document;
    return *navigable->local_root()->active_document();
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/intersection-observer/#intersectionobserver-root-intersection-rectangle
CSSPixelRect IntersectionObserver::root_intersection_rectangle(Layout::BegunRead const& read, Optional<MonotonicTime> visual_animation_sample_time) const
{
    // If the IntersectionObserver is an implicit root observer,
    //    it’s treated as if the root were the top-level browsing context’s document, according to the following rule for document.
    auto intersection_root = this->intersection_root();

    CSSPixelRect rect;
    bool intersection_root_is_scrollable = false;

    // If the intersection root is a document,
    //    it’s the size of the document's viewport (note that this processing step can only be reached if the document is fully active).
    if (intersection_root.has<GC::Ref<DOM::Document>>()) {
        auto document = intersection_root.get<GC::Ref<DOM::Document>>();

        // Since the spec says that this is only reach if the document is fully active, that means it must have a navigable.
        VERIFY(document->navigable());

        // NOTE: This rect is in the same layout viewport coordinate space as
        //       Element::getBoundingClientRect().
        rect = CSSPixelRect {
            CSSPixelPoint { 0, 0 },
            document->viewport_rect().size(),
        };

        // A local root another process embeds is the top-level viewport only where its embedder shows it, and a
        // margin cannot bring back what it shows none of.
        if (auto intersection = document->navigable()->viewport_intersection(); intersection.has_value()) {
            if (intersection->is_empty())
                return {};
            rect = *intersection;
        }
        intersection_root_is_scrollable = true;
    } else {
        VERIFY(intersection_root.has<GC::Ref<DOM::Element>>());
        auto element = intersection_root.get<GC::Ref<DOM::Element>>();

        // FIXME: Otherwise, if the intersection root has a content clip,
        //          it’s the element’s content area.

        // Otherwise,
        //    it’s the result of getting the bounding box for the intersection root.
        rect = visual_animation_sample_time.has_value()
            ? element->bounding_client_rect_assuming_layout_clean(read, *visual_animation_sample_time)
            : element->bounding_client_rect_assuming_layout_clean();
        if (auto const* layout_node = element->layout_node(read); layout_node && Painting::has_committed_box(*layout_node))
            intersection_root_is_scrollable = layout_node->is_scroll_container();
    }

    // When calculating the root intersection rectangle for a same-origin-domain target, the rectangle is then
    // expanded according to the offsets in the IntersectionObserver’s [[rootMargin]] slot in a manner similar
    // to CSS’s margin property, with the four values indicating the amount the top, right, bottom, and left
    // edges, respectively, are offset by, with positive lengths indicating an outward offset. Percentages
    // are resolved relative to the width of the undilated rectangle.
    DOM::Document* document = { nullptr };
    if (intersection_root.has<GC::Ref<DOM::Document>>()) {
        document = intersection_root.get<GC::Ref<DOM::Document>>().ptr();
    } else {
        document = &intersection_root.get<GC::Ref<DOM::Element>>()->document();
    }
    if (m_document && document->origin().is_same_origin(m_document->origin())) {
        auto const undilated_width = rect.width();
        CSSPixels top = m_root_margin[0].to_px(rect.height());
        CSSPixels right = m_root_margin[1].to_px(undilated_width);
        CSSPixels bottom = m_root_margin[2].to_px(rect.height());
        CSSPixels left = m_root_margin[3].to_px(undilated_width);

        // https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#scrollmargin
        // NOTE: scrollMargin affects the clipping of target by all scrollable ancestors up to and including the
        //       intersection root. Both the scrollMargin and the rootMargin are applied to a scrollable intersection
        //       root's rectangle.
        if (intersection_root_is_scrollable) {
            top += m_scroll_margin[0].to_px(undilated_width);
            right += m_scroll_margin[1].to_px(undilated_width);
            bottom += m_scroll_margin[2].to_px(undilated_width);
            left += m_scroll_margin[3].to_px(undilated_width);
        }

        rect.inflate(top, right, bottom, left);
    }

    return rect;
}

void IntersectionObserver::queue_entry(Badge<DOM::Document>, GC::Ref<IntersectionObserverEntry> entry)
{
    m_queued_entries.append(entry);
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IntersectionObserver/#parse-a-margin
Optional<Vector<CSS::LengthPercentage>> IntersectionObserver::parse_a_margin(String margin_string)
{
    // 1. Parse a list of component values marginString, storing the result as tokens.
    // 2. Remove all whitespace tokens from tokens.
    // 3. If the length of tokens is greater than 4, return failure.
    // 4. If there are zero elements in tokens, set tokens to ["0px"].
    struct MarginParsingContext {
        Vector<CSS::LengthPercentage>* values;
        bool* valid;
    };

    // 5. Replace each token in tokens:
    // NOTE: In the spec, tokens miraculously changes type from a list of component values
    //       to a list of pixel lengths or percentages.
    Vector<CSS::LengthPercentage> tokens_length_percentage;
    bool valid = true;
    auto source = Utf16String::from_utf8(margin_string);
    auto source_view = source.utf16_view();
    CSS::Parser::ValueParserFFI::FfiUtf16View ffi_source {
        .latin1 = source_view.has_latin1_storage() ? source_view.latin1_span().data() : nullptr,
        .utf16 = source_view.has_latin1_storage() ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<u16 const*>(source_view.utf16_span().data()),
        .length = source_view.length_in_code_units(),
    };
    auto visit = [](void* context, u8 type, double value, u16 const* unit, size_t unit_length) {
        auto& state = *static_cast<MarginParsingContext*>(context);
        if (type == 1) {
            // If token is a <percentage> token, replace it with an equivalent percentage.
            state.values->append(CSS::Percentage(value));
            return;
        }
        // If token is an absolute length dimension token, replace it with a an equivalent pixel length.
        auto unit_name = Utf16View { reinterpret_cast<char16_t const*>(unit), unit_length };
        if (auto length_unit = CSS::string_to_length_unit(unit_name); length_unit.has_value()) {
            if (auto length = CSS::Length(value, length_unit.release_value()); length.is_absolute()) {
                state.values->append(length);
                return;
            }
        }
        // Otherwise, return failure.
        *state.valid = false;
    };
    MarginParsingContext context { &tokens_length_percentage, &valid };
    if (!CSS::Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_visit_margin_components(ffi_source, &context, visit) || !valid)
        return {};
    if (tokens_length_percentage.is_empty())
        tokens_length_percentage.append(CSS::Length::make_px(0));

    // 6.
    switch (tokens_length_percentage.size()) {
    // If there is one element in tokens, append three duplicates of that element to tokens.
    case 1:
        tokens_length_percentage.append(tokens_length_percentage.first());
        tokens_length_percentage.append(tokens_length_percentage.first());
        tokens_length_percentage.append(tokens_length_percentage.first());
        break;
    // Otherwise, if there are two elements are tokens, append a duplicate of each element to tokens.
    case 2:
        tokens_length_percentage.append(tokens_length_percentage.at(0));
        tokens_length_percentage.append(tokens_length_percentage.at(1));
        break;
    // Otherwise, if there are three elements in tokens, append a duplicate of the second element to tokens.
    case 3:
        tokens_length_percentage.append(tokens_length_percentage.at(1));
        break;
    }

    // 7. Return tokens.
    return tokens_length_percentage;
}

}

// https://w3c.github.io/largest-contentful-paint/#effective-visual-size-result
struct EffectiveVisualSizeResult {
    double size { 0 };
    double width { 0 };
    double height { 0 };
};

static CSSPixelRect content_box_of(DOM::Element const& element, CSSPixelRect border_box)
{
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { element.document() };
    auto const* layout_node = element.layout_node(read);
    if (!layout_node || !Painting::has_committed_box(*layout_node))
        return border_box;
    auto box_model = Painting::box_model(*layout_node);
    auto left = box_model.border.left + box_model.padding.left;
    auto top = box_model.border.top + box_model.padding.top;
    auto right = box_model.border.right + box_model.padding.right;
    auto bottom = box_model.border.bottom + box_model.padding.bottom;
    return CSSPixelRect {
        border_box.x() + left,
        border_box.y() + top,
        max(CSSPixels(0), border_box.width() - left - right),
        max(CSSPixels(0), border_box.height() - top - bottom),
    };
}

// https://w3c.github.io/largest-contentful-paint/#effective-visual-size
static Optional<EffectiveVisualSizeResult> effective_visual_size(CSSPixelRect const& intersection_rect, Optional<PaintTiming::ImageRequestInfo> const& image_request, DOM::Element const& element, DOM::Document const& document, CSSPixelRect const& bounding_client_rect)
{
    // 1. Let width be intersectionRect's width, rounded up to the nearest integer.
    auto width = ceil(intersection_rect.width().to_double());

    // 2. Let height be intersectionRect's height, rounded up to the nearest integer.
    auto height = ceil(intersection_rect.height().to_double());

    // 3. Let size be width * height.
    auto size = width * height;

    // 4. Let root be document's browsing context's top-level browsing context's active document.
    // NB: The top-level browsing context may be in another process, so this uses the active document of the local
    //     root of document's navigable.
    auto navigable = document.navigable();
    if (!navigable)
        return {};
    auto root = navigable->local_root()->active_document();
    if (!root || !root->navigable())
        return {};

    // 5. Let rootWidth be root's visual viewport's width, excluding any scrollbars.
    // 6. Let rootHeight be root's visual viewport's height, excluding any scrollbars.
    auto root_size = root->navigable()->viewport_rect().size();
    auto root_width = root_size.width().to_double();
    auto root_height = root_size.height().to_double();

    // 7. If size is equal to rootWidth times rootHeight, return null.
    if (size == root_width * root_height)
        return {};

    // 8. If imageRequest is not null, run the following steps to adjust for image position and upscaling:
    if (image_request.has_value()) {
        // FIXME: 1. If imageRequest's response's content length in bytes is less than size * 0.004, then return null.

        // 2. Let concreteDimensions be imageRequest's concrete object size within element.
        // 3. Let visibleDimensions be concreteDimensions, adjusted for positioning by object-position or
        //    background-position and element's content box.
        // 4. Let clientContentRect be the smallest DOMRectReadOnly containing visibleDimensions with element's
        //    transforms applied.
        // FIXME: Find the concrete object size and position of the image within the element. This takes the whole
        //        content box of the element instead.
        auto client_content_rect = content_box_of(element, bounding_client_rect);

        // 5. Let intersectingClientContentRect be the intersection of clientContentRect with intersectionRect.
        auto intersecting_client_content_rect = client_content_rect.intersected(intersection_rect);

        // 6. Set width to intersectingClientContentRect's width, rounded up to the nearest integer.
        width = ceil(intersecting_client_content_rect.width().to_double());

        // 7. Set height to intersectingClientContentRect's height, rounded up to the nearest integer.
        height = ceil(intersecting_client_content_rect.height().to_double());

        // 8. Set size to width * height.
        size = width * height;

        // 9. Let naturalArea be imageRequest's natural width * imageRequest's natural height.
        double natural_area = 0;
        if (auto const& natural_size = image_request->natural_size; natural_size.has_value())
            natural_area = natural_size->width().to_double() * natural_size->height().to_double();

        // 10. If naturalArea is 0, then return null.
        if (natural_area == 0)
            return {};

        // 11. Let boundingClientArea be clientContentRect's width * clientContentRect's height.
        auto bounding_client_area = client_content_rect.width().to_double() * client_content_rect.height().to_double();

        // 12. Let scaleFactor be boundingClientArea / naturalArea.
        auto scale_factor = bounding_client_area / natural_area;

        // 13. If scaleFactor is greater than 1, then divide size by scaleFactor.
        if (scale_factor > 1)
            size /= scale_factor;
    }

    // 9. Return an effective visual size result with size set to size, width set to width, and height set to height.
    return EffectiveVisualSizeResult { .size = size, .width = width, .height = height };
}

// https://w3c.github.io/largest-contentful-paint/#compute-a-new-largest-contentful-paint-candidate
static Optional<PaintTiming::LargestContentfulPaintCandidate> compute_a_new_largest_contentful_paint_candidate(DOM::Document& document, Vector<PaintTiming::PendingImageRecord> const& painted_images, PaintTiming::PaintedTextNodes const& painted_text_nodes, Optional<PaintTiming::LargestContentfulPaintCandidate> const& current_candidate)
{
    // 1. Let currentSize be currentCandidate's size if currentCandidate is not null or 0 otherwise.
    auto current_size = current_candidate.has_value() ? current_candidate->size : 0;

    // 2. Let largestSize be currentSize.
    auto largest_size = current_size;

    // 3. Let newCandidate be null.
    Optional<PaintTiming::LargestContentfulPaintCandidate> new_candidate;

    auto navigable = document.navigable();
    if (!navigable)
        return {};
    CSSPixelRect viewport_rect { {}, navigable->viewport_rect().size() };

    // 4. For each record of paintedImages:
    for (auto const& record : painted_images) {
        // 1. Let imageElement be record's element.
        auto image_element = record.element;

        // 2. If imageElement is not exposed for paint timing, given document, continue.
        if (!PaintTiming::is_exposed_for_paint_timing(*image_element, document))
            continue;

        // 3. Let intersectionRect be the value returned by the intersection rect algorithm using imageElement as the
        //    target and viewport as the root.
        auto bounding_client_rect = image_element->bounding_client_rect_assuming_layout_clean();
        auto intersection_rect = bounding_client_rect.intersected(viewport_rect);

        // 4. Let result be the effective visual size of imageElement given intersectionRect and record's request.
        auto result = effective_visual_size(intersection_rect, record.request, *image_element, document, bounding_client_rect);

        // 5. If result is null, continue.
        if (!result.has_value())
            continue;

        // 6. If result's size is less than or equal to largestSize, continue.
        if (result->size <= largest_size)
            continue;

        // 7. Set largestSize to result's size.
        largest_size = result->size;

        // 8. Set newCandidate to be a new largest contentful paint candidate with the following values:
        new_candidate = PaintTiming::LargestContentfulPaintCandidate {
            // 1. element set to imageElement.
            .element = image_element,
            // 2. size set to result's size.
            .size = result->size,
            // 3. width set to result's width.
            .width = result->width,
            // 4. height set to result's height.
            .height = result->height,
            // 5. request set to record's request.
            .request = record.request,
            // 6. loadTime set to record's loadTime.
            .load_time = record.load_time,
        };
    }

    // 5. For each textNode of paintedTextNodes,
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document };
    auto viewport_mapping = Painting::viewport_mapping(document);
    for (auto const& [text_node, owned_text_nodes] : painted_text_nodes) {
        // 1. If textNode is not exposed for paint timing, given document, continue.
        if (!PaintTiming::is_exposed_for_paint_timing(*text_node, document))
            continue;

        // 2. If textNode has alpha channel value <=0 or opacity value <=0:
        auto const* layout_node = text_node->layout_node(read);
        if (!layout_node)
            continue;
        if (layout_node->color().alpha() == 0 || layout_node->opacity() <= 0) {
            // 1. If textNode's text-shadow value is none, textNode's stroke-color value is transparent and textNode's
            //    stroke-image value is none, continue.
            // FIXME: Check stroke-color and stroke-image once we support text strokes.
            if (layout_node->text_shadow().is_empty())
                continue;
        }

        // 3. Let intersectionRect be the union of the border boxes of all Text nodes in textNode's set of owned text
        //    nodes, intersected with the visual viewport.
        CSSPixelRect text_rect;
        for (auto const& text : owned_text_nodes) {
            auto const* text_layout_node = text->layout_node(read);
            if (!text_layout_node)
                continue;
            auto rect = PaintTiming::client_rect_of_box(*text_layout_node, viewport_mapping);
            if (rect.is_empty())
                continue;
            text_rect = text_rect.is_empty() ? rect : text_rect.united(rect);
        }
        auto intersection_rect = text_rect.intersected(viewport_rect);

        // 4. Let result be the effective visual size of textNode given intersectionRect and null.
        auto result = effective_visual_size(intersection_rect, {}, *text_node, document, {});

        // 5. If result is null, continue.
        if (!result.has_value())
            continue;

        // 6. If result's size is less than or equal to largestSize, continue.
        if (result->size <= largest_size)
            continue;

        // 7. Set largestSize to result's size.
        largest_size = result->size;

        // 8. Set newCandidate to be a new largest contentful paint candidate with the following values:
        new_candidate = PaintTiming::LargestContentfulPaintCandidate {
            // 1. element set to textNode.
            .element = text_node,
            // 2. size set to result's size.
            .size = result->size,
            // 3. width set to result's width.
            .width = result->width,
            // 4. height set to result's height.
            .height = result->height,
            // 5. request set to null.
            .request = {},
            // 6. loadTime set to 0.
            .load_time = 0,
        };
    }

    // 6. If newCandidate is not null and currentSize is greater than 0:
    if (new_candidate.has_value() && current_size > 0) {
        // 1. If newCandidate's width minus currentCandidate's width is less than or equal to 3, and newCandidate's
        //    height minus currentCandidate's height is less than or equal to 3, return null.
        if (new_candidate->width - current_candidate->width <= 3 && new_candidate->height - current_candidate->height <= 3)
            return {};
    }

    // 7. Return newCandidate.
    return new_candidate;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/largest-contentful-paint/#create-a-largestcontentfulpaint-entry
static GC::Ref<LargestContentfulPaint> create_a_largest_contentful_paint_entry(PaintTiming::LargestContentfulPaintCandidate const& candidate, PaintTiming::PaintTimingInfo const& paint_timing_info)
{
    // 1. Let url be the empty string.
    Utf16String url;

    // 2. If candidate's request is not null, set url to be candidate's request's request URL.
    if (candidate.request.has_value())
        url = candidate.request->url;

    // 3. Let entry be a new LargestContentfulPaint entry with document's relevant realm, whose paint timing info is
    //    paintTimingInfo, with its
    //    - size set to candidate's size,
    //    - url set to url,
    //    - id set to candidate's element's element id,
    //    - loadTime set to candidate's loadTime,
    //    - and element set to candidate's element.
    Utf16String id;
    if (auto const& element_id = candidate.element->id(); element_id.has_value())
        id = element_id->to_utf16_string();
    auto size = static_cast<WebIDL::UnsignedLong>(clamp(candidate.size, 0.0, static_cast<double>(NumericLimits<WebIDL::UnsignedLong>::max())));

    // 4. Return entry.
    return LargestContentfulPaint::create(paint_timing_info, size, move(url), move(id), candidate.load_time, *candidate.element.ptr());
}

// https://w3c.github.io/largest-contentful-paint/#report-largest-contentful-paint
void report_largest_contentful_paint(DOM::Document& document, PaintTiming::PaintTimingInfo const& paint_timing_info, Vector<PaintTiming::PendingImageRecord> const& painted_images, PaintTiming::PaintedTextNodes const& painted_text_nodes)
{
    // NOTE: Each pending image record in paintedImages and text element in paintedTextNodes will only be reported
    //       exactly once, from mark paint timing, for the first paint where the element is considered paintable (i.e.
    //       has opacity and visibility) and contentful (i.e. image resource or blocking fonts are sufficiently loaded).

    // 1. Let window be document’s relevant global object.
    auto& window = HTML::relevant_window(document);

    // 2. If either of window's has dispatched scroll event or has dispatched input event is true, return.
    if (window.has_dispatched_scroll_event() || EventTiming::has_dispatched_input_event(window))
        return;

    // 3. Let newCandidate be the result of computing a new largest contentful paint candidate given document,
    //    paintedImages, paintedTextNodes, and document's current largest contentful paint candidate.
    auto& state = document.paint_timing_state();
    auto new_candidate = compute_a_new_largest_contentful_paint_candidate(document, painted_images, painted_text_nodes, state.current_largest_contentful_paint_candidate);

    // 4. If newCandidate is null, return.
    if (!new_candidate.has_value())
        return;

    // 5. Set document's current largest contentful paint candidate to newCandidate.
    state.current_largest_contentful_paint_candidate = new_candidate;

    // 6. Let entry be the result of creating a LargestContentfulPaint entry with newCandidate, paintTimingInfo, and
    //    document.
    auto entry = create_a_largest_contentful_paint_entry(*new_candidate, paint_timing_info);

    // 7. Queue the PerformanceEntry entry.
    window.queue_performance_entry(entry);
    window.add_performance_entry(entry, HTML::WindowOrWorkerGlobalScopeMixin::CheckIfPerformanceBufferIsFull::Yes);
}

}

Box::Box(DOM::Document& document, BindToPreparedArenaSlot bind, Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId slot, RustFFI::NodeKind kind)
    : NodeWithStyle(document, bind, slot, kind)
{
}

Box::~Box()
{
}

static ImageProvider const* image_provider_for_element(DOM::Element const& element)
{
    if (auto const* image = as_if<HTML::HTMLImageElement>(element))
        return image;
    if (auto const* input = as_if<HTML::HTMLInputElement>(element))
        return input;
    if (auto const* embed = as_if<HTML::HTMLEmbedElement>(element))
        return embed;
    if (auto const* object = as_if<HTML::HTMLObjectElement>(element))
        return object;
    return nullptr;
}

ImageProvider* Box::owned_image_provider() const
{
    return static_cast<ImageProvider*>(RustFFI::document_host_owned_image_provider(document_host(), Node::slot_id(this)));
}

ImageProvider const* Box::image_provider_if_any() const
{
    VERIFY(kind() == RustFFI::NodeKind::ImageBox);
    if (auto const* owned = owned_image_provider())
        return owned;
    auto const* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(dom_node());
    return element ? image_provider_for_element(*element) : nullptr;
}

ImageProvider const& Box::image_provider() const
{
    auto const* image_provider = image_provider_if_any();
    VERIFY(image_provider);
    return *image_provider;
}

void Box::set_owned_image_provider(NonnullOwnPtr<ImageProvider> image_provider)
{
    VERIFY(kind() == RustFFI::NodeKind::ImageBox);
    RustFFI::document_host_set_owned_image_provider(document_host(), Node::slot_id(this), image_provider.leak_ptr());
}

#include <LibGfx/DecodedImageFrame.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/DecodedImageData.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/ImageProvider.h>

namespace Web::Layout {

Optional<CSSPixels> ImageProvider::intrinsic_width() const
{
    if (auto const& data = decoded_image_data())
        return data->intrinsic_width();
    return {};
}

Optional<CSSPixels> ImageProvider::intrinsic_height() const
{
    if (auto const& data = decoded_image_data())
        return data->intrinsic_height();
    return {};
}

Optional<CSSPixelFraction> ImageProvider::intrinsic_aspect_ratio() const
{
    if (auto const& data = decoded_image_data())
        return data->intrinsic_aspect_ratio();
    return {};
}

Optional<CSSPixelSize> ImageProvider::intrinsic_size() const
{
    auto width = intrinsic_width();
    auto height = intrinsic_height();
    if (!width.has_value() || !height.has_value())
        return {};

    return CSSPixelSize { *width, *height };
}

Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> ImageProvider::current_image_frame(Optional<Gfx::IntSize> size) const
{
    if (auto const& data = decoded_image_data())
        return data->current_frame(size.value_or(intrinsic_size().value_or({}).to_type<int>()));
    return {};
}

Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> ImageProvider::default_image_frame(Optional<Gfx::IntSize> size) const
{
    if (auto const& data = decoded_image_data())
        return data->default_frame(size.value_or(intrinsic_size().value_or({}).to_type<int>()));
    return {};
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <LibGC/Cell.h>
#include <LibGfx/DecodedImageFrame.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeParsing.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/PixelUnits.h>

namespace Web::Layout {

// FIXME: Update all ImageProviders to be DecodedImageData::Clients (i.e. support animated images)
class ImageProvider {
public:
    virtual ~ImageProvider() { }

    bool is_image_available() const { return decoded_image_data() != nullptr; }

    // Whether image data is expected to become available later, e.g. a fetch is still in progress
    // or a lazy load is deferred.
    virtual bool is_image_pending() const { return false; }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#images-3
    // The alt text fallback is only for images that are known not to render (they failed, or there
    // is nothing to load); while an image is still expected to arrive, the element renders as
    // blank space, matching other engines.
    bool renders_as_alt_text() const { return !is_image_available() && !is_image_pending(); }

    virtual GC::Ptr<HTML::DecodedImageData> decoded_image_data() const = 0;

    virtual Optional<CSSPixels> intrinsic_width() const;
    virtual Optional<CSSPixels> intrinsic_height() const;
    Optional<CSSPixelSize> intrinsic_size() const;
    virtual Optional<CSSPixelFraction> intrinsic_aspect_ratio() const;

    // How the image is fitted into the rectangle it's drawn in, which only an SVG image element lets authors change.
    virtual SVG::PreserveAspectRatio preserve_aspect_ratio() const { return {}; }

    Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> current_image_frame(Optional<Gfx::IntSize> size = {}) const;
    Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> default_image_frame(Optional<Gfx::IntSize> size = {}) const;

    virtual void layout_node_was_detached() const { }
};

}
