ActiveMediaSessionTracker::ActiveMediaSessionTracker(Page& page)
    : m_page(page)
    , m_weak_page(page)
{
}

static bool is_audible_and_controllable(HTML::HTMLMediaElement const& element)
{
    return element.is_playing_audio() && element.duration() >= 5
        && !element.src_object().has<GC::Ref<MediaCapture::MediaStream>>();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#active-media-session
void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::media_element_became_audible(HTML::HTMLMediaElement& element)
{
    auto& document = element.document();
    if (!document.is_fully_active() || document.has_been_destroyed() || !is_audible_and_controllable(element))
        return;

    auto controlled = m_controlled_elements.find_if([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.element_id == element.unique_id(); });
    if (!controlled.is_end()) {
        if (controlled->audible_and_controllable)
            return;
        controlled->activation_order = ++m_activation_counter;
        controlled->audible_and_controllable = true;
    } else {
        m_controlled_elements.append({ element.unique_id(), document.unique_id(), ++m_activation_counter, true });
    }

    auto session = document.window()->navigator()->media_session();
    // A session counts as paused until its media first plays, so a position the page set before that starts
    // advancing only once playback does.
    m_position_states.ensure(document.unique_id(), [&] {
        return PositionState { session->position_state(), session->position_state(), Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Paused };
    });
    mark_dirty();
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::media_element_removed(HTML::HTMLMediaElement& element)
{
    m_controlled_elements.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.element_id == element.unique_id(); });
    mark_dirty();
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::media_element_unregistered(UniqueNodeID element_id)
{
    if (!m_controlled_elements.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.element_id == element_id; }))
        return;

    // Unregistration runs during finalization, so defer GC object access and allocation until collection ends.
    GC::Heap::the().enqueue_post_gc_task([page = m_weak_page] {
        if (page)
            page->active_media_session_tracker().mark_dirty();
    });
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::document_became_inactive(DOM::Document& document)
{
    m_controlled_elements.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.document_id == document.unique_id(); });
    mark_dirty();
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::update_active_document()
{
    m_controlled_elements.remove_all_matching([](ControlledElement const& entry) {
        auto* element = as_if<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>(DOM::Node::from_unique_id(entry.element_id));
        return !element || element->document().unique_id() != entry.document_id
            || !element->document().is_fully_active() || element->document().has_been_destroyed()
            || element->src_object().has<GC::Ref<MediaCapture::MediaStream>>();
    });

    auto previous_document = m_active_document;
    m_active_document.clear();
    u64 latest_activation = 0;
    for (auto& entry : m_controlled_elements) {
        auto& element = as<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>(*DOM::Node::from_unique_id(entry.element_id));
        if (!is_audible_and_controllable(element))
            entry.audible_and_controllable = false;
        if (entry.activation_order > latest_activation) {
            latest_activation = entry.activation_order;
            m_active_document = entry.document_id;
        }
    }
    if (m_active_document != previous_document)
        m_paused_by_user_agent.clear();
    else
        m_paused_by_user_agent.remove_all_matching([&](auto id) {
            return !m_controlled_elements.contains([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.element_id == id; });
        });
    m_position_states.remove_all_matching([](auto id, auto const&) {
        auto* document = as_if<DOM::Document>(DOM::Node::from_unique_id(id));
        return !document || !document->is_fully_active() || document->has_been_destroyed();
    });
}

Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState ActiveMediaSessionTracker::actual_playback_state(DOM::Document& document)
{
    auto session = document.window()->navigator()->media_session();

    // https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#actual-playback-state
    // If the declared playback state is playing, return playing.
    // Otherwise, return the guessed playback state.
    auto playback_state = session->playback_state() == Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Playing
        ? Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Playing
        : Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Paused;

    // https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#guessed-playback-state
    // The browsing context's guessed playback state is "playing" if any of them is potentially playing and not muted,
    // and is "paused" otherwise.
    m_page->for_each_media_element([&](auto& element) {
        if (&element.document() == &document && element.potentially_playing() && !element.muted())
            playback_state = Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Playing;
    });
    return playback_state;
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::update_position_states()
{
    for (auto& entry : m_position_states) {
        auto& document = as<DOM::Document>(*DOM::Node::from_unique_id(entry.key));
        auto session = document.window()->navigator()->media_session();
        auto playback_state = actual_playback_state(document);
        auto& position = entry.value;
        if (position.explicit_position != session->position_state()) {
            position.explicit_position = session->position_state();
            position.reported_position = position.explicit_position;
        } else if (position.reported_position.has_value() && position.playback_state != playback_state) {
            auto& reported = *position.reported_position;
            auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
            if (position.playback_state == Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Playing) {
                auto elapsed = (now - reported.last_position_updated_time).to_seconds_f64();
                reported.position = clamp(reported.position + elapsed * reported.playback_rate, 0.0, reported.duration);
            }
            reported.last_position_updated_time = now;
        }
        position.playback_state = playback_state;
    }
}

GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> ActiveMediaSessionTracker::active_document()
{
    // A document stops being fully active without telling the tracker when its iframe leaves the tree.
    update_active_document();
    if (!m_active_document.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    auto* document = as_if<DOM::Document>(DOM::Node::from_unique_id(*m_active_document));
    if (!document || !document->is_fully_active() || document->has_been_destroyed())
        return nullptr;
    return document;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#handle-media-session-action
void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::handle_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction action, Optional<double> seek_offset, Optional<double> seek_time, Optional<bool> fast_seek)
{
    // 1. Let session be source's target.
    // 2. If session is null, set session to the active media session.
    // NB: Actions from the platform don't have an explicit target.
    auto document = active_document();

    // 3. If session is null, abort these steps.
    if (!document)
        return;
    auto session = document->window()->navigator()->media_session();

    // 4. Let actions be session's supported media session actions.
    auto const& actions = session->action_handlers();

    // 5. If actions does not contain the key action, abort these steps.
    auto entry = actions.find(action);
    if (entry == actions.end()) {
        // AD-HOC: The spec aborts without a handler. OS media keys and Now Playing controls must also work on pages
        //         that never call setActionHandler, so apply the default action to the controlled elements.
        run_default_action(action, seek_offset, seek_time, fast_seek);
        return;
    }

    // 6. Let handler be the MediaSessionActionHandler associated with the key action in actions.
    auto handler = entry->value;
    auto& realm = handler->associated_realm();
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };
    auto details = JS::Object::create(realm, realm.intrinsics().object_prototype());
    details->define_direct_property("action"_utf16_fly_string, JS::PrimitiveString::create(realm.vm(), Bindings::idl_enum_to_string(action)), JS::default_attributes);
    if (seek_offset.has_value())
        details->define_direct_property("seekOffset"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(*seek_offset), JS::default_attributes);
    if (seek_time.has_value())
        details->define_direct_property("seekTime"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(*seek_time), JS::default_attributes);
    if (fast_seek.has_value())
        details->define_direct_property("fastSeek"_utf16_fly_string, JS::Value(*fast_seek), JS::default_attributes);

    // 8. Run the activation notification steps in the browsing context associated with session.
    // AD-HOC: The spec grants activation after the callback. Grant it before the callback so the handler can use
    //         APIs that require user activation while responding to the user's media control.
    HTML::Window::run_activation_notification_steps(*document);

    // 7. Run handler with the details parameter set to: MediaSessionActionDetails.
    (void)WebIDL::invoke_callback(*handler, {}, WebIDL::ExceptionBehavior::Report, { { details } });
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::run_default_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction action, Optional<double> seek_offset, Optional<double> seek_time, Optional<bool> fast_seek)
{
    switch (action) {
    case Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Play:
    case Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Pause:
    case Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Stop:
    case Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekbackward:
    case Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekforward:
        break;
    case Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekto:
        if (!seek_time.has_value())
            return;
        break;
    default:
        return;
    }

    auto document = active_document();
    if (!document)
        return;
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { document->relevant_settings_object() };
    HTML::Window::run_activation_notification_steps(*document);

    Vector<UniqueNodeID> elements;
    Optional<UniqueNodeID> most_recent_element;
    u64 latest_activation = 0;
    for (auto const& entry : m_controlled_elements) {
        if (entry.document_id != document->unique_id())
            continue;
        auto* element = as_if<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>(DOM::Node::from_unique_id(entry.element_id));
        if (!element || &element->document() != document.ptr())
            continue;
        elements.append(entry.element_id);
        if (entry.activation_order > latest_activation) {
            latest_activation = entry.activation_order;
            most_recent_element = entry.element_id;
        }
    }

    if (action == Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Play) {
        auto paused_elements = move(m_paused_by_user_agent);
        m_paused_by_user_agent.clear();
        paused_elements.remove_all_matching([&](auto id) { return !elements.contains_slow(id); });
        if (paused_elements.is_empty() && most_recent_element.has_value())
            paused_elements.append(*most_recent_element);
        for (auto id : paused_elements) {
            auto* element = as_if<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>(DOM::Node::from_unique_id(id));
            if (!element)
                continue;
            auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise_for(*element);
            WebIDL::mark_promise_as_handled(promise);
            element->play(promise);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (action == Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Pause || action == Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Stop) {
        Vector<UniqueNodeID> paused_elements;
        for (auto id : elements) {
            auto* element = as_if<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>(DOM::Node::from_unique_id(id));
            if (!element || element->paused())
                continue;
            paused_elements.append(id);
            element->pause();
        }
        if (action == Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Stop) {
            m_paused_by_user_agent.clear();
            m_controlled_elements.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) {
                return entry.document_id == document->unique_id();
            });
            mark_dirty();
        } else if (!paused_elements.is_empty()) {
            m_paused_by_user_agent = move(paused_elements);
        }
        return;
    }

    for (auto id : elements) {
        auto* element = as_if<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>(DOM::Node::from_unique_id(id));
        if (!element || !isfinite(element->duration()))
            continue;
        double position;
        if (action == Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekto) {
            position = min(*seek_time, element->duration());
        } else {
            auto offset = seek_offset.value_or(15.0);
            if (action == Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekbackward)
                offset = -offset;
            position = clamp(element->current_time() + offset, 0.0, element->duration());
        }
        if (action == Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekto && fast_seek.value_or(false))
            element->fast_seek(position);
        else
            element->set_current_time(position);
    }
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    visitor.visit(m_page);
    visitor.visit(m_artwork_metadata);
    visitor.visit(m_artwork_fetch_controller);
    visitor.visit(m_artwork_waiters);
}

static Vector<URL::URL> ranked_artwork_urls(Vector<Bindings::MediaImage> const& images)
{
    struct Candidate {
        size_t index;
        unsigned category { 2 };
        u32 distance { NumericLimits<u32>::max() };
        bool square { false };
    };
    Vector<Candidate> candidates;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < images.size(); ++index) {
        Candidate candidate { index };
        auto sizes = MUST(images[index].sizes.utf16_view().to_utf8());
        for (auto token : sizes.bytes_as_string_view().split_view_if([](char ch) { return ch == ' ' || ch == '\t' || ch == '\n' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\f'; })) {
            if (token.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("any"sv)) {
                candidate.category = 0;
                break;
            }
            auto separator = token.find_any_of("xX"sv);
            if (!separator.has_value())
                continue;
            auto width_text = token.substring_view(0, *separator);
            auto height_text = token.substring_view(*separator + 1);
            if (width_text.is_empty() || height_text.is_empty()
                || !all_of(width_text, [](char ch) { return is_ascii_digit(ch); })
                || !all_of(height_text, [](char ch) { return is_ascii_digit(ch); }))
                continue;
            auto width = width_text.to_number<u32>();
            auto height = height_text.to_number<u32>();
            if (!width.has_value() || !height.has_value() || *width == 0 || *height == 0)
                continue;
            auto deviation = [](u32 side) { return side > artwork_maximum_side ? side - artwork_maximum_side : artwork_maximum_side - side; };
            auto distance = max(deviation(*width), deviation(*height));
            bool square = width == height;
            if (distance < candidate.distance || (distance == candidate.distance && square)) {
                candidate.distance = distance;
                candidate.square = square;
            }
            candidate.category = 1;
        }
        candidates.append(candidate);
    }
    quick_sort(candidates, [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        if (a.category != b.category)
            return a.category < b.category;
        if (a.category == 1) {
            if (a.distance != b.distance)
                return a.distance < b.distance;
            if (a.square != b.square)
                return a.square;
        }
        return a.index < b.index;
    });
    Vector<URL::URL> urls;
    for (auto const& candidate : candidates)
        urls.append(DOMURL::parse(images[candidate.index].src).release_value());
    return urls;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#fetch-image-algorithm
void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::update_artwork()
{
    auto document = active_document();
    Optional<UniqueNodeID> document_id;
    GC::Ptr<MediaMetadata> metadata;
    if (document) {
        document_id = document->unique_id();
        metadata = document->window()->navigator()->media_session()->metadata();
    }
    auto version = metadata ? metadata->artwork_version() : 0;
    if (document_id == m_artwork_document && metadata == m_artwork_metadata && version == m_artwork_version)
        return;

    auto urls = metadata ? ranked_artwork_urls(metadata->artwork_images()) : Vector<URL::URL> {};
    bool same_document = document_id == m_artwork_document;
    m_artwork_document = document_id;
    m_artwork_metadata = metadata;
    m_artwork_version = version;

    // Text changes don't restart a fetch. A decoded image remains usable while the preferred URL is unchanged.
    bool same_preferred_url = !urls.is_empty() && !m_artwork_urls.is_empty() && urls.first() == m_artwork_urls.first();
    bool can_reuse_artwork = m_artwork && m_next_artwork_index == 1 && same_preferred_url;
    bool previous_fetch_failed = !m_artwork && !m_artwork_fetch_in_flight;
    if (same_document && !previous_fetch_failed && (urls == m_artwork_urls || can_reuse_artwork)) {
        m_artwork_urls = move(urls);
        return;
    }

    // 1. If there are other fetch image algorithms running, cancel existing algorithm execution instances.
    ++m_artwork_generation;
    if (auto controller = exchange(m_artwork_fetch_controller, nullptr))
        controller->stop_fetch();
    m_artwork = nullptr;
    m_artwork_urls.clear();
    m_next_artwork_index = 0;

    // 2. If metadata's artwork of the active media session is empty, then terminate these steps.
    if (urls.is_empty()) {
        finish_artwork(nullptr);
        return;
    }

    // 3. If the platform supports displaying media artwork, select a preferred artwork image from metadata's artwork
    //    of the active media session.
    // NB: Rank by the larger of the width and height deviations from 512, preferring squares on ties. Array order
    //     breaks equal ranks. Entries with "any" precede declared sizes, which precede entries without usable sizes.
    m_artwork_urls = move(urls);
    m_artwork_fetch_in_flight = true;
    fetch_next_artwork();
}

static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap const>> scale_artwork(Page& page, Gfx::Bitmap const& bitmap)
{
    auto longest_side = max(bitmap.width(), bitmap.height());
    if (longest_side <= artwork_maximum_side)
        return bitmap;
    if (!page.has_compositor_host())
        return Error::from_string_literal("No compositor to scale media session artwork");

    auto scale = static_cast<double>(artwork_maximum_side) / longest_side;
    Gfx::IntSize size { max(1, static_cast<int>(round(bitmap.width() * scale))), max(1, static_cast<int>(round(bitmap.height() * scale))) };
    auto output = TRY(Gfx::Bitmap::create_shareable(Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, size));
    auto frame = TRY(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::create(bitmap));
    if (!Painting::rasterize_image_frame(page.compositor_host(), frame, output->rect().to_type<float>(), Gfx::ScalingMode::BilinearMipmap, output))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to scale media session artwork");
    return output;
}

bool ActiveMediaSessionTracker::artwork_document_is_active()
{
    auto document = active_document();
    return document && document->unique_id() == m_artwork_document;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#fetch-image-algorithm
void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::fetch_next_artwork()
{
    auto document = active_document();
    if (!document || document->unique_id() != m_artwork_document) {
        abandon_artwork_fetch();
        return;
    }
    if (m_next_artwork_index == m_artwork_urls.size()) {
        finish_artwork(nullptr);
        return;
    }
    auto& settings = document->relevant_settings_object();

    // 4. Let request be a new request whose URL is the preferred artwork image's src, destination is "image", mode is
    //    "no-cors", credentials mode is "include", and whose use-URL-credentials flag is set.
    auto request = Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::create();
    request->set_url(m_artwork_urls[m_next_artwork_index++]);
    request->set_destination(Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::Destination::Image);
    request->set_mode(Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::Mode::NoCORS);
    request->set_credentials_mode(Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::CredentialsMode::Include);
    request->set_use_url_credentials(true);
    request->set_client(settings.address());

    // 5. Fetch request with the following steps executed as the fetch's processResponse algorithm.
    // NB: Consume the body before handing its bytes to the image decoder.
    Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchAlgorithms::Input algorithms { Fetch::Engine::BodyIntent::ConsumeForCallback };
    algorithms.process_response_consume_body = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*m_page, m_artwork_generation), [](Page& page, u64 generation, GC::Ref<Fetch::Infrastructure::ResponseView> response, Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchAlgorithms::BodyBytes bytes) {
        auto& tracker = page.active_media_session_tracker();
        if (generation != tracker.m_artwork_generation)
            return;
        if (!tracker.artwork_document_is_active()) {
            tracker.abandon_artwork_fetch();
            return;
        }
        tracker.m_artwork_fetch_controller = nullptr;

        // 1. Let response be the response given to the fetch's processResponse algorithm.
        // 2. If response's type is not "error", attempt to decode response's body as an image.
        if (response->is_network_error() || !bytes.has<Core::ImmutableBytes>()) {
            tracker.fetch_next_artwork();
            return;
        }
        auto on_decoded = [page = GC::Root(page), generation](Platform::DecodedImage& image) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            // Platform artwork uses only the first frame, so release any animation session, even for a stale decode.
            if (image.session_id != 0)
                Platform::ImageCodecPlugin::the().stop_animation_decode(image.session_id);
            auto& tracker = page->active_media_session_tracker();
            if (generation != tracker.m_artwork_generation)
                return {};
            if (!tracker.artwork_document_is_active()) {
                tracker.abandon_artwork_fetch();
                return {};
            }

            // 3. If the image format is supported, use the image as the artwork for display in platform UI. Otherwise
            //    the fetch image algorithm fails and terminates.
            // AD-HOC: If an entry fails, try the next ranked entry before giving up on the session's artwork.
            if (!image.frames.is_empty() && image.frames.first().bitmap && !image.frames.first().bitmap->size().is_empty()) {
                auto bitmap = scale_artwork(*page, *image.frames.first().bitmap);
                if (generation != tracker.m_artwork_generation)
                    return {};
                if (!tracker.artwork_document_is_active()) {
                    tracker.abandon_artwork_fetch();
                    return {};
                }
                if (!bitmap.is_error()) {
                    tracker.finish_artwork(bitmap.release_value());
                    return {};
                }
            }
            tracker.fetch_next_artwork();
            return {};
        };
        auto on_failed = [page = GC::Root(page), generation](Error&) {
            auto& tracker = page->active_media_session_tracker();
            if (generation == tracker.m_artwork_generation)
                tracker.fetch_next_artwork();
        };
        (void)Platform::ImageCodecPlugin::the().decode_image(bytes.get<Core::ImmutableBytes>().bytes(), move(on_decoded), move(on_failed));
    });
    m_artwork_fetch_controller = Fetch::Fetching::fetch(settings.realm(), request, Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchAlgorithms::create(move(algorithms)));
}

// The document the artwork list belongs to stopped being the active one mid-fetch. Forget it, so the next update builds
// the list again for whichever document is active, and fetch again then.
void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::abandon_artwork_fetch()
{
    m_artwork_document.clear();
    finish_artwork(nullptr);
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::finish_artwork(RefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap const> bitmap)
{
    m_artwork_fetch_controller = nullptr;
    m_artwork_fetch_in_flight = false;
    m_artwork = move(bitmap);
    mark_dirty();
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::when_artwork_settled(GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise)
{
    update_artwork();
    if (!m_artwork_fetch_in_flight) {
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(promise);
        return;
    }
    m_artwork_waiters.append(promise);
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::mark_dirty()
{
    update_active_document();
    // Re-anchor before coalescing reports so a pause and resume in one task can't advance through the paused interval.
    update_position_states();
    if (m_report_scheduled)
        return;
    m_report_scheduled = true;
    Platform::EventLoopPlugin::the().deferred_invoke(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*m_page), [](Page& page) {
        page.active_media_session_tracker().report_state();
    }));
}

Optional<MediaSessionState> ActiveMediaSessionTracker::compute_state()
{
    update_artwork();
    update_position_states();

    // https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#update-metadata-algorithm
    // 1. If the active media session is null, unset the media metadata presented to the platform,
    //    and terminate these steps.
    auto document = active_document();
    if (!document)
        return {};

    auto session = document->window()->navigator()->media_session();
    MediaSessionState state;
    state.activation_counter = m_activation_counter;

    // https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#update-metadata-algorithm
    // 2. If the metadata of the active media session is an empty metadata, unset the media metadata presented to the
    //    platform, and terminate these steps.
    // 3. Update the media metadata presented to the platform to match the metadata for the active media session.
    // NB: Empty strings and a null bitmap represent unset metadata.
    if (auto metadata = session->metadata()) {
        state.title = MUST(metadata->title().utf16_view().to_utf8());
        state.artist = MUST(metadata->artist().utf16_view().to_utf8());
        state.album = MUST(metadata->album().utf16_view().to_utf8());
        state.artwork = m_artwork;
    }

    // 4. If the user agent wants to display an artwork image, the user agent MUST run the fetch image algorithm.
    // NB: update_artwork() starts the fetch without delaying the text metadata report.

    auto const& position_state = m_position_states.get(*m_active_document).value();
    state.playback_state = position_state.playback_state;

    // https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#position-state
    state.position = position_state.reported_position;
    size_t controlled_element_count = 0;
    for (auto const& entry : m_controlled_elements) {
        if (entry.document_id == *m_active_document)
            ++controlled_element_count;
    }
    bool has_finite_duration = false;
    for (auto const& entry : m_controlled_elements) {
        if (entry.document_id != *m_active_document)
            continue;
        auto& element = as<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>(*DOM::Node::from_unique_id(entry.element_id));
        if (!isfinite(element.duration()))
            continue;
        has_finite_duration = true;
        if (!state.position.has_value() && controlled_element_count == 1) {
            state.position = MediaSessionPositionState {
                element.duration(), element.potentially_playing() ? element.playback_rate() : 0.0,
                element.current_time(), MonotonicTime::now()
            };
        }
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#media-session-actions-update-algorithm
    // 1. Let available actions be an array of media session actions.
    // 3. Otherwise, set the available actions to the list of keys available in the active media session's supported
    //    media session actions.
    for (auto const& entry : session->action_handlers())
        state.supported_actions.append(entry.key);

    // AD-HOC: The spec lists only registered handlers here. Include actions the user agent can perform on controlled
    //         elements too, so removing a handler restores the corresponding default control.
    auto add_default_action = [&](auto action) {
        if (!state.supported_actions.contains_slow(action))
            state.supported_actions.append(action);
    };
    add_default_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Play);
    add_default_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Pause);
    add_default_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Stop);
    if (has_finite_duration) {
        add_default_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekto);
        add_default_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekbackward);
        add_default_action(Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Seekforward);
    }
    quick_sort(state.supported_actions);
    return state;
}

static bool states_match(Optional<MediaSessionState> const& previous, Optional<MediaSessionState> const& current)
{
    if (previous == current)
        return true;
    if (!previous.has_value() || !current.has_value())
        return false;
    if (previous->activation_counter != current->activation_counter
        || previous->title != current->title || previous->artist != current->artist || previous->album != current->album
        || previous->artwork != current->artwork
        || previous->playback_state != current->playback_state || previous->supported_actions != current->supported_actions)
        return false;
    if (!previous->position.has_value() || !current->position.has_value())
        return false;

    auto const& old_position = *previous->position;
    auto const& new_position = *current->position;
    if (old_position.duration != new_position.duration || old_position.playback_rate != new_position.playback_rate)
        return false;

    auto expected_position = old_position.position;
    if (previous->playback_state == Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Playing) {
        auto elapsed = (new_position.last_position_updated_time - old_position.last_position_updated_time).to_seconds_f64();
        expected_position += elapsed * old_position.playback_rate;
    }
    expected_position = clamp(expected_position, 0.0, old_position.duration);
    return fabs(new_position.position - expected_position) <= 0.1;
}

void ActiveMediaSessionTracker::report_state()
{
    m_report_scheduled = false;
    auto state = compute_state();
    if (!states_match(m_last_reported_state, state)) {
        m_last_reported_state = state;
        m_page->client().page_did_change_media_session_state(state);
    }

    // Settle waiters after the coalesced update, since metadata can change while a decode is pending.
    if (!m_artwork_fetch_in_flight) {
        GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise>> waiters { move(m_artwork_waiters) };
        m_artwork_waiters.clear();
        for (auto const& promise : waiters) {
            HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext context { WebIDL::promise_realm(promise) };
            WebIDL::resolve_promise(promise);
        }
    }
}

}

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(ChapterInformation);

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#create-a-chapterinformation
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<ChapterInformation>> ChapterInformation::create(Bindings::ChapterInformationInit const& init)
{
    // 1. Let chapterInfo be a new ChapterInformation object.
    auto chapter_info = GC::Heap::the().allocate<ChapterInformation>();

    // 2. Set chapterInfo's title to init's title.
    chapter_info->m_title = init.title;

    // 3. Set chapterInfo's startTime to init's startTime. If the startTime is negative or greater than duration, throw
    //    a TypeError.
    // NB: Nothing here has a duration, so only a negative startTime is rejected.
    if (init.start_time < 0)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Chapter startTime must not be negative"_utf16 };
    chapter_info->m_start_time = init.start_time;

    // 4. Let artwork be the result of running the convert artwork algorithm with init's artwork as input.
    // 5. Set chapterInfo's artwork images to the result of creating a frozen array from artwork.
    // NB: The frozen array is created when the artwork attribute is first read in a wrapper world.
    chapter_info->m_artwork_images = TRY(convert_artwork(init.artwork));

    // 6. Return chapterInfo.
    return chapter_info;
}

void ChapterInformation::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_retained_artwork_arrays);
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-chapterinformation-artwork
JS::Value ChapterInformation::artwork(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    // On getting, it MUST return the ChapterInformation's artwork images.
    auto& wrapper_world = Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm);
    if (auto array = m_artwork_arrays.get(wrapper_world))
        return array.ptr();

    auto array = MUST(JS::Array::create(realm, 0));
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_artwork_images.size(); ++index)
        MUST(array->create_data_property_or_throw(index, Bindings::media_image_to_value(realm, m_artwork_images[index])));
    MUST(array->set_integrity_level(JS::Object::IntegrityLevel::Frozen));
    m_artwork_arrays.set(wrapper_world, array);
    m_retained_artwork_arrays.append(array);
    return array;
}

}

namespace Web::MediaSession {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(MediaMetadata);

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#convert-artwork-algorithm
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Vector<Bindings::MediaImage>> convert_artwork(Vector<Bindings::MediaImage> const& input)
{
    // 1. Let output be an empty list of type MediaImage.
    Vector<Bindings::MediaImage> output;

    // 2. For each entry in input (which is a MediaImage list), perform the following steps:
    for (auto const& entry : input) {
        // 1. Let image be a new MediaImage.
        Bindings::MediaImage image;

        // 2. Let baseURL be the API base URL specified by the entry settings object.
        // AD-HOC: Use the current settings object's base URL instead of the entry settings object's, as the
        //         web-platform-tests expect. Artwork built with another realm's constructor uses that realm's base URL.
        auto base_url = HTML::current_settings_object().api_base_url();

        // 3. Parse entry's src using baseURL. If it does not return failure, set image's src to the return value.
        //    Otherwise, throw a TypeError and abort these steps.
        auto url = DOMURL::parse(entry.src, base_url);
        if (!url.has_value())
            return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Artwork src could not be parsed as a URL"_utf16 };
        image.src = utf16_string_from_url_ascii(url->serialize());

        // 4. Set image's sizes to entry's sizes.
        image.sizes = entry.sizes;

        // 5. Set image's type to entry's type.
        image.type = entry.type;

        // 6. Append image to the output.
        output.append(move(image));
    }

    // 3. Return output as result.
    return output;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediametadata-mediametadata
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<MediaMetadata>> MediaMetadata::create(Bindings::MediaMetadataInit const& init)
{
    // 1. Let metadata be a new MediaMetadata object.
    auto metadata = GC::Heap::the().allocate<MediaMetadata>();

    // 2. Set metadata's title to init's title.
    metadata->m_title = init.title;

    // 3. Set metadata's artist to init's artist.
    metadata->m_artist = init.artist;

    // 4. Set metadata's album to init's album.
    metadata->m_album = init.album;

    // 5. Run the convert artwork algorithm with init's artwork as input and set metadata's artwork images as the
    //    result if it succeeded.
    metadata->m_artwork_images = TRY(convert_artwork(init.artwork));

    // 6. Let chapters be an empty list of type ChapterInformation.
    // 7. For each entry in init's chapterInfo, create a ChapterInformation from entry and append it to chapters.
    // 8. Set metadata's chapter information to the result of creating a frozen array from chapters.
    // NB: The chapters go straight into metadata's chapter information, which keeps them alive. The frozen array is
    //     created when the chapterInfo attribute is first read in a wrapper world.
    for (auto const& entry : init.chapter_info)
        metadata->m_chapter_information.append(TRY(ChapterInformation::create(entry)));

    // 9. Return metadata.
    return metadata;
}

void MediaMetadata::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_retained_converted_artwork_images);
    visitor.visit(m_chapter_information);
    visitor.visit(m_retained_chapter_information_arrays);
    visitor.visit(m_media_session);
}

void MediaMetadata::set_media_session(GC::Ptr<MediaSession> session)

    m_media_session = session;
}

    metadata_updated();

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediametadata-artist

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediametadata-artwork
JS::Value MediaMetadata::artwork(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    // 1. If the MediaMetadata's converted artwork images is undefined, run the following steps:
    // NB: We keep the converted artwork images for each wrapper world that reads them, so that no world gets another's
    //     array.
    auto& wrapper_world = Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm);
    auto converted_artwork_images = m_converted_artwork_images.get(wrapper_world);
    if (!converted_artwork_images) {
        // 1. Let frozenArtwork be a JavaScript Array value.
        auto frozen_artwork = MUST(JS::Array::create(realm, 0));

        // 2. For each entry in the MediaMetadata's artwork images, perform the following steps:
        for (size_t index = 0; index < m_artwork_images.size(); ++index) {
            // 1. Let image be the result of converting to a JavaScript object entry.
            auto image = Bindings::media_image_to_value(realm, m_artwork_images[index]);

            // 2. Perform SetIntegrityLevel(image, "frozen"), to prevent accidental mutation by scripts.
            MUST(image.as_object().set_integrity_level(JS::Object::IntegrityLevel::Frozen));

            // 3. Push image to frozenArtwork.
            MUST(frozen_artwork->create_data_property_or_throw(index, image));
        }

        // 3. Perform SetIntegrityLevel(frozenArtwork, "frozen").
        MUST(frozen_artwork->set_integrity_level(JS::Object::IntegrityLevel::Frozen));

        // 4. Set the MediaMetadata's converted artwork images to frozenArtwork.
        m_converted_artwork_images.set(wrapper_world, frozen_artwork);
        m_retained_converted_artwork_images.append(frozen_artwork);
        converted_artwork_images = frozen_artwork;
    }

    // 2. Return the MediaMetadata's converted artwork images.
    return converted_artwork_images.ptr();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediametadata-chapterinfo
JS::Value MediaMetadata::chapter_info(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    // On getting, it MUST return the MediaMetadata's chapter information.
    auto& wrapper_world = Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm);
    if (auto array = m_chapter_information_arrays.get(wrapper_world))
        return array.ptr();

    auto array = MUST(JS::Array::create(realm, 0));
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_chapter_information.size(); ++index) {
        auto wrapper = Bindings::wrap(wrapper_world, realm, m_chapter_information[index]);

        // AD-HOC: The spec freezes only the array, but each ChapterInformation object is frozen too, as the
        //         web-platform-tests expect.
        MUST(wrapper->set_integrity_level(JS::Object::IntegrityLevel::Frozen));
        MUST(array->create_data_property_or_throw(index, wrapper));
    }
    MUST(array->set_integrity_level(JS::Object::IntegrityLevel::Frozen));
    m_chapter_information_arrays.set(wrapper_world, array);
    m_retained_chapter_information_arrays.append(array);
    return array;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediametadata-artwork
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MediaMetadata::set_artwork(JS::Realm& realm, GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<JS::Object>> const& value)
{
    // 1. Let convertedArtwork be the result of converting value to a sequence of type MediaImage.
    Vector<Bindings::MediaImage> converted_artwork;
    for (auto const& entry : value)
        converted_artwork.append(TRY(Bindings::convert_to_idl_value_for_media_image(realm.vm(), entry)));

    // 2. Run convert artwork algorithm with convertedArtwork, and set the MediaMetadata's artwork images as the
    //    result if it succeeds.
    m_artwork_images = TRY(convert_artwork(converted_artwork));
    ++m_artwork_version;

    // 3. Set the MediaMetadata's converted artwork images to undefined.
    m_converted_artwork_images.clear();
    m_retained_converted_artwork_images.clear();
    metadata_updated();
    return {};
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#the-mediametadata-interface
void MediaMetadata::metadata_updated()
{
    // 1. If the instance has no associated media session, abort these steps.
    if (!m_media_session)
        return;

    // 2. Otherwise, queue a task to run the following substeps:
    //    1. If the instance no longer has an associated media session, abort these steps.
    //    2. Otherwise, in parallel, run the update metadata algorithm.
    // NB: The deferred update reads the active session's metadata, so metadata detached before it runs isn't reported.
    m_media_session->state_changed();
}

}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediasession-metadata
void MediaSession::set_metadata(GC::Ptr<MediaMetadata> value)
{
    // 1. If the MediaSession's metadata is not null, set its media session to null.
    if (m_metadata)
        m_metadata->set_media_session(nullptr);

    // 2. Set the MediaSession's metadata to value.
    m_metadata = value;

    // 3. If the MediaSession's metadata is not null, set its media session to the current MediaSession.
    if (m_metadata)
        m_metadata->set_media_session(this);

    // 4. In parallel, run the update metadata algorithm.
    state_changed();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediasession-playbackstate
void MediaSession::set_playback_state(Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState value)
{
    // On setting, the user agent MUST set the IDL attribute to the new value if it is a valid
    // MediaSessionPlaybackState value.
    m_playback_state = value;

    // Setting playbackState may cause the actual playback state to change and run the media session actions
    // update algorithm.
    state_changed();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#update-action-handler-algorithm
void MediaSession::set_action_handler(Bindings::MediaSessionAction action, GC::Ptr<WebIDL::CallbackType> handler)
{
    // 1. If handler is null, remove action from the supported media session actions for MediaSession
    //    and abort these steps.
    if (!handler) {
        m_action_handlers.remove(action);
        state_changed();
        return;
    }

    // 2. Add action to the supported media session actions for MediaSession and associate to it the handler.
    m_action_handlers.set(action, handler);

    state_changed();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mediasession/#dom-mediasession-setpositionstate
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MediaSession::set_position_state(Bindings::MediaPositionState state)
{
    // 1. If state is an empty dictionary, clear the position state and abort these steps.
    if (!state.duration.has_value() && !state.position.has_value() && !state.playback_rate.has_value()) {
        m_position_state.clear();
        state_changed();
        return {};
    }

    // 2. If state's duration is not present, throw a TypeError.
    if (!state.duration.has_value())
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Position state requires a duration"_utf16 };

    // 3. If state's duration is negative or NaN, throw a TypeError.
    if (*state.duration < 0 || isnan(*state.duration))
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Position state duration must be non-negative and not NaN"_utf16 };

    // 4. If state's position is not present, set it to zero.
    if (!state.position.has_value())
        state.position = 0;

    // 5. If state's position is negative or greater than duration, throw a TypeError.
    if (*state.position < 0 || *state.position > *state.duration)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Position must be between zero and duration"_utf16 };

    // 6. If state's playbackRate is not present, set it to 1.0.
    if (!state.playback_rate.has_value())
        state.playback_rate = 1.0;

    // 7. If state's playbackRate is zero, throw a TypeError.
    if (*state.playback_rate == 0)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Position state playback rate must be nonzero"_utf16 };

    // 8. Update the position state and last position updated time.
    m_position_state = MediaSessionPositionState { *state.duration, *state.playback_rate, *state.position, MonotonicTime::now() };
    state_changed();
    return {};
}

}

void MediaSource::queue_a_media_source_task(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void()>> task)
{
    // FIXME: The MSE spec does not say what task source to use for its tasks. Should this use the media element's
    //        task source? We may not have access to it if we're in a worker.
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> document = nullptr;
    if (media_element_assigned_to() != nullptr)
        document = media_element_assigned_to()->document();

    HTML::queue_a_task(HTML::Task::Source::Unspecified, HTML::current_event_loop(), document, task);
}

bool MediaSource::ready_state_is_closed() const
{
    return m_ready_state == ReadyState::Closed;
}

void MediaSource::set_has_ever_been_attached()
{
    m_has_ever_been_attached = true;
}

void MediaSource::set_ready_state_to_open_and_fire_sourceopen_event()
{
    m_ready_state = ReadyState::Open;

    // NB: [[live seekable range]] outlives an attachment, so a MediaSource attached again hands it to its new media
    //     element's playback manager.
    if (m_live_seekable_range.has_value() && m_media_element_assigned_to)
        m_media_element_assigned_to->playback_manager().set_live_seekable_range(m_live_seekable_range);

    // AD-HOC: Notify all demuxers that we have new data coming in and cannot consider the end of the buffer to be
    //         the end of the stream.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_source_buffers->length(); i++) {
        auto& source_buffer = *m_source_buffers->item(i);
        source_buffer.clear_reached_end_of_stream({});
    }

    queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this), [](auto& self) {
        auto event = self.create_associated_event(EventNames::sourceopen);
        self.dispatch_event(event);
    }));
}

void MediaSource::set_assigned_to_media_element(Badge<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>, HTML::HTMLMediaElement& media_element)
{
    m_media_element_assigned_to = media_element;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#mediasource-detach
void MediaSource::detach_from_media_element(Badge<HTML::HTMLMediaElement>)
{
    // FIXME: 1. If the MediaSource was constructed in a DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope:
    //               1. Notify the MediaSource using an internal detach message posted to [[port to worker]].
    //               2. Set [[port to worker]] null.
    //               3. Set [[channel with worker]] null.
    //               4. The implicit message handler for this detach notification runs the remainder of these
    //                  steps in the DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope MediaSource.
    //           Otherwise, the MediaSource was constructed in a Window:
    //               Continue the remainder of these steps on the Window MediaSource.
    // FIXME: 2. Set [[port to main]] null.

    // 3. Set the readyState attribute to "closed".
    m_ready_state = ReadyState::Closed;

    // FIXME: 4. If this is a ManagedMediaSource, then set streaming attribute to false.

    // 5. Update duration to NaN.
    m_duration = NAN;

    // AD-HOC: Abort the buffer-append algorithm of every SourceBuffer removed below. The spec steps (copied in below)
    //         don't say to do that, but other engines implement them by running the removeSourceBuffer() steps on every
    //         SourceBuffer — and those steps abort the buffer-append algorithm when the updating attribute is true.
    //         Without this, a buffer-append task queued before detaching would still run afterwards — against a media
    //         element that the media element load algorithm has reset.
    //         https://github.com/w3c/media-source/issues/378
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_source_buffers->length(); i++)
        m_source_buffers->item(i)->abort_if_updating({});

    // 6. Remove all the SourceBuffer objects from activeSourceBuffers.
    m_active_source_buffers->remove_all_buffers({});

    // 7. Queue a task to fire an event named removesourcebuffer at activeSourceBuffers.
    queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref(*this), m_active_source_buffers), [](auto& media_source, auto& source_buffers) {
        source_buffers->dispatch_event(media_source->create_associated_event(EventNames::removesourcebuffer));
    }));

    // 8. Remove all the SourceBuffer objects from sourceBuffers.
    m_source_buffers->remove_all_buffers({});

    // 9. Queue a task to fire an event named removesourcebuffer at sourceBuffers.
    queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref(*this), m_source_buffers), [](auto& media_source, auto& source_buffers) {
        source_buffers->dispatch_event(media_source->create_associated_event(EventNames::removesourcebuffer));
    }));

    // 10. Queue a task to fire an event named sourceclose at the MediaSource.
    queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this), [](auto& self) {
        self.dispatch_event(self.create_associated_event(EventNames::sourceclose));
    }));

    // AD-HOC: Sever the media element assignment that was established when this MediaSource was attached.
    m_media_element_assigned_to = nullptr;
}

GC::Ref<SourceBufferList> MediaSource::source_buffers()
{
    return m_source_buffers;
}

GC::Ref<SourceBufferList> MediaSource::active_source_buffers()
{
    return m_active_source_buffers;
}

Utf16String MediaSource::next_track_id()
{
    return Utf16String::number(m_next_track_id++);
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#active-source-buffer-changes
void MediaSource::selected_video_track_changed(Badge<HTML::VideoTrack>, GC::Ptr<SourceBuffer> previously_selected_track_source_buffer, GC::Ptr<SourceBuffer> newly_selected_track_source_buffer)
{
    // If the selected video track changes, then run the following steps:
    // 1. If the SourceBuffer associated with the previously selected video track is not associated with any other
    //    enabled tracks, run the following steps:
    auto previously_selected_track_source_buffer_became_inactive = [&] {
        if (!previously_selected_track_source_buffer || !m_active_source_buffers->contains(*previously_selected_track_source_buffer))
            return false;
        return !previously_selected_track_source_buffer->is_associated_with_an_enabled_or_selected_track();
    }();
    if (previously_selected_track_source_buffer_became_inactive) {
        // 1. Remove the SourceBuffer from activeSourceBuffers.
        m_active_source_buffers->remove(*previously_selected_track_source_buffer);

        // 2. Queue a task to fire an event named removesourcebuffer at activeSourceBuffers
        queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref(*this), m_active_source_buffers), [](auto& media_source, auto& source_buffers) {
            source_buffers->dispatch_event(media_source->create_associated_event(EventNames::removesourcebuffer));
        }));
    }

    // 2. If the SourceBuffer associated with the newly selected video track is not already in activeSourceBuffers,
    //    run the following steps:
    if (newly_selected_track_source_buffer && !m_active_source_buffers->contains(*newly_selected_track_source_buffer)) {
        // 1. Add the SourceBuffer to activeSourceBuffers.
        m_active_source_buffers->insert_in_order_of(*newly_selected_track_source_buffer, m_source_buffers);

        // 2. Queue a task to fire an event named addsourcebuffer at activeSourceBuffers
        queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref(*this), m_active_source_buffers), [](auto& media_source, auto& source_buffers) {
            source_buffers->dispatch_event(media_source->create_associated_event(EventNames::addsourcebuffer));
        }));
    }
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#active-source-buffer-changes
void MediaSource::audio_track_enabled_changed(Badge<HTML::AudioTrack>, SourceBuffer& source_buffer, bool enabled)
{
    // If an audio track becomes disabled and the SourceBuffer associated with this track is not associated with any
    // other enabled or selected track, then run the following steps:
    if (!enabled && m_active_source_buffers->contains(source_buffer) && !source_buffer.is_associated_with_an_enabled_or_selected_track()) {
        // 1. Remove the SourceBuffer associated with the audio track from activeSourceBuffers
        m_active_source_buffers->remove(source_buffer);

        // 2. Queue a task to fire an event named removesourcebuffer at activeSourceBuffers
        queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref(*this), m_active_source_buffers), [](auto& media_source, auto& source_buffers) {
            source_buffers->dispatch_event(media_source->create_associated_event(EventNames::removesourcebuffer));
        }));
    }

    // If an audio track becomes enabled and the SourceBuffer associated with this track is not already in
    // activeSourceBuffers, then run the following steps:
    if (enabled && !m_active_source_buffers->contains(source_buffer)) {
        // 1. Add the SourceBuffer associated with the audio track to activeSourceBuffers
        m_active_source_buffers->insert_in_order_of(source_buffer, m_source_buffers);

        // 2. Queue a task to fire an event named addsourcebuffer at activeSourceBuffers
        queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref(*this), m_active_source_buffers), [](auto& media_source, auto& source_buffers) {
            source_buffers->dispatch_event(media_source->create_associated_event(EventNames::addsourcebuffer));
        }));
    }
}

    set_event_handler_attribute(EventNames::sourceopen, event_handler);

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#addsourcebuffer-method
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<SourceBuffer>> MediaSource::add_source_buffer(Utf16String const& type)
{
    // 1. If type is an empty string then throw a TypeError exception and abort these steps.
    if (type.is_empty()) {
        return WebIDL::SimpleException {
            WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError,
            "SourceBuffer type must not be empty"_utf16
        };
    }

    // 2. If type contains a MIME type that is not supported or contains a MIME type that is not
    //    supported with the types specified for the other SourceBuffer objects in sourceBuffers,
    //    then throw a NotSupportedError exception and abort these steps.
    if (!is_type_supported(type.utf16_view())) {
        return WebIDL::NotSupportedError::create("Unsupported MIME type"_utf16);
    }

    // FIXME: 3. If the user agent can't handle any more SourceBuffer objects or if creating a SourceBuffer
    //           based on type would result in an unsupported SourceBuffer configuration, then throw a
    //           QuotaExceededError exception and abort these steps.

    // 4. If the readyState attribute is not in the "open" state then throw an InvalidStateError exception and abort these steps.
    if (m_ready_state != ReadyState::Open)
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("MediaSource is not open"_utf16);

    // 5. Let buffer be a new instance of a ManagedSourceBuffer if this is a ManagedMediaSource, or
    //    a SourceBuffer otherwise, with their respective associated resources.
    auto buffer = SourceBuffer::create(
        *this,
        HTML::AudioTrackList::create(),
        HTML::VideoTrackList::create(),
        HTML::TextTrackList::create());
    buffer->set_content_type(type.utf16_view());

    // FIXME: 6. Set buffer's [[generate timestamps flag]] to the value in the "Generate Timestamps Flag"
    //           column of the Media Source Extensions™ Byte Stream Format Registry entry that is
    //           associated with type.
    // FIXME: 7. If buffer's [[generate timestamps flag]] is true, set buffer's mode to "sequence".
    //           Otherwise, set buffer's mode to "segments".
    // 8. Append buffer to this's sourceBuffers.
    m_source_buffers->append(buffer);

    // 9. Queue a task to fire an event named addsourcebuffer at this's sourceBuffers.
    queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref(*this), m_source_buffers), [](auto& media_source, auto& source_buffers) {
        source_buffers->dispatch_event(media_source->create_associated_event(EventNames::addsourcebuffer));
    }));

    // 10. Return buffer.
    return buffer;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-endofstream
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MediaSource::end_of_stream(Optional<EndOfStreamError> const& error)
{
    // 1. If the readyState attribute is not in the "open" state then throw an InvalidStateError exception
    //    and abort these steps.
    if (m_ready_state != ReadyState::Open)
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("MediaSource is not open"_utf16);

    // 2. If the updating attribute equals true on any SourceBuffer in sourceBuffers, then throw an
    //    InvalidStateError exception and abort these steps.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_source_buffers->length(); i++) {
        if (m_source_buffers->item(i)->updating())
            return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("A SourceBuffer is still updating"_utf16);
    }

    // 3. Run the end of stream algorithm with the error parameter set to error.
    run_end_of_stream_algorithm(error);

    return {};
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#end-of-stream-algorithm
void MediaSource::run_end_of_stream_algorithm(Optional<EndOfStreamError> const& error)
{
    // 1. Change the readyState attribute value to "ended".
    m_ready_state = ReadyState::Ended;

    // 2. Queue a task to fire an event named sourceended at the MediaSource.
    queue_a_media_source_task(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this), [](auto& self) {
        self.dispatch_event(self.create_associated_event(EventNames::sourceended));
    }));

    // AD-HOC: Notify all demuxers that end of stream was reached, so that they can return the requisite error and
    //         allow decoders to flush all their frames.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_source_buffers->length(); i++) {
        auto& source_buffer = *m_source_buffers->item(i);
        source_buffer.set_reached_end_of_stream({});
    }

    // 3. If error is not set:
    if (!error.has_value()) {
        // 1. Run the duration change algorithm with new duration set to the largest track buffer ranges
        //    end time across all the track buffers across all SourceBuffer objects in sourceBuffers.
        AK::Duration highest_end_time;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_source_buffers->length(); i++)
            highest_end_time = max(highest_end_time, m_source_buffers->item(i)->highest_end_time());
        assign_duration_change(highest_end_time.to_seconds_f64());

        // 2. Notify the media element that it now has all of the media data.
        // FIXME: Signal to the HTMLMediaElement that all data has been provided.
        return;
    }

    // 4. If error is set to "network":
    if (error.value() == EndOfStreamError::Network) {
        // FIXME: If the HTMLMediaElement's readyState attribute equals HAVE_NOTHING:
        //            Run the "If the media data cannot be fetched at all" steps of the resource fetch algorithm.
        //        Otherwise:
        //            Run the "If the connection is interrupted after some media data has been received" steps
        //            of the resource fetch algorithm.
        return;
    }

    // 5. If error is set to "decode":
    if (error.value() == EndOfStreamError::Decode) {
        // FIXME: If the HTMLMediaElement's readyState attribute equals HAVE_NOTHING:
        //            Run the "If the media data can be fetched but is found by inspection to be in an
        //            unsupported format" steps of the resource fetch algorithm.
        //        Otherwise:
        //            Run the "If the media data can be fetched but has fatal network errors" steps of the
        //            resource fetch algorithm.
        return;
    }
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-duration
double MediaSource::duration() const
{
    // 1. If the readyState attribute is "closed" then return NaN and abort these steps.
    if (m_ready_state == ReadyState::Closed)
        return NAN;

    // 2. Return the current value of the attribute.
    return m_duration;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-duration
// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-setliveseekablerange
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MediaSource::set_live_seekable_range(double start, double end)
{
    // 1. If the readyState attribute is not "open" then throw an InvalidStateError exception and abort these steps.
    if (m_ready_state != ReadyState::Open)
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("MediaSource is not open"_utf16);

    // 2. If start is negative or greater than end, then throw a TypeError exception and abort these steps.
    if (start < 0 || start > end)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "start must not be negative or greater than end"_utf16 };

    // 3. Set [[live seekable range]] to be a new normalized TimeRanges object containing a single range whose start
    //    position is start and end position is end.
    m_live_seekable_range = Media::TimeRanges::Range { AK::Duration::from_seconds_f64(start), AK::Duration::from_seconds_f64(end) };
    media_element_assigned_to()->playback_manager().set_live_seekable_range(m_live_seekable_range);
    return {};
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-clearliveseekablerange
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MediaSource::clear_live_seekable_range()
{
    // 1. If the readyState attribute is not "open" then throw an InvalidStateError exception and abort these steps.
    if (m_ready_state != ReadyState::Open)
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("MediaSource is not open"_utf16);

    // 2. If [[live seekable range]] contains a range, then set [[live seekable range]] to be a new empty TimeRanges
    //    object.
    m_live_seekable_range.clear();
    media_element_assigned_to()->playback_manager().set_live_seekable_range({});
    return {};
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-duration
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MediaSource::set_duration(double new_duration)
{
    // 1. If the value being set is negative or NaN then throw a TypeError exception and abort these steps.
    if (new_duration < 0 || isnan(new_duration))
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "duration must not be negative or NaN"_utf16 };

    // 2. If the readyState attribute is not in the "open" state then throw an InvalidStateError exception
    //    and abort these steps.
    if (m_ready_state != ReadyState::Open)
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("MediaSource is not open"_utf16);

    // 3. If the updating attribute equals true on any SourceBuffer in sourceBuffers, then throw an
    //    InvalidStateError exception and abort these steps.
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_source_buffers->length(); i++) {
        if (m_source_buffers->item(i)->updating())
            return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("A SourceBuffer is still updating"_utf16);
    }

    // 4. Run the duration change algorithm with new duration set to the value being assigned to this attribute.
    TRY(run_duration_change_algorithm(new_duration));

    return {};
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#duration-change-algorithm
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MediaSource::run_duration_change_algorithm(double new_duration)
{
    // 1. If the current value of duration is equal to new duration, then return.
    if (m_duration == new_duration)
        return {};

    // NB: Calculate the highest presentation timestamp and the highest end time for step 3 in one loop.
    AK::Duration highest_presentation_timestamp;
    AK::Duration highest_end_time;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_source_buffers->length(); i++) {
        auto source_buffer = m_source_buffers->item(i);
        highest_presentation_timestamp = max(highest_presentation_timestamp, source_buffer->highest_presentation_timestamp());
        highest_end_time = max(highest_end_time, source_buffer->highest_end_time());
    }

    // 2. If new duration is less than the highest presentation timestamp of any buffered coded frames for all
    //    SourceBuffer objects in sourceBuffers, then throw an InvalidStateError exception and abort these steps.
    // NOTE: Duration reductions that would truncate currently buffered media are disallowed. When truncation is
    //       necessary, use remove() to reduce the buffered range before updating duration.
    if (new_duration < highest_presentation_timestamp.to_seconds_f64())
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("Duration would truncate buffered coded frames"_utf16);

    // 3. Let highest end time be the largest track buffer ranges end time across all the track buffers across all
    //    SourceBuffer objects in sourceBuffers.
    // 4. If new duration is less than highest end time, then
    // NOTE: This condition can occur because the coded frame removal algorithm preserves coded frames that start
    //       before the start of the removal range.
    //     1. Update new duration to equal highest end time.
    new_duration = max(new_duration, highest_end_time.to_seconds_f64());

    assign_duration_change(new_duration);
    return {};
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#duration-change-algorithm
void MediaSource::assign_duration_change(double new_duration)
{
    // 5. Update duration to new duration.
    m_duration = new_duration;

    // 6. Use the mirror if necessary algorithm to run the following steps in Window to update the
    //    media element's duration:
    // FIXME: Mirror to the Window when workers are supported.
    //        Update the media element's duration to new duration.
    //        Run the HTMLMediaElement duration change algorithm.
    // NB: The element seeks if its playback position is past the new duration, and that seek reads the seekable ranges,
    //     which the playback manager computes from the duration. So the playback manager gets the new duration first,
    //     but the element compares the position from before the change: The playback manager caps a pending seek's
    //     target at its duration. An infinite duration, a live stream's, is unbounded for the playback manager.
    auto& media_element = *media_element_assigned_to();
    auto playback_position = media_element.current_playback_position();
    media_element.playback_manager().set_duration(isinf(new_duration) ? AK::Duration::max() : AK::Duration::from_seconds_f64(new_duration));
    media_element.set_duration({}, new_duration, playback_position);
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-istypesupported
bool MediaSource::mime_type_is_supported_in_a_byte_stream(MimeSniff::MimeType const& mime_type)
{
    // 3. If type contains a media type or media subtype that the MediaSource does not support, then return false.
    if (mime_type.type() != "video" && mime_type.type() != "audio")
        return false;

    using SupportsCodec = bool (*)(StringView, Media::CodecID);
    auto supports_codec = [&]() -> SupportsCodec {
        if (mime_type.subtype() == "webm")
            return Media::MediaSourceExtensions::WebMByteStreamParser::supports_codec;
        if (mime_type.subtype() == "mp4")
            return Media::MediaSourceExtensions::ISOBMFFByteStreamParser::supports_codec;
        return nullptr;
    }();
    // NB: A subtype that no byte stream format handles is the media subtype half of the step above.
    if (!supports_codec)
        return false;

    // 4. If type contains a codec that the MediaSource does not support, then return false.
    // 5. If the MediaSource does not support the specified combination of media type, media subtype, and codecs then
    //    return false.
    auto codecs_iter = mime_type.parameters().find("codecs"sv);
    if (codecs_iter == mime_type.parameters().end())
        return false;

    auto codec_strings = codecs_iter->value.bytes_as_string_view().split_view(',', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty);
    if (codec_strings.is_empty())
        return false;

    for (auto codec_string : codec_strings) {
        codec_string = codec_string.trim_whitespace();
        auto codec = Media::parse_codec_parameters_string(codec_string);
        if (!codec.has_value())
            return false;

        // AD-HOC: An underspecified codec string names a family rather than a specific codec, so we cannot confirm
        //         support in this case.
        if (!codec->is_fully_specified())
            return false;

        if (mime_type.type() == "audio" && Media::track_type_from_codec_id(codec->codec_id()) != Media::TrackType::Audio)
            return false;

        if (!supports_codec(codec_string, codec->codec_id()))
            return false;
    }

    // NB: Steps 4 and 5 also ask whether the codecs can be decoded, which the caller answers.
    return true;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-istypesupported
bool MediaSource::is_type_supported(Utf16View type)
{
    // 1. If type is an empty string, then return false.
    if (type.is_empty())
        return false;

    // 2. If type does not contain a valid MIME type string, then return false.
    auto mime_type = MimeSniff::MimeType::parse(type);
    if (!mime_type.has_value())
        return false;

    // 3. If type contains a media type or media subtype that the MediaSource does not support, then return false.
    // 4. If type contains a codec that the MediaSource does not support, then return false.
    // 5. If the MediaSource does not support the specified combination of media type, media subtype, and codecs then
    //    return false.
    if (!mime_type_is_supported_in_a_byte_stream(*mime_type))
        return false;

    auto media_client = MediaClient::Client::acquire();
    if (media_client.is_error())
        return false;
    if (!media_client.value()->query_decoder_capabilities(mime_type->parameters().get("codecs"sv)->bytes_as_string_view()).has_value())
        return false;

    // 6. Return true.
    return true;
}

}

class MediaSource : public DOM::EventTarget {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(MediaSource, DOM::EventTarget);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(MediaSource);

    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<MediaSource> create_for_constructor(JS::Object&);

    GC::Ref<SourceBufferList> active_source_buffers();

    void selected_video_track_changed(Badge<HTML::VideoTrack>, GC::Ptr<SourceBuffer> previously_selected_track_source_buffer, GC::Ptr<SourceBuffer> newly_selected_track_source_buffer);
    void audio_track_enabled_changed(Badge<HTML::AudioTrack>, SourceBuffer&, bool enabled);

    // https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-canconstructindedicatedworker
    static bool can_construct_in_dedicated_worker() { return false; }

    void run_end_of_stream_algorithm(Badge<SourceBuffer>, Optional<EndOfStreamError> const& error) { run_end_of_stream_algorithm(error); }

    // https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dom-mediasource-duration
    double duration() const;
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_duration(double);

    // https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#duration-change-algorithm
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> run_duration_change_algorithm(double new_duration);
    void assign_duration_change(double new_duration);

    static bool is_type_supported(Utf16View);
    // Whether a byte stream format handles the type and every codec it lists; whether decoders exist is asked separately.
    static bool mime_type_is_supported_in_a_byte_stream(MimeSniff::MimeType const&);

protected:
    MediaSource(GC::Ref<DOM::EventTarget> relevant_global_object);

    virtual ~MediaSource() override;
    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

private:
    virtual GC::Ptr<Bindings::Wrappable> relevant_global_impl() const override;

    // https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#end-of-stream-algorithm
    void run_end_of_stream_algorithm(Optional<EndOfStreamError> const&);

    ReadyState m_ready_state { ReadyState::Closed };
    bool m_has_ever_been_attached { false };
    GC::Ptr<HTML::HTMLMediaElement> m_media_element_assigned_to;

    GC::Ref<SourceBufferList> m_source_buffers;
    GC::Ref<SourceBufferList> m_active_source_buffers;

    double m_duration { NAN };

    // https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#dfn-live-seekable-range
    // NB: The one range [[live seekable range]] holds, if any. The media element's playback manager gets a copy of it
    //     whenever this MediaSource opens, since it computes the seekable ranges.
    Optional<Media::TimeRanges::Range> m_live_seekable_range;

    u64 m_next_track_id = 1;

    GC::Ref<DOM::EventTarget> m_global_object;
};

    "closed",
    "open",
    "ended",

    "decode",

[Exposed=(Window,DedicatedWorker)]
interface MediaSource : EventTarget {
    constructor();

    [FIXME, SameObject, Exposed=DedicatedWorker]

    attribute unrestricted double duration;
    attribute EventHandler onsourceopen;
    attribute EventHandler onsourceended;

    [FIXME] undefined removeSourceBuffer(SourceBuffer sourceBuffer);

    undefined setLiveSeekableRange(double start, double end);
    undefined clearLiveSeekableRange();
    static boolean isTypeSupported(DOMString type);
};
