#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Utf16View.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Forward.h>

namespace Web {

// The link a page asks its client to show the URL of, as the pointer hovers it. No script takes part in this, so what
// is hovered may be told from any thread: the main thread tells as it handles the pointer, and a hover of the render
// clock tells while a task runs, on the Render thread. Each asks under one lock, so the client is left showing the link
// asked for last.
class WEB_API PageHoverLink final : public AtomicRefCounted<PageHoverLink> {
public:
    // Asks the client to show the URL of a link, or none, from any thread.
    using Send = Function<void(Optional<URL::URL> const&)>;

    static NonnullRefPtr<PageHoverLink> create() { return adopt_ref(*new PageHoverLink); }

    Optional<URL::URL> current() const;
    bool has_link() const;

    // Asks the client to show `url`, or no link, where the link asked for last is another. `document` is the document
    // the pointer is over, if any.
    void request(Optional<URL::URL> url, Optional<UniqueNodeID> document);

    // Asks the client to show no link, where what it shows was asked for over the document `document`.
    void withdraw(UniqueNodeID document);

    // What asks the client from now on. None asks nothing.
    void set_send(Send);

private:
    PageHoverLink() = default;

    void update(Optional<URL::URL> url);

    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    Optional<URL::URL> m_current;
    Optional<UniqueNodeID> m_document;
    Send m_send;
};

// What tells a page the link a hover of the render clock is over, in one document. A hover cannot read the document,
// so the hrefs of its links are kept here by the style node of each link, with the base URL and encoding that resolve
// them.
class WEB_API HoverLinkReporter final : public AtomicRefCounted<HoverLinkReporter> {
public:
    static NonnullRefPtr<HoverLinkReporter> create(NonnullRefPtr<PageHoverLink>, UniqueNodeID document);

    bool resolves_as(String const& serialized_base_url, Utf16String const& encoding) const;
    void set_base(URL::URL base_url, Utf16String encoding);

    // Notes the href of the link `element` is, or that it is no link.
    void set_link(u32 element, Optional<Utf16String> href);

    // Whether `element` is a link. From any thread.
    bool is_link(u32 element) const;

    // Tells the page of the link `element` is, or of no link where it is none. From any thread.
    void report(u32 element);

    // Tells the page that the pointer left the document. From any thread.
    void withdraw();

    // Tells the page of no more links, as the document is being replaced. A hover of the render clock shows the frame on
    // screen, which may still be of this document after the client has heard that its hover ended.
    void retire();

private:
    HoverLinkReporter(NonnullRefPtr<PageHoverLink>, UniqueNodeID document);

    NonnullRefPtr<PageHoverLink> m_hover_link;
    UniqueNodeID m_document;

    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    HashMap<u32, Utf16String> m_links;
    URL::URL m_base_url;
    Utf16String m_encoding;
    String m_encoding_name;
    bool m_is_retired { false };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Page/RenderingStats.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibGC/RootVector.h>
#include <LibGC/Weak.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakHashMap.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakHashSet.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/VM.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/MainThreadVM.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/StyleComputer.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/LocalNavigable.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/NavigableContainer.h>
#include <LibWeb/Page/Page.h>
#include <LibWeb/Page/RenderingStats.h>
#include <LibWeb/Streams/ReadableStream.h>

namespace Web {

struct PagePendingStats {
    RenderingPendingCounts last_counts {};
    GC::WeakHashSet<DOM::Document const> documents;
    bool logged { false };
};

struct PendingOperation {
    GC::Weak<DOM::Document const> document;
    RenderingPendingReason reason;
    GC::Weak<Streams::ReadableStream const> stream;
};

struct PendingStats {
    GC::WeakHashMap<Page const, PagePendingStats> pages;
    // By the address of each operation's token, which the token's finalizer can still name.
    HashMap<FlatPtr, PendingOperation> operations;
    GC::WeakHashMap<Streams::ReadableStream const, HashTable<FlatPtr>> streams;
    GC::WeakHashSet<Page const> dirty_pages;
    bool flush_queued { false };
    size_t task_depth { 0 };
};

static thread_local PendingStats* s_pending_stats;

static PendingStats& pending_stats()
{
    static thread_local NeverDestroyed<PendingStats> stats;
    s_pending_stats = &*stats;
    return *stats;
}

static void pending_changed(Page const& page)
{
    auto& stats = pending_stats();
    stats.dirty_pages.set(page);
    if (stats.flush_queued)
        return;
    stats.flush_queued = true;
    Core::deferred_invoke([] {
        s_pending_stats->flush_queued = false;
        // HTML tasks flush after their microtasks. Other engine callbacks flush at the Core event-loop boundary.
        if (!Bindings::main_thread_vm().has_running_execution_context())
            flush_rendering_pending();
    });
}

static void remove_pending_document(DOM::Document const& document, RenderingStats& stats)
{
    auto page = stats.pending_page.ptr();
    stats.pending_page = GC::Weak<Page const> {};
    if (!page || !s_pending_stats)
        return;
    auto page_stats = s_pending_stats->pages.get(*page);
    if (!page_stats.has_value())
        return;
    page_stats->documents.remove(document);
    pending_changed(*page);
}

void Detail::forget_rendering_stats(DOM::Document const& document)
{
    if (auto* stats = document.rendering_stats())
        remove_pending_document(document, *stats);
}

void Detail::set_rendering_pending(DOM::Document const& document, RenderingPendingReason reason, u64 count)
{
    if (!Core::StatsLog::the() || document.is_decoded_svg())
        return;
    auto& stats = document.ensure_rendering_stats();
    auto& previous = stats.pending[to_underlying(reason)];
    if (previous == count)
        return;
    if (auto page = stats.pending_page.ptr())
        pending_changed(*page);
    previous = count;
}

void Detail::rendering_pending_document_changed(DOM::Document const& document)
{
    if (!Core::StatsLog::the() || document.is_decoded_svg())
        return;
    auto& stats = document.ensure_rendering_stats();
    remove_pending_document(document, stats);
    auto& pages = pending_stats().pages;
    auto navigable = document.navigable();
    if (!navigable || document.has_been_destroyed() || !navigable->active_document_is(document))
        return;
    auto& page = document.page();
    auto& page_stats = pages.ensure(page);
    stats.pending_page = page;
    page_stats.documents.set(document);
    stats.displayed = navigable->is_local_root() || (navigable->container() && navigable->container()->stats_displayed());
    pending_changed(page);
    Detail::set_rendering_pending(document, RenderingPendingReason::NeedsRenderingUpdate, 1);
    Detail::set_rendering_pending(document, RenderingPendingReason::DocumentLoads, document.readiness() != HTML::DocumentReadyState::Complete);
}

void Detail::set_rendering_pending_displayed(HTML::Navigable const& navigable, bool displayed)
{
    auto const* local = as_if<HTML::LocalNavigable>(navigable);
    if (!local)
        return;
    if (auto document = local->active_document()) {
        auto& stats = document->ensure_rendering_stats();
        if (exchange(stats.displayed, displayed) != displayed && stats.pending_page)
            pending_changed(*stats.pending_page);
    }
}

void Detail::set_rendering_pending_ancestors_displayed(HTML::LocalNavigable& navigable, bool displayed)
{
    if (navigable.update_stats_ancestors_displayed(displayed))
        pending_changed(navigable.page());
}

void Detail::forget_rendering_pending(Page const& page)
{
    if (!s_pending_stats)
        return;
    auto page_stats = s_pending_stats->pages.get(page);
    if (!page_stats.has_value())
        return;
    for (auto& document : page_stats->documents)
        document.rendering_stats()->pending_page = GC::Weak<Page const> {};
    s_pending_stats->dirty_pages.remove(page);
    s_pending_stats->pages.remove(page);
}

static FlatPtr operation_key(GC::Cell const* token)
{
    return reinterpret_cast<FlatPtr>(token);
}

void Detail::begin_rendering_pending_operation(GC::Cell const* token, DOM::Document const& document, RenderingPendingReason reason)
{
    if (!Core::StatsLog::the() || document.is_decoded_svg())
        return;
    auto& operations = pending_stats().operations;
    VERIFY(!operations.contains(operation_key(token)));
    operations.set(operation_key(token), PendingOperation { document, reason, {} });
    Detail::set_rendering_pending(document, reason, document.ensure_rendering_stats().pending[to_underlying(reason)] + 1);
}

static void end_pending_operation(FlatPtr key)
{
    if (!s_pending_stats)
        return;
    auto pending_operation = s_pending_stats->operations.take(key);
    if (!pending_operation.has_value())
        return;
    auto& operation = *pending_operation;
    if (auto stream = operation.stream.ptr()) {
        if (auto tokens = s_pending_stats->streams.get(*stream); tokens.has_value()) {
            tokens->remove(key);
            if (tokens->is_empty())
                s_pending_stats->streams.remove(*stream);
        }
    }
    if (!operation.document)
        return;
    auto& document = *operation.document;
    auto& count = document.ensure_rendering_stats().pending[to_underlying(operation.reason)];
    VERIFY(count);
    Detail::set_rendering_pending(document, operation.reason, count - 1);
}

void Detail::end_rendering_pending_operation(GC::Cell const* token)
{
    end_pending_operation(operation_key(token));
}

void Detail::track_rendering_pending_stream(GC::Cell const* token, Streams::ReadableStream& stream)
{
    if (!s_pending_stats)
        return;
    auto operation = s_pending_stats->operations.get(operation_key(token));
    if (!operation.has_value())
        return;
    // Closing a source with unread queued bytes need not close its identity transform. Observe the source's
    // close request, before fetch installs that transform, so an unread response cannot keep the page pending.
    if (!stream.is_readable() || stream.close_requested()) {
        end_rendering_pending_operation(token);
        return;
    }
    VERIFY(!operation->stream);
    operation->stream = stream;
    s_pending_stats->streams.ensure(stream).set(operation_key(token));
}

void Detail::complete_rendering_pending_stream(Streams::ReadableStream const& stream)
{
    if (!s_pending_stats)
        return;
    auto stream_tokens = s_pending_stats->streams.get(stream);
    if (!stream_tokens.has_value())
        return;
    auto tokens = move(*stream_tokens);
    s_pending_stats->streams.remove(stream);
    for (auto token : tokens)
        end_pending_operation(token);
}

void Detail::did_update_rendering(DOM::Document& document)
{
    if (!Core::StatsLog::the())
        return;
    auto navigable = document.navigable();
    if (!navigable || navigable->needs_repaint() || document.needs_animated_style_update())
        return;
    if (auto* style_computer = document.style_computer_if_created(); style_computer && style_computer->style_engine().has_recorded_input())
        return;
    // A no-op style/layout update can consume an invalidation without committing a presentation.
    Detail::set_rendering_pending(document, RenderingPendingReason::NeedsRenderingUpdate, 0);
}

void Detail::flush_rendering_pending()
{
    auto* log = Core::StatsLog::the();
    if (!log || !s_pending_stats || s_pending_stats->task_depth)
        return;
    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<Page const>> dirty_pages;
    for (auto& page : s_pending_stats->dirty_pages)
        dirty_pages.append(page);
    s_pending_stats->dirty_pages.clear();
    for (auto page : dirty_pages) {
        auto page_stats = s_pending_stats->pages.get(page);
        if (!page_stats.has_value() || !page->has_top_level_traversable())
            continue;
        auto& stats = *page_stats;
        RenderingPendingCounts counts {};
        for (auto& document : stats.documents) {
            auto const& document_stats = *document.rendering_stats();
            auto navigable = document.navigable();
            auto local_root = navigable->local_root();
            if (local_root->parent() && !local_root->stats_ancestors_displayed())
                continue;
            if (!document_stats.displayed || document.visibility_state() != HTML::VisibilityState::Visible
                || navigable->has_inclusive_ancestor_with_visibility_hidden())
                continue;
            if (auto intersection = navigable->viewport_intersection(); intersection.has_value() && intersection->is_empty())
                continue;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < counts.size(); ++i)
                counts[i] += document_stats.pending[i];
        }
        if (stats.logged && counts == stats.last_counts)
            continue;
        static constexpr Array names {
            "needs_rendering_update"sv,
            "image_decodes"sv,
            "font_loads"sv,
            "style_sheet_loads"sv,
            "resource_fetches_in_flight"sv,
            "scheduled_animation_frame_callbacks"sv,
            "load_event_delayers"sv,
            "document_loads"sv,
        };
        static_assert(names.size() == to_underlying(RenderingPendingReason::Count));
        JsonObject reasons;
        bool pending = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < names.size(); ++i) {
            reasons.set(names[i], counts[i]);
            pending |= counts[i] != 0;
        }
        JsonObject data;
        data.set("page_id"sv, page->client().id().value());
        data.set("navigable_id"sv, MUST(String::formatted("{}", page->top_level_traversable()->id())));
        data.set("pending"sv, pending);
        data.set("reasons"sv, move(reasons));
        log->event("rendering_pending"sv, move(data));
        stats.last_counts = counts;
        stats.logged = true;
    }
}

void Detail::begin_rendering_pending_task()
{
    flush_rendering_pending();
    ++pending_stats().task_depth;
}

void Detail::end_rendering_pending_task()
{
    VERIFY(s_pending_stats && s_pending_stats->task_depth);
    --s_pending_stats->task_depth;
    flush_rendering_pending();
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Page/RenderingStats.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <LibCore/StatsLog.h>
#include <LibGC/Weak.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>

namespace Web {

enum class RenderingPendingReason {
    NeedsRenderingUpdate,
    ImageDecodes,
    FontLoads,
    StyleSheetLoads,
    ResourceFetchesInFlight,
    ScheduledAnimationFrameCallbacks,
    LoadEventDelayers,
    DocumentLoads,
    Count,
};

using RenderingPendingCounts = Array<u64, to_underlying(RenderingPendingReason::Count)>;

struct RenderingStats {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    RenderingPendingCounts pending {};
    GC::Weak<Page const> pending_page;
    bool displayed { true };
};

namespace Detail {

WEB_API void set_rendering_pending(DOM::Document const& document, RenderingPendingReason reason, u64 count);
WEB_API void rendering_pending_document_changed(DOM::Document const& document);
WEB_API void set_rendering_pending_displayed(HTML::Navigable const& navigable, bool displayed);
WEB_API void set_rendering_pending_ancestors_displayed(HTML::LocalNavigable&, bool);

namespace Web::Painting {

Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator mix_blend_mode_to_compositing_and_blending_operator(CSS::MixBlendMode blend_mode)
{
    switch (blend_mode) {
#undef __ENUMERATE
#define __ENUMERATE(blend_mode)         \
    case CSS::MixBlendMode::blend_mode: \
        return Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::blend_mode;
        ENUMERATE_MIX_BLEND_MODES(__ENUMERATE)
#undef __ENUMERATE
    default:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }
}

}

GC::Ptr<SVG::SVGFilterElement> resolve_svg_filter_reference(CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedStyleValueHandle const& url_value, Layout::NodeWithStyle const& layout_node)
{
    auto fragment = CSS::ComputedFilterView::url_fragment(url_value);
    auto referenced_element = fragment.is_empty() ? nullptr : layout_node.document().get_element_by_id(fragment);
    return referenced_element ? as_if<SVG::SVGFilterElement>(*referenced_element) : nullptr;
}

Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId committed_row_slot(Layout::Node const& node)

Optional<Layout::RustFFI::PaintableData> committed_row(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::PaintableData row;
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_row(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), &row))
        return {};
    return row;
}

bool has_committed_box(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    return Layout::RustFFI::render_state_has_paintable_row(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node));
}

Layout::Node* layout_node_for_committed_slot(Layout::BegunRead const& read, Layout::NodeArena& arena, Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId slot)
{
    return static_cast<Layout::Node*>(Layout::RustFFI::layout_row_paintable_layout_node_shell(arena.host(), &read, slot));
}

static PixelBox pixel_box_from_ffi(Layout::RustFFI::FfiPixelBox const& box)

    return { box.top, box.right, box.bottom, box.left };
}

    return content_size(node).width();
}

    return content_size(node).height();
}

BoxModelMetrics box_model(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiBoxModelMetrics metrics;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_script_paintable_box_model(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), &metrics);
    return {
        .margin = pixel_box_from_ffi(metrics.margin),
        .padding = pixel_box_from_ffi(metrics.padding),
        .border = pixel_box_from_ffi(metrics.border),
        .inset = pixel_box_from_ffi(metrics.inset),
    };
}

CSSPixels border_box_width(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto border_box = box_model(node).border_box();
    return content_width(node) + border_box.left + border_box.right;
}

CSSPixels border_box_height(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto border_box = box_model(node).border_box();
    return content_height(node) + border_box.top + border_box.bottom;
}

bool has_scrollable_overflow(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiOptionalOverflowData overflow;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_scrollable_overflow(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), &overflow);
    return overflow.has_value && overflow.value.has_scrollable_overflow;
}

Optional<CSSPixelRect> scrollable_overflow_rect(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiOptionalOverflowData overflow;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_scrollable_overflow(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), &overflow);
    if (!overflow.has_value)
        return {};
    return overflow.value.rect;
}

static bool layout_node_is_visible(Layout::NodeWithStyle const& layout_node)
{
    return layout_node.visibility() == CSS::Visibility::Visible && layout_node.opacity() != 0;
}

bool is_visible(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return false;
    return layout_node_is_visible(as<Layout::NodeWithStyle>(node));
}

bool visible_for_hit_testing(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return false;
    if (auto dom_node = node.dom_node(); dom_node && dom_node->is_inert())
        return false;
    return as<Layout::NodeWithStyle>(node).pointer_events() != CSS::PointerEvents::None;
}

bool has_stacking_context(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto row = committed_row(node);
    return row.has_value() && row->establishes_stacking_context;
}

CSS::Display display(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return {};
    return as<Layout::NodeWithStyle>(node).display();
}

bool is_positioned(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    return Layout::RustFFI::layout_row_paintable_is_positioned(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node));
}

CSS::StyleRecordID style_record_identity(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return {};
    return as<Layout::NodeWithStyle>(node).style_record_identity();
}

bool is_navigable_container_viewport_paintable(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    return has_committed_box(node) && node.kind() == Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::NavigableContainerViewport;
}

bool is_viewport_paintable(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    return has_committed_box(node) && node.kind() == Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::Viewport;
}

bool is_paintable_with_lines(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return false;
    switch (node.kind()) {
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::Viewport:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::BlockContainer:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::LegendBox:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::TableWrapper:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::TextAreaBox:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::TextInputBox:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::RangeInputBox:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::ListItemMarkerBox:
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::SVGForeignObjectBox:
        return true;
    case Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::ListItemBox:
        return !node.is_fragmented_inline();
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static bool is_inline_paintable(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    return has_committed_box(node) && node.is_fragmented_inline();
}

bool has_accumulated_visual_context(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto row = committed_row(node);
    return row.has_value() && row->has_accumulated_visual_context;
}

Compositing::ContextRef accumulated_visual_context(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto row = committed_row(node);
    return row.has_value() ? row->accumulated_visual_context : Compositing::ContextRef {};
}

Compositing::ContextRef accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto row = committed_row(node);
    return row.has_value() ? row->accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants : Compositing::ContextRef {};
}

Compositing::SpatialNodeIndex own_scroll_node_index(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto row = committed_row(node);
    return row.has_value() ? row->own_scroll_node_index : Compositing::VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX;
}

Optional<Layout::RustFFI::SvgGeometry> svg_geometry(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::SvgGeometry geometry;
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::render_state_svg_geometry(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), &geometry))
        return {};
    return geometry;
}

// The glyph cells a text content element's box committed for its own characters, one per code unit, copied out
// before any later commit can replace them.
Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgTextCharacterCell> svg_text_character_cells(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto result = Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_svg_text_character_cells(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node));
    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgTextCharacterCell> cells;
    cells.ensure_capacity(result.count);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < result.count; ++index)
        cells.unchecked_append(result.cells[index]);
    return cells;
}

Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform> svg_viewport_transform(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto result = Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_svg_viewport_transform(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node));
    if (!result.has_value)
        return {};
    auto const& transform = result.transform;
    return Gfx::AffineTransform { transform.a, transform.b, transform.c, transform.d, transform.e, transform.f };
}

Gfx::AffineTransform svg_element_transform(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto transform = Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_svg_element_transform(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node));
    return { transform.a, transform.b, transform.c, transform.d, transform.e, transform.f };
}

CSS::RustStyleValueHandle used_value_for_grid_template(Layout::Node const& node, CSS::PropertyID property)
{
    VERIFY(property == CSS::PropertyID::GridTemplateColumns || property == CSS::PropertyID::GridTemplateRows);
    auto* value = Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_used_grid_tracks(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), property == CSS::PropertyID::GridTemplateColumns);
    if (!value)
        return {};
    return CSS::RustStyleValueHandle { static_cast<CSS::StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const*>(value) };
}

CSSPixelPoint box_type_agnostic_position(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto row = committed_row(node);
    if (!row.has_value())
        return {};
    if (is_inline_paintable(node)) {
        Layout::RustFFI::FfiOptionalCssPixelPoint result;
        Layout::RustFFI::render_state_inline_paintable_first_piece_position(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), &result);
        if (result.has_value)
            return { result.x, result.y };
    }
    return absolute_position(node);
}

Optional<Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretPosition> layout_caret_position(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Node const& node, size_t offset, TextAffinity affinity)
{
    auto const* layout_node = node.unsafe_layout_node(read);
    if (!layout_node)
        return {};
    auto slot_of = [&](DOM::Node const* child) {
        auto const* child_layout_node = child ? child->unsafe_layout_node(read) : nullptr;
        return child_layout_node ? Layout::Node::slot_id(child_layout_node) : Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId { Compositing::RustFFI::INVALID_NODE_SLOT_INDEX };
    };
    auto const* child_before = offset > 0 ? node.child_at_index(offset - 1) : nullptr;
    return Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretPosition {
        .node = Layout::Node::slot_id(layout_node),
        .offset = offset,
        .downstream = affinity == TextAffinity::Downstream,
        .child_before = slot_of(child_before),
        .child_before_length = child_before ? child_before->length() : 0,
        .child_after = slot_of(node.child_at_index(offset)),
    };
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaret caret_at_position(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Position const& position, Layout::RustFFI::FfiViewportMapping viewport_mapping)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaret caret {};
    auto ffi_position = layout_caret_position(read, *position.node(), position.offset(), position.affinity());
    if (!ffi_position.has_value())
        return caret;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_script_caret(position.node()->unsafe_layout_node(read)->document_host(), *ffi_position, viewport_mapping, &caret);
    return caret;
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretPaint resolve_document_caret_paint(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document& document)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretPaint caret_paint {};
    Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId const no_slot { Compositing::RustFFI::INVALID_NODE_SLOT_INDEX };
    caret_paint.kind = Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretPaintKind::None;
    caret_paint.block = no_slot;
    caret_paint.owner = no_slot;

    auto cursor_position = document.cursor_position();
    if (!cursor_position)
        return caret_paint;
    // The caret paints only while the cursor node is editable (or a mutable text control has focus), and the recorder
    // paints it only while the window has focus.
    bool cursor_is_editable = false;
    if (auto const* text_control = as_if<HTML::FormAssociatedTextControlElement>(document.focused_area().ptr()); text_control && text_control->text_control_to_html_element().is_mutable())
        cursor_is_editable = true;
    else
        cursor_is_editable = cursor_position->node()->is_editable_or_editing_host();
    if (!cursor_is_editable)
        return caret_paint;

    auto caret = caret_at_position(read, *cursor_position, {});
    if (!caret.found)
        return caret_paint;
    auto const* style_source = static_cast<Layout::NodeWithStyle const*>(document.layout_node_arena().node_if_live(read, caret.style_source));
    if (!style_source || !layout_node_is_visible(*style_source))
        return caret_paint;
    caret_paint.kind = caret.paint;
    caret_paint.block = caret.block;
    caret_paint.owner = caret.owner;
    caret_paint.rect = caret.rect;
    caret_paint.color = style_source->caret_color();
    caret_paint.blink_cycle_start_time_ns = document.cursor_blink_cycle_start_time_ns();
    caret_paint.should_blink = !HTML::Window::in_test_mode();
    return caret_paint;
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiFocusedTextControlSelection resolve_focused_text_control_selection(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document const& document)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiFocusedTextControlSelection selection {};
    auto const* text_control = as_if<HTML::FormAssociatedTextControlElement>(document.focused_area().ptr());
    if (!text_control)
        return selection;
    auto text_node = text_control->form_associated_element_to_text_node();
    if (!text_node)
        return selection;
    auto selection_start = text_control->selection_start();
    auto selection_end = text_control->selection_end();
    if (selection_start == selection_end)
        return selection;
    auto const* text_layout_node = text_node->unsafe_layout_node(read);
    if (!text_layout_node)
        return selection;
    selection.text_node = Layout::Node::slot_id(text_layout_node);
    selection.start = selection_start;
    selection.end = selection_end;
    return selection;
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiFocusedAreaOutline resolve_focused_area_outline(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document const& document)
{
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#focusable-area
    // The shapes of area elements in an image map associated with an img element that is being rendered and is not
    // inert. Focused area elements have no box of their own, so the image whose rendering makes the area's shape a
    // focusable area paints the focus outline along that shape.
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiFocusedAreaOutline outline {};
    auto const* area_element = as_if<HTML::HTMLAreaElement>(document.focused_area().ptr());
    if (!area_element)
        return outline;
    auto const* map_element = area_element->first_ancestor_of_type<HTML::HTMLMapElement>();
    if (!map_element)
        return outline;
    auto image_element = map_element->first_painted_image_with_focusable_shapes(read);
    if (!image_element)
        return outline;
    auto const* layout_node = image_element->layout_node(read);
    if (!layout_node || !has_committed_box(*layout_node))
        return outline;
    auto area_computed_values = area_element->computed_style();
    if (!area_computed_values || area_computed_values->outline_style() != CSS::OutlineStyle::Auto)
        return outline;
    outline.image = committed_row_slot(*layout_node);
    outline.area = DOM::NodeIdentity::of(*area_element).style_node().value();
    return outline;
}

CSSPixelRect transform_reference_box(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    CSSPixelRect rect;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_transform_reference_box(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), &rect);
    return rect;
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiViewportMapping viewport_mapping(DOM::Document const& document)
{
    if (!document.has_committed_viewport_box())
        return {};
    return document.paint_state().viewport_mapping(document, {}, document.page().client().device_pixels_per_css_pixel());
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiViewportMapping viewport_mapping_with_visual_animations_sampled_at(DOM::Document const& document, MonotonicTime sample_time)
{
    if (!document.has_committed_viewport_box())
        return {};
    return document.paint_state().viewport_mapping(document, sample_time, document.page().client().device_pixels_per_css_pixel());
}

// NB: Making a viewport mapping brings the document's visual context tree up to date, which can compact it and move a
//     box's visual context to other nodes. The functions below read a box's visual context only once they have the
//     mapping.
CSSPixelRect rect_to_viewport(Layout::Node const& node, CSSPixelRect const& rect, Layout::RustFFI::ViewportSpace space)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return {};
    auto mapping = viewport_mapping(node.document());
    CSSPixelRect result;
    Layout::RustFFI::viewport_mapping_rect_in_space_to_viewport(mapping, accumulated_visual_context(node).spatial, rect, space, &result);
    return result;
}

CSSPixelRect visible_rect_in_containing_blocks(Layout::Node const& node, CSSPixelRect const& rect, Layout::RustFFI::ViewportSpace space)
{
    auto mapping = viewport_mapping(node.document());
    CSSPixelRect visible;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_visible_rect_in_containing_blocks(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), mapping, rect, space, &visible);
    return visible;
}

CSSPixelPoint point_to_local(Layout::Node const& node, CSSPixelPoint point, Layout::RustFFI::ViewportSpace space)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return {};
    auto mapping = viewport_mapping(node.document());
    CSSPixelPoint local;
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::viewport_mapping_point_to_local(mapping, accumulated_visual_context(node), point, space, &local))
        return point;
    return local;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-mouseevent-offsetx
CSSPixelPoint mouse_event_offset(Layout::Node const& node, CSSPixelPoint viewport_position)
{
    // The position where the event occurred, ignoring the transforms that apply to the element and its ancestors,
    // relative to the origin of the padding edge of the target node.
    return point_to_local(node, viewport_position, Layout::RustFFI::ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport) - box_type_agnostic_position(node);
}

CSSPixelPoint presented_scroll_offset(Layout::Node const& node, CSSPixelPoint scroll_offset)
{
    auto const& document = node.document();
    if (!has_committed_box(node) || !document.has_committed_viewport_box())
        return scroll_offset;
    if (!document.paint_state().translations_snap_to_device_pixels(document, committed_row_slot(node)))
        return scroll_offset;
    auto pixel_ratio = document.page().client().device_pixels_per_css_pixel();
    auto snap = [&](CSSPixels value) { return CSSPixels::nearest_value_for(round(value.to_double() * pixel_ratio) / pixel_ratio); };
    return { snap(scroll_offset.x()), snap(scroll_offset.y()) };
}

Optional<String> grid_layout_json(Layout::Node const& node, UniqueNodeID container_node_id)
{
    Optional<String> result;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_grid_layout_json(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), container_node_id.value(), &result,
        [](void* context, u8 const* bytes, size_t length) {
            *static_cast<Optional<String>*>(context) = MUST(String::from_utf8(StringView { bytes, length }));
        });
    return result;
}

// The devtools protocol names a flex item by its DOM node's unique id, while the layout row that
// recorded the item names it by its style node.
static i64 devtools_node_id_for_style_node(void const* context, u32 style_node)
{
    auto const& document = *static_cast<DOM::Document const*>(context);
    auto dom_node = document.style_computer().node_for_style_node(CSS::StyleNodeID { style_node });
    return dom_node ? dom_node->unique_id().value() : -1;
}

Optional<String> flex_layout_json(Layout::Node const& node, UniqueNodeID container_node_id)
{
    Optional<String> result;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_paintable_flex_layout_json(
        node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), container_node_id.value(), &result,
        [](void* context, u8 const* bytes, size_t length) {
            *static_cast<Optional<String>*>(context) = MUST(String::from_utf8(StringView { bytes, length }));
        },
        &node.document(), devtools_node_id_for_style_node);
    return result;
}

DOM::NodeIdentity node_identity_of(Layout::RustFFI::FfiNodeIdentity identity)
{
    if (identity.is_document)
        return DOM::NodeIdentity::of_document();
    return DOM::NodeIdentity::of_style_node(CSS::StyleNodeID { identity.style_node });
}

void push_highlight_pseudo_styles(DOM::Element const& element)
{
    auto* arena = const_cast<DOM::Document&>(element.document()).layout_node_arena_if_created();
    if (!arena)
        return;
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_sync_highlight_pseudo_styles(arena->host(), element.style_node_id().value(), element.style_record_identity(CSS::PseudoElement::Selection).value(), element.style_record_identity(CSS::PseudoElement::SearchText).value(), element.style_record_identity(CSS::PseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent).value(), element.style_record_identity(CSS::PseudoElement::SpellingError).value());
    Vector<u32, 4> names;
    Vector<u64, 4> style_records;
    if (auto const* styles = element.custom_highlight_styles()) {
        for (auto const& [name, style] : *styles) {
            names.append(name.value());
            style_records.append(style.record().value());
        }
    }
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_sync_custom_highlight_pseudo_styles(arena->host(), element.style_node_id().value(), names.span(), style_records.span());
}

class BoxViewRepaintAccess {
public:
    static void set_document_needs_repaint(DOM::Document& document, InvalidateDisplayList should_invalidate_display_list)
    {
        document.set_needs_repaint(Badge<BoxViewRepaintAccess> {}, should_invalidate_display_list);
    }
};

void mark_box(Layout::Node const& node, Layout::RustFFI::FfiBoxMarks marks)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_mark_row_box(node.document_host(), Layout::Node::slot_id(&node), marks);
    BoxViewRepaintAccess::set_document_needs_repaint(const_cast<DOM::Document&>(node.document()), display_list_invalidation_of(marks));
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiBoxMarks repaint_marks(InvalidateDisplayList should_invalidate_display_list)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiBoxMarks marks {};
    marks.repaint = should_invalidate_display_list != InvalidateDisplayList::No;
    marks.repaint_hit_testing = should_invalidate_display_list == InvalidateDisplayList::PaintCommandsAndHitTestList;
    return marks;
}

InvalidateDisplayList display_list_invalidation_of(Layout::RustFFI::FfiBoxMarks marks)
{
    if (marks.repaint_hit_testing || marks.repaint_subtree || marks.has_dom_paint_facts)
        return InvalidateDisplayList::PaintCommandsAndHitTestList;
    return marks.repaint ? InvalidateDisplayList::PaintCommands : InvalidateDisplayList::No;
}

void set_needs_repaint(Layout::Node const& node, InvalidateDisplayList should_invalidate_display_list)
{
    if (has_committed_box(node))
        mark_box(node, repaint_marks(should_invalidate_display_list));
}

void request_document_repaint(DOM::Document const& document, InvalidateDisplayList should_invalidate_display_list)
{
    BoxViewRepaintAccess::set_document_needs_repaint(const_cast<DOM::Document&>(document), should_invalidate_display_list);
}

void set_needs_repaint_in_subtree(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    if (!has_committed_box(node))
        return;
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiBoxMarks marks {};
    marks.repaint_subtree = true;
    mark_box(node, marks);
}

static void invalidate_propagated_text_decoration_caches(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiBoxMarks marks {};
    marks.propagated_text_decorations = true;
    mark_box(node, marks);
}

void repaint_after_style_change(Layout::Node const& node, CSS::RequiredInvalidationAfterStyleChange const& invalidation)
{
    if (invalidation.needs_repaint())
        set_needs_repaint(node, invalidation.invalidates_hit_test_display_list() ? InvalidateDisplayList::PaintCommandsAndHitTestList : InvalidateDisplayList::PaintCommands);
    if (invalidation.repaint_propagated_text_decorations)
        invalidate_propagated_text_decoration_caches(node);
    if (invalidation.needs_stacking_context_tree_rebuild())
        const_cast<DOM::Document&>(node.document()).schedule_accumulated_visual_context_update(node, DOM::Document::AccumulatedVisualContextUpdateScope::Structure);
}

Vector<CSSPixelRect> client_rects(Layout::Node const& node, Layout::RustFFI::FfiViewportMapping const& viewport_mapping)
{
    Vector<CSSPixelRect> rects;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_script_client_rects(
        node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), viewport_mapping, &rects,
        [](void* context, CSSPixelRect rect) {
            static_cast<Vector<CSSPixelRect>*>(context)->append(rect);
        });
    return rects;
}

bool has_sticky_positioned_inclusive_ancestor(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    return Layout::RustFFI::layout_script_has_sticky_positioned_inclusive_ancestor(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node));
}

CSSPixelPoint accumulated_sticky_offset(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    CSSPixelPoint offset;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_script_accumulated_sticky_offset(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), viewport_mapping(node.document()), &offset);
    return offset;
}

CSSPixelRect bounding_client_rect(Layout::Node const& node, Layout::RustFFI::FfiViewportMapping const& viewport_mapping)
{
    CSSPixelRect rect;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_script_bounding_client_rect(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), viewport_mapping, &rect);
    return rect;
}

CSSPixelPoint offset_to_viewport_ignoring_transforms(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    CSSPixelPoint offset;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_script_offset_to_viewport_ignoring_transforms(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node), viewport_mapping(node.document()), &offset);
    return offset;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <LibWebCommon/PixelUnits.h>

namespace Web {

struct ChromeMetrics {
    // Chrome sizing constants independent of page zoom.
    static constexpr CSSPixels ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_MIN_LENGTH { 24 };
    static constexpr CSSPixels ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_PADDING_THIN { 2 };
    static constexpr CSSPixels ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_THICKNESS_THIN { 7 };
    static constexpr CSSPixels ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_THICKNESS { 11 };
    static constexpr CSSPixels ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_GUTTER_THICKNESS { 15 };
    static constexpr CSSPixels ZOOM_INVARIANT_RESIZE_GRIPPER_SIZE { 12 };
    static constexpr CSSPixels ZOOM_INVARIANT_RESIZE_GRIPPER_PADDING { 2 };

    ChromeMetrics() = default;
    explicit ChromeMetrics(double zoom_factor)
    {
        VERIFY(zoom_factor > 0);
        // So we can still use device_pixels_per_css_pixel transforms at paint time.
        CSSPixels const inverse_zoom { 1.0 / zoom_factor };
        scroll_thumb_min_length = ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_MIN_LENGTH * inverse_zoom;
        scroll_thumb_padding_thin = ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_PADDING_THIN * inverse_zoom;
        scroll_thumb_thickness_thin = ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_THICKNESS_THIN * inverse_zoom;
        scroll_thumb_thickness = ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_THUMB_THICKNESS * inverse_zoom;
        scroll_gutter_thickness = ZOOM_INVARIANT_SCROLL_GUTTER_THICKNESS * inverse_zoom;
        resize_gripper_size = ZOOM_INVARIANT_RESIZE_GRIPPER_SIZE * inverse_zoom;
        resize_gripper_padding = ZOOM_INVARIANT_RESIZE_GRIPPER_PADDING * inverse_zoom;
    }
    CSSPixels scroll_thumb_min_length;
    CSSPixels scroll_thumb_padding_thin;
    CSSPixels scroll_thumb_thickness_thin;
    CSSPixels scroll_thumb_thickness;
    CSSPixels scroll_gutter_thickness;
    CSSPixels resize_gripper_size;
    CSSPixels resize_gripper_padding;
};

}

/*

#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/Node.h>
#include <LibWeb/Painting/BoxViews.h>
#include <LibWeb/Painting/ChromeWidget.h>
#include <LibWeb/Painting/ResizeHandle.h>

namespace Web::Painting {

ChromeWidgetRegistry::ChromeWidgetRegistry() = default;

ChromeWidgetRegistry::~ChromeWidgetRegistry()
{
    clear();
}

RefPtr<ResizeHandle> ChromeWidgetRegistry::resize_handle(Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId slot) const
{
    auto resize_handle = m_resize_handles.find(slot.index);
    if (resize_handle == m_resize_handles.end())
        return nullptr;
    return resize_handle->value;
}

NonnullRefPtr<ResizeHandle> ChromeWidgetRegistry::get_or_create_resize_handle(Layout::NodeArena& arena, Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId slot)
{
    return m_resize_handles.ensure(slot.index, [&] { return ResizeHandle::create(arena, slot); });
}

void ChromeWidgetRegistry::drop_widgets_for_slot(Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId slot)
{
    if (auto resize_handle = m_resize_handles.take(slot.index); resize_handle.has_value())
        resize_handle.value()->detach({});
}

void ChromeWidgetRegistry::clear()
{
    for (auto& entry : m_resize_handles)
        entry.value->detach({});
    m_resize_handles.clear();
}

ChromeWidget::ChromeWidget(Layout::NodeArena& arena, Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId slot)
    : m_arena(arena)
    , m_slot(slot)
{
}

Layout::Node* ChromeWidget::layout_node() const
{
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { m_arena->render_document() };
    return layout_node_for_committed_slot(read, *m_arena, m_slot);
}

void ChromeWidget::detach(Badge<ChromeWidgetRegistry>)
{
    did_detach();
    m_slot = Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId_INVALID;
}

PhysicalResizeAxes physical_resize_axes(Layout::Node const& node)
{
    auto axes = Layout::RustFFI::layout_row_paintable_physical_resize_axes(node.document_host(), committed_row_slot(node));
    return { axes.horizontal, axes.vertical };
}

BlockingWheelEventRegionState DocumentPaintState::collect_root_blocking_wheel_event_regions(DOM::Document& document)
{
    GC::Ptr<DOM::EventTarget> roots[] = {
        document.navigable() ? document.navigable()->active_window() : nullptr,
        &document,
        document.document_element(),
        document.body(),
    };
    for (auto target : roots) {
        if (target && target->has_blocking_wheel_event_listener()) {
            return {
                .has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners = true,
                .has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport = true,
            };
        }
    }
    return {};
}

void DocumentPaintState::viewport_row_was_reset()
{
    Layout::RustFFI::document_host_viewport_row_was_reset(m_layout_node_arena->host());
    m_boxes_with_auto_content_visibility.clear();
}

    rust_update_visual_viewport_transform(read, document);
}

void DocumentPaintState::publish_compositor_animations(Layout::BegunRead const& read, PublishPendingCompositorAnimations publish_pending)
{
    auto outcome = Layout::RustFFI::render_state_publish_compositor_animations(m_layout_node_arena->host(), &read, publish_pending == PublishPendingCompositorAnimations::Yes);
    if (!outcome.published)
        return;
    if (outcome.parameters_changed)
        HTML::note_rendering_trace_event("compositor animations updated"sv);
    if (outcome.timing_anchors_changed)
        HTML::note_rendering_trace_event("compositor animation timing anchor updated"sv);
}

void DocumentPaintState::republish_visual_animations(Layout::BegunRead const& read)

        return;
    did_update_visual_context_values();
    HTML::note_rendering_trace_event("compositor animations updated"sv);
}

    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_viewport_mapping(m_layout_node_arena->host(), read, sample_time_ns.has_value(), sample_time_ns.value_or(0), static_cast<float>(device_pixels_per_css_pixel), &mapping);
    return mapping;
}

void DocumentPaintState::reset_selection_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document& document)

static void append_highlight_entry(Layout::BegunRead const& read, Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSelectionEntry>& entries, DOM::Node& container, SelectionState state)
{
    if (is<DOM::Text>(container)) {
        if (auto* layout_node = container.unsafe_layout_node(read)) {
            entries.append({
                .is_text_node_entry = true,
                .layout_node = Layout::Node::slot_id(layout_node),
                .state = to_underlying(state),
            });
        }
        return;
    }
    if (auto* layout_node = container.unsafe_layout_node(read)) {
        if (has_committed_box(*layout_node)) {
            entries.append({
                .is_text_node_entry = false,
                .layout_node = Layout::Node::slot_id(layout_node),
                .state = to_underlying(state),
            });
        }
    }
}

template<typename IsExcluded, typename Callback>
static void for_each_node_in_highlight_range(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::AbstractRange const& range, IsExcluded is_excluded, Callback callback)
{
    auto start_container = range.start_container();
    auto end_container = range.end_container();

    // 2. If the selection starts and ends in the same node:
    if (start_container == end_container) {
        // 1. If the selection starts and ends at the same offset, return.
        if (range.start_offset() == range.end_offset()) {
            // NOTE: A zero-length selection should not be visible.
            return;
        }

        // 2. If it's a text node, mark it as StartAndEnd and return.
        if (is<DOM::Text>(*start_container) && !is_excluded(*start_container)) {
            callback(*start_container, SelectionState::StartAndEnd);
            return;
        }
    }

    // 3. Mark the selection start node as Start (if text) or Full (if anything else).
    if (!is_excluded(*start_container) && start_container->unsafe_layout_node(read)) {
        if (is<DOM::Text>(*start_container))
            callback(*start_container, SelectionState::Start);
        else
            callback(*start_container, SelectionState::Full);
    }

    // 4. Mark the nodes between the start and end of the selection as Full.
    auto* start_at = start_container->child_at_index(range.start_offset());
    // If the start container has no child at that index, nothing of what it holds is in the range, and we need to start
    // on the node right after it. If the end container holds nothing after it, there is no node to mark.
    if (!start_at) {
        for (auto* node = start_container.ptr(); node && node != end_container.ptr() && !start_at; node = node->parent())
            start_at = node->next_sibling();
    }

    DOM::Node* stop_at = end_container->child_at_index(range.end_offset());
    // Only stop at the end container if it has no children that may need to be included.
    for (auto* node = start_at; node && (node != stop_at && !(node == end_container.ptr() && !end_container->has_children())); node = node->next_in_pre_order(end_container.ptr())) {
        if (is_excluded(*node))
            continue;
        callback(*node, SelectionState::Full);
    }

    // 5. Mark the selection end node as End if it is a text node.
    if (!is_excluded(*end_container) && is<DOM::Text>(*end_container) && end_container->unsafe_layout_node(read)) {
        callback(*end_container, SelectionState::End);
    }
}

void DocumentPaintState::recompute_selection_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document& document, DOM::Range& range)
{
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ui/#valdef-user-select-none
    // "The content of the element must be excluded from selection by [...] the selection methods of the Selection API
    // and the like." We honor this by leaving such nodes at SelectionState::None — even when they fall inside the
    // range. So, the selection highlight skips them.
    auto is_excluded_from_selection = [&read](DOM::Node const& node) {
        if (node.is_inert())
            return true;
        auto const* layout = node.unsafe_layout_node(read);
        return layout && layout->user_select_used_value() == CSS::UserSelect::None;
    };

    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSelectionEntry> entries;
    for_each_node_in_highlight_range(read, range, is_excluded_from_selection, [&](DOM::Node& node, SelectionState state) {
        append_highlight_entry(read, entries, node, state);
    });
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_apply_selection(m_layout_node_arena->host(), viewport_row_slot(read, document), entries.span(), range.start_offset(), range.end_offset());
}

void DocumentPaintState::reset_search_text_states()
{
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_clear_search_text(m_layout_node_arena->host());
}

void DocumentPaintState::recompute_search_text_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document& document, GC::Ptr<DOM::Range> active_match, Vector<GC::Ref<DOM::Range>> const& highlighted_matches)
{
    auto is_excluded_from_search_text = [](DOM::Node const&) { return false; };

    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSearchTextRange> ranges;
    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSelectionEntry> entries;
    auto append_range = [&](DOM::Range& range, bool is_current) {
        auto first_entry = entries.size();
        for_each_node_in_highlight_range(read, range, is_excluded_from_search_text, [&](DOM::Node& node, SelectionState state) {
            if (is<DOM::Text>(node))
                append_highlight_entry(read, entries, node, state);
        });
        if (entries.size() == first_entry)
            return;
        ranges.append({
            .first_entry = first_entry,
            .entry_count = entries.size() - first_entry,
            .start_offset = range.start_offset(),
            .end_offset = range.end_offset(),
            .is_current = is_current,
        });
    };
    for (auto const& match : highlighted_matches) {
        if (match.ptr() != active_match.ptr())
            append_range(*match, false);
    }
    if (active_match)
        append_range(*active_match, true);
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_apply_search_text(m_layout_node_arena->host(), viewport_row_slot(read, document), ranges.span(), entries.span());
}

// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#contained
// A node node is contained in a live range range if node’s root is range’s root, and (node, 0) is after range’s
// start, and (node, node’s length) is before range’s end.
static bool range_contains_node(DOM::AbstractRange const& range, DOM::Node& node)
{
    if (&node.root() != &range.start_container()->root())
        return false;
    auto length = static_cast<WebIDL::UnsignedLong>(node.length());
    return DOM::position_of_boundary_point_relative_to_other_boundary_point({ node, 0 }, range.start()) == DOM::RelativeBoundaryPointPosition::After
        && DOM::position_of_boundary_point_relative_to_other_boundary_point({ node, length }, range.end()) == DOM::RelativeBoundaryPointPosition::Before;
}

void DocumentPaintState::reset_custom_highlight_states()
{
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_clear_custom_highlights(m_layout_node_arena->host());
}

void DocumentPaintState::recompute_custom_highlight_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document& document, CSS::HighlightRegistry& registry)
{
    auto& style_engine = document.style_computer().style_engine();
    Vector<u32> layers;
    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiCustomHighlightTextEntry> text_entries;
    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiCustomHighlightReplacedEntry> replaced_entries;
    auto is_excluded = [](DOM::Node const&) { return false; };
    registry.for_each_highlight_in_stacking_order([&](Utf16String const& name, ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<DOM::AbstractRange>> ranges) {
        auto layer = static_cast<u32>(layers.size());
        bool covers_something = false;
        for (auto const& range : ranges) {
            if (!CSS::HighlightRegistry::range_is_paintable(document, *range))
                continue;
            for_each_node_in_highlight_range(read, *range, is_excluded, [&](DOM::Node& node, SelectionState state) {
                auto* layout_node = node.unsafe_layout_node(read);
                if (!layout_node)
                    return;
                if (is<DOM::Text>(node)) {
                    bool starts_in_node = state == SelectionState::Start || state == SelectionState::StartAndEnd;
                    bool ends_in_node = state == SelectionState::End || state == SelectionState::StartAndEnd;
                    text_entries.append({
                        .layer = layer,
                        .layout_node = Layout::Node::slot_id(layout_node),
                        .start_offset = starts_in_node ? range->start_offset() : 0,
                        .end_offset = ends_in_node ? range->end_offset() : NumericLimits<size_t>::max(),
                    });
                    covers_something = true;
                    return;
                }
                if (layout_node->kind() == Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::ImageBox && has_committed_box(*layout_node) && range_contains_node(*range, node)) {
                    replaced_entries.append({
                        .layer = layer,
                        .layout_node = Layout::Node::slot_id(layout_node),
                    });
                    covers_something = true;
                }
            });
        }
        if (covers_something)
            layers.append(style_engine.intern_atom(Utf16FlyString { name }).value());
    });
    if (text_entries.is_empty() && replaced_entries.is_empty()) {
        reset_custom_highlight_states();
        return;
    }
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_apply_custom_highlights(m_layout_node_arena->host(), viewport_row_slot(read, document), layers.span(), text_entries.span(), replaced_entries.span());
}

void DocumentPaintState::reset_spelling_error_states()
{
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_clear_spelling_errors(m_layout_node_arena->host());
}

void DocumentPaintState::recompute_spelling_error_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document& document, Editing::SpellingMarkers& markers)
{
    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSpellingError> errors;
    markers.for_each_marked_text([&](DOM::Text& text, ReadonlySpan<Editing::SpellingMarker> text_markers) {
        auto* layout_node = text.unsafe_layout_node(read);
        if (!layout_node)
            return;
        for (auto const& marker : text_markers) {
            errors.append({
                .layout_node = Layout::Node::slot_id(layout_node),
                .start_offset = marker.start,
                .end_offset = marker.end,
            });
        }
    });
    Layout::RustFFI::render_state_apply_spelling_errors(m_layout_node_arena->host(), viewport_row_slot(read, document), errors.span());
}

}

struct BlockingWheelEventRegionState {
    bool has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners { false };
    bool has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport { false };
};

class WEB_API DocumentPaintState {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit DocumentPaintState(Layout::NodeArena&);

    void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor) const { m_layout_node_arena->visit_edges(visitor); }

    void viewport_row_was_reset();

    BlockingWheelEventRegionState collect_root_blocking_wheel_event_regions(DOM::Document&);

    // The mapping through the document's visual context tree, brought up to date, with the compositor's animations
    // sampled at the time where one is given. It reads the scroll state, and the tree the host keeps for its mappings,
    // where it is used.
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiViewportMapping viewport_mapping(DOM::Document const&, Optional<MonotonicTime> visual_animation_sample_time, double device_pixels_per_css_pixel) const;
    // Whether the scroll translations of the space the box is painted in, and the origins drawn in it, round to whole
    // device pixels: no transform but identities lies above it in the visual context tree, brought up to date.
    bool translations_snap_to_device_pixels(DOM::Document const&, Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId box) const;
    // Only the scroll logic of the compositor, which is Rust, decodes it.
    void did_update_visual_context_values();

    void update_visual_viewport_accumulated_visual_context(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document&);
    // An update pass publishes each effect's compositor animations into a list the tree takes at the end.
    void begin_compositor_animation_update();
    enum class PublishPendingCompositorAnimations {
        No,
        Yes,
    };
    void publish_compositor_animations(Layout::BegunRead const& read, PublishPendingCompositorAnimations);
    void republish_visual_animations(Layout::BegunRead const& read);
    // Whether the visual context tree changed since a frame last took it to the compositor, which the caller's frame now
    // does.
    bool take_visual_context_tree_compositor_update(Layout::BegunRead const& read);
    bool has_visual_context_tree(Layout::BegunRead const& read) const;
    void append_recording_trace(String trace) { m_recording_traces.append(move(trace)); }
    Vector<String> take_recording_traces() { return exchange(m_recording_traces, {}); }

    void recompute_selection_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document&, DOM::Range&);
    void reset_selection_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document&);
    void recompute_search_text_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document&, GC::Ptr<DOM::Range> active_match, Vector<GC::Ref<DOM::Range>> const& highlighted_matches);
    void reset_search_text_states();
    void recompute_spelling_error_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document&, Editing::SpellingMarkers&);
    void reset_spelling_error_states();
    void recompute_custom_highlight_states(Layout::BegunRead const& read, DOM::Document&, CSS::HighlightRegistry&);
    void reset_custom_highlight_states();

    void set_boxes_with_auto_content_visibility(Vector<Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId> boxes) { m_boxes_with_auto_content_visibility = move(boxes); }
    Vector<Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId> const& boxes_with_auto_content_visibility() const { return m_boxes_with_auto_content_visibility; }

    u64 visual_context_tree_structural_epoch(Layout::BegunRead const& read) const;

private:
    Vector<String> m_recording_traces;

    NonnullRefPtr<Layout::NodeArena> m_layout_node_arena;

    Vector<Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId> m_boxes_with_auto_content_visibility;
};

Layout::RustFFI::FfiHitTestQuery HitTestQuery::ffi_query() const
{
    return {
        .device_pixels_per_css_pixel = m_device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
        .chrome_metrics = m_chrome_metrics,
        .has_visual_animation_sample_time = m_visual_animation_sample_time_nanoseconds.has_value(),
        .visual_animation_sample_time_ns = m_visual_animation_sample_time_nanoseconds.value_or(0),
    };
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/image-maps.html#image-map-processing-model
// NB: The image publishes the areas of the map it is associated with onto its row, so the hit names one of them without
//     asking the DOM for the map or for the areas' attributes.
static DOM::NodeIdentity image_map_area_for_point(Layout::Node const& layout_node, CSSPixelPoint local_point)
{
    // For historical reasons, the coordinates must be interpreted relative to the displayed image after any stretching
    // caused by the CSS 'width' and 'height' properties.
    auto point = (local_point - Painting::absolute_rect(layout_node).location()).to_type<float>();
    auto area = Layout::RustFFI::layout_image_map_area_for_point(layout_node.document_host(), Layout::Node::slot_id(&layout_node), point.x(), point.y());
    if (area == 0)
        return {};
    return DOM::NodeIdentity::of_style_node(CSS::StyleNodeID { area });
}

HitTestResult HitTestQuery::hit_test_result_for(Layout::BegunRead const& read, Layout::RustFFI::FfiPointHit const& hit) const
{
    CSSPixelPoint local_point = hit.local;
    auto const* paintable_layout_node = layout_node_for_committed_slot(read, *m_arena, hit.paintable);
    auto hit_node = hit.hit_node;

    auto const* named_layout_node = layout_node_for_committed_slot(read, *m_arena, hit_node);
    VERIFY(named_layout_node && as<Layout::NodeWithStyle>(*named_layout_node).pointer_events() != CSS::PointerEvents::None);

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-document-elementfrompoint
    // 2. If there is a box in the viewport that would be a target for hit testing at coordinates x,y, when applying
    //    the transforms that apply to the descendants of the viewport, return the associated element and terminate
    //    these steps.
    // 3. If the document has a root element, return the root element and terminate these steps.
    // AD-HOC: Our viewport refers to the document instead of the root element. The steps above imply that we should
    //         not hit test the viewport as a box, and report the root element as hit when we otherwise miss, so we
    //         correct those hits here. This is where both pointer event hit testing and elementFromPoint() converge.
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> root_element;
    if (paintable_layout_node && paintable_layout_node->kind() == Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::Viewport) {
        auto* named_element = const_cast<DOM::Element*>(paintable_layout_node->document().document_element());
        if (auto* root_layout_node = named_element ? named_element->unsafe_layout_node(read) : nullptr; root_layout_node && has_committed_box(*root_layout_node)) {
            root_element = named_element;
            hit_node = committed_row_slot(*root_layout_node);
        }
    }

    auto const& resolved = hit.resolved;
    auto identity = DOM::NodeIdentity::of(root_element.ptr());
    // NB: Style runs before layout, so a laid-out document's style engine tracks its tree and every connected element
    //     in it has a StyleNodeID.
    VERIFY(!root_element || identity);
    if (identity.is_none() && paintable_layout_node)
        identity = image_map_area_for_point(*paintable_layout_node, local_point);
    if (identity.is_none())
        identity = node_identity_of(resolved.dispatch);
    if (identity.is_none())
        identity = node_identity_of(resolved.fallback_dispatch);

    auto chrome_widget_kind = static_cast<ChromeWidgetKind>(hit.chrome_widget_kind);
    RefPtr<ChromeWidget> chrome_widget;
    if (chrome_widget_kind == ChromeWidgetKind::ResizeHandle)
        chrome_widget = m_chrome_widget_registry->get_or_create_resize_handle(*m_arena, hit.paintable);

    auto result = HitTestResult {
        .node = identity,
        .hit_node = hit_node,
        .arena = *m_arena,
        .chrome_widget = move(chrome_widget),
        .is_scrollbar = first_is_one_of(chrome_widget_kind, ChromeWidgetKind::HorizontalScrollbar, ChromeWidgetKind::VerticalScrollbar),
        .is_text_fragment = resolved.is_text_fragment,
    };
    if (resolved.has_index_in_node)
        result.index_in_node = resolved.index_in_node;
    return result;
}

Optional<CaretPosition> HitTestQuery::caret_position_from(Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretAt const& caret_at) const
{
    auto const& resolved = caret_at.caret;
    if (!resolved.has_position)
        return {};
    auto* document = m_arena->document();
    if (!document)
        return {};
    auto dom_node = node_identity_of(resolved.node).resolve(*document);
    if (!dom_node)
        return {};

    Optional<CSSPixelRect> debug_rect;
    if (resolved.has_debug_rect)
        debug_rect = resolved.debug_rect;

    switch (resolved.boundary) {
    case Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretBoundaryKind::Offset:
        return CaretPosition {
            .paintable = caret_at.paintable,
            .arena = *m_arena,
            .boundary = { DOM::NodeIdentity::of(*dom_node), static_cast<WebIDL::UnsignedLong>(resolved.offset) },
            .affinity = resolved.affinity_is_upstream ? TextAffinity::Upstream : TextAffinity::Downstream,
            .debug_rect = debug_rect,
        };
    case Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretBoundaryKind::BeforeNode:
    case Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretBoundaryKind::AfterNode:
    case Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretBoundaryKind::IndexOfNodeInParent:
        break;
    }

    auto* parent = dom_node->parent();
    if (!parent)
        return {};
    auto parent_identity = DOM::NodeIdentity::of(*parent);
    if (resolved.boundary == Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretBoundaryKind::IndexOfNodeInParent) {
        return CaretPosition {
            .paintable = caret_at.paintable,
            .arena = *m_arena,
            .boundary = { parent_identity, static_cast<WebIDL::UnsignedLong>(dom_node->index()) },
            .debug_rect = debug_rect,
        };
    }
    auto before_boundary = BoundaryIdentity { parent_identity, static_cast<WebIDL::UnsignedLong>(dom_node->index()) };
    auto after_boundary = BoundaryIdentity { parent_identity, static_cast<WebIDL::UnsignedLong>(dom_node->index() + 1) };
    auto is_before = resolved.boundary == Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretBoundaryKind::BeforeNode;
    return CaretPosition {
        .paintable = caret_at.paintable,
        .arena = *m_arena,
        .boundary = is_before ? before_boundary : after_boundary,
        .secondary_boundary = is_before ? after_boundary : before_boundary,
        .debug_rect = debug_rect,
    };
}

Optional<CaretPosition> HitTestQuery::caret_position_from_point(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSSPixelPoint point, GC::Ptr<DOM::Node const> constraint_scope) const
{
    auto const* scope_layout_node = constraint_scope ? constraint_scope->unsafe_layout_node(read) : nullptr;
    auto scope = scope_layout_node ? Layout::Node::slot_id(scope_layout_node) : Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId { Compositing::RustFFI::INVALID_NODE_SLOT_INDEX };
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretAt caret_at;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_hit_test_caret_position_from_point(m_arena->host(), &read, ffi_query(), point, scope, &caret_at);
    return caret_position_from(caret_at);
}

Optional<HitTestResult> HitTestQuery::hit_test(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSSPixelPoint point) const
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiPointHit hit;
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::layout_hit_test_topmost_hit(m_arena->host(), &read, ffi_query(), point, &hit))
        return {};
    return hit_test_result_for(read, hit);
}

TraversalDecision HitTestQuery::hit_test_all(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSSPixelPoint point, Function<TraversalDecision(HitTestResult)> const& callback) const
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiPointHit topmost_hit;
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::layout_hit_test_topmost_hit(m_arena->host(), &read, ffi_query(), point, &topmost_hit))
        return TraversalDecision::Continue;
    if (callback(hit_test_result_for(read, topmost_hit)) == TraversalDecision::Break)
        return TraversalDecision::Break;

    Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiPointHit> hits;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_hit_test_all_hits(m_arena->host(), &read, ffi_query(), point, &hits, [](void* sink, Layout::RustFFI::FfiPointHit const* hit) {
        static_cast<Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiPointHit>*>(sink)->append(*hit);
    });
    for (size_t index_below_topmost_hit = 1; index_below_topmost_hit < hits.size(); ++index_below_topmost_hit) {
        if (callback(hit_test_result_for(read, hits[index_below_topmost_hit])) == TraversalDecision::Break)
            return TraversalDecision::Break;
    }

    return TraversalDecision::Continue;
}

}

#pragma once

namespace Web::Painting {

// A hit test of a document's rows, with what it reads besides the rows and the document's scroll state, such as the
// time it samples the compositor's animations at. Only the document makes one, once it has prepared its paint
// properties, so every box a query looks at reads the same preparation, and nothing in a query prepares the document
// again.
class HitTestQuery {
public:
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<HitTestResult> hit_test(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSSPixelPoint) const;
    // The caret position the box hit at the point gives it, or when constraint_scope is given, the one that node's box
    // gives it wherever the point is.
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<CaretPosition> caret_position_from_point(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSSPixelPoint, GC::Ptr<DOM::Node const> constraint_scope = nullptr) const;
    TraversalDecision hit_test_all(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSSPixelPoint, Function<TraversalDecision(HitTestResult)> const&) const;

private:
    friend class DOM::Document;

    HitTestQuery(Layout::NodeArena& arena, ChromeWidgetRegistry& chrome_widget_registry, double device_pixels_per_css_pixel, ChromeMetrics chrome_metrics, Optional<i64> visual_animation_sample_time_nanoseconds)
        : m_arena(arena)
        , m_chrome_widget_registry(chrome_widget_registry)
        , m_device_pixels_per_css_pixel(device_pixels_per_css_pixel)
        , m_chrome_metrics(chrome_metrics)
        , m_visual_animation_sample_time_nanoseconds(visual_animation_sample_time_nanoseconds)
    {
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Layout::RustFFI::FfiHitTestQuery ffi_query() const;
    [[nodiscard]] HitTestResult hit_test_result_for(Layout::BegunRead const& read, Layout::RustFFI::FfiPointHit const&) const;
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<CaretPosition> caret_position_from(Layout::RustFFI::FfiCaretAt const&) const;

    NonnullRefPtr<Layout::NodeArena> m_arena;
    NonnullRefPtr<ChromeWidgetRegistry> m_chrome_widget_registry;
    double m_device_pixels_per_css_pixel { 1 };
    ChromeMetrics m_chrome_metrics;
    // The time the query reads the compositor's animations at, as a frame of the compositor's shows them, if any.
    Optional<i64> m_visual_animation_sample_time_nanoseconds;
};

}

DOM::Node* HitTestResult::dom_node() const
{
    auto* document = arena->document();
    if (!document)
        return nullptr;
    return node.resolve(*document).ptr();
}

Optional<DOM::BoundaryPoint> BoundaryIdentity::resolve(DOM::Document& document) const
{
    auto resolved_node = node.resolve(document);
    if (!resolved_node)
        return {};
    return DOM::BoundaryPoint { *resolved_node, offset };
}

GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> CaretPosition::boundary_node() const
{
    auto* document = arena->document();
    if (!document)
        return nullptr;
    return boundary.node.resolve(*document);
}

Optional<DOM::BoundaryPoint> CaretPosition::boundary_point() const
{
    auto* document = arena->document();
    if (!document)
        return {};
    return boundary.resolve(*document);
}

Layout::Node* CaretPosition::boundary_layout_node(Layout::BegunRead const& read) const
{
    return boundary.node.bound_layout_node(read, *arena);
}

struct HitTestResult {
    DOM::NodeIdentity node;
    Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId hit_node;
    NonnullRefPtr<Layout::NodeArena> arena;
    RefPtr<ChromeWidget> chrome_widget {};
    // A scrollbar takes the pointer in the compositor, and the scroller is hit here.
    bool is_scrollbar { false };
    size_t index_in_node { 0 };
    bool is_text_fragment { false };

    DOM::Node* dom_node() const;
    Layout::Node* layout_node(Layout::BegunRead const& read) const { return layout_node_for_committed_slot(read, *arena, hit_node); }
};

// A boundary point that names its node instead of pointing at it. A node that left the tree since
// the hit test resolves to nothing, where a pointer would have handed back a node the document no
// longer contains.
struct WEB_API BoundaryIdentity {
    DOM::NodeIdentity node;
    WebIDL::UnsignedLong offset { 0 };

    Optional<DOM::BoundaryPoint> resolve(DOM::Document&) const;
};

struct WEB_API CaretPosition {
    Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId paintable;
    NonnullRefPtr<Layout::NodeArena> arena;
    BoundaryIdentity boundary;
    TextAffinity affinity { TextAffinity::Downstream };
    Optional<BoundaryIdentity> secondary_boundary {};
    Optional<CSSPixelRect> debug_rect {};

    GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> boundary_node() const;
    Optional<DOM::BoundaryPoint> boundary_point() const;
    // The layout node the boundary's node is bound to, found in the arena rather than asked of that node.
    Layout::Node* boundary_layout_node(Layout::BegunRead const& read) const;
    Layout::Node* layout_node(Layout::BegunRead const& read) const { return layout_node_for_committed_slot(read, *arena, paintable); }
};
