/// The identity of an animation effect, which no other effect of the process shares.
#[repr(transparent)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct AnimationEffectId(pub u64);

impl AnimationEffectId {
    fn mint() -> Self {
        static NEXT: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(1);
        Self(NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed))
    }
}

/// What the host notes of an effect as it runs it on the compositor, throttles it, or samples it for script, by bit.
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum EffectFlag {
    /// A compositor animation runs the effect.
    CompositorDriven = 1 << 0,
    /// A compositor animation runs what the effect animates in its place.
    CompositorReplaced = 1 << 1,
    /// Nothing the effect animates shows, as its target is offscreen.
    OffscreenThrottled = 1 << 2,
    /// Script can observe what the compositor animation running the effect shows.
    ObservationRelevantCompositorAnimation = 1 << 3,
    /// Script asked for a sample of the effect, which the next style update takes.
    NeedsObservationSample = 1 << 4,
    /// A frame skipped its tick of the effect.
    PerFrameAnimationTickWasSkipped = 1 << 5,
}

impl EffectFlag {
    /// Whether the flag decides whether a frame can skip the style update of the effect.
    fn decides_per_frame_style_update_skip(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            Self::CompositorDriven | Self::CompositorReplaced | Self::OffscreenThrottled
        )
    }
}

/// What the host found whether a frame can skip the style update of an effect from, besides the effect itself: the
/// generations of the style of its target and of the target's subtree, the identity of the target's layout node, and
/// whether the target was connected.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipKey {
    pub target_style_generation: u64,
    pub target_subtree_style_generation: u64,
    pub layout_node: usize,
    pub target_is_connected: bool,
}

/// Whether a frame can skip the style update of an effect, and what the host found that from.
/// NB: The fields of the key are kept apart, so that the decision fits in the padding the key leaves.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct RememberedPerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision {
    target_style_generation: u64,
    target_subtree_style_generation: u64,
    layout_node: usize,
    target_is_connected: bool,
    can_skip: bool,
}

impl RememberedPerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision {
    fn key(&self) -> PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipKey {
        PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipKey {
            target_style_generation: self.target_style_generation,
            target_subtree_style_generation: self.target_subtree_style_generation,
            layout_node: self.layout_node,
            target_is_connected: self.target_is_connected,
        }
    }
}

/// What an effect remembers of whether a frame can skip its style update, for a key.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision {
    /// The effect remembers no decision.
    Unknown,
    /// The effect remembers a decision for another key.
    Stale,
    /// A frame can skip the style update of the effect.
    CanSkip,
    /// A frame cannot skip the style update of the effect.
    CannotSkip,
}

/// What became of a request that the next style update take an observation sample of an effect, at most once in a
/// task.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ObservationSampleRequest {
    /// The effect was already asked for a sample in the task.
    AlreadyRequestedInTask,
    /// The effect is asked for a sample, which it already was.
    Requested,
    /// The effect is asked for a sample, which it was not before.
    NewlyRequested,
}

/// How to reach the compositor animations of an effect.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CompositorAnimationStateAccess {
    /// Only where the effect built any before.
    Existing,
    /// Making the state where the effect has none yet.
    CreateIfMissing,
}

/// The pseudo-element an effect targets, by the host's `PseudoElement`, and its serialization.
pub(crate) struct EffectPseudoElement<'a> {
    pub(crate) kind: u8,
    pub(crate) serialization: &'a RetainedUtf16FlyString,
}

/// The state of an animation effect.
/// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#the-animationeffect-interface
/// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#the-keyframeeffect-interface
pub(crate) struct AnimationEffectRecord {
    id: AnimationEffectId,
    /// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#the-effecttiming-dictionaries
    specified: SpecifiedEffectTiming,
    /// The start delay, end delay and iteration duration, as normalizing the specified timing last made them.
    /// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#start-delay
    start_delay: TimeValue,
    /// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#end-delay
    end_delay: TimeValue,
    /// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#iteration-duration
    iteration_duration: TimeValue,
    /// The keyframes, timing function and composite operation, and what the associated animation is, which the
    /// effect keeps in its description for the style engine, whose lists of the effects of elements share it.
    description: Arc<EffectDescription>,
    /// The serialization of the value the timing function was made from, which script reads.
    timing_function_serialization: RetainedUtf16FlyString,
    /// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#animation-associated-effect
    /// The animation whose associated effect the effect is, if any, which keeps the effect alive.
    associated_animation: WeakAnimationHandle,
    /// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#effect-target-target-element
    /// The host's `DOM::Element`, which the host's effect keeps alive.
    target_element: Option<NonNull<c_void>>,
    /// The serialization of the target pseudo-selector, or none where the effect has none.
    /// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#dom-keyframeeffect-pseudoelement
    pseudo_element_serialization: RetainedUtf16FlyString,
    /// The current iteration the effect was at when the host last dispatched its style events.
    pub(crate) previous_current_iteration: f64,
    /// The host's `PseudoElement` of the target pseudo-selector.
    pseudo_element_kind: u8,
    /// The phase the effect was in when the host last dispatched its style events.
    pub(crate) previous_phase: AnimationEffectPhase,
    /// The `EffectFlag`s set.
    flags: u8,
    /// Whether script replaced keyframes the effect took from CSS, after which it takes no more from CSS.
    ignores_css_keyframes: bool,
    /// Whether a frame can skip the style update of the effect, as the host last found it, and what from.
    per_frame_style_update_skip_decision: Option<RememberedPerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision>,
    /// The generation of the task in which the host last asked for an observation sample of the effect on behalf of a
    /// read of an element.
    observation_sample_task_generation: Option<u64>,
    /// What the host built of the effect for the compositor, made when it first builds anything.
    compositor_animation_state: Option<Box<CompositorAnimationEffectState>>,
}

impl AnimationEffectRecord {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let timing = AnimationEffectTiming::default();
        let id = AnimationEffectId::mint();
        Self {
            id,
            specified: SpecifiedEffectTiming::default(),
            start_delay: timing.start_delay,
            end_delay: timing.end_delay,
            iteration_duration: timing.iteration_duration,
            description: Arc::new(EffectDescription::new(id)),
            timing_function_serialization: RetainedUtf16FlyString::from_utf16(
                &"linear".encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            ),
            associated_animation: WeakAnimationHandle::default(),
            target_element: None,
            pseudo_element_serialization: RetainedUtf16FlyString::none(),
            previous_current_iteration: 0.0,
            pseudo_element_kind: 0,
            previous_phase: AnimationEffectPhase::Idle,
            flags: 0,
            ignores_css_keyframes: false,
            per_frame_style_update_skip_decision: None,
            observation_sample_task_generation: None,
            compositor_animation_state: None,
        }
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn id(&self) -> AnimationEffectId {
        self.id
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn specified_timing(&self) -> &SpecifiedEffectTiming {
        &self.specified
    }

    /// Sets the specified timing, which takes effect on the start delay, end delay and iteration duration once it is
    /// normalized.
    pub(crate) fn set_specified_timing(&mut self, specified: SpecifiedEffectTiming) {
        // NB: Whether a frame can skip the style update of the effect depends on its iteration count.
        if self.specified.iteration_count.to_bits() != specified.iteration_count.to_bits() {
            self.per_frame_style_update_skip_decision = None;
        }
        self.specified = specified;
    }

    /// The timing the timing model reads of the effect.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn timing(&self) -> AnimationEffectTiming {
        AnimationEffectTiming {
            start_delay: self.start_delay,
            end_delay: self.end_delay,
            iteration_duration: self.iteration_duration,
            iteration_start: self.specified.iteration_start,
            iteration_count: self.specified.iteration_count,
            fill_mode: self.specified.fill_mode,
            playback_direction: self.specified.playback_direction,
        }
    }

    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/web-animations-2/#normalize-specified-timing
    /// Against `timeline`, the timeline of the associated animation as the animation sees it, if any.
    pub(crate) fn normalize_specified_timing(&mut self, timeline: Option<&TimelineState>) {
        let timeline_duration = timeline.and_then(TimelineState::duration_for_attachment_range);
        let timing = timing::normalize_specified_timing(&self.specified, timeline_duration, time_unit(timeline));
        self.start_delay = timing.start_delay;
        self.end_delay = timing.end_delay;
        self.iteration_duration = timing.iteration_duration;
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn timing_function(&self) -> &CompactEasing {
        &self.description.timing_function
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn timing_function_serialization(&self) -> &RetainedUtf16FlyString {
        &self.timing_function_serialization
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_timing_function(
        &mut self,
        timing_function: CompactEasing,
        serialization: RetainedUtf16FlyString,
    ) {
        self.describe().timing_function = timing_function;
        self.timing_function_serialization = serialization;
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn keyframes(&self) -> Option<&Arc<KeyframeSet>> {
        self.description.keyframe_set.as_ref()
    }

    /// Whether the compositor may run all the effect animates.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn may_run_on_the_compositor(&self) -> bool {
        self.keyframes()
            .is_none_or(|keyframes| keyframes.may_run_on_the_compositor())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_keyframes(&mut self, keyframes: Option<Arc<KeyframeSet>>) {
        self.describe().keyframe_set = keyframes;
    }

    /// Whether the effect's keyframes come from CSS: from a `@keyframes` rule, or a CSS transition.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn keyframes_from_css(&self) -> bool {
        self.keyframes()
            .is_some_and(|keyframes| keyframes.origin() != KeyframeOrigin::Script)
    }

    /// Notes that script is about to set the effect's keyframes, which keeps those it replaces of CSS from coming back.
    pub(crate) fn note_keyframes_set_by_script(&mut self) {
        self.ignores_css_keyframes |= self.keyframes_from_css();
    }

    /// Whether script replaced keyframes the effect took from CSS, after which it takes no more from CSS.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn ignores_css_keyframes(&self) -> bool {
        self.ignores_css_keyframes
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn composite(&self) -> FfiCompositeOperation {
        self.description.composite
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_composite(&mut self, composite: FfiCompositeOperation) {
        if self.description.composite != composite {
            self.describe().composite = composite;
        }
    }

    /// The description of the effect for the style engine.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn description(&self) -> &Arc<EffectDescription> {
        &self.description
    }

    /// Sets what the associated animation is, as far as describing the effect goes, or that it has none.
    pub(crate) fn set_described_animation(&mut self, animation: EffectAnimation) {
        self.describe().animation = animation;
    }

    /// Describes the effect anew, so that whatever the style engine kept of the description before stops applying to
    /// it: interval values it retained, and preparations for sampling it.
    pub(crate) fn describe_anew(&mut self) {
        self.describe();
    }

    /// The description to change, which is a new one wherever anything but the record holds the current one.
    fn describe(&mut self) -> &mut EffectDescription {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.description)
    }

    /// The animation whose associated effect the effect is, if any.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn associated_animation(&self) -> Option<AnimationHandle> {
        self.associated_animation.upgrade()
    }

    /// Notes that the effect is the associated effect of `animation`, or of none, and normalizes its specified timing
    /// against `timeline`, the timeline of that animation as the animation sees it, if any.
    /// NB: The normalization of the specified timing depends on the timeline of the associated animation.
    pub(crate) fn set_associated_animation(
        &mut self,
        animation: Option<&AnimationHandle>,
        timeline: Option<&TimelineState>,
    ) {
        self.associated_animation = animation.map(AnimationHandle::downgrade).unwrap_or_default();
        self.normalize_specified_timing(timeline);
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn target_element(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.target_element
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_target_element(&mut self, element: Option<NonNull<c_void>>) {
        self.target_element = element;
        // NB: What the engine kept of the description was kept for the element the effect targeted.
        self.describe_anew();
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn pseudo_element(&self) -> Option<EffectPseudoElement<'_>> {
        (self.pseudo_element_serialization.raw() != 0).then_some(EffectPseudoElement {
            kind: self.pseudo_element_kind,
            serialization: &self.pseudo_element_serialization,
        })
    }

    /// Sets the target pseudo-selector to the pseudo-element of the host's `PseudoElement` `kind`, serialized as
    /// `serialization`, or to none where `serialization` is none.
    pub(crate) fn set_pseudo_element(&mut self, kind: u8, serialization: RetainedUtf16FlyString) {
        self.pseudo_element_kind = kind;
        self.pseudo_element_serialization = serialization;
        // NB: What the engine kept of the description was kept for the pseudo-element the effect targeted.
        self.describe_anew();
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn has_flag(&self, flag: EffectFlag) -> bool {
        self.flags & flag as u8 != 0
    }

    /// Sets or clears `flag`, answering whether that changed it.
    pub(crate) fn set_flag(&mut self, flag: EffectFlag, value: bool) -> bool {
        let flags = if value {
            self.flags | flag as u8
        } else {
            self.flags & !(flag as u8)
        };
        let changed = std::mem::replace(&mut self.flags, flags) != flags;
        if changed && flag.decides_per_frame_style_update_skip() {
            self.per_frame_style_update_skip_decision = None;
        }
        changed
    }

    /// What the effect remembers of whether a frame can skip its style update, for `key`.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn per_frame_style_update_skip_decision(
        &self,
        key: &PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipKey,
    ) -> PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision {
        match &self.per_frame_style_update_skip_decision {
            None => PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::Unknown,
            Some(decision) if decision.key() != *key => PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::Stale,
            Some(decision) if decision.can_skip => PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::CanSkip,
            Some(_) => PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::CannotSkip,
        }
    }

    /// Remembers whether a frame can skip the style update of the effect, as the host found it from `key`.
    pub(crate) fn note_per_frame_style_update_skip_decision(
        &mut self,
        key: PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipKey,
        can_skip: bool,
    ) {
        self.per_frame_style_update_skip_decision = Some(RememberedPerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision {
            target_style_generation: key.target_style_generation,
            target_subtree_style_generation: key.target_subtree_style_generation,
            layout_node: key.layout_node,
            target_is_connected: key.target_is_connected,
            can_skip,
        });
    }

    /// Asks the next style update for an observation sample of the effect on behalf of a read of an element in the
    /// task of generation `task_generation`, unless the effect was already asked for one in that task.
    pub(crate) fn request_observation_sample_in_task(&mut self, task_generation: u64) -> ObservationSampleRequest {
        if self.observation_sample_task_generation == Some(task_generation) {
            return ObservationSampleRequest::AlreadyRequestedInTask;
        }
        self.observation_sample_task_generation = Some(task_generation);
        if self.set_flag(EffectFlag::NeedsObservationSample, true) {
            ObservationSampleRequest::NewlyRequested
        } else {
            ObservationSampleRequest::Requested
        }
    }

    /// What the host built of the effect for the compositor, reached as `access` says.
    pub(crate) fn compositor_animation_state(
        &mut self,
        access: CompositorAnimationStateAccess,
    ) -> Option<&mut CompositorAnimationEffectState> {
        if access == CompositorAnimationStateAccess::CreateIfMissing {
            self.compositor_animation_state.get_or_insert_default();
        }
        self.compositor_animation_state.as_deref_mut()
    }

    /// Forgets what the host concluded of the effect as it was, since the effect changed: what it built for the
    /// compositor from the keyframes, how it ran or throttled the effect, and whether a frame can skip its style update.
    pub(crate) fn forget_what_the_host_concluded(&mut self) {
        if let Some(state) = &mut self.compositor_animation_state {
            state.reset();
        }
        for flag in [
            EffectFlag::CompositorDriven,
            EffectFlag::CompositorReplaced,
            EffectFlag::OffscreenThrottled,
            EffectFlag::ObservationRelevantCompositorAnimation,
        ] {
            self.set_flag(flag, false);
        }
        self.per_frame_style_update_skip_decision = None;
    }
}

/// An animation effect's record, which every handle to the effect shares, and the host's `AnimationEffect` of it.
pub struct AnimationEffectCell {
    record: RefCell<AnimationEffectRecord>,
    /// The host's `AnimationEffect`, which holds a reference to the record until it is finalized and clears this as it
    /// does.
    object_cell: Cell<Option<NonNull<c_void>>>,
}

impl AnimationEffectCell {
    pub(crate) fn borrow(&self) -> Ref<'_, AnimationEffectRecord> {
        self.record.borrow()
    }

    pub(crate) fn borrow_mut(&self) -> RefMut<'_, AnimationEffectRecord> {
        self.record.borrow_mut()
    }

    /// The host's `AnimationEffect` of the effect, while it is alive.
    pub(crate) fn object_cell(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.object_cell.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_object_cell(&self, object_cell: Option<NonNull<c_void>>) {
        self.object_cell.set(object_cell);
    }

    /// Whether the host may reach the effect and the element it targets: while the object script sees of it is, or,
    /// for an effect without one, while its associated animation is.
    pub(crate) fn is_alive(&self) -> bool {
        if self.object_cell().is_some() {
            return true;
        }
        let animation = self.borrow().associated_animation();
        animation.is_some_and(|animation| animation.is_alive())
    }

    /// The bytes of the allocation every handle shares. The description the record holds counts toward the style
    /// engine's descriptions of the effects of elements, which share it.
    pub(crate) fn memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        2 * size_of::<usize>() + size_of::<Self>()
    }
}

/// A strong reference to an animation effect.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct EffectHandle(Rc<AnimationEffectCell>);

impl EffectHandle {
    /// A new effect with the default timing, no keyframes and no target.
    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
        Self(Rc::new(AnimationEffectCell {
            record: RefCell::new(AnimationEffectRecord::new()),
            object_cell: Cell::new(None),
        }))
    }

    /// Whether both handles are to the same effect.
    pub(crate) fn ptr_eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        Rc::ptr_eq(&self.0, &other.0)
    }

    /// Hands the reference to the host, which gives it back to `from_raw`.
    pub(crate) fn into_raw(self) -> *const AnimationEffectCell {
        Rc::into_raw(self.0)
    }

    /// Takes a reference of its own to the effect the host lends.
    pub(crate) fn retained_from_lent(cell: RcRef<'_, AnimationEffectCell>) -> Self {
        Self(cell.to_rc())
    }

    /// Takes a reference of its own to an effect the host holds a reference to.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// `cell` must be an effect the host holds a reference to.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn retained_from_host(cell: *const AnimationEffectCell) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        unsafe {
            Rc::increment_strong_count(cell);
            Self(Rc::from_raw(cell))
        }
    }

    /// Takes back a reference the host was handed.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// `cell` must be a reference `into_raw` handed out, which the host gives up.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn from_raw(cell: *const AnimationEffectCell) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        Self(unsafe { Rc::from_raw(cell) })
    }
}

/// A set of effects that keeps none of them alive.
///
/// NB: An effect that is no longer alive to the host is dead to the set, though what else holds its record may only let
///     go of it as the host sweeps what holds it, so that the host never meets an effect it finalized.
pub struct WeakEffectSet(WeakRecordSet<AnimationEffectCell>);

impl Default for WeakEffectSet {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self(WeakRecordSet::new(AnimationEffectCell::is_alive))
    }
}

impl WeakEffectSet {
    /// Adds `effect` to the set, answering whether the set did not hold it yet.
    pub(crate) fn insert(&mut self, effect: &EffectHandle) -> bool {
        self.0.insert(&effect.0)
    }

    /// Removes `effect` from the set, answering whether the set held it.
    pub(crate) fn remove(&mut self, effect: &AnimationEffectCell) -> bool {
        self.0.remove(effect)
    }

    /// Whether the set holds `effect`.
    pub(crate) fn contains(&self, effect: &AnimationEffectCell) -> bool {
        self.0.contains(effect)
    }

    /// Empties the set, calling `callback` with each effect alive to it, in insertion order.
    pub(crate) fn take_each(&mut self, mut callback: impl FnMut(&EffectHandle)) {
        self.0.take_each(|effect| callback(&EffectHandle(effect)));
    }
}

impl PartialEq for EffectHandle {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.ptr_eq(other)
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for EffectHandle {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        formatter
            .debug_tuple("EffectHandle")
            .field(&self.borrow().id())
            .finish()
    }
}

impl std::ops::Deref for EffectHandle {
    type Target = AnimationEffectCell;

    fn deref(&self) -> &AnimationEffectCell {
        &self.0
    }
}

/// The timing of an effect at one local time, and what follows from its timing alone.
pub struct EffectTimingAtLocalTime {
    pub phase: AnimationEffectPhase,
    pub current_iteration: Option<f64>,
    /// Unresolved where it was not asked for.
    pub transformed_progress: Option<f64>,
    pub active_duration: TimeValue,
    pub end_time: TimeValue,
}

/// The timing of `effect` at `local_time` with `fill_mode` as its fill mode, associated with `animation`, if any, on
/// its timeline, if it has one, and with its transformed progress through its timing function where
/// `with_transformed_progress`.
pub(crate) fn resolve_effect_timing(
    effect: &AnimationEffectCell,
    local_time: Option<TimeValue>,
    fill_mode: FillMode,
    animation: Option<&AnimationCell>,
    with_transformed_progress: bool,
) -> EffectTimingAtLocalTime {
    let timeline = animation.and_then(|animation| animation.borrow().timeline().map(|timeline| timeline.sample()));
    let timeline = timeline.as_ref();
    let animation = animation.map(|animation| *animation.borrow().playback());
    let effect = effect.borrow();
    let timing = AnimationEffectTiming {
        fill_mode,
        ..effect.timing()
    };
    let resolved = timing::resolve_timing(&timing, local_time, animation.as_ref(), timeline);
    let transformed_progress = with_transformed_progress
        .then(|| timing::transformed_progress(&timing, &resolved, effect.timing_function().as_easing()))
        .flatten();
    EffectTimingAtLocalTime {
        phase: resolved.phase,
        current_iteration: timing::current_iteration(&timing, &resolved),
        transformed_progress,
        active_duration: timing::active_duration(&timing),
        end_time: timing::end_time(&timing),
    }
}

//! The animations of an element: those associated with it, the CSS animations and transitions it and its
//! pseudo-elements own, and the descriptions of the effects of each it last published to the style engine. The lists
//! publish what the style engine reads of them to the engine the host names as it changes them.
//! https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#the-animatable-interface-mixin

use super::animation::{
    AnimationCell, AnimationHandle, AnimationRecord, HostCellKind, SmilHolder, WeakAnimationHandle,
};
use super::composite_order::{TreeOrder, composite_order};
use crate::css::retained_fly_string::RetainedUtf16FlyString;
use crate::css::style::animations::CssDefinedAnimation;
use crate::css::style::effect_descriptions::EffectDescription;
use crate::css::style::engine_calls::EngineWrite;
use crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID;
use crate::heap_size::small_vec_bytes;
use crate::render_state::{ArenaChange, DocumentHost};
use smallvec::SmallVec;
use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// The element or one of its pseudo-elements, as one of the lists of the CSS animations and transitions it owns, and of
/// the effects that target it: 0 for the element, and the host's `PseudoElement` plus one for a pseudo-element.
#[repr(transparent)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct AnimationOwnerSlot(pub u8);

/// The style engine that reads an element's lists, by the document host the host names it by and the element's identity
/// in it, as the host passes them each time it changes the lists, since the element's identity there changes over its
/// life and the lists follow the element from document to document.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct StyleEngineTarget<'a> {
    pub(crate) host: &'a DocumentHost,
    pub(crate) node: StyleNodeID,
}

/// The property a CSS transition runs: the host's `PropertyID` of a longhand, or the raw fly string of a custom
/// property's name where it is not zero.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(crate) struct TransitionProperty {
    pub(crate) property_id: u16,
    pub(crate) custom_name: usize,
}

impl TransitionProperty {
    pub(crate) fn of(animation: &AnimationRecord) -> Self {
        let state = animation.css_transition();
        Self {
            property_id: state.property_id,
            custom_name: state.custom_property_name.raw(),
        }
    }
}

/// The CSS animations and transitions of one owner, and the effects that target it as the style engine has them.
struct OwnedAnimations {
    slot: AnimationOwnerSlot,
    /// The CSS animations, in the order of the owner's `animation-name`.
    css_animations: SmallVec<[AnimationHandle; 1]>,
    /// The running or completed transition of each property, which runs no other.
    transitions: SmallVec<[AnimationHandle; 1]>,
    /// The descriptions of the effects that target the owner, in composite order, as the host last published them to
    /// the style engine.
    published_effects: Box<[Arc<EffectDescription>]>,
}

impl OwnedAnimations {
    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.css_animations.is_empty() && self.transitions.is_empty() && self.published_effects.is_empty()
    }
}

/// The animations of an element, which holds them strongly.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ElementAnimations {
    /// The animations whose effects target the element or one of its pseudo-elements.
    associated: SmallVec<[AnimationHandle; 1]>,
    /// The lists of the owners that own any CSS animation or transition.
    owners: SmallVec<[OwnedAnimations; 1]>,
    /// The animations disassociated from the element, which may still name it as their effect target: An animation
    /// that turns inert leaves `associated`, but its effect keeps targeting the element until it is revived.
    disassociated: SmallVec<[WeakAnimationHandle; 1]>,
    /// Whether `associated` is in composite order.
    is_sorted_by_composite_order: bool,
    /// Whether any owner has had a CSS animation since the element last canceled them all.
    has_css_defined_animations: bool,
}

impl Drop for ElementAnimations {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // NB: The element is finalized, and what else holds the records of its animations may only let go of them as
        //     the host sweeps it, after the element itself may be gone. So that no record names the element by then,
        //     nor is alive to the sets of animations by it, the records forget it here.
        for animation in &self.associated {
            animation.note_smil_holder(SmilHolder::TargetList, false);
            let effect = animation.borrow().effect().cloned();
            if let Some(effect) = effect {
                effect.borrow_mut().set_target_element(None);
            }
        }
        for owner in &self.owners {
            for animation in owner.css_animations.iter().chain(&owner.transitions) {
                animation.borrow_mut().set_owning_element(None);
            }
        }
    }
}

impl ElementAnimations {
    fn owner(&self, slot: AnimationOwnerSlot) -> Option<&OwnedAnimations> {
        self.owners.iter().find(|owner| owner.slot == slot)
    }

    fn ensure_owner(&mut self, slot: AnimationOwnerSlot) -> &mut OwnedAnimations {
        let index = match self.owners.iter().position(|owner| owner.slot == slot) {
            Some(index) => index,
            None => {
                self.owners.push(OwnedAnimations {
                    slot,
                    css_animations: SmallVec::new(),
                    transitions: SmallVec::new(),
                    published_effects: Box::default(),
                });
                self.owners.len() - 1
            }
        };
        &mut self.owners[index]
    }

    fn remove_empty_owners(&mut self) {
        self.owners.retain(|owner| !owner.is_empty());
    }

    /// Associates `animation` with the element, answering whether it was not associated yet.
    pub(crate) fn associate(&mut self, animation: AnimationHandle) -> bool {
        if self.associated.iter().any(|associated| associated.ptr_eq(&animation)) {
            return false;
        }
        self.disassociated
            .retain(|disassociated| disassociated.upgrade().is_some_and(|other| !other.ptr_eq(&animation)));
        animation.note_smil_holder(SmilHolder::TargetList, true);
        self.associated.push(animation);
        self.is_sorted_by_composite_order = false;
        true
    }

    /// Disassociates `animation` from the element, answering whether it was associated.
    pub(crate) fn disassociate(&mut self, animation: &AnimationCell) -> bool {
        self.is_sorted_by_composite_order = false;
        let Some(index) = self.associated.iter().position(|associated| associated.is(animation)) else {
            return false;
        };
        let animation = self.associated.remove(index);
        animation.note_smil_holder(SmilHolder::TargetList, false);
        self.disassociated
            .retain(|disassociated| disassociated.upgrade().is_some());
        self.disassociated.push(animation.downgrade());
        true
    }

    /// Makes the effects of the animations disassociated from `element`, whose lists these are, forget it as their
    /// target, as the element is finalized: An animation that outlives the element, for an event still pending on it,
    /// would otherwise name an element that is gone.
    pub(crate) fn forget_element_as_target_of_disassociated(&mut self, element: NonNull<c_void>) {
        for disassociated in self.disassociated.drain(..) {
            let Some(animation) = disassociated.upgrade() else {
                continue;
            };
            let effect = animation.borrow().effect().cloned();
            if let Some(effect) = effect
                && effect.borrow().target_element() == Some(element)
            {
                effect.borrow_mut().set_target_element(None);
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn associated(&self) -> &[AnimationHandle] {
        &self.associated
    }

    pub(crate) fn invalidate_composite_order(&mut self) {
        self.is_sorted_by_composite_order = false;
    }

    /// Sorts the associated animations in composite order, with `tree_order` comparing elements in tree order.
    pub(crate) fn sort_in_composite_order(&mut self, tree_order: &mut impl TreeOrder) {
        if self.is_sorted_by_composite_order {
            return;
        }
        // NB: An animation without an effect has no place in an effect stack, and sorts first by its position in the
        //     global animation list.
        self.associated.sort_by(|a, b| {
            let (a, b) = (a.borrow(), b.borrow());
            match (a.effect().is_some(), b.effect().is_some()) {
                (true, true) => composite_order(&a, &b, tree_order),
                (false, true) => Ordering::Less,
                (true, false) => Ordering::Greater,
                (false, false) => a.global_animation_list_order().cmp(&b.global_animation_list_order()),
            }
        });
        self.is_sorted_by_composite_order = true;
    }

    /// The CSS animations of the first owner after `slot`, or of the first owner without one, by the order of their
    /// slots, which is the element's and then each pseudo-element's in the order of the host's `PseudoElement`.
    pub(crate) fn css_animations_after(
        &self,
        slot: Option<AnimationOwnerSlot>,
    ) -> Option<(AnimationOwnerSlot, SmallVec<[AnimationHandle; 1]>)> {
        self.owners
            .iter()
            .filter(|owner| slot.is_none_or(|slot| owner.slot.0 > slot.0) && !owner.css_animations.is_empty())
            .min_by_key(|owner| owner.slot.0)
            .map(|owner| (owner.slot, owner.css_animations.clone()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn css_animations(&self, slot: AnimationOwnerSlot) -> &[AnimationHandle] {
        self.owner(slot).map_or(&[], |owner| &owner.css_animations)
    }

    /// Sets the CSS animations of the owner at `slot`, and publishes them to `engine`, if any, where the owner had or
    /// now has any.
    pub(crate) fn set_css_animations(
        &mut self,
        slot: AnimationOwnerSlot,
        animations: impl ExactSizeIterator<Item = AnimationHandle>,
        engine: Option<StyleEngineTarget<'_>>,
    ) {
        // NB: The flag says the element has animations to play or cancel, not that it has been through the step that
        //     would have registered some. It stays set once any list is non-empty, since the lists are per owner and
        //     this is one flag for all of them.
        if animations.len() != 0 {
            self.has_css_defined_animations = true;
        }
        let owner = self.ensure_owner(slot);
        let had_animations = !owner.css_animations.is_empty();
        let animations: SmallVec<[AnimationHandle; 1]> = animations.collect();
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-1/#animations
        // Once an animation has started it continues until it ends or the animation-name is removed
        // NB: An animation removed from its owning element no longer follows its named timeline.
        for removed in &owner.css_animations {
            if !animations.iter().any(|animation| animation.ptr_eq(removed)) {
                removed.borrow_mut().css_animation_mut().named_timeline = RetainedUtf16FlyString::none();
            }
        }
        owner.css_animations = animations;
        let publishes = had_animations || !owner.css_animations.is_empty();
        self.remove_empty_owners();
        if publishes && let Some(engine) = engine {
            publish_css_defined_animations(engine, slot, self.css_animations(slot));
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_css_animations_or_transitions(&self) -> bool {
        self.has_css_defined_animations || self.owners.iter().any(|owner| !owner.transitions.is_empty())
    }

    pub(crate) fn transitions(&self, slot: AnimationOwnerSlot) -> &[AnimationHandle] {
        self.owner(slot).map_or(&[], |owner| &owner.transitions)
    }

    /// The running or completed transition of `property` the owner at `slot` has, if any.
    pub(crate) fn transition(
        &self,
        slot: AnimationOwnerSlot,
        property: TransitionProperty,
    ) -> Option<&AnimationHandle> {
        self.transitions(slot)
            .iter()
            .find(|transition| TransitionProperty::of(&transition.borrow()) == property)
    }

    /// Gives the owner at `slot` the transition `transition` of a property it has no transition of.
    pub(crate) fn add_transition(&mut self, slot: AnimationOwnerSlot, transition: AnimationHandle) {
        let property = TransitionProperty::of(&transition.borrow());
        assert!(
            self.transition(slot, property).is_none(),
            "the owner has no transition of the property yet"
        );
        self.ensure_owner(slot).transitions.push(transition);
    }

    /// Removes the transition of `property` the owner at `slot` has, which is disassociated from its target once it is
    /// inert.
    pub(crate) fn remove_transition(&mut self, slot: AnimationOwnerSlot, property: TransitionProperty) {
        let owner = self.ensure_owner(slot);
        let index = owner
            .transitions
            .iter()
            .position(|transition| TransitionProperty::of(&transition.borrow()) == property)
            .expect("the owner has a transition of the property");
        let transition = owner.transitions.remove(index);
        self.remove_empty_owners();
        transition.borrow_mut().disassociation_from_target_pending = true;
    }

    /// Takes the CSS animations and transitions of the owner at `slot`, or of every owner where it names none, answering
    /// them, and publishes to `engine`, if any, that the owners that had CSS animations have none.
    pub(crate) fn take_css_animations_and_transitions(
        &mut self,
        slot: Option<AnimationOwnerSlot>,
        engine: Option<StyleEngineTarget<'_>>,
    ) -> Vec<AnimationHandle> {
        let mut animations = Vec::new();
        for owner in &mut self.owners {
            if slot.is_some_and(|slot| owner.slot != slot) {
                continue;
            }
            if !owner.css_animations.is_empty()
                && let Some(engine) = engine
            {
                publish_css_defined_animations(engine, owner.slot, &[]);
            }
            // NB: An animation removed from its owning element no longer follows its named timeline.
            for animation in std::mem::take(&mut owner.css_animations) {
                animation.borrow_mut().css_animation_mut().named_timeline = RetainedUtf16FlyString::none();
                animations.push(animation);
            }
            animations.extend(std::mem::take(&mut owner.transitions));
        }
        self.remove_empty_owners();
        if slot.is_none() {
            self.has_css_defined_animations = false;
        }
        animations
    }

    /// Notes that the host publishes `descriptions` as the effects that target the owner at `slot`, answering whether
    /// that publishes anything the style engine does not have: whether they differ, description by description, from
    /// what the host last published for it.
    pub(crate) fn publish_effect_descriptions(
        &mut self,
        slot: AnimationOwnerSlot,
        descriptions: &[Arc<EffectDescription>],
    ) -> bool {
        let published = self.owner(slot).map_or(&[][..], |owner| &owner.published_effects);
        if published.len() == descriptions.len()
            && published
                .iter()
                .zip(descriptions)
                .all(|(published, description)| Arc::ptr_eq(published, description))
        {
            return false;
        }
        self.ensure_owner(slot).published_effects = descriptions.into();
        self.remove_empty_owners();
        true
    }

    /// Forgets what the host published to the style engine, whose lists of the element's effects are those of the
    /// identity the element no longer has.
    pub(crate) fn forget_published_effect_descriptions(&mut self) {
        for owner in &mut self.owners {
            owner.published_effects = Box::default();
        }
        self.remove_empty_owners();
    }

    /// Calls `visit` with each GC cell of the host that keeps alive what an animation in the lists names.
    pub(crate) fn for_each_host_cell(&self, mut visit: impl FnMut(NonNull<c_void>, HostCellKind)) {
        let owned = self
            .owners
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|owner| owner.css_animations.iter().chain(&owner.transitions));
        for animation in self.associated.iter().chain(owned) {
            animation.for_each_host_cell(&mut visit);
        }
    }

    /// The bytes of the lists, without the animations and the descriptions of their effects.
    pub(crate) fn memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        size_of::<Self>()
            + small_vec_bytes(&self.associated)
            + small_vec_bytes(&self.owners)
            + small_vec_bytes(&self.disassociated)
            + self
                .owners
                .iter()
                .map(|owner| {
                    small_vec_bytes(&owner.css_animations)
                        + small_vec_bytes(&owner.transitions)
                        + size_of_val::<[Arc<EffectDescription>]>(&owner.published_effects)
                })
                .sum::<usize>()
    }
}

/// Publishes `animations` to `engine` as the CSS animations the owner at `slot` holds, in its order: the name of each and
/// the definition last applied to it, which the computation of the owner's animation definitions matches its
/// definitions against.
fn publish_css_defined_animations(
    engine: StyleEngineTarget<'_>,
    slot: AnimationOwnerSlot,
    animations: &[AnimationHandle],
) {
    engine
        .host
        .queue_change(ArenaChange::Engine(EngineWrite::CssDefinedAnimations {
            node: engine.node,
            slot: slot.0,
            animations: animations
                .iter()
                .map(|animation| CssDefinedAnimation::of(animation))
                .collect(),
        }));
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::animations::animation::AnimationKind;
    use crate::animations::effect::EffectHandle;

    fn element_at(address: &mut u8) -> NonNull<c_void> {
        NonNull::from(address).cast()
    }

    fn animation_targeting(element: NonNull<c_void>) -> AnimationHandle {
        let effect = EffectHandle::new();
        effect.borrow_mut().set_target_element(Some(element));
        let animation = AnimationHandle::new(AnimationKind::Script);
        animation.borrow_mut().set_effect(Some(effect));
        animation
    }

    fn target_of(animation: &AnimationHandle) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        animation
            .borrow()
            .effect()
            .and_then(|effect| effect.borrow().target_element())
    }

    #[test]
    fn finalizing_an_element_clears_the_target_of_an_animation_it_let_go_of() {
        let mut element = 0;
        let element = element_at(&mut element);
        let animation = animation_targeting(element);
        let mut animations = ElementAnimations::default();
        animations.associate(animation.clone());
        animations.disassociate(&animation);
        animations.forget_element_as_target_of_disassociated(element);
        assert_eq!(target_of(&animation), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn finalizing_an_element_keeps_the_target_an_animation_it_let_go_of_moved_to() {
        let (mut first, mut second) = (0, 0);
        let (first, second) = (element_at(&mut first), element_at(&mut second));
        let animation = animation_targeting(first);
        let mut animations = ElementAnimations::default();
        animations.associate(animation.clone());
        animations.disassociate(&animation);
        let effect = animation.borrow().effect().cloned().unwrap();
        effect.borrow_mut().set_target_element(Some(second));
        animations.forget_element_as_target_of_disassociated(first);
        assert_eq!(target_of(&animation), Some(second));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_animation_associated_again_is_no_longer_held_as_let_go_of() {
        let mut element = 0;
        let element = element_at(&mut element);
        let animation = animation_targeting(element);
        let mut animations = ElementAnimations::default();
        animations.associate(animation.clone());
        animations.disassociate(&animation);
        animations.associate(animation.clone());
        assert!(animations.disassociated.is_empty());
    }
}

/// One thing a procedure asks the host to do for the animation `animation`, and what it needs to do it.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiHostEffect {
    pub animation: NonNull<AnimationCell>,
    pub kind: FfiHostEffectKind,
    /// For `QueuePlaybackEvent`.
    pub playback_event_type: PlaybackEventType,
    /// For `InvalidateEffect`.
    pub changes_plan: bool,
    /// For `InvalidateUnlessThrottled`.
    pub invalidate: bool,
    /// For `QueuePlaybackEvent`.
    pub current_time: OptionalTimeValue,
    pub timeline_time: OptionalTimeValue,
    pub scheduled_timeline_time: OptionalTimeValue,
    /// For `ScheduleWakeup`, in milliseconds.
    pub delay: f64,
    /// For `CancelFinishNotificationTask`, the host's identity of the task to cancel.
    pub task: u64,
    /// For `AssociateWithTarget` and `DisassociateFromTarget`, the host's `DOM::Element`.
    pub element: *mut c_void,
    /// For `DisassociateFromTarget` and `RecomputeEffectStyle`, the effect, which lives as long as the host performs
    /// this.
    pub effect: *const AnimationEffectCell,
}

/// What a procedure asks the host to do, as `HostEffectKind` describes it.
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum FfiHostEffectKind {
    ReplaceReadyPromise,
    ResolveReadyPromise,
    RejectReadyPromise,
    ReplaceFinishedPromise,
    ResolveFinishedPromise,
    RejectFinishedPromise,
    QueueFinishNotificationTask,
    CancelFinishNotificationTask,
    QueuePlaybackEvent,
    InvalidateEffect,
    InvalidateUnlessThrottled,
    AssociateWithTarget,
    DisassociateFromTarget,
    RecomputeEffectStyle,
    RequestRepaint,
    ScheduleWakeup,
}

impl FfiHostEffect {
    fn new(animation: &AnimationHandle, kind: &HostEffectKind, task: Option<HostTaskId>) -> Self {
        let mut effect = Self {
            animation: NonNull::from(&**animation),
            kind: FfiHostEffectKind::ReplaceReadyPromise,
            playback_event_type: PlaybackEventType::Finish,
            changes_plan: false,
            invalidate: false,
            current_time: OptionalTimeValue::UNRESOLVED,
            timeline_time: OptionalTimeValue::UNRESOLVED,
            scheduled_timeline_time: OptionalTimeValue::UNRESOLVED,
            delay: 0.0,
            task: task.map_or(0, |task| task.0.get()),
            element: std::ptr::null_mut(),
            effect: std::ptr::null(),
        };
        effect.kind = match *kind {
            HostEffectKind::ReplaceReadyPromise => FfiHostEffectKind::ReplaceReadyPromise,
            HostEffectKind::ResolveReadyPromise => FfiHostEffectKind::ResolveReadyPromise,
            HostEffectKind::RejectReadyPromise => FfiHostEffectKind::RejectReadyPromise,
            HostEffectKind::ReplaceFinishedPromise => FfiHostEffectKind::ReplaceFinishedPromise,
            HostEffectKind::ResolveFinishedPromise => FfiHostEffectKind::ResolveFinishedPromise,
            HostEffectKind::RejectFinishedPromise => FfiHostEffectKind::RejectFinishedPromise,
            HostEffectKind::QueueFinishNotificationTask => FfiHostEffectKind::QueueFinishNotificationTask,
            HostEffectKind::CancelFinishNotificationTask => FfiHostEffectKind::CancelFinishNotificationTask,
            HostEffectKind::QueuePlaybackEvent {
                r#type,
                current_time,
                timeline_time,
                scheduled_timeline_time,
            } => {
                effect.playback_event_type = r#type;
                effect.current_time = current_time.into();
                effect.timeline_time = timeline_time.into();
                effect.scheduled_timeline_time = scheduled_timeline_time.into();
                FfiHostEffectKind::QueuePlaybackEvent
            }
            HostEffectKind::InvalidateEffect { changes_plan } => {
                effect.changes_plan = changes_plan;
                FfiHostEffectKind::InvalidateEffect
            }
            HostEffectKind::InvalidateUnlessThrottled { invalidate } => {
                effect.invalidate = invalidate;
                FfiHostEffectKind::InvalidateUnlessThrottled
            }
            HostEffectKind::AssociateWithTarget { element } => {
                effect.element = element.as_ptr();
                FfiHostEffectKind::AssociateWithTarget
            }
            HostEffectKind::DisassociateFromTarget {
                element,
                effect: ref animation_effect,
            } => {
                effect.element = element.as_ptr();
                effect.effect = &raw const **animation_effect;
                FfiHostEffectKind::DisassociateFromTarget
            }
            HostEffectKind::RecomputeEffectStyle {
                effect: ref animation_effect,
            } => {
                effect.effect = &raw const **animation_effect;
                FfiHostEffectKind::RecomputeEffectStyle
            }
            HostEffectKind::RequestRepaint => FfiHostEffectKind::RequestRepaint,
            HostEffectKind::ScheduleWakeup { delay } => {
                effect.delay = delay;
                FfiHostEffectKind::ScheduleWakeup
            }
        };
        effect
    }
}

/// The host's function that performs what a procedure asks of it.
pub type HostEffectPerformer = extern "C" fn(effect: &FfiHostEffect);

/// Runs `procedure`, which does not throw, on `animation` and then has the host perform what it asked for through
/// `perform`, in order, holding no borrow of any record.
pub(crate) fn run_procedure(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
    procedure: impl FnOnce(&mut Procedures<'_>),
) {
    run_procedure_on(animation, perform, |procedures| {
        procedure(procedures);
        Ok(())
    })
    .expect("the procedure does not throw");
}

/// Runs `procedure` on `animation` and then has the host perform what it asked for through `perform`, in order, holding
/// no borrow of any record.
pub(crate) fn run_procedure_on(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
    procedure: impl FnOnce(&mut Procedures<'_>) -> Result<(), AnimationError>,
) -> Result<(), AnimationError> {
    // SAFETY: The host holds a reference to every animation it runs a procedure on.
    let animation = unsafe { AnimationHandle::retained_from_host(animation) };
    let ((), effects) = procedures::run(&animation, procedure)?;
    perform_host_effects(effects, perform);
    Ok(())
}

/// Has the host perform `effects` through `perform`, in order, holding no borrow of any record.
fn perform_host_effects(effects: HostEffects, perform: HostEffectPerformer) {
    for (animation, kind) in effects {
        // NB: A procedure may name an animation that is no longer alive to the host, whose record the host only lets go
        //     of as it sweeps.
        if !animation.is_alive() {
            continue;
        }
        // NB: The record keeps the task the host queued, which the host then neither queues again nor cancels without.
        let task = animation.borrow().finish_notification_task;
        match kind {
            HostEffectKind::QueueFinishNotificationTask if task.is_some() => continue,
            HostEffectKind::CancelFinishNotificationTask if task.is_none() => continue,
            _ => {}
        }
        perform(&FfiHostEffect::new(&animation, &kind, task));
        // NB: A canceled task is no longer queued, so a later finish notification task can be queued again.
        if matches!(kind, HostEffectKind::CancelFinishNotificationTask) {
            animation.borrow_mut().finish_notification_task = None;
        }
    }
}

/// Notes `task`, the host's identity of the task it queued to run the finish notification steps of `animation`, or to
/// dispatch its finish event.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_set_finish_notification_task(animation: &AnimationCell, task: u64) {
    let task = HostTaskId(NonZeroU64::new(task).expect("the host's tasks have nonzero identities"));
    animation.borrow_mut().finish_notification_task = Some(task);
}

pub(crate) fn invalidate(invalidate: bool) -> Invalidate {
    if invalidate { Invalidate::Yes } else { Invalidate::No }
}

/// Runs the finish notification steps of `animation` on its timeline, if it has one, from the task the host queued.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_run_finish_notification_steps(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) {
    run_procedure(animation, perform, |procedures| procedures.finish_notification_steps());
}

/// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#dom-animation-cancel
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_cancel(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
    should_invalidate: bool,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) {
    run_procedure(animation, perform, |procedures| {
        procedures.cancel(invalidate(should_invalidate));
    });
}

/// Hands the host the one reference to a new keyframe set.
fn into_host(set: KeyframeSet) -> *const KeyframeSet {
    Arc::into_raw(Arc::new(set))
}

/// Takes another reference to a keyframe set the host holds one to.
///
/// # Safety
/// `set` must be a keyframe set the host holds a reference to.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_keyframe_set_retain(set: *const KeyframeSet) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { Arc::increment_strong_count(set) };
}

/// Gives up one of the references the host holds to a keyframe set.
///
/// # Safety
/// `set` must be a keyframe set the host holds a reference to, which it gives up.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_keyframe_set_release(set: *const KeyframeSet) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { Arc::decrement_strong_count(set) };
}

/// The keyframe set of the `@keyframes` rule `rule` views, from a style sheet whose base URL, where
/// `has_resource_context`, is `base_url`, with the reference to it the host takes over.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_keyframe_set_from_keyframes_rule(
    rule: &crate::css::rule::read::NativeRuleView<'_>,
    has_resource_context: bool,
    base_url: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    origin_clean: bool,
) -> *const KeyframeSet {
    let resource_context = has_resource_context.then(|| ResourceContext {
        base_url: base_url.as_slice().into(),
        origin_clean,
    });
    let mut blocks = Vec::new();
    rule.for_each_keyframe(|keys, declarations| blocks.push((keys.to_vec(), declarations)));
    into_host(KeyframeSet::from_keyframes_rule(
        blocks
            .iter()
            .map(|(keys, declarations)| (keys.as_slice(), &**declarations)),
        resource_context,
    ))
}

/// One keyframe script gave a `KeyframeEffect`, as processing the keyframes argument made it: its computed offset, its
/// composite operation, its easing where it has one, and the range of the properties it
/// declares.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiProcessedKeyframe {
    pub offset: f64,
    pub composite: CompositeOperationOrAuto,
    pub has_easing: bool,
    pub easing: FfiEasingDescriptor,
    pub first_property: u32,
    pub property_count: u32,
}

/// One property a processed keyframe declares: a longhand or shorthand by its id, or, where `custom_name` is not
/// zero, the custom property of that raw fly string, with its value.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiProcessedKeyframeProperty {
    pub property_id: u16,
    pub custom_name: usize,
    pub value: *const c_void,
}

/// The property a host names by its id, or by the raw fly string of a custom property's name where that is not zero.
///
/// # Safety
/// `custom_name` must be zero or a live raw fly string.
unsafe fn keyframe_property(property_id: u16, custom_name: usize) -> KeyframeProperty {
    match custom_name {
        0 => KeyframeProperty::Id(property_id),
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        name => KeyframeProperty::Custom(unsafe { RetainedUtf16FlyString::from_borrowed_raw(name) }),
    }
}

/// # Safety
/// `value` must be null or a live style value.
unsafe fn retained_optional_value(value: *const c_void) -> RetainedStyleValueData {
    if value.is_null() {
        return RetainedStyleValueData::none();
    }
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { retained_value(value) }
}

/// # Safety
/// `value` must be a live style value.
unsafe fn retained_value(value: *const c_void) -> RetainedStyleValueData {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { RetainedStyleValueData::from_retained_pointer(retain_style_value(value.cast::<StyleValueData>())) }
}

/// The keyframe set of the keyframes script gave a `KeyframeEffect`, in the order it gave them, with the reference to
/// it the host takes over.
///
/// # Safety
/// Every value, custom-property name and linear easing point the keyframes name must be live for the call.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_keyframe_set_from_processed_keyframes(
    keyframes: ak::Span<'_, FfiProcessedKeyframe>,
    properties: ak::Span<'_, FfiProcessedKeyframeProperty>,
) -> *const KeyframeSet {
    let properties = properties.as_slice();
    let keyframes = keyframes
        .as_slice()
        .iter()
        .map(|keyframe| {
            let first = keyframe.first_property as usize;
            ProcessedKeyframe {
                key: key_of_offset(keyframe.offset),
                composite: keyframe.composite,
                // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
                easing: keyframe
                    .has_easing
                    .then(|| unsafe { Easing::from_descriptor(&keyframe.easing) }),
                declarations: properties[first..first + keyframe.property_count as usize]
                    .iter()
                    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
                    .map(|property| unsafe {
                        (
                            keyframe_property(property.property_id, property.custom_name),
                            retained_value(property.value),
                        )
                    })
                    .collect(),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    into_host(KeyframeSet::from_processed_keyframes(keyframes, None))
}

/// What follows from a set's keyframes alone, borrowed from the set: the longhands they animate, sorted, the raw fly
/// strings of the names of the custom properties they animate, and what the set answers of them.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiKeyframeSetFacts {
    pub target_properties: *const u16,
    pub target_property_count: usize,
    pub target_custom_properties: *const usize,
    pub target_custom_property_count: usize,
    pub animates_what_a_tick_cannot: bool,
    pub animates_an_inherited_property: bool,
}

/// What follows from the keyframes of a set alone.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_keyframe_set_facts(set: &KeyframeSet) -> FfiKeyframeSetFacts {
    FfiKeyframeSetFacts {
        target_properties: set.target_properties().as_ptr(),
        target_property_count: set.target_properties().len(),
        target_custom_properties: set.target_custom_properties().as_ptr().cast(),
        target_custom_property_count: set.target_custom_properties().len(),
        animates_what_a_tick_cannot: set.animates_what_a_tick_cannot(),
        animates_an_inherited_property: set.animates_an_inherited_property(),
    }
}

/// Notes what the `attr()`s of the values a keyframe set declares can read, answering whether they can read a name
/// none could before.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_note_attr_names_read_by_keyframe_set(host: &DocumentHost, set: &KeyframeSet) -> bool {
    let before = crate::css::style::host_atoms::attr_names_read_generation(host);
    crate::css::style::host_atoms::note_attr_names_read_by(host, set.declared_values());
    crate::css::style::host_atoms::attr_names_read_generation(host) != before
}

/// Takes a reference of its own to `effect`, which the host gives up with `animations_effect_release`.
///
/// # Safety
/// `effect` must be an effect the host holds a reference to.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_effect_retain(effect: *const AnimationEffectCell) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let _ = unsafe { EffectHandle::retained_from_host(effect) }.into_raw();
}

/// The host's `AnimationEffect` of `effect`, while it is alive.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_effect_object_cell(effect: &AnimationEffectCell) -> *mut c_void {
    effect.object_cell().map_or(std::ptr::null_mut(), NonNull::as_ptr)
}

/// Gives up a reference the host holds to an effect.
///
/// # Safety
/// `effect` must be an effect the host holds a reference to, which it gives up.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_effect_release(effect: *const AnimationEffectCell) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    drop(unsafe { EffectHandle::from_raw(effect) });
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_effect_id(effect: &AnimationEffectCell) -> AnimationEffectId {
    effect.borrow().id()
}

    effect.borrow_mut().set_keyframes(Some(set.to_arc()));

/// Sets the host's `DOM::Element` that `effect` targets, which the host keeps alive while the effect targets it, or
/// none where `element` is null, and has the host associate the associated animation of `effect`, if any, with it
/// through `perform`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_effect_set_target_element(
    effect: &AnimationEffectCell,
    element: *mut c_void,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) {
    // SAFETY: The host holds a reference to the effect it passes.
    let effect = unsafe { EffectHandle::retained_from_host(effect) };
    perform_host_effects(procedures::set_effect_target(&effect, NonNull::new(element)), perform);
}

/// The animation whose associated effect `effect` is, which it borrows for as long as it is, or null where it is the
/// associated effect of none.

    effect
        .borrow()
        .associated_animation()
        .map_or(std::ptr::null(), |animation| {
            std::ptr::from_ref::<AnimationCell>(&animation)
        })
}

/// The target pseudo-selector of an effect: the host's `PseudoElement`, and the raw fly string of its serialization,
/// or zero where the effect has none.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiEffectPseudoElement {
    pub kind: u8,
    pub serialization: usize,
}

/// The target of an effect: the host's `DOM::Element` it targets, or null where it targets none, and its target
/// pseudo-selector.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiEffectTarget {
    pub element: *mut c_void,
    pub pseudo_element: FfiEffectPseudoElement,
}

/// The target of `effect`, whose pseudo-selector's serialization it borrows until it changes.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_effect_target(effect: &AnimationEffectCell) -> FfiEffectTarget {
    let effect = effect.borrow();
    FfiEffectTarget {
        element: effect
            .target_element()
            .map_or(std::ptr::null_mut(), std::ptr::NonNull::as_ptr),
        pseudo_element: effect.pseudo_element().map_or(
            FfiEffectPseudoElement {
                kind: 0,
                serialization: 0,
            },
            |pseudo_element| FfiEffectPseudoElement {
                kind: pseudo_element.kind,
                serialization: pseudo_element.serialization.raw(),
            },
        ),
    }
}

    effect.borrow().has_flag(flag)

    effect.borrow_mut().forget_what_the_host_concluded();
}

}

/// A new idle CSS animation named `name` with no associated effect.
pub(crate) fn new_css_animation(name: RetainedUtf16FlyString) -> AnimationHandle {
    AnimationHandle::new(AnimationKind::CssAnimation(CssAnimationState {
        name,
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-1/#animation-timing-function
        // NB: The initial value of animation-timing-function is ease.
        default_easing: CompactEasing::of(super::easing::keyword_cubic_bezier(0)),
        applied_definition: None,
        named_timeline: RetainedUtf16FlyString::none(),
        name_index: 0,
        last_css_play_state: None,
        flags: 0,
    }))
}

/// What a CSS transition is of and runs between, as the host starts one and reads it: the longhand by its id, or, where
/// `custom_name` is not zero, the custom property of that raw fly string, and the values, which a transition the host
/// reads lends it for as long as it holds the transition.
pub struct TransitionDescription {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub start_time: f64,
    pub reversing_shortening_factor: f64,
    pub custom_name: usize,
    pub start_value: *const c_void,
    pub end_value: *const c_void,
    pub reversing_adjusted_start_value: *const c_void,
    pub property_id: u16,
}

/// What the host describes of the animation of an SVG animation element as it creates it.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiSmilAnimation {
    /// The host's `SVGAnimationElement` whose animation it is, which holds the animation until it lets go of it.
    pub animation_element: NonNull<c_void>,
    /// The host's `DOM::Element` the effect of the animation targets.
    pub target: NonNull<c_void>,
    /// The keyframes the effect runs, which the host holds a reference to.
    pub keyframes: *const KeyframeSet,
    pub timing: SpecifiedEffectTiming,
    /// The timing function of the effect and the serialization of the value it was made from, or null for linear.
    pub timing_function: *const FfiEasingDescriptor,
    pub timing_function_serialization: usize,
    /// The time the animation begins at, which orders it among the animations of its time container.
    pub begin_time: f64,
}

/// A new animation of an SVG animation element on the default document timeline of its document, whose associated effect is a new keyframe effect as
/// `description` describes, with the one reference to it the host takes over. The host makes no `Animation` of it, and
/// its animation element holds it until it lets go of it.
///
/// # Safety
/// `description` must name live host objects and keyframes, and a timing function, if any, must be live.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_smil_animation_create(
    description: &FfiSmilAnimation,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) -> *const AnimationCell {
    let effect = EffectHandle::new();
    {
        let mut record = effect.borrow_mut();
        record.set_specified_timing(description.timing);
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        if let Some(timing_function) = unsafe { description.timing_function.as_ref() } {
            // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
            let (timing_function, serialization) = unsafe {
                (
                    CompactEasing::of(Easing::from_descriptor(timing_function)),
                    RetainedUtf16FlyString::from_borrowed_raw(description.timing_function_serialization),
                )
            };
            record.set_timing_function(timing_function, serialization);
        }
        record.normalize_specified_timing(None);
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        record.set_keyframes(Some(unsafe { KeyframeSet::retained_from_host(description.keyframes) }));
    }
    perform_host_effects(
        procedures::set_effect_target(&effect, Some(description.target)),
        perform,
    );

    let animation = AnimationHandle::new(AnimationKind::Smil {
        begin_time: description.begin_time,
        animation_element: description.animation_element,
        holders: SmilHolder::AnimationElement as u8,
    });
    let timeline = default_document_timeline(element_node_document(description.animation_element));
    run_procedure(&animation, perform, |procedures| {
        procedures.set_timeline(Some(timeline));
    });
    run_procedure(&animation, perform, |procedures| {
        procedures.set_the_associated_effect(Some(&effect), Invalidate::Yes);
    });
    animation.into_raw()
}

/// Notes that the SVG animation element of `animation` lets go of it, as it is done with it or as the host finalizes the
/// element.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_smil_animation_let_go(animation: &AnimationCell) {
    animation.note_smil_holder(SmilHolder::AnimationElement, false);
}

/// Calls `visit` with `context` and each GC cell of the host that keeps alive the elements the record of `animation`
/// names, which a holder of the record the GC traces visits.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_visit_host_cells(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
    context: *mut c_void,
    visit: unsafe extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void, cell: *mut c_void, kind: HostCellKind),
) {
    animation.for_each_host_cell(|cell, kind| {
        // SAFETY: The host visits a cell of an animation it holds.
        unsafe { visit(context, cell.as_ptr(), kind) }
    });
}

/// The associated effect of `animation`, which it borrows for as long as the animation holds it, or null where it has
/// none.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_effect(animation: &AnimationCell) -> *const AnimationEffectCell {
    animation.borrow().effect().map_or(std::ptr::null(), |effect| {
        std::ptr::from_ref::<AnimationEffectCell>(effect)
    })
}

/// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#animation-timeline
/// The record of the timeline of `animation`, or null where it has none. The pointer stays valid while the animation
/// keeps that timeline.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_timeline(animation: &AnimationCell) -> *const TimelineCell {
    animation
        .borrow()
        .timeline()
        .map_or(std::ptr::null(), |timeline| &raw const **timeline)
}

/// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#play-states
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_play_state(animation: &AnimationCell) -> AnimationPlayState {
    animation.borrow().play_state()
}

/// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#playback-rate
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_playback_rate(animation: &AnimationCell) -> f64 {
    animation.borrow().playback().playback_rate
}

/// The host's function that keeps `animation`, which it holds a reference to, alive to it with `context` until the call
/// that handed it the function returns, since what it performs for the animation can run the GC.
pub type FfiKeepAlive = unsafe extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void, animation: &AnimationCell);

/// Has the host keep alive, through `keep_alive` with `context`, every animation `effects` names.
fn keep_alive_for_host_effects(effects: &HostEffects, keep_alive: FfiKeepAlive, context: *mut c_void) {
    let mut previous: Option<&AnimationHandle> = None;
    for (animation, _) in effects.iter() {
        if previous.is_some_and(|previous| previous.ptr_eq(animation)) {
            continue;
        }
        // SAFETY: The host keeps alive an animation it is handed for as long as the call that handed it lasts.
        unsafe { keep_alive(context, animation) };
        previous = Some(animation);
    }
}

/// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#remove-replaced-animations
/// For the host's `DOM::Document` `document`, whose animations are `animations`, comparing elements in tree order with
/// `tree_order`, and has the host keep each animation it removes alive through `keep_alive` with `context` and perform
/// what that asks of it through `perform`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_remove_replaced_animations(
    animations: &DocumentAnimations,
    document: NonNull<c_void>,
    tree_order: FfiTreeOrder,
    keep_alive: FfiKeepAlive,
    context: *mut c_void,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) {
    let timelines = animations.timelines.clone();
    let effects = procedures::remove_replaced_animations(
        timelines.iter().map(|timeline| &**timeline),
        |element| element_node_document(element) == document,
        &mut host_tree_order(tree_order),
    );
    keep_alive_for_host_effects(&effects, keep_alive, context);
    perform_host_effects(effects, perform);
}

/// Keeps the animation of an SVG animation element, on its timeline, if it has one, at the time of its time container,
/// which began at `zero_time` of the document timeline and, where `is_paused`, is paused at `paused_time`, in
/// milliseconds.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_smil_animation_synchronize(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
    zero_time: f64,
    is_paused: bool,
    paused_time: f64,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) {
    run_procedure(animation, perform, |procedures| {
        procedures.synchronize_with_smil_time_container(zero_time, is_paused.then_some(paused_time));
    });
}

/// What the render clock's plan makes of `animation`: its play is pending and a tick holds its element still, a tick
/// cannot move it, or a tick moves it.
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum FfiClockPlanAnimationKind {
    Held,
    NotTicked,
    Ticked,
}

/// What the render clock's plan makes of an animation, and, where a tick moves it, the local time of its effect and,
/// on a document timeline, the time its active interval ends at.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiClockPlanAnimation {
    pub kind: FfiClockPlanAnimationKind,
    pub local_time: TimeValue,
    pub active_end: TimeValue,
}

/// What the render clock's plan makes of `animation`, of a keyframe effect with a target, on its timeline.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_clock_plan(animation: &AnimationCell) -> FfiClockPlanAnimation {
    let unresolved = TimeValue::milliseconds(0.0);
    let animation = animation.borrow();
    let timeline = animation.timeline().expect("the plan runs on animations of timelines");
    let on_scroll_timeline = timeline.borrow().scroll().is_some();
    let plan = match animation.clock_plan(timeline.current_time(), on_scroll_timeline) {
        // NB: A tick moves an animation of a scroll timeline only where it follows the timeline as the plan seals it.
        ClockPlanAnimation::Ticked { .. } if on_scroll_timeline && timeline.clock_snapshot().is_none() => {
            ClockPlanAnimation::NotTicked
        }
        plan => plan,
    };
    match plan {
        ClockPlanAnimation::Held => FfiClockPlanAnimation {
            kind: FfiClockPlanAnimationKind::Held,
            local_time: unresolved,
            active_end: unresolved,
        },
        ClockPlanAnimation::NotTicked => FfiClockPlanAnimation {
            kind: FfiClockPlanAnimationKind::NotTicked,
            local_time: unresolved,
            active_end: unresolved,
        },
        ClockPlanAnimation::Ticked { local_time, active_end } => FfiClockPlanAnimation {
            kind: FfiClockPlanAnimationKind::Ticked,
            local_time,
            active_end,
        },
    }
}

/// The timing a hover of the render clock's lane runs `animation`, of a keyframe effect, with, on its timeline.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_hover_timing(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
) -> super::snapshot::EffectTimingSnapshot {
    let animation = animation.borrow();
    let timeline = animation.timeline().expect("the hover runs animations of timelines");
    animation.hover_timing(timeline.sample(), true, timeline.clock())
}

/// The owning element of a CSS animation or transition: the host's `DOM::Element`, or null where it has none, and the
/// host's `PseudoElement`, where `has_pseudo_element`.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct FfiOwningElement {
    pub element: *mut c_void,
    pub pseudo_element: u8,
    pub has_pseudo_element: bool,
}

/// https://www.w3.org/TR/css-animations-2/#owning-element-section
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_animation_owning_element(animation: &AnimationCell) -> FfiOwningElement {
    match animation.borrow().owning_element() {
        Some(owner) => FfiOwningElement {
            element: owner.element.as_ptr(),
            pseudo_element: owner.pseudo_element.unwrap_or(0),
            has_pseudo_element: owner.pseudo_element.is_some(),
        },
        None => FfiOwningElement {
            element: std::ptr::null_mut(),
            pseudo_element: 0,
            has_pseudo_element: false,
        },
    }
}

/// Applies the timing, attachment range, easing, composite operation and play state the style computation computed in
/// `definition` to the CSS animation `animation`, whose timeline is updated, having the host perform what that asks for
/// through `perform`.
/// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-2/#animations
///
/// # Safety
/// The values `definition` names must be null or live style values.
unsafe fn apply_css_animation_properties(
    animation: &AnimationCell,
    definition: &crate::css::style_compute::FfiComputedAnimation,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) {
    use crate::css::css_enums::{animation_composition, animation_direction, animation_fill_mode};
    use libcompositing_rust::animation_timing::effect_timing::{
        FillMode as SpecifiedFillMode, PlaybackDirection, SpecifiedIterationDuration,
    };
