                vec![keyframe(0), keyframe(crate::animations::keyframes::FINAL_KEY)],
                None,
            ))));
        // NB: A set of animations holds only the animations whose host `Animation` is alive.
        animation.set_object_cell(Some(NonNull::<u8>::dangling().cast()));
        animation.borrow_mut().playback_mut().start_time = Some(TimeValue::milliseconds(0.0)).into();
        run(&animation, |procedures| {
            procedures.set_timeline(Some(timeline.clone()));
            Ok(())
        })
        .unwrap();
        animation
    }

    fn removed_animations(effects: HostEffects) -> Vec<AnimationHandle> {
        effects
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|(animation, kind)| {
                matches!(
                    kind,
                    HostEffectKind::QueuePlaybackEvent {
                        r#type: PlaybackEventType::Remove,
                        ..
                    }
                )
                .then_some(animation)
            })
            .collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_animation_whose_properties_later_animations_replace_is_removed() {
        use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
        let dangling = NonNull::<u8>::dangling().cast::<c_void>();
        let timeline = TimelineHandle::new(
            dangling,
            TimelineKind::Internal {
                time_for_observation: None,
            },
        );
        timeline.set_internal_time(Some(2000.0), false, 0, || {});
        let target = dangling;
        let in_document = |_| true;
        let replaced = finished_animation(&timeline, target, &[property_id::OPACITY]);
        let partly_replaced = finished_animation(&timeline, target, &[property_id::OPACITY, property_id::COLOR]);
        let replacing = finished_animation(&timeline, target, &[property_id::OPACITY]);

        let effects = remove_replaced_animations([&*timeline], in_document, &mut |_, _| std::cmp::Ordering::Equal);
        let removed = removed_animations(effects);
        assert_eq!(removed.len(), 1);
        assert!(removed[0].ptr_eq(&replaced));
        assert_eq!(
            replaced.borrow().playback().replace_state,
            AnimationReplaceState::Removed
        );
        assert!(!timeline.associated_animations().borrow().contains(&replaced));
        for animation in [&partly_replaced, &replacing] {
            assert_eq!(
                animation.borrow().playback().replace_state,
                AnimationReplaceState::Active
            );
        }

        // A removed animation is no longer replaceable, and the others replace nothing more.
        let effects = remove_replaced_animations([&*timeline], in_document, &mut |_, _| std::cmp::Ordering::Equal);
        assert!(removed_animations(effects).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_finished_animations_of_the_document_are_replaced() {
        use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
        let dangling = NonNull::<u8>::dangling().cast::<c_void>();
        let timeline = TimelineHandle::new(
            dangling,
            TimelineKind::Internal {
                time_for_observation: None,
            },
        );
        timeline.set_internal_time(Some(500.0), false, 0, || {});
        let running = finished_animation(&timeline, dangling, &[property_id::OPACITY]);
        let _replacing = finished_animation(&timeline, dangling, &[property_id::OPACITY]);

        // An animation that has not finished is not replaceable.
        let effects = remove_replaced_animations([&*timeline], |_| true, &mut |_, _| std::cmp::Ordering::Equal);
        assert!(removed_animations(effects).is_empty());

        // Nor is one whose target is not a descendant of the document.
        timeline.set_internal_time(Some(2000.0), false, 0, || {});
        let effects = remove_replaced_animations([&*timeline], |_| false, &mut |_, _| std::cmp::Ordering::Equal);
        assert!(removed_animations(effects).is_empty());

        let effects = remove_replaced_animations([&*timeline], |_| true, &mut |_, _| std::cmp::Ordering::Equal);
        let removed = removed_animations(effects);
        assert_eq!(removed.len(), 1);
        assert!(removed[0].ptr_eq(&running));
    }
}

/*

//! The transition actions a style stabilization epoch decides, which stay provisional until the epoch commits.
//! https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transitions/#starting

use super::animation::{AnimationHandle, HostCellKind};
use super::effect::AnimationEffectCell;
use super::element_animations::{AnimationOwnerSlot, ElementAnimations, TransitionProperty};
use crate::css::retained_fly_string::RetainedUtf16FlyString;
use crate::css::transition::FfiTransitionActionKind;
use smallvec::SmallVec;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

/// The element, or one of its pseudo-elements, whose transitions a transition step decides.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(crate) struct TransitionTarget {
    pub(crate) element: NonNull<c_void>,
    /// The host's `PseudoElement`, where the target is a pseudo-element.
    pub(crate) pseudo_element: Option<u8>,
}

/// What the epoch decided so far for the transitions of one property of one target.
pub(crate) struct ProvisionalTransitionState {
    pub(crate) target: TransitionTarget,
    /// The lists of the target's element, which the element owns for as long as it lives, and the slot of the target
    /// in them, where it can own transitions.
    pub(crate) animations: NonNull<ElementAnimations>,
    pub(crate) slot: Option<AnimationOwnerSlot>,
    pub(crate) property: TransitionProperty,
    /// The name of a custom property, which the state keys on by its raw fly string, kept alive with the state.
    _custom_name: RetainedUtf16FlyString,
    /// The transition of the property the target held as the epoch first decided over it.
    pub(crate) committed: Option<AnimationHandle>,
    /// The transition the latest decision started provisionally, if any.
    pub(crate) proposed: Option<AnimationHandle>,
    pub(crate) action: FfiTransitionActionKind,
    pub(crate) has_decision: bool,
}

/// The provisional transition states of a document's current style stabilization epoch, in the order the epoch first
/// decided over each.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct ProvisionalTransitions {
    states: Vec<ProvisionalTransitionState>,
    by_property: HashMap<(TransitionTarget, TransitionProperty), usize>,
    by_target: HashMap<TransitionTarget, SmallVec<[usize; 2]>>,
}

impl ProvisionalTransitions {
    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.states.is_empty()
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_states(&self, target: TransitionTarget) -> bool {
        self.by_target.contains_key(&target)
    }

    /// The indices of the states of `target`.
    pub(crate) fn indices_of(&self, target: TransitionTarget) -> SmallVec<[usize; 2]> {
        self.by_target.get(&target).cloned().unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub(crate) fn state_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> &mut ProvisionalTransitionState {
        &mut self.states[index]
    }

    pub(crate) fn state(&self, index: usize) -> &ProvisionalTransitionState {
        &self.states[index]
    }

    /// The index of the state of `property` of `target`, created with the transition of the property its lists
    /// `animations` hold at `slot` as the committed one where the epoch did not decide over it yet.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// `animations` must be the lists of the target's element.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn ensure(
        &mut self,
        target: TransitionTarget,
        animations: NonNull<ElementAnimations>,
        slot: Option<AnimationOwnerSlot>,
        property: TransitionProperty,
    ) -> usize {
        if let Some(&index) = self.by_property.get(&(target, property)) {
            return index;
        }
        let index = self.states.len();
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        let committed = slot.and_then(|slot| unsafe { animations.as_ref() }.transition(slot, property).cloned());
        self.states.push(ProvisionalTransitionState {
            target,
            animations,
            slot,
            property,
            // SAFETY: The name is a live fly string the step decides over, or zero.
            _custom_name: unsafe { RetainedUtf16FlyString::from_borrowed_raw(property.custom_name) },
            committed,
            proposed: None,
            action: FfiTransitionActionKind::None,
            has_decision: false,
        });
        self.by_property.insert((target, property), index);
        self.by_target.entry(target).or_default().push(index);
        index
    }

    pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.states.len()
    }

    /// The effect of the transition at `index` among those the epoch started provisionally for `target`, which the
    /// transition holds for as long as the epoch holds it, or null past the last.
    pub(crate) fn proposed_effect(&self, target: TransitionTarget, index: usize) -> *const AnimationEffectCell {
        self.by_target
            .get(&target)
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter_map(|&state| self.states[state].proposed.as_ref())
            .filter_map(|transition| transition.borrow().effect().map(|effect| &raw const **effect))
            .nth(index)
            .unwrap_or(std::ptr::null())
    }

    /// Takes every state, as the epoch commits.
    pub(crate) fn take(&mut self) -> Vec<ProvisionalTransitionState> {
        self.by_property.clear();
        self.by_target.clear();
        std::mem::take(&mut self.states)
    }

    /// Calls `visit` with each GC cell of the host the states keep alive: the elements they decide over and what keeps
    /// alive what their transitions name.
    pub(crate) fn for_each_host_cell(&self, mut visit: impl FnMut(NonNull<c_void>, HostCellKind)) {
        for state in &self.states {
            visit(state.target.element, HostCellKind::Element);
            for transition in state.committed.iter().chain(state.proposed.iter()) {
                transition.for_each_host_cell(&mut visit);
            }
        }
    }
}

//! What the animated style updates and the rendering updates of a document decide of the animations associated with
//! it.

use super::animation::{AnimationCell, AnimationHandle};
use super::composite_order::composite_order;
use super::compositor_update::{
    next_throttled_animation_iteration_event_time, request_observation_sample, set_needs_animated_style_update,
};
use super::document_animations::{DocumentAnimationSetKind, DocumentAnimations};
use super::effect::{AnimationEffectCell, EffectFlag, EffectHandle, ObservationSampleRequest};
use super::element_animations::ElementAnimations;
use super::ffi::{
    FfiKeepAlive, HostEffectPerformer, host_tree_order, run_procedure, web_animation_compare_elements_in_tree_order,
};
use super::host_timing::FfiAnimationKind;
use super::throttling::{can_skip_per_frame_animation_tick, can_skip_per_frame_style_update};
use super::timing::{AnimationPlayState, OptionalNumber, TimeValueType};
use std::ffi::c_void;

/// What sampling the effects that need an animated style update of a document asks of the host, which hands each
/// function `context`.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiAnimatedStyleSampleHost {
    pub context: *mut c_void,
    pub keep_alive: FfiKeepAlive,
    /// Readies the host to sample the effects.
    pub begin: unsafe extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void),
    /// Samples `effect` into the style of its target.
    pub update: unsafe extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void, effect: &AnimationEffectCell),
    /// Has the host publish what it sampled.
    pub end: unsafe extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void),
}

/// What sampling the effects that need an animated style update of a document found.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiAnimatedStyleSampleOutcome {
    /// Whether there were any effects to sample.
    pub sampled: bool,
    /// Whether an effect that can skip its per-frame style update was left unsampled.
    pub has_throttled_animation_style_update: bool,
}

/// Samples the effects whose animated style a document's next animated style update samples, in the composite order
/// of their animations, or, where `force_throttled`, those of every animation associated with it that is not idle,
/// and the idle ones that need it, skipping those that can skip their per-frame style update and that no observation
/// asked for unless `force_throttled`. `has_throttled` is whether an earlier update left a throttled effect unsampled.
///
/// # Safety
/// `animations` must be what a live document knows of animations, which the host may reach as it samples.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_document_animations_sample_effects_needing_style_update(
    animations: *mut DocumentAnimations,
    force_throttled: bool,
    has_throttled: bool,
    host: &FfiAnimatedStyleSampleHost,
) -> FfiAnimatedStyleSampleOutcome {
    let mut effects: Vec<(AnimationHandle, EffectHandle)> = Vec::new();
    {
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller, and the borrow ends before the host is called.
        let animations = unsafe { &mut *animations };
        if force_throttled {
            for animation in animations.associated_animations() {
                let Some(effect) = animation.borrow().effect().cloned() else {
                    continue;
                };
                // NB: Dirty idle effects still need to remove their last sampled values after cancellation.
                if animation.borrow().play_state() == AnimationPlayState::Idle
                    && !animations.needing_animated_style_update().contains(&effect)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                effects.push((animation, effect));
            }
            animations.needing_animated_style_update().take_each(|_| {});
        } else {
            animations.needing_animated_style_update().take_each(|effect| {
                // NB: A canceled animation still needs to remove its last sampled values.
                if let Some(animation) = effect.borrow().associated_animation() {
                    effects.push((animation, effect.clone()));
                }
            });
        }
    }

    if effects.is_empty() {
        // A compositor-driven effect can remain throttled when every dirty effect was canceled before this sample.
        // Preserve the flag so a later style or geometry read can still request a current main-thread sample.
        return FfiAnimatedStyleSampleOutcome {
            sampled: false,
            has_throttled_animation_style_update: has_throttled,
        };
    }

    // NB: The effects stay alive for as long as the update holds them.
    for (animation, _) in &effects {
        // SAFETY: The host keeps alive an animation it is handed for as long as this call lasts.
        unsafe { (host.keep_alive)(host.context, animation) };
    }

    let has_requested_observation_sample = effects
        .iter()
        .any(|(_, effect)| effect.borrow().has_flag(EffectFlag::NeedsObservationSample));

    // A timeline script observed ahead of its current time in this task is sampled at that time too, so that a style
    // read agrees with the time script read, however many reads the task makes. Where an observation asked for the
    // sample, all of them are.
    DocumentAnimations::at_observed_times(animations, force_throttled || has_requested_observation_sample, || {
        // SAFETY: The host answers synchronously.
        unsafe { (host.begin)(host.context) };
        // SAFETY: As above.
        let has_throttled_animation_style_update =
            unsafe { sample_effects_in_composite_order(effects, force_throttled, has_throttled, host) };
        // SAFETY: As above.
        unsafe { (host.end)(host.context) };
        FfiAnimatedStyleSampleOutcome {
            sampled: true,
            has_throttled_animation_style_update,
        }
    })
}

/// Samples `effects` through `host` in the composite order of their animations, answering whether an effect that can
/// skip its per-frame style update was left unsampled.
///
/// # Safety
/// The host must sample synchronously.
unsafe fn sample_effects_in_composite_order(
    mut effects: Vec<(AnimationHandle, EffectHandle)>,
    force_throttled: bool,
    has_throttled: bool,
    host: &FfiAnimatedStyleSampleHost,
) -> bool {
    let mut tree_order = host_tree_order(web_animation_compare_elements_in_tree_order);
    effects.sort_by(|(a, _), (b, _)| {
        if a.ptr_eq(b) {
            return std::cmp::Ordering::Equal;
        }
        composite_order(&a.borrow(), &b.borrow(), &mut tree_order)
    });

    let mut has_throttled_animation_style_update = !force_throttled && has_throttled;
    for (_, effect) in &effects {
        let observation_sample_requested = effect.borrow_mut().set_flag(EffectFlag::NeedsObservationSample, false);
        if can_skip_per_frame_style_update(effect) {
            has_throttled_animation_style_update = true;
            if !force_throttled && !observation_sample_requested {
                continue;
            }
        }
        // SAFETY: The host answers synchronously, and the effect stays alive through the call.
        unsafe { (host.update)(host.context, effect) };
    }
    has_throttled_animation_style_update
}

/// A change of the sets of the effects a document's animated style updates sample.
#[expect(dead_code, reason = "C++ constructs the variants")]
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum EffectSetsChange {
    /// Sets aside the effects the next animated style update samples while the transaction of a style update that
    /// flew drains.
    SetAside,
    /// Restores the effects set aside.
    Restore,
    /// Forgets the effects the next animated style update samples, and those to ask for an observation sample.
    Clear,
    /// Asks for an observation sample of each effect that asked for one while the animated style update that finishes
    /// ran.
    FinishUpdate,
}

/// Makes `change` to the sets of the effects the animated style updates of a document sample.
///
/// # Safety
/// `animations` must be what a live document knows of animations, which the host may reach as it is asked for
/// samples.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_document_animations_change_effect_sets(
    animations: *mut DocumentAnimations,
    change: EffectSetsChange,
) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller, and the borrow ends before the host is called.
    let document = unsafe { &mut *animations };
    match change {
        EffectSetsChange::SetAside => document.set_aside_effects_needing_animated_style_update(false),
        EffectSetsChange::Restore => document.set_aside_effects_needing_animated_style_update(true),
        EffectSetsChange::Clear => {
            document.needing_animated_style_update().take_each(|_| {});
            document
                .needing_animated_style_update_after_current_update()
                .take_each(|_| {});
        }
        EffectSetsChange::FinishUpdate => {
            let mut effects = Vec::new();
            document
                .needing_animated_style_update_after_current_update()
                .take_each(|effect| effects.push(effect.clone()));
            for effect in &effects {
                request_observation_sample(effect);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Asks for an observation sample of each effect of the animations associated with an element, whose lists
/// `element` are, on behalf of a read of its style or layout in the task of generation `task_generation`: those
/// the next animated style update of the document samples anyway, unless `is_updating_animated_style`, and those that
/// can skip their per-frame style update, after the current update where `is_updating_animated_style`, and once per
/// task otherwise.
///
/// # Safety
/// `document` must be what the live document of the element knows of animations, which the host may reach as it is
/// asked for samples.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_element_animations_request_observation_samples(
    element: &ElementAnimations,
    document: *mut DocumentAnimations,
    is_updating_animated_style: bool,
    task_generation: u64,
) {
    let effects: Vec<EffectHandle> = element
        .associated()
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|animation| animation.borrow().effect().cloned())
        .collect();
    for effect in &effects {
        // NB: An effect that changed since it was last sampled, such as one script seeked after an earlier read in
        //     this task, is sampled for the read whether or not it can skip per-frame style updates now: the sample
        //     decides that again, from a layout that may have moved since.
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller; the borrow ends before the host is called.
        if !is_updating_animated_style
            && unsafe { &mut *document }
                .needing_animated_style_update()
                .contains(effect)
        {
            request_observation_sample(effect);
            continue;
        }
        if !can_skip_per_frame_style_update(effect) {
            continue;
        }
        if is_updating_animated_style {
            // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
            unsafe { &mut *document }
                .needing_animated_style_update_after_current_update()
                .insert(effect);
            continue;
        }
        let request = effect.borrow_mut().request_observation_sample_in_task(task_generation);
        if request == ObservationSampleRequest::NewlyRequested {
            set_needs_animated_style_update(effect);
        }
    }
}

/// Something a document asks of the animations associated with it.
#[expect(dead_code, reason = "C++ constructs the variants")]
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum DocumentAnimationsQuery {
    /// The number of the animations associated with the document.
    AssociatedCount,
    /// Whether the associated effect of one of them can skip its per-frame style update, as one or zero.
    AnyCanSkipPerFrameStyleUpdate,
    /// Whether a scroll timeline is associated with the document, as one or zero.
    AnyScrollTimeline,
}

/// Answers `query` of the animations associated with a document.
///
/// # Safety
/// `animations` must be what a live document knows of animations.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_document_animations_query(
    animations: *mut DocumentAnimations,
    query: DocumentAnimationsQuery,
) -> usize {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller, and the borrow ends before the host is called.
    let document = unsafe { &mut *animations };
    match query {
        DocumentAnimationsQuery::AssociatedCount => {
            document.set_mut(DocumentAnimationSetKind::Associated).iter().count()
        }
        DocumentAnimationsQuery::AnyCanSkipPerFrameStyleUpdate => usize::from(
            document
                .set_mut(DocumentAnimationSetKind::Associated)
                .iter()
                .any(|animation| {
                    let effect = animation.borrow().effect().cloned();
                    effect.is_some_and(|effect| can_skip_per_frame_style_update(&effect))
                }),
        ),
        DocumentAnimationsQuery::AnyScrollTimeline => usize::from(
            document
                .timelines
                .iter()
                .any(|timeline| timeline.borrow().scroll().is_some()),
        ),
    }
}

/// What keeps the rendering updates of a document coming while its animations run.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiAnimationFramePump {
    /// The delay after which the next iteration event of a throttled CSS animation is due, where one is.
    pub wakeup_delay: OptionalNumber,
    /// Whether an animation needs the next rendering update.
    pub request_frame: bool,
}

/// Decides how the running animations associated with a document of a monotonically increasing timeline keep its
/// rendering updates coming: by asking for the next where one needs main-thread painting or observable animation
/// events, or by waking up as the next iteration event of a throttled CSS animation is due, noting of each effect
/// whether a frame skipped its tick.
///
/// # Safety
/// `animations` must be what a live document knows of animations.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_document_animations_frame_pump(
    animations: *mut DocumentAnimations,
) -> FfiAnimationFramePump {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller, and the borrow ends before the host is called.
    let associated = unsafe { &mut *animations }.associated_animations();
    let mut wakeup_delay: Option<f64> = None;
    for animation in &associated {
        let effect = {
            let record = animation.borrow();
            if !record.has_monotonically_increasing_timeline() || record.play_state() != AnimationPlayState::Running {
                continue;
            }
            record.effect().cloned()
        };
        if let Some(effect) = effect {
            if can_skip_per_frame_animation_tick(&effect) {
                effect
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .set_flag(EffectFlag::PerFrameAnimationTickWasSkipped, true);
                continue;
            }
            effect
                .borrow_mut()
                .set_flag(EffectFlag::PerFrameAnimationTickWasSkipped, false);
            let state = animation.borrow().timing_state(None);
            if let Some(iteration_event_time) = next_throttled_animation_iteration_event_time(&state, &effect)
                && let Some(current_time) = state.current_time.get()
                && current_time.r#type == TimeValueType::Milliseconds
            {
                let delay = (iteration_event_time - current_time.value) / state.playback.playback_rate;
                if delay > 0.0 {
                    wakeup_delay = Some(wakeup_delay.map_or(delay, |earliest| earliest.min(delay)));
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        return FfiAnimationFramePump {
            wakeup_delay: wakeup_delay.into(),
            request_frame: true,
        };
    }
    FfiAnimationFramePump {
        wakeup_delay: wakeup_delay.into(),
        request_frame: false,
    }
}

/// Whether `animation` is a CSS animation or transition that the style of a rendering update began, which the update
/// makes ready once its style and layout are done.
fn rendering_update_makes_ready(animation: &AnimationCell) -> bool {
    let record = animation.borrow();
    let Some(effect) = record.effect() else {
        return false;
    };
    let playback = record.playback();
    (playback.has_pending_play_task || playback.has_pending_pause_task)
        && matches!(
            record.ffi_kind(),
            FfiAnimationKind::CssAnimation | FfiAnimationKind::CssTransition
        )
        && !effect.borrow().may_run_on_the_compositor()
}

/// Runs the pending play tasks of the CSS animations and transitions associated with the timelines of a document whose
/// animations are `animations` that the style of a rendering update began, which the update makes ready once its style
/// and layout are done, having the host keep each alive through `keep_alive` with `context`.
///
/// # Safety
/// `animations` must be what a live document knows of animations, and `keep_alive` must keep alive an animation it is
/// handed with `context` for as long as the call lasts.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn animations_document_run_pending_css_play_tasks(
    animations: *mut DocumentAnimations,
    context: *mut c_void,
    keep_alive: FfiKeepAlive,
    perform: HostEffectPerformer,
) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller, and the borrow ends here.
    let timelines = unsafe { &*animations }.timelines.clone();
    let mut pending: Vec<AnimationHandle> = Vec::new();
    // NB: An animation with a pending task needs updates, so only those are looked at.
    for timeline in &timelines {
        pending.extend(
            timeline
                .associated_animations_needing_update()
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|animation| rendering_update_makes_ready(animation)),
        );
    }
    for animation in &pending {
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        unsafe { keep_alive(context, animation) };
    }
    for animation in &pending {
        run_procedure(animation, perform, |procedures| {
            procedures.run_pending_play_task_if_ready();
        });
    }
}

/// Whether an animation associated with a timeline of a document whose animations are `animations` has a rendering
/// update hold the tasks of the document until the whole of it has run: any, where the update did not take in the style
/// of the document, or else one the update makes ready or one the compositor runs, which the update's frame publishes.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn animations_document_timelines_hold_rendering_update_tasks(
    animations: &DocumentAnimations,
    style_taken_in: bool,
) -> bool {
    animations.timelines.iter().any(|timeline| {
        timeline.associated_animations().borrow().iter().any(|animation| {
            !style_taken_in
                || rendering_update_makes_ready(&animation)
                || animation
                    .borrow()
                    .effect()
                    .is_some_and(|effect| effect.borrow().has_flag(EffectFlag::CompositorDriven))
        })
    })
}

    ) -> i32 {

    }

/*

//! The timing of an animation effect as the host publishes it to the style engine, which samples the
//! effect from it wherever the engine runs.

use super::timeline::AnimationTimelineId;
use super::timing::{
    AnimationEffectTiming, AnimationPlayback, AnimationReplaceState, FillMode, OptionalNumber, OptionalTimeValue,
    PlaybackDirection, TimeValue, TimeValueType, TimelineSample,
};

/// What moves an effect's timeline as a clock tick samples it.
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TimelineClockSource {
    /// Nothing a tick moves: the effect's animation has no timeline, or one no tick moves.
    #[default]
    Unticked,
    /// A document timeline, whose time is a timestamp less the clock's origin time, in milliseconds.
    Document,
    /// A scroll timeline, whose time is the progress, in percent, of the scroller the clock's scroll
    /// timeline follows.
    Scroll,
}

/// What moves an effect's timeline as a clock tick samples it, and where from.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct TimelineClock {
    pub source: TimelineClockSource,
    /// The origin time of a document timeline.
    pub origin_time: f64,
    /// The identity of a scroll timeline.
    pub scroll_timeline: AnimationTimelineId,
}

/// The progress, in percent, of a scroll timeline, which is its time.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ScrollProgress {
    pub timeline: AnimationTimelineId,
    pub progress: f64,
}

impl TimelineClock {
    /// The time of the timeline at a tick at `timestamp`, which moves every scroll timeline in
    /// `scroll_progress`, sorted by timeline, to its progress, or `None` where the tick does not move
    /// the timeline.
    #[inline]
    #[must_use]
    pub fn time_at_tick(&self, timestamp: f64, scroll_progress: &[ScrollProgress]) -> Option<TimeValue> {
        match self.source {
            TimelineClockSource::Unticked => None,
            TimelineClockSource::Document => Some(TimeValue::new(
                TimeValueType::Milliseconds,
                timestamp - self.origin_time,
            )),
            TimelineClockSource::Scroll => scroll_progress
                .binary_search_by_key(&self.scroll_timeline, |scroll| scroll.timeline)
                .ok()
                .map(|index| TimeValue::new(TimeValueType::Percentage, scroll_progress[index].progress)),
        }
    }
}

/// The timing of an animation effect as the host holds it when it samples the effect: the effect's own
/// normalized timing, the playback state of its animation, its animation's timeline as it stood, and
/// what moves that timeline as a clock tick samples it.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct EffectTimingSnapshot {
    pub effect: AnimationEffectTiming,
    pub playback: AnimationPlayback,
    /// The animation's timeline, where `has_timeline`.
    pub timeline: TimelineSample,
    pub has_timeline: bool,
    pub clock: TimelineClock,
}

/// Bits of `CompactEffectTiming`, one for each time it holds, which mark the time a percentage in `units` and the
/// time resolved in `resolved`.
mod time_bit {
    pub(super) const START_DELAY: u8 = 1 << 0;
    pub(super) const END_DELAY: u8 = 1 << 1;
    pub(super) const ITERATION_DURATION: u8 = 1 << 2;
    pub(super) const START_TIME: u8 = 1 << 3;
    pub(super) const HOLD_TIME: u8 = 1 << 4;
    pub(super) const TIMELINE_TIME: u8 = 1 << 5;
    pub(super) const MINIMUM_TIMELINE_TIME: u8 = 1 << 6;
    pub(super) const MAXIMUM_TIMELINE_TIME: u8 = 1 << 7;
}

/// Bits of `CompactEffectTiming::flags`.
mod flag {
    pub(super) const HAS_PENDING_PLAYBACK_RATE: u8 = 1 << 0;
    pub(super) const HAS_PENDING_PLAY_TASK: u8 = 1 << 1;
    pub(super) const HAS_PENDING_PAUSE_TASK: u8 = 1 << 2;
    pub(super) const IS_FINISHED: u8 = 1 << 3;
    pub(super) const HAS_TIMELINE: u8 = 1 << 4;
    pub(super) const IS_MONOTONICALLY_INCREASING: u8 = 1 << 5;
}

/// An `EffectTimingSnapshot` as the style engine keeps it for every effect it describes: each time a bare number,
/// with its unit and whether it is resolved in a bit each, and the origin time of a document timeline and the
/// identity of a scroll timeline in one place, as a timeline has at most one of them. It expands to the timing
/// model's types wherever the engine samples the effect.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct CompactEffectTiming {
    start_delay: f64,
    end_delay: f64,
    iteration_duration: f64,
    iteration_start: f64,
    iteration_count: f64,
    start_time: f64,
    hold_time: f64,
    playback_rate: f64,
    pending_playback_rate: f64,
    timeline_time: f64,
    minimum_timeline_time: f64,
    maximum_timeline_time: f64,
    /// The origin time of a document timeline, as its bits, or the identity of a scroll timeline.
    clock_reference: u64,
    /// The times that are percentages, by `time_bit`; the others are milliseconds.
    units: u8,
    /// The optional times that are resolved, by `time_bit`.
    resolved: u8,
    flags: u8,
    fill_mode: FillMode,
    playback_direction: PlaybackDirection,
    replace_state: AnimationReplaceState,
    clock_source: TimelineClockSource,
}

impl CompactEffectTiming {
    #[inline]
    fn time(&self, value: f64, bit: u8) -> TimeValue {
        let unit = match self.units & bit {
            0 => TimeValueType::Milliseconds,
            _ => TimeValueType::Percentage,
        };
        TimeValue::new(unit, value)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn optional_time(&self, value: f64, bit: u8) -> OptionalTimeValue {
        OptionalTimeValue {
            value: self.time(value, bit),
            has_value: self.resolved & bit != 0,
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    fn has(&self, flag: u8) -> bool {
        self.flags & flag != 0
    }

    /// The effect's own normalized timing.
    #[inline]
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn effect(&self) -> AnimationEffectTiming {
        AnimationEffectTiming {
            start_delay: self.time(self.start_delay, time_bit::START_DELAY),
            end_delay: self.time(self.end_delay, time_bit::END_DELAY),
            iteration_duration: self.time(self.iteration_duration, time_bit::ITERATION_DURATION),
            iteration_start: self.iteration_start,
            iteration_count: self.iteration_count,
            fill_mode: self.fill_mode,
            playback_direction: self.playback_direction,
        }
    }

    /// The playback state of the effect's animation.
    #[inline]
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn playback(&self) -> AnimationPlayback {
        AnimationPlayback {
            start_time: self.optional_time(self.start_time, time_bit::START_TIME),
            hold_time: self.optional_time(self.hold_time, time_bit::HOLD_TIME),
            playback_rate: self.playback_rate,
            pending_playback_rate: OptionalNumber {
                value: self.pending_playback_rate,
                has_value: self.has(flag::HAS_PENDING_PLAYBACK_RATE),
            },
            has_pending_play_task: self.has(flag::HAS_PENDING_PLAY_TASK),
            has_pending_pause_task: self.has(flag::HAS_PENDING_PAUSE_TASK),
            is_finished: self.has(flag::IS_FINISHED),
            replace_state: self.replace_state,
        }
    }

    /// The animation's timeline as the host sampled it, if it has one.
    #[inline]
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn timeline(&self) -> Option<TimelineSample> {
        self.has(flag::HAS_TIMELINE).then(|| self.timeline_sample())
    }

    #[inline]
    fn timeline_sample(&self) -> TimelineSample {
        TimelineSample {
            current_time: self.optional_time(self.timeline_time, time_bit::TIMELINE_TIME),
            minimum_timeline_time: self.optional_time(self.minimum_timeline_time, time_bit::MINIMUM_TIMELINE_TIME),
            maximum_timeline_time: self.optional_time(self.maximum_timeline_time, time_bit::MAXIMUM_TIMELINE_TIME),
            is_monotonically_increasing: self.has(flag::IS_MONOTONICALLY_INCREASING),
        }
    }

    /// The current time of the animation's timeline as the host sampled it, which is unresolved without a timeline.
    #[inline]
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn timeline_time(&self) -> Option<TimeValue> {
        if !self.has(flag::HAS_TIMELINE) {
            return None;
        }
        self.optional_time(self.timeline_time, time_bit::TIMELINE_TIME).get()
    }

    /// What moves the animation's timeline as a clock tick samples it, and where from.
    #[inline]
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn clock(&self) -> TimelineClock {
        match self.clock_source {
            TimelineClockSource::Unticked => TimelineClock::default(),
            TimelineClockSource::Document => TimelineClock {
                source: TimelineClockSource::Document,
                origin_time: f64::from_bits(self.clock_reference),
                scroll_timeline: AnimationTimelineId::default(),
            },
            TimelineClockSource::Scroll => TimelineClock {
                source: TimelineClockSource::Scroll,
                origin_time: 0.0,
                scroll_timeline: AnimationTimelineId(self.clock_reference),
            },
        }
    }

    /// Sets the hold time of the effect's animation.
    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn set_hold_time(&mut self, hold_time: Option<TimeValue>) {
        let hold_time = OptionalTimeValue::from(hold_time);
        self.set_time(&hold_time.value, time_bit::HOLD_TIME);
        self.hold_time = hold_time.value.value;
        self.set_resolved(hold_time.has_value, time_bit::HOLD_TIME);
    }

    #[inline]
    fn set_time(&mut self, time: &TimeValue, bit: u8) {
        match time.r#type {
            TimeValueType::Milliseconds => self.units &= !bit,
            TimeValueType::Percentage => self.units |= bit,
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    fn set_resolved(&mut self, resolved: bool, bit: u8) {
        match resolved {
            true => self.resolved |= bit,
            false => self.resolved &= !bit,
        }
    }

    /// The timing as the host published it.
    #[cfg(test)]
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) fn snapshot(&self) -> EffectTimingSnapshot {
        EffectTimingSnapshot {
            effect: self.effect(),
            playback: self.playback(),
            timeline: self.timeline_sample(),
            has_timeline: self.has(flag::HAS_TIMELINE),
            clock: self.clock(),
        }
    }
}

impl From<&EffectTimingSnapshot> for CompactEffectTiming {
    fn from(snapshot: &EffectTimingSnapshot) -> Self {
        let EffectTimingSnapshot {
            effect,
            playback,
            timeline,
            has_timeline,
            clock,
        } = snapshot;
        let mut compact = Self {
            start_delay: effect.start_delay.value,
            end_delay: effect.end_delay.value,
            iteration_duration: effect.iteration_duration.value,
            iteration_start: effect.iteration_start,
            iteration_count: effect.iteration_count,
            start_time: playback.start_time.value.value,
            hold_time: playback.hold_time.value.value,
            playback_rate: playback.playback_rate,
            pending_playback_rate: playback.pending_playback_rate.value,
            timeline_time: timeline.current_time.value.value,
            minimum_timeline_time: timeline.minimum_timeline_time.value.value,
            maximum_timeline_time: timeline.maximum_timeline_time.value.value,
            clock_reference: match clock.source {
                TimelineClockSource::Unticked => 0,
                TimelineClockSource::Document => clock.origin_time.to_bits(),
                TimelineClockSource::Scroll => clock.scroll_timeline.0,
            },
            units: 0,
            resolved: 0,
            flags: 0,
            fill_mode: effect.fill_mode,
            playback_direction: effect.playback_direction,
            replace_state: playback.replace_state,
            clock_source: clock.source,
        };
        compact.set_time(&effect.start_delay, time_bit::START_DELAY);
        compact.set_time(&effect.end_delay, time_bit::END_DELAY);
        compact.set_time(&effect.iteration_duration, time_bit::ITERATION_DURATION);
        for (time, bit) in [
            (&playback.start_time, time_bit::START_TIME),
            (&playback.hold_time, time_bit::HOLD_TIME),
            (&timeline.current_time, time_bit::TIMELINE_TIME),
            (&timeline.minimum_timeline_time, time_bit::MINIMUM_TIMELINE_TIME),
            (&timeline.maximum_timeline_time, time_bit::MAXIMUM_TIMELINE_TIME),
        ] {
            compact.set_time(&time.value, bit);
            compact.set_resolved(time.has_value, bit);
        }
        for (set, flag) in [
            (
                playback.pending_playback_rate.has_value,
                flag::HAS_PENDING_PLAYBACK_RATE,
            ),
            (playback.has_pending_play_task, flag::HAS_PENDING_PLAY_TASK),
            (playback.has_pending_pause_task, flag::HAS_PENDING_PAUSE_TASK),
            (playback.is_finished, flag::IS_FINISHED),
            (*has_timeline, flag::HAS_TIMELINE),
            (timeline.is_monotonically_increasing, flag::IS_MONOTONICALLY_INCREASING),
        ] {
            if set {
                compact.flags |= flag;
            }
        }
        compact
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn ms(time: f64) -> OptionalTimeValue {
        Some(TimeValue::milliseconds(time)).into()
    }

    fn percent(time: f64) -> OptionalTimeValue {
        Some(TimeValue::percentage(time)).into()
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_packed_timing_round_trips() {
        let document_timeline = EffectTimingSnapshot {
            effect: AnimationEffectTiming {
                start_delay: TimeValue::milliseconds(-250.0),
                end_delay: TimeValue::milliseconds(125.0),
                iteration_duration: TimeValue::milliseconds(1000.0),
                iteration_start: 0.5,
                iteration_count: f64::INFINITY,
                fill_mode: FillMode::Both,
                playback_direction: PlaybackDirection::AlternateReverse,
            },
            playback: AnimationPlayback {
                start_time: ms(40.0),
                hold_time: ms(700.0),
                playback_rate: -2.0,
                pending_playback_rate: Some(0.5).into(),
                has_pending_play_task: true,
                has_pending_pause_task: false,
                is_finished: true,
                replace_state: AnimationReplaceState::Persisted,
            },
            timeline: TimelineSample {
                current_time: ms(1234.5),
                is_monotonically_increasing: true,
                ..TimelineSample::default()
            },
            has_timeline: true,
            clock: TimelineClock {
                source: TimelineClockSource::Document,
                origin_time: 16.75,
                scroll_timeline: AnimationTimelineId::default(),
            },
        };
        let scroll_timeline = EffectTimingSnapshot {
            effect: AnimationEffectTiming {
                start_delay: TimeValue::percentage(10.0),
                end_delay: TimeValue::percentage(5.0),
                iteration_duration: TimeValue::percentage(85.0),
                fill_mode: FillMode::Backwards,
                ..AnimationEffectTiming::default()
            },
            playback: AnimationPlayback {
                start_time: percent(20.0),
                has_pending_pause_task: true,
                replace_state: AnimationReplaceState::Removed,
                ..AnimationPlayback::default()
            },
            timeline: TimelineSample {
                current_time: OptionalTimeValue::from(None),
                minimum_timeline_time: percent(0.0),
                maximum_timeline_time: percent(100.0),
                is_monotonically_increasing: false,
            },
            has_timeline: true,
            clock: TimelineClock {
                source: TimelineClockSource::Scroll,
                origin_time: 0.0,
                scroll_timeline: AnimationTimelineId(u64::MAX - 3),
            },
        };
        for snapshot in [document_timeline, scroll_timeline, EffectTimingSnapshot::default()] {
            let compact = CompactEffectTiming::from(&snapshot);
            assert_eq!(compact.snapshot(), snapshot);
            assert_eq!(compact.timeline(), snapshot.has_timeline.then_some(snapshot.timeline));
        }
    }
}

/*

//! Whether a frame can skip the style update or the tick of an effect, from its record and what the host knows of its
//! target.

use super::animation::AnimationHandle;
use super::compositor_update::is_transform_family;
use super::effect::{AnimationEffectCell, EffectFlag, PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision, PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipKey};
use super::host_timing::FfiAnimationKind;
use super::rendering_trace::note_rendering_trace_event;
use super::timing::{self, AnimationEffectPhase, AnimationPlayState};
use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
use std::cell::OnceCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

// NB: What the host is asked of, or told about, an element, by bit: the facts it answers, and the counters it bumps.

/// The node document of the element has its layout up to date.
pub const TARGET_FACT_LAYOUT_IS_UP_TO_DATE: u32 = 1 << 0;
/// The element is connected.
pub const TARGET_FACT_IS_CONNECTED: u32 = 1 << 1;
/// The element has a layout box.
pub const TARGET_FACT_HAS_LAYOUT_BOX: u32 = 1 << 2;
/// The element is in the SVG namespace.
pub const TARGET_FACT_IS_SVG: u32 = 1 << 3;
/// A navigable container the element's document is nested through has an up to date layout and no box.
pub const TARGET_FACT_INSIDE_BOXLESS_CONTAINER: u32 = 1 << 4;
/// Nothing shows the style of the element, as a display: none ancestor leaves it without a box, and no SVG
/// element in its subtree can be referenced from elsewhere.
pub const TARGET_FACT_UNSEEN_IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE: u32 = 1 << 5;
/// The element has a box with hidden visibility, and nothing in its box's subtree is visible.
pub const TARGET_FACT_HIDDEN_WITHOUT_VISIBLE_DESCENDANT: u32 = 1 << 6;
/// A listener on the element, the nodes its events bubble to or its window hears a CSS animation event that needs
/// a tick.
pub const TARGET_FACT_HEARS_CSS_ANIMATION_EVENTS: u32 = 1 << 7;
/// The same, for the iteration events alone.
pub const TARGET_FACT_HEARS_CSS_ANIMATION_ITERATION_EVENTS: u32 = 1 << 8;
/// A listener on the element, an SVG animation element, hears its beginEvent, endEvent or repeatEvent.
pub const TARGET_FACT_HEARS_TIME_EVENTS: u32 = 1 << 9;
/// The same, for its repeatEvent alone.
pub const TARGET_FACT_HEARS_REPEAT_EVENT: u32 = 1 << 10;
/// What the host found whether a frame can skip a style update from, for the key it answers.
pub const TARGET_FACT_SKIP_KEY: u32 = 1 << 11;

/// What the host answers of an element: the facts it was asked of that hold, and the skip key where it was asked for
/// one.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct FfiTargetFacts {
    pub facts: u32,
    pub key: PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipKey,
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_animation_target_facts(element: NonNull<c_void>, wanted: u32) -> FfiTargetFacts;
}

/// What the host answers of `wanted` of the host's `DOM::Element` `element`, which something the caller holds keeps
/// alive.
pub(crate) fn target_facts(element: NonNull<c_void>, wanted: u32) -> FfiTargetFacts {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { web_animation_target_facts(element, wanted) }
}

/// Whether `fact` holds of `element`.
pub(crate) fn target_fact_holds(element: NonNull<c_void>, fact: u32) -> bool {
    target_facts(element, fact).facts & fact != 0
}

/// Whether a frame can skip the style update of `effect`.
pub(crate) fn can_skip_per_frame_style_update(effect: &AnimationEffectCell) -> bool {
    let record = effect.borrow();
    if record.has_flag(EffectFlag::CompositorDriven) || record.has_flag(EffectFlag::CompositorReplaced) {
        return true;
    }
    let offscreen_throttled = record.has_flag(EffectFlag::OffscreenThrottled);
    let keyframes = record.keyframes().cloned();
    let target_properties = keyframes
        .as_ref()
        .map_or(&[][..], |keyframes| keyframes.target_properties());
    if offscreen_throttled && !target_properties.iter().copied().any(is_transform_family) {
        return true;
    }

    let Some(target) = record.target_element() else {
        return false;
    };
    let has_pseudo_element = record.pseudo_element().is_some();
    let timing = record.timing();
    let animation = record.associated_animation();
    drop(record);

    // An animation inside a box-less iframe can't affect its embedding document's rendering. Check the containers
    // before the target-local cache, since their layout can change without changing the target's style or layout box.
    // Reverse playback and effects with a finite end time need ticks to finish, even with an infinite iteration count.
    if let Some(animation) = &animation
        && timing.iteration_count.is_infinite()
        && {
            let animation = animation.borrow();
            animation.playback().playback_rate > 0.0 && animation.associated_effect_end().value.is_infinite()
        }
        && target_fact_holds(target, TARGET_FACT_INSIDE_BOXLESS_CONTAINER)
    {
        return true;
    }

    let facts = target_facts(
        target,
        TARGET_FACT_LAYOUT_IS_UP_TO_DATE | TARGET_FACT_IS_CONNECTED | TARGET_FACT_SKIP_KEY,
    );
    let layout_is_up_to_date = facts.facts & TARGET_FACT_LAYOUT_IS_UP_TO_DATE != 0;
    let is_connected = facts.facts & TARGET_FACT_IS_CONNECTED != 0;
    let key = facts.key;
    let cache_result = |result: bool| {
        if layout_is_up_to_date {
            effect
                .borrow_mut()
                .note_per_frame_style_update_skip_decision(key, result);
        }
        result
    };
    if layout_is_up_to_date {
        let decision = effect.borrow().per_frame_style_update_skip_decision(&key);
        match decision {
            PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::CanSkip | PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::CannotSkip => {
                note_rendering_trace_event("animation style skip cache hit");
                return decision == PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::CanSkip;
            }
            PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::Stale => {
                note_rendering_trace_event("animation style skip cache miss");
            }
            PerFrameStyleUpdateSkipDecision::Unknown => {}
        }
    }

    // Restrict throttling within a rendered document to infinite transform-only effects until animation overflow
    // updates can also be throttled safely.
    if !timing.iteration_count.is_infinite() || has_pseudo_element {
        return cache_result(false);
    }

    if !is_connected {
        return cache_result(true);
    }
    // NB: A custom property can feed the display of the target through var().
    let may_animate_display = keyframes.as_ref().is_some_and(|keyframes| {
        keyframes.target_properties().contains(&property_id::DISPLAY)
            || !keyframes.target_custom_properties().is_empty()
    });
    if layout_is_up_to_date
        && !may_animate_display
        && target_fact_holds(target, TARGET_FACT_UNSEEN_IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE)
    {
        return cache_result(true);
    }
    let Some(keyframes) = keyframes else {
        return false;
    };
    if (keyframes.target_properties().is_empty() && keyframes.target_custom_properties().is_empty())
        || !keyframes.target_custom_properties().is_empty()
        || !keyframes.target_properties().iter().copied().all(is_transform_family)
    {
        return cache_result(false);
    }

    let facts = target_facts(target, TARGET_FACT_HAS_LAYOUT_BOX | TARGET_FACT_IS_SVG).facts;
    // NB: Transforms cannot affect rendering without a layout box. This also covers SVG content inside
    //     display-none subtrees and closed details elements.
    if layout_is_up_to_date && facts & TARGET_FACT_HAS_LAYOUT_BOX == 0 {
        return cache_result(true);
    }
    if facts & TARGET_FACT_IS_SVG != 0 {
        return cache_result(false);
    }

    if offscreen_throttled {
        return cache_result(true);
    }

    if !layout_is_up_to_date {
        return false;
    }
    cache_result(target_fact_holds(target, TARGET_FACT_HIDDEN_WITHOUT_VISIBLE_DESCENDANT))
}

/// Whether a frame can skip the tick of `effect`.
pub(crate) fn can_skip_per_frame_animation_tick(effect: &AnimationEffectCell) -> bool {
    let record = effect.borrow();
    let animation = record.associated_animation();
    let timing = record.timing();
    let target = record.target_element();
    let compositor_handled =
        record.has_flag(EffectFlag::CompositorDriven) || record.has_flag(EffectFlag::CompositorReplaced);
    let observation_relevant = record.has_flag(EffectFlag::ObservationRelevantCompositorAnimation);
    drop(record);
    // NB: The phase of the effect is at the current time of its associated animation. Resolve it once, where needed.
    let phase_cell = OnceCell::new();
    let phase = || {
        *phase_cell.get_or_init(|| match &animation {
            Some(animation) => animation.borrow().effect_phase(),
            None => timing::resolve_timing(&timing, None, None, None).phase,
        })
    };

    if let Some(animation) = &animation
        && {
            let animation = animation.borrow();
            let playback = animation.playback();
            !playback.has_pending_play_task
                && !playback.has_pending_pause_task
                && animation.play_state() == AnimationPlayState::Running
                && playback.playback_rate > 0.0
                && animation.has_monotonically_increasing_timeline()
        }
        && phase() == AnimationEffectPhase::Before
    {
        return true;
    }

    if !compositor_handled && !can_skip_per_frame_style_update(effect) {
        return false;
    }

    // NB: Playing backward, an effect with an infinite iteration count finishes at time zero, and with a zero iteration
    //     duration it finishes at its end time. No timer wakes the main thread for either.
    if let Some(animation) = &animation
        && timing.iteration_count.is_infinite()
        && {
            let animation = animation.borrow();
            animation.playback().playback_rate < 0.0 || !animation.associated_effect_end().value.is_infinite()
        }
    {
        return false;
    }

    // A compositor-handled one-iteration effect has a document timer that wakes the main thread at its active end.
    if compositor_handled && (!timing.iteration_count.is_infinite() || observation_relevant) {
        return true;
    }

    // NB: Infinite effects cannot reach their natural end, and finite offscreen paint effects have an end timer.
    //     Neither needs a continuous tick for animationend listeners.
    // NB: Starting or canceling an active animation requests an update independently of playback.
    //     Only iteration events require future updates while a visually throttled effect runs.
    !css_animation_events_are_heard(
        animation.as_ref(),
        animation.as_ref().map(|animation| animation.borrow().ffi_kind()),
        target,
        phase() == AnimationEffectPhase::Active,
    )
}

/// Whether a listener hears the CSS animation events of an effect targeting `target`, associated with `animation` of
/// `kind`, that need a tick: only its iteration events if `only_iteration_events`.
fn css_animation_events_are_heard(
    animation: Option<&AnimationHandle>,
    kind: Option<FfiAnimationKind>,
    target: Option<NonNull<c_void>>,
    only_iteration_events: bool,
) -> bool {
    // NB: SMIL animations raise time events at their animation element instead, which do not bubble.
    if let Some(animation) = animation
        && kind == Some(FfiAnimationKind::Smil)
    {
        let animation_element = super::ffi::smil_animation_element(animation);
        let fact = if only_iteration_events {
            TARGET_FACT_HEARS_REPEAT_EVENT
        } else {
            TARGET_FACT_HEARS_TIME_EVENTS
        };
        return target_fact_holds(animation_element, fact);
    }

    // Script animations do not dispatch CSS animation events, even when an ancestor listens for them.
    if animation.is_some() && kind != Some(FfiAnimationKind::CssAnimation) {
        return false;
    }

    let target = target.expect("an effect whose events are heard has a target");
    let fact = if only_iteration_events {
        TARGET_FACT_HEARS_CSS_ANIMATION_ITERATION_EVENTS
    } else {
        TARGET_FACT_HEARS_CSS_ANIMATION_EVENTS
    };
    target_fact_holds(target, fact)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod ffi_test_stubs {
    #[unsafe(no_mangle)]
    extern "C" fn web_animation_target_facts(
        _element: std::ptr::NonNull<std::ffi::c_void>,
        _wanted: u32,
    ) -> super::FfiTargetFacts {
        unreachable!("the tests ask the host nothing of elements")
    }
}
