        shape: OwnedBasicShapeData::new(BasicShapeData {
            kind: if ellipse { 4 } else { 3 },
            v0: retained(radius?),
            v1: parsed_position.map_or_else(RetainedStyleValueData::none, retained),
            v2: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            v3: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            v4: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            fill_rule: 0,
            points: RetainedShapePointList::from_vec(vec![]),
            path: CssPath::none(),
            commands: crate::css::style_value::ShapeCommands::default(),
        }),
    })
}

fn parse_polygon(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, arguments: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let mut arguments = arguments.split(ComponentValue::is_comma).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let fill_rule = arguments.first().and_then(|argument| parse_fill_rule(argument));
    let fill_rule = if let Some(fill_rule) = fill_rule {
        arguments.remove(0);
        fill_rule
    } else {
        0
    };
    if arguments.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let points = arguments
        .into_iter()
        .map(|argument| {
            let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(argument);
            let x = parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
                context,
                property,
                &mut tokens,
                NumericRange::INFINITE,
                NumericRange::INFINITE,
            )?;
            let y = parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
                context,
                property,
                &mut tokens,
                NumericRange::INFINITE,
                NumericRange::INFINITE,
            )?;
            tokens.discard_whitespace();
            if tokens.has_next_token() {
                return None;
            }
            Some(RetainedShapePoint::from_retained_values(retained(x), retained(y)))
        })
        .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?;
    Some(basic_shape(5, vec![], fill_rule, points, CssPath::none()))
}

fn parse_path(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, arguments: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let arguments = arguments.split(ComponentValue::is_comma).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    // NB: Like other engines, offset-path does not accept a <fill-rule> in path(), which does not affect a path the
    //     box moves along.
    let maximum_arguments = if property == property_id::OFFSET_PATH { 1 } else { 2 };
    if arguments.is_empty() || arguments.len() > maximum_arguments {
        return None;
    }
    let fill_rule = if arguments.len() == 2 {
        parse_fill_rule(arguments[0])?
    } else {
        0
    };
    let mut values = arguments[arguments.len() - 1]
        .iter()
        .filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace());
    let path = values.next()?.string()?;
    if values.next().is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    let path = crate::svg::parse_utf16_path(path, context.is_svg_presentation_attribute)?;
    if path.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(basic_shape(6, vec![], fill_rule, vec![], CssPath::new(path)))
}

fn parse_basic_shape(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let mut significant = values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace());
    let (name, arguments) = significant.next()?.function()?;
    if significant.next().is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"inset") {
        parse_inset_shape(context, property, arguments)
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"xywh") {
        parse_xywh_shape(context, property, arguments)
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"rect") {
        parse_rect_shape(context, property, arguments)
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"circle") {
        parse_circle_or_ellipse(context, property, arguments, false)
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"ellipse") {
        parse_circle_or_ellipse(context, property, arguments, true)
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"polygon") {
        parse_polygon(context, property, arguments)
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"path") {
        parse_path(context, property, arguments)
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"shape") {
        parse_shape(context, property, arguments)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

/// The index in `values` of the first top-level identifier at or after `start` that matches one of `names`.
fn find_identifier(values: &[ComponentValue], start: usize, names: &[&str]) -> Option<usize> {
    values[start..]
        .iter()
        .position(|value| {
            value.ident().is_some_and(|ident| {
                names
                    .iter()
                    .any(|name| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, name.as_bytes()))
            })
        })
        .map(|index| start + index)
}

fn shape_point(x: StyleValueData, y: StyleValueData) -> RetainedShapePoint {
    RetainedShapePoint::from_retained_values(retained(x), retained(y))
}

/// <coordinate-pair> = <length-percentage>{2}, filling all of `values`.
fn parse_coordinate_pair(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> Option<RetainedShapePoint> {
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(values);
    let x = parse_length_percentage(context, property, &mut tokens)?;
    let y = parse_length_percentage(context, property, &mut tokens)?;
    tokens.discard_whitespace();
    (!tokens.has_next_token()).then(|| shape_point(x, y))
}

/// A <position>, filling all of `values`, as the point of its two edges.
fn parse_shape_position(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> Option<RetainedShapePoint> {
    let StyleValueData::Position(position_payload) = parse_position_value(context, property, values, false)? else {
        return None;
    };
    let PositionPayload { edge_x, edge_y } = position_payload.into_inner();
    Some(RetainedShapePoint::from_retained_values(edge_x, edge_y))
}

/// <command-end-point> = [ to <position> | by <coordinate-pair> ], filling all of `values`, and whether it is
/// relative.
fn parse_command_end_point(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> Option<(bool, RetainedShapePoint)> {
    let start = values.iter().position(|value| !value.is_whitespace())?;
    let keyword = values[start].ident()?;
    let rest = &values[start + 1..];
    if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(keyword, b"to") {
        Some((false, parse_shape_position(context, property, rest)?))
    } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(keyword, b"by") {
        Some((true, parse_coordinate_pair(context, property, rest)?))
    } else {
        None
    }
}

/// <control-point> = [ <position> | <relative-control-point> ] when `allows_position`, otherwise
/// <relative-control-point> = <coordinate-pair> [ from [ start | end | origin ] ]?
fn parse_control_point(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
    allows_position: bool,
) -> Option<(crate::css::style_value::ShapeControlPointAnchor, RetainedShapePoint)> {
    use crate::css::style_value::ShapeControlPointAnchor;
    if let Some(from) = find_identifier(values, 0, &["from"]) {
        let point = parse_coordinate_pair(context, property, &values[..from])?;
        let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(&values[from + 1..]);
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        let anchor = tokens.consume_a_token().ident()?;
        let anchor = if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(anchor, b"start") {
            ShapeControlPointAnchor::Start
        } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(anchor, b"end") {
            ShapeControlPointAnchor::End
        } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(anchor, b"origin") {
            ShapeControlPointAnchor::Origin
        } else {
            return None;
        };
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        return (!tokens.has_next_token()).then_some((anchor, point));
    }
    if allows_position && let Some(point) = parse_shape_position(context, property, values) {
        return Some((ShapeControlPointAnchor::Origin, point));
    }
    Some((
        ShapeControlPointAnchor::Start,
        parse_coordinate_pair(context, property, values)?,
    ))
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-shapes-1/#shape-function
fn parse_shape(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, arguments: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    use crate::css::style_value::{ShapeCommand, ShapeCommandKind, ShapeCommands};
    let segments = arguments.split(ComponentValue::is_comma).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if segments.len() < 2 {
        return None;
    }

    let mut commands = Vec::new();
    let mut points = Vec::new();

    // <'fill-rule'>? from <position>
    let first = segments[0];
    let from = find_identifier(first, 0, &["from"])?;
    let fill_rule = if first[..from].iter().all(ComponentValue::is_whitespace) {
        0
    } else {
        parse_fill_rule(&first[..from])?
    };
    points.push(parse_shape_position(context, property, &first[from + 1..])?);
    commands.push(ShapeCommand::new(ShapeCommandKind::From, false));

    for segment in &segments[1..] {
        let start = segment.iter().position(|value| !value.is_whitespace())?;
        let name = segment[start].ident()?;
        let rest = &segment[start + 1..];
        let named = |expected: &str| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, expected.as_bytes());
        if named("close") {
            if !rest.iter().all(ComponentValue::is_whitespace) {
                return None;
            }
            commands.push(ShapeCommand::new(ShapeCommandKind::Close, false));
        } else if named("move") || named("line") {
            let (relative, point) = parse_command_end_point(context, property, rest)?;
            let kind = if named("move") {
                ShapeCommandKind::Move
            } else {
                ShapeCommandKind::Line
            };
            commands.push(ShapeCommand::new(kind, relative));
            points.push(point);
        } else if named("hline") || named("vline") {
            let horizontal = named("hline");
            let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(rest);
            tokens.discard_whitespace();
            let keyword = tokens.consume_a_token().ident()?;
            let relative = if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(keyword, b"by") {
                true
            } else if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(keyword, b"to") {
                false
            } else {
                return None;
            };
            tokens.discard_whitespace();
            let keywords: &[&str] = if horizontal {
                &["left", "center", "right", "x-start", "x-end"]
            } else {
                &["top", "center", "bottom", "y-start", "y-end"]
            };
            let named_keyword = (!relative)
                .then(|| tokens.next_token().ident())
                .flatten()
                .filter(|ident| {
                    keywords
                        .iter()
                        .any(|name| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, name.as_bytes()))
                })
                .and_then(keyword_from_ascii_case_insensitive);
            let coordinate = match named_keyword {
                Some(parsed_keyword) => {
                    tokens.discard_a_token();
                    StyleValueData::Keyword {
                        keyword: parsed_keyword,
                    }
                }
                None => parse_length_percentage(context, property, &mut tokens)?,
            };
            tokens.discard_whitespace();
            if tokens.has_next_token() {
                return None;
            }
            let zero = || StyleValueData::Percentage { value: 0.0 };
            points.push(if horizontal {
                shape_point(coordinate, zero())
            } else {
                shape_point(zero(), coordinate)
            });
            let kind = if horizontal {
                ShapeCommandKind::HorizontalLine
            } else {
                ShapeCommandKind::VerticalLine
            };
            commands.push(ShapeCommand::new(kind, relative));
        } else if named("curve") || named("smooth") {
            let curve = named("curve");
            let with = find_identifier(rest, 0, &["with"]);
            let (relative, end_point) =
                parse_command_end_point(context, property, &rest[..with.unwrap_or(rest.len())])?;
            let mut command = ShapeCommand::new(
                if curve {
                    ShapeCommandKind::Curve
                } else {
                    ShapeCommandKind::Smooth
                },
                relative,
            );
            points.push(end_point);
            match with {
                Some(with) => {
                    let control_points = rest[with + 1..].split(|value| value.is_delim(b'/')).collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    if control_points.len() > if curve { 2 } else { 1 } {
                        return None;
                    }
                    for (index, values) in control_points.into_iter().enumerate() {
                        let (anchor, point) = parse_control_point(context, property, values, !relative)?;
                        command.control_points[index] = anchor;
                        command.control_point_count += 1;
                        points.push(point);
                    }
                }
                None if curve => return None,
                None => {}
            }
            commands.push(command);
        } else if named("arc") {
            let options = find_identifier(rest, 0, &["of", "cw", "ccw", "large", "small", "rotate"])?;
            let (relative, end_point) = parse_command_end_point(context, property, &rest[..options])?;
            let mut command = ShapeCommand::new(ShapeCommandKind::Arc, relative);
            let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(&rest[options..]);
            let mut radii = None;
            let (mut sweep, mut size, mut rotation) = (None, None, None);
            loop {
                tokens.discard_whitespace();
                if !tokens.has_next_token() {
                    break;
                }
                let option = tokens.consume_a_token().ident()?;
                let is = |expected: &str| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(option, expected.as_bytes());
                if is("of") && radii.is_none() {
                    let horizontal = parse_length_percentage(context, property, &mut tokens)?;
                    let mut after_first = tokens.clone();
                    let vertical = parse_length_percentage(context, property, &mut after_first);
                    command.arc_has_one_radius = vertical.is_none();
                    let vertical = match vertical {
                        Some(vertical) => {
                            tokens = after_first;
                            vertical
                        }
                        None => horizontal.clone(),
                    };
                    radii = Some(shape_point(horizontal, vertical));
                } else if (is("cw") || is("ccw")) && sweep.is_none() {
                    sweep = Some(is("cw"));
                } else if (is("large") || is("small")) && size.is_none() {
                    size = Some(is("large"));
                } else if is("rotate") && rotation.is_none() {
                    rotation = Some(super::value_parser::parse_angle_from_stream(
                        context,
                        property,
                        &mut tokens,
                        NumericRange::INFINITE,
                    )?);
                } else {
                    return None;
                }
            }
            command.arc_clockwise = sweep.unwrap_or(false);
            command.arc_large = size.unwrap_or(false);
            command.arc_has_rotation = rotation.is_some();
            let rotation = rotation.unwrap_or(StyleValueData::Angle {
                value: 0.0,
                unit: crate::css::calc::canonical_unit_code(&crate::css::calc::ANGLE_UNIT_CANONICAL_RATIOS),
            });
            points.push(end_point);
            points.push(radii?);
            points.push(shape_point(rotation.clone(), rotation));
            commands.push(command);
        } else {
            return None;
        }
    }

    Some(StyleValueData::BasicShape {
        shape: OwnedBasicShapeData::new(BasicShapeData {
            kind: 7,
            v0: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            v1: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            v2: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            v3: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            v4: RetainedStyleValueData::none(),
            fill_rule,
            points: RetainedShapePointList::from_vec(points),
            path: CssPath::none(),
            commands: ShapeCommands::from_vec(commands),
        }),
    })
}

fn shape_box(value: &ComponentValue) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let parsed_keyword = keyword_from_ascii_case_insensitive(value.ident()?)?;
    ["content-box", "padding-box", "border-box", "margin-box"]
        .iter()
        .any(|accepted| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(value.ident().unwrap(), accepted.as_bytes()))
        .then_some(StyleValueData::Keyword {
            keyword: parsed_keyword,
        })
}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/css-masking-1/#typedef-geometry-box
// <geometry-box> = <shape-box> | fill-box | stroke-box | view-box
fn geometry_box(value: &ComponentValue) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    keyword_value(
        value,
        &[
            keyword::CONTENT_BOX,
            keyword::PADDING_BOX,
            keyword::BORDER_BOX,
            keyword::MARGIN_BOX,
            keyword::FILL_BOX,
            keyword::STROKE_BOX,
            keyword::VIEW_BOX,
        ],
    )
}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/css-masking-1/#the-clip-path
// [ <basic-shape> || <geometry-box> ]
fn parse_clip_path_shape(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let mut shape = None;
    let mut box_value = None;
    for value in values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace()) {
        if value.function().is_some() {
            if shape.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            shape = Some(parse_basic_shape(context, property, std::slice::from_ref(value))?);
        } else {
            if box_value.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            box_value = Some(geometry_box(value)?);
        }
    }
    match (shape, box_value) {
        // NB: The border box is the reference box of a basic shape without one, so it is left out of the value.
        (Some(shape), Some(StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword })) if keyword == keyword::BORDER_BOX => Some(shape),
        (Some(shape), Some(box_value)) => Some(StyleValueData::ValueList {
            values: RetainedStyleValueDataList::from_retained_values(vec![retained(shape), retained(box_value)]),
            separator: 0,
            collapsible: false,
        }),
        (Some(value), None) | (None, Some(value)) => Some(value),
        (None, None) => None,
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-borders-4/#propdef-border-shape
// none | [ <basic-shape> <geometry-box>? ]{1,2}
fn parse_border_shape(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let significant = values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if let [only] = significant[..]
        && let Some(none) = keyword_value(only, &[keyword::NONE])
    {
        return Some(none);
    }
    let geometry_box =
        |value: &ComponentValue| geometry_box(value).or_else(|| keyword_value(value, &[keyword::HALF_BORDER_BOX]));
    let mut items = Vec::new();
    let mut shape_count = 0;
    let mut index = 0;
    while index < significant.len() {
        items.push(parse_basic_shape(
            context,
            property,
            std::slice::from_ref(significant[index]),
        )?);
        shape_count += 1;
        index += 1;
        if let Some(box_value) = significant.get(index).and_then(|value| geometry_box(value)) {
            items.push(box_value);
            index += 1;
        }
    }
    if shape_count == 0 || shape_count > 2 {
        return None;
    }
    if items.len() == 1 {
        return items.pop();
    }
    Some(StyleValueData::ValueList {
        values: RetainedStyleValueDataList::from_retained_values(items.into_iter().map(retained).collect()),
        separator: 0,
        collapsible: false,
    })
}

fn parse_shape_outside(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    if let Some(value) = values
        .iter()
        .find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
        .and_then(|value| keyword_value(value, &[keyword::NONE]))
        && values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).count() == 1
    {
        return Some(value);
    }
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(values);
    let mut shape = None;
    let mut box_value = None;
    while tokens.has_next_token() {
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        if !tokens.has_next_token() {
            break;
        }
        if tokens.next_token().function().is_some() {
            if shape.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            shape = Some(parse_basic_shape(
                context,
                property,
                std::slice::from_ref(tokens.consume_a_token()),
            )?);
        } else {
            if box_value.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            box_value = Some(shape_box(tokens.consume_a_token())?);
        }
    }
    match (shape, box_value) {
        (Some(shape), Some(box_value)) => Some(StyleValueData::ValueList {
            values: RetainedStyleValueDataList::from_retained_values(vec![retained(shape), retained(box_value)]),
            separator: 0,
            collapsible: false,
        }),
        (Some(shape), None) | (None, Some(shape)) => Some(shape),
        (None, None) => None,
    }
}

fn space_separated_list(values: Vec<StyleValueData>) -> StyleValueData {
    StyleValueData::ValueList {
        values: RetainedStyleValueDataList::from_retained_values(values.into_iter().map(retained).collect()),
        separator: 0,
        collapsible: false,
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-box-4/#typedef-coord-box
// <coord-box> = <paint-box> | view-box
// <paint-box> = <visual-box> | fill-box | stroke-box
fn coord_box(value: &ComponentValue) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let ident = value.ident()?;
    [
        "content-box",
        "padding-box",
        "border-box",
        "fill-box",
        "stroke-box",
        "view-box",
    ]
    .iter()
    .any(|accepted| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, accepted.as_bytes()))
    .then(|| keyword_from_ascii_case_insensitive(ident))
    .flatten()
    .map(|keyword| StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword })
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/motion-1/#ray-function
// ray() = ray( <angle> && <ray-size>? && contain? && [at <position>]? )
// <ray-size> = <radial-extent> | sides
fn parse_ray(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, arguments: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(arguments);
    let mut angle = None;
    let mut size = None;
    let mut contain = false;
    let mut position = None;
    loop {
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        if !tokens.has_next_token() {
            break;
        }
        if let Some(ident) = tokens.next_token().ident() {
            if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, b"contain") {
                if contain {
                    return None;
                }
                contain = true;
                tokens.discard_a_token();
                continue;
            }
            if equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, b"at") {
                if position.is_some() {
                    return None;
                }
                tokens.discard_a_token();
                position = Some(parse_position_from_stream(context, property, &mut tokens, false)?);
                continue;
            }
            let is_size = [
                "closest-side",
                "closest-corner",
                "farthest-side",
                "farthest-corner",
                "sides",
            ]
            .iter()
            .any(|accepted| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, accepted.as_bytes()));
            if !is_size || size.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            size = Some(keyword_from_ascii_case_insensitive(ident)?);
            tokens.discard_a_token();
            continue;
        }
        if angle.is_some() {
            return None;
        }
        angle = Some(super::value_parser::parse_angle_from_stream(
            context,
            property,
            &mut tokens,
            NumericRange::INFINITE,
        )?);
    }
    Some(StyleValueData::Ray(StyleValueBox::new(RayPayload {
        size: size.unwrap_or(keyword::CLOSEST_SIDE),
        contain,
        angle: retained(angle?),
        position: position.map_or_else(RetainedStyleValueData::none, retained),
    })))
}

/// Whether this component value starts an <'offset-path'> value.
fn starts_offset_path(value: &ComponentValue) -> bool {
    if value
        .ident()
        .is_some_and(|ident| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, b"none"))
        || coord_box(value).is_some()
        || matches!(value.kind, ComponentKind::Token(ParserTokenKind::Url(_)))
    {
        return true;
    }
    value.function().is_some_and(|(name, _)| {
        [
            "ray", "url", "src", "inset", "xywh", "rect", "circle", "ellipse", "polygon", "path", "shape",
        ]
        .iter()
        .any(|expected| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, expected.as_bytes()))
    })
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/motion-1/#offset-path-property
// none | <offset-path> || <coord-box>
// <offset-path> = <ray()> | <url> | <basic-shape>
fn parse_offset_path(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let significant = values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if let [only] = significant[..]
        && let Some(none) = keyword_value(only, &[keyword::NONE])
    {
        return Some(none);
    }
    if significant.is_empty() || significant.len() > 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut path = None;
    let mut box_value = None;
    for value in significant {
        if let Some(parsed_box) = coord_box(value) {
            if box_value.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            box_value = Some(parsed_box);
            continue;
        }
        if path.is_some() {
            return None;
        }
        let is_ray = value
            .function()
            .is_some_and(|(name, _)| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"ray"));
        path = Some(if is_ray {
            parse_ray(context, property, value.function()?.1)?
        } else if let Some(url) = super::value_parser::parse_url_value(context, value) {
            url
        } else {
            parse_basic_shape(context, property, std::slice::from_ref(value))?
        });
    }
    match (path, box_value) {
        (
            Some(path),
            Some(StyleValueData::Keyword {
                keyword: keyword::BORDER_BOX,
            })
            | None,
        ) => Some(path),
        (Some(path), Some(box_value)) => Some(space_separated_list(vec![path, box_value])),
        (None, Some(box_value)) => Some(box_value),
        (None, None) => None,
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/motion-1/#offset-rotate-property
// [ auto | reverse ] || <angle>
fn parse_offset_rotate(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let mut keyword_part = None;
    let mut angle = None;
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(values);
    loop {
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        if !tokens.has_next_token() {
            break;
        }
        if let Some(parsed) = keyword_value(tokens.next_token(), &[keyword::AUTO, keyword::REVERSE]) {
            if keyword_part.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            keyword_part = Some(parsed);
            tokens.discard_a_token();
            continue;
        }
        if angle.is_some() {
            return None;
        }
        angle = Some(super::value_parser::parse_angle_from_stream(
            context,
            property,
            &mut tokens,
            NumericRange::INFINITE,
        )?);
    }
    match (keyword_part, angle) {
        (Some(keyword_part), Some(angle)) => Some(space_separated_list(vec![keyword_part, angle])),
        (Some(single), None) | (None, Some(single)) => Some(single),
        (None, None) => None,
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/motion-1/#offset-position-property
// normal | auto | <position>
// https://drafts.csswg.org/motion-1/#offset-anchor-property
// auto | <position>
fn parse_offset_position_or_anchor(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let significant = values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if let [only] = significant[..] {
        let accepted: &[u16] = if property == property_id::OFFSET_POSITION {
            &[keyword::AUTO, keyword::NORMAL]
        } else {
            &[keyword::AUTO]
        };
        if let Some(parsed) = keyword_value(only, accepted) {
            return Some(parsed);
        }
    }
    parse_position_value(context, property, values, false)
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/motion-1/#offset-shorthand
// [ <'offset-position'>? [ <'offset-path'> [ <'offset-distance'> || <'offset-rotate'> ]? ]? ]! [ / <'offset-anchor'> ]?
fn parse_offset_shorthand(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let mut parts = values.split(|value| value.is_delim(b'/'));
    let main = parts.next()?;
    let anchor_part = parts.next();
    if parts.next().is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    let anchor = match anchor_part {
        Some(anchor_values) => {
            let parsed = parse_offset_position_or_anchor(context, property_id::OFFSET_ANCHOR, anchor_values)?;
            Some(parsed)
        }
        None => None,
    };

    let significant = main
        .iter()
        .filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
        .cloned()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if significant.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let path_start = significant.iter().position(starts_offset_path);
    let position_end = path_start.unwrap_or(significant.len());
    let position = if position_end > 0 {
        Some(parse_offset_position_or_anchor(
            context,
            property_id::OFFSET_POSITION,
            &significant[..position_end],
        )?)
    } else {
        None
    };

    let mut path = None;
    let mut distance = None;
    let mut rotate = None;
    if let Some(path_start) = path_start {
        let mut path_end = path_start + 1;
        if significant.get(path_end).is_some_and(|value| {
            starts_offset_path(value) && coord_box(value).is_some() != coord_box(&significant[path_start]).is_some()
        }) {
            path_end += 1;
        }
        path = Some(parse_offset_path(
            context,
            property_id::OFFSET_PATH,
            &significant[path_start..path_end],
        )?);

        // <'offset-distance'> || <'offset-rotate'>
        let rest = &significant[path_end..];
        let is_rotate_component = |value: &ComponentValue| {
            keyword_value(value, &[keyword::AUTO, keyword::REVERSE]).is_some()
                || super::value_parser::parse_angle_from_stream(
                    context,
                    property_id::OFFSET_ROTATE,
                    &mut TokenStream::new(std::slice::from_ref(value)),
                    NumericRange::INFINITE,
                )
                .is_some()
        };
        let mut index = 0;
        while index < rest.len() {
            if is_rotate_component(&rest[index]) {
                if rotate.is_some() {
                    return None;
                }
                let start = index;
                while index < rest.len() && is_rotate_component(&rest[index]) {
                    index += 1;
                }
                rotate = Some(parse_offset_rotate(
                    context,
                    property_id::OFFSET_ROTATE,
                    &rest[start..index],
                )?);
            } else {
                if distance.is_some() {
                    return None;
                }
                let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(std::slice::from_ref(&rest[index]));
                distance = Some(parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
                    context,
                    property_id::OFFSET_DISTANCE,
                    &mut tokens,
                    NumericRange::INFINITE,
                    NumericRange::INFINITE,
                )?);
                index += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    let initial = |longhand: u16| crate::css::parser::value_parser::parse_initial_longhand(context, longhand);
    let sub_properties = longhands_for_shorthand(property).to_vec();
    let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(sub_properties.len());
    for &longhand in &sub_properties {
        let value = match longhand {
            property_id::OFFSET_POSITION => position.clone(),
            property_id::OFFSET_PATH => path.clone(),
            property_id::OFFSET_DISTANCE => distance.clone(),
            property_id::OFFSET_ROTATE => rotate.clone(),
            property_id::OFFSET_ANCHOR => anchor.clone(),
            _ => None,
        };
        output.push(match value {
            Some(value) => value,
            None => initial(longhand)?,
        });
    }
    Some(crate::css::parser::value_parser::shorthand_value(
        property,
        sub_properties,
        output,
    ))
}

fn is_border_radius_longhand(property: u16) -> bool {
    matches!(
        property,
        property_id::BORDER_TOP_LEFT_RADIUS
            | property_id::BORDER_TOP_RIGHT_RADIUS
            | property_id::BORDER_BOTTOM_RIGHT_RADIUS
            | property_id::BORDER_BOTTOM_LEFT_RADIUS
            | property_id::BORDER_END_END_RADIUS
            | property_id::BORDER_END_START_RADIUS
            | property_id::BORDER_START_END_RADIUS
            | property_id::BORDER_START_START_RADIUS
    )
}

fn dashed_ident(_context: &ParseContext, value: &ComponentValue) -> Option<CssString> {
    let identifier = value.ident()?;
    (identifier.starts_with(&[u16::from(b'-'), u16::from(b'-')])).then(|| CssString::from_utf16(identifier))
}

fn anchor_side(value: &ComponentValue) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let identifier = value.ident()?;
    [
        "inside",
        "outside",
        "top",
        "left",
        "right",
        "bottom",
        "start",
        "end",
        "self-start",
        "self-end",
        "center",
    ]
    .iter()
    .any(|accepted| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(identifier, accepted.as_bytes()))
    .then(|| StyleValueData::Keyword {
        keyword: keyword_from_ascii_case_insensitive(identifier).unwrap(),
    })
}

fn property_allows_anchor(property: u16) -> bool {
    matches!(
        property,
        property_id::INSET
            | property_id::TOP
            | property_id::RIGHT
            | property_id::BOTTOM
            | property_id::LEFT
            | property_id::INSET_BLOCK
            | property_id::INSET_BLOCK_START
            | property_id::INSET_BLOCK_END
            | property_id::INSET_INLINE
            | property_id::INSET_INLINE_START
            | property_id::INSET_INLINE_END
    )
}

pub(crate) fn parse_anchor_function(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    value: &ComponentValue,
) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    if !property_allows_anchor(property) {
        return None;
    }
    let (name, arguments) = value.function()?;
    if !equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"anchor") {
        return None;
    }
    let arguments = arguments.split(ComponentValue::is_comma).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if arguments.is_empty() || arguments.len() > 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(arguments[0]);
    let mut anchor_name = None;
    let mut side = None;
    for _ in 0..2 {
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        if !tokens.has_next_token() {
            break;
        }
        if let Some(parsed_name) = dashed_ident(context, tokens.next_token()) {
            if anchor_name.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            tokens.discard_a_token();
            anchor_name = Some(parsed_name);
            continue;
        }
        if side.is_some() {
            break;
        }
        if let Some(parsed_side) = anchor_side(tokens.next_token()) {
            tokens.discard_a_token();
            side = Some(parsed_side);
            continue;
        }
        let parsed_side = parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
            context,
            property,
            &mut tokens,
            NumericRange::INFINITE,
            NumericRange::INFINITE,
        )?;
        if matches!(parsed_side, StyleValueData::Length { .. }) {
            return None;
        }
        side = Some(parsed_side);
    }
    tokens.discard_whitespace();
    if tokens.has_next_token() {
        return None;
    }
    let fallback = if arguments.len() == 2 {
        let mut candidate = TokenStream::new(arguments[1]);
        candidate.discard_whitespace();
        let parsed = parse_anchor_function(context, property, candidate.next_token())
            .inspect(|_| {
                candidate.discard_a_token();
            })
            .or_else(|| {
                parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
                    context,
                    property,
                    &mut candidate,
                    NumericRange::INFINITE,
                    NumericRange::INFINITE,
                )
            })?;
        candidate.discard_whitespace();
        if candidate.has_next_token() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(parsed)
    } else {
        None
    };
    Some(StyleValueData::Anchor(StyleValueBox::new(AnchorPayload {
        has_anchor_name: anchor_name.is_some(),
        anchor_name: anchor_name.unwrap_or_else(CssString::none),
        anchor_side: retained(side?),
        fallback_value: fallback.map_or_else(RetainedStyleValueData::none, retained),
    })))
}

fn anchor_size_keyword(value: &ComponentValue) -> Option<u8> {
    let identifier = value.ident()?;
    ["block", "height", "inline", "self-block", "self-inline", "width"]
        .iter()
        .position(|accepted| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(identifier, accepted.as_bytes()))
        .and_then(|index| u8::try_from(index).ok())
}

fn property_allows_anchor_size(property: u16) -> bool {
    property_allows_anchor(property)
        || matches!(
            property,
            property_id::MARGIN
                | property_id::MARGIN_TOP
                | property_id::MARGIN_RIGHT
                | property_id::MARGIN_BOTTOM
                | property_id::MARGIN_LEFT
                | property_id::MARGIN_BLOCK
                | property_id::MARGIN_BLOCK_START
                | property_id::MARGIN_BLOCK_END
                | property_id::MARGIN_INLINE
                | property_id::MARGIN_INLINE_START
                | property_id::MARGIN_INLINE_END
                | property_id::WIDTH
                | property_id::MIN_WIDTH
                | property_id::MAX_WIDTH
                | property_id::HEIGHT
                | property_id::MIN_HEIGHT
                | property_id::MAX_HEIGHT
                | property_id::BLOCK_SIZE
                | property_id::MIN_BLOCK_SIZE
                | property_id::MAX_BLOCK_SIZE
                | property_id::INLINE_SIZE
                | property_id::MIN_INLINE_SIZE
                | property_id::MAX_INLINE_SIZE
                | property_id::ALIGN_SELF
                | property_id::JUSTIFY_SELF
                | property_id::PLACE_SELF
        )
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#funcdef-anchor-size
pub(crate) fn parse_anchor_size_function(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    value: &ComponentValue,
) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    if !property_allows_anchor_size(property) {
        return None;
    }
    let (name, arguments) = value.function()?;
    if !equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"anchor-size") {
        return None;
    }
    let arguments = arguments.split(ComponentValue::is_comma).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if arguments.is_empty() || arguments.len() > 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(arguments[0]);
    let mut anchor_name = None;
    let mut anchor_size = None;
    for _ in 0..2 {
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        if !tokens.has_next_token() || tokens.next_token().ident().is_none() {
            break;
        }
        if let Some(parsed_name) = dashed_ident(context, tokens.next_token()) {
            if anchor_name.is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            tokens.discard_a_token();
            anchor_name = Some(parsed_name);
            continue;
        }
        let parsed_size = anchor_size_keyword(tokens.next_token())?;
        if anchor_size.is_some() {
            return None;
        }
        tokens.discard_a_token();
        anchor_size = Some(parsed_size);
    }
    tokens.discard_whitespace();
    let has_name_or_size = anchor_name.is_some() || anchor_size.is_some();
    let comma_present = arguments.len() == 2;
    if comma_present && !has_name_or_size {
        return None;
    }
    let fallback_values = if comma_present { arguments[1] } else { arguments[0] };
    let fallback_start = if comma_present { 0 } else { tokens.current_index() };
    let mut fallback_tokens = TokenStream::new(&fallback_values[fallback_start..]);
    fallback_tokens.discard_whitespace();
    if comma_present && !fallback_tokens.has_next_token() {
        return None;
    }
    let fallback = if fallback_tokens.has_next_token() {
        let mut candidate = fallback_tokens.clone();
        let parsed = parse_anchor_size_function(context, property, candidate.next_token())
            .inspect(|_| {
                candidate.discard_a_token();
            })
            .or_else(|| {
                parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
                    context,
                    property,
                    &mut candidate,
                    NumericRange::INFINITE,
                    NumericRange::INFINITE,
                )
            })?;
        candidate.discard_whitespace();
        if candidate.has_next_token() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(parsed)
    } else {
        None
    };
    if fallback.is_some() && !comma_present && has_name_or_size {
        return None;
    }
    Some(StyleValueData::AnchorSize(StyleValueBox::new(AnchorSizePayload {
        has_anchor_name: anchor_name.is_some(),
        anchor_name: anchor_name.unwrap_or_else(CssString::none),
        has_anchor_size: anchor_size.is_some(),
        anchor_size: anchor_size.unwrap_or(0),
        fallback_value: fallback.map_or_else(RetainedStyleValueData::none, retained),
    })))
}

fn contains_anchor_in_math_function(values: &[ComponentValue], inside_math_function: bool) -> bool {
    values.iter().any(|value| match &value.kind {
        ComponentKind::Function { name, values } => {
            let is_math_function = crate::css::math_functions::math_function_from_name(name).is_some();
            (inside_math_function
                && (equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"anchor")
                    || equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"anchor-size")))
                || contains_anchor_in_math_function(values, inside_math_function || is_math_function)
        }
        ComponentKind::SimpleBlock { values, .. } => contains_anchor_in_math_function(values, inside_math_function),
        ComponentKind::Token(_) => false,
    })
}

fn parse_fit_content(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, values: &[ComponentValue]) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let value = values.iter().find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())?;
    if values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).count() != 1 {
        return None;
    }
    if value
        .ident()
        .is_some_and(|identifier| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(identifier, b"fit-content"))
    {
        return Some(StyleValueData::Keyword {
            keyword: keyword::FIT_CONTENT,
        });
    }
    let (name, arguments) = value.function()?;
    if !equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"fit-content") {
        return None;
    }
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(arguments);
    let argument = parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
        context,
        property,
        &mut tokens,
        NumericRange::INFINITE,
        NumericRange::INFINITE,
    )?;
    tokens.discard_whitespace();
    if tokens.has_next_token() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(StyleValueData::Function(StyleValueBox::new(FunctionPayload {
        name: CssString::from_utf16(&"fit-content".encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>()),
        value: retained(argument),
    })))
}

fn parse_inset_leaf(context: &ParseContext, property: u16, tokens: &mut TokenStream<'_>) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    tokens.discard_whitespace();
    if let Some(auto) = keyword_value(tokens.next_token(), &[keyword::AUTO]) {
        tokens.discard_a_token();
        return Some(auto);
    }
    if let Some(anchor) = parse_anchor_function(context, property, tokens.next_token()) {
        tokens.discard_a_token();
        return Some(anchor);
    }
    if let Some(anchor_size) = parse_anchor_size_function(context, property, tokens.next_token()) {
        tokens.discard_a_token();
        return Some(anchor_size);
    }
    parse_length_percentage_from_stream(
        context,
        property,
        tokens,
        NumericRange::INFINITE,
        NumericRange::INFINITE,
    )
}

fn parse_positional_anchor_shorthand(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> Option<StyleValueData> {
    let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(values);
    let mut parsed = Vec::new();
    let maximum = longhands_for_shorthand(property).len();
    while parsed.len() < maximum {
        let mut candidate = tokens.clone();
        let Some(value) = parse_inset_leaf(context, property, &mut candidate) else {
            break;
        };
        tokens = candidate;
        parsed.push(value);
    }
    tokens.discard_whitespace();
    if tokens.has_next_token() {
        return None;
    }
    positional_shorthand(property, parsed)
}

fn is_inset_or_margin_shorthand(property: u16) -> bool {
    matches!(
        property,
        property_id::INSET
            | property_id::INSET_BLOCK
            | property_id::INSET_INLINE
            | property_id::MARGIN
            | property_id::MARGIN_BLOCK
            | property_id::MARGIN_INLINE
    )
}

pub(crate) fn parse_anchor_fit_property(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> ParseOutcome {
    let parsed = if is_inset_or_margin_shorthand(property) {
        parse_positional_anchor_shorthand(context, property, values)
    } else if property_allows_anchor(property) {
        let mut tokens = TokenStream::new(values);
        let parsed = parse_inset_leaf(context, property, &mut tokens);
        tokens.discard_whitespace();
        if parsed.is_none() && contains_anchor_in_math_function(values, false) {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        } else if tokens.has_next_token() {
            None
        } else {
            parsed
        }
    } else if property_accepted_value_types(property).contains(&VALUE_TYPE_FIT_CONTENT)
        && let [value] = trim_whitespace(values)
        && value
            .function()
            .is_some_and(|(name, _)| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"calc-size"))
    {
        crate::css::calc_size::parse_calc_size(context, property, value)
    } else if property_accepted_value_types(property).contains(&VALUE_TYPE_FIT_CONTENT) {
        let is_fit_or_anchor_size = values.iter().find(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).is_some_and(|value| {
            value
                .ident()
                .is_some_and(|identifier| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(identifier, b"fit-content"))
                || value.function().is_some_and(|(name, _)| {
                    equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"fit-content")
                        || equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"anchor-size")
                })
        });
        if !is_fit_or_anchor_size {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        }
        parse_fit_content(context, property, values).or_else(|| {
            let value = values.iter().find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())?;
            parse_anchor_size_function(context, property, value)
        })
    } else if property_allows_anchor_size(property) {
        let parsed = values
            .iter()
            .find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
            .and_then(|value| parse_anchor_size_function(context, property, value));
        if parsed.is_none() {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        }
        parsed
    } else if property_accepted_value_types(property).contains(&VALUE_TYPE_ANCHOR) {
        values
            .iter()
            .find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
            .and_then(|value| parse_anchor_function(context, property, value))
    } else {
        return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
    };
    parsed.map_or(ParseOutcome::Invalid, |parsed| {
        ParseOutcome::Parsed(StyleValueArc::new(parsed))
    })
}

pub(crate) fn parse_geometry_property(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> ParseOutcome {
    let parsed = if property == property_id::BORDER_RADIUS {
        parse_border_radius_shorthand(context, property, values)
    } else if is_border_radius_longhand(property) {
        parse_single_border_radius(context, property, values)
    } else if property_accepted_value_types(property).contains(&VALUE_TYPE_CORNER_SHAPE) {
        parse_corner_shape_property(context, property, values)
    } else if property_accepted_value_types(property).contains(&VALUE_TYPE_RECT) {
        let is_rect = values
            .iter()
            .find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
            .and_then(ComponentValue::function)
            .is_some_and(|(name, _)| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"rect"));
        if !is_rect {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        }
        parse_legacy_rect(context, property, values)
    } else if property == property_id::BORDER_SHAPE {
        parse_border_shape(context, property, values)
    } else if property == property_id::OFFSET {
        parse_offset_shorthand(context, property, values)
    } else if property == property_id::OFFSET_PATH {
        parse_offset_path(context, property, values)
    } else if property == property_id::OFFSET_ROTATE {
        parse_offset_rotate(context, property, values)
    } else if property == property_id::CLIP_PATH {
        let starts_shape_or_box = values.iter().find(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).is_some_and(|value| {
            value.function().is_some_and(|(name, _)| {
                !equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"url") && !equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"src")
            }) || geometry_box(value).is_some()
        });
        if !starts_shape_or_box {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        }
        parse_clip_path_shape(context, property, values)
    } else if property == property_id::SHAPE_OUTSIDE {
        let is_shape_outside_value = values.iter().find(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).is_some_and(|value| {
            value.ident().is_some_and(|ident| {
                equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, b"none")
                    || ["content-box", "padding-box", "border-box", "margin-box"]
                        .iter()
                        .any(|expected| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(ident, expected.as_bytes()))
            }) || value.function().is_some_and(|(name, _)| {
                ["inset", "xywh", "rect", "circle", "ellipse", "polygon", "path", "shape"]
                    .iter()
                    .any(|expected| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, expected.as_bytes()))
            })
        });
        if !is_shape_outside_value {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        }
        parse_shape_outside(context, property, values)
    } else if property == property_id::D {
        if let Some(value) = values
            .iter()
            .find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
            .and_then(|value| keyword_value(value, &[keyword::NONE]))
            .filter(|_| values.iter().filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace()).count() == 1)
        {
            Some(value)
        } else {
            parse_basic_shape(context, property, values).filter(|_| {
                values
                    .iter()
                    .find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
                    .and_then(ComponentValue::function)
                    .is_some_and(|(name, _)| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, b"path"))
            })
        }
    } else if property_accepted_value_types(property).contains(&VALUE_TYPE_BASIC_SHAPE) {
        let is_known_shape = values
            .iter()
            .find(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
            .and_then(ComponentValue::function)
            .is_some_and(|(name, _)| {
                ["inset", "xywh", "rect", "circle", "ellipse", "polygon", "path", "shape"]
                    .iter()
                    .any(|expected| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, expected.as_bytes()))
            });
        if !is_known_shape {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        }
        parse_basic_shape(context, property, values)
    } else {
        return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
    };
    parsed.map_or(ParseOutcome::Invalid, |parsed| {
        ParseOutcome::Parsed(StyleValueArc::new(parsed))
    })
}

pub(crate) fn parse_position_property(
    context: &ParseContext,
    property: u16,
    values: &[ComponentValue],
) -> ParseOutcome {
    let parsed = if property == property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION {
        parse_background_position(context, property, values)
    } else if matches!(
        property,
        property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION_X | property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION_Y
    ) {
        parse_background_position_axis(context, property, values)
    } else if matches!(property, property_id::OFFSET_POSITION | property_id::OFFSET_ANCHOR) {
        parse_offset_position_or_anchor(context, property, values)
    } else {
        let accepted_types = property_accepted_value_types(property);
        let background_position = accepted_types.contains(&VALUE_TYPE_BACKGROUND_POSITION);
        if !background_position && !accepted_types.contains(&VALUE_TYPE_POSITION) {
            return ParseOutcome::NotHandled;
        }
        parse_position_list(context, property, values, background_position).map(|mut positions| {
            if property_has_coordinating_list_multiplicity(property) {
                value_list(positions)
            } else {
                positions.remove(0)
            }
        })
    };
    parsed.map_or(ParseOutcome::Invalid, |parsed| {
        ParseOutcome::Parsed(StyleValueArc::new(parsed))
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::css_tokenizer::tokenize_for_parser;
    use crate::css::parser::component_value::consume_a_list_of_component_values;

    fn context() -> ParseContext<'static> {
        ParseContext::default()
    }

    fn parse(property: u16, source: &str) -> ParseOutcome {
        let values = consume_a_list_of_component_values(tokenize_for_parser(source.as_bytes())).unwrap();
        parse_position_property(&context(), property, &values)
    }

    fn parse_geometry(property: u16, source: &str) -> ParseOutcome {
        let values = consume_a_list_of_component_values(tokenize_for_parser(source.as_bytes())).unwrap();
        parse_geometry_property(&context(), property, &values)
    }

    fn parse_anchor_fit(property: u16, source: &str) -> ParseOutcome {
        let values = consume_a_list_of_component_values(tokenize_for_parser(source.as_bytes())).unwrap();
        parse_anchor_fit_property(&context(), property, &values)
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_position_alternatives() {
        for source in [
            "center",
            "top right",
            "25% bottom",
            "right 10px bottom calc(20% + 1px)",
            "calc(50% - 2px) 25%",
        ] {
            assert!(
                matches!(parse(property_id::OBJECT_POSITION, source), ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)),
                "{source}"
            );
        }
        assert!(matches!(
            parse(property_id::OBJECT_POSITION, "left 10px center"),
            ParseOutcome::Invalid
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_background_position_extensions_and_axes() {
        let ParseOutcome::Parsed(value) = parse(property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION, "left 10px center, right bottom")
        else {
            panic!("background-position should parse");
        };
        let StyleValueData::Shorthand(shorthand_payload) = &*value else {
            panic!("background-position should expand to its axes");
        };
        let ShorthandPayload {
            sub_properties, values, ..
        } = &**shorthand_payload;
        assert_eq!(
            sub_properties.as_slice(),
            [property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION_X, property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION_Y]
        );
        assert_eq!(values.as_slice().len(), 2);

        for (property, source) in [
            (property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION_X, "left 10px, center"),
            (property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION_Y, "bottom 20%, top"),
        ] {
            assert!(matches!(parse(property, source), ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)), "{source}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_coordinating_position_lists() {
        let ParseOutcome::Parsed(value) = parse(property_id::MASK_POSITION, "left top, 25% 75%") else {
            panic!("mask-position should parse");
        };
        let StyleValueData::ValueList { values, separator, .. } = &*value else {
            panic!("mask-position should produce a comma-separated list");
        };
        assert_eq!(*separator, 1);
        assert_eq!(values.as_slice().len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_border_radius_properties() {
        for source in ["10px", "10px 20%", "10px / 20%"] {
            assert!(
                matches!(
                    parse_geometry(property_id::BORDER_TOP_LEFT_RADIUS, source),
                    ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
                ),
                "{source}"
            );
        }
        let ParseOutcome::Parsed(value) = parse_geometry(property_id::BORDER_RADIUS, "1px 2px 3px / 4px 5px") else {
            panic!("border-radius should parse");
        };
        assert!(matches!(&*value, StyleValueData::Shorthand(shorthand) if shorthand.values.as_slice().len() == 4));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_geometry(property_id::BORDER_RADIUS, "-1px"),
            ParseOutcome::Invalid
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_corner_shapes() {
        for source in ["round", "squircle", "superellipse(2)", "superellipse(-infinity)"] {
            assert!(
                matches!(
                    parse_geometry(property_id::CORNER_TOP_LEFT_SHAPE, source),
                    ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
                ),
                "{source}"
            );
        }
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_geometry(property_id::CORNER_SHAPE, "round scoop bevel notch"),
            ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_rect_and_basic_shapes() {
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_geometry(property_id::CLIP, "rect(auto, 10px, 20px, 0)"),
            ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
        ));
        for (source, expected_kind) in [
            ("inset(1px 2% round 3px / 4px)", 0),
            ("xywh(1px 2px 30% 40% round 5px)", 1),
            ("rect(auto 2px 30% auto)", 2),
            ("circle(closest-side at right 2px bottom 3px)", 3),
            ("ellipse(10px 20% at center)", 4),
            ("polygon(evenodd, 0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%)", 5),
            ("path(evenodd, \"M 0 0 L 10 10\")", 6),
            ("shape(from 0 0, line to right bottom, close)", 7),
        ] {
            let ParseOutcome::Parsed(value) = parse_geometry(property_id::CLIP_PATH, source) else {
                panic!("basic shape should parse: {source}");
            };
            assert!(matches!(&*value, StyleValueData::BasicShape { shape } if shape.as_ref().kind == expected_kind));
        }
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_geometry(property_id::CLIP_PATH, "shape(from 0 0)"),
            ParseOutcome::Invalid
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_shape_outside_combinations() {
        for source in ["none", "margin-box", "circle() border-box", "content-box inset(10px)"] {
            assert!(
                matches!(
                    parse_geometry(property_id::SHAPE_OUTSIDE, source),
                    ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
                ),
                "{source}"
            );
        }
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_geometry(property_id::SHAPE_OUTSIDE, "url(shape.png)"),
            ParseOutcome::NotHandled
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_anchor_functions_and_insets() {
        for source in [
            "anchor(top)",
            "anchor(--card 25%, 10px)",
            "anchor(left, anchor(--fallback right))",
        ] {
            assert!(
                matches!(parse_anchor_fit(property_id::TOP, source), ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)),
                "{source}"
            );
        }
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_anchor_fit(property_id::TOP, "anchor(10px)"),
            ParseOutcome::Invalid
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_anchor_fit(property_id::TOP, "calc(anchor(top, 1px) + 2px)"),
            ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_anchor_fit(property_id::TOP, "anchor(--foo top, calc(0.5 * anchor(--bar bottom)))"),
            ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_anchor_fit(property_id::INSET, "auto anchor(right) 10px 20%"),
            ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_anchor_size_and_fit_content_functions() {
        for (property, source) in [
            (property_id::WIDTH, "anchor-size()"),
            (property_id::WIDTH, "anchor-size(--card width, 10px)"),
            (property_id::WIDTH, "anchor-size(anchor-size(20%))"),
            (property_id::WIDTH, "fit-content(20%)"),
            (property_id::WIDTH, "fit-content"),
            (property_id::MARGIN, "anchor-size(width) 10px"),
        ] {
            assert!(
                matches!(parse_anchor_fit(property, source), ParseOutcome::Parsed(_)),
                "{source}"
            );
        }
        for source in ["anchor-size(--foo width,)", "anchor-size(--foo,)"] {
            assert!(matches!(
                parse_anchor_fit(property_id::WIDTH, source),
                ParseOutcome::Invalid
            ));
        }
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_anchor_fit(property_id::WIDTH, "auto"),
            ParseOutcome::NotHandled
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_anchor_fit(property_id::COLOR, "anchor-size()"),
            ParseOutcome::NotHandled
        ));
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct QueryFeatureMetadata {
    name: &'static str,
    allows_range: bool,
}

const SIZE_FEATURES: &[QueryFeatureMetadata] = &[
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "aspect-ratio",
        allows_range: true,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "block-size",
        allows_range: true,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "height",
        allows_range: true,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "inline-size",
        allows_range: true,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "orientation",
        allows_range: false,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "width",
        allows_range: true,
    },
];

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-5/#scroll-state-container
const SCROLL_STATE_FEATURES: &[QueryFeatureMetadata] = &[
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "scrollable",
        allows_range: false,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "scrolled",
        allows_range: false,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "snapped",
        allows_range: false,
    },
    QueryFeatureMetadata {
        name: "stuck",
        allows_range: false,
    },
];

const SCROLL_STATE_FEATURE_SCROLLABLE: u8 = 0;
const SCROLL_STATE_FEATURE_SCROLLED: u8 = 1;
const SCROLL_STATE_FEATURE_SNAPPED: u8 = 2;
const SCROLL_STATE_FEATURE_STUCK: u8 = 3;

// NB: Media feature IDs follow MediaFeatures.json iteration order.
/// Looks up a query feature by name over a table of `(name, allows_range)` entries. The media and
/// size tables come from different generators, so they are matched through this shared accessor.
fn feature_from_name<'a>(table: impl IntoIterator<Item = (&'a str, bool)>, name: &[u16]) -> Option<(u8, bool)> {
    table
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
        .find_map(|(id, (candidate, allows_range))| {
            if !equals_ascii_case_insensitive(name, candidate.as_bytes()) {
                return None;
            }
            Some((u8::try_from(id).ok()?, allows_range))
        })
}

pub(crate) fn media_feature_from_name(name: &[u16]) -> Option<(u8, bool)> {
    feature_from_name(
        MEDIA_FEATURES
            .iter()
            .map(|metadata| (metadata.name, metadata.allows_range)),
        name,
    )
}

pub(crate) fn resolve_query_feature(kind: QueryKind, name: &[u16]) -> Option<(u8, bool)> {
    match kind {
        QueryKind::Media => media_feature_from_name(name),
        QueryKind::Size => feature_from_name(
            SIZE_FEATURES
                .iter()
                .map(|metadata| (metadata.name, metadata.allows_range)),
            name,
        ),
        QueryKind::ScrollState => feature_from_name(
            SCROLL_STATE_FEATURES
                .iter()
                .map(|metadata| (metadata.name, metadata.allows_range)),
            name,
        ),
        QueryKind::Style => property_id_from_name(name).map(|_| (0, false)),
        QueryKind::Supports => None,
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub(crate) enum QueryKind {
    Media,
    Size,
    ScrollState,
    Style,
    Supports,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub(crate) enum MatchResult {
    False,
    True,
    Unknown,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
#[expect(dead_code, reason = "C++ constructs the variants")]
pub enum FfiMediaFeatureValueKind {
    Absent,
    Ident,
    Integer,
    Length,
    Ratio,
    Resolution,
    Number,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum SupportsFeatureKind {
    Declaration,
    Selector,
    FontTech,
    FontFormat,
    AtRule,
    Env,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiMediaFeatureValue {
    pub kind: FfiMediaFeatureValueKind,
    pub keyword: u16,
    pub value: f64,
    pub second_value: f64,
}

/// The media feature values and length resolution context media queries evaluate against, borrowed for `'a`.
///
/// Rust builds one only from borrowed values, and C++ hands one over under the same contract: `values` identifies
/// `value_count` values, and a non-null `length_resolution_context` a context, which stay readable for `'a`.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiMediaEnvironment<'a> {
    values: *const FfiMediaFeatureValue,
    value_count: usize,
    length_resolution_context: *const c_void,
    lent: PhantomData<(&'a [FfiMediaFeatureValue], Option<&'a FfiLengthResolutionContext>)>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct MediaEnvironment<'a> {
    values: Option<&'a [FfiMediaFeatureValue]>,
    length_context: Option<&'a FfiLengthResolutionContext>,
}

impl<'a> FfiMediaEnvironment<'a> {
    pub(crate) fn new(values: &'a [FfiMediaFeatureValue], length: Option<&'a FfiLengthResolutionContext>) -> Self {
        Self {
            values: values.as_ptr(),
            value_count: values.len(),
            length_resolution_context: length.map_or(std::ptr::null(), |length| std::ptr::from_ref(length).cast()),
            lent: PhantomData,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn borrow(&self) -> MediaEnvironment<'a> {
        let data = self.parts();
        MediaEnvironment {
            values: data.map(|(values, _)| values),
            length_context: data.and_then(|(_, context)| context),
        }
    }

    /// The feature values and the length context, or none for an environment that names values it has no storage for.
    fn parts(&self) -> Option<(&'a [FfiMediaFeatureValue], Option<&'a FfiLengthResolutionContext>)> {
        if self.value_count != 0 && self.values.is_null() {
            return None;
        }
        // SAFETY: The environment is readable for 'a, as the type says.
        unsafe {
            Some((
                ak::slice_from_raw_parts(self.values, self.value_count),
                self.length_resolution_context
                    .cast::<FfiLengthResolutionContext>()
                    .as_ref(),
            ))
        }
    }
}

/// The container's sibling count and index, asked for by a value that reads them.
pub(crate) type TreeCounting<'a> = &'a dyn Fn() -> Option<(u64, u64)>;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct ContainerFacts<'a> {
    pub container_available: bool,
    pub size_available: bool,
    pub width: f64,
    pub height: f64,
    pub inline_axis_horizontal: bool,
    pub length_resolution_context: *const c_void,
    pub tree_counting: TreeCounting<'a>,
    // The container's scroll state as of the last post-layout snapshot. The edge sets use the
    // SCROLL_STATE_EDGE_* bits, and the start sides are SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_* values that name the
    // physical side the container's writing mode maps each logical start side to.
    pub scroll_state_available: bool,
    pub stuck: u8,
    pub snapped: u8,
    pub scrollable: u8,
    pub scrolled: u8,
    pub block_start_side: u8,
    pub inline_start_side: u8,
}

pub const SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_TOP: u8 = 0;
pub const SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_RIGHT: u8 = 1;
pub const SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_BOTTOM: u8 = 2;
pub const SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_LEFT: u8 = 3;

pub const SCROLL_STATE_EDGE_TOP: u8 = 1 << SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_TOP;
pub const SCROLL_STATE_EDGE_RIGHT: u8 = 1 << SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_RIGHT;
pub const SCROLL_STATE_EDGE_BOTTOM: u8 = 1 << SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_BOTTOM;
pub const SCROLL_STATE_EDGE_LEFT: u8 = 1 << SCROLL_STATE_SIDE_LEFT;

pub const SCROLL_STATE_SNAPPED_X: u8 = 1 << 0;
pub const SCROLL_STATE_SNAPPED_Y: u8 = 1 << 1;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub(crate) enum FeatureComparison {
    Equal,
    LessThan,
    LessThanOrEqual,
    GreaterThan,
    GreaterThanOrEqual,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum FeatureNameType {
    Normal,
    Min,
    Max,
}

/// A query feature's value, kept as its source text rather than the tokens it was parsed from,
/// which hold several times as much. The components the text holds are tokenized again
/// whenever they are read, which only parsing it into a value the first time a query evaluates it
/// and serializing it do.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct QueryFeatureValue {
    text: CssString,
    /// The keyword a value that is a lone identifier names, which evaluation reads as it is.
    keyword: Option<u16>,
    /// What the value parses to, made the first time a query evaluates the value.
    parsed: std::sync::OnceLock<Box<ParsedFeatureValues>>,
}

impl PartialEq for QueryFeatureValue {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.text == other.text
    }
}

impl QueryFeatureValue {
    pub(crate) fn new(components: Vec<ComponentValue>) -> Self {
        let components = trim_whitespace(&components);
        let keyword = match components {
            [component] => component.ident().and_then(keyword_from_ascii_case_insensitive),
            _ => None,
        };
        Self {
            text: source_text(components),
            keyword,
            parsed: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
        }
    }

    /// The components of the value, without the whitespace around them.
    pub(crate) fn components(&self) -> Vec<ComponentValue> {
        components_from_source(TokenizerInput::Utf16(self.text.units())).unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// What the value parses to as `kind`, which it is parsed to the first time it is asked for.
    fn parsed_as(&self, kind: FeatureValueParse) -> Option<&StyleValueData> {
        self.parsed_in(kind, FeatureValueQuery::Media)
    }

    /// What the value of a feature of `query` parses to as `kind`, as `parsed_as` says.
    fn parsed_in(&self, kind: FeatureValueParse, query: FeatureValueQuery) -> Option<&StyleValueData> {
        self.parsed.get_or_init(Box::default).0[kind as usize]
            .get_or_init(|| parse_feature_value_as(&self.components(), kind, query))
            .as_ref()
    }
}

/// What a query feature's value parses to, by what it was parsed as. Parsing does not depend on the environment a query
/// is evaluated in, so each evaluation only resolves what the first one parsed.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct ParsedFeatureValues([std::sync::OnceLock<Option<StyleValueData>>; FeatureValueParse::COUNT]);

impl std::fmt::Debug for ParsedFeatureValues {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        formatter.write_str("ParsedFeatureValues")
    }
}

/// The kind of query a feature value belongs to, which it keeps for its whole life.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum FeatureValueQuery {
    Media,
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values-5/#tree-counting
    /// A container's size feature may count the container's siblings, where a media feature has no element to count.
    ContainerSize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum FeatureValueParse {
    Integer,
    Length,
    Number,
    Ratio,
    Resolution,
}

impl FeatureValueParse {
    const COUNT: usize = Self::Resolution as usize + 1;
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum QueryFeature {
    Boolean {
        id: u8,
    },
    Plain {
        id: u8,
        name_type: FeatureNameType,
        value: QueryFeatureValue,
    },
    /// Each side boxed, so that every other feature, and every expression, stays small.
    Range {
        id: u8,
        left: Option<Box<(QueryFeatureValue, FeatureComparison)>>,
        right: Option<Box<(FeatureComparison, QueryFeatureValue)>>,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum SupportsFeature {
    /// A declaration or selector is evaluated as it is parsed and kept as its source text, which
    /// serializing the condition reads.
    Declaration {
        text: CssString,
        matches: bool,
    },
    Selector {
        text: CssString,
        matches: bool,
    },
    FontTech {
        name: ParserString,
        matches: bool,
    },
    FontFormat {
        name: ParserString,
        matches: bool,
    },
    AtRule {
        name: ParserString,
        matches: bool,
    },
    Env {
        name: ParserString,
        matches: bool,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum StyleRangeValue {
    Property(ParserString),
    Components(Vec<ComponentValue>),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum StyleFeature {
    Boolean(ParserString),
    Plain {
        name: ParserString,
        value: Vec<ComponentValue>,
        original_source: ParserString,
        original_value_source: ParserString,
    },
    Range {
        left: StyleRangeValue,
        left_comparison: FeatureComparison,
        middle: StyleRangeValue,
        right: Option<(FeatureComparison, StyleRangeValue)>,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum Expression {
    Not(Box<Expression>),
    And(Vec<Expression>),
    Or(Vec<Expression>),
    InParens(Box<Expression>),
    /// A `<general-enclosed>`, kept as its source text: it only serializes.
    GeneralEnclosed {
        text: CssString,
        result: MatchResult,
    },
    GeneralEnclosedValues {
        text: CssString,
        result: MatchResult,
    },
    QueryFeature(QueryFeature),
    SupportsFeature(SupportsFeature),
    StyleFunction(Box<Expression>),
    /// Boxed, as the largest feature, so that the expressions of other features stay small.
    StyleFeature(Box<StyleFeature>),
    ScrollStateFunction(Box<Expression>),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct MediaQuery {
    pub negated: bool,
    pub media_type: Option<CssString>,
    pub condition: Option<Expression>,
    pub valid: bool,
}

fn is_ident(value: &ComponentValue, expected: &[u8]) -> bool {
    value
        .ident()
        .is_some_and(|value| equals_ascii_case_insensitive(value, expected))
}

fn parenthesized_values(value: &ComponentValue) -> Option<&[ComponentValue]> {
    match &value.kind {
        ComponentKind::SimpleBlock {
            opening: ParserTokenKind::OpenParen,
            values,
        } => Some(values),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn original_source(values: &[ComponentValue]) -> ParserString {
    ParserString::from(
        values
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|component| component.original_source_text.iter())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .into_boxed_slice(),
    )
}

/// The source text `values` were tokenized from.
fn source_text(values: &[ComponentValue]) -> CssString {
    let text: smallvec::SmallVec<[u16; 128]> = values
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|component| component.original_source_text.iter())
        .collect();
    CssString::from_utf16(&text)
}

fn components_from_source<'a>(source: impl Into<TokenizerInput<'a>>) -> Option<Vec<ComponentValue>> {
    consume_a_list_of_component_values(tokenize_for_parser(source)).ok()
}

fn contains_only_any_value(values: &[ComponentValue]) -> bool {
    values.iter().all(|value| match &value.kind {
        ComponentKind::Function { values, .. } | ComponentKind::SimpleBlock { values, .. } => {
            contains_only_any_value(values)
        }
        ComponentKind::Token(
            ParserTokenKind::EndOfFile
            | ParserTokenKind::BadString
            | ParserTokenKind::BadUrl
            | ParserTokenKind::Function(_)
            | ParserTokenKind::OpenCurly
            | ParserTokenKind::OpenParen
            | ParserTokenKind::OpenSquare
            | ParserTokenKind::CloseCurly
            | ParserTokenKind::CloseParen
            | ParserTokenKind::CloseSquare,
        ) => false,
        ComponentKind::Token(_) => true,
    })
}

fn contains_only_declaration_value(values: &[ComponentValue]) -> bool {
    contains_only_any_value(values)
        && values.iter().all(|value| {
            !matches!(value.kind, ComponentKind::Token(ParserTokenKind::Semicolon)) && !value.is_delim(b'!')
        })
        && crate::css::parser::arbitrary_substitution::collect_arbitrary_substitution_function_presence(
            values,
            &mut Default::default(),
        )
        .is_ok()
}
