#[test]
fn parsed_anchor_and_font_values_retain_their_children() {
    use crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData;
    let block = declarations("width: anchor-size(width, 1px); left: anchor(left, 2px)");
    let data = block.data();
    assert_eq!(data.properties().len(), 2);
    let StyleValueData::AnchorSize(anchor_size_payload) = &**data.properties().get(0).unwrap().value else {
        panic!()
    };
    let AnchorSizePayload { fallback_value, .. } = &**anchor_size_payload;
    let fallback = fallback_value.clone();
    let StyleValueData::Anchor(anchor_payload) = &**data.properties().get(1).unwrap().value else {
        panic!()
    };
    let AnchorPayload {
        anchor_side,
        fallback_value,
        ..
    } = &**anchor_payload;
    let side = anchor_side.clone();
    let second_fallback = fallback_value.clone();
    drop((block, data));
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(fallback.data()), utf16("1px"));
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(side.data()), utf16("left"));
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(second_fallback.data()), utf16("2px"));

    let sheet = parse_shared_on_worker("@font-face { font-family: Graph; src: local('Font Name'); }");
    let descriptors = sheet.root(0).descriptor_block().cloned().unwrap();
    let value = &*descriptors.descriptors[1].value;
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(value), utf16("local(\"Font Name\")"));
    let StyleValueData::ValueList { values, .. } = value else {
        panic!()
    };
    let StyleValueData::FontSource(font_source_payload) = values.as_slice()[0].data() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let FontSourcePayload { local_name, .. } = &**font_source_payload;
    let name = local_name.clone();
    drop((sheet, descriptors));
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(name.data()), utf16("\"Font Name\""));
}

#[test]
fn calculation_nodes_retain_native_function_values() {
    use crate::css::calc::{CalcNode, CalcNumericValue};
    use crate::css::style_value::{RetainedStyleValueData, StyleValueData};
    let node = CalcNode::Random {
        min: Arc::new(CalcNode::Numeric(CalcNumericValue::Number {
            value: 0.0,
            number_type: 0,
        })),
        max: Arc::new(CalcNode::Numeric(CalcNumericValue::Number {
            value: 1.0,
            number_type: 0,
        })),
        step: None,
        sharing: RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::RandomValueSharing(StyleValueBox::new(
            RandomValueSharingPayload {
                fixed_value: RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::Number { value: 0.25 }),
                is_auto: false,
                has_name: false,
                name: crate::css::css_string::CssString::from_utf16(&[]),
                element_shared: false,
            },
        ))),
    };
    let CalcNode::Random { sharing, .. } = &node else {
        panic!()
    };
    let sharing = sharing.clone();
    drop(node);
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(sharing.data()), utf16("fixed 0.25"));
    let node = CalcNode::NonMathFunction {
        value: RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::TreeCountingFunction {
            function: 0,
            computed_type: 0,
        }),
        numeric_type: Default::default(),
    };
    let CalcNode::NonMathFunction { value, .. } = &node else {
        panic!()
    };
    let value = value.clone();
    drop(node);
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(value.data()), utf16("sibling-count()"));
}

#[test]
fn declaration_image_traversal_skips_non_resource_values() {
    use crate::css::declaration_block::visit_declaration_images;
    use crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData;
    let block = declarations(
        "width: 13px; background-image: url(a), linear-gradient(red, blue); content: url(b) / 'text'; border-image-source: image-set(url(c) 1x, url(d) 2x); --ignored: url(e)",
    );
    let mut images = 0;
    let mut image_sets = 0;
    visit_declaration_images(&block.data(), &mut |value| match value {
        StyleValueData::Image { .. } => images += 1,
        StyleValueData::ImageSet { .. } => image_sets += 1,
        _ => panic!("Image traversal visited a non-resource value"),
    });
    assert_eq!(images, 2);
    assert_eq!(image_sets, 1);
}

#[test]
fn declaration_mutation_does_not_change_cached_or_nested_shared_blocks() {
    use crate::css::declaration_block::{
        DeclarationBlock, rust_declaration_block_remove_custom, rust_declaration_block_remove_expanding_shorthands,
    };
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
    let source = utf16("a { margin: 13px; --色: green }");
    let context = super::tests::parse_context();
    let first = parse(&source, &context);
    let second = parse(&source, &context);
    let original = first.root(0).declaration_block().cloned().unwrap();
    assert!(SharedDeclarationBlock::ptr_eq(
        &original,
        second.root(0).declaration_block().unwrap()
    ));
    let mut changed = DeclarationBlock::new(original.clone());
    let independent = DeclarationBlock::new(original.clone());
    assert_eq!(changed.data().properties().len(), 4);
    assert!(rust_declaration_block_remove_expanding_shorthands(
        &mut changed,
        property_id::MARGIN_TOP
    ));
    assert!(rust_declaration_block_remove_custom(&mut changed, view(&utf16("--色"))));
    assert_eq!(independent.data().properties().len(), 4);
    assert_eq!(independent.data().custom_properties().len(), 1);
    let third = parse(&source, &context);
    assert!(SharedDeclarationBlock::ptr_eq(
        &original,
        third.root(0).declaration_block().unwrap()
    ));
    drop((first, second, third, original));
    assert_eq!(
        serialize_style_value_to_utf16(&independent.data().properties().get(0).unwrap().value),
        utf16("13px")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        serialize_style_value_to_utf16(&independent.data().custom_properties().get(0).unwrap().declaration.value),
        utf16("green")
    );

    let nested = parse_shared_on_worker(".parent { .child {} margin: var(--gap); --色: green; }");
    assert_eq!(nested.children_of(nested.root(0)).len(), 2);
    let ParsedRuleChild::Declarations(list) = &nested.children_of(nested.root(0))[1] else {
        panic!()
    };
    let original = list.declaration_block.clone().unwrap();
    drop(nested);
    let mut changed = DeclarationBlock::new(original.clone());
    let shared = DeclarationBlock::new(original);
    assert_eq!(changed.data().properties().len(), 5);
    assert_eq!(changed.data().custom_properties().len(), 1);
    assert!(rust_declaration_block_remove_expanding_shorthands(
        &mut changed,
        property_id::MARGIN_LEFT
    ));
    assert_eq!(shared.data().properties().len(), 5);
}

#[test]
fn media_mutation_preserves_live_owners_and_shared_snapshots() {
    use crate::css::media_list::*;
    fn text(list: &MediaList) -> Vec<u16> {
        let mut text = Vec::<u16>::new();
        unsafe { rust_media_list_serialize(list, (&raw mut text).cast(), collect_text) };
        text
    }
    let sheet = parse_shared_on_worker("@import 'data:text/css,' screen, écran; @media all, print {}");
    assert_eq!(sheet.roots.len(), 2);
    let imported = MediaList::new(sheet.root(0).media_list().cloned().unwrap());
    let media = MediaList::new(sheet.root(1).media_list().cloned().unwrap());
    drop(sheet);
    assert_eq!(text(&imported), utf16("screen, écran"));
    assert_eq!(text(&media), utf16("all, print"));
    let retained = media.clone();
    unsafe {
        let shared = Box::from_raw(rust_media_list_share(&media));
        assert!(rust_media_list_evaluate(
            &media,
            crate::css::parser::query_parser::FfiMediaEnvironment::new(&[], None)
        ));
        assert!(rust_media_list_matches(&retained));
        assert!(!rust_media_list_matches(&shared));
        assert!(matches!(
            media.delete_medium(ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(&utf16("all"))),
            MediaListDeleteResult::Removed
        ));
        assert!(!rust_media_list_matches(&media));
        assert_eq!(text(&retained), utf16("print"));
        assert_eq!(text(&shared), utf16("all, print"));
        assert!(!media.append_medium(ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(&utf16("PRINT"))));
        assert!(!media.append_medium(ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(&utf16("screen, print"))));
        assert!(matches!(
            media.delete_medium(ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(&utf16("screen, print"))),
            MediaListDeleteResult::Invalid
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            media.delete_medium(ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(&utf16("screen"))),
            MediaListDeleteResult::NotFound
        ));
        rust_media_list_set_text(&media, view(&utf16("écran, écran")));
        assert!(matches!(
            media.delete_medium(ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(&utf16("écran"))),
            MediaListDeleteResult::Removed
        ));
        assert_eq!(rust_media_list_length(&retained), 0);
        assert!(rust_media_list_matches(&retained));
        let mut item = Vec::<u16>::new();
        assert!(!rust_media_list_item(
            &retained,
            0,
            (&raw mut item).cast(),
            collect_text
        ));
        assert!(media.append_medium(ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(&utf16(""))));
        assert!(rust_media_list_item(&retained, 0, (&raw mut item).cast(), collect_text));
        assert_eq!(item, utf16("not all"));
        drop(media);
        assert_eq!(text(&retained), utf16("not all"));
        assert_eq!(text(&shared), utf16("all, print"));
    }
}

#[test]
fn function_descriptor_blocks_retain_worker_parsed_values() {
    use crate::css::descriptor_block::FfiDescriptorBlock;
    let (data, parsed_values) = std::thread::spawn(|| {
        let source = utf16("--色: 13px; result: var(--色)");
        let parse = super::parse_shared_block(
            TokenizerInput::Utf16(&source),
            vec![super::RuleContext::AtFunction],
            Some(&super::tests::parse_context()),
            false,
        );
        assert_eq!(parse.items.len(), 1);
        let ParsedRuleChild::Declarations(list) = &parse.items[0] else {
            panic!()
        };
        let data = list.descriptor_block.clone().unwrap();
        let block = unsafe { Box::from_raw(super::rust_css_syntax_parse_descriptor_block(&*parse)) };
        assert_eq!(block.data().descriptors.len(), 2);
        assert!(StyleValueArc::ptr_eq(
            &data.descriptors[0].value,
            &block.data().descriptors[0].value
        ));
        drop(parse);
        assert_eq!(data.descriptors[0].name.units(), utf16("--色"));
        assert_eq!(crate::css::ffi_stats::THREAD_UNSAFE_CPP_CALLBACK_COUNT.get(), 0);
        (data, block.data())
    })
    .join()
    .unwrap();
    let descriptors = FfiDescriptorBlock::new(data);
    assert_eq!(descriptors.data().descriptors.len(), 2);
    assert!(StyleValueArc::ptr_eq(
        &descriptors.data().descriptors[1].value,
        &parsed_values.descriptors[1].value
    ));
    assert_eq!(
        serialize_style_value_to_utf16(&descriptors.data().descriptors[1].value),
        utf16("var(--色)")
    );
}

#[test]
fn descriptor_mutation_forks_worker_parsed_data() {
    use crate::css::descriptor_block::{FfiDescriptorBlock, rust_descriptor_block_set};
    use crate::css::descriptor_metadata::descriptor_metadata;
    let sheet = parse_shared_on_worker(
        "@page { margin-top: 13px; margin-left: 29px; margin-top: 17px } @font-face { font-family: 色; src: local(色) }",
    );
    assert_eq!(sheet.roots.len(), 2);
    let mut page = FfiDescriptorBlock::new(sheet.root(0).descriptor_block().cloned().unwrap());
    let shared = FfiDescriptorBlock::new(sheet.root(0).descriptor_block().cloned().unwrap());
    let font = sheet.root(1).descriptor_block().cloned().unwrap();
    drop(sheet);
    let data = page.data();
    assert_eq!(data.descriptors.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        data.descriptors[0].id,
        descriptor_metadata(1, &utf16("margin-left")).unwrap().id
    );
    assert_eq!(
        data.descriptors[1].id,
        descriptor_metadata(1, &utf16("margin-top")).unwrap().id
    );
    let original = data.descriptors[1].value.clone();
    unsafe {
        let original = data.descriptors[1].view();
        let replacement = crate::css::descriptor_block::FfiDescriptor {
            name: original.name,
            id: original.id,
            value: StyleValueArc::as_ptr(&data.descriptors[0].value).cast(),
        };
        assert!(rust_descriptor_block_set(&mut page, &replacement));
    }
    assert!(StyleValueArc::ptr_eq(&shared.data().descriptors[1].value, &original));
    assert!(StyleValueArc::ptr_eq(
        &page.data().descriptors[1].value,
        &data.descriptors[0].value
    ));
    assert_eq!(font.descriptors.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(serialize_style_value_to_utf16(&font.descriptors[0].value), utf16("色"));
}

use super::{
    NativeRuleType, NestedDeclarationsKind, ParsedDeclarationList, ParsedRule, ParsedRuleChild, ParsedRuleKind,
    ParsedStyleSheet,

use crate::css::descriptor_block::DescriptorBlockData;

/// A position among a sheet's rules or a rule's children, which fits in 32 bits.
pub(super) fn narrow_index(index: usize) -> u32 {
    u32::try_from(index).expect("style sheet has too many rules")
}

/// The positions among `children` of the rules the CSSOM sees, where the rules of `children` are indices among `rules`.
pub(super) fn native_child_indices<'a>(
    rules: &'a [ParsedRule],
    children: &'a [ParsedRuleChild],
    parent: Option<ParsedRuleKind>,
) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32> + 'a {
    let has_native_children = matches!(
        parent,
        None | Some(
            ParsedRuleKind::Qualified
                | ParsedRuleKind::Media
                | ParsedRuleKind::Supports
                | ParsedRuleKind::Container
                | ParsedRuleKind::Scope
                | ParsedRuleKind::Layer
                | ParsedRuleKind::Function
                | ParsedRuleKind::Page
                | ParsedRuleKind::Keyframes
        )
    );
    let children = if has_native_children { children } else { &[] };
    children.iter().enumerate().filter_map(move |(index, child)| {
        let kind = match child {
            &ParsedRuleChild::Rule(rule) => rules[rule as usize].native_type()?,
            ParsedRuleChild::Declarations(_) => NativeRuleType::NestedDeclarations,
        };
        if (parent == Some(ParsedRuleKind::Page) && kind != NativeRuleType::Margin)
            || (parent == Some(ParsedRuleKind::Keyframes) && kind != NativeRuleType::Keyframe)
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(narrow_index(index))
    })
}

// An immutable list projection retains the original graph, not copies of its rules.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct ParsedRuleList {
    sheet: Arc<ParsedStyleSheet>,
    /// The index among the rules of the sheet of the rule whose children the list is, or none for the top-level
    /// rules of the sheet.
    parent: Option<(u32, NestedDeclarationsKind)>,
}

impl ParsedRuleList {
    pub(crate) fn root_sheet(&self) -> Option<&Arc<ParsedStyleSheet>> {
        self.parent.is_none().then_some(&self.sheet)
    }

    pub(crate) fn root(sheet: Arc<ParsedStyleSheet>) -> Self {
        Self { sheet, parent: None }
    }

    pub(super) fn children(
        sheet: Arc<ParsedStyleSheet>,
        parent: u32,
        declarations_kind: NestedDeclarationsKind,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            sheet,
            parent: Some((parent, declarations_kind)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn visit_rules<'a>(
        &'a self,
        visit: &mut impl FnMut(SharedRule<'a>) -> ControlFlow<()>,
    ) -> ControlFlow<()> {
        for index in 0..self.len() {
            visit(self.rule_at(index))?;
        }
        ControlFlow::Continue(())
    }

    /// Visits the rules of [`Self::visit_rules`] that are, or hold, a rule a media evaluation reads: of a sheet's
    /// top-level rules, the few its parse found; of a rule's children, all.
    pub(crate) fn visit_media_holding_rules<'a>(
        &'a self,
        visit: &mut impl FnMut(SharedRule<'a>) -> ControlFlow<()>,
    ) -> ControlFlow<()> {
        if self.parent.is_some() {
            return self.visit_rules(visit);
        }
        for &position in &self.sheet.media_holding_roots {
            visit(self.rule_at(position as usize))?;
        }
        ControlFlow::Continue(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.parent.map_or(self.sheet.native_roots.len(), |(parent, _)| {
            self.sheet.native_children_of(self.sheet.rule(parent)).len()
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule_at(&self, index: usize) -> SharedRule<'_> {
        let sheet = &*self.sheet;
        match self.parent {
            Some((parent, kind)) => {
                let parent = sheet.rule(parent);
                let position = sheet.native_children_of(parent)[index] as usize;
                SharedRule::from_child(sheet, &sheet.children_of(parent)[position], kind).unwrap()
            }
            None => {
                let index = sheet.native_roots[index] as usize;
                if sheet.items.is_empty() {
                    SharedRule::from_rule(sheet, sheet.roots[index], sheet.declarations_kind).unwrap()
                } else {
                    SharedRule::from_child(sheet, &sheet.items[index], sheet.declarations_kind).unwrap()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn materialize_at(
        &self,
        index: usize,
        list: &crate::css::rule::NativeRuleList,
    ) -> std::rc::Rc<crate::css::rule::NativeRule> {
        let rule = self.rule_at(index);
        match rule.data {
            SharedRuleData::Rule(_, rule_index) => self
                .sheet
                .native_rule(rule_index, rule.declarations_kind, list)
                .unwrap(),
            SharedRuleData::Declarations(declarations) => {
                self.sheet
                    .native_declarations(declarations, rule.declarations_kind, list)
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum SharedRuleData<'a> {
    /// A rule of the sheet, by its index among the rules of the sheet.
    Rule(&'a ParsedStyleSheet, u32),
    Declarations(&'a ParsedDeclarationList),
}

// A borrowed view of the worker's graph, not a document-local rule owner.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct SharedRule<'a> {
    data: SharedRuleData<'a>,
    declarations_kind: NestedDeclarationsKind,
    rule_type: NativeRuleType,
}

impl NativeRuleType {
    pub(super) fn child_declarations_kind(self, enclosing: NestedDeclarationsKind) -> Option<NestedDeclarationsKind> {
        match self {
            NativeRuleType::Style => Some(NestedDeclarationsKind::Style),
            NativeRuleType::Function => Some(NestedDeclarationsKind::Function),
            NativeRuleType::Media
            | NativeRuleType::Supports
            | NativeRuleType::Container
            | NativeRuleType::Scope
            | NativeRuleType::LayerBlock
            | NativeRuleType::Page
            | NativeRuleType::Keyframes => Some(enclosing),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

impl ParsedRule {
    pub(super) fn native_type(&self) -> Option<NativeRuleType> {
        Some(match self.rule_kind {
            ParsedRuleKind::Invalid
            | ParsedRuleKind::Unknown
            | ParsedRuleKind::IgnoredVendor
            | ParsedRuleKind::FontFeatureValuesRule => return None,
            ParsedRuleKind::Qualified if self.keyframe().is_some() => NativeRuleType::Keyframe,
            ParsedRuleKind::Qualified => NativeRuleType::Style,
            ParsedRuleKind::Import => NativeRuleType::Import,
            ParsedRuleKind::Media => NativeRuleType::Media,
            ParsedRuleKind::Supports => NativeRuleType::Supports,
            ParsedRuleKind::Container => NativeRuleType::Container,
            ParsedRuleKind::Scope => NativeRuleType::Scope,
            ParsedRuleKind::Layer if self.has_block => NativeRuleType::LayerBlock,
            ParsedRuleKind::Layer => NativeRuleType::LayerStatement,
            ParsedRuleKind::Function => NativeRuleType::Function,
            ParsedRuleKind::Page => NativeRuleType::Page,
            ParsedRuleKind::Margin => NativeRuleType::Margin,
            ParsedRuleKind::PositionTry => NativeRuleType::PositionTry,
            ParsedRuleKind::FontFace => NativeRuleType::FontFace,
            ParsedRuleKind::FontFeatureValues => NativeRuleType::FontFeatureValues,
            ParsedRuleKind::Keyframes => NativeRuleType::Keyframes,
            ParsedRuleKind::Namespace => NativeRuleType::Namespace,
            ParsedRuleKind::CounterStyle => NativeRuleType::CounterStyle,
            ParsedRuleKind::Property => NativeRuleType::Property,
        })
    }
}

impl ParsedRule {
    /// Whether the rule is, or holds, a rule a media evaluation reads: a `@media` rule, or an `@import`, whose sheet
    /// may hold one.
    pub(super) fn holds_media_rules(&self, sheet: &ParsedStyleSheet) -> bool {
        matches!(self.rule_kind, ParsedRuleKind::Media | ParsedRuleKind::Import)
            || sheet
                .children_of(self)
                .iter()
                .any(|child| matches!(*child, ParsedRuleChild::Rule(rule) if sheet.rule(rule).holds_media_rules(sheet)))
    }
}

impl<'a> SharedRule<'a> {
    fn from_rule(sheet: &'a ParsedStyleSheet, index: u32, declarations_kind: NestedDeclarationsKind) -> Option<Self> {
        Some(Self {
            data: SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index),
            declarations_kind,
            rule_type: sheet.rule(index).native_type()?,
        })
    }

    fn from_child(
        sheet: &'a ParsedStyleSheet,
        child: &'a ParsedRuleChild,
        declarations_kind: NestedDeclarationsKind,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        match child {
            &ParsedRuleChild::Rule(index) => Self::from_rule(sheet, index, declarations_kind),
            ParsedRuleChild::Declarations(declarations) => Some(Self {
                data: SharedRuleData::Declarations(declarations),
                declarations_kind,
                rule_type: match declarations_kind {
                    NestedDeclarationsKind::Style => NativeRuleType::NestedDeclarations,
                    NestedDeclarationsKind::Function => NativeRuleType::FunctionDeclarations,
                },
            }),
        }
    }

    /// The parsed rule this is, unless it is a list of declarations.
    fn parsed(self) -> Option<&'a ParsedRule> {
        match self.data {
            SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index) => Some(sheet.rule(index)),
            SharedRuleData::Declarations(_) => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule_type(self) -> NativeRuleType {
        self.rule_type
    }

    pub(crate) fn local_identity(self) -> u64 {
        match self.data {
            SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index) => u64::from(sheet.rule(index).local_identity),
            SharedRuleData::Declarations(declarations) => declarations.local_identity,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn namespace(self) -> Option<&'a Arc<NamespaceRuleData>> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.namespace_rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn property(self) -> Option<&'a PropertyRuleData> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.property_rule().map(|value| &**value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn import(self) -> Option<&'a Arc<ImportRuleData>> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.import_rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn media_data(self) -> Arc<MediaListData> {
        let Some(rule) = self.parsed() else { unreachable!() };
        rule.media_list().unwrap().clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn function_signature(self) -> Option<Arc<FunctionSignature>> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.function_signature().cloned()
    }

    pub(crate) fn font_feature_values(self) -> Option<Arc<FontFeatureValuesData>> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.font_feature_values().cloned()
    }

    pub(crate) fn descriptors(self) -> Option<Arc<DescriptorBlockData>> {
        match self.data {
            SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index) => sheet.rule(index).descriptor_block().cloned(),
            SharedRuleData::Declarations(declarations) => declarations.descriptor_block.clone(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn keyframe(self) -> Option<&'a KeyframeData> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.keyframe().map(|value| &**value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn selectors(self) -> Option<RustParsedSelectorList> {
        match self.data {
            SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index) => sheet.rule_selectors(sheet.rule(index)),
            SharedRuleData::Declarations(_) => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn scope(self) -> Option<Arc<ScopeSelectors>> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.scope_selectors().cloned()
    }

    pub(crate) fn container(self) -> Option<&'a Arc<ContainerConditionsData>> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.container_conditions()
    }

    pub(crate) fn layer_name(self) -> Option<&'a [u16]> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        match self.rule_type {
            NativeRuleType::LayerBlock => Some(rule.layer_names().unwrap().names[0].units()),
            NativeRuleType::Import => Some(rule.import_rule().unwrap().layer.as_ref()?.units()),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn definition_name(self) -> Option<CssString> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        match self.rule_type {
            NativeRuleType::Property => Some(rule.property_rule().unwrap().name.clone()),
            NativeRuleType::Keyframes => rule.keyframes_name().cloned(),
            NativeRuleType::PositionTry => rule.position_try_name().cloned(),
            NativeRuleType::CounterStyle => Some(rule.counter_style().unwrap().name.clone()),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn layer_names(self) -> Option<&'a LayerNames> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.layer_names().map(|value| &**value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn media(self) -> Option<&'a MediaListData> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        rule.media_list().map(|value| &**value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn supports(self) -> Option<&'a Arc<FfiQueryHandle>> {
        let rule = self.parsed()?;
        if self.rule_type == NativeRuleType::Import {
            rule.import_rule().unwrap().supports.as_ref()
        } else {
            rule.supports_condition()
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn cascade_declarations(self) -> Option<SharedDeclarationBlock> {
        match self.data {
            SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index) if self.rule_type == NativeRuleType::Style => {
                sheet.rule(index).declaration_block().cloned()
            }
            SharedRuleData::Declarations(declarations) if self.rule_type == NativeRuleType::NestedDeclarations => {
                declarations.declaration_block.clone()
            }
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn position_try_declarations(self) -> Option<SharedDeclarationBlock> {
        match self.data {
            SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index) if self.rule_type == NativeRuleType::PositionTry => {
                sheet.rule(index).declaration_block().cloned()
            }
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn visit_children(self, visit: &mut impl FnMut(Self) -> ControlFlow<()>) -> ControlFlow<()> {
        let SharedRuleData::Rule(sheet, index) = self.data else {
            return ControlFlow::Continue(());
        };
        let Some(declarations_kind) = self.rule_type.child_declarations_kind(self.declarations_kind) else {
            return ControlFlow::Continue(());
        };
        let rule = sheet.rule(index);
        let children = sheet.children_of(rule);
        for &position in sheet.native_children_of(rule) {
            let child = Self::from_child(sheet, &children[position as usize], declarations_kind).unwrap();
            visit(child)?;
        }
        ControlFlow::Continue(())
    }
}
