                let rare = AttributeRare {
                    name: QualifiedRare {
                        prefix: name.namespace,
                        local: name.name,
                    },
                    value: attribute.value_identity,
                    text,
                };
                // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics-other.html#case-sensitivity-of-selectors
                let legacy_case_insensitive =
                    matches!(name.namespace_type, NamespaceType::Default | NamespaceType::None)
                        && crate::css::style::process_atoms().text(name.name).is_some_and(|text| {
                            crate::css::selector::is_ascii_case_insensitive_html_attribute(&text.to_utf16())
                        });
                (
                    ComponentBits::new(ComponentKind::Attribute)
                        .with_namespace(name.namespace_type)
                        .with_pseudo(attribute.match_type as u8 | ((attribute.case_type as u8) << 3))
                        .with(ASCII_LOWERCASE, name.name_is_ascii_lowercase)
                        .with(LEGACY_CASE_INSENSITIVE, legacy_case_insensitive),
                    pool_push(&mut self.attributes, rare),
                )
            }
            tree::SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => self.pseudo_class_component(pseudo_class),
            tree::SimpleSelector::PseudoElement(pseudo_element) => self.pseudo_element_component(pseudo_element),
            tree::SimpleSelector::Nesting => (
                ComponentBits::new(ComponentKind::Nesting).with_pseudo(self.nesting.kind()),
                match self.nesting {
                    NestingTarget::Rule(rule) => rule.0,
                    NestingTarget::Root | NestingTarget::Scope | NestingTarget::Unbound => NONE,
                },
            ),
            tree::SimpleSelector::Invalid(text) => {
                let range = self.push_text(text);
                (
                    ComponentBits::new(ComponentKind::Invalid),
                    pool_push(&mut self.text_ranges, range),
                )
            }
            tree::SimpleSelector::Compound { .. } => unreachable!("a compound start is not among its simple selectors"),
        };
        Component { bits, data }
    }

    fn finish(mut self) -> SelectorArena {
        let namespace_prefixes = PoolRange {
            start: index_u32(self.atoms.len()),
            length: index_u32(self.namespace_prefixes.len()),
        };
        // NB: `[*|x]` and `[ns|x]` test names qualified by a namespace, which what reads the arena,
        //     as the host deciding which attributes to publish, looks up by their qualified atoms.
        let atoms = crate::css::style::process_atoms();
        let mut qualified_names = Vec::new();
        for component in &self.components {
            if component.bits.kind() != ComponentKind::Attribute {
                continue;
            }
            let qualifier = match component.bits.namespace() {
                NamespaceType::Any => Some(StyleAtomID::NONE),
                NamespaceType::Named => {
                    let prefix = self.attributes[component.data as usize].name.prefix;
                    self.namespace_prefixes
                        .as_chunks::<2>()
                        .0
                        .iter()
                        .find(|declared| declared[0] == prefix)
                        .map(|declared| declared[1])
                }
                _ => None,
            };
            let Some(namespace) = qualifier else {
                continue;
            };
            let local = self.attributes[component.data as usize].name.local;
            for name in [local, atoms.ascii_lowercase(local)] {
                qualified_names.push(crate::css::style::AtomLease::acquire_qualified(atoms, namespace, name));
            }
        }
        self.atoms.extend_from_slice(&self.namespace_prefixes);
        let namespace_atoms = self
            .default_namespace
            .into_iter()
            .chain(self.namespace_prefixes)
            .chain(qualified_names.iter().map(crate::css::style::AtomLease::atom));
        let mut arena = SelectorArena {
            components: self.components.into_boxed_slice(),
            qualified: self.qualified.into_boxed_slice(),
            attributes: self.attributes.into_boxed_slice(),
            nths: self.nths.into_boxed_slice(),
            arguments: self.arguments.into_boxed_slice(),
            pseudo_elements: self.pseudo_elements.into_boxed_slice(),
            atoms: self.atoms.into_boxed_slice(),
            numbers: self.numbers.into_boxed_slice(),
            text_ranges: self.text_ranges.into_boxed_slice(),
            text: self.text.into_boxed_slice(),
            rule_lists: self.rule_lists.into_boxed_slice(),
            _leases: crate::css::style::process_atoms().lease(self.leased.into_iter().chain(namespace_atoms)),
            default_namespace: self.default_namespace,
            namespace_prefixes,
            serial: crate::render_state::process_style().next_selector_arena_serial(),
            compound_blooms: Box::default(),
            compound_shapes: Box::default(),
            compound_starts: Box::default(),
            compound_ranks: Box::default(),
        };
        arena.mark_selector_facts();
        arena
    }
}

impl SelectorArena {
    /// Write what matching asks of each selector as a whole on its first component, once, as the arena freezes.
    fn mark_selector_facts(&mut self) {
        fn names_the_scope(selector: Selector<'_>) -> bool {
            fn simple(simple: &SimpleSelector<'_>) -> bool {
                match simple {
                    SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => {
                        pseudo_class.pseudo_class == PseudoClassType::Scope
                            || pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.iter().any(names_the_scope)
                    }
                    SimpleSelector::Nesting(Nesting::Scope) => true,
                    SimpleSelector::Nesting(Nesting::Rule(parent)) => parent.iter().any(names_the_scope),
                    _ => false,
                }
            }
            selector
                .compounds()
                .any(|compound| compound.simple_selectors.iter().any(|candidate| simple(&candidate)))
        }
        let escapes_its_namespace = |selector: Selector<'_>| {
            selector.compounds().any(|compound| {
                compound.simple_selectors.iter().any(|simple| {
                    matches!(simple, SimpleSelector::PseudoElement(pseudo_element)
                        if matches!(pseudo_element.pseudo_element, PseudoElementType::Slotted | PseudoElementType::Part))
                })
            })
        };
        let search_text_filters: Vec<usize> = (0..self.components.len())
            .filter(|&at| {
                self.components[at].bits.kind() == ComponentKind::PseudoClass
                    && matches!(self.decode(at), SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class)
                        if search_text_match_filter_of_pseudo_class(&pseudo_class) == Some(SearchTextMatchFilter::NotCurrent))
            })
            .collect();
        for at in search_text_filters {
            self.components[at].bits.0 |= SEARCH_TEXT_FILTER;
        }
        // NB: Every component is of one selector, which its last component, the one ending the leftmost compound,
        //     ends.
        let mut facts = Vec::new();
        let mut start = 0;
        for index in 0..self.components.len() {
            if self.components[index].bits.relation() != Relation::Leftmost {
                continue;
            }
            let selector = Selector {
                arena: self,
                at: ComponentOffset(index_u32(start)),
            };
            let subject_end = (start..=index)
                .find(|&at| self.components[at].bits.relation() != Relation::SubSelector)
                .unwrap_or(index);
            let describes_its_subject =
                !(start..=subject_end).any(|at| self.components[at].bits.kind() == ComponentKind::PseudoElement);
            // NB: Only a pseudo-class or a `&` can name the scope, and only a pseudo-element can escape the namespace.
            //     Most selectors have none of them, and are then not read as selectors here.
            let (mut may_name_the_scope, mut may_escape_its_namespace) = (false, false);
            for component in &self.components[start..=index] {
                match component.bits.kind() {
                    ComponentKind::PseudoClass | ComponentKind::Nesting => may_name_the_scope = true,
                    ComponentKind::PseudoElement => may_escape_its_namespace = true,
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            let flags = (u32::from(may_name_the_scope && names_the_scope(selector)) * NAMES_THE_SCOPE)
                | (u32::from(may_escape_its_namespace && escapes_its_namespace(selector)) * ESCAPES_ITS_NAMESPACE)
                | (u32::from(describes_its_subject) * DESCRIBES_ITS_SUBJECT);
            if flags != 0 {
                facts.push((start, flags));
            }
            start = index + 1;
        }
        for (start, flags) in facts {
            self.components[start].bits.0 |= flags;
        }
        self.mark_compound_lengths();
        self.note_compound_facts();
        self.note_relative_subtree_keys();
    }

    /// Note what the witnesses of each relative selector carry on the anchor it ends in, as [`RelativeSubtreeKeys`]
    /// says.
    fn note_relative_subtree_keys(&mut self) {
        let mut noted = Vec::new();
        let mut start = 0;
        for index in 0..self.components.len() {
            if self.components[index].bits.relation() != Relation::Leftmost {
                continue;
            }
            // NB: The implicit anchor is a compound of one component.
            if index > start && self.components[index].bits.kind() == ComponentKind::RelativeAnchor {
                let (keys, folds) = RelativeSubtreeKeys::of(Selector {
                    arena: self,
                    at: ComponentOffset(index_u32(start)),
                });
                if keys.chain != 0 {
                    noted.push((index, keys, folds));
                }
            }
            start = index + 1;
        }
        if noted.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let mut numbers = std::mem::take(&mut self.numbers).into_vec();
        numbers.reserve_exact(noted.len() * 2);
        for (anchor, keys, folds) in noted {
            self.components[anchor].data = ((index_u32(numbers.len()) + 1) << 1) | u32::from(folds);
            numbers.extend([keys.chain.cast_signed(), keys.subject.cast_signed()]);
        }
        self.numbers = numbers.into_boxed_slice();
    }

    /// Write the length of each compound shorter than 16 components on its first component.
    fn mark_compound_lengths(&mut self) {
        let mut start = 0;
        for index in 0..self.components.len() {
            if self.components[index].bits.relation() == Relation::SubSelector {
                continue;
            }
            let length = index + 1 - start;
            if length < 16 {
                debug_assert_eq!(self.components[start].bits.0 & COMPOUND_LENGTH_BITS, 0);
                self.components[start].bits.0 |= (length as u32) << COMPOUND_LENGTH_SHIFT;
            }
            start = index + 1;
        }
    }

    /// Note what matching asks of each compound as a whole, and where each compound starts.
    fn note_compound_facts(&mut self) {
        let words = self.components.len().div_ceil(64);
        let mut starts = vec![0u64; words];
        // NB: A compound has one component at least, so this holds all ends without growing.
        let mut ends = Vec::with_capacity(self.components.len());
        let mut start = 0;
        while start < self.components.len() {
            let end = self.compound_end(start);
            starts[start / 64] |= 1 << (start % 64);
            ends.push(index_u32(end));
            start = end;
        }
        let mut shapes: crate::css::style::fast_hash::FastMap<CompoundShapeKey, u32> = Default::default();
        let mut blooms = Vec::with_capacity(ends.len());
        let mut compound_shapes = Vec::with_capacity(ends.len());
        let mut start = 0;
        for end in ends {
            let end = end as usize;
            compound_shapes.push(self.compound_shape(start..end, &mut shapes));
            blooms.push(self.compound_bloom(start..end));
            start = end;
        }
        let mut ranks = Vec::with_capacity(words);
        let mut before = 0;
        for &word in &starts {
            ranks.push(before);
            before += word.count_ones();
        }
        self.compound_blooms = blooms.into_boxed_slice();
        self.compound_shapes = compound_shapes.into_boxed_slice();
        self.compound_starts = starts.into_boxed_slice();
        self.compound_ranks = ranks.into_boxed_slice();
    }

    /// The dispatch bloom bits of the ids, classes, types and attributes written in ASCII lowercase and states the
    /// compound of `components` tests: what an element has to carry to match it, which a walk up across a descendant
    /// combinator rejects ancestors on and a bucket's candidates are rejected on.
    fn compound_bloom(&self, components: std::ops::Range<usize>) -> u64 {
        use crate::css::style::index::{DispatchKey, dispatch_bloom_bit};
        self.components[components]
            .iter()
            .fold(0, |bloom, component| match component.bits.kind() {
                ComponentKind::Id => bloom | dispatch_bloom_bit(DispatchKey::Id(StyleAtomID(component.data))),
                ComponentKind::Class => bloom | dispatch_bloom_bit(DispatchKey::Class(StyleAtomID(component.data))),
                // NB: A type written in ASCII lowercase is carried as written by every element matching it. A
                //     type qualified by a prefix holds its name in the rare table.
                ComponentKind::Tag
                    if component.bits.has(ASCII_LOWERCASE) && component.bits.namespace() != NamespaceType::Named =>
                {
                    bloom | dispatch_bloom_bit(DispatchKey::TagName(StyleAtomID(component.data)))
                }
                // NB: An attribute written in ASCII lowercase in no namespace is carried under that name by every
                //     element matching it, as one of the name forms of the attribute it holds.
                ComponentKind::Attribute
                    if component.bits.has(ASCII_LOWERCASE)
                        && matches!(component.bits.namespace(), NamespaceType::Default | NamespaceType::None) =>
                {
                    let name = self.attributes[component.data as usize].name.local;
                    bloom | dispatch_bloom_bit(DispatchKey::AttributeName(name))
                }
                ComponentKind::PseudoClass => {
                    match crate::css::style::component_matching::state_tested_by(pseudo_class_from_ffi(
                        component.bits.pseudo(),
                    )) {
                        Some(fact) => bloom | dispatch_bloom_bit(DispatchKey::State(fact)),
                        None => bloom,
                    }
                }
                _ => bloom,
            })
    }

    /// The number of the compound's own tests among those of the arena, alike for compounds of the arena testing the
    /// same facts alike, or [`NO_SHAPE`].
    fn compound_shape(
        &self,
        components: std::ops::Range<usize>,
        shapes: &mut crate::css::style::fast_hash::FastMap<CompoundShapeKey, u32>,
    ) -> u32 {
        // NB: Only what a compound's own tests read counts toward its shape: not the combinator its last component
        //     carries, nor the facts the arena notes of a selector or a compound.
        const SHAPE_BITS: u32 = !(RELATION_BITS
            | LAST_IN_LIST
            | NAMES_THE_SCOPE
            | ESCAPES_ITS_NAMESPACE
            | DESCRIBES_ITS_SUBJECT
            | COMPOUND_LENGTH_BITS);
        let reads_its_selector = components.clone().any(|at| match self.components[at].bits.kind() {
            ComponentKind::Nesting
            | ComponentKind::Invalid
            | ComponentKind::RelativeAnchor
            | ComponentKind::PseudoElement => true,
            // NB: What `:host` matches depends on the tree of the sheet the selector's rule decides in.
            ComponentKind::PseudoClass => matches!(
                self.decode(at),
                SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class)
                    if matches!(pseudo_class.pseudo_class, PseudoClassType::Scope | PseudoClassType::Host)
            ),
            _ => false,
        });
        if reads_its_selector {
            return NO_SHAPE;
        }
        let key: CompoundShapeKey = self.components[components]
            .iter()
            .map(|component| (component.bits.0 & SHAPE_BITS, component.data))
            .collect();
        let next = index_u32(shapes.len());
        *shapes.entry(key).or_insert(next)
    }
}

impl Selector<'_> {
    /// The selector as a parse tree again, for a transformation that builds another selector from
    /// it. The tree names the arena's atoms, which the arena keeps live while it is packed again.
    pub(crate) fn to_tree(self) -> tree::CompiledSelector {
        let compounds: Box<[tree::CompoundSelector]> = self
            .compound_selectors()
            .iter()
            .map(|compound| tree::CompoundSelector {
                combinator: compound.combinator,
                is_implicit_universal_anchor: compound.is_implicit_universal_anchor,
                simple_selectors: compound
                    .simple_selectors
                    .iter()
                    .map(|simple| simple_to_tree(&simple))
                    .collect(),
            })
            .collect();
        tree::CompiledSelector::new(compounds)
    }
}

impl SelectorListView<'_> {
    pub(crate) fn to_tree(self) -> tree::SelectorList {
        self.iter().map(Selector::to_tree).collect()
    }
}

fn simple_to_tree(simple: &SimpleSelector<'_>) -> tree::SimpleSelector {
    use crate::css::selector::SelectorString;
    match *simple {
        SimpleSelector::Universal(name) => tree::SimpleSelector::Universal(Box::new(name)),
        SimpleSelector::TagName(name) => tree::SimpleSelector::TagName(Box::new(name)),
        SimpleSelector::Id(name) => tree::SimpleSelector::Id(name),
        SimpleSelector::Class(name) => tree::SimpleSelector::Class(name),
        SimpleSelector::Attribute(attribute) => tree::SimpleSelector::Attribute(Box::new(tree::AttributeSelector {
            match_type: attribute.match_type,
            qualified_name: attribute.qualified_name,
            value: attribute.value.into(),
            value_identity: attribute.value_identity,
            case_type: attribute.case_type,
        })),
        SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => {
            tree::SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(Box::new(tree::PseudoClassSelector {
                pseudo_class: pseudo_class.pseudo_class,
                an_plus_b_pattern: pseudo_class.an_plus_b_pattern,
                argument_selector_list: pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.to_tree(),
                languages: pseudo_class
                    .languages
                    .iter()
                    .map(|range| tree::LanguageRange {
                        value: range.value.into(),
                        is_string: range.is_string,
                    })
                    .collect(),
                direction: pseudo_class.direction,
                identifier: pseudo_class.identifier.map(SelectorString::from),
                identifier_identity: pseudo_class.identifier_identity,
                levels: pseudo_class.levels.into(),
                is_forgiving: pseudo_class.is_forgiving,
            }))
        }
        SimpleSelector::PseudoElement(pseudo_element) => {
            tree::SimpleSelector::PseudoElement(Box::new(tree::PseudoElementSelector {
                pseudo_element: pseudo_element.pseudo_element,
                serialized_name: pseudo_element.serialized_name.map(SelectorString::from),
                value: match pseudo_element.value {
                    PseudoElementValue::None => tree::PseudoElementValue::None,
                    PseudoElementValue::CompoundSelector(selector) => {
                        tree::PseudoElementValue::CompoundSelector(Arc::new(selector.to_tree()))
                    }
                    PseudoElementValue::Identifiers(identifiers) => {
                        tree::PseudoElementValue::Identifiers(identifiers.iter().map(SelectorString::from).collect())
                    }
                    PseudoElementValue::TransitionName(argument) => {
                        tree::PseudoElementValue::TransitionName(Box::new(tree::TransitionNameAndClassSelector {
                            name: argument.name.map(|name| match name {
                                TransitionNameSelector::Universal => tree::TransitionNameSelector::Universal,
                                TransitionNameSelector::Name(name) => tree::TransitionNameSelector::Name(name.into()),
                            }),
                            classes: argument.classes.iter().map(SelectorString::from).collect(),
                        }))
                    }
                    PseudoElementValue::Universal => tree::PseudoElementValue::Universal,
                },
                identifier_identities: pseudo_element.identifier_identities.into(),
            }))
        }
        SimpleSelector::Nesting(_) => tree::SimpleSelector::Nesting,
        SimpleSelector::Invalid(text) => tree::SimpleSelector::Invalid(text.into()),
    }
}

/// The selectors of a list, each found past the last by the lengths of its compounds.
pub struct SelectorsOf<'a> {
    arena: &'a SelectorArena,
    /// Where the next selector starts, or `usize::MAX` past the last.
    at: usize,
}

impl<'a> Iterator for SelectorsOf<'a> {
    type Item = Selector<'a>;

    #[inline]
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Selector<'a>> {
        if self.at == usize::MAX {
            return None;
        }
        let components = &self.arena.components;
        let first = self.at;
        let mut at = first;
        loop {
            let end = self.arena.compound_end(at);
            let bits = components[end - 1].bits;
            at = end;
            if bits.relation() == Relation::Leftmost {
                self.at = match bits.has(LAST_IN_LIST) {
                    true => usize::MAX,
                    false => at,
                };
                return Some(Selector {
                    arena: self.arena,
                    at: ComponentOffset(index_u32(first)),
                });
            }
        }
    }
}

impl<'a> IntoIterator for SelectorListView<'a> {
    type Item = Selector<'a>;
    type IntoIter = SelectorsOf<'a>;

    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        self.arena.selectors_of(self.start)
    }
}

impl<'a> IntoIterator for &SelectorListView<'a> {
    type Item = Selector<'a>;
    type IntoIter = SelectorsOf<'a>;

    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        (*self).into_iter()
    }
}

impl PartialEq for SelectorArena {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.components == other.components
            && self.qualified == other.qualified
            && self.attributes == other.attributes
            && self.nths == other.nths
            && self.arguments == other.arguments
            && self.pseudo_elements == other.pseudo_elements
            && self.atoms == other.atoms
            && self.numbers == other.numbers
            && self.text_ranges == other.text_ranges
            && self.text == other.text
            && self.rule_lists == other.rule_lists
    }
}

impl SelectorListRef {
    /// Whether both are the same list of the same arena, not only equal ones.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn is_same_list(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        Arc::ptr_eq(&self.arena, &other.arena) && self.start == other.start
    }
}

impl PartialEq for SelectorListRef {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.start == other.start
            && (Arc::ptr_eq(&self.arena, &other.arena) || frozen(&self.arena) == frozen(&other.arena))
    }
}

//! Queries and transformations over Rust-owned CSS selectors.

use super::css_tokenizer::{ParserTokenKind, tokenize_for_parser};
use super::selector::{Combinator, PseudoClassType, PseudoElementType, RustSelector};
use super::selector_arena::{
    PseudoElementValue as ArenaPseudoElementValue, Selector as ArenaSelector, SimpleSelector as ArenaSimpleSelector,
    SimpleView,
};
use super::selector_parser::StyleNestingParent;
use super::selector_tree::{
    CompiledSelector, CompoundSelector, PseudoClassSelector, PseudoElementValue, SelectorList, SimpleSelector,
};

fn pseudo_class(pseudo_class: PseudoClassType, arguments: SelectorList) -> SimpleSelector {
    SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(Box::new(PseudoClassSelector {
        pseudo_class,
        an_plus_b_pattern: Default::default(),
        argument_selector_list: arguments,
        languages: Box::new([]),
        direction: None,
        identifier: None,
        identifier_identity: crate::css::style::index::StyleAtomID::NONE,
        levels: Box::new([]),
        is_forgiving: false,
    }))
}

fn scope_selector() -> CompiledSelector {
    CompiledSelector::new(Box::new([CompoundSelector {
        combinator: Combinator::None,
        is_implicit_universal_anchor: false,
        simple_selectors: smallvec::smallvec![pseudo_class(PseudoClassType::Scope, Box::new([]))],
    }]))
}

/// `:where(:scope)`, which matches the scoping root and adds no specificity.
pub(crate) fn scope_root_anchor() -> SimpleSelector {
    pseudo_class(PseudoClassType::Where, Box::new([scope_selector()]))
}

pub(crate) fn scope_root_selector_list() -> SelectorList {
    Box::new([CompiledSelector::new(Box::new([CompoundSelector {
        combinator: Combinator::None,
        is_implicit_universal_anchor: false,
        simple_selectors: smallvec::smallvec![scope_root_anchor()],
    }]))])
}

fn invalid_selector_names_nesting(source: &[u16]) -> bool {
    tokenize_for_parser(source)
        .iter()
        .any(|token| matches!(token.kind, ParserTokenKind::Delim(value) if value == u32::from(b'&')))
}

pub(crate) fn contains_nesting(selector: &CompiledSelector) -> bool {
    selector.compound_selectors().iter().any(|compound| {
        compound.simple_selectors.iter().any(|simple| match simple {
            SimpleSelector::Nesting => true,
            SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => {
                pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.iter().any(contains_nesting)
            }
            SimpleSelector::Invalid(source) => invalid_selector_names_nesting(source.as_ref()),
            _ => false,
        })
    })
}

pub(crate) fn contains_pseudo_class(selector: &CompiledSelector, expected: PseudoClassType) -> bool {
    selector.compound_selectors().iter().any(|compound| {
        compound.simple_selectors.iter().any(|simple| {
            let SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) = simple else {
                return false;
            };
            pseudo_class.pseudo_class == expected
                || pseudo_class
                    .argument_selector_list
                    .iter()
                    .any(|selector| contains_pseudo_class(selector, expected))
        })
    })
}

fn any_simple(selector: &CompiledSelector, predicate: &impl Fn(&SimpleSelector) -> bool) -> bool {
    selector
        .compound_selectors()
        .iter()
        .any(|compound| compound.simple_selectors.iter().any(predicate))
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-4/#support-definition
// A CSS processor is considered to support a CSS selector if it accepts that all aspects of that selector,
// recursively, (rather than considering any of its syntax to be unknown or invalid) and that selector doesn’t
// contain unknown -webkit- pseudo-elements.
pub(crate) fn contains_unsupported_selector(selector: &CompiledSelector) -> bool {
    fn visit(selector: &CompiledSelector, allow_pseudo_elements: bool) -> bool {
        any_simple(selector, &|simple| match simple {
            SimpleSelector::Invalid(..) => true,
            SimpleSelector::PseudoElement(pseudo_element) => {
                !allow_pseudo_elements
                    || pseudo_element.pseudo_element == PseudoElementType::UnknownWebKit
                    || matches!(&pseudo_element.value, PseudoElementValue::CompoundSelector(selector)
                        if visit(selector, false))
            }
            SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => pseudo_class
                .argument_selector_list
                .iter()
                .any(|selector| visit(selector, false)),
            _ => false,
        })
    }
    visit(selector, true)
}

fn contains_named_namespace(selector: ArenaSelector<'_>) -> bool {
    selector.compounds().any(|compound| {
        compound.simple_selectors.iter().any(|simple| match simple {
            ArenaSimpleSelector::Universal(name) | ArenaSimpleSelector::TagName(name) => {
                name.namespace_type == super::selector::NamespaceType::Named
            }
            ArenaSimpleSelector::Attribute(attribute) => {
                attribute.qualified_name.namespace_type == super::selector::NamespaceType::Named
            }
            ArenaSimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => {
                pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.iter().any(contains_named_namespace)
            }
            ArenaSimpleSelector::PseudoElement(pseudo_element) => match pseudo_element.value {
                ArenaPseudoElementValue::CompoundSelector(selector) => contains_named_namespace(selector),
                _ => false,
            },
            _ => false,
        })
    })
}

pub(crate) fn invalid_for_has(selector: &CompiledSelector) -> bool {
    any_simple(selector, &|simple| match simple {
        SimpleSelector::PseudoElement(_) => true,
        SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => {
            pseudo_class.pseudo_class == PseudoClassType::Has
                || pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.iter().any(invalid_for_has)
        }
        _ => false,
    })
}

fn absolutize(selector: &CompiledSelector, replacement: &SimpleSelector) -> Option<CompiledSelector> {
    if !contains_nesting(selector) {
        return Some(CompiledSelector::new(selector.to_compounds()));
    }
    let mut compounds = selector.to_compounds();
    for compound in &mut compounds {
        let mut simples = Vec::with_capacity(compound.simple_selectors.len());
        for simple in &compound.simple_selectors {
            match simple {
                SimpleSelector::Nesting => simples.push(replacement.clone()),
                SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => {
                    let mut pseudo_class = pseudo_class.clone();
                    let mut arguments = Vec::with_capacity(pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.len());
                    for argument in &pseudo_class.argument_selector_list {
                        match absolutize(argument, replacement) {
                            Some(argument) => arguments.push(argument),
                            None if pseudo_class.is_forgiving => {}
                            None => return None,
                        }
                    }
                    pseudo_class.argument_selector_list = arguments.into_boxed_slice();
                    if pseudo_class.pseudo_class == PseudoClassType::Has
                        && pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.iter().any(invalid_for_has)
                    {
                        return None;
                    }
                    simples.push(SimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class));
                }
                _ => simples.push(simple.clone()),
            }
        }
        compound.simple_selectors = simples.into();
    }
    Some(CompiledSelector::new(compounds))
}

pub(crate) fn relative_to(selector: &CompiledSelector, parent: SimpleSelector) -> CompiledSelector {
    let mut compounds = Vec::with_capacity(selector.compound_selectors().len() + 1);
    compounds.push(CompoundSelector {
        combinator: Combinator::None,
        is_implicit_universal_anchor: false,
        simple_selectors: smallvec::smallvec![parent],
    });
    compounds.extend(
        selector
            .compound_selectors()
            .iter()
            .map(|compound| compound.to_compound()),
    );
    if let Some(second) = compounds.get_mut(1)
        && second.combinator == Combinator::None
    {
        second.combinator = Combinator::Descendant;
    }
    CompiledSelector::new(compounds.into_boxed_slice())
}

/// What a query reads of a selector, from one walk of the selector's arena.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiSelectorQueryFacts {
    /// The pseudo-classes the selector contains, with those of the selectors they take, one bit for the value of each.
    pub pseudo_classes: [u64; 2],
    pub contains_nesting: bool,
    /// Whether every element matches the selector, so that a query over a subtree can collect its elements without
    /// matching any of them.
    pub matches_every_element: bool,
}

fn collect_query_facts(selector: ArenaSelector<'_>, facts: &mut FfiSelectorQueryFacts) {
    for compound in selector.compounds() {
        for view in compound.simple_selectors.views() {
            if let SimpleView::Id(_) | SimpleView::Class(_) | SimpleView::TagName(_) = view {
                continue;
            }
            match view.decode() {
                ArenaSimpleSelector::PseudoClass(pseudo_class) => {
                    let value = pseudo_class.pseudo_class as usize;
                    facts.pseudo_classes[value / u64::BITS as usize] |= 1 << (value % u64::BITS as usize);
                    for argument in pseudo_class.argument_selector_list.iter() {
                        collect_query_facts(argument, facts);
                    }
                }
                ArenaSimpleSelector::Nesting(_) => facts.contains_nesting = true,
                ArenaSimpleSelector::Invalid(source) => {
                    facts.contains_nesting |= invalid_selector_names_nesting(source);
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }
}

fn query_facts(selector: ArenaSelector<'_>) -> FfiSelectorQueryFacts {
    let mut facts = FfiSelectorQueryFacts::default();
    collect_query_facts(selector, &mut facts);
    let mut compounds = selector.compounds();
    if let (Some(compound), None) = (compounds.next(), compounds.next())
        && compound.simple_selectors.len() == 1
        && let Some(ArenaSimpleSelector::Universal(name)) = compound.simple_selectors.first()
    {
        facts.matches_every_element = matches!(
            name.namespace_type,
            super::selector::NamespaceType::Any | super::selector::NamespaceType::Default
        );
    }
    facts
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_selector_query_facts(selector: &RustSelector) -> FfiSelectorQueryFacts {
    query_facts(selector.compiled())
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_selector_contains_named_namespace(selector: &RustSelector) -> bool {
    contains_named_namespace(selector.compiled())
}

pub(crate) fn absolutize_selector_list(
    selectors: &SelectorList,
    parent: StyleNestingParent,
    parents: &SelectorList,
) -> Option<SelectorList> {
    if !selectors.iter().any(|selector| {
        contains_nesting(selector)
            || (parent == StyleNestingParent::Scope
                && !matches!(
                    selector
                        .compound_selectors()
                        .first()
                        .map_or(Combinator::None, |compound| compound.combinator),
                    Combinator::None | Combinator::Descendant
                ))
    }) {
        return None;
    }
    let replacement = if parent == StyleNestingParent::Style {
        pseudo_class(PseudoClassType::Is, parents.clone())
    } else {
        pseudo_class(PseudoClassType::Where, Box::new([scope_selector()]))
    };
    Some(
        selectors
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|selector| {
                let first = selector
                    .compound_selectors()
                    .first()
                    .map_or(Combinator::None, |compound| compound.combinator);
                if contains_nesting(selector) {
                    absolutize(selector, &replacement)
                } else if parent == StyleNestingParent::Scope
                    && !matches!(first, Combinator::None | Combinator::Descendant)
                {
                    Some(relative_to(selector, replacement.clone()))
                } else {
                    Some(selector.clone())
                }
            })
            .collect(),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn adapt_scope_end_selector_list(selectors: &SelectorList) -> SelectorList {
    selectors
        .iter()
        .map(|selector| {
            let first = selector
                .compound_selectors()
                .first()
                .map_or(Combinator::None, |compound| compound.combinator);
            if !matches!(first, Combinator::None | Combinator::Descendant)
                || (!contains_nesting(selector) && !contains_pseudo_class(selector, PseudoClassType::Scope))
            {
                relative_to(
                    selector,
                    pseudo_class(PseudoClassType::Where, Box::new([scope_selector()])),
                )
            } else if first == Combinator::Descendant {
                let mut compounds = selector.to_compounds();
                compounds[0].combinator = Combinator::None;
                CompiledSelector::new(compounds)
            } else {
                selector.clone()
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::super::css_tokenizer::{TokenizerInput, tokenize_for_parser};
    use super::super::parser::component_value::consume_a_list_of_component_values;
    use super::super::selector_parser::{SelectorType, parse_selector_list_from_component_values};
    use super::contains_named_namespace;

    #[test]
    fn query_facts_agree_with_the_parse_tree() {
        use super::{contains_nesting, contains_pseudo_class, query_facts};
        use crate::css::selector::{NamespaceType, PseudoClassType, SelectorListRef, pseudo_class_from_ffi};
        use crate::css::selector_tree::SimpleSelector;

        let sources = [
            "div",
            "*",
            "*|*",
            "|*",
            "* *",
            "*.a",
            "[data-id=\"item\"]",
            ":hover",
            "a:hover > b:focus ~ c:first-child",
            ":not(:is(a:checked, b:where(:disabled)))",
            ":has(> a:empty, + b:nth-child(2n of :required))",
            ":is(:unknown-forgiven, :root)",
            "a::before:hover",
            "::slotted(a:hover)",
            ":host(:focus-within) a",
            ":lang(en):dir(ltr):state(open)",
            "&",
            "a &",
            ":is(a, :not(& b))",
            ":has(> &)",
            ":is(&!, a)",
            ":is(!, a)",
        ];
        for source in sources {
            let units: Vec<_> = source.encode_utf16().collect();
            let values = consume_a_list_of_component_values(tokenize_for_parser(units.as_slice())).unwrap();
            let parsed = parse_selector_list_from_component_values(&values, &[], SelectorType::Standalone)
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("{source} parses"));
            let list = SelectorListRef::pack(&parsed.selectors);
            for (tree, packed) in parsed.selectors.iter().zip(list.owned()) {
                let facts = query_facts(packed.view());
                for value in 0..=PseudoClassType::Where as u8 {
                    let expected = contains_pseudo_class(tree, pseudo_class_from_ffi(value));
                    let contained = facts.pseudo_classes[usize::from(value) / 64] & (1 << (value % 64)) != 0;
                    assert_eq!(contained, expected, "{source} with pseudo-class {value}");
                }
                assert_eq!(facts.contains_nesting, contains_nesting(tree), "{source} nesting");
                let every_element = match tree.compound_selectors().as_slice() {
                    [compound] => matches!(
                        compound.simple_selectors,
                        [SimpleSelector::Universal(name)]
                            if matches!(name.namespace_type, NamespaceType::Any | NamespaceType::Default)
                    ),
                    _ => false,
                };
                assert_eq!(facts.matches_every_element, every_element, "{source} every element");
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn transformed_lists_own_their_results_after_inputs_are_dropped() {
        use super::{absolutize_selector_list, adapt_scope_end_selector_list};
        use crate::css::selector_parser::StyleNestingParent;
        use crate::css::selector_serialization::serialize_selector_without_namespaces;

        // NB: The parsed trees keep their names live, which the results packed from them lease.
        let trees = std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
        let parse = |source: &str, kind: SelectorType| -> super::SelectorList {
            let units: Vec<_> = source.encode_utf16().collect();
            let values = consume_a_list_of_component_values(tokenize_for_parser(units.as_slice())).unwrap();
            let parsed = parse_selector_list_from_component_values(&values, &[], kind).unwrap();
            let selectors = parsed
                .selectors
                .iter()
                .map(|selector| crate::css::selector_tree::CompiledSelector::new(selector.to_compounds()))
                .collect();
            trees.borrow_mut().push(parsed);
            selectors
        };
        fn text(selectors: super::SelectorList) -> Vec<Vec<u16>> {
            selectors
                .into_vec()
                .into_iter()
                .map(|selector| {
                    let list = crate::css::selector::SelectorListRef::pack(&[selector]);
                    let selector = super::RustSelector {
                        selector: list.owned().next().unwrap(),
                    };
                    serialize_selector_without_namespaces(&selector)
                })
                .collect()
        }
        let utf16 = |source: &str| source.encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let empty: super::SelectorList = Box::new([]);
        let parents = parse(".親, #id", SelectorType::Standalone);
        let selectors = parse(".plain, & > .子", SelectorType::Standalone);
        let result = absolutize_selector_list(&selectors, StyleNestingParent::Style, &parents).unwrap();
        drop((parents, selectors));
        assert_eq!(text(result), [".plain", ":is(.親, #id) > .子"].map(utf16));

        let selectors = parse("> .子, :scope .lim, .plain", SelectorType::Relative);
        let result = adapt_scope_end_selector_list(&selectors);
        drop(selectors);
        assert_eq!(
            text(result),
            [":where(:scope) > .子", ":scope .lim", ":where(:scope) .plain"].map(utf16)
        );
        assert!(
            absolutize_selector_list(
                &parse(".plain", SelectorType::Standalone),
                StyleNestingParent::None,
                &empty
            )
            .is_none()
        );

        let selectors = parse("&", SelectorType::Standalone);
        let result = absolutize_selector_list(&selectors, StyleNestingParent::Style, &empty).unwrap();
        drop(selectors);
        assert_eq!(text(result), [utf16(":is()")]);
        let selectors = parse("> .子, & .plain", SelectorType::Relative);
        let result = absolutize_selector_list(&selectors, StyleNestingParent::Scope, &empty).unwrap();
        drop(selectors);
        assert_eq!(
            text(result),
            [":where(:scope) > .子", ":where(:scope) .plain"].map(utf16)
        );
        let parents = parse(":has(.親)", SelectorType::Standalone);
        let selectors = parse(":has(&)", SelectorType::Standalone);
        let result = absolutize_selector_list(&selectors, StyleNestingParent::Style, &parents).unwrap();
        drop((parents, selectors));
        assert!(result.is_empty());
    }

    fn contains_named_namespace_with_namespace_context(source: &str) -> bool {
        let units: Vec<_> = source.encode_utf16().collect();
        let values = consume_a_list_of_component_values(tokenize_for_parser(units.as_slice())).unwrap();
        let parsed = parse_selector_list_from_component_values(
            &values,
            &[TokenizerInput::Latin1(b"foo")],
            SelectorType::Standalone,
        )
        .unwrap();
        // NB: The parsed tree keeps its names live, which the list packed from it leases.
        let list = crate::css::selector::SelectorListRef::pack(&parsed.selectors);
        list.owned().any(|selector| contains_named_namespace(selector.view()))
    }

    #[test]
    fn named_namespace_inside_pseudo_element_compound_selector_is_seen() {
        assert!(contains_named_namespace_with_namespace_context("::slotted(foo|div)"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn named_namespace_inside_pseudo_class_argument_is_seen() {
        assert!(contains_named_namespace_with_namespace_context(":is(foo|div)"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn pseudo_element_compound_selector_without_namespace_is_clean() {
        assert!(!contains_named_namespace_with_namespace_context("::slotted(div.a)"));
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum SelectorType {
    Standalone,
    Relative,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum SelectorParsingMode {
    Standard,
    Forgiving,
