        StringUnits::Ascii(bytes) => bytes.iter().for_each(|&byte| emit(u16::from(byte))),
        StringUnits::Utf16(utf16) => utf16.iter().for_each(|&unit| emit(unit)),
    }
}

/// Port of Web::CSS::Display::to_string, including to_keyword's short-form precedence.
fn serialize_display(sink: &mut TextSink, raw: u32) {
    use crate::css::css_enums::{display_box, display_inside, display_internal, display_outside};
    use crate::css::display::{DISPLAY_TAG_BOX, DISPLAY_TAG_INTERNAL, FfiDisplay};

    let display = FfiDisplay::from_raw(raw);
    match display.tag {
        DISPLAY_TAG_BOX => sink.push_ascii(display_box::NAMES[display.box_value as usize]),
        DISPLAY_TAG_INTERNAL => sink.push_ascii(display_internal::NAMES[display.internal as usize]),
        _ => {
            // NOTE: Following the precedence rules of "most backwards-compatible, then
            //       shortest", serialization of equivalent display values uses the short form.
            let outside = display.outside;
            let inside = display.inside;
            let short: Option<&str> = if display.list_item {
                (outside == display_outside::BLOCK && inside == display_inside::FLOW).then_some("list-item")
            } else if outside == display_outside::BLOCK {
                match inside {
                    _ if inside == display_inside::FLOW => Some("block"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::FLOW_ROOT => Some("flow-root"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::FLEX => Some("flex"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::_WEBKIT_BOX => Some("-webkit-box"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::GRID => Some("grid"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::GRID_LANES => Some("grid-lanes"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::TABLE => Some("table"),
                    _ => None,
                }
            } else if outside == display_outside::INLINE {
                match inside {
                    _ if inside == display_inside::FLOW => Some("inline"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::FLOW_ROOT => Some("inline-block"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::FLEX => Some("inline-flex"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::_WEBKIT_BOX => Some("-webkit-inline-box"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::GRID => Some("inline-grid"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::GRID_LANES => Some("inline-grid-lanes"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::RUBY => Some("ruby"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::TABLE => Some("inline-table"),
                    _ if inside == display_inside::MATH => Some("math"),
                    _ => None,
                }
            } else if outside == display_outside::RUN_IN && inside == display_inside::FLOW {
                Some("run-in")
            } else {
                None
            };
            if let Some(short) = short {
                sink.push_ascii(short);
                return;
            }
            let mut first = true;
            let mut part = |sink: &mut TextSink, text: &str| {
                if !first {
                    sink.push_ascii(" ");
                }
                first = false;
                sink.push_ascii(text);
            };
            if !(outside == display_outside::BLOCK && inside == display_inside::FLOW_ROOT) {
                part(sink, display_outside::NAMES[outside as usize]);
            }
            if inside != display_inside::FLOW {
                part(sink, display_inside::NAMES[inside as usize]);
            }
            if display.list_item {
                part(sink, "list-item");
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Whether two runs of gap decoration longhands hold the same values, regardless of how a color was written.
fn gap_decoration_values_equal(first: &[&StyleValueData], second: &[&StyleValueData]) -> bool {
    first.len() == second.len()
        && first
            .iter()
            .zip(second)
            .all(|(first, second)| crate::css::style_value::optional_style_values_equal(Some(first), Some(second)))
}

/// Serialize shorthand values directly from their native longhands.
fn serialize_shorthand(
    sink: &mut TextSink,
    whole_value: &StyleValueData,
    shorthand_property: u16,
    sub_properties: &[u16],
    values: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueDataList,
    mode: SerializationMode,
) {
    use crate::css::property_metadata::{POSITIONAL_VALUE_LIST_SHORTHANDS, property_id, property_initial_value};
    use crate::css::style_compute::{expand_shorthands_with, value_is_css_wide_keyword};

    // If all the longhands are the same CSS-wide keyword, just return that once.
    let mut built_in_keyword: Option<u16> = None;
    let mut all_same_keyword = true;
    // The expansion of a shorthand value is that of each of its sub-values.
    let mut check = |_, data: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData, _| {
        let value = data.data();
        if !value_is_css_wide_keyword(value) {
            all_same_keyword = false;
            return;
        }
        let StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: code } = value else {
            all_same_keyword = false;
            return;
        };
        match built_in_keyword {
            None => built_in_keyword = Some(*code),
            Some(existing) if existing != *code => all_same_keyword = false,
            _ => {}
        }
    };
    for (&sub_property, sub_value) in sub_properties.iter().zip(values.as_slice()) {
        expand_shorthands_with(sub_property, sub_value, false, &mut check);
    }
    if let Some(code) = built_in_keyword {
        if all_same_keyword {
            sink.push_ascii(keyword::NAMES[code as usize]);
        }
        return;
    }

    let longhand = |id: u16| -> Option<&StyleValueData> {
        let index = sub_properties.iter().position(|&sub| sub == id)?;
        values.as_slice().get(index).map(|value| value.data())
    };
    let property_is_shorthand = |id: u16| !crate::css::property_metadata::longhands_for_shorthand(id).is_empty();
    let initial_source = |id: u16| -> Option<&'static str> {
        if property_is_shorthand(id) {
            return None;
        }
        Some(property_initial_value(id))
    };
    let sub_sink = |value: &StyleValueData| {
        let mut serialized = TextSink::new();
        serialize_style_value(&mut serialized, value, mode);
        serialized
    };

    let default_serialize = |sink: &mut TextSink| {
        let entries = values.as_slice();
        let first_value = entries.first().expect("Shorthand style values contain values").data();
        if entries.iter().all(|value| value.data() == first_value) {
            return serialize_style_value(sink, first_value, mode);
        }
        let mut first = true;
        for (index, value) in entries.iter().enumerate() {
            let value_sink = sub_sink(value.data());
            let mut initial_sink = TextSink::new();
            if let Some(source) = initial_source(sub_properties[index]) {
                initial_sink.push_ascii(source);
            } else {
                serialize_style_value(&mut initial_sink, &shorthand::initial(sub_properties[index]), mode);
            }
            if value_sink.content_equals(&initial_sink)
                || value_sink.content_equals_ascii_case_insensitive(&initial_sink)
            {
                continue;
            }
            if first {
                first = false;
            } else {
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
            }
            sink.push_sink(&value_sink);
        }
        // NOTE: Like the C++ serializer, this checks the whole builder, not just this
        //       shorthand's own output.
        if sink.len() == 0 {
            serialize_style_value(sink, first_value, mode);
        }
    };

    if shorthand_property == property_id::ALL {
        // NOTE: 'all' can only be serialized in the case all sub-properties share the same
        //       CSS-wide keyword, which was handled above; serialize the empty string.
        return;
    }
    if matches!(
        shorthand_property,
        property_id::_WEBKIT_LINE_CLAMP | property_id::LINE_CLAMP
    ) {
        let (Some(max_lines), Some(block_ellipsis), Some(continue_value)) = (
            longhand(property_id::MAX_LINES),
            longhand(property_id::BLOCK_ELLIPSIS),
            longhand(property_id::CONTINUE),
        ) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        let is_keyword = |value: &StyleValueData, expected| matches!(value, StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: code } if *code == expected);
        let max_lines_is_none = is_keyword(max_lines, keyword::NONE);
        let block_ellipsis_is_auto = is_keyword(block_ellipsis, keyword::AUTO);
        let block_ellipsis_is_none = is_keyword(block_ellipsis, keyword::NO_ELLIPSIS);
        let continue_is_auto = is_keyword(continue_value, keyword::AUTO);
        let continue_is_legacy = is_keyword(continue_value, keyword::_WEBKIT_LEGACY);

        if shorthand_property == property_id::_WEBKIT_LINE_CLAMP {
            if max_lines_is_none && block_ellipsis_is_none && continue_is_auto {
                sink.push_ascii("none");
            } else if !max_lines_is_none && block_ellipsis_is_auto && continue_is_legacy {
                return serialize_style_value(sink, max_lines, mode);
            }
            return;
        }

        if max_lines_is_none && is_keyword(block_ellipsis, keyword::NO_ELLIPSIS) && continue_is_auto {
            sink.push_ascii("none");
            return;
        }
        if !continue_is_legacy && !is_keyword(continue_value, keyword::COLLAPSE) {
            return;
        }

        if !max_lines_is_none {
            serialize_style_value(sink, max_lines, mode);
        }
        if !block_ellipsis_is_auto || max_lines_is_none {
            if sink.len() != 0 {
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
            }
            serialize_style_value(sink, block_ellipsis, mode);
        }
        if continue_is_legacy {
            if sink.len() != 0 {
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
            }
            sink.push_ascii("-webkit-legacy");
        }
        return;
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::OFFSET {
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/motion-1/#offset-shorthand
        // [ <'offset-position'>? [ <'offset-path'> [ <'offset-distance'> || <'offset-rotate'> ]? ]? ]! [ / <'offset-anchor'> ]?
        let (Some(position), Some(path), Some(distance), Some(rotate), Some(anchor)) = (
            longhand(property_id::OFFSET_POSITION),
            longhand(property_id::OFFSET_PATH),
            longhand(property_id::OFFSET_DISTANCE),
            longhand(property_id::OFFSET_ROTATE),
            longhand(property_id::OFFSET_ANCHOR),
        ) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        let is_keyword = |value: &StyleValueData, expected| matches!(value, StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: code } if *code == expected);
        let is_zero_angle =
            |value: &StyleValueData| matches!(value, StyleValueData::Angle { value, .. } if *value == 0.0);
        let distance_is_default = matches!(distance, StyleValueData::Length { value, .. } if *value == 0.0);
        let rotate_is_default = is_keyword(rotate, keyword::AUTO)
            || matches!(rotate, StyleValueData::ValueList { values, .. }
                if matches!(values.as_slice(), [first, angle] if is_keyword(first.data(), keyword::AUTO) && is_zero_angle(angle.data())));
        let mut parts = Vec::new();
        if !is_keyword(position, keyword::NORMAL) {
            parts.push(position);
        }
        if !is_keyword(path, keyword::NONE) || !distance_is_default || !rotate_is_default || parts.is_empty() {
            parts.push(path);
        }
        if !distance_is_default {
            parts.push(distance);
        }
        if !rotate_is_default {
            parts.push(rotate);
        }
        for (index, part) in parts.into_iter().enumerate() {
            if index > 0 {
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
            }
            serialize_style_value(sink, part, mode);
        }
        if !is_keyword(anchor, keyword::AUTO) {
            sink.push_ascii(" / ");
            serialize_style_value(sink, anchor, mode);
        }
        return;
    }
    if matches!(
        shorthand_property,
        property_id::BORDER_IMAGE | property_id::MASK_BORDER | property_id::_WEBKIT_MASK_BOX_IMAGE
    ) {
        let components: &[(u16, &str)] = match shorthand_property {
            property_id::BORDER_IMAGE => &[
                (property_id::BORDER_IMAGE_SOURCE, ""),
                (property_id::BORDER_IMAGE_SLICE, " "),
                (property_id::BORDER_IMAGE_WIDTH, " / "),
                (property_id::BORDER_IMAGE_OUTSET, " / "),
                (property_id::BORDER_IMAGE_REPEAT, " "),
            ],
            property_id::MASK_BORDER => &[
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_SOURCE, ""),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_SLICE, " "),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_WIDTH, " / "),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_OUTSET, " / "),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_REPEAT, " "),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_MODE, " "),
            ],
            _ => &[
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_SOURCE, ""),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_SLICE, " "),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_WIDTH, " / "),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_OUTSET, " / "),
                (property_id::MASK_BORDER_REPEAT, " "),
            ],
        };
        // NB: -webkit-mask-box-image always fills the middle, so it can't represent a mask-border-slice without fill,
        //     except in the initial value of mask-border, where there's no mask border image to fill with.
        if shorthand_property == property_id::_WEBKIT_MASK_BOX_IMAGE {
            let slice_fills = matches!(longhand(property_id::MASK_BORDER_SLICE), Some(StyleValueData::BorderImageSlice(payload)) if payload.fill);
            let all_initial = components
                .iter()
                .all(|&(id, _)| longhand(id) == Some(&*shorthand::initial(id)));
            if !slice_fills && !all_initial {
                return;
            }
        }
        for (index, &(id, separator)) in components.iter().enumerate() {
            if index > 0 {
                sink.push_ascii(separator);
            }
            let Some(value) = longhand(id) else {
                unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
            };
            serialize_style_value(sink, value, mode);
        }
        return;
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::BORDER_RADIUS {
        let corners = [
            longhand(property_id::BORDER_TOP_LEFT_RADIUS),
            longhand(property_id::BORDER_TOP_RIGHT_RADIUS),
            longhand(property_id::BORDER_BOTTOM_RIGHT_RADIUS),
            longhand(property_id::BORDER_BOTTOM_LEFT_RADIUS),
        ];
        let radius_sink = |corner: &StyleValueData, vertical: bool| {
            if let StyleValueData::BorderRadius(border_radius_payload) = corner {
                let BorderRadiusPayload {
                    horizontal_radius,
                    vertical_radius,
                    ..
                } = &**border_radius_payload;
                let radius = if vertical { vertical_radius } else { horizontal_radius };
                return sub_sink(radius.data());
            }
            sub_sink(corner)
        };
        let serialize_radius = |sink: &mut TextSink, values: &[TextSink; 4]| {
            let [top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left] = values;
            let parts: &[&TextSink] = if top_left.content_equals(top_right)
                && top_left.content_equals(bottom_right)
                && top_left.content_equals(bottom_left)
            {
                &[top_left]
            } else if top_left.content_equals(bottom_right) && top_right.content_equals(bottom_left) {
                &[top_left, top_right]
            } else if top_right.content_equals(bottom_left) {
                &[top_left, top_right, bottom_right]
            } else {
                &[top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left]
            };
            for (index, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
                if index > 0 {
                    sink.push_ascii(" ");
                }
                sink.push_sink(part);
            }
        };
        let mut horizontal = Vec::with_capacity(4);
        let mut vertical = Vec::with_capacity(4);
        for corner in corners {
            let corner = corner.expect("Shorthand style values retain their required corners");
            horizontal.push(radius_sink(corner, false));
            vertical.push(radius_sink(corner, true));
        }
        let horizontal: [TextSink; 4] = horizontal.try_into().ok().unwrap();
        let vertical: [TextSink; 4] = vertical.try_into().ok().unwrap();
        let mut horizontal_sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_radius(&mut horizontal_sink, &horizontal);
        let mut vertical_sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_radius(&mut vertical_sink, &vertical);
        sink.push_sink(&horizontal_sink);
        if !horizontal_sink.content_equals(&vertical_sink) {
            sink.push_ascii(" / ");
            sink.push_sink(&vertical_sink);
        }
        return;
    }
    if matches!(
        shorthand_property,
        property_id::PAGE_BREAK_BEFORE | property_id::PAGE_BREAK_AFTER | property_id::PAGE_BREAK_INSIDE
    ) {
        let Some(serialized_longhand) = sub_properties
            .first()
            .and_then(|&longhand_id| longhand(longhand_id))
            .map(&sub_sink)
        else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        let legacy_keyword_passes_through = ["auto", "avoid", "left", "right"]
            .iter()
            .any(|legacy_keyword| sink_is_ascii_str(&serialized_longhand, legacy_keyword));
        if legacy_keyword_passes_through {
            sink.push_sink(&serialized_longhand);
        } else if sink_is_ascii_str(&serialized_longhand, "page") {
            sink.push_ascii("always");
        } else if shorthand_property == property_id::PAGE_BREAK_INSIDE
            && sink_is_ascii_str(&serialized_longhand, "avoid-page")
        {
            sink.push_ascii("avoid");
        }
        return;
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::COLUMNS {
        let (Some(width), Some(count), Some(height)) = (
            longhand(property_id::COLUMN_WIDTH).map(&sub_sink),
            longhand(property_id::COLUMN_COUNT).map(&sub_sink),
            longhand(property_id::COLUMN_HEIGHT).map(&sub_sink),
        ) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        if width.content_equals(&count) {
            sink.push_sink(&width);
        } else if sink_is_ascii_str(&width, "auto") {
            sink.push_sink(&count);
        } else if sink_is_ascii_str(&count, "auto") {
            sink.push_sink(&width);
        } else {
            sink.push_sink(&width);
            sink.push_ascii(" ");
            sink.push_sink(&count);
        }
        if !sink_is_ascii_str(&height, "auto") {
            sink.push_ascii(" / ");
            sink.push_sink(&height);
        }
        return;
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::FLEX {
        for (index, id) in [
            property_id::FLEX_GROW,
            property_id::FLEX_SHRINK,
            property_id::FLEX_BASIS,
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
        {
            if index > 0 {
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
            }
            let Some(value) = longhand(id) else {
                unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
            };
            serialize_style_value(sink, value, mode);
        }
        return;
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::CONTAINER {
        let (Some(name), Some(container_type)) = (
            longhand(property_id::CONTAINER_NAME),
            longhand(property_id::CONTAINER_TYPE),
        ) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        serialize_style_value(sink, name, mode);
        let Some(container_type_initial) = initial_source(property_id::CONTAINER_TYPE) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        let container_type_sink = sub_sink(container_type);
        let mut container_type_initial_sink = TextSink::new();
        container_type_initial_sink.push_ascii(container_type_initial);
        if !container_type_sink.content_equals(&container_type_initial_sink) {
            sink.push_ascii(" / ");
            serialize_style_value(sink, container_type, mode);
        }
        return;
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::POSITION_TRY {
        let (Some(order), Some(fallbacks)) = (
            longhand(property_id::POSITION_TRY_ORDER),
            longhand(property_id::POSITION_TRY_FALLBACKS),
        ) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        if !matches!(order, StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: code } if *code == keyword::NORMAL) {
            serialize_style_value(sink, order, mode);
            sink.push_ascii(" ");
        }
        return serialize_style_value(sink, fallbacks, mode);
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::GRID_COLUMN || shorthand_property == property_id::GRID_ROW {
        let (start_id, end_id) = if shorthand_property == property_id::GRID_COLUMN {
            (property_id::GRID_COLUMN_START, property_id::GRID_COLUMN_END)
        } else {
            (property_id::GRID_ROW_START, property_id::GRID_ROW_END)
        };
        let (Some(start), Some(end)) = (longhand(start_id), longhand(end_id)) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        let end_is_auto_placement = matches!(end, StyleValueData::GridTrackPlacement(placement) if placement.kind == 0);
        // NB: When the start line is a lone <custom-ident>, omitting the end line would make it copy
        //     that ident on re-parse, so "/ auto" must be kept.
        let start_is_lone_custom_ident = crate::css::parser::grid_parser::is_custom_ident_placement(start);
        if start == end || (end_is_auto_placement && !start_is_lone_custom_ident) {
            return serialize_style_value(sink, start, mode);
        }
        serialize_style_value(sink, start, mode);
        sink.push_ascii(" / ");
        return serialize_style_value(sink, end, mode);
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::PLACE_CONTENT
        || shorthand_property == property_id::PLACE_ITEMS
        || shorthand_property == property_id::PLACE_SELF
    {
        let entries: Vec<&StyleValueData> = values.as_slice().iter().map(|value| value.data()).collect();
        return serialize_a_positional_value_list(sink, &entries, mode);
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::TEXT_DECORATION {
        // The rule here seems to be, only print what's different from the default value,
        // but if they're all default, print the line.
        for id in [
            property_id::TEXT_DECORATION_LINE,
            property_id::TEXT_DECORATION_THICKNESS,
            property_id::TEXT_DECORATION_STYLE,
            property_id::TEXT_DECORATION_COLOR,
        ] {
            let (Some(value), Some(initial_source)) = (longhand(id), initial_source(id)) else {
                unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
            };
            let value_sink = sub_sink(value);
            let mut initial_sink = TextSink::new();
            initial_sink.push_ascii(initial_source);
            if !value_sink.content_equals(&initial_sink) {
                if sink.len() != 0 {
                    sink.push_ascii(" ");
                }
                serialize_style_value(sink, value, mode);
            }
        }
        if sink.len() == 0 {
            let Some(line) = longhand(property_id::TEXT_DECORATION_LINE) else {
                unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
            };
            return serialize_style_value(sink, line, mode);
        }
        return;
    }
    if shorthand_property == property_id::WHITE_SPACE {
        let (Some(collapse), Some(wrap_mode), Some(trim)) = (
            longhand(property_id::WHITE_SPACE_COLLAPSE),
            longhand(property_id::TEXT_WRAP_MODE),
            longhand(property_id::WHITE_SPACE_TRIM),
        ) else {
            unreachable!("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs");
        };
        if matches!(trim, StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: code } if *code == keyword::NONE)
            && let (StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: collapse }, StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: wrap_mode }) =
                (collapse, wrap_mode)
        {
            let short = match (*collapse, *wrap_mode) {
                (collapse, wrap) if collapse == keyword::COLLAPSE && wrap == keyword::WRAP => Some("normal"),
                (collapse, wrap) if collapse == keyword::PRESERVE && wrap == keyword::NOWRAP => Some("pre"),
                (collapse, wrap) if collapse == keyword::PRESERVE && wrap == keyword::WRAP => Some("pre-wrap"),
                (collapse, wrap) if collapse == keyword::PRESERVE_BREAKS && wrap == keyword::WRAP => Some("pre-line"),
                _ => None,
            };
            if let Some(short) = short {
                sink.push_ascii(short);
                return;
            }
        }
        return default_serialize(sink);
    }
    if matches!(
        shorthand_property,
        property_id::COLUMN_RULE | property_id::ROW_RULE | property_id::RULE
    ) {
        let entries: Vec<&StyleValueData> = crate::css::property_metadata::longhands_for_shorthand(shorthand_property)
            .iter()
            .map(|&id| longhand(id).expect("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs"))
            .collect();
        if entries.len() == 6 && !gap_decoration_values_equal(&entries[..3], &entries[3..]) {
            return;
        }
        let longhands = &crate::css::property_metadata::longhands_for_shorthand(shorthand_property)[..3];
        let write_gap_rule = |sink: &mut TextSink, rule: [&StyleValueData; 3]| {
            let mut wrote_any = false;
            for (value, &id) in rule.iter().zip(longhands) {
                let value_sink = sub_sink(value);
                let mut initial_sink = TextSink::new();
                initial_sink.push_ascii(property_initial_value(id));
                if value_sink.content_equals_ascii_case_insensitive(&initial_sink) {
                    continue;
                }
                if wrote_any {
                    sink.push_ascii(" ");
                }
                sink.push_sink(&value_sink);
                wrote_any = true;
            }
            if !wrote_any {
                serialize_style_value(sink, rule[0], mode);
            }
        };
        let items = |value: &StyleValueData| -> Vec<StyleValueData> {
            match value {
                StyleValueData::ValueList { values, .. } => {
                    values.as_slice().iter().map(|value| value.data().clone()).collect()
                }
                value => vec![value.clone()],
            }
        };
        let repeat_arguments = |value: &StyleValueData| -> Option<Vec<StyleValueData>> {
            let StyleValueData::Function(function) = value else {
                return None;
            };
            Some(items(function.value.data()))
        };
        let [widths, styles, colors] = [items(entries[0]), items(entries[1]), items(entries[2])];
        if widths.len() != styles.len() || widths.len() != colors.len() {
            return;
        }
        let mut serialized = TextSink::new();
        for (index, ((width, style), color)) in widths.iter().zip(&styles).zip(&colors).enumerate() {
            if index != 0 {
                serialized.push_ascii(", ");
            }
            match (
                repeat_arguments(width),
                repeat_arguments(style),
                repeat_arguments(color),
            ) {
                (None, None, None) => write_gap_rule(&mut serialized, [width, style, color]),
                (Some(widths), Some(styles), Some(colors)) => {
                    if widths[0] != styles[0]
                        || widths[0] != colors[0]
                        || widths.len() != styles.len()
                        || widths.len() != colors.len()
                    {
                        return;
                    }
                    serialized.push_ascii("repeat(");
                    serialize_style_value(&mut serialized, &widths[0], mode);
                    for ((width, style), color) in widths.iter().zip(&styles).zip(&colors).skip(1) {
                        serialized.push_ascii(", ");
                        write_gap_rule(&mut serialized, [width, style, color]);
                    }
                    serialized.push_ascii(")");
                }
                _ => return,
            }
        }
        sink.push_sink(&serialized);
        return;
    }
    if let Some(values_per_axis) =
        crate::css::parser::gap_decorations_parser::shorthand_values_per_axis(shorthand_property)
    {
        let entries: Vec<&StyleValueData> = crate::css::property_metadata::longhands_for_shorthand(shorthand_property)
            .iter()
            .map(|&id| longhand(id).expect("Shorthand style values must have valid value graphs"))
            .collect();
        let mut axes = entries.chunks(values_per_axis);
        let axis = axes.next().expect("Gap decoration shorthands have longhands");
        if axes.any(|other| !gap_decoration_values_equal(other, axis)) {
            return;
        }
        let write_pair = |sink: &mut TextSink, start: &StyleValueData, end: &StyleValueData| {
            serialize_style_value(sink, start, mode);
            if start != end {
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
                serialize_style_value(sink, end, mode);
            }
        };
        match axis {
            [value] => serialize_style_value(sink, value, mode),
            [start, end] => write_pair(sink, start, end),
            [cap_start, ..] if axis.iter().all(|value| value == cap_start) => {
                serialize_style_value(sink, cap_start, mode);
            }
            [cap_start, cap_end, junction_start, junction_end] => {
                serialize_style_value(sink, cap_start, mode);
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
                serialize_style_value(sink, cap_end, mode);
                sink.push_ascii(" / ");
                serialize_style_value(sink, junction_start, mode);
                sink.push_ascii(" ");
                serialize_style_value(sink, junction_end, mode);
            }
            _ => unreachable!("Gap decoration shorthands cover one, two or four longhands per axis"),
        }
        return;
    }
    // Shorthands requiring per-layer coordination or grammar disambiguation.
    if [
        property_id::ANIMATION,
        property_id::ANIMATION_RANGE,
        property_id::BACKGROUND,
        property_id::BORDER,
        property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION,
        property_id::FONT,
        property_id::FONT_SYNTHESIS,
        property_id::FONT_VARIANT,
        property_id::GRID,
        property_id::GRID_AREA,
        property_id::GRID_TEMPLATE,
        property_id::MASK,
        property_id::SCROLL_TIMELINE,
        property_id::TRANSITION,
        property_id::VIEW_TIMELINE,
    ]
    .contains(&shorthand_property)
    {
        return shorthand::serialize(sink, whole_value, shorthand_property, mode, default_serialize);
    }
    if POSITIONAL_VALUE_LIST_SHORTHANDS.contains(&shorthand_property) {
        let entries: Vec<&StyleValueData> = values.as_slice().iter().map(|value| value.data()).collect();
        return serialize_a_positional_value_list(sink, &entries, mode);
    }
    default_serialize(sink);
}

/// Transfers a native `AK::Utf16String` ownership reference without copying.
pub(crate) fn sink_into_raw(sink: TextSink) -> usize {
    let string = if sink.is_ascii {
        // SAFETY: The ASCII representation is valid UTF-8.
        let text = unsafe { str::from_utf8_unchecked(&sink.ascii) };
        ak::Utf16String::from_utf8(text)
    } else {
        ak::Utf16String::from_utf16(&sink.utf16)
    };
    string.into_raw()
}

fn with_view_units<R>(view: crate::css::ffi_support::FfiUtf16View<'_>, f: impl FnOnce(StringUnits) -> R) -> R {
    with_fly_string_units(view.units().unwrap_or(TokenizerInput::Latin1(&[])), f)
}

fn raw_string_of(sink: TextSink) -> usize {
    sink.into_utf16_string().into_raw()
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-an-identifier
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_serialize_an_identifier(ident: crate::css::ffi_support::FfiUtf16View<'_>) -> usize {
    let mut sink = TextSink::new();
    with_view_units(ident, |units| serialize_an_identifier(&mut sink, &units));
    raw_string_of(sink)
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-string
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_serialize_a_string(string: crate::css::ffi_support::FfiUtf16View<'_>) -> usize {
    let mut sink = TextSink::new();
    with_view_units(string, |units| serialize_a_string(&mut sink, &units));
    raw_string_of(sink)
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-url
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_serialize_a_url(url: crate::css::ffi_support::FfiUtf16View<'_>) -> usize {
    // To serialize a URL means to create a string represented by "url(", followed by the serialization of the URL as a
    // string, followed by ")".
    let mut sink = TextSink::new();
    sink.push_ascii("url(");
    with_view_units(url, |units| serialize_a_string(&mut sink, &units));
    sink.push_ascii(")");
    raw_string_of(sink)
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-value
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_serialize_a_number(value: f64) -> usize {
    let mut sink = TextSink::new();
    serialize_a_number(&mut sink, value, SerializationMode::Normal);
    raw_string_of(sink)
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_style_value_serialize(value: &StyleValueData, mode: u8) -> usize {
    let mut sink = TextSink::new();
    serialize_style_value(&mut sink, value, SerializationMode::from_ffi(mode));
    sink_into_raw(sink)
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-shapes-1/#shape-function
fn serialize_shape_function(
    sink: &mut TextSink,
    fill_rule: u8,
    points: &[crate::css::style_value::RetainedShapePoint],
    commands: &[crate::css::style_value::ShapeCommand],
    mode: SerializationMode,
) {
    use crate::css::style_value::{ShapeCommandKind, ShapeControlPointAnchor};
    let push_point = |sink: &mut TextSink, point: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedShapePoint| {
        let [x, y] = point.values();
        serialize_style_value(sink, x.data(), mode);
        sink.push_ascii(" ");
        serialize_style_value(sink, y.data(), mode);
    };
    sink.push_ascii("shape(");
    if fill_rule == 1 {
        sink.push_ascii("evenodd ");
    }
    let mut points = points.iter();
    for (index, command) in commands.iter().enumerate() {
        if index > 0 {
            sink.push_ascii(", ");
        }
        let to_or_by = if command.relative { "by " } else { "to " };
        match command.kind {
            ShapeCommandKind::From => {
                sink.push_ascii("from ");
                push_point(sink, points.next().unwrap());
            }
            ShapeCommandKind::Close => sink.push_ascii("close"),
            ShapeCommandKind::Move | ShapeCommandKind::Line => {
                sink.push_ascii(if command.kind == ShapeCommandKind::Move {
                    "move "
                } else {
                    "line "
                });
                sink.push_ascii(to_or_by);
                push_point(sink, points.next().unwrap());
            }
            ShapeCommandKind::HorizontalLine | ShapeCommandKind::VerticalLine => {
                let horizontal = command.kind == ShapeCommandKind::HorizontalLine;
                sink.push_ascii(if horizontal { "hline " } else { "vline " });
                sink.push_ascii(to_or_by);
                let [x, y] = points.next().unwrap().values();
                serialize_style_value(sink, if horizontal { x.data() } else { y.data() }, mode);
            }
            ShapeCommandKind::Curve | ShapeCommandKind::Smooth => {
                sink.push_ascii(if command.kind == ShapeCommandKind::Curve {
                    "curve "
                } else {
                    "smooth "
                });
                sink.push_ascii(to_or_by);
                push_point(sink, points.next().unwrap());
                for control_point in 0..usize::from(command.control_point_count) {
                    sink.push_ascii(if control_point == 0 { " with " } else { " / " });
                    push_point(sink, points.next().unwrap());
                    // A control point is relative to the start of a relative command, and to the origin of an
                    // absolute one, unless it says otherwise.
                    match command.control_points[control_point] {
                        ShapeControlPointAnchor::Start if !command.relative => sink.push_ascii(" from start"),
                        ShapeControlPointAnchor::End => sink.push_ascii(" from end"),
                        ShapeControlPointAnchor::Origin if command.relative => sink.push_ascii(" from origin"),
                        ShapeControlPointAnchor::Start | ShapeControlPointAnchor::Origin => {}
                    }
                }
            }
            ShapeCommandKind::Arc => {
                sink.push_ascii("arc ");
                sink.push_ascii(to_or_by);
                push_point(sink, points.next().unwrap());
                sink.push_ascii(" of ");
                let radii = points.next().unwrap();
                if command.arc_has_one_radius {
                    serialize_style_value(sink, radii.values()[0].data(), mode);
                } else {
                    push_point(sink, radii);
                }
                if command.arc_clockwise {
                    sink.push_ascii(" cw");
                }
                if command.arc_large {
                    sink.push_ascii(" large");
                }
                let rotation = points.next().unwrap();
                let rotation_is_zero =
                    matches!(rotation.values()[0].data(), StyleValueData::Angle { value, .. } if *value == 0.0);
                if command.arc_has_rotation && !rotation_is_zero {
                    sink.push_ascii(" rotate ");
                    serialize_style_value(sink, rotation.values()[0].data(), mode);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    sink.push_ascii(")");
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn text(sink: TextSink) -> String {
        if sink.is_ascii {
            String::from_utf8(sink.ascii).unwrap()
        } else {
            String::from_utf16(&sink.utf16).unwrap()
        }
    }

    fn number_to_string(value: f64) -> String {
        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_a_number(&mut sink, value, SerializationMode::Normal);
        text(sink)
    }

    fn number_to_reparse_string(value: f64) -> String {
        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_a_number(&mut sink, value, SerializationMode::ResolvedValueForReparse);
        text(sink)
    }

    #[test]
    fn number_serialization_matches_ak_format() {
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(0.0), "0");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(1.0), "1");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(-1.0), "-1");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(0.5), "0.5");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(1.5), "1.5");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(-0.25), "-0.25");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(0.0000004), "0");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(100.0), "100");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(0.1), "0.1");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(16.0 / 9.0), "1.777778");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(1.0 / 3.0), "0.333333");
    }

    #[test]
    fn number_serialization_holds_integer_parts_past_u64() {
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(18446744073709551616.0), "18446744073709551616");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(-18446744073709551616.0), "-18446744073709551616");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(1e21), "1000000000000000000000");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(9007199254740993.0), "9007199254740992");
        assert_eq!(number_to_string(1234567.9999999), "1234568");
    }

    #[test]
    fn internal_reparse_number_serialization_preserves_precision() {
        assert_eq!(number_to_reparse_string(0.0000001), "0.0000001");
        assert_eq!(number_to_reparse_string(1.0 / 3.0).parse::<f64>().unwrap(), 1.0 / 3.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn explicitly_signed_negative_zero_integer_round_trips() {
        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_number_with_type(&mut sink, -0.0, 1, SerializationMode::ResolvedValueForReparse);
        assert_eq!(text(sink), "-0");
    }

    #[test]
    fn identifier_escaping() {
        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_an_identifier(&mut sink, &StringUnits::Ascii(b"7abc"));
        assert_eq!(text(sink), "\\37 abc");

        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_an_identifier(&mut sink, &StringUnits::Ascii(b"-"));
        assert_eq!(text(sink), "\\-");

        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_an_identifier(&mut sink, &StringUnits::Ascii(b"hello world"));
        assert_eq!(text(sink), "hello\\ world");
    }

    #[test]
    fn string_escaping() {
        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        serialize_a_string(&mut sink, &StringUnits::Ascii(b"a\"b\\c"));
        assert_eq!(text(sink), "\"a\\\"b\\\\c\"");
    }

    #[test]
    fn utf16_promotion() {
        let mut sink = TextSink::new();
        sink.push_ascii("abc");
        sink.push_code_point(0x1F600);
        assert!(!sink.is_ascii);
        assert_eq!(text(sink), "abc\u{1F600}");
    }
}

//! Serialization of a CSS declaration block.

use super::*;
use crate::css::declaration_block::{DeclarationBlockHeader, DeclarationRef};
use crate::css::property_metadata::{
    expanded_longhands_for_shorthand, longhands_for_shorthand, property_is_legacy_shorthand,
    property_is_logical_alias_including_shorthands, property_is_shorthand, property_logical_group, property_name,
    shorthands_for_longhand,
};
use crate::css::style_value::{RetainedPropertyIdList, RetainedStyleValueData, RetainedStyleValueDataList};
use crate::css::style_value::{ShorthandPayload, StyleValueBox};
use crate::css::style_value_arc::StyleValueArc;
use std::collections::HashSet;

fn append_property_to_already_serialized(already_serialized: &mut HashSet<u16>, property: u16) {
    already_serialized.insert(property);

    // AD-HOC: The spec assumes that we only store values against expanded longhands, there are however limited
    //         circumstances where we store against shorthands directly in addition to the expanded longhands. For
    //         example if the value of the shorthand is unresolved we store an UnresolvedStyleValue against the
    //         shorthand directly and a PendingSubstitutionStyleValue against each of the longhands. In the case we
    //         serialize a shorthand directly we should also mark it's longhands as serialized to avoid serializing
    //         them separately.
    if property_is_shorthand(property) {
        for &longhand in longhands_for_shorthand(property) {
            append_property_to_already_serialized(already_serialized, longhand);
        }
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-declaration
fn serialize_a_css_declaration(list: &mut Vec<TextSink>, property: &StringUnits, value: TextSink, important: bool) {
    // 1. Let s be the empty string.
    let mut s = TextSink::new();

    // 2. Append property to s.
    // AD-HOC: There's no place currently on the spec where the property name properly escaped,
    //         and this needs to be done when custom properties have special characters.
    //         Related spec issues:
    //          - https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/11729
    //          - https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/12258
    serialize_an_identifier(&mut s, property);

    // 3. Append ": " (U+003A U+0020) to s.
    s.push_ascii(": ");

    // 4. If value contains any non-whitespace characters, append value to s.
    let value = value.into_utf16();
    if !value.iter().all(|&unit| unit == 0x20 || (0x09..=0x0D).contains(&unit)) {
        for unit in value {
            s.push_code_unit(unit);
        }
    }

    // 5. If the important flag is set, append " !important" (U+0020 U+0021 U+0069 U+006D U+0070 U+006F U+0072
    //    U+0061 U+006E U+0074) to s.
    if important {
        s.push_ascii(" !important");
    }

    // 6. Append ";" (U+003B) to s.
    s.push_ascii(";");

    // 7. Return s.
    list.push(s);
}

fn shorthand_value(shorthand: u16, longhand_values: Vec<RetainedStyleValueData>) -> StyleValueArc {
    StyleValueArc::new(StyleValueData::Shorthand(StyleValueBox::new(ShorthandPayload {
        shorthand_property: shorthand,
        sub_properties: RetainedPropertyIdList::from_vec(longhands_for_shorthand(shorthand).to_vec()),
        values: RetainedStyleValueDataList::from_retained_values(longhand_values),
    })))
}

/// Whether the value of a longhand still waits for an arbitrary substitution function.
fn awaits_substitution(value: &StyleValueData) -> bool {
    matches!(
        value,
        StyleValueData::PendingSubstitution { .. } | StyleValueData::Unresolved(_)
    )
}

/// The shorthand and the value that the shorthand was written with, which a longhand that pends it holds. A longhand of
/// a shorthand nested in the one written pends the nested shorthand, which pends the written one in turn.
fn written_shorthand(value: &RetainedStyleValueData) -> Option<(u16, &RetainedStyleValueData)> {
    let StyleValueData::PendingSubstitution {
        original_shorthand,
        original_shorthand_value,
    } = value.data()
    else {
        return None;
    };
    written_shorthand(original_shorthand_value).or(Some((*original_shorthand, original_shorthand_value)))
}

/// The value of the shorthand whose longhands, in canonical order, have the values, or None if it serializes to the
/// empty string.
pub(crate) fn shorthand_value_of_longhands(
    shorthand: u16,
    longhand_values: Vec<RetainedStyleValueData>,
) -> Option<StyleValueArc> {
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values-5/#pending-substitution-value
    // If all of the component longhand properties for a given shorthand are pending-substitution values from the same
    // original shorthand value, the shorthand property must serialize to that original (arbitrary substitution
    // function-containing) value.
    // NB: Writing an equal value again leaves longhands holding equal values, not the same one, so what they have in
    //     common is the shorthand written and its value as written.
    let first = longhand_values.first()?;
    if let StyleValueData::PendingSubstitution {
        original_shorthand_value,
        ..
    } = first.data()
    {
        let first_written_shorthand = written_shorthand(first);
        if longhand_values
            .iter()
            .all(|value| written_shorthand(value).is_some() && written_shorthand(value) == first_written_shorthand)
        {
            return Some(original_shorthand_value.clone().into_arc());
        }
    }

    // Otherwise, if any of the component longhand properties for a given shorthand are pending-substitution values, or
    // contain arbitrary substitution functions of their own that have not yet been substituted, the shorthand property
    // must serialize to the empty string.
    if longhand_values.iter().any(|value| awaits_substitution(value.data())) {
        return None;
    }

    Some(shorthand_value(shorthand, longhand_values))
}

fn make_shorthand_value(shorthand: u16, list: &[DeclarationRef]) -> StyleValueArc {
    let longhand_values = longhands_for_shorthand(shorthand)
        .iter()
        .map(|&longhand_id| {
            RetainedStyleValueData::from_arc(if property_is_shorthand(longhand_id) {
                make_shorthand_value(longhand_id, list)
            } else {
                list.iter()
                    .find(|declaration| declaration.property_id == longhand_id)
                    .expect("the list holds every longhand of the shorthand")
                    .value
                    .clone()
            })
        })
        .collect();
    shorthand_value(shorthand, longhand_values)
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/cssom/#serialize-a-css-value
fn serialize_a_css_value_of_list(list: &[DeclarationRef]) -> TextSink {
    let mut value = TextSink::new();
    let Some(first) = list.first() else {
        return value;
    };

    // 1. Let shorthand be the first shorthand property, in preferred order, that exactly maps to all of the longhand
    //    properties in list.
    let shorthand = shorthands_for_longhand(first.property_id).iter().find(|&&shorthand| {
        let longhands_for_potential_shorthand = expanded_longhands_for_shorthand(shorthand);

        // The potential shorthand exactly maps to all of the longhand properties in list if:
        // a. The number of longhand properties in the list is equal to the number of longhand properties that the
        //    potential shorthand maps to.
        if longhands_for_potential_shorthand.len() != list.len() {
            return false;
        }

        // b. All longhand properties in the list are contained in the list of longhands for the potential shorthand.
        longhands_for_potential_shorthand
            .iter()
            .all(|&longhand| list.iter().any(|declaration| declaration.property_id == longhand))
    });

    // 2. If there is no such shorthand or shorthand cannot exactly represent the values of all the properties in
    //    list, return the empty string.
    let Some(&shorthand) = shorthand else {
        return value;
    };

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values-5/#pending-substitution-value
    // If any of the component longhand properties for a given shorthand are pending-substitution
    // values, or contain arbitrary substitution functions of their own that have not yet been substituted, the
    // shorthand property must serialize to the empty string.
    if list.iter().any(|declaration| awaits_substitution(declaration.value)) {
        return value;
    }

    // 3. Otherwise, serialize a CSS value from a hypothetical declaration of the property shorthand with its value
    //    representing the combined values of the declarations in list.
    serialize_style_value(
        &mut value,
        &make_shorthand_value(shorthand, list),
        SerializationMode::Normal,
    );
    value
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-declaration-block
pub(crate) fn serialize_a_css_declaration_block(block: &DeclarationBlockHeader) -> TextSink {
    // 1. Let list be an empty array.
    let mut list = Vec::new();

    // 2. Let already serialized be an empty array.
    let mut already_serialized = HashSet::new();

    // NB: The spec treats custom properties the same as any other property, and expects the loop below to handle
    //     them. However, our implementation separates them from regular properties, so we handle them here.
    // FIXME: Is the relative order of custom properties and regular properties supposed to be preserved?
    for declaration in block.custom_properties().iter() {
        // 5. Let value be the result of invoking serialize a CSS value of declaration.
        let mut value = TextSink::new();
        serialize_style_value(&mut value, declaration.declaration.value, SerializationMode::Normal);

        // 6. Let serialized declaration be the result of invoking serialize a CSS declaration with property name
        //    property, value value, and the important flag set if declaration has its important flag set.
        // 7. Append serialized declaration to list.
        serialize_a_css_declaration(
            &mut list,
            &StringUnits::Utf16(declaration.name.units()),
            value,
            declaration.declaration.important,
        );
    }

    let declarations: Vec<DeclarationRef> = block.properties().iter().collect();

    // 3. Declaration loop: For each CSS declaration declaration in declaration block's declarations, follow these
    //    substeps:
    for declaration in &declarations {
        // 1. Let property be declaration's property name.
        let property = declaration.property_id;

        // 2. If property is in already serialized, continue with the steps labeled declaration loop.
        if already_serialized.contains(&property) {
            continue;
        }

        // AD-HOC: A shorthand pending an outer shorthand has no value of its own to serialize. The outer shorthand
        //         serializes for it, or else each of its longhands does.
        if property_is_shorthand(property) && matches!(&**declaration.value, StyleValueData::PendingSubstitution { .. })
        {
            continue;
        }

        // 3. If property maps to one or more shorthand properties, let shorthands be an array of those shorthand
        //    properties, in preferred order.
        let shorthands = shorthands_for_longhand(property);

        // 4. Shorthand loop: For each shorthand in shorthands, follow these substeps:
        for &shorthand in shorthands {
            // 1. Let longhands be an array consisting of all CSS declarations in declaration block's declarations
            //    that are not in already serialized and have a property name that maps to one of the shorthand
            //    properties in shorthands.
            let longhands: Vec<DeclarationRef> = declarations
                .iter()
                .filter(|longhand| {
                    !already_serialized.contains(&longhand.property_id)
                        && shorthands_for_longhand(longhand.property_id).contains(&shorthand)
                })
                .copied()
                .collect();

            // 2. If not all properties that map to shorthand are present in longhands, continue with the steps
            //    labeled shorthand loop.
            if expanded_longhands_for_shorthand(shorthand)
                .iter()
                .any(|&longhand_id| !longhands.iter().any(|longhand| longhand.property_id == longhand_id))
            {
                continue;
            }

            // 3. Let current longhands be an empty array.
            // 4. Append all CSS declarations in longhands that have a property name that maps to shorthand to current
            //    longhands.
            // NB: longhands holds only those already, as it is made for this shorthand alone.
            let current_longhands = longhands;

            // 5. If there are one or more CSS declarations in current longhands have their important flag set and
            //    one or more with it unset, continue with the steps labeled shorthand loop.
            if current_longhands
                .iter()
                .any(|longhand| longhand.important != current_longhands[0].important)
            {
                continue;
            }

            // 6. If there is any declaration in declaration block in between the first and the last longhand
            //    in current longhands which belongs to the same logical property group, but has a different
            //    mapping logic as any of the longhands in current longhands, and is not in current
            //    longhands, continue with the steps labeled shorthand loop.
            let index_of = |property_id: u16| {
                declarations
                    .iter()
                    .position(|current_declaration| current_declaration.property_id == property_id)
                    .expect("current longhands are declarations of the block")
            };
            let first_current_longhand_index = index_of(current_longhands[0].property_id);
            let last_current_longhand_index = index_of(current_longhands[current_longhands.len() - 1].property_id);
            let has_conflicting_declaration = declarations[first_current_longhand_index..=last_current_longhand_index]
                .iter()
                .any(|current_declaration| {
                    // NB: Declaration is in current longhands
                    if current_longhands
                        .iter()
                        .any(|longhand| longhand.property_id == current_declaration.property_id)
                    {
                        return false;
                    }

                    let Some(group) = property_logical_group(current_declaration.property_id) else {
                        return false;
                    };
                    let is_logical_alias =
                        property_is_logical_alias_including_shorthands(current_declaration.property_id);

                    // NB: Declaration has any counterpart in current longhands with same logical property group but
                    //     different mapping logic
                    current_longhands.iter().any(|longhand| {
                        property_logical_group(longhand.property_id) == Some(group)
                            && property_is_logical_alias_including_shorthands(longhand.property_id) != is_logical_alias
                    })
                });
            if has_conflicting_declaration {
                continue;
            }

            // 7. Let value be the result of invoking serialize a CSS value with current longhands.
            let value = serialize_a_css_value_of_list(&current_longhands);

            // 8. If value is the empty string, continue with the steps labeled shorthand loop.
            if value.len() == 0 {
                continue;
            }

            // 9. Let serialized declaration be the result of invoking serialize a CSS declaration with property
            //    name shorthand, value value, and the important flag set if the CSS declarations in current
            //    longhands have their important flag set.
            // 10. Append serialized declaration to list.
            serialize_a_css_declaration(
                &mut list,
                &StringUnits::Ascii(property_name(shorthand).as_bytes()),
                value,
                current_longhands[0].important,
            );

            // 11. Append the property names of all items of current longhands to already serialized.
            for longhand in &current_longhands {
                append_property_to_already_serialized(&mut already_serialized, longhand.property_id);
            }

            // 12. Continue with the steps labeled declaration loop.
            // NB: The check below skips the rest of the declaration loop, and the remaining shorthands no longer have
            //     all of their longhands in longhands.
        }

        // FIXME: File spec issue that this should only be run if we haven't serialized this declaration in the above
        //        shorthand loop.
        if !already_serialized.contains(&property) {
            // 5. Let value be the result of invoking serialize a CSS value of declaration.
            let mut value = TextSink::new();
            serialize_style_value(&mut value, declaration.value, SerializationMode::Normal);

            // 6. Let serialized declaration be the result of invoking serialize a CSS declaration with property name
            //    property, value value, and the important flag set if declaration has its important flag set.
            // 7. Append serialized declaration to list.
            let serialized_property_name = if property_is_legacy_shorthand(property) {
                longhands_for_shorthand(property)[0]
            } else {
                property
            };
            serialize_a_css_declaration(
                &mut list,
                &StringUnits::Ascii(property_name(serialized_property_name).as_bytes()),
                value,
                declaration.important,
            );

            // 8. Append property to already serialized.
            append_property_to_already_serialized(&mut already_serialized, property);
        }
    }

    // 4. Return list joined with " " (U+0020).
    let mut result = TextSink::new();
    for (index, declaration) in list.into_iter().enumerate() {
        if index != 0 {
            result.push_ascii(" ");
        }
        result.push_sink(&declaration);
    }
    result
}
