//! The cache-free selector correctness floor.
//!
//! This matcher enumerates attached rules directly from the rule store and matches their selectors
//! against committed facts and tree relations. It deliberately owns no
//! dispatch index, Bloom summary, prefix state, relation or position cache, retained witness,
//! retained answer, or cascade-pruning state.

use super::RetainedState;
use super::pipeline::projection::Projection;
use super::pipeline::rule_store::CascadeOrigin;
use super::pipeline::rule_store::RuleID;
use super::pipeline::rule_store::RuleStore;
use super::selector::Incomplete;
use super::selector::Specificity;
use super::tree::PseudoElementTarget;
use super::tree::StyleNodeID;
use super::tree::TreeScopeID;
use smallvec::SmallVec;

/// One selector-list answer produced without derived matching state.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
pub struct ExactRuleMatch {
    pub node: StyleNodeID,
    pub pseudo_element: Option<PseudoElementTarget>,
    pub rule: RuleID,
    pub entry: u32,
    pub specificity: Specificity,
    pub tree_scope: TreeScopeID,
    pub scope_proximity: u32,
}

/// How a scope is allowed to reach the node being asked.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ExactMatchContext {
    #[default]
    Ordinary,
    Slotted,
    Part,
    Host,
}

/// Direct evaluator over attached rules and committed base relations only.
pub struct ExactMatcher<'a> {
    projection: &'a Projection,
    program: &'a RuleStore,
    scope: TreeScopeID,
    shadow_root: Option<StyleNodeID>,
    context: ExactMatchContext,
    document: super::component_matching::DocumentMatching,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum DocumentSheets {
    All,
    NonAuthorOnly,
}

impl<'a> ExactMatcher<'a> {
    #[must_use]
    pub(super) fn new(
        projection: &'a Projection,
        program: &'a RuleStore,
        document: super::component_matching::DocumentMatching,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            projection,
            program,
            scope: TreeScopeID::DOCUMENT,
            shadow_root: None,
            context: ExactMatchContext::Ordinary,
            document,
        }
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn in_scope(mut self, scope: TreeScopeID) -> Self {
        self.scope = scope;
        self
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn in_shadow_tree(mut self, shadow_root: StyleNodeID) -> Self {
        self.shadow_root = Some(shadow_root);
        self
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn with_context(mut self, context: ExactMatchContext) -> Self {
        self.context = context;
        self
    }

    /// Evaluate one element by walking every attached rule entry directly.
    pub fn match_node(&self, node: StyleNodeID, out: &mut Vec<ExactRuleMatch>) -> Result<(), Incomplete> {
        if self.projection.facts(node).is_none() {
            return Err(Incomplete::MissingFacts(node));
        }
        let start = out.len();
        let result = (|| {
            self.match_sheets(node, self.scope, DocumentSheets::All, start, out)?;
            if self.scope != TreeScopeID::DOCUMENT {
                let document_sheets = match self.program.scope_uses_document_sheets(self.scope) {
                    true => DocumentSheets::All,
                    false => DocumentSheets::NonAuthorOnly,
                };
                self.match_sheets(node, TreeScopeID::DOCUMENT, document_sheets, start, out)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        })();
        if let Err(incomplete) = result {
            out.truncate(start);
            return Err(incomplete);
        }
        out[start..].sort_unstable_by_key(|matched| (matched.rule, matched.pseudo_element));
        Ok(())
    }

    fn match_sheets(
        &self,
        node: StyleNodeID,
        sheet_scope: TreeScopeID,
        take: DocumentSheets,
        match_start: usize,
        out: &mut Vec<ExactRuleMatch>,
    ) -> Result<(), Incomplete> {
        for &sheet in self.program.sheets_in_scope(sheet_scope) {
            if take == DocumentSheets::NonAuthorOnly
                && !matches!(
                    self.program.sheet_origin(sheet),
                    CascadeOrigin::UserAgent | CascadeOrigin::User
                )
            {
                continue;
            }
            for rule in self.program.rules_in_sheet(sheet) {
                if !self.program.rule_can_decide(rule) {
                    continue;
                }
                let version = self.program.rule_version(rule);
                if !version.kind.matches_elements() {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(selectors) = self.program.selectors_of(sheet, version) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let scope = self.program.scope_chain(version.scope).map(|chain| &**chain);
                let mut evaluator = self.projection.evaluator();
                evaluator.set_scope_shadow_root(self.shadow_root);
                if self.context == ExactMatchContext::Part {
                    evaluator.set_part_exposure_scope(Some(self.scope));
                }
                for (index, (selector, specificity, pseudo_kind)) in super::pipeline::entries_of(&selectors).enumerate()
                {
                    let entry_selector = super::component_matching::EntrySelector::new(selector, scope);
                    let facts = super::selector_analysis::EntryFacts::of(entry_selector);
                    let context_admits = match self.context {
                        ExactMatchContext::Ordinary => true,
                        ExactMatchContext::Slotted => facts.slotted,
                        ExactMatchContext::Part => facts.part,
                        ExactMatchContext::Host => facts.host,
                    };
                    if !context_admits {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let matched = evaluator.matches_entry_selector(entry_selector, node, self.document)?;
                    let pseudo_element = (pseudo_kind != u8::MAX)
                        .then(|| PseudoElementTarget::new(super::tree::PseudoElementKind(u16::from(pseudo_kind))));
                    if !matched {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let scope_proximity = evaluator.scope_proximity_of_match(node);
                    let candidate = ExactRuleMatch {
                        node,
                        pseudo_element,
                        rule,
                        entry: u32::try_from(index).expect("selector entry space exhausted"),
                        specificity,
                        tree_scope: self.scope,
                        scope_proximity,
                    };
                    if let Some(existing) = out[match_start..].iter_mut().find(|existing| {
                        existing.node == node
                            && existing.rule == rule
                            && existing.tree_scope == self.scope
                            && existing.pseudo_element == pseudo_element
                    }) {
                        if candidate.specificity > existing.specificity {
                            *existing = candidate;
                        }
                    } else {
                        out.push(candidate);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl RetainedState {
    pub(super) fn append_exact_matches_in_scope(
        &self,
        node: StyleNodeID,
        scope: TreeScopeID,
        context: ExactMatchContext,
        matches: &mut Vec<ExactRuleMatch>,
    ) -> Result<(), Incomplete> {
        let shadow_root = self.scope_root(scope);
        let mut matcher = ExactMatcher::new(&self.projection, &self.rules, self.document_matching())
            .in_scope(scope)
            .with_context(context);
        if let Some(shadow_root) = shadow_root {
            matcher = matcher.in_shadow_tree(shadow_root);
        }
        matcher.match_node(node, matches)
    }

    /// Append what `node` matches from every tree whose rules can decide for it, evaluating every
    /// attached rule directly, and answer whether a rule can match it from more than one tree.
    pub(super) fn append_exact_matches_in_every_scope(
        &self,
        node: StyleNodeID,
        exact: &mut Vec<ExactRuleMatch>,
    ) -> Result<bool, Incomplete> {
        let scope = self.projection.tree_scope(node);
        let inner_scope = self
            .projection
            .shadow_root_of(node)
            .and_then(|shadow_root| self.scope_by_root.get(shadow_root).filter(|&inner| inner != scope));
        let slotted_scopes: SmallVec<[TreeScopeID; 1]> = self
            .scopes_slotted_into(node)
            .filter(|&slotted| slotted != scope && Some(slotted) != inner_scope)
            .collect();
        let part_scopes: SmallVec<[TreeScopeID; 1]> = self
            .part_exposure_scopes(node)
            .filter(|&exposed| exposed != scope && Some(exposed) != inner_scope && !slotted_scopes.contains(&exposed))
            .collect();

        for_each_matching_scope(scope, inner_scope, &slotted_scopes, &part_scopes, |scope, context| {
            self.append_exact_matches_in_scope(node, scope, context, exact)
        })?;
        Ok(inner_scope.is_some() || !slotted_scopes.is_empty() || !part_scopes.is_empty())
    }
}

fn for_each_matching_scope(
    scope: TreeScopeID,
    inner_scope: Option<TreeScopeID>,
    slotted_scopes: &[TreeScopeID],
    part_scopes: &[TreeScopeID],
    mut ask: impl FnMut(TreeScopeID, ExactMatchContext) -> Result<(), Incomplete>,
) -> Result<(), Incomplete> {
    ask(scope, ExactMatchContext::Ordinary)?;
    if let Some(inner_scope) = inner_scope {
        ask(inner_scope, ExactMatchContext::Host)?;
    }
    for &slotted_scope in slotted_scopes {
        ask(slotted_scope, ExactMatchContext::Slotted)?;
    }
    for &part_scope in part_scopes {
        ask(part_scope, ExactMatchContext::Part)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/*

use super::pipeline::projection::NoteChanges;
use super::*;

/// One clock shared by every phase; rounded cumulative endpoints make the intervals additive.
/// It owns no engine borrow, and is read only for diagnostics.
struct TransactionClock {
    started_at: std::time::Instant,
    elapsed_microseconds: u64,
    phase: Counter,
}

impl TransactionClock {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            started_at: std::time::Instant::now(),
            elapsed_microseconds: 0,
            phase: Counter::CommitMicroseconds,
        }
    }

    fn enter(&mut self, phase: Counter, counters: &Counters) {
        let elapsed = self.started_at.elapsed().as_micros().min(u128::from(u64::MAX)) as u64;
        counters.add(self.phase, elapsed - self.elapsed_microseconds);
        self.elapsed_microseconds = elapsed;
        self.phase = phase;
    }

    fn finish(mut self, counters: &Counters) {
        self.enter(Counter::TransactionRemainderMicroseconds, counters);
        counters.add(Counter::TransactionMicroseconds, self.elapsed_microseconds);
    }
}

impl RetainedState {
    /// Whether `node` keeps its style below an element that is not displayed: an SVG element that
    /// content can reference, which an SVG resource reference paints, or an element with
    /// animations, which go on running.
    pub(super) fn keeps_style_in_display_none_subtree(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> bool {
        self.projection.adjustment_facts(node) & bridge::element_adjustment_fact::HAS_ANIMATIONS != 0
            || self.is_referenceable_in_display_none_subtree(node)
    }

    pub(super) fn is_referenceable_in_display_none_subtree(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> bool {
        use bridge::element_adjustment_fact::IS_SVG_ELEMENT;
        use bridge::element_construction_fact::{IS_SVG_GEOMETRY_ELEMENT, IS_SVG_RESOURCE_ELEMENT};
        if self.projection.construction_facts(node) & IS_SVG_GEOMETRY_ELEMENT != 0
            && self.projection.facts(node).is_some_and(|facts| !facts.id().is_none())
        {
            return true;
        }
        let mut current = Some(node);
        while let Some(element) = current
            && self.projection.adjustment_facts(element) & IS_SVG_ELEMENT != 0
        {
            if self.projection.construction_facts(element) & IS_SVG_RESOURCE_ELEMENT != 0 {
                return true;
            }
            current = self
                .projection
                .parent(element)
                .map(|parent| self.projection.host_of(parent).unwrap_or(parent));
        }
        false
    }
}

impl StyleEngine {
    fn run_style_update_with_clock(
        &mut self,
        root: StyleNodeID,
        mut emit: impl FnMut(&[PublishedStyleDeltaRecord]),
        clock: &mut TransactionClock,
    ) {
        self.reclaim_unreachable_computed_records();
        for (node, input) in std::mem::take(&mut self.host.deferred_element_style_inputs) {
            self.host.element_inputs.note_style_input(
                node,
                ElementStyleInput {
                    reaction: input.reaction,
                    inherited_style_groups: input.inherited_style_groups,
                },
            );
        }
        self.host.deferred_element_style_inputs_are_pending = false;

        let mut transaction = self.drain_transaction();
        // NB: Only the live style reads what a transaction changed. The first transaction of a document brings all of
        //     its elements, and a cold pass styles them whatever they changed.
        let note_changes = match self.retained.live_style.is_some() {
            true => NoteChanges::Yes,
            false => NoteChanges::No,
        };
        self.apply_staged_transaction(&mut transaction, note_changes);
        if let Some(mut live) = self.retained.live_style.take() {
            live.note_transaction(&self.retained, &transaction);
            self.retained.live_style = Some(live);
        }
        let process_style = self
            .retained
            .atoms
            .is_process_global()
            .then(|| Arc::clone(&self.retained.process_style));
        self.retained
            .rules
            .share_rule_storage(process_style.as_deref().map(|style| &style.rule_indexes));
        // The engine owns the document from its first transaction with a document element on,
        // and takes the records it computes.
        self.own_from_the_start(root);
        let rows = self.install_restyled(root);
        self.release_transaction_and_sweep_atoms(transaction);
        if !rows.is_empty() {
            emit(&rows);
        }
        clock.enter(Counter::TransactionRemainderMicroseconds, &self.retained.counters);
    }
}

impl StyleEngine {
    pub fn run_style_update(&mut self, root: StyleNodeID, emit: impl FnMut(&[PublishedStyleDeltaRecord])) {
        let mut clock = TransactionClock::new();
        self.run_style_update_with_clock(root, emit, &mut clock);
        // Include transaction-local destruction.
        clock.finish(&self.retained.counters);
    }
}

use super::HashMap;
use super::bridge::{
    FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT, FfiFontResolutionRequest, FfiHostHandle, FfiResolvedFont, FontSizeAdjustKind,
};
use super::tree::TreeScopeID;
use crate::css::host_shared::HostShared;
use crate::css::style_value::{RetainedStyleValueData, retain_style_value};

use smallvec::SmallVec;
use std::ffi::c_void;

/// Resolves one request against the document's published `@font-face` table, through the memo of
/// what has been resolved from it. It is handed nothing else, so it cannot reach the document.
pub type ResolveFontCallback =
    unsafe extern "C" fn(memo: *const c_void, snapshot: *const c_void, FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> FfiResolvedFont;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_resolve_font(
        memo: *const c_void,
        snapshot: *const c_void,
        request: FfiFontResolutionRequest,
    ) -> FfiResolvedFont;
    fn web_css_resolve_font_for_fork(
        memo: *const c_void,
        snapshot: *const c_void,
        request: FfiFontResolutionRequest,
    ) -> FfiResolvedFont;
    fn web_css_font_face_snapshot_reference(snapshot: *const c_void);
    fn web_css_font_face_snapshot_unreference(snapshot: *const c_void);
    fn web_css_font_cascade_memo_reference(memo: *const c_void);
    fn web_css_font_cascade_memo_unreference(memo: *const c_void);
}

/// The scalars of a request, as bits: a request answers another exactly where both name the same
/// values and these are equal.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
struct FontRequestScalars {
    font_size_raw: i32,
    font_weight: u64,
    font_width: u64,
    font_size_adjust_value: u64,
    font_feature_values_scope: u32,
    // NB: An f32's bits, which keep the request within its size.
    font_oblique_angle: u32,
    font_optical_sizing: u8,
    /// The slope in the low two bits, and the synthesis bits above them, which keeps the request within its size.
    font_slope_and_synthesis: u8,
    font_size_adjust: FontSizeAdjustKind,
    font_size_adjust_metric: u8,
}

impl FontRequestScalars {
    fn of(request: &FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> Self {
        Self {
            font_size_raw: request.font_size_raw,
            font_weight: request.font_weight.to_bits(),
            font_width: request.font_width.to_bits(),
            font_size_adjust_value: request.font_size_adjust_value.to_bits(),
            font_oblique_angle: (request.font_oblique_angle as f32).to_bits(),
            font_feature_values_scope: request.font_feature_values_scope,
            font_optical_sizing: request.font_optical_sizing,
            font_slope_and_synthesis: (request.font_slope as u8 & 3) | (request.font_synthesis << 2),
            font_size_adjust: request.font_size_adjust,
            font_size_adjust_metric: request.font_size_adjust_metric,
        }
    }
}

/// A hash of the identities of the values `request` names and of its scalars, which the cache
/// finds its resolutions by.
fn request_identity_hash(request: &FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> u64 {
    use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
    let mut hasher = crate::fast_hash::fast_hasher();
    request.font_family.address.hash(&mut hasher);
    for value in request.font_feature_values {
        value.address.hash(&mut hasher);
    }
    FontRequestScalars::of(request).hash(&mut hasher);
    hasher.finish()
}

/// The value a request names by `handle`, or none for a null one.
fn requested_value(handle: FfiHostHandle) -> Option<&'static crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData> {
    // SAFETY: A request names live style values for as long as it is asked about.
    (!handle.as_pointer().is_null())
        .then(|| unsafe { &*handle.as_pointer().cast::<crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData>() })
}

/// A hash of the content of the values a request names.
fn request_content_hash(request: &FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> u64 {
    let mut hash =
        requested_value(request.font_family).map_or(0, crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData::content_hash);
    for value in request.font_feature_values {
        hash = hash.rotate_left(7)
            ^ requested_value(value).map_or(0, crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData::content_hash);
    }
    hash
}

/// A request for a font, which holds the values it names alive for their identities, with its
/// scalars and the generation of the font environment it was made for.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct FontRequest {
    family: RetainedStyleValueData,
    /// The feature values, each empty where the property has its initial value, boxed only where
    /// any is set: most requests name none.
    feature_values: Option<Box<[RetainedStyleValueData; FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT]>>,
    scalars: FontRequestScalars,
    generation: u64,
}

const _: () = assert!(size_of::<FontRequest>() <= 64);

impl FontRequest {
    pub fn new(ffi: FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> Self {
        let retain = |handle: FfiHostHandle| {
            if handle.as_pointer().is_null() {
                return RetainedStyleValueData::none();
            }
            // SAFETY: A request names live style values, a reference to which this takes.
            unsafe { RetainedStyleValueData::from_retained_pointer(retain_style_value(handle.as_pointer().cast())) }
        };
        let names_feature_values = ffi
            .font_feature_values
            .iter()
            .any(|value| !value.as_pointer().is_null());
        Self {
            family: retain(ffi.font_family),
            feature_values: names_feature_values.then(|| Box::new(ffi.font_feature_values.map(retain))),
            scalars: FontRequestScalars::of(&ffi),
            generation: ffi.font_environment_generation,
        }
    }

    /// The request, made for the font environment of `generation`.
    pub fn for_generation(mut self, generation: u64) -> Self {
        self.generation = generation;
        self
    }

    /// The generation of the font environment the request was made for.
    pub fn generation(&self) -> u64 {
        self.generation
    }

    /// The request as the host resolves it, naming the values this holds.
    fn ffi(&self) -> FfiFontResolutionRequest {
        let handle = |value: &RetainedStyleValueData| FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(value.pointer().cast());
        let scalars = self.scalars;
        FfiFontResolutionRequest {
            font_family: handle(&self.family),
            font_feature_values: match &self.feature_values {
                Some(values) => std::array::from_fn(|index| handle(&values[index])),
                None => [FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(std::ptr::null()); FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT],
            },
            font_size_raw: scalars.font_size_raw,
            font_slope: i32::from(scalars.font_slope_and_synthesis & 3),
            font_weight: f64::from_bits(scalars.font_weight),
            font_width: f64::from_bits(scalars.font_width),
            font_optical_sizing: scalars.font_optical_sizing,
            font_oblique_angle: f64::from(f32::from_bits(scalars.font_oblique_angle)),
            font_synthesis: scalars.font_slope_and_synthesis >> 2,
            font_size_adjust: scalars.font_size_adjust,
            font_size_adjust_metric: scalars.font_size_adjust_metric,
            font_size_adjust_value: f64::from_bits(scalars.font_size_adjust_value),
            font_feature_values_scope: scalars.font_feature_values_scope,
            font_environment_generation: self.generation,
        }
    }

    /// The feature value at `index`, or none where the request names none.
    fn feature_value(&self, index: usize) -> Option<&crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData> {
        self.feature_values.as_ref()?[index].optional_data()
    }

    /// Whether the request names the values `request` names, by identity, and has its scalars:
    /// it is the same request, whatever generation either was made for.
    fn is(&self, request: &FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> bool {
        self.scalars == FontRequestScalars::of(request)
            && self.family.pointer() as usize == request.font_family.address
            && (0..FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT).all(|index| {
                self.feature_values
                    .as_ref()
                    .map_or(0, |values| values[index].pointer() as usize)
                    == request.font_feature_values[index].address
            })
    }

    /// Whether the request names values equal to those `request` names, by whatever identities,
    /// and has its scalars.
    fn names_values_equal_to(&self, request: &FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> bool {
        self.scalars == FontRequestScalars::of(request)
            && self.family.optional_data() == requested_value(request.font_family)
            && (0..FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT)
                .all(|index| self.feature_value(index) == requested_value(request.font_feature_values[index]))
    }
}

/// One resolution: the request it answers and what the host resolved it to.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct FontResolution {
    request: FontRequest,
    ffi: FfiResolvedFont,
}

/// A reference to a cascade, which a cache only holds.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct HeldFontCascadeList(#[allow(dead_code)] libgfx_rust::font::FontCascadeListHandle);

// SAFETY: A `Gfx::FontCascadeList` counts its references atomically, and the holder never reads it: the reference only
// keeps it alive, and is taken and given up on any thread.
unsafe impl Send for HeldFontCascadeList {}
unsafe impl Sync for HeldFontCascadeList {}

/// The resolutions of one generation, with the indices a lookup finds them by.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct FontResolutions {
    /// Each holding its request once.
    resolutions: Vec<FontResolution>,
    /// The resolutions by the hash of their requests' identities.
    by_identity: HashMap<u64, SmallVec<[u32; 1]>>,
    /// The resolutions by the content of the values their requests name, for a request naming
    /// equal values by other identities.
    by_content: HashMap<u64, SmallVec<[u32; 1]>>,
}

impl FontResolutions {
    fn heap_size(&self) -> usize {
        use crate::heap_size::{map_bytes, small_vec_bytes, vec_bytes};
        vec_bytes(&self.resolutions)
            + self
                .resolutions
                .iter()
                .filter(|resolution| resolution.request.feature_values.is_some())
                .count()
                * size_of::<[RetainedStyleValueData; FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT]>()
            + map_bytes(&self.by_identity)
            + self.by_identity.values().map(small_vec_bytes).sum::<usize>()
            + map_bytes(&self.by_content)
            + self.by_content.values().map(small_vec_bytes).sum::<usize>()
    }

    /// The resolution of `request`, made for its very values.
    fn find(&self, request: &FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> Option<&FontResolution> {
        self.by_identity
            .get(&request_identity_hash(request))?
            .iter()
            .map(|&index| &self.resolutions[index as usize])
            .find(|resolution| resolution.request.is(request))
    }
}

/// The resolutions this document has already been given, keyed by content and scoped to one
/// font-environment generation. This is retained engine state: an evaluation step reads it and
/// never calls the host.
///
/// It names the cascades it was given without holding a reference to any of them. The host's
/// cascade memo keeps every cascade it resolves alive until it publishes the font faces of a later
/// generation, which empties the cache, and a lookup answers only for the generation the cache was
/// filled at. So the engine never gives up the last reference to a `Gfx::FontCascadeList`, whose
/// destructor releases fonts into host caches, and nothing in the cache stops it from moving to
/// another thread.
///
/// A fork of the render state shares the resolutions until either side writes, and sees no
/// publication, so its cache holds a reference of its own to each cascade they name instead. See
/// [`Self::hold_cascades_for_fork`].
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(super) struct FontResolutionCache {
    generation: Option<u64>,
    resolutions: ForkShared<FontResolutions>,
    /// Whether a lookup finds a resolution made for equal values by other identities, which a
    /// style pass needs: it computes the values its requests name anew each time.
    matches_by_content: bool,
    /// The references a fork's cache holds to the cascades its resolutions name, and none in the
    /// cache of the render state the host writes.
    held_cascades: Option<Vec<HeldFontCascadeList>>,
    /// The requests the earlier generations resolved, which the next one is likely to be asked
    /// for again.
    carried: Vec<FontRequest>,
    /// The shadow tree scopes whose own `@font-feature-values` the published table carries.
    feature_values_shadow_scopes: Box<[TreeScopeID]>,
}

impl FontResolutionCache {
    /// The bytes the cache holds on the heap, but for the values its requests name, which their
    /// declarations and records hold too.
    pub(super) fn heap_size(&self) -> usize {
        use crate::heap_size::vec_bytes;
        self.resolutions.heap_size()
            + self.held_cascades.as_ref().map_or(0, vec_bytes)
            + vec_bytes(&self.carried)
            + size_of_val::<[TreeScopeID]>(&self.feature_values_shadow_scopes)
    }

    pub fn matches_by_content(&self) -> bool {
        self.matches_by_content
    }

    pub fn set_matches_by_content(&mut self, matches_by_content: bool) {
        self.matches_by_content = matches_by_content;
    }

    pub fn publish_feature_values_shadow_scopes(&mut self, scopes: Box<[TreeScopeID]>) {
        self.feature_values_shadow_scopes = scopes;
    }

    pub fn feature_values_shadow_scopes(&self) -> &[TreeScopeID] {
        &self.feature_values_shadow_scopes
    }

    /// Has the cache of a fork of the render state hold a reference to each cascade it names, the shared resolutions'
    /// and those it resolves from here on: the host frees the cascades of a generation once it publishes the next,
    /// which the fork never sees. The fork resolves what the state it forked resolved as that state did, at the
    /// generation of its inputs, whatever the host's font environment moved to since.
    pub fn hold_cascades_for_fork(&mut self) {
        if self.held_cascades.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let held = self
            .resolutions
            .resolutions
            .iter()
            .map(|resolution| {
                // SAFETY: The host keeps the cascades of the generation the cache was filled at alive until it
                //         publishes the font faces of the next, which empties the cache first.
                HeldFontCascadeList(unsafe {
                    libgfx_rust::font::FontCascadeListHandle::retain(resolution.ffi.font_cascade_list.as_pointer())
                })
            })
            .collect();
        self.held_cascades = Some(held);
    }

    /// Forget every resolution, as the host published the font faces of a later generation: it frees the cascades of
    /// the earlier ones from here on.
    pub fn forget_earlier_generations(&mut self) {
        self.generation = None;
        self.carry_requests();
    }

    pub fn prepare(&mut self, generation: u64) {
        if self.generation != Some(generation) {
            self.carry_requests();
            self.generation = Some(generation);
        }
    }

    /// Forget every resolution, keeping the requests they answered.
    fn carry_requests(&mut self) {
        let resolutions = self.resolutions.take();
        self.carried
            .extend(resolutions.resolutions.into_iter().map(|resolution| resolution.request));
        if let Some(held) = &mut self.held_cascades {
            held.clear();
        }
    }

    /// Take the requests the earlier generations resolved, which no resolution of this one
    /// answers yet.
    pub fn take_carried_requests(&mut self) -> Vec<FontRequest> {
        // NB: A request carried over several generations is carried once for each, the latest last.
        let mut taken: HashMap<u64, SmallVec<[usize; 1]>> = HashMap::default();
        let mut requests: Vec<FontRequest> = Vec::new();
        for request in std::mem::take(&mut self.carried).into_iter().rev() {
            let ffi = request.ffi();
            if self.resolutions.find(&ffi).is_some() {
                continue;
            }
            let same = taken.entry(request_identity_hash(&ffi)).or_default();
            if same.iter().any(|&index| requests[index].is(&ffi)) {
                continue;
            }
            same.push(requests.len());
            requests.push(request);
        }
        requests.reverse();
        requests
    }

    pub fn lookup(&self, request: FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> Option<FfiResolvedFont> {
        if self.generation != Some(request.font_environment_generation) {
            return None;
        }
        if let Some(resolution) = self.resolutions.find(&request) {
            return Some(resolution.ffi);
        }
        if !self.matches_by_content {
            return None;
        }
        // A family or feature value equal to one a resolution was made for resolves the same.
        let candidates = self.resolutions.by_content.get(&request_content_hash(&request))?;
        candidates.iter().find_map(|&index| {
            let resolution = &self.resolutions.resolutions[index as usize];
            resolution
                .request
                .names_values_equal_to(&request)
                .then_some(resolution.ffi)
        })
    }

    /// Takes in what the threads of a pass resolved. Nothing waits on the requests carried from the generations before
    /// any more: a pass resolves what it asks for. Answers how many fonts they resolved.
    pub(super) fn take_in_pass_fonts(&mut self, pass_fonts: PassFonts) -> usize {
        let mut resolved = pass_fonts.into_resolved();
        let Some(generation) = resolved.generation else {
            return 0;
        };
        self.prepare(generation);
        self.carried.clear();
        if let (Some(held), Some(resolved_held)) = (&mut self.held_cascades, resolved.held_cascades) {
            held.extend(resolved_held);
        }
        let resolutions = resolved.resolutions.take().resolutions;
        let count = resolutions.len();
        for resolution in resolutions {
            self.insert(resolution.request, resolution.ffi, None);
        }
        count
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, request: FontRequest, ffi: FfiResolvedFont, font_cascade_list: Option<HeldFontCascadeList>) {
        // The host resolves every request, to the fallback font where nothing else matches, so the
        // resolution always names a list.
        debug_assert!(!ffi.font_cascade_list.is_none());
        if let (Some(held), Some(font_cascade_list)) = (&mut self.held_cascades, font_cascade_list) {
            held.push(font_cascade_list);
        }
        let request_ffi = request.ffi();
        let identity_hash = request_identity_hash(&request_ffi);
        let resolutions = &mut *self.resolutions;
        let resolution = FontResolution { request, ffi };
        let same_request = resolutions.by_identity.get(&identity_hash).and_then(|indices| {
            indices
                .iter()
                .copied()
                .find(|&index| resolutions.resolutions[index as usize].request.is(&request_ffi))
        });
        if let Some(index) = same_request {
            resolutions.resolutions[index as usize] = resolution;
            return;
        }
        let index = u32::try_from(resolutions.resolutions.len()).expect("a document resolves fewer than 2^32 fonts");
        resolutions.resolutions.push(resolution);
        resolutions.by_identity.entry(identity_hash).or_default().push(index);
        resolutions
            .by_content
            .entry(request_content_hash(&request_ffi))
            .or_default()
            .push(index);
    }
}

/// A `Web::CSS::FontFaceSnapshot`, which Rust only names by pointer.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone)]
struct FontFaceSnapshotObject {
    _opaque: [u8; 0],
    _not_send_or_sync: std::marker::PhantomData<*const ()>,
}

// SAFETY: The snapshot is immutable once built and counts its references atomically, so a shared
// reference to one may be read, taken and given up on any thread.
unsafe impl Sync for FontFaceSnapshotObject {}

/// A `Web::CSS::FontCascadeMemo`, which Rust only names by pointer.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone)]
struct FontCascadeMemoObject {
    _opaque: [u8; 0],
    _not_send_or_sync: std::marker::PhantomData<*const ()>,
}

// SAFETY: The memo counts its references atomically, so a shared reference to it may be taken and
// given up on any thread. Resolving through it reads the document's font face state, which the
// memo's lock does not cover, so only `FontResolverHost::refill` resolves, on one thread at a time:
// the one running the rounds of a pass, or a thread of a pass holding the lock of `PassFonts`.
unsafe impl Sync for FontCascadeMemoObject {}

/// One reference to a host object, given up on drop. It may cross threads exactly when the object
/// may be shared between them.
struct HostReference<T> {
    object: HostShared<T>,
    reference: unsafe extern "C" fn(*const c_void),
    unreference: unsafe extern "C" fn(*const c_void),
}

impl<T> HostReference<T> {
    /// # Safety
    /// `object` must be a live `T`, with one reference this takes over and `unreference` gives up.
    unsafe fn adopt(
        object: *const c_void,
        reference: unsafe extern "C" fn(*const c_void),
        unreference: unsafe extern "C" fn(*const c_void),
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            object: HostShared::new(object.cast()),
            reference,
            unreference,
        }
    }

    fn as_ptr(&self) -> *const c_void {
        self.object.as_ptr().cast()
    }
}

/// A fork holds its own reference.
impl<T> Clone for HostReference<T> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: This owns one reference, so the object is live.
        unsafe { (self.reference)(self.as_ptr()) };
        Self {
            object: self.object,
            reference: self.reference,
            unreference: self.unreference,
        }
    }
}

impl<T> Drop for HostReference<T> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: This owns one reference, taken in `adopt`.
        unsafe { (self.unreference)(self.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

/// The document's `@font-face` table as published, and the memo of the cascades resolved from it:
/// one reference to each host object.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct PublishedFontFaces {
    snapshot: HostReference<FontFaceSnapshotObject>,
    memo: HostReference<FontCascadeMemoObject>,
}

impl PublishedFontFaces {
    /// # Safety
    /// `snapshot` and `memo` must be a live `Web::CSS::FontFaceSnapshot` and `FontCascadeMemo`, one
    /// reference to each of which this takes over.
    pub(super) unsafe fn adopt(snapshot: *const c_void, memo: *const c_void) -> Self {
        unsafe {
            Self {
                snapshot: HostReference::adopt(
                    snapshot,
                    web_css_font_face_snapshot_reference,
                    web_css_font_face_snapshot_unreference,
                ),
                memo: HostReference::adopt(
                    memo,
                    web_css_font_cascade_memo_reference,
                    web_css_font_cascade_memo_unreference,
                ),
            }
        }
    }
}

/// The host's synchronous font resolver and the table it resolves against. This is host state, which
/// one thread at a time may call.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct FontResolverHost {
    resolve: ResolveFontCallback,
    /// Resolves for a fork's cache, handing over a reference to the cascade.
    resolve_for_fork: ResolveFontCallback,
    font_faces: PublishedFontFaces,
}

impl FontResolverHost {
    pub(super) fn new(font_faces: PublishedFontFaces) -> Self {
        Self::with_callbacks(web_css_resolve_font, web_css_resolve_font_for_fork, font_faces)
    }

    pub(super) fn with_callbacks(
        resolve: ResolveFontCallback,
        resolve_for_fork: ResolveFontCallback,
        font_faces: PublishedFontFaces,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            resolve,
            resolve_for_fork,
            font_faces,
        }
    }

    /// The table the document published last, which every later resolution reads.
    pub(super) fn publish(&mut self, font_faces: PublishedFontFaces) {
        self.font_faces = font_faces;
    }

    /// Service a synchronous request: a memo miss
    /// builds and freezes a cascade from the document's font face state. Pending web faces remain
    /// in the returned cascade and retain the host's rendering-triggered loading behavior.
    pub fn refill(&self, cache: &mut FontResolutionCache, request: FontRequest) {
        cache.prepare(request.generation);
        let resolve = if cache.held_cascades.is_some() {
            self.resolve_for_fork
        } else {
            self.resolve
        };
        let ffi = unsafe {
            resolve(
                self.font_faces.memo.as_ptr(),
                self.font_faces.snapshot.as_ptr(),
                request.ffi(),
            )
        };
        // SAFETY: A fork's resolution hands over a reference to the cascade it names.
        let font_cascade_list = cache.held_cascades.is_some().then(|| {
            HeldFontCascadeList(unsafe {
                libgfx_rust::font::FontCascadeListHandle::adopt(ffi.font_cascade_list.as_pointer())
            })
        });
        cache.insert(request, ffi, font_cascade_list);
    }
}

/// The fonts the threads of a style pass resolve as they first ask for them, one thread at a time under the lock, the
/// others going on with what they have. What they resolve joins the cache as the pass ends.
pub(super) struct PassFonts {
    resolver: FontResolverHost,
    resolved: std::sync::RwLock<FontResolutionCache>,
}

impl PassFonts {
    /// What a pass reading `cache` resolves through `resolver`.
    pub(super) fn new(resolver: &FontResolverHost, cache: &FontResolutionCache) -> Self {
        Self {
            resolver: resolver.clone(),
            resolved: std::sync::RwLock::new(FontResolutionCache {
                matches_by_content: cache.matches_by_content,
                held_cascades: cache.held_cascades.as_ref().map(|_| Vec::new()),
                ..Default::default()
            }),
        }
    }

    /// The resolution of `request`, resolved now where no thread of the pass did yet.
    pub(super) fn resolve(&self, request: FfiFontResolutionRequest) -> FfiResolvedFont {
        let lock_failed = "no thread panicked while resolving a font";
        if let Some(resolved) = self.resolved.read().expect(lock_failed).lookup(request) {
            return resolved;
        }
        let mut resolved = self.resolved.write().expect(lock_failed);
        if let Some(resolution) = resolved.lookup(request) {
            return resolution;
        }
        self.resolver.refill(&mut resolved, FontRequest::new(request));
        resolved.lookup(request).expect("a resolved request has its resolution")
    }

    /// What the pass resolved.
    fn into_resolved(self) -> FontResolutionCache {
        self.resolved
            .into_inner()
            .expect("no thread panicked while resolving a font")
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::style_compute::ffi_test_stubs::font_cascade_list_unref_count;
    use crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

    static RESOLVES: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);

    unsafe extern "C" fn resolve_font(
        _memo: *const c_void,
        _snapshot: *const c_void,
        _request: FfiFontResolutionRequest,
    ) -> FfiResolvedFont {
        RESOLVES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        FfiResolvedFont {
            first_available_font: crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(std::ptr::dangling()),
            font_cascade_list: crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(std::ptr::dangling()),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn font_resolution_cache_is_engine_owned_and_generation_scoped() {
        RESOLVES.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let unrefs_before = font_cascade_list_unref_count();
        let family = RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: 1 });
        let host = FontResolverHost::with_callbacks(resolve_font, resolve_font, unsafe {
            PublishedFontFaces::adopt(std::ptr::dangling(), std::ptr::dangling())
        });
        let mut resolver = FontResolutionCache::default();
        let mut request = FfiFontResolutionRequest {
            font_family: crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(family.pointer().cast()),
            font_feature_values: [crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(std::ptr::null());
                FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT],
            font_size_raw: 1024,
            font_slope: 0,
            font_weight: 400.0,
            font_width: 100.0,
            font_optical_sizing: 0,
            font_oblique_angle: 14.0,
            font_synthesis: 0,
            font_size_adjust: FontSizeAdjustKind::None,
            font_size_adjust_metric: 0,
            font_size_adjust_value: 0.0,
            font_feature_values_scope: 0,
            font_environment_generation: 1,
        };

        resolver.prepare(1);
        assert!(resolver.lookup(request).is_none());
        assert_eq!(RESOLVES.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 0);
        host.refill(&mut resolver, FontRequest::new(request));
        let first = resolver.lookup(request).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            resolver.lookup(request).unwrap().font_cascade_list,
            first.font_cascade_list
        );
        assert_eq!(RESOLVES.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
        assert_eq!(font_cascade_list_unref_count(), unrefs_before);

        request.font_environment_generation = 2;
        assert!(resolver.lookup(request).is_none());
        resolver.prepare(2);
        assert_eq!(font_cascade_list_unref_count(), unrefs_before);
        host.refill(&mut resolver, FontRequest::new(request));
        resolver.lookup(request).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(RESOLVES.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 2);
        assert_eq!(font_cascade_list_unref_count(), unrefs_before);

        // The host's memo owns the cascades, so neither a new generation nor dropping the cache
        // gives up a reference.
        drop(resolver);
        assert_eq!(font_cascade_list_unref_count(), unrefs_before);
    }

    unsafe extern "C" fn resolve_font_uncounted(
        _memo: *const c_void,
        _snapshot: *const c_void,
        _request: FfiFontResolutionRequest,
    ) -> FfiResolvedFont {
        FfiResolvedFont {
            first_available_font: crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(std::ptr::dangling()),
            font_cascade_list: crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(std::ptr::dangling()),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_forks_cache_answers_what_it_copied_and_holds_the_cascades() {
        let unrefs_before = font_cascade_list_unref_count();
        let family = RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword: 2 });
        let host = FontResolverHost::with_callbacks(resolve_font_uncounted, resolve_font_uncounted, unsafe {
            PublishedFontFaces::adopt(std::ptr::dangling(), std::ptr::dangling())
        });
        let mut resolver = FontResolutionCache::default();
        let request = FfiFontResolutionRequest {
            font_family: crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(family.pointer().cast()),
            font_feature_values: [crate::css::style::bridge::FfiHostHandle::from_pointer(std::ptr::null());
                FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT],
            font_size_raw: 2048,
            font_slope: 0,
            font_weight: 700.0,
            font_width: 100.0,
            font_optical_sizing: 0,
            font_oblique_angle: 14.0,
            font_synthesis: 0,
            font_size_adjust: FontSizeAdjustKind::None,
            font_size_adjust_metric: 0,
            font_size_adjust_value: 0.0,
            font_feature_values_scope: 0,
            font_environment_generation: 1,
        };
        host.refill(&mut resolver, FontRequest::new(request));
        assert!(resolver.lookup(request).is_some());

        // The fork answers what the cache it copied answered, holding a reference to each cascade, which the host frees
        // once it publishes another generation.
        let mut fork = resolver.clone();
        fork.hold_cascades_for_fork();
        assert!(fork.lookup(request).is_some());
        assert_eq!(font_cascade_list_unref_count(), unrefs_before);
        drop(fork);
        assert_eq!(font_cascade_list_unref_count(), unrefs_before + 1);
        drop(resolver);
        assert_eq!(font_cascade_list_unref_count(), unrefs_before + 1);
    }
}

//! The atoms a document's host interned for its engine, and what it worked out of the attribute names among them. The
//! host asks again for every attribute name and value it publishes, so a name it interned before is answered on the
//! host's own thread, without a lock or a write to the engine: one hash lookup on the name's raw identity.

use super::atoms::{AtomLease, ReclaimedStyleAtom};
use super::engine_calls::{EngineWrite, with_engine};
use super::index::{AttributeNameForms, StyleAtomID};
use crate::css::declaration_block::SharedDeclarationBlock;
use crate::css::ffi_support::{FfiUtf16View, ascii_lowercase};
use crate::css::parser::arbitrary_substitution::AttrNamesRead;
use crate::css::retained_fly_string::RetainedUtf16FlyString;
use crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData;
use crate::fast_hash::{FastMap, FastSet};
use crate::render_state::{ArenaChange, BegunRead, DocumentHost};

/// What the host interned for its document's engine.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct HostAtoms {
    /// The atom of each name the host interned, by the name's raw identity, with a reference to the name: while the
    /// atom is here, no other string can take the identity.
    names: FastMap<usize, (StyleAtomID, RetainedUtf16FlyString)>,
    /// How many times the engine reclaimed atoms, which a cache the host keys by atoms is only good for one of.
    generation: u64,
    /// The languages whose tag the engine was given.
    languages_with_text: FastSet<StyleAtomID>,
    /// The name each attribute is published under, by its local name and its namespace, none for no namespace.
    attribute_names: FastMap<(StyleAtomID, StyleAtomID), StyleAtomID>,
    /// What the host published of each attribute name.
    published_attribute_names: FastMap<StyleAtomID, PublishedAttributeName>,
    /// The attribute names the host knows nothing reads the value text of, as of the engine's requirements numbered
    /// `value_text_requirements`.
    names_with_unread_value_text: FastSet<StyleAtomID>,
    value_text_requirements: u64,
    /// The values the host withheld the text of, by the attribute name they were published under, each by its atom with
    /// the raw identity of what it spells, which `names` holds a reference to while the atom lives: what the host hands
    /// the engine for exactly the names something comes to read, without asking the document again.
    withheld_value_texts: FastMap<StyleAtomID, FastMap<StyleAtomID, usize>>,
    /// The attribute names something reads the value text of. What selectors and `attr()`s read only grows, so this
    /// holds until the engine reclaims a name.
    names_with_read_value_text: FastSet<StyleAtomID>,
    /// The attribute names something reads. What selectors and `attr()`s read only grows, so this holds until the
    /// engine reclaims a name.
    names_read: FastSet<StyleAtomID>,
    /// The attribute names the host knows nothing reads, as of the selectors its last job left, which the host forgets
    /// when they move, and as of the `attr()` names read generation `names_unread_attr_generation`.
    names_known_unread: FastSet<StyleAtomID>,
    names_unread_attr_generation: u64,
    /// What the `attr()`s of the declarations the host handed the engine can read.
    attr_names_read: AttrNamesRead,
}

/// The other names an attribute name answers to, and the local name an `attr()` reads it by where it is in no namespace.
struct PublishedAttributeName {
    forms: AttributeNameForms,
    substitution_name: Option<Box<[u16]>>,
}

impl HostAtoms {
    /// The bytes the atoms' tables hold on the heap, but for the names, which the host's strings hold.
    pub(crate) fn heap_size(&self) -> usize {
        use crate::heap_size::{map_bytes, set_bytes};
        map_bytes(&self.names)
            + self.attr_names_read.heap_size()
            + set_bytes(&self.languages_with_text)
            + map_bytes(&self.attribute_names)
            + map_bytes(&self.published_attribute_names)
            + self
                .published_attribute_names
                .values()
                .filter_map(|name| name.substitution_name.as_deref())
                .map(size_of_val::<[u16]>)
                .sum::<usize>()
            + set_bytes(&self.names_with_unread_value_text)
            + map_bytes(&self.withheld_value_texts)
            + self.withheld_value_texts.values().map(map_bytes).sum::<usize>()
            + set_bytes(&self.names_with_read_value_text)
            + set_bytes(&self.names_read)
            + set_bytes(&self.names_known_unread)
    }

    /// Forgets the atoms the engine reclaimed, whose numbers may name other names from now on.
    pub(crate) fn forget(&mut self, reclaimed: &[ReclaimedStyleAtom]) {
        if reclaimed.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        for reclaimed in reclaimed {
            // NB: The engine names the raw identity of every name it reclaimed, whether or not the host interned it.
            if let Some((atom, _)) = self.names.remove(&reclaimed.raw) {
                debug_assert_eq!(atom, reclaimed.atom);
            }
        }
        let reclaimed: FastSet<StyleAtomID> = reclaimed.iter().map(|reclaimed| reclaimed.atom).collect();
        self.languages_with_text
            .retain(|language| !reclaimed.contains(language));
        self.attribute_names
            .retain(|&(local, namespace), name| ![local, namespace, *name].iter().any(|atom| reclaimed.contains(atom)));
        self.published_attribute_names
            .retain(|name, _| !reclaimed.contains(name));
        self.names_with_unread_value_text
            .retain(|name| !reclaimed.contains(name));
        self.names_with_read_value_text.retain(|name| !reclaimed.contains(name));
        self.withheld_value_texts.retain(|name, values| {
            values.retain(|value, _| !reclaimed.contains(value));
            !reclaimed.contains(name) && !values.is_empty()
        });
        self.names_read.retain(|name| !reclaimed.contains(name));
        self.names_known_unread.retain(|name| !reclaimed.contains(name));
        self.generation += 1;
    }
}

/// The atom of the name whose raw identity is `raw`: the one the host interned it as, or else a reference the host
/// takes to the name's process-global atom, which the engine adopts as it applies the host's writes.
///
/// # Safety
/// `raw` must be the raw identity of a live `AK::Utf16FlyString`.
pub(crate) unsafe fn intern(host: &DocumentHost, raw: usize) -> StyleAtomID {
    let atoms = &host.engine_memo().atoms;
    if let Some(&(atom, _)) = atoms.borrow().names.get(&raw) {
        return atom;
    }
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let (lease, name) = unsafe {
        (
            AtomLease::acquire_raw(host.style_atoms(), raw),
            RetainedUtf16FlyString::from_borrowed_raw(raw),
        )
    };
    let atom = adopt(host, lease);
    atoms.borrow_mut().names.insert(raw, (atom, name));
    atom
}

/// The atom of `name` qualified by `namespace`, which the engine adopts as it does a name's.
fn intern_qualified(host: &DocumentHost, namespace: StyleAtomID, name: StyleAtomID) -> StyleAtomID {
    adopt(host, AtomLease::acquire_qualified(host.style_atoms(), namespace, name))
}

/// Queues the engine's adoption of the atom `lease` holds, and answers the atom.
fn adopt(host: &DocumentHost, lease: AtomLease) -> StyleAtomID {
    let atom = lease.atom();
    host.queue_change(ArenaChange::Engine(EngineWrite::AdoptAtom(lease)));
    atom
}

/// Interns the name whose raw identity is `raw` for the document.
///
/// # Safety
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, and `raw` the raw identity of a live
/// `AK::Utf16FlyString`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn document_host_intern_atom(host: &DocumentHost, raw: usize) -> u32 {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { intern(host, raw) }.0
}

/// How many times the engine reclaimed atoms the host interned, which tells apart what the host keyed by the atoms
/// before and after.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn document_host_atom_generation(host: &DocumentHost) -> u64 {
    host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow().generation
}

/// Records the language the element `node` resolves to, or none for no element. The first time the host names a
/// language, the engine is also given its tag: a range is not a name, so `:lang()` compares against the tag itself.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn style_engine_set_element_language(host: &DocumentHost, node: u32, language: u32, text: FfiUtf16View) {
    let tag_is_new = language != 0
        && !text.is_empty()
        && host
            .engine_memo()
            .atoms
            .borrow_mut()
            .languages_with_text
            .insert(StyleAtomID(language));
    let mut projection = host.engine_memo().projection.borrow_mut();
    let mut writes = projection.writes();
    if tag_is_new {
        // A range is not a name, so `:lang()` compares against the tag itself. It is recorded once per language
        // rather than once per element.
        writes.set_language_text(StyleAtomID(language), &text.to_utf16().unwrap_or_default());
    }
    if let Some(node) = super::tree::StyleNodeID::from_raw(node) {
        writes.set_element_language(node, StyleAtomID(language));
    }
}

/// Interns the name an attribute in `namespace` called `local_name` is published under, and has the engine know the
/// other names it answers to.
///
/// Three selectors ask three different questions of an attribute called `x`. `[ns|x]` reaches only the one in that
/// namespace, `[x]` reaches only the one in no namespace - which is what the bare local name is - and `[*|x]` reaches
/// whichever of them the element carries. The first two name exactly one of an element's attributes, so they are the
/// key: an element can hold `x` in several namespaces at once, and each is a fact with its own value. `[*|x]` asks
/// about all of them together, so the shared form is published as an identity of the name rather than as a fact of
/// its own, and one entry per attribute answers all three. Demand expansion revisits every live attribute, so the
/// forms are worked out once per name.
///
/// # Safety
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, `local_name` the raw identity of a live
/// `AK::Utf16FlyString`, and `namespace` that of a live non-empty one, or zero for no namespace.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn document_host_intern_attribute_name(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    local_name: usize,
    namespace: usize,
) -> u32 {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let local = unsafe { intern(host, local_name) };
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let namespace = if namespace == 0 {
        StyleAtomID::NONE
    } else {
        unsafe { intern(host, namespace) }
    };
    if let Some(name) = host
        .engine_memo()
        .atoms
        .borrow()
        .attribute_names
        .get(&(local, namespace))
    {
        return name.0;
    }
    let in_namespace = |name| {
        if namespace.is_none() {
            name
        } else {
            intern_qualified(host, namespace, name)
        }
    };
    let name = in_namespace(local);
    // `[*|x]` names an attribute in any namespace, which no interned namespace is: none keys it.
    let mut forms = AttributeNameForms {
        local: intern_qualified(host, StyleAtomID::NONE, local),
        ..AttributeNameForms::default()
    };
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let local_name: Box<[u16]> = match unsafe { ak::utf16_string_units(&local_name) } {
        ak::Utf16StringUnits::Ascii(units) | ak::Utf16StringUnits::Latin1(units) => {
            units.iter().map(|&unit| u16::from(unit)).collect()
        }
        ak::Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(units) => units.into(),
    };
    if local_name.iter().any(|&unit| ascii_lowercase(unit) != unit) {
        let folded =
            ak::Utf16FlyString::from_utf16(&local_name.iter().copied().map(ascii_lowercase).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        // SAFETY: The folded name is live for the call.
        let folded_local = unsafe { intern(host, folded.raw_identity()) };
        forms.folded_name = in_namespace(folded_local);
        forms.folded_local = intern_qualified(host, StyleAtomID::NONE, folded_local);
    }
    // An attr() reads an attribute in no namespace by its local name.
    let substitution_name = namespace.is_none().then_some(local_name);
    {
        let mut projection = host.engine_memo().projection.borrow_mut();
        projection.note_attribute_name_forms(name, forms);
        if let Some(local_name) = &substitution_name {
            projection.note_attribute_substitution_name(name, local_name);
        }
    }
    let mut atoms = host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow_mut();
    atoms.published_attribute_names.insert(
        name,
        PublishedAttributeName {
            forms,
            substitution_name,
        },
    );
    atoms.attribute_names.insert((local, namespace), name);
    name.0
}

/// Interns the value of an attribute published under `name` whose raw identity is `value`, and hands the engine what
/// it spells unless the host knows that nothing reads the value text of `name`. The engine keeps the text only where
/// something reads it.
///
/// # Safety
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, `name` an attribute name the host interned, and
/// `value` the raw identity of a live `AK::Utf16FlyString`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn document_host_intern_attribute_value(host: &DocumentHost, name: u32, value: usize) -> u32 {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let atom = unsafe { intern(host, value) };
    let name = StyleAtomID(name);
    if value_text_is_known_unread(host, name) {
        // NB: The atom's entry in `names` holds what it spells for as long as the atom lives.
        host.engine_memo()
            .atoms
            .borrow_mut()
            .withheld_value_texts
            .entry(name)
            .or_default()
            .insert(atom, value);
    } else {
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        let text = unsafe { RetainedUtf16FlyString::from_borrowed_raw(value) };
        host.engine_memo()
            .projection
            .borrow_mut()
            .set_attribute_value_text(atom, text);
    }
    atom.0
}

/// Whether the host knows that nothing reads what the values of the attribute name `name` spell: no selector of the
/// engine, by `name` or the other forms the host published with it, and no `attr()`, by its local name if it has one.
/// The host knows what the selectors read where it queued no rule since its last job, and what `attr()`s read always,
/// as it hands the engine every declaration. Where it does not know, the host hands the engine each value's text, which the engine keeps only where
/// something reads it.
fn value_text_is_known_unread(host: &DocumentHost, name: StyleAtomID) -> bool {
    let atoms = host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow();
    if atoms.names_with_unread_value_text.contains(&name) {
        return true;
    }
    if atoms.names_with_read_value_text.contains(&name) {
        return false;
    }
    // The host interned every name it asks about, with its forms. Where it knows none, it hands the text over.
    let Some(PublishedAttributeName {
        forms,
        substitution_name,
    }) = atoms.published_attribute_names.get(&name)
    else {
        return false;
    };
    let read_by_attr = substitution_name
        .as_deref()
        .is_some_and(|name| atoms.attr_names_read.may_read(name));
    let read_by_selectors =
        host.known_selectors_read_value_text_of(&[name, forms.local, forms.folded_name, forms.folded_local]);
    drop(atoms);
    let mut atoms = host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow_mut();
    if read_by_attr || read_by_selectors == Some(true) {
        atoms.names_with_read_value_text.insert(name);
        return false;
    }
    let unread = read_by_selectors == Some(false);
    if unread {
        atoms.names_with_unread_value_text.insert(name);
    }
    unread
}

/// Brings what the host knows of the engine's selectors up to date with the writes it queued, where a rule it queued
/// since its last job left it not knowing: the host asks the engine, which applies them first.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn document_host_learn_selector_requirements(host: &DocumentHost, read: &BegunRead) {
    if host.known_selectors_test_local_link().is_none() {
        host.ask(read, |_| ());
    }
}

/// Whether the host knows that no selector of the engine tests `:local-link`, which spares it resolving the URL of each
/// link that arrives.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn document_host_local_link_is_known_untested(host: &DocumentHost) -> bool {
    host.known_selectors_test_local_link() == Some(false)
}

/// Whether the host knows that no selector of the engine tests `:valid`, `:invalid`, `:user-valid` or `:user-invalid`,
/// which spares it checking the constraints of a control as its value moves.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn document_host_validity_is_known_untested(host: &DocumentHost) -> bool {
    host.known_selectors_test_validity() == Some(false)
}

/// Whether the host knows that nothing of the engine reads the attribute name `name`: no selector tests it, by `name` or
/// the other forms the host published with it, and no `attr()` reads it, by its local name if it has one. Where it does
/// not know, the host hands the engine each change to the attribute.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn document_host_attribute_is_known_unread(host: &DocumentHost, name: u32) -> bool {
    let name = StyleAtomID(name);
    // The host knows nothing of the selectors where it queued a rule since its last job.
    if host
        .known_selector_attribute_value_text_requirements_version()
        .is_none()
    {
        return false;
    }
    let mut atoms = host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow_mut();
    let attr_generation = atoms.attr_names_read.generation();
    if atoms.names_read.contains(&name) {
        return false;
    }
    if atoms.names_unread_attr_generation != attr_generation {
        atoms.names_unread_attr_generation = attr_generation;
        atoms.names_known_unread.clear();
    } else if atoms.names_known_unread.contains(&name) {
        return true;
    }
    let Some(PublishedAttributeName {
        forms,
        substitution_name,
    }) = atoms.published_attribute_names.get(&name)
    else {
        return false;
    };
    let read = substitution_name
        .as_deref()
        .is_some_and(|name| atoms.attr_names_read.may_read(name))
        || host.known_selectors_test_attribute(&[name, forms.local, forms.folded_name, forms.folded_local])
            != Some(false);
    if read {
        atoms.names_read.insert(name);
    } else {
        atoms.names_known_unread.insert(name);
    }
    !read
}

/// Notes what the `attr()`s of the declarations `change` hands the engine can read. Every write of the host goes through
/// here on its way into the queue, and the matches name each write, so that a new write holding declarations has to say
/// so: an `attr()` nothing noted reads an attribute the host never handed over, as if it were absent.
pub(crate) fn note_attr_names_read_by_change(host: &DocumentHost, change: &ArenaChange) {
    use super::engine_calls::EngineWrite as Engine;
    use super::rule_writes::RuleWrite as Rule;
    match change {
        ArenaChange::Rule(write) => match write {
            Rule::PublishRules { rules, .. } => {
                for declarations in rules.iter().filter_map(|rule| rule.declarations.as_ref()) {
                    note_attr_names_read_by_block(host, declarations);
                }
            }
            Rule::RuleDeclarations {
                declarations: Some(declarations),
                ..
            } => note_attr_names_read_by_block(host, declarations),
            Rule::AddUserAgentSheet { source_identity, .. } => {
                let rules = crate::render_state::process_style().user_agent_rules();
                host.engine_memo()
                    .atoms
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .attr_names_read
                    .include(rules.attr_names_read(*source_identity));
            }
            Rule::RuleDeclarations { declarations: None, .. }
            | Rule::AddSheet { .. }
            | Rule::BeginSheetRulesReplacement(_)
            | Rule::ReplaceSelectors { .. }
            | Rule::RemoveRules(_)
            | Rule::RuleConditions(_)
            | Rule::LayerOrder { .. } => {}
        },
        ArenaChange::Engine(write) => match write {
            Engine::PresentationalHints { properties, .. } => {
                note_attr_names_read_by(host, properties.iter().map(|property| &*property.value));
            }
            Engine::AnimationEffectDescriptions { effects, .. } => {
                for effect in effects {
                    note_attr_names_read_by(host, effect.declared_values());
                }
            }
            Engine::PositionTryRules { row, .. } => {
                for rule in row.values() {
                    note_attr_names_read_by_block(host, rule.declarations());
                }
            }
            Engine::InlineCustomProperties { .. }
            | Engine::PublishFontFaces { .. }
            | Engine::ElementCustomPropertyData { .. }
            | Engine::PseudoElementCustomPropertyData { .. }
            | Engine::MintStyleNodes(_)
            | Engine::ElementUniqueNodeIds(_)
            | Engine::TextArrivals(_)
            | Engine::EndStyleUpdate { .. }
            | Engine::Publish(_)
            | Engine::MoveHover(_)
            | Engine::ShadowRoot { .. }
            | Engine::SlotAssignedNodes
            | Engine::TopLayerMove { .. }
            | Engine::BoxKindChange { .. }
            | Engine::RetireTexts(_)
            | Engine::TreeScopeRoot { .. }
            | Engine::TextData { .. }
            | Engine::AdoptAtom(_)
            | Engine::ParkRandomBaseValues { .. }
            | Engine::UnparkRandomBaseValues { .. }
            | Engine::NoteCustomPropertyEnvironment { .. }
            | Engine::AnimationKeyframes { .. }
            | Engine::CssDefinedAnimations { .. }
            | Engine::AnimationEffectTimings { .. } => {}
        },
        _ => {}
    }
}

/// Moves with every name an `attr()` the host handed the engine can newly read.
pub(crate) fn attr_names_read_generation(host: &DocumentHost) -> u64 {
    host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow().attr_names_read.generation()
}

/// Notes what the `attr()`s of `values`, which the host is handing the engine, can read.
pub(crate) fn note_attr_names_read_by<'v>(host: &DocumentHost, values: impl Iterator<Item = &'v StyleValueData>) {
    for value in values {
        if let Some(unresolved) = super::custom_property_cascade::unresolved_reading_attributes(value) {
            host.engine_memo()
                .atoms
                .borrow_mut()
                .attr_names_read
                .note(unresolved.components().as_ref());
        }
    }
}

/// Notes what the `attr()`s of the declarations of `block`, which the host is handing the engine, can read.
pub(crate) fn note_attr_names_read_by_block(host: &DocumentHost, block: &SharedDeclarationBlock) {
    note_attr_names_read_by(
        host,
        block
            .properties()
            .values()
            .iter()
            .chain(block.custom_properties().values())
            .map(|value| &**value),
    );
}

/// Notes what the `attr()`s of `values`, tokens the host is handing the engine, can read.
pub(crate) fn note_attr_names_read_by_tokens(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    values: &[crate::css::parser::component_value::ComponentValue],
) {
    host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow_mut().attr_names_read.note(values);
}

/// Forgets which attribute names the host knew nothing reads, once the engine's selectors test other names.
pub(crate) fn forget_attribute_names_known_unread(host: &DocumentHost) {
    host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow_mut().names_known_unread.clear();
}

/// Brings what the host knows of the engine's requirements of attribute value text up to date, and hands the engine
/// the text of every value the host withheld under a name something reads now: only those values, rather than every attribute
/// of the document again.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn document_host_refresh_attribute_value_text_requirements(host: &DocumentHost, read: &BegunRead) {
    // The host knows where the requirements are where it queued no rule since its last job.
    let selector_requirements = match host.known_selector_attribute_value_text_requirements_version() {
        Some(version) => version,
        None => with_engine(read, host, |engine| {
            engine.selector_attribute_value_text_requirements_version()
        }),
    };
    let withheld_names: Vec<StyleAtomID> = {
        let mut atoms = host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow_mut();
        let requirements = selector_requirements.wrapping_add(atoms.attr_names_read.generation());
        if requirements == atoms.value_text_requirements {
            return;
        }
        atoms.value_text_requirements = requirements;
        atoms.names_with_unread_value_text.clear();
        atoms.withheld_value_texts.keys().copied().collect()
    };
    for name in withheld_names {
        if value_text_is_known_unread(host, name) {
            continue;
        }
        let texts: Vec<(StyleAtomID, RetainedUtf16FlyString)> = {
            let mut atoms = host.engine_memo().atoms.borrow_mut();
            let Some(values) = atoms.withheld_value_texts.remove(&name) else {
                continue;
            };
            values
                .into_iter()
                .filter_map(|(value, raw)| {
                    let (atom, text) = atoms.names.get(&raw)?;
                    debug_assert_eq!(*atom, value, "a withheld value's atom lives as long as its name entry");
                    Some((value, text.clone()))
                })
                .collect()
        };
        let mut projection = host.engine_memo().projection.borrow_mut();
        for (value, text) in texts {
            projection.set_attribute_value_text(value, text);
        }
    }
}
