// SAFETY: The cache holds counted references to immutable groups, which any thread may read and
//         release, and only the thread styling with it reaches it.
unsafe impl Send for GroupCache {}

impl GroupCache {
    /// How many payloads a thread keeps before it starts over.
    const CAPACITY: usize = 4096;

    /// How many payloads a thread keeps from one pass to the next: what a restyle of a few
    /// elements finds again, without a large page's groups outliving its pass.
    const KEPT_ACROSS_PASSES: usize = 256;

    /// Counts the cache's tables and the groups only it holds toward the worker caches.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn report_memory(&self, report: &mut crate::css::style::memory_report::MemoryReport) {
        use crate::css::style::memory_report::MemoryOwner;
        use crate::heap_size::{map_bytes, vec_bytes};
        for entry in self.entries.values().flatten() {
            if report.sizer.first_sight(entry.payload) {
                let bytes = crate::css::computed_values::group_payload_allocation_bytes(entry.group, entry.payload);
                report.add(MemoryOwner::WorkerCaches, bytes);
            }
        }
        report.add(
            MemoryOwner::WorkerCaches,
            map_bytes(&self.entries) + vec_bytes(&self.key_values) + vec_bytes(&self.key_inputs),
        );
    }

    /// This cache, as a thread keeps it for its next pass: as it is where it holds few payloads,
    /// else empty.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn kept(mut self) -> Self {
        if self.count > Self::KEPT_ACROSS_PASSES {
            self.clear();
            return self;
        }
        // NB: A large pass leaves its room behind for the next one. Where the passes since have all been small, as an
        //     animation's are, the room goes back, and a large pass grows it again.
        self.small_passes = self.small_passes.saturating_add(1);
        if self.small_passes == Self::SMALL_PASSES_BEFORE_SHRINKING {
            self.trim();
        }
        self
    }

    /// How many small passes in a row give back the room a large pass left.
    const SMALL_PASSES_BEFORE_SHRINKING: u8 = 32;

    /// Lets go of the room the cache holds beyond its entries, which it keeps for the next pass: a few elements restyled
    /// later, as on hover, still find their payloads.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn trim(&mut self) {
        self.entries.shrink_to_fit();
        self.key_values.shrink_to_fit();
        self.key_inputs.shrink_to_fit();
    }

    /// How many lookups the hit counts cover before they start over.
    const COUNT_PERIOD: u32 = 4096;

    /// Whether looking for a payload of `group` is worth its cost.
    fn worth_looking_for(&mut self, group: usize) -> bool {
        self.lookups += 1;
        if self.lookups == Self::COUNT_PERIOD {
            self.lookups = 0;
            self.hits = Default::default();
            self.misses = Default::default();
        }
        self.misses[group] < 32 || self.hits[group] * 4 >= self.misses[group]
    }

    /// What the groups of an element with `values`, in the color scheme `scheme`, are built from
    /// beside their values, with their hash: what its lookups have in common.
    fn inputs(
        values: &crate::css::computed_values::GroupValues<'_>,
        scheme: u8,
        length: &crate::css::style_compute::FfiLengthResolutionContext,
    ) -> (GroupInputs, u64) {
        use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
        let metrics = |metrics: &crate::css::style_compute::FfiFontMetrics| {
            [
                metrics.font_size,
                metrics.x_height,
                metrics.cap_height,
                metrics.zero_advance,
                metrics.line_height,
            ]
            .map(f64::to_bits)
        };
        let [a, b, c, d, e] = metrics(&length.font_metrics);
        let [f, g, h, i, j] = metrics(&length.root_font_metrics);
        let facts = values.facts();
        let inputs = [
            u64::from(scheme),
            u64::from(facts.display_before_box_type_transformation())
                | (u64::from(facts.native_appearance_disabled()) << u32::BITS)
                | (u64::from(facts.user_agent_margin_sides()) << (u32::BITS + 1)),
            u64::from(facts.effective_zoom().to_bits()),
            length.viewport_width.to_bits(),
            length.viewport_height.to_bits(),
            length.zoom.to_bits(),
            u64::from(length.subject_inline_axis_is_horizontal),
            a,
            b,
            c,
            d,
            e,
            f,
            g,
            h,
            i,
            j,
        ];
        let mut hasher = crate::fast_hash::fast_hasher();
        inputs.hash(&mut hasher);
        (inputs, hasher.finish())
    }

    fn key<'a>(
        values: &'a crate::css::computed_values::GroupValues<'a>,
        group: usize,
        current_color: Option<u32>,
        (inputs, inputs_hash): &'a (GroupInputs, u64),
    ) -> GroupLookup<'a> {
        use crate::css::computed_values::GroupValueLayout;
        use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
        let layout = GroupValueLayout::get();
        let reads = layout.key_reads_of(group);
        let read_groups = layout.read_groups_of(group);
        let current_color = current_color.map_or(0, |color| u64::from(color) | (1 << u32::BITS));
        let mut hasher = crate::fast_hash::fast_hasher();
        group.hash(&mut hasher);
        hasher.write_u64(*inputs_hash);
        hasher.write_u64(current_color);
        values.read_hash(reads, read_groups, &mut hasher);
        for (property, value) in values.facts().values_read_in_place(reads, read_groups) {
            hasher.write_u16(property);
            hasher.write_usize(value.pointer() as usize);
        }
        GroupLookup {
            hash: hasher.finish(),
            group,
            values,
            reads,
            read_groups,
            inputs,
            current_color,
        }
    }

    /// The payload a group with `key` was assembled to, which the cache holds a reference to.
    fn find(&self, lookup: &GroupLookup<'_>) -> Option<*const std::ffi::c_void> {
        let entry = self
            .entries
            .get(&lookup.hash)?
            .iter()
            .find(|entry| lookup.matches(entry.group, &entry.key, self))?;
        Some(entry.payload)
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, lookup: &GroupLookup<'_>, payload: *const std::ffi::c_void) {
        if self.count == Self::CAPACITY {
            self.clear();
        }
        let group = lookup.group;
        crate::css::computed_values::retain_group_payload(group, payload);
        if self.key_inputs.last() != Some(lookup.inputs) {
            self.key_inputs.push(*lookup.inputs);
        }
        let values_start = self.key_values.len();
        self.key_values.extend(
            lookup
                .values
                .read_writes(lookup.reads, lookup.read_groups)
                .map(|(order, value)| (order, value.clone())),
        );
        let writes_length = self.key_values.len() - values_start;
        self.key_values.extend(
            lookup
                .values_read_in_place()
                .map(|(property, value)| (u32::from(property), value.clone())),
        );
        let key = GroupKey {
            seeds: lookup.values.held_read_seeds(lookup.read_groups).collect(),
            values_start: values_start as u32,
            writes_length: writes_length as u32,
            read_in_place_length: (self.key_values.len() - values_start - writes_length) as u32,
            inputs: (self.key_inputs.len() - 1) as u32,
            current_color: lookup.current_color,
        };
        self.entries
            .entry(lookup.hash)
            .or_default()
            .push(GroupCacheEntry { group, key, payload });
        self.count += 1;
    }

    fn clear(&mut self) {
        for entry in self.entries.drain().flat_map(|(_, entries)| entries) {
            crate::css::computed_values::release_group_payload(entry.group, entry.payload);
        }
        self.key_values.clear();
        self.key_inputs.clear();
        self.count = 0;
        // NB: A pass that filled the cache was a large one, whatever it holds once it ends.
        self.small_passes = 0;
    }
}

impl Drop for GroupCache {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.clear();
    }
}

/// The engine: a winner computing directly, with its value and the external dependencies prepared
/// for it.
type DirectWinner<'a> = (
    u16,
    std::borrow::Cow<'a, RetainedStyleValueData>,
    Option<crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies>,
    crate::css::style_compute::KnownComputation,
);

/// The engine: what an element's group values start from.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct GroupSeeds<'a> {
    /// The groups the element's values share where they hold the same values: its parent's, then
    /// the initial ones.
    pub(in crate::css::style) seeds: [crate::css::computed_values::GroupSeed<'a>; 2],
    /// The record whose groups the first seed is, or none where it is the initial style's.
    pub(in crate::css::style) parent: Option<&'a std::sync::Arc<super::pipeline::Record>>,
}

/// The initial values as a drive computes them, with a reference to each payload.
pub(in crate::css::style) struct ComputedInitialStyle {
    pub(in crate::css::style) payloads: [*const std::ffi::c_void; crate::css::table_group_builder::group_index::COUNT],
    /// The groups of the initial values, with no font in them, where a drive computed them.
    pub(in crate::css::style) value_groups: Option<crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups>,
    /// The groups of the process the values were found in, where they were.
    pub(in crate::css::style) shared: Option<Arc<SharedInitialGroups>>,
    pub(in crate::css::style) value_facts: crate::css::computed_values::GroupValueFacts,
    pub(in crate::css::style) flags: crate::css::computed_longhand_table::LonghandTableFlags,
    pub(in crate::css::style) dependency_flags: u8,
    pub(in crate::css::style) color: u32,
    pub(in crate::css::style) font: super::traversal::InitialFont,
}

/// One element's computed style from the engine.
pub(in crate::css::style) struct ComputedElement {
    /// The flags the element's records keep beside its values.
    pub(in crate::css::style) flags: crate::css::computed_longhand_table::LonghandTableFlags,
    /// What the element's records read of its style without its longhand table.
    pub(in crate::css::style) facts: super::pipeline::RecordFacts,
    /// What the element's groups were built from beside their values, which its groups hold.
    pub(in crate::css::style) value_facts: crate::css::computed_values::GroupValueFacts,
    /// The element's groups, which its record takes, borrowing those of the sets of its parent's
    /// or the initial style it shares.
    pub(in crate::css::style) groups: crate::css::computed_values::ComputedGroups,
    /// Whether a winner computed against the element itself, so the style is the element's alone.
    pub(in crate::css::style) element_dependent: bool,
    /// The custom properties the winners substitute.
    pub(in crate::css::style) custom_property_reads: super::custom_property_cascade::LonghandCustomPropertyReads,
    /// What else the computation read.
    pub(in crate::css::style) reads: super::records::ComputationReads,
    /// What the element's lengths resolve against.
    pub(in crate::css::style) length: crate::css::style_compute::FfiLengthResolutionContext,
    /// What the winners' substitutions read beyond the element's custom properties, as
    /// `FfiNodeRecordReads` bits.
    pub(in crate::css::style) substitution_reads: u8,
}

/// A winner with its value resolved, how that computes and what it reads.
struct ClassifiedWinner<'a> {
    value: ResolvedWinnerValue<'a>,
    computation: WinnerComputation,
    reads: WinnerReads,
}

/// What an element's winners come to: which compute directly, with their values, and which need the
/// drive, and what they read.
/// NB: The lists are the caller's own locals, of which only the winners' entries are written. A struct
///     holding their inline room would have the room written whole as it is made.
struct DecidedWinners<'l, 'a> {
    easy: &'l mut smallvec::SmallVec<[DirectWinner<'a>; 24]>,
    hard: &'l mut smallvec::SmallVec<[u16; 24]>,
    /// The font longhands that compute natively, where the element resolves its font without
    /// a drive.
    native_font: &'l mut smallvec::SmallVec<[(u16, std::borrow::Cow<'a, RetainedStyleValueData>); 8]>,
    /// The winners computing directly, with whether each takes the value its parent computed.
    direct_inheritance: &'l mut smallvec::SmallVec<[(u16, bool); 24]>,
    /// What each winner substituted to, where its value waited on substitution.
    substituted: &'l mut smallvec::SmallVec<[Option<RetainedStyleValueData>; 24]>,
    /// The winners that decide anything, with what each substituted to where its value waited
    /// on substitution.
    deciding: &'l mut smallvec::SmallVec<[Winner; 24]>,
    /// The logical aliases declared with a CSS-wide keyword that compute directly, with the
    /// physical longhand each computes as and whether it takes the parent's value.
    keyword_aliases: &'l mut smallvec::SmallVec<[(u16, u16, bool); 8]>,
    reads: &'l mut ElementWinnerReads,
}

/// What an element's winners read.
#[derive(Default)]
struct ElementWinnerReads {
    /// Whether a winner computes against the element itself rather than only its context.
    element_dependent: bool,
    /// The style groups of the properties that do not inherit whose value the winners take from the
    /// parent.
    parent_reset_groups: u32,
    /// Whether a winner computes against the element's place among its siblings.
    reads_sibling_position: bool,
    /// How much of the root element's font a winner resolves lengths against.
    reads_root_font: RootFontReads,
    /// Whether a winner resolves a length against a metric of a first available font.
    reads_font_metric_lengths: bool,
    /// Whether a winner other than font-size resolves a length against a metric of the element's
    /// own first available font.
    reads_own_font_metric_lengths: bool,
    /// Whether the winner for font-size resolves a length against a metric of the parent's first
    /// available font.
    reads_parent_font_metric_lengths: bool,
    /// What the winners compute from of the document's environment.
    environment_reads: StyleEnvironment,
    /// What the winners' substitutions read beyond the element's custom properties.
    substitution_reads: u8,
    /// The custom properties the winners substitute, and whether one may read others.
    custom_property_reads: Vec<std::sync::Arc<[u16]>>,
    reads_unnamed_custom_properties: bool,
}

/// What a CSS-wide keyword computes from.
struct WinnerDefaulting<'a> {
    parent: ParentValues<'a>,
    winners: &'a [Winner],
    initial: &'a super::traversal::InitialStyle,
}

impl WinnerDefaulting<'_> {
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-logical/#box
    /// A logical alias computes as its physical counterpart for the element's writing mode and
    /// direction, which an element declaring neither has from its parent.
    fn parent_flow(&self) -> Option<(u8, u8)> {
        use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id as prop;
        if self
            .winners
            .iter()
            .any(|winner| winner.property == prop::WRITING_MODE || winner.property == prop::DIRECTION)
        {
            return None;
        }
        self.parent
            .value(prop::WRITING_MODE)
            .zip(self.parent.value(prop::DIRECTION))
            .map(|(writing_mode, direction)| {
                crate::css::style_compute::writing_mode_and_direction_of(Some(writing_mode), Some(direction))
            })
    }
}

/// The computed values of an element's parent.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct ParentValues<'a> {
    longhands: Option<computed::ViewLonghands<'a>>,
    overlay: Option<&'a crate::css::animated_overlay::AnimatedOverlay>,
}

impl<'a> ParentValues<'a> {
    /// A parent's computed value: its record's, or its table's with the animated value it hands
    /// down where its animations compose.
    fn value(self, property: u16) -> Option<&'a RetainedStyleValueData> {
        let longhands = self.longhands?;
        longhands
            .overlay_value(self.overlay, property)
            .or_else(|| longhands.handle(property))
    }
}

impl<'a> DecidedWinners<'_, 'a> {
    /// Takes a winner as it decides, in cascade order, with its classification.
    #[inline]
    fn take(&mut self, winner: Winner, classified: ClassifiedWinner<'a>, defaulting: &WinnerDefaulting<'_>) {
        use crate::css::style_compute::{LOGICAL_ALIAS_BIT, map_logical_alias_to_physical, table_row_bits};
        let ClassifiedWinner {
            value,
            computation,
            reads,
        } = classified;
        let mut custom_properties = reads.custom_properties;
        self.reads.custom_property_reads.append(&mut custom_properties);
        self.reads.reads_unnamed_custom_properties |= reads.unnamed_custom_properties;
        self.reads.substitution_reads |= reads.substitution;
        let property = winner.property;
        self.reads.element_dependent |= reads.element;
        if reads.parent_reset_value {
            self.reads.parent_reset_groups |= crate::css::property_metadata::property_style_group_index(property)
                .map_or(u32::MAX, |group| 1 << group);
        }
        self.reads.reads_sibling_position |= reads.sibling_position;
        self.reads.reads_root_font = self.reads.reads_root_font.max(reads.root_font);
        self.reads.reads_font_metric_lengths |= reads.font_metrics;
        // NB: A font-size reads the parent's font, and an `lh` in a line-height the parent's line height, which a
        //     `normal` one takes from the parent's font. Any other length reads the element's own font.
        if reads.font_metrics {
            let is_font_size = property == crate::css::property_metadata::property_id::FONT_SIZE;
            let (line_height_reads, glyph_metric_reads) =
                if property == crate::css::property_metadata::property_id::LINE_HEIGHT {
                    crate::css::style_compute::font_metric_length_reads(value.value().data())
                } else {
                    (false, true)
                };
            self.reads.reads_own_font_metric_lengths |= !is_font_size && glyph_metric_reads;
            self.reads.reads_parent_font_metric_lengths |= is_font_size || line_height_reads;
        }
        self.reads.environment_reads |= reads.environment | property_environment_reads(property);
        let written = value.value();
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade-5/#defaulting-keywords
        // A CSS-wide keyword's computed value is the initial value or the parent's computed
        // value, which computes directly as any computed value does.
        let mut inherits_keyword = false;
        let is_logical_alias = table_row_bits(property) & LOGICAL_ALIAS_BIT != 0;
        // The longhand whose parent's value the winner inherits: a logical alias inherits its
        // physical counterpart's.
        let mut inherited_property = property;
        let keyword_value = reads.css_wide_keyword.and_then(|keyword| {
            if is_logical_alias {
                let (writing_mode, direction) = defaulting.parent_flow()?;
                inherited_property = map_logical_alias_to_physical(property, writing_mode, direction);
            }
            let inherits = match keyword {
                CascadeOperator::Inherit => true,
                CascadeOperator::Initial => false,
                CascadeOperator::Unset => crate::css::property_metadata::property_is_inherited(property),
                _ => return None,
            };
            inherits_keyword = inherits;
            match (inherits, defaulting.parent.longhands.is_some()) {
                (true, true) => defaulting.parent.value(inherited_property),
                // NB: Both longhands of a logical pair take the alias's initial value, where a
                //     drive gives each its own.
                _ => {
                    let initial_value = |property| {
                        Some(
                            defaulting
                                .initial
                                .longhand(crate::css::computed_values::LonghandID::new(property)),
                        )
                        .filter(|value| !value.pointer().is_null())
                    };
                    // NB: A system color resolves against the element's own used color scheme, which the
                    //     initial style can't know, so that initial value computes with the element.
                    initial_value(property)
                        .filter(|value| initial_value(inherited_property) == Some(*value))
                        .filter(|_| {
                            !matches!(
                                crate::css::style_compute::initial_value_handle(property).data(),
                                StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword } if crate::css::style_compute::keyword_is_color(*keyword)
                            )
                        })
                }
            }
            .filter(|value| {
                value.optional_data().is_some_and(|data| {
                    crate::css::style_compute::value_computes_directly(property, data, Some(Default::default()))
                })
            })
            .cloned()
        });
        if is_logical_alias {
            if keyword_value.is_some() {
                self.keyword_aliases
                    .push((property, inherited_property, inherits_keyword));
            }
        } else if matches!(computation, WinnerComputation::Direct(_)) || keyword_value.is_some() {
            self.direct_inheritance
                .push((property, keyword_value.is_some() && inherits_keyword));
        }
        let font_computes_natively = !is_logical_alias
            && matches!(computation, WinnerComputation::Full)
            && reads.css_wide_keyword.is_none()
            && written
                .optional_data()
                .is_some_and(|data| crate::css::style_compute::font_value_computes_natively(property, data));
        match (computation, keyword_value) {
            (_, Some(value)) => self.easy.push((
                property,
                std::borrow::Cow::Owned(value),
                Some(Default::default()),
                Default::default(),
            )),
            (WinnerComputation::Direct(dependencies), None) => self.easy.push((
                property,
                match &value {
                    ResolvedWinnerValue::Written(written) => std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(*written),
                    _ => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(written.clone()),
                },
                dependencies,
                Default::default(),
            )),
            (WinnerComputation::Full, None) if font_computes_natively => self.native_font.push((
                property,
                match &value {
                    ResolvedWinnerValue::Written(written) => std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(*written),
                    _ => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(written.clone()),
                },
            )),
            (WinnerComputation::Full, None) => self.hard.push(property),
        }
        self.deciding.push(winner);
        self.substituted.push(value.into_substituted());
    }
}

impl ClassifiedWinner<'_> {
    /// Whether the winner's value is `revert` or `revert-layer`, declared or substituted, so that
    /// the winner rolls back below its declaration.
    #[inline]
    fn rolls_back(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self.cascade_operator(),
            Some(CascadeOperator::Revert | CascadeOperator::RevertLayer)
        )
    }

    fn cascade_operator(&self) -> Option<CascadeOperator> {
        match &self.value {
            ResolvedWinnerValue::Substituted(value) => value
                .optional_data()
                .map(crate::css::declaration_block::declaration_operator),
            _ => self.reads.css_wide_keyword,
        }
    }
}

/// How a winner's value computes.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum WinnerComputation {
    /// With the rest of the element's values, in the full computation.
    Full,
    /// On its own, with the dependencies that were prepared for it, if any.
    Direct(Option<crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies>),
}

/// What a winner's computed value reads beyond the element's inherited context.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct WinnerReads {
    /// Something of the element itself.
    element: bool,
    /// The CSS-wide keyword the winner was declared with.
    css_wide_keyword: Option<CascadeOperator>,
    /// The parent's value of a property that is not inherited.
    parent_reset_value: bool,
    /// The element's place among its siblings.
    sibling_position: bool,
    /// How much of the root element's font, through root-relative lengths.
    root_font: RootFontReads,
    /// A metric of a first available font, through a font-relative length.
    font_metrics: bool,
    /// What of the document's environment the winner's value resolves against.
    environment: StyleEnvironment,
    /// What the winner's substitution read beyond the element's custom properties, as
    /// `FfiNodeRecordReads` bits.
    substitution: u8,
    /// The custom properties the winner's substitution read by name.
    custom_properties: Vec<std::sync::Arc<[u16]>>,
    /// Whether the winner's substitution may read custom properties it does not name.
    unnamed_custom_properties: bool,
}

/// Whether a value computes against something of the element beyond its parent's style and its own
/// declarations: its place among its siblings, its own random values or its containers. A value
/// whose dependencies are unknown is taken to.
/// Whether a value computes against the element's place among its siblings, through a
/// tree-counting function. A value whose dependencies are unknown is taken to.
fn reads_sibling_position(dependencies: Option<crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies>) -> bool {
    dependencies.is_none_or(|dependencies| dependencies.uses_tree_counting_function)
}

/// How much of the root element's font `value` resolves lengths against, by its `dependencies`
/// where they are known. Root-relative lengths are found by walking the value, which needs no
/// answer to whether the value is computationally independent.
fn reads_root_font(
    value: Option<&StyleValueData>,
    dependencies: Option<crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies>,
) -> RootFontReads {
    value.map_or(RootFontReads::None, |value| {
        dependencies
            .unwrap_or_else(|| crate::css::style_compute::collect_external_value_dependencies(value))
            .root_font_reads
    })
}

/// Whether `value` resolves a length against a metric of the first available font of the element or
/// its parent, by its `dependencies` where they are known.
fn reads_font_metrics(
    value: Option<&StyleValueData>,
    dependencies: Option<crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies>,
) -> bool {
    value.is_some_and(|value| {
        dependencies
            .unwrap_or_else(|| crate::css::style_compute::collect_external_value_dependencies(value))
            .font_metric_relative_length
    })
}

/// What of the document's environment `value` resolves against, by its `dependencies` where they
/// are known: the used color scheme, through `light-dark()` or a system color, the device pixel
/// ratio, through `image-set()`, and the axes of the viewport its viewport-relative lengths
/// resolve against.
fn environment_reads(
    value: Option<&StyleValueData>,
    dependencies: Option<crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies>,
) -> StyleEnvironment {
    let Some(value) = value else {
        return StyleEnvironment::default();
    };
    dependency_environment_reads(
        dependencies.unwrap_or_else(|| crate::css::style_compute::collect_external_value_dependencies(value)),
    )
}

/// What of the document's environment a value with `dependencies` resolves against.
fn dependency_environment_reads(
    dependencies: crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies,
) -> StyleEnvironment {
    let mut reads = StyleEnvironment::default();
    if dependencies.color_scheme_dependent {
        reads |= StyleEnvironment::COLOR_SCHEME;
    }
    if dependencies.device_pixel_ratio_dependent {
        reads |= StyleEnvironment::DEVICE_PIXEL_RATIO;
    }
    if dependencies.viewport_axes & crate::css::style_compute::VIEWPORT_WIDTH_AXIS != 0 {
        reads |= StyleEnvironment::VIEWPORT_WIDTH;
    }
    if dependencies.viewport_axes & crate::css::style_compute::VIEWPORT_HEIGHT_AXIS != 0 {
        reads |= StyleEnvironment::VIEWPORT_HEIGHT;
    }
    reads
}

/// What of the document's environment the computed value of `property` reads whatever its value:
/// `color-scheme` computes the used color scheme, and a border, outline or column rule width is
/// snapped to device pixels.
fn property_environment_reads(property: u16) -> StyleEnvironment {
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id as prop;
    if property == prop::COLOR_SCHEME {
        return StyleEnvironment::COLOR_SCHEME;
    }
    if crate::css::style_compute::property_snaps_as_border_width(property) {
        return StyleEnvironment::DEVICE_PIXEL_RATIO;
    }
    StyleEnvironment::default()
}

fn depends_on_element(dependencies: Option<crate::css::style_compute::ExternalValueDependencies>) -> bool {
    dependencies.is_none_or(|dependencies| {
        dependencies.uses_tree_counting_function
            || dependencies.uses_random_function
            || dependencies.container_relative_length_unit_mask != 0
    })
}

/// What the engine's cascade of an element holds below its winners, for a winner whose substitution
/// produces `revert` or `revert-layer`.
pub(in crate::css::style) trait CascadeBelow {
    /// The priority of the block a winner of the cascade came from.
    fn priority_of(&self, source: WinnerSource, important: bool) -> CascadePriority;

    /// The highest declaration of `property` or its mapped counterpart that none of the reverting declarations,
    /// at their priorities with the keywords they substituted to, roll back past, with its priority.
    fn winner_below(
        &self,
        property: u16,
        counterpart: Option<u16>,
        reverted: &[(CascadePriority, CascadeOperator)],
    ) -> Option<(CascadePriority, Winner)>;

    /// The own declarations of an element no rule reaches, which its winners name in place of
    /// those of the node they are keyed by, where the cascade is of those alone.
    fn declared_only(&self) -> Option<&super::pipeline::DeclaredOnly>;
}

pub(in crate::css::style) enum ResolvedWinnerValue<'a> {
    Written(&'a RetainedStyleValueData),
    Substituted(RetainedStyleValueData),
}

impl ResolvedWinnerValue<'_> {
    fn value(&self) -> &RetainedStyleValueData {
        match self {
            Self::Written(value) => value,
            Self::Substituted(value) => value,
        }
    }

    fn into_substituted(self) -> Option<RetainedStyleValueData> {
        match self {
            Self::Written(_) => None,
            Self::Substituted(value) => Some(value),
        }
    }
}

/// Where a winner rolled back below a revert decides: at the declaration it rolled back to, by
/// its block's priority and its index in the block, or at the revert, which rolled back as
/// `operator`.
struct RolledBack {
    place: (CascadePriority, usize),
    revert: (CascadePriority, usize),
    operator: CascadeOperator,
}

/// The logical or physical counterpart of `property` in the element's resolved writing mode and direction.
fn logical_counterpart(property: u16, writing_mode: u8, direction: u8) -> Option<u16> {
    use crate::css::style_compute::{
        LOGICAL_ALIAS_BIT, PHYSICAL_TO_LOGICAL_BIT, map_logical_alias_to_physical, map_physical_to_logical_alias,
        table_row_bits,
    };
    let bits = table_row_bits(property);
    if bits & (LOGICAL_ALIAS_BIT | PHYSICAL_TO_LOGICAL_BIT) == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(match bits & LOGICAL_ALIAS_BIT != 0 {
        true => map_logical_alias_to_physical(property, writing_mode, direction),
        false => map_physical_to_logical_alias(property, writing_mode, direction),
    })
}

/// What a drive computes for: the node whose record it inherits from (the flat-tree parent, or
/// the originating element of a pseudo-element) and the element facts the computation's
/// adjustments read.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct DriveSubject {
    /// What is being driven, element or pseudo-element.
    pub(in crate::css::style) target: computed::ComputedStyleTarget,
    /// The flat-tree parent the element inherits from; the document element has none and
    /// inherits from the initial values.
    pub(in crate::css::style) parent: Option<StyleNodeID>,
    pub(in crate::css::style) facts: u32,
}

/// The element facts a pseudo-element's computation reads: the C++ adjustments for what the
/// originating element is stay off for its pseudo-elements, past the ones about its markup
/// language.
const PSEUDO_ELEMENT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTS: u32 = {
    use bridge::element_adjustment_fact as fact;
    fact::IS_MATHML
        | fact::IS_MATHML_MTABLE
        | fact::IS_MATHML_MTR
        | fact::IS_MATHML_MTD
        | fact::IS_TH
        | fact::HAS_ANIMATIONS
};

/// The outermost shorthand a longhand pending substitution takes its part of, and the value that
/// shorthand was written with. A shorthand nested in another, such as `border-width` in `border`,
/// is itself pending the outer one.
fn written_shorthand_of_pending(
    shorthand: u16,
    value: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData,
) -> (u16, &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData) {
    match value.data() {
        crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData::PendingSubstitution {
            original_shorthand,
            original_shorthand_value,
        } => written_shorthand_of_pending(*original_shorthand, original_shorthand_value),
        _ => (shorthand, value),
    }
}

/// The longhand's part of a substituted shorthand value, as the cascade expands it.
fn expanded_longhand_value(
    shorthand: u16,
    property: u16,
    value: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData,
) -> Option<crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData> {
    let mut found = None;
    crate::css::style_compute::expand_shorthands_with(shorthand, value, false, &mut |longhand, data, _| {
        if longhand == property && found.is_none() {
            found = Some(data.clone());
        }
    });
    found
}

fn shorthand_longhand_value(
    property: u16,
    data: &crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData,
) -> Option<crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData> {
    let crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData::Shorthand(shorthand_payload) = data else {
        return None;
    };
    let ShorthandPayload {
        sub_properties, values, ..
    } = &**shorthand_payload;
    for (&sub_property, sub_value) in sub_properties.as_slice().iter().zip(values.as_slice()) {
        if sub_property == property {
            return Some(sub_value.clone());
        }
        if let Some(found) = shorthand_longhand_value(property, sub_value.data()) {
            return Some(found);
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Whether a longhand is read by the box-type transformation, which rewrites the computed display.
/// A `-webkit-box` becomes a block container while its `-webkit-box-orient` and `continue` say
/// that `-webkit-line-clamp` applies to it.
fn property_feeds_box_type_transformation(property: u16) -> bool {
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id as prop;
    matches!(
        property,
        prop::DISPLAY | prop::POSITION | prop::FLOAT | prop::_WEBKIT_BOX_ORIENT | prop::CONTINUE
    )
}

/// Whether a longhand's new value would start an animation or a transition in the C++
/// computation, register anchor names there, or feed the counter-style environment identity it
/// resolves.
/// The longhands the drive's font resolution selects a font by, which its request carries.
fn font_resolution_selects_by(property: u16) -> bool {
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id as prop;
    matches!(
        property,
        prop::FONT_FAMILY
            | prop::FONT_STYLE
            | prop::FONT_WEIGHT
            | prop::FONT_WIDTH
            | prop::FONT_OPTICAL_SIZING
            | prop::FONT_SIZE_ADJUST
            | prop::FONT_SYNTHESIS_WEIGHT
            | prop::FONT_SYNTHESIS_STYLE
    )
}

/// The computed style groups a moved longhand reaches. One the font group carries feeds no group of
/// its own and reaches every value the font feeds, through the font group: a delta moving it is
/// driven in full, as is one moving a longhand no registered group names.
fn moved_longhand_groups(property: u16) -> u32 {
    use crate::css::table_group_builder::group_index;
    // NB: The computation writes a longhand the bits beside the groups hold into the bits
    //     themselves: it reaches only the groups other than the one its readers see it in.
    if crate::css::computed_values::StyleBitField::of(property).is_some() {
        return StyleGroupMasks::get().dependencies(property)
            & !crate::css::computed_values::computed_group_output_mask(property).unwrap_or(0);
    }
    match StyleGroupMasks::get().dependencies(property) {
        0 if font_group_carries_longhand(property) => 1 << group_index::FONT,
        0 => (1 << crate::css::table_group_builder::group_index::COUNT) - 1,
        groups => groups,
    }
}

/// Whether what `property_id` is declared with, where its value computes directly, computes without
/// a drive and without a logical mapping.
fn longhand_takes_plain_values(property: u16) -> bool {
    use crate::css::style_compute::{LOGICAL_ALIAS_BIT, computes_directly, computes_in_font_phases, table_row_bits};
    computes_directly(property)
        && !computes_in_font_phases(property)
        && table_row_bits(property) & LOGICAL_ALIAS_BIT == 0
        && moved_longhand_groups(property) & (1 << crate::css::table_group_builder::group_index::FONT) == 0
}

/// The font-phase longhands the font group carries without a group binding of their own.
fn font_group_carries_longhand(property: u16) -> bool {
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id as prop;
    font_resolution_selects_by(property)
        || matches!(
            property,
            prop::FONT_FEATURE_SETTINGS
                | prop::FONT_KERNING
                | prop::FONT_LANGUAGE_OVERRIDE
                | prop::FONT_VARIANT_ALTERNATES
                | prop::FONT_VARIANT_CAPS
                | prop::FONT_VARIANT_EAST_ASIAN
                | prop::FONT_VARIANT_EMOJI
                | prop::FONT_VARIANT_LIGATURES
                | prop::FONT_VARIANT_NUMERIC
                | prop::FONT_VARIANT_POSITION
                | prop::FONT_VARIATION_SETTINGS
                | prop::MATH_DEPTH
                | prop::MATH_SHIFT
                | prop::MATH_STYLE
                | prop::TEXT_RENDERING
        )
}

/// Static checks attached to the original declaration spelling at input preparation, in one word:
/// the external dependencies of the value a longhand computes from, packed the way a winner
/// memoizes them (bits 0-20 and 31), or zero for a value that waits on substitution (bit 23), and how
/// the longhand computes from the value (bits 24-27).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(transparent)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct WrittenValueChecks(u32);

const _: () = assert!(size_of::<WrittenValueChecks>() == 4);
const _: () = assert!(
    winner_store::DEPENDENCY_BITS
        & (WrittenValueChecks::WAITS_ON_SUBSTITUTION
            | WrittenValueChecks::IS_SHORTHAND
            | WrittenValueChecks::PLAIN
            | WrittenValueChecks::COMPUTES_TO_ITSELF
            | WrittenValueChecks::IS_INITIAL)
        == 0
);

impl WrittenValueChecks {
    const WAITS_ON_SUBSTITUTION: u32 = 1 << 23;
    const IS_SHORTHAND: u32 = 1 << 24;
    const PLAIN: u32 = 1 << 25;
    const COMPUTES_TO_ITSELF: u32 = 1 << 26;
    const IS_INITIAL: u32 = 1 << 27;

    /// Whether the value is a shorthand declared whole, of which a longhand computes from its part.
    fn is_shorthand(self) -> bool {
        self.0 & Self::IS_SHORTHAND != 0
    }

    /// Whether the longhand computes from this value, written as a declared value, by having it
    /// absolutized against the element's context, with what it computes against told by these
    /// checks: no drive, no font resolution and no logical mapping have anything to do with it.
    fn is_plain(self) -> bool {
        self.0 & Self::PLAIN != 0
    }

    /// What is known of how the longhand computes from the value where nothing zooms it.
    fn known_computation(self) -> crate::css::style_compute::KnownComputation {
        crate::css::style_compute::KnownComputation {
            to_itself: self.0 & Self::COMPUTES_TO_ITSELF != 0,
            is_initial: self.0 & Self::IS_INITIAL != 0,
        }
    }

    /// The packed external dependencies of the value, when they were prepared.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn dependencies(self) -> u32 {
        self.0 & winner_store::DEPENDENCY_BITS
    }

    /// Whether the value waits on `var()` or `attr()` substitution before it computes.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn waits_on_substitution(self) -> bool {
        self.0 & Self::WAITS_ON_SUBSTITUTION != 0
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn prepare(
        property: u16,
        value: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData,
    ) -> Self {
        use crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData;
        match value.data() {
            StyleValueData::Unresolved { .. } | StyleValueData::PendingSubstitution { .. } => {
                Self(Self::WAITS_ON_SUBSTITUTION)
            }
            // The longhand a shorthand declared whole contributes is what a winner computes from.
            data @ StyleValueData::Shorthand { .. } => Self(
                Self::IS_SHORTHAND
                    | shorthand_longhand_value(property, data)
                        .map_or(0, |part| Self::of_longhand_value(property, &part)),
            ),
            _ => Self(Self::of_longhand_value(property, value)),
        }
    }

    /// The checks of `value` that depend on the value alone: what it computes against, and whether
    /// it computes to itself. Zero for a value it is not known of.
    fn of_value(value: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData) -> u32 {
        use crate::css::style_compute::{
            try_external_value_dependencies, value_absolutization_is_identity_where_nothing_zooms,
            value_is_a_plain_scalar,
        };
        use crate::css::style_value::StyleValueData;
        let data = value.data();
        // NB: Most declared values are scalars, of which nothing need be walked to tell this. It runs for
        //     each declaration of a style attribute, on the one thread that takes them in.
        if value_is_a_plain_scalar(data) {
            return winner_store::pack_dependencies(Default::default()) | Self::COMPUTES_TO_ITSELF;
        }
        if matches!(data, StyleValueData::Unresolved { .. }) {
            return 0;
        }
        let Some(dependencies) = try_external_value_dependencies(data) else {
            return 0;
        };
        let to_itself = match value_absolutization_is_identity_where_nothing_zooms(data) {
            true => Self::COMPUTES_TO_ITSELF,
            false => 0,
        };
        winner_store::pack_dependencies(dependencies) | to_itself
    }

    /// The checks of `value`, which `property` computes from: those of the value alone, then those
    /// of this longhand declaring it.
    fn of_longhand_value(property: u16, value: &crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData) -> u32 {
        use crate::css::style_compute::{
            initial_value_data, initial_value_dependencies, table_row_bits, value_computes_directly,
        };
        if !(crate::css::property_metadata::FIRST_LONGHAND_PROPERTY_ID
            ..=crate::css::property_metadata::LAST_LONGHAND_PROPERTY_ID)
            .contains(&property)
        {
            return Self::of_value(value);
        }
        let is_initial_value = value.pointer() == initial_value_data(property);
        // NB: A shorthand mostly leaves longhands at their initial values, whose dependencies are known.
        let mut bits = match is_initial_value {
            true => {
                let to_itself =
                    crate::css::style_compute::value_absolutization_is_identity_where_nothing_zooms(value.data());
                winner_store::pack_dependencies(initial_value_dependencies(property))
                    | (u32::from(to_itself) * Self::COMPUTES_TO_ITSELF)
            }
            false => Self::of_value(value),
        };
        if bits & winner_store::DEPENDENCIES_COMPUTED == 0 {
            return bits;
        }
        let dependencies = winner_store::unpack_dependencies(bits & winner_store::DEPENDENCY_BITS);
        if longhand_takes_plain_values(property) && value_computes_directly(property, value.data(), Some(dependencies))
        {
            bits |= Self::PLAIN;
        }
        if is_initial_value
            && !crate::css::property_metadata::property_is_inherited(property)
            && table_row_bits(property) == 0
            && !dependencies.inheritance_dependent
        {
            bits |= Self::IS_INITIAL;
        }
        bits
    }
}

/// The physical sides of an element's margins whose cascaded values come from the user agent's style sheet, as
/// `user_agent_margin_side` bits: those whose own winning declaration, or that of their flow-relative counterpart where
/// that one wins over it, is the user agent's.
fn user_agent_margin_sides(
    winners: &[Winner],
    priority_of: impl Fn(&Winner) -> CascadePriority,
    writing_mode: u8,
    direction: u8,
) -> u8 {
    use crate::css::cascaded_properties::CascadeOrigin;
    use crate::css::computed_value_types::user_agent_margin_side as side;
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id as prop;
    [
        (prop::MARGIN_TOP, side::TOP),
        (prop::MARGIN_RIGHT, side::RIGHT),
        (prop::MARGIN_BOTTOM, side::BOTTOM),
        (prop::MARGIN_LEFT, side::LEFT),
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .filter(|&(physical, _)| {
        let flow_relative = crate::css::style_compute::map_physical_to_logical_alias(physical, writing_mode, direction);
        // The winners come in the order the cascade resolved them, rollbacks included, so the first of the two is
        // the one the logical pair takes its value from.
        winners
            .iter()
            .find(|winner| winner.property == physical || winner.property == flow_relative)
            .is_some_and(|winner| priority_of(winner).cascade_origin() == CascadeOrigin::UserAgent)
    })
    .fold(0, |sides, (_, bit)| sides | bit)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn pending_longhand_names_the_outermost_written_shorthand() {
        use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
        use crate::css::style_value::{RetainedStyleValueData, StyleValueData};

        for (shorthand, nested_shorthand) in [
            (property_id::BACKGROUND, property_id::BACKGROUND_POSITION),
            (property_id::BORDER, property_id::BORDER_WIDTH),
            (property_id::FONT, property_id::FONT_VARIANT),
        ] {
            let written = RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::Number { value: 1.0 });
            let nested = RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::PendingSubstitution {
                original_shorthand: shorthand,
                original_shorthand_value: written.clone_retained(),
            });
            let (found_shorthand, found_value) = written_shorthand_of_pending(nested_shorthand, &nested);
            assert_eq!(found_shorthand, shorthand);
            assert!(std::ptr::eq(found_value.pointer(), written.pointer()));
            let (found_shorthand, found_value) = written_shorthand_of_pending(shorthand, &written);
            assert_eq!(found_shorthand, shorthand);
            assert!(std::ptr::eq(found_value.pointer(), written.pointer()));
        }
    }
}

//! What the engine did over the life of a document's render state, counted for tests to bound,
//! and the passes a test traces.
//!
//! A pass counts what it does in counts of its own, kept with the engine between the
//! transactions it restyles after, which the state takes into its counters once the pass kept the
//! records it computed. Unlike the live report, which a fork of the state starts anew, the counters
//! are the state's: a fork copies them as they are and counts its own passes in its copy, which
//! the state never sees, as the host never installs what a fork computes.

use super::super::tree::StyleNodeID;
use super::live::LiveField;
use super::projection::Projection;
use super::rules::RuleIndex;
use super::traversal::{Outcome, Statistics};

/// One of the counters of [`Counters`], in the order the host names them.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(u32)]
pub(in super::super) enum StyleCounter {
    /// The passes of the engine: each restyle, of everything, of what transactions changed, or
    /// of the elements a pass before left waiting on fonts. A transaction that hints no element
    /// runs none.
    Passes,
    /// The passes that restyled every element: the one the engine starts from, and one after an
    /// input that can restyle any element, such as a stylesheet change.
    FullPasses,
    /// The elements passes styled: each once per pass that styled it.
    StyledElements,
    /// The elements passes styled differently than before in what their children compute from.
    ChangedElements,
    /// The elements whose hints asked a pass restyling what changed to restyle them, or their
    /// pseudo-elements, counted as the pass starts.
    HintedElements,
    /// The elements whose hints asked a pass restyling what changed to restyle their descendants,
    /// counted as the pass starts.
    HintedSubtrees,
    /// The elements the invalidation of transactions visited, following the selectors of the
    /// inputs they changed: each once per visit.
    InvalidationVisits,
    /// The compounds the invalidation of transactions tested against an element.
    InvalidationTests,
    /// The cold passes the engine started from: one each time it started.
    ColdPasses,
    /// The elements passes gave the record of an element they styled before with the same parent,
    /// the same inputs and the same revalidation answers, without matching them.
    SharedElements,
    /// The elements passes gave the record of an element that matched the same rules and declared
    /// the same declarations, under a parent they inherit the same from, which they matched but
    /// did not cascade or compute.
    ReusedElements,
    /// The rule indexes the engine built: one as it started, and one for each pass after a rule
    /// change.
    IndexBuilds,
    /// The entries of those indexes, summed.
    IndexedEntries,
    /// The selector entries those indexes, and the ones cold passes built, compiled: those of the
    /// programs no rule index build of the process compiled before.
    CompiledSelectors,
    /// The user agent indexes those indexes built, which no document of the process had built
    /// before: a document whose user agent rules decide as another's did shares its index.
    UserAgentIndexBuilds,
    /// The elements passes matched against the whole rule index, not only against the entries
    /// they were restyled for.
    MatchedElements,
    /// The walks of the argument of a `:has()` that passes took to answer it for an anchor.
    RelativeWalks,
}

impl StyleCounter {
    pub(in super::super) const COUNT: usize = Self::RelativeWalks as usize + 1;
}

/// What a pass counts until the state takes it, and what it styled while a trace is open.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(super) struct PassCounts {
    counts: [u64; StyleCounter::COUNT],
    traced: Vec<TracedPass>,
    /// What the engine did to its rule index since the state last took the counts, which a trace keeps.
    program_events: Vec<(ProgramEvent, u64)>,
}

/// Something the engine did to the rules it styles from, which a trace lists in a `style PROGRAM` block, with how many
/// times it happened in a row.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub(in super::super) enum ProgramEvent {
    RuleIndexBuilt = 1,
    RuleIndexUpdated = 2,
    UserAgentRuleIndexBuilt = 3,
    SelectorsCompiled = 4,
    StyleRulesCompiled = 5,
    SheetDeclarationsInterned = 6,
    SheetDeclarationsShared = 7,
}

/// How an element of a traced pass came by its record.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub(super) enum TracedOutcome {
    Computed = 1,
    Shared = 2,
    Reused = 3,
    Declined = 4,
    /// The element took the custom properties its parent hands down now without being styled.
    KeptWithMovedCustomProperties = 5,
    /// The host composed the element's animations over its record, rebuilding only the groups they write.
    Sampled = 6,
    /// The host composed the element's animations over its record, rebuilding every group of it.
    SampledEveryGroup = 7,
}

impl From<&Outcome> for TracedOutcome {
    fn from(outcome: &Outcome) -> Self {
        match outcome {
            Outcome::Computed => Self::Computed,
            Outcome::Shared => Self::Shared,
            Outcome::Reused => Self::Reused,
            Outcome::CascadeDeclined | Outcome::ComputeDeclined => Self::Declined,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
enum TracedPassKind {
    Full = 1,
    Partial = 2,
    Cold = 3,
    /// The animation samples the host composed over records, which no pass ran.
    Animation = 5,
    /// What the engine did to the rules it styles from.
    Program = 6,
}

/// A pass a test traces: the elements it styled, each with how it came by its record, and the elements whose records
/// it changed, or, for a program block, what the engine did to its rules.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct TracedPass {
    kind: TracedPassKind,
    elements: Vec<(StyleNodeID, Option<TracedOutcome>)>,
    changed: Vec<StyleNodeID>,
    program_events: Vec<(ProgramEvent, u64)>,
}

/// The passes the engine ran since a test began tracing, with their entries in tree order once a test reads them.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct StyleTrace {
    passes: Vec<TracedPass>,
    entries: Option<Vec<u64>>,
}

/// The kind of an entry of a style trace, in bits 32 to 39, as the host decodes it.
const TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_SHIFT: u32 = 32;
/// The outcome of an element entry, in bits 40 to 47.
const TRACE_ENTRY_OUTCOME_SHIFT: u32 = 40;
/// Whether the record of the element of an entry changed.
const TRACE_ENTRY_CHANGED: u64 = 1 << 48;
const TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_ELEMENT: u64 = 4;
const TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_PROGRAM_EVENT: u64 = 7;

impl StyleTrace {
    /// The passes as entries: one per pass, followed by one per element it lists, in the order a style traversal from
    /// `root` reaches them. A full pass lists only the elements whose records it changed, as it styled every one.
    fn entries(&mut self, tree: &Projection, root: StyleNodeID) -> &[u64] {
        self.entries.get_or_insert_with(|| {
            let order: std::collections::HashMap<StyleNodeID, usize> = if tree.is_live(root) {
                tree.style_preorder(root)
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(position, node)| (node, position))
                    .collect()
            } else {
                Default::default()
            };
            let mut entries = Vec::new();
            for pass in &self.passes {
                entries.push((pass.kind as u64) << TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_SHIFT);
                for &(event, times) in &pass.program_events {
                    entries.push(
                        times.min(u64::from(u32::MAX))
                            | (TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_PROGRAM_EVENT << TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_SHIFT)
                            | ((event as u64) << TRACE_ENTRY_OUTCOME_SHIFT),
                    );
                }
                let changed: std::collections::HashSet<StyleNodeID> = pass.changed.iter().copied().collect();
                let mut elements: Vec<(StyleNodeID, Option<TracedOutcome>)> = pass
                    .elements
                    .iter()
                    .copied()
                    .filter(|(node, _)| order.contains_key(node))
                    .filter(|(node, _)| pass.kind != TracedPassKind::Full || changed.contains(node))
                    .collect();
                elements.sort_by_key(|(node, _)| order[node]);
                elements.dedup_by_key(|(node, _)| *node);
                for (node, outcome) in elements {
                    let mut entry = u64::from(node.raw()) | (TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_ELEMENT << TRACE_ENTRY_KIND_SHIFT);
                    if let Some(outcome) = outcome {
                        entry |= (outcome as u64) << TRACE_ENTRY_OUTCOME_SHIFT;
                    }
                    if changed.contains(&node) {
                        entry |= TRACE_ENTRY_CHANGED;
                    }
                    entries.push(entry);
                }
            }
            entries
        })
    }
}

impl PassCounts {
    /// Note `value` of `field` of the live report, where it is one of the counters.
    pub(super) fn note(&mut self, field: LiveField, value: u64) {
        let counter = match field {
            LiveField::Passes => StyleCounter::Passes,
            LiveField::FullPasses => StyleCounter::FullPasses,
            LiveField::StyledElements => StyleCounter::StyledElements,
            LiveField::ChangedElements => StyleCounter::ChangedElements,
            LiveField::HintedElements => StyleCounter::HintedElements,
            LiveField::HintedSubtrees => StyleCounter::HintedSubtrees,
            LiveField::InvalidationVisits => StyleCounter::InvalidationVisits,
            LiveField::InvalidationTests => StyleCounter::InvalidationTests,
        };
        self.counts[counter as usize] += value;
    }

    /// Note that the engine updated `index`, indexing `arrived` entries.
    pub(super) fn note_index_update(&mut self, index: &RuleIndex, arrived: usize) {
        self.counts[StyleCounter::IndexedEntries as usize] += arrived as u64;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::CompiledSelectors as usize] += index.compiled_selectors;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::UserAgentIndexBuilds as usize] += u64::from(index.built_user_agent_index);
        self.program_events.push((ProgramEvent::RuleIndexUpdated, 1));
        self.note_index_program(index);
    }

    /// Note that the engine built `index`.
    pub(super) fn note_index_build(&mut self, index: &RuleIndex) {
        self.counts[StyleCounter::IndexBuilds as usize] += 1;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::IndexedEntries as usize] += index.indexed_entries;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::CompiledSelectors as usize] += index.compiled_selectors;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::UserAgentIndexBuilds as usize] += u64::from(index.built_user_agent_index);
        self.program_events.push((ProgramEvent::RuleIndexBuilt, 1));
        self.note_index_program(index);
    }

    fn note_index_program(&mut self, index: &RuleIndex) {
        if index.built_user_agent_index {
            self.program_events.push((ProgramEvent::UserAgentRuleIndexBuilt, 1));
        }
        if index.compiled_selectors > 0 {
            self.program_events
                .push((ProgramEvent::SelectorsCompiled, index.compiled_selectors));
        }
    }

    /// Note a pass, which restyled everything where `full` is, and, where `traces` is, what it styled and `changed`,
    /// the elements whose records, or pseudo-element records, are not the ones they held.
    pub(super) fn note_pass(&mut self, full: bool, statistics: &Statistics, changed: &[StyleNodeID], traces: bool) {
        self.counts[StyleCounter::SharedElements as usize] += statistics.outcomes.shared;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::ReusedElements as usize] += statistics.outcomes.reused;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::MatchedElements as usize] += statistics.outcomes.matched;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::RelativeWalks as usize] += statistics.match_counters.relative_walks;
        if !traces {
            return;
        }
        let outcomes: std::collections::HashMap<StyleNodeID, TracedOutcome> =
            statistics.traced_outcomes.iter().copied().collect();
        let mut elements: Vec<(StyleNodeID, Option<TracedOutcome>)> = statistics
            .styled
            .iter()
            .map(|node| (*node, outcomes.get(node).copied()))
            .collect();
        elements.extend(
            statistics
                .moved_custom_properties
                .iter()
                .map(|node| (*node, Some(TracedOutcome::KeptWithMovedCustomProperties))),
        );
        self.traced.push(TracedPass {
            kind: if full {
                TracedPassKind::Full
            } else {
                TracedPassKind::Partial
            },
            elements,
            changed: changed.to_vec(),
            program_events: Vec::new(),
        });
    }
}

/// How many elements of a pass took the record of another, by how they found it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub(super) struct OutcomeCounts {
    shared: u64,
    reused: u64,
    /// The elements matched against the whole rule index.
    matched: u64,
}

impl OutcomeCounts {
    pub(super) fn note(&mut self, outcome: &Outcome) {
        match outcome {
            Outcome::Shared => self.shared += 1,
            Outcome::Reused => self.reused += 1,
            Outcome::Computed | Outcome::CascadeDeclined | Outcome::ComputeDeclined => {}
        }
    }

    /// Note an element matched against the whole rule index.
    pub(super) fn note_matched(&mut self) {
        self.matched += 1;
    }

    pub(super) fn add(&mut self, other: &Self) {
        self.shared += other.shared;
        self.reused += other.reused;
        self.matched += other.matched;
    }
}

/// What the engine did on a document's render state, and the passes it ran while a test traces
/// them.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(in super::super) struct Counters {
    counts: [u64; StyleCounter::COUNT],
    /// A fork starts without one: it restyles nothing until the host moves on under it.
    trace: crate::fork::ForkReset<Option<Box<StyleTrace>>>,
}

impl Counters {
    /// Take what a pass counted, once it kept the records it computed.
    pub(super) fn take_pass(&mut self, pass: &mut PassCounts) {
        let PassCounts {
            counts,
            traced,
            program_events,
        } = std::mem::take(pass);
        for (total, count) in self.counts.iter_mut().zip(counts) {
            *total += count;
        }
        for (event, times) in program_events {
            self.note_program_event(event, times);
        }
        if let Some(trace) = &mut *self.trace {
            trace.passes.extend(traced);
            trace.entries = None;
        }
    }

    /// Note, for a trace, that the engine did `event` to its rules `times` times.
    pub(in super::super) fn note_program_event(&mut self, event: ProgramEvent, times: u64) {
        let Some(trace) = &mut *self.trace else {
            return;
        };
        trace.entries = None;
        if let Some(pass) = trace.passes.last_mut()
            && pass.kind == TracedPassKind::Program
        {
            match pass.program_events.last_mut() {
                Some((last, total)) if *last == event => *total += times,
                _ => pass.program_events.push((event, times)),
            }
            return;
        }
        trace.passes.push(TracedPass {
            kind: TracedPassKind::Program,
            elements: Vec::new(),
            changed: Vec::new(),
            program_events: vec![(event, times)],
        });
    }

    /// Note that the engine started from a cold pass, with `index`, the rule index it built.
    pub(super) fn note_live_start(&mut self, index: &RuleIndex) {
        if let Some(trace) = &mut *self.trace {
            trace.passes.push(TracedPass {
                kind: TracedPassKind::Cold,
                elements: Vec::new(),
                changed: Vec::new(),
                program_events: Vec::new(),
            });
            trace.entries = None;
        }
        self.note_program_event(ProgramEvent::RuleIndexBuilt, 1);
        if index.built_user_agent_index {
            self.note_program_event(ProgramEvent::UserAgentRuleIndexBuilt, 1);
        }
        if index.compiled_selectors > 0 {
            self.note_program_event(ProgramEvent::SelectorsCompiled, index.compiled_selectors);
        }
        self.counts[StyleCounter::ColdPasses as usize] += 1;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::IndexBuilds as usize] += 1;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::IndexedEntries as usize] += index.indexed_entries;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::CompiledSelectors as usize] += index.compiled_selectors;
        self.counts[StyleCounter::UserAgentIndexBuilds as usize] += u64::from(index.built_user_agent_index);
    }

    /// Note that a cold pass built `index`, which counts the selectors it compiled.
    pub(super) fn note_cold_pass_index(&mut self, index: &RuleIndex) {
        self.counts[StyleCounter::CompiledSelectors as usize] += index.compiled_selectors;
    }

    /// The counter of index `index` of [`StyleCounter`], or zero for none.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in super::super) fn get(&self, index: u32) -> u64 {
        self.counts.get(index as usize).copied().unwrap_or(0)
    }

    /// Start tracing the passes of the engine anew.
    pub(in super::super) fn begin_trace(&mut self) {
        *self.trace = Some(Default::default());
    }

    /// Stop tracing the passes of the engine, forgetting the ones traced.
    pub(in super::super) fn end_trace(&mut self) {
        *self.trace = None;
    }

    pub(in super::super) fn is_tracing(&self) -> bool {
        self.trace.is_some()
    }

    /// The elements the traced passes styled, without the ones that only took moved custom properties, in the order a
    /// style traversal from `root` reaches them, or `None` where one of the passes restyled every element.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in super::super) fn elements_styled_by_traced_partial_passes(
        &self,
        tree: &Projection,
        root: StyleNodeID,
    ) -> Option<Vec<StyleNodeID>> {
        let passes = &self.trace.as_ref()?.passes;
        if passes
            .iter()
            .any(|pass| matches!(pass.kind, TracedPassKind::Full | TracedPassKind::Cold))
        {
            return None;
        }
        let styled: std::collections::HashSet<StyleNodeID> = passes
            .iter()
            .filter(|pass| pass.kind == TracedPassKind::Partial)
            .flat_map(|pass| &pass.elements)
            .filter(|(_, outcome)| *outcome != Some(TracedOutcome::KeptWithMovedCustomProperties))
            .map(|(node, _)| *node)
            .collect();
        Some(tree.style_preorder(root).filter(|node| styled.contains(node)).collect())
    }

    /// The traced passes as the host reads them: one entry per pass, its kind in bits 32 to 39, followed by one entry
    /// per element it lists, in the order a style traversal from `root` reaches them, with the element's node in bits 0
    /// to 31, the kind of an element entry, its outcome in bits 40 to 47, and bit 48 set where its record changed.
    pub(in super::super) fn trace_entries(&mut self, tree: &Projection, root: StyleNodeID) -> &[u64] {
        match &mut *self.trace {
            Some(trace) => trace.entries(tree, root),
            None => &[],
        }
    }

    /// Note that the host composed an animation sample over the record `node` installed,
    /// rebuilding every group of it where `rebuilt_every_group` is.
    pub(in super::super) fn note_animated_sample(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, rebuilt_every_group: bool) {
        if let Some(trace) = &mut *self.trace {
            let outcome = match rebuilt_every_group {
                true => TracedOutcome::SampledEveryGroup,
                false => TracedOutcome::Sampled,
            };
            match trace.passes.last_mut() {
                Some(pass) if pass.kind == TracedPassKind::Animation => pass.elements.push((node, Some(outcome))),
                _ => trace.passes.push(TracedPass {
                    kind: TracedPassKind::Animation,
                    elements: vec![(node, Some(outcome))],
                    changed: Vec::new(),
                    program_events: Vec::new(),
                }),
            }
            trace.entries = None;
        }
    }
}
