//! The host's side of the projection: the rows, which the host writes as its DOM changes and nothing else writes, and
//! the catalogs that spell their atoms. At each barrier the host publishes them to the render owner's [`Projection`]:
//! a generation of the rows that shares every chunk the host does not write again (the copy-on-write spine of a
//! [`CowColumn`]), with the elements written since the last barrier. The render owner reads only what was published,
//! so the host's writes beside a transaction in flight stay out of it without a copy.
//!
//! An element that left the tree is retired and forgotten here as its departure is published: the generations
//! published before keep its facts, which is where the render owner reads what a departed element carried.

use super::super::super::index::AttributeFact;
use super::super::super::index::AttributeNameForms;
use super::super::super::index::StyleAtomID;
use super::super::super::input_types::StateFact;
use super::super::super::input_types::TreeRelations;
use super::super::super::instrumentation::Counter;
use super::super::super::instrumentation::Counters;
use super::super::super::tree::StyleNodeID;

use super::super::super::element_declarations::{
    InlineDeclarationColumn, InlineDeclarationSnapshot, InlineDeclarations,
};
use super::super::super::element_host_facts::HostFactSet;
use super::super::super::element_host_facts::HostFactSets;
use super::ArrivalFacts;
use super::Catalogs;
use super::ElementFacts;
use super::Links;
use super::ROWS_PER_CHUNK;
use super::Row;
use super::ShadowColumn;
use super::ShadowLinks;
use super::ShadowSnapshot;
use super::SharedList;
use super::WrittenRows;
use super::fact_lists::FactLists;
use super::fact_lists::RecentFactLists;
use super::fact_lists::{EditedList, FactListsEdit};
use super::list_bloom_of;
use super::relations_of;
use super::subtree_keys_of;
use crate::cow_column::ColumnSnapshot;
use crate::cow_column::CowColumn;
use crate::css::declaration_block::SharedDeclarationBlock;
use crate::css::retained_fly_string::RetainedUtf16FlyString;
use smallvec::SmallVec;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// The counters a host's writes count, which a publication carries to the render owner's.
const WRITE_COUNTERS: [Counter; 8] = [
    Counter::RawMutationRecords,
    Counter::TreeDeltas,
    Counter::LocalFeatureDeltas,
    Counter::StateDeltas,
    Counter::ArrivingNodeFactsFolded,
    Counter::TreeDepartureDeltas,
    Counter::SlotAssignedNodeListsPublished,
    Counter::LanguageTextsPublished,
];

/// The rows of a document's elements as its host writes them.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct ProjectionWriter {
    rows: CowColumn<Row, ROWS_PER_CHUNK>,
    /// The elements' shadow relations, made only as far as the last element that held any.
    shadows: ShadowColumn,
    /// The elements' inline declarations.
    inline_declarations: InlineDeclarationColumn,
    /// Whether the inline declarations of an element were written since the last publication, which the rows written do
    /// not list: what a transaction takes of them the host says beside its rows.
    inline_declarations_written: bool,
    /// The rows as the host last published them.
    published: ColumnSnapshot<Row, ROWS_PER_CHUNK>,
    /// One past the greatest element slot written.
    slot_count: usize,
    catalogs: Catalogs,
    /// The distinct sets of host facts the rows name.
    host_fact_sets: Arc<HostFactSets>,
    recent_lists: RecentFactLists,
    /// A slotted text node's slot. Text nodes have no rows, and a slotted one is rare.
    text_assigned_slots: crate::cow_map::CowMap<StyleNodeID, StyleNodeID>,
    /// The elements whose facts say they are disabled, which only the writes of their states and their departures move.
    disabled: crate::cow_map::CowSet<StyleNodeID>,
    /// The elements whose rows were written since the last publication.
    written: WrittenRows,
    /// Of those, the elements whose links were written.
    links_written: WrittenRows,
    /// Of those, the elements whose own relations were written, rather than only their first element child.
    relations_written: WrittenRows,
    /// Whether the catalogs or the slots of text nodes were written since the last publication, which no row says.
    catalogs_written: bool,
    /// Whether the host facts of an element were written since the last publication, which the rows written do not
    /// list: no transaction takes them.
    host_facts_written: bool,
    /// The elements the host took out of the tree since the last publication.
    departures: Vec<StyleNodeID>,
    /// What the writes since the last publication counted.
    pub(in crate::css::style) counters: Counters,
}

/// What the host published of its rows at a barrier: the rows as written, which share every chunk with the host's
/// until it writes there again, with the catalogs, and the elements written since the barrier before.
pub(in crate::css::style) struct ProjectionPublication {
    pub(super) rows: ColumnSnapshot<Row, ROWS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(super) shadows: ShadowSnapshot,
    pub(in crate::css::style) inline_declarations: InlineDeclarationSnapshot,
    pub(super) slot_count: usize,
    pub(super) catalogs: Catalogs,
    pub(super) host_fact_sets: Arc<HostFactSets>,
    pub(super) text_assigned_slots: crate::cow_map::CowMap<StyleNodeID, StyleNodeID>,
    pub(super) disabled: crate::cow_map::CowSet<StyleNodeID>,
    pub(super) written: Vec<StyleNodeID>,
    pub(super) links_written: Vec<StyleNodeID>,
    pub(super) relations_written: Vec<StyleNodeID>,
    /// What the writes counted.
    pub(in crate::css::style) counts: SmallVec<[(Counter, u64); 4]>,
}

impl ProjectionPublication {
    /// How many elements' links the publication wrote, each of which may deepen the tree by a level.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn link_rows_written(&self) -> usize {
        self.links_written.len()
    }

    /// Whether the publication moves elements in the tree, or their shadow relations.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn moves_links(&self) -> bool {
        !self.links_written.is_empty()
    }
}

impl ProjectionWriter {
    /// Counts what the host's rows hold beside the projection: the chunks, shadow relations and
    /// catalogs it wrote since the barrier, as those it shares with the published projection are
    /// counted where they are seen first, and the lists of what it wrote. Like the generations a
    /// transaction in flight holds, how much that is depends on when the report runs.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn report_memory(&self, report: &mut crate::css::style::memory_report::MemoryReport) {
        let sizer = &mut report.sizer;
        let mut bytes = self.rows.heap_size(sizer, Row::heap_size)
            + self.shadows.heap_size(sizer, |shadow, sizer| {
                super::shadow_links_heap_size(shadow.as_ref(), sizer)
            })
            + self.inline_declarations.heap_size(sizer, InlineDeclarations::heap_size)
            + self.published.heap_size(sizer, Row::heap_size);
        if sizer.arc_shallow(&self.host_fact_sets) != 0 {
            bytes += crate::heap_size::ARC_HEADER_BYTES + size_of::<HostFactSets>() + self.host_fact_sets.heap_size();
        }
        let catalogs = &self.catalogs;
        bytes += catalogs.name_forms.heap_size(sizer);
        bytes += catalogs.value_texts.heap_size(sizer);
        for texts in [&catalogs.substitution_names, &catalogs.language_texts] {
            bytes += texts.heap_size(sizer);
            bytes += texts.values().map(|text| size_of_val::<[u16]>(text)).sum::<usize>();
        }
        bytes += self.text_assigned_slots.heap_size();
        bytes += self.disabled.heap_size();
        bytes += [&self.written, &self.links_written, &self.relations_written]
            .iter()
            .map(|rows| rows.heap_size())
            .sum::<usize>();
        bytes += crate::heap_size::vec_bytes(&self.departures);
        report.add(
            crate::css::style::memory_report::MemoryOwner::ProjectionGenerations,
            bytes,
        );
    }

    /// The writes the host makes, with what they mean.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn writes(&mut self) -> super::super::super::projection_writes::ProjectionWrites<'_> {
        super::super::super::projection_writes::ProjectionWrites { projection: self }
    }

    /// Whether anything was written since the last publication.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn has_unpublished_writes(&self) -> bool {
        !self.written.nodes.is_empty()
            || self.catalogs_written
            || self.host_facts_written
            || self.inline_declarations_written
    }

    /// Publish the rows as written: the barrier the render owner takes them at. The elements that left the tree are
    /// retired and forgotten as their departure is published.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn publish(&mut self) -> ProjectionPublication {
        let mut departed = std::mem::take(&mut self.departures);
        departed.retain(|&node| {
            self.row(node)
                .is_some_and(|row| row.live() && relations_of(row).is_none())
        });
        // NB: Nothing routes from a departed element's facts but the generations published before, which keep them.
        for &node in &departed {
            self.retire(node);
            self.note_disabled(node, false);
            if let Some(mut row) = self.rows.row_mut(node.element_slot()) {
                row.facts = row.facts.forgotten();
            }
        }
        self.summarize_written_subtrees();
        let rows = self.rows.publish();
        self.catalogs_written = false;
        self.host_facts_written = false;
        self.inline_declarations_written = false;
        let counts = WRITE_COUNTERS
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|counter| {
                let count = self.counters.get(counter);
                self.counters.set(counter, 0);
                (count != 0).then_some((counter, count))
            })
            .collect();
        let publication = ProjectionPublication {
            rows: rows.clone(),
            shadows: self.shadows.publish(),
            inline_declarations: self.inline_declarations.publish(),
            slot_count: self.slot_count,
            catalogs: self.catalogs.clone(),
            host_fact_sets: Arc::clone(&self.host_fact_sets),
            text_assigned_slots: self.text_assigned_slots.clone(),
            disabled: self.disabled.clone(),
            written: self.written.take(),
            links_written: self.links_written.take(),
            relations_written: self.relations_written.take(),
            counts,
        };
        self.published = rows;
        publication
    }

    /// Bring the summaries of the keys below each element up to date with the rows written. A summary changes only as
    /// the keys or the parent of a descendant do, both of which write the descendant's row. Each written element
    /// hands its keys and its summary up to its ancestors, as far as one that holds them all already: that one's
    /// ancestors hold them too.
    fn summarize_written_subtrees(&mut self) {
        for index in 0..self.written.nodes.len() {
            let node = self.written.nodes[index];
            let Some(row) = self.row(node).filter(|row| row.live()) else {
                continue;
            };
            let keys = row.subtree_keys | subtree_keys_of(&row.facts.lists, &self.catalogs.name_forms);
            let mut ancestor = row.links.parent;
            while let Some(current) = ancestor {
                let slot = current.element_slot();
                let Some((held, parent)) = self.rows.get(slot).map(|row| (row.subtree_keys, row.links.parent)) else {
                    break;
                };
                if held & keys == keys {
                    break;
                }
                if let Some(mut row) = self.rows.row_mut(slot) {
                    row.subtree_keys = held | keys;
                }
                ancestor = parent;
            }
        }
    }

    /// How many times the rows were written where an edit changed them, which a test reads to see that an edit that
    /// changes nothing copies no chunk.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(super) fn rows_version(&self) -> u64 {
        self.rows.version()
    }

    fn row(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<&Row> {
        self.rows.get(node.element_slot())
    }

    fn note_written(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, slot: usize) {
        self.written.insert(node, slot);
    }

    fn note_links_written(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID) {
        self.links_written.insert(node, node.element_slot());
    }

    /// Note whether the facts of `node` say it is disabled.
    fn note_disabled(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, disabled: bool) {
        if self.disabled.contains(&node) == disabled {
            return;
        }
        let elements = &mut self.disabled;
        if disabled {
            elements.insert(node);
        } else {
            elements.remove(&node);
        }
    }

    /// The element's facts as written, or none where nothing was written of it.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn written_facts(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<&ElementFacts> {
        self.row(node).map(|row| &row.facts).filter(|facts| facts.resident())
    }

    /// How the element stands in the tree as written, or none where it stands in no tree.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn written_relations(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<TreeRelations> {
        self.row(node).and_then(relations_of)
    }

    /// Whether the relations of `node` were written since the last publication.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn relations_were_written(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> bool {
        node.element_index().is_some() && self.relations_written.contains(node.element_slot())
    }

    /// Whether `node` arrives in the publication to come: it stood in no tree as last published, and stands in one as
    /// written.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn arrival_is_pending(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> bool {
        node.element_index().is_some()
            && self.published.get(node.element_slot()).and_then(relations_of).is_none()
            && self.written_relations(node).is_some()
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn shadow_root_of(&self, host: StyleNodeID) -> Option<StyleNodeID> {
        self.shadow(host)?.shadow_root
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn host_of(&self, shadow_root: StyleNodeID) -> Option<StyleNodeID> {
        self.shadow(shadow_root)?.host
    }

    fn assigned_nodes_of(&self, slot: StyleNodeID) -> &[StyleNodeID] {
        self.shadow(slot).map_or(&[], |shadow| shadow.assigned_nodes.as_slice())
    }

    /// Edit the row of an element, making room for it first.
    fn edit<R>(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut Row) -> R) -> R {
        let slot = node.element_slot();
        assert!(node.element_index().is_some(), "only an element has a projection row");
        self.note_written(node, slot);
        self.rows.grow_to(slot + 1);
        self.slot_count = self.slot_count.max(slot + 1);
        let mut row = self.rows.row_mut(slot).expect("the row was just made room for");
        let answer = edit(&mut row);
        drop(row);
        answer
    }

    fn edit_facts(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut ElementFacts)) {
        let slot = node.element_slot();
        assert!(node.element_index().is_some(), "only an element has a projection row");
        self.note_written(node, slot);
        self.rows.grow_to(slot + 1);
        self.slot_count = self.slot_count.max(slot + 1);
        let mut row = self.rows.row_mut(slot).expect("the row was just made room for");
        row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::RESIDENT, true);
        edit(&mut row.facts);
        row.facts.refresh_dispatch_bloom();
        drop(row);
    }

    /// Edit the fact lists of an element as its links move, which `edit` says whether it changed, without publishing a
    /// fact of it: its tree scope and assigned slot live in its lists, but say nothing of the element itself.
    fn edit_lists_quietly(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut FactListsEdit) -> bool) {
        let empty = FactLists::default();
        let mut lists = self
            .rows
            .get(node.element_slot())
            .map_or_else(|| empty.edit(), |row| row.facts.lists.edit());
        if !edit(&mut lists) {
            return;
        }
        let lists = Self::make_lists(&mut self.recent_lists, &self.catalogs.name_forms, lists);
        self.edit(node, |row| row.facts.lists = lists);
    }

    /// Edit the fact lists of an element, which `edit` says whether it changed. Lists made the same
    /// as ones made recently share their allocation.
    fn edit_lists(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut FactListsEdit) -> bool) {
        let empty = FactLists::default();
        let mut lists = self
            .rows
            .get(node.element_slot())
            .map_or_else(|| empty.edit(), |row| row.facts.lists.edit());
        if !edit(&mut lists) {
            self.edit_facts(node, |_| {});
            return;
        }
        let lists = Self::make_lists(&mut self.recent_lists, &self.catalogs.name_forms, lists);
        self.edit_facts(node, |facts| facts.lists = lists);
    }

    /// Fact lists holding what `lists` holds, with the Bloom summary of their dispatch keys, shared with any made the
    /// same.
    fn make_lists(
        recent_lists: &mut RecentFactLists,
        name_forms: &super::Catalog<AttributeNameForms>,
        mut lists: FactListsEdit,
    ) -> FactLists {
        lists.bloom = list_bloom_of(&lists, name_forms);
        recent_lists.make(&lists, &crate::render_state::process_style().fact_lists)
    }

    fn shadow(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<&ShadowLinks> {
        self.shadows.get(node.element_slot())?.as_deref()
    }

    fn edit_shadow<R>(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut ShadowLinks) -> R) -> R {
        // NB: The element's row is written too, so that the publication lists the element.
        self.edit(node, |_| ());
        let slot = node.element_slot();
        let mut shadow = self.shadow(node).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let result = edit(&mut shadow);
        let shadow = (shadow != ShadowLinks::default()).then(|| Arc::new(shadow));
        if shadow.is_some() || self.shadows.get(slot).is_some_and(Option::is_some) {
            self.shadows.grow_to(slot + 1);
            self.shadows.set(slot, shadow);
        }
        result
    }

    /// Take the element's shadow relations, leaving it none.
    fn take_shadow(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<Arc<ShadowLinks>> {
        let slot = node.element_slot();
        let shadow = self.shadows.get(slot).cloned().flatten()?;
        self.shadows.set(slot, None);
        Some(shadow)
    }

    /// Make the element identity `node` live, with no links yet.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn mint(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID) {
        self.edit(node, |row| {
            assert!(!row.live(), "minting an element identity that is live");
            row.links = Links::default();
            row.subtree_keys = 0;
            row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::LIVE, true);
            row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::CONNECTED, false);
            // NB: A departed element keeps its host facts until its identity is minted again, which may hand it to a
            //     shadow root or the document, which publish none of their own.
            row.facts.host_facts = Default::default();
        });
    }

    /// Have the inline declarations of `node` be `block`, answering those it held. The render owner reads them from the
    /// next publication on.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn write_inline_declarations(
        &mut self,
        node: StyleNodeID,
        block: Option<SharedDeclarationBlock>,
    ) -> Option<SharedDeclarationBlock> {
        let slot = node.element_slot();
        if block.is_none()
            && !self
                .inline_declarations
                .get(slot)
                .is_some_and(InlineDeclarations::is_some)
        {
            return None;
        }
        self.inline_declarations.grow_to(slot + 1);
        self.inline_declarations_written = true;
        self.inline_declarations
            .replace(slot, InlineDeclarations::new(block))
            .and_then(InlineDeclarations::into_block)
    }

    /// Retire the element identity `node`, dropping its links and every shadow relation that names
    /// it. Its facts stay until [`Self::forget`].
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn retire(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID) {
        self.write_inline_declarations(node, None);
        let slot = self.edit(node, |row| {
            assert!(row.live(), "retiring an identity that is not live");
            row.links = Links::default();
            row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::LIVE, false);
            row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::CONNECTED, false);
            row.facts.lists.assigned_slot()
        });
        if slot.is_some() {
            self.edit_lists_quietly(node, |lists| std::mem::take(&mut lists.assigned_slot).is_some());
        }
        let shadow = self.take_shadow(node);
        if let Some(slot) = slot {
            self.remove_assigned_node(slot, node);
        }
        let Some(shadow) = shadow else {
            return;
        };
        for &assigned in shadow.assigned_nodes.as_slice() {
            if assigned.text_index().is_some() {
                if self.text_assigned_slots.get(&assigned) == Some(&node) {
                    self.text_assigned_slots.remove(&assigned);
                }
            } else if self.row(assigned).and_then(|row| row.facts.lists.assigned_slot()) == Some(node) {
                self.edit_lists_quietly(assigned, |lists| std::mem::take(&mut lists.assigned_slot).is_some());
            }
        }
        if let Some(root) = shadow.shadow_root {
            self.edit_shadow(root, |links| links.host = None);
        }
        if let Some(host) = shadow.host {
            self.edit_shadow(host, |links| links.shadow_root = None);
        }
    }

    /// Retire text identities, dropping them from the slot each was assigned to.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn retire_texts(&mut self, nodes: impl IntoIterator<Item = StyleNodeID>) {
        for node in nodes {
            let Some(slot) = self.text_assigned_slots.remove(&node) else {
                continue;
            };
            self.remove_assigned_node(slot, node);
        }
    }

    fn remove_assigned_node(&mut self, slot: StyleNodeID, node: StyleNodeID) {
        if !self.assigned_nodes_of(slot).contains(&node) {
            return;
        }
        self.edit_shadow(slot, |links| {
            let remaining: Vec<_> = links
                .assigned_nodes
                .as_slice()
                .iter()
                .copied()
                .filter(|&assigned| assigned != node)
                .collect();
            links.assigned_nodes = SharedList::new(&remaining);
        });
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    /// Drop the facts of an element that departed, now that nothing can still route from them.
    /// They leave what style reads when the transaction is released.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn forget(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID) {
        if self.row(node).is_some_and(|row| row.facts.resident()) {
            self.note_disabled(node, false);
            self.edit(node, |row| row.facts = row.facts.forgotten());
        }
    }

    /// Give a node a row without publishing a fact of it, as a shadow root, which is featureless,
    /// still has to be readable.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn ensure_facts(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID) {
        self.edit_facts(node, |_| {});
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_tag(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, tag: StyleAtomID) {
        self.edit_facts(node, |facts| facts.tag = tag);
    }

    /// A folding equal to the name itself carries no information and is dropped.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_folded_tag(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, folded: StyleAtomID) {
        let tag = self.row(node).map_or(StyleAtomID::NONE, |row| row.facts.tag);
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            let folded = if folded == tag { StyleAtomID::NONE } else { folded };
            std::mem::replace(&mut lists.folded_tag, folded) != folded
        });
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_namespace(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, namespace: StyleAtomID) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            std::mem::replace(&mut lists.namespace, namespace) != namespace
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_id(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, id: StyleAtomID) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| std::mem::replace(&mut lists.id, id) != id);
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_state(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, fact: StateFact, value: bool) {
        if fact == StateFact::Disabled {
            self.note_disabled(node, value);
        }
        self.edit_facts(node, |facts| match value {
            true => facts.states.insert(fact),
            false => facts.states.remove(fact),
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_language(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, language: StyleAtomID) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            std::mem::replace(&mut lists.language, language) != language
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_directionality(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, directionality: StyleAtomID) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            std::mem::replace(&mut lists.directionality, directionality) != directionality
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_part_exposure(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, exposure: StyleAtomID) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            std::mem::replace(&mut lists.part_exposure, exposure) != exposure
        });
    }

    /// The host facts of the element as written.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn written_host_facts(&self, node: StyleNodeID) -> HostFactSet {
        let id = self.row(node).map(|row| row.facts.host_facts).unwrap_or_default();
        self.host_fact_sets.get(id)
    }

    /// Change the host facts of the element with `edit`, without noting its row written for a transaction, but where
    /// the element-backed pseudo-element it stands for moves, which is a key of the element: the host facts change
    /// nothing a transaction reads. Answers the facts as they were.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn edit_host_facts(
        &mut self,
        node: StyleNodeID,
        edit: impl FnOnce(&mut HostFactSet),
    ) -> HostFactSet {
        assert!(node.element_index().is_some(), "only an element has host facts");
        let previous = self.written_host_facts(node);
        let mut set = previous;
        edit(&mut set);
        if set == previous {
            return previous;
        }
        let id = match self.host_fact_sets.id_of(&set) {
            Some(id) => id,
            None => Arc::make_mut(&mut self.host_fact_sets).intern(set),
        };
        let slot = node.element_slot();
        self.rows.grow_to(slot + 1);
        self.slot_count = self.slot_count.max(slot + 1);
        self.rows
            .row_mut(slot)
            .expect("the row was just made room for")
            .facts
            .host_facts = id;
        self.host_facts_written = true;
        if previous.associated_pseudo_kind() != set.associated_pseudo_kind() {
            self.note_written(node, slot);
        }
        previous
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_heading_level(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, level: u8) {
        self.edit_facts(node, |facts| facts.heading_level = level);
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_has_text_content(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, has_text_content: bool) {
        self.edit_facts(node, |facts| {
            facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::HAS_TEXT_CONTENT, has_text_content);
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_class(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, class: StyleAtomID, present: bool) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            match (present, lists.classes.binary_search(&class)) {
                (true, Err(index)) => lists.classes.to_mut().insert(index, class),
                (false, Ok(index)) => {
                    lists.classes.to_mut().remove(index);
                }
                _ => return false,
            }
            true
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_attribute(
        &mut self,
        node: StyleNodeID,
        name: StyleAtomID,
        value: StyleAtomID,
        present: bool,
    ) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            let attributes = &mut lists.attributes;
            match (
                present,
                attributes.binary_search_by_key(&name, |attribute| attribute.name),
            ) {
                (true, Ok(index)) if attributes[index].value == value => return false,
                (true, Ok(index)) => attributes.to_mut()[index].value = value,
                (true, Err(index)) => attributes.to_mut().insert(index, AttributeFact { name, value }),
                (false, Ok(index)) => {
                    attributes.to_mut().remove(index);
                }
                (false, Err(_)) => return false,
            }
            true
        });
    }

    /// Write every fact an element arrives with in one edit of its row: the facts it names are
    /// set, its classes and attributes join any its row holds, and its states join those set.
    /// Relations it arrives with are written in the same edit, as [`Self::write_relations`] writes them.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn write_arrival_facts(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, arrival: &ArrivalFacts<'_>) {
        let empty = FactLists::default();
        let mut lists = self
            .rows
            .get(node.element_slot())
            .map_or_else(|| empty.edit(), |row| row.facts.lists.edit());
        for &class in arrival.classes {
            if let Err(index) = lists.classes.binary_search(&class) {
                lists.classes.to_mut().insert(index, class);
            }
        }
        for &attribute in arrival.attributes {
            match lists
                .attributes
                .binary_search_by_key(&attribute.name, |written| written.name)
            {
                Ok(index) => lists.attributes.to_mut()[index].value = attribute.value,
                Err(index) => lists.attributes.to_mut().insert(index, attribute),
            }
        }
        lists.custom_states = EditedList::Held(arrival.custom_states);
        lists.namespace = arrival.namespace;
        if !arrival.id.is_none() {
            lists.id = arrival.id;
        }
        if !arrival.language.is_none() {
            lists.language = arrival.language;
        }
        if !arrival.directionality.is_none() {
            lists.directionality = arrival.directionality;
        }
        lists.folded_tag = match arrival.folded_tag == arrival.tag {
            true => StyleAtomID::NONE,
            false => arrival.folded_tag,
        };
        if let Some(relations) = arrival.relations {
            lists.tree_scope = relations.tree_scope;
            lists.assigned_slot = relations.assigned_slot;
        }
        let lists = Self::make_lists(&mut self.recent_lists, &self.catalogs.name_forms, lists);
        if arrival.relations.is_some() {
            self.relations_written.insert(node, node.element_slot());
            self.note_links_written(node);
        }
        if arrival.states.contains(StateFact::Disabled) {
            self.note_disabled(node, true);
        }
        self.edit(node, |row| {
            if let Some(relations) = arrival.relations {
                assert!(row.live(), "linking an identity that is not live");
                row.links.parent = relations.parent;
                row.links.previous_element_sibling = relations.previous_element_sibling;
                row.links.next_element_sibling = relations.next_element_sibling;
                row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::CONNECTED, true);
            }
            let facts = &mut row.facts;
            facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::RESIDENT, true);
            facts.tag = arrival.tag;
            facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::IS_SLOT, arrival.is_slot);
            facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::HAS_TEXT_CONTENT, arrival.has_text_content);
            facts.states.0 |= arrival.states.0;
            if arrival.heading_level != 0 {
                facts.heading_level = arrival.heading_level;
            }
            facts.lists = lists;
            facts.refresh_dispatch_bloom();
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_parts(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, parts: &[StyleAtomID]) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            if &*lists.parts == parts {
                return false;
            }
            lists.parts = EditedList::Changed(SmallVec::from_slice(parts));
            true
        });
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_custom_states(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, states: &[StyleAtomID]) {
        self.edit_lists(node, |lists| {
            if &*lists.custom_states == states {
                return false;
            }
            lists.custom_states = EditedList::Changed(SmallVec::from_slice(states));
            true
        });
    }

    /// Record the other names an attribute name answers to, where the two atoms are minted.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn note_attribute_name_forms(&mut self, name: StyleAtomID, forms: AttributeNameForms) {
        if self.catalogs.name_forms.get(&name) != Some(&forms) {
            self.catalogs.name_forms.insert(name, forms);
            self.catalogs_written = true;
        }
    }

    /// Record the local name an `attr()` reads the attribute `name` by, which is in no namespace.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn note_attribute_substitution_name(&mut self, name: StyleAtomID, local_name: &[u16]) {
        if self.catalogs.substitution_names.get(&name).map(AsRef::as_ref) != Some(local_name) {
            self.catalogs.substitution_names.insert(name, local_name.into());
            self.catalogs_written = true;
        }
    }

    /// Record what one attribute-value atom spells. The first spelling stands for as long as the
    /// atom does.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_attribute_value_text(&mut self, value: StyleAtomID, text: RetainedUtf16FlyString) {
        if !value.is_none() && !self.catalogs.value_texts.contains_key(&value) {
            self.catalogs.value_texts.insert(value, text);
            self.catalogs_written = true;
        }
    }

    /// Record what one language atom spells. The first spelling stands for as long as the atom
    /// does.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_language_text(&mut self, language: StyleAtomID, text: &[u16]) {
        if !language.is_none() && !self.catalogs.language_texts.contains_key(&language) {
            self.catalogs.language_texts.insert(language, text.into());
            self.catalogs_written = true;
        }
    }

    /// Drop everything the catalogs hold of atoms that are reclaimed, before an identity can be
    /// reused to spell something else.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn forget_atoms(&mut self, atoms: &[StyleAtomID]) {
        self.catalogs.name_forms.forget(atoms);
        self.catalogs.substitution_names.forget(atoms);
        self.catalogs.value_texts.forget(atoms);
        self.catalogs.language_texts.forget(atoms);
    }

    /// Edit the relations of an element, which are all its links but its first element child.
    fn edit_links(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut Row)) {
        self.relations_written.insert(node, node.element_slot());
        self.edit_any_links(node, edit);
    }

    fn edit_any_links(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut Row)) {
        self.note_links_written(node);
        self.edit(node, |row| {
            assert!(row.live(), "linking an identity that is not live");
            edit(row);
        });
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_parent(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, parent: Option<StyleNodeID>) {
        self.edit_links(node, |row| row.links.parent = parent);
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_first_element_child(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, child: Option<StyleNodeID>) {
        self.edit_any_links(node, |row| row.links.first_element_child = child);
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_previous_element_sibling(
        &mut self,
        node: StyleNodeID,
        sibling: Option<StyleNodeID>,
    ) {
        self.edit_links(node, |row| row.links.previous_element_sibling = sibling);
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_next_element_sibling(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, sibling: Option<StyleNodeID>) {
        self.edit_links(node, |row| row.links.next_element_sibling = sibling);
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_connected(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, connected: bool) {
        self.edit_links(node, |row| row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::CONNECTED, connected));
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    /// Assign an element to `slot`, or to no slot.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_assigned_slot(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, slot: Option<StyleNodeID>) {
        self.note_links_written(node);
        self.relations_written.insert(node, node.element_slot());
        self.edit_lists_quietly(node, |lists| std::mem::replace(&mut lists.assigned_slot, slot) != slot);
    }

    /// Write how an element stands in the tree, or that it stands in none, leaving the links of
    /// its neighbors to their own writes. An element leaving keeps its tree scope.
    ///
    /// The write is noted even where the row holds these relations already: the host moved them,
    /// and an element it took out of a tree has to be settled as departed.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn write_relations(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, relations: Option<TreeRelations>) {
        let mut departed = false;
        self.edit_links(node, |row| {
            let links = &mut row.links;
            match relations {
                Some(relations) => {
                    links.parent = relations.parent;
                    links.previous_element_sibling = relations.previous_element_sibling;
                    links.next_element_sibling = relations.next_element_sibling;
                }
                None => {
                    departed = true;
                    links.parent = None;
                    links.previous_element_sibling = None;
                    links.next_element_sibling = None;
                }
            }
            row.facts.set_flag(ElementFacts::CONNECTED, relations.is_some());
        });
        // NB: An element leaving keeps its tree scope.
        let (tree_scope, assigned_slot) = match relations {
            Some(relations) => (Some(relations.tree_scope), relations.assigned_slot),
            None => (None, None),
        };
        self.edit_lists_quietly(node, |lists| {
            let scope_moved = tree_scope.is_some_and(|scope| std::mem::replace(&mut lists.tree_scope, scope) != scope);
            let slot_moved = std::mem::replace(&mut lists.assigned_slot, assigned_slot) != assigned_slot;
            scope_moved || slot_moved
        });
        if departed {
            self.departures.push(node);
        }
    }

    /// Record that `host` hosts `shadow_root`, unpairing whichever root or host either had before.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_shadow_root(&mut self, host: StyleNodeID, shadow_root: StyleNodeID) {
        let previous_root = self.edit_shadow(host, |links| links.shadow_root.replace(shadow_root));
        if let Some(previous_root) = previous_root
            && previous_root != shadow_root
            && self.host_of(previous_root) == Some(host)
        {
            self.edit_shadow(previous_root, |links| links.host = None);
        }
        let previous_host = self.edit_shadow(shadow_root, |links| links.host.replace(host));
        if let Some(previous_host) = previous_host
            && previous_host != host
            && self.shadow_root_of(previous_host) == Some(shadow_root)
        {
            self.edit_shadow(previous_host, |links| links.shadow_root = None);
        }
    }

    /// Replace the ordered list of nodes `slot` has assigned to it. An element's own slot arrives
    /// with its links; a text node has none, so this is where its slot comes from.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_assigned_nodes(&mut self, slot: StyleNodeID, nodes: &[StyleNodeID]) {
        if nodes == self.assigned_nodes_of(slot) && nodes.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let previous: Vec<_> = self.assigned_nodes_of(slot).to_vec();
        let text_slots = &mut self.text_assigned_slots;
        // A tree-wide assignment can have moved a departing text node to another slot already,
        // and this slot must not take that newer assignment away again.
        for node in &previous {
            if text_slots.get(node) == Some(&slot) {
                text_slots.remove(node);
            }
        }
        for &node in nodes {
            if node.text_index().is_some() {
                text_slots.insert(node, slot);
            }
        }
        self.edit_shadow(slot, |links| links.assigned_nodes = SharedList::new(nodes));
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn set_part_hosts(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, pairs: &[(StyleAtomID, StyleNodeID)]) {
        self.edit_shadow(node, |links| links.part_hosts = SharedList::new(pairs));
    }
}

//! The computed styles a style pass produced, by element, which the elements after them compute
//! against. Each element's record is written once, by whichever thread styles it, before any of its
//! children is styled.

use super::super::animations::DeclarationScope;
use super::super::container_queries::{ContainerRecords, ContainerVerdict};
use super::super::input_types::TransactionFactSide;
use super::super::selector_evaluation::StructuralRead;
use super::super::*;
use super::drive::DriveRecords;
use super::traversal::InitialStyle;
use super::write_once::WriteOnce;
use crate::css::computed_values::{GroupSeed, GroupValueFacts, GroupValueLayout, LonghandID};
use crate::css::style::installed_records::InstalledRecordID;
use crate::css::style::memory_report::{MemoryOwner, MemoryReport};
use crate::css::style_compute::RootFontReads;
use crate::css::table_group_builder::group_index;
use std::borrow::Cow;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// One element's computed style: its groups, each holding one reference, with their computed values,
/// the facts its readers read without them, and what its computation recorded beside them.
#[repr(C)]
pub(crate) struct Record {
    /// NB: First, so that a record's address is the address of the groups the host and layout read
    ///     through their places.
    pub(in super::super) payloads: crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups,
    /// What the record's readers read of the element's style without its groups, and the identity
    /// of the slot holding the record.
    pub(super) header: RecordHeader,
}

/// A record's header word, which the host reads from its own thread: the facts of the record,
/// settled when it is made, the computed `display` in bits 0-12 and the flags in bits 16-23; whether
/// its groups hold images in bit 15, which bit 14 says is settled, by the thread computing it or the
/// slot taking it; and the identity of that slot, its index in bits 24-47 and its generation in bits
/// 48-63, which the slot names as it takes the record and forgets as it lets go of it.
pub(in super::super) struct RecordHeader(std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64);

const _: () = assert!((InstalledRecordID::MAX_SLOT as u64) < RecordHeader::SLOT_MASK);
const _: () = assert!((InstalledRecordID::MAX_GENERATION as u64) <= u64::MAX >> RecordHeader::GENERATION_SHIFT);

impl RecordHeader {
    const DISPLAY_MASK: u64 = (1 << 13) - 1;
    const IMAGE_VALUES_SETTLED: u64 = 1 << 14;
    const HOLDS_IMAGE_VALUES: u64 = 1 << 15;
    const FLAGS_SHIFT: u32 = 16;
    const SLOT_SHIFT: u32 = 24;
    const GENERATION_SHIFT: u32 = 48;
    const SLOT_MASK: u64 = (1 << 24) - 1;
    /// The slot bits of a record no slot holds.
    const NO_SLOT: u64 = Self::SLOT_MASK;
    const IDENTITY_MASK: u64 = !((1 << Self::SLOT_SHIFT) - 1);

    pub(super) fn new(facts: RecordFacts) -> Self {
        Self(std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(
            u64::from(facts.display) | u64::from(facts.flags) << Self::FLAGS_SHIFT | Self::NO_SLOT << Self::SLOT_SHIFT,
        ))
    }

    fn facts(&self) -> RecordFacts {
        let header = self.load();
        RecordFacts {
            display: (header & Self::DISPLAY_MASK) as u16,
            flags: (header >> Self::FLAGS_SHIFT) as u8,
        }
    }

    fn load(&self) -> u64 {
        self.0.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)
    }

    fn holds_image_values(&self) -> bool {
        self.load() & Self::HOLDS_IMAGE_VALUES != 0
    }

    /// Replaces the bits of `mask` with `bits` in one step: the host reads the word from its own thread, and must
    /// never see an identity no slot named.
    fn replace(&self, mask: u64, bits: u64) {
        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
        let _ = self
            .0
            .fetch_update(Relaxed, Relaxed, |header| Some((header & !mask) | bits));
    }

    fn set_holds_image_values(&self, holds_image_values: bool) {
        self.replace(
            Self::IMAGE_VALUES_SETTLED | Self::HOLDS_IMAGE_VALUES,
            Self::IMAGE_VALUES_SETTLED
                | if holds_image_values {
                    Self::HOLDS_IMAGE_VALUES
                } else {
                    0
                },
        );
    }

    /// Whether the groups of the record hold images, where that is settled.
    fn settled_holds_image_values(&self) -> Option<bool> {
        let header = self.load();
        (header & Self::IMAGE_VALUES_SETTLED != 0).then_some(header & Self::HOLDS_IMAGE_VALUES != 0)
    }

    fn installed_record(&self) -> Option<InstalledRecordID> {
        let header = self.load();
        match (header >> Self::SLOT_SHIFT) & Self::SLOT_MASK {
            Self::NO_SLOT => None,
            slot => Some(InstalledRecordID::from_parts(
                slot as u32,
                (header >> Self::GENERATION_SHIFT) as u32,
            )),
        }
    }

    /// Names the slot `id` where no slot is named yet, and answers whether it did: a fork of the
    /// render state may be naming a slot of its own for the same record on its own thread.
    fn name_installed_record(&self, id: InstalledRecordID) -> bool {
        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
        assert!(id.slot() <= InstalledRecordID::MAX_SLOT && id.generation() <= InstalledRecordID::MAX_GENERATION);
        let identity = u64::from(id.slot()) << Self::SLOT_SHIFT | u64::from(id.generation()) << Self::GENERATION_SHIFT;
        self.0
            .fetch_update(Relaxed, Relaxed, |header| {
                ((header >> Self::SLOT_SHIFT) & Self::SLOT_MASK == Self::NO_SLOT)
                    .then_some((header & !Self::IDENTITY_MASK) | identity)
            })
            .is_ok()
    }

    fn forget_installed_record(&self) {
        self.replace(Self::IDENTITY_MASK, Self::NO_SLOT << Self::SLOT_SHIFT);
    }
}

/// The pseudo-element of a kind, or the `::highlight()` of a custom highlight name.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(in super::super) struct PseudoElementTarget {
    pub(in super::super) kind: u8,
    pub(in super::super) highlight_name: StyleAtomID,
}

impl PseudoElementTarget {
    pub(in super::super) const fn of_kind(kind: u8) -> Self {
        Self {
            kind,
            highlight_name: StyleAtomID::NONE,
        }
    }

    pub(in super::super) const fn custom_highlight(name: StyleAtomID) -> Self {
        Self {
            kind: super::super::publication::pseudo_kind::HIGHLIGHT,
            highlight_name: name,
        }
    }

    pub(in super::super) fn is_custom_highlight(self) -> bool {
        !self.highlight_name.is_none()
    }
}

/// The pseudo-elements of an element that generate a box, as a bit per kind.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(in super::super) struct PseudoElementStyles(u16);

impl PseudoElementStyles {
    pub(in super::super) const NONE: Self = Self(0);

    /// The pseudo-elements `records` style, by kind.
    pub(in super::super) fn of(records: &[(PseudoElementTarget, Arc<Record>)]) -> Self {
        Self(
            records
                .iter()
                .filter(|(target, _)| !target.is_custom_highlight())
                .fold(0, |mask, (target, _)| mask | (1 << target.kind)),
        )
    }

    /// The pseudo-elements of the kinds whose bits `bits` holds, as a test names them.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in super::super) fn from_bits(bits: u64) -> Self {
        Self(u16::try_from(bits).expect("every pseudo-element kind has a bit of 16"))
    }

    /// The bits of the kinds, `1 << kind` each, as the host reads them.
    pub(in super::super) fn bits(self) -> u64 {
        u64::from(self.0)
    }
}

/// The custom properties the children of an element inherit.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(in super::super) enum InheritableCustomProperties {
    /// Those the element holds, as they are where no registration keeps one from inheriting.
    Held,
    /// Others: those it holds but for the ones a registration keeps from inheriting, or those its
    /// parent handed down where it holds none that inherit.
    Other(Option<Arc<crate::css::custom_properties::CustomPropertyStore>>),
}

impl InheritableCustomProperties {
    /// The custom properties children inherit as `inheritable`, of an element holding `held`.
    pub(in super::super) fn of(
        held: Option<&Arc<crate::css::custom_properties::CustomPropertyStore>>,
        inheritable: Option<Cow<'_, Arc<crate::css::custom_properties::CustomPropertyStore>>>,
    ) -> Self {
        match (held, &inheritable) {
            (None, None) => Self::Held,
            (Some(held), Some(inheritable)) if Arc::ptr_eq(held, inheritable) => Self::Held,
            _ => Self::Other(inheritable.map(Cow::into_owned)),
        }
    }

    fn same_as(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        match (self, other) {
            (Self::Held, Self::Held) => true,
            (Self::Other(None), Self::Other(None)) => true,
            (Self::Other(Some(mine)), Self::Other(Some(theirs))) => Arc::ptr_eq(mine, theirs),
            _ => false,
        }
    }
}

/// Whether both are the very same allocation, or neither is any.
fn same_arc<T: ?Sized>(first: Option<&Arc<T>>, second: Option<&Arc<T>>) -> bool {
    match (first, second) {
        (None, None) => true,
        (Some(first), Some(second)) => Arc::ptr_eq(first, second),
        _ => false,
    }
}

/// The custom declarations an element's cascade decided, as written.
pub(crate) type CustomDeclarations = Arc<[(CustomDeclaration, RetainedStyleValueData)]>;

/// What a record's rare set holds beside its groups.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct RareSetFacts {
    /// What the element's computation recorded and read beyond its values, which the records of
    /// elements styled alike share.
    pub(crate) facts: Option<Arc<RareStyleFacts>>,
    /// The custom declarations the element's cascade decided, as written, which a sample of its
    /// animations resolves the ones reading an animated custom property from.
    pub(crate) custom_declarations: Option<CustomDeclarations>,
}

impl RareSetFacts {
    /// Whether `other` holds these facts and declarations themselves.
    pub(crate) fn is(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        same_arc(self.facts.as_ref(), other.facts.as_ref())
            && same_arc(self.custom_declarations.as_ref(), other.custom_declarations.as_ref())
    }
}

/// What an element's computation read beyond its inherited context and its declarations.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct ComputationReads {
    /// The style groups of the properties that do not inherit whose parent's values the element's
    /// computation read, or every group where one of them belongs to none.
    pub(in crate::css::style) parent_reset_groups: u32,
    /// Whether the element's computation read its place among its siblings, through a
    /// tree-counting function.
    pub(in crate::css::style) reads_sibling_position: bool,
    /// How much of the root element's font the element's computation resolved lengths against.
    pub(in crate::css::style) reads_root_font: RootFontReads,
    /// Whether the element's computation resolved a length against a metric of its own or its
    /// parent's first available font.
    pub(in crate::css::style) reads_font_metric_lengths: bool,
    /// What the element's computation read of the document's environment.
    pub(in crate::css::style) environment_reads: crate::css::style::input_types::StyleEnvironment,
    /// Whether the element's computation read its attributes, through `attr()`, which what reads
    /// them beside the winners' values settles as the record is made.
    pub(in crate::css::style) reads_attributes: bool,
    /// The container-relative units the element's computation resolved against its query
    /// containers, as a `container_relative_length_unit_mask`.
    pub(in crate::css::style) container_units: u8,
    /// Whether the element's `display` computed to `none` only through the custom properties its
    /// animations sampled, and so to something else when ignoring them.
    pub(in crate::css::style) display_none_is_animated: bool,
}

/// What a style records of its computation beyond its values: the flags beside its values, what
/// its groups are built from, where its longhands live, and what its computation read. Elements
/// styled alike record the same, so siblings, and parents and their children, share one.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct RareStyleFacts {
    /// The custom properties the element's children inherit.
    pub(in super::super) inheritable_custom_properties: InheritableCustomProperties,
    /// The flags a longhand table of the element publishes beside its values, which elements
    /// whose declarations and computations wrote the same longhands share.
    pub(in super::super) table_flags: Arc<crate::css::computed_longhand_table::LonghandTableFlags>,
    /// What the groups are built from beside their computed values.
    pub(in super::super) value_facts: GroupValueFacts,
    /// Where the record's computed longhand values live.
    pub(in super::super) longhand_home: LonghandHome,
    /// The custom properties the element's longhands substitute, which a sample of its animations
    /// moving none of them leaves them as they are.
    pub(in super::super) custom_property_reads: crate::css::style::custom_property_cascade::LonghandCustomPropertyReads,
    /// What else the element's computation read.
    pub(in super::super) reads: ComputationReads,
    /// The identity of the counter-style registry of its style scope, where the style reads it,
    /// or zero.
    pub(in super::super) counter_style_environment_identity: u64,
    /// The scope the winning `animation-name` was declared in, where the `@keyframes` it names are
    /// looked for first.
    pub(in super::super) animation_name_scope: DeclarationScope,
    /// The pseudo-elements of the element that generate a box, which a pass settles as it styles
    /// them beside the element.
    // NB: Records styled alike but for these hold the same style, so `same_as` leaves them out.
    pub(in super::super) pseudo_element_styles: PseudoElementStyles,
}

// NB: Every element with a style of its own holds one of these; a field that grows it grows them all.
const _: () = assert!(size_of::<Record>() == 64);
const _: () = assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(Record, payloads) == 0);
const _: () = assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(Record, header) == 56);
const _: () = assert!(size_of::<RecordFacts>() == 4);
const _: () = assert!(size_of::<GroupValueFacts>() == 40);
const _: () = assert!(size_of::<RareStyleFacts>() == 128);

impl RareStyleFacts {
    /// These facts, with `inheritable` as the custom properties the element's children inherit.
    pub(in super::super) fn with_inheritable_custom_properties(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        inheritable: InheritableCustomProperties,
    ) -> Arc<Self> {
        if self.inheritable_custom_properties.same_as(&inheritable) {
            return self.clone();
        }
        Arc::new(Self {
            inheritable_custom_properties: inheritable,
            ..(**self).clone()
        })
    }

    /// These facts, styling the pseudo-elements of `styles`.
    pub(in super::super) fn with_pseudo_element_styles(self: &Arc<Self>, styles: PseudoElementStyles) -> Arc<Self> {
        if self.pseudo_element_styles == styles {
            return self.clone();
        }
        Arc::new(Self {
            pseudo_element_styles: styles,
            ..(**self).clone()
        })
    }

    /// The facts of a style a computation made, which holds its longhands in its groups, and whose
    /// pseudo-elements a pass settles after it.
    pub(in super::super) fn of_computation(
        inheritable_custom_properties: InheritableCustomProperties,
        counter_style_environment_identity: u64,
        table_flags: Arc<crate::css::computed_longhand_table::LonghandTableFlags>,
        value_facts: GroupValueFacts,
        custom_property_reads: crate::css::style::custom_property_cascade::LonghandCustomPropertyReads,
        reads: ComputationReads,
        animation_name_scope: DeclarationScope,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            inheritable_custom_properties,
            table_flags,
            value_facts,
            longhand_home: LonghandHome::Groups,
            custom_property_reads,
            reads,
            counter_style_environment_identity,
            animation_name_scope,
            pseudo_element_styles: PseudoElementStyles::NONE,
        }
    }

    /// The facts of a style the host made, which read nothing of the document: `source_groups` holds
    /// its longhands.
    fn of_host_style(
        table_flags: crate::css::computed_longhand_table::LonghandTableFlags,
        value_facts: crate::css::computed_values::GroupValueFacts,
        source_groups: crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups,
        counter_style_environment_identity: u64,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            inheritable_custom_properties: InheritableCustomProperties::Held,
            table_flags: Arc::new(table_flags),
            value_facts,
            longhand_home: LonghandHome::SourceGroups(DerivedSource::of(source_groups)),
            custom_property_reads: Default::default(),
            reads: ComputationReads::default(),
            counter_style_environment_identity,
            animation_name_scope: DeclarationScope::Unscoped,
            pseudo_element_styles: PseudoElementStyles::NONE,
        }
    }

    /// Whether `other` records what these do, so that a record may hold either.
    pub(in super::super) fn same_as(&self, other: &RareStyleFacts) -> bool {
        matches!(
            (&self.longhand_home, &other.longhand_home),
            (LonghandHome::Groups, LonghandHome::Groups)
        ) && self
            .inheritable_custom_properties
            .same_as(&other.inheritable_custom_properties)
            && (Arc::ptr_eq(&self.table_flags, &other.table_flags) || self.table_flags.same_as(&other.table_flags))
            && self.value_facts.publication_equals(&other.value_facts)
            && self.custom_property_reads == other.custom_property_reads
            && self.reads == other.reads
            && self.counter_style_environment_identity == other.counter_style_environment_identity
            && self.animation_name_scope == other.animation_name_scope
    }
}

/// Where a record's computed longhand values live.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(in super::super) enum LonghandHome {
    /// In the record's own groups.
    Groups,
    /// In the groups of the style a derived record was derived from, each of which it holds a
    /// reference to: a derived style holds the longhands of its source.
    SourceGroups(Box<DerivedSource>),
}

/// What a derived record holds of the style it was derived from.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(in super::super) struct DerivedSource {
    /// The source's groups, which hold the derived record's longhands.
    pub(in super::super) groups: crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups,
    /// What the animations of the element sampled over the source, where the derived record is a
    /// sample of them.
    pub(in super::super) sample: Option<Box<Sample>>,
}

impl DerivedSource {
    fn of(groups: crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups) -> Box<Self> {
        Box::new(Self { groups, sample: None })
    }
}

/// What a record of a sample of the animations of an element holds beside its groups.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(in super::super) struct Sample {
    /// The installed record the animations sample over.
    pub(in super::super) base: Arc<Record>,
    /// The values the animations compose over the base.
    pub(in super::super) animated_overlay: Arc<crate::css::animated_overlay::AnimatedOverlay>,
    /// What a view of the sample depends on: what a view of the base does, with an `<image>` a
    /// sampled value holds where the base holds none, and in the display:none subtree a sampled
    /// display puts it in.
    pub(in super::super) dependency_flags: u8,
    /// The identity the host names the sample by.
    pub(in super::super) identity: computed::FinalStyleRecordID,
}

/// What a record holds of an element's style beside its values, settled when the record is made.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub(in super::super) struct RecordFacts {
    /// The computed `display`, packed by `pack_display`.
    display: u16,
    /// The dependency flags at their bit values, with whether the element is `display: none` or
    /// inherits from one that is at `IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE`, and `DECLARES_CSS_ANIMATIONS` and
    /// `DECLARES_TRANSITIONS`.
    flags: u8,
}

/// `display` in 16 bits: its tag in bits 0-1, then the three bytes of its encoding in five, five
/// and one bit.
fn pack_display(display: crate::css::display::FfiDisplay) -> u16 {
    let [tag, first, second, third] = display.encoded().to_le_bytes();
    assert!(
        tag < 4 && first < 32 && second < 32 && third < 2,
        "every display value packs into 16 bits"
    );
    u16::from(tag) | u16::from(first) << 2 | u16::from(second) << 7 | u16::from(third) << 12
}

fn unpack_display(packed: u16) -> crate::css::display::FfiDisplay {
    let field = |shift: u16, bits: u16| u32::from((packed >> shift) & ((1 << bits) - 1));
    crate::css::display::FfiDisplay::from_raw(field(0, 2) | field(2, 5) << 8 | field(7, 5) << 16 | field(12, 1) << 24)
}

impl RecordFacts {
    /// Whether the computed `animation-name` names any animation.
    const DECLARES_CSS_ANIMATIONS: u8 = 1 << 3;
    /// Whether the computed `transition-*` values make any longhand transitionable.
    const DECLARES_TRANSITIONS: u8 = 1 << 4;

    /// The facts of a style whose computed values `value_of` answers, which resolves no color yet.
    pub(in super::super) fn of_values<'v>(
        value_of: impl Fn(u16) -> &'v RetainedStyleValueData,
        dependency_flags: u8,
        in_display_none_subtree: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        use crate::css::computed_longhand_table::IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE;
        use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id as prop;
        use crate::css::style_compute::{
            animation_names_declare_css_animations, display_of, transition_values_declare_transitions,
        };
        let mut facts = Self {
            display: pack_display(display_of(value_of(prop::DISPLAY))),
            flags: 0,
        };
        facts.add_dependency_flags(dependency_flags);
        facts.flags |= (u8::from(in_display_none_subtree) * IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE)
            | (u8::from(animation_names_declare_css_animations(value_of(prop::ANIMATION_NAME)))
                * Self::DECLARES_CSS_ANIMATIONS)
            | (u8::from(transition_values_declare_transitions(
                value_of(prop::TRANSITION_PROPERTY),
                value_of(prop::TRANSITION_DURATION),
                value_of(prop::TRANSITION_DELAY),
            )) * Self::DECLARES_TRANSITIONS);
        facts
    }

    /// The computed `display`.
    pub(in super::super) fn display(&self) -> crate::css::display::FfiDisplay {
        unpack_display(self.display)
    }

    /// The dependency flags of the element's computation, without whether it is in a
    /// `display: none` subtree.
    pub(in super::super) fn dependency_flags(&self) -> u8 {
        use crate::css::computed_longhand_table::IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE;
        self.flags & !(IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE | Self::DECLARES_CSS_ANIMATIONS | Self::DECLARES_TRANSITIONS)
    }

    /// Adds `flags` to the dependency flags of the element's computation.
    pub(in super::super) fn add_dependency_flags(&mut self, flags: u8) {
        assert_eq!(
            flags & (Self::DECLARES_CSS_ANIMATIONS | Self::DECLARES_TRANSITIONS),
            0,
            "a computation's dependency flags leave the declaration bits clear"
        );
        self.flags |= flags;
    }

    /// Whether the element is `display: none` or inherits from one that is.
    pub(in super::super) fn in_display_none_subtree(&self) -> bool {
        self.flags & crate::css::computed_longhand_table::IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE != 0
    }

    /// Whether the computed `animation-name` names any animation.
    pub(in super::super) fn declares_css_animations(&self) -> bool {
        self.flags & Self::DECLARES_CSS_ANIMATIONS != 0
    }

    /// Whether the computed `transition-*` values make any longhand transitionable.
    pub(in super::super) fn declares_transitions(&self) -> bool {
        self.flags & Self::DECLARES_TRANSITIONS != 0
    }

    /// The dependency flags the element's style publishes.
    pub(in super::super) fn publication_dependency_flags(&self) -> u8 {
        self.flags & !(Self::DECLARES_CSS_ANIMATIONS | Self::DECLARES_TRANSITIONS)
    }
}

/// Which children of an element its new record restyles.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum ChildImpact {
    None,
    /// Only the children that read the element's values of properties that do not inherit.
    ResetReaders,
    /// Only the custom properties it hands down moved: each child reads them anew, and computes
    /// again where it substitutes one that moved.
    CustomProperties,
    /// Both of the above.
    ResetReadersAndCustomProperties,
    All,
}

// NB: The inherited groups are the inherited sets, which a child holding its parents set shares.
const _: () = assert!(
    crate::css::computed_values::INHERITED_SET_GROUPS.len()
        == crate::css::style::computed::ENGINE_INHERITED_GROUP_COUNT
);

impl ChildImpact {
    /// Which children of an element computing `new` where it computed `old` compute anew, where
    /// they inherited `inherited`.
    pub(super) fn of_records(new: &Record, old: &Record, inherited: &crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups) -> Self {
        // An inherited longhand no group holds reaches the children through the table alone.
        let ungrouped_inherited_moved = || {
            crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroupMasks::get()
                .ungrouped_inherited()
                .iter()
                .any(|&property| {
                    match (
                        computed::ViewLonghands::of_record(new).handle(property),
                        computed::ViewLonghands::of_record(old).handle(property),
                    ) {
                        (Some(new), Some(old)) => !crate::css::style_value::retained_style_values_equal(new, old),
                        (new, old) => new.is_some() != old.is_some(),
                    }
                })
        };
        if new.payloads.current_color() != old.payloads.current_color()
            || new.payloads.inherited_values() != old.payloads.inherited_values()
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-adjust-1/#color-scheme-prop
            // A child whose `color-scheme` is the one it inherits uses the scheme its parent uses.
            || new.effective_color_scheme() != old.effective_color_scheme()
            || new.facts().publication_dependency_flags() != old.facts().publication_dependency_flags()
            || new.facts().display != old.facts().display
            || ungrouped_inherited_moved()
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/#resolving-other-colors
            // A child inheriting a value that reads `currentcolor` resolves it against its own
            // color, so the specified values the record retains reach the children where the
            // colors they resolve to here did not move.
            || crate::css::computed_longhand_table::inherited_inheritance_dependent_value_moved(
                old.inheritance_dependent_values(),
                new.inheritance_dependent_values(),
            )
        {
            return ChildImpact::All;
        }
        let impact = match ChildImpact::of_groups(&new.payloads, inherited) {
            ChildImpact::None
                if crate::css::computed_longhand_table::non_inherited_inheritance_changes(
                    old.inheritance_dependent_values(),
                    new.inheritance_dependent_values(),
                ) != 0 =>
            {
                Self::ResetReaders
            }
            impact => impact,
        };
        let stores_moved = !same_arc(new.custom_properties(), old.custom_properties())
            || !same_arc(new.inheritable_custom_properties(), old.inheritable_custom_properties());
        match (impact, stores_moved) {
            (ChildImpact::None, true) => ChildImpact::CustomProperties,
            (ChildImpact::ResetReaders, true) => ChildImpact::ResetReadersAndCustomProperties,
            (impact, _) => impact,
        }
    }

    /// Which children of an element moving from the groups `old` to `new` restyle: all of them
    /// where an inherited group moved, and the ones reading their parent's values of properties
    /// that do not inherit where another did.
    pub(super) fn of_groups(
        new: &crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups,
        old: &crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups,
    ) -> Self {
        let group_differs = |group: usize| {
            let (new, old) = (new[group].as_ptr(), old[group].as_ptr());
            // SAFETY: Both are live payloads of the group.
            new != old && !unsafe { crate::css::computed_values::style_group_payloads_equal(group, new, old) }
        };
        let inherited = crate::css::style::computed::ENGINE_INHERITED_GROUP_COUNT;
        // NB: The inherited bits and zoom beside the inherited groups reach the children as the groups do.
        if !new.shares_inherited_groups_with(old)
            && (new.inherited_values() != old.inherited_values() || (0..inherited).any(group_differs))
        {
            return Self::All;
        }
        // NB: The reset bits are read by the children reading their parent's reset values, as
        //     the box group's were.
        if new.reset_bits() != old.reset_bits() {
            return Self::ResetReaders;
        }
        match !new.shares_reset_groups_with(old) && (inherited..group_index::COUNT).any(group_differs) {
            true => Self::ResetReaders,
            false => Self::None,
        }
    }
}

impl RetainedState {
    /// Whether `node`, holding `record`, reads its parent's values of properties that do not
    /// inherit: its record does, or the keyframes of its animations say `inherit` for one.
    pub(super) fn reads_parent_reset_values(&self, node: StyleNodeID, record: &Record) -> bool {
        record.rare().reads.parent_reset_groups != 0 || self.keyframes_reading_parent_reset_values.contains(&node)
    }
}

impl Record {
    /// What the element's computation recorded and read beyond its values, which most elements
    /// share with their siblings, and which the record's rare set holds beside its groups.
    pub(in super::super) fn rare(&self) -> &Arc<RareStyleFacts> {
        self.payloads.rare_facts().expect("a record's rare set holds its facts")
    }

    /// The custom declarations the element's cascade decided, as written, which a sample of its
    /// animations resolves the ones reading an animated custom property from, and which its rare
    /// set holds beside its groups.
    pub(in super::super) fn custom_declarations(&self) -> Option<&CustomDeclarations> {
        self.payloads.custom_declarations()
    }

    /// The custom properties the element holds, which its inherited set holds beside its groups.
    pub(crate) fn custom_properties(&self) -> Option<&Arc<crate::css::custom_properties::CustomPropertyStore>> {
        self.payloads.custom_properties()
    }

    /// The custom properties the element's children inherit.
    pub(in super::super) fn inheritable_custom_properties(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<&Arc<crate::css::custom_properties::CustomPropertyStore>> {
        match &self.rare().inheritable_custom_properties {
            InheritableCustomProperties::Held => self.custom_properties(),
            InheritableCustomProperties::Other(inheritable) => inheritable.as_ref(),
        }
    }

    /// The identity of the custom-property environment the record was resolved in: that of the store it holds, or
    /// zero where it holds none.
    pub(in super::super) fn custom_property_environment(&self) -> u64 {
        self.custom_properties()
            .map_or(0, super::super::custom_property_environments::environment_identity)
    }

    /// The record holding what this one does, resolved in the custom-property environment of `store` instead.
    pub(in super::super) fn in_custom_property_environment(
        &self,
        store: Option<Arc<crate::css::custom_properties::CustomPropertyStore>>,
    ) -> Self {
        let derived = Self::derived(self, &self.payloads);
        Self {
            payloads: derived.payloads.with_custom_properties(store.as_ref()),
            ..derived
        }
    }

    /// The groups holding the record's computed values, where groups hold them.
    pub(in super::super) fn value_groups(&self) -> &crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups {
        match &self.rare().longhand_home {
            LonghandHome::Groups => &self.payloads,
            LonghandHome::SourceGroups(source) => &source.groups,
        }
    }

    /// What the element's animations sampled over the style this record samples them over, where
    /// it is a sample of them.
    pub(in super::super) fn sample_of_animations(&self) -> Option<&Sample> {
        match &self.rare().longhand_home {
            LonghandHome::Groups => None,
            LonghandHome::SourceGroups(source) => source.sample.as_deref(),
        }
    }

    /// The computed value of `longhand`.
    pub(in super::super) fn longhand(&self, longhand: LonghandID) -> &RetainedStyleValueData {
        let groups = self.value_groups();
        let property =
            GroupValueLayout::get().resolved(longhand.property(), |property| self.longhand(LonghandID::new(property)));
        let place = GroupValueLayout::get().place(LonghandID::new(property));
        if let Some(field) = place.bit_field() {
            return groups.style_bits().value(field);
        }
        crate::css::computed_values::value_at(
            groups.group(crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroupIndex::new(place.group())),
            place,
        )
    }

    /// The value a group build reads for `property`: its recorded currentcolor-dependent specified
    /// value where a drive did not evaluate it, else its computed value.
    pub(in super::super) fn effective_value(&self, property: u16) -> &RetainedStyleValueData {
        self.rare()
            .value_facts
            .value_read_in_place(property)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| self.longhand(LonghandID::new(property)))
    }

    /// The recorded specified values of the longhands whose computed values depend on what the
    /// element inherits.
    pub(in super::super) fn inheritance_dependent_values(
        &self,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u16, &RetainedStyleValueData)> + Clone {
        self.rare().value_facts.inheritance_dependent_values()
    }

    /// The color scheme the element's colors resolved against.
    pub(in super::super) fn effective_color_scheme(&self) -> i16 {
        self.rare().value_facts.effective_color_scheme()
    }

    /// The groups the children of an element holding the record start their values from.
    pub(in super::super) fn group_seed(&self) -> GroupSeed<'_> {
        GroupSeed::new(self.value_groups(), &self.rare().value_facts)
    }

    /// Whether the element holding the record generates boxes, or its descendants do: whether
    /// they have styles.
    pub(super) fn is_displayed(&self) -> bool {
        !self.facts().display().is_none()
    }

    /// What the record's readers read of the element's style without its groups.
    pub(in super::super) fn facts(&self) -> RecordFacts {
        self.header.facts()
    }

    /// The identity of the slot holding the record, while one does.
    pub(in super::super) fn installed_record(&self) -> Option<InstalledRecordID> {
        self.header.installed_record()
    }

    /// The pseudo-elements of the element that generate a box.
    pub(in super::super) fn pseudo_element_styles(&self) -> PseudoElementStyles {
        self.rare().pseudo_element_styles
    }

    /// This record, styling the pseudo-elements of `styles`: itself where it does, otherwise a copy
    /// sharing all it holds.
    pub(in super::super) fn with_pseudo_element_styles(self: &Arc<Self>, styles: PseudoElementStyles) -> Arc<Self> {
        if self.pseudo_element_styles() == styles {
            return self.clone();
        }
        Arc::new(Self {
            payloads: self
                .payloads
                .clone()
                .with_rare_facts(
                    self.rare().with_pseudo_element_styles(styles),
                    self.custom_declarations().cloned(),
                    &[],
                )
                .with_custom_properties(self.custom_properties()),
            header: RecordHeader::new(self.facts()),
        })
    }

    /// This record, whose computation depends on `dependency_flags` too, as a test makes one.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(in super::super) fn with_test_dependency_flags(self: &Arc<Self>, dependency_flags: u8) -> Arc<Self> {
        let mut facts = self.facts();
        facts.add_dependency_flags(dependency_flags);
        Arc::new(Self {
            payloads: self.payloads.clone(),
            header: RecordHeader::new(facts),
        })
    }

    /// Name the identity of the slot that takes the record, and what a view of it depends on, and
    /// answer whether it did: a record a fork's slot names already keeps that name.
    #[must_use]
    pub(in super::super) fn name_installed_record(&self, id: InstalledRecordID, view_dependency_flags: u8) -> bool {
        self.settle_view_dependency_flags(view_dependency_flags);
        self.header.name_installed_record(id)
    }

    /// A copy of the record sharing all it holds, which no slot names.
    pub(in super::super) fn copy_without_a_name(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
