use super::RuleID;
use crate::css::container_conditions::ContainerConditionsData;
use crate::css::style::RetainedState;
use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::num::NonZeroU64;
use std::sync::Arc;

mod identities;
mod targets;
use identities::NativeRuleIdentities;
use targets::NativeRuleTargets;
pub(in crate::css::style) use targets::{NativeRuleTargetRef, TargetPages};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct NativeRuleTarget {
    pub identity: NonZeroU64,
    pub source_identity: u64,
    conditions: Option<Box<NativeRuleConditions>>,
}

// NB: Every rule the host compiled has one. Its declarations are the block its rule holds.
const _: () = assert!(size_of::<NativeRuleTarget>() == 24);

#[derive(Clone)]
struct NativeRuleConditions {
    /// The qualified name of the layer, which every rule of the layer shares.
    layer_name: Arc<[u16]>,
    containers: Box<[Arc<ContainerConditionsData>]>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct NativeRuleRegistry {
    pub targets: NativeRuleTargets,
    pub identities: NativeRuleIdentities,
}

impl PartialEq for NativeRuleTarget {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        let Self {
            identity,
            source_identity,
            conditions: _,
        } = self;
        *identity == other.identity
            && *source_identity == other.source_identity
            && self.layer_name() == other.layer_name()
            && self.containers().len() == other.containers().len()
            && self
                .containers()
                .iter()
                .zip(other.containers())
                .all(|(a, b)| Arc::ptr_eq(a, b))
    }
}

impl Eq for NativeRuleTarget {}

impl Hash for NativeRuleTarget {
    fn hash<H: Hasher>(&self, hasher: &mut H) {
        let Self {
            identity,
            source_identity,
            conditions: _,
        } = self;
        identity.hash(hasher);
        source_identity.hash(hasher);
        self.layer_name().hash(hasher);
        for container in self.containers() {
            Arc::as_ptr(container).hash(hasher);
        }
    }
}

impl NativeRuleTarget {
    pub fn layer_name(&self) -> &[u16] {
        self.conditions
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(&[], |conditions| &conditions.layer_name)
    }

    pub fn containers(&self) -> &[Arc<ContainerConditionsData>] {
        self.conditions
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(&[], |conditions| &conditions.containers)
    }
}

impl NativeRuleRegistry {
    pub fn remove(&mut self, id: RuleID) {
        if let Some(target) = self.targets.remove(&id) {
            let identity = target.identity.get();
            if self.identities.get(&identity) == Some(id) {
                self.identities.remove(&identity);
            }
        }
        self.reconcile_memory();
    }

    fn reconcile_memory(&mut self) {}
}

impl RetainedState {
    /// The identity of the native sheet a rule was compiled from: an imported sheet's own, not the
    /// importing sheet's.
    pub(crate) fn rule_source_identity(&self, id: RuleID) -> Option<u64> {
        self.rules.native_target(id).map(|target| target.source_identity)
    }

    pub(crate) fn native_rule_id(&self, identity: u64) -> Option<RuleID> {
        self.rules
            .native
            .identities
            .get(&identity)
            .or_else(|| self.rules.user_agent_rule_of_identity(identity))
    }

    /// Register immutable cascade inputs independently of document-local rule owners, with the container conditions
    /// the rule is inside, innermost first.
    pub(crate) fn register_native_rule(
        &mut self,
        id: RuleID,
        identity: u64,
        source_identity: u64,
        layer_name: Arc<[u16]>,
        containers: Box<[Arc<ContainerConditionsData>]>,
    ) {
        // Whole-sheet replacement can reuse the semantic ID with a new native rule. Retire the
        // old reverse lookup before installing the replacement; detached CSSOM rules keep their
        // native identity but no longer name a rule in this engine.
        self.rules.native.remove(id);
        let target = NativeRuleTarget {
            identity: NonZeroU64::new(identity).expect("native rule identities are nonzero"),
            source_identity,
            conditions: (!layer_name.is_empty() || !containers.is_empty())
                .then(|| Box::new(NativeRuleConditions { layer_name, containers })),
        };
        self.rules.native.identities.insert(identity, id);
        self.rules.native.targets.insert(id, target);
        self.rules.native.reconcile_memory();
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::css::media_list::MediaList;
    use crate::css::parser::syntax_parser::parse_shared_stylesheet;
    use crate::css::parser::value_parser::ParseContext;
    use crate::css::rule::{rust_rule_identity, rust_rule_list_clear};
    use crate::css::style::StyleEngine;
    use crate::css::style::pipeline::rule_store::{CascadeOrigin, RuleKind};
    use crate::css::style_sheet::NativeStyleSheet;
    use std::rc::Rc;

    fn source() -> Rc<NativeStyleSheet> {
        let units: Vec<_> = "@function --f() { result: 1px; }".encode_utf16().collect();
        let view = crate::css::css_tokenizer::TokenizerInput::Utf16(&units);
        // All context fields are booleans, integers, or nullable pointers.
        let context = ParseContext::default();
        let parsed = parse_shared_stylesheet(view, Some(&context));
        let rules = crate::css::rule::NativeRuleList::from_parsed(parsed);
        let media = MediaList::new(Default::default());
        NativeStyleSheet::new(rules, media)
    }

    #[test]
    fn native_rule_inputs_do_not_retain_document_local_sheets_or_rules() {
        let source = source();
        let rule = source.rules().rule_at(0);
        let identity = rust_rule_identity(&rule);
        let source_weak = Rc::downgrade(&source);
        let source_identity = source.identity();
        let rule_weak = Rc::downgrade(&rule);
        let mut engines = [StyleEngine::new(), StyleEngine::new()];
        let mut ids = Vec::new();
        for (index, engine) in engines.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            let sheet = engine.add_sheet(CascadeOrigin::Author);
            for _ in 0..index {
                engine.add_non_matching_rule(sheet, None, RuleKind::Function);
            }
            let id = engine.add_non_matching_rule(sheet, None, RuleKind::Function);
            engine.register_native_rule(
                id,
                identity,
                source.identity(),
                std::sync::Arc::default(),
                Box::default(),
            );
            assert_eq!(engine.native_rule_id(identity), Some(id));
            ids.push(id);
            assert_eq!(
                engine.rules.native.targets.get(&id).unwrap().source_identity,
                source_identity
            );
        }
        assert_ne!(ids[0], ids[1]);
        drop(rule);
        drop(source);
        assert!(rule_weak.upgrade().is_none());
        assert!(source_weak.upgrade().is_none());
        let replacement = self::source();
        assert_ne!(replacement.identity(), source_identity);
        assert_eq!(
            engines[1].rules.native.targets.get(&ids[1]).unwrap().source_identity,
            source_identity
        );
        engines[0].remove_style_rule(ids[0]);
        assert!(engines[0].rules.native.identities.is_empty());
        assert!(rule_weak.upgrade().is_none());
        assert!(source_weak.upgrade().is_none());
        assert_eq!(engines[1].rules.native.identities.get(&identity), Some(ids[1]));
        engines[1].remove_style_rule(ids[1]);
        assert!(engines[1].rules.native.identities.is_empty());
        assert!(rule_weak.upgrade().is_none());
        assert!(source_weak.upgrade().is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn declaration_edits_resolve_native_owners_and_use_engine_revisions() {
        use crate::css::style::rule_writes::publish_native_rule_declarations;
        let source = source();
        let rule = &source.rules().rule_at(0);
        let children = rule.child_rules().unwrap();
        let child = children.rule_at(0);
        let mut engine = StyleEngine::new();
        let sheet = engine.add_sheet(CascadeOrigin::Author);
        let id = engine.add_non_matching_rule(sheet, None, RuleKind::Function);
        engine.register_native_rule(
            id,
            rust_rule_identity(rule),
            source.identity(),
            std::sync::Arc::default(),
            Box::default(),
        );
        let mut notifications = Vec::<u32>::new();
        // What the engine does with the host's write: it publishes the edit through the rule that owns the declarations.
        let declarations_changed = |engine: &mut StyleEngine, notifications: &mut Vec<u32>| {
            if let Some(owner) = child
                .declaration_owner_identity()
                .and_then(|identity| engine.native_rule_id(identity))
            {
                notifications.push(owner.0 + 1);
                publish_native_rule_declarations(engine, child.cascade_declarations(), owner);
            }
        };
        let initial = engine.current_rule_version(id).declaration_block;
        declarations_changed(&mut engine, &mut notifications);
        let first = engine.current_rule_version(id).declaration_block;
        assert_ne!(initial, first);
        // Inline declarations and whole-sheet replacement use the same revision issuer.
        engine.next_declaration_block_version();
        declarations_changed(&mut engine, &mut notifications);
        let second = engine.current_rule_version(id).declaration_block;
        assert_ne!(first, second);
        assert_eq!(notifications, [id.0 + 1, id.0 + 1]);
        rust_rule_list_clear(children);
        declarations_changed(&mut engine, &mut notifications);
        assert_eq!(engine.current_rule_version(id).declaration_block, second);
        assert_eq!(notifications.len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn replacing_a_native_owner_retires_the_old_reverse_lookup() {
        let old_source = source();
        let new_source = source();
        let old_rule = &old_source.rules().rule_at(0);
        let new_rule = &new_source.rules().rule_at(0);
        let mut engine = StyleEngine::new();
        let sheet = engine.add_sheet(CascadeOrigin::Author);
        let id = engine.add_non_matching_rule(sheet, None, RuleKind::Function);
        engine.register_native_rule(
            id,
            rust_rule_identity(old_rule),
            old_source.identity(),
            std::sync::Arc::default(),
            Box::default(),
        );
        engine.register_native_rule(
            id,
            rust_rule_identity(new_rule),
            new_source.identity(),
            std::sync::Arc::default(),
            Box::default(),
        );
        assert!(
            !engine
                .rules
                .native
                .identities
                .contains_key(&rust_rule_identity(old_rule))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            engine.rules.native.identities.get(&rust_rule_identity(new_rule)),
            Some(id)
        );
        assert_eq!(engine.rules.native.targets.len(), 1);
    }
}

use crate::css::style::pipeline::rule_store::RuleID;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

/// Native identities that follow one another by a constant step, naming rules that follow one another.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct IdentityRun {
    first_rule: u32,
    count: u32,
    /// How far each identity is from the one before.
    step: u32,
}

impl IdentityRun {
    /// Where `identity` is in the run starting at `first`, if it is there.
    fn place_of(self, first: u64, identity: u64) -> Option<u32> {
        let distance = identity - first;
        let step = u64::from(self.step);
        (distance.is_multiple_of(step) && distance / step < u64::from(self.count)).then(|| (distance / step) as u32)
    }

    fn last_identity(self, first: u64) -> u64 {
        first + u64::from(self.count - 1) * u64::from(self.step)
    }
}

/// The rule each native identity names. A parsed sheet numbers its rules in one range, and a document publishes them
/// in that order, so a sheet's rules take one run however many they are: what a document holds per rule of a sheet
/// other documents share is nothing, as the rest of a rule's records are shared pages.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct NativeRuleIdentities {
    /// The runs, by their first identity.
    runs: BTreeMap<u64, IdentityRun>,
}

impl NativeRuleIdentities {
    fn run_of(&self, identity: u64) -> Option<(u64, IdentityRun, u32)> {
        let (&first, &run) = self.runs.range(..=identity).next_back()?;
        Some((first, run, run.place_of(first, identity)?))
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn get(&self, identity: &u64) -> Option<RuleID> {
        let (_, run, place) = self.run_of(*identity)?;
        Some(RuleID(run.first_rule + place))
    }

    /// Have no run span `identity`, which no run holds: the identities of a run past it make a run of their own.
    fn split_at(&mut self, identity: u64) {
        let Some((&first, run)) = self.runs.range_mut(..identity).next_back() else {
            return;
        };
        if run.last_identity(first) < identity {
            return;
        }
        let before = (identity - first).div_ceil(u64::from(run.step)) as u32;
        let after = IdentityRun {
            first_rule: run.first_rule + before,
            count: run.count - before,
            step: run.step,
        };
        run.count = before;
        self.runs
            .insert(first + u64::from(before) * u64::from(after.step), after);
    }

    pub(super) fn insert(&mut self, identity: u64, id: RuleID) {
        self.remove(&identity);
        self.split_at(identity);
        if let Some((&first, run)) = self.runs.range_mut(..identity).next_back() {
            let last_rule = run.first_rule + run.count - 1;
            let last = run.last_identity(first);
            let extends = last < identity
                && last_rule.checked_add(1) == Some(id.0)
                && u32::try_from(identity - last).is_ok_and(|step| run.count == 1 || step == run.step);
            if extends {
                run.step = u32::try_from(identity - last).expect("the step fits");
                run.count += 1;
                return;
            }
        }
        self.runs.insert(
            identity,
            IdentityRun {
                first_rule: id.0,
                count: 1,
                step: 1,
            },
        );
    }

    pub(super) fn remove(&mut self, identity: &u64) -> Option<RuleID> {
        let (first, run, place) = self.run_of(*identity)?;
        self.runs.remove(&first);
        if place > 0 {
            self.runs.insert(first, IdentityRun { count: place, ..run });
        }
        let after = run.count - place - 1;
        if after > 0 {
            self.runs.insert(
                identity + u64::from(run.step),
                IdentityRun {
                    first_rule: run.first_rule + place + 1,
                    count: after,
                    step: run.step,
                },
            );
        }
        Some(RuleID(run.first_rule + place))
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(super) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.runs.is_empty()
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(super) fn contains_key(&self, identity: &u64) -> bool {
        self.get(identity).is_some()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn a_sheet_published_in_order_takes_one_run() {
        let mut identities = NativeRuleIdentities::default();
        for index in 0..1000 {
            identities.insert(5000 + index * 2, RuleID(7 + index as u32));
        }
        assert_eq!(identities.runs.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&5000), Some(RuleID(7)));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&5002), Some(RuleID(8)));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&5001), None);
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&(5000 + 999 * 2)), Some(RuleID(1006)));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&(5000 + 1000 * 2)), None);
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&4998), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn removing_splits_a_run_and_overwriting_moves_an_identity() {
        let mut identities = NativeRuleIdentities::default();
        for index in 0..10 {
            identities.insert(100 + index, RuleID(index as u32));
        }
        assert_eq!(identities.remove(&104), Some(RuleID(4)));
        assert_eq!(identities.remove(&104), None);
        assert_eq!(identities.runs.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&103), Some(RuleID(3)));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&105), Some(RuleID(5)));
        identities.insert(102, RuleID(50));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&102), Some(RuleID(50)));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&101), Some(RuleID(1)));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&103), Some(RuleID(3)));
        for identity in [100, 101, 102, 103, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109] {
            assert!(identities.remove(&identity).is_some());
        }
        assert!(identities.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_identity_between_those_of_a_run_splits_it() {
        let mut identities = NativeRuleIdentities::default();
        for index in 0..5 {
            identities.insert(100 + index * 2, RuleID(index as u32));
        }
        identities.insert(103, RuleID(50));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&103), Some(RuleID(50)));
        for index in 0..5 {
            assert_eq!(identities.get(&(100 + index * 2)), Some(RuleID(index as u32)));
        }
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&101), None);
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&105), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn sparse_identities_and_the_largest_one_are_found() {
        let mut identities = NativeRuleIdentities::default();
        for (identity, rule) in [(1, 0), (127, 1), (128, 2), (u64::MAX, 3)] {
            identities.insert(identity, RuleID(rule));
        }
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&u64::MAX), Some(RuleID(3)));
        assert_eq!(identities.get(&2), None);
        assert_eq!(identities.remove(&2), None);
        for identity in [1, 127, 128, u64::MAX] {
            assert!(identities.remove(&identity).is_some());
        }
        assert!(identities.is_empty());
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Rust/src/css/style/pipeline/rule_store/native/targets.rs
/*

use super::NativeRuleTarget;
use crate::css::container_conditions::ContainerConditionsData;
use crate::css::style::fast_hash::fast_hasher;
use crate::css::style::pipeline::rule_store::RuleID;
use crate::css::style::weak_pool::WeakPool;
use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::num::NonZeroU64;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

const TARGETS_PER_PAGE: usize = 128;

#[derive(Clone)]

pub(in crate::css::style) struct TargetPage {
    values: [Option<NativeRuleTarget>; TARGETS_PER_PAGE],
    live_count: u16,
    shared_hash: Option<u64>,
}

impl TargetPage {
    fn new(values: [Option<NativeRuleTarget>; TARGETS_PER_PAGE]) -> Self {
        Self {
            live_count: u16::try_from(values.iter().flatten().count()).unwrap(),
            values,
            shared_hash: None,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]

struct BoundTargetPage {
    data: Arc<TargetPage>,
    identity_base: u64,
    source_base: u64,
}

impl BoundTargetPage {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            data: Arc::new(TargetPage::new(std::array::from_fn(|_| None))),
            identity_base: 0,
            source_base: 0,
        }
    }

    fn normalize(&mut self) {
        debug_assert_eq!(self.identity_base, 0);
        debug_assert_eq!(self.source_base, 0);
        let data = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.data);
        self.identity_base = data
            .values
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .map(|target| target.identity.get())
            .min()
            .unwrap_or(1)
            - 1;
        self.source_base = data
            .values
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .map(|target| target.source_identity)
            .min()
            .unwrap_or(0);
        for target in data.values.iter_mut().flatten() {
            target.identity = NonZeroU64::new(target.identity.get() - self.identity_base).unwrap();
            target.source_identity -= self.source_base;
        }
    }
}

/// Borrow shared payloads while resolving this document's native identities from its page binding.
pub(in crate::css::style) struct NativeRuleTargetRef<'a> {
    data: &'a NativeRuleTarget,
    pub identity: NonZeroU64,
    pub source_identity: u64,
}

impl<'a> NativeRuleTargetRef<'a> {
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn layer_name(&self) -> &'a [u16] {
        self.data.layer_name()
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn containers(&self) -> &'a [Arc<ContainerConditionsData>] {
        self.data.containers()
    }
}

/// The pool equal pages of native rule targets are shared through.
pub(in crate::css::style) type TargetPages = Mutex<WeakPool<TargetPage>>;

/// Dense semantic rule identities address immutable pages directly. Store native identities
/// relative to each page's document-local bases so copies of one parsed stylesheet can share
/// payloads, through the process's pool, while retaining distinct native rule and stylesheet
/// identities.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct NativeRuleTargets {
    pages: Vec<Option<BoundTargetPage>>,
    needs_sharing: bool,
}

impl NativeRuleTargets {
    fn page_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> &mut TargetPage {
        self.needs_sharing = true;
        let page = self.pages[index / TARGETS_PER_PAGE].as_mut().unwrap();
        // NB: A page the pool knows is copied, as one another table holds is: the pool keeps no
        //     page alive, and the copy is published again where the table is next shared.
        if Arc::get_mut(&mut page.data).is_none() {
            page.data = Arc::new(TargetPage::new(page.data.values.clone()));
        }
        let data = Arc::get_mut(&mut page.data).expect("a private page has one owner");
        if page.identity_base != 0 || page.source_base != 0 {
            for target in data.values.iter_mut().flatten() {
                target.identity =
                    NonZeroU64::new(target.identity.get().checked_add(page.identity_base).unwrap()).unwrap();
                target.source_identity = target.source_identity.checked_add(page.source_base).unwrap();
            }
            page.identity_base = 0;
            page.source_base = 0;
        }
        data.shared_hash = None;
        data
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn get(&self, id: &RuleID) -> Option<NativeRuleTargetRef<'_>> {
        let index = id.0 as usize;
        let page = self.pages.get(index / TARGETS_PER_PAGE)?.as_ref()?;
        let data = page.data.values[index % TARGETS_PER_PAGE].as_ref()?;
        Some(NativeRuleTargetRef {
            data,
            identity: NonZeroU64::new(data.identity.get().checked_add(page.identity_base).unwrap()).unwrap(),
            source_identity: data.source_identity.checked_add(page.source_base).unwrap(),
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn insert(&mut self, id: RuleID, target: NativeRuleTarget) {
        let index = id.0 as usize;
        let page_index = index / TARGETS_PER_PAGE;
        if self.pages.len() <= page_index {
            self.pages.resize_with(page_index + 1, || None);
        }
        if self.pages[page_index].is_none() {
            self.pages[page_index] = Some(BoundTargetPage::new());
        }
        let page = self.page_mut(index);
        if page.values[index % TARGETS_PER_PAGE].replace(target).is_none() {
            page.live_count += 1;
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn remove(&mut self, id: &RuleID) -> Option<NativeRuleTarget> {
        self.get(id)?;
        let index = id.0 as usize;
        let page = self.page_mut(index);
        let target = page.values[index % TARGETS_PER_PAGE].take().unwrap();

        page.live_count -= 1;
        if page.live_count == 0 {
            self.pages[index / TARGETS_PER_PAGE] = None;
        }
        Some(target)
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(super) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.pages
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .map(|page| usize::from(page.data.live_count))
            .sum()
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn share(&mut self, pool: &TargetPages) {
        if !self.needs_sharing {
            return;
        }
        let mut pool = pool.lock().unwrap();
        for page in self.pages.iter_mut().flatten() {
            if page.data.shared_hash.is_some() {
                continue;
            }
            page.normalize();
            let mut hasher = fast_hasher();
            page.data.values.hash(&mut hasher);
            let hash = hasher.finish();
            if let Some(found) = pool.find(hash, |candidate| candidate.values == page.data.values) {
                page.data = found;
                continue;
            }
            Arc::make_mut(&mut page.data).shared_hash = Some(hash);
            pool.insert(hash, &page.data);
        }
        self.needs_sharing = false;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::num::NonZeroU64;

    fn target(identity: u64) -> NativeRuleTarget {
        NativeRuleTarget {
            identity: NonZeroU64::new(identity).unwrap(),
            source_identity: 1,
            conditions: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn relative_pages_preserve_native_identities_across_sharing_and_mutation() {
        let pool = TargetPages::default();
        let mut first = NativeRuleTargets::default();
        let mut second = NativeRuleTargets::default();
        for (base, table) in [(0, &mut first), (1000, &mut second)] {
            for index in 0..TARGETS_PER_PAGE {
                let mut value = target(index as u64 + 1 + base);
                value.source_identity += base;
                table.insert(RuleID(index as u32), value);
            }
        }
        first.insert(RuleID(TARGETS_PER_PAGE as u32), target(200));
        second.insert(RuleID(TARGETS_PER_PAGE as u32), target(201));
        first.share(&pool);
        second.share(&pool);
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(
            &first.pages[0].as_ref().unwrap().data,
            &second.pages[0].as_ref().unwrap().data
        ));
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(
            &first.pages[1].as_ref().unwrap().data,
            &second.pages[1].as_ref().unwrap().data
        ));
        assert_eq!(first.get(&RuleID(TARGETS_PER_PAGE as u32)).unwrap().identity.get(), 200);
        assert_eq!(
            second.get(&RuleID(TARGETS_PER_PAGE as u32)).unwrap().identity.get(),
            201
        );
        assert_eq!(first.get(&RuleID(7)).unwrap().source_identity, 1);
        assert_eq!(second.get(&RuleID(7)).unwrap().source_identity, 1001);
        assert_eq!(second.remove(&RuleID(7)).unwrap().identity.get(), 1008);
        assert!(second.get(&RuleID(7)).is_none());
        assert_eq!(first.get(&RuleID(7)).unwrap().identity.get(), 8);
        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(
            &first.pages[0].as_ref().unwrap().data,
            &second.pages[0].as_ref().unwrap().data
        ));
        let mut replacement = target(1008);
        replacement.source_identity = 1001;
        second.insert(RuleID(7), replacement);
        second.share(&pool);
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(
            &first.pages[0].as_ref().unwrap().data,
            &second.pages[0].as_ref().unwrap().data
        ));
        let mut edited = target(300);
        edited.source_identity = 1001;
        second.insert(RuleID(7), edited);
        assert_eq!(first.get(&RuleID(7)).unwrap().identity.get(), 8);
        assert_eq!(second.get(&RuleID(7)).unwrap().identity.get(), 300);
        for index in 0..=TARGETS_PER_PAGE {
            second.remove(&RuleID(index as u32));
        }
        assert_eq!(second.len(), 0);
        assert!(second.pages.iter().all(Option::is_none));
        let mut largest = target(u64::MAX);
        largest.source_identity = u64::MAX;
        second.insert(RuleID(0), largest);
        second.share(&pool);
        assert_eq!(second.get(&RuleID(0)).unwrap().identity.get(), u64::MAX);
        assert_eq!(second.get(&RuleID(0)).unwrap().source_identity, u64::MAX);
        let removed = second.remove(&RuleID(0)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(removed.identity.get(), u64::MAX);
        assert_eq!(removed.source_identity, u64::MAX);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Option<NativeRuleTarget>>(), size_of::<NativeRuleTarget>());
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Rust/src/css/style/pipeline/rule_store/rule_records.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

use super::Rule;
use crate::css::style::fast_hash::fast_hasher;
use crate::css::style::weak_pool::WeakPool;
use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::ops::{Index, IndexMut};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

const RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE: usize = 128;

pub(in crate::css::style) struct RuleRecordPage {
    values: [Option<Rule>; RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE],
    shared_hash: Option<u64>,
}

impl RuleRecordPage {
    fn new(values: [Option<Rule>; RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE]) -> Self {
        Self {
            values,
            shared_hash: None,
        }
    }
}

/// The pool equal pages of rule records are shared through.
pub(in crate::css::style) type RuleRecordPages = Mutex<WeakPool<RuleRecordPage>>;

/// Equal rule records share immutable pages through the process's pool. Child lists remain
/// outside the records; mutations detach only their page, including updates to its child-list slot.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(super) struct RuleRecordTable {
    pages: Vec<Arc<RuleRecordPage>>,
    len: usize,
    needs_sharing: bool,
}

impl RuleRecordTable {
    /// The bytes of the table's pages, each counted once, with what `rule_heap` says each rule
    /// holds.
    pub(super) fn heap_size(
        &self,
        sizer: &mut crate::heap_size::HeapSizer,
        mut rule_heap: impl FnMut(&Rule, &mut crate::heap_size::HeapSizer) -> usize,
    ) -> usize {
        let mut bytes = crate::heap_size::vec_bytes(&self.pages);
        for page in &self.pages {
            if sizer.first_sight(Arc::as_ptr(page)) {
                bytes += crate::heap_size::ARC_HEADER_BYTES + size_of::<RuleRecordPage>();
                bytes += page
                    .values
                    .iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .map(|rule| rule_heap(rule, sizer))
                    .sum::<usize>();
            }
        }
        bytes
    }

    pub(super) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.len
    }

    pub(super) fn push(&mut self, value: Rule) {
        if self.len.is_multiple_of(RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE) {
            self.pages
                .push(Arc::new(RuleRecordPage::new(std::array::from_fn(|_| None))));
        }
        let index = self.len;
        self.len = self.len.checked_add(1).expect("rule record space exhausted");
        self.needs_sharing = true;
        self.set(index, value);
    }

    fn page_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> &mut RuleRecordPage {
        assert!(index < self.len);
        self.needs_sharing = true;
        let page = &mut self.pages[index / RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE];
        // NB: A page the pool knows is copied, as one another table holds is: the pool keeps no
        //     page alive, and the copy is published again where the table is next shared.
        if Arc::get_mut(page).is_none() {
            *page = Arc::new(RuleRecordPage::new(page.values.clone()));
        }
        let page = Arc::get_mut(page).expect("a private page has one owner");
        page.shared_hash = None;
        page
    }

    fn set(&mut self, index: usize, value: Rule) {
        self.page_mut(index).values[index % RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE] = Some(value);
    }

    pub(super) fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Rule> {
        self.pages
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|page| page.values.iter())
            .take(self.len)
            .map(|rule| rule.as_ref().expect("a live rule slot has a record"))
    }

    pub(super) fn share(&mut self, pool: &RuleRecordPages) {
        if !self.needs_sharing {
            return;
        }
        let mut pool = pool.lock().unwrap();
        for page in &mut self.pages {
            if page.shared_hash.is_some() {
                continue;
            }
            let mut hasher = fast_hasher();
            page.values.hash(&mut hasher);
            let hash = hasher.finish();
            if let Some(found) = pool.find(hash, |candidate| candidate.values == page.values) {
                *page = found;
                continue;
            }
            // A clone of the table, as a fork of the style engine, holds the unpublished page too, and publishes a
            // copy of its own.
            if Arc::get_mut(page).is_none() {
                *page = Arc::new(RuleRecordPage::new(page.values.clone()));
            }
            Arc::get_mut(page).expect("a private page has one owner").shared_hash = Some(hash);
            pool.insert(hash, page);
        }
        self.needs_sharing = false;
    }
}

impl Index<usize> for RuleRecordTable {
    type Output = Rule;

    fn index(&self, index: usize) -> &Self::Output {
        assert!(index < self.len);
        self.pages[index / RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE].values[index % RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE]
            .as_ref()
            .expect("a live rule slot has a record")
    }
}

impl IndexMut<usize> for RuleRecordTable {
    fn index_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> &mut Self::Output {
        self.page_mut(index).values[index % RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE]
            .as_mut()
            .expect("a live rule slot has a record")
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::style::pipeline::rule_store::RuleStore;
    use crate::css::style::pipeline::rule_store::{CascadeOrigin, RuleID, RuleKind};

    #[test]
    fn shared_rule_records_detach_flags_and_keep_child_lists_document_local() {
        let pools = crate::css::style::pipeline::ProcessRuleIndexes::default();
        let make_program = || {
            let mut program = RuleStore::new();
            let sheet = program.add_sheet(CascadeOrigin::Author);
            for _ in 0..RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE * 2 + 1 {
                program.append_rule(sheet, None, RuleKind::Style);
            }
            program.share_rule_storage(Some(&pools));
            program
        };
        let first = make_program();
        let mut second = make_program();
        assert!(!second.set_rule_live(RuleID(0), first.rules[0].live));
        for (left, right) in first.rules.pages.iter().zip(&second.rules.pages) {
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(left, right));
        }
        let changed = RuleID((RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE + 7) as u32);
        second.set_rule_conditions_hold(changed, false);
        assert!(first.rule_conditions_hold(changed));
        assert!(!second.rule_conditions_hold(changed));
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&first.rules.pages[0], &second.rules.pages[0]));
        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&first.rules.pages[1], &second.rules.pages[1]));
        second.share_rule_storage(Some(&pools));

        let parent = RuleID(0);
        let child = second.append_rule(second.rule_sheet(parent), Some(parent), RuleKind::Style);
        assert!(first.rule_children(parent).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(second.rule_children(parent), &[child]);
        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&first.rules.pages[0], &second.rules.pages[0]));
        drop(second);
        let third = make_program();
        for (left, right) in first.rules.pages.iter().zip(&third.rules.pages) {
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(left, right));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_clone_shares_the_unpublished_pages_it_holds_with_the_original() {
        let pools = crate::css::style::pipeline::ProcessRuleIndexes::default();
        let mut program = RuleStore::new();
        let sheet = program.add_sheet(CascadeOrigin::Author);
        for _ in 0..RULE_RECORDS_PER_PAGE + 1 {
            program.append_rule(sheet, None, RuleKind::Style);
        }
        let mut clone = program.clone();
        clone.share_rule_storage(Some(&pools));
        program.share_rule_storage(Some(&pools));
        for (left, right) in program.rules.pages.iter().zip(&clone.rules.pages) {
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(left, right));
        }
    }
}

/*

use crate::css::style::fast_hash::fast_hasher;
use crate::css::style::pipeline::rule_store::{RuleKind, RuleVersion};
use crate::css::style::weak_pool::WeakPool;
use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::ops::Index;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

const RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE: usize = 128;
const EMPTY_VERSION: RuleVersion = RuleVersion::new(RuleKind::Style);

pub(in crate::css::style) struct RuleVersionPage {
    values: [RuleVersion; RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE],
    shared_hash: Option<u64>,
}

impl RuleVersionPage {
    fn new(values: [RuleVersion; RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE]) -> Self {
        Self {
            values,
            shared_hash: None,
        }
    }
}

/// The pool equal pages of rule versions are shared through.
pub(in crate::css::style) type RuleVersionPages = Mutex<WeakPool<RuleVersionPage>>;

/// Rule versions contain only identities: numbers, and selector programs compared by address. Equal
/// pages are interned through the process's pool rather than copied.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(super) struct RuleVersionTable {
    pages: Vec<Arc<RuleVersionPage>>,
    len: usize,
    needs_sharing: bool,
}

impl RuleVersionTable {
    /// The bytes of the table's pages, each counted once.
    pub(super) fn heap_size(&self, sizer: &mut crate::heap_size::HeapSizer) -> usize {
        crate::heap_size::vec_bytes(&self.pages) + self.pages.iter().map(|page| sizer.arc_shallow(page)).sum::<usize>()
    }

    pub(super) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.len
    }

    pub(super) fn push(&mut self, value: RuleVersion) {
        if self.len.is_multiple_of(RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE) {
            self.pages
                .push(Arc::new(RuleVersionPage::new([EMPTY_VERSION; RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE])));
        }
        let index = self.len;
        self.len = self.len.checked_add(1).expect("rule version space exhausted");
        self.needs_sharing = true;
        self.set(index, value);
    }

    pub(super) fn set(&mut self, index: usize, value: RuleVersion) {
        assert!(index < self.len);
        if self[index] == value {
            return;
        }
        let page = &mut self.pages[index / RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE];
        // NB: A page the pool knows is copied, as one another table holds is: the pool keeps no
        //     page alive, and the copy is published again where the table is next shared.
        if Arc::get_mut(page).is_none() {
            *page = Arc::new(RuleVersionPage::new(page.values.clone()));
        }
        let page = Arc::get_mut(page).expect("a private page has one owner");
        page.shared_hash = None;
        page.values[index % RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE] = value;
        self.needs_sharing = true;
    }

    pub(super) fn share(&mut self, pool: &RuleVersionPages) {
        if !self.needs_sharing {
            return;
        }
        let mut pool = pool.lock().unwrap();
        for page in &mut self.pages {
            if page.shared_hash.is_some() {
                continue;
            }
            let mut hasher = fast_hasher();
            page.values.hash(&mut hasher);
            let hash = hasher.finish();
            if let Some(found) = pool.find(hash, |candidate| candidate.values == page.values) {
                *page = found;
                continue;
            }
            // A clone of the table, as a fork of the style engine, holds the unpublished page too, and publishes a
            // copy of its own.
            if Arc::get_mut(page).is_none() {
                *page = Arc::new(RuleVersionPage::new(page.values.clone()));
            }
            Arc::get_mut(page).expect("a private page has one owner").shared_hash = Some(hash);
            pool.insert(hash, page);
        }
        self.needs_sharing = false;
    }
}

impl Index<usize> for RuleVersionTable {
    type Output = RuleVersion;

    fn index(&self, index: usize) -> &Self::Output {
        assert!(index < self.len);
        &self.pages[index / RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE].values[index % RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE]
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn equal_pages_share_and_edits_detach_only_the_changed_page() {
        let pool = RuleVersionPages::default();
        let make_table = || {
            let mut table = RuleVersionTable::default();
            for _ in 0..RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE * 2 + 1 {
                table.push(RuleVersion::new(RuleKind::Style));
            }
            table.share(&pool);
            table
        };
        let first = make_table();
        let mut second = make_table();
        for (left, right) in first.pages.iter().zip(&second.pages) {
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(left, right));
        }
        let index = RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE + 7;
        let mut changed = second[index].clone();
        changed.kind = RuleKind::Media;
        second.set(index, changed);
        assert_eq!(first[index].kind, RuleKind::Style);
        assert_eq!(second[index].kind, RuleKind::Media);
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&first.pages[0], &second.pages[0]));
        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&first.pages[1], &second.pages[1]));
        second.share(&pool);
        second.push(RuleVersion::new(RuleKind::Style));
        assert_eq!(first.len(), RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE * 2 + 1);
        assert_eq!(second.len(), first.len() + 1);
        drop(second);
        let third = make_table();
        for (left, right) in first.pages.iter().zip(&third.pages) {
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(left, right));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_clone_shares_the_unpublished_pages_it_holds_with_the_original() {
        let pool = RuleVersionPages::default();
        let mut table = RuleVersionTable::default();
        for index in 0..RULE_VERSIONS_PER_PAGE + 1 {
            // NB: Names no other test gives, so that no page another test published is equal.
            let mut version = RuleVersion::new(RuleKind::Keyframes);
            version.set_declared_name(crate::css::style::StyleAtomID(0x5ee7_0000 + index as u32));
            table.push(version);
        }
        let mut clone = table.clone();
        clone.share(&pool);
        table.share(&pool);
        for (left, right) in table.pages.iter().zip(&clone.pages) {
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(left, right));
        }
    }
}

/*
