//! The audit of what a pass reuses. With `LIBWEB_STYLE_AUDIT_CACHES` set, every element a pass
//! with its caches on gives a record, whether through style sharing, the matched declarations cache, a move of
//! its custom properties or a computation reading the group, absolutized value, custom property
//! store and substitution caches of its thread, is styled again from nothing: on a scratch of its
//! own, with every cache off, over the records the pass holds for the elements before it. The
//! element's record and its pseudo-elements' records, the ones from the matched declarations cache
//! included, must be the ones that recomputation gives, and the rules it matched the ones that
//! recomputation matches. `report` prints what differs at the end of the pass, and any other value
//! but `0` aborts there.

use super::super::super::*;
use super::super::records::{PseudoElementRecords, PseudoElementTarget, Record};
use super::super::self_check::{Mode, describe, pseudo_element_name, pseudo_element_target_name, record_differences};
use super::{PassContext, Scratch, is_document_element};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// What `LIBWEB_STYLE_AUDIT_CACHES` asks for, which the engine reads once as it starts.
pub(in super::super) fn mode_from_environment() -> Mode {
    match std::env::var("LIBWEB_STYLE_AUDIT_CACHES").as_deref() {
        Err(_) | Ok("" | "0") => Mode::Off,
        Ok("report") => Mode::Report,
        Ok(_) => Mode::Abort,
    }
}

/// What gave an element the record the audit checks.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Reuse {
    SharedStyle,
    MatchedDeclarations,
    MovedCustomProperties,
    /// A computation, reading the caches its thread kept of the computations before it.
    ComputationCaches,
    /// The matched declarations cache, for a pseudo-element.
    PseudoElementRecord,
}

impl Reuse {
    const COUNT: usize = 5;

    fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::SharedStyle => "style sharing",
            Self::MatchedDeclarations => "the matched declarations cache",
            Self::MovedCustomProperties => "a move of its custom properties",
            Self::ComputationCaches => "a computation with the caches of its thread",
            Self::PseudoElementRecord => "the matched declarations cache, for a pseudo-element",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(in super::super) struct CacheAudit {
    /// How many records the audit checked, by what gave them.
    checked: [u64; Reuse::COUNT],
    /// How many elements the audit checked nothing of, or nothing of the pseudo-elements of, as
    /// recomputation declined to style them or waited on a font or a random base value.
    declined: u64,
    failures: Vec<String>,
}

impl CacheAudit {
    /// The audit of a thread of a pass over `context`, where the context asks for one and the pass
    /// has caches to audit.
    pub(super) fn for_pass(context: &PassContext<'_>) -> Option<Box<Self>> {
        (context.uses_caches && context.cache_audit != Mode::Off).then(Box::default)
    }

    pub(in super::super) fn add(&mut self, other: Self) {
        for (checked, other) in self.checked.iter_mut().zip(other.checked) {
            *checked += other;
        }
        self.declined += other.declined;
        self.failures.extend(other.failures);
    }

    /// Print what differs from its recomputation to stderr, and abort where `mode` asks to.
    pub(super) fn conclude(&self, mode: Mode) {
        if self.failures.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        eprintln!(
            "Style cache audit: what a pass reused differs from recomputing it without caches in {} places (live is what the pass holds, cold the recomputation):",
            self.failures.len()
        );
        for failure in &self.failures {
            eprintln!("    {failure}");
        }
        assert!(
            mode != Mode::Abort,
            "a cache gave a record recomputation does not; set LIBWEB_STYLE_AUDIT_CACHES=report to only print the differences"
        );
    }
}

impl Scratch<'_> {
    /// Check the record `context` holds for `node`, which `reuse` gave it, and the records of its
    /// pseudo-elements, against styling it again with every cache off, where the audit is on.
    pub(super) fn audit_caches(&mut self, context: &PassContext<'_>, node: StyleNodeID, reuse: Reuse) {
        let Some(audit) = self.cache_audit.as_deref_mut() else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(live) = context.records.get_shared(node) else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(recomputed) = recompute(context, node) else {
            audit.declined += 1;
            return;
        };
        let cold = &recomputed.record;
        let state = context.state;
        let name_of = |atom: StyleAtomID| state.atoms.name_of(atom).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("atom{}", atom.0));
        let element = || describe(state, node, &name_of);
        audit.checked[reuse as usize] += 1;
        // NB: What an element matched decides its style, so a record differing for other matches
        //     than recomputation finds differs for those, whatever the caches gave.
        if let Some(live_matches) = context.records.matches_of(node).filter(|_| context.keeps_matches)
            && live_matches[..] != recomputed.matches[..]
        {
            let only_in = |first: &[u32], second: &[u32]| {
                first
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|entry| !second.contains(entry))
                    .map(
                        |&entry| match context.index.entries.entry(entry as usize).pseudo_kind() {
                            u8::MAX => entry.to_string(),
                            kind => format!("{entry} ({})", pseudo_element_name(kind)),
                        },
                    )
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(", ")
            };
            audit.failures.push(format!(
                "{}, from {}: live matched other rule entries than cold, live alone [{}], cold alone [{}]",
                element(),
                reuse.name(),
                only_in(live_matches, &recomputed.matches),
                only_in(&recomputed.matches, live_matches)
            ));
        }
        let differences = record_differences(live, cold);
        if !differences.is_empty() {
            audit.failures.push(format!(
                "{}, from {}: live differs from cold in {}",
                element(),
                reuse.name(),
                differences.join(", ")
            ));
        }
        // NB: An element whose pseudo-element waits on a font waits in the pass too, which styles
        //     it again once the font resolved.
        let Some(cold_pseudo_elements) = &recomputed.pseudo_elements else {
            audit.declined += 1;
            return;
        };
        let live_pseudo_elements = context.records.pseudo_element_records(node);
        let targets = |records: &[(PseudoElementTarget, Arc<Record>)]| {
            records.iter().map(|(target, _)| *target).collect::<Vec<_>>()
        };
        if targets(live_pseudo_elements) != targets(cold_pseudo_elements) {
            let names = |targets: Vec<PseudoElementTarget>| {
                targets.into_iter().map(pseudo_element_target_name).collect::<Vec<_>>()
            };
            audit.failures.push(format!(
                "{}, from {}: live holds the pseudo-elements {:?}, cold computes {:?}",
                element(),
                reuse.name(),
                names(targets(live_pseudo_elements)),
                names(targets(cold_pseudo_elements))
            ));
            return;
        }
        for ((target, live), (_, cold)) in live_pseudo_elements.iter().zip(cold_pseudo_elements) {
            let reuse = match self.pseudo_element_cache_hits.contains(target) {
                true => Reuse::PseudoElementRecord,
                false => reuse,
            };
            audit.checked[reuse as usize] += u64::from(reuse == Reuse::PseudoElementRecord);
            let differences = record_differences(live, cold);
            if !differences.is_empty() {
                audit.failures.push(format!(
                    "{} of {}, from {}: live differs from cold in {}",
                    pseudo_element_target_name(*target),
                    element(),
                    reuse.name(),
                    differences.join(", ")
                ));
            }
        }
    }
}

/// What an element styled from nothing comes to.
struct Recomputed {
    record: Arc<Record>,
    /// None where one of them waits on a font or a random base value.
    pseudo_elements: Option<PseudoElementRecords>,
    /// The entries of the rule index the element matched.
    matches: Vec<u32>,
}

/// The record of `node` and those of its pseudo-elements, styled from nothing on a scratch of
/// their own with every cache off, over the records `context` holds for the elements before it,
/// the pseudo-elements over the one it holds for `node`. None where that declines to style the
/// element, or waits on a font or a random base value.
fn recompute(context: &PassContext<'_>, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<Recomputed> {
    let state = context.state;
    // NB: The pass computes the document element against the root font it held before, and its
    //     pseudo-elements and every element after it against the one it computes.
    let is_document_element = is_document_element(state, node);
    let reference = PassContext {
        uses_caches: false,
        ..PassContext::new(
            state,
            context.index,
            context.initial,
            context.records,
            context.held_root_font,
        )
    };
    let note_root_font = || {
        if let Some(&root_font) = context.root_font.get() {
            let _ = reference.root_font.set(root_font);
        }
    };
    if !is_document_element {
        note_root_font();
    }
    let mut scratch = Scratch::new(&reference);
    let facts = state.projection.facts(node)?;
    scratch.enter_parent(&reference, state.projection.parent(node));
    scratch
        .matcher
        .match_element(node, facts, &scratch.filter, &mut scratch.matches)
        .ok()?;
    scratch.apply_container_gates(&reference, node, false);
    if !scratch.cascade_element(&reference, node, state.backed_host_pseudo_element(node)) {
        return None;
    }
    let (record, _) = scratch.compute(&reference, node, None).ok()?;
    if is_document_element {
        note_root_font();
    }
    let pseudo_elements = scratch
        .styled_pseudo_elements(&reference, node)
        .map(|(pseudo_elements, _)| pseudo_elements);
    Some(Recomputed {
        record,
        pseudo_elements: pseudo_elements.filter(|_| scratch.requested() == (0, 0)),
        matches: scratch.matches.iter().map(|matched| matched.entry).collect(),
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(super) mod tests {
    use super::super::super::test_support::*;
    use super::*;

    /// `root -> [a, b, c, d -> e -> f -> g]`, every element but the root an `.item`, whose style
    /// and `::before` every one shares or reuses from another but the first.
    fn document_of_items() -> (StyleEngine, Vec<StyleNodeID>) {
        let mut engine = hosted_engine();
        let nodes = allocate_nodes(&mut engine, 8);
        engine.record_tree_delta(nodes[0], None, Some(relations(None, None, None)));
        for index in 1..5 {
            let previous = (index > 1).then(|| nodes[index - 1]);
            engine.record_tree_delta(nodes[index], None, Some(relations(Some(nodes[0]), previous, None)));
        }
        for index in 5..8 {
            engine.record_tree_delta(nodes[index], None, Some(relations(Some(nodes[index - 1]), None, None)));
        }
        engine.set_element_adjustment_facts(nodes[0], bridge::element_adjustment_fact::IS_DOCUMENT_ELEMENT);
        for &node in &nodes {
            set_tag(&mut engine, node, "div");
        }
        for &node in &nodes[1..] {
            add_class(&mut engine, node, "item");
        }
        let sheet = add_sheet(&mut engine, TreeScopeID::DOCUMENT);
        add_rules(
            &mut engine,
            sheet,
            ".item { color: rgb(0, 128, 0); width: 10px; --name: 1; } .item::before { content: \"x\"; }",
        );
        (engine, nodes)
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_live_style_reuses_is_what_it_recomputes() {
        let (mut engine, nodes) = document_of_items();
        start_live(&mut engine, nodes[0]);
        // NB: The engine starting again keeps the audit it started with, here one reporting
        //     what differs.
        engine
            .retained
            .live_style
            .as_mut()
            .expect("the engine runs")
            .cache_audit = Mode::Report;
        start_live(&mut engine, nodes[0]);
        add_class(&mut engine, nodes[2], "other");
        remove_class(&mut engine, nodes[6], "item");
        run_style_update(&mut engine, nodes[0]);
        let audit = &engine
            .retained
            .live_style
            .as_ref()
            .expect("the engine runs")
            .cache_audits;
        assert_eq!(audit.failures, Vec::<String>::new());
        for reuse in [
            Reuse::SharedStyle,
            Reuse::MatchedDeclarations,
            Reuse::ComputationCaches,
            Reuse::PseudoElementRecord,
        ] {
            assert_ne!(
                audit.checked[reuse as usize],
                0,
                "the audit checks records from {}",
                reuse.name()
            );
        }
    }

    /// Style `nodes` in turn on one scratch with its caches on, having `poison` seed its caches
    /// before the last one, and answer what the audit found.
    fn poisoned_pass(
        engine: &mut StyleEngine,
        nodes: &[StyleNodeID],
        poison: impl FnOnce(&mut Scratch<'_>, &PassContext<'_>),
    ) -> CacheAudit {
        let initial = engine
            .computed_initial(nodes[0])
            .expect("the document has initial values");
        let state = &engine.retained;
        let index = super::super::super::rules::RuleIndex::build(&state.rules, state.process_rule_indexes());
        let mut cells = super::super::super::records::RecordCells::default();
        cells.reserve(state.projection.element_slot_count());
        let records = super::super::super::records::Records::new(state, &cells, None);
        let context = PassContext {
            cache_audit: Mode::Report,
            ..PassContext::new(state, &index, &initial, &records, None)
        };
        let mut scratch = Scratch::new(&context);
        let (last, first) = nodes.split_last().expect("there are elements to style");
        for &node in first {
            scratch.style_element(&context, node, None, super::super::PARENT_CHANGED);
        }
        poison(&mut scratch, &context);
        scratch.style_element(&context, *last, None, super::super::PARENT_CHANGED);
        *scratch.cache_audit.take().expect("the scratch audits")
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_shared_style_that_differs_from_recomputation_is_reported() {
        let (mut engine, nodes) = document_of_items();
        start_live(&mut engine, nodes[0]);
        let audit = poisoned_pass(&mut engine, &nodes[..3], |scratch, context| {
            // Seed a candidate the second item agrees with, holding the root's record.
            let state = context.state;
            let facts = state.projection.facts(nodes[2]).unwrap();
            let key = super::super::super::sharing::key_of(state, context.index, context.records, nodes[2], facts)
                .expect("the item can share");
            let wrong = context.records.get_shared(nodes[0]).unwrap().clone();
            scratch.sharing = Default::default();
            scratch.sharing.insert(key, wrong, nodes[1], Default::default());
        });
        assert_eq!(audit.checked[Reuse::SharedStyle as usize], 1);
        // NB: The `::before` the item shares recomputes over the record the item holds.
        assert_eq!(audit.failures.len(), 2, "{:?}", audit.failures);
        assert!(audit.failures[1].starts_with("::before of "), "{:?}", audit.failures);
        let failure = &audit.failures[0];
        for part in [
            &format!(
                "(node {}), from style sharing: live differs from cold in ",
                nodes[2].raw()
            )[..],
            "width: live auto, cold 10px",
            "custom properties",
        ] {
            assert!(failure.contains(part), "{failure} names {part}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_matched_declarations_record_that_differs_from_recomputation_is_reported() {
        let (mut engine, nodes) = document_of_items();
        start_live(&mut engine, nodes[0]);
        let audit = poisoned_pass(&mut engine, &nodes[..3], |scratch, context| {
            // Have every element record the pass keeps be the root's record.
            let wrong = context.records.get_shared(nodes[0]).unwrap();
            context.matched_declarations().poison_with(wrong, false);
            scratch.sharing = Default::default();
        });
        assert_eq!(audit.checked[Reuse::MatchedDeclarations as usize], 1);
        assert!(
            audit.failures[0].contains(&format!(
                "(node {}), from the matched declarations cache: live differs from cold in ",
                nodes[2].raw()
            )),
            "{:?}",
            audit.failures
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_pseudo_element_record_that_differs_from_recomputation_is_reported() {
        let (mut engine, nodes) = document_of_items();
        start_live(&mut engine, nodes[0]);
        let audit = poisoned_pass(&mut engine, &nodes[..3], |scratch, context| {
            // Have every pseudo-element record the pass keeps be the root's record.
            let wrong = context.records.get_shared(nodes[0]).unwrap();
            context.matched_declarations().poison_with(wrong, true);
            scratch.sharing = Default::default();
        });
        assert_eq!(audit.checked[Reuse::PseudoElementRecord as usize], 1);
        assert_eq!(audit.failures.len(), 1, "{:?}", audit.failures);
        let failure = &audit.failures[0];
        // NB: The atoms of a test's engine name no strings the audit could show.
        assert!(failure.starts_with("::before of <"), "{failure}");
        assert!(
            failure.contains(&format!(
                "(node {}), from the matched declarations cache, for a pseudo-element: live differs from cold in ",
                nodes[2].raw()
            )),
            "{failure}"
        );
    }
}

//! The winning declarations of one element's drive, with values borrowed from the committed
//! declaration inputs. Only substituted values need ownership here. A view cannot outlive its
//! input borrow.

use super::super::*;
use crate::css::cascaded_properties::{CascadedValues, WinningDeclaration};
use crate::css::style_compute::{ExternalValueDependencies, RootFontReads};
use crate::css::style_value::ShorthandPayload;
use crate::css::style_value::{RetainedStyleValueData, StyleValueData};
use std::cell::Cell;

pub(in crate::css::style) enum WinnerValue {
    Written {
        node: StyleNodeID,
        source: WinnerSource,
        index: usize,
    },
    /// A value substituted from what `source` declared, which keeps the sheet a `url()` in it
    /// resolves against.
    Substituted {
        value: RetainedStyleValueData,
        source: WinnerSource,
    },
}

pub(in crate::css::style) struct WinnerDeclaration {
    pub(in crate::css::style) property: u16,
    pub(in crate::css::style) important: bool,
    pub(in crate::css::style) value: WinnerValue,
    /// The origin of the winning declaration.
    pub(in crate::css::style) origin: CascadeOrigin,
    /// `external_value_dependencies(value)`, memoized, packed into one word with a bit saying
    /// it has been computed.
    dependencies: Cell<u32>,
}

/// Set on a packed `ExternalValueDependencies` word that has been computed.
pub(in crate::css::style) const DEPENDENCIES_COMPUTED: u32 = 1 << 31;

/// The bits a packed `ExternalValueDependencies` word may set: those `pack_dependencies` sets.
pub(in crate::css::style) const DEPENDENCY_BITS: u32 = DEPENDENCIES_COMPUTED | ((1 << 21) - 1);

pub(in crate::css::style) fn pack_dependencies(dependencies: ExternalValueDependencies) -> u32 {
    let ExternalValueDependencies {
        uses_tree_counting_function,
        container_relative_length_unit_mask,
        has_unfixed_random_sharing,
        uses_random_function,
        needs_document_base_url,
        may_need_style_sheet_resource_context,
        inheritance_dependent,
        root_font_reads,
        font_metric_relative_length,
        color_scheme_dependent,
        device_pixel_ratio_dependent,
        viewport_axes,
    } = dependencies;
    DEPENDENCIES_COMPUTED
        | u32::from(container_relative_length_unit_mask)
        | (u32::from(uses_tree_counting_function) << 8)
        | (u32::from(has_unfixed_random_sharing) << 9)
        | (u32::from(uses_random_function) << 10)
        | (u32::from(needs_document_base_url) << 11)
        | (u32::from(may_need_style_sheet_resource_context) << 12)
        | (u32::from(inheritance_dependent) << 13)
        | (u32::from(root_font_reads as u8) << 14)
        | (u32::from(color_scheme_dependent) << 17)
        | (u32::from(device_pixel_ratio_dependent) << 18)
        | (u32::from(viewport_axes) << 19)
        | (u32::from(font_metric_relative_length) << 16)
}

pub(in crate::css::style) fn unpack_dependencies(bits: u32) -> ExternalValueDependencies {
    ExternalValueDependencies {
        uses_tree_counting_function: bits & (1 << 8) != 0,
        container_relative_length_unit_mask: (bits & 0xff) as u8,
        has_unfixed_random_sharing: bits & (1 << 9) != 0,
        uses_random_function: bits & (1 << 10) != 0,
        needs_document_base_url: bits & (1 << 11) != 0,
        may_need_style_sheet_resource_context: bits & (1 << 12) != 0,
        inheritance_dependent: bits & (1 << 13) != 0,
        root_font_reads: match (bits >> 14) & 0b11 {
            0 => RootFontReads::None,
            1 => RootFontReads::FontSize,
            _ => RootFontReads::Metrics,
        },
        font_metric_relative_length: bits & (1 << 16) != 0,
        color_scheme_dependent: bits & (1 << 17) != 0,
        device_pixel_ratio_dependent: bits & (1 << 18) != 0,
        viewport_axes: ((bits >> 19) & 0b11) as u8,
    }
}

impl WinnerDeclaration {
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn new(
        property: u16,
        important: bool,
        value: WinnerValue,
        origin: CascadeOrigin,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            property,
            important,
            value,
            origin,
            dependencies: Cell::new(0),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(in crate::css::style) struct WinnerStore {
    // NB: Cascade order supplies both source slots and logical/physical tie breaking.
    declarations: Vec<WinnerDeclaration>,
    by_property: Vec<u16>,
}

impl WinnerStore {
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn new(declarations: Vec<WinnerDeclaration>) -> Self {
        let mut by_property = vec![u16::MAX; crate::css::property_metadata::NUMBER_OF_LONGHAND_PROPERTIES];
        for (index, declaration) in declarations.iter().enumerate() {
            by_property
                [usize::from(declaration.property - crate::css::property_metadata::FIRST_LONGHAND_PROPERTY_ID)] =
                u16::try_from(index).expect("winner count exceeds longhand count");
        }
        Self {
            declarations,
            by_property,
        }
    }

    /// Whether no value the store holds resolves a `url()` against a style sheet's or the
    /// document's base URL. The engine keeps only such records across transactions, so a move of
    /// those base URLs, which every `history.pushState()` makes without a `<base>`, leaves nothing
    /// it keeps to forget.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn reads_no_resource_contexts(&self, engine: &RetainedState) -> bool {
        let view = self.view(engine);
        !self
            .declarations
            .iter()
            .any(|declaration| view.dependencies(declaration).may_need_style_sheet_resource_context)
    }

    /// The container-relative units the values the store holds resolve, as a
    /// `container_relative_length_unit_mask`.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn container_unit_mask(&self, engine: &RetainedState) -> u8 {
        let view = self.view(engine);
        self.declarations.iter().fold(0, |mask, declaration| {
            mask | view.dependencies(declaration).container_relative_length_unit_mask
        })
    }

    pub(in crate::css::style) fn view<'a>(&'a self, engine: &'a RetainedState) -> WinnerView<'a> {
        WinnerView { store: self, engine }
    }

    fn declaration(&self, property: u16) -> Option<(usize, &WinnerDeclaration)> {
        let index = usize::from(*self.by_property.get(usize::from(
            property.checked_sub(crate::css::property_metadata::FIRST_LONGHAND_PROPERTY_ID)?,
        ))?);
        self.declarations.get(index).map(|declaration| (index, declaration))
    }
}

pub(in crate::css::style) struct WinnerView<'a> {
    store: &'a WinnerStore,
    engine: &'a RetainedState,
}

pub(in crate::css::style) fn shorthand_longhand_data(
    property: u16,
    data: &StyleValueData,
) -> Option<&RetainedStyleValueData> {
    let StyleValueData::Shorthand(shorthand_payload) = data else {
        return None;
    };
    let ShorthandPayload {
        sub_properties, values, ..
    } = &**shorthand_payload;
    for (&sub_property, sub_value) in sub_properties.as_slice().iter().zip(values.as_slice()) {
        if sub_property == property {
            return Some(sub_value);
        }
        if let Some(found) = shorthand_longhand_data(property, sub_value.data()) {
            return Some(found);
        }
    }
    None
}

impl WinnerView<'_> {
    fn value<'a>(&'a self, declaration: &'a WinnerDeclaration) -> &'a RetainedStyleValueData {
        let written = match &declaration.value {
            WinnerValue::Substituted { value, .. } => return value,
            WinnerValue::Written { node, source, index } => match source {
                WinnerSource::Rule(rule) => &self.engine.rules.written_values_of(*rule)[*index],
                WinnerSource::Element(kind) => self
                    .engine
                    .element_declarations
                    .declarations(*node, *kind)
                    .expect("a written winner's declarations are held")
                    .written(*index),
            },
        };
        match written.data() {
            data @ StyleValueData::Shorthand { .. } => {
                shorthand_longhand_data(declaration.property, data).expect("validated shorthand winner")
            }
            _ => written,
        }
    }
}

impl WinnerStore {
    /// The resource context of each declaration, in cascade order, as the drive reads a winner's
    /// source slot. Empty, and no allocation, when no declaration may read one.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn drive_resource_contexts(
        &self,
        engine: &RetainedState,
    ) -> Vec<crate::css::style_compute::FfiStyleSheetResourceContext> {
        if self.reads_no_resource_contexts(engine) {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let view = self.view(engine);
        self.declarations
            .iter()
            .map(|declaration| {
                view.resource_context(declaration).map_or(
                    crate::css::style_compute::FfiStyleSheetResourceContext::empty(),
                    |context| context.as_drive_context(),
                )
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

impl WinnerStore {
    /// The random sharings of the declarations' random functions whose random base value is not
    /// fixed, as the drive finds their base values: by pointer.
    fn unfixed_random_sharings(&self, engine: &RetainedState) -> Vec<*const StyleValueData> {
        let view = self.view(engine);
        let mut sharings = Vec::new();
        for declaration in &self.declarations {
            if view.dependencies(declaration).has_unfixed_random_sharing {
                crate::css::style_compute::collect_unfixed_random_sharings_in_value(
                    view.value(declaration).data(),
                    &mut sharings,
                );
            }
        }
        sharings
    }

    /// The random caching key of every random function in the declarations that has not got a
    /// base value yet, for a drive of `node`'s record.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn undrawn_random_keys(
        &self,
        engine: &RetainedState,
        node: StyleNodeID,
    ) -> Vec<crate::css::style::random_bases::RandomBaseRequest> {
        self.unfixed_random_sharings(engine)
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|sharing| {
                // SAFETY: The declarations retain every value a sharing is part of.
                let (name, element_shared) = crate::css::style_compute::random_caching_key(unsafe { &*sharing });
                engine
                    .drawn_random_base_value(node, name, element_shared)
                    .is_none()
                    .then(|| crate::css::style::random_bases::RandomBaseRequest {
                        node,
                        name: name.into(),
                        element_shared,
                    })
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// The random base values of the declarations' random functions for a drive of `node`'s
    /// record. Empty, and no allocation, when they hold none; `None` when one was not drawn for
    /// the node.
    pub(in crate::css::style) fn drive_random_base_values(
        &self,
        engine: &RetainedState,
        node: StyleNodeID,
    ) -> Option<Vec<crate::css::style_compute::FfiRandomBaseValue>> {
        self.unfixed_random_sharings(engine)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|sharing| {
                // SAFETY: The declarations retain every value a sharing is part of.
                let (name, element_shared) = crate::css::style_compute::random_caching_key(unsafe { &*sharing });
                Some(crate::css::style_compute::FfiRandomBaseValue {
                    source: sharing.cast(),
                    value: engine.random_base_values.get(node, name, element_shared)?,
                })
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

impl<'a> WinnerView<'a> {
    fn dependencies(&self, declaration: &WinnerDeclaration) -> ExternalValueDependencies {
        let memoized = declaration.dependencies.get();
        if memoized & DEPENDENCIES_COMPUTED != 0 {
            return unpack_dependencies(memoized);
        }
        // A written value's dependencies were prepared with the declaration it was written in.
        if let WinnerValue::Written { node, source, index } = &declaration.value {
            let prepared = match source {
                WinnerSource::Rule(rule) => self.engine.rules.written_value_checks(*rule, *index).dependencies(),
                WinnerSource::Element(kind) => self
                    .engine
                    .element_declarations
                    .declarations(*node, *kind)
                    .map_or(0, |declarations| declarations.checks(*index).dependencies()),
            };
            if prepared & DEPENDENCIES_COMPUTED != 0 {
                declaration.dependencies.set(prepared);
                return unpack_dependencies(prepared);
            }
        }
        // A value whose independence is not known reads its parent, conservatively.
        let dependencies = crate::css::style_compute::try_external_value_dependencies(self.value(declaration).data())
            .unwrap_or(ExternalValueDependencies {
                inheritance_dependent: true,
                ..ExternalValueDependencies::default()
            });
        declaration.dependencies.set(pack_dependencies(dependencies));
        dependencies
    }

    /// The resource context of the sheet a rule declaration came from, written or substituted. An
    /// element's own declarations resolve against the document's base URL, as they do in the
    /// host's cascade.
    fn resource_context(
        &self,
        declaration: &WinnerDeclaration,
    ) -> Option<&'a super::resource_contexts::StyleSheetResourceContext> {
        let (WinnerValue::Written {
            source: WinnerSource::Rule(rule),
            ..
        }
        | WinnerValue::Substituted {
            source: WinnerSource::Rule(rule),
            ..
        }) = declaration.value
        else {
            return None;
        };
        let engine: &'a RetainedState = self.engine;
        engine
            .document_resource_contexts
            .for_source(engine.rule_source_identity(rule)?)
    }
}

impl CascadedValues for WinnerView<'_> {
    fn winning_declaration(&self, property: u16) -> Option<WinningDeclaration<'_>> {
        let (index, declaration) = self.store.declaration(property)?;
        Some((
            self.value(declaration),
            declaration.important,
            u32::try_from(index).unwrap(),
            self.resource_context(declaration).is_some(),
            self.dependencies(declaration),
        ))
    }

    fn winning_origin(&self, property: u16) -> Option<CascadeOrigin> {
        Some(self.store.declaration(property)?.1.origin)
    }

    fn property_with_higher_priority(&self, first: u16, second: u16) -> u16 {
        match (self.store.declaration(first), self.store.declaration(second)) {
            (Some((first_index, _)), Some((second_index, _))) if first_index >= second_index => first,
            (Some(_), None) => first,
            _ => second,
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
    use crate::css::style_value::{ImagePayload, StyleValueBox, UrlPayload};

    #[test]
    fn only_urls_without_resource_dependencies_read_no_resource_contexts() {
        use crate::css::style_value::{ImageResourceContext, RetainedRequestUrlModifierList, RetainedString};

        let store = |property, value| {
            WinnerStore::new(vec![WinnerDeclaration::new(
                property,
                false,
                WinnerValue::Substituted {
                    value: RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(value),
                    source: WinnerSource::Element(ElementDeclarationKind::InlineStyle),
                },
                CascadeOrigin::Author,
            )])
        };
        let engine = StyleEngine::new();
        for (url, can_reuse) in [
            ("https://example.com/paint.svg#fill", true),
            ("data:image/svg+xml,paint", true),
            ("paint.svg#fill", false),
            ("/paint.svg#fill", false),
            ("//example.com/paint.svg#fill", false),
        ] {
            let url_value = || {
                StyleValueData::Url(StyleValueBox::new(UrlPayload {
                    url: RetainedString::from_ascii(url.to_owned()),
                    url_type: 0,
                    modifiers: RetainedRequestUrlModifierList::from_vec(Vec::new()),
                }))
            };
            let first = store(property_id::FILL, url_value());
            assert_eq!(first.reads_no_resource_contexts(&engine.retained), can_reuse, "{url}");
        }

        let image_value = |base_url: &str, origin_clean| {
            StyleValueData::Image(StyleValueBox::new(ImagePayload {
                url: RetainedString::from_ascii("https://example.com/image.png".to_owned()),
                url_type: 0,
                url_modifiers: RetainedRequestUrlModifierList::from_vec(Vec::new()),
                resource_context: ImageResourceContext {
                    base_url: RetainedString::from_ascii(base_url.to_owned()),
                    has_base_url: true,
                    has_parent_style_sheet_origin_clean: true,
                    parent_style_sheet_origin_clean: origin_clean,
                    should_absolutize_url_for_computed_value: true,
                },
            }))
        };
        let first = store(
            property_id::BACKGROUND_IMAGE,
            image_value("https://example.com/first.css", true),
        );
        assert!(!first.reads_no_resource_contexts(&engine.retained));
    }

    #[test]
    fn winner_view_borrows_written_spelling_and_preserves_cascade_order() {
        let mut engine = StyleEngine::new();
        let node = StyleNodeID::element(1);
        let kind = ElementDeclarationKind::InlineStyle;
        let properties = [property_id::MARGIN_LEFT, property_id::MARGIN_INLINE_START];
        let written = [1.25, 2.5].map(|value| RetainedStyleValueData::from_owned(StyleValueData::Number { value }));
        let mut owned = CascadedPropertyStore::new();
        for (&property, value) in properties.iter().zip(&written) {
            owned.seed_retained_property(property, value.clone_retained(), true, false);
        }
        let observer = written[0].clone_retained().into_arc();
        engine.element_declarations.set_inline_for_test(
            node,
            properties
                .iter()
                .map(|&property| DeclarationEntry::new(property, true, CascadeOperator::Declared))
                .zip(written)
                .collect(),
        );
        let owners = crate::css::style_value_arc::StyleValueArc::strong_count(&observer);
        let store = WinnerStore::new(
            properties
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(index, &property)| {
                    WinnerDeclaration::new(
                        property,
                        true,
                        WinnerValue::Written {
                            node,
                            source: WinnerSource::Element(kind),
                            index,
                        },
                        CascadeOrigin::Author,
                    )
                })
                .collect(),
        );
        let view = store.view(&engine);
        for property in properties {
            let actual = view.winning_declaration(property).unwrap();
            let expected = owned.winning_declaration(property).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                (actual.0.pointer(), actual.1, actual.2, actual.3),
                (expected.0.pointer(), expected.1, expected.2, expected.3)
            );
            assert!(matches!(view.winning_origin(property), Some(CascadeOrigin::Author)));
        }
        assert_eq!(
            view.property_with_higher_priority(properties[0], properties[1]),
            properties[1]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            view.property_with_higher_priority(properties[1], properties[0]),
            properties[1]
        );
        assert!(view.winning_declaration(property_id::OPACITY).is_none());
        assert_eq!(
            crate::css::style_value_arc::StyleValueArc::strong_count(&observer),
            owners
        );
        drop(store);
        assert_eq!(
            crate::css::style_value_arc::StyleValueArc::strong_count(&observer),
            owners
        );
    }
}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

//! A slot one thread writes once, which other threads read after it is written: what a pass keeps
//! per element, written by the thread styling the element and read by those styling its
//! descendants. Writing it takes one atomic compare-exchange and one store, where a `OnceLock` goes
//! through `Once`.

use std::cell::UnsafeCell;
use std::mem::MaybeUninit;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU8, Ordering};

const EMPTY: u8 = 0;
const WRITING: u8 = 1;
const WRITTEN: u8 = 2;

pub(super) struct WriteOnce<T> {
    state: AtomicU8,
    value: UnsafeCell<MaybeUninit<T>>,
}

impl<T> Default for WriteOnce<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            state: AtomicU8::new(EMPTY),
            value: UnsafeCell::new(MaybeUninit::uninit()),
        }
    }
}

impl<T> WriteOnce<T> {
    pub(super) fn get(&self) -> Option<&T> {
        // SAFETY: A written value is initialized and never written again, and the acquire load
        //         sees the writes that made it.
        (self.state.load(Ordering::Acquire) == WRITTEN).then(|| unsafe { (*self.value.get()).assume_init_ref() })
    }

    /// Write the slot, or hand the value back where it was written before.
    pub(super) fn set(&self, value: T) -> Result<(), T> {
        if self
            .state
            .compare_exchange(EMPTY, WRITING, Ordering::Acquire, Ordering::Relaxed)
            .is_err()
        {
            return Err(value);
        }
        // SAFETY: Only the thread that moved the slot from empty to writing writes it, and no
        //         reader reads it before it is marked written.
        unsafe { (*self.value.get()).write(value) };
        self.state.store(WRITTEN, Ordering::Release);
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl<T> WriteOnce<T> {
    /// Take the value, where the slot was written, leaving it empty.
    pub(super) fn take(&mut self) -> Option<T> {
        let written = *self.state.get_mut() == WRITTEN;
        *self.state.get_mut() = EMPTY;
        // SAFETY: A written value is initialized, and marking the slot empty keeps it from being
        //         read or dropped again.
        written.then(|| unsafe { self.value.get_mut().assume_init_read() })
    }
}

impl<T> Drop for WriteOnce<T> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if *self.state.get_mut() == WRITTEN {
            // SAFETY: The value was written and is dropped once, with the slot.
            unsafe { self.value.get_mut().assume_init_drop() };
        }
    }
}

// SAFETY: The slot hands out shared references to its value across threads and drops it on the
//         thread dropping the slot, as a `OnceLock` does.
unsafe impl<T: Send + Sync> Sync for WriteOnce<T> {}
unsafe impl<T: Send> Send for WriteOnce<T> {}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Rust/src/css/style/pointer_key.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! Keys that find a counted value by its address and hold it, so that for as long as the key stands no other value can
//! take the address. A key can only be made from a counted reference, so one holding a bare address cannot be written:
//! `Meta/Linters/check_rust_address_keys.py` rejects the casts that would make one.

use crate::css::style_value::RetainedStyleValueData;
use std::borrow::Borrow;
use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// A counted reference, whose address names what it counts for as long as it is held.
pub(crate) trait Counted: Clone {
    fn address(&self) -> usize;
}

impl<T> Counted for Arc<T> {
    fn address(&self) -> usize {
        Arc::as_ptr(self).addr()
    }
}

impl Counted for RetainedStyleValueData {
    fn address(&self) -> usize {
        self.pointer().addr()
    }
}

impl Counted for libgfx_rust::font::FrozenFontListRef {
    fn address(&self) -> usize {
        self.as_raw().addr()
    }
}

/// What a map keyed by [`PointerKey`] is looked up by, which takes no count, so that a hit costs what one by the bare
/// address would. It is made only from a counted reference, and a key is the only way to keep one in a map.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct PointerLookup<E = ()> {
    address: usize,
    extra: E,
}

impl<E> PointerLookup<E> {
    pub(crate) fn new(value: &impl Counted, extra: E) -> Self {
        Self {
            address: value.address(),
            extra,
        }
    }
}

/// A map key naming `T` by its address, with `E`, whatever else the key says. It holds a count of `T`.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct PointerKey<T: Counted, E = ()> {
    lookup: PointerLookup<E>,
    _held: T,
}

impl<T: Counted, E> PointerKey<T, E> {
    pub(crate) fn new(value: &T, extra: E) -> Self {
        Self {
            lookup: PointerLookup::new(value, extra),
            _held: value.clone(),
        }
    }
}

impl<T: Counted, E: Hash> Hash for PointerKey<T, E> {
    fn hash<H: Hasher>(&self, state: &mut H) {
        self.lookup.hash(state);
    }
}

impl<T: Counted, E: Eq> PartialEq for PointerKey<T, E> {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.lookup == other.lookup
    }
}

impl<T: Counted, E: Eq> Eq for PointerKey<T, E> {}

impl<T: Counted, E> Borrow<PointerLookup<E>> for PointerKey<T, E> {
    fn borrow(&self) -> &PointerLookup<E> {
        &self.lookup
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn a_key_keeps_its_value_alive_and_a_lookup_finds_it_by_identity() {
        let mut map = crate::fast_hash::FastMap::default();
        let value = Arc::new(1);
        let equal = Arc::new(1);
        map.insert(PointerKey::new(&value, 2_u8), "value");
        assert_eq!(Arc::strong_count(&value), 2);
        assert_eq!(map.get(&PointerLookup::new(&value, 2_u8)), Some(&"value"));
        assert_eq!(map.get(&PointerLookup::new(&value, 3_u8)), None);
        assert_eq!(map.get(&PointerLookup::new(&equal, 2_u8)), None);
        assert_eq!(Arc::strong_count(&value), 2);
    }
}
