                // NB: Along the inline axis of a frame, line-left is its left side.
                ..AxisDirections::of(container_start_is_low, Some(true))
            },
        ))
    }

    /// Lays out and places `node`, kept with the cells `cells` for its run, with the inputs `inputs`, where its insets
    /// compensate for the scroll shift `default_scroll_shift`, and returns the block end of its border box in its
    /// containing block.
    fn layout_element(
        &self,
        run: &FormattingContextRun<'pass>,
        node: Node,
        cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
        inputs: abspos_inputs::AbsposLayoutInputs,
        default_scroll_shift: Option<abspos_inputs::DefaultScrollShift>,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        assert!(!self.facts(node).is_svg_box());
        let (available_space, constraints) = out_of_flow_root_space(&inputs);
        let inputs = std::sync::Arc::new(inputs);

        let laid_out = formatting_context::layout_inside_child_with_input_cells(
            run,
            None,
            None,
            node,
            LayoutInput::new(
                available_space,
                constraints,
                ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::AbsolutelyPositioned(inputs.clone()),
            ),
            cells,
            None,
            false,
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-sizing-3/#definite
            // "Additionally, the size of the containing block of an absolutely positioned element is always definite
            //  with respect to that element."
            true,
        );
        laid_out.report_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(run, node);
        let mut used_insets = laid_out
            .out_of_flow_root_used_insets()
            .expect("the layout of an absolutely positioned box gives it used insets");

        let metrics = laid_out.cells();
        let collapsed = metrics.uses_collapsing_borders_model();
        let static_offset = aligned_static_offset(
            inputs.static_position_rect,
            metrics.margin_box_inline_size(collapsed),
            metrics.margin_box_block_size(collapsed),
        );
        let mut used_offset = geometry::LogicalOffset {
            inline_offset: if inputs.containing_block_info.inline_placement.mode
                == abspos_inputs::AbsposAxisMode::StaticPosition
            {
                static_offset.inline_offset
            } else {
                inputs.containing_block_info.rect.offset.inline_offset + used_insets.left
            },
            block_offset: if inputs.containing_block_info.block_placement.mode
                == abspos_inputs::AbsposAxisMode::StaticPosition
            {
                static_offset.block_offset
            } else {
                inputs.containing_block_info.rect.offset.block_offset + used_insets.top
            },
        };
        used_offset.inline_offset += metrics.margin_left() + metrics.border_box_left(collapsed);
        used_offset.block_offset += metrics.margin_top() + metrics.border_box_top(collapsed);
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#position-area
        // The used value of any auto inset properties and auto margin properties resolves to 0.
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#anchor-center
        // The used value of any auto inset properties and auto margin properties resolves to 0.
        // NB: The box is aligned within its inset-modified containing block through its insets above. Now that it is
        //     placed, its used insets go back to the values of its inset properties.
        let (aligns_inline, aligns_block) = inputs.containing_block_info.anchor_aligned_axes();
        if aligns_inline || aligns_block {
            let style = self
                .style(node)
                .with_resolved_insets(inputs.resolved_anchor_insets.as_ref());
            let containing_block_size = inputs.containing_block_info.rect.size;
            if aligns_inline {
                used_insets.left = style.inset_left().to_px(containing_block_size.inline_size);
                used_insets.right = style.inset_right().to_px(containing_block_size.inline_size);
            }
            if aligns_block {
                used_insets.top = style.inset_top().to_px(containing_block_size.block_size);
                used_insets.bottom = style.inset_bottom().to_px(containing_block_size.block_size);
            }
        }
        let mut placed_child = laid_out.placed_child();
        placed_child.facts_decided_by_parent.used_insets = used_insets;
        placed_child.facts_decided_by_parent.default_scroll_shift = default_scroll_shift;
        placed_child.abspos_layout_inputs = Some(inputs);
        formatting_context::place_child(
            run,
            node,
            placed_child,
            FfiCssPixelPoint {
                x: used_offset.inline_offset,
                y: used_offset.block_offset,
            },
            None,
            laid_out.into_fragment_arrival(run),
        );
        used_offset.block_offset + metrics.content_block_size() + metrics.border_box_bottom(collapsed)
    }

    /// Lays out and places `child`, and returns the block end of its border box in its containing block.
    pub(crate) fn layout_pending_child(
        &self,
        run: &FormattingContextRun<'pass>,
        mut child: abspos_inputs::PendingAbsposChild,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        let child_box = child.child_box;
        let position_option = self.determine_position_fallback_styles(&child);
        self.with_position_option_style(child_box, position_option.style, |engine| {
            let run = run.with_pass(engine.pass);
            let cells =
                used_values::cells_before_sizing(&engine.pass, child_box, ContainingBlockConstraints::default());
            let (mut inputs, default_scroll_shift) = engine.pending_child_layout_inputs(&mut child);
            inputs.position_option = position_option.choice;
            engine.layout_element(&run, child_box, cells, inputs, Some(default_scroll_shift))
        })
    }

    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#determine-position-fallback-styles
    /// Chooses the position option the pending child `child` is laid out with, whose styles live until the answer is
    /// dropped.
    fn determine_position_fallback_styles(&self, child: &abspos_inputs::PendingAbsposChild) -> PositionOptionStyles {
        let node = child.child_box;
        let mut styles = PositionOptionStyles {
            choice: None,
            style: None,
            option_styles: Vec::new(),
        };
        let style = StyleValues::for_node(&self.pass, node);
        let anchor = style.anchor();
        let arena = self.pass.arena();
        if anchor.position_try_fallbacks.length == 0 || !style.is_absolutely_positioned() {
            return styles;
        }
        let Some(style_node) = arena.node_style_node(node) else {
            return styles;
        };
        let base_style_record = arena.node_style_record(node);
        // Logical directions are resolved against the writing mode of the containing block.
        let containing_block = child.containing_block();
        let (writing_mode, direction) = if containing_block.is_invalid() {
            (writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB, direction::LTR)
        } else {
            let containing_block_style = StyleValues::for_node(&self.pass, containing_block);
            (
                containing_block_style.writing_mode(),
                containing_block_style.direction(),
            )
        };

        // Implementations may choose to impose an implementation-defined limit on the length of position options
        // lists, to limit the amount of excess layout work that may be required. This limit must be at least five.
        const POSITION_OPTIONS_LIST_LIMIT: usize = 32;
        // NB: Each option is an entry of the position options list, the base styles first.
        let entries = arena.with_style_store(|engine| {
            engine.position_option_entries(style_node, base_style_record, POSITION_OPTIONS_LIST_LIMIT - 1)
        });
        if entries.is_empty() {
            return styles;
        }
        let entry_of = |option: u32| {
            option
                .checked_sub(1)
                .and_then(|index| entries.get(index as usize))
                .copied()
        };
        let mut options: Vec<u32> = (0..=entries.len() as u32).collect();

        // OPTIMIZATION: The styles of an option are made the first time it is tried, so that a box that fits with
        //               its current styles makes no other.
        let made_styles: std::cell::RefCell<Vec<(u32, Option<Option<node_data::LayoutStyleRef>>)>> =
            std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
        let option_styles = std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
        // The styles the option applies: none where the entry makes no option, and no styles of its own for the base
        // styles or an option that changes none of them.
        let option_style = |option: u32| -> Option<Option<node_data::LayoutStyleRef>> {
            let Some((index, _)) = entry_of(option) else {
                return Some(None);
            };
            let made = made_styles
                .borrow()
                .iter()
                .find(|&&(made_option, _)| made_option == option)
                .map(|&(_, style)| style);
            if let Some(style) = made {
                return style;
            }
            let style = arena
                .with_style_store(|engine| {
                    engine.position_option_style(style_node, base_style_record, index, writing_mode, direction)
                })
                .map(|style| match style {
                    PositionOptionStyle::SameAsBase => None,
                    PositionOptionStyle::Applied(style) => {
                        let payloads = style.payloads_for_style_reads();
                        option_styles.borrow_mut().push(style);
                        Some(payloads)
                    }
                });
            made_styles.borrow_mut().push((option, style));
            style
        };

        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#position-try-order-property
        // For each entry in the position options list, apply that position option to the box, and find the
        // inset-modified containing block size that results from those styles (treating auto inset values as zero).
        // Stably sort the position options list according to this size, with the largest coming first.
        if anchor.has_position_try_order {
            let try_order = anchor.position_try_order;
            let sized: Vec<(u32, CssPixels)> = options
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|&option| {
                    let style = option_style(option)?;
                    let size = self.with_position_option_style(node, style, |engine| {
                        let mut child = *child;
                        let (inputs, _) = engine.pending_child_layout_inputs(&mut child);
                        let size = engine.inset_modified_containing_block_size(node, &inputs);
                        let horizontal_is_frame_inline = !engine.pass.frame.is_transposed();
                        let inline_axis_is_horizontal = writing_mode == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB;
                        let (horizontal, vertical) = if horizontal_is_frame_inline {
                            (size.inline_size, size.block_size)
                        } else {
                            (size.block_size, size.inline_size)
                        };
                        match try_order {
                            crate::css::css_enums::try_order::MOST_WIDTH => horizontal,
                            crate::css::css_enums::try_order::MOST_HEIGHT => vertical,
                            crate::css::css_enums::try_order::MOST_INLINE_SIZE if inline_axis_is_horizontal => {
                                horizontal
                            }
                            crate::css::css_enums::try_order::MOST_INLINE_SIZE => vertical,
                            _ if inline_axis_is_horizontal => vertical,
                            _ => horizontal,
                        }
                    });
                    Some((option, size))
                })
                .collect();
            let mut sorted = sized;
            sorted.sort_by_key(|a| core::cmp::Reverse(a.1));
            options = sorted.into_iter().map(|(option, _)| option).collect();
        }

        // 1. Let current styles be the current used styles of abspos, as derived from the computed base style (which
        //    might be the result of earlier fallback).
        // NB: A box whose @position-try rule of its last successful position option changed has no last successful
        //     position option.
        let last_successful_option = arena
            .last_successful_position_option(node)
            .filter(|choice| {
                entry_of(choice.option).map_or(crate::css::style::position_try::PositionTryRuleID::NONE, |(_, rule)| {
                    rule
                }) == choice.rule
            })
            .map_or(0, |choice| choice.option);
        let current = options
            .iter()
            .position(|&option| option == last_successful_option && option_style(option).is_some())
            .or_else(|| options.iter().position(|&option| option == 0))
            .expect("the base styles are a position option");
        let choice_of = |option: u32| abspos_inputs::PositionOptionChoice {
            option,
            rule: entry_of(option).map_or(crate::css::style::position_try::PositionTryRuleID::NONE, |(_, rule)| {
                rule
            }),
        };
        let fits = |index: usize| {
            let option = options[index];
            let Some(style) = option_style(option) else {
                return false;
            };
            self.with_position_option_style(node, style, |engine| {
                engine.position_option_fits(child, choice_of(option))
            })
        };
        // NB: The box determines its position fallback styles only where it overflows with its current styles.
        // INTEROP: Other browsers take the first option of a list that position-try-order sorted that fits, even
        //          where the base styles fit too.
        let chosen = if anchor.has_position_try_order {
            (0..options.len()).find(|&index| fits(index)).unwrap_or(current)
        } else if fits(current) {
            current
        } else {
            // 2. For each option in the position options list:
            //    1. If option is currently abspos's last successful position option, continue.
            // NB: position_option_fits() runs the other steps for each option.
            // 3. Assert: The previous step finished without finding a position option that avoids overflow.
            // 4. Return current styles.
            (0..options.len())
                .filter(|&index| index != current)
                .find(|&index| fits(index))
                .unwrap_or(current)
        };
        let option = options[chosen];
        styles.choice = Some(choice_of(option));
        styles.style = option_style(option).flatten();
        styles.option_styles = option_styles.into_inner();
        styles
    }

    /// Runs `callback` with this engine as it lays out `node` with `style`, which its style reads see, or with the
    /// style of its row for none.
    fn with_position_option_style<T>(
        &self,
        node: Node,
        style: Option<node_data::LayoutStyleRef>,
        callback: impl for<'option> FnOnce(&AbsposEngine<'option>) -> T,
    ) -> T {
        let Some(style) = style else {
            return callback(self);
        };
        self.pass.with_position_option_style(node, style, |pass| {
            callback(&AbsposEngine {
                state: self.state,
                pass,
                fragments: self.fragments,
            })
        })
    }

    /// The size of the inset-modified containing block that `inputs` give the box `node`, treating auto inset values
    /// as zero.
    fn inset_modified_containing_block_size(
        &self,
        node: Node,
        inputs: &abspos_inputs::AbsposLayoutInputs,
    ) -> geometry::LogicalSize {
        let style = self
            .style(node)
            .with_resolved_insets(inputs.resolved_anchor_insets.as_ref());
        let size = inputs.containing_block_info.rect.size;
        let inset_modified_size = |start, end, size| {
            let (start_inset, end_inset) = inset_modified_containing_block_insets(start, end, size, None);
            size - start_inset - end_inset
        };
        geometry::LogicalSize {
            inline_size: inset_modified_size(style.inset_left(), style.inset_right(), size.inline_size),
            block_size: inset_modified_size(style.inset_top(), style.inset_bottom(), size.block_size),
        }
    }

    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#determine-position-fallback-styles
    /// Whether the margin box of the pending child `child`, laid out with the styles its style reads see, is fully
    /// contained within its inset-modified containing block.
    fn position_option_fits(
        &self,
        child: &abspos_inputs::PendingAbsposChild,
        choice: abspos_inputs::PositionOptionChoice,
    ) -> bool {
        let node = child.child_box;
        let mut child = *child;
        let (mut inputs, _) = self.pending_child_layout_inputs(&mut child);
        inputs.position_option = Some(choice);
        let inputs = std::sync::Arc::new(inputs);
        // 3. Let el rect be the size and position of abspos's margin box, and cb rect be the size and position of
        //    abspos's inset-modified containing block, when laid out with adjusted styles.
        let (available_space, constraints) = out_of_flow_root_space(&inputs);
        let laid_out = formatting_context::run_root_without_parent_fragments(
            self.pass,
            node,
            used_values::cells_before_sizing(&self.pass, node, ContainingBlockConstraints::default()),
            LayoutInput::new(
                available_space,
                constraints,
                ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::AbsolutelyPositioned(inputs.clone()),
            ),
        );
        let used = laid_out.root_cells_left_by_run;
        let used_insets = laid_out
            .result
            .out_of_flow_root_used_insets
            .expect("the run of an absolutely positioned box gives it used insets");
        let style = self
            .style(node)
            .with_resolved_insets(inputs.resolved_anchor_insets.as_ref());
        let collapsed = used.uses_collapsing_borders_model();
        let margin_box_size = geometry::LogicalSize {
            inline_size: used.margin_box_inline_size(collapsed),
            block_size: used.margin_box_block_size(collapsed),
        };
        let static_offset = aligned_static_offset(
            inputs.static_position_rect,
            margin_box_size.inline_size,
            margin_box_size.block_size,
        );
        let containing_block = inputs.containing_block_info.rect;
        let axis_is_contained = |start: style_values::InsetValue<'_>,
                                 end: style_values::InsetValue<'_>,
                                 containing_block_size: CssPixels,
                                 margin_box_start: CssPixels,
                                 margin_box_size: CssPixels| {
            let (start_inset, end_inset) =
                inset_modified_containing_block_insets(start, end, containing_block_size, None);
            let inset_modified_start = start_inset;
            let inset_modified_end = containing_block_size - end_inset;
            // 4. If cb rect was negative-size in either axis and corrected into zero-size, continue.
            if inset_modified_end < inset_modified_start {
                return false;
            }
            // 5. If el rect is not fully contained within cb rect, continue.
            margin_box_start >= inset_modified_start && margin_box_start + margin_box_size <= inset_modified_end
        };
        let margin_box_start = |mode: abspos_inputs::AbsposAxisMode,
                                static_offset: CssPixels,
                                containing_block_offset: CssPixels,
                                start_inset: CssPixels| match mode {
            abspos_inputs::AbsposAxisMode::StaticPosition => static_offset - containing_block_offset,
            abspos_inputs::AbsposAxisMode::InsetFromRect => start_inset,
        };
        axis_is_contained(
            style.inset_left(),
            style.inset_right(),
            containing_block.size.inline_size,
            margin_box_start(
                inputs.containing_block_info.inline_placement.mode,
                static_offset.inline_offset,
                containing_block.offset.inline_offset,
                used_insets.left,
            ),
            margin_box_size.inline_size,
        ) && axis_is_contained(
            style.inset_top(),
            style.inset_bottom(),
            containing_block.size.block_size,
            margin_box_start(
                inputs.containing_block_info.block_placement.mode,
                static_offset.block_offset,
                containing_block.offset.block_offset,
                used_insets.top,
            ),
            margin_box_size.block_size,
        )
    }

    /// The layout inputs of the pending child `child`, as its style resolves them against its containing block and
    /// its anchors.
    fn pending_child_layout_inputs(
        &self,
        child: &mut abspos_inputs::PendingAbsposChild,
    ) -> (abspos_inputs::AbsposLayoutInputs, abspos_inputs::DefaultScrollShift) {
        let child_box = child.child_box;
        let containing_block_geometry = self.containing_block_geometry_for_pending_child(child);
        let inline_containing_block_rect =
            self.inline_containing_block_rect_for_pending_child(child, &containing_block_geometry);
        let translation_into_containing_block_space = formatting_context::point_sub(
            FfiCssPixelPoint::default(),
            containing_block_geometry.content_origin_in_entry_space,
        );
        child.static_position_rect = formatting_context::translate_static_position_rect(
            child.static_position_rect,
            translation_into_containing_block_space,
        );
        let containing_block_info_override = child.containing_block_info_override.or_else(|| {
            self.fragments
                .and_then(|fragments| fragments.find_abspos_containing_block_info(child_box))
        });
        let unresolved_containing_block_info = containing_block_info_override.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            self.base_containing_block_info(
                child_box,
                inline_containing_block_rect,
                &containing_block_geometry,
                None,
            )
        });
        let position_area_inputs = self.position_area_layout_inputs(
            child_box,
            child.containing_block(),
            &containing_block_geometry,
            child.coordinate_space_box,
            unresolved_containing_block_info,
        );
        let (containing_block_info, resolved, resolved_anchor_sizes, default_scroll_shift) = if let Some((
            position_area_containing_block_info,
            position_area_geometry,
            anchor_box,
            (stretches_inline, stretches_block),
        )) =
            position_area_inputs
        {
            let mut resolved_anchor_sizes = self.resolve_anchor_sizes(
                child_box,
                child.containing_block(),
                &position_area_geometry,
                child.coordinate_space_box,
            );
            self.zero_aligned_auto_margins(
                child_box,
                &mut resolved_anchor_sizes,
                &position_area_containing_block_info,
            );
            let (resolved, default_scroll_shift) = self.resolve_anchor_insets(
                child_box,
                child.containing_block(),
                &position_area_geometry,
                child.coordinate_space_box,
                Some(anchor_box),
            );
            let resolved = self.position_area_stretch_insets(child_box, resolved, stretches_inline, stretches_block);
            (
                position_area_containing_block_info,
                resolved,
                resolved_anchor_sizes,
                default_scroll_shift,
            )
        } else {
            let mut resolved_anchor_sizes = self.resolve_anchor_sizes(
                child_box,
                child.containing_block(),
                &containing_block_geometry,
                child.coordinate_space_box,
            );
            let (resolved, default_scroll_shift) = self.resolve_anchor_insets(
                child_box,
                child.containing_block(),
                &containing_block_geometry,
                child.coordinate_space_box,
                None,
            );
            let mut containing_block_info = containing_block_info_override.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                self.base_containing_block_info(
                    child_box,
                    inline_containing_block_rect,
                    &containing_block_geometry,
                    resolved.as_ref(),
                )
            });
            self.apply_anchor_center_alignment(
                child_box,
                &containing_block_geometry,
                child.coordinate_space_box,
                resolved.as_ref(),
                &mut containing_block_info,
            );
            self.zero_aligned_auto_margins(child_box, &mut resolved_anchor_sizes, &containing_block_info);
            (
                containing_block_info,
                resolved,
                resolved_anchor_sizes,
                default_scroll_shift,
            )
        };
        let inputs = abspos_inputs::AbsposLayoutInputs {
            containing_block: child.containing_block(),
            inline_containing_block: child.inline_containing_block(),
            static_position_rect: child.static_position_rect,
            containing_block_info,
            resolved_anchor_insets: resolved,
            resolved_anchor_sizes,
            position_option: None,
            frame: self.pass.frame,
        }
        .without_static_position_in_axes_placed_by_own_insets();
        (inputs, default_scroll_shift)
    }

    /// Joins the entry against the inline containing block rect its IFC
    /// contributed, folding the payload's resting space into the containing
    /// block's content-box space (no padding term, unlike anchor rects).
    fn inline_containing_block_rect_for_pending_child(
        &self,
        child: &abspos_inputs::PendingAbsposChild,
        containing_block_geometry: &ContainingBlockGeometry,
    ) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
        if child.inline_containing_block().is_invalid() {
            return None;
        }
        let fragments = self.fragments?;
        let (rect, payload_space) = fragments.find_inline_containing_block_rect(child.inline_containing_block())?;
        let fold_into_entry_space =
            self.translation_between_payload_resting_spaces(payload_space, child.coordinate_space_box);
        Some(CssPixelRect {
            x: rect.x + fold_into_entry_space.x - containing_block_geometry.content_origin_in_entry_space.x,
            y: rect.y + fold_into_entry_space.y - containing_block_geometry.content_origin_in_entry_space.y,
            width: rect.width,
            height: rect.height,
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn replay(&self, run: &FormattingContextRun<'pass>, node: Node) {
        let mut inputs = self
            .pass
            .saved_abspos_layout_inputs(node)
            .expect("abspos relayout root must have committed layout inputs");
        if !inputs.containing_block_info.derives_from_own_computed_values() {
            let style = self
                .style(node)
                .with_resolved_insets(inputs.resolved_anchor_insets.as_ref());
            inputs.containing_block_info =
                abspos_inputs::AbsposContainingBlockInfo::of_own_insets(inputs.containing_block_info.rect, style);
            inputs = inputs.without_static_position_in_axes_placed_by_own_insets();
        }
        // Partial relayout uses a fresh state and keeps the replay root
        // exactly once.
        let cells = used_values::cells_before_sizing(&self.pass, node, ContainingBlockConstraints::default());
        let default_scroll_shift = self
            .pass
            .committed_fragment_link(node)
            .and_then(|link| link.placement.default_scroll_shift);
        self.layout_element(run, node, cells, inputs, default_scroll_shift);
    }

    fn compute_inset(
        &self,
        node: Node,
        containing_block: &impl BoxMetricCells,
        percentage_basis: geometry::LogicalSize,
        percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis: bool,
    ) -> InFlowBoxInsets {
        // Most boxes are neither relatively positioned nor carry anchor()
        // insets, and both facts come straight from the node's style payload.
        let initial_style = self.style(node);
        let has_anchor_insets = initial_style.inset_top().contains_anchor_function()
            || initial_style.inset_right().contains_anchor_function()
            || initial_style.inset_bottom().contains_anchor_function()
            || initial_style.inset_left().contains_anchor_function();
        if !has_anchor_insets && initial_style.position() != positioning::RELATIVE {
            return InFlowBoxInsets::default();
        }
        let mut insets = InFlowBoxInsets::default();
        // Anchor resolution also refreshes the box's default scroll shift, so
        // an anchor-bearing box resolves its insets even when it turns out not
        // to be relatively positioned.
        let resolved = if has_anchor_insets {
            let in_flow_containing_block = self.pass.in_flow_containing_block(node);
            let containing_block_geometry =
                ContainingBlockGeometry::from_box_metrics(containing_block, FfiCssPixelPoint::default());
            let (resolved, default_scroll_shift) = self.resolve_anchor_insets(
                node,
                in_flow_containing_block,
                &containing_block_geometry,
                NodeSlotId::INVALID,
                None,
            );
            insets.default_scroll_shift = Some(default_scroll_shift);
            resolved
        } else {
            None
        };
        let style = initial_style.with_resolved_insets(resolved.as_ref());
        if style.position() != positioning::RELATIVE {
            return insets;
        }
        formatting_context::propagate_percentage_block_size_dependency_to_containing_block(
            self.state, &self.pass, node, false,
        );

        let resolve_opposing = |first: style_values::InsetValue, second: style_values::InsetValue, basis: CssPixels| {
            let resolved_first = first.to_px(basis);
            let resolved_second = second.to_px(basis);
            if first.is_auto() && second.is_auto() {
                (CssPixels::default(), CssPixels::default())
            } else if first.is_auto() {
                (-resolved_second, resolved_second)
            } else {
                (resolved_first, -resolved_first)
            }
        };
        let (left, right) = resolve_opposing(style.inset_left(), style.inset_right(), percentage_basis.inline_size);

        let treat_block_axis_percentage_insets_as_auto = (style.inset_top().contains_percentage()
            || style.inset_bottom().contains_percentage())
            && !percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis;
        fn block_axis_inset_value(
            value: style_values::InsetValue<'_>,
            treat_percentage_as_auto: bool,
        ) -> style_values::InsetValue<'_> {
            if treat_percentage_as_auto && value.contains_percentage() {
                style_values::InsetValue::auto_value()
            } else {
                value
            }
        }
        let (top, bottom) = resolve_opposing(
            block_axis_inset_value(style.inset_top(), treat_block_axis_percentage_insets_as_auto),
            block_axis_inset_value(style.inset_bottom(), treat_block_axis_percentage_insets_as_auto),
            percentage_basis.block_size,
        );
        insets.used_insets = Some(run_state::UsedInsets {
            left,
            right,
            top,
            bottom,
        });
        insets
    }
}

pub(crate) fn drain_abspos_with_placed_containing_blocks(
    state: &RunState,
    pass: LayoutPass<'_>,
    should_collect_devtools_layout_data: bool,
    entry_fragments: &fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder,
) {
    let accumulator_root = entry_fragments.root_node();
    let run = FormattingContextRun::new(
        state,
        accumulator_root,
        pass,
        formatting_context::RunMode::Commit {
            devtools: should_collect_devtools_layout_data,
        },
        false,
        None,
    );
    loop {
        let batch = entry_fragments.take_drainable_abspos(accumulator_root, &pass);
        if batch.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        formatting_context::lay_out_pending_abspos_children(&run, batch);
    }
}

/// What the insets of an in-flow box resolve to: the used insets of a relatively positioned box, and the scroll shift
/// its anchor() insets compensate for.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct InFlowBoxInsets {
    pub(crate) used_insets: Option<run_state::UsedInsets>,
    pub(crate) default_scroll_shift: Option<abspos_inputs::DefaultScrollShift>,
}

/// Resolves the insets of `node`, an in-flow box whose containing block has the metrics `containing_block`, with
/// percentages against `percentage_basis`, where block-axis percentages resolve against a definite block size if
/// `percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis`.
pub(crate) fn compute_inset_native(
    run: &FormattingContextRun<'_>,
    node: Node,
    containing_block: &impl BoxMetricCells,
    percentage_basis: geometry::LogicalSize,
    percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis: bool,
) -> InFlowBoxInsets {
    AbsposEngine::for_run(run).compute_inset(
        node,
        containing_block,
        percentage_basis,
        percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis,
    )
}

/// The position option a box is laid out with and the styles it makes, if any, and the styles of the box's position
/// options, which the style reads of the box address while this lives.
struct PositionOptionStyles {
    choice: Option<abspos_inputs::PositionOptionChoice>,
    style: Option<node_data::LayoutStyleRef>,
    /// Boxed so that the payloads the style reads address stay in place as the list grows.
    #[expect(clippy::vec_box)]
    option_styles: Vec<Box<LayoutStyle>>,
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn px(value: i64) -> CssPixels {
        CssPixels::from_integer(value)
    }

    fn equation(
        containing_block_size: i64,
        start: Option<i64>,
        end: Option<i64>,
        margin_start: Option<i64>,
        margin_end: Option<i64>,
        auto_margin_overflow: AutoMarginOverflow,
    ) -> AxisEquation {
        AxisEquation {
            containing_block_size: px(containing_block_size),
            start: start.map(px),
            end: end.map(px),
            margin_start: margin_start.map(px),
            margin_end: margin_end.map(px),
            borders_and_paddings: CssPixels::default(),
            auto_margin_overflow,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn axis_with_an_auto_inset_zeroes_auto_margins() {
        for available in [-50, 50] {
            for (start, end, margin_start, margin_end, expected) in [
                (None, Some(0), None, None, [available, 0, 0, 0]),
                (Some(0), None, None, None, [0, available, 0, 0]),
                (None, None, None, None, [17, available - 17, 0, 0]),
                (None, Some(0), Some(10), None, [available - 10, 0, 10, 0]),
                (None, Some(0), None, Some(10), [available - 10, 0, 0, 10]),
                (Some(0), None, Some(10), None, [0, available - 10, 10, 0]),
                (Some(0), None, None, Some(10), [0, available - 10, 0, 10]),
            ] {
                // NB: Each policy represents an axis/direction selected by the caller, including orthogonal boxes.
                for overflow in [
                    AutoMarginOverflow::Split,
                    AutoMarginOverflow::LowSide,
                    AutoMarginOverflow::HighSide,
                ] {
                    let actual = equation(available, start, end, margin_start, margin_end, overflow)
                        .solve(CssPixels::default(), || px(17));
                    assert_eq!(
                        actual,
                        AxisSolution {
                            start: px(expected[0]),
                            end: px(expected[1]),
                            margin_start: px(expected[2]),
                            margin_end: px(expected[3]),
                        },
                        "available={available}, start={start:?}, end={end:?}, margins={margin_start:?}/{margin_end:?}",
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn axis_with_both_insets_distributes_auto_margins() {
        for (overflow, negative_start, negative_end) in [
            (AutoMarginOverflow::Split, -25, -25),
            (AutoMarginOverflow::LowSide, -50, 0),
            (AutoMarginOverflow::HighSide, 0, -50),
        ] {
            for (available, margin_start, margin_end) in [(-50, negative_start, negative_end), (50, 25, 25)] {
                assert_eq!(
                    equation(available, Some(0), Some(0), None, None, overflow).solve(CssPixels::default(), || px(17)),
                    AxisSolution {
                        start: px(0),
                        end: px(0),
                        margin_start: px(margin_start),
                        margin_end: px(margin_end),
                    },
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

use super::*;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct StaticPositionRect {
    pub(crate) rect: geometry::LogicalRect,
    pub(crate) inline_alignment: AxisEdge,
    pub(crate) block_alignment: AxisEdge,
    pub(crate) alignment_derives_from_own_computed_values: bool,
}

impl StaticPositionRect {
    /// The rect, laid out in frame `from` within a box whose physical size is `container_size`, as frame `to` sees
    /// it.
    pub(crate) fn in_frame(
        mut self,
        from: geometry::Frame,
        to: geometry::Frame,
        container_size: crate::css::css_pixels::FfiCssPixelSize,
    ) -> Self {
        if from == to {
            return self;
        }
        let rect = crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect {
            x: self.rect.offset.inline_offset,
            y: self.rect.offset.block_offset,
            width: self.rect.size.inline_size,
            height: self.rect.size.block_size,
        };
        let rect = from.rect_in(rect, to, container_size);
        self.rect = geometry::LogicalRect {
            offset: geometry::LogicalOffset {
                inline_offset: rect.x,
                block_offset: rect.y,
            },
            size: geometry::LogicalSize {
                inline_size: rect.width,
                block_size: rect.height,
            },
        };
        // NB: An alignment is towards the left or top of an axis of the frame, which may run along the other
        //     physical axis, or the other way along it, in another frame.
        let along_physical_axis = |frame: geometry::Frame, alignment: AxisEdge, horizontal: bool| {
            let reversed = if horizontal {
                frame.horizontal_axis_is_reversed()
            } else {
                frame.vertical_axis_is_reversed()
            };
            if reversed { alignment.reversed() } else { alignment }
        };
        let (physical_horizontal, physical_vertical) = {
            let horizontal = along_physical_axis(from, self.inline_alignment, true);
            let vertical = along_physical_axis(from, self.block_alignment, false);
            if from.is_transposed() {
                (vertical, horizontal)
            } else {
                (horizontal, vertical)
            }
        };
        let (frame_horizontal, frame_vertical) = if to.is_transposed() {
            (physical_vertical, physical_horizontal)
        } else {
            (physical_horizontal, physical_vertical)
        };
        self.inline_alignment = along_physical_axis(to, frame_horizontal, true);
        self.block_alignment = along_physical_axis(to, frame_vertical, false);
        self
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum AbsposAxisMode {
    StaticPosition,
    InsetFromRect,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum AbsposAxisAlignment {
    /// The box keeps the place its insets give it in its inset-modified containing block, as for normal, stretch and
    /// baseline alignment.
    Stretch,
    Edge(AxisEdge),
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#anchor-center
    /// Centers the box over its default anchor box, which starts at `anchor_start` in the containing block rect.
    AnchorCenter {
        anchor_start: CssPixels,
        anchor_size: CssPixels,
    },
}

/// How an absolutely positioned box is placed along one axis of its containing block.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct AxisPlacement {
    pub(crate) mode: AbsposAxisMode,
    /// The alignment that a grid area, a position area or anchor-center gives the axis, whatever its insets are.
    pub(crate) alignment: Option<AbsposAxisAlignment>,
}

impl AxisPlacement {
    /// The placement that the insets `start` and `end` of the box give it, at its static position where both are auto.
    pub(crate) fn of_own_insets(start: style_values::InsetValue<'_>, end: style_values::InsetValue<'_>) -> Self {
        Self {
            mode: if start.is_auto() && end.is_auto() {
                AbsposAxisMode::StaticPosition
            } else {
                AbsposAxisMode::InsetFromRect
            },
            alignment: None,
        }
    }

    fn is_placed_by_own_insets(self) -> bool {
        self.mode == AbsposAxisMode::InsetFromRect && self.alignment.is_none()
    }

    fn is_anchor_centered(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.alignment, Some(AbsposAxisAlignment::AnchorCenter { .. }))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct AbsposContainingBlockInfo {
    pub(crate) rect: geometry::LogicalRect,
    pub(crate) inline_placement: AxisPlacement,
    pub(crate) block_placement: AxisPlacement,
    /// Whether a position area made this the box's containing block.
    pub(crate) is_position_area: bool,
}

impl AbsposContainingBlockInfo {
    /// The containing block rect `rect`, along whose axes the box styled `style` is placed by its own insets.
    pub(crate) fn of_own_insets(rect: geometry::LogicalRect, style: StyleValues<'_>) -> Self {
        Self {
            rect,
            inline_placement: AxisPlacement::of_own_insets(style.inset_left(), style.inset_right()),
            block_placement: AxisPlacement::of_own_insets(style.inset_top(), style.inset_bottom()),
            is_position_area: false,
        }
    }

    // NB: A grid area, a position area and anchor-center give an axis an alignment, and set its mode whatever the
    //     insets are. They may size or align the box against the static position rect.
    pub(crate) fn axes_placed_by_own_insets(&self) -> (bool, bool) {
        (
            self.inline_placement.is_placed_by_own_insets(),
            self.block_placement.is_placed_by_own_insets(),
        )
    }

    /// Whether a grid area, a position area or anchor-center, which the box's own computed values ask for, places it.
    pub(crate) fn derives_from_own_computed_values(&self) -> bool {
        self.inline_placement.alignment.is_some() || self.block_placement.alignment.is_some()
    }

    /// Whether a position area or anchor-center aligns the box in the inline and the block axis.
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#position-area
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#anchor-center
    pub(crate) fn anchor_aligned_axes(&self) -> (bool, bool) {
        (
            self.is_position_area || self.inline_placement.is_anchor_centered(),
            self.is_position_area || self.block_placement.is_anchor_centered(),
        )
    }
}

/// The default anchor whose scroll a box compensates for, and in which physical axes.
/// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#scroll
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct DefaultScrollShift {
    pub(crate) anchor: super::formatting_context::Node,
    pub(crate) compensates_for_horizontal_scroll: bool,
    pub(crate) compensates_for_vertical_scroll: bool,
}

/// The position option a box was laid out with: an entry of its position options list.
/// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#last-successful-position-option
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct PositionOptionChoice {
    /// 0 for the base styles, or one more than the index of the position-try-fallbacks entry that made the option.
    pub(crate) option: u32,
    /// The @position-try rule the entry names.
    /// NB: A choice whose rule was replaced since is no longer the box's last successful position option.
    pub(crate) rule: crate::css::style::position_try::PositionTryRuleID,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct AbsposLayoutInputs {
    pub(crate) containing_block: super::formatting_context::Node,
    pub(crate) inline_containing_block: super::formatting_context::Node,
    /// Where the box would have been in flow, in the axes its layout reads that. An axis the box's own insets place it
    /// in holds nothing, so that the inputs stay the same as the static position moves along that axis.
    pub(crate) static_position_rect: StaticPositionRect,
    pub(crate) containing_block_info: AbsposContainingBlockInfo,
    pub(crate) resolved_anchor_insets: Option<super::formatting_context::ResolvedAnchorInsets>,
    pub(crate) resolved_anchor_sizes: super::style_values::ResolvedAnchorSizes,
    /// The position option the box is laid out with, or none for a box without position options.
    pub(crate) position_option: Option<PositionOptionChoice>,
    /// The frame in which the containing block lays out its contents, in which the box is laid out and its resolved
    /// anchor sizes lie.
    pub(crate) frame: super::geometry::Frame,
}

impl AbsposLayoutInputs {
    pub(crate) fn without_static_position_in_axes_placed_by_own_insets(mut self) -> Self {
        let (inline_placed_by_insets, block_placed_by_insets) = self.containing_block_info.axes_placed_by_own_insets();
        let rect = &mut self.static_position_rect.rect;
        if inline_placed_by_insets {
            rect.offset.inline_offset = CssPixels::default();
            rect.size.inline_size = CssPixels::default();
        }
        if block_placed_by_insets {
            rect.offset.block_offset = CssPixels::default();
            rect.size.block_size = CssPixels::default();
        }
        self
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct ContainingBlockSearch {
    pub(crate) is_fixed_position: bool,

/// What the layout of a block-level box hands back to the loop over its parent's children, as the box stands once it is
/// placed.
struct BlockLevelBoxOutcome {
    /// The offset of the content box in the containing block, or the origin while the box is not placed.
    content_offset: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    is_placed: bool,
    /// The sizes and box sides of the box, in the frame of its containing block.
    cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    /// The baselines of the contents of the box, relative to its content box.
    content_baselines: DerivedBaselines,
    collapses_through: bool,
    is_invisible_for_line_clamp: bool,
    can_break_inside: bool,
    broken_inside: Option<BrokenInside>,
    /// The baselines the box gives its containing block, relative to the containing block's content box.
    baselines_in_containing_block: DerivedBaselines,
    /// The block end of the margin box in the containing block, where the layout of the box found it.
    margin_box_block_end: Option<CssPixels>,
    /// For a box with clearance that margins collapse through: the collapsed margin between the clearance and the
    /// box. The margins of the box collapse with those after it from that far before its block end, rather than from
    /// its block end.
    collapsed_margin_after_clearance: Option<CssPixels>,
    /// A rendered legend, which its fieldset places once it knows the fieldset's block-start border. Boxed, as the
    /// outcome of every block-level box carries it through deeply nested layout.
    deferred_legend: Option<Box<DeferredLegend>>,
}

/// A rendered legend laid out in its fieldset's flow, which the fieldset places later: where the flow would put the
/// legend's content box, and what placing it takes.
struct DeferredLegend {
    flow_position: geometry::LogicalOffset,
    placed_child: formatting_context::PlacedChild,
    fragment_arrival: Option<fragment_tree::RunRootFragment>,
}

impl BlockLevelBoxOutcome {
    fn content_block_size(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.cells.content_block_size
    }

    fn border_box_bottom(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.cells.border_box_bottom(self.cells.uses_collapsing_borders_model)
    }

    fn border_box_block_size(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.cells
            .border_box_block_size(self.cells.uses_collapsing_borders_model)
    }

    fn margin_bottom(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.cells.margin_bottom
    }

    fn border_box_block_end(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.content_offset.y + self.content_block_size() + self.border_box_bottom()
    }
}

/// A block container whose children a block formatting context lays out, with the cells the container is laid out with.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct BlockContainer {
    pub(crate) node: Node,
    pub(crate) cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    /// Whether the block-axis percentage insets of the boxes laid out in the container resolve against a definite
    /// block size.
    pub(crate) percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis: bool,
}

impl BlockContainer {
    /// The run's root, laid out with `root_cells`, as the block container of the boxes laid out in it.
    pub(crate) fn root_of(run: &FormattingContextRun<'_>, root_cells: used_values::RootInputCells) -> Self {
        Self {
            node: run.box_,
            cells: root_cells,
            percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis: run
                .percentage_block_insets_of_root_children_have_definite_basis(&root_cells),
        }
    }

    /// `node`, laid out with `cells` in `containing_block`, as the block container of the boxes laid out in it.
    fn laid_out_in(
        pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
        node: Node,
        cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
        containing_block: BlockContainer,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            node,
            cells,
            percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis:
                formatting_context::percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis_in(
                    pass,
                    node,
                    || cells.has_definite_block_size,
                    containing_block.percentage_block_insets_have_definite_basis,
                ),
        }
    }
}

/// A box a block formatting context sizes, in cells the call laying the box out owns: the cells the context lays the
/// box out in, or the cells it sizes a child in ahead of the child's layout.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct ChildSizedHere<'sized> {
    pub(crate) node: Node,
    sized_in: SizedIn<'sized>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum SizedIn<'sized> {
    LaidOutHere(&'sized Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>),
    CellsAheadOfItsRun(&'sized Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>),
}

impl<'sized> ChildSizedHere<'sized> {
    /// `node`, laid out in `cells`, which its layout owns.
    pub(crate) fn laid_out_in(node: Node, cells: &'sized Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>) -> Self {
        Self {
            node,
            sized_in: SizedIn::LaidOutHere(cells),
        }
    }

    /// `node`, a child sized in `cells` ahead of its layout, which takes them.
    pub(crate) fn ahead_of_its_run(node: Node, cells: &'sized Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>) -> Self {
        Self {
            node,
            sized_in: SizedIn::CellsAheadOfItsRun(cells),
        }
    }

    /// The cells the box is laid out in, if the context lays it out itself.
    fn cells_laid_out_here(self) -> Option<&'sized Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>> {
        match self.sized_in {
            SizedIn::LaidOutHere(cells) => Some(cells),
            SizedIn::CellsAheadOfItsRun(_) => None,
        }
    }
}

/// What laying out the children of a block container hands back to the layout of the container.

    /// The break token of the container, where the fragmentainer stopped while its children were laid out.
    pub(crate) fragmentainer_stop_token: Option<std::rc::Rc<fragmentation::BlockBreakToken>>,
    /// Whether the lines of the container are kept together in one fragmentainer.
    pub(crate) lines_are_unbreakable: bool,
    /// The last line laid out in the container.
    pub(crate) last_line: Option<inline_content::LineRecord>,
    /// The last in-flow child whose margins do not collapse through it.
    pub(crate) last_in_flow_child: Option<LastInFlowChild>,
    /// The lowest block end of the border box of a child placed in the container, in the container's content box.
    pub(crate) block_end_of_placed_children: Option<CssPixels>,
    /// Whether the children laid out include the outside marker of the container, which the container places after
    /// them.
    pub(crate) includes_list_item_marker: bool,
    /// The block size of the line box that the outside marker of the container creates, where the children laid out
    /// hold no line box for it.
    pub(crate) outside_marker_line_box_block_size: Option<CssPixels>,
    /// Whether margins do not collapse through one of the children laid out, which keeps them from collapsing through
    /// the container.
    pub(crate) has_child_whose_margins_do_not_collapse_through: bool,
    /// Whether no content of the container closed the top margin group its children collapse into, so the margins
    /// still pending after them collapse through the container's block-start edge.
    pub(crate) pending_margins_collapse_through_block_start: bool,
}

pub(crate) struct LastInFlowChild {
    /// The block end of the child's border box, in the container's content box.
    pub(crate) border_box_block_end: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) margin_bottom: CssPixels,
    /// See [`BlockLevelBoxOutcome::collapsed_margin_after_clearance`].
    pub(crate) collapsed_margin_after_clearance: Option<CssPixels>,

/// A child of the run's root that its flow laid out, as the automatic block size of the root reads it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct RootFlowChild {
    pub(crate) node: Node,
    /// The block end of the child's border box, in the root's content box.
    pub(crate) border_box_block_end: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) margin_bottom: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) collapses_through: bool,
    pub(crate) is_invisible_for_line_clamp: bool,
    /// See [`BlockLevelBoxOutcome::collapsed_margin_after_clearance`].
    pub(crate) collapsed_margin_after_clearance: Option<CssPixels>,
}

impl RootFlowChild {
    fn of(node: Node, outcome: &BlockLevelBoxOutcome) -> Self {
        Self {
            node,
            border_box_block_end: outcome.border_box_block_end(),
            margin_bottom: outcome.margin_bottom(),
            collapses_through: outcome.collapses_through,
            is_invisible_for_line_clamp: outcome.is_invisible_for_line_clamp,
            collapsed_margin_after_clearance: outcome.collapsed_margin_after_clearance,
        }
    }
}

impl ChildrenSummary {
    fn has_in_flow_content_edge(&self) -> bool {
        self.last_line.is_some() || self.last_in_flow_child.is_some()
    }

    fn has_unbreakable_lines(&self) -> bool {
        self.lines_are_unbreakable && self.last_line.is_some()
    }

    /// The block end of the content of the container: of its last line, or of the lowest child placed in it.
    fn block_end_of_content(&self) -> CssPixels {
        match self.last_line {
            Some(last_line) => last_line.physical_vertical_end(),
            None => self.block_end_of_placed_children.unwrap_or_default(),
        }
    }

    fn include_placed_child(&mut self, border_box_block_end: CssPixels) {
        self.block_end_of_placed_children = Some(
            self.block_end_of_placed_children
                .map_or(border_box_block_end, |lowest| lowest.max(border_box_block_end)),
        );
    }
}

struct FragmentationState {
    container_content_box_block_start_in_root: CssPixels,
    /// The break token of the container, once the fragmentainer stops inside it.
    container_stop_token: Option<std::rc::Rc<fragmentation::BlockBreakToken>>,
    resume: Option<fragmentation::BlockResume>,
    deferred_floats: Vec<Node>,
    fragmentainer_had_content_before_container: bool,
    fragmentainer_had_content_before_child: bool,
    truncate_next_block_start_margin: bool,
    previous_in_flow_child_forces_break_after: bool,
    previous_in_flow_child_avoids_break_after: Option<bool>,
    last_child_allowing_break_before: Option<Node>,
}

impl FragmentationState {
    fn new(
        incoming: Option<&fragmentation::BlockBreakToken>,
        container_content_box_block_start_in_root: CssPixels,
        fragmentainer_had_content_before_container: bool,
        block_start_margin_is_truncated: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        let truncate_next_block_start_margin = block_start_margin_is_truncated
            || matches!(
                incoming.map(|token| &token.resume),
                Some(fragmentation::BlockResume::BeforeChild {
                    after_forced_break: false,
                    ..
                })
            );
        Self {
            container_content_box_block_start_in_root,
            container_stop_token: None,
            resume: incoming.map(|token| token.resume.clone()),
            deferred_floats: incoming.map_or_else(Vec::new, |token| token.deferred_floats.clone()),
            fragmentainer_had_content_before_container,
            fragmentainer_had_content_before_child: false,
            truncate_next_block_start_margin,
            previous_in_flow_child_forces_break_after: false,
            previous_in_flow_child_avoids_break_after: None,
            last_child_allowing_break_before: None,
        }
    }
}

struct FloatAvoidanceProbe {
    opportunity: Option<CssPixels>,
    content_inline_size: Option<CssPixels>,
}

/// The sides whose floats the `clear` of a box names, or on which a scan of boxes found floats.
// FIXME: Honor writing-mode, direction and text-orientation.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct FloatSides {
    left: bool,
    right: bool,
}

impl FloatSides {
    fn cleared_by(style: &StyleValues<'_>) -> Self {
        Self {
            left: matches!(style.clear(), clear::LEFT | clear::BOTH | clear::INLINE_START),
            right: matches!(style.clear(), clear::RIGHT | clear::BOTH | clear::INLINE_END),
        }
    }

    fn of_float(style: &StyleValues<'_>) -> Self {
        let is_left = matches!(style.float_(), float::LEFT | float::INLINE_START);
        Self {
            left: is_left,
            right: !is_left,
        }
    }

    fn any_of(self, sides: Self) -> bool {
        (self.left && sides.left) || (self.right && sides.right)
    }

    fn with(self, sides: Self) -> Self {
        Self {
            left: self.left || sides.left,
            right: self.right || sides.right,
        }
    }
}

/// What a scan of the contents of a box has found of the margins that collapse with the block-start margin of the box.
struct MarginsOfContents<'scan> {
    /// The margins that collapse with the block-start margin of the box, as far as the scan has found them.
    margins: CollapsedMargins,
    /// The sides of the floats among the boxes the scan went through.
    passed_floats: FloatSides,
    /// Answers whether one of the contents that clears the floats on the given sides would get clearance, where the
    /// given margins are those the scan found down to that one's own.
    gets_clearance: &'scan dyn Fn(FloatSides, CollapsedMargins) -> bool,
    /// Whether the margins the scan finds collapse into the block start of a quirks-mode body or table cell, which
    /// leaves out the quirky ones among them, as laying them out does.
    ignores_quirky_margins: bool,
}

impl MarginsOfContents<'_> {
    /// Adds a margin of a box, which is a quirky one where `is_quirky` says so.
    fn add_margin_of_box(&mut self, margin: CssPixels, is_quirky: bool) {
        if !(is_quirky && self.ignores_quirky_margins) {
            self.margins = self.margins.with_margin_of_box(margin, is_quirky);
        }
    }
}

/// Where the block-start border edge of a box would go if the box cleared no float.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct PositionWithoutClearance {
    /// The position among the flow positions of the box's block container, as that container stands now.
    flow_position: CssPixels,
    /// The block-start margin of the box, collapsed with those of its first children. Clearance goes above them.
    margins_of_box: CollapsedMargins,
    /// The block container whose contents the block-start margin of the box moves along with the box, and how far,
    /// where it collapses into the block-start margin of that container and moves it.
    moves_contents: Option<(Node, CssPixels)>,
}

/// Where the flow puts the content box of a block-level box in its containing block, past the floats the box avoids.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct InFlowBoxPlacement {
    content_inline_offset: CssPixels,
    content_block_offset: CssPixels,
    content_inline_size: CssPixels,
}

fn round_css_pixels(value: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
    let half = CssPixels::from_raw(crate::layout::FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR >> 1);
    if value > CssPixels::default() {
        (value + half).floor()
    } else {
        (value - half).ceil()
    }
}

/// Margins that collapse together, kept as their largest positive and most negative margin.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct CollapsedMargins {
    largest_positive: CssPixels,
    most_negative: CssPixels,
    /// The largest of the quirky margins among them, which a quirks-mode body or table cell leaves out where they
    /// collapse into its block end (see `NodeFacts::ignores_quirky_margins_at_its_edges`).
    largest_quirky: CssPixels,
}

impl CollapsedMargins {
    fn with_margin(self, margin: CssPixels) -> Self {
        if margin < CssPixels::default() {
            Self {
                most_negative: margin.min(self.most_negative),
                ..self
            }
        } else {
            Self {
                largest_positive: margin.max(self.largest_positive),
                ..self
            }
        }
    }

    /// These margins with a margin of a box, which is a quirky one where `is_quirky` says so.
    fn with_margin_of_box(self, margin: CssPixels, is_quirky: bool) -> Self {
        if !is_quirky || margin < CssPixels::default() {
            return self.with_margin(margin);
        }
        Self {
            largest_quirky: margin.max(self.largest_quirky),
            ..self
        }
    }

    fn collapsed_with(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        Self {
            largest_positive: self.largest_positive.max(other.largest_positive),
            most_negative: self.most_negative.min(other.most_negative),
            largest_quirky: self.largest_quirky.max(other.largest_quirky),
        }
    }

    fn collapsed_margin(self) -> CssPixels {
        self.largest_positive.max(self.largest_quirky) + self.most_negative
    }

    /// The collapsed margin of these margins, leaving out the quirky ones.
    fn collapsed_margin_without_quirky_margins(self) -> CssPixels {
        self.largest_positive + self.most_negative
    }
}

/// The margins that collapse into the block-start margin of a block container while its contents are laid out, until
/// content of the container closes the group.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct TopMarginGroup {
    /// Whether the margins collapse into the group of the enclosing margin state, as the container has no block-start
    /// edge of its own to stop them, instead of into the container's own block-start margin.
    joins_enclosing_group: bool,
    /// The margins of the contents that joined the group, as of its last update.
    margins: CollapsedMargins,
    open: bool,
    pinned_by_clearance: bool,
}

/// The margins that collapse in the flow of one block container while its contents are laid out. The margins before the
/// container, and those its ancestors collapse, stay in the margin states of the enclosing containers, so the contents
/// read none of them.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct BlockMarginState {
    block_container: Node,
    margins_since_reset: CollapsedMargins,
    /// Whether the margins since the last reset continue those of the enclosing margin state: whether nothing in this
    /// one was reset yet.
    continues_enclosing_margins: bool,
    top_margin_group: Option<TopMarginGroup>,
    box_last_in_flow_child_margin_bottom_collapsed: bool,
    /// Whether the margins since the last reset collapse into the block start of a quirks-mode body or table cell,
    /// which leaves the quirky ones among them out (see `NodeFacts::ignores_quirky_margins_at_its_edges`).
    ignores_quirky_margins: bool,
}

/// Collapses the block-start margin of a reused child whose contents left `margins_left_by_contents` with the margins in
/// `margin_state`, as laying the child out does where it is not floated and margins do not collapse through it, and
/// returns what separates its border box from the flow position. A child with clearance sits at the position clearance
/// gave it, which its contents collapse no margin past.
fn collapse_block_start_margin_of_reused_child(
    margin_state: &mut BlockMarginState,
    cells: &used_values::RootInputCells,
    margin_top_is_quirky: bool,
    margins_left_by_contents: &mut BlockMarginState,
    introduces_clearance: bool,
) -> CssPixels {
    margin_state.add_margin_of_box(cells.margin_top(), margin_top_is_quirky);
    if introduces_clearance {
        margin_state.reset();
    }
    margin_state.update_open_top_margin_group();
    if cells.border_top() > CssPixels::default() || cells.padding_top() > CssPixels::default() {
        let margin = margin_state.pending_margin_for_next_box();
        margin_state.reset();
        margin
    } else if margin_state.has_open_top_margin_group() {
        margins_left_by_contents.join_enclosing_top_margin_group();
        CssPixels::default()
    } else {
        let group = margins_left_by_contents
            .top_margin_group
            .take()
            .expect("the contents of a box collapse into a top margin group");
        if introduces_clearance {
            CssPixels::default()
        } else {
            margin_state.block_start_margin_collapsing(group)
        }
    }
}

impl BlockMarginState {
    fn of_flow_root(root: Node) -> Self {
        Self {
            block_container: root,
            margins_since_reset: CollapsedMargins::default(),
            continues_enclosing_margins: false,
            top_margin_group: None,
            box_last_in_flow_child_margin_bottom_collapsed: false,
            ignores_quirky_margins: false,
        }
    }

    /// This margin state, where the margins since its last reset collapse into the block start of a quirks-mode body or
    /// table cell if `ignores_quirky_margins` says so.
    fn ignoring_quirky_margins(self, ignores_quirky_margins: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            ignores_quirky_margins,
            ..self
        }
    }

    /// The margin state of the contents of `block_container`, which a block-start border or padding separates from the
    /// margins before it.
    fn of_contents_after_block_start_edge(block_container: Node) -> Self {
        Self::of_flow_root(block_container)
    }

    /// The margin state of the contents of `block_container`, whose margins collapse into its own block-start margin.
    fn of_contents_collapsing_into_own_block_start_margin(block_container: Node, pinned_by_clearance: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            continues_enclosing_margins: true,
            top_margin_group: Some(TopMarginGroup {
                joins_enclosing_group: false,
                margins: CollapsedMargins::default(),
                open: true,
                pinned_by_clearance,
            }),
            ..Self::of_flow_root(block_container)
        }
    }

    /// The margin state of the contents of `block_container`, whose margins join the open top margin group of the
    /// enclosing margin state.
    fn of_contents_joining_enclosing_group(block_container: Node) -> Self {
        Self {
            continues_enclosing_margins: true,
            top_margin_group: Some(TopMarginGroup {
                joins_enclosing_group: true,
                margins: CollapsedMargins::default(),
                open: true,
                pinned_by_clearance: false,
            }),
            ..Self::of_flow_root(block_container)
        }
    }

    /// The margin state of the contents of `block_container`, which keep collapsing the margins of `enclosing` that no
    /// open group holds.
    fn of_contents_continuing_margins_of(block_container: Node, enclosing: &Self) -> Self {
        Self {
            margins_since_reset: enclosing.margins_since_reset,
            ..Self::of_flow_root(block_container)
        }
    }

    /// Adds a margin of a box, which is a quirky one where `is_quirky` says so. A quirky margin that collapses into the
    /// block start of a quirks-mode body or table cell is left out.
    pub(crate) fn add_margin_of_box(&mut self, margin: CssPixels, is_quirky: bool) {
        if is_quirky && self.ignores_quirky_margins {
            return;
        }
        self.margins_since_reset = self.margins_since_reset.with_margin_of_box(margin, is_quirky);
    }

    /// Whether a quirky margin added now would be left out, as it collapses into the block start of a quirks-mode body
    /// or table cell.
    pub(crate) fn ignores_quirky_margins(&self) -> bool {
        self.ignores_quirky_margins
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_collapsed_margin(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.margins_since_reset.collapsed_margin()
    }

    /// The collapsed margin that stays inside a block container at its block end, which leaves out the quirky margins
    /// there in a quirks-mode body or table cell (see `NodeFacts::ignores_quirky_margins_at_its_edges`).
    fn collapsed_margin_at_block_end_of(&self, facts: &NodeFacts<'_>) -> CssPixels {
        if facts.ignores_quirky_margins_at_its_edges() {
            self.margins_since_reset.collapsed_margin_without_quirky_margins()
        } else {
            self.current_collapsed_margin()
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_open_top_margin_group(&self) -> bool {
        self.top_margin_group.is_some_and(|group| group.open)
    }

    pub(crate) fn pending_margin_for_next_box(&self) -> CssPixels {
        if self.has_open_top_margin_group() {
            return CssPixels::default();
        }
        self.current_collapsed_margin()
    }

    pub(crate) fn update_open_top_margin_group(&mut self) {
        if let Some(group) = self.top_margin_group.as_mut()
            && group.open
        {
            group.margins = self.margins_since_reset;
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn reset(&mut self) {
        if let Some(group) = self.top_margin_group.as_mut() {
            group.open = false;
        }
        self.margins_since_reset = CollapsedMargins::default();
        self.continues_enclosing_margins = false;
        self.ignores_quirky_margins = false;
    }

    /// Takes in what the contents of a child left in their margin state, `contents`, once they are laid out.
    fn take_in_margins_left_by_contents(&mut self, contents: &Self) {
        self.margins_since_reset = if contents.continues_enclosing_margins {
            self.margins_since_reset.collapsed_with(contents.margins_since_reset)
        } else {
            contents.margins_since_reset
        };
        if let Some(joined) = contents.top_margin_group.filter(|group| group.joins_enclosing_group) {
            let group = self
                .top_margin_group
                .as_mut()
                .expect("contents join the top margin group of their enclosing margin state");
            group.margins = group.margins.collapsed_with(joined.margins);
            group.open &= joined.open;
        }
        if !contents.continues_enclosing_margins {
            self.continues_enclosing_margins = false;
        }
        // Contents that ended the margins collapsing into the block start of a quirks-mode body or table cell end
        // them here too.
        self.ignores_quirky_margins &= contents.ignores_quirky_margins;
    }

    /// Collapses the margins after a block-level box of the flow: what the contents of the box left in their margin
    /// state, `margins_left_by_contents`, where the box has contents in the flow, and its block-end margin. Returns the
    /// margin the flow leaves past the block end of the box: its block-end margin, collapsed with the margins of its
    /// contents that collapse through its block end. For a box that margins collapse through, which sits past the
    /// margins before it, that is how much its block-end margin adds to them.
    fn collapse_margins_after_block_level_box(
        &mut self,
        margins_left_by_contents: Option<&Self>,
        collapses_through: bool,
        continues_in_next_fragment: bool,
        margin_bottom: CssPixels,
        margin_bottom_is_quirky: bool,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        if let Some(contents) = margins_left_by_contents {
            self.take_in_margins_left_by_contents(contents);
        }
        let last_in_flow_child_margin_bottom_collapsed =
            margins_left_by_contents.is_some_and(|contents| contents.box_last_in_flow_child_margin_bottom_collapsed);
        if !collapses_through && (!last_in_flow_child_margin_bottom_collapsed || continues_in_next_fragment) {
            self.reset();
        }
        let margin_before_block_end_margin = self.current_collapsed_margin();
        self.add_margin_of_box(margin_bottom, margin_bottom_is_quirky);
        self.update_open_top_margin_group();
        if collapses_through {
            self.current_collapsed_margin() - margin_before_block_end_margin
        } else {
            self.current_collapsed_margin()
        }
    }

    /// Collapses the margins of a box with clearance that margins collapse through, which stay together across the
    /// box: `margins_after_clearance`, which lie between the clearance and the box, what the contents of the box left
    /// in their margin state, and its block-end margin. Returns how much of the collapsed margin lies past the block
    /// end of the box.
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#collapsing-margins
    // If the top and bottom margins of an element with clearance are adjoining, its margins collapse with the adjoining
    // margins of following siblings but that resulting margin does not collapse with the bottom margin of the parent
    // block.
    fn collapse_margins_through_box_with_clearance(
        &mut self,
        margins_after_clearance: CollapsedMargins,
        margins_left_by_contents: Option<&Self>,
        margin_bottom: CssPixels,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        let margins_of_contents =
            margins_left_by_contents.map_or_else(CollapsedMargins::default, |contents| contents.margins_since_reset);
        self.margins_since_reset = margins_after_clearance
            .collapsed_with(margins_of_contents)
            .with_margin(margin_bottom);
        self.continues_enclosing_margins = false;
        self.current_collapsed_margin() - margins_after_clearance.collapsed_margin()
    }

    /// The block-start margin of a block container in this margin state, whose contents collapsed `group` into it.
    fn block_start_margin_collapsing(&self, group: TopMarginGroup) -> CssPixels {
        self.margins_since_reset
            .collapsed_with(group.margins)
            .collapsed_margin()
    }

    fn take_own_top_margin_group(&mut self) -> TopMarginGroup {
        let group = self
            .top_margin_group
            .take()
            .expect("the contents of a box collapse into its own top margin group");
        debug_assert!(!group.joins_enclosing_group);
        group
    }

    /// Makes the margins these contents collapsed into their own block-start margin join the open top margin group of
    /// the enclosing margin state instead.
    fn join_enclosing_top_margin_group(&mut self) {
        self.top_margin_group
            .as_mut()
            .expect("the contents of a box collapse into a top margin group")
            .joins_enclosing_group = true;
    }

    /// These contents with `own_top_margin_group`, the group they collapsed into their own block-start margin once it
    /// was resolved, where they have one.
    fn with_own_top_margin_group(self, own_top_margin_group: Option<TopMarginGroup>) -> Self {
        Self {
            top_margin_group: own_top_margin_group.or(self.top_margin_group),
            ..self
        }
    }
}

/// What the probe for a stored in-flow layout found, and what storing the fresh layout needs.
#[expect(
    clippy::large_enum_variant,
    reason = "a probe result lives on the stack for one child's layout, which boxing would give an allocation"
)]
enum InFlowReuse {
    Ineligible,
    Hit {
        entry: std::sync::Arc<in_flow_block_cache::InFlowBlockEntry>,
        fragment: std::sync::Arc<fragment_tree::Fragment>,
    },
    Store {
        key: in_flow_block_cache::InFlowBlockKey,
        validity: fc_run_cache::FcRunCacheValidity,
        abspos_containing_block_info_contributions_received: u64,
        host_findings_noted_so_far: u64,
        float_reads_before_child: FloatReads,
        float_count_before_child: usize,
        margins_before_box: CollapsedMargins,
        in_open_top_margin_group: bool,
        introduced_clearance: bool,
        containing_block_position_in_root: FfiCssPixelPoint,
        lowest_column_content_block_end_before_child: Option<CssPixels>,
    },
}

/// An in-flow child placed from a stored layout or a layout made ahead.
struct ReusedInFlowChild {
    content_offset: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    margin_box_block_end: CssPixels,
    introduced_clearance: bool,
    collapses_through: bool,
    collapsed_margin_after_clearance: Option<CssPixels>,
