                    .latest
                    .take_if(|latest| latest.holds_fragments_unused_too_long(layout_commit_count));
            }
            if entries.latest.is_none() && !earlier.is_empty() {
                entries.latest = Some(earlier.remove(0));
            }
            let may_go_unused = earlier.iter().any(|earlier| earlier.holds_fragments())
                || (entries.committed.is_some()
                    && entries.latest.as_ref().is_some_and(|latest| latest.holds_fragments()));
            entries.earlier = earlier;
            entries.refresh_summaries();
            if entries.latest.is_none()
                && entries.committed.is_none()
                && let Some(damage) = inline_layout_damage.get_mut(slot as usize)
            {
                *damage = InlineLayoutDamage::default();
            }
            may_go_unused
        });
    }
}

fn shared_entry_in_allocation_of(
    displaced: Option<std::sync::Arc<FcRunCacheEntry>>,
    entry: FcRunCacheEntry,
) -> std::sync::Arc<FcRunCacheEntry> {
    let Some(mut displaced) = displaced else {
        return std::sync::Arc::new(entry);
    };
    match std::sync::Arc::get_mut(&mut displaced) {
        Some(unshared) => {
            *unshared = entry;
            displaced
        }
        None => std::sync::Arc::new(entry),
    }
}

pub(super) fn run_root_validity(pass: &LayoutPass<'_>, box_: Node) -> FcRunCacheValidity {
    let data = NodeFacts::new(pass, box_).data();
    FcRunCacheValidity {
        slot_generation: data.slot_generation.get(),
        fragment_cache_epoch: data.fragment_cache_epoch,
    }
}

/// A run's cache interaction, decided at probe time and concluded after
/// the run executes. Uncacheable classes bypass entirely: subgridded grid
/// items copy the parent grid's mid-run track state, which the key cannot
/// see; anchor()-positioned roots keep their bypass while the resolved-inset
/// side effects are audited; pass entries, measurement roots that do not
/// keep their result and internal runs are not spawned child runs; devtools
/// collection emits per-run callbacks a replay would skip.
pub(super) enum FcRunCacheAttempt {
    Bypass,
    Store {
        /// Captured at probe time and reused at store time: an invalidation
        /// landing between probe and store makes the stored entry look stale
        /// on its next probe (a fail-safe miss) instead of being baked into
        /// a forever-valid entry.
        validity: FcRunCacheValidity,
        structurally_damaged_entry: Option<std::sync::Arc<FcRunCacheEntry>>,
    },
    /// A run that builds no fragments, whose result is kept.
    StoreResultOnly {
        validity: FcRunCacheValidity,
    },
}

impl FcRunCacheAttempt {
    pub(super) fn stores_outputs(&self) -> bool {
        !matches!(self, Self::Bypass)
    }

    pub(super) fn trace_action(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Bypass => "RUN (cache=bypass)",
            Self::Store { .. } | Self::StoreResultOnly { .. } => "RUN (cache=miss)",
        }
    }

    /// Err carries the entry the caller must replay instead of running. A probe whose run builds fragments takes only
    /// an entry whose run built them; any other probe reads the result of any matching entry.
    pub(super) fn probe(
        box_: Node,
        runs_as_subgrid: bool,
        mode: formatting_context::RunMode,
        measurement_root_keeps_its_result: bool,
        pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
        key: &LayoutRequest,
    ) -> Result<Self, FcRunCacheHit> {
        let builds_fragments = mode.builds_fragments();
        let Some(store) = pass.fc_run_cache_store().filter(|_| {
            can_describe_run(
                box_,
                runs_as_subgrid,
                mode.collects_devtools_layout_data(),
                measurement_root_keeps_its_result,
                pass,
                key,
            )
        }) else {
            return Ok(Self::Bypass);
        };
        let validity = run_root_validity(pass, box_);
        if !builds_fragments {
            if let Some(entry) = store.first_entry_where_summary_allows(
                box_.slot_index(),
                |summary| summary.may_answer_probe(validity, false),
                |entry| entry.validity == validity && entry.answers_probe_for(key),
            ) {
                entry.note_used_at_layout_commit(pass.arena().layout_commit_count());
                return Err(FcRunCacheHit { entry });
            }
            return Ok(Self::StoreResultOnly { validity });
        }
        if let Some(entry) = store.first_entry_where_summary_allows(
            box_.slot_index(),
            |summary| summary.may_answer_probe(validity, true),
            |entry| entry.validity == validity && entry.result.fragment.is_some() && entry.answers_probe_for(key),
        ) {
            // NB: Once the replayed fragments are committed, the sweep keeps the entry beside later ones. A store that
            //     replaces the latest entry checks whether its fragments were committed itself.
            if !store.entry_is_the_only_one_its_box_holds(box_.slot_index(), &entry) {
                store.enqueue_for_sweep(box_.slot_index());
            }
            entry.note_used_at_layout_commit(pass.arena().layout_commit_count());
            return Err(FcRunCacheHit { entry });
        }
        let structurally_damaged_entry = store.structurally_damaged_entry(box_, validity, key);
        Ok(Self::Store {
            validity,
            structurally_damaged_entry,
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn would_reuse_stored_run(
        box_: Node,
        mode: formatting_context::RunMode,
        measurement_root_keeps_its_result: bool,
        pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
        key: &LayoutRequest,
    ) -> bool {
        let builds_fragments = mode.builds_fragments();
        let Some(store) = pass.fc_run_cache_store().filter(|_| {
            can_describe_run(
                box_,
                false,
                mode.collects_devtools_layout_data(),
                measurement_root_keeps_its_result,
                pass,
                key,
            )
        }) else {
            return false;
        };
        let validity = run_root_validity(pass, box_);
        store
            .first_entry_where_summary_allows(
                box_.slot_index(),
                |summary| summary.may_answer_probe(validity, builds_fragments),
                |entry| {
                    entry.validity == validity
                        && (!builds_fragments || entry.result.fragment.is_some())
                        && entry.answers_probe_for(key)
                },
            )
            .is_some()
    }

    pub(super) fn previous_line_data(&self) -> Option<std::sync::Arc<inline_content::InlineContent>> {
        let Self::Store {
            structurally_damaged_entry: Some(entry),
            ..
        } = self
        else {
            return None;
        };
        entry.result.line_data().cloned()
    }

    /// Stores `result` where the probe asked for it, and hands it back to the run's parent: as the stored entry's, so
    /// that the parent takes in what it keeps of it without a copy, or as it is.
    pub(super) fn conclude(
        self,
        pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
        box_: Node,
        key: &LayoutRequest,
        result: formatting_context::LayoutResult,
    ) -> formatting_context::LayoutResultHandle {
        if !matches!(self, Self::Bypass) && (cfg!(debug_assertions) || run_repeatability::verification_is_enabled()) {
            assert_eq!(
                cells_at_probe(&result, key),
                result.cells,
                "the stored run of {box_:?} would hand a probe of its own key other root cells than it left"
            );
        }
        let store = || {
            pass.fc_run_cache_store()
                .expect("a run that probed a store concludes where it can store")
        };
        let (validity, structurally_damaged_entry) = match self {
            Self::Bypass => return formatting_context::LayoutResultHandle::Owned(result),
            Self::StoreResultOnly { validity } => {
                debug_assert!(
                    result.fragment.is_none(),
                    "a run that builds no fragments returned a root"
                );
                return formatting_context::LayoutResultHandle::Stored(store().store(
                    box_,
                    FcRunCacheEntry {
                        key: key.clone(),
                        validity,
                        result,
                        last_used_at_layout_commit: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(
                            pass.arena().layout_commit_count(),
                        ),
                        structural_epoch_bumps_when_stored: 0,
                    },
                    |entry| entry.holds_committed_fragments(pass.arena(), box_),
                ));
            }
            Self::Store {
                validity,
                structurally_damaged_entry,
            } => (validity, structurally_damaged_entry),
        };
        // Release the probed entry so that store() can replace it in place.
        drop(structurally_damaged_entry);
        if result.fragment.is_none() {
            return formatting_context::LayoutResultHandle::Owned(result);
        }
        let entry = FcRunCacheEntry {
            key: key.clone(),
            validity,
            result,
            last_used_at_layout_commit: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(pass.arena().layout_commit_count()),
            structural_epoch_bumps_when_stored: 0,
        };
        formatting_context::LayoutResultHandle::Stored(
            store().store(box_, entry, |entry| entry.holds_committed_fragments(pass.arena(), box_)),
        )
    }
}

pub(super) fn can_describe_run(
    box_: Node,
    runs_as_subgrid: bool,
    should_collect_devtools_layout_data: bool,
    measurement_root_keeps_its_result: bool,
    pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
    key: &LayoutRequest,
) -> bool {
    let fc_type = key.fc_type;
    let input = &key.input;
    if should_collect_devtools_layout_data
        || (input.participation == ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Root && !measurement_root_keeps_its_result)
        || fc_type == formatting_context::FormattingContextType::InternalReplaced
        // The direct normal-layout path for an empty atomic block only sizes and snapshots its root.
        // Replaying a stored output costs more than rebuilding it and retains an entry needlessly.
        || (fc_type == formatting_context::FormattingContextType::Block
            && input.participation == ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::AtomicInline
            && pass.first_child(box_).is_invalid())
    {
        return false;
    }
    if runs_as_subgrid {
        return false;
    }
    // Structural invariants behind this root-flag check, to re-verify if it is ever
    // narrowed: anchor() applies only to absolutely positioned boxes and every abspos
    // box is the root of its own spawned run, so the flag on the run root covers every
    // anchor consumer; anchor eligibility is resolved from used values of the same
    // pass under the anchor lookup's containing-block guard, never from a previous
    // pass; scroll compensation compares chains that converge at the run root; and
    // anchor-size() resolves to None today, so inset properties are the only anchor
    // dependency a run can have.
    !node_facts::has_flag(NodeFacts::new(pass, box_).data(), NodeFlag::InsetsUseAnchorFunctions)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn key(available_inline: AvailableSize, percentage_basis_inline_size: Option<CssPixels>) -> LayoutRequest {
        LayoutRequest {
            fc_type: formatting_context::FormattingContextType::Block,
            input: LayoutInput::new(
                AvailableSpace {
                    inline_size: available_inline,
                    block_size: AvailableSize::Indefinite,
                },
                ContainingBlockConstraints {
                    percentage_basis_inline_size,
                    ..ContainingBlockConstraints::default()
                },
                ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::AtomicInline,
            ),
            root_cells: used_values::RootInputCells::default(),
            parent_frame: geometry::Frame::PHYSICAL,
        }
    }

    fn px(value: i64) -> CssPixels {
        CssPixels::from_integer(value)
    }

    fn inline_inputs_unobserved_at_or_above(threshold: i64) -> RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
        RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
            definite_available_inline_sizes_at_or_above: Some(px(threshold)),
            percentage_inline_basis: true,
            ..RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()
        }
    }

    fn at(inline_size: i64) -> LayoutRequest {
        key(AvailableSize::definite(px(inline_size)), Some(px(inline_size)))
    }

    fn root_with_a_descendant() -> fragment_tree::RunRootFragment {
        let mut root = fragment_tree::FragmentLink::for_test(Node::new(0, 1)).fragment;
        std::sync::Arc::get_mut(&mut root)
            .expect("a fresh fragment is not shared")
            .children = vec![fragment_tree::FragmentLink::for_test(Node::new(1, 1))];
        fragment_tree::RunRootFragment::propagating_nothing(root)
    }

    fn entry(
        key: LayoutRequest,
        fragment_cache_epoch: u32,
        root: Option<fragment_tree::RunRootFragment>,
        layout_commit_count: u64,
    ) -> FcRunCacheEntry {
        FcRunCacheEntry {
            key,
            validity: FcRunCacheValidity {
                slot_generation: 1,
                fragment_cache_epoch,
            },
            result: formatting_context::LayoutResult {
                outcome: formatting_context::ChildLayoutResult::default(),
                fragment: root,
                cells: used_values::RootInputCells::default(),
                // NB: As a run whose result depends on no percentage block size proves.
                observed: RunObservations {
                    never_observed: RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
                        percentage_block_basis_and_block_size_definiteness: true,
                        ..RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()
                    },
                    parent_owns_root_cells: false,
                    laid_out_abspos_contained_by_root: false,
                },
                residue: None,
            },
            last_used_at_layout_commit: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(layout_commit_count),
            structural_epoch_bumps_when_stored: 0,
        }
    }

    fn widths(inline_sizes: &[i64]) -> Vec<AvailableSize> {
        inline_sizes
            .iter()
            .map(|&inline_size| AvailableSize::definite(px(inline_size)))
            .collect()
    }

    fn widths_of_entries(store: &FcRunCacheStore, slot: u32) -> Vec<AvailableSize> {
        let mut widths = Vec::new();
        store.first_entry_where(slot, |entry| {
            widths.push(entry.key.input.available_space.inline_size);
            false
        });
        widths
    }

    fn width_of_committed_entry(store: &FcRunCacheStore, slot: u32) -> Option<AvailableSize> {
        store
            .slots
            .with_row(slot as usize, |entries| entries.cloned())
            .unwrap()
            .committed
            .as_ref()
            .map(|entry| entry.key.input.available_space.inline_size)
    }

    /// The committedness the arena would report while the box's committed fragments are those of the entry of `marked`.
    fn mark_entries_of_key(marked: LayoutRequest) -> impl FnMut(Node, &FcRunCacheEntry) -> bool {
        move |_, entry| entry.key == marked
    }

    fn entries_of_key_are_committed(marked: LayoutRequest) -> impl Fn(&FcRunCacheEntry) -> bool {
        move |entry| entry.key == marked
    }

    fn nothing_is_committed(_: &FcRunCacheEntry) -> bool {
        false
    }

    #[test]
    fn sweep_checks_changed_entries_without_discarding_reusable_stale_data_early() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let entry = |epoch| entry(at(300), epoch, None, 0);
        store.store(Node::new(0, 1), entry(1), nothing_is_committed);
        store.store(Node::new(1, 1), entry(1), nothing_is_committed);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, |_, _| false, 1);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| panic!("unchanged entries must not be swept"), |_, _| false, 2);

        store.note_invalidated_entry(Node::new(0, 1));
        store.note_invalidated_entry(Node::new(0, 1));
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0).len(), 1);
        let mut checked = 0;
        store.sweep_pending_entries(
            |slot, _| {
                assert_eq!(slot, 0);
                checked += 1;
                false
            },
            |_, _| false,
            3,
        );
        assert_eq!(checked, 1);
        assert!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 1).len(), 1);

        store.note_invalidated_entry(Node::new(1, 1));
        store.store(Node::new(1, 1), entry(2), nothing_is_committed);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, validity| validity.fragment_cache_epoch == 2, |_, _| false, 4);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 1).len(), 1);

        // A result stored after a mid-run invalidation still needs its validity checked.
        store.store(Node::new(0, 1), entry(1), nothing_is_committed);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, validity| validity.fragment_cache_epoch == 2, |_, _| false, 5);
        assert!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_store_keeps_the_entry_whose_fragments_the_box_committed_beside_newer_ones() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(300)), 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(320), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 1),
            entries_of_key_are_committed(at(300)),
        );
        store.store(box_, entry(at(340), 1, None, 1), entries_of_key_are_committed(at(300)));
        assert_eq!(
            width_of_committed_entry(&store, 0),
            Some(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)))
        );
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[300, 340, 320]));

        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 1),
            entries_of_key_are_committed(at(300)),
        );
        assert_eq!(width_of_committed_entry(&store, 0), None);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[300, 340, 320]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_sweep_keeps_the_entry_whose_fragments_the_box_committed_and_its_fragments() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(320), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(300)), 1);
        let committed = store
            .slots
            .with_row(0, |entries| entries.cloned())
            .unwrap()
            .committed
            .clone()
            .expect("the earlier entry whose fragments the box committed moves beside the latest one");
        assert_eq!(
            committed.key.input.available_space.inline_size,
            AvailableSize::definite(px(300))
        );
        assert_eq!(committed.result.fragment.as_ref().unwrap().fragment.children.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[300, 320]));

        store.enqueue_for_sweep(0);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(300)), 2);
        assert_eq!(
            width_of_committed_entry(&store, 0),
            Some(AvailableSize::definite(px(300))),
            "the entry stays beside the latest one while the box keeps its fragments committed"
        );
        store
            .first_entry_where(0, |entry| entry.key == at(320))
            .unwrap()
            .note_used_at_layout_commit(2);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(320)), 3);
        assert_eq!(width_of_committed_entry(&store, 0), None);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[320]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_earlier_entry_committed_in_place_of_the_latest_one_stays_beside_later_stores() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(320), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(320)), 1);
        store
            .first_entry_where(0, |entry| entry.key == at(300))
            .unwrap()
            .note_used_at_layout_commit(1);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(300)), 2);
        assert_eq!(
            width_of_committed_entry(&store, 0),
            Some(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)))
        );
        store.store(box_, entry(at(340), 1, None, 2), entries_of_key_are_committed(at(300)));
        assert_eq!(
            width_of_committed_entry(&store, 0),
            Some(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            widths_of_entries(&store, 0),
            widths(&[300, 340, 320]),
            "the entry whose fragments the box committed before stays to be replayed"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_committed_entry_that_no_longer_describes_the_committed_subtree_goes() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(300)), 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(320), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 1),
            entries_of_key_are_committed(at(300)),
        );
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[300, 320]));
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, |_, _| false, 2);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[320]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn entries_holding_fragments_the_box_never_committed_go_after_two_unused_layout_commits_beside_one_it_did() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(280), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(280)), 1);
        store.store(box_, entry(at(300), 1, None, 1), entries_of_key_are_committed(at(280)));
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(320), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 1),
            entries_of_key_are_committed(at(280)),
        );
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(340), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 1),
            entries_of_key_are_committed(at(280)),
        );
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(280)), 2);
        store
            .first_entry_where(0, |entry| entry.key == at(320))
            .unwrap()
            .note_used_at_layout_commit(2);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(280)), 3);
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(280)), 4);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[280, 320, 300]));
        store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, mark_entries_of_key(at(280)), 5);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[280, 300]));
        store.sweep_pending_entries(
            |_, _| panic!("a box holding no fragments it did not commit is not swept again"),
            |_, _| false,
            6,
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_latest_entry_of_a_box_that_committed_none_of_its_entries_stays() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        for layout_commit_count in 1..5 {
            store.sweep_pending_entries(|_, _| true, |_, _| false, layout_commit_count);
        }
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[300]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn earlier_entries_make_room_oldest_first_and_results_of_runs_without_fragments_first() {
        let store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(100), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.store(box_, entry(at(200), 1, None, 0), nothing_is_committed);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(400), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[400, 300, 200, 100]));
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(500), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[500, 400, 300, 100]));
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(600), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[600, 500, 400, 300]));
        store.store(box_, entry(at(400), 1, None, 0), nothing_is_committed);
        assert_eq!(widths_of_entries(&store, 0), widths(&[400, 600, 500, 300]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn queued_memo_invalidations_count_structural_changes_only_while_the_box_holds_entries() {
        use crate::layout::in_flow_block_cache::InFlowBlockCacheStore;
        use crate::layout::memo_invalidations::MemoInvalidations;
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let mut in_flow_block_cache = InFlowBlockCacheStore::default();
        let mut text_memos = crate::layout::rendered_text::TextMemos::default();
        let mut prepared_inline_content = crate::layout::prepared_inline_content::PreparedInlineContentMemos::default();
        let mut intrinsic_size_caches = crate::layout::layout_node_arena::IntrinsicSizeCaches::default();
        let node = Node::new(0, 1);
        let mut notes = MemoInvalidations::default();
        notes.note_structural_inline_change(node);
        notes.apply_to(
            &mut store,
            &mut in_flow_block_cache,
            &mut text_memos,
            &mut prepared_inline_content,
            &mut intrinsic_size_caches,
        );
        assert_eq!(store.structural_epoch_bumps_of(node), 0);

        store.store(
            node,
            entry(at(100), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        let mut notes = MemoInvalidations::default();
        notes.note_structural_inline_change(node);
        notes.note_fragment_cache_epoch_bumped(node);
        notes.note_structural_inline_change(node);
        notes.apply_to(
            &mut store,
            &mut in_flow_block_cache,
            &mut text_memos,
            &mut prepared_inline_content,
            &mut intrinsic_size_caches,
        );
        assert_eq!(store.structural_epoch_bumps_of(node), 2);

        let reused = Node::new(0, 2);
        let mut notes = MemoInvalidations::default();
        notes.note_structural_inline_change(node);
        notes.note_slot_freed(node.slot_index());
        notes.note_structural_inline_change(reused);
        notes.apply_to(
            &mut store,
            &mut in_flow_block_cache,
            &mut text_memos,
            &mut prepared_inline_content,
            &mut intrinsic_size_caches,
        );
        assert!(!store.slot_holds_entries(0));
        assert_eq!(store.structural_epoch_bumps_of(reused), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_store_keeps_the_inline_damage_an_earlier_entry_saw() {
        let mut store = FcRunCacheStore::for_test();
        let box_ = Node::new(0, 1);
        store.store(
            box_,
            entry(at(300), 1, Some(root_with_a_descendant()), 0),
            nothing_is_committed,
        );
        store.note_inline_layout_damage(box_);
        store.store(box_, entry(at(320), 3, None, 0), nothing_is_committed);
        let damaged_validity = FcRunCacheValidity {
            slot_generation: 1,
            fragment_cache_epoch: 3,
        };
        let damaged = store
            .structurally_damaged_entry(box_, damaged_validity, &at(300))
            .expect("the entry stored before the damage supplies its line data");
        assert_eq!(
            damaged.key.input.available_space.inline_size,
            AvailableSize::definite(px(300))
        );
        store.note_inline_layout_damage(box_);
        assert!(
            store
                .structurally_damaged_entry(box_, damaged_validity, &at(300))
                .is_none()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_item_run_that_never_read_the_block_size_its_root_adopts_matches_at_another() {
        let root_cells = used_values::RootInputCells::default();
        let item_input = LayoutInput::new(
            AvailableSpace {
                inline_size: AvailableSize::definite(px(300)),
                block_size: AvailableSize::Indefinite,
            },
            ContainingBlockConstraints::default(),
            ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Item,
        );
        let key_of = |input| LayoutRequest {
            fc_type: formatting_context::FormattingContextType::Block,
            input,
            root_cells,
            parent_frame: geometry::Frame::PHYSICAL,
        };
        let stored = key_of(item_input.clone());

        let mut adopting_input = item_input;
        adopting_input.sizing.content_block_size_after_run = geometry::ContentBlockSizeAfterRun::Given(px(40));
        let probe = key_of(adopting_input);

        assert!(!stored.matches(&probe, RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()));
        assert!(stored.matches(
            &probe,
            RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
                content_block_size_adopted_after_run: true,
                ..RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()
            }
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn identical_keys_match_without_relaxations() {
        let stored = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(300)));
        assert!(stored.matches(&stored, RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_different_available_inline_size_misses_without_the_inline_relaxation() {
        let stored = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(300)));
        let probe = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(320)), Some(px(320)));
        assert!(!stored.matches(&probe, RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()));
        assert!(!stored.matches(
            &probe,
            RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
                percentage_block_basis_and_block_size_definiteness: true,
                ..RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()
            }
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_inline_guarantees_are_granted_separately() {
        let stored = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(300)));
        let only_available_inline_sizes_unobserved = RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
            definite_available_inline_sizes_at_or_above: Some(px(0)),
            ..RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()
        };
        let only_inline_basis_unobserved = RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
            percentage_inline_basis: true,
            ..RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()
        };
        let wider_with_same_basis = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(320)), Some(px(300)));
        assert!(stored.matches(&wider_with_same_basis, only_available_inline_sizes_unobserved));
        assert!(!stored.matches(&wider_with_same_basis, only_inline_basis_unobserved));
        let same_width_with_other_basis = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(320)));
        assert!(stored.matches(&same_width_with_other_basis, only_inline_basis_unobserved));
        assert!(!stored.matches(&same_width_with_other_basis, only_available_inline_sizes_unobserved));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_inline_relaxation_accepts_available_sizes_at_or_above_the_threshold() {
        let stored = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(300)));
        assert!(stored.matches(
            &key(AvailableSize::definite(px(320)), Some(px(320))),
            inline_inputs_unobserved_at_or_above(100)
        ));
        assert!(stored.matches(
            &key(AvailableSize::definite(px(100)), Some(px(100))),
            inline_inputs_unobserved_at_or_above(100)
        ));
        assert!(!stored.matches(
            &key(AvailableSize::definite(px(99)), Some(px(99))),
            inline_inputs_unobserved_at_or_above(100)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_inline_relaxation_needs_definite_available_sizes_on_both_sides() {
        let stored = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(300)));
        assert!(!stored.matches(
            &key(AvailableSize::MaxContent, None),
            inline_inputs_unobserved_at_or_above(0)
        ));
        let stored_intrinsic = key(AvailableSize::MaxContent, None);
        assert!(!stored_intrinsic.matches(
            &key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(300))),
            inline_inputs_unobserved_at_or_above(0)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_inline_relaxation_leaves_every_other_input_exact() {
        let stored = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(300)), Some(px(300)));
        let mutators: [fn(&mut LayoutRequest); 4] = [
            |probe| probe.input.containing_block_constraints.percentage_basis_block_size = Some(px(10)),
            |probe| probe.input.available_space.block_size = AvailableSize::definite(px(10)),
            |probe| {
                probe.input.sizing.forced_min_border_box_block_size =
                    geometry::PackedOptionalCssPixels::from(Some(px(10)))
            },
            |probe| {
                probe.input.participation = ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Float {
                    flex_container_resolves_its_own_automatic_block_size: false,
                }
            },
        ];
        for mutate in mutators {
            let mut probe = key(AvailableSize::definite(px(320)), Some(px(320)));
            mutate(&mut probe);
            assert!(!stored.matches(&probe, inline_inputs_unobserved_at_or_above(0)));
        }
    }

    fn item_key(content_block_size: i64, has_definite_block_size: bool) -> LayoutRequest {
        let root_cells = used_values::RootInputCells {
            content_inline_size: px(300),
            content_block_size: px(content_block_size),
            has_definite_inline_size: true,
            has_definite_block_size,
            ..used_values::RootInputCells::default()
        };
        LayoutRequest {
            fc_type: formatting_context::FormattingContextType::Block,
            input: LayoutInput::new(
                AvailableSpace {
                    inline_size: AvailableSize::definite(px(300)),
                    block_size: if has_definite_block_size {
                        AvailableSize::definite(px(content_block_size))
                    } else {
                        AvailableSize::Indefinite
                    },
                },
                ContainingBlockConstraints::default(),
                ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Item,
            ),
            root_cells,
            parent_frame: geometry::Frame::PHYSICAL,
        }
    }

    fn own_block_size(observation: formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation) -> RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
        RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved {
            percentage_block_basis_and_block_size_definiteness: true,
            own_block_size: observation,
            ..RunInputsTheStoredRunNeverObserved::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_item_run_that_observed_its_own_block_size_matches_only_the_block_size_it_was_assigned() {
        let observed = own_block_size(formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Observed);
        let stored = item_key(40, false);
        assert!(stored.matches(&item_key(40, false), observed));
        assert!(!stored.matches(&item_key(40, true), observed));
        assert!(!stored.matches(&item_key(60, false), observed));
        assert!(!stored.matches(&item_key(60, true), observed));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_item_run_that_never_observed_its_own_block_size_matches_any_assigned_block_size_and_definiteness() {
        let unobserved = own_block_size(formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Unobserved);
        for stored in [item_key(40, false), item_key(40, true)] {
            for probe in [
                item_key(40, false),
                item_key(40, true),
                item_key(60, true),
                item_key(0, false),
            ] {
                assert!(stored.matches(&probe, unobserved));
            }
        }
        let mut wider = item_key(60, true);
        wider.root_cells.content_inline_size = px(320);
        assert!(
            !item_key(40, false).matches(&wider, unobserved),
            "only the root's own block size is unobserved"
        );
        let mut button_aligned = item_key(60, true);
        button_aligned
            .root_cells
            .has_definite_block_size_only_for_button_content_alignment = true;
        assert!(!item_key(40, false).matches(&button_aligned, unobserved));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_item_run_whose_root_never_observed_its_percentage_inline_basis_matches_at_another_basis() {
        let at_percentage_inline_basis = |basis: i64| {
            let mut key = item_key(40, false);
            key.input.containing_block_constraints.percentage_basis_inline_size = Some(px(basis));
            key
        };
        let mut unobserved = entry(item_key(40, false), 1, None, 0).result.observed.never_observed;
        assert!(!at_percentage_inline_basis(400).matches(&at_percentage_inline_basis(300), unobserved));
        unobserved.percentage_inline_basis = true;
        assert!(at_percentage_inline_basis(400).matches(&at_percentage_inline_basis(300), unobserved));
        let mut wider = at_percentage_inline_basis(300);
        wider.root_cells.content_inline_size = px(320);
        wider.input.available_space.inline_size = AvailableSize::definite(px(320));
        assert!(
            !at_percentage_inline_basis(400).matches(&wider, unobserved),
            "only the percentage inline basis is unobserved"
        );
        assert!(!at_percentage_inline_basis(400).matches(
            &at_percentage_inline_basis(300),
            unobserved.accepted_when_reusing_stale_line_data_after_structural_inline_damage()
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_item_run_that_never_observed_its_own_block_size_matches_at_other_block_margins() {
        let at_margins = |margin_top: i64, margin_bottom: i64, margin_left: i64| {
            let mut key = item_key(40, true);
            key.root_cells.margin_top = px(margin_top);
            key.root_cells.margin_bottom = px(margin_bottom);
            key.root_cells.margin_left = px(margin_left);
            key
        };
        let stored = at_margins(0, 0, 0);
        let unobserved = own_block_size(formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Unobserved);
        let observed = own_block_size(formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Observed);
        assert!(stored.matches(&at_margins(30, -10, 0), unobserved));
        assert!(!stored.matches(&at_margins(30, -10, 0), observed));
        assert!(
            !stored.matches(&at_margins(0, 0, 10), unobserved),
            "only the root's block margins are unobserved"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn stale_line_data_after_structural_inline_damage_is_taken_only_at_the_same_own_block_size() {
        let mut unobserved = entry(item_key(40, false), 1, None, 0).result.observed.never_observed;
        unobserved.own_block_size = formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Unobserved;
        assert!(item_key(40, false).matches(&item_key(60, true), unobserved));
        assert!(!item_key(40, false).matches(
            &item_key(60, true),
            unobserved.accepted_when_reusing_stale_line_data_after_structural_inline_damage()
        ));
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Rust/src/layout/first_paint_text.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! The text rows paint timing has not looked at yet, which is how it learns that it paints a text node for the first
//! time without the host noting anything as a text node is inserted or its data changes. The arena notes a text row
//! each time the row is given rendered text it did not have, which every row a tree build makes is once, and a row is
//! again when what it renders changes. Paint timing takes the rows once a frame is laid out, and the host knows from a
//! flag the arena shares with it whether there are any, so a frame that made no text rows asks nothing.

use super::LayoutNodeArena;
use super::node_data::{NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::fork::ForkReset;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

/// The fewest rows the noted rows are compacted at, whose dead and repeated rows are dropped as they grow while paint
/// timing takes none, as it does for a document that renders no frames.
const FEWEST_ROWS_TO_COMPACT: usize = 4096;

#[derive(Default)]
struct NotedRows {
    rows: Vec<NodeSlotId>,
    /// How many rows the rows are compacted at, once they grow to it.
    compact_at: usize,
}

/// The text rows of the arena that were given new rendered text since paint timing last took them.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct FirstPaintTextRows {
    /// A fork starts with no rows: paint timing takes the rows of the state the host writes.
    noted: ForkReset<NotedRows>,
    /// Whether paint timing will never take the rows again, which it says once it reports nothing more about text.
    stopped: bool,
    /// Raised while any row is noted, which the host reads without asking.
    any_noted: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}

impl FirstPaintTextRows {
    pub(crate) fn share_any_noted_flag(&mut self, flag: Arc<AtomicBool>) {
        self.any_noted = flag;
    }

    /// Gives a fork a flag of its own, which no host reads, and stops the fork noting rows, which paint timing never
    /// takes from it.
    pub(crate) fn detach_any_noted_flag_for_fork(&mut self) {
        self.any_noted = Arc::default();
        self.stopped = true;
    }
}

impl LayoutNodeArena {
    /// Notes that the row `id` was given rendered text it did not have, for paint timing to look at.
    pub(super) fn note_text_row_for_first_paint(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) {
        if self.first_paint_text_rows.stopped || self.data(id).kind.get() != NodeKind::TextNode {
            return;
        }
        let mut noted = std::mem::take(&mut *self.first_paint_text_rows.noted);
        if noted.rows.len() >= noted.compact_at.max(FEWEST_ROWS_TO_COMPACT) {
            noted.rows.retain(|&row| self.slot_is_live(row));
            noted.rows.sort_unstable_by_key(|row| row.index);
            noted.rows.dedup();
            noted.compact_at = noted.rows.len() * 2;
        }
        if noted.rows.is_empty() {
            self.first_paint_text_rows.any_noted.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
        noted.rows.push(id);
        *self.first_paint_text_rows.noted = noted;
    }

    /// Takes the text rows noted since the last take that are still live, each as the row its text node is bound to,
    /// which is the text node's layout node, once and in the order of their slot ids.
    pub(crate) fn take_text_rows_for_first_paint(&mut self) -> Vec<NodeSlotId> {
        let noted = std::mem::take(&mut *self.first_paint_text_rows.noted);
        self.first_paint_text_rows.any_noted.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let mut rows: Vec<NodeSlotId> = noted
            .rows
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|row| self.node_style_node(row))
            .map(|text| self.bound_row(text))
            .filter(|&row| self.slot_is_live(row) && self.data(row).kind.get() == NodeKind::TextNode)
            .collect();
        rows.sort_unstable_by_key(|row| row.index);
        rows.dedup();
        rows
    }

    /// Stops noting text rows for paint timing, which will never take them again.
    pub(crate) fn stop_noting_text_rows_for_first_paint(&mut self) {
        self.first_paint_text_rows.stopped = true;
        *self.first_paint_text_rows.noted = NotedRows::default();
        self.first_paint_text_rows.any_noted.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

const _: () = assert!(size_of::<FlexItem>() <= 128);

impl FlexItem {
    fn new(
        box_: Node,
        alignment_facts: FlexItemAlignmentFacts,
        inputs: &FlexItemInputs<'_>,
        main_axis_is_horizontal: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-sizing-3/#valdef-width-min-content
        // NB: In a box's block axis, min-content, max-content and fit-content are equivalent to its automatic size, so
        //     such a minimum main size is an automatic minimum size where the main axis is the item's block axis.
        let main_axis_is_block_axis = main_axis_is_horizontal != inputs.inline_axis_is_horizontal;
        let main_min_size_is_auto = inputs.min_main_size.is_auto()
            || (main_axis_is_block_axis && inputs.min_main_size.is_intrinsic_sizing_constraint());
        Self {
            box_,
            alignment_facts,
            cross_size_is_stretch: inputs.preferred_cross_size.is_stretch(),
            cross_size_is_calc_size: inputs.preferred_cross_size.calc_size().is_some(),
            cross_min_or_max_size_is_stretch: inputs.min_cross_size.is_stretch() || inputs.max_cross_size.is_stretch(),
            main_min_size_is_auto,
            main_min_size_is_calc_size: inputs.min_main_size.calc_size().is_some(),
            max_main_size_is_none: false,
            max_cross_size_is_none: false,
            used_flex_basis_is_definite: false,
            main_size_was_resolved_from_aspect_ratio: false,
            cross_size_was_resolved_from_aspect_ratio: false,
            frozen: false,
            is_min_violation: false,
            is_max_violation: false,
            flex_base_size: CssPixels::default(),
            automatic_minimum_size_before_flexing: None,
            hypothetical_main_size: CssPixels::default(),
            hypothetical_cross_size: CssPixels::default(),
            hypothetical_cross_size_before_clamp: CssPixels::default(),
            target_main_size: CssPixels::default(),
            flex_factor: 0.0,
            scaled_flex_shrink_factor: 0.0,
            main_size: None,
            cross_size: None,
            main_offset: CssPixels::default(),
            cross_offset: CssPixels::default(),
            margins: DirectionAgnosticMargins::default(),
            borders_and_padding: DirectionAgnosticSides::default(),
        }
    }

    fn hypothetical_cross_size_with_margins(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.hypothetical_cross_size
            + self.margins.cross_before
            + self.margins.cross_after
            + self.borders_and_padding.cross_after
            + self.borders_and_padding.cross_before
    }

    fn outer_hypothetical_main_size(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.add_main_margin_box_sizes(self.hypothetical_main_size)
    }

    fn outer_cross_size(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.add_cross_margin_box_sizes(self.cross_size.unwrap())
    }

    fn outer_target_main_size(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.add_main_margin_box_sizes(self.target_main_size)
    }

    fn outer_flex_base_size(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.add_main_margin_box_sizes(self.flex_base_size)
    }

    fn add_main_margin_box_sizes(&self, content_size: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
        content_size
            + self.margins.main_before
            + self.margins.main_after
            + self.borders_and_padding.main_before
            + self.borders_and_padding.main_after
    }

    fn add_cross_margin_box_sizes(&self, content_size: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
        content_size
            + self.margins.cross_before
            + self.margins.cross_after
            + self.borders_and_padding.cross_before
            + self.borders_and_padding.cross_after
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct FlexLineItems {
    first: usize,
    count: usize,
    reversed: bool,
}

impl FlexLineItems {
    fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.count
    }

    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.count == 0
    }

    fn at(&self, position: usize) -> usize {
        debug_assert!(position < self.count);
        if self.reversed {
            self.first + self.count - 1 - position
        } else {
            self.first + position
        }
    }

    fn iter(&self) -> impl DoubleEndedIterator<Item = usize> + ExactSizeIterator + use<> {
        let items = *self;
        (0..items.count).map(move |position| items.at(position))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct FlexLine {
    items: FlexLineItems,
    cross_size: CssPixels,
    has_baseline_aligned_items: bool,
    remaining_free_space: Option<CssPixels>,
    growth_state: formatting_context::FlexLayoutGrowthState,
}

impl Default for FlexLine {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            items: FlexLineItems::default(),
            cross_size: CssPixels::default(),
            has_baseline_aligned_items: false,
            remaining_free_space: None,
            growth_state: formatting_context::FlexLayoutGrowthState::Growing,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct FlexContainerConstants<'pass> {
    style: StyleValues<'pass>,
    is_row_layout: bool,
    inline_axis_is_horizontal: bool,
    main_axis_is_horizontal: bool,
    is_legacy_webkit_box: bool,
    used_flex_wrap: u8,
    is_direction_reverse: bool,
    cross_axis_is_reverse: bool,
    /// How the container aligns its items along the main axis and its lines along the cross axis.
    justify_content: ContentAlignment,
    align_content: ContentAlignment,
    /// The directions of the cross axis, but for the start side of an item.
    cross_axis_directions: AxisDirections,
    main_gap: &'pass ComputedGap,
    cross_gap: &'pass ComputedGap,
}

impl<'pass> FlexContainerConstants<'pass> {
    // https://www.w3.org/TR/css-flexbox-1/#flex-direction-property
    fn of(run: &FormattingContextRun<'pass>) -> Self {
        let style = StyleValues::for_node(&run.pass, run.box_);
        let flex_direction = style.effective_flex_direction();
        let is_row_layout = matches!(flex_direction, flex_direction::ROW | flex_direction::ROW_REVERSE);
        let inline_axis_is_horizontal = !geometry::Frame::of(style.writing_mode()).is_orthogonal_to(run.pass.frame);
        let main_axis_is_horizontal = inline_axis_is_horizontal == is_row_layout;
        let is_legacy_webkit_box = style.display().inside == display_inside::_WEBKIT_BOX;
        // AD-HOC: A legacy webkit box is always single-line; `flex-wrap` does not apply, matching other engines.
        let used_flex_wrap = if is_legacy_webkit_box {
            flex_wrap::NOWRAP
        } else {
            style.flex_wrap()
        };
        let main_axis_is_parallel_to_inline_axis = main_axis_is_horizontal == inline_axis_is_horizontal;
        let mut cross_axis_is_reverse = if main_axis_is_parallel_to_inline_axis {
            style.block_axis_is_reverse()
        } else {
            style.inline_axis_is_reverse()
        };
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-flexbox/#flex-wrap-property
        // When flex-wrap is wrap-reverse, the cross-start and cross-end directions are swapped.
        // NB: The writing mode of the container decides where 'start' and 'end' are, without that swap.
        let cross_axis_directions = AxisDirections {
            flex_start_is_low: cross_axis_is_reverse == (used_flex_wrap == flex_wrap::WRAP_REVERSE),
            ..AxisDirections::of(!cross_axis_is_reverse, None)
        };
        if used_flex_wrap == flex_wrap::WRAP_REVERSE {
            cross_axis_is_reverse = !cross_axis_is_reverse;
        }
        let main_axis_writing_mode_start_is_reverse = if is_row_layout {
            style.inline_axis_is_reverse()
        } else {
            style.block_axis_is_reverse()
        };
        let flex_direction_is_reverse = matches!(
            flex_direction,
            flex_direction::COLUMN_REVERSE | flex_direction::ROW_REVERSE
        );
        let is_direction_reverse = main_axis_writing_mode_start_is_reverse != flex_direction_is_reverse;
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-align-3/#positional-values
        // left: Aligns the alignment subject to be flush with the alignment container's line-left or physical left
        //       edge, whichever is in the appropriate axis.
        //       If the property's axis is not parallel with either left↔right axis, this value behaves as start.
        // NB: The frame's left side is the line-left side. The main axis of a column flex container runs along the
        //     physical left↔right axis in a vertical writing mode.
        let frame = run.pass.frame;
        let main_axis_line_left_is_low = if is_row_layout {
            Some(true)
        } else if frame.is_transposed() {
            Some(frame.frame_side(geometry::Side::Left) != geometry::Side::Bottom)
        } else {
            None
        };
        let main_axis_directions = AxisDirections {
            flex_start_is_low: !is_direction_reverse,
            ..AxisDirections::of(!main_axis_writing_mode_start_is_reverse, main_axis_line_left_is_low)
        };
        // AD-HOC: A legacy webkit box distributes its items along the main axis as its -webkit-box-pack says, and
        //         ignores justify-content, matching other engines. The compat spec makes -webkit-box-pack an alias of
        //         justify-content, which it notes isn't web-compatible: https://github.com/whatwg/compat/issues/87
        let (justify_content, justify_content_safety) = if is_legacy_webkit_box {
            (ContentKeyword::webkit_box_pack_of(*style), OverflowSafety::Unsafe)
        } else {
            ContentKeyword::justify_content_of(*style)
        };
        let (align_content, align_content_safety) = ContentKeyword::align_content_of(*style);
        let (main_gap, cross_gap) = if is_row_layout {
            (style.column_gap(), style.row_gap())
        } else {
            (style.row_gap(), style.column_gap())
        };
        Self {
            style,
            is_row_layout,
            inline_axis_is_horizontal,
            main_axis_is_horizontal,
            is_legacy_webkit_box,
            used_flex_wrap,
            is_direction_reverse,
            cross_axis_is_reverse,
            justify_content: justify_content.resolve(justify_content_safety, main_axis_directions),
            align_content: align_content.resolve(align_content_safety, cross_axis_directions),
            cross_axis_directions,
            main_gap,
            cross_gap,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct FlexFormattingContext<'pass> {
    run: FormattingContextRun<'pass>,
    flex_lines: Vec<FlexLine>,
    flex_items: Vec<FlexItem>,
    flex_item_details: Vec<FlexItemDetails<'pass>>,
    derived_baselines_of_root_box: DerivedBaselines,
    /// The lines and items the devtools show of the container, where the run collects devtools data.
    flex_layout_data: Option<std::sync::Arc<formatting_context::FlexLayoutData>>,
    container: FlexContainerConstants<'pass>,
    available_space_for_items: Option<AxisAgnosticAvailableSpace>,
    available_space: Option<AvailableSpace>,
    layout_input: Option<LayoutInput>,
    /// The space in which the container resolves its own automatic block size, if its run left that to it.
    own_automatic_block_size_resolution_space: Option<AvailableSpace>,
    item_percentage_bases: ContainingBlockConstraints,
    item_runs_offered_to_block_size_measurements: Option<ItemRunsOfferedToBlockSizeMeasurements>,
    flex_item_index_by_node: OnceCell<HashMap<Node, usize>>,
    items_to_fork: OnceCell<Vec<usize>>,
    in_flow_items_margin_box_block_extent: Option<CssPixels>,
    /// The cells in which this context sizes the flex container, in the frame its items are laid out in. The context
    /// takes them again after the run sizes the container's own box.
    container_cells: Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>,
}

impl formatting_context::ChildRunShapes for FlexFormattingContext<'_> {
    fn child_run_shape_at(
        &self,
        node: Node,
        inline_size: CssPixels,
        constraints: ContainingBlockConstraints,
    ) -> Option<formatting_context::ChildRunShape> {
        let offered = self.item_runs_offered_to_block_size_measurements?;
        let index = self.index_of_flex_item(node)?;
        let measured_inline_size = match offered.measured_at {
            ItemBlockSizeMeasuredAt::UsedMainSize => {
                if self.has_definite_cross_size(index) {
                    return None;
                }
                clamp_to_max_dimension_value(self.flex_items[index].main_size?)
            }
            ItemBlockSizeMeasuredAt::IntrinsicBlockInlineSize => {
                if self.has_definite_main_size(index) {
                    return None;
                }
                self.intrinsic_block_inline_size(index)
            }
        };
        self.item_run_shape(index, measured_inline_size, offered.space_for_items)
            .filter(|shape| shape.lays_out_at(inline_size, constraints))
    }
}

impl<'pass> formatting_context::FormattingContextAlgorithm<'pass> for FlexFormattingContext<'pass> {
    fn lay_out(
        &mut self,
        run: &FormattingContextRun<'pass>,
        input: formatting_context::AlgorithmInput<'_>,
    ) -> formatting_context::AlgorithmOutput {
        self.run(run, input.body_input, input.flex_self_block_size_resolution_space);
        let container_cells = self.container_cells.get();
        let mut root_payload = fragment_tree::PendingPayload::default();
        if let Some(flex_layout_data) = self.flex_layout_data.take() {
            root_payload.set(fragment_tree::FcPayload::Flex(flex_layout_data));
        }
        formatting_context::AlgorithmOutput::of_root(
            formatting_context::ChildLayoutResult {
                automatic_content_block_size: container_cells.content_block_size,
                baselines: self.derived_baselines_of_root_box,
                in_flow_children_margin_box_block_extent: self.in_flow_items_margin_box_block_extent,
                ..formatting_context::ChildLayoutResult::default()
            },
            container_cells,
        )
        .with_root_payload(root_payload)
    }

    fn after_root_is_dimensioned(
        &self,
        _run: &FormattingContextRun<'pass>,
        root_cells_in_own_frame: used_values::RootInputCells,
    ) -> formatting_context::AfterDimensioning {
        self.parent_did_dimension(root_cells_in_own_frame);
        formatting_context::AfterDimensioning::LaysOutAbsposContainedByRoot
    }
}

impl<'pass> FlexFormattingContext<'pass> {
    pub(super) fn new(run: &FormattingContextRun<'pass>, container_cells: used_values::RootInputCells) -> Self {
        Self {
            run: run.clone(),
            flex_layout_data: None,
            flex_lines: Vec::new(),
            flex_items: Vec::new(),
            flex_item_details: Vec::new(),
            derived_baselines_of_root_box: DerivedBaselines::default(),
            container: FlexContainerConstants::of(run),
            available_space_for_items: None,
            available_space: None,
            layout_input: None,
            own_automatic_block_size_resolution_space: None,
            item_percentage_bases: ContainingBlockConstraints::default(),
            item_runs_offered_to_block_size_measurements: None,
            flex_item_index_by_node: OnceCell::new(),
            items_to_fork: OnceCell::new(),
            in_flow_items_margin_box_block_extent: None,
            container_cells: Cell::new(container_cells),
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    fn style(&self, node: Node) -> StyleValues<'pass> {
        StyleValues::for_node(&self.run.pass, node)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn facts(&self, node: Node) -> NodeFacts<'_> {
        NodeFacts::new(&self.run.pass, node)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn sizing(&self) -> sizing_context::SizingContext<'pass, '_> {
        sizing_context::SizingContext::new(self.run.state, self.run.pass).with_child_run_shapes(self)
    }

    fn keep_item_for_its_run(&self, node: Node) -> used_values::RootInputCells {
        let constraints = self.item_percentage_bases;
        used_values::cells_before_sizing(&self.run.pass, node, constraints)
    }

    /// The constraints the children of the container are laid out with, where the container is laid out with the
    /// constraints `constraints`.
    fn constraints_for_children(&self, constraints: ContainingBlockConstraints) -> ContainingBlockConstraints {
        self.sizing()
            .constraints_for_child_context(self.run.box_, &self.container_cells, constraints)
    }

    fn item_containing_block_constraints(&self) -> ContainingBlockConstraints {
        self.item_percentage_bases
    }

    fn is_row_layout(&self) -> bool {
        self.container.is_row_layout
    }

    fn is_legacy_webkit_box(&self) -> bool {
        self.container.is_legacy_webkit_box
    }

    fn item_of_legacy_webkit_box_fits_its_content(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        let inputs = &self.flex_item_details[index].inputs;
        self.is_legacy_webkit_box()
            && self.is_row_layout()
            && !inputs.flex_basis_is_content
            && inputs.flex_basis.is_auto()
            && inputs.preferred_main_size.is_auto()
    }

    /// The order of an item styled `style` in order-modified document order.
    fn order_of_item(&self, style: StyleValues<'_>) -> i32 {
        // AD-HOC: The items of a legacy webkit box are ordered by their -webkit-box-ordinal-group, and order doesn't
        //         apply, matching other engines.
        if self.is_legacy_webkit_box() {
            style.webkit_box_ordinal_group()
        } else {
            style.order()
        }
    }

    fn used_flex_wrap(&self) -> u8 {
        self.container.used_flex_wrap
    }

    fn is_single_line(&self) -> bool {
        self.used_flex_wrap() == flex_wrap::NOWRAP
    }

    fn main_axis_is_horizontal(&self) -> bool {
        self.container.main_axis_is_horizontal
    }

    fn cross_axis_is_horizontal(&self) -> bool {
        !self.main_axis_is_horizontal()
    }

    // Picks whichever of the two values describes the main (resp. cross) axis of this flex container.
    fn select_main<T>(&self, horizontal: T, vertical: T) -> T {
        if self.main_axis_is_horizontal() {
            horizontal
        } else {
            vertical
        }
    }

    fn select_cross<T>(&self, horizontal: T, vertical: T) -> T {
        self.select_main(vertical, horizontal)
    }

    fn main_sizing_axis(&self) -> SizingAxis {
        self.select_main(SizingAxis::Inline, SizingAxis::Block)
    }

    fn cross_sizing_axis(&self) -> SizingAxis {
        self.select_cross(SizingAxis::Inline, SizingAxis::Block)
    }

    fn main_axis_is_parallel_to_inline_axis_of_item(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        self.main_axis_is_horizontal() == self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.inline_axis_is_horizontal
    }

    fn cross_axis_is_reverse(&self) -> bool {
        self.container.cross_axis_is_reverse
    }

    fn is_direction_reverse(&self) -> bool {
        self.container.is_direction_reverse
    }

    // Both sizes are content sizes; the ratio applies to the border box under box-sizing: border-box.
    fn main_size_from_cross_size_and_aspect_ratio(&self, index: usize, cross_size: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
        self.content_size_transferred_through_aspect_ratio(index, cross_size, self.main_axis_is_horizontal())
    }

    fn cross_size_from_main_size_and_aspect_ratio(&self, index: usize, main_size: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
        self.content_size_transferred_through_aspect_ratio(index, main_size, self.cross_axis_is_horizontal())
    }

    fn content_size_transferred_through_aspect_ratio(
        &self,
        index: usize,
        size_in_ratio_determining_axis: CssPixels,
        ratio_dependent_axis_is_horizontal: bool,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        let inputs = &self.flex_item_details[index].inputs;
        sizing_context::SizingContext::content_size_transferred_through_aspect_ratio(
            inputs.style,
            &self.flex_item_details[index].cells,
            inputs.preferred_aspect_ratio.unwrap(),
            size_in_ratio_determining_axis,
            if ratio_dependent_axis_is_horizontal {
                SizingAxis::Inline
            } else {
                SizingAxis::Block
            },
        )
    }

    // The content size that a min/max size in an axis of the item allows, per its box-sizing.
    fn inner_size_for_min_max_through_aspect_ratio(
        &self,
        index: usize,
        size: &ComputedSize,
        reference: CssPixels,
        horizontal: bool,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        let value = size.to_px(reference);
        let style = self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.style;
        if style.box_sizing() != box_sizing::BORDER_BOX {
            return value;
        }
        let metrics = &self.flex_item_details[index].cells;
        if horizontal {
            formatting_context::subtract_border_box_adjustment(
                value,
                style.border_left_width(),
                metrics.padding_left(),
                style.border_right_width(),
                metrics.padding_right(),
            )
        } else {
            formatting_context::subtract_border_box_adjustment(
                value,
                style.border_top_width(),
                metrics.padding_top(),
                style.border_bottom_width(),
                metrics.padding_bottom(),
            )
        }
    }

    fn has_definite_main_size_used(&self, metrics: &impl BoxMetricCells) -> bool {
        self.select_main(metrics.has_definite_inline_size(), metrics.has_definite_block_size())
    }

    fn has_definite_cross_size_used(&self, metrics: &impl BoxMetricCells) -> bool {
        self.select_cross(metrics.has_definite_inline_size(), metrics.has_definite_block_size())
    }

    fn container_cross_size_is_known_for_layout(&self) -> bool {
        self.has_definite_cross_size_used(&self.container_cells)
            || (self.layout_input.as_ref().unwrap().participation == ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Item
                && !self
                    .available_space_for_items
                    .unwrap()
                    .cross
                    .is_intrinsic_sizing_constraint())
    }

    fn has_definite_main_size(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        self.has_definite_main_size_used(&self.flex_item_details[index].cells)
    }

    fn has_definite_cross_size(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        self.has_definite_cross_size_used(&self.flex_item_details[index].cells)
    }

    fn inner_main_size_used(&self, metrics: &impl BoxMetricCells) -> CssPixels {
        self.select_main(metrics.content_inline_size(), metrics.content_block_size())
    }

    fn inner_cross_size_used(&self, metrics: &impl BoxMetricCells) -> CssPixels {
        self.select_cross(metrics.content_inline_size(), metrics.content_block_size())
    }

    fn inner_main_size(&self, index: usize) -> CssPixels {
        self.inner_main_size_used(&self.flex_item_details[index].cells)
    }

    fn inner_cross_size(&self, index: usize) -> CssPixels {
        self.inner_cross_size_used(&self.flex_item_details[index].cells)
    }

    fn set_has_definite_main_size(&mut self, index: usize) {
        let main_axis_is_horizontal = self.main_axis_is_horizontal();
        let cells = &mut self.flex_item_details[index].cells;
        if main_axis_is_horizontal {
            cells.has_definite_inline_size = true;
        } else {
            cells.has_definite_block_size = true;
        }
    }

    fn set_has_definite_cross_size(&mut self, index: usize) {
        let cross_axis_is_horizontal = self.cross_axis_is_horizontal();
        let cells = &mut self.flex_item_details[index].cells;
        if cross_axis_is_horizontal {
            cells.has_definite_inline_size = true;
        } else {
            cells.has_definite_block_size = true;
        }
    }

    fn set_main_size(&mut self, index: usize, size: CssPixels) {
        let main_axis_is_horizontal = self.main_axis_is_horizontal();
        Self::set_size_of_item_cells(&mut self.flex_item_details[index].cells, main_axis_is_horizontal, size);
    }

    fn set_cross_size(&mut self, index: usize, size: CssPixels) {
        let cross_axis_is_horizontal = self.cross_axis_is_horizontal();
        Self::set_size_of_item_cells(&mut self.flex_item_details[index].cells, cross_axis_is_horizontal, size);
    }

    fn set_size_of_item_cells(cells: &mut used_values::RootInputCells, axis_is_horizontal: bool, size: CssPixels) {
        if axis_is_horizontal {
            cells.set_content_inline_size(size);
        } else {
            cells.set_content_block_size(size);
        }
    }

    fn set_container_main_size(&mut self, size: CssPixels) {
        self.set_main_size_used(&self.container_cells, size);
    }

    fn set_container_cross_size(&mut self, size: CssPixels) {
        self.set_cross_size_used(&self.container_cells, size);
    }

    fn set_main_size_used(&self, used: &Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>, size: CssPixels) {
        if self.main_axis_is_horizontal() {
            used.set_content_inline_size(size);
        } else {
            used.set_content_block_size(size);
        }
    }

    fn set_cross_size_used(&self, used: &Cell<used_values::RootInputCells>, size: CssPixels) {
        if self.cross_axis_is_horizontal() {
            used.set_content_inline_size(size);
        } else {
            used.set_content_block_size(size);
        }
    }

    fn computed_main_size(&self, index: usize) -> &'pass ComputedSize {
        self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.preferred_main_size
    }

    fn computed_main_min_size(&self, index: usize) -> &'pass ComputedSize {
        self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.min_main_size
    }

    fn computed_main_max_size(&self, index: usize) -> &'pass ComputedSize {
        self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.max_main_size
    }

    fn computed_cross_size(&self, index: usize) -> &'pass ComputedSize {
        self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.preferred_cross_size
    }

    fn computed_cross_min_size(&self, index: usize) -> &'pass ComputedSize {
        self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.min_cross_size
    }

    fn computed_cross_max_size(&self, index: usize) -> &'pass ComputedSize {
        self.flex_item_details[index].inputs.max_cross_size
    }

    fn container_computed_main_size(&self) -> &'pass ComputedSize {
        let style = self.container.style;
        self.select_main(style.width(), style.height())
    }

    fn container_computed_cross_min_size(&self) -> (&'pass ComputedSize, SizingProperty) {
        let style = self.container.style;
        self.select_cross(
            (style.min_width(), SizingProperty::MinWidth),
            (style.min_height(), SizingProperty::MinHeight),
        )
    }

    fn container_computed_cross_max_size(&self) -> (&'pass ComputedSize, SizingProperty) {
        let style = self.container.style;
        self.select_cross(
            (style.max_width(), SizingProperty::MaxWidth),
            (style.max_height(), SizingProperty::MaxHeight),
        )
    }

    fn calculate_inner_size(
        &self,
        index: usize,
        axis: SizingAxis,
        value: &ComputedSize,
        available_space: AvailableSpace,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        let sized = sizing_context::SizedBox::new(self.flex_items[index].box_, &self.flex_item_details[index].cells);
        let constraints = self.item_containing_block_constraints();
        match axis {
            SizingAxis::Inline => {
                self.sizing()
                    .calculate_inner_inline_size(sized, available_space.inline_size, value, constraints)
            }
            SizingAxis::Block => self
                .sizing()
                .calculate_inner_block_size(sized, available_space, value, constraints),
        }
    }

    fn calculate_inner_size_with_constraints(
        &self,
        sized: sizing_context::SizedBox<'_>,
        axis: SizingAxis,
        property: SizingProperty,
        available_space: AvailableSpace,
        constraints: ContainingBlockConstraints,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        self.sizing()
            .calculate_inner_size_for_property(sized, axis, property, available_space, constraints)
    }

    fn resolve_inner_inline_size(&self, index: usize, value: &ComputedSize) -> CssPixels {
        self.calculate_inner_size(
            index,
            SizingAxis::Inline,
            value,
            AvailableSpace {
                inline_size: self.available_space.unwrap().inline_size,
                block_size: AvailableSize::Indefinite,
            },
        )
    }

    fn resolve_inner_block_size(&self, index: usize, value: &ComputedSize) -> CssPixels {
        // NOTE: When the main axis is horizontal, after we've determined the main size, we use that as the
        //       available inline size for any intrinsic sizing layout needed to resolve the block size.
        let available_space = if self.main_axis_is_horizontal() && value.is_intrinsic_sizing_constraint() {
            AvailableSpace {
                inline_size: self.flex_items[index]
                    .main_size
                    .map(|size| AvailableSize::definite(clamp_to_max_dimension_value(size)))
                    .unwrap_or(AvailableSize::Indefinite),
                block_size: AvailableSize::Indefinite,
            }
        } else {
            self.available_space.unwrap()
        };
        self.calculate_inner_size(index, SizingAxis::Block, value, available_space)
    }

    fn resolve_size_for_axis(&self, index: usize, axis_is_horizontal: bool, value: &ComputedSize) -> CssPixels {
        if axis_is_horizontal {
            self.resolve_inner_inline_size(index, value)
        } else {
            self.resolve_inner_block_size(index, value)
        }
    }

    fn calculate_fit_content_size(&self, index: usize, axis: SizingAxis, space: AvailableSpace) -> CssPixels {
        self.sizing().calculate_fit_content_size(
            sizing_context::SizedBox::new(self.flex_items[index].box_, &self.flex_item_details[index].cells),
            axis,
            space,
            self.item_containing_block_constraints(),
        )
    }

    fn should_treat_size_as_auto(&self, sized: sizing_context::SizedBox<'_>, axis: SizingAxis) -> bool {
        self.sizing().should_treat_size_as_auto(
            sized,
            axis,
            self.available_space_for_items.unwrap().space,
            self.item_containing_block_constraints(),
        )
    }

    fn should_treat_main_size_as_auto(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        self.should_treat_size_as_auto(
            sizing_context::SizedBox::new(self.flex_items[index].box_, &self.flex_item_details[index].cells),
            self.main_sizing_axis(),
        )
    }

    fn should_treat_cross_size_as_auto(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        self.should_treat_size_as_auto(
            sizing_context::SizedBox::new(self.flex_items[index].box_, &self.flex_item_details[index].cells),
            if self.cross_axis_is_horizontal() {
                SizingAxis::Inline
            } else {
                SizingAxis::Block
            },
        )
    }

    fn max_size_is_treated_as_none(
        &self,
        max_size: &ComputedSize,
        is_replaced_box: bool,
        axis_is_horizontal: bool,
        available: AvailableSize,
        constraints: ContainingBlockConstraints,
    ) -> bool {
        if axis_is_horizontal {
            sizing_context::SizingContext::max_inline_size_value_is_treated_as_none(
                max_size,
                || is_replaced_box,
                available,
                constraints,
            )
        } else {
            sizing_context::SizingContext::max_block_size_value_is_treated_as_none(max_size, available, constraints)
        }
    }

    fn resolve_whether_max_sizes_of_items_are_treated_as_none(&mut self) {
        let available = self.available_space_for_items.unwrap();
        let constraints = self.item_containing_block_constraints();
        let main_axis_is_horizontal = self.main_axis_is_horizontal();
        for index in 0..self.flex_items.len() {
            let inputs = self.flex_item_details[index].inputs;
            let max_main_size_is_none = self.max_size_is_treated_as_none(
                inputs.max_main_size,
                inputs.is_replaced_box,
                main_axis_is_horizontal,
                available.main,
                constraints,
            );
            let max_cross_size_is_none = self.max_size_is_treated_as_none(
                inputs.max_cross_size,
                inputs.is_replaced_box,
                !main_axis_is_horizontal,
                available.cross,
                constraints,
            );
            let item = &mut self.flex_items[index];
            item.max_main_size_is_none = max_main_size_is_none;
            item.max_cross_size_is_none = max_cross_size_is_none;
        }
    }

    fn should_treat_max_size_as_none(&self, index: usize, cross: bool) -> bool {
        let item = &self.flex_items[index];
        if cross {
            item.max_cross_size_is_none
        } else {
            item.max_main_size_is_none
        }
    }

    fn should_treat_max_inline_size_as_none(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        self.should_treat_max_size_as_none(index, self.cross_axis_is_horizontal())
    }

    fn container_should_treat_max_cross_size_as_none(&self) -> bool {
        let (max_cross_size, _) = self.container_computed_cross_max_size();
        self.max_size_is_treated_as_none(
            max_cross_size,
            self.facts(self.run.box_).is_replaced_box(),
            self.cross_axis_is_horizontal(),
            self.available_space_for_items.unwrap().cross,
            self.layout_input.as_ref().unwrap().containing_block_constraints,
        )
    }

    fn has_main_min_size(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
