                arena.request_fragment_overflow_recalculation_of_containing_block(root);
            }
        }
        notifications
    }
}

/// The full layout stage: computes the fragments of the document from its viewport, without the
/// host.
fn compute_root_layout(input: LayoutStageInput<'_>, should_collect_devtools_layout_data: bool) -> LayoutStageOutput {
    let LayoutStageInput {
        arena,
        scratch,
        root,
        stage,
    } = input;
    let host_findings_outside_runs = super::run_state::HostFindingsSink::default();
    let mut pass = LayoutPass::new(arena, scratch, &host_findings_outside_runs, stage);
    if !should_collect_devtools_layout_data {
        pass = pass.forking_runs();
    }
    let viewport_inline_size = stage.viewport_inline_size;
    let viewport_block_size = stage.viewport_block_size;

    let root_constraints = ContainingBlockConstraints {
        percentage_basis_inline_size: Some(viewport_inline_size),
        percentage_basis_block_size: Some(viewport_block_size),
        ..ContainingBlockConstraints::default()
    };
    RunState::with_root_building_fragments(
        pass,
        root,
        Node::INVALID,
        None,
        Some(fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder::new_entry_accumulator(&pass, root)),
        |entry_run_state, pass| {
            let _trace = scratch.layout_trace.pass(None);
            let entry_fragments = entry_run_state
                .fragments()
                .expect("an entry pass accumulates fragments");
            let entry_run = FormattingContextRun::new(
                entry_run_state,
                root,
                pass,
                RunMode::Commit {
                    devtools: should_collect_devtools_layout_data,
                },
                false,
                None,
            );

            let first_child = pass.first_child(root);
            let root_for_layout = if !first_child.is_invalid() && NodeFacts::new(&pass, first_child).is_svg_svg_box() {
                let mut viewport_cells = used_values::cells_before_sizing(&pass, root, root_constraints);
                viewport_cells.set_content_inline_size(viewport_inline_size);
                viewport_cells.set_content_block_size(viewport_block_size);
                place_child(
                    &entry_run,
                    root,
                    PlacedChild::new(fragment_tree::FragmentGeometry {
                        cells: viewport_cells,
                        line_data: None,
                    }),
                    FfiCssPixelPoint::default(),
                    None,
                    None,
                );
                first_child
            } else {
                root
            };
            let mut root_cells = used_values::cells_before_sizing(&pass, root_for_layout, root_constraints);
            root_cells.set_content_inline_size(viewport_inline_size);
            root_cells.set_content_block_size(viewport_block_size);
            root_cells.has_definite_block_size = true;
            if root_for_layout != root {
                svg_formatting_context::size_document_element_svg_from_its_width_and_height(
                    &pass,
                    root_for_layout,
                    &mut root_cells,
                );
            }
            let input = LayoutInput::new(
                AvailableSpace {
                    inline_size: AvailableSize::definite(viewport_inline_size),
                    block_size: AvailableSize::definite(viewport_block_size),
                },
                ContainingBlockConstraints::default(),
                ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Root,
            );
            let request = RunRequest::new(
                &pass,
                root_for_layout,
                independent_formatting_context_type(root_for_layout, &pass),
                input,
                root_cells,
                pass.in_flow_containing_block(root_for_layout),
                RunCaller::Parent {
                    collects_fragments: true,
                },
                should_collect_devtools_layout_data,
            );
            let root_layout = run_formatting_context(pass, request, RunSideInputs::default());
            place_child(
                &entry_run,
                root_for_layout,
                root_layout.placed_child(),
                FfiCssPixelPoint::default(),
                None,
                root_layout.into_fragment_arrival(&entry_run),
            );
            finish_entry_pass(
                entry_run_state,
                entry_fragments,
                &pass,
                &host_findings_outside_runs,
                should_collect_devtools_layout_data,
            )
        },
    )
}

/// Brings the arena up to date for a stage before the stage borrows it: a root stage covers whatever kept pending
/// updates from a partial relayout, and the stage's memos take the arena's memo invalidations.
fn prepare_layout_stage(state: &mut super::ArenaHandle, kind: LayoutStageKind) {
    let (arena, scratch) = state.arena_mut_and_layout_scratch();
    if matches!(kind, LayoutStageKind::Root { .. }) {
        arena.clear_partial_relayout_escape();
    }
    arena.mark_container_length_readers_whose_bases_moved_for_layout();
    scratch.apply_memo_invalidations(arena);
    scratch.layout_trace.take_over_from(&mut arena.layout_trace);
    arena.begin_active_layout_pass();
}

fn finish_entry_pass(
    entry_run_state: &RunState,
    entry_fragments: &fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder,
    pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
    host_findings_outside_runs: &super::run_state::HostFindingsSink,
    should_collect_devtools_layout_data: bool,
) -> LayoutStageOutput {
    abspos_engine::drain_abspos_with_placed_containing_blocks(
        entry_run_state,
        *pass,
        should_collect_devtools_layout_data,
        entry_fragments,
    );
    let pass_fragments = entry_fragments.take_completed_pass(pass);
    debug_assert!(
        !pass_fragments.roots.is_empty(),
        "an entry pass always produces the entry root's fragment"
    );
    let mut host_findings = host_findings_outside_runs.take();
    if let Some(found_by_entry_run) = entry_run_state.take_host_findings() {
        host_findings.receive(*found_by_entry_run);
    }
    LayoutStageOutput {
        fragments: pass_fragments,
        host_findings,
    }
}

/// The partial layout stage: computes the fragments of one partial relayout boundary in place,
/// without the host, in the containing block the planner found the boundary still has.
fn compute_subtree_layout_fragments(input: LayoutStageInput<'_>, containing_block: NodeSlotId) -> LayoutStageOutput {
    let LayoutStageInput {
        arena,
        scratch,
        root,
        stage,
    } = input;
    let host_findings_outside_runs = super::run_state::HostFindingsSink::default();
    let pass = LayoutPass::new(arena, scratch, &host_findings_outside_runs, stage).forking_runs();

    // NB: Either way, the boundary root's own geometry lies in the frame of its containing block.
    let pass = if containing_block.is_invalid() {
        pass
    } else {
        pass.in_frame_of(frame_established_by(&pass, containing_block).writing_mode())
    };

    // Abspos boundaries recompute their size and position in their containing block's space.
    // In-flow SVG boundaries keep their committed geometry and lay out only their contents.
    let root_is_absolutely_positioned = NodeFacts::new(&pass, root).is_absolutely_positioned();
    let (entry_root, entry_root_containing_block) = if root_is_absolutely_positioned {
        (containing_block, NodeSlotId::INVALID)
    } else {
        (root, containing_block)
    };
    RunState::with_root_building_fragments(
        pass,
        entry_root,
        entry_root_containing_block,
        None,
        Some(fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder::new_entry_accumulator(
            &pass, entry_root,
        )),
        |entry_run_state, pass| {
            let _trace = scratch.layout_trace.pass(Some(root));
            let entry_fragments = entry_run_state
                .fragments()
                .expect("an entry pass accumulates fragments");
            let entry_run = FormattingContextRun::new(
                entry_run_state,
                entry_root,
                pass,
                RunMode::Commit { devtools: false },
                false,
                None,
            );
            if root_is_absolutely_positioned {
                abspos_engine::AbsposEngine::for_run(&entry_run).replay(&entry_run, root);
            } else {
                layout_subtree_with_frozen_root_geometry(&entry_run);
            }
            finish_entry_pass(
                entry_run_state,
                entry_fragments,
                &pass,
                &host_findings_outside_runs,
                false,
            )
        },
    )
}

fn layout_subtree_with_frozen_root_geometry(run: &FormattingContextRun<'_>) {
    let root = run.box_;
    let pass = &run.pass;
    let committed_root_link = pass
        .committed_fragment_link(root)
        .expect("partial relayout root must have committed geometry");
    let root_cells = used_values::RootInputCells::of_committed_fragment_link(&committed_root_link, pass.frame);
    let fragments = run.fragments.expect("partial relayout must build fragments");
    let input = LayoutInput::new(
        AvailableSpace {
            inline_size: AvailableSize::definite(root_cells.content_inline_size),
            block_size: AvailableSize::definite(root_cells.content_block_size),
        },
        // The subtree root has definite sizes in both axes, so boxes
        // below it do not need inherited percentage constraints.
        ContainingBlockConstraints::default(),
        ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Root,
    );

    let facts = NodeFacts::new(pass, root);
    debug_assert!(facts.is_svg_svg_box());
    let fc_type = formatting_context_type_created_by_box(facts)
        .expect("partial relayout root must establish an independent formatting context");
    let request = RunRequest::new(
        pass,
        root,
        fc_type,
        input,
        root_cells,
        pass.in_flow_containing_block(root),
        RunCaller::Parent {
            collects_fragments: true,
        },
        run.collects_devtools_layout_data(),
    );
    let root_layout = run_formatting_context(*pass, request, RunSideInputs::default());
    assert_eq!(
        sizes_and_box_sides(root_layout.cells()),
        sizes_and_box_sides(root_cells),
        "the run of {root:?} changed the committed geometry of its root"
    );
    let root_geometry = root_layout.placed_child().geometry;
    let fragment_arrival = root_layout.into_fragment_arrival(run);
    let facts_decided_by_parent = run_state::FactsDecidedByParent::of_committed_link(
        &committed_root_link,
        pass.frame,
        fragment_tree::committed_content_size_of(pass, committed_root_link.placement.containing_block),
    );
    let placement = facts_decided_by_parent
        .placement
        .expect("the root of a partial relayout keeps the placement it committed");
    let Some(run_root_fragment) = fragment_arrival else {
        panic!("the root of a partial relayout is laid out by a run of its own");
    };
    fragments.take_in_child_root_at_placement(root, run_root_fragment, pass);
    // The retained offset already includes relative positioning. Publish it directly instead
    // of applying placement adjustments a second time.
    fragments.note_placed_box(
        &run.pass,
        root,
        placement,
        cells_kept_for_contained_abspos(run, root, || root_geometry.cells),
    );
    fragments.build_fragment_for_placed_box(
        pass,
        root,
        None,
        root_geometry,
        facts_decided_by_parent,
        None,
        None,
        placement.content_offset_in_containing_block,
        None,
        FfiCssPixelPoint::default(),
    );
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod baseline_tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::css_enums::keyword;
    use crate::css::display::FfiDisplay;
    use crate::css::style::layout_style::LayoutScratchStyle;
    use crate::layout::layout_node_arena::LayoutNodeArena;
    use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeConstructionFacts, NodeKind};
    use crate::layout::run_state::LayoutScratch;

    #[test]
    fn block_derivation_preserves_flex_last_baseline() {
        check_block_derivation(keyword::FLEX);
    }

    #[test]
    fn block_derivation_preserves_grid_last_baseline() {
        check_block_derivation(keyword::GRID);
    }

    fn check_block_derivation(display: u16) {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let scratch = LayoutScratch::default();
        let parent_style = LayoutScratchStyle::over_defaults(|style| style.box_mut().display = FfiDisplay::block());
        let child_style = LayoutScratchStyle::over_defaults(|style| {
            style.box_mut().display = FfiDisplay::from_single_keyword(display).unwrap();
        });
        let facts = NodeConstructionFacts {
            kind: NodeKind::BlockContainer,
            is_anonymous: false,
            is_html_input_element: false,
            is_html_html_element: false,
            is_document_element: false,
            is_in_user_agent_shadow_tree: false,
            uses_button_layout: false,
            is_editing_host: false,
            is_body: false,
            dom_paint_facts: 0,
            style_node: 0,
        };
        let parent = arena.allocate(facts);
        let child = arena.allocate(facts);
        arena.set_node_style(parent, 0, Some(parent_style.style()));
        arena.set_node_style(child, 0, Some(child_style.style()));
        arena.insert_child(parent, child, Node::INVALID);
        let host_findings_outside_runs = super::run_state::HostFindingsSink::default();
        let pass = LayoutPass::new(
            &arena,
            &scratch,
            &host_findings_outside_runs,
            LayoutStageFacts {
                viewport_inline_size: CssPixels::from_integer(800),
                viewport_block_size: CssPixels::from_integer(600),
                document_in_quirks_mode: false,
                document_in_limited_quirks_mode: false,
            },
        );
        RunState::with_root(pass, parent, Node::INVALID, None, |_, pass| {
            let child_cells = used_values::RootInputCells::default();
            assert!(child_gives_container_baselines(&pass, parent, child));
            let mut baselines = DerivedBaselines::default();
            baselines.fold_in_later_child(baselines_laid_out_child_gives_container(
                &pass,
                LaidOutChild {
                    node: child,
                    metrics: &child_cells,
                    content_baselines: DerivedBaselines {
                        first: Some(CssPixels::from_integer(10)),
                        last: Some(CssPixels::from_integer(30)),
                        inline_alignment: None,
                    },
                    content_offset: FfiCssPixelPoint::default(),
                },
            ));
            assert_eq!(baselines.first, Some(CssPixels::from_integer(10)));
            assert_eq!(baselines.last, Some(CssPixels::from_integer(30)));
            assert_eq!(baselines.inline_alignment, Some(CssPixels::from_integer(10)));
        });
        arena
            .free_subtree(parent)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&crate::stage::MainThread::for_test());
    }
}

use crate::cow_map::CowMap;
use crate::css::css_enums::{overflow, positioning, writing_mode};
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::css::display::FfiDisplay;
use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::layout::fragment_tree::{Fragment, FragmentLink, OuterLinks, SvgPayload};
use crate::layout::geometry::{Frame, Side, Sides};
use crate::layout::inline_content::{InlineContent, PhysicalPlane};
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeFlag, NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::layout::node_facts::{self, NodeShape};
use crate::layout::svg_formatting_context::SvgGeometry;
use crate::layout::used_transform::TransformGeometry;
use crate::layout::used_values::FfiCssPixelSize;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead, PaintRow};
use crate::painting::scrollable_overflow::physical_overflow_directions_of_style;
use crate::painting::visual_context::node_values;
use crate::painting::{node_painting, scroll_snap, style_queries};
use libgfx_rust::AffineTransform;
use smallvec::SmallVec;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct FragmentScrollableOverflow {
    pub(crate) rect_relative_to_padding_box: CssPixelRect,
    pub(crate) has_scrollable_overflow: bool,
}

fn inflated_by(rect: CssPixelRect, sides: Sides) -> CssPixelRect {
    rect.inflated(sides.top, sides.right, sides.bottom, sides.left)
}

/// The physical border box of `fragment` around its physical content box `content_box`.
pub(crate) fn physical_border_box_around(content_box: CssPixelRect, fragment: &Fragment) -> CssPixelRect {
    inflated_by(
        inflated_by(content_box, fragment.sides.padding),
        fragment.sides.border_box_edges(),
    )
}

struct BoxesRelativeToOwnPaddingBox {
    content_size: FfiCssPixelSize,
    padding_box: CssPixelRect,
    content_box: CssPixelRect,
    border_box: CssPixelRect,
}

impl BoxesRelativeToOwnPaddingBox {
    fn of(fragment: &Fragment) -> Self {
        let content_size = fragment.sides.content_size;
        let padding = fragment.sides.padding;
        let content_box = CssPixelRect::new(padding.left, padding.top, content_size.width, content_size.height);
        let padding_box = inflated_by(content_box, padding);
        Self {
            content_size,
            padding_box,
            content_box,
            border_box: inflated_by(padding_box, fragment.sides.border_box_edges()),
        }
    }
}

struct ContainedBoxesRelativeToContainerPaddingBox {
    content_box: CssPixelRect,
    padding_box: CssPixelRect,
    border_box: CssPixelRect,
}

impl ContainedBoxesRelativeToContainerPaddingBox {
    fn of(link: &FragmentLink, container: &BoxesRelativeToOwnPaddingBox) -> Self {
        let fragment = &link.fragment;
        let content_box = CssPixelRect::from_location_and_size(link.offset.into(), fragment.sides.content_size.into())
            .translated_by(container.content_box.location());
        let padding_box = inflated_by(content_box, fragment.sides.padding);
        Self {
            content_box,
            padding_box,
            border_box: inflated_by(padding_box, fragment.sides.border_box_edges()),
        }
    }
}

struct ContainedBoxTransformGeometry<'boxes> {
    contained: &'boxes ContainedBoxesRelativeToContainerPaddingBox,
    container: &'boxes BoxesRelativeToOwnPaddingBox,
    svg: Option<&'boxes SvgPayload>,
}

impl TransformGeometry for ContainedBoxTransformGeometry<'_> {
    fn content_box(&self) -> CssPixelRect {
        self.contained.content_box
    }

    fn border_box(&self) -> CssPixelRect {
        self.contained.border_box
    }

    fn scrollable_overflow_rect(&self) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
        None
    }

    fn svg_geometry(&self) -> Option<SvgGeometry> {
        self.svg.map(|svg| svg.geometry)
    }

    fn containing_block_box(&self, coord_box: u16) -> CssPixelRect {
        use crate::css::css_enums::keyword;
        match coord_box {
            keyword::CONTENT_BOX | keyword::FILL_BOX => self.container.content_box,
            keyword::PADDING_BOX => self.container.padding_box,
            _ => self.container.border_box,
        }
    }

    fn svg_additional_element_transform(&self) -> Option<AffineTransform> {
        self.svg?.facts.additional_element_transform.map(Into::into)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn contained_links(fragment: &Fragment) -> impl Iterator<Item = &FragmentLink> {
    let node = fragment.node;
    fragment.children.iter().flat_map(move |link| {
        let outer_links = (link.fragment.outer_links != OuterLinks::None)
            .then_some(&link.fragment.children)
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter(move |outer_link| outer_link.placement.containing_block == node);
        (link.placement.containing_block == node)
            .then_some(link)
            .into_iter()
            .chain(outer_links)
    })
}

pub(crate) fn include_links_held_beside_their_containing_blocks(
    arena: &LayoutNodeArena,
    run_root: NodeSlotId,
    links: &mut [FragmentLink],
) {
    let mut held_beside: crate::fast_hash::FastMap<NodeSlotId, smallvec::SmallVec<[usize; 2]>> = Default::default();
    for (index, link) in links.iter().enumerate() {
        if !link.placement.containing_block.is_invalid() && link.placement.containing_block != run_root {
            held_beside
                .entry(link.placement.containing_block)
                .or_default()
                .push(index);
        }
    }
    for index in 0..links.len() {
        let Some(held_beside_indices) = held_beside.get(&links[index].fragment.node) else {
            continue;
        };
        let fragment = &links[index].fragment;
        let overflow = scrollable_overflow_of(
            arena,
            fragment,
            contained_links(fragment).chain(held_beside_indices.iter().map(|&held| &links[held])),
        );
        if overflow != fragment.scrollable_overflow {
            links[index].fragment = std::sync::Arc::new(fragment.with_scrollable_overflow(overflow));
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn holds_links_of_outer_containing_blocks(node: NodeSlotId, children: &[FragmentLink]) -> bool {
    children
        .iter()
        .any(|link| !link.placement.containing_block.is_invalid() && link.placement.containing_block != node)
}

// NB: The nearest line-clamp container among a hidden box's ancestors is the one whose formatting context hid it.
fn hidden_content_is_scrollable_overflow(
    arena: &LayoutNodeArena,
    fragment_being_built: &Fragment,
    hidden_box: NodeSlotId,
) -> bool {
    let mut ancestor = arena.node_parent_if_live(hidden_box);
    while let Some(node) = ancestor {
        if node == fragment_being_built.node {
            if fragment_being_built.line_clamp.has_line_clamp_point {
                return fragment_being_built.line_clamp.clamped_content_is_scrollable_overflow;
            }
        } else if let Some(keeps_clamped_content) = line_clamp_container_keeps_clamped_content_scrollable(arena, node) {
            return keeps_clamped_content;
        }
        ancestor = arena.node_parent_if_live(node);
    }
    false
}

fn line_clamp_container_keeps_clamped_content_scrollable(arena: &LayoutNodeArena, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<bool> {
    use crate::css::css_enums::{continue_value, webkit_box_orient};
    let style = arena.node_style_if_live(node)?;
    let computed_continue = style.continue_();
    // AD-HOC: Content after a -webkit-legacy clamp point stays scrollable overflow, matching other engines.
    let is_webkit_legacy_line_clamp_container = computed_continue == continue_value::_WEBKIT_LEGACY
        && style.display_before_box_type_transformation().is_webkit_box_inside()
        && style.webkit_box_orient() == webkit_box_orient::VERTICAL;
    let is_line_clamp_container = (computed_continue == continue_value::COLLAPSE
        || is_webkit_legacy_line_clamp_container)
        && !node_facts::node_lays_out_in_columns(arena.data(node), style);
    is_line_clamp_container.then_some(is_webkit_legacy_line_clamp_container)
}

struct InlineBoxUnions {
    padding_box: CssPixelRect,
    border_box: CssPixelRect,
}

fn inline_box_unions(
    plane: &PhysicalPlane<'_>,
    content: &InlineContent,
    link: &FragmentLink,
    content_origin: CssPixelPoint,
) -> Option<InlineBoxUnions> {
    let padding_widths = link.fragment.sides.padding;
    let border_widths = link.fragment.sides.border;
    let unite = |union: &mut Option<CssPixelRect>, rect: CssPixelRect| match union {
        None => *union = Some(rect),
        Some(_) if rect.is_empty() => {}
        Some(current) if current.is_empty() => *current = rect,
        Some(current) => current.unite(rect),
    };
    let mut padding_union = None;
    let mut border_union = None;
    for &piece_index in content.inline_boxes.piece_indices_of(link.fragment.node) {
        let piece = &content.inline_box_pieces[piece_index as usize];
        // An interrupting block's placeholder records inline geometry; the block supplies its own overflow.
        if piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder && piece.fragment_count != 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let border_rect = plane.piece_border_box_rect(piece);
        if piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder {
            let padding_rect = inflated_by(border_rect, padding_widths);
            unite(&mut padding_union, padding_rect);
            unite(&mut border_union, inflated_by(padding_rect, border_widths));
            continue;
        }
        let physical_piece = crate::layout::inline_content::InlineBoxPieceRecord {
            present_edges: plane.piece_present_edges(piece),
            ..*piece
        };
        unite(
            &mut padding_union,
            physical_piece.shrunken_by_present_edges(border_rect, border_widths.into()),
        );
        unite(&mut border_union, border_rect);
    }
    Some(InlineBoxUnions {
        padding_box: padding_union?.translated_by(content_origin),
        border_box: border_union?.translated_by(content_origin),
    })
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overflow-3/#scrollable-overflow-calculation
pub(crate) fn scrollable_overflow_of<'link>(
    arena: &LayoutNodeArena,
    fragment: &Fragment,
    contained_links: impl Iterator<Item = &'link FragmentLink>,
) -> FragmentScrollableOverflow {
    let node = fragment.node;
    let own = BoxesRelativeToOwnPaddingBox::of(fragment);
    let Some(row) = GeometryRead::node(arena, node) else {
        return FragmentScrollableOverflow {
            rect_relative_to_padding_box: own.padding_box,
            has_scrollable_overflow: false,
        };
    };
    let kind = row.kind();
    let style = row.style();

    // Replaced SVG viewports clip their content
    if kind == NodeKind::SVGSVGBox {
        return FragmentScrollableOverflow {
            rect_relative_to_padding_box: own.padding_box,
            has_scrollable_overflow: false,
        };
    }

    let box_is_scroll_container = node_facts::kind_and_style_make_scroll_container(kind, style);
    let line_clamp = fragment.line_clamp;
    let line_clamp_clip =
        (line_clamp.has_line_clamp_point && !line_clamp.clamped_content_is_scrollable_overflow).then(|| {
            Frame::of(style.map_or(writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB, |style| style.writing_mode()))
                .half_plane_before_block_end(own.content_size)
                .translated_by(own.content_box.location())
        });
    let clip_in_flow = |rect: CssPixelRect| line_clamp_clip.map_or(rect, |clip| rect.intersected(clip));
    let overflow_directions = style.map_or_else(Default::default, physical_overflow_directions_of_style);

    // The scrollable overflow area of a box is the union of:

    // - Its own padding box.
    let mut scrollable_overflow_rect = own.padding_box;
    let mut in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds = own.content_box;

    // - All line boxes it directly contains.
    let line_content = fragment
        .line_data
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|_| node_painting::has_lines(arena, node));
    let plane = line_content.map(|content| PhysicalPlane::of(content, own.content_size));
    if let (Some(content), Some(plane)) = (line_content, &plane) {
        let origin = own.content_box.location();
        // A block that interrupts inline layout contributes through its own transformed box. Its line record and
        // inline fragments describe its untransformed position, not an additional CSS line box.
        let line_rects = content
            .lines
            .iter()
            .filter(|line| !line.has_block_level_box)
            .map(|line| plane.rect(line.rect));
        let elided_content_rects = content.elided_content_rects.iter().map(|&(_, rect)| plane.rect(rect));
        let lines_after_clamp_point = content
            .lines_after_clamp_point_rect
            .as_deref()
            .map(|&rect| plane.rect(rect));
        for line_rect in line_rects.chain(elided_content_rects).chain(lines_after_clamp_point) {
            let line_rect = line_rect.translated_by(origin);
            scrollable_overflow_rect.unite(line_rect);
            in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds.unite_horizontally(line_rect);
            in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds.unite_vertically(line_rect);
        }
        for text_fragment in &content.fragments {
            if content.lines[text_fragment.line_index as usize].has_block_level_box {
                continue;
            }
            let mut fragment_rect = plane.fragment_rect(text_fragment).translated_by(origin);
            if arena.node_is_in_focused_text_control(text_fragment.layout_node)
                && let Some(style_source_style) = arena.node_style_if_live(text_fragment.style_source)
            {
                // NB: Reserve one pixel of reachable inline-axis overflow for an end-of-line caret. This keeps the
                //     caret at its insertion position while allowing a text control to scroll the painted bar fully
                //     into view, matching the caret overflow accounted for by other engines.
                let one = CssPixels::from_integer(1);
                if style_source_style.writing_mode() == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB {
                    if style_source_style.inline_axis_is_reverse() {
                        fragment_rect.set_left(fragment_rect.left() - one);
                    } else {
                        fragment_rect.set_right(fragment_rect.right() + one);
                    }
                } else if style_source_style.inline_axis_is_reverse() {
                    fragment_rect.set_top(fragment_rect.top() - one);
                } else {
                    fragment_rect.set_bottom(fragment_rect.bottom() + one);
                }
            }
            fragment_rect = clip_in_flow(fragment_rect);
            scrollable_overflow_rect.unite(fragment_rect);
            in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds.unite(fragment_rect);
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-grid-2/#overflow
    // The grid is also included in a grid container's scrollable overflow region.
    // INTEROP: Blink only does this when the grid container is a scroll container, so the grid does not reach the
    //          scrollable overflow of its ancestors.
    if box_is_scroll_container && let Some(tracks) = fragment.grid().and_then(|grid| grid.used_tracks.as_ref()) {
        let grid_area = tracks.grid_area.translated_by(own.content_box.location());
        // NB: A grid with tracks in one axis only, e.g. columns but no rows, still reaches the overflow in that axis.
        if grid_area.width > CssPixels::default() {
            scrollable_overflow_rect.unite_horizontally(grid_area);
            in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds.unite_horizontally(grid_area);
        }
        if grid_area.height > CssPixels::default() {
            scrollable_overflow_rect.unite_vertically(grid_area);
            in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds.unite_vertically(grid_area);
        }
    }

    // - The border boxes of all boxes for which it is the containing block and whose border boxes are positioned not
    //   wholly in the negative scrollable overflow region,
    //   FIXME: accounting for 3D transforms by projecting each box onto the plane of the element that establishes
    //          its 3D rendering context. [CSS3-TRANSFORMS]
    let container_inline_axis_is_horizontal =
        style.is_none_or(|style| style.writing_mode() == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB);
    let container_frame = Frame::of(style.map_or(writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB, |style| style.writing_mode()));
    for link in contained_links {
        let child = &link.fragment;
        let child_node = child.node;
        let Some(child_row) = GeometryRead::node(arena, child_node) else {
            continue;
        };
        if !node_facts::kind_is_box(child_row.kind()) {
            continue;
        }

        let child_style = child_row.style();
        let child_position = child_style.map_or(positioning::STATIC, |style| style.position());
        let child_is_absolutely_positioned = matches!(child_position, positioning::ABSOLUTE | positioning::FIXED);

        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position/#fixed-positioning-containing-block
        // [..] As a result, parts of fixed-positioned boxes that extend outside the layout viewport/page area
        //      cannot be scrolled to and will not print.
        // FIXME: Properly establish the fixed positioning containing block for `position: fixed`
        if child_position == positioning::FIXED {
            continue;
        }
        if link.placement.shown_as.facts.is_invisible_for_line_clamp
            && !hidden_content_is_scrollable_overflow(arena, fragment, child_node)
        {
            continue;
        }

        let child_has_css_transform =
            child_style.is_some_and(|style| style_queries::has_css_transform(arena, child_node, style));
        let child_flags = child_row.flags();
        let child_is_flex_or_grid_item = child_flags & (NodeFlag::IsFlexItem as u32 | NodeFlag::IsGridItem as u32) != 0;
        let child_is_floating = !child_is_flex_or_grid_item && child_style.is_some_and(|style| style.is_floating());
        let child_display = child_style.map_or_else(FfiDisplay::block, |style| style.display());
        let child_is_fragmented_inline = child_row.is_fragmented_inline();

        let mut contained = ContainedBoxesRelativeToContainerPaddingBox::of(link, &own);
        if child_is_fragmented_inline {
            let (Some(content), Some(plane)) = (line_content, &plane) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(unions) = inline_box_unions(plane, content, link, own.content_box.location()) else {
                continue;
            };
            contained.padding_box = unions.padding_box;
            contained.border_box = unions.border_box;
        }
        let untransformed_child_border_box = contained.border_box;
        // NB: Collect normal-flow bounds before filtering visible overflow, which relative positioning can move
        //     wholly before the scroll origin.
        let child_is_in_flow = !(child_is_floating || child_is_absolutely_positioned);
        if box_is_scroll_container && (child_is_in_flow || child_is_floating) {
            let mut normal_flow_border_box = untransformed_child_border_box;
            if child_position == positioning::RELATIVE {
                let inset = link.placement.insets;
                normal_flow_border_box = normal_flow_border_box.translated(-inset.left, -inset.top);
            }
            // INTEROP: The edges of in-flow and floated content, after which the container's end padding comes,
            //          are those of the margin boxes of block-level boxes, flex items and grid items, as in Blink:
            //          with their computed margins, auto counting as zero, and where they are laid out before
            //          relative positioning. Toward the end of the scrollable overflow a negative margin counts,
            //          but no further than the size of the box; toward its start, it does not.
            let child_is_block_level = child_is_flex_or_grid_item || !child_display.is_inline_outside();
            let content_box = match child_style {
                Some(style) if child_is_block_level || child_row.is_atomic_inline() => {
                    let border_box = normal_flow_border_box;
                    let margin = &style.surround().margin;
                    let basis = if container_inline_axis_is_horizontal {
                        own.content_size.width
                    } else {
                        own.content_size.height
                    };
                    let zero = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
                    // NB: An atomic inline's inline margins contribute even when its line box has zero area.
                    //     Its block-axis margins are already accounted for by the line box.
                    let (left, right) = if child_is_block_level || container_inline_axis_is_horizontal {
                        (margin.left.to_px(basis), margin.right.to_px(basis))
                    } else {
                        (zero, zero)
                    };
                    let (top, bottom) = if child_is_block_level || !container_inline_axis_is_horizontal {
                        (margin.top.to_px(basis), margin.bottom.to_px(basis))
                    } else {
                        (zero, zero)
                    };
                    // NB: Past the block end of a box in the flow of a block container, the margin that counts is
                    //     what that flow collapsed there, not the box's own: The margins of the box's contents that
                    //     collapse through its block end count too, and those that collapse through the box itself
                    //     count once.
                    let [top, right, bottom, left] =
                        match link.placement.shown_as.facts.block_end_margin_collapsed_in_flow {
                            Some(block_end_margin) => {
                                let mut margins = [top, right, bottom, left];
                                margins[container_frame.physical_side(Side::Bottom) as usize] = block_end_margin;
                                margins
                            }
                            None => [top, right, bottom, left],
                        };
                    let (left, right) = if overflow_directions.horizontal_axis_is_positive {
                        (left.max(zero), right.max(-border_box.width))
                    } else {
                        (left.max(-border_box.width), right.max(zero))
                    };
                    let (top, bottom) = if overflow_directions.vertical_axis_is_positive {
                        (top.max(zero), bottom.max(-border_box.height))
                    } else {
                        (top.max(-border_box.height), bottom.max(zero))
                    };
                    border_box.inflated(top, right, bottom, left)
                }
                _ => normal_flow_border_box,
            };
            // NB: Empty boxes still contribute their extents to the padding alignment bounds.
            in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds.unite_horizontally(content_box);
            in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds.unite_vertically(content_box);
        }
        let transform = child_has_css_transform
            .then(|| {
                node_values::compute_transform_against(
                    arena,
                    child_node,
                    &ContainedBoxTransformGeometry {
                        contained: &contained,
                        container: &own,
                        svg: child
                            .svg()
                            .filter(|_| style_queries::kind_is_svg_element_box(child_row.kind())),
                    },
                    1.0,
                )
            })
            .flatten()
            .map(|(transform, _is_invertible)| transform);
        let through_transform = |rect: CssPixelRect| {
            transform.as_ref().map_or(rect, |transform| {
                scroll_snap::map_rect_through_css_transform(transform.matrix, transform.origin, rect)
            })
        };
        let mut child_border_box = through_transform(untransformed_child_border_box);
        if !child_is_absolutely_positioned {
            child_border_box = clip_in_flow(child_border_box);
        }
        // INTEROP: Chrome and Firefox retain reachable overflow in each axis independently, even when
        //          the border box lies wholly in the other axis's unreachable region.
        let wholly_in_unreachable_horizontal_axis = if overflow_directions.horizontal_axis_is_positive {
            child_border_box.right() < own.padding_box.x
        } else {
            child_border_box.x > own.padding_box.right()
        };
        let wholly_in_unreachable_vertical_axis = if overflow_directions.vertical_axis_is_positive {
            child_border_box.bottom() < own.padding_box.y
        } else {
            child_border_box.y > own.padding_box.bottom()
        };
        if wholly_in_unreachable_horizontal_axis && wholly_in_unreachable_vertical_axis {
            continue;
        }

        // Border boxes with zero area do not affect the scrollable overflow area.
        if !child_border_box.is_empty() {
            if !wholly_in_unreachable_horizontal_axis {
                scrollable_overflow_rect.unite_horizontally(child_border_box);
            }
            if !wholly_in_unreachable_vertical_axis {
                scrollable_overflow_rect.unite_vertically(child_border_box);
            }
        }

        // - The scrollable overflow areas of all of the above boxes (including zero-area boxes and accounting for
        //   transforms as described above), provided they themselves have overflow: visible (i.e. do not themselves
        //   trap the overflow) and that scrollable overflow is not already clipped (e.g. by the clip property or the
        //   contain property).
        // Scrollable overflow is already clipped by the contain property.
        if child_style.is_some_and(|style| {
            style_queries::has_layout_containment(arena, child_node, style)
                || style_queries::has_paint_containment(arena, child_node, style)
        }) {
            continue;
        }

        let child_overflow_x = child_style.map_or(overflow::VISIBLE, |style| style.overflow_x());
        let child_overflow_y = child_style.map_or(overflow::VISIBLE, |style| style.overflow_y());
        if child_overflow_x == overflow::VISIBLE || child_overflow_y == overflow::VISIBLE {
            let untransformed_child_scrollable_overflow = child
                .scrollable_overflow
                .rect_relative_to_padding_box
                .translated_by(contained.padding_box.location());
            let mut child_scrollable_overflow = through_transform(untransformed_child_scrollable_overflow);
            if !child_is_absolutely_positioned {
                child_scrollable_overflow = clip_in_flow(child_scrollable_overflow);
            }
            if !child_scrollable_overflow.is_empty() {
                if child_overflow_x == overflow::VISIBLE && !wholly_in_unreachable_horizontal_axis {
                    scrollable_overflow_rect.unite_horizontally(child_scrollable_overflow);
                }
                if child_overflow_y == overflow::VISIBLE && !wholly_in_unreachable_vertical_axis {
                    scrollable_overflow_rect.unite_vertically(child_scrollable_overflow);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // FIXME: - The margin areas of grid item and flex item boxes for which the box establishes a containing block.

    // - Additional padding added to the scrollable overflow rectangle as necessary to enable scroll positions that
    //   satisfy the requirements of both place-content: start and place-content: end alignment.
    //
    // NOTE: This padding represents, within the scrollable overflow rectangle, the box’s own padding so that when its
    //       content is scrolled to its end, there is padding between the edge of its in-flow (or floated) content and
    //       the border edge of the box. It typically ends up being exactly the same size as the box's own padding,
    //       except in a few cases--such as when an out-of-flow positioned element, or the visible overflow of a
    //       descendent, has already increased the size of the scrollable overflow rectangle outside the conceptual
    //       “content edge” of the scroll container’s content.
    if box_is_scroll_container {
        // NB: The box's own padding surrounds its in-flow and floated content. Whatever of it falls inside the padding
        //     box, or in the unreachable scrollable overflow region, adds nothing. This matches Blink.
        scrollable_overflow_rect.unite(inflated_by(
            clip_in_flow(in_flow_and_floated_content_bounds),
            fragment.sides.padding,
        ));
    }

    let mut has_scrollable_overflow =
        box_is_scroll_container && !own.padding_box.contains_rect(scrollable_overflow_rect);

    // Additionally, due to Web-compatibility constraints (caused by authors exploiting legacy bugs to surreptitiously
    // hide content from visual readers but not search engines and/or speech output), UAs must clip any content in the
    // unreachable scrollable overflow region.
    //
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overflow-3/#unreachable-scrollable-overflow-region
    // Unless otherwise adjusted (e.g. by content alignment [css-align-3]), the area beyond the scroll origin in either
    // axis is considered the unreachable scrollable overflow region: content rendered here is not accessible to the
    // reader, see § 2.2 Scrollable Overflow.
    let left = if overflow_directions.horizontal_axis_is_positive {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.x.max(own.padding_box.x)
    } else {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.x
    };
    let top = if overflow_directions.vertical_axis_is_positive {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.y.max(own.padding_box.y)
    } else {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.y
    };
    let right = if overflow_directions.horizontal_axis_is_positive {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.right()
    } else {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.right().min(own.padding_box.right())
    };
    let bottom = if overflow_directions.vertical_axis_is_positive {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.bottom()
    } else {
        scrollable_overflow_rect.bottom().min(own.padding_box.bottom())
    };
    if left != scrollable_overflow_rect.x
        || top != scrollable_overflow_rect.y
        || right != scrollable_overflow_rect.right()
        || bottom != scrollable_overflow_rect.bottom()
    {
        let zero = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
        scrollable_overflow_rect = CssPixelRect::new(left, top, (right - left).max(zero), (bottom - top).max(zero));
        has_scrollable_overflow = !own.padding_box.contains_rect(scrollable_overflow_rect) && box_is_scroll_container;
    }

    FragmentScrollableOverflow {
        rect_relative_to_padding_box: scrollable_overflow_rect,
        has_scrollable_overflow,
    }
}

/// The boxes whose committed links a box other than their containing block holds, by the containing block they were
/// committed with, which a containing block reads its own from without walking every other one's.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct LinksHeldApartFromTheirContainingBlocks {
    containing_block_of: CowMap<NodeSlotId, NodeSlotId>,
    by_containing_block: CowMap<NodeSlotId, SmallVec<[NodeSlotId; 4]>>,
}

impl LinksHeldApartFromTheirContainingBlocks {
    fn insert(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId, containing_block: NodeSlotId) {
        match self.containing_block_of.insert(node, containing_block) {
            Some(previous) if previous == containing_block => return,
            Some(previous) => self.remove_from(previous, node),
            None => {}
        }
        self.by_containing_block
            .get_or_insert_with(containing_block, SmallVec::new)
            .push(node);
    }

    pub(super) fn remove(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        if let Some(containing_block) = self.containing_block_of.remove(&node) {
            self.remove_from(containing_block, node);
        }
    }

    fn remove_from(&mut self, containing_block: NodeSlotId, node: NodeSlotId) {
        let Some(nodes) = self.by_containing_block.get_mut(&containing_block) else {
            return;
        };
        if let Some(position) = nodes.iter().position(|held| *held == node) {
            nodes.swap_remove(position);
        }
        if nodes.is_empty() {
            self.by_containing_block.remove(&containing_block);
        }
    }

    fn held_apart_from(&self, containing_block: NodeSlotId) -> &[NodeSlotId] {
        self.by_containing_block
            .get(&containing_block)
            .map_or(&[], |nodes| nodes.as_slice())
    }

    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.containing_block_of.is_empty()
    }

    pub(crate) fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.containing_block_of.clear();
        self.by_containing_block.clear();
    }
}

impl LayoutNodeArena {
    pub(crate) fn request_fragment_overflow_recalculation(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        if !node.is_invalid() {
            self.scrollable_overflow.recalculation_requests.push(node);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_whether_link_is_held_apart_from_its_containing_block(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        containing_block: NodeSlotId,
        is_held_apart: bool,
    ) {
        if is_held_apart {
            self.links_held_apart_from_their_containing_blocks
                .insert(node, containing_block);
            self.request_fragment_overflow_recalculation(containing_block);
        } else if !self.links_held_apart_from_their_containing_blocks.is_empty() {
            self.links_held_apart_from_their_containing_blocks.remove(node);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn request_fragment_overflow_recalculation_of_containing_block(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        if self.slot_is_live(node) && self.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
            let containing_block = self.paintable_data(node).containing_block;
            self.request_fragment_overflow_recalculation(containing_block);
        }
    }

    fn committed_links_in_containing_block_fragment(
        &self,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        containing_block_fragment: u32,
        links: &mut Vec<FragmentLink>,
    ) {
        let side_data = self.committed_side_data(node);
        if side_data.containing_block_fragment == containing_block_fragment
            && let Some(link) = self
                .paintable_rows
                .committed_fragment_link_cloned(node.slot_index(), node.generation())
        {
            links.push(link);
        }
        links.extend(
            side_data
                .box_fragments()
                .iter()
                .filter(|fragment| fragment.containing_block_fragment == containing_block_fragment)
                .map(|fragment| fragment.link.clone()),
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn links_in_containing_block_fragment(
        &self,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        link: &FragmentLink,
        fragment_index: u32,
    ) -> Vec<FragmentLink> {
        let mut met = crate::fast_hash::FastSet::default();
        let mut contained = Vec::new();
        let holder_fragment = self
            .committed_link_holder(node)
            .map(|(holder, _)| holder)
            .filter(|&holder| self.slot_is_live(holder))
            .and_then(|holder| {
                self.paintable_rows
                    .committed_fragment_link_cloned(holder.slot_index(), holder.generation())
            })
            .map(|holder_link| holder_link.fragment)
            .filter(|holder_fragment| holder_fragment.outer_links != OuterLinks::None);
        let links_held_beside = holder_fragment
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|holder_fragment| holder_fragment.children.iter())
            .filter(|held| held.placement.containing_block == node)
            .map(|held| held.fragment.node);
        let candidates = contained_links(&link.fragment)
            .map(|contained_link| contained_link.fragment.node)
            .chain(links_held_beside)
            .chain(
                self.links_held_apart_from_their_containing_blocks
                    .held_apart_from(node)
                    .iter()
                    .copied(),
            );
        for candidate in candidates {
            if met.insert(candidate)
                && self.slot_is_live(candidate)
                && self.paintable_row_is_populated(candidate)
                && self.paintable_data(candidate).containing_block == node
            {
                self.committed_links_in_containing_block_fragment(candidate, fragment_index, &mut contained);
            }
        }
        contained
    }

    fn recalculated_fragment_overflow(
        &self,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        link: &FragmentLink,
        fragment_index: u32,
    ) -> FragmentScrollableOverflow {
        let contained = self.links_in_containing_block_fragment(node, link, fragment_index);
        scrollable_overflow_of(self, &link.fragment, contained.iter())
    }

    fn has_scrollable_overflow_in_any_fragment(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        self.with_committed_fragment_link(node, |link| {
            link.is_some_and(|link| link.fragment.scrollable_overflow.has_scrollable_overflow)
        }) || self
            .committed_side_data(node)
            .box_fragments()
            .iter()
            .any(|fragment| fragment.link.fragment.scrollable_overflow.has_scrollable_overflow)
    }

    fn recalculate_fragment_overflow_of(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        if !self.node_kind_if_live(node).is_some_and(node_facts::kind_is_box) {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(link) = self
            .paintable_rows
            .committed_fragment_link_cloned(node.slot_index(), node.generation())
        else {
            return false;
        };
        let had_scrollable_overflow = self.has_scrollable_overflow_in_any_fragment(node);
        let mut changed = false;
        let overflow = self.recalculated_fragment_overflow(node, &link, 0);
        if overflow != link.fragment.scrollable_overflow {
            let fragment = std::sync::Arc::new(link.fragment.with_scrollable_overflow(overflow));
            self.paintable_rows
                .replace_committed_fragment_link_keeping_its_geometry_epoch(
                    node.slot_index(),
                    node.generation(),
                    FragmentLink { fragment, ..link },
                );
            changed = true;
        }
        let box_fragments = self.committed_side_data(node).box_fragments.clone();
        if let Some(box_fragments) = box_fragments {
            let mut recalculated = (*box_fragments).clone();
            let mut any_changed = false;
            for (index, box_fragment) in recalculated.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                let overflow = self.recalculated_fragment_overflow(node, &box_fragment.link, index as u32 + 1);
                if overflow != box_fragment.link.fragment.scrollable_overflow {
                    box_fragment.link.fragment =
                        std::sync::Arc::new(box_fragment.link.fragment.with_scrollable_overflow(overflow));
                    any_changed = true;
                }
            }
            if any_changed {
                self.committed_side_data_mut(node).box_fragments = Some(std::sync::Arc::new(recalculated));
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        if changed {
            let has_scrollable_overflow = self.has_scrollable_overflow_in_any_fragment(node);
            self.note_scrollable_overflow_change(node, had_scrollable_overflow, has_scrollable_overflow, true);
            self.note_scroll_offset_may_leave_range(node);
        }
        changed
    }

    fn tree_depth(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> u32 {
        std::iter::successors(Some(node), |&ancestor| self.node_parent_if_live(ancestor)).count() as u32
    }

    pub(crate) fn recalculate_requested_fragment_overflow(&mut self) {
        if self.scrollable_overflow.recalculation_requests.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let requests = std::mem::take(&mut self.scrollable_overflow.recalculation_requests);
        let mut queued = crate::fast_hash::FastSet::default();
        let mut queue = std::collections::BinaryHeap::new();
        for node in requests {
            if self.slot_is_live(node) && queued.insert(node) {
                queue.push((self.tree_depth(node), node.index));
            }
        }
        while let Some((_, index)) = queue.pop() {
            let node = NodeSlotId { index };
            if !self.slot_is_live(node) || !self.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
                continue;
            }
            if !self.recalculate_fragment_overflow_of(node) {
                continue;
            }
            let containing_block = self.paintable_data(node).containing_block;
            if !containing_block.is_invalid() && self.slot_is_live(containing_block) && queued.insert(containing_block)
            {
                queue.push((self.tree_depth(containing_block), containing_block.index));
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::computed_values::{ComputedLengthPercentageOrAuto, ComputedStyleValueHandle};
    use crate::css::css_enums::overflow;
    use crate::css::style::layout_style::LayoutScratchStyle;

    #[test]
    fn discarded_fragment_links_leave_the_containing_block_index() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let container = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let cleared = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let freed = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        for child in [cleared, freed] {
            arena.set_committed_fragment_link(child, FragmentLink::for_test(child), None);
            arena.note_whether_link_is_held_apart_from_its_containing_block(child, container, true);
        }
        assert_eq!(
            arena
                .links_held_apart_from_their_containing_blocks
                .held_apart_from(container),
            &[cleared, freed]
        );

        arena.clear_committed_fragment_link(cleared);
        assert_eq!(
            arena
                .links_held_apart_from_their_containing_blocks
                .held_apart_from(container),
            &[freed]
        );

        let main_thread = crate::stage::MainThread::for_test();
        arena
            .free_subtree(freed)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
        assert!(arena.links_held_apart_from_their_containing_blocks.is_empty());

        for row in [cleared, container] {
            arena
                .free_subtree(row)
                .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn overflow_percentage_margins_use_the_containing_blocks_inline_size() {
        for (mode, expected_bottom) in [
            (writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB, 260),
            (writing_mode::VERTICAL_LR, 310),
            (writing_mode::VERTICAL_RL, 310),
        ] {
            let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
            let container_style = LayoutScratchStyle::over_defaults(|style| {
                let box_values = style.box_mut();
                box_values.display = FfiDisplay::block();
                style.set_writing_mode(mode);
                style.set_overflow(overflow::AUTO, overflow::AUTO);
            });
            // SAFETY: The container's style outlives the child's.
            let child_style = LayoutScratchStyle::over(unsafe { container_style.style().view() }, |style| {
                style.surround_mut().margin.bottom =
                    ComputedLengthPercentageOrAuto::new(false, ComputedStyleValueHandle::percentage(50.0));
            });
            let container = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
            let child = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
            for (node, style) in [(container, &container_style), (child, &child_style)] {
                arena.write_shape(node).set_kind(NodeKind::BlockContainer);
                arena.set_node_style(node, 0, Some(style.style()));
            }
            arena.insert_child(container, child, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
            let mut container_link = FragmentLink::for_test(container);
            let fragment = std::sync::Arc::get_mut(&mut container_link.fragment).unwrap();
            fragment.sides.content_size.width = CssPixels::from_integer(100);
            fragment.sides.content_size.height = CssPixels::from_integer(200);
            fragment.sides.padding.bottom = CssPixels::from_integer(10);
            let mut child_link = FragmentLink::for_test(child);
            let fragment = std::sync::Arc::get_mut(&mut child_link.fragment).unwrap();
            fragment.sides.content_size.width = CssPixels::from_integer(20);
            fragment.sides.content_size.height = CssPixels::from_integer(20);
            child_link.offset.y = CssPixels::from_integer(180).into();
            child_link.placement.containing_block = container;
            let overflow = scrollable_overflow_of(&arena, &container_link.fragment, std::iter::once(&child_link));
            assert_eq!(
                overflow.rect_relative_to_padding_box.bottom(),
                CssPixels::from_integer(expected_bottom),
                "writing mode {mode}"
            );
            arena
                .free_subtree(container)
                .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&crate::stage::MainThread::for_test());
        }
    }
}

use super::*;

/// Which border model a box follows, and in the collapsing borders model, whether the box is the table box or a cell:
/// the two own different parts of the collapsed borders at their edges (see `used_values::collapsed_border_share`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum CollapsingBorders {
    #[default]
    Separate,
    CollapsedCell,
    CollapsedTableBox,
}

impl CollapsingBorders {
    pub(crate) fn of(uses_collapsing_borders_model: bool, is_collapsed_borders_table_box: bool) -> Self {
        match (uses_collapsing_borders_model, is_collapsed_borders_table_box) {
            (false, _) => Self::Separate,
            (true, false) => Self::CollapsedCell,
            (true, true) => Self::CollapsedTableBox,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn uses_collapsing_borders_model(self) -> bool {
        self != Self::Separate
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_collapsed_borders_table_box(self) -> bool {
        self == Self::CollapsedTableBox
    }
}

/// The content size, borders and paddings a fragment shows of its box, in the physical plane.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct BoxSides {
    pub(crate) content_size: FfiCssPixelSize,
    pub(crate) border: geometry::Sides,
    pub(crate) padding: geometry::Sides,
    pub(crate) collapsing: CollapsingBorders,
}

impl BoxSides {
    /// The sides, which frame `from` holds, as frame `to` holds them.
    pub(crate) fn in_frame(self, from: geometry::Frame, to: geometry::Frame) -> Self {
        if from == to {
            return self;
        }
        let content_size = if from.is_orthogonal_to(to) {
            FfiCssPixelSize {
                width: self.content_size.height,
                height: self.content_size.width,
            }
        } else {
            self.content_size
        };
        Self {
            content_size,
            border: self.border.in_frame(from, to),
            padding: self.padding.in_frame(from, to),
            collapsing: self.collapsing,
        }
    }

    /// The widths of the borders that lie within the border box. In the collapsing borders model, a collapsed border is
    /// centered on the grid line between two boxes, so only a part of it belongs to each (see
    /// `used_values::collapsed_border_share`).
    pub(crate) fn border_box_edges(&self) -> geometry::Sides {
        if !self.collapsing.uses_collapsing_borders_model() {
            return self.border;
        }
        let is_table_box = self.collapsing.is_collapsed_borders_table_box();
        geometry::Sides {
            top: used_values::collapsed_border_share(self.border.top, true, is_table_box),
            right: used_values::collapsed_border_share(self.border.right, false, is_table_box),
            bottom: used_values::collapsed_border_share(self.border.bottom, false, is_table_box),
            left: used_values::collapsed_border_share(self.border.left, true, is_table_box),
        }
    }
}

/// Whether fragmentation broke the box, so that its fragment continues one in an earlier fragmentainer, or continues
/// in a later one.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct BreakFacts {
    pub(crate) continues_from_previous: bool,
    pub(crate) continues_in_next: bool,
}

impl BreakFacts {
    pub(crate) fn box_is_broken(self) -> bool {
        self.continues_from_previous || self.continues_in_next
    }
}

/// still counts as scrollable overflow.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct LineClampFacts {
    pub(crate) has_line_clamp_point: bool,
    pub(crate) clamped_content_is_scrollable_overflow: bool,
}

/// A part of the glyph outlines of a text content element's own text, which paints after one of the element's children.

    /// glyphs.

    /// after that child. None where all of the element's text comes before its child elements.
    pub(crate) text_segments: Option<std::sync::Arc<Vec<SvgTextSegment>>>,
    pub(crate) text_character_cells: Option<std::sync::Arc<Vec<svg_formatting_context::FfiSvgTextCharacterCell>>>,
    /// The cells of the characters of a <text> or <tspan>'s own text nodes, without those of the elements inside it,
    /// which it's hit-tested by.
    pub(crate) text_own_character_cells: Option<std::sync::Arc<Vec<svg_formatting_context::FfiSvgTextCharacterCell>>>,
}

pub(crate) struct CommittedSvgPath {
    pub(crate) path: libgfx_rust::path::Path,
    latest_stroke_outline: std::sync::Mutex<Option<StrokeOutline>>,
}

struct StrokeOutline {
    style_it_was_built_for: libgfx_rust::path::StrokeStyle,
    outline: libgfx_rust::path::Path,
}

impl CommittedSvgPath {
    pub(crate) fn new(path: libgfx_rust::path::Path) -> Self {
        Self {
            path,
            latest_stroke_outline: std::sync::Mutex::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn stroke_with_style_contains(&self, style: &libgfx_rust::path::StrokeStyle, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool {
        let mut latest_stroke_outline = self
            .latest_stroke_outline
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
        let stroke_outline = match latest_stroke_outline.take() {
            Some(stroke_outline) if stroke_outline.style_it_was_built_for == *style => stroke_outline,
            _ => StrokeOutline {
                style_it_was_built_for: style.clone(),
                outline: self.path.stroke_to_fill(style),
            },
        };
        latest_stroke_outline
            .insert(stroke_outline)
            .outline
            .contains(x, y, libgfx_rust::WindingRule::Nonzero)
    }
}

impl std::ops::Deref for CommittedSvgPath {
    type Target = libgfx_rust::path::Path;

    fn deref(&self) -> &libgfx_rust::path::Path {
        &self.path
    }
}

impl PartialEq for CommittedSvgPath {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.path == other.path
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for CommittedSvgPath {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        self.path.fmt(formatter)
    }
}

/// Compares payloads as painting needs: the layout data painting reads through its allocation as the same allocations,
/// and the facts it copies as equal values.
impl PartialEq for FcPayload {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        use std::sync::Arc;
        match (self, other) {
            (Self::Table(left), Self::Table(right)) => Arc::ptr_eq(left, right),
            (Self::Grid(left), Self::Grid(right)) => {
                same_allocation(left.layout_data.as_ref(), right.layout_data.as_ref())
                    && same_allocation(left.used_tracks.as_ref(), right.used_tracks.as_ref())
            }
            (Self::Flex(left), Self::Flex(right)) => Arc::ptr_eq(left, right),
            (Self::Multicol(left), Self::Multicol(right)) => left == right,
            (Self::Math(left), Self::Math(right)) => left == right,
            (Self::Svg(left), Self::Svg(right)) => {
                left.facts == right.facts
                    && left.geometry == right.geometry
                    && same_allocation(left.path.as_ref(), right.path.as_ref())
                    && same_allocation(left.text_segments.as_ref(), right.text_segments.as_ref())
                    && same_allocation(left.text_character_cells.as_ref(), right.text_character_cells.as_ref())
                    && same_allocation(
                        left.text_own_character_cells.as_ref(),
                        right.text_own_character_cells.as_ref(),
                    )
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }
}

impl FcPayload {
    /// Whether the payloads hold equal values, as two layouts of one box do.
    pub(crate) fn same_value(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        match (self, other) {
            (Self::Table(left), Self::Table(right)) => left == right,
            (Self::Grid(left), Self::Grid(right)) => {
                left.layout_data == right.layout_data && left.used_tracks == right.used_tracks
            }
            (Self::Flex(left), Self::Flex(right)) => left == right,
            (Self::Multicol(left), Self::Multicol(right)) => left == right,
            (Self::Math(left), Self::Math(right)) => left == right,
            (Self::Svg(left), Self::Svg(right)) => {
                left.facts == right.facts
                    && left.geometry == right.geometry
                    && left.path == right.path
                    && left.text_segments == right.text_segments
                    && left.text_character_cells == right.text_character_cells
                    && left.text_own_character_cells == right.text_own_character_cells
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    fn holds_nothing(&self) -> bool {
        match self {
            Self::Grid(grid) => grid.layout_data.is_none() && grid.used_tracks.is_none(),
            Self::Svg(svg) => {
                svg.facts == CommittedSvgFacts::default()
                    && svg.geometry == Default::default()
                    && svg.path.is_none()
                    && svg.text_segments.is_none()
                    && svg.text_character_cells.is_none()
                    && svg.text_own_character_cells.is_none()
            }
            Self::Table(_) | Self::Flex(_) | Self::Multicol(_) | Self::Math(_) => false,
        }
    }
}

/// What the layout of a box hands the box's fragment besides its geometry, until the fragment is built.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct PendingPayload {
    payload: Option<std::sync::Arc<FcPayload>>,
    pub(crate) line_clamp: LineClampFacts,
}

impl PendingPayload {
    fn of_fragment(fragment: &Fragment) -> Self {
        Self {
            payload: fragment.payload.clone(),
            line_clamp: fragment.line_clamp,
        }
    }

    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.payload.is_none() && self.line_clamp == LineClampFacts::default()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set(&mut self, payload: FcPayload) {
        debug_assert!(
            self.payload
                .as_deref()
                .is_none_or(|held| std::mem::discriminant(held) == std::mem::discriminant(&payload)),
            "the fragment of a box gets payloads of two kinds"
        );
        self.payload = Some(std::sync::Arc::new(payload));
    }

    fn variant_mut<Variant>(
        &mut self,
        empty: fn() -> FcPayload,
        variant: fn(&mut FcPayload) -> Option<&mut Variant>,
    ) -> &mut Variant {
        let payload = std::sync::Arc::make_mut(self.payload.get_or_insert_with(|| std::sync::Arc::new(empty())));
        let holds_other_kind = variant(payload).is_none();
        debug_assert!(!holds_other_kind, "the fragment of a box gets payloads of two kinds");
        if holds_other_kind {
            *payload = empty();
        }
        variant(payload).expect("the payload is of the kind just made")
    }

    pub(crate) fn svg_mut(&mut self) -> &mut SvgPayload {
        self.variant_mut(
            || FcPayload::Svg(Default::default()),
            |payload| match payload {
                FcPayload::Svg(svg) => Some(std::sync::Arc::make_mut(svg)),
                _ => None,
            },
        )
    }
}

/// Whether a fragment holds links whose containing block is outside its box, as a table box holds the rows and cells
/// its wrapper contains, and whether their offsets are final.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum OuterLinks {
    #[default]
    None,
    /// The links of boxes whose containing block is that of the fragment's own box, offset as if that containing
    /// block's content box had no size, until the fragment of the containing block is built. Only a frame that reverses
    /// an axis leaves them so.
    AwaitingContainingBlockSize,
    Placed,
}

pub(crate) struct Fragment {
    pub(crate) identity: u64,
    pub(crate) node: crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) sides: BoxSides,
    pub(crate) line_data: Option<std::sync::Arc<inline_content::InlineContent>>,
    pub(crate) payload: Option<std::sync::Arc<FcPayload>>,
    pub(crate) line_clamp: LineClampFacts,
    pub(crate) breaks: BreakFacts,
    pub(crate) scrollable_overflow: fragment_overflow::FragmentScrollableOverflow,
    pub(crate) outer_links: OuterLinks,
    pub(crate) children: Vec<FragmentLink>,
}

/// What the layout of its parent decides about how a box shows, which the link placing the box's fragment holds.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct ParentShowFacts {
    /// For table cells and table-column(-group) boxes: the first grid column the box occupies and the number of grid
    /// columns it spans, so painting can find the cells that originate in a column (CSS 2.2 §17.5.1).
    pub(crate) table_column_index: u32,
    pub(crate) table_column_span: u32,
    /// For table cells: whether every column the cell spans has 'visibility: collapse', which removes the cell from
    /// the display along with the columns (CSS 2.2 §17.5.5).
    pub(crate) hidden_by_collapsed_columns: bool,
    /// Whether the box lies after the clamp point of a line-clamp container, which hides it.
    pub(crate) is_invisible_for_line_clamp: bool,
    /// The physical clip an ancestor's layout puts on the box and its contents, relative to the box's border box: empty
    /// for a box hidden after a clamp point, and the area before the block-end content edge of a line-clamp container
    /// for a float inside it.
    pub(crate) clip_decided_by_parent: Option<CssPixelRect>,
    /// For a block-level box in the flow of a block container: the margin that flow leaves past the block end of the
    /// box, which is its block-end margin, collapsed with the margins of its contents that collapse through its block
    /// end. For a box that margins collapse through, which sits past the margins before it, that is how much its
    /// block-end margin adds to them. The scrollable overflow of a scroll container ends its in-flow content there.
    pub(crate) block_end_margin_collapsed_in_flow: Option<CssPixels>,
}

impl ParentShowFacts {
    pub(crate) fn hide_after_clamp_point(&mut self) {
        self.is_invisible_for_line_clamp = true;
        self.clip_decided_by_parent = Some(CssPixelRect::default());
    }
}

/// What a link shows of its box apart from the fragment, which change what painting shows of the box while the
/// fragment stays the same: the used margins, which the placement of the box decides, and what the parent decided
/// about how the box shows.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct ShownAs {
    pub(crate) margins: geometry::Sides,
    pub(crate) facts: ParentShowFacts,
}

/// Where and how a link places its fragment, apart from its offset. Its insets and margins are physical.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct LinkPlacement {
    pub(crate) insets: geometry::Sides,
    pub(crate) shown_as: ShownAs,
    pub(crate) containing_line_box_index: Option<u32>,
    /// Shared, as few links place an absolutely positioned box, the inputs are larger than the rest of the link, and
    /// layout run cache entries keep copies of links.
    pub(crate) abspos_layout_inputs: Option<std::sync::Arc<abspos_inputs::AbsposLayoutInputs>>,
    /// The default scroll shift of a box whose anchor insets its layout resolved, which commit records for the box.
    pub(crate) default_scroll_shift: Option<abspos_inputs::DefaultScrollShift>,
    pub(crate) containing_block: crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId,
}

impl LinkPlacement {
    /// The placement of a box that `facts` and `cells` describe in `frame`.
    fn of_box(
        facts: &run_state::FactsDecidedByParent,
        cells: &used_values::RootInputCells,
        abspos_layout_inputs: Option<std::sync::Arc<abspos_inputs::AbsposLayoutInputs>>,
        containing_line_box_index: Option<u32>,
        frame: geometry::Frame,
    ) -> Self {
        let insets = facts.used_insets;
        Self {
            insets: geometry::Sides {
                top: insets.top,
                right: insets.right,
                bottom: insets.bottom,
                left: insets.left,
            }
            .in_frame(frame, geometry::Frame::PHYSICAL),
            shown_as: ShownAs {
                margins: cells.margins().in_frame(frame, geometry::Frame::PHYSICAL),
                facts: facts.fragment_facts.show,
            },
            containing_line_box_index,
            abspos_layout_inputs,
            default_scroll_shift: facts.default_scroll_shift,
            containing_block: facts
                .placement
                .map_or(crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId::INVALID, |placement| {
                    placement.containing_block
                }),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct FragmentLink {
    pub(crate) fragment: std::sync::Arc<Fragment>,
    /// The physical offset of the content box of the fragment's box in the content box of its containing block.
    pub(crate) offset: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    pub(crate) placement: LinkPlacement,
}

/// The physical offset of a content box of physical size `content_size` that lies at `offset_in_frame` in the content
/// box of a containing block of physical size `containing_block_size`, which lays out its contents in `frame`.
fn physical_offset(
    offset_in_frame: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    frame: geometry::Frame,
    content_size: FfiCssPixelSize,
    containing_block_size: FfiCssPixelSize,
) -> FfiCssPixelPoint {
    if frame.is_physical() {
        return offset_in_frame;
    }
    let size_in_frame = frame.size_from_physical(content_size);
    frame
        .rect_to_physical(
            CssPixelRect::new(
                offset_in_frame.x,
                offset_in_frame.y,
                size_in_frame.width,
                size_in_frame.height,
            ),
            containing_block_size,
        )
        .location()
        .into()
}

/// A link the builder holds until the physical size of its containing block is known, with its offset in `frame`, the
/// frame in which the containing block lays out its contents.
pub(crate) struct PendingLink {
    fragment: std::sync::Arc<Fragment>,
    offset_in_frame: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    frame: geometry::Frame,
    placement: LinkPlacement,
    /// The physical content size of the containing block, once the builder knows it.
