//! What the host registers with a document's layout arena: the callback tables it answers
//! through. None of it is data layout reads, so it is kept beside the arena rather than in it, and
//! it is reached only through the main thread token, which entry points mint from the handle C++
//! holds. Code that borrows the arena and is not handed a token cannot reach a callback.

use super::LayoutNodeArena;
use super::formatting_context::FfiLayoutHostCallbacks;
use super::layout_node_arena::{FfiStyleRecordHostCallbacks, ShellFactory};
use super::node_data::{NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use super::trace::DescribeNode;
use super::update_layout::FfiLayoutUpdateHostCallbacks;
use crate::css::style::fast_hash::{FastMap as HashMap, FastSet as HashSet};
use crate::painting::host::{FfiGeometryHostCallbacks, FfiPaintPreparationHostCallbacks};
use crate::painting::paintable_rows::ChromeStateCallback;
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

/// What the shell factory needs to know of a row to make its layout node.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct ShellFacts {
    pub(crate) id: NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) kind: NodeKind,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct HostTables {
    pub(super) layout_host: Cell<Option<FfiLayoutHostCallbacks>>,
    pub(super) layout_update_host: Cell<Option<FfiLayoutUpdateHostCallbacks>>,
    /// Makes the shell of an anonymous row the first time something asks for it.
    pub(super) shell_factory: Cell<Option<ShellFactory>>,
    pub(super) style_record_host: Cell<Option<FfiStyleRecordHostCallbacks>>,
    pub(crate) chrome_state_callback: Cell<Option<ChromeStateCallback>>,
    /// What the overflow pass tells the document once it has settled a box's scroll offset.
    pub(crate) geometry_host: Cell<Option<FfiGeometryHostCallbacks>>,
    /// What preparing the paint and hit testing properties asks of the document, and tells it.
    pub(crate) paint_preparation_host: Cell<Option<FfiPaintPreparationHostCallbacks>>,
    /// How the host names a node a layout trace mentions, set when tracing begins.
    pub(super) layout_trace_describe_node: Cell<Option<DescribeNode>>,
    /// The image provider each row whose image comes from its style owns, made for the row and
    /// destroyed when the row is freed.
    pub(super) owned_image_providers: RefCell<HashMap<NodeSlotId, *mut c_void>>,
    /// The image observers and cursor values each row's style asks for, for a style that holds an
    /// image, destroyed when the row is freed if the row did not drop them before.
    pub(super) image_observer_sets: RefCell<HashMap<NodeSlotId, *mut c_void>>,
    /// The layout node C++ made for each row something asked for one, which rows themselves do
    /// not name. A row is keyed with its generation, so a slot restamped before the layout node of
    /// the row it replaced is destroyed holds both apart.
    pub(crate) shells: RefCell<HashMap<NodeSlotId, NonNull<c_void>>>,
    /// Whether the document runs a layout update, which it does one at a time.
    pub(crate) update_layout_running: Cell<bool>,
    /// Whether the host gave the rows search text highlights that it has not cleared since.
    pub(crate) shows_search_text: Cell<bool>,
    /// Whether the host gave the rows spelling-error highlights that it has not cleared since.
    pub(crate) shows_spelling_errors: Cell<bool>,
    /// Whether the host gave the rows custom highlights that it has not cleared since.
    pub(crate) shows_custom_highlights: Cell<bool>,
    /// The rows the host gave layer image paint facts, which the arena drops with the row.
    pub(crate) rows_with_layer_image_paint_facts: RefCell<HashSet<NodeSlotId>>,
    /// The image resources the tree builds of the rounds the host was paid for owe the rows they stamped, which the
    /// host attaches once its layout update is over.
    pub(super) owed_images: RefCell<Vec<super::update_layout::OwedImage>>,
}

impl HostTables {
    pub(super) fn clear_callbacks(&self) {
        self.layout_host.set(None);
        self.layout_update_host.set(None);
        self.shell_factory.set(None);
        self.style_record_host.set(None);
        self.chrome_state_callback.set(None);
        self.geometry_host.set(None);
        self.paint_preparation_host.set(None);
    }

    /// The layout node of the row `facts` describes, made by the shell factory the first time
    /// something asks for it.
    pub(crate) fn shell_of(&self, facts: ShellFacts) -> *mut c_void {
        if let Some(shell) = self.shells.borrow().get(&facts.id) {
            return shell.as_ptr();
        }
        let Some((context, factory)) = self.shell_factory.get() else {
            return std::ptr::null_mut();
        };
        assert!(
            !crate::stage_thread::render_thread().is_current(),
            "a layout node is made on the main thread, whose heap it is allocated from"
        );
        // SAFETY: Registration and unregistration keep the factory context live. The factory's
        // layout node attaches itself to the table, which no borrow is held of across the call.
        unsafe { factory(context, facts.id, facts.kind) };
        self.shells
            .borrow()
            .get(&facts.id)
            .map_or(std::ptr::null_mut(), |shell| shell.as_ptr())
    }

    /// Records the layout node C++ made for the row `id`.
    pub(crate) fn attach_shell(&self, id: NodeSlotId, shell: *mut c_void) {
        let shell = NonNull::new(shell).expect("a row was given a null layout node");
        let previous = self.shells.borrow_mut().insert(id, shell);
        assert!(previous.is_none(), "a row was given a second layout node");
    }

    /// Gives `slot` the image provider it owns. A row is given one once, while it is built.
    pub(crate) fn set_owned_image_provider(&self, slot: NodeSlotId, provider: *mut c_void) {
        assert!(!provider.is_null(), "a row was given a null owned image provider");
        let previous = self.owned_image_providers.borrow_mut().insert(slot, provider);
        assert!(previous.is_none(), "a row was given a second owned image provider");
    }

    /// The image provider `slot` owns, or null for a row whose image comes from its DOM element.
    pub(crate) fn owned_image_provider(&self, slot: NodeSlotId) -> *mut c_void {
        self.owned_image_providers
            .borrow()
            .get(&slot)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(std::ptr::null_mut())
    }

    /// Gives `slot` the image observer set `observers`, or none, and answers the set it held, or
    /// null. The caller registers the new set before it drops the old one, so a resource both
    /// observe is never dropped and fetched again in between.
    pub(crate) fn replace_image_observers(&self, slot: NodeSlotId, observers: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void {
        let mut sets = self.image_observer_sets.borrow_mut();
        let previous = if observers.is_null() {
            sets.remove(&slot)
        } else {
            sets.insert(slot, observers)
        };
        previous.unwrap_or(std::ptr::null_mut())
    }

    /// The image observer set `slot` holds, or null.
    pub(crate) fn image_observers(&self, slot: NodeSlotId) -> *mut c_void {
        self.image_observer_sets
            .borrow()
            .get(&slot)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(std::ptr::null_mut())
    }
}

/// The arena of a document's render state, and the layout stage's scratch beside it.
pub(crate) struct ArenaHandle {
    arena: LayoutNodeArena,
    layout_scratch: super::run_state::LayoutScratch,
}

impl ArenaHandle {
    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            arena: LayoutNodeArena::new(),
            layout_scratch: Default::default(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn arena(&self) -> &LayoutNodeArena {
        &self.arena
    }

    /// A fork of the arena, linked to `engine`, the fork of its style engine. See [`crate::fork`].
    pub(crate) fn fork(&self, engine: crate::css::style::StyleEngineHandle) -> Self {
        Self {
            arena: self.arena.fork(engine),
            layout_scratch: self.layout_scratch.fork(),
        }
    }

    /// The layout stage's own scratch.
    pub(crate) fn layout_scratch(&self) -> &super::run_state::LayoutScratch {
        &self.layout_scratch
    }

    pub(crate) fn arena_mut(&mut self) -> &mut LayoutNodeArena {
        &mut self.arena
    }

    /// The arena to write, beside the layout stage's scratch, which the stage maintains as it prepares and ends a pass.
    pub(crate) fn arena_mut_and_layout_scratch(
        &mut self,
    ) -> (&mut LayoutNodeArena, &mut super::run_state::LayoutScratch) {
        (&mut self.arena, &mut self.layout_scratch)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::layout::tree_mutation::UnplacedLayoutNode;
    use crate::stage::MainThread;

    fn object(address: usize) -> *mut c_void {
        std::ptr::without_provenance_mut(address)
    }

    #[test]
    fn replacing_image_observers_hands_back_the_set_a_row_held() {
        let host = crate::render_state::DocumentHost::for_test();
        let host_tables = host.host_tables();
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let row = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        assert!(host_tables.replace_image_observers(row, object(8)).is_null());
        assert_eq!(host_tables.replace_image_observers(row, object(16)), object(8));
        assert_eq!(host_tables.image_observers(row), object(16));
        assert_eq!(
            host_tables.replace_image_observers(row, std::ptr::null_mut()),
            object(16)
        );
        assert!(host_tables.image_observers(row).is_null());
        arena
            .free_subtree(row)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&MainThread::for_test_with_host(&host));
    }

    #[test]
    fn freeing_a_subtree_takes_its_rows_image_objects_from_the_host_tables() {
        let host = crate::render_state::DocumentHost::for_test();
        let host_tables = host.host_tables();
        let main_thread = MainThread::for_test_with_host(&host);
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let child = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let kept = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.attach_child(root, UnplacedLayoutNode::new(child), NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        host_tables.set_owned_image_provider(child, object(8));
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(root, object(16));
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(kept, object(24));

        arena
            .free_subtree(root)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);

        assert!(host_tables.owned_image_provider(child).is_null());
        assert!(host_tables.image_observers(root).is_null());
        assert_eq!(host_tables.image_observers(kept), object(24));
        arena
            .free_subtree(kept)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
        assert!(host_tables.image_observer_sets.borrow().is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_restamped_slot_does_not_answer_with_the_layout_node_of_the_row_it_replaced() {
        use crate::layout::tree_mutation::{HostCalls, OwedHostWork};

        let host = crate::render_state::DocumentHost::for_test();
        let host_tables = host.host_tables();
        let main_thread = MainThread::for_test_with_host(&host);
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        arena.queue_box_presence();
        let work = OwedHostWork::default();
        let freed = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        host_tables.attach_shell(freed, object(8));

        // A walk frees the row and stamps another in its slot before its host work is applied.
        HostCalls(&work).free_subtree(&mut arena, freed);
        let reused = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        assert_eq!(reused.slot_index(), freed.slot_index());
        assert!(host_tables.shells.borrow().get(&reused).is_none());
        assert_eq!(
            host_tables.shells.borrow().get(&freed).map(|shell| shell.as_ptr()),
            Some(object(8))
        );
        // The walk can ask for the new row's layout node before the old one is destroyed.
        host_tables.attach_shell(reused, object(16));

        work.resolve(&mut arena).pay(&main_thread);
        assert_eq!(
            host_tables.shells.borrow().get(&reused).map(|shell| shell.as_ptr()),
            Some(object(16))
        );
        assert_eq!(host_tables.shells.borrow().len(), 1);
        arena
            .free_subtree(reused)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
    }

    #[test]
    fn freeing_rows_destroys_exactly_their_layout_nodes() {
        let host = crate::render_state::DocumentHost::for_test();
        let host_tables = host.host_tables();
        let main_thread = MainThread::for_test_with_host(&host);
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let child = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let kept = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.attach_child(root, UnplacedLayoutNode::new(child), NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        host_tables.attach_shell(child, object(8));
        host_tables.attach_shell(kept, object(16));

        arena
            .free_subtree(root)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
        assert!(host_tables.shells.borrow().get(&child).is_none());
        assert_eq!(
            host_tables.shells.borrow().get(&kept).map(|shell| shell.as_ptr()),
            Some(object(16))
        );
        arena
            .free_subtree(kept)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
        assert_eq!(host_tables.shells.borrow().len(), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_tree_build_lets_go_of_a_freed_rows_image_objects_once_the_walk_is_over() {
        use crate::layout::tree_mutation::{HostCalls, OwedHostWork};

        let host = crate::render_state::DocumentHost::for_test();
        let host_tables = host.host_tables();
        let main_thread = MainThread::for_test_with_host(&host);
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        arena.queue_box_presence();
        let work = OwedHostWork::default();
        let freed = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena
            .write_shape(freed)
            .set_kind(super::super::node_data::NodeKind::BlockContainer);
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(freed, object(8));

        let host_calls = HostCalls(&work);
        super::super::layout_node_arena::prepare_subtree_for_detach(host_calls, &mut arena, freed);
        host_calls.free_subtree(&mut arena, freed);
        // The walk owes the host the observers it let go of, so they stay until the walk is over.
        assert_eq!(host_tables.image_observers(freed), object(8));

        // A row the walk builds in the freed row's slot is another row, whose objects stay.
        let reused = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        assert_eq!(reused.slot_index(), freed.slot_index());
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(reused, object(16));

        work.resolve(&mut arena).pay(&main_thread);
        assert!(host_tables.image_observers(freed).is_null());
        assert_eq!(host_tables.image_observers(reused), object(16));
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(reused, std::ptr::null_mut());
        arena
            .free_subtree(reused)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
    }

    #[test]
    fn preparing_a_subtree_for_detach_drops_the_image_observers_of_its_styled_rows() {
        let host = crate::render_state::DocumentHost::for_test();
        let host_tables = host.host_tables();
        let main_thread = MainThread::for_test_with_host(&host);
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let text = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena
            .write_shape(root)
            .set_kind(super::super::node_data::NodeKind::BlockContainer);
        arena
            .write_shape(text)
            .set_kind(super::super::node_data::NodeKind::TextNode);
        arena.attach_child(root, UnplacedLayoutNode::new(text), NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(root, object(8));
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(text, object(16));

        let work = crate::layout::tree_mutation::OwedHostWork::default();
        arena.queue_box_presence();
        super::super::layout_node_arena::prepare_subtree_for_detach(
            crate::layout::tree_mutation::HostCalls(&work),
            &mut arena,
            root,
        );
        work.resolve(&mut arena).pay(&main_thread);

        assert!(host_tables.image_observers(root).is_null());
        assert_eq!(host_tables.image_observers(text), object(16));
        host_tables.replace_image_observers(text, std::ptr::null_mut());
        arena
            .free_subtree(root)
            .destroy_shells_and_invoke_callbacks(&main_thread);
    }
}

//! Reuse of an in-flow block-level child of a block formatting context whose subtree did not change, moved to where
//! the flow now puts it. A block container that does not establish a formatting context is laid out inside its
//! parent's run, so the formatting context run cache cannot see it. Its contents collapse their margins in a margin
//! state of their own, so reuse collapses what they left there with the margins before the box again, as the flow does
//! after laying them out.

use super::*;

/// Everything the layout of an in-flow block container and its subtree reads from outside that subtree, apart from
/// the flow position it starts at and the margins before it. Reuse moves the stored layout by the difference in flow
/// position, and collapses the margins its contents left with those now before it.
///
/// NB: Reuse is exact only while this key covers every such read. A new read of block formatting context or
///     containing block state inside the in-flow child path must be added here. Line clamping reads the position in
///     the formatting context root, so it may not be present for an entry to be stored or used. What the subtree
///     reads of floats is kept in the entry and has to hold where the box is placed now.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq)]
pub(super) struct InFlowBlockKey {
    pub(super) input: LayoutInput,
    pub(super) containing_block_inline_size: CssPixels,
    pub(super) containing_block_is_right_to_left: bool,
    containing_text_align: u8,
    containing_justify_items: (u8, u8),
    /// The block margins of the child that stretch-fit sizing subtracts, which it treats as zero on a side where the
    /// containing block has no border or padding.
    pub(super) stretch_fit_block_margins: (CssPixels, CssPixels),
    pub(super) incoming_outside_marker_line: Option<block_formatting_context::OutsideMarkerLine>,
    pub(super) run_root: Node,
    pub(super) treat_block_axis_percentage_insets_as_auto_beyond_root: bool,
    pub(super) initial_containing_block_size: (CssPixels, CssPixels),
    pub(super) document_in_quirks_mode: bool,
    pub(super) document_in_limited_quirks_mode: bool,
    /// Whether the margins of the contents that collapse with the block-start margin of the box leave out the quirky
    /// ones, as those collapsing into the block start of a quirks-mode body or table cell do.
    pub(super) contents_ignore_quirky_margins: bool,
}

impl InFlowBlockKey {
    pub(super) fn new(
        run: &FormattingContextRun<'_>,
        input: LayoutInput,
        containing_block_inline_size: CssPixels,
        container_style: StyleValues<'_>,
        stretch_fit_block_margins: (CssPixels, CssPixels),
        incoming_outside_marker_line: Option<block_formatting_context::OutsideMarkerLine>,
        contents_ignore_quirky_margins: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            input,
            containing_block_inline_size,
            containing_block_is_right_to_left: container_style.direction() == direction::RTL,
            containing_text_align: container_style.text_align(),
            containing_justify_items: (
                container_style.justify_items(),
                container_style.justify_items_overflow(),
            ),
            stretch_fit_block_margins,
            incoming_outside_marker_line,
            run_root: run.box_,
            treat_block_axis_percentage_insets_as_auto_beyond_root: run
                .treat_block_axis_percentage_insets_as_auto_beyond_root,
            initial_containing_block_size: (
                run.pass.initial_containing_block_inline_size,
                run.pass.initial_containing_block_block_size,
            ),
            document_in_quirks_mode: run.pass.document_in_quirks_mode,
            document_in_limited_quirks_mode: run.pass.document_in_limited_quirks_mode,
            contents_ignore_quirky_margins,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct FloatsReadByContents {
    pub(super) margins_before_box: block_formatting_context::CollapsedMargins,
    pub(super) stored_in_open_top_margin_group: bool,
    pub(super) introduced_clearance: bool,
    /// Whether the contents read floats before their top margins settled, so that the margins before the box decide
    /// where they read them.
    pub(super) read_before_top_margins_settled: bool,
    pub(super) read_start_from_border_box: Option<CssPixels>,
    pub(super) floats_in_reach: smallvec::SmallVec<[block_formatting_context::FloatInReach; 2]>,
}

/// What the layout of an in-flow block container leaves behind for its parent, apart from the flow position it started
/// at and the margins before it.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct InFlowBlockEntry {
    pub(super) key: InFlowBlockKey,
    pub(super) validity: fc_run_cache::FcRunCacheValidity,
    /// The child's cells as its layout left them.
    pub(super) cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    /// The baselines of the child's contents as its layout left them.
    pub(super) baselines: formatting_context::DerivedBaselines,
    /// The inline offset of the child's content box in its containing block.
    pub(super) content_inline_offset: CssPixels,
    /// What the child's contents left in their margin state, with the top margin group they collapsed into.
    pub(super) margins_left_by_contents: block_formatting_context::BlockMarginState,
    pub(super) floats_read_by_contents: FloatsReadByContents,
    /// The floats the child's contents placed, relative to the child's content box.
    pub(super) floats_placed_by_contents: Vec<block_formatting_context::FloatingBox>,
    pub(super) outgoing_outside_marker_line: Option<block_formatting_context::OutsideMarkerLine>,
    pub(super) depends_on_percentage_block_size: bool,
    /// Whether margins collapse through the child where placing it introduces no clearance.
    pub(super) margins_collapse_through_without_clearance: bool,
    /// The fragment the stored layout placed. The committed subtree is reused only while it is still that fragment.
    pub(super) fragment_identity: u64,
}

/// The in-flow block layouts kept for one slot: the latest one, and the one whose fragment the box committed, which a
/// later layout whose result is not committed must not displace.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct InFlowBlockSlot {
    latest: Option<std::sync::Arc<InFlowBlockEntry>>,
    committed: Option<std::sync::Arc<InFlowBlockEntry>>,
}

/// Per-document store of in-flow block layouts, surviving across layout passes in the layout stage's scratch.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct InFlowBlockCacheStore {
    /// Written in place, while a fork of the arena reads them as they were when it was made.
    entries: super::pass_column::ForkSharedRows<InFlowBlockSlot>,
}

impl InFlowBlockCacheStore {
    pub(super) fn fork(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
            entries: self.entries.fork(),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn cover_slots(&mut self, slot_count: usize) {
        self.entries.cover_slots(slot_count);
    }

    /// The stored layout of the box in `slot` for `key` that placed the fragment the box committed, `committed_identity`.
    pub(super) fn matching(
        &self,
        slot: u32,
        validity: fc_run_cache::FcRunCacheValidity,
        key: &InFlowBlockKey,
        committed_identity: u64,
    ) -> Option<std::sync::Arc<InFlowBlockEntry>> {
        self.entries.with_row(slot as usize, |slot| {
            [&slot?.committed, &slot?.latest]
                .into_iter()
                .flatten()
                .find(|entry| {
                    entry.validity == validity && entry.key == *key && entry.fragment_identity == committed_identity
                })
                .cloned()
        })
    }

    /// Stores `entry`, keeping the entry that placed the box's committed fragment, `committed_identity`.
    pub(super) fn store(&self, slot: u32, entry: InFlowBlockEntry, committed_identity: Option<u64>) {
        self.entries.with_row_mut(slot as usize, |slot| {
            let places_committed_fragment = |entry: &Option<std::sync::Arc<InFlowBlockEntry>>| {
                entry
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|entry| Some(entry.fragment_identity) == committed_identity)
            };
            if places_committed_fragment(&slot.latest) {
                slot.committed = slot.latest.take();
            } else if !places_committed_fragment(&slot.committed) {
                slot.committed = None;
            }
            // An entry nothing else holds is written in place rather than allocated again.
            if let Some(existing) = slot.latest.as_mut().and_then(std::sync::Arc::get_mut) {
                *existing = entry;
                return;
            }
            slot.latest = Some(std::sync::Arc::new(entry));
        });
    }

    pub(crate) fn remove_entry(&mut self, slot: u32) {
        self.entries.reset_row_where(slot as usize, |entries| {
            entries.latest.is_some() || entries.committed.is_some()
        });
    }
}

/// The indices of each inline box's pieces in its line root's content, in line order, which painting and geometry
/// queries look up by box.
#[derive(Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct InlineBoxIndex {
    /// Sorted by box.
    boxes: Vec<InlineBoxPieces>,
    piece_indices: Vec<u32>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
struct InlineBoxPieces {
    node: NodeSlotId,
    first: u32,
    count: u32,
}

fn inline_box_order(node: NodeSlotId) -> (u32, u8) {
    (node.slot_index(), node.generation())
}

impl InlineBoxIndex {
    fn of(pieces: &[InlineBoxPieceRecord]) -> Self {
        Self::of_nodes(pieces.iter().map(|piece| piece.node))
    }

    fn of_nodes(nodes: impl Iterator<Item = NodeSlotId>) -> Self {
        let mut pieces_by_box: Vec<(NodeSlotId, u32)> = nodes
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, node)| !node.is_invalid())
            .map(|(index, node)| (node, index as u32))
            .collect();
        pieces_by_box.sort_unstable_by_key(|&(node, index)| (inline_box_order(node), index));
        let mut index = Self {
            boxes: Vec::new(),
            piece_indices: Vec::with_capacity(pieces_by_box.len()),
        };
        for (node, piece_index) in pieces_by_box {
            match index.boxes.last_mut() {
                Some(pieces) if pieces.node == node => pieces.count += 1,
                _ => index.boxes.push(InlineBoxPieces {
                    node,
                    first: index.piece_indices.len() as u32,
                    count: 1,
                }),
            }
            index.piece_indices.push(piece_index);
        }
        index
    }

    /// The indices of the pieces of `node`, in line order.
    pub(crate) fn piece_indices_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> &[u32] {
        self.boxes
            .binary_search_by_key(&inline_box_order(node), |pieces| inline_box_order(pieces.node))
            .map_or(&[], |position| {
                let pieces = self.boxes[position];
                &self.piece_indices[pieces.first as usize..(pieces.first + pieces.count) as usize]
            })
    }

    /// Each inline box with pieces, with the indices of its pieces in line order.
    pub(crate) fn boxes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (NodeSlotId, &[u32])> {
        self.boxes.iter().map(|pieces| {
            (
                pieces.node,
                &self.piece_indices[pieces.first as usize..(pieces.first + pieces.count) as usize],
            )
        })
    }
}

impl LineRecord {
    pub(crate) fn mirrored_block_offset(&self, block_offset: CssPixels, block_length: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
        let line_block_start = self.block_end - self.block_length;
        let line_content_block_end = self.block_end - self.clearance_block_length;
        line_block_start + line_content_block_end - block_offset - block_length
    }

    pub(crate) fn physical_horizontal_extent(&self) -> CssPixels {
        super::geometry::to_physical(self.writing_mode, self.inline_length, self.block_length).0
    }

    pub(crate) fn physical_vertical_extent(&self) -> CssPixels {
        super::geometry::to_physical(self.writing_mode, self.inline_length, self.block_length).1
    }

    pub(crate) fn physical_vertical_end(&self) -> CssPixels {
        super::geometry::to_physical(self.writing_mode, self.inline_length, self.block_end).1
    }
}

/// Where each cluster of a glyph run lies along the inline axis, in logical order, with offsets in code units of the
/// run's text and coordinates from the run's inline start. A cluster's advance is split evenly among its code units.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ClusterGeometry {
    clusters: Vec<ClusterExtent>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct ClusterExtent {
    start: usize,
    end: usize,
    left: f32,
    right: f32,
    is_rtl: bool,
}

impl ClusterExtent {
    fn x_at(&self, offset: usize) -> f32 {
        let advance = (self.right - self.left) * (offset - self.start) as f32 / (self.end - self.start) as f32;
        if self.is_rtl {
            self.right - advance
        } else {
            self.left + advance
        }
    }
}

impl ClusterGeometry {
    fn of(run: &GlyphRunRecord) -> Self {
        let mut clusters: Vec<ClusterExtent> = Vec::new();
        let mut pen = 0.0f32;
        for placed in run.glyphs.placed() {
            // NB: Upright glyphs are placed across the line, so their advances give their inline positions.
            let left = if run.is_upright { pen } else { placed.x };
            let right = left + placed.glyph.advance;
            pen += placed.glyph.advance;
            let length = placed.glyph.length_in_code_units();
            if length > 0 {
                let start = placed.cluster_start as usize;
                clusters.push(ClusterExtent {
                    start,
                    end: start + length,
                    left,
                    right,
                    is_rtl: placed.is_rtl,
                });
            } else if let Some(cluster) = clusters.last_mut() {
                // Another glyph of the cluster before it in glyph order.
                cluster.left = cluster.left.min(left);
                cluster.right = cluster.right.max(right);
            }
        }
        clusters.sort_by_key(|cluster| cluster.start);
        Self { clusters }
    }

    /// The inline coordinate of the caret at `offset`. Where one cluster ends and another starts, `downstream` picks
    /// the one that starts there.
    pub fn x_for_offset(&self, offset: usize, downstream: bool) -> Option<f32> {
        let mut fallback = None;
        for cluster in self.clusters.iter().filter(|c| (c.start..=c.end).contains(&offset)) {
            let x = cluster.x_at(offset);
            if offset != if downstream { cluster.end } else { cluster.start } {
                return Some(x);
            }
            fallback = Some(x);
        }
        fallback
    }

    /// The physical extents (left, right) of the code units `start..end` of the first `length`, from left to right, one
    /// for each piece of the line they are drawn in: a cluster of other code units between two of theirs, as in text
    /// that mixes directions, starts a new piece. Clusters that do not advance are left out.
    pub fn range_extents(&self, start: usize, end: usize, length: usize) -> Vec<(f32, f32)> {
        let mut clusters_left_to_right: Vec<&ClusterExtent> = self
            .clusters
            .iter()
            .filter(|cluster| cluster.right > cluster.left && cluster.start < length)
            .collect();
        clusters_left_to_right.sort_by(|a, b| a.left.total_cmp(&b.left));
        let mut extents: Vec<(f32, f32)> = Vec::new();
        let mut extends_last_piece = false;
        for cluster in clusters_left_to_right {
            let (from, to) = (start.max(cluster.start), end.min(cluster.end).min(length));
            if from >= to {
                extends_last_piece = false;
                continue;
            }
            let (a, b) = (cluster.x_at(from), cluster.x_at(to));
            match extents.last_mut() {
                Some(last) if extends_last_piece => *last = (last.0.min(a.min(b)), last.1.max(a.max(b))),
                _ => extents.push((a.min(b), a.max(b))),
            }
            extends_last_piece = true;
        }
        extents
    }

    /// The physical extent (left, right) of all pieces of the code units `start..end` of the first `length`, or where
    /// the caret at `start` is when they draw nothing.
    pub fn range_extent(&self, start: usize, end: usize, length: usize) -> (f32, f32) {
        self.range_extents(start, end, length)
            .into_iter()
            .reduce(|(l1, r1), (l2, r2)| (l1.min(l2), r1.max(r2)))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                let x = self.x_for_offset(start, true).unwrap_or_else(|| self.end_x(length));
                (x, x)
            })
    }

    /// Where the first `length` code units end along the inline axis.
    pub fn end_x(&self, length: usize) -> f32 {
        self.x_for_offset(length, false).unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// The offset for the inline coordinate `x` within the first `length` code units: the nearer edge of the grapheme
    /// under `x`, the right one at its middle, or else the nearest grapheme edge.
    pub fn offset_for_x(
        &self,
        x: f32,
        length: usize,
        next_grapheme_boundary: impl Fn(usize) -> Option<usize>,
    ) -> usize {
        let mut nearest = (0, f32::INFINITY);
        for cluster in self.clusters.iter().filter(|cluster| cluster.start < length) {
            let end = cluster.end.min(length);
            let mut grapheme_start = cluster.start;
            while grapheme_start < end {
                let grapheme_end = next_grapheme_boundary(grapheme_start)
                    .filter(|&next| next > grapheme_start)
                    .map_or(end, |next| next.min(end));
                let mut left = (grapheme_start, cluster.x_at(grapheme_start));
                let mut right = (grapheme_end, cluster.x_at(grapheme_end));
                if cluster.is_rtl {
                    std::mem::swap(&mut left, &mut right);
                }
                if x >= left.1 && x <= right.1 {
                    return if x - left.1 < right.1 - x { left.0 } else { right.0 };
                }
                let edge = if x < left.1 {
                    (left.0, left.1 - x)
                } else {
                    (right.0, x - right.1)
                };
                if edge.1 < nearest.1 {
                    nearest = edge;
                }
                grapheme_start = grapheme_end;
            }
        }
        nearest.0
    }

    /// The boundary at the physical left or right edge of the clusters that advance, and whether it ends its cluster.
    pub fn edge_offset(&self, left: bool) -> Option<(usize, bool)> {
        let edge = self
            .clusters
            .iter()
            .filter(|cluster| cluster.right > cluster.left)
            .min_by(|a, b| {
                if left {
                    a.left.total_cmp(&b.left)
                } else {
                    b.right.total_cmp(&a.right)
                }
            })?;
        let at_end = left == edge.is_rtl;
        Some((if at_end { edge.end } else { edge.start }, at_end))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct FragmentRecord {
    pub layout_node: NodeSlotId,
    pub style_source: NodeSlotId,
    pub start: usize,
    pub length_in_code_units: usize,
    pub inline_offset: CssPixels,
    pub block_offset: CssPixels,
    pub relpos_delta: used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint,
    pub inline_length: CssPixels,
    pub block_length: CssPixels,
    pub border_box_block_start: CssPixels,
    pub baseline: CssPixels,
    pub accumulated_vertical_shift: CssPixels,
    pub direction: u8,
    pub writing_mode: u8,
    pub is_block_ellipsis: bool,
    /// Whether the fragment is the ellipsis that text-overflow draws, rather than content.
    pub is_text_overflow_ellipsis: bool,
    pub is_atomic_inline: bool,
    pub white_space_collapse: u8,
    pub(crate) content_baselines: Option<formatting_context::DerivedBaselines>,
    pub line_index: u32,
    pub dom_start_offset_in_node: usize,
    pub dom_end_offset_in_node: usize,
    pub dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace: usize,
    /// The whitespace the line trimmed off the end of the fragment, which carets and selections still reach.
    pub(crate) trimmed_trailing_whitespace: super::line_box_fragment::TrailingWhitespace,
    pub glyph_run: Option<std::sync::Arc<GlyphRunRecord>>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct InlineBoxPieceRecord {
    pub node: NodeSlotId,
    pub first_fragment_index: u32,
    pub fragment_count: u32,
    pub line_index: u32,
    pub border_box_rect: used_values::FfiCssPixelRect,
    pub relpos_delta: used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint,
    pub baseline: CssPixels,
    pub accumulated_vertical_shift: CssPixels,
    pub present_edges: u8,
    pub is_geometry_only_placeholder: bool,
}

fn pieces_only_moved<'a>(
    previous_pieces: impl ExactSizeIterator<Item = &'a InlineBoxPieceRecord>,
    pieces: impl ExactSizeIterator<Item = &'a InlineBoxPieceRecord>,
) -> bool {
    if previous_pieces.len() != pieces.len() {
        return false;
    }
    let mut offset_of_every_piece = None;
    for (previous_piece, piece) in previous_pieces.zip(pieces) {
        let (previous_rect, rect) = (previous_piece.border_box_rect, piece.border_box_rect);
        if previous_piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder
            || piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder
            || previous_piece.present_edges != piece.present_edges
            || (previous_rect.width, previous_rect.height) != (rect.width, rect.height)
        {
            return false;
        }
        let offset = (rect.x - previous_rect.x, rect.y - previous_rect.y);
        if *offset_of_every_piece.get_or_insert(offset) != offset {
            return false;
        }
    }
    offset_of_every_piece.is_some()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct ClampedInlineBoxRect {
    pub node: NodeSlotId,
    pub rect: used_values::FfiCssPixelRect,
    pub box_fragment: u32,
}

impl InlineContent {
    pub(crate) fn finish(
        data: used_values::LineData,
        arena: &LayoutNodeArena,
        content_inline_size: CssPixels,
        writing_mode: u8,
    ) -> Self {
        let mut lines = Vec::with_capacity(data.line_boxes.len());
        let mut fragment_count = 0usize;
        let mut elided_content_rects = Vec::new();
        for (line_index, line) in data.line_boxes.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(rect) = inline_formatting_context::elided_content_rect(line) {
                elided_content_rects.push((line_index as u32, rect));
            }
            let visible_fragment_count = line.visible_fragments().count();
            fragment_count = fragment_count
                .checked_add(visible_fragment_count)
                .expect("fragment count overflowed");
            lines.push(LineRecord {
                rect: inline_formatting_context::line_rect(line, content_inline_size),
                first_fragment: (fragment_count - visible_fragment_count) as u32,
                fragment_count: visible_fragment_count as u32,
                reusable_atomic_prefix: !line.fragments.is_empty()
                    && !line.has_block_level_box
                    && line.static_position_markers.is_empty()
                    && line.inline_box_baselines.is_empty()
                    && line
                        .fragments
                        .iter()
                        .all(|fragment| fragment.is_atomic_inline && !fragment.is_fully_truncated),
                ..line.retained_metrics()
            });
        }
        let mut fragments = Vec::with_capacity(fragment_count);
        for (line_index, line) in data.line_boxes.into_iter().enumerate() {
            for mut fragment in line.fragments {
                if fragment.is_fully_truncated {
                    continue;
                }
                fragment.record.glyph_run = fragment.glyphs.take().map(|glyph_data| {
                    let bounding_box = libgfx_rust::FloatRect::from_array(
                        libgfx_rust::text_layout::glyph_run_bounding_box(&glyph_data.font, &glyph_data.glyphs, 1.0),
                    );
                    std::sync::Arc::new(GlyphRunRecord {
                        ascent: super::line_builder::font_metric_in_whole_pixels(glyph_data.font.facts().ascent),
                        descent: super::line_builder::font_metric_in_whole_pixels(glyph_data.font.facts().descent),
                        glyphs: glyph_data.glyphs,
                        font: glyph_data.font,
                        is_upright: glyph_data.is_upright,
                        bounding_box,
                        cluster_geometry: Default::default(),
                    })
                });
                fragment.record.line_index = line_index as u32;
                fragment.record.finish_text_offsets(arena);
                fragments.push(fragment.record);
            }
        }
        let mut pieces = data.inline_box_pieces;
        for piece in &mut pieces {
            assert!((piece.first_fragment_index + piece.fragment_count) as usize <= fragments.len());
            piece.border_box_rect.x += piece.relpos_delta.x;
            piece.border_box_rect.y += piece.relpos_delta.y;
            piece.baseline += piece.relpos_delta.y;
            piece.relpos_delta = used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint::default();
        }
        let mut content = Self {
            lines,
            fragments,
            inline_boxes: InlineBoxIndex::of(&pieces),
            text_fragments: TextFragmentIndex::default(),
            inline_box_pieces: pieces,
            items: Vec::new(),
            lines_after_clamp_point_rect: data.lines_after_clamp_point_rect,
            inline_box_rects_after_clamp: data.inline_box_rects_after_clamp,
            elided_content_rects,
            writing_mode,
            glyph_ink_of_lines: GlyphInkOfLines::default(),
        };
        content.glyph_ink_of_lines();
        // Plain text needs no interleaving and keeps its single foreground producer.
        if content.inline_box_pieces.is_empty() && !content.fragments.iter().any(|fragment| fragment.is_atomic_inline) {
            return content;
        }
        let box_pieces = content
            .inline_box_pieces
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, piece)| !piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder)
            .map(|(index, _)| InlineItem::BoxPiece(index as u32));
        let fragment_items = content.fragments.iter().enumerate().filter_map(|(index, fragment)| {
            if fragment.glyph_run.is_some() {
                Some(InlineItem::TextFragment(index as u32))
            } else {
                fragment
                    .is_atomic_inline
                    .then_some(InlineItem::AtomicInline(index as u32))
            }
        });
        let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(box_pieces.clone().count() + fragment_items.clone().count());
        items.extend(box_pieces.chain(fragment_items));
        items.sort_by_key(|&item| {
            let (node, line) = content.item_position(item);
            (line, arena.node_pre_order_label(node))
        });
        content.items = items;
        content
    }

    pub(crate) fn merge_box_fragments<'content>(
        contents: impl Iterator<Item = Option<&'content InlineContent>>,
    ) -> Option<std::sync::Arc<InlineContent>> {
        let contents: Vec<(&InlineContent, u32, used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint)> = contents
            .enumerate()
            .filter_map(|(index, content)| {
                content.map(|content| (content, index as u32, used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint::default()))
            })
            .collect();
        if contents.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Self::combine(&contents))
    }

    pub(crate) fn concatenate_translated(
        contents: &[(std::sync::Arc<InlineContent>, used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint)],
    ) -> std::sync::Arc<InlineContent> {
        let contents: Vec<(&InlineContent, u32, used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint)> = contents
            .iter()
            .map(|(content, offset)| (&**content, 0, *offset))
            .collect();
        Self::combine(&contents)
    }

    fn combine(contents: &[(&InlineContent, u32, used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint)]) -> std::sync::Arc<InlineContent> {
        let interleaves = contents.iter().any(|(content, ..)| !content.items.is_empty());
        let mut combined = InlineContent {
            writing_mode: contents.first().map_or(0, |(content, ..)| content.writing_mode),
            ..InlineContent::default()
        };
        for (content, box_fragment, offset) in contents {
            combined.append_translated(content, interleaves, *box_fragment, *offset);
        }
        combined.drop_repeated_placeholder_pieces();
        combined.index_inline_boxes();
        let translated_glyph_ink_of_lines = contents
            .iter()
            .map(|(content, _, offset)| {
                let ink = content.glyph_ink_of_lines.0.get()?;
                (content.writing_mode == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB).then(|| {
                    ink.iter()
                        .map(|rect| rect.translated(offset.x, offset.y))
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                })
            })
            .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>();
        if let Some(translated) = translated_glyph_ink_of_lines {
            let _ = combined
                .glyph_ink_of_lines
                .0
                .set(translated.into_iter().flatten().collect());
        }
        std::sync::Arc::new(combined)
    }

    pub(crate) fn glyph_ink_of_lines(&self) -> &[CssPixelRect] {
        self.glyph_ink_of_lines.0.get_or_init(|| {
            let mut ink = vec![CssPixelRect::default(); self.lines.len()];
            for fragment in &self.fragments {
                if let Some(line_ink) = ink.get_mut(fragment.line_index as usize) {
                    line_ink.unite(crate::painting::text_fragment::glyph_ink_rect_in_containing_block(
                        fragment,
                    ));
                }
            }
            ink.into_boxed_slice()
        })
    }

    /// The inline boxes whose pieces all lie as they did in `previous`, moved by one offset and drawn at the same size.
    pub(crate) fn inline_boxes_whose_pieces_only_moved_since<'a>(
        &'a self,
        previous: &'a InlineContent,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = NodeSlotId> + 'a {
        let mut previous_boxes = previous.inline_boxes.boxes().peekable();
        self.inline_boxes.boxes().filter_map(move |(node, piece_indices)| {
            while previous_boxes
                .next_if(|(previous_node, _)| inline_box_order(*previous_node) < inline_box_order(node))
                .is_some()
            {}
            let (_, previous_piece_indices) = previous_boxes.next_if(|(previous_node, _)| *previous_node == node)?;
            pieces_only_moved(
                previous_piece_indices
                    .iter()
                    .map(|&index| &previous.inline_box_pieces[index as usize]),
                piece_indices
                    .iter()
                    .map(|&index| &self.inline_box_pieces[index as usize]),
            )
            .then_some(node)
        })
    }

    /// Indexes the pieces of each inline box again, after they were renumbered or given to other boxes.
    pub(crate) fn index_inline_boxes(&mut self) {
        self.inline_boxes = InlineBoxIndex::of(&self.inline_box_pieces);
        self.text_fragments = TextFragmentIndex::default();
    }

    /// The indices of the fragments of `node`, in fragment order.
    pub(crate) fn fragment_indices_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> &[u32] {
        self.text_fragments
            .fragments
            .get_or_init(|| InlineBoxIndex::of_nodes(self.fragments.iter().map(|fragment| fragment.layout_node)))
            .piece_indices_of(node)
    }

    /// Lines with a preserved break owned by this node and no fragments to identify the line by.
    pub(crate) fn fragmentless_break_lines_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> &[u32] {
        self.text_fragments
            .fragmentless_break_lines
            .get_or_init(|| {
                Box::new(InlineBoxIndex::of_nodes(self.lines.iter().map(|line| {
                    line.forced_break
                        .filter(|_| line.fragment_count == 0)
                        .map_or(NodeSlotId::INVALID, |position| position.node)
                })))
            })
            .piece_indices_of(node)
    }

    fn drop_repeated_placeholder_pieces(&mut self) {
        // NB: An inline box that's empty within one fragment has a piece there with no fragment of its content,
        //     which is a placeholder unless the box is empty in every fragment it's laid out in.
        let is_placeholder = |piece: &InlineBoxPieceRecord| piece.fragment_count == 0;
        if !self.inline_box_pieces.iter().any(is_placeholder) {
            return;
        }
        let mut nodes_with_pieces: HashSet<NodeSlotId> = self
            .inline_box_pieces
            .iter()
            .filter(|piece| !is_placeholder(piece))
            .map(|piece| piece.node)
            .collect();
        let mut new_indices = Vec::with_capacity(self.inline_box_pieces.len());
        let mut kept_count = 0u32;
        self.inline_box_pieces.retain(|piece| {
            let keep = !is_placeholder(piece) || nodes_with_pieces.insert(piece.node);
            new_indices.push(keep.then_some(kept_count));
            kept_count += u32::from(keep);
            keep
        });
        // NB: A dropped piece that isn't a geometry-only placeholder is painted, so its item goes too.
        self.items.retain_mut(|item| match item {
            InlineItem::BoxPiece(index) => match new_indices[*index as usize] {
                Some(new_index) => {
                    *index = new_index;
                    true
                }
                None => false,
            },
            _ => true,
        });
    }

    fn append_translated(
        &mut self,
        content: &InlineContent,
        interleaves: bool,
        box_fragment: u32,
        offset: used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint,
    ) {
        let line_offset = self.lines.len() as u32;
        let fragment_offset = self.fragments.len() as u32;
        let piece_offset = self.inline_box_pieces.len() as u32;
        self.lines.extend(content.lines.iter().map(|line| {
            let mut line = LineRecord {
                box_fragment,
                first_fragment: line.first_fragment + fragment_offset,
                ..*line
            };
            line.rect.x += offset.x;
            line.rect.y += offset.y;
            line.block_start += offset.y;
            line.block_end += offset.y;
            line.next_line_block_offset += offset.y;
            line
        }));
        self.elided_content_rects
            .extend(content.elided_content_rects.iter().map(|&(line_index, mut rect)| {
                rect.x += offset.x;
                rect.y += offset.y;
                (line_index + line_offset, rect)
            }));
        if let Some(rect) = content.lines_after_clamp_point_rect.as_deref() {
            let mut united = crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect::from(*rect).translated(offset.x, offset.y);
            if let Some(existing) = self.lines_after_clamp_point_rect.as_deref() {
                united.unite((*existing).into());
            }
            self.lines_after_clamp_point_rect = Some(Box::new(united.into()));
        }
        if let Some(rects) = content.inline_box_rects_after_clamp.as_deref() {
            let mut combined = self.inline_box_rects_after_clamp.take().unwrap_or_default().into_vec();
            combined.extend(rects.iter().map(|rect| {
                let mut rect = *rect;
                rect.box_fragment = box_fragment;
                rect.rect.x += offset.x;
                rect.rect.y += offset.y;
                rect
            }));
            self.inline_box_rects_after_clamp = Some(combined.into_boxed_slice());
        }
        self.fragments
            .extend(content.fragments.iter().cloned().map(|mut fragment| {
                fragment.line_index += line_offset;
                let (inline_delta, block_delta) =
                    super::geometry::to_physical(fragment.writing_mode, offset.x, offset.y);
                fragment.inline_offset += inline_delta;
                fragment.block_offset += block_delta;
                fragment
            }));
        self.inline_box_pieces
            .extend(content.inline_box_pieces.iter().map(|piece| {
                let mut piece = *piece;
                piece.line_index += line_offset;
                piece.first_fragment_index += fragment_offset;
                piece.border_box_rect.x += offset.x;
                piece.border_box_rect.y += offset.y;
                piece.baseline += offset.y;
                piece
            }));
        if !interleaves {
            return;
        }
        if content.items.is_empty() {
            self.items.extend(
                content
                    .fragments
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .filter(|(_, fragment)| fragment.glyph_run.is_some())
                    .map(|(index, _)| InlineItem::TextFragment(index as u32 + fragment_offset)),
            );
        } else {
            self.items.extend(content.items.iter().map(|item| match *item {
                InlineItem::BoxPiece(index) => InlineItem::BoxPiece(index + piece_offset),
                InlineItem::TextFragment(index) => InlineItem::TextFragment(index + fragment_offset),
                InlineItem::AtomicInline(index) => InlineItem::AtomicInline(index + fragment_offset),
            }));
        }
    }

    /// The content as painting sees it: laid out in the frame of `writing_mode` within a line root whose content box
    /// has the physical size `content_size`, mapped onto the physical plane.
    pub(crate) fn in_physical_plane(&self, writing_mode: u8, content_size: used_values::FfiCssPixelSize) -> Self {
        let plane = PhysicalPlane::new(self, writing_mode, content_size);
        let frame = plane.frame;
        let mut content = self.clone();
        if frame.is_physical() {
            return content;
        }
        let to_physical =
            |rect: used_values::FfiCssPixelRect| -> used_values::FfiCssPixelRect { plane.rect(rect).into() };
        let delta_to_physical = |delta| plane.delta(delta);
        let mirror_in_line =
            |line_index, block_offset, block_length| plane.block_offset_in_line(line_index, block_offset, block_length);
        for line in &mut content.lines {
            line.rect = to_physical(line.rect);
            line.writing_mode = writing_mode;
        }
        for (_, rect) in &mut content.elided_content_rects {
            *rect = to_physical(*rect);
        }
        if let Some(rect) = content.lines_after_clamp_point_rect.as_deref_mut() {
            *rect = to_physical(*rect);
        }
        if let Some(rects) = content.inline_box_rects_after_clamp.as_deref_mut() {
            for rect in rects {
                rect.rect = to_physical(rect.rect);
            }
        }
        for fragment in &mut content.fragments {
            let block_offset = mirror_in_line(fragment.line_index, fragment.block_offset, fragment.block_length);
            let rect = plane.unmoved_fragment_rect(fragment, block_offset);
            fragment.relpos_delta = delta_to_physical(fragment.relpos_delta);
            if fragment.glyph_run.as_ref().is_some_and(|run| run.is_upright) {
                // NB: Upright glyphs are painted unturned, stacked downwards one em apart and centered within the
                //     line, so the fragment is painted as horizontal text whose glyphs sit at those positions.
                let run = fragment.glyph_run.as_ref().unwrap();
                let ascent = fragment.baseline.to_double() as f32;
                let line_width = rect.width.to_double() as f32;
                let mut glyphs = run.glyphs.clone();
                glyphs.update_positions(|glyph, x, y| {
                    let inline_position = *x;
                    *x = (line_width - glyph.advance) / 2.0;
                    *y += inline_position;
                });
                let bounding_box = libgfx_rust::FloatRect::from_array(
                    libgfx_rust::text_layout::glyph_run_bounding_box(&run.font, &glyphs, 1.0),
                );
                fragment.glyph_run = Some(std::sync::Arc::new(GlyphRunRecord {
                    glyphs,
                    font: run.font.clone(),
                    is_upright: true,
                    bounding_box,
                    ascent: run.ascent,
                    descent: run.descent,
                    cluster_geometry: Default::default(),
                }));
                fragment.baseline = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(ascent);
                fragment.writing_mode = crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB;
                fragment.inline_offset = rect.x;
                fragment.block_offset = rect.y;
                fragment.inline_length = rect.width;
                fragment.block_length = rect.height;
                continue;
            }
            // NB: A vertical fragment keeps its inline offset and length along the physical vertical axis.
            fragment.writing_mode = writing_mode;
            fragment.inline_offset = rect.y;
            fragment.block_offset = rect.x;
            fragment.inline_length = rect.height;
            fragment.block_length = rect.width;
        }
        for piece in &mut content.inline_box_pieces {
            let mut rect = piece.border_box_rect;
            rect.y = mirror_in_line(piece.line_index, rect.y, rect.height);
            piece.border_box_rect = to_physical(rect);
            piece.relpos_delta = delta_to_physical(piece.relpos_delta);
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-break-3/#break-decoration
            // NB: Painting reads physical edge bits, just as it reads the physical piece rectangle.
            piece.present_edges = [Side::Top, Side::Right, Side::Bottom, Side::Left]
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|side| piece.present_edges & (1 << *side as u8) != 0)
                .fold(0, |edges, side| edges | (1 << frame.physical_side(side) as u8));
        }
        content
    }

    fn item_position(&self, item: InlineItem) -> (NodeSlotId, u32) {
        match item {
            InlineItem::BoxPiece(index) => {
                let piece = &self.inline_box_pieces[index as usize];
                (piece.node, piece.line_index)
            }
            InlineItem::TextFragment(index) | InlineItem::AtomicInline(index) => {
                let fragment = &self.fragments[index as usize];
                (fragment.layout_node, fragment.line_index)
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_same_item_order(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.items == other.items
            && self
                .items
                .iter()
                .all(|&item| self.item_position(item).0 == other.item_position(item).0)
    }
}

impl FragmentRecord {
    fn finish_text_offsets(&mut self, arena: &LayoutNodeArena) {
        let end = self.start + self.length_in_code_units;
        let dom_offset =
            |offset, boundary| arena.dom_offset_for_rendered_text_offset(self.layout_node, offset, boundary);
        self.dom_start_offset_in_node = dom_offset(self.start, super::RenderedTextBoundary::Start);
        self.dom_end_offset_in_node = if self.length_in_code_units == 0 {
            self.dom_start_offset_in_node
        } else {
            dom_offset(end, super::RenderedTextBoundary::End)
        };
        let trailing_whitespace_length = self.trimmed_trailing_whitespace.length_in_code_units;
        self.dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace = if trailing_whitespace_length == 0 {
            self.dom_end_offset_in_node
        } else {
            dom_offset(end + trailing_whitespace_length, super::RenderedTextBoundary::End)
        };
    }

    pub(crate) fn offset(&self) -> (CssPixels, CssPixels) {
        super::geometry::to_physical(self.writing_mode, self.inline_offset, self.block_offset)
    }

    pub(crate) fn size(&self) -> (CssPixels, CssPixels) {
        super::geometry::to_physical(self.writing_mode, self.inline_length, self.block_length)
    }

    pub(crate) fn physical_vertical_extent(&self) -> CssPixels {
        super::geometry::to_physical(self.writing_mode, self.inline_length, self.block_length).1
    }
}

pub(crate) struct PhysicalPlane<'content> {
    content: &'content InlineContent,
    frame: super::geometry::Frame,
    lines_are_mirrored: bool,
    content_size: used_values::FfiCssPixelSize,
}

impl<'content> PhysicalPlane<'content> {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        content: &'content InlineContent,
        writing_mode: u8,
        content_size: used_values::FfiCssPixelSize,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            content,
            frame: super::geometry::Frame::of(writing_mode),
            lines_are_mirrored: writing_mode == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::VERTICAL_LR,
            content_size,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn of(content: &'content InlineContent, content_size: used_values::FfiCssPixelSize) -> Self {
        Self::new(content, content.writing_mode, content_size)
    }

    pub(crate) fn rect(&self, rect: used_values::FfiCssPixelRect) -> crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect {
        self.frame.rect_to_physical(rect.into(), self.content_size)
    }

    pub(crate) fn delta(&self, delta: used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint) -> used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint {
        let origin = self.frame.rect_to_physical(CssPixelRect::default(), self.content_size);
        let moved = self.frame.rect_to_physical(
            CssPixelRect::new(delta.x, delta.y, CssPixels::default(), CssPixels::default()),
            self.content_size,
        );
        used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint {
            x: moved.x - origin.x,
            y: moved.y - origin.y,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn block_offset_in_line(
        &self,
        line_index: u32,
        block_offset: CssPixels,
        block_length: CssPixels,
    ) -> CssPixels {
        // NB: Glyphs that run along a vertical line are turned a quarter turn clockwise, so their line-over side
        //     faces the physical right side. That is the block-start side of the frame of vertical-rl, but the
        //     block-end side of the frame of vertical-lr, where each line is laid out mirrored in the block axis.
        //     The glyphs of sideways-lr are turned counterclockwise instead, so they face its line-over side on the
        //     left, its block-start side, and run upwards like its inline axis.
        //     https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-4/#line-orientation
        if !self.lines_are_mirrored {
            return block_offset;
        }
        let Some(line) = self.content.lines.get(line_index as usize) else {
            return block_offset;
        };
        // The line's content is mirrored within its own extent: a clearing break after the line extends the line
        // toward the clearance, and the content stays where it is.
        line.mirrored_block_offset(block_offset, block_length)
    }

    fn unmoved_fragment_rect(
        &self,
        fragment: &FragmentRecord,
        block_offset: CssPixels,
    ) -> crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect {
        self.frame.rect_to_physical(
            crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect::new(
                fragment.inline_offset,
                block_offset,
                fragment.inline_length,
                fragment.block_length,
            ),
            self.content_size,
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn fragment_rect(&self, fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect {
        if self.frame.is_physical() {
            let (x, y) = fragment.offset();
            let (width, height) = fragment.size();
            return crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect::new(
                x + fragment.relpos_delta.x,
                y + fragment.relpos_delta.y,
                width,
                height,
            );
        }
        let block_offset = self.block_offset_in_line(fragment.line_index, fragment.block_offset, fragment.block_length);
        let delta = self.delta(fragment.relpos_delta);
        self.unmoved_fragment_rect(fragment, block_offset)
            .translated(delta.x, delta.y)
    }

    pub(crate) fn piece_present_edges(&self, piece: &InlineBoxPieceRecord) -> u8 {
        if self.frame.is_physical() {
            return piece.present_edges;
        }
        [Side::Top, Side::Right, Side::Bottom, Side::Left]
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|side| piece.present_edges & (1 << *side as u8) != 0)
            .fold(0, |edges, side| edges | (1 << self.frame.physical_side(side) as u8))
    }

    pub(crate) fn piece_border_box_rect(&self, piece: &InlineBoxPieceRecord) -> crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect {
        let mut rect = piece.border_box_rect;
        rect.y = self.block_offset_in_line(piece.line_index, rect.y, rect.height);
        self.rect(rect)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn piece_of(node: NodeSlotId, line_index: u32) -> InlineBoxPieceRecord {
        InlineBoxPieceRecord {
            node,
            line_index,
            ..InlineBoxPieceRecord::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_inline_box_index_lists_each_box_with_its_pieces_in_line_order() {
        let outer = NodeSlotId::new(7, 1);
        let inner = NodeSlotId::new(3, 2);
        let pieces = [
            piece_of(outer, 0),
            piece_of(inner, 0),
            piece_of(NodeSlotId::INVALID, 0),
            piece_of(outer, 1),
            piece_of(inner, 1),
            piece_of(outer, 2),
        ];
        let index = InlineBoxIndex::of(&pieces);
        assert_eq!(index.piece_indices_of(outer), &[0, 3, 5]);
        assert_eq!(index.piece_indices_of(inner), &[1, 4]);
        assert!(index.piece_indices_of(NodeSlotId::new(3, 1)).is_empty());
        assert!(index.piece_indices_of(NodeSlotId::INVALID).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(
            index.boxes().map(|(node, _)| node).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            vec![inner, outer]
        );
    }
}

use super::*;

const ELLIPSIS_CODE_POINT: u32 = 0x2026;

fn truncate_line_at_glyph_boundary(
    line: &mut line_box::LineBoxData,
    available_inline_size: CssPixels,
    line_direction: u8,
) -> Option<(usize, CssPixels)> {
    let index = line.fragments.iter().position(|fragment| {
        !fragment.is_fully_truncated && fragment.inline_offset + fragment.inline_length > available_inline_size
    })?;
    let fragment = &mut line.fragments[index];
    let available = available_inline_size - fragment.inline_offset;
    let Some(glyphs) = fragment.glyphs.as_mut().filter(|_| available > CssPixels::default()) else {
        return (index > 0).then_some((index, fragment.inline_offset));
    };
    let placed: Vec<_> = glyphs.glyphs.placed().collect();
    let glyph_end = |placed: &libgfx_rust::text_layout::PlacedGlyph| {
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(placed.x + placed.glyph.advance)
    };
    let keep_from_end = fragment.current_insert_direction == direction::RTL && line_direction == direction::RTL;
    let (mut start, mut end) = if keep_from_end {
        (
            placed.partition_point(|placed| {
                fragment.record.inline_length - CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(placed.x) > available
            }),
            placed.len(),
        )
    } else {
        (0, placed.partition_point(|placed| glyph_end(placed) <= available))
    };
    while end > start && end < placed.len() && placed[end].glyph.length_in_code_units() == 0 {
        end -= 1;
    }
    while start < end && placed[start].glyph.length_in_code_units() == 0 {
        start += 1;
    }
    if start == end {
        return (index > 0).then_some((index, fragment.inline_offset));
    }
    let origin = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(placed[start].x);
    let inline_size = glyph_end(&placed[end - 1]) - origin;
    glyphs.glyphs.keep_range(start..end);
    let origin_x = origin.to_double() as f32;
    glyphs.glyphs.update_positions(|_, x, _| *x -= origin_x);
    let length = glyphs.glyphs.iter().map(|glyph| glyph.length_in_code_units()).sum();
    glyphs.width = inline_size.to_double() as f32;
    if fragment.current_insert_direction == direction::RTL && !keep_from_end {
        fragment.start += fragment.length_in_code_units - length;
    }
    fragment.length_in_code_units = length;
    fragment.inline_length = inline_size;
    fragment.trailing_whitespace = Default::default();
    Some((index + 1, fragment.inline_offset + inline_size))
}

/// The ellipsis that text-overflow: ellipsis draws, shaped in the font its block container's style gives it.
struct TextOverflowEllipsis {
    glyphs: libgfx_rust::text_layout::GlyphBuffer,
    font: libgfx_rust::font::FontHandle,
    width: f32,
    length_in_code_units: usize,
}

impl TextOverflowEllipsis {
    fn of_block(context: &InlineFormattingContext<'_>) -> Self {
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overflow-4/#ellipsing-details
        // "The ellipsis is styled and baseline-aligned according to the block."
        let style = context.style(context.containing_block);
        let font_list = style.frozen_font_list();
        let first_available_font = style
            .font()
            .first_available_font()
            .expect("layout read a font group that never received a frozen font list");
        let presentation = libgfx_rust::font::emoji_presentation_for_code_point(ELLIPSIS_CODE_POINT, None, None);
        // NB: Where the block's first available font has no glyph for U+2026 HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS, three periods stand
        //     for it, rather than an ellipsis from whatever font the cascade falls back to.
        const ELLIPSIS: [u16; 1] = [ELLIPSIS_CODE_POINT as u16];
        const THREE_PERIODS: [u16; 3] = [b'.' as u16; 3];
        // NB: The cascade can hand back the first font for a code point that no font in it has, so the first font
        //     also has to have the glyph.
        let text: &[u16] = if first_available_font.contains_glyph(ELLIPSIS_CODE_POINT)
            && font_list.font_for_code_point(ELLIPSIS_CODE_POINT, presentation) == *first_available_font
        {
            &ELLIPSIS
        } else {
            &THREE_PERIODS
        };
        // NB: The periods come from whichever font of the block has a period for them, which needn't be its first
        //     available font: That one can be a font whose unicode-range leaves the period out.
        let code_point = u32::from(text[0]);
        let font = font_list.font_for_code_point(
            code_point,
            libgfx_rust::font::emoji_presentation_for_code_point(code_point, None, None),
        );
        let shaped = libgfx_rust::text_layout::shape_text(
            &font,
            text,
            libgfx_rust::text_layout::TextType::Common,
            0.0,
            style.letter_spacing().to_double() as f32,
            style.word_spacing().to_double() as f32,
        );
        Self {
            width: shaped.width(),
            glyphs: shaped.into_glyphs(),
            font,
            length_in_code_units: text.len(),
        }
    }

    fn inline_size(&self) -> CssPixels {
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(self.width)
    }

    /// The fragment that draws the ellipsis at `inline_offset` on `line`, next to the text of `layout_node` that it
    /// stands for, from `start`.
    fn into_fragment(
        self,
        context: &InlineFormattingContext<'_>,
        line: &line_box::LineBoxData,
        layout_node: Node,
        start: usize,
        inline_offset: CssPixels,
    ) -> line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData {
        let style_source = context.containing_block;
        let style = context.style(style_source);
        let inline_size = self.inline_size();
        let mut fragment = line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData::new(
            layout_node,
            start,
            self.length_in_code_units,
            inline_offset,
            CssPixels::default(),
            inline_size,
            line_builder::content_area_block_size(style),
            CssPixels::default(),
            line.direction,
            line.writing_mode,
            Some(line_box_fragment::GlyphData {
                glyphs: self.glyphs,
                font: self.font,
                text_type: line_box_fragment::GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_COMMON,
                width: self.width,
                is_upright: false,
                derived_placements_end: None,
            }),
            line_box_fragment::FragmentBuildFacts {
                style_source,
                is_atomic_inline: false,
                white_space_collapse: style.white_space_collapse(),
                text_utf16: std::ptr::null(),
                text_length_in_code_units: 0,
            },
        );
        fragment.is_text_overflow_ellipsis = true;
        // NB: Placing a line aligns its fragments, so on a line that's placed already, the ellipsis sits on the line's
        //     baseline by itself. The fragments of a placed line are offset from the start of the formatting context,
        //     and its baseline from the start of the line.
        if line.uses_last_line_alignment.is_some() {
            let ascent = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(style.font_ascent());
            fragment.baseline = ascent;
            fragment.block_offset = line.block_start + line.baseline - ascent;
        }
        fragment
    }
}

/// The glyphs of `glyphs` whose clusters lie wholly within what `keeps` accepts, as the start and end of each cluster
/// along the inline axis, with the cluster's extent. A cluster such as a base character and its combining marks is
/// kept or dropped as a whole.
fn glyphs_of_clusters_kept(
    glyphs: &libgfx_rust::text_layout::GlyphBuffer,
    keeps: impl Fn(f32, f32) -> bool,
) -> (libgfx_rust::text_layout::GlyphBuffer, Option<(f32, f32)>) {
    let mut cluster_extents = HashMap::<u32, (f32, f32)>::default();
    for placed in glyphs.placed() {
        let extent = cluster_extents
            .entry(placed.cluster_start)
            .or_insert((placed.x, placed.x + placed.glyph.advance));
        extent.0 = extent.0.min(placed.x);
        extent.1 = extent.1.max(placed.x + placed.glyph.advance);
    }
    let mut kept = libgfx_rust::text_layout::GlyphBuffer::default();
    let mut kept_extent = None::<(f32, f32)>;
    for placed in glyphs.placed() {
        let (start, end) = cluster_extents[&placed.cluster_start];
        if !keeps(start, end) {
            continue;
        }
        kept_extent = Some(kept_extent.map_or((start, end), |(kept_start, kept_end)| {
            (kept_start.min(start), kept_end.max(end))
        }));
        kept.push_placed(placed);
    }
    (kept, kept_extent)
}

/// The cluster of `glyphs` that's farthest toward the line's start edge: its left end, or its right end where
/// `from_right` is set. Its start and end along the inline axis.
fn start_edge_cluster(glyphs: &libgfx_rust::text_layout::GlyphBuffer, from_right: bool) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    let mut extent = None::<(f32, f32)>;
    for placed in glyphs.placed() {
        let (start, end) = (placed.x, placed.x + placed.glyph.advance);
        let is_farther = extent.is_none_or(
            |(kept_start, kept_end)| {
                if from_right { end > kept_end } else { start < kept_start }
            },
        );
        if is_farther {
            extent = Some((start, end));
        }
    }
    extent
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overflow-4/#text-overflow
// "implementations must hide characters and atomic inline-level elements at the applicable edge(s) of the line as
// necessary to fit the ellipsis/string, and place the ellipsis/string immediately adjacent to the applicable edge(s)
// of the remaining inline content. The first character or atomic inline-level element on a line must be clipped
// rather than ellipsed."
fn apply_text_overflow_to_line(line: &mut line_box::LineBoxData, context: &InlineFormattingContext<'_>) {
    if !matches!(line.original_available_inline_size, AvailableSize::Definite(_)) {
        return;
    }
    let available_inline_size = line.original_available_inline_size.to_px_or_zero();
    if line.inline_length <= available_inline_size || line.fragments.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let ellipsis = TextOverflowEllipsis::of_block(context);
    // NB: The end edge of a right-to-left line is its left end. Its fragments are laid out from the left, in logical
    //     order, and placing the line aligns its right end with the right edge of the line box, past its indent. So
    //     on a line that's placed already, what overflows is left of where the line box starts; on one that isn't,
    //     it's whatever is more than the available inline size, less the indent, away from its right end. A line
    //     whose items are ordered right to left is mirrored as it's placed, so until then, its end is on its right
    //     like that of any other line.
    let is_placed = line.uses_last_line_alignment.is_some();
    if line.direction == direction::RTL && (is_placed || !context.atomic_items_are_right_to_left) {
        let (left_edge, shift) = if is_placed {
            (line.placed_inline_start, CssPixels::default())
        } else {
            let overflow = line.inline_length - available_inline_size;
            (overflow + line.indent, overflow)
        };
        apply_text_overflow_at_left_edge(line, context, ellipsis, left_edge, shift, available_inline_size);
    } else {
        let right_edge = if is_placed {
            line.placed_inline_start + available_inline_size
        } else {
            available_inline_size
        };
        apply_text_overflow_at_right_edge(line, context, ellipsis, right_edge, available_inline_size);
    }
}

/// Where a fragment's border box starts and ends on its line: The fragment of an atomic inline is its content box.
fn border_box_inline_extent(fragment: &line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData) -> (CssPixels, CssPixels) {
    let start = fragment.inline_offset;
    let end = start + fragment.inline_length;
    match fragment.box_cells.filter(|_| fragment.is_atomic_inline) {
