use super::node_facts::ReplacedContentFacts;
use super::*;

/// Arena inputs borrowed while computing a layout result. The pass ends before commit takes a
/// mutable arena borrow, so its text and style views cannot survive commit.
///
/// A layout run reads only the subtree it lays out. Whatever it needs from above arrives through
/// its layout input, its root's used values and its run state, or was derived onto the subtree
/// before the pass, like ancestor facts. That is what lets partial relayout, the formatting context
/// run cache and the intrinsic size caches reuse a subtree's layout without looking outside it.
///
/// A pass holds no part of the host. Every host call takes the main thread token, which a pass is
/// not handed, so a pass has no way to call into the document.
///
/// Each run is handed a copy of its own, through which the code inside the run reaches what the run
/// keeps for it, so no state that the runs share tells which run is in progress.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct LayoutPass<'arena> {
    arena: &'arena LayoutNodeArena,
    scratch: &'arena super::run_state::LayoutScratch,
    pub(crate) initial_containing_block_inline_size: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) initial_containing_block_block_size: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) document_in_quirks_mode: bool,
    pub(crate) document_in_limited_quirks_mode: bool,
    /// The frame of the formatting context the pass is laying out, in which style reads see sizes and box sides.
    pub(crate) frame: super::geometry::Frame,
    /// The root of the run this pass view was handed to and that root's containing block, where containing block
    /// searches from inside the run stop. Invalid outside any run.
    innermost_run: (Node, Node),
    /// What the run this pass view was handed to found out for the host so far, or the pass outside any run.
    host_findings: &'arena super::run_state::HostFindingsSink,
    /// The layout memos the runs this pass view reaches read and keep.
    memos: MemoScope<'arena>,
    /// The innermost of the position options the boxes this pass view lays out are laid out with.
    position_option_styles: Option<&'arena PositionOptionStyle<'arena>>,
    records_trace: bool,
    forks_runs: bool,
    worker_scratch: WorkerScratchOfThisThread,
}

const _: () = {
    const fn assert_send_and_sync<T: Send + Sync>() {}
    assert_send_and_sync::<LayoutPass<'static>>();
};

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct WorkerScratch {
    pub(super) spare_fragment_builder_buffers: std::cell::RefCell<Vec<super::fragment_tree::FragmentBuilderBuffers>>,
    pub(super) reserved_unique_identities: std::cell::Cell<std::ops::Range<u64>>,
    inline_content_preparation_buffers:
        std::cell::Cell<super::prepared_inline_content::InlineContentPreparationBuffers>,
}

thread_local! {
    static WORKER_SCRATCH_OF_THIS_THREAD: WorkerScratch = WorkerScratch::default();
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct WorkerScratchOfThisThread {
    scratch: std::ptr::NonNull<WorkerScratch>,
    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    thread: std::thread::ThreadId,
}

// SAFETY: A pass view reaches the worker scratch of the thread it was pointed at only on that thread: a pass view
// handed to a task on another thread is first pointed at the scratch of that thread (debug builds check the thread on
// every use).
unsafe impl Send for WorkerScratchOfThisThread {}
// SAFETY: As above.
unsafe impl Sync for WorkerScratchOfThisThread {}

impl WorkerScratchOfThisThread {
    fn get() -> Self {
        WORKER_SCRATCH_OF_THIS_THREAD.with(|scratch| Self {
            scratch: std::ptr::NonNull::from(scratch),
            #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
            thread: std::thread::current().id(),
        })
    }

    #[inline]
    fn scratch(&self) -> &WorkerScratch {
        #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
        assert_eq!(
            self.thread,
            std::thread::current().id(),
            "a pass view reaches the worker scratch of another thread"
        );
        // SAFETY: The scratch lives as long as its thread, on which alone it is reached (see the Send impl).
        unsafe { self.scratch.as_ref() }
    }
}

/// Which layout memos a pass view reads and keeps: the run cache, the in-flow block cache, prepared inline content and
/// intrinsic sizes.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum MemoScope<'arena> {
    /// Those kept for the runs and passes after the ones that made them.
    Kept,
    /// None from before a run whose result is discarded, which keeps none after it either. It measures intrinsic sizes
    /// into caches of its own.
    Discarded(&'arena super::layout_node_arena::IntrinsicSizeCaches),
}

/// The style a box is laid out with in place of the style of its row: that of one of its position options. It links to
/// the position option the box is laid out inside of, if any.
/// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#apply-a-position-option
struct PositionOptionStyle<'pass> {
    node: Node,
    style: super::node_data::LayoutStyleRef,
    enclosing: Option<&'pass PositionOptionStyle<'pass>>,
}

impl<'arena> LayoutPass<'arena> {
    /// A pass over `arena` and `scratch`, which notes what it finds out for the host outside any run in
    /// `host_findings_outside_runs`.
    pub(crate) fn new(
        arena: &'arena LayoutNodeArena,
        scratch: &'arena super::run_state::LayoutScratch,
        host_findings_outside_runs: &'arena super::run_state::HostFindingsSink,
        stage: super::formatting_context::LayoutStageFacts,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            arena,
            scratch,
            initial_containing_block_inline_size: stage.viewport_inline_size,
            initial_containing_block_block_size: stage.viewport_block_size,
            document_in_quirks_mode: stage.document_in_quirks_mode,
            document_in_limited_quirks_mode: stage.document_in_limited_quirks_mode,
            frame: super::geometry::Frame::PHYSICAL,
            innermost_run: (NodeSlotId::INVALID, NodeSlotId::INVALID),
            host_findings: host_findings_outside_runs,
            memos: MemoScope::Kept,
            position_option_styles: None,
            records_trace: scratch.layout_trace.is_recording(),
            forks_runs: false,
            worker_scratch: WorkerScratchOfThisThread::get(),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn on_this_thread(self) -> Self {
        Self {
            worker_scratch: WorkerScratchOfThisThread::get(),
            ..self
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(super) fn worker_scratch(&self) -> &WorkerScratch {
        self.worker_scratch.scratch()
    }

    pub(crate) fn forking_runs(self) -> Self {
        Self {
            forks_runs: true,
            ..self
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn forks_runs(&self) -> bool {
        self.forks_runs && !self.is_discarded_run() && !self.records_trace
    }

    pub(super) fn noting_host_findings_in<'findings>(
        self,
        host_findings: &'findings super::run_state::HostFindingsSink,
    ) -> LayoutPass<'findings>
    where
        'arena: 'findings,
    {
        let pass: LayoutPass<'findings> = self;
        LayoutPass { host_findings, ..pass }
    }

    /// A pass over `arena` and `scratch` with no viewport, in no-quirks mode.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn for_test(
        arena: &'arena LayoutNodeArena,
        scratch: &'arena super::run_state::LayoutScratch,
        host_findings_outside_runs: &'arena super::run_state::HostFindingsSink,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::new(
            arena,
            scratch,
            host_findings_outside_runs,
            super::formatting_context::LayoutStageFacts {
                viewport_inline_size: CssPixels::default(),
                viewport_block_size: CssPixels::default(),
                document_in_quirks_mode: false,
                document_in_limited_quirks_mode: false,
            },
        )
    }

    /// This pass, as the run rooted at `root` sees it, which notes what it finds out for the host in `host_findings`.
    #[inline]
    pub(super) fn for_run<'run>(
        self,
        root: Node,
        root_containing_block: Node,
        host_findings: &'run super::run_state::HostFindingsSink,
    ) -> LayoutPass<'run>
    where
        'arena: 'run,
    {
        let pass: LayoutPass<'run> = self;
        LayoutPass {
            innermost_run: (root, root_containing_block),
            host_findings,
            ..pass
        }
    }

    /// This pass, laying out in the frame of `writing_mode`.
    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn in_frame_of(mut self, writing_mode: u8) -> Self {
        self.frame = super::geometry::Frame::of(writing_mode);
        self
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn arena(&self) -> &'arena LayoutNodeArena {
        self.arena
    }

    /// Lays out `run`, whose result is discarded, with this pass as that run sees it: it reads no memoized layout from
    /// before it and keeps none, so that it computes everything afresh and leaves nothing for the runs after it. It
    /// measures intrinsic sizes into caches of its own, which start empty and are dropped when it returns.
    pub(crate) fn lay_out_discarded_run<R>(self, run: impl for<'discarded> FnOnce(LayoutPass<'discarded>) -> R) -> R {
        let mut intrinsic_size_caches = super::layout_node_arena::IntrinsicSizeCaches::default();
        intrinsic_size_caches.cover_slots(self.arena.slot_capacity());
        let pass: LayoutPass<'_> = self;
        run(LayoutPass {
            memos: MemoScope::Discarded(&intrinsic_size_caches),
            ..pass
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn lays_out_with_position_option(&self) -> bool {
        self.position_option_styles.is_some()
    }

    /// Runs `run` with this pass as it lays out `node` with `style`, the style of one of its position options, which
    /// the style reads of `node` see in place of the style of its row. The payloads `style` names must stay alive
    /// until `run` returns.
    pub(crate) fn with_position_option_style<R>(
        self,
        node: Node,
        style: super::node_data::LayoutStyleRef,
        run: impl for<'option> FnOnce(LayoutPass<'option>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        let position_option_style = PositionOptionStyle {
            node,
            style,
            enclosing: self.position_option_styles,
        };
        let pass: LayoutPass<'_> = self;
        run(LayoutPass {
            position_option_styles: Some(&position_option_style),
            ..pass
        })
    }

    /// The style the style reads of `node` see in place of the style of its row, if any.
    #[inline]
    fn position_option_style(&self, node: Node) -> Option<super::node_data::LayoutStyleRef> {
        let mut position_option_style = self.position_option_styles;
        while let Some(option) = position_option_style {
            if option.node == node {
                return Some(option.style);
            }
            position_option_style = option.enclosing;
        }
        None
    }

    /// Where this pass view records what its runs do while the document traces its layout: the document's layout trace,
    /// or nowhere inside a run whose result is discarded.
    pub(crate) fn layout_trace(&self) -> super::trace::LayoutTraceTarget<'arena> {
        if self.is_discarded_run() || !self.records_trace {
            return super::trace::LayoutTraceTarget::recording_nothing();
        }
        super::trace::LayoutTraceTarget::recording_into(&self.scratch.layout_trace)
    }

    /// The results of formatting context runs, kept for the runs and passes after them, unless this pass view is inside
    /// a run whose result is discarded.
    pub(crate) fn fc_run_cache_store(&self) -> Option<&'arena super::fc_run_cache::FcRunCacheStore> {
        self.kept_memos().then(|| self.scratch.fc_run_cache_store())
    }

    pub(crate) fn fragment_builder_scratch(&self) -> &'arena super::fragment_tree::FragmentBuilderScratch {
        self.scratch.fragment_builder_scratch()
    }

    /// The layouts of in-flow blocks, kept for the passes after the one that laid them out, unless this pass view is
    /// inside a run whose result is discarded.
    pub(crate) fn in_flow_block_cache_store(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<&'arena super::in_flow_block_cache::InFlowBlockCacheStore> {
        self.kept_memos().then(|| self.scratch.in_flow_block_cache_store())
    }

    /// Whether this pass view is inside a run whose result is discarded, which reads no memoized layout from before it
    /// and keeps none.
    pub(crate) fn is_discarded_run(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.memos, MemoScope::Discarded(_))
    }

    fn kept_memos(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.memos, MemoScope::Kept)
    }

    /// Notes what the run this pass view was handed to found out for the host, or the pass outside any run.
    pub(crate) fn note_host_findings(&self, note: impl FnOnce(&mut super::run_state::HostFindings)) {
        self.host_findings.note(note);
    }

    pub(crate) fn host_findings_noted_so_far(&self) -> u64 {
        self.host_findings.notes_so_far()
    }

    /// Hands what a finished run found out besides its result to the run this pass view was handed to, which takes in
    /// its result.
    pub(crate) fn receive_residue(&self, residue: Option<Box<super::run_state::RunResidue>>) {
        if let Some(residue) = residue {
            self.note_host_findings(|into| into.receive(residue.host_findings));
        }
    }

    /// Hands what a finished run found out to the run this pass view was handed to, which used its result.
    pub(crate) fn receive_host_findings(&self, findings: Option<Box<super::run_state::HostFindings>>) {
        if let Some(findings) = findings {
            self.note_host_findings(|into| into.receive(*findings));
        }
    }

    /// The intrinsic sizes passes measured, kept for the passes after them, or inside a run whose result is discarded,
    /// that run's own.
    pub(crate) fn intrinsic_size_caches(&self) -> &'arena super::layout_node_arena::IntrinsicSizeCaches {
        match self.memos {
            MemoScope::Kept => &self.scratch.intrinsic_size_caches,
            MemoScope::Discarded(intrinsic_size_caches) => intrinsic_size_caches,
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn node_data(&self, node: Node) -> &'arena NodeData {
        self.arena().data(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn text_content(&self, node: Node) -> &'arena super::rendered_text::TextContent {
        self.arena
            .text_content(node)
            .expect("text node content must be synced to the arena before layout")
    }

    /// The chunks of the text row `node` for `key`, made by `compute` where the last run that chunked the row's text did
    /// so for another key.
    pub(crate) fn text_chunks(
        &self,
        node: Node,
        key: &super::rendered_text::TextChunkCacheKey,
        compute: impl FnOnce() -> super::text_chunker::ChunkedText,
    ) -> std::sync::Arc<super::rendered_text::CachedTextChunks> {
        super::parallel_layout::check_row_reached_by_forked_task(node.slot_index() as usize, true);
        self.scratch.text_memos().text_chunks(
            self.text_state_index(node),
            self.text_content(node).rendered(),
            key,
            compute,
        )
    }

    /// The inline content prepared for block containers, kept for the runs after the one that prepared it, unless this
    /// pass view is inside a run whose result is discarded.
    pub(crate) fn prepared_inline_content_memos(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<&'arena super::prepared_inline_content::PreparedInlineContentMemos> {
        self.kept_memos().then(|| self.scratch.prepared_inline_content_memos())
    }

    pub(crate) fn take_inline_content_preparation_buffers(
        &self,
    ) -> super::prepared_inline_content::InlineContentPreparationBuffers {
        self.worker_scratch().inline_content_preparation_buffers.take()
    }

    pub(crate) fn return_inline_content_preparation_buffers(
        &self,
        buffers: super::prepared_inline_content::InlineContentPreparationBuffers,
    ) {
        self.worker_scratch().inline_content_preparation_buffers.set(buffers);
    }

    /// Runs `read` with the grapheme segmenter of the text row `node`.
    pub(crate) fn with_grapheme_segmenter<R>(
        &self,
        node: Node,
        read: impl FnOnce(&super::text_chunker::GraphemeSegmenter) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        super::parallel_layout::check_row_reached_by_forked_task(node.slot_index() as usize, true);
        self.scratch.text_memos().with_grapheme_segmenter(
            self.text_state_index(node),
            self.text_content(node).rendered(),
            read,
        )
    }

    fn text_state_index(&self, node: Node) -> u32 {
        self.arena
            .text_state_index(node)
            .expect("a text row holds its text in a text state")
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn style_view(&self, node: Node) -> ComputedValuesView<'arena> {
        self.computed_values_view_if_styled(node)
            .expect("styled node must publish its style container before layout")
    }

    pub(crate) fn replaced_content_facts(&self, node: Node) -> Option<ReplacedContentFacts> {
        self.arena.replaced_content_facts(node)
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn has_replaced_content_facts(&self, node: Node) -> bool {
        self.arena.has_replaced_content_facts(node)
    }

    /// The style of `node`: that of its row, or the position option it is being laid out with.
    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn computed_values_view_if_styled(&self, node: Node) -> Option<ComputedValuesView<'arena>> {
        self.row_and_style(node).1
    }

    /// The row of `node` together with its style as [`Self::computed_values_view_if_styled`] answers it, from one
    /// lookup of the row.
    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn row_and_style(&self, node: Node) -> (&'arena NodeData, Option<ComputedValuesView<'arena>>) {
        let data = self.node_data(node);
        if let Some(style) = self.position_option_style(node) {
            // SAFETY: A position option's style stays alive while a box is laid out with it.
            return (data, Some(unsafe { style.view() }));
        }
        (data, node_facts::node_style_view(data))
    }

    pub(crate) fn can_skip_is_anonymous_text_run(&self, node: Node) -> bool {
        let data = self.node_data(node);
        if !node_facts::has_flag(data, NodeFlag::Anonymous) || data.generated_for.get() != 0 {
            return false;
        }

        let mut child = data.first_child.get();
        while !child.is_invalid() {
            let data = self.node_data(child);
            if !node_facts::kind_is_text(data.kind.get())
                || !self.text_content(child).untransformed_text_is_ascii_whitespace
            {
                return false;
            }
            child = data.next_sibling.get();
        }
        true
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_before(&self, node: Node, other: Node) -> bool {
        self.arena().is_before(node, other)
    }

    pub(crate) fn saved_abspos_layout_inputs(&self, node: Node) -> Option<abspos_inputs::AbsposLayoutInputs> {
        let data = self.node_data(node);
        assert!(node_facts::kind_is_box(data.kind.get()));
        self.arena().saved_abspos_layout_inputs(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn committed_fragment_link(&self, node: Node) -> Option<FragmentLink> {
        self.arena().committed_fragment_link(node)
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn has_committed_fragment_link(&self, node: Node) -> bool {
        self.node_data(node).flags.get() & NodeFlag::HasCommittedFragmentLink as u32 != 0
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn parent(&self, node: Node) -> Node {
        self.node_data(node).parent.get()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn first_child(&self, node: Node) -> Node {
        self.node_data(node).first_child.get()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn last_child(&self, node: Node) -> Node {
        self.node_data(node).last_child.get()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn next_sibling(&self, node: Node) -> Node {
        self.node_data(node).next_sibling.get()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub(crate) fn previous_sibling(&self, node: Node) -> Node {
        self.node_data(node).previous_sibling.get()
    }

    /// The children of `node`, in tree order.
    pub(crate) fn children(self, node: Node) -> impl Iterator<Item = Node> + 'arena {
        std::iter::successors(link(self.first_child(node)), move |&child| {
            link(self.next_sibling(child))
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn siblings_from(self, first: Node, last: Node) -> impl Iterator<Item = Node> + 'arena {
        std::iter::successors(link(first), move |&child| {
            (child != last).then(|| link(self.next_sibling(child))).flatten()
        })
    }

    /// The children of `node`, last first.
    pub(crate) fn children_rev(self, node: Node) -> impl Iterator<Item = Node> + 'arena {
        std::iter::successors(link(self.last_child(node)), move |&child| {
            link(self.previous_sibling(child))
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn in_flow_containing_block(&self, node: Node) -> Node {
        let (innermost_root, innermost_root_containing_block) = self.innermost_run;
        if node == innermost_root {
            return innermost_root_containing_block;
        }
        let mut ancestor = self.parent(node);
        while !ancestor.is_invalid() {
            let data = self.node_data(ancestor);
            if node_facts::node_forms_containing_block_for_children(data, node_facts::node_style_view(data)) {
                return ancestor;
            }
            if ancestor == innermost_root {
                return innermost_root_containing_block;
            }
            ancestor = data.parent.get();
        }
        NodeSlotId::INVALID
    }

    pub(crate) fn containing_block_for_child_run(
        &self,
        child: Node,
        participation: &ParticipationInParentFormattingContext,
    ) -> Node {
        match participation {
            ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::AbsolutelyPositioned(inputs) => inputs.containing_block,
            _ => self.in_flow_containing_block(child),
        }
    }

    /// Whether `ancestor` is `node` or one of its ancestors. The walk stops at `root`, so `node` must be
    /// in `root`'s subtree and `ancestor` must not be above `root`.
    pub(crate) fn is_ancestor(&self, ancestor: Node, mut node: Node, root: Node) -> bool {
        while !node.is_invalid() {
            if node == ancestor {
                return true;
            }
            if node == root {
                return false;
            }
            node = self.node_data(node).parent.get();
        }
        false
    }
}

/// A node's link to another, which is none for an invalid slot.
fn link(node: Node) -> Option<Node> {
    (!node.is_invalid()).then_some(node)
}

use super::*;

pub(crate) const GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_COMMON: u8 = 0;
pub(crate) const GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT: u8 = 1;
pub(crate) const GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_END_PADDING: u8 = 2;
pub(crate) const GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_LTR: u8 = 3;
pub(crate) const GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_RTL: u8 = 4;

pub(crate) fn is_ascii_space(code_unit: u16) -> bool {
    matches!(code_unit, 0x09..=0x0d | 0x20)
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct GlyphData {
    pub(crate) glyphs: libgfx_rust::text_layout::GlyphBuffer,
    pub(crate) font: libgfx_rust::font::FontHandle,
    pub(crate) text_type: u8,
    // GlyphRun::width is not updated by the C++ fragment merge machine.
    pub(crate) width: f32,
    /// Whether the glyphs are set upright in vertical text, one em apart along the inline axis.
    pub(crate) is_upright: bool,
    /// Where merging more glyphs into the run last left it.
    pub(crate) derived_placements_end: Option<libgfx_rust::text_layout::DerivedPlacementsEnd>,
}

/// The glyphs of a text item and the font they are set in, which a line merges into a fragment or makes one of.
pub(crate) struct ItemGlyphRun<'run> {
    pub(crate) glyphs: std::borrow::Cow<'run, libgfx_rust::text_layout::GlyphBuffer>,
    pub(crate) font: &'run libgfx_rust::font::FontHandle,
    pub(crate) text_type: u8,
    pub(crate) width: f32,
    pub(crate) is_upright: bool,
}

impl ItemGlyphRun<'_> {
    /// The glyph run of a fragment made of these glyphs alone, which shares them with the shape they came from until
    /// merging more into it changes them.
    pub(crate) fn into_glyph_data(self) -> GlyphData {
        GlyphData {
            glyphs: self.glyphs.into_owned(),
            font: self.font.clone(),
            text_type: self.text_type,
            width: self.width,
            is_upright: self.is_upright,
            derived_placements_end: None,
        }
    }
}

// The advance of a run's trailing whitespace, recorded at shaping time so that trimming it subtracts exactly what
// shaping added.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct TrailingWhitespace {
    pub(crate) length_in_code_units: usize,
    pub(crate) inline_size: CssPixels,
    /// The inline size of the ASCII white space at the very end alone, which is what intrinsic sizing takes off: An
    /// ideographic space that hangs at the end of a line still counts toward the intrinsic sizes.
    pub(crate) ascii_inline_size: CssPixels,
}

impl std::ops::AddAssign for TrailingWhitespace {
    fn add_assign(&mut self, other: Self) {
        self.length_in_code_units += other.length_in_code_units;
        self.inline_size += other.inline_size;
        self.ascii_inline_size += other.ascii_inline_size;
    }
}

    /// Shaping run ends as UTF-16 offsets in the text node, paired with their original text types.
    pub(crate) runs: Vec<(usize, u8)>,
}

impl LineBoxFragmentData {
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(crate) fn new(
        layout_node: Node,
        start: usize,
        length_in_code_units: usize,
        inline_offset: CssPixels,
        block_offset: CssPixels,
        inline_length: CssPixels,
        block_length: CssPixels,
        border_box_block_start: CssPixels,
        direction: u8,
        writing_mode: u8,
        glyphs: Option<GlyphData>,
        facts: FragmentBuildFacts,
    ) -> Self {
        let record = inline_content::FragmentRecord {
            layout_node,
            style_source: facts.style_source,
            start,
            length_in_code_units,
            inline_offset,
            block_offset,
            relpos_delta: FfiCssPixelPoint::default(),
            inline_length,
            block_length,
            border_box_block_start,
            baseline: CssPixels::default(),
            accumulated_vertical_shift: CssPixels::default(),
            direction,
            writing_mode,
            is_block_ellipsis: false,
            is_text_overflow_ellipsis: false,
            is_atomic_inline: facts.is_atomic_inline,
            white_space_collapse: facts.white_space_collapse,
            content_baselines: None,
            line_index: 0,
            dom_start_offset_in_node: 0,
            dom_end_offset_in_node: 0,
            dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace: 0,
            trimmed_trailing_whitespace: TrailingWhitespace::default(),
            glyph_run: None,
        };
        let mut fragment = Self::with_record(record, glyphs);
        fragment.text_utf16 = facts.text_utf16;
        fragment.text_length_in_code_units = facts.text_length_in_code_units;
        fragment
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_record(record: inline_content::FragmentRecord, glyphs: Option<GlyphData>) -> Self {
        let mut fragment = Self {
            record,
            glyphs,
            insert_position: 0.0,
            current_insert_direction: direction::LTR,
            has_text_overflow_ellipsis: false,
            has_soft_wrap_opportunity_after: false,
            block_ellipsis_text: None,
            is_fully_truncated: false,
            is_hidden_by_text_overflow: false,
            trailing_whitespace: TrailingWhitespace::default(),
            text_utf16: std::ptr::null(),
            text_length_in_code_units: 0,
            box_cells: None,
        };
        if let Some(glyphs) = &fragment.glyphs {
            fragment.current_insert_direction = fragment.resolve_glyph_run_direction(glyphs.text_type);
            if fragment.direction == direction::RTL {
                fragment.insert_position = fragment.inline_length.to_double() as f32;
            }
        }
        fragment
    }

    /// The sizes and box sides of the box of the fragment of an element item.
    #[track_caller]
    pub(crate) fn box_cells(&self) -> used_values::RootInputCells {
        self.box_cells
            .expect("the fragment of an element item carries the cells of its box")
    }

    pub(crate) fn text(&self) -> &[u16] {
        if self.length_in_code_units == 0 || self.is_block_ellipsis || self.is_text_overflow_ellipsis {
            return &[];
        }
        assert!(!self.text_utf16.is_null());
        assert!(self.start + self.length_in_code_units <= self.text_length_in_code_units);
        // SAFETY: The text snapshot owns this buffer for the layout-state
        // lifetime, and the asserted range comes from its chunk snapshot.
        unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(self.text_utf16.add(self.start), self.length_in_code_units) }
    }

    pub(crate) fn reshape_prefix_for_block_ellipsis(
        &self,
        full_text: &[u16],
        end: usize,
        letter_spacing: f32,
        word_spacing: f32,
    ) -> (CssPixels, GlyphData) {
        let glyphs = self.glyphs.as_ref().expect("a text prefix has glyphs");
        let text = self
            .block_ellipsis_text
            .as_ref()
            .expect("a text prefix has shaping boundaries");
        let mut prefix: Option<Self> = None;
        let mut start = self.start;
        for &(run_end, text_type) in &text.runs {
            let run_end = run_end.min(end);
            if run_end <= start {
                continue;
            }
            let shape = libgfx_rust::text_layout::shape_text_shared(
                &glyphs.font,
                &full_text[start..run_end],
                libgfx_rust::text_layout::TextType::try_from(text_type).expect("invalid Gfx::GlyphRun::TextType"),
                letter_spacing,
                word_spacing,
                text_chunker::joining_context(full_text, start..run_end),
                glyphs.is_upright,
            );
            let inline_size = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(shape.width());
            let run = ItemGlyphRun {
                glyphs: std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(shape.glyphs()),
                font: &glyphs.font,
                text_type,
                width: shape.width(),
                is_upright: glyphs.is_upright,
            };
            if let Some(prefix) = &mut prefix {
                prefix.append_glyph_run(&run, inline_size, start - self.start);
            } else {
                let mut record = self.record.clone();
                record.inline_length = inline_size;
                prefix = Some(Self::with_record(record, Some(run.into_glyph_data())));
            }
            start = run_end;
            if start == end {
                break;
            }
        }
        let prefix = prefix.expect("a soft wrap retains a nonempty text prefix");
        let inline_size = prefix.inline_length;
        let mut glyphs = prefix.glyphs.unwrap();
        glyphs.width = inline_size.to_double() as f32;
        (inline_size, glyphs)
    }

    /// Whether the fragment counts toward the height and baseline of its line: Content that a block overflow ellipsis
    /// displaced doesn't, but content that a text-overflow ellipsis hides does.
    pub(crate) fn takes_part_in_line_alignment(&self) -> bool {
        !self.is_fully_truncated || self.is_hidden_by_text_overflow
    }

    pub(crate) fn ends_in_whitespace(&self) -> bool {
        self.text().last().is_some_and(|code_unit| is_ascii_space(*code_unit))
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_justifiable_whitespace(&self) -> bool {
        self.text() == [b' ' as u16]
    }

    fn resolve_glyph_run_direction(&self, text_type: u8) -> u8 {
        match text_type {
            GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_COMMON | GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT | GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_END_PADDING => self.direction,
            GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_LTR => direction::LTR,
            GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_RTL => direction::RTL,
            _ => panic!("invalid glyph text type"),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn append_glyph_run(&mut self, run: &ItemGlyphRun<'_>, run_inline_size: CssPixels, text_offset: usize) {
        let text_offset = u32::try_from(text_offset).expect("text offset fits a shaping cluster index");
        match self.direction {
            direction::LTR => self.append_glyph_run_ltr(run, run_inline_size, text_offset),
            direction::RTL => self.append_glyph_run_rtl(run, run_inline_size, text_offset),
            _ => panic!("invalid direction"),
        }
    }

    fn append_glyph_run_ltr(&mut self, run: &ItemGlyphRun<'_>, run_inline_size: CssPixels, text_offset: u32) {
        let run_direction = self.resolve_glyph_run_direction(run.text_type);
        let inline_offset = self.inline_length.to_double() as f32;

        if self.current_insert_direction != run_direction {
            if run_direction == direction::RTL {
                self.insert_position = inline_offset;
            }
            self.current_insert_direction = run_direction;
        }

        let insert_position = self.insert_position;
        let glyph_data = self.glyphs.as_mut().expect("merged fragment must have a glyph run");
        if run_direction == direction::LTR
            && glyph_data.glyphs.append_keeping_placements_derived(
                &mut glyph_data.derived_placements_end,
                &run.glyphs,
                inline_offset,
                text_offset,
            )
        {
            self.inline_length += run_inline_size;
            return;
        }
        let existing = &mut glyph_data.glyphs;
        existing.reserve(run.glyphs.len());
        match run_direction {
            direction::LTR => {
                for placed in run.glyphs.placed() {
                    existing.push_placed(libgfx_rust::text_layout::PlacedGlyph {
                        x: placed.x + inline_offset,
                        cluster_start: placed.cluster_start + text_offset,
                        ..placed
                    });
                }
            }
            direction::RTL => {
                let run_offset = run_inline_size.to_double() as f32;
                existing.update_positions(|_, x, _| {
                    if *x >= insert_position {
                        *x += run_offset;
                    }
                });
                for placed in run.glyphs.placed() {
                    existing.push_placed(libgfx_rust::text_layout::PlacedGlyph {
                        x: placed.x + insert_position,
                        cluster_start: placed.cluster_start + text_offset,
                        ..placed
                    });
                }
            }
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
        self.inline_length += run_inline_size;
    }

    fn append_glyph_run_rtl(&mut self, run: &ItemGlyphRun<'_>, run_inline_size: CssPixels, text_offset: u32) {
        let run_direction = self.resolve_glyph_run_direction(run.text_type);
        let run_offset = run_inline_size.to_double() as f32;

        if self.current_insert_direction != run_direction {
            if run_direction == direction::LTR {
                self.insert_position = 0.0;
            }
            self.current_insert_direction = run_direction;
        }

        let insert_position = self.insert_position;
        let existing = &mut self
            .glyphs
            .as_mut()
            .expect("merged fragment must have a glyph run")
            .glyphs;
        existing.reserve(run.glyphs.len());
        match run_direction {
            direction::LTR => {
                existing.update_positions(|_, x, _| {
                    if *x >= insert_position {
                        *x += run_offset;
                    }
                });
                for placed in run.glyphs.placed() {
                    existing.push_placed(libgfx_rust::text_layout::PlacedGlyph {
                        x: placed.x + insert_position,
                        cluster_start: placed.cluster_start + text_offset,
                        ..placed
                    });
                }
            }
            direction::RTL => {
                if run.text_type != GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_END_PADDING {
                    existing.update_positions(|_, x, _| *x += run_offset);
                }
                for placed in run.glyphs.placed() {
                    existing.push_placed(libgfx_rust::text_layout::PlacedGlyph {
                        cluster_start: placed.cluster_start + text_offset,
                        ..placed
                    });
                }
            }
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }

        self.inline_length += run_inline_size;
        self.insert_position += run_offset;
    }
}

use super::*;

// NB: Keep the addition order shared with intrinsic sizing: CssPixels arithmetic saturates.
pub(crate) fn inline_advance(
    leading_margin: CssPixels,
    leading_size: CssPixels,
    content_inline_size: CssPixels,
    trailing_size: CssPixels,
    trailing_margin: CssPixels,
) -> CssPixels {
    leading_margin + leading_size + content_inline_size + trailing_size + trailing_margin
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct StaticPositionMarker {
    pub(crate) box_: Node,
    pub(crate) inline_offset: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) block_offset: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) writing_mode: u8,
    pub(crate) preceded_by_in_flow_content: bool,
    /// How many fragments the line held when the marker was added, which places it in the line's logical order.
    pub(crate) fragments_before: usize,
}

impl StaticPositionMarker {
    pub(crate) fn offset(self) -> (CssPixels, CssPixels) {
        geometry::to_physical(self.writing_mode, self.inline_offset, self.block_offset)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct InlineBoxBaseline {
    pub(crate) box_: Node,
    pub(crate) baseline: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) accumulated_vertical_shift: CssPixels,
}

/// An inline box on a line, and where on the line its content begins. No fragment on the line belongs to a box that's
/// empty, or to one whose content there is only whitespace that collapsed away, the forced break that ends the line,
/// or a block-level box the line stops at.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct InlineBoxStrut {
    pub(crate) box_: Node,
    pub(crate) inline_offset: CssPixels,
}

/// What text-overflow elided from the end of a line.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct TextOverflowElision {
    /// The inline length of the line before the ellipsis.
    pub(crate) inline_length: CssPixels,
    /// Where in the line the fragment that ends in the ellipsis starts.
    pub(crate) ellipsis_fragment_start: CssPixels,
    /// The inline length of the fragment that ends in the ellipsis before it was shortened.
    pub(crate) ellipsis_fragment_inline_length: CssPixels,
    /// How much of its inline length that fragment lost at its left end, where the ellipsis is on the left. And there,
    /// the fragments are still where the content put them, rather than where the line box starts.
    pub(crate) ellipsis_fragment_inline_length_lost_on_left: Option<CssPixels>,
}

/// What a line its block container interrupted for a block-level box keeps of the box, as the layout of the box left it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct BlockLevelBoxOnLine {
    /// The offset of the content box of the box in its containing block.
    pub(crate) content_offset: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    /// The sizes and box sides of the box.
    pub(crate) cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    /// The baselines the box gives the line.
    pub(crate) baselines: formatting_context::LineBaselines,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct LineBoxData {
    pub(crate) start: super::fragmentation::LinePosition,
    pub(crate) fragments: Vec<line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData>,
    pub(crate) static_position_markers: Vec<StaticPositionMarker>,
    pub(crate) inline_box_baselines: Vec<InlineBoxBaseline>,
    /// The inline boxes that are on the line whether or not a fragment on it belongs to them. One that no fragment
    /// belongs to takes part in the height and alignment of the line box by its strut (a box as wide as nothing, with
    /// its font and line height) — but only where the line holds content or ends in a forced break.
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline-3/#invisible-line-boxes
    pub(crate) inline_box_struts: Vec<InlineBoxStrut>,
    pub(crate) text_overflow_elision: Option<TextOverflowElision>,
    /// The block-level box the line holds, where the line is interrupted for one.
    pub(crate) block_level_box: Option<BlockLevelBoxOnLine>,
    /// Whether placing the line aligned it as the last line of its block, or a line before a forced break, by
    /// text-align-last. Justification follows the same decision.
    pub(crate) uses_last_line_alignment: Option<bool>,
    /// Where the line box starts, past any floats, once the line is placed.
    pub(crate) placed_inline_start: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) record: inline_content::LineRecord,
}

impl std::ops::Deref for LineBoxData {
    type Target = inline_content::LineRecord;
    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
        &self.record
    }
}

impl std::ops::DerefMut for LineBoxData {
    fn deref_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Self::Target {
        &mut self.record
    }
}

impl LineBoxData {
    pub(crate) fn new(direction: u8, writing_mode: u8, start: super::fragmentation::LinePosition) -> Self {
        Self {
            start,
            fragments: Vec::new(),
            static_position_markers: Vec::new(),
            inline_box_baselines: Vec::new(),
            inline_box_struts: Vec::new(),
            text_overflow_elision: None,
            block_level_box: None,
            uses_last_line_alignment: None,
            placed_inline_start: CssPixels::default(),
            record: inline_content::LineRecord {
                direction,
                writing_mode,
                is_empty: true,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn retained_metrics(&self) -> inline_content::LineRecord {
        inline_content::LineRecord {
            is_empty: self.is_empty(),
            horizontal_extent: inline_formatting_context::line_physical_horizontal_extent(self),
            ..self.record
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn push_fragment(&mut self, fragment: line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData) {
        // Many lines contain a single fragment, so avoid Vec's initial capacity of four large fragments.
        if self.fragments.capacity() == 0 {
            self.fragments.reserve_exact(1);
        }
        self.fragments.push(fragment);
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(crate) fn add_fragment(
        &mut self,
        layout_node: Node,
        start: usize,
        length: usize,
        leading_size: CssPixels,
        trailing_size: CssPixels,
        leading_margin: CssPixels,
        trailing_margin: CssPixels,
        content_inline_size: CssPixels,
        content_block_size: CssPixels,
        border_box_block_start: CssPixels,
        border_box_block_end: CssPixels,
        glyphs: Option<line_box_fragment::ItemGlyphRun<'_>>,
        facts: line_box_fragment::FragmentBuildFacts,
        text_align_is_justify: bool,
        trailing_whitespace: line_box_fragment::TrailingWhitespace,
    ) {
        let can_merge = glyphs.as_ref().is_some_and(|glyphs| {
            !text_align_is_justify
                && self.fragments.last().is_some_and(|last| {
                    !last.has_soft_wrap_opportunity_after
                        && last.layout_node == layout_node
                        && last.glyphs.as_ref().is_some_and(|last_glyphs| {
                            last_glyphs.font == *glyphs.font && last_glyphs.is_upright == glyphs.is_upright
                        })
                        && last.start + last.length_in_code_units == start
                })
        });
        if can_merge {
            let last = self.fragments.last_mut().unwrap();
            last.length_in_code_units += length;
            last.append_glyph_run(&glyphs.unwrap(), content_inline_size, start - last.start);
            if trailing_whitespace.length_in_code_units == length {
                last.trailing_whitespace += trailing_whitespace;
            } else {
                last.trailing_whitespace = trailing_whitespace;
            }
        } else {
            let inline_offset = leading_margin + leading_size + self.record.inline_length;
            let mut fragment = line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData::new(
                layout_node,
                start,
                length,
                inline_offset,
                CssPixels::default(),
                content_inline_size,
                content_block_size,
                border_box_block_start,
                self.direction,
                self.writing_mode,
                glyphs.map(line_box_fragment::ItemGlyphRun::into_glyph_data),
                facts,
            );
            fragment.trailing_whitespace = trailing_whitespace;
            self.push_fragment(fragment);
        }
        self.record.inline_length += inline_advance(
            leading_margin,
            leading_size,
            content_inline_size,
            trailing_size,
            trailing_margin,
        );
        self.block_length = self
            .block_length
            .max(content_block_size + border_box_block_start + border_box_block_end);
    }

    pub(crate) fn advance_inline_length(&mut self, inline_size: CssPixels) {
        self.record.inline_length += inline_size;
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_static_position_marker(&mut self, box_: Node, preceded_by_inline_box_start_edges: bool) {
        self.static_position_markers.push(StaticPositionMarker {
            box_,
            inline_offset: self.record.inline_length,
            block_offset: CssPixels::default(),
            writing_mode: self.writing_mode,
            preceded_by_in_flow_content: !self.fragments.is_empty() || preceded_by_inline_box_start_edges,
            fragments_before: self.fragments.len(),
        });
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_inline_box_baseline(
        &mut self,
        box_: Node,
        baseline: CssPixels,
        accumulated_vertical_shift: CssPixels,
    ) -> bool {
        if self.inline_box_baselines.iter().any(|entry| entry.box_ == box_) {
            return false;
        }
        self.inline_box_baselines.push(InlineBoxBaseline {
            box_,
            baseline,
            accumulated_vertical_shift,
        });
        true
    }

    pub(crate) fn inline_box_baseline(&self, box_: Node) -> Option<InlineBoxBaseline> {
        self.inline_box_baselines
            .iter()
            .find(|entry| entry.box_ == box_)
            .copied()
    }

    /// Puts `box_` on the line, with its content beginning `leading_edges` past the content the line holds so far.
    pub(crate) fn add_inline_box_strut(&mut self, box_: Node, leading_edges: CssPixels) {
        if self.inline_box_struts.iter().any(|strut| strut.box_ == box_) {
            return;
        }
        self.inline_box_struts.push(InlineBoxStrut {
            box_,
            inline_offset: self.record.inline_length + leading_edges,
        });
    }

    /// Whether the struts of the inline boxes on the line count, which they don't on a line with nothing else on it.
    pub(crate) fn takes_inline_box_struts(&self) -> bool {
        !self.has_block_level_box && (!self.fragments.is_empty() || self.has_forced_break)
    }

    pub(crate) fn clamp_static_position_markers_to_inline_length(&mut self) {
        for marker in &mut self.static_position_markers {
            if marker.inline_offset > self.record.inline_length {
                marker.inline_offset = self.record.inline_length;
            }
        }
    }

    fn calculate_or_trim_trailing_whitespace(&mut self, should_remove: bool) -> CssPixels {
        let mut whitespace_inline_size = CssPixels::default();
        // The whitespace fragments removed so far that follow on from the same node.
        let mut removed_whitespace: Option<(Node, line_box_fragment::TrailingWhitespace)> = None;
        let mut fragment_index = self.fragments.len();

        let last_fragment_index = loop {
            if fragment_index == 0 {
                return whitespace_inline_size;
            }
            fragment_index -= 1;
            let fragment = &self.fragments[fragment_index];
            if !matches!(
                fragment.white_space_collapse,
                white_space_collapse::COLLAPSE | white_space_collapse::PRESERVE_BREAKS
            ) {
                return whitespace_inline_size;
            }
            // NB: A fragment that's all trailing white space other than a space, such as an element holding just an
            //     ideographic space, is trimmed to nothing rather than removed, so a line with nothing else on it stays.
            let is_all_trailing_whitespace = fragment.length_in_code_units > 0
                && fragment.trailing_whitespace.length_in_code_units == fragment.length_in_code_units;
            if is_all_trailing_whitespace && !fragment.is_justifiable_whitespace() {
                let fragment_trailing_whitespace = fragment.trailing_whitespace;
                whitespace_inline_size += fragment_trailing_whitespace.inline_size;
                if should_remove {
                    let fragment = &mut self.fragments[fragment_index];
                    fragment.length_in_code_units -= fragment_trailing_whitespace.length_in_code_units;
                    fragment.inline_length -= fragment_trailing_whitespace.inline_size;
                    fragment.trailing_whitespace = line_box_fragment::TrailingWhitespace::default();
                    fragment.record.trimmed_trailing_whitespace += fragment_trailing_whitespace;
                    self.record.inline_length -= fragment_trailing_whitespace.inline_size;
                    self.clamp_static_position_markers_to_inline_length();
                }
                continue;
            }
            if !fragment.is_justifiable_whitespace() {
                break fragment_index;
            }

            whitespace_inline_size += fragment.inline_length;
            if should_remove {
                let removed = line_box_fragment::TrailingWhitespace {
                    length_in_code_units: fragment.length_in_code_units,
                    inline_size: fragment.inline_length,
                    ascii_inline_size: fragment.inline_length,
                };
                removed_whitespace = match removed_whitespace {
                    Some((node, mut sum)) if node == fragment.layout_node => {
                        sum += removed;
                        Some((node, sum))
                    }
                    _ => Some((fragment.layout_node, removed)),
                };
                self.record.inline_length -= fragment.inline_length;
                self.fragments.remove(fragment_index);
                self.clamp_static_position_markers_to_inline_length();
            }
        };

        let last_fragment = &self.fragments[last_fragment_index];
        if last_fragment.text().is_empty() {
            return whitespace_inline_size;
        }

        // Trim the last fragment's trailing whitespace by the advance recorded when it was shaped.
        let fragment_trailing_whitespace = last_fragment.trailing_whitespace;
        whitespace_inline_size += fragment_trailing_whitespace.inline_size;
        if should_remove {
            let fragment = &mut self.fragments[last_fragment_index];
            fragment.length_in_code_units -= fragment_trailing_whitespace.length_in_code_units;
            fragment.inline_length -= fragment_trailing_whitespace.inline_size;
            fragment.trailing_whitespace = line_box_fragment::TrailingWhitespace::default();
            fragment.record.trimmed_trailing_whitespace += fragment_trailing_whitespace;
            if let Some((node, removed)) = removed_whitespace
                && node == fragment.layout_node
            {
                fragment.record.trimmed_trailing_whitespace += removed;
            }
            self.record.inline_length -= fragment_trailing_whitespace.inline_size;
            self.clamp_static_position_markers_to_inline_length();
        }
        whitespace_inline_size
    }

    pub(crate) fn trailing_whitespace_inline_size(&mut self) -> CssPixels {
        self.calculate_or_trim_trailing_whitespace(false)
    }

    pub(crate) fn trim_trailing_whitespace(&mut self) {
        let trimmed_inline_size = self.calculate_or_trim_trailing_whitespace(true);
        // An inline box after the trimmed whitespace is at the end of what the line keeps.
        if trimmed_inline_size != CssPixels::default()
            && let Some(last) = self.fragments.last()
        {
            let end = last.inline_offset + last.inline_length;
            for strut in &mut self.inline_box_struts {
                strut.inline_offset = strut.inline_offset.min(end);
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn trim_trailing_whitespace_before_block_ellipsis(&mut self) {
        while let Some(fragment) = self.fragments.last_mut() {
            let whitespace = std::mem::take(&mut fragment.trailing_whitespace);
            if whitespace.length_in_code_units == 0 {
                break;
            }
            self.record.inline_length -= whitespace.inline_size;
            if whitespace.length_in_code_units == fragment.length_in_code_units {
                self.fragments.pop();
                continue;
            }
            fragment.length_in_code_units -= whitespace.length_in_code_units;
            fragment.inline_length -= whitespace.inline_size;
            fragment.record.trimmed_trailing_whitespace += whitespace;
            break;
        }
        self.clamp_static_position_markers_to_inline_length();
    }
    pub(crate) fn is_empty_or_ends_in_whitespace(&self) -> bool {
        self.fragments
            .last()
            .is_none_or(line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData::ends_in_whitespace)
    }

    pub(crate) fn visible_fragments(&self) -> impl DoubleEndedIterator<Item = &line_box_fragment::LineBoxFragmentData> {
        self.fragments.iter().filter(|fragment| !fragment.is_fully_truncated)
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.fragments.is_empty() && !self.has_break
    }

    pub(crate) fn counts_toward_widows_and_orphans(&self) -> bool {
        // Empty records can have a soft break when advancing below a float, without representing a line of content.
        !self.fragments.is_empty() || self.has_forced_break
    }
}

use super::*;
use line_box_fragment::{GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_LTR, GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_RTL};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum ForcedBreak {
    No,
    Yes,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct VerticalAlignMetrics {
    baseline: CssPixels,
    block_size: CssPixels,
    effective_box_block_start_offset: CssPixels,
    effective_box_block_end_offset: CssPixels,
    line_height: CssPixels,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct InlineBoxAlignment {
    box_: Node,
    vertical_shift: CssPixels,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct FragmentAlignmentSnapshot {
    style_source: Node,
    layout_node: Node,
    baseline: CssPixels,
    is_atomic_inline: bool,
    inline_offset: CssPixels,
    block_offset: CssPixels,
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#line-height
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct LineRelativeAlignedSubtree {
    root: Node,
    alignment: u8,
    block_start: CssPixels,
    block_end: CssPixels,
    shift: CssPixels,
}

/// Extends the aligned subtree whose root and alignment `subtree` names to hold `start..end`, or the line box
/// `earliest..latest` where the box is in no aligned subtree.
fn extend_aligned_subtree_or_line_box(
    aligned_subtrees: &mut Vec<LineRelativeAlignedSubtree>,
    (earliest, latest): (&mut CssPixels, &mut CssPixels),
    subtree: Option<(Node, u8)>,
    (start, end): (CssPixels, CssPixels),
) {
    let Some((root, alignment)) = subtree else {
        *earliest = (*earliest).min(start);
        *latest = (*latest).max(end);
        return;
    };
    match aligned_subtrees.iter_mut().find(|subtree| subtree.root == root) {
        Some(subtree) => {
            subtree.block_start = subtree.block_start.min(start);
            subtree.block_end = subtree.block_end.max(end);
        }
        None => aligned_subtrees.push(LineRelativeAlignedSubtree {
            root,
            alignment,
            block_start: start,
            block_end: end,
            shift: CssPixels::default(),
        }),
    }
}

struct LineAlignment {
    earliest: CssPixels,
    latest: CssPixels,
    line_box_baseline: CssPixels,
    has_line_relative_aligned_subtree: bool,
    aligned_subtrees: Vec<LineRelativeAlignedSubtree>,
    first_unshifted_text_baseline: Option<CssPixels>,
}

/// What the line-height calculation quirk needs to know about the text on a line, found once for the line.
struct LineTextFacts {
    in_line_height_quirks_mode: bool,
    /// The fragments from this one on are those of the struts of inline boxes.
    strut_fragment_start: usize,
    /// The fragments from the first to the last that isn't collapsible whitespace, all of which the line keeps.
    kept_fragments: std::ops::Range<usize>,
    /// The inline boxes that hold text the line keeps directly, found only in quirks mode.
    boxes_holding_text: std::collections::HashSet<Node>,
    /// Whether a block ellipsis displaced all of the line's content.
    holds_only_block_ellipsis: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct LineBuilder<'builder, 'context> {
    context: &'builder inline_formatting_context::InlineFormattingContext<'context>,
    available_inline_size_for_current_line: AvailableSize,
    /// The inline size that text-wrap-style: balance takes off the available inline size of each line of each group
    /// between forced breaks, for the lines to break at.
    balancing_reductions: Vec<Option<CssPixels>>,
    forced_break_count: usize,
    /// Whether this builder finds line breaks without placing the boxes on the lines.
    only_finds_line_breaks: bool,
    /// Heights retained across retries, indexed by content lines rather than empty lines skipped to clear floats.
    float_fit_heights: Option<Vec<CssPixels>>,
    float_fit_line_index: usize,
    float_fit_trial: bool,
    float_refit: Option<(usize, CssPixels)>,
    current_block_offset: CssPixels,
    max_block_size_on_current_line: CssPixels,
    nodes_with_edges_of_collapsed_whitespace: Vec<(Node, CssPixels)>,
    /// The outside markers that the first line box this builder lays out contributes to.
    outside_marker_line: Option<block_formatting_context::OutsideMarkerLine>,
    unbreakable_run_inline_size_interrupted_by_float: CssPixels,
    /// The advance of the preserved white space that a line is breaking at, which hangs at the end of that line.
    hanging_whitespace_inline_size: CssPixels,
    /// The end edges of the inline boxes that end with the white space a line is breaking at, which stay on that line.
    end_edges_of_whitespace_at_break: CssPixels,
    /// How many lines from the first are known to hold no content, while no line is known to: Every line until the
    /// first formatted line is one past floats that held nothing.
    lines_known_to_hold_no_content: Option<usize>,
    text_indentation: inline_formatting_context::TextIndentation,
    direction: u8,
    /// The direction that unicode-bidi: plaintext gives a line from the first strong text of the next content, while
    /// the line holds none yet.
    plaintext_direction_of_next_content: Option<u8>,
    /// The last search for the first strong text ahead: the items it covers, from where it started to where it
    /// stopped, and the text type it found.
    first_strong_text_ahead: Option<(std::ops::RangeInclusive<u32>, Option<u8>)>,
    last_line_needs_update: bool,
    is_continuation: bool,
    should_advance_to_last_line_box_block_end: bool,
    current_line_committed_pending_margin: bool,
    pending_margin_follows_block_level_box: bool,
    containing_style: StyleValues<'context>,
    fragment_facts_cache: Option<(Node, line_box_fragment::FragmentBuildFacts)>,
    style_cache: Cell<Option<(Node, StyleValues<'context>)>>,
    /// The lookups behind the facts last asked for. Keeping the facts themselves copied the pass they
    /// hold into the cell and back, and the copy of the pass's padded tail stalled the loads after it.
    facts_cache: Cell<Option<(Node, &'builder NodeData, Option<ComputedValuesView<'builder>>)>>,
}

impl<'builder, 'context> LineBuilder<'builder, 'context> {
    pub(crate) fn new(context: &'builder inline_formatting_context::InlineFormattingContext<'context>) -> Self {
        let mut builder = Self::initialized(context);
        builder.begin_new_line(false, true, ForcedBreak::No);
        builder
    }

    /// A builder that only finds where the lines break, to balance them.
    pub(crate) fn new_for_finding_balanced_line_breaks(
        context: &'builder inline_formatting_context::InlineFormattingContext<'context>,
    ) -> Self {
        let mut builder = Self::initialized(context);
        builder.only_finds_line_breaks = true;
        builder.begin_new_line(false, true, ForcedBreak::No);
        builder
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_float_fit_heights(&mut self, heights: Vec<CssPixels>, trial: bool) {
        self.float_fit_heights = Some(heights);
        self.float_fit_line_index = 0;
        self.float_fit_trial = trial;
        self.float_refit = None;
        if trial {
            self.only_finds_line_breaks = true;
        }
        self.recalculate_available_space();
    }

    fn float_fit_height(&self) -> CssPixels {
        self.float_fit_heights
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|heights| heights.get(self.float_fit_line_index))
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub(crate) fn float_refit(&self) -> Option<(usize, CssPixels)> {
        self.float_refit
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_balancing_reductions(&mut self, balancing_reductions: Vec<Option<CssPixels>>) {
        self.balancing_reductions = balancing_reductions;
    }

    pub(crate) fn new_for_continuation(
        context: &'builder inline_formatting_context::InlineFormattingContext<'context>,
        after_forced_break: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        let mut builder = Self::initialized(context);
        builder.is_continuation = true;
        builder.begin_new_line(
            false,
            true,
            if after_forced_break {
                ForcedBreak::Yes
            } else {
                ForcedBreak::No
            },
        );
        builder
    }

    fn initialized(context: &'builder inline_formatting_context::InlineFormattingContext<'context>) -> Self {
        let style = context.style(context.containing_block);
        let containing_inline_size = context.input.containing_block_constraints.inline_basis();
        Self {
            context,
            available_inline_size_for_current_line: AvailableSize::Indefinite,
            balancing_reductions: Vec::new(),
            forced_break_count: 0,
            only_finds_line_breaks: false,
            float_fit_heights: None,
            float_fit_line_index: 0,
            float_fit_trial: false,
            float_refit: None,
            current_block_offset: CssPixels::default(),
            max_block_size_on_current_line: CssPixels::default(),
            nodes_with_edges_of_collapsed_whitespace: Vec::new(),
            outside_marker_line: context.parent.pending_outside_marker_line(),
            unbreakable_run_inline_size_interrupted_by_float: CssPixels::default(),
            hanging_whitespace_inline_size: CssPixels::default(),
            end_edges_of_whitespace_at_break: CssPixels::default(),
            lines_known_to_hold_no_content: Some(0),
            text_indentation: inline_formatting_context::TextIndentation::of(style, containing_inline_size),
            direction: style.direction(),
            plaintext_direction_of_next_content: None,
            first_strong_text_ahead: None,
            last_line_needs_update: false,
            is_continuation: false,
            should_advance_to_last_line_box_block_end: false,
            current_line_committed_pending_margin: false,
            pending_margin_follows_block_level_box: false,
            containing_style: style,
            fragment_facts_cache: None,
            style_cache: Cell::new(None),
            facts_cache: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn new_after_reused_lines(
        context: &'builder inline_formatting_context::InlineFormattingContext<'context>,
    ) -> Self {
        assert!(!context.line_data().line_boxes.is_empty());
        let current_block_offset = context.line_data().line_boxes.last().unwrap().next_line_block_offset;
        let mut builder = Self::initialized(context);
        builder.current_block_offset = current_block_offset;
        builder.push_line_box();
        builder.begin_new_line(false, true, ForcedBreak::No);
        builder.current_line_committed_pending_margin = true;
        builder
    }

    fn context(&self) -> &inline_formatting_context::InlineFormattingContext<'context> {
        self.context
    }

    fn line_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.context().line_data().line_boxes.len()
    }

    fn push_line_box(&self) {
        self.context()
            .line_data_mut()
            .line_boxes
            .push(line_box::LineBoxData::new(
                self.direction,
                // NB: Lines are laid out in the frame of their formatting context, where they run horizontally.
                writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB,
                self.context().current_line_start.get(),
            ));
    }

    fn ensure_last_line_index(&mut self) -> usize {
        if self.line_count() == 0 {
            self.push_line_box();
        }
        self.line_count() - 1
    }

    fn line(&self, index: usize) -> Ref<'_, line_box::LineBoxData> {
        Ref::map(self.context().line_data(), |data| &data.line_boxes[index])
    }

    fn line_mut(&self, index: usize) -> RefMut<'_, line_box::LineBoxData> {
        RefMut::map(self.context().line_data_mut(), |data| &mut data.line_boxes[index])
    }

    fn containing_style(&self) -> StyleValues<'_> {
        self.containing_style
    }

    fn style(&self, node: Node) -> StyleValues<'context> {
        if let Some((cached_node, style)) = self.style_cache.get()
            && cached_node == node
        {
            return style;
        }
        let style = self.context().style(node);
        self.style_cache.set(Some((node, style)));
        style
    }

    fn facts(&self, node: Node) -> NodeFacts<'builder> {
        if let Some((cached_node, data, style_payloads)) = self.facts_cache.get()
            && cached_node == node
        {
            return NodeFacts::from_lookups(&self.context.pass, node, data, style_payloads);
        }
        let facts = NodeFacts::new(&self.context.pass, node);
        self.facts_cache.set(Some((node, facts.data(), facts.style_view())));
        facts
    }

    fn fragment_facts(&mut self, node: Node) -> line_box_fragment::FragmentBuildFacts {
        if let Some((cached_node, facts)) = self.fragment_facts_cache
            && cached_node == node
        {
            return facts;
        }
        let style_source = self.context().style_source(node);
        let style = self.style(style_source);
        let facts = self.facts(node);
        let (text_utf16, text_length) = if facts.is_text_node() {
            let text = &self.context().pass.text_content(node).text;
            (text.as_ptr(), text.len())
        } else {
            (std::ptr::null(), 0)
        };
        let facts = line_box_fragment::FragmentBuildFacts {
            style_source,
            is_atomic_inline: facts.is_atomic_inline(),
            white_space_collapse: style.white_space_collapse(),
            text_utf16,
            text_length_in_code_units: text_length,
        };
        self.fragment_facts_cache = Some((node, facts));
        facts
    }

    fn begin_new_line(&mut self, advance: bool, first_in_sequence: bool, forced: ForcedBreak) {
        let line_height = self.containing_style().line_height();
        if advance {
            if first_in_sequence {
                if self.should_advance_to_last_line_box_block_end && self.line_count() > 1 {
                    let previous_line_end = self.line(self.line_count() - 2).physical_vertical_end();
                    self.current_block_offset = previous_line_end;
                } else {
                    self.current_block_offset += self.max_block_size_on_current_line.max(line_height);
                }
            } else if let Some(next) = self
                .context()
                .next_float_band_block_start_after(self.current_block_offset)
            {
                self.current_block_offset = next;
            } else {
                self.current_block_offset += self.max_block_size_on_current_line.max(line_height);
            }
        }
        if self.float_fit_heights.is_some() {
            self.max_block_size_on_current_line = CssPixels::default();
        }
        self.recalculate_available_space();
        let line_index = self.ensure_last_line_index();
        self.line_mut(line_index).original_available_inline_size = self.available_inline_size_for_current_line;
        self.max_block_size_on_current_line = CssPixels::default();
        self.last_line_needs_update = true;
        self.should_advance_to_last_line_box_block_end = false;
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text-3/#text-indent-property
        // "only lines that are the first formatted line of an element are affected."
        // NB: Line boxes beside floats that no content fit beside come before the first formatted line, rather than
        //     being it.
        // NB: Each line before this one is checked once, from where the check for the line before it stopped.
        while let Some(checked) = self.lines_known_to_hold_no_content
            && checked < line_index
        {
            let holds_no_content = {
                let line = self.line(checked);
                !line.counts_toward_widows_and_orphans() && line.block_level_box.is_none()
            };
            self.lines_known_to_hold_no_content = holds_no_content.then_some(checked + 1);
        }
        let is_first_formatted_line = !self.is_continuation && self.lines_known_to_hold_no_content.is_some();
        let indent = self
            .text_indentation
            .indent_of_line(is_first_formatted_line, forced == ForcedBreak::Yes);
        {
            let mut line = self.line_mut(line_index);
            line.inline_length += indent;
            line.indent = indent;
        }
        self.current_line_committed_pending_margin = false;
    }

    pub(crate) fn break_line(
        &mut self,
        forced: ForcedBreak,
        forced_break: Option<inline_content::ForcedBreakPosition>,
        next_size: Option<CssPixels>,
    ) {
        self.break_line_sized_by(forced, forced_break, next_size, None);
    }

    /// Breaks the line, as break_line() does. `size_at`, where given, is the inline size of the next content where a
    /// line starts at the given position, for content whose size depends on that (tabs, e.g.): Each line the break
    /// moves past floats to is checked with the size the content would have there.
    fn break_line_sized_by(
        &mut self,
        forced: ForcedBreak,
        forced_break: Option<inline_content::ForcedBreakPosition>,
        next_size: Option<CssPixels>,
        mut size_at: Option<&mut dyn FnMut(CssPixels) -> CssPixels>,
    ) {
        // FIXME: Respect inline direction.

        self.keep_line_of_collapsed_whitespace_edges();
        let line_index = self.ensure_last_line_index();
        if forced == ForcedBreak::No && !self.line(line_index).fragments.is_empty() {
            let end_edges = std::mem::take(&mut self.end_edges_of_whitespace_at_break);
            self.line_mut(line_index).advance_inline_length(end_edges);
        }
        {
            let mut line = self.line_mut(line_index);
            line.has_break = true;
            line.has_forced_break = forced == ForcedBreak::Yes;
            line.forced_break = forced_break;
        }
        if forced == ForcedBreak::No {
            self.hyphenate_end_of_line(line_index);
        }
        self.last_line_needs_update = true;
        self.update_last_line(forced == ForcedBreak::No || next_size.is_some());
        if forced == ForcedBreak::Yes || !self.line(line_index).fragments.is_empty() {
            self.float_fit_line_index += 1;
        }
        if forced == ForcedBreak::Yes {
            self.forced_break_count += 1;
        }

        let mut break_count = 0usize;
        loop {
            self.push_line_box();
            self.begin_new_line(true, break_count == 0, forced);
            break_count += 1;
            let line_height = self.containing_style().line_height();
            let current_line_block_size = self
                .max_block_size_on_current_line
                .max(line_height)
                .max(self.float_fit_height());
            let floats_intrude = self.context().any_floats_intrude_in_block_range(
                self.current_block_offset,
                self.current_block_offset + current_line_block_size,
            );
            let available = self.available_inline_size_for_current_line;
            let indent = self.line(self.line_count() - 1).indent;
            let next_size_on_line = match size_at.as_mut() {
                Some(size_at) => {
                    let position = self.inline_position_of_next_content();
                    size_at(position)
                }
                None => next_size.unwrap_or_default(),
            };
            let next_too_wide = available.pixels_greater_than(next_size_on_line + indent);
            if !floats_intrude
                || (self
                    .context()
                    .can_fit_new_line_at_block_offset(self.current_block_offset, current_line_block_size)
                    && !next_too_wide)
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Where the next content on the current line starts, from the start edge of the block container's content box:
    /// past the floats on the start side of the line's direction, any indent, and the content already on the line.
    /// Notes `item` as the next content, for the direction that the first strong text from it on gives a line under
    /// unicode-bidi: plaintext, which tabs that start the item are placed for.
    pub(crate) fn note_next_content(
        &mut self,
        prepared: &prepared_inline_content::PreparedInlineContent,
        item: &inline_level_iterator::Item,
    ) {
        self.plaintext_direction_of_next_content = None;
        if self.containing_style().unicode_bidi() != unicode_bidi::PLAINTEXT || !item.starts_with_tabs(prepared) {
            return;
        }
        let index = item.prepared_item_index();
        let text_type = match &self.first_strong_text_ahead {
            Some((covered, text_type)) if covered.contains(&index) => *text_type,
            _ => {
                let (stop, text_type) = prepared.first_strong_text_from(index);
                self.first_strong_text_ahead = Some((index..=stop, text_type));
                text_type
            }
        };
        self.plaintext_direction_of_next_content = text_type.map(|text_type| {
            if text_type == GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_RTL {
                direction::RTL
            } else {
                direction::LTR
            }
        });
    }

    fn line_holds_strong_text(&self, line_index: usize) -> bool {
        self.line(line_index).fragments.iter().any(|fragment| {
            fragment
                .glyphs
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|glyphs| matches!(glyphs.text_type, GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_LTR | GLYPH_TEXT_TYPE_RTL))
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn inline_position_of_next_content(&mut self) -> CssPixels {
        let line_index = self.ensure_last_line_index();
        let line_block_size = self
            .max_block_size_on_current_line
            .max(self.containing_style().line_height())
            .max(self.float_fit_height());
        // NB: Under unicode-bidi: plaintext, a line takes its direction from its first strong text, which content
        //     before that text is placed for too.
        let line_direction = match self.plaintext_direction_of_next_content {
            Some(direction) if !self.line_holds_strong_text(line_index) => direction,
            _ => self.line(line_index).direction,
        };
        let start_side_intrusion = self.context().start_side_float_intrusion(
            self.current_block_offset,
            self.current_block_offset + line_block_size,
            line_direction,
        );
        start_side_intrusion + self.line(line_index).inline_length
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_line_is_empty(&mut self) -> bool {
        self.line_count() == 0 || self.line(self.line_count() - 1).is_empty()
    }

    pub(crate) fn can_break_before_next_item(&mut self) -> bool {
        !self.current_line_is_empty() || self.floats_intrude_at_current_line_start()
    }

    fn floats_intrude_at_current_line_start(&self) -> bool {
        let line_height = self.containing_style().line_height().max(self.float_fit_height());
        self.context()
            .any_floats_intrude_in_block_range(self.current_block_offset, self.current_block_offset + line_height)
    }

    /// The inline size the current line breaks at. Balancing breaks lines before they fill the available inline size,
    /// but they still align within it.
    fn inline_size_to_break_current_line_at(&self) -> AvailableSize {
        let balancing_reduction = self
            .balancing_reductions
            .get(self.forced_break_count)
            .copied()
            .flatten();
        match (self.available_inline_size_for_current_line, balancing_reduction) {
            (AvailableSize::Definite(available), Some(reduction)) => AvailableSize::Definite(available - reduction),
            (available, _) => available,
        }
    }

    fn remaining_inline_size_on_current_line_within(&mut self, inline_size: AvailableSize) -> Option<CssPixels> {
        let AvailableSize::Definite(available) = inline_size else {
            return None;
        };
        let line_index = self.ensure_last_line_index();
        Some(available - self.line(line_index).physical_horizontal_extent())
    }

    pub(crate) fn remaining_inline_size_for_soft_wrap(&mut self) -> Option<CssPixels> {
        self.remaining_inline_size_on_current_line_within(self.inline_size_to_break_current_line_at())
    }

    /// NB: Balancing does not break words that fit the available inline size, so they overflow the inline size the
    ///     line breaks at instead.
    pub(crate) fn remaining_inline_size_for_overflow_break(&mut self) -> Option<CssPixels> {
