            SQUARE_ROOT,
            libgfx_rust::font::emoji_presentation_for_code_point(SQUARE_ROOT, None, None),
        );
        let glyph_id = font.glyph_id_for_code_point(SQUARE_ROOT);
        // The radical gap is given by RadicalVerticalGap if the math-style is compact and
        // RadicalDisplayStyleVerticalGap if the math-style is normal.
        let gap = if style.math_style() == math_style::NORMAL {
            constants.radical_display_style_vertical_gap()
        } else {
            constants.radical_vertical_gap()
        };
        let rule_thickness = constants.radical_rule_thickness();
        // The radical target size for the stretchy radical glyph is the sum of RadicalRuleThickness, radical gap and
        // the ink height of the base.
        let target_size = rule_thickness + gap + base_ink_height;
        // The box metrics of the radical glyph and painting of the surd are given by the algorithm to shape a stretchy
        // glyph to the target size for the radical glyph in the block dimension.
        // NB: A glyph that cannot be stretched is used as it is.
        let glyph = shape_stretchy_glyph(&font, glyph_id, StretchAxis::Block, target_size)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| GlyphRun::for_glyph(font, glyph_id));
        Self {
            glyph,
            gap,
            rule_thickness,
            extra_ascender: constants.radical_extra_ascender(),
        }
    }
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#square-root
fn layout_square_root(base: MathContent, radical: &RadicalMetrics) -> MathContent {
    let glyph = &radical.glyph;
    // The inline size of the math content is the sum of the advance width of the box metrics of the radical glyph
    // and of the inline size of the msqrt base's margin's box.
    let inline_size = glyph.advance + base.inline_size;
    // The line-ascent of the math content is the maximum between:
    // - The line-ascent of the msqrt base's margin box.
    // - The sum of the ink line-ascent of the msqrt base, the radical gap, the RadicalRuleThickness and
    //   RadicalExtraAscender.
    let ascent = base
        .ascent
        .max(base.ascent + radical.gap + radical.rule_thickness + radical.extra_ascender);
    // The line-descent of the math content is the maximum between:
    // - The line-descent of the msqrt base's margin box.
    // - The sum of the line-ascent and line-descent for the box metrics of the radical glyph and of the
    //   RadicalExtraAscender, minus the line-ascent of the math content.
    let descent = base
        .descent
        .max(glyph.ascent + glyph.descent + radical.extra_ascender - ascent);
    // The inline size of the overbar is the inline size of the msqrt base's margin's box. The inline offsets of the
    // msqrt base and overbar are also the same and equal to the width of the box metrics of the radical glyph.
    // The block size of the overbar is RadicalRuleThickness. Its vertical center is shifted away from the alphabetic
    // baseline by a distance towards the line-over equal to the line-ascent of the math content, minus the
    // RadicalExtraAscender, minus half the RadicalRuleThickness.
    let overbar_baseline_shift = radical.extra_ascender - ascent;
    let base_inline_size = base.inline_size;
    let mut content = base.translated(glyph.advance, CssPixels::default());
    content.rules.push(MathRule {
        line_left_offset: glyph.advance,
        baseline_shift: overbar_baseline_shift,
        inline_size: base_inline_size,
        block_size: radical.rule_thickness,
        spans_content_box: false,
    });
    // Finally, the painting of the surd is performed:
    // - At inline offset 0.
    // - At block offset shifted away from the line-over edge of the overbar towards the line-under by a distance
    //   given by the ascent of the box metrics of the radical glyph.
    content.glyph_runs.push(PlacedGlyphRun {
        line_left_offset: CssPixels::default(),
        baseline_shift: overbar_baseline_shift + glyph.ascent,
        glyphs: glyph.clone(),
    });
    MathContent {
        inline_size,
        ascent,
        descent,
        ..content
    }
}

// https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#root-with-index
fn layout_root(base: &Child, index: &Child, radical: &RadicalMetrics, constants: &MathConstants) -> MathContent {
    // The mroot index is first ignored and the mroot base and radical glyph are laid out as shown on figure using the
    // same algorithm as in <msqrt> in order to produce a margin box B.
    let b = layout_square_root(
        MathContent {
            inline_size: base.inline_size,
            ascent: base.ascent,
            descent: base.descent,
            positions: vec![ChildPosition::default()],
            ..MathContent::default()
        },
        radical,
    );
    let b_block_size = b.ascent + b.descent;
    let kern_before_degree = constants.radical_kern_before_degree();
    let kern_after_degree = constants.radical_kern_after_degree();
    let degree_bottom_raise = b_block_size.scaled(constants.radical_degree_bottom_raise_percent());
    // AdjustedRadicalKernBeforeDegree and AdjustedRadicalKernAfterDegree are respectively defined as
    // max(0, RadicalKernBeforeDegree) and max(−inline size of the index's margin box, RadicalKernAfterDegree).
    let adjusted_kern_before_degree = kern_before_degree.max(CssPixels::default());
    let adjusted_kern_after_degree = kern_after_degree.max(-index.inline_size);
    // The inline size of the math content is the sum of AdjustedRadicalKernBeforeDegree, the inline size of the
    // index's margin box, AdjustedRadicalKernAfterDegree and of the inline size of B.
    let inline_size = adjusted_kern_before_degree + index.inline_size + adjusted_kern_after_degree + b.inline_size;
    // The alphabetic baseline of the index is shifted away from the line-under edge by a distance of
    // RadicalDegreeBottomRaisePercent × the block size of B + the line-descent of the index's margin box.
    let index_baseline_shift = b.descent - degree_bottom_raise - index.descent;
    // NB: The line-ascent and line-descent of the math content are those of the union of B and the index.
    let ascent = b.ascent.max(index.ascent - index_baseline_shift);
    let descent = b.descent.max(index.descent + index_baseline_shift);
    // The inline offset of the index is AdjustedRadicalKernBeforeDegree. The inline-offset of the mroot base is the
    // same + the inline size of the index's margin box.
    // NB: The base also follows the radical glyph and AdjustedRadicalKernAfterDegree.
    let b_offset = adjusted_kern_before_degree + index.inline_size + adjusted_kern_after_degree;
    let mut content = b.translated(b_offset, CssPixels::default());
    content.positions.push(ChildPosition {
        line_left_offset: adjusted_kern_before_degree,
        baseline_shift: index_baseline_shift,
    });
    MathContent {
        inline_size,
        ascent,
        descent,
        ..content
    }
}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! What the arena's writes leave the layout stage's memos to drop or reconsider. The memos live in the stage's scratch,
//! which the arena cannot reach, so the arena notes what a write did to a box and the stage applies the notes to its
//! memos before a layout pass reads them and before it sweeps them.
//!
//! The notes of a box coalesce. Only a layout pass stores memo entries, and a stage applies the notes before each pass,
//! so between two applications a box's entries change only through the notes: entries a note drops stay dropped, and
//! the notes after it see none.

use super::fc_run_cache::FcRunCacheStore;
use super::in_flow_block_cache::InFlowBlockCacheStore;
use super::layout_node_arena::IntrinsicSizeCaches;
use super::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use super::prepared_inline_content::PreparedInlineContentMemos;
use super::rendered_text::TextMemos;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct SlotNotes {
    noted: bool,
    prepared_inline_content_dropped: bool,
    run_cache_entries_dropped: bool,
    in_flow_block_entries_dropped: bool,
    intrinsic_sizes_dropped: bool,
    fragment_cache_epoch_bumped: bool,
    structural_inline_changes: u32,
    generation: u8,
}

const NOTES_PER_PAGE: usize = 256;

/// The notes of each box the arena wrote since the stage last applied them, in the order the boxes were first noted.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct MemoInvalidations {
    /// Each page holds the notes of `NOTES_PER_PAGE` slots, and comes to be with the first of them noted, so that a copy
    /// of the notes costs what was noted.
    pages: Vec<Option<Box<[SlotNotes; NOTES_PER_PAGE]>>>,
    noted_slots: Vec<u32>,
    dropped_text_states: Vec<u32>,
}

impl MemoInvalidations {
    fn notes_of(&mut self, slot: u32) -> &mut SlotNotes {
        let (page, row) = (slot as usize / NOTES_PER_PAGE, slot as usize % NOTES_PER_PAGE);
        if self.pages.len() <= page {
            self.pages.resize_with(page + 1, || None);
        }
        let notes = &mut self.pages[page].get_or_insert_with(|| Box::new([SlotNotes::default(); NOTES_PER_PAGE]))[row];
        if !notes.noted {
            notes.noted = true;
            self.noted_slots.push(slot);
        }
        notes
    }

    /// The box in `slot` left its committed subtree or the arena, which drops its run cache entries.
    pub(crate) fn note_run_cache_entries_dropped(&mut self, slot: u32) {
        let notes = self.notes_of(slot);
        notes.run_cache_entries_dropped = true;
        notes.fragment_cache_epoch_bumped = false;
        notes.structural_inline_changes = 0;
    }

    /// The box in `slot` left the arena, which drops all its memo entries.
    pub(crate) fn note_slot_freed(&mut self, slot: u32) {
        self.note_run_cache_entries_dropped(slot);
        let notes = self.notes_of(slot);
        notes.prepared_inline_content_dropped = true;
        notes.in_flow_block_entries_dropped = true;
        notes.intrinsic_sizes_dropped = true;
    }

    /// Something the intrinsic sizes of the box in `slot` were measured from changed.
    pub(crate) fn note_intrinsic_sizes_dropped(&mut self, slot: u32) {
        self.notes_of(slot).intrinsic_sizes_dropped = true;
    }

    /// The text state at `text_state` got other rendered text or was let go of, which the chunks and segmenter made of
    /// the old text no longer describe.
    pub(crate) fn note_text_state_dropped(&mut self, text_state: u32) {
        self.dropped_text_states.push(text_state);
    }

    /// The fragment cache epoch of `node` moved on: its run cache entries need the sweep, and its in-flow block entry
    /// and prepared inline content, valid for one epoch only, are dropped.
    pub(crate) fn note_fragment_cache_epoch_bumped(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        let notes = self.notes_of(node.slot_index());
        notes.in_flow_block_entries_dropped = true;
        notes.prepared_inline_content_dropped = true;
        if !notes.run_cache_entries_dropped {
            notes.fragment_cache_epoch_bumped = true;
            notes.generation = node.generation();
        }
    }

    /// The child list of `node` changed, which run cache entries holding line data count.
    pub(crate) fn note_structural_inline_change(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        let notes = self.notes_of(node.slot_index());
        if !notes.run_cache_entries_dropped {
            notes.structural_inline_changes += 1;
            notes.generation = node.generation();
        }
    }

    /// Applies the notes to the memos, in the order the boxes were first noted.
    pub(crate) fn apply_to(
        self,
        run_cache: &mut FcRunCacheStore,
        in_flow_block_cache: &mut InFlowBlockCacheStore,
        text_memos: &mut TextMemos,
        prepared_inline_content: &mut PreparedInlineContentMemos,
        intrinsic_size_caches: &mut IntrinsicSizeCaches,
    ) {
        for text_state in self.dropped_text_states {
            text_memos.forget(text_state);
        }
        for slot in self.noted_slots {
            let notes = self.pages[slot as usize / NOTES_PER_PAGE]
                .as_ref()
                .expect("a noted slot has its page")[slot as usize % NOTES_PER_PAGE];
            if notes.run_cache_entries_dropped {
                run_cache.remove_entry(slot);
            } else if notes.structural_inline_changes > 0 || notes.fragment_cache_epoch_bumped {
                let node = NodeSlotId::new(slot, notes.generation);
                for _ in 0..notes.structural_inline_changes {
                    run_cache.note_inline_layout_damage(node);
                }
                if notes.fragment_cache_epoch_bumped {
                    run_cache.note_invalidated_entry(node);
                }
            }
            if notes.in_flow_block_entries_dropped {
                in_flow_block_cache.remove_entry(slot);
            }
            if notes.prepared_inline_content_dropped {
                prepared_inline_content.forget(slot);
            }
            if notes.intrinsic_sizes_dropped {
                intrinsic_size_caches.drop_entries_of_slot(slot);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// `GENERATED_FOR_AFTER` up to it are an element's synthetic pseudo-elements.
pub const GENERATED_FOR_LAST_SYNTHETIC: u8 = 11;
/// `CSS::PseudoElement::Selection`, as the style engine numbers an element's pseudo-element
/// records. It generates no box, so no row names it.
pub const SELECTION_PSEUDO_KIND: u8 = 8;

pub const SPELLING_ERROR_PSEUDO_KIND: u8 = 9;

/// The pseudo-element a row generated for `generated_for` stands for, as the style engine numbers
/// an element's pseudo-element records. `Layout::Node::encode_generated_for` is its inverse.
pub(crate) const fn pseudo_kind_of(generated_for: u8) -> u8 {
    generated_for - 1
}

/// The style a row is laid out by: the groups at the front of the style record the row pins, of an
/// anonymous box's style or of an animation overlay. A copy counts no reference: whoever made the
/// row's style keeps it alive while the row holds it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
#[repr(transparent)]
pub(crate) struct LayoutStyleRef(std::ptr::NonNull<crate::css::computed_value_views::StyleRecordGroups>);

const _: () = assert!(size_of::<LayoutStyleRef>() == 8 && size_of::<Option<LayoutStyleRef>>() == 8);

// SAFETY: A style's groups are immutable while a row holds them, and the handle touches no
//         reference count, so sharing one shares only reads.
unsafe impl Send for LayoutStyleRef {}
unsafe impl Sync for LayoutStyleRef {}

impl LayoutStyleRef {
    pub(crate) fn of(groups: &crate::css::computed_value_views::StyleRecordGroups) -> Self {
        Self(std::ptr::NonNull::from(groups))
    }

    pub(crate) fn of_groups(groups: &crate::css::computed_values::StyleGroups) -> Self {
        Self::of(crate::css::computed_value_views::StyleRecordGroups::of(groups))
    }

    /// The style `pointer` names, as the host passes one, or `None` for null.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// A non-null `pointer` must point at the groups of a style that outlives every row holding it.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn from_raw(pointer: *const c_void) -> Option<Self> {
        std::ptr::NonNull::new(pointer.cast_mut()).map(|pointer| Self(pointer.cast()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn as_ptr(self) -> *const crate::css::computed_value_views::StyleRecordGroups {
        self.0.as_ptr().cast_const()
    }

    /// A style no read reaches, for a row a test lays out without reading its style.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn dangling() -> Self {
        Self(std::ptr::NonNull::dangling())
    }

    /// The style's computed values.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// The style must stay alive and unchanged for `'a`.
    #[inline]
    pub(crate) unsafe fn view<'a>(self) -> crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'a> {
        // SAFETY: As the caller guarantees.
        crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView::of_record_groups(unsafe { self.0.as_ref() })
    }
}

impl From<crate::painting::host::FfiNaturalSize> for crate::css::style::NaturalSize {
    fn from(size: crate::painting::host::FfiNaturalSize) -> Self {
        Self {
            width: size.width.has_value.then_some(size.width.value.raw_value()),
            height: size.height.has_value.then_some(size.height.value.raw_value()),
            aspect_ratio: size.has_aspect_ratio.then_some((
                size.aspect_ratio_numerator.raw_value(),
                size.aspect_ratio_denominator.raw_value(),
            )),
        }
    }
}

impl From<crate::css::style::NaturalSize> for crate::painting::host::FfiNaturalSize {
    fn from(size: crate::css::style::NaturalSize) -> Self {
        let (numerator, denominator) = size.aspect_ratio.unwrap_or_default();
        Self {
            width: size.width.map(CssPixels::from_raw).into(),
            height: size.height.map(CssPixels::from_raw).into(),
            has_aspect_ratio: size.aspect_ratio.is_some(),
            aspect_ratio_numerator: CssPixels::from_raw(numerator),
            aspect_ratio_denominator: CssPixels::from_raw(denominator),
        }
    }
}

/// A DOM node, named the way the host names one without pointing at it: the document, by itself,
/// or any other node by its StyleNodeID. No node at all is a StyleNodeID of 0.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiNodeIdentity {
    pub style_node: u32,
    pub is_document: bool,
}

impl FfiNodeIdentity {
    pub(crate) fn is_none(self) -> bool {
        self.style_node == 0 && !self.is_document
    }
}

    SVGGeometryBox = 24,
    SVGGraphicsBox = 25,
    SVGImageBox = 26,
    SVGMaskBox = 27,
    SVGPatternBox = 28,
    SVGSVGBox = 29,
    SVGTextBox = 30,
    SVGTextPathBox = 31,
    TableWrapper = 32,
    TextAreaBox = 33,
    TextInputBox = 34,
    TextNode = 35,
    VideoBox = 37,
    Viewport = 38,
    FrameSetBox = 39,
    /// A `<wbr>`, which gives the line a soft wrap opportunity.
    WordBreakOpportunityNode = 40,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u32)]
pub enum NodeFlag {
    Anonymous = 1 << 0,
    HasStyle = 1 << 1,
    ChildrenAreInline = 1 << 2,
    IsFlexItem = 1 << 3,
    IsGridItem = 1 << 4,
    /// The box is an element's or a pseudo-element's own box, and that element or pseudo-element
    /// stores a scroll offset other than zero. The overflow update measures such a box eagerly
    /// after a full commit so the offset can be clamped.
    HasScrollOffset = 1 << 5,
    IsBody = 1 << 6,
    NeedsLayoutUpdate = 1 << 7,
    /// A style change altered geometry-determining properties of this node itself, so a partial relayout must re-resolve
    /// its own size and position instead of reusing them.
    NeedsOwnGeometryUpdate = 1 << 8,
    AbsposDescendantEscapes = 1 << 9,
    CompensatesForHorizontalScroll = 1 << 10,
    CompensatesForVerticalScroll = 1 << 11,
    IsReplacedElement = 1 << 12,
    IsHtmlInputElement = 1 << 13,
    IsHtmlHtmlElement = 1 << 14,
    IsInUserAgentShadowTree = 1 << 15,
    UsesButtonLayout = 1 << 16,
    IsEditingHost = 1 << 17,
    ReplacedBoxCanHaveChildren = 1 << 18,
    IsPseudoElementPrincipalBox = 1 << 19,
    FollowsPrincipalStyle = 1 << 20,
    EstablishesAbsolutePositionContainingBlock = 1 << 21,
    ProducesLineBoxFragmentWhenEmpty = 1 << 22,
    ListMarkerIsInside = 1 << 23,
    HasAnchorNames = 1 << 24,
    InsetsUseAnchorFunctions = 1 << 25,
    HasCommittedFragmentLink = 1 << 26,
    HasPreserve3dTransformStyle = 1 << 27,
    IsMissingTableCell = 1 << 28,
    HasAnimatedOpacityOrTransform = 1 << 29,
    IsDocumentElement = 1 << 30,
    EstablishesFixedPositionContainingBlock = 0x8000_0000,
}

impl NodeFlag {
    /// The flags that say what node a row stands for. A row is built with them, and installing a style changes none.
    pub(crate) const IDENTITY: u32 = Self::Anonymous as u32 | Self::IsBody as u32 | Self::IsDocumentElement as u32;
    /// The flags a box is built with from what its element is, which no style change changes: see
    /// `node_facts::construction_flags`.
    pub(crate) const CONSTRUCTION: u32 = Self::Anonymous as u32
        | Self::HasStyle as u32
        | Self::IsReplacedElement as u32
        | Self::IsHtmlInputElement as u32
        | Self::IsHtmlHtmlElement as u32
        | Self::IsDocumentElement as u32
        | Self::IsInUserAgentShadowTree as u32
        | Self::UsesButtonLayout as u32
        | Self::IsEditingHost as u32
        | Self::IsBody as u32
        | Self::ReplacedBoxCanHaveChildren as u32;
}

/// Facts a node takes from its ancestors. They are derived when the node is attached or its
/// ancestors' styles change, so laying out a subtree never reads above it to learn them.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub(crate) enum AncestorFact {
    /// The parent's inner display type is flex or grid.
    ParentIsFlexOrGridContainer = 1 << 0,
    /// The parent is unstyled, or is not floating and has a flow or flow-root inner display type.
    ParentIsUnfloatedFlowContainer = 1 << 1,
    /// An anonymous box whose parent uses button layout, like the wrapper around a button's content.
    IsAnonymousButtonContentWrapper = 1 << 2,
    /// An anonymous box whose parent is an anonymous button content wrapper.
    IsAnonymousButtonContentBox = 1 << 3,
    /// An anonymous box whose nearest non-anonymous ancestor puts an ellipsis on overflowing lines.
    InheritsTextOverflowEllipsis = 1 << 4,
    ParentLaysOutInColumns = 1 << 5,
    /// The parent lays out its children with a MathML layout algorithm.
    ParentUsesMathLayout = 1 << 6,
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct NodeData {
    pub parent: ShapeCell<NodeSlotId>,
    pub first_child: ShapeCell<NodeSlotId>,
    pub last_child: ShapeCell<NodeSlotId>,
    pub previous_sibling: ShapeCell<NodeSlotId>,
    pub next_sibling: ShapeCell<NodeSlotId>,
    pub kind: ShapeCell<NodeKind>,
    pub generated_for: ShapeCell<u8>,
    pub flags: ShapeCell<u32>,
    /// Advanced on every layout invalidation that reaches this node or its
    /// subtree, with no propagation boundary: unlike intrinsic size resets,
    /// changes inside absolutely positioned and SVG descendants must reach
    /// every ancestor, because their fragments live in ancestor run trees.
    /// Wide enough that wrapping between a cache store and the next probe
    /// is unreachable.
    pub fragment_cache_epoch: u32,
    pub slot_generation: ShapeCell<u8>,
    pub compositor_animation_frame_kinds: ShapeCell<u8>,
    pub table_column_span: u16,
    pub table_row_span: u16,
    pub dom_paint_facts: ShapeCell<u8>,
    pub ancestor_facts: u8,
    pub style: ShapeCell<Option<LayoutStyleRef>>,
}

impl Default for NodeData {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            parent: ShapeCell::new(NodeSlotId::INVALID),
            first_child: ShapeCell::new(NodeSlotId::INVALID),
            last_child: ShapeCell::new(NodeSlotId::INVALID),
            previous_sibling: ShapeCell::new(NodeSlotId::INVALID),
            next_sibling: ShapeCell::new(NodeSlotId::INVALID),
            kind: ShapeCell::new(NodeKind::Unset),
            generated_for: ShapeCell::new(0),
            flags: ShapeCell::new(0),
            slot_generation: ShapeCell::new(0),
            compositor_animation_frame_kinds: ShapeCell::new(0),
            table_column_span: 1,
            table_row_span: 1,
            dom_paint_facts: ShapeCell::new(0),
            ancestor_facts: 0,
            fragment_cache_epoch: 0,
            style: ShapeCell::new(None),
        }
    }
}

/// The facts of a node that no publication carries, for writing: writing them marks nothing for the paint side,
/// unlike a write to the node's shape.
pub(crate) struct UnpublishedNodeFactsMut<'a> {
    pub(crate) fragment_cache_epoch: &'a mut u32,
    pub(crate) table_column_span: &'a mut u16,
    pub(crate) table_row_span: &'a mut u16,
    pub(crate) ancestor_facts: &'a mut u8,
}

impl NodeData {
    pub(super) fn unpublished_facts_mut(&mut self) -> UnpublishedNodeFactsMut<'_> {
        UnpublishedNodeFactsMut {
            fragment_cache_epoch: &mut self.fragment_cache_epoch,
            table_column_span: &mut self.table_column_span,
            table_row_span: &mut self.table_row_span,
            ancestor_facts: &mut self.ancestor_facts,
        }
    }
}

/// The part of a node the paint side reads, as a row of the arena's published column.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct PaintNode {
    pub(crate) generation: u8,
    pub(crate) kind: NodeKind,
    pub(crate) generated_for: u8,
    pub(crate) dom_paint_facts: u8,
    pub(crate) compositor_animation_frame_kinds: u8,
    pub(crate) flags: u32,
    pub(crate) parent: NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) first_child: NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) last_child: NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) previous_sibling: NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) next_sibling: NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) style: Option<LayoutStyleRef>,
    /// The style record the row is built from, or 0.
    pub(crate) style_record: u64,
    /// The node whose style the row carries.
    pub(crate) style_node: Option<crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID>,
    /// Whether the arena derived the row's style record: an anonymous box's, or a style layout adjusted.
    pub(crate) style_is_derived: bool,
}

impl Default for PaintNode {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            generation: 0,
            kind: NodeKind::Unset,
            generated_for: 0,
            dom_paint_facts: 0,
            compositor_animation_frame_kinds: 0,
            flags: 0,
            parent: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            first_child: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            last_child: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            previous_sibling: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            next_sibling: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            style: None,
            style_record: 0,
            style_node: None,
            style_is_derived: false,
        }
    }
}

impl PaintNode {
    /// The node's row as `data` holds it, with the style record and node the arena keeps beside it, and whether it
    /// derived the record.
    pub(crate) fn of(
        data: &NodeData,
        style_record: u64,
        style_node: Option<crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID>,
        style_is_derived: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            generation: data.slot_generation.get(),
            kind: data.kind.get(),
            generated_for: data.generated_for.get(),
            dom_paint_facts: data.dom_paint_facts.get(),
            compositor_animation_frame_kinds: data.compositor_animation_frame_kinds.get(),
            flags: data.flags.get(),
            parent: data.parent.get(),
            first_child: data.first_child.get(),
            last_child: data.last_child.get(),
            previous_sibling: data.previous_sibling.get(),
            next_sibling: data.next_sibling.get(),
            style: data.style.get(),
            style_record,
            style_node,
            style_is_derived,
        }
    }

    /// The node's computed style, or `None` for a node without one.
    pub(crate) fn style(&self) -> Option<crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'_>> {
        // SAFETY: No style record is released while a recording reads the rows published for it.
        self.style.map(|style| unsafe { style.view() })
    }
}

mod tests {

        assert_eq!(std::mem::offset_of!(NodeData, table_column_span), 34);
        assert_eq!(std::mem::offset_of!(NodeData, table_row_span), 36);
        assert_eq!(std::mem::offset_of!(NodeData, dom_paint_facts), 38);
        assert_eq!(std::mem::offset_of!(NodeData, ancestor_facts), 39);
        assert_eq!(std::mem::offset_of!(NodeData, style), 40);

        assert_eq!(NodeFlag::IsDocumentElement as u32, 1 << 30);
    }
}
