//! With LIBWEB_VERIFY_RUN_REPEATABILITY=cold, every layout run that executes is laid out twice. The first layout reads
//! no memoized layout from before it, keeps none after it, and its result is discarded; the second is the run itself.
//! Both have to agree on everything the run hands its parent, which shows that a run depends on nothing but its input
//! and the state of the pass, and that what it reads from memoized layout is what it would have computed.
//!
//! With LIBWEB_VERIFY_UNOBSERVED_BLOCK_SIZE, every run that claims it never observed its own block size or block
//! margins is laid out again the same way, at the other definiteness of that size, with extra space and at other block
//! margins, and has to agree with the run too.

use super::*;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum RunRepeatabilityVerification {
    Off,
    Cold,
}

fn run_repeatability_verification() -> RunRepeatabilityVerification {
    static VERIFICATION: std::sync::OnceLock<RunRepeatabilityVerification> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *VERIFICATION.get_or_init(|| match std::env::var("LIBWEB_VERIFY_RUN_REPEATABILITY").as_deref() {
        Err(_) => RunRepeatabilityVerification::Off,
        Ok("cold") => RunRepeatabilityVerification::Cold,
        Ok(other) => panic!("LIBWEB_VERIFY_RUN_REPEATABILITY must be cold, not {other:?}"),
    })
}

pub(super) fn verification_is_enabled() -> bool {
    run_repeatability_verification() != RunRepeatabilityVerification::Off
}

/// Lays out a run whose result is discarded through `run`, where the verification is on and no such run is in
/// progress around it already. Nothing it does is traced.
pub(super) fn lay_out_discarded_run(
    pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
    run: impl for<'discarded> FnOnce(LayoutPass<'discarded>) -> formatting_context::LayoutResult,
) -> Option<formatting_context::LayoutResult> {
    if run_repeatability_verification() == RunRepeatabilityVerification::Off || pass.is_discarded_run() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(pass.lay_out_discarded_run(run))
}

/// Checks that the run of `box_` that produced `used` repeated what the discarded run that produced `discarded` did.
pub(super) fn verify_repeated_run(
    box_: Node,
    discarded: &formatting_context::LayoutResult,
    used: &formatting_context::LayoutResult,
) {
    ComparedLayouts {
        checked: &format!("the run of {box_:?}"),
        reference: "its discarded repetition",
    }
    .verify(box_, used, discarded);
}

fn unobserved_own_block_size_verification_is_enabled() -> bool {
    static ENABLED: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ENABLED.get_or_init(|| std::env::var_os("LIBWEB_VERIFY_UNOBSERVED_BLOCK_SIZE").is_some())
}

fn run_is_verified_at_other_block_margins(own_block_size: formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation) -> bool {
    matches!(
        own_block_size,
        formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Unobserved
            | formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::ObservedOnlyByAbsposContainedByRoot
    )
}

fn root_inputs_at_other_own_block_sizes(
    root_cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    input: LayoutInput,
    own_block_size: formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation,
    automatic_content_block_size: CssPixels,
) -> Vec<(used_values::RootInputCells, LayoutInput)> {
    match own_block_size {
        formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Observed => Vec::new(),
        formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Unobserved => {
            root_inputs_at_other_unobserved_own_block_sizes(root_cells, input, automatic_content_block_size)
        }
        formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::ObservedOnlyByAbsposContainedByRoot => {
            root_inputs_at_other_definiteness_leaving_root_with_same_block_size(
                root_cells,
                input,
                automatic_content_block_size,
            )
            .into_iter()
            .collect()
        }
    }
}

fn root_inputs_at_other_unobserved_own_block_sizes(
    root_cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    input: LayoutInput,
    automatic_content_block_size: CssPixels,
) -> Vec<(used_values::RootInputCells, LayoutInput)> {
    let mut other_definite_own_block_sizes = Vec::new();
    if root_cells.has_definite_block_size {
        other_definite_own_block_sizes.push(None);
    }
    let definite_block_size_with_extra_space_beyond_assigned_and_automatic_sizes =
        root_cells.content_block_size.max(automatic_content_block_size) + CssPixels::from_integer(50);
    if definite_block_size_with_extra_space_beyond_assigned_and_automatic_sizes.raw_value() != i32::MAX {
        other_definite_own_block_sizes.push(Some(
            definite_block_size_with_extra_space_beyond_assigned_and_automatic_sizes,
        ));
    }
    other_definite_own_block_sizes
        .into_iter()
        .map(|definite_own_block_size| {
            let cells = used_values::RootInputCells {
                content_block_size: definite_own_block_size.unwrap_or_default(),
                has_definite_block_size: definite_own_block_size.is_some(),
                ..root_cells
            };
            let mut input = input.clone();
            input.available_space.block_size =
                definite_own_block_size.map_or(AvailableSize::Indefinite, AvailableSize::definite);
            (cells, input)
        })
        .collect()
}

// NB: The absolutely positioned boxes the root contains read the block size the run leaves the root with, so the run is
//     verified only where it leaves the root with the same one: definite where the root adopted its automatic block
//     size, and adopting it where the root was handed that size.
fn root_inputs_at_other_definiteness_leaving_root_with_same_block_size(
    root_cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    mut input: LayoutInput,
    automatic_content_block_size: CssPixels,
) -> Option<(used_values::RootInputCells, LayoutInput)> {
    let block_size_left = formatting_context::content_block_size_run_leaves_root_whose_cells_its_parent_owns(
        &input,
        root_cells,
        automatic_content_block_size,
    );
    if root_cells.has_definite_block_size {
        if clamp_to_max_dimension_value(automatic_content_block_size.max(CssPixels::default())) != block_size_left {
            return None;
        }
        input.available_space.block_size = AvailableSize::Indefinite;
        input.sizing.content_block_size_after_run = geometry::ContentBlockSizeAfterRun::Automatic;
        let cells = used_values::RootInputCells {
            content_block_size: CssPixels::default(),
            has_definite_block_size: false,
            ..root_cells
        };
        return Some((cells, input));
    }
    input.available_space.block_size = AvailableSize::definite(block_size_left);
    input.sizing.content_block_size_after_run = geometry::ContentBlockSizeAfterRun::HandedOver;
    let cells = used_values::RootInputCells {
        content_block_size: block_size_left,
        has_definite_block_size: true,
        ..root_cells
    };
    Some((cells, input))
}

fn root_cells_at_other_block_margins(
    root_cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    own_block_size: formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation,
) -> Option<used_values::RootInputCells> {
    run_is_verified_at_other_block_margins(own_block_size).then(|| used_values::RootInputCells {
        margin_top: root_cells.margin_top + CssPixels::from_integer(30),
        margin_bottom: root_cells.margin_bottom - CssPixels::from_integer(20),
        ..root_cells
    })
}

pub(super) fn verify_run_ignores_its_unobserved_own_block_size_and_block_margins(
    pass: &LayoutPass<'_>,
    box_: Node,
    root_cells: used_values::RootInputCells,
    input: &LayoutInput,
    outputs: &formatting_context::LayoutResult,
    lay_out: impl for<'discarded> Fn(
        LayoutPass<'discarded>,
        used_values::RootInputCells,
        LayoutInput,
    ) -> formatting_context::LayoutResult,
) {
    if !unobserved_own_block_size_verification_is_enabled() || pass.is_discarded_run() {
        return;
    }
    let checked = format!("the run of {box_:?}, which never observed its own block size or block margins,");
    let own_block_size = outputs.observed.never_observed.own_block_size;
    let mut reference_inputs = root_inputs_at_other_own_block_sizes(
        root_cells,
        input.clone(),
        own_block_size,
        outputs.outcome.automatic_content_block_size,
    )
    .into_iter()
    .map(|(cells, input)| {
        let reference = if cells.has_definite_block_size {
            format!("its layout at the definite block size {:?}", cells.content_block_size)
        } else {
            "its layout at an indefinite block size".to_owned()
        };
        (cells, input, reference)
    })
    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if let Some(cells) = root_cells_at_other_block_margins(root_cells, own_block_size) {
        let reference = format!(
            "its layout at the block margins {:?} and {:?}",
            cells.margin_top, cells.margin_bottom
        );
        reference_inputs.push((cells, input.clone(), reference));
    }
    for (reference_cells, reference_input, reference) in reference_inputs {
        let reference_outputs = pass.lay_out_discarded_run(|pass| lay_out(pass, reference_cells, reference_input));
        ComparedLayouts {
            checked: &checked,
            reference: &reference,
        }
        .verify(box_, outputs, &reference_outputs);
    }
}

struct ComparedLayouts<'a> {
    checked: &'a str,
    reference: &'a str,
}

impl ComparedLayouts<'_> {
    fn verify(
        &self,
        box_: Node,
        checked_outputs: &formatting_context::LayoutResult,
        reference_outputs: &formatting_context::LayoutResult,
    ) {
        let Self { checked, reference } = self;
        assert_eq!(
            checked_outputs.outcome, reference_outputs.outcome,
            "{checked} returned a result {reference} does not"
        );
        // NB: Where the parent owns the root's cells, they are those of the layout's own input.
        let cells_left_by_run = |outputs: &formatting_context::LayoutResult| {
            (!outputs.observed.parent_owns_root_cells).then_some(outputs.cells)
        };
        assert_eq!(
            cells_left_by_run(checked_outputs),
            cells_left_by_run(reference_outputs),
            "{checked} left root cells {reference} does not"
        );
        assert!(
            checked_outputs.line_data().map(|line_data| &**line_data)
                == reference_outputs.line_data().map(|line_data| &**line_data),
            "{checked} left line data {reference} does not"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            checked_outputs.observed, reference_outputs.observed,
            "{checked} claims to have never observed inputs {reference} does not"
        );
        assert!(
            host_findings_match(
                checked_outputs.residue.as_deref().map(|residue| &residue.host_findings),
                reference_outputs
                    .residue
                    .as_deref()
                    .map(|residue| &residue.host_findings)
            ),
            "{checked} found out for the host what {reference} does not"
        );
        let (checked_root, reference_root) = match (&checked_outputs.fragment, &reference_outputs.fragment) {
            (None, None) => return,
            (Some(checked_root), Some(reference_root)) => (checked_root, reference_root),
            _ => panic!("{checked} and {reference} do not both build fragments"),
        };
        assert!(
            checked_root
                .fragment
                .has_payloads_of_same_value_as(&reference_root.fragment),
            "{checked} hands its root's fragment payloads {reference} does not"
        );
        assert!(
            same_elements_in_any_order(
                &checked_root.payloads_past_run().pending_abspos,
                &reference_root.payloads_past_run().pending_abspos
            ) && same_elements_in_any_order(
                &checked_root.payloads_past_run().anchor_candidates,
                &reference_root.payloads_past_run().anchor_candidates
            ) && same_elements_in_any_order(
                &checked_root.payloads_past_run().inline_containing_block_rects,
                &reference_root.payloads_past_run().inline_containing_block_rects
            ) && same_elements_in_any_order(
                &checked_root.payloads_past_run().abspos_containing_block_info,
                &reference_root.payloads_past_run().abspos_containing_block_info
            ),
            "{checked} propagates payloads {reference} does not"
        );
        if let Err(difference) =
            compare_children(box_, &checked_root.fragment.children, &reference_root.fragment.children)
        {
            panic!("{checked} lays out descendants unlike {reference}: {difference}");
        }
    }
}

fn same_elements_in_any_order<T: PartialEq>(left: &[T], right: &[T]) -> bool {
    if left.len() != right.len() {
        return false;
    }
    let mut matched = vec![false; right.len()];
    left.iter().all(|element| {
        let Some(index) = (0..right.len()).find(|&index| !matched[index] && right[index] == *element) else {
            return false;
        };
        matched[index] = true;
        true
    })
}

fn host_findings_match(left: Option<&run_state::HostFindings>, right: Option<&run_state::HostFindings>) -> bool {
    let none = run_state::HostFindings::default();
    let left = left.unwrap_or(&none);
    let right = right.unwrap_or(&none);
    same_elements_in_any_order(&left.messages, &right.messages)
        && same_elements_in_any_order(&left.container_length_reads, &right.container_length_reads)
        && left.document_svg_root_natural_size == right.document_svg_root_natural_size
}

/// Compares the descendant fragments a run produced with those a fresh layout of its root produced.
fn compare_children(
    parent: Node,
    expected: &[fragment_tree::FragmentLink],
    fresh: &[fragment_tree::FragmentLink],
) -> Result<(), String> {
    if expected.len() != fresh.len() {
        return Err(format!(
            "{parent:?} has children {:?} where the fresh layout has {:?}",
            nodes_of(expected),
            nodes_of(fresh)
        ));
    }
    for (index, fresh_link) in fresh.iter().enumerate() {
        let node = fresh_link.fragment.node;
        let expected_link = if expected[index].fragment.node == node {
            &expected[index]
        } else {
            let occurrence = fresh[..index].iter().filter(|link| link.fragment.node == node).count();
            expected
                .iter()
                .filter(|link| link.fragment.node == node)
                .nth(occurrence)
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    format!(
                        "{parent:?} has children {:?} where the fresh layout has {:?}",
                        nodes_of(expected),
                        nodes_of(fresh)
                    )
                })?
        };
        compare_links(expected_link, fresh_link)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn compare_links(expected: &fragment_tree::FragmentLink, fresh: &fragment_tree::FragmentLink) -> Result<(), String> {
    let node = fresh.fragment.node;
    if !expected.has_same_placement(fresh) {
        return Err(format!(
            "{node:?} is placed at {} where the fresh layout places it at {}",
            describe_placement(expected),
            describe_placement(fresh)
        ));
    }
    let (expected, fresh) = (&expected.fragment, &fresh.fragment);
    if !expected.has_same_box_properties_comparing_payloads_by_value(fresh) {
        return Err(format!("{node:?} has box properties unlike the fresh layout"));
    }
    if expected.line_data.as_deref() != fresh.line_data.as_deref() {
        return Err(format!("{node:?} has line data unlike the fresh layout"));
    }
    if expected.scrollable_overflow != fresh.scrollable_overflow {
        return Err(format!(
            "{node:?} has scrollable overflow {:?} where the fresh layout has {:?}",
            expected.scrollable_overflow, fresh.scrollable_overflow
        ));
    }
    compare_children(node, &expected.children, &fresh.children)
}

fn nodes_of(links: &[fragment_tree::FragmentLink]) -> Vec<Node> {
    links.iter().map(|link| link.fragment.node).collect()
}

fn describe_placement(link: &fragment_tree::FragmentLink) -> String {
    format!(
        "offset ({:?}, {:?}) insets ({:?} {:?} {:?} {:?}) line box {:?} in {:?}, abspos inputs {}",
        link.offset.x,
        link.offset.y,
        link.placement.insets.top,
        link.placement.insets.right,
        link.placement.insets.bottom,
        link.placement.insets.left,
        link.placement.containing_line_box_index,
        link.placement.containing_block,
        if link.placement.abspos_layout_inputs.is_some() {
            "present"
        } else {
            "absent"
        }
    )
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn px(value: i64) -> CssPixels {
        CssPixels::from_integer(value)
    }

    fn item_root_inputs(
        content_block_size: i64,
        has_definite_block_size: bool,
    ) -> (used_values::RootInputCells, LayoutInput) {
        let root_cells = used_values::RootInputCells {
            content_block_size: px(content_block_size),
            has_definite_block_size,
            ..used_values::RootInputCells::default()
        };
        let input = LayoutInput::new(
            AvailableSpace {
                inline_size: AvailableSize::definite(px(300)),
                block_size: if has_definite_block_size {
                    AvailableSize::definite(px(content_block_size))
                } else {
                    AvailableSize::Indefinite
                },
            },
            ContainingBlockConstraints::default(),
            ParticipationInParentFormattingContext::Item,
        );
        (root_cells, input)
    }

    fn own_block_sizes_verified_from(
        (root_cells, input): (used_values::RootInputCells, LayoutInput),
        automatic_content_block_size: i64,
    ) -> Vec<Option<CssPixels>> {
        root_inputs_at_other_own_block_sizes(
            root_cells,
            input,
            formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Unobserved,
            px(automatic_content_block_size),
        )
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(cells, input)| {
            assert_eq!(
                cells.has_definite_block_size,
                matches!(input.available_space.block_size, AvailableSize::Definite(_))
            );
            cells.has_definite_block_size.then_some(cells.content_block_size)
        })
        .collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_unobserved_own_block_size_is_verified_at_the_other_definiteness_and_with_extra_space() {
        let (root_cells, input) = item_root_inputs(40, false);
        assert!(
            root_inputs_at_other_own_block_sizes(
                root_cells,
                input,
                formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Observed,
                px(40)
            )
            .is_empty()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            own_block_sizes_verified_from(item_root_inputs(40, false), 40),
            [Some(px(90))]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            own_block_sizes_verified_from(item_root_inputs(20, false), 40),
            [Some(px(90))]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            own_block_sizes_verified_from(item_root_inputs(40, true), 40),
            [None, Some(px(90))],
            "a stretched run whose content fills it exactly is also verified where extra space is left"
        );
        let (mut saturated_cells, saturated_input) = item_root_inputs(40, true);
        saturated_cells.content_block_size = CssPixels::from_raw(i32::MAX);
        assert_eq!(
            own_block_sizes_verified_from((saturated_cells, saturated_input), 40),
            [None]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_own_block_size_observed_only_by_abspos_is_verified_where_the_root_is_left_with_the_same_block_size() {
        let observed_only_by_abspos = formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::ObservedOnlyByAbsposContainedByRoot;
        let (measured_cells, mut measured_input) = item_root_inputs(0, false);
        measured_input.sizing.content_block_size_after_run = geometry::ContentBlockSizeAfterRun::Automatic;
        let references =
            root_inputs_at_other_own_block_sizes(measured_cells, measured_input, observed_only_by_abspos, px(40));
        let [(cells, input)] = references.as_slice() else {
            panic!("a measured run is verified once, at the block size it adopted");
        };
        assert!(cells.has_definite_block_size);
        assert_eq!(cells.content_block_size, px(40));
        assert_eq!(input.available_space.block_size, AvailableSize::definite(px(40)));
        assert_eq!(
            input.sizing.content_block_size_after_run,
            geometry::ContentBlockSizeAfterRun::HandedOver
        );

        let (stretched_cells, stretched_input) = item_root_inputs(40, true);
        let references = root_inputs_at_other_own_block_sizes(
            stretched_cells,
            stretched_input.clone(),
            observed_only_by_abspos,
            px(40),
        );
        let [(cells, input)] = references.as_slice() else {
            panic!("a run stretched to its automatic block size is verified once, adopting it");
        };
        assert!(!cells.has_definite_block_size);
        assert_eq!(input.available_space.block_size, AvailableSize::Indefinite);
        assert_eq!(
            input.sizing.content_block_size_after_run,
            geometry::ContentBlockSizeAfterRun::Automatic
        );
        assert!(
            root_inputs_at_other_own_block_sizes(stretched_cells, stretched_input, observed_only_by_abspos, px(30))
                .is_empty(),
            "a run stretched past its automatic block size leaves the root with no other block size"
        );
        assert!(root_cells_at_other_block_margins(stretched_cells, observed_only_by_abspos).is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn unobserved_block_margins_are_verified_at_other_block_margins_only() {
        let (root_cells, _) = item_root_inputs(40, true);
        assert_eq!(
            root_cells_at_other_block_margins(root_cells, formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Observed),
            None
        );
        let cells =
            root_cells_at_other_block_margins(root_cells, formatting_context::OwnBlockSizeObservation::Unobserved)
                .expect("an unobserved own block size is verified at other block margins");
        assert_ne!(cells.margin_top, root_cells.margin_top);
        assert_ne!(cells.margin_bottom, root_cells.margin_bottom);
        assert_eq!(
            used_values::RootInputCells {
                margin_top: root_cells.margin_top,
                margin_bottom: root_cells.margin_bottom,
                ..cells
            },
            root_cells
        );
    }
}

use super::*;

/// What the layout stage keeps for itself besides what each of its runs keeps: what the runs of a layout pass share. It
/// is the stage's scratch rather than arena columns: nothing outside a running pass reads it, but for the memos it
/// keeps for later passes.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct LayoutScratch {
    /// The intrinsic sizes passes measured, kept for the passes after them.
    pub(super) intrinsic_size_caches: super::layout_node_arena::IntrinsicSizeCaches,
    /// The results of formatting context runs, kept for the runs after them in this pass and the passes after it.
    fc_run_cache_store: super::fc_run_cache::FcRunCacheStore,
    /// The layouts of in-flow blocks, kept for the passes after the one that laid them out.
    in_flow_block_cache_store: super::in_flow_block_cache::InFlowBlockCacheStore,
    /// The document's layout trace while a stage lays the document out, which the stage takes from the arena and hands
    /// back once it is done.
    pub(super) layout_trace: super::trace::LayoutTrace,
    /// The chunks and grapheme segmenters of the text rows the passes laid out.
    text_memos: super::rendered_text::TextMemos,
    prepared_inline_content_memos: super::prepared_inline_content::PreparedInlineContentMemos,
    fragment_builder_scratch: fragment_tree::FragmentBuilderScratch,
}

/// What layout found out that the host hears of once the layout that found it is committed: what the
/// container-relative lengths it resolved depend on, and the natural size it negotiated for the box of an `<svg>`
/// document element. A run hands them to its parent with its result, so a discarded result tells the host nothing.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct HostFindings {
    pub(crate) messages: Vec<super::commit::FfiCommitMessage>,
    pub(crate) document_svg_root_natural_size: Option<(NodeSlotId, crate::css::style::NaturalSize)>,
    pub(crate) container_length_reads: Vec<ContainerLengthRead>,
}

/// What a run found out besides its result, which the run that takes in its result receives with it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct RunResidue {
    pub(crate) host_findings: HostFindings,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct ContainerLengthRead {
    pub(crate) reader: NodeSlotId,
    pub(crate) element: crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID,
    pub(crate) bases: crate::css::style::ContainerUnitBases,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct HostFindingsSink {
    findings: std::sync::Mutex<HostFindings>,
    noted_any: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
    notes: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64,
}

impl HostFindingsSink {
    pub(crate) fn note(&self, note: impl FnOnce(&mut HostFindings)) {
        let mut findings = self.findings.lock().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
        note(&mut findings);
        self.noted_any.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
        self.notes.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    pub(crate) fn notes_so_far(&self) -> u64 {
        self.notes.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)
    }

    pub(crate) fn take(&self) -> HostFindings {
        if !self.noted_any.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
            return HostFindings::default();
        }
        let mut findings = self.findings.lock().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
        self.noted_any.store(false, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
        std::mem::take(&mut *findings)
    }
}

impl HostFindings {
    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.messages.is_empty()
            && self.document_svg_root_natural_size.is_none()
            && self.container_length_reads.is_empty()
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_container_length_dependencies(
        &mut self,
        reader: NodeSlotId,
        element: crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID,
        bases: &crate::css::style::ContainerUnitBases,
    ) {
        use super::commit::{FfiCommitMessage, FfiCommitMessageKind};
        self.note_container_length_read(ContainerLengthRead {
            reader,
            element,
            bases: *bases,
        });
        self.note_message(FfiCommitMessage::new(
            element.raw(),
            FfiCommitMessageKind::StyleDependsOnSizeContainerQuery,
        ));
        for basis in bases.width_and_height() {
            if let Some(container) = basis.container() {
                self.note_message(FfiCommitMessage::new(
                    container.raw(),
                    FfiCommitMessageKind::SizeQueryContainerResolvedAgainst,
                ));
            }
            if let Some(boxless_container) = basis.boxless_container() {
                self.note_message(FfiCommitMessage::new(
                    boxless_container.raw(),
                    FfiCommitMessageKind::SizeQueryContainerResolvedAgainst,
                ));
                self.note_message(FfiCommitMessage::new(
                    boxless_container.raw(),
                    FfiCommitMessageKind::ContainerQueryEvaluationNeededAfterLayout,
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    fn note_message(&mut self, message: super::commit::FfiCommitMessage) {
        if !self.messages.contains(&message) {
            self.messages.push(message);
        }
    }

    fn note_container_length_read(&mut self, read: ContainerLengthRead) {
        if !self.container_length_reads.contains(&read) {
            self.container_length_reads.push(read);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn receive(&mut self, other: HostFindings) {
        for message in other.messages {
            self.note_message(message);
        }
        for read in other.container_length_reads {
            self.note_container_length_read(read);
        }
        if other.document_svg_root_natural_size.is_some() {
            self.document_svg_root_natural_size = other.document_svg_root_natural_size;
        }
    }
}

// The scratch can move to the thread a layout stage runs on, and the runs of a pass can share it across threads.
const _: () = {
    const fn assert_send_and_sync<T: Send + Sync>() {}
    assert_send_and_sync::<LayoutScratch>();
};

impl LayoutScratch {
    /// The scratch of a fork of the arena, which keeps the run memos the arena's entries were stored for and starts
    /// the rest anew.
    pub(super) fn fork(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
            fc_run_cache_store: self.fc_run_cache_store.fork(),
            in_flow_block_cache_store: self.in_flow_block_cache_store.fork(),
            text_memos: self.text_memos.fork(),
            prepared_inline_content_memos: self.prepared_inline_content_memos.fork(),
            ..Self::default()
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn fc_run_cache_store(&self) -> &super::fc_run_cache::FcRunCacheStore {
        &self.fc_run_cache_store
    }

    pub(super) fn fragment_builder_scratch(&self) -> &fragment_tree::FragmentBuilderScratch {
        &self.fragment_builder_scratch
    }

    pub(super) fn in_flow_block_cache_store(&self) -> &super::in_flow_block_cache::InFlowBlockCacheStore {
        &self.in_flow_block_cache_store
    }

    pub(super) fn text_memos(&self) -> &super::rendered_text::TextMemos {
        &self.text_memos
    }

    pub(super) fn prepared_inline_content_memos(&self) -> &super::prepared_inline_content::PreparedInlineContentMemos {
        &self.prepared_inline_content_memos
    }

    /// Brings the run memos up to date with what the arena's writes since the last call did to their boxes.
    pub(super) fn apply_memo_invalidations(&mut self, arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena) {
        let slot_count = arena.slot_capacity();
        self.intrinsic_size_caches.cover_slots(slot_count);
        self.text_memos.cover_text_states(arena.text_state_capacity());
        self.fragment_builder_scratch.cover_slots(slot_count);
        self.fc_run_cache_store.cover_slots(slot_count);
        self.in_flow_block_cache_store.cover_slots(slot_count);
        self.prepared_inline_content_memos.cover_slots(slot_count);
        arena.take_memo_invalidations().apply_to(
            &mut self.fc_run_cache_store,
            &mut self.in_flow_block_cache_store,
            &mut self.text_memos,
            &mut self.prepared_inline_content_memos,
            &mut self.intrinsic_size_caches,
        );
    }

    /// Brings the run memos up to date with what the commit into `arena` did to their boxes, and sweeps the run cache.
    pub(crate) fn end_layout_pass(&mut self, arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena) {
        self.apply_memo_invalidations(arena);
        arena.sweep_stale_fc_run_cache_entries(&mut self.fc_run_cache_store);
    }
}

/// What a run keeps while it is in progress: its root, the percentage block size dependencies it resolves, the
/// anchor-size() resolutions of its root and what it found out for the host. It keeps no metrics of any box: the
/// formatting context or call that lays out a box holds the box's cells, or hands the box to a run of its own. The
/// scoped constructors lend this to the run, so callers cannot extend its lifetime.
pub(crate) struct RunState {
    root: Node,
    content_sizing: ContentSizing,
    /// What the run found so far about the percentage block size dependency of its root and of the boxes whose
    /// layout in it is in progress, the innermost last. Only these boxes have their dependency resolved.
    percentage_block_size_dependencies_in_progress: PercentageBlockSizeDependenciesInProgress,
    /// The anchor-size() resolutions of an absolutely positioned root, a run input that is constant for the run.
    root_anchor_resolved_values: Option<Box<style_values::AnchorResolvedValues>>,
    /// What the run found out for the host so far, which the pass the run is handed notes into.
    host_findings: HostFindingsSink,
    fragments: Option<fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder>,
    /// For the run of a fragmentainer, what it found out so far about breaking in it.
    fragmentainer_outcome: RefCell<super::fragmentation::FragmentainerOutcome>,
}

/// Where a box is placed: the offset of its content box in the containing block it is placed in.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct BoxPlacement {
    pub(crate) content_offset_in_containing_block: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    pub(crate) containing_block: Node,
}

/// What the placement of a box shows of the layout of its parent, which decides it: the link that places the box's
/// fragment shows the table and line clamp facts and the clip, and the fragment shows whether fragmentation broke the
/// box.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct FragmentFactsDecidedByParent {
    pub(crate) show: fragment_tree::ParentShowFacts,
    pub(crate) breaks: fragment_tree::BreakFacts,
}

/// What the parent of a box decides about the box, kept with the box by the run that holds it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct FactsDecidedByParent {
    pub(crate) placement: Option<BoxPlacement>,
    pub(crate) used_insets: UsedInsets,
    /// The scroll shift the anchor positioning of the box's insets compensates for.
    pub(crate) default_scroll_shift: Option<abspos_inputs::DefaultScrollShift>,
    pub(crate) fragment_facts: FragmentFactsDecidedByParent,
}

impl FactsDecidedByParent {
    /// What the parent decided about a box, as the committed link of the box shows it, read in `frame`, where the
    /// content box of the box's containing block has the physical size `containing_block_size`.
    pub(crate) fn of_committed_link(
        link: &fragment_tree::FragmentLink,
        frame: geometry::Frame,
        containing_block_size: FfiCssPixelSize,
    ) -> Self {
        let insets = link.placement.insets.in_frame(geometry::Frame::PHYSICAL, frame);
        Self {
            placement: Some(BoxPlacement {
                content_offset_in_containing_block: link.offset_in_frame(frame, containing_block_size),
                containing_block: link.placement.containing_block,
            }),
            used_insets: UsedInsets {
                left: insets.left,
                right: insets.right,
                top: insets.top,
                bottom: insets.bottom,
            },
            default_scroll_shift: None,
            fragment_facts: FragmentFactsDecidedByParent {
                show: link.placement.shown_as.facts,
                breaks: fragment_tree::BreakFacts::default(),
            },
        }
    }
}

/// The used values of a box's inset properties.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct UsedInsets {
    pub(crate) left: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) right: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) top: CssPixels,
    pub(crate) bottom: CssPixels,
}

/// Whether a box depends on the block size its percentages resolve against, and whether a box it contains does.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct PercentageBlockSizeDependency {
    pub(crate) depends_on_percentage_block_size: bool,
    pub(crate) has_descendant_that_depends_on_percentage_block_size: bool,
}

type PercentageBlockSizeDependenciesInProgress =
    RefCell<smallvec::SmallVec<[(Node, PercentageBlockSizeDependency); 8]>>;

/// Keeps tracking the percentage block size dependency of a box while its layout is in progress.
pub(crate) struct PercentageBlockSizeDependencyTracking<'state> {
    dependencies_in_progress: &'state PercentageBlockSizeDependenciesInProgress,
    node: Node,
}

impl Drop for PercentageBlockSizeDependencyTracking<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let finished = self.dependencies_in_progress.borrow_mut().pop();
        if !std::thread::panicking() {
            assert_eq!(
                finished.map(|(node, _)| node),
                Some(self.node),
                "the layouts of boxes in progress finished out of order"
            );
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum ContentSizing {
    Layout,
    RootContributions,
    RootContentInlineSizes,
}

impl RunState {
    /// Runs `run` with what a run rooted at `root` keeps, and the pass as that run sees it. The style reads of an
    /// absolutely positioned root see `root_anchor_resolved_values`.
    pub(crate) fn with_root<R>(
        pass: LayoutPass<'_>,
        root: Node,
        root_containing_block: Node,
        root_anchor_resolved_values: Option<Box<style_values::AnchorResolvedValues>>,
        run: impl for<'run> FnOnce(&'run Self, LayoutPass<'run>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        Self::enter(
            pass,
            root,
            root_containing_block,
            root_anchor_resolved_values,
            ContentSizing::Layout,
            None,
            run,
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_root_building_fragments<R>(
        pass: LayoutPass<'_>,
        root: Node,
        root_containing_block: Node,
        root_anchor_resolved_values: Option<Box<style_values::AnchorResolvedValues>>,
        fragments: Option<fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder>,
        run: impl for<'run> FnOnce(&'run Self, LayoutPass<'run>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        Self::enter(
            pass,
            root,
            root_containing_block,
            root_anchor_resolved_values,
            ContentSizing::Layout,
            fragments,
            run,
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_content_sizing_root<R>(
        pass: LayoutPass<'_>,
        root: Node,
        root_containing_block: Node,
        run: impl for<'run> FnOnce(&'run Self, LayoutPass<'run>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        Self::enter(
            pass,
            root,
            root_containing_block,
            None,
            ContentSizing::RootContributions,
            None,
            run,
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_content_inline_sizes_root<R>(
        pass: LayoutPass<'_>,
        root: Node,
        root_containing_block: Node,
        run: impl for<'run> FnOnce(&'run Self, LayoutPass<'run>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        Self::enter(
            pass,
            root,
            root_containing_block,
            None,
            ContentSizing::RootContentInlineSizes,
            None,
            run,
        )
    }

    fn enter<R>(
        pass: LayoutPass<'_>,
        root: Node,
        root_containing_block: Node,
        root_anchor_resolved_values: Option<Box<style_values::AnchorResolvedValues>>,
        content_sizing: ContentSizing,
        fragments: Option<fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder>,
        run: impl for<'run> FnOnce(&'run Self, LayoutPass<'run>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        let state = Self {
            root,
            content_sizing,
            percentage_block_size_dependencies_in_progress: RefCell::new(smallvec::smallvec![(
                root,
                PercentageBlockSizeDependency::default()
            )]),
            root_anchor_resolved_values,
            host_findings: HostFindingsSink::default(),
            fragments,
            fragmentainer_outcome: RefCell::default(),
        };
        run(&state, pass.for_run(root, root_containing_block, &state.host_findings))
    }

    pub(crate) fn fragments(&self) -> Option<&fragment_tree::RunFragmentBuilder> {
        self.fragments.as_ref()
    }

    /// Where the run of a fragmentainer keeps what it found out so far about breaking in it.
    pub(crate) fn fragmentainer_outcome(&self) -> &RefCell<super::fragmentation::FragmentainerOutcome> {
        &self.fragmentainer_outcome
    }

    /// What this run found out besides its result, which the result carries to the run that takes it in.
    pub(crate) fn take_residue(&self) -> Option<Box<RunResidue>> {
        let host_findings = self.host_findings.take();
        (!host_findings.is_empty()).then(|| Box::new(RunResidue { host_findings }))
    }

    /// What this run found out for the host, which its outputs carry to the run that uses its result.
    pub(crate) fn take_host_findings(&self) -> Option<Box<HostFindings>> {
        let findings = self.host_findings.take();
        (!findings.is_empty()).then(|| Box::new(findings))
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_content_sizing(&self) -> bool {
        self.content_sizing != ContentSizing::Layout
    }

    pub(crate) fn measures_content_inline_sizes_of(&self, node: Node) -> bool {
        self.content_sizing == ContentSizing::RootContentInlineSizes && node == self.root
    }

    pub(crate) fn root(&self) -> Node {
        self.root
    }

    /// The anchor-size() resolutions the style reads of `node` see, which only an absolutely positioned run root has.
    pub(crate) fn anchor_resolved_values_of(&self, node: Node) -> Option<&style_values::AnchorResolvedValues> {
        if node != self.root {
            return None;
        }
        self.root_anchor_resolved_values.as_deref()
    }

    /// Tracks the percentage block size dependency of `node` until the returned tracking is dropped, which the layout
    /// of `node` holds while it is in progress.
    pub(crate) fn track_percentage_block_size_dependency_while_laying_out(
        &self,
        node: Node,
    ) -> PercentageBlockSizeDependencyTracking<'_> {
        self.percentage_block_size_dependencies_in_progress
            .borrow_mut()
            .push((node, PercentageBlockSizeDependency::default()));
        PercentageBlockSizeDependencyTracking {
            dependencies_in_progress: &self.percentage_block_size_dependencies_in_progress,
            node,
        }
    }

    /// The percentage block size dependency found so far for the run's root or a box whose layout is in progress.
    #[track_caller]
    pub(crate) fn percentage_block_size_dependency_of(&self, node: Node) -> PercentageBlockSizeDependency {
        self.percentage_block_size_dependencies_in_progress
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .rev()
            .find(|(tracked, _)| *tracked == node)
            .map(|(_, dependency)| *dependency)
            .expect("only the run root and boxes whose layout is in progress have their dependency resolved")
    }

    /// Notes that `node` depends on the block size its percentages resolve against. Nothing resolves the dependency of
    /// a box that is neither the run root nor in progress, so the note is dropped for such a box.
    pub(crate) fn note_box_depends_on_percentage_block_size(&self, node: Node) {
        self.update_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(node, |dependency| {
            dependency.depends_on_percentage_block_size = true;
        });
    }

    /// Whether this run resolves the percentage block size dependency of `node`: the run root, or a box whose layout is
    /// in progress.
    pub(crate) fn resolves_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(&self, node: Node) -> bool {
        self.percentage_block_size_dependencies_in_progress
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .any(|(tracked, _)| *tracked == node)
    }

    /// Notes that a box `containing_block` contains depends on the block size its percentages resolve against.
    /// Nothing resolves the dependency of a box that is neither the run root nor in progress, so the note is dropped for
    /// such a box.
    pub(crate) fn note_descendant_depends_on_percentage_block_size(&self, containing_block: Node) {
        self.update_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(containing_block, |dependency| {
            dependency.has_descendant_that_depends_on_percentage_block_size = true;
        });
    }

    fn update_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(
        &self,
        node: Node,
        update: impl FnOnce(&mut PercentageBlockSizeDependency),
    ) {
        if let Some((_, dependency)) = self
            .percentage_block_size_dependencies_in_progress
            .borrow_mut()
            .iter_mut()
            .rev()
            .find(|(tracked, _)| *tracked == node)
        {
            update(dependency);
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn a_nested_run_keeps_its_own_root_and_host_findings() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let scratch = LayoutScratch::default();
        let host_findings_outside_runs = HostFindingsSink::default();
        let root = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        let child = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        RunState::with_root(
            LayoutPass::for_test(&arena, &scratch, &host_findings_outside_runs),
            root,
            NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            None,
            |parent, parent_pass| {
                assert_eq!(parent.root(), root);
                let nested_findings = RunState::with_root(parent_pass, child, root, None, |nested, pass| {
                    assert_eq!(nested.root(), child);
                    assert!(nested.resolves_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(child));
                    assert!(!nested.resolves_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(root));
                    assert!(!parent.resolves_percentage_block_size_dependency_of(child));
                    assert!(nested.anchor_resolved_values_of(child).is_none());
                    pass.note_host_findings(|findings| {
                        findings.document_svg_root_natural_size =
                            Some((child, crate::css::style::NaturalSize::default()));
                    });
                    nested.take_host_findings()
                });
                assert_eq!(parent.root(), root);
                assert!(parent.take_host_findings().is_none());
                assert_eq!(
                    nested_findings.and_then(|findings| findings.document_svg_root_natural_size),
                    Some((child, crate::css::style::NaturalSize::default()))
                );
            },
        );
        assert!(host_findings_outside_runs.take().is_empty());
    }
}

//! The entries script APIs call for an element's geometry: its boxes and client rects, the rects of a text range and of
//! a caret, and what an intersection observer computes. Each spends the one forced read of the script call that
//! reached it, and answers from the rows the document's render state published, which the host asks for again only
//! where it wrote them since.

use super::FfiCssPixelRect;
use super::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use super::query::inline_cursor::{self, CaretPosition, InlineCursor};
use super::used_values::{FfiCssPixelPoint, FfiCssPixelSize};
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::css::ffi_support::FfiUtf16View;
use crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID;
use crate::layout::text_queries::FfiDomTextRange;
use crate::painting::ffi::FfiBoxModelMetrics;
use crate::painting::host::FfiCaretPaintKind;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead, PaintRow, PaintSource};
use crate::painting::viewport_mapping::{FfiViewportMapping, ViewportSpace};
use crate::render_state::{DocumentHost, ScriptForcedRead};
use std::ffi::c_void;

/// Mints the forced read of a script call that reaches the host through one of this module's entries.
pub(crate) struct ScriptEntry {
    _private: (),
}

const SCRIPT_ENTRY: ScriptEntry = ScriptEntry { _private: () };

/// Answers `read` from the rows of `host`'s document as of every write the host made, spending the script call's
/// forced read. Every entry here is called with a live document host, on its document's thread.
fn read_rows<R>(host: &DocumentHost, read: impl FnOnce(&PaintSource<'_>) -> R) -> R {
    host.read_rows(ScriptForcedRead::at_script_entry(&SCRIPT_ENTRY), false, read)
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The callback must be sound to call with `context`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_client_rects(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    layout_node: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    context: *mut c_void,
    push_rect: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, FfiCssPixelRect),
) {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        crate::painting::client_rects::for_each_client_rect(arena, layout_node, &viewport_mapping.mapping(), |rect| {
            // SAFETY: The consumer copies the plain-data rect synchronously.
            unsafe { push_rect(context, rect.into()) };
        });
    });
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_bounding_client_rect(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    layout_node: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    out: &mut FfiCssPixelRect,
) {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    *out = read_rows(host, |arena| {
        crate::painting::client_rects::bounding_client_rect(arena, layout_node, &viewport_mapping.mapping()).into()
    });
}

/// # Safety
///
/// A supplied callback must be sound to call with `context`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_transform_subtree_is_clipped_outside(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    target: NodeSlotId,
    intersection_root: NodeSlotId,
    root_bounds: FfiCssPixelRect,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    context: *const c_void,
    inflate_scroll_clip: Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(*const c_void, FfiCssPixelRect) -> FfiCssPixelRect>,
) -> bool {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        crate::painting::intersection_observer::transform_subtree_is_clipped_outside(
            arena,
            target,
            intersection_root,
            root_bounds.into(),
            &viewport_mapping.mapping(),
            inflate_scroll_clip.map(|inflate| {
                move |rect: CssPixelRect| {
                    // SAFETY: The callback copies the plain-data rect synchronously.
                    unsafe { inflate(context, rect.into()) }.into()
                }
            }),
        )
    })
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The callback must be sound to call with `context`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_intersection_observer_intersection_rect(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    target: NodeSlotId,
    target_rect: FfiCssPixelRect,
    intersection_root: NodeSlotId,
    root_bounds: FfiCssPixelRect,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    context: *const c_void,
    inflate_scroll_container_clip_rect_by_scroll_margin: unsafe extern "C" fn(
        *const c_void,
        FfiCssPixelRect,
    ) -> FfiCssPixelRect,
    out: &mut FfiCssPixelRect,
) -> bool {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    let intersection_rect = read_rows(host, |arena| {
        crate::painting::intersection_observer::intersection_rect(
            arena,
            target,
            target_rect.into(),
            intersection_root,
            root_bounds.into(),
            &viewport_mapping.mapping(),
            |clip_rect: CssPixelRect| -> CssPixelRect {
                // SAFETY: The callback copies the plain-data rect synchronously.
                unsafe { inflate_scroll_container_clip_rect_by_scroll_margin(context, clip_rect.into()) }.into()
            },
        )
    });
    *out = intersection_rect.unwrap_or_default().into();
    intersection_rect.is_some()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_can_compute_client_rects_without_visual_context_update(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    layout_node: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_scroll_offset_is_zero: bool,
) -> bool {
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        crate::painting::client_rects::can_compute_client_rects_without_visual_context_update(
            arena,
            layout_node,
            viewport_scroll_offset_is_zero,
        )
    })
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The callback must be sound to call with `context`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_text_range_rects(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    primary: NodeSlotId,
    selection_state: u8,
    range_start_offset: usize,
    range_end_offset: usize,
    filter_dom_start: usize,
    filter_dom_end: usize,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    context: *mut c_void,
    push_rect: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, FfiCssPixelRect),
) {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        let paintable_rows = arena;
        let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.mapping();

        // A collapsed range has the rect of the caret it is in text, with no width.
        if selection_state == crate::painting::paintable_data::SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END
            && range_start_offset == range_end_offset
        {
            let cursor = InlineCursor::new(arena);
            if let Some(position) = cursor.line_of(primary, range_start_offset, true)
                && let Some(index) = position.fragment
            {
                let root = position.line.root;
                let side = arena.committed_side_data(root);
                let fragment = &side.fragments()[index as usize];
                let mut rect = cursor
                    .caret_rect_in_fragment(root, fragment, range_start_offset, true)
                    .rect;
                if crate::painting::text_fragment::is_horizontal(fragment) {
                    rect.width = CssPixels::default();
                } else {
                    rect.height = CssPixels::default();
                }
                let rect = viewport_mapping.line_content_rect_to_viewport(
                    arena,
                    root,
                    fragment.layout_node,
                    rect,
                    ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport,
                );
                // SAFETY: The consumer copies the plain-data rect synchronously.
                unsafe { push_rect(context, rect.into()) };
            }
            return;
        }

        let fragments = arena.text_fragments(primary);
        let node_slots = fragments.as_slice();
        crate::painting::text_fragment::for_each_fragment_of_nodes(paintable_rows, node_slots, |block, _, fragment| {
            let fragment_dom_start = fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node;
            let fragment_dom_end = fragment.dom_end_offset_in_node;
            if fragment_dom_end <= filter_dom_start || fragment_dom_start >= filter_dom_end {
                return true;
            }

            let rect = crate::painting::text_fragment::range_rect(
                paintable_rows,
                fragment,
                selection_state,
                range_start_offset,
                range_end_offset,
            );

            let rect_in_viewport_space = if arena.slot_is_live(block) {
                viewport_mapping.line_content_rect_to_viewport(
                    paintable_rows,
                    block,
                    fragment.layout_node,
                    rect,
                    ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport,
                )
            } else {
                rect
            };

            // SAFETY: The consumer copies the plain-data rect synchronously.
            unsafe { push_rect(context, rect_in_viewport_space.into()) };
            true
        });
    });
}

/// Calls `push_source` with what the character geometry of the text node `primary` is computed from: for each of its
/// layout nodes, a retained reference to its containing block's line content, and the raw document-absolute position
/// of that block. The same references at the same positions mean the same geometry. The consumer owns every reference
/// pushed, and releases each one with layout_release_inline_content(). Returns false when the geometry depends on more
/// than this: when a block is fragmented, or holds no line content.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The callback must be sound to call with `context`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_text_geometry_sources(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    primary: NodeSlotId,
    context: *mut c_void,
    push_source: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const crate::layout::inline_content::InlineContent, i32, i32),
) -> bool {
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        let fragments = arena.text_fragments(primary);
        let node_slots = fragments.as_slice();
        if node_slots.is_empty() {
            return false;
        }
        for &node in node_slots {
            let Some(block) = crate::painting::text_fragment::containing_block_paintable_of_node(arena, node) else {
                return false;
            };
            let side_data = arena.committed_side_data(block);
            let Some(content) = side_data.inline_content.as_ref() else {
                return false;
            };
            // Lines in different fragments of a block can each move on their own.
            if side_data.box_fragments().len() > 1 {
                return false;
            }
            let position = crate::painting::paintable_geometry::absolute_line_root_position(arena, block, 0);
            let retained = std::sync::Arc::into_raw(content.clone());
            // SAFETY: The consumer takes ownership of the reference, and copies the position synchronously.
            unsafe { push_source(context, retained, position.x.raw_value(), position.y.raw_value()) };
        }
        true
    })
}

/// Releases a reference to line content that layout_script_text_geometry_sources() handed out.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_release_inline_content(
    content: crate::css::ffi_support::OwnedArc<crate::layout::inline_content::InlineContent>,
) {
    drop(content);
}

/// Calls `push_position` with each DOM offset (in UTF-16 code units) of the text node `primary` that one of its
/// horizontal fragments renders, along with the document-absolute x coordinate where that offset's character starts,
/// read from the fragment's shaped glyph run. `is_fragment_end` marks the offset one past a fragment's last character,
/// whose x is where that fragment's text ends.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The callback must be sound to call with `context`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_text_character_x_positions(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    primary: NodeSlotId,
    context: *mut c_void,
    push_position: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize, f32, bool),
) {
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        let fragments = arena.text_fragments(primary);
        crate::painting::text_fragment::for_each_fragment_of_nodes(arena, fragments.as_slice(), |_, _, fragment| {
            let end = fragment.dom_end_offset_in_node;
            crate::painting::text_fragment::for_each_dom_offset_x(arena, fragment, |dom_offset, x| {
                // SAFETY: The consumer copies the plain-data position synchronously.
                unsafe { push_position(context, dom_offset, x, dom_offset == end) };
            });
            true
        });
    });
}

/// A caret position as the host names it: `offset` in the DOM text whose layout node is `node`, or, where `node` is the
/// box of an element, the position between the children of the element whose boxes are `child_before` and
/// `child_after` (`NodeSlotId::INVALID` for none), where the DOM text of `child_before` is `child_before_length` long.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct FfiCaretPosition {
    pub node: NodeSlotId,
    pub offset: usize,
    pub downstream: bool,
    pub child_before: NodeSlotId,
    pub child_before_length: usize,
    pub child_after: NodeSlotId,
}

impl FfiCaretPosition {
    /// The caret positions the position can take, in the order to try them.
    pub(crate) fn candidates(&self, arena: &impl PaintRead) -> impl Iterator<Item = CaretPosition> {
        let is_text = arena
            .node_kind_if_live(self.node)
            .is_some_and(super::node_facts::kind_is_text);
        let text = is_text.then_some(CaretPosition::Text {
            text: self.node,
            offset: self.offset,
            downstream: self.downstream,
        });
        let between_children = (!is_text)
            .then(|| {
                inline_cursor::caret_positions_between_children(
                    arena,
                    self.node,
                    self.child_before,
                    self.child_before_length,
                    self.child_after,
                )
            })
            .into_iter()
            .flatten();
        text.into_iter().chain(between_children)
    }
}

/// The caret layout gives a position, as the recorder paints it and in the layout viewport.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiCaret {
    pub found: bool,
    pub paint: FfiCaretPaintKind,
    pub block: NodeSlotId,
    pub owner: NodeSlotId,
    pub rect: FfiCssPixelRect,
    pub viewport_rect: FfiCssPixelRect,
    pub style_source: NodeSlotId,
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_caret(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    position: FfiCaretPosition,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    out: &mut FfiCaret,
) {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    *out = read_rows(host, |arena| {
        let cursor = InlineCursor::new(arena);
        let Some(caret) = position
            .candidates(arena)
            .find_map(|candidate| cursor.caret_rect(candidate))
        else {
            return FfiCaret {
                found: false,
                paint: FfiCaretPaintKind::None,
                block: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
                owner: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
                rect: FfiCssPixelRect::default(),
                viewport_rect: FfiCssPixelRect::default(),
                style_source: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            };
        };
        // A box with no line content around the caret paints the caret itself.
        let at_start_of_box = caret.owner == caret.node;
        FfiCaret {
            found: true,
            paint: if at_start_of_box && crate::painting::node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, caret.owner) {
                FfiCaretPaintKind::EmptyInline
            } else {
                FfiCaretPaintKind::InBlock
            },
            block: caret.owner,
            owner: crate::painting::fragment_ownership::nearest_self_painting_inline_box(arena, caret.node)
                .filter(|_| !at_start_of_box)
                .unwrap_or(NodeSlotId::INVALID),
            rect: caret.rect.into(),
            viewport_rect: viewport_mapping
                .mapping()
                .line_content_rect_to_viewport(
                    arena,
                    caret.owner,
                    caret.node,
                    caret.rect,
                    ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport,
                )
                .into(),
            style_source: caret.style_source,
        }
    });
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]

/// Whether the box or one of its ancestors is sticky positioned, which moves the box by an offset that depends on the
/// scroll position.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_has_sticky_positioned_inclusive_ancestor(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
) -> bool {
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        let mut node = slot;
        while let Some(row) = arena.node(node) {
            if let Some(style) = row.style()
                && crate::painting::style_queries::is_sticky_position(style)
            {
                return true;
            }
            node = row.parent();
        }
        false
    })
}

/// The offset by which sticky positioning moves the box, as the sum of the offsets of the sticky positioned box and
/// its sticky positioned ancestors.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_accumulated_sticky_offset(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    out: &mut FfiCssPixelPoint,
) {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    *out = read_rows(host, |arena| viewport_mapping.mapping().sticky_offset(arena, slot)).into();
}

/// The offset by which scrolling, sticky positioning and anchor scroll shifts move the box, without its transforms.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_offset_to_viewport_ignoring_transforms(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    out: &mut FfiCssPixelPoint,
) {
    let viewport_mapping = viewport_mapping.resolve();
    *out = read_rows(host, |arena| {
        viewport_mapping
            .mapping()
            .offset_to_viewport_ignoring_transforms(arena, slot)
    })
    .into();
}

/// Whether the forced break `forced_break` ends an empty line of `block`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_forced_break_ends_empty_line(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    block: NodeSlotId,
    forced_break: NodeSlotId,
) -> bool {
    read_rows(host, |arena| {
        arena.paintable_row_is_populated(block)
            && arena.committed_side_data(block).lines().iter().any(|line| {
                line.fragment_count == 0 && line.forced_break.is_some_and(|position| position.node == forced_break)
            })
    })
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_paintable_box_model(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    out: &mut FfiBoxModelMetrics,
) {
    *out = read_rows(host, |arena| {
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return FfiBoxModelMetrics::default();
        }
        let (margin, padding, border) = crate::painting::paintable_geometry::unbroken_box_model(arena, slot);
        FfiBoxModelMetrics {
            margin,
            padding,
            border,
            inset: crate::painting::paintable_geometry::committed_inset(arena, slot),
        }
    });
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_paintable_content_size(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    out: &mut FfiCssPixelSize,
) {
    *out = read_rows(host, |arena| {
        let paintable_rows = arena;
        if !paintable_rows.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return FfiCssPixelSize::default();
        }
        crate::painting::paintable_geometry::unbroken_content_size(paintable_rows, slot)
    });
}

/// Answers `read` of the layout arena of `host`'s document, spending the script call's forced read.
fn read_arena<R>(host: &DocumentHost, read: impl FnOnce(&mut crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena) -> R) -> R {
    host.ask(ScriptForcedRead::at_script_entry(&SCRIPT_ENTRY), |state| {
        read(state.arena_mut())
    })
}

}

}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiRenderedTextWithOffsetsView {
    pub text: *const u16,
    pub length_in_code_units: usize,
    pub offset_mapping: *const FfiRenderedTextOffset,
    pub offset_mapping_length: usize,
}

/// The text the rows of the text node whose primary row is `primary` render, handed to `append`.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, the primary and its fragments live text rows with
/// styled parents, and `append` must copy the view synchronously.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_rendered_text(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    primary: NodeSlotId,
    context: *mut c_void,
    append: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, FfiRenderedTextView),
) {
    // The rows carry the text each text row renders, unless the row waits for its text to be rendered again, which only
    // the render state does.
    let from_rows = host.read_rows_with_rendered_text(
        ScriptForcedRead::at_script_entry(&SCRIPT_ENTRY),
        |rows, awaiting_render| crate::layout::text_queries::rendered_text_of_rows(rows, awaiting_render, primary),
    );
    let text = match from_rows {
        Some(text) => text,
        None => read_arena(host, |arena| crate::layout::text_queries::rendered_text(arena, primary)),
    };
    let view = FfiRenderedTextView {
        text: text.as_ptr(),
        length_in_code_units: text.len(),
    };
    // SAFETY: The text outlives the call, which copies it.
    unsafe { append(context, view) };
}

/// The rendered text and its rendered-to-DOM UTF-16 offset mapping for a text row.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host on its document's thread, `primary` must be a live text row, and `append` must
/// copy both views synchronously.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_rendered_text_with_dom_offsets(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    primary: NodeSlotId,
    context: *mut c_void,
    append: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, FfiRenderedTextWithOffsetsView),
) {
    let (text, offsets) = read_arena(host, |arena| {
        crate::layout::text_queries::rendered_text_with_dom_offsets(arena, primary)
    });
    let offset_mapping: Vec<_> = offsets
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(dom_start_offset, dom_end_offset)| FfiRenderedTextOffset {
            dom_start_offset,
            dom_end_offset,
        })
        .collect();
    let view = FfiRenderedTextWithOffsetsView {
        text: text.as_ptr(),
        length_in_code_units: text.len(),
        offset_mapping: offset_mapping.as_ptr(),
        offset_mapping_length: offset_mapping.len(),
    };
    // SAFETY: Both vectors outlive the call, which copies the views.
    unsafe { append(context, view) };
}

/// The text the pseudo-element of kind `generated_for` on the element `style_node` resolved its generated content to
/// when its box was built, as a raw `AK::Utf16String` representation for which the caller takes one reference.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_script_generated_content_accessible_text(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    style_node: u32,
    generated_for: u8,
) -> usize {
    let text = match StyleNodeID::from_raw(style_node) {
        Some(element) => read_arena(host, |arena| {
            let owner = crate::layout::counters::CounterOwner { element, generated_for };
            arena.generated_content().accessible_text(owner).to_vec()
        }),
        None => Vec::new(),
    };
    ak::Utf16String::from_utf16(&text).into_raw()
}

/// Where `query` occurs in the searchable text below `viewport`, each match handed to `append`. The text of a DOM
/// text node `is_searchable` turns down is not searched.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, the query must stay readable during the call, and
/// the callbacks may read the DOM but must not change it or the layout tree.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_script_find_matching_text(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    query: FfiUtf16View,
    case_sensitive: bool,
    is_searchable: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32) -> bool,
    context: *mut c_void,
    append: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, FfiDomTextRange),
) {
    // SAFETY: The host lends the query for this synchronous call.
    let query = query.to_utf16().expect("query carries no storage");
    if query.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let candidates = read_arena(host, |arena| {
        crate::layout::text_queries::search_candidates(arena, viewport)
    });
    let mut excluded: Vec<StyleNodeID> = candidates
        .into_iter()
        // SAFETY: The callback only reads whether the DOM text node is searchable.
        .filter(|text| !unsafe { is_searchable(context, text.raw()) })
        .collect();
    excluded.sort_unstable();
    let matches = read_arena(host, |arena| {
        crate::layout::text_queries::find_matching_text(arena, viewport, &query, case_sensitive, &excluded)
    });
    for range in matches {
        // SAFETY: The host resolves each identity's DOM node itself, synchronously.
        unsafe { append(context, range) };
    }
}

/// A min or max sizing property, whose anchor-size() functions the abspos engine resolves.
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum FfiAnchorSizedProperty {
    MinWidth,
    MinHeight,
    MaxWidth,
    MaxHeight,
}

/// Writes the size `property` of the absolutely positioned box `slot` resolved to in the committed layout to `out`,
/// when its anchor-size() functions resolved against an anchor box.
pub fn layout_script_anchor_resolved_size(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    property: FfiAnchorSizedProperty,
    out: &mut crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels,
) -> bool {
    use super::style_values::ResolvedSizeOverride;
    let resolved = read_rows(host, |arena| {
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return None;
        }
        arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
            let link = link?;
            let inputs = link.placement.abspos_layout_inputs.as_ref()?;
            let sizes = inputs.resolved_anchor_sizes;
            // NB: The sizes lie in the frame the box was laid out in, whose axes a vertical writing mode transposes.
            let (physical_width, physical_height) = if inputs.frame.is_transposed() {
                ((sizes.min_height, sizes.max_height), (sizes.min_width, sizes.max_width))
            } else {
                ((sizes.min_width, sizes.max_width), (sizes.min_height, sizes.max_height))
            };
            match property {
                FfiAnchorSizedProperty::MinWidth => physical_width.0,
                FfiAnchorSizedProperty::MaxWidth => physical_width.1,
                FfiAnchorSizedProperty::MinHeight => physical_height.0,
                FfiAnchorSizedProperty::MaxHeight => physical_height.1,
            }
        })
    });
    // NB: A size resolved to a keyword holds an anchor function with neither an anchor box nor a fallback value, which
    //     makes the declaration invalid at computed-value time however its other functions resolve.
    let Some(ResolvedSizeOverride::Length(px)) = resolved else {
        return false;
    };
    *out = px;
    true
}

//! What the host asks about the rows of its document's layout: what a layout node asks about its own row (its flags,
//! links and style), the row a node is bound to, and the shape and paint facts of a row. The host answers from the rows
//! the document's render state published, which it asks for again only after the host wrote them, so none of these
//! reaches the arena. What a row is and the row a node is bound to are read through [`RowIdentities`], which the host
//! reads again only after a write that changed them: installing a style, which a style update does for every element
//! it restyles, does not.
//!
//! The entries that find the layout node of an element, a document or a row take the read the host began, and the
//! reads of a node found so spend that read (see [`NodeRead`]).

use super::node_data::{CompositorAnimationFrameKind, FfiNodeLink, NodeSlotId};
use super::row_reads::{RowIdentities, RowSnapshot};
use crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead, PaintSource};
use crate::render_state::{BegunRead, DocumentHost, RenderWait};
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::rc::Rc;

crate::render_state::held_node_entries!();

/// Answers `answer` from the render state of `host`'s document and `args`, as of every write the host made, spending
/// `wait`.
pub(crate) fn read_arena<A, R>(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    wait: impl RenderWait,
    args: A,
    answer: fn(&mut super::LayoutNodeArena, A) -> R,
) -> R {
    host.ask(wait, |state| answer(state.arena_mut(), args))
}

/// The rows of `host`'s document as of every write the host made, spending `wait`.
fn rows(host: &DocumentHost, wait: impl RenderWait) -> Rc<RowSnapshot> {
    host.fresh_rows(wait)
}

/// The style record each row of `host`'s document has, as of every write the host made, for a read of the row `id`,
/// spending `wait`.
fn styles(host: &DocumentHost, id: NodeSlotId, wait: impl RenderWait) -> crate::layout::row_reads::RowStyles {
    host.row_styles_of(id, wait)
}

/// What each row of `host`'s document is, and the row each node is bound to, as of every write the host made, spending
/// `wait`.
fn identities(host: &DocumentHost, wait: impl RenderWait) -> RowIdentities {
    host.row_identities(wait)
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_row_flags(host: &DocumentHost, id: NodeSlotId) -> u32 {
    rows(host, node_read()).flags(id)
}

/// The row's flags that say what node it stands for (see [`super::node_data::NodeFlag::IDENTITY`]); every other flag
/// reads as unset.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_row_identity_flags(host: &DocumentHost, id: NodeSlotId) -> u32 {
    identities(host, node_read()).identity_flags(id)
}

/// The layout node of the row `id` links to, made if nothing has asked for it yet, or null.

    let linked = rows(host, node_read()).link(id, link);
    shell_of(host, node_read(), (!linked.is_invalid()).then_some(linked))
