//! https://drafts.csswg.org/css-borders-4/#border-shape

use crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView;
use crate::css::css_enums::keyword;
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
use crate::css::style_value::{BasicShapeData, StyleValueData};
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::display_list::device_pixels::DevicePixelConverter;
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::paintable_data::BorderEdge;
use crate::painting::record::paint::border::{BordersDataDevicePixels, border_color};
use crate::painting::visual_context::basic_shapes::basic_shape_device_path;
use crate::painting::{paintable_geometry, style_queries};
use libgfx_rust::path::Path;
use libgfx_rust::{Color, WindingRule};

/// A border drawn along a shape, in device space.
pub(crate) enum BorderShape {
    /// A single shape: the border is a stroke along its path.
    Stroke {
        path: Path,
        fill_rule: WindingRule,
        /// The shape against its reference box shrunk by half the stroke width, along the inner edge of the stroke.
        inner_edge: Path,
        /// The shape against its reference box grown by half the stroke width, along the outer edge of the stroke.
        outer_edge: Path,
        width: f32,
        color: Option<Color>,
    },
    /// Two shapes: the border is the area between them.
    Fill {
        outer: Path,
        inner: Path,
        inner_fill_rule: WindingRule,
        color: Option<Color>,
    },
}

/// Whether the computed value of 'border-shape' is not none.
pub(crate) fn has_border_shape(style: ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> bool {
    style_queries::handle_value(&style.border().border_shape)
        .is_some_and(|value| !matches!(value, StyleValueData::Keyword { .. }))
}

/// One path holding the subpaths of both `paths`.
fn combined_path(paths: [&Path; 2]) -> Option<Path> {
    let svg = paths.map(|path| path.to_svg_string()).join(" ");
    let parsed = crate::svg::parse_utf16_path(&svg.encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>(), false)?;
    Some(crate::css::css_path::CssPath::new(parsed).to_gfx_path())
}

impl BorderShape {
    /// The area the border covers, filled with the even-odd rule, when it is not a stroke.
    pub(crate) fn fill_area(&self) -> Option<Path> {
        match self {
            Self::Stroke { .. } => None,
            Self::Fill { outer, inner, .. } => combined_path([outer, inner]),
        }
    }

    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-borders-4/#border-shape-shadow-interaction
    /// An outer box-shadow is cast as if the shape defined by the outer path were opaque. An inner box-shadow is cast
    /// as if everything outside the shape defined by the inner path were opaque. A single shape's outer and inner
    /// paths are the edges of its stroke.
    pub(crate) fn into_shadow_paths(self) -> (Path, Path) {
        match self {
            Self::Stroke {
                outer_edge, inner_edge, ..
            } => (outer_edge, inner_edge),
            Self::Fill { outer, inner, .. } => (outer, inner),
        }
    }

    /// The inner border-shape clips the background. A single shape clips it along its path, under the stroke.
    pub(crate) fn background_clip_path(&self) -> (&Path, WindingRule) {
        match self {
            Self::Stroke { path, fill_rule, .. } => (path, *fill_rule),
            Self::Fill {
                inner, inner_fill_rule, ..
            } => (inner, *inner_fill_rule),
        }
    }

    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-borders-4/#border-shape-overflow-interaction
    /// The inner border-shape clips the overflow content of the element. A single shape clips it along the inner edge
    /// of its stroke.
    pub(crate) fn into_overflow_clip_path(self) -> (Path, WindingRule) {
        match self {
            Self::Stroke {
                inner_edge, fill_rule, ..
            } => (inner_edge, fill_rule),
            Self::Fill {
                inner, inner_fill_rule, ..
            } => (inner, inner_fill_rule),
        }
    }
}

/// The edge of the relevant side for border shape.
/// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-borders-4/#relevant-side-for-border-shape
fn relevant_side(style: ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> BorderEdge {
    let edge_of = |logical_style: u16| match crate::css::style_compute::map_logical_alias_to_physical(
        logical_style,
        style.writing_mode(),
        style.direction(),
    ) {
        property_id::BORDER_TOP_STYLE => BorderEdge::Top,
        property_id::BORDER_RIGHT_STYLE => BorderEdge::Right,
        property_id::BORDER_BOTTOM_STYLE => BorderEdge::Bottom,
        _ => BorderEdge::Left,
    };
    // An element's relevant side for border shape is the first side (in the order block-start, inline-start,
    // block-end, and inline-end) that has a non-none border style, or block-start if they're all none.
    let sides = [
        edge_of(property_id::BORDER_BLOCK_START_STYLE),
        edge_of(property_id::BORDER_INLINE_START_STYLE),
        edge_of(property_id::BORDER_BLOCK_END_STYLE),
        edge_of(property_id::BORDER_INLINE_END_STYLE),
    ];
    let computed_style = |edge| match edge {
        BorderEdge::Top => style.border_top_style(),
        BorderEdge::Right => style.border_right_style(),
        BorderEdge::Bottom => style.border_bottom_style(),
        BorderEdge::Left => style.border_left_style(),
    };
    sides
        .into_iter()
        .find(|&edge| computed_style(edge) != crate::css::css_enums::line_style::NONE)
        .unwrap_or(sides[0])
}

fn relevant_side_width(style: ComputedValuesView<'_>, edge: BorderEdge) -> CssPixels {
    match edge {
        BorderEdge::Top => style.border_top_width(),
        BorderEdge::Right => style.border_right_width(),
        BorderEdge::Bottom => style.border_bottom_width(),
        BorderEdge::Left => style.border_left_width(),
    }
}

/// The reference box a <geometry-box> keyword names, or `default` when there is none.
/// FIXME: Inline boxes paint once per fragment, but this resolves against the whole element's border box, so a box
///        broken across lines paints the whole shape in each fragment. The spec does not say how a border shape
///        fragments yet.
pub(crate) fn reference_box(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    style: ComputedValuesView<'_>,
    geometry_box: Option<u16>,
    default: u16,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    let border_box = paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(layout_arena, slot);
    let widths = [
        style.border_top_width(),
        style.border_right_width(),
        style.border_bottom_width(),
        style.border_left_width(),
    ];
    let inset = |rect: CssPixelRect, [top, right, bottom, left]: [CssPixels; 4]| {
        CssPixelRect::new(
            rect.x + left,
            rect.y + top,
            rect.width - left - right,
            rect.height - top - bottom,
        )
    };
    match geometry_box.unwrap_or(default) {
        keyword::PADDING_BOX => inset(border_box, widths),
        keyword::CONTENT_BOX => paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(layout_arena, slot),
        keyword::MARGIN_BOX => {
            let margin = paintable_geometry::committed_margin(layout_arena, slot);
            inset(border_box, [-margin.top, -margin.right, -margin.bottom, -margin.left])
        }
        // The box halfway between the border box and the padding box.
        keyword::HALF_BORDER_BOX => inset(border_box, widths.map(|width| width.scaled(0.5))),
        // FIXME: Map fill-box, stroke-box and view-box for SVG elements. They name the border box for CSS boxes.
        _ => border_box,
    }
}

impl BorderShape {
    pub(crate) fn of(
        layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
        slot: NodeSlotId,
        borders_data: &BordersDataDevicePixels,
        pixel_ratio: f64,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        let style = layout_arena.node_style_if_live(slot)?;
        let value = style_queries::handle_value(&style.border().border_shape)?;
        // [ <basic-shape> <geometry-box>? ]{1,2}, as a lone shape or a list of shapes and boxes.
        let mut shapes: Vec<(&BasicShapeData, Option<u16>)> = Vec::new();
        let items = match value {
            StyleValueData::ValueList { values, .. } => values.as_slice().iter().map(|value| value.data()).collect(),
            value => vec![value],
        };
        for item in items {
            match item {
                StyleValueData::BasicShape { shape } => shapes.push((shape.as_ref(), None)),
                StyleValueData::Keyword { keyword } => shapes.last_mut()?.1 = Some(*keyword),
                _ => return None,
            }
        }

        let edge = relevant_side(style);
        let side = borders_data.for_edge(edge);
        let color = (side.width > 0).then(|| border_color(edge, borders_data));
        // The fill color of the border is the relevant side's computed 'border-color', whatever its width.
        let fill_color = Color(match edge {
            BorderEdge::Top => style.border_top_color(),
            BorderEdge::Right => style.border_right_color(),
            BorderEdge::Bottom => style.border_bottom_color(),
            BorderEdge::Left => style.border_left_color(),
        });
        match shapes[..] {
            // A single shape defaults to the half-border-box, so that the stroke matches the default border.
            [(shape, geometry_box)] => {
                let reference = reference_box(layout_arena, slot, style, geometry_box, keyword::HALF_BORDER_BOX);
                let (path, fill_rule) = basic_shape_device_path(shape, reference, pixel_ratio);
                let half_width = relevant_side_width(style, edge).scaled(0.5);
                let inset_reference = |by: CssPixels| {
                    CssPixelRect::new(
                        reference.x + by,
                        reference.y + by,
                        reference.width - by - by,
                        reference.height - by - by,
                    )
                };
                // FIXME: Moving the reference box by half the stroke width only offsets coordinates given as
                //        percentages. Shapes with absolute lengths need the edges of the stroke's outline instead.
                let (inner_edge, _) = basic_shape_device_path(shape, inset_reference(half_width), pixel_ratio);
                let (outer_edge, _) = basic_shape_device_path(shape, inset_reference(-half_width), pixel_ratio);
                Some(Self::Stroke {
                    path,
                    fill_rule,
                    inner_edge,
                    outer_edge,
                    width: side.width as f32,
                    color,
                })
            }
            // The outer shape defaults to the border box, and the inner one to the padding box.
            [(outer, outer_box), (inner, inner_box)] => {
                let outer_reference = reference_box(layout_arena, slot, style, outer_box, keyword::BORDER_BOX);
                let inner_reference = reference_box(layout_arena, slot, style, inner_box, keyword::PADDING_BOX);
                let (outer, _) = basic_shape_device_path(outer, outer_reference, pixel_ratio);
                let (inner, inner_fill_rule) = basic_shape_device_path(inner, inner_reference, pixel_ratio);
                Some(Self::Fill {
                    outer,
                    inner,
                    inner_fill_rule,
                    color: Some(fill_color),
                })
            }
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    /// The border shape of a box being painted, with the device pixel converter's scale.
    pub(crate) fn for_paintable(
        layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
        slot: NodeSlotId,
        converter: &DevicePixelConverter,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        let style = layout_arena.node_style_if_live(slot)?;
        if !has_border_shape(style) {
            return None;
        }
        let border = paintable_geometry::committed_border(layout_arena, slot);
        let borders_data = crate::painting::record::paint::border::style_borders_data(
            style,
            border,
            crate::painting::record::paint::border::ALL_PIECE_EDGES,
            converter,
        );
        Self::of(
            layout_arena,
            slot,
            &borders_data,
            converter.device_pixels_per_css_pixel(),
        )
    }
}

use crate::css::css_enums;
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelFraction, CssPixelPoint, CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::layout::node_facts::{self, NodeShape};
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX;
use crate::painting::ffi::{FfiChromeMetrics, ScrollDirection};
use crate::painting::host::{FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks, RootBackgroundSource};
use crate::painting::paint_read::{PaintRead, PaintRow};
use crate::painting::paintable_data::PaintableFlag;
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;
use crate::painting::record::RecordingInputs;
use crate::painting::style_queries;
use libgfx_rust::Color;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct ScrollbarData {
    pub(crate) gutter_rect: CssPixelRect,
    pub(crate) thumb_rect: CssPixelRect,
    pub(crate) track_rect: CssPixelRect,
    pub(crate) thumb_travel_to_scroll_ratio: CssPixelFraction,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct PhysicalAxes {
    pub(crate) horizontal: bool,
    pub(crate) vertical: bool,
}

impl PhysicalAxes {
    fn along(self, direction: ScrollDirection) -> bool {
        match direction {
            ScrollDirection::Horizontal => self.horizontal,
            ScrollDirection::Vertical => self.vertical,
        }
    }
}

fn primary_size(rect: CssPixelRect, direction: ScrollDirection) -> CssPixels {
    match direction {
        ScrollDirection::Horizontal => rect.width,
        ScrollDirection::Vertical => rect.height,
    }
}

fn primary_offset(point: CssPixelPoint, direction: ScrollDirection) -> CssPixels {
    match direction {
        ScrollDirection::Horizontal => point.x,
        ScrollDirection::Vertical => point.y,
    }
}

struct AxisView<'r> {
    primary_offset: &'r mut CssPixels,
    primary_size: &'r mut CssPixels,
    secondary_offset: &'r mut CssPixels,
    secondary_size: &'r mut CssPixels,
}

fn axis_view(rect: &mut CssPixelRect, direction: ScrollDirection) -> AxisView<'_> {
    match direction {
        ScrollDirection::Horizontal => AxisView {
            primary_offset: &mut rect.x,
            primary_size: &mut rect.width,
            secondary_offset: &mut rect.y,
            secondary_size: &mut rect.height,
        },
        ScrollDirection::Vertical => AxisView {
            primary_offset: &mut rect.y,
            primary_size: &mut rect.height,
            secondary_offset: &mut rect.x,
            secondary_size: &mut rect.width,
        },
    }
}

pub(crate) fn is_chrome_mirrored(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    arena.node_style_if_live(slot).is_some_and(|style| {
        let writing_mode = style.writing_mode();
        (writing_mode == css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB && style.direction() == css_enums::direction::RTL)
            || writing_mode == css_enums::writing_mode::VERTICAL_RL
            || writing_mode == css_enums::writing_mode::SIDEWAYS_RL
    })
}

pub(crate) fn physical_resize_axes(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> PhysicalAxes {
    let Some(style) = arena.node_style_if_live(slot) else {
        return PhysicalAxes::default();
    };
    let box_values = style.box_values();
    if box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::NONE {
        return PhysicalAxes::default();
    }
    if style.display().is_inline_outside() && style.display().is_flow_inside() {
        return PhysicalAxes::default();
    }

    let horizontal_writing_mode = style.writing_mode() == css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB;
    let overflow_allows_resize =
        |overflow| overflow != css_enums::overflow::VISIBLE && overflow != css_enums::overflow::CLIP;
    PhysicalAxes {
        horizontal: overflow_allows_resize(style.overflow_x())
            && (box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::BOTH
                || box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::HORIZONTAL
                || (box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::INLINE && horizontal_writing_mode)
                || (box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::BLOCK && !horizontal_writing_mode)),
        vertical: overflow_allows_resize(style.overflow_y())
            && (box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::BOTH
                || box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::VERTICAL
                || (box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::INLINE && !horizontal_writing_mode)
                || (box_values.resize == css_enums::resize::BLOCK && horizontal_writing_mode)),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn has_resizer(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot)
        || arena.node_kind_if_live(slot) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport)
        || arena.node_is_generated_for_pseudo_element(slot)
    {
        return false;
    }
    let axes = physical_resize_axes(arena, slot);
    axes.horizontal || axes.vertical
}

/// What a box does with a scroll that reaches the boundary of its scroll range, along each physical axis.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct ScrollBoundaryBehavior {
    /// The scroll is passed on to the scrollers around the box.
    pub(crate) chains_to_ancestors: PhysicalAxes,
    pub(crate) shows_overscroll_effect: PhysicalAxes,
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overscroll-1/#overscroll-behavior-properties
// NB: The viewport's own overscroll behavior is the one the layout pass propagated to it from the root element.
pub(crate) fn scroll_boundary_behavior(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> ScrollBoundaryBehavior {
    let unrestricted = ScrollBoundaryBehavior {
        chains_to_ancestors: PhysicalAxes {
            horizontal: true,
            vertical: true,
        },
        shows_overscroll_effect: PhysicalAxes {
            horizontal: true,
            vertical: true,
        },
    };
    // An element that is not scroll container must accept but ignore the values of this property.
    let Some(row) = arena.node(slot) else {
        return unrestricted;
    };
    if !node_facts::kind_is_box(row.kind())
        || !node_facts::kind_and_style_make_scroll_container(row.kind(), row.style())
    {
        return unrestricted;
    }
    let Some(style) = row.style() else {
        return unrestricted;
    };

    use css_enums::overscroll_behavior::{AUTO, CHAIN, CONTAIN};
    let misc_interaction = style.misc_interaction();
    // contain: The element must not perform non-local boundary default actions such as scroll chaining. This value
    //          must not modify the behavior of how local boundary default actions should behave, such as showing any
    //          overscroll affordances.
    // none: This value implies the same behavior as contain and in addition this element must also not perform local
    //       boundary default actions such as showing any overscroll affordances.
    // chain: The element may perform non-local boundary default actions such as scroll chaining. However, the element
    //        must not perform local boundary default actions, such as showing any overscroll affordances.
    let chains = |value: u8| value == AUTO || value == CHAIN;
    let shows_overscroll_effect = |value: u8| value == AUTO || value == CONTAIN;
    ScrollBoundaryBehavior {
        chains_to_ancestors: PhysicalAxes {
            horizontal: chains(misc_interaction.overscroll_behavior_x),
            vertical: chains(misc_interaction.overscroll_behavior_y),
        },
        shows_overscroll_effect: PhysicalAxes {
            horizontal: shows_overscroll_effect(misc_interaction.overscroll_behavior_x),
            vertical: shows_overscroll_effect(misc_interaction.overscroll_behavior_y),
        },
    }
}

// A scroll container that keeps the scrolls along some axis to itself gets a scroll node even when it has nothing to
// scroll, so that the compositor stops passing a scroll on at it.
pub(crate) fn keeps_scrolls_along_some_axis(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    let chains_to_ancestors = scroll_boundary_behavior(arena, slot).chains_to_ancestors;
    !chains_to_ancestors.horizontal || !chains_to_ancestors.vertical
}

// NB: The viewport's own overflow is the one the layout pass propagated to it, as applied to the viewport.
pub(crate) fn wheel_scrollable_axes(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> PhysicalAxes {
    let Some(style) = arena.node_style_if_live(slot) else {
        return PhysicalAxes::default();
    };
    let allows_wheel_scrolling =
        |overflow| overflow == css_enums::overflow::AUTO || overflow == css_enums::overflow::SCROLL;
    let mut axes = PhysicalAxes {
        horizontal: allows_wheel_scrolling(style.overflow_x()),
        vertical: allows_wheel_scrolling(style.overflow_y()),
    };
    if !axes.horizontal && !axes.vertical {
        return axes;
    }

    let Some(scrollable_overflow) = paintable_geometry::scrollable_overflow_rect(arena, slot) else {
        return PhysicalAxes::default();
    };
    let scrollport = paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(arena, slot);
    axes.horizontal &= scrollable_overflow.width > scrollport.width;
    axes.vertical &= scrollable_overflow.height > scrollport.height;
    axes
}

pub(crate) fn scroll_offset_bounds(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> Option<(CssPixelPoint, CssPixelPoint)> {
    let overflow = paintable_geometry::scrollable_overflow_rect(arena, slot)?;
    let scrollport = paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(arena, slot);
    let zero = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
    let minimum = CssPixelPoint::new(
        (overflow.left() - scrollport.left()).min(zero),
        (overflow.top() - scrollport.top()).min(zero),
    );
    let maximum = CssPixelPoint::new(
        (overflow.right() - scrollport.right()).max(zero),
        (overflow.bottom() - scrollport.bottom()).max(zero),
    );
    Some((minimum, maximum))
}

pub(crate) fn minimum_scroll_offset(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelPoint {
    scroll_offset_bounds(arena, slot).map_or(CssPixelPoint::default(), |(minimum, _)| minimum)
}

pub(crate) fn maximum_scroll_offset(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelPoint {
    scroll_offset_bounds(arena, slot).map_or(CssPixelPoint::default(), |(_, maximum)| maximum)
}

pub(crate) fn scrollbar_is_hidden(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId, direction: ScrollDirection) -> bool {
    let flag = match direction {
        ScrollDirection::Horizontal => PaintableFlag::HorizontalScrollbarHidden,
        ScrollDirection::Vertical => PaintableFlag::VerticalScrollbarHidden,
    };
    arena.paintable_data(slot).has_flag(flag)
}

pub(crate) struct ChromeGeometry<'a, Arena: PaintRead> {
    pub(crate) arena: &'a Arena,
    pub(crate) metrics: FfiChromeMetrics,
}

impl<'a, Arena: PaintRead> ChromeGeometry<'a, Arena> {
    pub(crate) fn for_recording(arena: &'a Arena, inputs: &RecordingInputs) -> Self {
        Self {
            arena,
            metrics: inputs.uncaptured.chrome_metrics,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn for_hit_test_query(arena: &'a Arena, callbacks: &FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks) -> Self {
        Self {
            arena,
            metrics: callbacks.chrome_metrics,
        }
    }

    fn wheel_scrollable_axes(&self, slot: NodeSlotId) -> PhysicalAxes {
        wheel_scrollable_axes(self.arena, slot)
    }

    pub(crate) fn absolute_resizer_rect(&self, slot: NodeSlotId) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
        if !has_resizer(self.arena, slot) {
            return None;
        }
        let padding_rect = paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(self.arena, slot);
        let gripper_size = self.metrics.resize_gripper_size;
        let x = if is_chrome_mirrored(self.arena, slot) {
            padding_rect.x
        } else {
            padding_rect.right() - gripper_size
        };
        Some(CssPixelRect::new(
            x,
            padding_rect.bottom() - gripper_size,
            gripper_size,
            gripper_size,
        ))
    }

    pub(crate) fn resizer_contains(&self, slot: NodeSlotId, point: CssPixelPoint) -> bool {
        if !self.arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(mut rect) = self.absolute_resizer_rect(slot) else {
            return false;
        };
        let border = paintable_geometry::committed_border(self.arena, slot);
        if is_chrome_mirrored(self.arena, slot) {
            rect.x -= border.left;
            rect.width += border.left;
        } else {
            rect.width += border.right;
        }
        rect.height += border.bottom;
        rect.contains_point(point)
    }

    fn available_scrollbar_length(&self, slot: NodeSlotId, direction: ScrollDirection) -> CssPixels {
        if !self.arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return CssPixels::from_raw(0);
        }
        let mut length = primary_size(
            paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(self.arena, slot),
            direction,
        );
        let axes = self.wheel_scrollable_axes(slot);
        let other_axis_scrolls = match direction {
            ScrollDirection::Horizontal => axes.vertical,
            ScrollDirection::Vertical => axes.horizontal,
        };
        if has_resizer(self.arena, slot) {
            length -= self.metrics.resize_gripper_size;
        } else if other_axis_scrolls {
            length -= self.metrics.scroll_gutter_thickness;
        }
        length
    }

    pub(crate) fn absolute_scrollbar_rect(
        &self,
        slot: NodeSlotId,
        direction: ScrollDirection,
        with_gutter: bool,
    ) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
        if !self.arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return None;
        }
        let axes = self.wheel_scrollable_axes(slot);
        if !axes.along(direction) {
            return None;
        }
        let style = self.arena.node_style_if_live(slot)?;
        if style.misc_interaction().scrollbar_width == css_enums::scrollbar_width::NONE {
            return None;
        }

        let metrics = self.metrics;
        let adjusting_for_resizer = has_resizer(self.arena, slot);
        let mirrored = is_chrome_mirrored(self.arena, slot);
        let rect_thickness = if with_gutter {
            metrics.scroll_gutter_thickness
        } else {
            metrics.scroll_thumb_thickness_thin + metrics.scroll_thumb_padding_thin
        };
        let zero = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
        let mut rect = paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(self.arena, slot);
        match direction {
            ScrollDirection::Horizontal => {
                if !adjusting_for_resizer && axes.vertical {
                    rect.width = (rect.width - metrics.scroll_gutter_thickness).max(zero);
                    if mirrored {
                        rect.x += metrics.scroll_gutter_thickness;
                    }
                } else if adjusting_for_resizer {
                    rect.width = self.available_scrollbar_length(slot, direction);
                    if mirrored {
                        rect.x += metrics.resize_gripper_size;
                    }
                }
                rect.y = (rect.bottom() - rect_thickness).max(rect.y);
                rect.height = rect_thickness;
            }
            ScrollDirection::Vertical => {
                if adjusting_for_resizer {
                    rect.height = self.available_scrollbar_length(slot, direction);
                }
                if !mirrored {
                    rect.x = (rect.right() - rect_thickness).max(rect.x);
                }
                rect.width = rect_thickness;
            }
        }
        Some(rect)
    }

    pub(crate) fn compute_scrollbar_data(
        &self,
        slot: NodeSlotId,
        direction: ScrollDirection,
        enlarged: bool,
    ) -> Option<ScrollbarData> {
        let arena = self.arena;
        let metrics = self.metrics;
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return None;
        }
        let style = arena.node_style_if_live(slot)?;
        let overflow = match direction {
            ScrollDirection::Horizontal => style.overflow_x(),
            ScrollDirection::Vertical => style.overflow_y(),
        };
        if overflow != css_enums::overflow::SCROLL && !self.wheel_scrollable_axes(slot).along(direction) {
            return None;
        }
        if arena.paintable_data(slot).own_scroll_node_index == VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX {
            return None;
        }
        // NB: A box that keeps its scrolls has a scroll node even when it has nothing to scroll.
        if arena.node_kind_if_live(slot) != Some(NodeKind::Viewport)
            && !paintable_geometry::has_scrollable_overflow(arena, slot)
        {
            return None;
        }
        let overflow_length = primary_size(paintable_geometry::scrollable_overflow_rect(arena, slot)?, direction);
        if overflow_length == CssPixels::from_raw(0) {
            return None;
        }
        let scrollbar_rect = self.absolute_scrollbar_rect(slot, direction, enlarged)?;
        let (thumb_thickness, thumb_margin) = if enlarged {
            (
                metrics.scroll_thumb_thickness,
                (metrics.scroll_gutter_thickness - metrics.scroll_thumb_thickness) / 2,
            )
        } else {
            (metrics.scroll_thumb_thickness_thin, metrics.scroll_thumb_padding_thin)
        };
        let usable_length = (primary_size(scrollbar_rect, direction) - thumb_margin * 2).max(CssPixels::from_raw(0));
        let scrollport_size = primary_size(paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(arena, slot), direction);
        let min_thumb_length = usable_length.min(metrics.scroll_thumb_min_length);
        let thumb_length = usable_length
            .mul_by_fraction(CssPixelFraction::ratio_of(scrollport_size, overflow_length))
            .max(min_thumb_length);
        let ratio = if overflow_length > scrollport_size {
            CssPixelFraction::ratio_of(usable_length - thumb_length, overflow_length - scrollport_size)
        } else {
            CssPixelFraction::zero()
        };
        let mut thumb_rect = scrollbar_rect;
        let thumb = axis_view(&mut thumb_rect, direction);
        *thumb.primary_size = thumb_length;
        *thumb.secondary_size = thumb_thickness;
        let minimum_offset = primary_offset(minimum_scroll_offset(arena, slot), direction);
        *thumb.primary_offset += thumb_margin - minimum_offset.mul_by_fraction(ratio);
        if enlarged || (direction == ScrollDirection::Vertical && is_chrome_mirrored(arena, slot)) {
            *thumb.secondary_offset += thumb_margin;
        }
        Some(ScrollbarData {
            gutter_rect: if enlarged {
                scrollbar_rect
            } else {
                CssPixelRect::default()
            },
            thumb_rect,
            track_rect: scrollbar_rect,
            thumb_travel_to_scroll_ratio: ratio,
        })
    }
}

fn is_canvas_background_source(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    root_background_source: RootBackgroundSource,
) -> bool {
    style_queries::node_is_root_element(arena, slot)
        || (root_background_source.use_body_background_properties && root_background_source.body_layout_node == slot)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct ScrollbarColors {
    pub thumb: Color,
    // The thumb is stroked with this, so that it stays visible over whatever the scrollbar is drawn on.
    pub thumb_outline: Color,
    pub track: Color,
}

/// The color behind what `slot` paints, as far as background colors tell: the canvas's, with the backgrounds of `slot`
/// and its ancestors composited over it. Background images, and content of other boxes painted underneath, don't count.
fn estimated_backdrop_color(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    root_background_source: RootBackgroundSource,
    canvas_background_color: Color,
) -> Color {
    let mut ancestors = Vec::new();
    let mut current = Some(slot);
    while let Some(ancestor) = current {
        ancestors.push(ancestor);
        current = arena.node_parent_if_live(ancestor);
    }
    let mut background_color = canvas_background_color;
    for ancestor in ancestors.into_iter().rev() {
        if is_canvas_background_source(arena, ancestor, root_background_source) {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(style) = arena.node_style_if_live(ancestor) else {
            continue;
        };
        let color = Color(style.background_color());
        if color.alpha() != 0 {
            background_color = background_color.blend(color);
        }
    }
    background_color
}

pub(crate) fn scrollbar_colors_for_paint(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    root_background_source: RootBackgroundSource,
    canvas_background_color: Color,
) -> ScrollbarColors {
    let Some(style) = arena.node_style_if_live(slot) else {
        return ScrollbarColors {
            thumb: Color::TRANSPARENT,
            thumb_outline: Color::TRANSPARENT,
            track: Color::TRANSPARENT,
        };
    };
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scrollbars/#scrollbar-color
    // UAs must apply the scrollbar-color value set on the root element to the viewport.
    let color_style = if arena.node_kind_if_live(slot) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport) {
        style_queries::document_element_box_under(arena, slot)
            .and_then(|root| arena.node_style_if_live(root))
            .unwrap_or(style)
    } else {
        style
    };
    let colors = color_style.inherited_ui().scrollbar_color;
    if !colors.is_auto {
        let thumb = Color(colors.thumb_color);
        return ScrollbarColors {
            thumb,
            thumb_outline: thumb.lightened(1.2),
            track: Color(colors.track_color),
        };
    }

    let background_color = estimated_backdrop_color(arena, slot, root_background_source, canvas_background_color);
    let black_thumb = Color::from_rgb(0, 0, 0).with_alpha(128);
    let white_thumb = Color::from_rgb(255, 255, 255).with_alpha(128);
    let black_contrast = background_color.contrast_ratio(background_color.blend(black_thumb));
    let white_contrast = background_color.contrast_ratio(background_color.blend(white_thumb));
    let (thumb, thumb_outline) = if black_contrast >= white_contrast {
        (black_thumb, white_thumb)
    } else {
        (white_thumb, black_thumb)
    };
    // The background guessed above is what's behind the scroll container, which isn't always what's under the
    // scrollbar: Content of the opposite lightness can cover it. An outline in the opposite color to the thumb's keeps
    // the thumb visible over that content too.
    ScrollbarColors {
        thumb,
        thumb_outline: thumb_outline.with_alpha(64),
        track: thumb.with_alpha(25),
    }
}

use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::layout::inline_content::InlineBoxPieceRecord;
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeFlag, NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::layout::node_facts::{self, NodeShape};
use crate::painting::node_painting;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{PaintRead, PaintRow};
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;
use crate::painting::paintable_rows::with_inline_pieces;
use crate::painting::style_queries;
use crate::painting::viewport_mapping::{ViewportMapping, ViewportSpace};

pub(crate) fn can_compute_client_rects_without_visual_context_update(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    layout_node: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_scroll_offset_is_zero: bool,
) -> bool {
    let mut node = layout_node;
    while let Some(row) = arena.node(node) {
        let (kind, flags, parent) = (row.kind(), row.flags(), row.parent());
        if node_facts::kind_is_svg_box(kind) || kind == NodeKind::SVGSVGBox || kind == NodeKind::SVGForeignObjectBox {
            return false;
        }

        if flags & NodeFlag::HasStyle as u32 == 0 {
            node = parent;
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(style) = row.style()
            && (style_queries::has_css_transform(arena, node, style)
                || style.transform().has_perspective
                || style_queries::is_sticky_position(style))
        {
            return false;
        }
        let compensates_for_scroll =
            NodeFlag::CompensatesForHorizontalScroll as u32 | NodeFlag::CompensatesForVerticalScroll as u32;
        if flags & compensates_for_scroll != 0 {
            return false;
        }
        // A scroll container's contents move, but its own border box does not.
        if node != layout_node {
            let scroll_offset_is_zero = if kind == NodeKind::Viewport {
                viewport_scroll_offset_is_zero
            } else {
                flags & NodeFlag::HasScrollOffset as u32 == 0
            };
            if !scroll_offset_is_zero && arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        node = parent;
    }
    true
}

/// The border boxes of the fragments of an inline box, in content order: its pieces on the lines, and the in-flow
/// block-level boxes inside it, which break it around themselves.
fn for_each_inline_fragment_border_box_rect(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    inline_paintable: NodeSlotId,
    mut push_rect: impl FnMut(CssPixelRect),
) {
    let Some(root) = arena.inline_pieces_root(inline_paintable) else {
        return;
    };
    let root_positions = paintable_geometry::LineRootPositions::new(arena, root);
    let root_side = arena.committed_side_data(root);
    let rects_after_clamp = root_side
        .inline_content
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|content| content.inline_box_rects_after_clamp.as_deref());
    // NB: An inline box whose content is all past the clamp point has a placeholder piece that isn't on any line.
    let is_on_lines_after_clamp =
        rects_after_clamp.is_some_and(|rects| rects.iter().any(|rect| rect.node == inline_paintable));
    let mut pushed_a_rect = false;
    let mut empty_piece_after_last_block = None;
    with_inline_pieces(arena, inline_paintable, |piece| {
        if piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder {
            // A placeholder piece on a line that a block-level box takes up stands for that box, if the box is inside
            // the inline box. (Empty inline boxes get placeholder pieces too.)
            if let Some(block) = interrupting_block(arena, root, inline_paintable, piece) {
                // https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#anonymous-block-level
                // When an inline box contains an in-flow block-level box, the inline box (and its inline ancestors
                // within the same line box) is broken around the block-level box (and any block-level siblings
                // that are consecutive or separated only by collapsible whitespace and/or out-of-flow elements),
                // splitting the inline box into two boxes (even if either side is empty), one on each side
                // of the block-level box(es).
                // NB: So the empty part of the inline box before the first block gets a rect when nothing of
                //     it precedes that block, and the empty part after the last block gets one when nothing
                //     of it follows that block.
                if !pushed_a_rect {
                    push_rect(empty_piece_rect(&block, false));
                }
                push_rect(block.border_box_rect);
                pushed_a_rect = true;
                empty_piece_after_last_block = Some(empty_piece_rect(&block, true));
                return true;
            }
            if piece.fragment_count != 0 || is_on_lines_after_clamp {
                return true;
            }
        }
        let root_position = root_positions.of_line(root_side.lines(), piece.line_index as usize);
        let mut rect = CssPixelRect::from(piece.border_box_rect).translated_by(root_position);
        if piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder {
            // NB: The placeholder piece of an empty part of the inline box holds the content box of that part.
            let padding = paintable_geometry::committed_padding(arena, inline_paintable);
            let border = paintable_geometry::committed_border(arena, inline_paintable);
            rect = rect
                .inflated(padding.top, padding.right, padding.bottom, padding.left)
                .inflated(border.top, border.right, border.bottom, border.left);
        }
        push_rect(rect);
        pushed_a_rect = true;
        empty_piece_after_last_block = None;
        true
    });
    if let Some(rect) = empty_piece_after_last_block {
        push_rect(rect);
    }
    if let Some(rects) = rects_after_clamp {
        for rect in rects.iter().filter(|rect| rect.node == inline_paintable) {
            push_rect(CssPixelRect::from(rect.rect).translated_by(root_positions.of_fragment(rect.box_fragment)));
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn border_box_rect_of_fragments(arena: &impl PaintRead, node: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelRect {
    let has_clamped_lines = arena.inline_pieces_root(node).is_some_and(|root| {
        arena
            .committed_side_data(root)
            .inline_content
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|content| content.inline_box_rects_after_clamp.as_deref())
            .is_some_and(|rects| rects.iter().any(|rect| rect.node == node))
    });
    if !has_clamped_lines {
        return paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(arena, node);
    }
    let mut bounds: Option<CssPixelRect> = None;
    for_each_inline_fragment_border_box_rect(arena, node, |rect| match &mut bounds {
        Some(bounds) => bounds.unite(rect),
        None => bounds = Some(rect),
    });
    bounds.unwrap_or_default()
}

struct InterruptingBlock {
    border_box_rect: CssPixelRect,
    /// The margin box the block would have without its relative offset.
    normal_flow_margin_box_rect: CssPixelRect,
    /// The content box of the block's line root, on the block's line.
    line_root_content_rect: CssPixelRect,
    writing_mode: u8,
    direction: u8,
}

/// The block-level box that takes up the line that the placeholder `piece` of `inline_paintable` is on, if that box is
/// inside `inline_paintable`.
fn interrupting_block(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    line_root: NodeSlotId,
    inline_paintable: NodeSlotId,
    piece: &InlineBoxPieceRecord,
) -> Option<InterruptingBlock> {
    let root_side = arena.committed_side_data(line_root);
    let line = root_side.lines().get(piece.line_index as usize)?;
    if !line.has_block_level_box {
        return None;
    }
    // NOTE: A line taken up by a block-level box holds that box's fragment and nothing else.
    let first = piece.first_fragment_index as usize;
    let fragment = root_side
        .fragments()
        .get(first..first + piece.fragment_count as usize)?
        .iter()
        .find(|fragment| arena.paintable_row_is_populated(fragment.layout_node))?;
    let mut ancestor = arena.node(fragment.layout_node)?.parent();
    while ancestor != inline_paintable {
        if ancestor == line_root {
            return None;
        }
        ancestor = arena.node(ancestor)?.parent();
    }
    let border_box_rect = paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(arena, fragment.layout_node);
    // NOTE: For an in-flow box, the insets are its relative offset, and zero unless it's relatively positioned.
    let relative_offset = paintable_geometry::committed_inset(arena, fragment.layout_node);
    let margin = paintable_geometry::committed_margin(arena, fragment.layout_node);
    let line_root_content_size = paintable_geometry::committed_content_size(arena, line_root);
    Some(InterruptingBlock {
        border_box_rect,
        normal_flow_margin_box_rect: CssPixelRect {
            x: border_box_rect.x - relative_offset.left - margin.left,
            y: border_box_rect.y - relative_offset.top - margin.top,
            width: border_box_rect.width + margin.left + margin.right,
            height: border_box_rect.height + margin.top + margin.bottom,
        },
        line_root_content_rect: CssPixelRect::from_location_and_size(
            paintable_geometry::absolute_line_root_position(arena, line_root, piece.line_index as usize),
            line_root_content_size.into(),
        ),
        writing_mode: line.writing_mode,
        direction: line.direction,
    })
}

/// The zero-size rect of an empty part of an inline box that a block-level box breaks. The parts are on the anonymous
/// lines around the block, so they're at the line's start (the inline-start edge of the block's margin box), and at the
/// block-start edge of the block's margin box for the part before the block (but not before the start of the line
/// root's content, which a margin that collapses through the line root can reach past), or its block-end edge for the
/// part after it. The parts are in normal flow, so a relative offset of the block doesn't move them.
fn empty_piece_rect(block: &InterruptingBlock, after_the_block: bool) -> CssPixelRect {
    use crate::css::css_enums::{direction, writing_mode};
    let inline_axis_is_reverse = match block.writing_mode {
        writing_mode::SIDEWAYS_LR => block.direction == direction::LTR,
        _ => block.direction == direction::RTL,
    };
    let block_axis_is_reverse = matches!(
        block.writing_mode,
        writing_mode::VERTICAL_RL | writing_mode::SIDEWAYS_RL
    );
    let at_block_axis_high_side = after_the_block != block_axis_is_reverse;
    let rect = block.normal_flow_margin_box_rect;
    let content = block.line_root_content_rect;
    // The block-axis position of the part on the block-axis low or high side, as above.
    let block_axis_position = |low: CssPixels, size: CssPixels, content_low: CssPixels, content_size: CssPixels| match (
        at_block_axis_high_side,
        after_the_block,
    ) {
        (true, true) => low + size,
        (false, true) => low,
        (true, false) => (low + size).min(content_low + content_size),
        (false, false) => low.max(content_low),
    };
    let (x, y) = if block.writing_mode == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB {
        (
            if inline_axis_is_reverse {
                rect.x + rect.width
            } else {
                rect.x
            },
            block_axis_position(rect.y, rect.height, content.y, content.height),
        )
    } else {
        (
            block_axis_position(rect.x, rect.width, content.x, content.width),
            if inline_axis_is_reverse {
                rect.y + rect.height
            } else {
                rect.y
            },
        )
    };
    let zero = CssPixels::from_integer(0);
    CssPixelRect {
        x,
        y,
        width: zero,
        height: zero,
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-element-getclientrects
pub(crate) fn for_each_client_rect(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    layout_node: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_mapping: &ViewportMapping<'_>,
    mut push_rect: impl FnMut(CssPixelRect),
) {
    let mut push_rect_in_viewport_space = |rect: CssPixelRect| {
        push_rect(viewport_mapping.rect_to_viewport(arena, layout_node, rect, ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport));
    };
    // INTEROP: A line break has no box fragments of its own, but browsers report a zero-width rect where it ends its
    //          line.
    if arena.node_kind_if_live(layout_node) == Some(NodeKind::BreakNode) {
        if let Some((line_root, rect)) = line_break_rect(arena, layout_node) {
            push_rect(viewport_mapping.line_content_rect_to_viewport(
                arena,
                line_root,
                layout_node,
                rect,
                ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport,
            ));
        }
        return;
    }

    let row_is_populated = arena.paintable_row_is_populated(layout_node);

    // FIXME: 2. If the element has an associated SVG layout box return a DOMRectList object containing a single
    //          DOMRect object that describes the bounding box of the element as defined by the SVG specification,
    //          applying the transforms that apply to the element and its ancestors.

    // 3. Return a DOMRectList object containing DOMRect objects in content order, one for each box fragment,
    // describing its border area (including those with a height or width of zero) with the following constraints:
    // - Apply the transforms that apply to the element and its ancestors.
    // FIXME: - If the element on which the method was invoked has a computed value for the display property of table
    //          or inline-table include both the table box and the caption box, if any, but not the anonymous container box.
    // - Replace each anonymous block box with its child box(es) and repeat this until no anonymous block boxes are left
    //   in the final list.
    // NB: The anonymous block boxes that wrap a block-level box inside an inline box are replaced by that block-level
    //     box, which is one of the fragments of the inline box it breaks.
    if row_is_populated && node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, layout_node) {
        let mut pushed_a_piece_rect = false;
        for_each_inline_fragment_border_box_rect(arena, layout_node, |piece_border_box_rect| {
            pushed_a_piece_rect = true;
            push_rect_in_viewport_space(piece_border_box_rect);
        });
        // An inline element whose content is only interrupting blocks generates no line fragments, but per CSSOM
        // we still report its (zero-sized) border area instead of an empty list.
        if !pushed_a_piece_rect {
            push_rect_in_viewport_space(paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(arena, layout_node));
        }
        return;
    }

    if row_is_populated {
        for index in 0..paintable_geometry::fragment_count(arena, layout_node) {
            push_rect_in_viewport_space(paintable_geometry::absolute_fragment_border_box_rect(
                arena,
                layout_node,
                index,
            ));
        }
    }
}

/// The line root whose line the forced line break ends, and the zero-width rect of the break at the inline end of
/// that line's content, or at the inline start of the line where it is empty.
fn line_break_rect(arena: &impl PaintRead, break_node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<(NodeSlotId, CssPixelRect)> {
    let mut ancestor = arena.node(break_node)?.parent();
    while let Some(row) = arena.node(ancestor) {
        if arena.paintable_row_is_populated(ancestor) {
            let side = arena.committed_side_data(ancestor);
            if let Some(line) = side
                .lines()
                .iter()
                .find(|line| line.forced_break.is_some_and(|position| position.node == break_node))
            {
                let style = arena.node_style_if_live(ancestor)?;
                let root_position =
                    paintable_geometry::LineRootPositions::new(arena, ancestor).of_fragment(line.box_fragment);
                let line_rect = CssPixelRect::from(line.rect).translated_by(root_position);
                let inline_axis_is_horizontal =
                    style.writing_mode() == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB;
                let at_high_side = (line.fragment_count == 0) == style.inline_axis_is_reverse();
                let zero = CssPixels::default();
                let rect = match (inline_axis_is_horizontal, at_high_side) {
                    (true, false) => CssPixelRect {
                        width: zero,
                        ..line_rect
                    },
                    (true, true) => CssPixelRect {
                        x: line_rect.x + line_rect.width,
                        width: zero,
                        ..line_rect
                    },
                    (false, false) => CssPixelRect {
                        height: zero,
                        ..line_rect
                    },
                    (false, true) => CssPixelRect {
                        y: line_rect.y + line_rect.height,
                        height: zero,
                        ..line_rect
                    },
                };
                return Some((ancestor, rect));
            }
        }
        ancestor = row.parent();
    }
    None
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-element-getboundingclientrect
pub(crate) fn bounding_client_rect(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    layout_node: NodeSlotId,
    viewport_mapping: &ViewportMapping<'_>,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    // 1. Let list be the result of invoking getClientRects() on element.
    let zero = CssPixels::from_integer(0);
    let mut first_rect = None;
    let mut union_of_rects_with_nonzero_width_and_height: Option<CssPixelRect> = None;
    for_each_client_rect(arena, layout_node, viewport_mapping, |rect| {
        first_rect.get_or_insert(rect);
        if rect.width == zero || rect.height == zero {
            return;
        }
        match &mut union_of_rects_with_nonzero_width_and_height {
            None => union_of_rects_with_nonzero_width_and_height = Some(rect),
            Some(union) => union.unite(rect),
        }
    });

    // 2. If the list is empty return a DOMRect object whose x, y, width and height members are zero.
    let Some(first_rect) = first_rect else {
        return CssPixelRect::default();
    };

    // 3. If all rectangles in list have zero width or height, return the first rectangle in list.

    // 4. Otherwise, return a DOMRect object describing the smallest rectangle that includes all of the rectangles in
    //    list of which the height or width is not zero.
    union_of_rects_with_nonzero_width_and_height.unwrap_or(first_rect)
}

use crate::css::css_enums::content_visibility;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::layout::node_facts;
use crate::painting::paintable_rows::PaintableRowsRead;

pub(crate) fn for_each_box_with_auto_content_visibility(
    arena: &impl PaintableRowsRead,
    root: NodeSlotId,
    mut push_box: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId),
) {
    if !arena.slot_is_live(root) {
        return;
    }
    arena.for_each_node_in_layout_subtree_in_pre_order_with_pruning(root, |node| {
        if node_facts::kind_is_svg_resource_box(arena.data(node).kind.get()) {
            return false;
        }
        if !arena.node_is_element_backed(node) || !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
            return true;
        }
        let content_visibility_is_auto = arena
            .node_style_if_live(node)
            .is_some_and(|style| style.content_visibility() == content_visibility::AUTO);
        if content_visibility_is_auto {
            push_box(node);
        }
        true
    });
}
