/// Where the stacking context structure below the viewport of `host`'s document differs from what paint preparation
/// recorded, handed to `consume` unless it does not.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, and `consume` must copy the bytes synchronously.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_stacking_context_structure_verification_report(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    context: *mut c_void,
    consume: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const u8, usize),
) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { prepare_paint_properties(host, read) };
    let report = read_arena(host, read, viewport, |arena, viewport| {
        crate::painting::stacking_context::verify::verification_report(arena, viewport)
    });
    if !report.is_empty() {
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        unsafe { consume(context, report.as_ptr(), report.len()) };
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread; the callbacks in `publish` are called
/// synchronously with their context while the recording's resources are live.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_publish_recording(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    publish: crate::painting::host::FfiRecordingPublishCallbacks,
) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the entry point's contract.
    let main_thread = unsafe { main_thread(host) };
    let mut recording = host.recording();
    if let Some(publication) = recording.take_publication() {
        crate::painting::record::publish::publish_recording(host, publication, &main_thread, &publish);
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread; `describe_node` and `append_text` are called
/// synchronously with `context`, and the slots handed to `describe_node` name the last recording's live paintables.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_take_recording_trace(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    context: *mut c_void,
    describe_node: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, NodeSlotId, *mut c_void),
    append_text: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const u8, usize),
) -> bool {
    let Some(pending) = host.recording().take_pending_recording_trace() else {
        return false;
    };
    let recording = read_arena(host, read, (), |arena, ()| arena.paint_state().last_recording.clone());
    let Some(recording) = recording else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(log) = recording.capture_log.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    let mut name = |slot| {
        if slot == pending.viewport {
            return "@viewport".into();
        }
        let mut name = Vec::<u8>::new();
        // SAFETY: the host copies the description synchronously into the sink.
        unsafe { describe_node(context, slot, (&raw mut name).cast()) };
        String::from_utf8(name).expect("trace label must be UTF-8")
    };
    let text = format!(
        "recording (overlay={})\n{}",
        pending.should_paint_overlay,
        log.format(&mut name)
    );
    // SAFETY: the host copies the text synchronously.
    unsafe { append_text(context, text.as_ptr(), text.len()) };
    true
}

/// The recorder state of `host`'s document, for a recording to take, once the last recording was published.
fn take_recorder_for_recording(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    _: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
) -> crate::painting::record::recorder_state::RecorderState {
    let mut recording = host.recording();
    debug_assert!(
        !recording.has_pending_recording() && !recording.has_recording_in_flight(),
        "a recording must be published before the next one starts"
    );
    recording.discard_pending_recording();
    recording.take_recorder()
}

/// What freezing the frame of a document's `viewport` for a recording with `inputs` reads.
fn frame_inputs(
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    inputs: &crate::painting::host::FfiRecordingInputs,
    recorder: &crate::painting::record::recorder_state::RecorderState,
) -> crate::painting::recording_slot::FrameInputs {
    crate::painting::recording_slot::FrameInputs {
        viewport,
        css_viewport_rect: inputs.css_viewport_rect.into(),
        publishes_recording: inputs.publishes_recording,
        published_root_background_canvas_rect: recorder
            .published_recording
            .as_ref()
            .map(|recording| recording.root_background_canvas_rect),
    }
}

/// Records `host`'s document's viewport with `inputs` on the Paint thread, in step with the host, which publishes the
/// recording and presents nothing. Answers whether the viewport had a box to record.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread. Input arrays and byte buffers must be valid and
/// immutable for this call; fonts for enabled overlays must be live `Gfx::Font`s.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_record_display_list(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    inputs: crate::painting::host::FfiRecordingInputs,
) -> FfiRecordingStart {
    let recorder = take_recorder_for_recording(host, read);
    let frame_inputs = frame_inputs(viewport, &inputs, &recorder);
    // SAFETY: The host lends the input arrays and buffers for this call, and the inputs copy what they read of them.
    let inputs = unsafe { inputs.recording_inputs() };
    let Some(frame) = read_arena(
        host,
        read,
        frame_inputs,
        crate::painting::recording_slot::freeze_recording_frame,
    ) else {
        host.recording().give_back_recorder(recorder);
        return FfiRecordingStart::NothingToRecord;
    };
    let inputs = inputs.for_frame(frame.tree_inputs, frame.root_background_source);
    let answer =
        crate::painting::recording_slot::RecordingJob::new(frame, recorder, viewport, None).run_on_paint_thread(inputs);
    host.recording().accept_recording_answer(answer);
    FfiRecordingStart::Recorded
}

/// Commits the frame of `host`'s document as the rendering update leaves it to the render owner, with `recorder`, which
/// samples it beside the event loop at `timestamp`, the time of the document's timeline the update sampled its
/// animations at, and hands it to the Paint thread, which presents it as `seal` sealed it. The frame flies until the
/// host takes it in.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `seal` must name a live presenter, and buffers of the sizes it gives.
unsafe fn commit_frame(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    recorder: crate::painting::record::recorder_state::RecorderState,
    content: crate::render_state::CommittedContent,
    held_for_testing: bool,
    timestamp: f64,
    seal: &crate::painting::presentation::FfiSeal,
) {
    let publishes_recording = match &content {
        crate::render_state::CommittedContent::Recording { frame_inputs, .. } => frame_inputs.publishes_recording,
        crate::render_state::CommittedContent::Unrecorded { .. } => false,
    };
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let presentation = unsafe {
        crate::painting::presentation::Presentation::adopt(
            seal,
            &host.scroll_state(),
            recorder.published_recording.clone(),
            publishes_recording,
        )
    };
    let commit = crate::render_state::CommittedFrame {
        content,
        recorder,
        presentation,
        timestamp,
        held_for_testing,
    };
    let flight = host.commit_rendering_update(read, commit);
    host.recording().fly(flight);
}

/// Commits the frame of `host`'s document as a recording of its viewport with `inputs` (see [`commit_frame`]).
///
/// # Safety
///
/// As for [`render_state_record_display_list`], and `seal` must be as [`commit_frame`] takes it.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_commit_recorded_frame(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    inputs: crate::painting::host::FfiRecordingInputs,
    timestamp: f64,
    seal: &crate::painting::presentation::FfiSeal,
) {
    let recorder = take_recorder_for_recording(host, read);
    let content = crate::render_state::CommittedContent::Recording {
        frame_inputs: frame_inputs(viewport, &inputs, &recorder),
        // SAFETY: The host lends the input arrays and buffers for this call, and the inputs copy what they read of them.
        inputs: unsafe { inputs.recording_inputs() },
    };
    let held_for_testing = crate::painting::recording_slot::take_recording_hold_for_testing();
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { commit_frame(host, read, recorder, content, held_for_testing, timestamp, seal) };
}

/// Commits the frame of `host`'s document as one that keeps the display list the compositor has, and sends the render
/// state's visual context tree where `sends_visual_context_tree` says it changed (see [`commit_frame`]).
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, and `seal` must be as [`commit_frame`] takes it.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_commit_unrecorded_frame(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    sends_visual_context_tree: bool,
    timestamp: f64,
    seal: &crate::painting::presentation::FfiSeal,
) {
    let recorder = take_recorder_for_recording(host, read);
    let content = crate::render_state::CommittedContent::Unrecorded {
        sends_visual_context_tree,
    };
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { commit_frame(host, read, recorder, content, false, timestamp, seal) };
}

/// Renders the SVG images of the committed frame of `host`'s document that waits for them, with the callbacks in
/// `publish`, and hands the frame back to the Paint thread, which presents it with them. The frame flies again until the
/// host takes it in.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, whose committed frame landed as
/// [`FfiRecordingLanding::NeedsVectorImages`]; the callbacks in `publish` are called synchronously with their context.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_render_vector_images(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    publish: crate::painting::host::FfiRecordingPublishCallbacks,
) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the entry point's contract.
    let main_thread = unsafe { main_thread(host) };
    let (frame, recorder) = host
        .recording()
        .take_vector_image_frame()
        .expect("a committed frame waits for its SVG images");
    let display_lists =
        crate::painting::record::publish::render_vector_images(frame.get().requests(), &main_thread, &publish);
    let flight = crate::paint_stage::submit_presenting(frame, move |frame, presenting| {
        frame.into_inner().present(recorder, &display_lists, presenting)
    });
    host.recording().fly(flight);
}

/// Takes the recording in flight of `host`'s document in where it has finished, and answers how it landed. The event
/// loop calls it between two tasks, so it never waits. A recording that landed writes whether presenting its frame sent
/// the compositor other scroll offsets than the frame before to `presented_other_scroll_offsets`.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, and the event loop must call this between two tasks.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_take_finished_recording_in(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    presented_other_scroll_offsets: &mut bool,
) -> FfiRecordingLanding {
    let boundary = crate::render_state::TaskBoundary::at_event_loop_entry(&TAKES_FINISHED_RECORDING_IN);
    let landing = host.recording().take_finished_recording_in(
        &boundary,
        |rows_version| landed_recording_stands(host, rows_version),
        &mut |output, publishes_recording| {
            take_in_presented_recording(host, output, publishes_recording);
        },
    );
    recording_landing(landing, presented_other_scroll_offsets)
}

/// Waits for the recording in flight of `host`'s document and takes it in, and answers how it landed (see
/// [`render_state_take_finished_recording_in`]).
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_state_join_recording_in_flight(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    presented_other_scroll_offsets: &mut bool,
) -> FfiRecordingLanding {
    let landing = host.recording().join_recording_in_flight(
        |rows_version| landed_recording_stands(host, rows_version),
        &mut |output, publishes_recording| {
            take_in_presented_recording(host, output, publishes_recording);
        },
    );
    recording_landing(landing, presented_other_scroll_offsets)
}

/// Takes the output of a recording that presented itself in as the document's last.
fn take_in_presented_recording(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    output: std::sync::Arc<crate::painting::record::RecordingOutput>,
    publishes_recording: bool,
) {
    host.queue_change(crate::render_state::ArenaChange::Paint(
        crate::painting::paint_changes::PaintChange::TakeInRecording {
            output,
            publishes_recording,
        },
    ));
}

/// Answers how a recording landed, and writes what the presentation it gave back presented to
/// `presented_other_scroll_offsets`.
fn recording_landing(
    landing: crate::painting::recording_slot::RecordingLanding,
    presentation: &mut bool,
) -> FfiRecordingLanding {
    use crate::painting::recording_slot::RecordingLanding;
    match landing {
        RecordingLanding::NoneInFlight => FfiRecordingLanding::NoneInFlight,
        RecordingLanding::StillInFlight => FfiRecordingLanding::StillInFlight,
        RecordingLanding::Landed(given_back) => {
            give_back(given_back, presentation);
            FfiRecordingLanding::Landed
        }
        RecordingLanding::LandedBehindRows(given_back) => {
            give_back(given_back, presentation);
            FfiRecordingLanding::LandedBehindRows
        }
        RecordingLanding::NothingRecorded(given_back) => {
            give_back(given_back, presentation);
            FfiRecordingLanding::NothingRecorded
        }
        RecordingLanding::PresentedUnrecorded(given_back) => {
            give_back(given_back, presentation);
            FfiRecordingLanding::PresentedUnrecorded
        }
        RecordingLanding::NeedsVectorImages => FfiRecordingLanding::NeedsVectorImages,
    }
}

/// Writes whether the presentation a recording gave back, if any, sent the compositor other scroll offsets than the
/// frame before to `presented_other_scroll_offsets`.
fn give_back(
    given_back: Option<crate::painting::presentation::Presentation>,
    presented_other_scroll_offsets: &mut bool,
) {
    *presented_other_scroll_offsets =
        given_back.is_some_and(|presentation| presentation.presented_other_scroll_offsets());
}

/// Whether the rows of `host`'s document are still at `version`, so that a recording that landed with a frame frozen
/// there shows what a hit test of the rows finds. The recording dropped its frame and the lease it held, so the style
/// engine frees what it kept for that lease here too, however idle the document stays.
fn landed_recording_stands(host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost, version: crate::layout::RowsVersion) -> bool {
    // A frame in flight, or a round that flew and is not paid yet, writes the rows, which then stand for no recording
    // made before it.
    let Some(here) = host.layout_waits_for_no_frame() else {
        return false;
    };
    host.ask(here, |state| {
        let arena = state.arena_mut();
        arena.with_style_engine(|engine| engine.free_style_records_kept_for_leases());
        arena.rows_version() == version
    })
}

/// `tree` with the compositor's animations sampled at the time the query reads them at, where it reads them so, kept in
/// `sampled`; otherwise `tree` itself.
fn tree_as_the_query_reads_it<'tree>(
    tree: &'tree crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree,
    callbacks: &crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks,
    sampled: &'tree mut Option<crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree>,
) -> &'tree crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree {
    match callbacks.visual_animation_sample_time_ns() {
        Some(sample_time_ns) if tree.has_visual_animations() => {
            sampled.insert(tree.with_visual_animation_samples(sample_time_ns))
        }
        _ => tree,
    }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_hit_test_items_on_screen_generation(host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost) -> u64 {
    host.recording().hit_test_items_generation()
}

/// The DOM node a hit on the paintable dispatches events to.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_paintable_event_dispatch_target(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
) -> crate::painting::host::FfiNodeIdentity {
    read_measured_rows(host, read, |rows| {
        crate::painting::hit_test::resolve::event_dispatch_target_of_paintable(rows, slot)
    })
}

/// Answers `query` about `point` through `answer`, from the rows as of every write the host made, with every row's
/// scrollable overflow and ink overflow measured, in `read`. A hit test paints nothing, so it walks the overlays a
/// frame paints.
fn with_point_query<R>(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    query: &crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQuery,
    point: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    default: R,
    answer: impl FnOnce(&crate::painting::paint_read::PaintSource<'_>, crate::painting::hit_test::walk::PointQuery<'_>) -> R,
) -> R {
    let scroll_state = host.scroll_state();
    let callbacks =
        crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks::for_host_query(query, scroll_state.device_offsets());
    host.read_rows_measured_for_hit_testing(read, |rows, source| {
        let Some(tree) = rows.visual_context_tree.as_deref() else {
            return default;
        };
        let mut sampled = None;
        let tree = tree_as_the_query_reads_it(tree, &callbacks, &mut sampled);
        let world = callbacks.build_world_transforms(tree);
        let callbacks = &callbacks.with_world_transforms(&world);
        answer(
            source,
            crate::painting::hit_test::walk::PointQuery {
                tree,
                callbacks,
                viewport: rows.viewport,
                paint_overlay: true,
                point: point.into(),
            },
        )
    })
}

fn ffi_point_hit(
    source: &crate::painting::paint_read::PaintSource<'_>,
    hit: &crate::painting::hit_test::walk::PointHit,
) -> crate::painting::host::FfiPointHit {
    use crate::painting::paint_read::GeometryRead;
    assert!(
        source.paintable_row_is_populated(hit.item.paintable),
        "a hit names a paintable that has a row"
    );
    crate::painting::host::FfiPointHit {
        paintable: hit.item.paintable,
        hit_node: hit.item.hit_node,
        chrome_widget_kind: hit.item.chrome_widget_kind,
        local: hit.local_point.into(),
        resolved: crate::painting::hit_test::resolve::resolve_hit(source, &hit.item, hit.local_point),
    }
}

/// Writes the topmost thing under `point` to `out` and answers whether there is one.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_hit_test_topmost_hit(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    query: crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQuery,
    point: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    out: &mut crate::painting::host::FfiPointHit,
) -> bool {
    let hit = with_point_query(host, read, &query, point, None, |source, point_query| {
        crate::painting::hit_test::walk::topmost_hit(source, point_query).map(|hit| ffi_point_hit(source, &hit))
    });
    match hit {
        Some(hit) => {
            *out = hit;
            true
        }
        None => false,
    }
}

/// Hands `visit` everything under `point`, topmost first.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread; the sink pointer must stay valid for this
/// synchronous call.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_hit_test_all_hits(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    query: crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQuery,
    point: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    sink: *mut c_void,
    visit: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, &crate::painting::host::FfiPointHit),
) {
    let hits = with_point_query(host, read, &query, point, Vec::new(), |source, point_query| {
        crate::painting::hit_test::walk::all_hits(source, point_query)
            .iter()
            .map(|hit| ffi_point_hit(source, hit))
            .collect()
    });
    for hit in &hits {
        // SAFETY: The C++ sink consumes the hit synchronously.
        unsafe { visit(sink, hit) };
    }
}

/// The caret position at `point`, or where `constraint_scope` is a box, the one that box gives it.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn layout_hit_test_caret_position_from_point(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    query: crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQuery,
    point: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    constraint_scope: NodeSlotId,
    out: &mut FfiCaretAt,
) {
    *out = with_point_query(host, read, &query, point, None, |source, point_query| {
        crate::painting::hit_test::caret::caret_position_from_point(source, point_query, constraint_scope)
    })
    .unwrap_or_else(FfiCaretAt::none);
}

/// The style-tree identity of the first `<area>` of the image's map, in tree order, whose shape
/// covers the point. Zero when the image has no map, or when no shape covers the point.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn layout_image_map_area_for_point(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
) -> u32 {
    host.fresh_rows(super::node_read()).image_map_area_for_point(slot, x, y)
}

use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::node_painting;
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::paintable_rows::PaintableRowsWrite;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct FragmentRange {
    pub begin: u32,
    pub end: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct FragmentOwnershipFilter {
    pub include_everything: bool,
    /// Sorted by begin and disjoint.
    pub included: Vec<FragmentRange>,
    pub excluded: Vec<FragmentRange>,
}

impl FragmentOwnershipFilter {
    pub fn everything() -> Self {
        Self {
            include_everything: true,
            included: Vec::new(),
            excluded: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn owns_fragment(&self, index: u32) -> bool {
        let contains = |ranges: &[FragmentRange]| {
            let end = ranges.partition_point(|range| range.begin <= index);
            end > 0 && index < ranges[end - 1].end
        };
        (self.include_everything || contains(&self.included)) && !contains(&self.excluded)
    }

    pub fn for_each_owned_fragment_index(&self, fragment_count: usize, mut callback: impl FnMut(usize)) {
        let mut excluded_cursor = 0;
        let mut is_excluded = |index: usize| {
            while excluded_cursor < self.excluded.len() && (self.excluded[excluded_cursor].end as usize) <= index {
                excluded_cursor += 1;
            }
            excluded_cursor < self.excluded.len() && index >= self.excluded[excluded_cursor].begin as usize
        };
        let mut visit_range = |begin: usize, end: usize| {
            for index in begin..end {
                if !is_excluded(index) {
                    callback(index);
                }
            }
        };
        if self.include_everything {
            visit_range(0, fragment_count);
            return;
        }
        for range in &self.included {
            visit_range(range.begin as usize, range.end as usize);
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn is_self_painting_inline(layout_arena: &impl PaintRead, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    // Whether this box paints its own foreground (fragments and caret) instead of the
    // containing block: it forms a group that content must be recorded inside.
    let data = layout_arena.paintable_data(paintable);
    node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(layout_arena, paintable)
        && (data.establishes_stacking_context || crate::painting::style_queries::is_positioned(layout_arena, paintable))
}

pub(crate) fn nearest_fragmented_inline_ancestor(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    node: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    let mut ancestor = layout_arena.node_parent_if_live(node);
    while let Some(candidate) = ancestor {
        let display = layout_arena.node_style_if_live(candidate).map(|style| style.display());
        if !display.is_some_and(|display| display.is_inline_outside() && display.is_flow_inside()) {
            break;
        }
        if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(layout_arena, candidate) {
            return Some(candidate);
        }
        ancestor = layout_arena.node_parent_if_live(candidate);
    }
    None
}

pub(crate) fn nearest_self_painting_inline_box(layout_arena: &impl PaintRead, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    let mut ancestor = nearest_fragmented_inline_ancestor(layout_arena, node);
    while let Some(candidate) = ancestor {
        if layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(candidate) && is_self_painting_inline(layout_arena, candidate) {
            return Some(candidate);
        }
        ancestor = nearest_fragmented_inline_ancestor(layout_arena, candidate);
    }
    None
}

pub(crate) fn assign_fragment_ownership(layout_arena: &mut impl PaintableRowsWrite, viewport: NodeSlotId) {
    let mut stack = vec![viewport];
    while let Some(current) = stack.pop() {
        if let Some(next) = crate::painting::paint_order::next_paint_sibling(&*layout_arena, current)
            && current != viewport
        {
            stack.push(next);
        }
        if let Some(first_child) = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(&*layout_arena, current) {
            stack.push(first_child);
        }
        if node_painting::has_lines(&*layout_arena, current)
            && !layout_arena.committed_side_data(current).inline_box_pieces().is_empty()
        {
            assign_for_block(layout_arena, current);
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn assign_fragment_ownership_for_pending_line_roots(layout_arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena) {
    let mut line_roots = layout_arena.take_line_roots_needing_fragment_ownership();
    line_roots.sort_unstable_by_key(|slot| (slot.index, slot.generation()));
    line_roots.dedup();
    let mut paintable_rows = layout_arena.paintable_rows_mut();
    for line_root in line_roots {
        if paintable_rows.paintable_row_is_populated(line_root)
            && node_painting::has_lines(&paintable_rows, line_root)
            && !paintable_rows
                .committed_side_data(line_root)
                .inline_box_pieces()
                .is_empty()
        {
            assign_for_block(&mut paintable_rows, line_root);
        }
    }
}

fn piece_paintable_of(layout_arena: &impl PaintRead, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    if node.is_invalid() || !layout_arena.slot_is_live(node) {
        return None;
    }
    (layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) && node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(layout_arena, node))
        .then_some(node)
}

pub(crate) fn compute_fragment_ownership_for_block(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    block: NodeSlotId,
) -> Vec<(NodeSlotId, FragmentOwnershipFilter)> {
    let pieces = layout_arena.committed_side_data(block).inline_box_pieces().to_vec();
    let mut block_filter = FragmentOwnershipFilter::everything();

    let mut owners: Vec<NodeSlotId> = Vec::new();
    let mut filters: Vec<FragmentOwnershipFilter> = Vec::new();
    let filter_index =
        |owners: &mut Vec<NodeSlotId>, filters: &mut Vec<FragmentOwnershipFilter>, owner: NodeSlotId| -> usize {
            if let Some(index) = owners.iter().position(|candidate| *candidate == owner) {
                return index;
            }
            owners.push(owner);
            filters.push(FragmentOwnershipFilter::default());
            owners.len() - 1
        };

    for piece in &pieces {
        if piece.fragment_count == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(piece_paintable) = piece_paintable_of(layout_arena, piece.node) else {
            continue;
        };
        if !is_self_painting_inline(layout_arena, piece_paintable) {
            continue;
        }
        let range = FragmentRange {
            begin: piece.first_fragment_index,
            end: piece.first_fragment_index + piece.fragment_count,
        };
        let index = filter_index(&mut owners, &mut filters, piece_paintable);
        filters[index].included.push(range);
        // The nearest self-painting box above owns the surrounding content but must not paint this
        // box's subtree; content outside any such box falls to the block.
        if let Some(enclosing_owner) = nearest_self_painting_inline_box(layout_arena, piece.node) {
            let index = filter_index(&mut owners, &mut filters, enclosing_owner);
            filters[index].excluded.push(range);
        } else {
            block_filter.excluded.push(range);
        }
    }

    block_filter.excluded.sort_by_key(|range| range.begin);
    let mut owners_with_filters = vec![(block, block_filter)];
    for (owner, mut filter) in owners.into_iter().zip(filters) {
        filter.excluded.sort_by_key(|range| range.begin);
        owners_with_filters.push((owner, filter));
    }
    owners_with_filters
}

/// Takes the fragment ownership filter `paintable` was assigned, or the one it held before its recommit.
fn take_previous_fragment_ownership(
    layout_arena: &mut impl PaintableRowsWrite,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<std::sync::Arc<FragmentOwnershipFilter>> {
    let assigned = layout_arena
        .committed_side_data_mut(paintable)
        .fragment_ownership
        .take();
    assigned.or_else(|| {
        layout_arena
            .paintable_side_data_mut(paintable)
            .fragment_ownership_before_recommit
            .take()
    })
}

fn assign_for_block(layout_arena: &mut impl PaintableRowsWrite, block: NodeSlotId) {
    use crate::painting::record::change_ticks::RowPaintChange;
    let owners_with_filters = compute_fragment_ownership_for_block(&*layout_arena, block);
    // Start every piece's box from a clean slate. A box whose filter changes paints a
    // different selection of the block's fragments.
    let pieces = layout_arena.committed_side_data(block).inline_box_pieces().to_vec();
    let mut boxes_with_previous_filters = Vec::new();
    for piece in &pieces {
        if let Some(paintable) = piece_paintable_of(&*layout_arena, piece.node)
            && let Some(previous) = take_previous_fragment_ownership(layout_arena, paintable)
        {
            boxes_with_previous_filters.push((paintable, previous));
        }
    }
    if let Some(previous) = take_previous_fragment_ownership(layout_arena, block) {
        boxes_with_previous_filters.push((block, previous));
    }
    for (owner, filter) in owners_with_filters {
        let unchanged = boxes_with_previous_filters
            .iter()
            .any(|(previous_owner, previous)| *previous_owner == owner && **previous == filter);
        if !unchanged {
            layout_arena.note_paint_change(
                owner,
                RowPaintChange::DRAWING | RowPaintChange::HIT_TESTING | RowPaintChange::ORDER,
            );
        }
        layout_arena.committed_side_data_mut(owner).fragment_ownership = Some(std::sync::Arc::new(filter));
    }
    for (previous_owner, _) in boxes_with_previous_filters {
        if layout_arena
            .committed_side_data(previous_owner)
            .fragment_ownership
            .is_none()
        {
            layout_arena.note_paint_change(
                previous_owner,
                RowPaintChange::DRAWING | RowPaintChange::HIT_TESTING | RowPaintChange::ORDER,
            );
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn effective_filter(layout_arena: &impl PaintRead, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> FragmentOwnershipFilter {
    if let Some(filter) = &layout_arena.committed_side_data(paintable).fragment_ownership {
        return FragmentOwnershipFilter::clone(filter);
    }
    if node_painting::has_lines(layout_arena, paintable) {
        return FragmentOwnershipFilter::everything();
    }
    FragmentOwnershipFilter::default()
}

use super::walk::{PointQuery, topmost_hit};
use super::*;
use crate::layout::node_data::{DomPaintFact, NodeFlag, NodeKind};
use crate::layout::query::inline_cursor::{CaretPosition, InlineCursor};
use crate::painting::host::{FfiCaretAt, FfiCaretBoundaryKind, FfiResolvedCaret};
use crate::painting::paint_read::{PaintRead, PaintRow};
use crate::painting::paintable_data::FragmentRecord;
use crate::painting::viewport_mapping::{ViewportMapping, ViewportSpace};
use crate::painting::visual_context::ClipBehavior;
use crate::painting::{node_painting, paintable_geometry, style_queries};

/// The caret position at the point of `query`: the one the box the point hits gives it, as editing resolves a point,
/// or with a `constraint_scope` box, the one that box gives it wherever the point is.
pub(crate) fn caret_position_from_point(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    query: PointQuery<'_>,
    constraint_scope: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<FfiCaretAt> {
    let resolver = PointResolver {
        arena,
        mapping: query.callbacks.viewport_mapping(query.tree),
        point: query.point,
    };
    if !constraint_scope.is_invalid() {
        let mut scope = constraint_scope;
        while !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(scope) {
            scope = arena.node_parent_if_live(scope)?;
        }
        return resolver.in_box(scope);
    }
    // A point that hits nothing, such as one past the edge of the viewport during a drag, goes to the viewport.
    let Some(hit) = topmost_hit(arena, query) else {
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(query.viewport) {
            return None;
        }
        return resolver.in_box(query.viewport);
    };
    let item = &hit.item;
    let caret = match item.kind {
        HitTestItemKind::TextFragment => resolver.in_lines_of(item.paintable),
        HitTestItemKind::Box | HitTestItemKind::EmptyEditable | HitTestItemKind::ChromeWidget => {
            resolver.in_box(item.paintable)
        }
        HitTestItemKind::SvgPath => Some(resolver.at_start_of(item.paintable)),
    };
    if let Some(caret) = caret.filter(|caret| caret.caret.has_position) {
        return Some(caret);
    }
    // Generated content, such as a list marker, gives no position, and the nearest box around it that stands for a
    // node takes the point.
    let mut node = arena.node_parent_if_live(item.paintable)?;
    while !arena.node_is_dom_backed(node) {
        node = arena.node_parent_if_live(node)?;
    }
    resolver.in_box(node)
}

/// Resolves a point, in the viewport, to a caret position the way a box gives one for a point over it.
struct PointResolver<'a, A: PaintRead> {
    arena: &'a A,
    mapping: ViewportMapping<'a>,
    point: CssPixelPoint,
}

impl<A: PaintRead> PointResolver<'_, A> {
    /// The point in the space `node` lays out its descendants in.
    fn point_in_descendants_space_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<CssPixelPoint> {
        let context = self
            .arena
            .paintable_data(node)
            .accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants;
        self.mapping
            .point_to_local(context, self.point, ViewportSpace::VisualViewport, ClipBehavior::Ignore)
            .map(to_css_point)
    }

    fn in_lines_of(&self, root: NodeSlotId) -> Option<FfiCaretAt> {
        let arena = self.arena;
        let point = self.point_in_descendants_space_of(root)?;
        let produces_caret = |fragment: &FragmentRecord| arena.node_is_dom_backed(fragment.layout_node);
        let position = InlineCursor::new(arena).position_for_point(root, point, &produces_caret)?;
        Some(self.caret_at(root, position))
    }

    /// The caret position the box `node` gives the point: in its lines, beside it where it is replaced, in the block
    /// child the point is over or next to, or at its start.
    fn in_box(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<FfiCaretAt> {
        let arena = self.arena;
        if style_queries::is_replaced_box(arena, node) {
            return self.beside_replaced_box(node);
        }
        if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, node) {
            return self.in_box(arena.node_containing_block_if_live(node)?);
        }
        if arena.node_flags_if_live(node) & NodeFlag::ChildrenAreInline as u32 != 0 {
            return self.in_lines_of(node).or_else(|| Some(self.at_start_of(node)));
        }
        if let Some(caret) = self.in_block_child_of(node) {
            return Some(caret);
        }
        Some(self.at_start_of(node))
    }

    // A point before the line of a replaced box in the block direction, or over its first half, is before it.
    fn beside_replaced_box(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<FfiCaretAt> {
        let arena = self.arena;
        let context = arena.paintable_data(node).accumulated_visual_context;
        let point = self
            .mapping
            .point_to_local(context, self.point, ViewportSpace::VisualViewport, ClipBehavior::Ignore)
            .map(to_css_point)?;
        let rect = paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(arena, node);
        let style = arena.node_style_if_live(node)?;
        let horizontal = style.writing_mode() == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB;
        let (inline, inline_start, inline_size, block, block_start, block_end) = if horizontal {
            (point.x, rect.x, rect.width, point.y, rect.y, rect.bottom())
        } else {
            (point.y, rect.y, rect.height, point.x, rect.x, rect.right())
        };
        let after = if block < block_start {
            style.block_axis_is_reverse()
        } else if block >= block_end {
            !style.block_axis_is_reverse()
        } else {
            (inline - inline_start > inline_size.scaled(0.5)) != style.inline_axis_is_reverse()
        };
        Some(self.caret_at(node, CaretPosition::BesideAtomicInline { node, after }))
    }

    /// The caret position the block child of `node` that the point is over, or the last one it is past, gives it. A
    /// child whose editability differs from that of `node` takes it beside itself instead.
    fn in_block_child_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<FfiCaretAt> {
        let arena = self.arena;
        let point = self.point_in_descendants_space_of(node)?;
        let style = arena.node_style_if_live(node)?;
        let horizontal = style.writing_mode() == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB;
        let block_axis_is_reverse = style.block_axis_is_reverse();
        // Block coordinates that grow in the block direction.
        let block_extent = |rect: CssPixelRect| match (horizontal, block_axis_is_reverse) {
            (true, _) => (rect.y, rect.bottom()),
            (false, false) => (rect.x, rect.right()),
            (false, true) => (-rect.right(), -rect.x),
        };
        let inline_extent = |rect: &CssPixelRect| {
            if horizontal {
                (rect.x, rect.right())
            } else {
                (rect.y, rect.bottom())
            }
        };
        let fragments_of = |child: NodeSlotId| {
            (0..paintable_geometry::fragment_count(arena, child))
                .map(move |index| (child, paintable_geometry::absolute_fragment_rect(arena, child, index)))
        };
        let children = || {
            arena
                .children(node)
                .filter(|&child| arena.paintable_row_is_populated(child))
        };
        let mut candidates: Vec<(NodeSlotId, CssPixelRect)> = children()
            .filter(|&child| {
                arena
                    .node(child)
                    .is_some_and(|row| !row.is_out_of_flow() && !row.is_floating())
            })
            .flat_map(fragments_of)
            .filter(|(_, rect)| !rect.is_empty())
            .collect();
        // A block flow takes the first child that ends past the point in the block direction, or the last one where the
        // point is past its start; other boxes take the child nearest the point.
        let is_block_flow = !matches!(style.display(), display if display.is_flex_inside() || display.is_grid_inside() || display.is_table_inside());
        // Children laid out in columns take the point in the column it is in, or else the one nearest to it.
        let inline = if horizontal { point.x } else { point.y };
        // Children are in columns where two of them side by side overlap in the block direction.
        let mut extents: Vec<_> = candidates
            .iter()
            .map(|(_, rect)| (block_extent(*rect), inline_extent(rect)))
            .collect();
        extents.sort_by_key(|((block_start, _), _)| *block_start);
        let in_columns = is_block_flow
            && extents.windows(2).any(|pair| {
                let (
                    ((_, first_block_end), (first_start, first_end)),
                    ((second_block_start, _), (second_start, second_end)),
                ) = (pair[0], pair[1]);
                second_block_start < first_block_end && (second_start >= first_end || first_start >= second_end)
            });
        if in_columns {
            let distance = |rect: &CssPixelRect| {
                let (start, end) = inline_extent(rect);
                (start - inline)
                    .max(inline - end + CssPixels::from_integer(1))
                    .max(CssPixels::default())
            };
            let nearest = candidates
                .iter()
                .map(|(_, rect)| distance(rect))
                .min()
                .unwrap_or_default();
            candidates.retain(|(_, rect)| distance(rect) == nearest);
        }
        // The point covers the pixel after it.
        let one = CssPixels::from_integer(1);
        let point_rect = CssPixelRect::new(point.x, point.y, one, one);
        let block = block_extent(point_rect).0;
        let distance = |rect: &CssPixelRect| {
            let gap = |start: CssPixels, end: CssPixels, point_start: CssPixels, point_end: CssPixels| {
                (start - point_start)
                    .max(point_end - end)
                    .max(CssPixels::default())
                    .to_double()
            };
            let horizontal_gap = gap(rect.x, rect.right(), point_rect.x, point_rect.right());
            let vertical_gap = gap(rect.y, rect.bottom(), point_rect.y, point_rect.bottom());
            horizontal_gap * horizontal_gap + vertical_gap * vertical_gap
        };
        if candidates.is_empty() {
            return self.in_nearest_positioned_child_of(node, point, &distance);
        }
        let &(child, rect) = if is_block_flow {
            candidates
                .last()
                .filter(|(_, rect)| block >= block_extent(*rect).0)
                .or_else(|| candidates.iter().find(|(_, rect)| block < block_extent(*rect).1))?
        } else {
            candidates
                .iter()
                .min_by(|(_, a), (_, b)| distance(a).total_cmp(&distance(b)))?
        };
        let is_editable = |node| arena.node_has_dom_paint_fact(node, DomPaintFact::EditableOrEditingHost);
        let is_root_element = arena
            .node_parent_if_live(node)
            .is_some_and(|parent| arena.node_kind_if_live(parent) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport));
        // A column stands for no node, and so the boxes in it keep the point whatever their editability.
        if arena.node_is_dom_backed(child)
            && arena.node_is_dom_backed(node)
            && !is_root_element
            && !in_columns
            && is_editable(child) != is_editable(node)
        {
            let (inline, inline_start, inline_size) = if horizontal {
                (point.x, rect.x, rect.width)
            } else {
                (point.y, rect.y, rect.height)
            };
            let after = inline - inline_start >= inline_size.scaled(0.5);
            return Some(self.caret_at(node, CaretPosition::BesideAtomicInline { node: child, after }));
        }
        self.in_box(child)
    }

    // INTEROP: A box with no in-flow child that has a size takes the point in the child nearest to it, of any kind, by
    //          its geometry before its transform.
    fn in_nearest_positioned_child_of(
        &self,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        point: CssPixelPoint,
        distance: &dyn Fn(&CssPixelRect) -> f64,
    ) -> Option<FfiCaretAt> {
        let arena = self.arena;
        let child = arena
            .children(node)
            .filter(|&child| arena.paintable_row_is_populated(child) && arena.node_is_dom_backed(child))
            .min_by(|&a, &b| {
                distance(&paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(arena, a))
                    .total_cmp(&distance(&paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(arena, b)))
            })?;
        let produces_caret = |fragment: &FragmentRecord| arena.node_is_dom_backed(fragment.layout_node);
        let position = node_painting::has_lines(arena, child)
            .then(|| InlineCursor::new(arena).position_for_point(child, point, &produces_caret))
            .flatten()
            .unwrap_or(CaretPosition::StartOfBox { node: child });
        Some(self.caret_at(child, position))
    }

    fn at_start_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> FfiCaretAt {
        self.caret_at(node, CaretPosition::StartOfBox { node })
    }

    fn caret_at(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId, position: CaretPosition) -> FfiCaretAt {
        let arena = self.arena;
        let identity = |node| resolve::row_node_identity(arena, node, false);
        let mut caret = match position {
            CaretPosition::Text {
                text,
                offset,
                downstream,
            } => FfiResolvedCaret {
                node: identity(text),
                boundary: FfiCaretBoundaryKind::Offset,
                offset,
                affinity_is_upstream: !downstream,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            CaretPosition::BesideAtomicInline { node, after } => FfiResolvedCaret {
                node: identity(node),
                boundary: if after {
                    FfiCaretBoundaryKind::AfterNode
                } else {
                    FfiCaretBoundaryKind::BeforeNode
                },
                ..Default::default()
            },
            CaretPosition::BeforeForcedBreak { node } => FfiResolvedCaret {
                node: identity(node),
                boundary: FfiCaretBoundaryKind::IndexOfNodeInParent,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            CaretPosition::StartOfBox { node } => FfiResolvedCaret {
                node: identity(node),
                boundary: FfiCaretBoundaryKind::Offset,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        };
        caret.has_position = !caret.node.is_none();
        if let Some(rect) = InlineCursor::new(arena).caret_rect(position) {
            caret.has_debug_rect = true;
            caret.debug_rect = if rect.owner == rect.node {
                self.mapping
                    .rect_to_viewport(arena, rect.owner, rect.rect, ViewportSpace::VisualViewport)
            } else {
                self.mapping.line_content_rect_to_viewport(
                    arena,
                    rect.owner,
                    rect.node,
                    rect.rect,
                    ViewportSpace::VisualViewport,
                )
            }
            .into();
        }
        FfiCaretAt { paintable, caret }
    }
}
