//! The hit-test items of one box in one paint phase, in the order they stack, read from rows.

use super::*;
use crate::css::computed_value_types::SVG_PAINT_NONE;
use crate::css::css_enums;
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::layout::node_data::{DomPaintFact, NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::layout::node_facts::{self, NodeShape};
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::ContextRef;
use crate::painting::fragment_ownership;
use crate::painting::node_painting;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{PaintRead, PaintRow};
use crate::painting::paintable_data::CommittedSideData;
use crate::painting::paintable_data::*;
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;
use crate::painting::record::PaintPhase;
use crate::painting::style_queries;
use crate::painting::text_fragment;
use libgfx_rust::{FloatPoint, WindingRule};

/// A fragment of a row's inline content, read through whatever holds the row's committed side
/// data.
struct CommittedFragment<SideData> {
    side_data: SideData,
    index: usize,
}

impl<SideData: std::ops::Deref<Target = CommittedSideData>> std::ops::Deref for CommittedFragment<SideData> {
    type Target = FragmentRecord;

    fn deref(&self) -> &FragmentRecord {
        &self.side_data.fragments()[self.index]
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct HitTestFacts {
    pub(crate) visible_for_hit_testing: bool,
    pub(crate) has_resizer: bool,
    pub(crate) could_be_scrolled_horizontally: bool,
    pub(crate) could_be_scrolled_vertically: bool,
    pub(crate) svg_hit_areas: u8,
    pub(crate) svg_path_winding_rule: WindingRule,
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/interact.html#PointerEventsProperty
fn svg_hit_areas(pointer_events: u8, visibility_is_visible: bool, fill_is_none: bool, stroke_is_none: bool) -> u8 {
    use css_enums::pointer_events;
    let fill_and_stroke = svg_hit_area::FILL | svg_hit_area::STROKE;
    // The pointer is over a painted area if it is over the interior (i.e., fill) of the element and the fill property
    // has an actual value other than none or it is over the perimeter (i.e., stroke) of the element and the stroke
    // property has an actual value other than none.
    let painted_areas =
        (if fill_is_none { 0 } else { svg_hit_area::FILL }) | (if stroke_is_none { 0 } else { svg_hit_area::STROKE });
    let if_visible = |areas: u8| if visibility_is_visible { areas } else { 0 };
    match pointer_events {
        // auto: The default behavior, which is the same as for visiblePainted.
        // visiblePainted: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the visibility property
        //                 is set to visible and when the pointer is over a "painted" area.
        pointer_events::AUTO | pointer_events::VISIBLEPAINTED => if_visible(painted_areas),
        // bounding-box: The given element can be a target element for pointer events when the pointer is over the
        //               bounding box of the element.
        pointer_events::BOUNDING_BOX => svg_hit_area::BOUNDING_BOX,
        // visibleFill: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the visibility property is
        //              set to visible and when the pointer is over the interior (i.e., fill) of the element.
        pointer_events::VISIBLEFILL => if_visible(svg_hit_area::FILL),
        // visibleStroke: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the visibility property
        //                is set to visible and when the pointer is over the perimeter (i.e., stroke) of the element.
        pointer_events::VISIBLESTROKE => if_visible(svg_hit_area::STROKE),
        // visible: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the visibility property is set
        //          to visible and the pointer is over either the interior (i.e., fill) or the perimeter (i.e.,
        //          stroke) of the element.
        pointer_events::VISIBLE => if_visible(fill_and_stroke),
        // painted: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the pointer is over a "painted"
        //          area.
        pointer_events::PAINTED => painted_areas,
        // fill: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the pointer is over the interior
        //       (i.e., fill) of the element.
        pointer_events::FILL => svg_hit_area::FILL,
        // stroke: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the pointer is over the
        //         perimeter (i.e., stroke) of the element.
        pointer_events::STROKE => svg_hit_area::STROKE,
        // all: The given element can be the target element for pointer events whenever the pointer is over either the
        //      interior (i.e., fill) or the perimeter (i.e., stroke) of the element.
        pointer_events::ALL => fill_and_stroke,
        // none: The given element does not receive pointer events.
        _ => 0,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn hit_test_facts(arena: &impl PaintRead, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> HitTestFacts {
    let Some(row) = arena.node(paintable) else {
        return HitTestFacts::default();
    };
    let Some(style) = row.style() else {
        return HitTestFacts::default();
    };
    let wheel_axes = crate::painting::chrome_geometry::wheel_scrollable_axes(arena, paintable);
    let svg_path = node_painting::is_svg_path(row.kind());
    let svg = style.inherited_svg();
    HitTestFacts {
        visible_for_hit_testing: arena.paintable_row_is_populated(paintable)
            && row.dom_paint_facts() & DomPaintFact::Inert as u8 == 0
            && style.pointer_events() != css_enums::pointer_events::NONE,
        has_resizer: crate::painting::chrome_geometry::has_resizer(arena, paintable),
        could_be_scrolled_horizontally: wheel_axes.horizontal,
        could_be_scrolled_vertically: wheel_axes.vertical,
        svg_hit_areas: if svg_path {
            let areas = svg_hit_areas(
                style.pointer_events(),
                style.visibility() == css_enums::visibility::VISIBLE,
                svg.fill.kind == SVG_PAINT_NONE,
                svg.stroke.kind == SVG_PAINT_NONE,
            );
            // For text elements, hit-testing is performed on a character cell basis, so the text receives events
            // anywhere within a character cell whenever its fill or its stroke would.
            if matches!(row.kind(), NodeKind::SVGTextBox | NodeKind::SVGTextPathBox)
                && areas & (svg_hit_area::FILL | svg_hit_area::STROKE) != 0
            {
                svg_hit_area::FILL
            } else {
                areas
            }
        } else if row.kind() == NodeKind::SVGImageBox {
            // For raster images, hit-testing is performed on a whole-image basis (i.e., the rectangular area for the
            // image is the determinant for whether the image receives the event).
            // NB: The rectangular area for the image is also its bounding box.
            if svg_hit_areas(
                style.pointer_events(),
                style.visibility() == css_enums::visibility::VISIBLE,
                false,
                false,
            ) != 0
            {
                svg_hit_area::BOUNDING_BOX
            } else {
                0
            }
        } else if row.kind() == NodeKind::SVGGraphicsBox
            && style.pointer_events() == css_enums::pointer_events::BOUNDING_BOX
        {
            svg_hit_area::BOUNDING_BOX
        } else {
            0
        },
        svg_path_winding_rule: if svg_path && svg.fill_rule == css_enums::fill_rule::EVENODD {
            WindingRule::EvenOdd
        } else {
            WindingRule::Nonzero
        },
    }
}

/// Where the items of a box go, with what generating them asks of whoever wants them.
pub(crate) trait HitTestItemSink {
    /// The facts of a row, which a sink that visits a row in several phases may keep.
    fn hit_test_facts(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> HitTestFacts;

    /// The scale from the space of the paintable's own box to the screen, which a stroke that does not scale is
    /// measured against.
    fn own_accumulated_2d_scale(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> libgfx_rust::FloatSize;

    /// Whether an item of this kind over this rect is worth building. The item of a text fragment resolves a font
    /// and measures the fragment, which a sink that only wants what lies under a point can save.
    fn wants(&mut self, _kind: HitTestItemKind, _rect: CssPixelRect, _context: ContextRef) -> bool {
        true
    }

    fn rejects_text_fragments_placed_at_their_line_root_before_building_them(&self) -> bool {
        false
    }

    fn misses_line(
        &mut self,
        _line_root: NodeSlotId,
        _line_index: u32,
        _line_root_absolute_content_origin: CssPixelPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        false
    }

    fn append(&mut self, item: HitTestItem);
}

pub(crate) struct HitTestItems<'a, R: PaintRead, S: HitTestItemSink> {
    rows: &'a R,
    sink: &'a mut S,
}

/// Hands `sink` the items `paintable` has in `phase`.
pub(crate) fn hit_test_items_of_phase<R: PaintRead, S: HitTestItemSink>(
    rows: &R,
    sink: &mut S,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
    phase: PaintPhase,
) {
    HitTestItems { rows, sink }.of_phase(paintable, phase);
}

impl<'a, R: PaintRead, S: HitTestItemSink> HitTestItems<'a, R, S> {
    fn visibility_is_visible(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        self.rows
            .node_style_if_live(paintable)
            .is_none_or(|style| style.visibility() == css_enums::visibility::VISIBLE)
    }

    fn is_anonymous(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        style_queries::is_anonymous(self.rows, paintable)
    }

    fn is_generated_for_pseudo_element(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        self.rows.node_is_generated_for_pseudo_element(paintable)
    }

    fn of_phase(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(self.rows, paintable) {
            self.inline_items(paintable, phase);
        } else if node_painting::has_lines(self.rows, paintable) {
            self.base_items(paintable, phase);
            self.lines_items(paintable, phase);
        } else if self
            .rows
            .node_kind_if_live(paintable)
            .is_some_and(node_painting::is_svg_path)
        {
            self.svg_path_items(paintable, phase);
        } else if self
            .rows
            .node_kind_if_live(paintable)
            .is_some_and(|kind| matches!(kind, NodeKind::SVGImageBox | NodeKind::SVGGraphicsBox))
        {
            self.svg_box_items(paintable, phase);
        } else {
            self.base_items(paintable, phase);
        }
    }

    fn base_items(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        if phase != PaintPhase::Background && phase != PaintPhase::Overlay {
            return;
        }
        if !self.visibility_is_visible(paintable) || !self.sink.hit_test_facts(paintable).visible_for_hit_testing {
            return;
        }
        if phase == PaintPhase::Background {
            if self.is_anonymous(paintable) && !self.is_generated_for_pseudo_element(paintable) {
                return;
            }
            // Column and column group boxes only exist to paint their backgrounds under the cells of their columns;
            // they are not hit-tested, as in other engines.
            let display = style_queries::display(self.rows, paintable);
            if display.is_table_column() || display.is_table_column_group() {
                return;
            }
            let context = self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context;
            for (rect, radii) in
                crate::painting::border_radii::border_boxes_and_radii_of_fragments(self.rows, paintable)
            {
                self.append_box(paintable, rect, context, radii);
            }
            return;
        }
        let facts = self.sink.hit_test_facts(paintable);
        let context = self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context;
        if facts.has_resizer {
            self.append_chrome_widget(paintable, CHROME_WIDGET_RESIZE_HANDLE, context);
        }
        if facts.could_be_scrolled_horizontally {
            self.append_chrome_widget(paintable, CHROME_WIDGET_HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR, context);
        }
        if facts.could_be_scrolled_vertically {
            self.append_chrome_widget(paintable, CHROME_WIDGET_VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR, context);
        }
    }

    fn lines_items(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        if phase != PaintPhase::Foreground {
            return;
        }
        let fragment_count = self.rows.committed_side_data(paintable).fragments().len();
        if fragment_count == 0 && crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(self.rows, paintable).is_none() {
            if style_queries::is_visible(self.rows, paintable)
                && self.sink.hit_test_facts(paintable).visible_for_hit_testing
            {
                self.empty_editable_item(paintable);
            }
            return;
        }
        let context = self
            .rows
            .paintable_data(paintable)
            .accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants;
        // Fragments inside self-painting inline boxes are recorded during that box's paint.
        let filter = fragment_ownership::effective_filter(self.rows, paintable);
        let line_root_positions = self
            .sink
            .rejects_text_fragments_placed_at_their_line_root_before_building_them()
            .then(|| paintable_geometry::LineRootPositions::new(self.rows, paintable));
        let side = self.rows.committed_side_data(paintable);
        let mut last_line_missed: Option<(u32, bool)> = None;
        filter.for_each_owned_fragment_index(fragment_count, |index| {
            let fragment = &side.fragments()[index];
            if fragment.is_atomic_inline {
                return;
            }
            if let Some(positions) = &line_root_positions {
                let line_root_origin = positions.of_line(side.lines(), fragment.line_index as usize);
                let line_missed = match last_line_missed {
                    Some((line_index, missed)) if line_index == fragment.line_index => missed,
                    _ => {
                        let missed = self.sink.misses_line(paintable, fragment.line_index, line_root_origin);
                        last_line_missed = Some((fragment.line_index, missed));
                        missed
                    }
                };
                if line_missed {
                    return;
                }
                let rect_placed_at_its_line_root =
                    text_fragment::rect_in_containing_block(fragment).translated_by(line_root_origin);
                if !self
                    .sink
                    .wants(HitTestItemKind::TextFragment, rect_placed_at_its_line_root, context)
                {
                    return;
                }
            }
            if text_fragment::is_block_level_box(self.rows, fragment) {
                return;
            }
            self.append_text_fragment(paintable, index as u32, context);
        });
    }

    fn inline_items(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        if self.is_anonymous(paintable) && !self.is_generated_for_pseudo_element(paintable) {
            return;
        }
        // Only this box's own items are gated on its visibility; the fragments it owns may belong
        // to descendants that override visibility or pointer-events, so they are filtered per
        // fragment instead.
        let box_itself_is_hit_testable = style_queries::is_visible(self.rows, paintable)
            && self.sink.hit_test_facts(paintable).visible_for_hit_testing;

        if phase == PaintPhase::Background {
            if box_itself_is_hit_testable {
                self.append_piece_boxes(paintable);
            }
            return;
        }
        if phase != PaintPhase::Foreground {
            return;
        }

        if fragment_ownership::is_self_painting_inline(self.rows, paintable) {
            let Some(root) = self.inline_root(paintable) else {
                return;
            };
            let context = self
                .rows
                .paintable_data(paintable)
                .accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants;
            let fragment_count = self.rows.committed_side_data(root).fragments().len();
            let filter = fragment_ownership::effective_filter(self.rows, paintable);
            // Hit-test precedence follows paint order: this box's own text loses to the box itself
            // (re-recorded so its z-order matches this box's paint order), while nested content
            // (e.g. a link inside this box) wins over it.
            let own_layout_node = paintable;
            let mut nested_content_indices = Vec::new();
            filter.for_each_owned_fragment_index(fragment_count, |index| {
                if self.fragment_is_block_level_box(root, index) {
                    return;
                }
                let fragment_node = self.rows.committed_side_data(root).fragments()[index].layout_node;
                if fragment_ownership::nearest_fragmented_inline_ancestor(self.rows, fragment_node)
                    == Some(own_layout_node)
                {
                    self.append_text_fragment(root, index as u32, context);
                } else {
                    nested_content_indices.push(index);
                }
            });
            if box_itself_is_hit_testable && self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).establishes_stacking_context {
                self.append_piece_boxes(paintable);
            }
            for index in nested_content_indices {
                self.append_text_fragment(root, index as u32, context);
            }
        }

        // Clicks must be able to place the caret in an editable element with no content, so its
        // target is recorded in foreground order, winning over earlier-painted overlapping content.
        if box_itself_is_hit_testable && !self.inline_has_content(paintable) {
            self.empty_editable_item(paintable);
        }
    }

    fn inline_root(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
        let block = self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).containing_block;
        if block.is_invalid() || !self.rows.paintable_row_is_populated(block) {
            return None;
        }
        node_painting::has_lines(self.rows, block).then_some(block)
    }

    fn piece_of(&self, root: NodeSlotId, piece_index: u32) -> InlineBoxPieceRecord {
        self.rows.committed_side_data(root).inline_box_pieces()[piece_index as usize]
    }

    fn inline_has_content(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        let has_content_pieces = self.inline_root(paintable).is_some_and(|root| {
            self.rows
                .committed_side_data(root)
                .inline_box_piece_indices(paintable)
                .iter()
                .any(|piece_index| {
                    let piece = self.piece_of(root, *piece_index);
                    !piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder && piece.fragment_count != 0
                })
        });
        has_content_pieces || crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(self.rows, paintable).is_some()
    }

    fn append_piece_boxes(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        let Some(root) = self.inline_root(paintable) else {
            return;
        };
        let root_positions = paintable_geometry::LineRootPositions::new(self.rows, root);
        let layout_arena = self.rows;
        let context = self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context;
        let side = layout_arena.committed_side_data(root);
        for piece_index in side.inline_box_piece_indices(paintable) {
            let piece = &side.inline_box_pieces()[*piece_index as usize];
            if piece.is_geometry_only_placeholder {
                continue;
            }
            let root_position = root_positions.of_line(side.lines(), piece.line_index as usize);
            let rect = CssPixelRect::from(piece.border_box_rect).translated_by(root_position);
            let radii = crate::painting::border_radii::piece_border_radii(self.rows, paintable, piece);
            self.append_box(paintable, rect, context, radii);
        }
    }

    fn svg_path_items(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        if phase != PaintPhase::Foreground {
            return;
        }
        let Some(mut path) = paintable_geometry::committed_svg_path(self.rows, paintable) else {
            return;
        };
        // OPTIMIZATION: The facts are computed afresh from the box's style each time they're asked for, so they're asked
        //               for once.
        let facts = self.sink.hit_test_facts(paintable);
        if !facts.visible_for_hit_testing {
            return;
        }
        // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/interact.html#PointerEventsProperty
        // For text elements, hit-testing is performed on a character cell basis
        let mut winding_rule = facts.svg_path_winding_rule;
        if let Some(cells_path) = self.svg_text_character_cells_path(paintable) {
            path = std::sync::Arc::new(crate::layout::fragment_tree::CommittedSvgPath::new(cells_path));
            // NB: Every point of a cell is in it, even where cells overlap, whatever the text's fill-rule.
            winding_rule = WindingRule::Nonzero;
        }
        if facts.svg_hit_areas == 0 {
            return;
        }
        if facts.svg_hit_areas & svg_hit_area::BOUNDING_BOX != 0 {
            self.append_svg_bounding_box(paintable);
            return;
        }
        let stroke = if facts.svg_hit_areas & svg_hit_area::STROKE != 0 {
            self.svg_stroke_hit_region(paintable)
        } else {
            None
        };
        if facts.svg_hit_areas & !svg_hit_area::STROKE == 0 && stroke.is_none() {
            return;
        }
        let [mut x, mut y, mut width, mut height] = path.bounding_box();
        if let Some(stroke) = &stroke {
            let outset = stroke.outset();
            x -= outset;
            y -= outset;
            width += outset * 2.0;
            height += outset * 2.0;
        }
        // The item rect rounds outward, past the far edges, so fixed-point quantization can never reject a valid hit
        // and points on those edges stay inside it.
        let x1 = x.floor() as i32;
        let y1 = y.floor() as i32;
        let x2 = (x + width).floor() as i32 + 1;
        let y2 = (y + height).floor() as i32 + 1;
        let bounding_box = CssPixelRect::new(
            CssPixels::from_integer(i64::from(x1)),
            CssPixels::from_integer(i64::from(y1)),
            CssPixels::from_integer(i64::from(x2 - x1)),
            CssPixels::from_integer(i64::from(y2 - y1)),
        );
        if bounding_box.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let context = self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context;
        if !self.sink.wants(HitTestItemKind::SvgPath, bounding_box, context) {
            return;
        }
        let item = HitTestItem {
            rect: bounding_box,
            path: Some(path),
            winding_rule,
            svg_hit_areas: facts.svg_hit_areas,
            svg_stroke: stroke,
            ..self.base_hit_test_item(HitTestItemKind::SvgPath, paintable, context)
        };
        self.sink.append(item);
    }

    /// The character cells of a text element, as one path, which it's hit-tested by rather than by its glyphs.
    /// FIXME: The cells of text on a path aren't laid along the path, so text on a path, a <text> with a <textPath> in
    ///        it, and a <tspan> in a <textPath> are still hit-tested by their glyphs.
    fn svg_text_character_cells_path(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> Option<libgfx_rust::path::Path> {
        if self.rows.node_kind_if_live(paintable) != Some(NodeKind::SVGTextBox)
            || self
                .rows
                .children(paintable)
                .any(|child| self.rows.node_kind_if_live(child) == Some(NodeKind::SVGTextPathBox))
        {
            return None;
        }
        let mut ancestor = self.rows.node_parent_if_live(paintable);
        while let Some(element) = ancestor {
            match self.rows.node_kind_if_live(element) {
                Some(NodeKind::SVGTextPathBox) => return None,
                Some(NodeKind::SVGTextBox) => ancestor = self.rows.node_parent_if_live(element),
                _ => break,
            }
        }
        // NB: Each element is hit-tested by its own characters, so that the elements inside it keep their own visibility and
        //     pointer-events.
        let cells = paintable_geometry::committed_svg_text_own_character_cells(self.rows, paintable)?;
        let mut path = libgfx_rust::path::Path::new();
        for cell in cells.iter().filter(|cell| cell.starts_typographic_character) {
            if cell.width <= 0.0 || cell.height <= 0.0 {
                continue;
            }
            let (left, top) = (cell.x, cell.y);
            let (right, bottom) = (cell.x + cell.width, cell.y + cell.height);
            path.move_to(FloatPoint { x: left, y: top });
            path.line_to(FloatPoint { x: right, y: top });
            path.line_to(FloatPoint { x: right, y: bottom });
            path.line_to(FloatPoint { x: left, y: bottom });
            path.close();
        }
        (!path.is_empty()).then_some(path)
    }

    fn svg_box_items(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        if phase != PaintPhase::Foreground || !self.sink.hit_test_facts(paintable).visible_for_hit_testing {
            return;
        }
        if self.sink.hit_test_facts(paintable).svg_hit_areas & svg_hit_area::BOUNDING_BOX != 0 {
            self.append_svg_bounding_box(paintable);
        }
    }

    // NB: The rect of an SVG box is its bounding box, which takes in the boxes of its descendants, like the tspans of a
    //     text element. A point on the far edges of the bounding box is over it too, so the item rect reaches one
    //     fixed-point unit past them.
    fn append_svg_bounding_box(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        let one_unit = CssPixels::from_raw(1);
        let rect = paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(self.rows, paintable).inflated(
            CssPixels::default(),
            one_unit,
            one_unit,
            CssPixels::default(),
        );
        let context = self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context;
        if !self.sink.wants(HitTestItemKind::Box, rect, context) {
            return;
        }
        let item = HitTestItem {
            rect,
            ..self.base_hit_test_item(HitTestItemKind::Box, paintable, context)
        };
        self.sink.append(item);
    }

    fn svg_stroke_hit_region(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> Option<SvgStrokeHitRegion> {
        let style = self.rows.node_style_if_live(paintable)?;
        let stroke = crate::painting::record::paint::svg::svg_stroke_style(self.rows, paintable, &style);
        let mut thickness = stroke.width;
        let mut dash_array = stroke.dash_array;
        let mut dash_offset = stroke.dash_offset;
        // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/painting.html#PaintingVectorEffects
        // With the non-scaling-stroke vector effect, stroke outline shall be calculated in the "host" coordinate
        // space instead of user coordinate system.
        if stroke.non_scaling_stroke {
            let accumulated_scale = self.sink.own_accumulated_2d_scale(paintable);
            let accumulated_scale_area = accumulated_scale.width * accumulated_scale.height;
            if accumulated_scale_area > 0.0 {
                let scale = accumulated_scale_area.sqrt();
                thickness /= scale;
                dash_array.iter_mut().for_each(|value| *value /= scale);
                dash_offset /= scale;
            }
        }
        if thickness.is_nan() || thickness <= 0.0 {
            return None;
        }
        Some(SvgStrokeHitRegion::new(libgfx_rust::path::StrokeStyle {
            thickness,
            cap_style: stroke.cap_style,
            join_style: stroke.join_style,
            miter_limit: stroke.miter_limit,
            dash_array,
            dash_offset,
        }))
    }

    fn empty_editable_item(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        if self.is_anonymous(paintable)
            || !self
                .rows
                .node_has_dom_paint_fact(paintable, DomPaintFact::EditableOrEditingHost)
        {
            return;
        }
        let context = self.rows.paintable_data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context;
        for rect in paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rects_of_fragments(self.rows, paintable) {
            self.append_empty_editable(paintable, rect, context);
        }
    }

    fn fragment(
        &self,
        owner: NodeSlotId,
        index: usize,
    ) -> CommittedFragment<impl std::ops::Deref<Target = CommittedSideData> + 'a> {
        CommittedFragment {
            side_data: self.rows.committed_side_data(owner),
            index,
        }
    }

    fn fragment_is_block_level_box(&self, owner: NodeSlotId, index: usize) -> bool {
        text_fragment::is_block_level_box(self.rows, &self.fragment(owner, index))
    }

    // A text node has no style of its own, so its parent both decides whether the fragment can be hit and is what an
    // event dispatched from it resolves against. Returns that node, or None when the fragment is not hit-testable.
    fn hit_node_for_text_fragment(&mut self, fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
        let node = fragment.layout_node;
        let row = self.rows.node(node)?;
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overflow-4/#ellipsing-details
        // "The UA should dispatch any pointer event on the ellipsis to the elided element"
        if fragment.is_block_ellipsis || !node_facts::kind_is_text(row.kind()) {
            return None;
        }
        let parent = row.parent();
        let parent_style = self.rows.node_style_if_live(parent)?;
        if parent_style.visibility() != css_enums::visibility::VISIBLE
            || parent_style.effects().opacity == 0.0
            || parent_style.pointer_events() == css_enums::pointer_events::NONE
            || row.dom_paint_facts() & DomPaintFact::Inert as u8 != 0
        {
            return None;
        }
        // Resolving the hit needs a committed paintable row; without one there is nothing to resolve against.
        if !self.rows.paintable_row_is_populated(parent) {
            return None;
        }
        Some(parent)
    }

    fn append_box(
        &mut self,
        paintable_box: NodeSlotId,
        rect: CssPixelRect,
        context: ContextRef,
        border_radii: BorderRadii,
    ) {
        if !self.sink.wants(HitTestItemKind::Box, rect, context) {
            return;
        }
        let item = HitTestItem {
            rect,
            border_radii,
            ..self.base_hit_test_item(HitTestItemKind::Box, paintable_box, context)
        };
        self.sink.append(item);
    }

    fn base_hit_test_item(&self, kind: HitTestItemKind, target: NodeSlotId, context: ContextRef) -> HitTestItem {
        HitTestItem {
            kind,
            paintable: target,
            hit_node: target,
            chrome_widget_kind: CHROME_WIDGET_NONE,
            text_fragment_index: None,
            rect: CssPixelRect::default(),
            context,
            border_radii: BorderRadii::default(),
            path: None,
            winding_rule: WindingRule::Nonzero,
            svg_hit_areas: 0,
            svg_stroke: None,
        }
    }

    fn append_text_fragment(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, fragment_index: u32, context: ContextRef) {
        let fragment = self.fragment(owner, fragment_index as usize);
        let layout_arena = self.rows;
        let rect = text_fragment::absolute_rect(layout_arena, &fragment);
        if !self.sink.wants(HitTestItemKind::TextFragment, rect, context) {
            return;
        }
        let Some(hit_node) = self.hit_node_for_text_fragment(&fragment) else {
            return;
        };
        let item = HitTestItem {
            text_fragment_index: Some(fragment_index),
            rect,
            hit_node,
            ..self.base_hit_test_item(HitTestItemKind::TextFragment, owner, context)
        };
        self.sink.append(item);
    }

    fn append_empty_editable(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, rect: CssPixelRect, context: ContextRef) {
        if !self.sink.wants(HitTestItemKind::EmptyEditable, rect, context) {
            return;
        }
        let item = HitTestItem {
            rect,
            ..self.base_hit_test_item(HitTestItemKind::EmptyEditable, paintable, context)
        };
        self.sink.append(item);
    }

    fn append_chrome_widget(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, chrome_widget_kind: u8, context: ContextRef) {
        if !self
            .sink
            .wants(HitTestItemKind::ChromeWidget, CssPixelRect::default(), context)
        {
            return;
        }
        let item = HitTestItem {
            chrome_widget_kind,
            ..self.base_hit_test_item(HitTestItemKind::ChromeWidget, paintable, context)
        };
        self.sink.append(item);
    }
}

pub mod caret;
pub(crate) mod items;
pub mod query;

pub(crate) mod walk;

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels;
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixelRect};
use crate::css::style::fast_hash::FastMap;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::ContextRef;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum HitTestItemKind {
    Box = 0,
    SvgPath = 1,
    TextFragment = 2,
    EmptyEditable = 3,
    ChromeWidget = 4,
}

pub const CHROME_WIDGET_NONE: u8 = 0;
pub const CHROME_WIDGET_RESIZE_HANDLE: u8 = 1;
pub const CHROME_WIDGET_HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR: u8 = 2;
pub const CHROME_WIDGET_VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR: u8 = 3;

pub use crate::painting::border_radii::BorderRadii;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct HitTestItem {
    pub kind: HitTestItemKind,
    pub paintable: NodeSlotId,
    /// The node whose style admitted this hit: a text fragment's parent, otherwise the paintable itself.
    pub hit_node: NodeSlotId,
    pub chrome_widget_kind: u8,
    pub text_fragment_index: Option<u32>,
    pub rect: CssPixelRect,
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub border_radii: BorderRadii,
    pub path: Option<Arc<crate::layout::fragment_tree::CommittedSvgPath>>,
    pub winding_rule: libgfx_rust::WindingRule,
    /// For an SVG path, the `svg_hit_area` flags naming which of its areas pointer events can target.
    pub svg_hit_areas: u8,
    /// For an SVG path whose stroke pointer events can target, the shape of that stroke.
    pub svg_stroke: Option<SvgStrokeHitRegion>,
}

/// The areas of an SVG graphics element that pointer events can target.
pub mod svg_hit_area {
    pub const FILL: u8 = 1 << 0;
    pub const STROKE: u8 = 1 << 1;
    pub const BOUNDING_BOX: u8 = 1 << 2;
}

/// The stroke of an SVG path as hit testing reads it. The outline of the stroke is only built when a point first
/// reaches it, and the committed path keeps it for as long as the stroke keeps its style.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct SvgStrokeHitRegion {
    style: libgfx_rust::path::StrokeStyle,
}

impl SvgStrokeHitRegion {
    pub fn new(style: libgfx_rust::path::StrokeStyle) -> Self {
        Self { style }
    }

    /// How far past the path its stroke can reach.
    pub fn outset(&self) -> f32 {
        let mut factor = 1.0f32;
        if self.style.join_style == libgfx_rust::JoinStyle::Miter {
            factor = factor.max(self.style.miter_limit);
        }
        if self.style.cap_style == libgfx_rust::CapStyle::Square {
            factor = factor.max(std::f32::consts::SQRT_2);
        }
        self.style.thickness / 2.0 * factor
    }

    pub fn contains(&self, path: &crate::layout::fragment_tree::CommittedSvgPath, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool {
        path.stroke_with_style_contains(&self.style, x, y)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn to_css_point(local: libgfx_rust::FloatPoint) -> CssPixelPoint {
    CssPixelPoint::new(
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(local.x),
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(local.y),
    )
}

/*

use super::*;
use crate::painting::chrome_geometry::{ChromeGeometry, scrollbar_is_hidden};
use crate::painting::ffi::ScrollDirection;
use crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks;
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::visual_context::{
    NO_SORTING_CONTEXT, SortingContexts, SpatialNodeIndex, VisualContextTree, WorldTransforms,
};
use libgfx_rust::FloatPoint;
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub(super) struct DepthSortingState<'a> {
    tree: &'a VisualContextTree,
    point: CssPixelPoint,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
    world_transforms: &'a WorldTransforms,
    sorting_contexts: Option<SortingContexts>,
    depth_key_by_plane: HashMap<u32, Option<i64>>,
}

impl<'a> DepthSortingState<'a> {
    pub(super) fn new(
        callbacks: &'a FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks,
        tree: &'a VisualContextTree,
        point: CssPixelPoint,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            tree,
            point,
            device_pixels_per_css_pixel: callbacks.device_pixels_per_css_pixel as f32,
            world_transforms: callbacks.world_transforms(),
            sorting_contexts: None,
            depth_key_by_plane: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn sorting_contexts(&mut self) -> &SortingContexts {
        self.sorting_contexts
            .get_or_insert_with(|| self.tree.resolve_sorting_contexts())
    }

    pub(super) fn group_for(&mut self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex) -> Option<u32> {
        let contexts = self.sorting_contexts();
        if contexts.is_empty() || contexts.leaf_by_node[spatial.0 as usize] == NO_SORTING_CONTEXT {
            None
        } else {
            Some(
                contexts
                    .outermost_context_of(contexts.context_by_node[spatial.0 as usize])
                    .0,
            )
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn depth_key_for(&mut self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex) -> Option<i64> {
        let contexts = self.sorting_contexts();
        if contexts.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let leaf = contexts.leaf_by_node[spatial.0 as usize];
        if leaf == NO_SORTING_CONTEXT {
            return None;
        }
        if let Some(depth_key) = self.depth_key_by_plane.get(&leaf.0) {
            return *depth_key;
        }

        let screen_point = libgfx_rust::FloatPoint {
            x: self.point.x.to_float() * self.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            y: self.point.y.to_float() * self.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
        };
        let depth = self
            .world_transforms
            .plane_depth_at_point_for_hit_test(leaf, screen_point);
        const DEPTH_LIMIT: f32 = 16777216.0;
        let depth_key = depth.map(|depth| (depth.clamp(-DEPTH_LIMIT, DEPTH_LIMIT) * 8.0).round() as i64);
        self.depth_key_by_plane.insert(leaf.0, depth_key);
        depth_key
    }
}

pub(super) fn item_contains_point(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    callbacks: &FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks,
    item: &HitTestItem,
    local: FloatPoint,
) -> bool {
    let local_point = to_css_point(local);
    match item.kind {
        HitTestItemKind::Box => {
            item.rect.contains_point(local_point) && item.border_radii.contains(local_point, item.rect)
        }
        HitTestItemKind::SvgPath => {
            // SVG paths test in float: their local units can map to many device pixels each.
            let rect = item.rect;
            let FloatPoint { x, y } = local;
            let in_rect = x >= rect.left().to_float()
                && x < rect.right().to_float()
                && y >= rect.top().to_float()
                && y < rect.bottom().to_float();
            if !in_rect {
                return false;
            }
            let Some(path) = item.path.as_ref() else {
                return false;
            };
            (item.svg_hit_areas & svg_hit_area::FILL != 0 && path.contains(x, y, item.winding_rule))
                || (item.svg_hit_areas & svg_hit_area::STROKE != 0
                    && item
                        .svg_stroke
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_some_and(|stroke| stroke.contains(path, x, y)))
        }
        HitTestItemKind::TextFragment => item.rect.contains_point(local_point),
        HitTestItemKind::EmptyEditable => item.rect.contains_point(local_point),
        HitTestItemKind::ChromeWidget => {
            if !layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(item.paintable) {
                return false;
            }
            assert!(
                callbacks.has_chrome_metrics,
                "chrome widget hit testing needs the chrome metrics"
            );
            let node = item.paintable;
            let rows = layout_arena;
            let chrome_geometry = ChromeGeometry::for_hit_test_query(rows, callbacks);
            match item.chrome_widget_kind {
                1 => chrome_geometry.resizer_contains(node, local_point),
                2 | 3 => {
                    let direction = if item.chrome_widget_kind == 2 {
                        ScrollDirection::Horizontal
                    } else {
                        ScrollDirection::Vertical
                    };
                    // An overlay scrollbar that has faded out takes no pointer input, as in Chromium. The
                    // compositor grows a hovered scrollbar, which is hit tested here as it is before it grows.
                    !scrollbar_is_hidden(rows, node, direction)
                        && chrome_geometry
                            .absolute_scrollbar_rect(node, direction, false)
                            .is_some_and(|rect| rect.contains_point(local_point))
                }
                _ => false,
            }
        }
    }
}

/*

use super::*;
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeFlag, NodeKind};
use crate::layout::node_facts::NodeShape;
use crate::painting::host::FfiNodeIdentity;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{PaintRead, PaintRow};

/// The DOM node a row stands for, named the way the host names one: by its StyleNodeID, or by 0
/// for a row that stands for no node of its own. An anonymous row stands for none, and so does
/// the viewport row, whose node is the document, which has no StyleNodeID.
pub(crate) fn row_dom_style_node(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> u32 {
    match arena.node(slot) {
        Some(row) if row.is_dom_backed() && row.kind() != NodeKind::Viewport => {
            row.style_node().map_or(0, |style_node| style_node.raw())
        }
        _ => 0,
    }
}

/// The DOM node the item dispatches events to. A text fragment generated for a pseudo-element
/// dispatches to the pseudo-element's generator.
pub(crate) fn item_dispatch_target(arena: &impl PaintRead, item: &HitTestItem) -> FfiNodeIdentity {
    match item.kind {
        HitTestItemKind::TextFragment => fragment_layout_node_slot(arena, item)
            .map_or_else(FfiNodeIdentity::default, |slot| row_node_identity(arena, slot, true)),
        _ => event_dispatch_target_of_paintable(arena, item.paintable),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn resolve_hit(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    item: &HitTestItem,
    local_point: CssPixelPoint,
) -> crate::painting::host::FfiResolvedHit {
    let mut result = crate::painting::host::FfiResolvedHit {
        dispatch: item_dispatch_target(arena, item),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    match item.kind {
        HitTestItemKind::TextFragment => {
            result.fallback_dispatch = event_dispatch_target_of_paintable(arena, item.paintable);
            result.has_index_in_node = true;
            result.index_in_node = fragment_index_in_node_for_point(arena, item, local_point);
            result.is_text_fragment = true;
        }
        HitTestItemKind::EmptyEditable => {
            result.has_index_in_node = true;
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    result
}

pub(crate) fn with_item_fragment<R>(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    item: &HitTestItem,
    f: impl FnOnce(&crate::painting::paintable_data::FragmentRecord) -> R,
) -> Option<R> {
    let fragment_index = item.text_fragment_index? as usize;
    arena
        .committed_side_data(item.paintable)
        .fragments()
        .get(fragment_index)
        .map(f)
}

pub(crate) fn fragment_layout_node_slot(arena: &impl PaintRead, item: &HitTestItem) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    with_item_fragment(arena, item, |fragment| fragment.layout_node)
}

/// The DOM node a hit on the paintable dispatches events to: the paintable's own node, or that of
/// the nearest paint ancestor that stands for one.
pub(crate) fn event_dispatch_target_of_paintable(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> FfiNodeIdentity {
    let paintable_rows = arena;
    let mut current = paintable_rows.paintable_row_is_populated(slot).then_some(slot);
    while let Some(paintable) = current {
        if arena.node_flags_if_live(paintable) & NodeFlag::Anonymous as u32 == 0 {
            return row_node_identity(arena, paintable, false);
        }
        current = crate::painting::paint_order::paint_parent(paintable_rows, paintable);
    }
    FfiNodeIdentity::default()
}

/// The DOM node a row stands for: the document for the viewport, and the row's identity for any
/// other row built for a node. An anonymous row stands for none, unless `allow_pseudo_fallback`
/// lets a row generated for a pseudo-element stand for its generator.
pub(crate) fn row_node_identity(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    allow_pseudo_fallback: bool,
) -> FfiNodeIdentity {
    let Some(row) = arena.node(slot) else {
        return FfiNodeIdentity::default();
    };
    if row.kind() == NodeKind::Viewport {
        return FfiNodeIdentity {
            style_node: 0,
            is_document: true,
        };
    }
    let is_anonymous = row.flags() & NodeFlag::Anonymous as u32 != 0;
    if is_anonymous && !(allow_pseudo_fallback && row.generated_for() != 0) {
        return FfiNodeIdentity::default();
    }
    FfiNodeIdentity {
        style_node: row.style_node().map_or(0, |style_node| style_node.raw()),
        is_document: false,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn fragment_index_in_node_for_point(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    item: &HitTestItem,
    local_point: CssPixelPoint,
) -> usize {
    with_item_fragment(arena, item, |fragment| {
        let paintable_rows = arena;
        crate::painting::text_fragment::index_in_node_for_point(paintable_rows, fragment, local_point)
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/*

//! Hit testing by walking the document's paint order over its rows.
//!
//! The walk follows the plans the display list recorder records by, so what it meets is in paint order, and a point
//! is answered by walking that order backwards: the first item under the point is the topmost one. A scope whose
//! owner's ink overflow bounds it is skipped when the point lies outside the bound.

use super::items::{HitTestFacts, HitTestItemSink, hit_test_facts, hit_test_items_of_phase};
use super::query::{DepthSortingState, item_contains_point};
use super::*;
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeFlag, NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::painting::host::FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks;
use crate::painting::ink_overflow::HitTestBoundOfLine;
use crate::painting::paint_order_plan::{
    PaintOrderInputs, PaintOrderItem, PaintProducer, PaintScope, PaintScopeKind, PaintScopePlan, PlanLeavesOut,
};
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::paintable_data::PaintableFlag;
use crate::painting::record::PaintPhase;
use crate::painting::viewport_mapping::{ViewportMapping, ViewportSpace};
use crate::painting::visual_context::{
    ClipBehavior, IncludeVisualViewportTransform, SpatialNodeIndex, VisualContextTree, WorldTransforms,
};
use crate::painting::{node_painting, paintable_geometry};
use libgfx_rust::FloatPoint;
use smallvec::SmallVec;

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transforms-1/#transform-function-lists
// If a transform function causes the current transformation matrix of an object to be
// non-invertible, the object and its content do not get displayed. Content whose transform
// is animated is retained so the compositor can reveal it without a main-thread repaint.
pub(crate) fn stacking_context_paints(rows: &impl PaintRead, owner: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    !(rows
        .paintable_data(owner)
        .has_flag(PaintableFlag::HasNonInvertibleCssTransform)
        && rows.node_flags_if_live(owner) & NodeFlag::HasAnimatedOpacityOrTransform as u32 == 0)
}

/// Whether the SVG box paints nothing, and so can be hit nowhere, because a mask or clip path it references covers
/// no area.
fn svg_box_is_hidden_by_an_empty_mask_or_clip(rows: &impl PaintRead, svg_box: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    rows.paintable_data(svg_box)
        .has_flag(PaintableFlag::HiddenByEmptySvgMaskOrClip)
}

/// The boxes below an SVG box that its producer walks: those a stacking context of their own does not paint.
fn svg_children_painted_with_their_parent(rows: &impl PaintRead, svg_box: NodeSlotId) -> SmallVec<[NodeSlotId; 8]> {
    let mut children = SmallVec::new();
    let mut next_child = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(rows, svg_box);
    while let Some(child) = next_child {
        next_child = crate::painting::paint_order::next_paint_sibling(rows, child);
        if !rows.paintable_data(child).establishes_stacking_context {
            children.push(child);
        }
    }
    children
}

/// What a producer of the paint order can be hit by: the items of one phase of its box, or an SVG box with the boxes
/// painted with it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum HitTestedPart {
    Phase(PaintPhase),
    SvgBox,
}

/// What `producer` can be hit by, in paint order.
fn hit_tested_parts(producer: PaintProducer) -> SmallVec<[HitTestedPart; 2]> {
    use HitTestedPart::*;
    match producer {
        PaintProducer::BoxPhase(phase @ (PaintPhase::Background | PaintPhase::Foreground | PaintPhase::Overlay)) => {
            smallvec::smallvec![Phase(phase)]
        }
        PaintProducer::SvgRoot => smallvec::smallvec![Phase(PaintPhase::Background), SvgBox],
        PaintProducer::SvgBoxForeground => smallvec::smallvec![SvgBox],
        PaintProducer::ForegroundHitTest => smallvec::smallvec![Phase(PaintPhase::Foreground)],
        PaintProducer::BoxPhase(_)
        | PaintProducer::ForegroundCommands
        | PaintProducer::InlinePiece(_)
        | PaintProducer::TextFragment(_)
        | PaintProducer::ScopePreamble => SmallVec::new(),
    }
}

// The scale of a space does not depend on where anything is scrolled to, so any table of the tree's spaces gives it.
fn own_accumulated_2d_scale(
    rows: &impl PaintRead,
    spaces: &WorldTransforms,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
) -> libgfx_rust::FloatSize {
    spaces.accumulated_2d_scale(
        rows.paintable_data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context.spatial,
        IncludeVisualViewportTransform::No,
    )
}

struct WhatThePointMisses<'walk, 'a, R: PaintRead> {
    walk: &'walk mut PointWalk<'a, R>,
    owner: PlacedOwner,
}

impl<R: PaintRead> PlanLeavesOut for WhatThePointMisses<'_, '_, R> {
    const LEAVES_OUT_THE_SAME_CHILD_SCOPES_IN_EVERY_PHASE: bool = true;

    fn leaves_out_child_scope(&mut self, child: PaintScope, child_inputs: PaintOrderInputs) -> bool {
        self.walk.point_misses_child_scope(child, child_inputs, self.owner)
    }

    fn leaves_out_line(&mut self, line_root: NodeSlotId, line_index: u32) -> bool {
        line_root == self.owner.slot
            && self
                .walk
                .point_misses_line(line_root, line_index, self.owner.absolute_content_origin)
    }

    fn paint_children_kept_by_an_earlier_phase(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId) -> Option<&[NodeSlotId]> {
        self.walk
            .paint_children_the_point_may_be_over
            .get(&owner)
            .map(|children| children.as_slice())
    }

    fn keep_paint_children_for_later_phases(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, children_in_tree_order: &[NodeSlotId]) {
        self.walk
            .paint_children_the_point_may_be_over
            .insert(owner, SmallVec::from_slice(children_in_tree_order));
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct PlacedOwner {
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    absolute_content_origin: CssPixelPoint,
    places_children_at_their_committed_offsets: bool,
}

/// An item under a point, with the point in the space of the item.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct PointHit {
    pub item: HitTestItem,
    pub local_point: CssPixelPoint,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Wanted {
    Topmost,
    Everything,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Flow {
    Continue,
    Stop,
}

struct PointWalk<'a, R: PaintRead> {
    rows: &'a R,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    callbacks: &'a FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks,
    viewport_mapping: ViewportMapping<'a>,
    point: CssPixelPoint,
    paint_overlay: bool,
    wanted: Wanted,
    skips_scopes_the_point_misses: bool,
    depth_sorting: DepthSortingState<'a>,
    local_points_inside_clips: FastMap<ContextRef, Option<FloatPoint>>,
    local_points_ignoring_clips: FastMap<SpatialNodeIndex, Option<FloatPoint>>,
    last_local_point_ignoring_clips: Option<(SpatialNodeIndex, Option<FloatPoint>)>,
    hits_of_producer_in_paint_order: Vec<PointHit>,
    paint_children_the_point_may_be_over: FastMap<NodeSlotId, SmallVec<[NodeSlotId; 8]>>,
    /// What lies under the point, topmost first as the walk met it.
    hits: Vec<PointHit>,
    /// The 3D rendering context the topmost hit is in, whose planes paint sorted by depth: the walk goes on until
    /// it leaves the context, and the plane nearest the viewer wins.
    sorting_group_of_topmost_hit: Option<u32>,
    walk_left_the_sorting_group: bool,
}

impl<R: PaintRead> HitTestItemSink for PointWalk<'_, R> {
    fn hit_test_facts(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> HitTestFacts {
        hit_test_facts(self.rows, paintable)
    }

    fn own_accumulated_2d_scale(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> libgfx_rust::FloatSize {
        own_accumulated_2d_scale(self.rows, self.callbacks.world_transforms(), paintable)
    }

    fn wants(&mut self, kind: HitTestItemKind, rect: CssPixelRect, context: ContextRef) -> bool {
        if let Some(group) = self.sorting_group_of_topmost_hit
            && self.depth_sorting.group_for(context.spatial) != Some(group)
        {
            self.walk_left_the_sorting_group = true;
            return false;
        }
        let Some(local) = self.local_point_inside_clips(context) else {
            return false;
        };
        // A chrome widget is placed when it is tested, and a path is tested in float units. Everything else lies in
        // its rect, which one unit of slack keeps from being rejected by rounding the point.
        let one_unit = CssPixels::from_raw(1);
        kind == HitTestItemKind::ChromeWidget
            || kind == HitTestItemKind::SvgPath
            || rect
                .inflated(one_unit, one_unit, one_unit, one_unit)
                .contains_point(to_css_point(local))
    }

    fn rejects_text_fragments_placed_at_their_line_root_before_building_them(&self) -> bool {
        self.skips_scopes_the_point_misses
    }

    fn misses_line(
        &mut self,
        line_root: NodeSlotId,
        line_index: u32,
        line_root_absolute_content_origin: CssPixelPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        self.point_misses_line(line_root, line_index, line_root_absolute_content_origin)
    }

    fn append(&mut self, item: HitTestItem) {
        let Some(local) = self.local_point_inside_clips(item.context) else {
            return;
        };
        if item_contains_point(self.rows, self.callbacks, &item, local) {
            self.hits_of_producer_in_paint_order.push(PointHit {
                item,
                local_point: to_css_point(local),
            });
        }
    }
}

impl<R: PaintRead> PointWalk<'_, R> {
    fn local_point(&self, context: ContextRef, clip_behavior: ClipBehavior) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        self.viewport_mapping
            .point_to_local(context, self.point, ViewportSpace::VisualViewport, clip_behavior)
    }

    fn local_point_inside_clips(&mut self, context: ContextRef) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        if let Some(local) = self.local_points_inside_clips.get(&context) {
            return *local;
        }
        let local = self.local_point(context, ClipBehavior::Respect);
        self.local_points_inside_clips.insert(context, local);
        local
    }

    fn local_point_ignoring_clips(&mut self, context: ContextRef) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        if let Some((spatial, local)) = self.last_local_point_ignoring_clips
            && spatial == context.spatial
        {
            return local;
        }
        let local = match self.local_points_ignoring_clips.get(&context.spatial) {
            Some(local) => *local,
            None => {
                let local = self.local_point(context, ClipBehavior::Ignore);
                self.local_points_ignoring_clips.insert(context.spatial, local);
                local
            }
        };
        self.last_local_point_ignoring_clips = Some((context.spatial, local));
        local
    }

    fn placed_owner(&self, owner: NodeSlotId, absolute_content_origin: CssPixelPoint) -> PlacedOwner {
        PlacedOwner {
            slot: owner,
            absolute_content_origin,
            places_children_at_their_committed_offsets: self.rows.node_kind_if_live(owner).is_some_and(|kind| {
                kind != NodeKind::SVGSVGBox && kind != NodeKind::SVGForeignObjectBox && !node_painting::is_svg(kind)
            }),
        }
    }

    fn is_placed_at_its_committed_offset_in(&self, child: NodeSlotId, owner: PlacedOwner) -> bool {
        let data = self.rows.paintable_data(child);
        owner.places_children_at_their_committed_offsets
            && data.containing_block == owner.slot
            && !data.has_flag(PaintableFlag::InLaterContainingBlockFragment)
    }

    fn absolute_content_origin_of_child(&self, child: NodeSlotId, owner: PlacedOwner) -> CssPixelPoint {
        if self.is_placed_at_its_committed_offset_in(child, owner) {
            let offset: CssPixelPoint = paintable_geometry::committed_offset(self.rows, child).into();
            return owner.absolute_content_origin.translated(offset.x, offset.y);
        }
        paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(self.rows, child).location()
    }

    fn point_misses_line(
        &mut self,
        line_root: NodeSlotId,
        line_index: u32,
        line_root_absolute_content_origin: CssPixelPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        let rows = self.rows;
        let side = rows.committed_side_data(line_root);
        let Some(bounds) = side.hit_test_bounds_of_lines.as_deref() else {
            return false;
        };
        if bounds.len() != side.lines().len() {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(HitTestBoundOfLine::RectInContentBoxOfLineRoot(bound)) = bounds.get(line_index as usize) else {
            return false;
        };
        let bound = bound.translated_by(line_root_absolute_content_origin);
        let context = rows
            .paintable_data(line_root)
            .accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants;
        let Some(local) = self.local_point_ignoring_clips(context) else {
            return false;
        };
        let one_pixel = CssPixels::from_integer(1);
        !bound
            .inflated(one_pixel, one_pixel, one_pixel, one_pixel)
            .contains_point(to_css_point(local))
    }

    /// Whether nothing the child scope paints can be under the point. A point that cannot be taken into the space of
    /// the child's box misses nothing.
    fn point_misses_child_scope(
        &mut self,
        child: PaintScope,
        child_inputs: PaintOrderInputs,
        owner: PlacedOwner,
    ) -> bool {
        let rows = self.rows;
        if child.owner == self.viewport
            || !rows.paintable_row_is_populated(child.owner)
            || !child_inputs.forms_containing_block_for_children()
        {
            return false;
        }
        let ink = rows.stored_ink_overflow(child.owner);
        if ink.unbounded || ink.contribution_unbounded {
            return false;
        }
        let (offset, padding_left, padding_top): (CssPixelPoint, CssPixels, CssPixels) = rows
            .with_committed_fragment_link(child.owner, |link| {
                link.map_or_else(Default::default, |link| {
                    (
                        link.offset.into(),
                        link.fragment.sides.padding.left,
                        link.fragment.sides.padding.top,
                    )
                })
            });
        let content_origin = if self.is_placed_at_its_committed_offset_in(child.owner, owner) {
            owner.absolute_content_origin.translated(offset.x, offset.y)
        } else {
            paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(rows, child.owner).location()
        };
        let padding_box_origin = CssPixelPoint::new(content_origin.x - padding_left, content_origin.y - padding_top);
        let bound = ink.rect.translated_by(padding_box_origin);
        let data = rows.paintable_data(child.owner);
        let Some(local) = self.local_point_ignoring_clips(data.accumulated_visual_context) else {
            return false;
        };
        let one_pixel = CssPixels::from_integer(1);
        if bound
            .inflated(one_pixel, one_pixel, one_pixel, one_pixel)
            .contains_point(to_css_point(local))
        {
            return false;
        }
        let paints_boxes_hoisted_to_it =
            child.kind == PaintScopeKind::PaintedAsStackingContext && data.establishes_stacking_context;
        !paints_boxes_hoisted_to_it || child.owner_contains_the_boxes_hoisted_to_its_stacking_context(rows)
    }

    fn scope(&mut self, scope: PaintScope, owner_absolute_content_origin: CssPixelPoint) -> Flow {
        let rows = self.rows;
        let owner = self.placed_owner(scope.owner, owner_absolute_content_origin);
        let plan = if self.skips_scopes_the_point_misses {
            let paint_overlay = self.paint_overlay;
            PaintScopePlan::build_leaving_out(
                rows,
                scope,
                paint_overlay,
                &mut WhatThePointMisses { walk: self, owner },
            )
        } else {
            PaintScopePlan::build(rows, scope, self.paint_overlay)
        };
        if plan.establishes_stacking_context && !stacking_context_paints(rows, scope.owner) {
            return Flow::Continue;
        }
        for item in plan.items.iter().rev() {
            let flow = match *item {
                PaintOrderItem::Producer(producer) => hit_tested_parts(producer)
                    .into_iter()
                    .rev()
                    .map(|part| self.part(scope.owner, part))
                    .find(|flow| *flow == Flow::Stop)
                    .unwrap_or(Flow::Continue),
                PaintOrderItem::Scope(child) => {
                    let child_origin = self.absolute_content_origin_of_child(child.owner, owner);
                    self.scope(child, child_origin)
                }
            };
            if flow == Flow::Stop {
                return Flow::Stop;
            }
        }
        Flow::Continue
    }

    fn part(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, part: HitTestedPart) -> Flow {
        match part {
            HitTestedPart::Phase(phase) => self.items_of_phase(owner, phase),
            HitTestedPart::SvgBox => self.svg_box(owner),
        }
    }

    fn svg_box(&mut self, svg_box: NodeSlotId) -> Flow {
        if svg_box_is_hidden_by_an_empty_mask_or_clip(self.rows, svg_box) {
            return Flow::Continue;
        }
        for child in svg_children_painted_with_their_parent(self.rows, svg_box)
            .into_iter()
            .rev()
        {
            if self.svg_box(child) == Flow::Stop {
                return Flow::Stop;
            }
        }
        self.items_of_phase(svg_box, PaintPhase::Foreground)
    }

    fn items_of_phase(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) -> Flow {
        let rows = self.rows;
        debug_assert!(self.hits_of_producer_in_paint_order.is_empty());
        hit_test_items_of_phase(rows, self, owner, phase);
        let mut hits = std::mem::take(&mut self.hits_of_producer_in_paint_order);
        let mut flow = if self.walk_left_the_sorting_group {
            Flow::Stop
        } else {
            Flow::Continue
        };
        for hit in hits.drain(..).rev() {
            if flow == Flow::Continue {
                flow = self.take_hit(hit);
            }
        }
        self.hits_of_producer_in_paint_order = hits;
        flow
    }

    fn take_hit(&mut self, hit: PointHit) -> Flow {
        if self.wanted == Wanted::Everything {
            self.hits.push(hit);
            return Flow::Continue;
        }
        let group = self.depth_sorting.group_for(hit.item.context.spatial);
        if self.hits.is_empty() {
            self.hits.push(hit);
            self.sorting_group_of_topmost_hit = group;
            return if group.is_some() { Flow::Continue } else { Flow::Stop };
        }
        // A context's items are consecutive in paint order, so the first hit outside it ends it.
        if group != self.sorting_group_of_topmost_hit {
            return Flow::Stop;
        }
        self.hits.push(hit);
        Flow::Continue
    }

    /// The key hits on the planes of one 3D rendering context sort by, greatest in front: the depth of the plane at
    /// the point, and for planes at one depth their paint order, which is the reverse of the order the walk met
    /// them in.
    fn front_to_back_key(&mut self, position_among_hits: usize) -> (Option<i64>, std::cmp::Reverse<usize>) {
        let spatial = self.hits[position_among_hits].item.context.spatial;
        (
            self.depth_sorting.depth_key_for(spatial),
            std::cmp::Reverse(position_among_hits),
        )
    }

    fn topmost(mut self) -> Option<PointHit> {
        let front = (0..self.hits.len()).max_by_key(|position| self.front_to_back_key(*position))?;
        Some(self.hits.swap_remove(front))
    }

    // Runs of hits on the planes of one 3D rendering context are reordered front to back. A context's items are
    // consecutive in paint order, so its hits sit next to each other.
    fn everything_topmost_first(mut self) -> Vec<PointHit> {
        let no_hit_is_on_a_plane_ranked_by_depth = (0..self.hits.len()).all(|position| {
            let spatial = self.hits[position].item.context.spatial;
            self.depth_sorting.group_for(spatial).is_none()
        });
        if no_hit_is_on_a_plane_ranked_by_depth {
            return self.hits;
        }
        let mut order: Vec<usize> = (0..self.hits.len()).collect();
        let mut run_begin = 0;
        while run_begin < order.len() {
            let group = self.depth_sorting.group_for(self.hits[run_begin].item.context.spatial);
            let mut run_end = run_begin + 1;
            if group.is_some() {
                while run_end < order.len()
                    && self.depth_sorting.group_for(self.hits[run_end].item.context.spatial) == group
                {
                    run_end += 1;
                }
                order[run_begin..run_end].sort_by_key(|position| std::cmp::Reverse(self.front_to_back_key(*position)));
            }
            run_begin = run_end;
        }
        let mut hits: Vec<Option<PointHit>> = self.hits.into_iter().map(Some).collect();
        order
            .into_iter()
            .map(|position| hits[position].take().expect("every hit is taken once"))
            .collect()
    }
}

/// What a point query reads besides the rows.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct PointQuery<'a> {
    pub tree: &'a VisualContextTree,
    pub callbacks: &'a FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks,
    pub viewport: NodeSlotId,
    pub paint_overlay: bool,
    pub point: CssPixelPoint,
}

fn walk_for<'a, R: PaintRead>(
    rows: &'a R,
    query: PointQuery<'a>,
    wanted: Wanted,
    skips_scopes_the_point_misses: bool,
) -> PointWalk<'a, R> {
    let mut walk = PointWalk {
        rows,
        viewport: query.viewport,
        callbacks: query.callbacks,
        viewport_mapping: query.callbacks.viewport_mapping(query.tree),
        point: query.point,
        paint_overlay: query.paint_overlay,
        wanted,
        skips_scopes_the_point_misses,
        depth_sorting: DepthSortingState::new(query.callbacks, query.tree, query.point),
        local_points_inside_clips: FastMap::default(),
        local_points_ignoring_clips: FastMap::default(),
        last_local_point_ignoring_clips: None,
        hits_of_producer_in_paint_order: Vec::new(),
        paint_children_the_point_may_be_over: FastMap::default(),
        hits: Vec::new(),
        sorting_group_of_topmost_hit: None,
        walk_left_the_sorting_group: false,
    };
    if rows.paintable_row_is_populated(query.viewport) {
        let viewport_origin = paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(rows, query.viewport).location();
        walk.scope(PaintScope::stacking_context(query.viewport), viewport_origin);
    }
    walk
}

fn skipped_scopes_are_verified() -> bool {
    static VERIFIED: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *VERIFIED.get_or_init(|| cfg!(debug_assertions) || std::env::var_os("LIBWEB_VERIFY_HIT_TEST_PRUNING").is_some())
}

/// The topmost item under the point.
pub(crate) fn topmost_hit(rows: &impl PaintRead, query: PointQuery<'_>) -> Option<PointHit> {
    let hit = walk_for(rows, query, Wanted::Topmost, true).topmost();
    if skipped_scopes_are_verified() {
        let hit_without_skipping = walk_for(rows, query, Wanted::Topmost, false).topmost();
        assert!(
            hit == hit_without_skipping,
            "Skipping paint scopes by their ink bounds changed the topmost hit at {:?}: {hit:?} instead of {hit_without_skipping:?}",
            query.point
        );
    }
    hit
}

/// Every item under the point, topmost first.
pub(crate) fn all_hits(rows: &impl PaintRead, query: PointQuery<'_>) -> Vec<PointHit> {
    let hits = walk_for(rows, query, Wanted::Everything, true).everything_topmost_first();
    if skipped_scopes_are_verified() {
        let hits_without_skipping = walk_for(rows, query, Wanted::Everything, false).everything_topmost_first();
        assert!(
            hits == hits_without_skipping,
            "Skipping paint scopes by their ink bounds changed the hits at {:?}: {hits:?} instead of {hits_without_skipping:?}",
            query.point
        );
        let topmost_without_skipping = walk_for(rows, query, Wanted::Topmost, false).topmost();
        assert!(
            topmost_without_skipping.as_ref() == hits_without_skipping.first(),
            "The walk that stops at the topmost hit at {:?} found {topmost_without_skipping:?} instead of {:?}",
            query.point,
            hits_without_skipping.first()
        );
    }
    hits
}

use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::layout::used_values;
use std::ffi::c_void;

/// What the host gives a query of its document's hit test list. The query finds the document scrolled where the scroll
/// state the host keeps has it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiHitTestQuery {
    pub device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    pub chrome_metrics: crate::painting::ffi::FfiChromeMetrics,
    /// Where set, the query reads the compositor's animations at this time, as a frame of the compositor's shows them.
    pub has_visual_animation_sample_time: bool,
    pub visual_animation_sample_time_ns: i64,
}

/// What a query of a hit test list reads besides the list, as an entry point put it together.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks {
    pub device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    /// Where the query finds the document scrolled to: the scroll state the host keeps, or the offsets a clock lane
    /// sealed.
    scroll_offsets: *const libgfx_rust::FloatPoint,
    scroll_offsets_len: usize,
    /// The world transforms an entry point builds for the query, from the tree it reads and the offsets.
    world_transforms: *const c_void,
    pub has_chrome_metrics: bool,
    pub chrome_metrics: crate::painting::ffi::FfiChromeMetrics,
    /// Where set, the query reads the compositor's animations at this time, as a frame of the compositor's shows them.
    pub has_visual_animation_sample_time: bool,
    pub visual_animation_sample_time_ns: i64,
}

impl FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks {
    /// Callbacks for a point query on the render owner, which reaches nothing of the host: the scroll offsets and
    /// chrome metrics are copies the host sealed.
    pub(crate) fn sealed(
        device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
        scroll_offsets: &[libgfx_rust::FloatPoint],
        chrome_metrics: crate::painting::ffi::FfiChromeMetrics,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            scroll_offsets: scroll_offsets.as_ptr(),
            scroll_offsets_len: scroll_offsets.len(),
            world_transforms: std::ptr::null(),
            has_chrome_metrics: true,
            chrome_metrics,
            has_visual_animation_sample_time: false,
            visual_animation_sample_time_ns: 0,
        }
    }

    /// Callbacks for `query`, a query of the host's, which finds the document scrolled to `scroll_offsets`. The entry
    /// point keeps the offsets for the query.
    pub(crate) fn for_host_query(query: &FfiHitTestQuery, scroll_offsets: &[libgfx_rust::FloatPoint]) -> Self {
        Self {
            device_pixels_per_css_pixel: query.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            scroll_offsets: scroll_offsets.as_ptr(),
            scroll_offsets_len: scroll_offsets.len(),
            world_transforms: std::ptr::null(),
            has_chrome_metrics: true,
            chrome_metrics: query.chrome_metrics,
            has_visual_animation_sample_time: query.has_visual_animation_sample_time,
            visual_animation_sample_time_ns: query.visual_animation_sample_time_ns,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn visual_animation_sample_time_ns(&self) -> Option<i64> {
        self.has_visual_animation_sample_time
            .then_some(self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns)
    }

    /// The world transforms of `tree`, the tree the query reads, under these callbacks' offsets.
    pub(crate) fn build_world_transforms(
        &self,
        tree: &crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree,
    ) -> crate::painting::visual_context::WorldTransforms {
        crate::painting::visual_context::WorldTransforms::new(tree, self.scroll_offsets(), None)
    }

    /// These callbacks with the world transforms the query reads, which `world` holds for the query.
    pub(crate) fn with_world_transforms(mut self, world: &crate::painting::visual_context::WorldTransforms) -> Self {
        self.world_transforms = std::ptr::from_ref(world).cast();
        self
    }

    /// The mapping between the viewport and the spaces of `tree`, the tree the query reads, under these callbacks'
    /// offsets.
    pub(crate) fn viewport_mapping<'a>(
        &'a self,
        tree: &'a crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree,
    ) -> crate::painting::viewport_mapping::ViewportMapping<'a> {
        crate::painting::viewport_mapping::ViewportMapping::new(
            tree,
            self.world_transforms(),
            self.scroll_offsets(),
            self.device_pixels_per_css_pixel as f32,
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn world_transforms(&self) -> &crate::painting::visual_context::WorldTransforms {
        assert!(
            !self.world_transforms.is_null(),
            "the query's entry point builds its world transforms"
        );
        // SAFETY: The entry point keeps the table alive for the synchronous query.
        unsafe {
            &*self
                .world_transforms
                .cast::<crate::painting::visual_context::WorldTransforms>()
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn scroll_offsets(&self) -> &[libgfx_rust::FloatPoint] {
        if self.scroll_offsets.is_null() {
            return &[];
        }
        // SAFETY: The entry point keeps the offsets alive for the synchronous query.
        unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(self.scroll_offsets, self.scroll_offsets_len) }
    }
}
