pub use crate::layout::inline_content::{FragmentRecord, GlyphRunRecord, InlineBoxPieceRecord};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum BorderEdge {
    Top,
    Right,
    Bottom,
    Left,
}

impl BorderEdge {
    pub const ALL: [BorderEdge; 4] = [BorderEdge::Top, BorderEdge::Right, BorderEdge::Bottom, BorderEdge::Left];
}

pub const PIECE_EDGE_TOP: u8 = 1 << 0;
pub const PIECE_EDGE_RIGHT: u8 = 1 << 1;
pub const PIECE_EDGE_BOTTOM: u8 = 1 << 2;
pub const PIECE_EDGE_LEFT: u8 = 1 << 3;

impl InlineBoxPieceRecord {
    pub fn shrunken_by_present_edges(
        &self,
        rect: crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect,
        widths: FfiPixelBox,
    ) -> crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect {
        let zero = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
        let has = |edge: u8| self.present_edges & edge != 0;
        rect.shrunken(
            if has(PIECE_EDGE_TOP) { widths.top } else { zero },
            if has(PIECE_EDGE_RIGHT) { widths.right } else { zero },
            if has(PIECE_EDGE_BOTTOM) { widths.bottom } else { zero },
            if has(PIECE_EDGE_LEFT) { widths.left } else { zero },
        )
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct PaintableSideData {
    // Invalidation also runs while paint geometry is borrowed. Keep this
    // mutable cache state out of the plain-data row shared with C++.
    pub(crate) overflow_style: Option<crate::painting::scrollable_overflow::OverflowStyle>,
    // The filter a recommit cleared, kept so the next assignment can tell whether the box
    // paints a different selection of fragments than before.
    pub(crate) fragment_ownership_before_recommit:
        Option<std::sync::Arc<crate::painting::fragment_ownership::FragmentOwnershipFilter>>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct CommittedBoxFragment {
    pub(crate) link: crate::layout::fragment_tree::FragmentLink,
    pub(crate) containing_block_fragment: u32,
}

/// What a row committed beside its geometry that painting reads with it: its inline content and what paint
/// preparation adds for the recording. Shared records are held by `Arc`, so copying a row
/// copies reference counts.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct CommittedSideData {
    pub(crate) inline_content: Option<std::sync::Arc<crate::layout::inline_content::InlineContent>>,
    /// The bounds of the SVG filter the box references, as the visual context update resolved
    /// them.
    pub(crate) svg_filter_bounds: Option<used_values::FfiCssPixelRect>,
    // Only meaningful while is_self_painting(); assigned by the containing block's
    // assign_fragment_ownership().
    pub(crate) fragment_ownership: Option<std::sync::Arc<crate::painting::fragment_ownership::FragmentOwnershipFilter>>,
    /// The paint-order decisions paint preparation gathered for the row, if it gathered them.
    pub(crate) order_inputs: crate::painting::paint_order_plan::PaintOrderInputs,
    pub(crate) containing_block_fragment: u32,
    pub(crate) box_fragments: Option<std::sync::Arc<Vec<CommittedBoxFragment>>>,
    pub(crate) hit_test_bounds_of_lines: Option<std::sync::Arc<[crate::painting::ink_overflow::HitTestBoundOfLine]>>,
}

/// Rows are the same when they hold equal records; a shared record is compared only when the rows
/// hold different allocations of it.
impl PartialEq for CommittedSideData {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        use crate::cow_column::same_payload;
        self.svg_filter_bounds == other.svg_filter_bounds
            && self.order_inputs == other.order_inputs
            && same_payload(
                self.fragment_ownership.as_ref(),
                other.fragment_ownership.as_ref(),
                |a, b| a == b,
            )
            && same_payload(self.inline_content.as_ref(), other.inline_content.as_ref(), |a, b| {
                a == b
            })
            && self.containing_block_fragment == other.containing_block_fragment
            && same_payload(
                self.hit_test_bounds_of_lines.as_ref(),
                other.hit_test_bounds_of_lines.as_ref(),
                |a, b| a == b,
            )
            && same_payload(self.box_fragments.as_ref(), other.box_fragments.as_ref(), |a, b| {
                a.len() == b.len()
                    && a.iter().zip(b.iter()).all(|(left, right)| {
                        left.containing_block_fragment == right.containing_block_fragment
                            && left.link.places_same_fragment_identically_to(&right.link)
                    })
            })
    }
}

impl CommittedSideData {
    pub(crate) fn prepared_order_inputs(&self) -> Option<crate::painting::paint_order_plan::PaintOrderInputs> {
        self.order_inputs.is_initialized().then_some(self.order_inputs)
    }

    pub(crate) fn box_fragments(&self) -> &[CommittedBoxFragment] {
        self.box_fragments.as_deref().map_or(&[], Vec::as_slice)
    }

    pub(crate) fn lines(&self) -> &[crate::layout::inline_content::LineRecord] {
        self.inline_content.as_ref().map_or(&[], |content| &content.lines)
    }
    pub(crate) fn fragments(&self) -> &[FragmentRecord] {
        self.inline_content.as_ref().map_or(&[], |content| &content.fragments)
    }
    pub(crate) fn glyph_ink_of_lines(&self) -> &[crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect] {
        self.inline_content
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(&[], |content| content.glyph_ink_of_lines())
    }
    /// For a line root, the indices of the fragments of `node` among its fragments, in fragment order.
    pub(crate) fn fragment_indices_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> &[u32] {
        self.inline_content
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(&[], |content| content.fragment_indices_of(node))
    }
    pub(crate) fn fragmentless_break_lines_of(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> &[u32] {
        self.inline_content
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(&[], |content| content.fragmentless_break_lines_of(node))
    }
    pub(crate) fn inline_box_pieces(&self) -> &[InlineBoxPieceRecord] {
        self.inline_content
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(&[], |content| &content.inline_box_pieces)
    }
    /// For a line root, the indices of the pieces of the inline box `node` among its inline box pieces, in line order.
    pub(crate) fn inline_box_piece_indices(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> &[u32] {
        self.inline_content
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(&[], |content| content.inline_boxes.piece_indices_of(node))
    }
}

pub(crate) fn committed_offset(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint {
    // NB: An inline box without pieces keeps the geometry its link gives it.
    if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, slot)
        && let Some(unions) = crate::painting::inline_box_geometry::unions(arena, slot)
    {
        return unions.content.location().into();
    }
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map_or_else(used_values::FfiCssPixelPoint::default, |link| link.offset)
    })
}

pub(crate) fn committed_content_size(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> used_values::FfiCssPixelSize {
    if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, slot)
        && let Some(unions) = crate::painting::inline_box_geometry::unions(arena, slot)
    {
        return unions.content.size().into();
    }
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map_or_else(used_values::FfiCssPixelSize::default, |link| {
            link.fragment.sides.content_size
        })
    })
}

pub(crate) fn committed_margin(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> FfiPixelBox {
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map_or_else(FfiPixelBox::default, |link| link.placement.shown_as.margins.into())
    })
}

pub(crate) fn committed_border(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> FfiPixelBox {
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map_or_else(FfiPixelBox::default, |link| link.fragment.sides.border.into())
    })
}

pub(crate) fn committed_padding(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> FfiPixelBox {
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map_or_else(FfiPixelBox::default, |link| link.fragment.sides.padding.into())
    })

pub(crate) fn committed_inset(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> FfiPixelBox {

pub(crate) fn committed_uses_collapsing_borders_model(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.is_some_and(|link| link.fragment.sides.collapsing.uses_collapsing_borders_model())
    })
}

/// For a table cell: whether every column it spans has 'visibility: collapse', which removes the cell from the display
/// along with the columns (CSS 2.2 §17.5.5).
pub(crate) fn committed_hidden_by_collapsed_columns(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.is_some_and(|link| link.placement.shown_as.facts.hidden_by_collapsed_columns)
    })
}

/// For a table cell or a table-column(-group) box: the first grid column it occupies and the number of grid columns
/// it spans.
pub(crate) fn committed_table_column_range(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> (u32, u32) {
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map_or((0, 0), |link| {
            (
                link.placement.shown_as.facts.table_column_index,
                link.placement.shown_as.facts.table_column_span,
            )
        })
    })
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_rect_or_default(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelRect {
    if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
        return CssPixelRect::default();
    }
    absolute_rect(arena, slot)
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_rect(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelRect {
    if let Some(rect) = arena.memoized_absolute_rect(slot) {
        return rect;
    }
    let data = arena.paintable_data(slot);
    let mut rect = CssPixelRect::from_location_and_size(
        committed_offset(arena, slot).into(),
        committed_content_size(arena, slot).into(),
    );
    if arena.node_kind_if_live(slot).is_some_and(node_painting::is_svg) {
        arena.memoize_absolute_rect(slot, rect);
        return rect;
    }
    let mut block = data.containing_block;
    let mut block_fragment = containing_block_fragment(arena, slot);
    while !block.is_invalid() && arena.paintable_row_is_populated(block) {
        if block_fragment != 0 {
            rect = rect.translated_by(absolute_fragment_rect(arena, block, block_fragment as usize).location());
            break;
        }
        let block_data = arena.paintable_data(block);
        let block_kind = arena.node_kind_if_live(block);
        if block_kind == Some(crate::layout::node_data::NodeKind::SVGSVGBox)
            || block_kind.is_some_and(node_painting::is_svg)
        {
            break;
        }
        if block_kind == Some(crate::layout::node_data::NodeKind::SVGForeignObjectBox) {
            rect = rect.translated_by(committed_offset(arena, block).into());
            break;
        }
        // A containing block whose rect this geometry already memoized carries its own containing blocks.
        if let Some(block_rect) = arena.memoized_absolute_rect(block) {
            rect = rect.translated_by(block_rect.location());
            break;
        }
        rect = rect.translated_by(committed_offset(arena, block).into());
        block_fragment = containing_block_fragment(arena, block);
        block = block_data.containing_block;
    }
    arena.memoize_absolute_rect(slot, rect);
    rect
}

fn containing_block_fragment(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> u32 {
    if !arena
        .paintable_data(slot)
        .has_flag(crate::painting::paintable_data::PaintableFlag::InLaterContainingBlockFragment)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    arena.committed_side_data(slot).containing_block_fragment
}

pub(crate) fn fragment_count(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> usize {
    if !arena
        .paintable_data(slot)
        .has_flag(crate::painting::paintable_data::PaintableFlag::HasLaterBoxFragments)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    1 + arena.committed_side_data(slot).box_fragments().len()
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_fragment_rect(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId, index: usize) -> CssPixelRect {
    if index == 0 {
        return absolute_rect(arena, slot);
    }
    let Some((rect, containing_block_fragment)) = with_later_box_fragment(arena, slot, index, |fragment| {
        let link = &fragment.link;
        (
            CssPixelRect::from_location_and_size(link.offset.into(), link.fragment.sides.content_size.into()),
            fragment.containing_block_fragment,
        )
    }) else {
        return absolute_rect(arena, slot);
    };
    let block = arena.paintable_data(slot).containing_block;
    if block.is_invalid() || !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(block) {
        return rect;
    }
    rect.translated_by(absolute_fragment_rect(arena, block, containing_block_fragment as usize).location())
}

fn with_later_box_fragment<R>(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    index: usize,
    read: impl FnOnce(&CommittedBoxFragment) -> R,
) -> Option<R> {
    arena.committed_side_data(slot).box_fragments().get(index - 1).map(read)
}

pub(crate) fn unbroken_content_size(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> used_values::FfiCssPixelSize {
    let mut size = committed_content_size(arena, slot);
    for fragment in arena.committed_side_data(slot).box_fragments() {
        size.height += fragment.link.fragment.sides.content_size.height;
    }
    size
}

pub(crate) fn unbroken_box_model(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
) -> (FfiPixelBox, FfiPixelBox, FfiPixelBox) {
    let (mut margin, mut padding, mut border) = (
        committed_margin(arena, slot),
        committed_padding(arena, slot),
        committed_border(arena, slot),
    );
    if let Some(last) = arena.committed_side_data(slot).box_fragments().last() {
        let fragment = &last.link.fragment;
        margin.bottom = last.link.placement.shown_as.margins.bottom;
        padding.bottom = fragment.sides.padding.bottom;
        border.bottom = fragment.sides.border.bottom;
    }
    (margin, padding, border)
}

pub(crate) fn unbroken_border_box_size(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> used_values::FfiCssPixelSize {
    let first_fragment = first_fragment_border_box_rect(arena, slot);
    if fragment_count(arena, slot) == 1 {
        return used_values::FfiCssPixelSize {
            width: first_fragment.width,
            height: first_fragment.height,
        };
    }
    let content = unbroken_content_size(arena, slot);
    let (_, padding, border) = unbroken_box_model(arena, slot);
    used_values::FfiCssPixelSize {
        width: first_fragment.width,
        height: content.height + padding.top + padding.bottom + border.top + border.bottom,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn committed_fragment_padding(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId, index: usize) -> FfiPixelBox {
    if index == 0 {
        return committed_padding(arena, slot);
    }
    with_later_box_fragment(arena, slot, index, |fragment| {
        fragment.link.fragment.sides.padding.into()
    })
    .unwrap_or_default()
}

pub(crate) fn committed_fragment_border(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId, index: usize) -> FfiPixelBox {
    if index == 0 {
        return committed_border_box_edges(arena, slot);
    }
    with_later_box_fragment(arena, slot, index, |fragment| {
        fragment.link.fragment.sides.border.into()
    })
    .unwrap_or_default()
}

pub(crate) fn committed_fragment_present_edges(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId, index: usize) -> u8 {
    let edges_of = |fragment: &crate::layout::fragment_tree::Fragment| {
        let mut edges = PIECE_EDGE_LEFT | PIECE_EDGE_RIGHT;
        if !fragment.breaks.continues_from_previous {
            edges |= PIECE_EDGE_TOP;
        }
        if !fragment.breaks.continues_in_next {
            edges |= PIECE_EDGE_BOTTOM;
        }
        edges
    };
    if index == 0 {
        return arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
            link.map_or(crate::painting::record::paint::border::ALL_PIECE_EDGES, |link| {
                edges_of(&link.fragment)
            })
        });
    }
    with_later_box_fragment(arena, slot, index, |fragment| edges_of(&fragment.link.fragment)).unwrap_or(0)
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_fragment_padding_box_rect(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    index: usize,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    if index == 0 {
        return first_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot);
    }
    let padding = committed_fragment_padding(arena, slot, index);
    absolute_fragment_rect(arena, slot, index).inflated(padding.top, padding.right, padding.bottom, padding.left)
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_fragment_border_box_rect(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    index: usize,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    if index == 0 {
        return first_fragment_border_box_rect(arena, slot);
    }
    let border = committed_fragment_border(arena, slot, index);
    absolute_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot, index).inflated(
        border.top,
        border.right,
        border.bottom,
        border.left,
    )
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct LineRootPositions(smallvec::SmallVec<[CssPixelPoint; 1]>);

impl LineRootPositions {
    pub(crate) fn new(arena: &impl GeometryRead, root: NodeSlotId) -> Self {
        Self(
            (0..fragment_count(arena, root))
                .map(|index| absolute_fragment_rect(arena, root, index).location())
                .collect(),
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn of_fragment(&self, box_fragment: u32) -> CssPixelPoint {
        self.0.get(box_fragment as usize).copied().unwrap_or(self.0[0])
    }

    pub(crate) fn of_line(
        &self,
        lines: &[crate::layout::inline_content::LineRecord],
        line_index: usize,
    ) -> CssPixelPoint {
        if self.0.len() == 1 {
            return self.0[0];
        }
        self.of_fragment(box_fragment_of_line(lines, line_index))
    }
}

fn box_fragment_of_line(lines: &[crate::layout::inline_content::LineRecord], line_index: usize) -> u32 {
    lines.get(line_index).map_or(0, |line| line.box_fragment)
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_line_root_position(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    root: NodeSlotId,
    line_index: usize,
) -> CssPixelPoint {
    let box_fragment = box_fragment_of_line(arena.committed_side_data(root).lines(), line_index);
    absolute_fragment_rect(arena, root, box_fragment as usize).location()
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_position(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelPoint {
    absolute_rect(arena, slot).location()
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_padding_box_rect(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelRect {
    let mut rect = first_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot);
    if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, slot) {
        return rect;
    }
    for index in 1..fragment_count(arena, slot) {
        rect.unite(absolute_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot, index));
    }
    rect
}

/// A union of the pieces of the inline box `slot`, placed where its content union lies at `absolute_content_rect`.
fn inline_box_union_at(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    absolute_content_rect: CssPixelRect,
    union: impl FnOnce(&crate::painting::inline_box_geometry::InlineBoxUnions) -> CssPixelRect,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    let Some(unions) = crate::painting::inline_box_geometry::unions(arena, slot) else {
        return CssPixelRect::from_location_and_size(absolute_content_rect.location(), Default::default());
    };
    union(&unions).translated(
        absolute_content_rect.x - unions.content.x,
        absolute_content_rect.y - unions.content.y,
    )
}

pub(crate) fn first_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelRect {
    let absolute = absolute_rect(arena, slot);
    if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, slot) {
        return inline_box_union_at(arena, slot, absolute, |unions| unions.padding);
    }
    let padding = committed_padding(arena, slot);
    let content_size = committed_content_size(arena, slot);
    CssPixelRect::new(
        absolute.x - padding.left,
        absolute.y - padding.top,
        content_size.width + padding.left + padding.right,
        content_size.height + padding.top + padding.bottom,
    )
}

/// The border widths that lie within the box's border box. In the collapsing borders model, a collapsed border is
/// centered on the grid line between two boxes, so only a part of it belongs to each: "the border-box of the table
/// includes half of the table border" and, for cells, "half the width of the collapsed border on each side".
/// https://www.w3.org/TR/CSS22/tables.html#collapsing-borders
/// The border is split the same way layout splits it when placing the boxes (`BoxMetricCells::border_left_collapsed`):
/// the part before the grid line goes to the box before the line, the part after it to the box after the line.
pub(crate) fn committed_border_box_edges(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> FfiPixelBox {
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map_or_else(FfiPixelBox::default, |link| {
            link.fragment.sides.border_box_edges().into()
        })
    })
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_border_box_rect(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelRect {
    let mut rect = first_fragment_border_box_rect(arena, slot);
    if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, slot) {
        return rect;
    }
    for index in 1..fragment_count(arena, slot) {
        rect.unite(absolute_fragment_border_box_rect(arena, slot, index));
    }
    rect
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_border_box_rects_of_fragments(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
) -> smallvec::SmallVec<[CssPixelRect; 1]> {
    let count = fragment_count(arena, slot);
    if count == 1 || node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, slot) {
        return smallvec::smallvec![absolute_border_box_rect(arena, slot)];
    }
    (0..count)
        .map(|index| absolute_fragment_border_box_rect(arena, slot, index))
        .collect()
}

pub(crate) fn first_fragment_border_box_rect(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelRect {
    if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(arena, slot) {
        return inline_box_union_at(arena, slot, absolute_rect(arena, slot), |unions| unions.border);
    }
    let padded = first_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot);
    let border = committed_border_box_edges(arena, slot);
    CssPixelRect::new(
        padded.x - border.left,
        padded.y - border.top,
        padded.width + border.left + border.right,
        padded.height + border.top + border.bottom,
    )
}

/// The scrollable overflow of the box in `slot`, united over its fragments, where its committed fragments hold one. An
/// inline box has none until it stores a scroll offset, which its padding box then bounds.
pub(crate) fn scrollable_overflow_rect(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
    if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
        return None;
    }
    if !arena
        .node_kind_if_live(slot)
        .is_some_and(crate::layout::node_facts::kind_is_box)
    {
        let stores_scroll_offset =
            arena.node_flags_if_live(slot) & crate::layout::node_data::NodeFlag::HasScrollOffset as u32 != 0;
        return stores_scroll_offset.then(|| first_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot));
    }
    let first = arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.map(|link| link.fragment.scrollable_overflow.rect_relative_to_padding_box)
    })?;
    let mut rect = first.translated_by(first_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot).location());
    for (index, fragment) in arena.committed_side_data(slot).box_fragments().iter().enumerate() {
        rect.unite(
            fragment
                .link
                .fragment
                .scrollable_overflow
                .rect_relative_to_padding_box
                .translated_by(absolute_fragment_padding_box_rect(arena, slot, index + 1).location()),
        );
    }
    Some(rect)
}

pub(crate) fn has_scrollable_overflow(arena: &impl GeometryRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot)
        || !arena
            .node_kind_if_live(slot)
            .is_some_and(crate::layout::node_facts::kind_is_box)
    {
        return false;
    }
    arena.with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
        link.is_some_and(|link| link.fragment.scrollable_overflow.has_scrollable_overflow)
    }) || arena
        .committed_side_data(slot)
        .box_fragments()
        .iter()
        .any(|fragment| fragment.link.fragment.scrollable_overflow.has_scrollable_overflow)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    #[cfg(target_pointer_width = "64")]
    fn committed_geometry_validity_costs_at_most_a_word_beside_the_link() {
        assert!(
            std::mem::size_of::<CommittedFragmentLinkSlot>()
                <= std::mem::size_of::<fragment_tree::FragmentLink>() + std::mem::size_of::<u64>()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn committed_fragment_link_slots_are_equal_when_they_place_the_same_fragment_the_same_way() {
        let node = NodeSlotId::new(1, 1);
        let link = fragment_tree::FragmentLink::for_test(node);
        let slot_with = |link: fragment_tree::FragmentLink| CommittedFragmentLinkSlot {
            layout_slot_generation: 1,
            link: Some(link),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(slot_with(link.clone()) == slot_with(link.clone()));

        let mut moved = link.clone();
        moved.offset.x = crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels::from_integer(10);
        assert!(slot_with(link.clone()) != slot_with(moved));

        // An equal fragment laid out again is a different fragment.
        assert!(slot_with(link.clone()) != slot_with(fragment_tree::FragmentLink::for_test(node)));

        let mut stale = slot_with(link.clone());
        stale.geometry_is_current = true;
        assert!(slot_with(link) != stale);
        assert!(CommittedFragmentLinkSlot::default() == CommittedFragmentLinkSlot::default());
    }

    #[test]
    fn committed_side_data_compares_shared_records_by_allocation_or_value() {
        use crate::layout::inline_content::InlineContent;
        use std::sync::Arc;

        let side_data = CommittedSideData {
            inline_content: Some(Arc::new(InlineContent::default())),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(side_data == side_data.clone());

        let equal_records = CommittedSideData {
            inline_content: Some(Arc::new(InlineContent::default())),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(side_data == equal_records);

        let without_content = CommittedSideData {
            inline_content: None,
            ..side_data.clone()
        };
        assert!(side_data != without_content);
    }

    /// Places the single piece of the inline box `node` on a line of a new line root, at the padding box `rect`.
    fn give_inline_box_a_piece(
        arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        rect: crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect,
    ) {
        use crate::layout::inline_content::{InlineBoxPieceRecord, InlineContent};
        use crate::layout::node_data::NodeKind;

        let root = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.write_shape(root).set_kind(NodeKind::BlockContainer);
        arena.populate_paintable_row(root);
        arena.paintable_rows_mut().paintable_data_mut(node).containing_block = root;
        let mut content = InlineContent {
            inline_box_pieces: vec![InlineBoxPieceRecord {
                node,
                border_box_rect: rect.into(),
                ..InlineBoxPieceRecord::default()
            }],
            ..InlineContent::default()
        };
        content.index_inline_boxes();
        arena.committed_side_data_mut(root).inline_content = Some(Arc::new(content));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_inline_box_shows_scrollable_overflow_once_it_stores_a_scroll_offset() {
        use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
        use crate::layout::node_data::NodeKind;
        use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;

        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let node = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.write_shape(node).set_kind(NodeKind::InlineNode);
        arena.populate_paintable_row(node);
        let rect = CssPixelRect::new(
            CssPixels::from_integer(0),
            CssPixels::from_integer(0),
            CssPixels::from_integer(100),
            CssPixels::from_integer(80),
        );
        give_inline_box_a_piece(&mut arena, node, rect);
        assert_eq!(
            paintable_geometry::scrollable_overflow_rect(&arena.paintable_rows(), node),
            None
        );

        arena.set_node_flag(node, NodeFlag::HasScrollOffset, true);
        let rows = arena.paintable_rows();
        assert_eq!(paintable_geometry::scrollable_overflow_rect(&rows, node), Some(rect));
        assert!(!paintable_geometry::has_scrollable_overflow(&rows, node));
    }
}

/// How the document's chrome state hears that a row was reset.
pub(crate) type ChromeStateCallback = (
    *mut c_void,
    unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, NodeSlotId, PaintableRowResetKind),
);

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct PaintableRowReset {
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    kind: PaintableRowResetKind,
}

impl PaintableRowReset {
    /// Tells the document's chrome state, if it listens, that the row was reset.
    pub(crate) fn tell(self, main_thread: &crate::stage::MainThread) {
        let callback = main_thread
            .host_tables()
            .and_then(|host_tables| host_tables.chrome_state_callback.get());
        if let Some((context, callback)) = callback {
            // SAFETY: Registration and unregistration keep the callback context live.
            unsafe { callback(context, self.slot, self.kind) };
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct CommittedFragmentLinkSlot {
    layout_slot_generation: u8,
    geometry_epoch: u32,
    geometry_is_current: bool,
    link: Option<fragment_tree::FragmentLink>,
}

/// Slots are the same when they hold the same link, or links that place the same fragment the
/// same way.
impl PartialEq for CommittedFragmentLinkSlot {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.layout_slot_generation == other.layout_slot_generation
            && self.geometry_epoch == other.geometry_epoch
            && self.geometry_is_current == other.geometry_is_current
            && match (&self.link, &other.link) {
                (None, None) => true,
                (Some(a), Some(b)) => a.places_same_fragment_identically_to(b),
                _ => false,
            }
    }
}

// The unique node id of what each box is the box of, as the document names it: an element, the
// element a pseudo-element was generated for, or the document itself for the viewport. It is the
// name the compositor scrolls and snaps by, and it is not the style node id, which a node gives up
// when it disconnects, so the build stamps it onto a row from what the style mirror publishes.
//
// Dense by slot, because nearly every element box has one. Each entry names the row it was stamped
// for, so a slot that has been recycled since answers for the new row and not the old one.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct UniqueNodeIdColumn {
    ids: crate::fork_vec::ForkVec<(NodeSlotId, i64)>,
}

impl UniqueNodeIdColumn {
    pub(crate) fn id(&self, slot: NodeSlotId) -> i64 {
        match self.ids.get(slot.slot_index() as usize) {
            Some(&(stamped_for, id)) if !slot.is_invalid() && stamped_for == slot => id,
            _ => 0,
        }
    }

    /// Publishes the names of the nodes the rows of a chunk new to the arena carry, from its first slot
    /// `first_slot_index` on, each in its first generation, `generation`; a row whose name is 0 carries none.
    pub(crate) fn publish_new_chunk(&mut self, first_slot_index: usize, generation: u8, ids: &[i64]) {
        if ids.iter().all(|&id| id == 0) {
            return;
        }
        debug_assert!(self.ids.len() <= first_slot_index);
        self.ids.resize_with_default(first_slot_index);
        let block: Vec<(NodeSlotId, i64)> = ids
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(offset, &id)| match id {
                0 => Default::default(),
                id => (NodeSlotId::new((first_slot_index + offset) as u32, generation), id),
            })
            .collect();
        self.ids.extend_from_slice(&block);
    }

    pub(crate) fn publish(&mut self, slot: NodeSlotId, id: i64) {
        if slot.is_invalid() || self.id(slot) == id {
            return;
        }
        let index = slot.slot_index() as usize;
        if self.ids.len() <= index {
            self.ids.resize_with_default(index + 1);
        }
        self.ids[index] = (slot, id);
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct PaintableRowStore {
    rows: CowColumn<PaintableData, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(crate) ink_overflow: CowColumn<crate::painting::ink_overflow::InkOverflow, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(crate) ink_overflow_stamp: u64,
    /// Names what the rows say can be hit, and where: it moves with every write that can change a hit-test item.
    /// Scrolling and selecting change none.
    pub(crate) hit_test_items_stamp: u64,
    pub(crate) ink_overflow_audit_sequence: u64,
    pub(crate) ink_overflow_dirty: crate::fork_vec::ForkVec<bool>,
    pub(crate) ink_overflow_requests: Vec<NodeSlotId>,
    /// In chunks a fork of the arena shares until either side writes one, so forking does not copy every row's.
    side_data: CowVec<PaintableSideData, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    committed_side_data: CowColumn<CommittedSideData, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(crate) paint_change_stamps: CowColumn<PaintChangeStamps, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(crate) paint_generations: PaintGenerations,
    // NB: Boxed, as most rows have no record, and a row holds no more than a pointer for one.
    visual_context_records: CowColumn<Option<Box<PaintableVisualContextRecord>>, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    /// The visual context node handles of each row that has a record. They are kept here only, in
    /// a column a frame publishes, so the visual context update and the recording read the same.
    visual_context_node_handles: VisualContextNodeHandleColumn,
    pub(crate) stacking_context_entries: StackingContextEntryColumn,
    pub(crate) stacking_context_roots_flagged_for_resort: Vec<NodeSlotId>,
    line_roots_needing_fragment_ownership: Vec<NodeSlotId>,
    absolute_rect_memo_epoch: u64,
    committed_fragment_links: CowColumn<CommittedFragmentLinkSlot, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    image_map_areas: crate::painting::image_map_areas::ImageMapAreaColumn,
    unique_node_ids: UniqueNodeIdColumn,
    /// How many times a row was populated or reset, which moves whether a row is populated.
    population_writes: u64,
}

pub(crate) type VisualContextNodeHandleColumn =
    CowColumn<Option<Arc<BoxVisualContextNodeHandles>>, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>;

/// Sets a row's node handles, copying its chunk only when they change.
fn set_visual_context_node_handles(
    column: &mut VisualContextNodeHandleColumn,
    index: usize,
    handles: Option<BoxVisualContextNodeHandles>,
) {
    if column
        .get(index)
        .is_none_or(|current| current.as_deref() == handles.as_ref())
    {
        return;
    }
    column
        .set(index, handles.map(Arc::new))
        .expect("the row is in the column");
}

impl<Arena> PaintableRows<Arena>
where
    Arena: Deref<Target = LayoutNodeArena>,
{
    /// A style repaint of a row also repaints the anonymous boxes it generated and, for an
    /// inline, the ancestors up to the line root that paints its pieces.
    pub(crate) fn for_each_row_repainted_with(&self, id: NodeSlotId, mut repaint: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId)) {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(id) {
            return;
        }
        repaint(id);
        let mut stack: SmallVec<[NodeSlotId; 16]> = smallvec![id];
        while let Some(current) = stack.pop() {
            let mut child = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(self, current);
            while let Some(child_slot) = child {
                let child_flags = self.arena.node_flags_if_live(child_slot);
                if child_flags & NodeFlag::Anonymous as u32 != 0 {
                    repaint(child_slot);
                    stack.push(child_slot);
                }
                child = crate::painting::paint_order::next_paint_sibling(self, child_slot);
            }
        }
        if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(self, id) {
            let mut ancestor = crate::painting::paint_order::paint_parent(self, id);
            while let Some(current) = ancestor {
                repaint(current);
                if node_painting::has_lines(self, current) {
                    break;
                }
                ancestor = crate::painting::paint_order::paint_parent(self, current);
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn prepare_paintable_row_recommit_notification(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> PaintableRowReset {
        assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        // The host hears which row is the viewport's here: a layout pass is under way, so it cannot read the rows.
        let kind = if id == self.arena.bound_viewport_row() {
            PaintableRowResetKind::ViewportRecommitted
        } else {
            PaintableRowResetKind::Recommitted
        };
        self.arena.prepare_paintable_row_reset(id, kind)
    }
}

impl<Arena> PaintableRows<Arena>
where
    Arena: DerefMut<Target = LayoutNodeArena>,
{
    /// A text-decoration change on a box repaints the text of every line root and inline
    /// below it that inherits the decoration.
    pub(crate) fn push_propagated_text_decoration_damage(&mut self, root: NodeSlotId) {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(root) {
            return;
        }

        let mut stack = Vec::new();
        if let Some(first_child) = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(&*self, root) {
            stack.push(first_child);
        }
        while let Some(current) = stack.pop() {
            if let Some(next_sibling) = crate::painting::paint_order::next_paint_sibling(&*self, current) {
                stack.push(next_sibling);
            }

            if crate::painting::style_queries::is_text_decoration_propagation_boundary(self.arena.deref(), current) {
                continue;
            }
            if node_painting::has_lines(&*self, current) || node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(&*self, current) {
                self.arena.note_paint_change(current, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
            }
            if let Some(first_child) = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(&*self, current) {
                stack.push(first_child);
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_data_mut(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) -> PaintableDataMut<'_> {
        assert!(!id.is_invalid(), "invalid paintable arena slot ID");
        let data = self
            .arena
            .paintable_rows
            .rows
            .row_mut(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .expect("invalid paintable arena slot ID");
        assert_eq!(
            data.slot_generation,
            id.generation(),
            "paintable arena read a stale or unused slot"
        );
        data
    }

    /// Starts committing a row anew. The commit writes its geometry and inline content over what it committed last, so
    /// that a row it commits as it was copies no chunk a published generation shares.
    pub(crate) fn begin_paintable_row_recommit(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) {
        // The row's stamps are deliberately kept; the commit diff stamps what actually changed.
        let filter = self.arena.committed_side_data_mut(id).fragment_ownership.take();
        if filter.is_some() {
            self.arena
                .paintable_side_data_mut(id)
                .fragment_ownership_before_recommit = filter;
        }
    }
}

impl<Arena> PaintableRowsRead for PaintableRows<Arena> where Arena: Deref<Target = LayoutNodeArena> {}

impl<Arena> PaintableRows<Arena>
where
    Arena: Deref<Target = LayoutNodeArena>,
{
    pub(crate) fn memoized_absolute_rect_of_view(
        &self,
        id: NodeSlotId,
    ) -> Option<crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect> {
        self.absolute_rects
            .borrow()
            .get(id, self.arena.absolute_rect_memo_epoch())
    }

    pub(crate) fn memoize_absolute_rect_of_view(&self, id: NodeSlotId, rect: crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect) {
        let epoch = self.arena.absolute_rect_memo_epoch();
        self.absolute_rects.borrow_mut().set(id, epoch, rect);
    }
}

impl<Arena> PaintableRowsWrite for PaintableRows<Arena>
where
    Arena: DerefMut<Target = LayoutNodeArena>,
{
    fn paintable_data_mut(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) -> PaintableDataMut<'_> {
        PaintableRows::paintable_data_mut(self, id)
    }
}

impl CommittedFragmentLinkSlot {
    /// The link this slot holds for the box with the given layout slot generation, if it holds
    /// one for that box and not for a box that held the slot before.
    pub(crate) fn link_for(&self, layout_slot_generation: u8) -> Option<&fragment_tree::FragmentLink> {
        (self.layout_slot_generation == layout_slot_generation)
            .then_some(self.link.as_ref())
            .flatten()
    }
}

impl PaintableRowStore {
    pub(crate) fn with_current_committed_fragment_link<R>(
        &self,
        layout_slot_index: u32,
        layout_slot_generation: u8,
        geometry_epoch: u32,
        read: impl FnOnce(&fragment_tree::FragmentLink) -> R,
    ) -> Option<R> {
        let slots = &self.committed_fragment_links;
        let slot = slots.get(layout_slot_index as usize)?;
        if slot.layout_slot_generation != layout_slot_generation
            || !slot.geometry_is_current
            || slot.geometry_epoch != geometry_epoch
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(read(slot.link.as_ref()?))
    }

    /// Whether the slot holds `link` already, placed the same way, with geometry current for `geometry_epoch`.
    pub(crate) fn holds_current_committed_fragment_link(
        &self,
        layout_slot_index: u32,
        layout_slot_generation: u8,
        geometry_epoch: u32,
        link: &fragment_tree::FragmentLink,
    ) -> bool {
        self.with_current_committed_fragment_link(
            layout_slot_index,
            layout_slot_generation,
            geometry_epoch,
            |committed| link.places_same_fragment_identically_to(committed),
        )
        .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    pub(crate) fn invalidate_committed_geometry(&mut self, layout_slot_index: u32) {
        if let Some(mut slot) = RowMut::new(&mut self.committed_fragment_links, layout_slot_index as usize) {
            slot.geometry_is_current = false;
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn committed_fragment_link_cloned(
        &self,
        layout_slot_index: u32,
        layout_slot_generation: u8,
    ) -> Option<fragment_tree::FragmentLink> {
        self.committed_fragment_links
            .get(layout_slot_index as usize)
            .filter(|slot| slot.layout_slot_generation == layout_slot_generation)
            .and_then(|slot| slot.link.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_committed_fragment_link<R>(
        &self,
        layout_slot_index: u32,
        layout_slot_generation: u8,
        read: impl FnOnce(Option<&fragment_tree::FragmentLink>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        let slots = &self.committed_fragment_links;
        read(
            slots
                .get(layout_slot_index as usize)
                .and_then(|slot| slot.link_for(layout_slot_generation)),
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_committed_fragment_link(
        &mut self,
        layout_slot_index: u32,
        layout_slot_generation: u8,
        geometry_epoch: Option<u32>,
        link: fragment_tree::FragmentLink,
    ) {
        let slots = &mut self.committed_fragment_links;
        slots.grow_to(layout_slot_index as usize + 1);
        let mut slot = slots
            .row_mut(layout_slot_index as usize)
            .expect("the column grew to hold the slot");
        if slot.layout_slot_generation != layout_slot_generation {
            *slot = CommittedFragmentLinkSlot {
                layout_slot_generation,
                link: Some(link),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        } else {
            slot.link = Some(link);
        }
        slot.geometry_epoch = geometry_epoch.unwrap_or_default();
        slot.geometry_is_current = geometry_epoch.is_some();
    }

    pub(crate) fn replace_committed_fragment_link_keeping_its_geometry_epoch(
        &mut self,
        layout_slot_index: u32,
        layout_slot_generation: u8,
        link: fragment_tree::FragmentLink,
    ) {
        if let Some(mut slot) = RowMut::new(&mut self.committed_fragment_links, layout_slot_index as usize)
            && slot.layout_slot_generation == layout_slot_generation
        {
            slot.link = Some(link);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn take_committed_fragment_link(
        &mut self,
        layout_slot_index: u32,
        layout_slot_generation: u8,
    ) -> Option<fragment_tree::FragmentLink> {
        RowMut::new(&mut self.committed_fragment_links, layout_slot_index as usize)
            .filter(|slot| slot.layout_slot_generation == layout_slot_generation)
            .and_then(|mut slot| slot.link.take())
    }

    pub(crate) fn reset_committed_fragment_link_slot(&mut self, layout_slot_index: u32) {
        self.committed_fragment_links
            .set(layout_slot_index as usize, CommittedFragmentLinkSlot::default());
    }
}

impl LayoutNodeArena {
    pub(crate) fn refresh_paint_order_inputs(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId) {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(row) {
            return;
        }
        let inputs = crate::painting::paint_order_plan::PaintOrderInputs::gather(&self.paintable_rows(), row);
        if self.update_paint_order_inputs(row, inputs) {
            self.note_paint_order_changed(row);
        }
    }

    // A row whose ordering decisions changed is placed differently by its ancestors' plans and
    // may plan its own descendants differently.
    pub(crate) fn note_paint_order_changed(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId) {
        self.note_paint_change(row, RowPaintChange::ORDER);
        self.note_enclosing_paint_order_change(row);
    }

    // The entry tables decide how a stacking context composes its hoisted content, so a table
    // change reorders the context's own painting even when no row changed its own decisions.
    pub(crate) fn note_stacking_context_composition_changed(&mut self, context_root: NodeSlotId) {
        self.note_paint_change(context_root, RowPaintChange::ORDER);
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_rows(&self) -> PaintableRowsRef<'_> {
        PaintableRows {
            arena: self,
            absolute_rects: RefCell::default(),
        }
    }

    /// The layout tree's shape and paint facts, the paintable rows and the columns read beside them
    /// as they are now. The live columns go on being written, copying only the
    /// chunks the publication shares.
    pub(crate) fn publish_rows(&mut self) -> PublishedRows {
        let nodes = self.publish_paint_tree();
        let paint_facts = self.publish_paint_facts();
        let store = &mut self.paintable_rows;
        PublishedRows {
            geometry_epoch: store.absolute_rect_memo_epoch,
            ink_overflow: store.ink_overflow.publish(),
            ink_overflow_stamp: store.ink_overflow_stamp,
            hit_test_items_stamp: store.hit_test_items_stamp,
            paint_change_stamps: store.paint_change_stamps.publish(),
            nodes,
            paint_facts,
            rows: store.rows.publish(),
            // Borrowed rather than reached through `&mut`, so a publication that a host read makes while
            // a writer of the columns is still on the stack panics instead of racing it.
            fragment_links: store.committed_fragment_links.publish(),
            side_data: store.committed_side_data.publish(),
            stacking_context_entries: store.stacking_context_entries.publish(),
            visual_context_node_handles: store.visual_context_node_handles.publish(),
        }
    }

    /// How far the paintable rows and the columns published beside them have been written. See
    /// [`crate::cow_column::CowColumn::version`].
    /// How far which rows are populated has been written since the arena was made.
    pub(crate) fn paintable_population_version(&self) -> u64 {
        self.paintable_rows.population_writes
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_rows_version(&self) -> u64 {
        let store = &self.paintable_rows;
        store.rows.version()
            + store.committed_fragment_links.version()
            + store.committed_side_data.version()
            + store.stacking_context_entries.version()
            + store.visual_context_node_handles.version()
            + store.ink_overflow.version()
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_rows_mut(&mut self) -> PaintableRowsMut<'_> {
        PaintableRows {
            arena: self,
            absolute_rects: RefCell::default(),
        }
    }

    /// The fragment link committed for `node`. A layout reaches boxes whose paintable row is not populated yet, and a
    /// slot can still hold the link of the box that held it before, which belongs to no box of this generation.
    pub(crate) fn with_committed_fragment_link<R>(
        &self,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        read: impl FnOnce(Option<&fragment_tree::FragmentLink>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        self.paintable_rows
            .with_committed_fragment_link(node.slot_index(), node.generation(), read)
    }

    fn prepare_paintable_row_reset(&self, slot: NodeSlotId, kind: PaintableRowResetKind) -> PaintableRowReset {
        PaintableRowReset { slot, kind }
    }

    /// What the absolute rects memoized for the rows are valid for, which moves on with every write that moves a row.
    pub(crate) fn absolute_rect_memo_epoch(&self) -> u64 {
        self.paintable_rows.absolute_rect_memo_epoch
    }

    pub(crate) fn clear_absolute_rect_memo(&mut self) {
        let epoch = &mut self.paintable_rows.absolute_rect_memo_epoch;
        *epoch = epoch.checked_add(1).expect("absolute rect memo epoch overflowed");
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_row_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.paintable_rows.side_data.len()
    }

    pub(crate) fn populate_paintable_row(&mut self, layout_node: NodeSlotId) {
        let overflow_style = self
            .node_style_if_live(layout_node)
            .map(crate::painting::scrollable_overflow::OverflowStyle::new);
        let store = &mut self.paintable_rows;
        let index = layout_node.slot_index() as usize;
        store.rows.grow_to(index + 1);
        store.visual_context_records.grow_to(index + 1);
        store.committed_side_data.grow_to(index + 1);
        store.visual_context_node_handles.grow_to(index + 1);
        store.stacking_context_entries.grow_to(index + 1);
        store.paint_change_stamps.grow_to(index + 1);
        while store.side_data.len() <= index {
            store.side_data.push(PaintableSideData::default());
        }

        store.population_writes += 1;
        store.rows.set(
            index,
            PaintableData {
                slot_generation: layout_node.generation(),
                ..PaintableData::default()
            },
        );
        store.side_data[index] = PaintableSideData {
            overflow_style,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        store.committed_side_data.set(index, CommittedSideData::default());
        store.paint_change_stamps.set(
            index,
            PaintChangeStamps::of_a_row_new_to_the_document(store.paint_generations.generation_writes_stamp_with()),
        );
        store.visual_context_records.set(index, None);
        set_visual_context_node_handles(&mut store.visual_context_node_handles, index, None);
        drop_table(&mut store.stacking_context_entries, index);
        if let Some(dirty) = self.paintable_rows.ink_overflow_dirty.get_mut(index) {
            *dirty = false;
        }
        self.request_ink_overflow_recalculation(layout_node);
        self.note_hit_test_items_changed();
        self.notify_committed_box_changed(layout_node);
    }

    fn reset_paintable_row(&mut self, row_is_still_linked: bool, reset: PaintableRowReset) {
        let id = reset.slot;
        self.forget_ink_overflow_of_row_being_reset(id);
        self.note_hit_test_items_changed();
        if row_is_still_linked {
            // A cleared row is still linked, so the ancestor whose plans listed it is known now.
            self.note_enclosing_paint_order_change(id);
        }
        if let Some((record, node_handles)) = self.take_paintable_visual_context_record(id) {
            self.withdraw_stacking_context_state_of_reset_row(id, Some(record.stacking_context));
            let former_paint_parent =
                crate::painting::paint_order::paint_parent(&self.paintable_rows(), id).unwrap_or(NodeSlotId::INVALID);
            let element = self.node_style_node(id);
            if let Some(trace) = self.paint_state_mut().visual_context.trace.as_mut() {
                trace.note_removed_box(id, element);
            }
            self.paint_state_mut()
                .visual_context
                .dirty_boxes
                .note_removed(RemovedBoxBlocks {
                    slot: id,
                    node_handles: Arc::unwrap_or_clone(node_handles),
                    former_paint_parent,
                });
        } else {
            self.withdraw_stacking_context_state_of_reset_row(id, None);
            self.paint_state_mut().visual_context.dirty_boxes.forget_box(id);
        }
        self.clear_absolute_rect_memo();
        let store = &mut self.paintable_rows;
        let index = id.slot_index() as usize;
        store.population_writes += 1;
        store.rows.set(index, PaintableData::default());
        store.side_data[index] = PaintableSideData::default();
        store.committed_side_data.set(index, CommittedSideData::default());
        store.paint_change_stamps.set(index, PaintChangeStamps::default());
        store.visual_context_records.set(index, None);
        set_visual_context_node_handles(&mut store.visual_context_node_handles, index, None);
        drop_table(&mut store.stacking_context_entries, index);
        if reset.kind == crate::painting::paintable_data::PaintableRowResetKind::Freed {
            store.image_map_areas.forget(id);
        }
        self.notify_committed_box_changed(id);
    }

    /// The areas of the image map each image is associated with, as the document published them.
    pub(crate) fn image_map_areas(&self) -> &crate::painting::image_map_areas::ImageMapAreaColumn {
        &self.paintable_rows.image_map_areas
    }

    pub(crate) fn image_map_areas_mut(&mut self) -> &mut crate::painting::image_map_areas::ImageMapAreaColumn {
        &mut self.paintable_rows.image_map_areas
    }

    /// The unique node id of what each box is the box of, as the build stamped it.
    pub(crate) fn unique_node_ids(&self) -> &UniqueNodeIdColumn {
        &self.paintable_rows.unique_node_ids
    }

    pub(crate) fn unique_node_ids_mut(&mut self) -> &mut UniqueNodeIdColumn {
        &mut self.paintable_rows.unique_node_ids
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_visual_context_record(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> Option<&PaintableVisualContextRecord> {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(id) {
            return None;
        }
        self.paintable_rows
            .visual_context_records
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .and_then(Option::as_deref)
    }

    /// A row's visual context record and node handles, which the row no longer has.
    pub(crate) fn take_paintable_visual_context_record(
        &mut self,
        id: NodeSlotId,
    ) -> Option<(PaintableVisualContextRecord, Arc<BoxVisualContextNodeHandles>)> {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(id) {
            return None;
        }
        let index = id.slot_index() as usize;
        let record = self
            .paintable_rows
            .visual_context_records
            .row_mut(index)
            .and_then(|mut record| record.take())
            .map(|record| *record)?;
        let node_handles = self
            .paintable_rows
            .visual_context_node_handles
            .row_mut(index)
            .and_then(|mut handles| handles.take())
            .expect("a row with a record has node handles");
        Some((record, node_handles))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_paintable_visual_context_record(
        &mut self,
        id: NodeSlotId,
        record: PaintableVisualContextRecord,
        node_handles: BoxVisualContextNodeHandles,
    ) {
        debug_assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        let inputs = self.committed_side_data(id).prepared_order_inputs().map(|inputs| {
            inputs.with_visual_context(
                &record.stacking_context,
                crate::painting::style_queries::z_index(self, id),
            )
        });
        set_visual_context_node_handles(
            &mut self.paintable_rows.visual_context_node_handles,
            id.slot_index() as usize,
            Some(node_handles),
        );
        self.paintable_rows
            .visual_context_records
            .set(id.slot_index() as usize, Some(Box::new(record)));
        if let Some(inputs) = inputs {
            if self.update_paint_order_inputs(id, inputs) {
                self.note_paint_order_changed(id);
            }
        } else {
            // Some resource paintables are first prepared outside a layout commit.
            self.refresh_paint_order_inputs(id);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn drop_all_visual_context_records(&mut self) {
        let rows = self.paintable_rows.side_data.len();
        let records = &mut self.paintable_rows.visual_context_records;
        for index in 0..rows {
            records.set(index, None);
        }
        let handles = &mut self.paintable_rows.visual_context_node_handles;
        for index in 0..rows {
            set_visual_context_node_handles(handles, index, None);
        }
    }

    /// A snapshot of every row's visual context node handles, as they are now, which later writes leave as it is.
    pub(crate) fn visual_context_node_handles_snapshot(
        &mut self,
    ) -> crate::cow_column::ColumnSnapshot<Option<Arc<BoxVisualContextNodeHandles>>, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK> {
        self.paintable_rows.visual_context_node_handles.publish()
    }

    /// A row's visual context node handles, if it has a visual context record.
    pub(crate) fn paintable_visual_context_node_handles(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> Option<&BoxVisualContextNodeHandles> {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(id) {
            return None;
        }
        self.paintable_rows
            .visual_context_node_handles
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .and_then(Option::as_deref)
    }

    /// The effect and spatial nodes of the box `id`, which compositor animations of their kinds drive.
    pub(crate) fn box_animation_nodes(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> BoxAnimationNodes {
        self.with_paintable_visual_context_node_handles(id, |handles| BoxAnimationNodes {
            effects: handles.effects.iter().map(|index| index.0).collect(),
            spatial: handles.spatial.iter().map(|index| index.0).collect(),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_paintable_visual_context_node_handles<R>(
        &self,
        id: NodeSlotId,
        read: impl FnOnce(&BoxVisualContextNodeHandles) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        match self.paintable_visual_context_node_handles(id) {
            Some(handles) => read(handles),
            None => read(&EMPTY_BOX_VISUAL_CONTEXT_NODE_HANDLES),
        }
    }

    /// The nodes of the box that an animation of the kind drives: the effect nodes of an opacity,
    /// background color or filter animation, or the spatial nodes of a transform animation, as far
    /// as the tree holds nodes of the right kind for them.
    pub(crate) fn paintable_visual_animation_target_indices(
        &self,
        id: NodeSlotId,
        tree: Option<&crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree>,
        target_kind: crate::painting::host::FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind,
    ) -> Vec<u32> {
        use crate::painting::host::FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind;
        let Some(tree) = tree else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        self.with_paintable_visual_context_node_handles(id, |handles| {
            let valid_targets = |indices: &mut dyn Iterator<Item = u32>| -> Vec<u32> {
                indices
                    .filter(|&index| tree.visual_animation_target_is_valid(target_kind, index))
                    .collect()
            };
            match target_kind {
                FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Opacity
                | FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::BackgroundColor
                | FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Filter => {
                    valid_targets(&mut handles.effects.iter().map(|index| index.0))
                }
                FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform => {
                    valid_targets(&mut handles.spatial.iter().map(|index| index.0))
                }
            }
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn mark_paintable_subtree_may_own_geometry_dependent_nodes(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) -> Option<bool> {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(id) {
            return None;
        }
        let records = &mut self.paintable_rows.visual_context_records;
        let mut row = records.row_mut(id.slot_index() as usize)?;
        let record = row.as_mut()?;
        let was_flagged = record.subtree_may_own_geometry_dependent_nodes;
        record.subtree_may_own_geometry_dependent_nodes = true;
        Some(was_flagged)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_paintable_record_stacking_context_contribution_registered(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) {
        debug_assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        let records = &mut self.paintable_rows.visual_context_records;
        if let Some(mut row) = records.row_mut(id.slot_index() as usize)
            && let Some(record) = row.as_mut()
        {
            record.stacking_context.contribution_is_registered = true;
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_line_root_needs_fragment_ownership(&mut self, line_root: NodeSlotId) {
        self.paintable_rows
            .line_roots_needing_fragment_ownership
            .push(line_root);
    }

    pub(crate) fn take_line_roots_needing_fragment_ownership(&mut self) -> Vec<NodeSlotId> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.paintable_rows.line_roots_needing_fragment_ownership)
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_visual_context_box_dirty(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId, kind: VisualContextBoxDirtyKind) {
        let pending_box_limit = self
            .paintable_row_count()
            .max(crate::painting::visual_context::dirty::MINIMUM_PENDING_DIRTY_BOX_LIMIT);
        self.paint_state_mut()
            .visual_context
            .dirty_boxes
            .note_box(id, kind, pending_box_limit);
    }

    pub(crate) fn request_full_visual_context_rebuild(&mut self, scope: VisualContextUpdateScope) {
        self.paint_state_mut()
            .visual_context
            .dirty_boxes
            .request_full_rebuild(scope);
    }

    pub(crate) fn prepare_paintable_row_freed_reset(&self, layout_slot_index: u32) -> Option<PaintableRowReset> {
        if layout_slot_index as usize >= self.paintable_row_count() {
            return None;
        }
        let generation = self.paintable_data_by_index(layout_slot_index).slot_generation;
        if generation == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        Some(self.prepare_paintable_row_reset(
            NodeSlotId::new(layout_slot_index, generation),
            PaintableRowResetKind::Freed,
        ))
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_row_freed(&mut self, reset: PaintableRowReset) {
        self.reset_paintable_row(false, reset);
    }

    pub(crate) fn prepare_paintable_row_cleared_reset(&self, layout_node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<PaintableRowReset> {
        self.paintable_row_is_populated(layout_node)
            .then(|| self.prepare_paintable_row_reset(layout_node, PaintableRowResetKind::Cleared))
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_row_cleared(&mut self, reset: PaintableRowReset) {
        self.reset_paintable_row(true, reset);
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_row_is_populated(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        if id.is_invalid() {
            return false;
        }
        self.paintable_rows
            .rows
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .is_some_and(|data| data.slot_generation != 0 && data.slot_generation == id.generation())
    }

    pub(crate) fn live_paintable_data(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> &PaintableData {
        assert!(!id.is_invalid(), "invalid paintable arena slot ID");
        let data = self
            .paintable_rows
            .rows
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .expect("invalid paintable arena slot ID");
        assert_eq!(
            data.slot_generation,
            id.generation(),
            "paintable arena read a stale or unused slot"
        );
        data
    }

    fn paintable_data_by_index(&self, index: u32) -> &PaintableData {
        self.paintable_rows
            .rows
            .get(index as usize)
            .expect("invalid paintable arena slot index")
    }

    pub(crate) fn transfer_fragments_to_replacement_node(
        &mut self,
        containing_block: NodeSlotId,
        old_node: NodeSlotId,
        new_node: NodeSlotId,
    ) {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(containing_block) {
            return;
        }
        self.note_paint_change(containing_block, RowPaintChange::EVERYTHING_IT_PAINTS);
        let mut side = self.committed_side_data_mut(containing_block);
        let Some(content) = side.inline_content.as_mut() else {
            return;
        };
        // Replacement preserves current paint geometry until the next layout commit. Give that
        // version new node identities without modifying retained run outputs or copying glyphs.
        let content = std::sync::Arc::make_mut(content);
        for fragment in &mut content.fragments {
            if fragment.layout_node == old_node {
                fragment.layout_node = new_node;
            }
        }
        for piece in &mut content.inline_box_pieces {
            if piece.node == old_node {
                piece.node = new_node;
            }
        }
        content.index_inline_boxes();
        drop(side);
        // The replacement gathered its paint order inputs while this content still named the old box.
        self.refresh_paint_order_inputs(new_node);
    }

    pub(crate) fn push_propagated_text_decoration_damage(&mut self, root: NodeSlotId) {
        self.paintable_rows_mut().push_propagated_text_decoration_damage(root);
    }

    /// Stores the paint-order inputs gathered for a row, answering whether they changed.
    pub(crate) fn update_paint_order_inputs(
        &mut self,
        row: NodeSlotId,
        inputs: crate::painting::paint_order_plan::PaintOrderInputs,
    ) -> bool {
        std::mem::replace(&mut self.committed_side_data_mut(row).order_inputs, inputs) != inputs
    }

    pub(crate) fn committed_side_data(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> &CommittedSideData {
        debug_assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        self.paintable_rows
            .committed_side_data
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .expect("a populated row has side data")
    }

    /// A populated row's committed side data, for writing. See [`RowMut`].
    pub(crate) fn committed_side_data_mut(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) -> CommittedSideDataMut<'_> {
        debug_assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        RowMut::new(&mut self.paintable_rows.committed_side_data, id.slot_index() as usize)
            .expect("a populated row has side data")
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_side_data(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> &PaintableSideData {
        debug_assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        &self.paintable_rows.side_data[id.slot_index() as usize]
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_side_data_mut(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId) -> &mut PaintableSideData {
        debug_assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        &mut self.paintable_rows.side_data[id.slot_index() as usize]
    }
}

pub(crate) fn with_inline_pieces(
    arena: &impl GeometryRead,
    inline_paintable: NodeSlotId,
    mut callback: impl FnMut(&InlineBoxPieceRecord) -> bool,
) {
    let Some(root) = arena.inline_pieces_root(inline_paintable) else {
        return;
    };
    let root_side = arena.committed_side_data(root);
    for piece_index in root_side.inline_box_piece_indices(inline_paintable) {
        let piece = &root_side.inline_box_pieces()[*piece_index as usize];
        if !callback(piece) {
            return;
        }
    }
}

/// The effect and spatial nodes of a box, which compositor animations of their kinds drive.
pub(crate) struct BoxAnimationNodes {
    pub(crate) effects: smallvec::SmallVec<[u32; 2]>,
    pub(crate) spatial: smallvec::SmallVec<[u32; 2]>,
}

impl BoxAnimationNodes {
    /// Whether `animation` drives a node of the box: a transform animation one of its spatial nodes, any other one of
    /// its effect nodes.
    pub(crate) fn driven_by(&self, animation: &crate::painting::visual_animation::VisualAnimation) -> bool {
        let nodes = match animation.target_kind {
            crate::painting::host::FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform => &self.spatial,
            _ => &self.effects,
        };
        animation.node_indices.iter().any(|node| nodes.contains(node))
    }
}

//! A navigable's presenter, which keeps what the navigable's compositor context holds, and the presentation of one frame
//! of the navigable: the presenter and the seal of what the frame is built from, which what presents the frame beside
//! the event loop owns while it is away from the navigable.
//!
//! Only the owner of a frame's presentation presents it, on the Paint thread, so frames reach the compositor in the order
//! their presentations were presented. The navigable reads what the presenter presented on the main thread.

    ApplyScrollRequests, PresentFrame, UpdateDisplayList, UpdateScrollState, UpdateVisualContextTree,
};

    Compositing_ScrollRequest, LayerPlanOnWire,
