/// What presented a navigable's last frame: the recording of a frame a rendering update committed, or a tick of the
/// document's clock lane.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum FfiPresentedBy {
    None,
    Commit,
    Clock,
}

/// `Web::HTML::PaintConfig`, which the presenter keeps for the display list the compositor context holds.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiPaintConfig {
    pub paint_overlay: bool,
    pub should_show_line_box_borders: bool,
    pub should_show_caret_hit_test_debug_overlay: bool,
    pub force_dark_enabled: bool,
    pub force_dark_foreground_threshold: i32,
    pub force_dark_background_threshold: i32,
    pub has_canvas_fill_rect: bool,
    pub canvas_fill_rect: IntRect,
}

/// The display list a navigable's compositor context holds, which the presenter presented last.
struct CompositorDisplayList {
    output: Arc<RecordingOutput>,
    /// What its commands draw, at any depth.
    command_resources: DisplayListResources,
}

/// What a navigable's presenter keeps of the frames it presented.
#[derive(Default)]
struct PresenterState {
    compositor_display_list: Option<CompositorDisplayList>,
    compositor_display_list_paint_config: Option<FfiPaintConfig>,
    last_frame_presented_by: Option<FfiPresentedBy>,
    last_keyboard_scroll_state_generation: Option<u64>,
    /// The generation of the last frame a rendering update committed that the presenter presented.
    last_committed_generation: u64,
    /// The scroll offsets the last frame the presenter presented sent the compositor.
    last_presented_scroll_state: Option<ScrollStateSnapshot>,
}

/// A navigable's presenter, which its navigable and what presents a frame of it beside the event loop share: the Paint
/// thread presents, and the main thread reads what it presented.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct NavigablePresenter {
    state: Mutex<PresenterState>,
}

impl NavigablePresenter {
    fn state(&self) -> MutexGuard<'_, PresenterState> {
        self.state.lock().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner)
    }
}

/// What a frame is built from that its navigable and document held where the frame began, sealed there: the frame reaches
/// neither of them again before it is presented.
pub(crate) struct Seal {
    paint_config: FfiPaintConfig,
    /// The structural epoch of the visual context tree a new display list is cut from, or of the one the compositor's
    /// display list takes where the document's tree changed since it took one.
    visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: Option<u64>,
    /// Whether the document's tree changed since the compositor took one.
    sends_visual_context_tree: bool,
    /// Whether presenting the frame sent the compositor other scroll offsets than the frame presented before it.
    presented_other_scroll_offsets: bool,
    /// The scrolls the navigable asked for since the frame before, which the compositor applies once it has the frame's
    /// boxes. Only the frame a rendering update commits carries them.
    scroll_requests: Vec<Compositing_ScrollRequest>,
    /// What keyboard scrolling targets, for a top-level traversable.
    keyboard_scroll_state: Option<Compositing_KeyboardScrollState>,
    /// The recording a recording of the frame copies paint commands from.
    paint_command_cache_source: Option<Arc<RecordingOutput>>,
    /// Whether a recording of the frame becomes the one the next recording copies from.
    publishes_recording: bool,
    context_id: CompositorContextId,
    present_viewport_rect: Option<IntRect>,
    presented_by: FfiPresentedBy,
    /// The recording the frame presented, once it is presented.
    published: Option<Arc<RecordingOutput>>,
    /// Whether the frame sends a visual context tree the compositor's display list was not recorded against, for a test.
    visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing: bool,
    /// The frame a rendering update committed, counted per navigable, or the one a clock lane's frames start from: a
    /// lane's frame of an older one than the presenter presented last shows what the screen no longer shows.
    generation: u64,
}

/// What C++ seals of a frame where it begins (see [`Seal`]).
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiSeal {
    pub presenter: *const NavigablePresenter,
    pub paint_config: FfiPaintConfig,
    pub has_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: bool,
    pub visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: u64,
    pub sends_visual_context_tree: bool,
    /// The scroll requests, IPC-encoded as a `Vector<Compositing::ScrollRequest>`.
    pub encoded_scroll_requests: *const u8,
    pub encoded_scroll_requests_size: usize,
    /// The keyboard scroll state, IPC-encoded as an `Optional<Compositing::KeyboardScrollState>`.
    pub encoded_keyboard_scroll_state: *const u8,
    pub encoded_keyboard_scroll_state_size: usize,
    pub context_id: u64,
    pub has_present_viewport_rect: bool,
    pub present_viewport_rect: IntRect,
    pub generation: u64,
    pub visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing: bool,
}

/// Decodes `T` from `size` IPC-encoded bytes at `bytes`, which hold no attachment.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `bytes` must point to `size` bytes, or be null with `size` 0.
unsafe fn decode_ipc_bytes<T: Decode>(bytes: *const u8, size: usize) -> T {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let bytes = unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(bytes, size) };
    Decoder::new(bytes, std::iter::empty())
        .decode()
        .expect("C++ encodes what it seals")
}

/// What presents one frame of a navigable beside the event loop: the navigable's presenter, and what the frame is built
/// from.
pub(crate) struct Presentation {
    presenter: Arc<NavigablePresenter>,
    seal: Box<Seal>,
    /// Where the document's boxes were scrolled to as the frame was sealed, which seeds the offsets of the boxes new to
    /// the compositor.
    scroll_state: ScrollStateSnapshot,
    /// The visual context tree the frames presented from the seal take to the compositor where a clock tick's update
    /// left one, or the render state's where a frame without a recording sends it. A frame with a recording goes with
    /// the tree it was recorded against otherwise.
    taken_visual_context_tree: Option<Arc<VisualContextTree>>,
}

/// What one frame hands the compositor, in the order it hands it.
struct CompositorFrame {
    context_id: CompositorContextId,
    display_list_update: Option<DisplayListUpdate>,
    visual_context_tree_update: Option<VisualContextTreeUpdate>,
    scroll_state_update: Option<ScrollStateUpdate>,
    scroll_requests: Vec<Compositing_ScrollRequest>,
    present_viewport_rect: Option<IntRect>,
}

/// The fonts and the image frames that a display list or a visual context tree draws, which the compositor is told of
/// ahead of it.
struct DrawnResources {
    fonts: Vec<FontHandle>,
    image_frames: Vec<ImageFrameHandle>,
}

struct DisplayListUpdate {
    output: Arc<RecordingOutput>,
    properties: Compositing_DisplayListProperties,
    async_scrolling_metadata: Compositing_AsyncScrollingMetadata,
    visual_context_tree: Arc<VisualContextTree>,
    resources: DrawnResources,
    scroll_state: ScrollStateSnapshot,
    keyboard_scroll_state: Compositing_KeyboardScrollState,
}

struct VisualContextTreeUpdate {
    visual_context_tree: Arc<VisualContextTree>,
    resources: DrawnResources,
    scroll_state: ScrollStateSnapshot,
    keyboard_scroll_state: Compositing_KeyboardScrollState,
}

struct ScrollStateUpdate {
    visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: u64,
    scroll_state: ScrollStateSnapshot,
    keyboard_scroll_state: Compositing_KeyboardScrollState,
}

pub(crate) fn empty_keyboard_scroll_state() -> Compositing_KeyboardScrollState {
    Compositing_KeyboardScrollState {
        generation: 0,
        target: None,
        page_scroll_distance: 0.0,
        arrow_scroll_distance: 0.0,
    }
}

fn empty_async_scrolling_metadata() -> Compositing_AsyncScrollingMetadata {
    Compositing_AsyncScrollingMetadata {
        document_id: None,
        viewport_rect: IntRect::default(),
        wheel_event_listener_state_generation: 0,
        has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners: false,
        has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport: false,
        viewport_keeps_horizontal_scrolls: false,
        viewport_keeps_vertical_scrolls: false,
        device_pixels_per_css_pixel: 1.0,
    }
}

/// What travels beside the tape of `output`'s display list.
pub(crate) fn display_list_properties_of(output: &RecordingOutput) -> Compositing_DisplayListProperties {
    Compositing_DisplayListProperties {
        id: output.display_list_id,
        compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: output.recorded_structural_epoch,
        surface_clear_color: output.surface_clear_color,
        root_group_color: output.root_group_color,
        window: output.window.as_deref().map(RecordedWindow::to_ipc),
    }
}

impl PresenterState {
    /// A clock lane's frame that starts from an older frame than the last one a rendering update committed shows what the
    /// screen no longer shows: it is not presented, and the compositor hears nothing of it.
    fn is_stale(&self, seal: &Seal) -> bool {
        seal.presented_by == FfiPresentedBy::Clock && seal.generation < self.last_committed_generation
    }

    fn note_presented(&mut self, seal: &mut Seal, scroll_state: &ScrollStateSnapshot) {
        seal.presented_other_scroll_offsets = !self
            .last_presented_scroll_state
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|last| last.holds_the_offsets_of(scroll_state));
        if seal.presented_other_scroll_offsets {
            self.last_presented_scroll_state = Some(scroll_state.clone());
        }
        if seal.presented_by == FfiPresentedBy::Commit {
            self.last_committed_generation = self.last_committed_generation.max(seal.generation);
        }
    }

    /// The image frames that the filters of `visual_context_tree` draw and `drawn` lacks, as the display list the
    /// compositor has holds them.
    fn filter_image_frames_missing_from(
        &self,
        drawn: &DisplayListResources,
        visual_context_tree: &VisualContextTree,
    ) -> Vec<ImageFrameHandle> {
        let mut image_frames = Vec::new();
        visual_context_tree.for_each_effects_filter_image_frame_id(&mut |id| {
            if drawn.image_frames.contains_key(&id) {
                return;
            }
            let held = self
                .compositor_display_list
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|display_list| display_list.command_resources.image_frames.get(&id));
            if let Some(image_frame) = held {
                image_frames.push(image_frame.clone());
            }
        });
        image_frames
    }

    /// Builds the frame that brings the compositor context `seal` names up to date with `published`, the display list a
    /// recording just published, or with what changed for the one the compositor has where none was published, from what
    /// `seal` sealed, the visual context tree the frame goes with, and the scroll state sealed beside it, which seeds the
    /// offsets of the boxes new to the compositor.
    fn build_frame(
        &mut self,
        seal: &Seal,
        published: Option<&Arc<RecordingOutput>>,
        visual_context_tree: &Arc<VisualContextTree>,
        scroll_state: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> CompositorFrame {
        // Keyboard eligibility belongs to this publication, not to the cached paint commands. Refresh it even if recording
        // was skipped or repeated the display list, and send it with the corresponding scroll state.
        let mut keyboard_scroll_state = empty_keyboard_scroll_state();
        if let Some(sealed_state) = &seal.keyboard_scroll_state {
            keyboard_scroll_state = sealed_state.clone();
            self.last_keyboard_scroll_state_generation = Some(sealed_state.generation);
        }

        self.last_frame_presented_by = Some(seal.presented_by);
        let mut frame = CompositorFrame {
            context_id: seal.context_id,
            display_list_update: None,
            visual_context_tree_update: None,
            scroll_state_update: None,
            scroll_requests: Vec::new(),
            present_viewport_rect: seal.present_viewport_rect,
        };
        let display_list_is_unchanged = published.is_some_and(|published| {
            self.compositor_display_list
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|held| held.output.display_list_id == published.display_list_id)
        });
        if let Some(published) = published.filter(|_| !display_list_is_unchanged) {
            let output = published.clone();
            let command_resources = output.resources.with_vector_image_resources();
            let mut image_frames: Vec<ImageFrameHandle> = command_resources.image_frames.values().cloned().collect();
            image_frames.extend(self.filter_image_frames_missing_from(&command_resources, visual_context_tree));
            let resources = DrawnResources {
                fonts: command_resources.fonts.values().cloned().collect(),
                image_frames,
            };
            let async_scrolling_metadata = output
                .async_scrolling_metadata
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(empty_async_scrolling_metadata);
            frame.display_list_update = Some(DisplayListUpdate {
                properties: display_list_properties_of(&output),
                async_scrolling_metadata,
                visual_context_tree: visual_context_tree.clone(),
                resources,
                scroll_state: scroll_state.clone(),
                keyboard_scroll_state,
                output: output.clone(),
            });
            self.compositor_display_list = Some(CompositorDisplayList {
                output,
                command_resources,
            });
            self.compositor_display_list_paint_config = Some(seal.paint_config);
            return frame;
        }

        if display_list_is_unchanged {
            self.compositor_display_list_paint_config = Some(seal.paint_config);
        }
        if seal.sends_visual_context_tree {
            let held_epoch = self
                .compositor_display_list
                .as_ref()
                .map(|display_list| display_list.output.recorded_structural_epoch);
            assert!(
                seal.visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing
                    || held_epoch.is_none_or(|epoch| epoch == visual_context_tree.structural_epoch),
                "a frame sends a tree of the structure the compositor's display list was recorded against"
            );
            let resources = DrawnResources {
                fonts: Vec::new(),
                image_frames: self
                    .filter_image_frames_missing_from(&DisplayListResources::default(), visual_context_tree),
            };
            frame.visual_context_tree_update = Some(VisualContextTreeUpdate {
                visual_context_tree: visual_context_tree.clone(),
                resources,
                scroll_state: scroll_state.clone(),
                keyboard_scroll_state,
            });
        } else {
            frame.scroll_state_update = Some(ScrollStateUpdate {
                visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: visual_context_tree.structural_epoch,
                scroll_state: scroll_state.clone(),
                keyboard_scroll_state,
            });
        }
        frame
    }
}

impl Presentation {
    /// The presentation of a frame `ffi` sealed, with `scroll_state`, the scroll state of the document, and
    /// `paint_command_cache_source`, the recording a recording of the frame copies from, whose recording becomes the
    /// next one's source where `publishes_recording`.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `ffi` must name a live presenter, and buffers of the sizes it gives.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn adopt(
        ffi: &FfiSeal,
        scroll_state: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        paint_command_cache_source: Option<Arc<RecordingOutput>>,
        publishes_recording: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
        let presenter = unsafe {
            Arc::increment_strong_count(ffi.presenter);
            Arc::from_raw(ffi.presenter)
        };
        Self {
            presenter,
            seal: Box::new(Seal {
                paint_config: ffi.paint_config,
                visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: ffi
                    .has_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch
                    .then_some(ffi.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch),
                sends_visual_context_tree: ffi.sends_visual_context_tree,
                presented_other_scroll_offsets: false,
                // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
                scroll_requests: unsafe {
                    decode_ipc_bytes(ffi.encoded_scroll_requests, ffi.encoded_scroll_requests_size)
                },
                // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
                keyboard_scroll_state: unsafe {
                    decode_ipc_bytes(
                        ffi.encoded_keyboard_scroll_state,
                        ffi.encoded_keyboard_scroll_state_size,
                    )
                },
                paint_command_cache_source,
                publishes_recording,
                context_id: CompositorContextId(ffi.context_id),
                present_viewport_rect: ffi.has_present_viewport_rect.then_some(ffi.present_viewport_rect),
                presented_by: FfiPresentedBy::Commit,
                published: None,
                visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing: ffi.visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing,
                generation: ffi.generation,
            }),
            scroll_state: scroll_state.clone(),
            taken_visual_context_tree: None,
        }
    }

    /// Whether presenting the frame sent the compositor other scroll offsets than the frame presented before it.
    pub(crate) fn presented_other_scroll_offsets(&self) -> bool {
        self.seal.presented_other_scroll_offsets
    }

    /// The structural epoch of the visual context tree the sealed frames go with: the one the compositor has, or the one
    /// a clock tick's update last left the seal.
    pub(crate) fn visual_context_tree_structural_epoch(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        self.seal.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch
    }

    /// What the clock lane of the frame this presented presents its frames with: the presenter, and a seal of frames
    /// that start from this one, or none where the compositor shows another display list than this frame records from.
    /// On the Paint thread, once this presented.
    pub(crate) fn for_clock_lane(&self) -> Option<Self> {
        let state = self.presenter.state();
        // A lane records the document again as the frame's recording did, or as the one an unrecorded frame keeps, which
        // the compositor has to show: a clock frame presented before the committed one may have taken its place.
        let committed = &self.seal;
        let source = committed
            .published
            .as_ref()
            .or(committed.paint_command_cache_source.as_ref())?;
        let held = state.compositor_display_list.as_ref()?;
        if held.output.display_list_id != source.display_list_id {
            return None;
        }
        let seal = Seal {
            paint_config: committed.paint_config,
            visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: Some(held.output.recorded_structural_epoch),
            sends_visual_context_tree: false,
            presented_other_scroll_offsets: false,
            scroll_requests: Vec::new(),
            keyboard_scroll_state: committed.keyboard_scroll_state.clone(),
            paint_command_cache_source: Some(held.output.clone()),
            publishes_recording: false,
            context_id: committed.context_id,
            present_viewport_rect: committed.present_viewport_rect,
            presented_by: FfiPresentedBy::Clock,
            published: None,
            visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing: false,
            generation: committed.generation,
        };
        drop(state);
        Some(Self {
            presenter: self.presenter.clone(),
            seal: Box::new(seal),
            scroll_state: self.scroll_state.clone(),
            taken_visual_context_tree: None,
        })
    }

    /// Has the frames presented from the seal take `visual_contexts` to the compositor, the tree with which a clock
    /// tick's update left the one the seal held.
    pub(crate) fn take_visual_context_tree(&mut self, visual_contexts: ClockTickVisualContexts) {
        let ClockTickVisualContexts {
            tree,
            scroll_offsets,
            restructured,
        } = visual_contexts;
        // A tree of another structure takes a new display list recorded against it. And a tree a tick updated takes the
        // scroll offsets of its own nodes, which the frame was recorded with. A frame that records nothing seals no tree,
        // and takes the render state's: the compositor's display list was cut from a tree of its structure.
        if let Some(scroll_offsets) = scroll_offsets {
            self.scroll_state = ScrollStateSnapshot::from_device_offsets(scroll_offsets);
        }
        if !restructured && let Some(epoch) = self.seal.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch {
            assert_eq!(
                tree.structural_epoch, epoch,
                "a tree of the same structure keeps its structural epoch"
            );
        }
        self.seal.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch = Some(tree.structural_epoch);
        // A frame whose display list is the one the compositor has takes the tree on its own.
        self.seal.sends_visual_context_tree = true;
        self.taken_visual_context_tree = Some(tree);
    }

    /// Presents the sealed frame without a recording: the display list the compositor has stands, with
    /// `visual_context_tree`, the render state's tree, where the seal sends one.
    pub(crate) fn present_unrecorded(
        &mut self,
        visual_context_tree: Option<Arc<VisualContextTree>>,
        presenting: &mut Presenting,
    ) {
        if let Some(tree) = visual_context_tree {
            self.take_visual_context_tree(ClockTickVisualContexts {
                tree,
                scroll_offsets: None,
                restructured: false,
            });
        }
        let presenter = self.presenter.clone();
        let mut state = presenter.state();
        if state.is_stale(&self.seal) {
            return;
        }
        let tree = self
            .taken_visual_context_tree
            .clone()
            .or_else(|| {
                state
                    .compositor_display_list
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|display_list| display_list.output.visual_context_tree.clone())
            })
            .unwrap_or_else(|| Arc::new(VisualContextTree::create_identity()));
        let mut frame = state.build_frame(&self.seal, None, &tree, &self.scroll_state);
        frame.scroll_requests = std::mem::take(&mut self.seal.scroll_requests);
        state.note_presented(&mut self.seal, &self.scroll_state);
        drop(state);
        presenting.post_frame(frame);
    }

    /// Presents the sealed frame with the recording that left `output`. The frame goes with the tree a clock tick's update
    /// left, or else the one the recording was recorded against: a recording that repeats the display list it published
    /// before publishes that list again.
    pub(crate) fn present(&mut self, output: &Arc<RecordingOutput>, presenting: &mut Presenting) {
        let tree = self
            .taken_visual_context_tree
            .clone()
            .or_else(|| output.visual_context_tree.clone())
            .expect("a recording was recorded against a tree");
        debug_assert_eq!(
            tree.structural_epoch, output.recorded_structural_epoch,
            "a frame goes with a tree of the structure its recording was recorded against"
        );
        let presenter = self.presenter.clone();
        let mut state = presenter.state();
        if state.is_stale(&self.seal) {
            return;
        }
        let replaces_paint_command_cache_source = self.seal.publishes_recording
            && !self
                .seal
                .paint_command_cache_source
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|source| source.display_list_id == output.display_list_id);
        let mut frame = state.build_frame(&self.seal, Some(output), &tree, &self.scroll_state);
        if replaces_paint_command_cache_source {
            self.seal.paint_command_cache_source = Some(output.clone());
        }
        self.seal.published = Some(output.clone());
        frame.scroll_requests = std::mem::take(&mut self.seal.scroll_requests);
        state.note_presented(&mut self.seal, &self.scroll_state);
        drop(state);
        presenting.post_frame(frame);
    }
}

/// What a display list or a visual context tree draws goes ahead of it, in messages the C++ of the compositor takes,
/// which C++ encodes. Answers whether the compositor could still be reached.
fn post_resources_ahead(
    poster: &crate::paint_stage::CompositorPoster,
    context_id: CompositorContextId,
    resources: &DrawnResources,
) -> bool {
    poster.post_fonts_and_image_frames(context_id, &resources.fonts, &resources.image_frames)
}

impl Presenting<'_> {
    /// Hands `frame` to the compositor, or drops it while the compositor cannot be reached or where its context was
    /// destroyed.
    fn post_frame(&mut self, frame: CompositorFrame) {
        if self.context_was_destroyed(frame.context_id) {
            return;
        }
        let Some((poster, sent_display_list_chunks)) = self.poster_and_sent_display_list_chunks() else {
            return;
        };
        if !post_frame_through(poster, sent_display_list_chunks, frame) {
            self.lose_compositor();
        }
    }
}

/// What the compositor keeps of the display lists sent for one context, which a display list sends the chunks it lacks
/// of, and the chunks that draw SVG images as they were sent, with the records of the images in them. Beside those, the
/// list the compositor holds and the plan of its layers, which the Paint thread plans as it sends what the plan reads.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct SentDisplayListChunks {
    kept: KeptChunks,
    holding_vector_image_records: HashMap<ChunkId, Arc<Chunk>>,
    /// The chunks the compositor keeps as it replays them, with what plans of layers work out of each chunk alone,
    /// which the lists of those chunks share.
    list_chunks: HashMap<ChunkId, Arc<ListChunk>>,
    /// The display list sent last, as the compositor replays it.
    held_list: Option<DisplayListSent>,
}

struct DisplayListSent {
    display_list_id: u64,
    recorded_structural_epoch: u64,
    list: Arc<DisplayListStorage>,
    /// The plan of its layers sent last with it, a visual context tree or a scroll state, or none where it or the tree
    /// sent last went without one.
    layer_plan: Option<LayerPlanSent>,
}

/// A plan of layers sent to the compositor, and what it was made from.
struct LayerPlanSent {
    inputs: InputsOfLayerPlan,
    plan: Arc<LayerPlan>,
}

impl LayerPlanSent {
    fn on_wire(&self) -> LayerPlanOnWire {
        LayerPlanOnWire::Planned(self.plan.clone())
    }
}

impl SentDisplayListChunks {
    /// `chunk` as the compositor replays it, with the records of `vector_images`, the SVG images it draws, in it.
    fn as_sent(&mut self, chunk: &RecordedChunk, vector_images: &HashMap<u64, Arc<VectorImageRecords>>) -> Arc<Chunk> {
        let latest = chunk.latest();
        if !chunk.draws_vector_image_placeholders() {
            return Arc::clone(latest);
        }
        // A chunk's name says which SVG images it draws, whose records never change.
        Arc::clone(
            self.holding_vector_image_records
                .entry(latest.id)
                .or_insert_with(|| Arc::new(chunk_holding_vector_image_records(latest, vector_images))),
        )
    }

    /// The chunks of `chunks_as_sent` the compositor does not keep, once each.
    fn new_chunks<'a>(&self, chunks_as_sent: &'a [Arc<Chunk>]) -> Vec<&'a Chunk> {
        let mut named = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        chunks_as_sent
            .iter()
            .filter(|chunk| !self.kept.keeps(chunk.id) && named.insert(chunk.id))
            .map(|chunk| &**chunk)
            .collect()
    }

    /// Takes in a display list sent that names `chunks_in_paint_order`.
    fn take_in(&mut self, chunks_in_paint_order: &[ChunkId]) {
        self.kept.take_in(chunks_in_paint_order);
        let kept = &self.kept;
        self.holding_vector_image_records.retain(|_, sent| kept.keeps(sent.id));
        self.list_chunks.retain(|id, _| kept.keeps(*id));
    }

    /// The display list of `chunks_as_sent` as the compositor replays it: the same chunks in the same order, so that a
    /// position in it names the same record in both processes.
    fn list_as_sent(&mut self, chunks_as_sent: &[Arc<Chunk>]) -> Option<Arc<DisplayListStorage>> {
        let chunks = chunks_as_sent
            .iter()
            .map(|chunk| {
                self.list_chunks
                    .entry(chunk.id)
                    .or_insert_with(|| Arc::new(ListChunk::of_chunk_made_in_this_process(chunk)))
                    .clone()
            })
            .collect();
        DisplayListStorage::of_chunks(chunks).ok()
    }

    fn held_layer_plan(&self) -> Option<&LayerPlanSent> {
        self.held_list.as_ref()?.layer_plan.as_ref()
    }

    /// The plan of the layers of `list`, which `display_list_id` names, under the other inputs: the plan sent last, where
    /// it was made from inputs that plan alike, and a new one otherwise.
    fn layer_plan_of(
        &self,
        display_list_id: u64,
        list: Arc<DisplayListStorage>,
        visual_context_tree: Arc<VisualContextTree>,
        scroll_state: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        viewport_rect: IntRect,
    ) -> LayerPlanSent {
        let held_plan = self.held_layer_plan();
        let inputs = InputsOfLayerPlan::new_after(
            held_plan.map(|held| &held.inputs),
            list,
            visual_context_tree,
            scroll_state.device_offsets(),
            viewport_rect,
        );
        match held_plan {
            Some(held) if held.inputs.plan_alike_as(&inputs) => LayerPlanSent {
                plan: if held.plan.display_list_id == display_list_id {
                    held.plan.clone()
                } else {
                    Arc::new(LayerPlan {
                        display_list_id,
                        ..(*held.plan).clone()
                    })
                },
                inputs,
            },
            _ => layer_plan_made_from(display_list_id, inputs),
        }
    }

    /// The plan of the layers of the display list the compositor holds under `visual_context_tree`, or none where the
    /// tree does not fit that list, which the compositor then drops.
    fn layer_plan_of_held_list_under(
        &self,
        visual_context_tree: &Arc<VisualContextTree>,
        scroll_state: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        viewport_rect: IntRect,
    ) -> Option<LayerPlanSent> {
        let held = self.held_list.as_ref()?;
        if visual_context_tree.structural_epoch != held.recorded_structural_epoch
            || !visual_context_tree.display_list_references_only_live_nodes(held.list.runs())
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(self.layer_plan_of(
            held.display_list_id,
            held.list.clone(),
            visual_context_tree.clone(),
            scroll_state,
            viewport_rect,
        ))
    }

    /// A new plan of the layers the compositor holds a plan of, where `scroll_state` or `viewport_rect_of_frame`, the
    /// rect the frame is presented within if it is presented, changed what that plan reads. A scroll state without a
    /// plan keeps the plan the compositor holds, and a display list or a tree without one leaves it with none. The
    /// compositor draws a frame within a viewport it takes no plan within as one layer, so such a frame gets no plan.
    fn layer_plan_for_scroll_state(
        &self,
        scroll_state: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        viewport_rect_of_frame: Option<IntRect>,
    ) -> Option<LayerPlanSent> {
        let held = self.held_layer_plan()?;
        let viewport_rect = viewport_rect_of_frame.unwrap_or(held.inputs.viewport_rect());
        if !compositor_takes_plans_within(viewport_rect) {
            return None;
        }
        let inputs = held
            .inputs
            .with_scroll_offsets_and_viewport_rect(scroll_state.device_offsets(), viewport_rect);
        (!held.inputs.plan_alike_as(&inputs)).then(|| layer_plan_made_from(held.plan.display_list_id, inputs))
    }
}

fn layer_plan_made_from(display_list_id: u64, inputs: InputsOfLayerPlan) -> LayerPlanSent {
    let planned = inputs.plan();
    LayerPlanSent {
        plan: Arc::new(LayerPlan {
            display_list_id,
            viewport_rect: inputs.viewport_rect(),
            note_lines: planned.note_lines_for_layers_overlay(),
            stack: planned.stack_on_wire,
        }),
        inputs,
    }
}

/// Posts the messages of `frame` through `poster`, in order, where `sent_display_list_chunks` says what the compositor
/// keeps of the display lists sent before. Answers whether the compositor could still be reached: a display list that
/// cannot be placed in shared memory is skipped, and the rest of the frame still goes over.
fn post_frame_through(
    poster: &crate::paint_stage::CompositorPoster,
    sent_display_list_chunks: &mut HashMap<CompositorContextId, SentDisplayListChunks>,
    frame: CompositorFrame,
) -> bool {
    let CompositorFrame {
        context_id,
        display_list_update,
        visual_context_tree_update,
        scroll_state_update,
        scroll_requests,
        present_viewport_rect,
    } = frame;
    // A plan is made for the rect the compositor rasters the frame within: at the origin, at the size of the viewport the
    // frame is presented in.
    let viewport_rect_of_frame =
        present_viewport_rect.map(|viewport_rect| IntRect::new(0, 0, viewport_rect.width, viewport_rect.height));
    let viewport_rect_of_layer_plans =
        viewport_rect_of_frame.filter(|viewport_rect| compositor_takes_plans_within(*viewport_rect));
    let sent = sent_display_list_chunks.entry(context_id).or_default();
    if let Some(update) = display_list_update {
        if !post_resources_ahead(poster, context_id, &update.resources) {
            return false;
        }
        // The compositor replays chunks with the records of the SVG images they draw in them.
        let vector_images = &update.output.resources.vector_images;
        let chunks_as_sent: Vec<Arc<Chunk>> = update
            .output
            .chunks
            .iter()
            .map(|chunk| sent.as_sent(chunk, vector_images))
            .collect();
        let chunks_in_paint_order: Vec<ChunkId> = chunks_as_sent.iter().map(|chunk| chunk.id).collect();
        let new_chunks = sent.new_chunks(&chunks_as_sent);
        let display_list_id = update.properties.id;
        let recorded_structural_epoch = update.properties.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch;
        match poster.share_display_list(
            chunks_in_paint_order.clone(),
            &new_chunks,
            update.properties,
            Some(update.async_scrolling_metadata),
        ) {
            Some(display_list) => {
                let list = sent.list_as_sent(&chunks_as_sent);
                let layer_plan = list
                    .clone()
                    .zip(viewport_rect_of_layer_plans)
                    .map(|(list, viewport_rect)| {
                        sent.layer_plan_of(
                            display_list_id,
                            list,
                            update.visual_context_tree.clone(),
                            &update.scroll_state,
                            viewport_rect,
                        )
                    });
                let message = UpdateDisplayList {
                    context_id,
                    display_list,
                    visual_context_tree: update.visual_context_tree,
                    scroll_state: update.scroll_state,
                    keyboard_scroll_state: update.keyboard_scroll_state,
                    layer_plan: layer_plan.as_ref().map(LayerPlanSent::on_wire),
                };
                if !poster.post(message) {
                    return false;
                }
                sent.take_in(&chunks_in_paint_order);
                sent.held_list = list.map(|list| DisplayListSent {
                    display_list_id,
                    recorded_structural_epoch,
                    list,
                    layer_plan,
                });
            }
            None => {
                eprintln!(
                    "WebContent: Could not place {} new display list chunks in shared memory",
                    new_chunks.len()
                );
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(update) = visual_context_tree_update {
        if !post_resources_ahead(poster, context_id, &update.resources) {
            return false;
        }
        let layer_plan = viewport_rect_of_layer_plans.and_then(|viewport_rect| {
            sent.layer_plan_of_held_list_under(&update.visual_context_tree, &update.scroll_state, viewport_rect)
        });
        let message = UpdateVisualContextTree {
            context_id,
            visual_context_tree: update.visual_context_tree,
            scroll_state: update.scroll_state,
            keyboard_scroll_state: update.keyboard_scroll_state,
            layer_plan: layer_plan.as_ref().map(LayerPlanSent::on_wire),
        };
        if !poster.post(message) {
            return false;
        }
        if let Some(held) = sent.held_list.as_mut() {
            held.layer_plan = layer_plan;
        }
    }
    if let Some(update) = scroll_state_update {
        let layer_plan = sent.layer_plan_for_scroll_state(&update.scroll_state, viewport_rect_of_frame);
        let message = UpdateScrollState {
            context_id,
            visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: update.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch,
            scroll_state: update.scroll_state,
            keyboard_scroll_state: update.keyboard_scroll_state,
            layer_plan: layer_plan.as_ref().map(LayerPlanSent::on_wire),
        };
        if !poster.post(message) {
            return false;
        }
        if let Some(layer_plan) = layer_plan
            && let Some(held) = sent.held_list.as_mut()
        {
            held.layer_plan = Some(layer_plan);
        }
    }
    if !scroll_requests.is_empty()
        && !poster.post(ApplyScrollRequests {
            context_id,
            scroll_requests,
        })
    {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(viewport_rect) = present_viewport_rect
        && !poster.post(PresentFrame {
            context_id,
            viewport_rect,
        })
    {
        return false;
    }
    true
}

/// A new presenter, with one reference the caller takes over.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_create() -> *const NavigablePresenter {
    Arc::into_raw(Arc::new(NavigablePresenter::default()))
}

/// Gives up a reference to `presenter`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_release(presenter: crate::css::ffi_support::OwnedArc<NavigablePresenter>) {
    drop(presenter);
}

/// Writes the paint config of the display list the compositor context holds to `out`, and answers whether it holds one.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_compositor_display_list_paint_config(
    presenter: &NavigablePresenter,
    out: &mut FfiPaintConfig,
) -> bool {
    let Some(paint_config) = presenter.state().compositor_display_list_paint_config else {
        return false;
    };
    *out = paint_config;
    true
}

/// Writes the structural epoch of the visual context tree the display list the compositor context holds was recorded
/// against to `out`, and answers whether it holds one.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_compositor_display_list_structural_epoch(
    presenter: &NavigablePresenter,
    out: &mut u64,
) -> bool {
    let state = presenter.state();
    let Some(display_list) = state.compositor_display_list.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    *out = display_list.output.recorded_structural_epoch;
    true
}

/// Forgets what the compositor context holds: a new compositor process holds nothing.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_forget_compositor_display_list(presenter: &NavigablePresenter) {
    let mut state = presenter.state();
    state.compositor_display_list_paint_config = None;
    state.compositor_display_list = None;
}

/// Writes the scroll positions the window of the display list the navigable's compositor context holds was placed at
/// to `receiver` through `write`, for a test: one `(x, y)` in CSS pixels per scroller that was scrolled, in the order
/// of their nodes, and nothing where the list has no window.
///
/// # Safety
/// `write` must be safe to call with `receiver` and a pointer to `byte_count` bytes that live for the call.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_display_list_window_scroll_positions_for_testing(
    presenter: &NavigablePresenter,
    receiver: *mut c_void,
    write: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const u8, usize),
) {
    let state = presenter.state();
    let window = state
        .compositor_display_list
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|display_list| display_list.output.window.as_deref());
    let positions: Vec<String> = window
        .into_iter()
        .flat_map(|window| {
            let scale = window.device_pixels_per_css_pixel as f32;
            window
                .scroll_offsets
                .iter()
                .filter(|offset| offset.x != 0.0 || offset.y != 0.0)
                .map(move |offset| format!("({}, {})", 0.0 - offset.x / scale, 0.0 - offset.y / scale))
        })
        .collect();
    let positions = positions.join(" ");
    // SAFETY: The caller keeps `write` callable with `receiver`, and the bytes live until it returns.
    unsafe { write(receiver, positions.as_ptr(), positions.len()) };
}

/// What presented the navigable's last frame.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_last_frame_presented_by(presenter: &NavigablePresenter) -> FfiPresentedBy {
    presenter
        .state()
        .last_frame_presented_by
        .unwrap_or(FfiPresentedBy::None)
}

/// Writes the generation of the keyboard scroll state the last frame handed the compositor to `out`, and answers
/// whether it handed one.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn navigable_presenter_last_keyboard_scroll_state_generation(
    presenter: &NavigablePresenter,
    out: &mut u64,
) -> bool {
    let Some(generation) = presenter.state().last_keyboard_scroll_state_generation else {
        return false;
    };
    *out = generation;
    true
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::painting::display_list::builder::DisplayListBuilder;
    use crate::painting::display_list::commands::{ContextRef, EffectNodeIndex, FillRect};
    use libgfx_rust::{Color, CompositingAndBlendingOperator};

    // A window can be dragged larger than the viewports the compositor takes plans within.
    #[test]
    fn a_frame_presented_within_a_viewport_the_compositor_takes_no_plan_within_gets_no_plan_for_its_scroll_state() {
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        builder.append(
            &FillRect {
                rect: IntRect::new(0, 0, 800, 600),
                color: Color::from_rgb(0, 128, 0),
                compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                background_color_animation_effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
            },
            &[],
            ContextRef::default(),
        );
        let list = DisplayListStorage::of_chunks(vec![Arc::new(ListChunk::copied(
            builder.bytes(),
            builder.command_runs(),
            0,
        ))])
        .unwrap();
        let tree = Arc::new(VisualContextTree::create_identity());
        let viewport_rect = IntRect::new(0, 0, 800, 600);
        let sent = SentDisplayListChunks {
            held_list: Some(DisplayListSent {
                display_list_id: 1,
                recorded_structural_epoch: tree.structural_epoch,
                list: list.clone(),
                layer_plan: Some(layer_plan_made_from(
                    1,
                    InputsOfLayerPlan::new(list, tree, &[], viewport_rect),
                )),
            }),
            ..SentDisplayListChunks::default()
        };
        let scroll_state = ScrollStateSnapshot::default();
        assert!(
            sent.layer_plan_for_scroll_state(&scroll_state, Some(IntRect::new(0, 0, 800, 500)))
                .is_some()
        );
        let viewport_past_the_limit = IntRect::new(0, 0, i32::MAX, 600);
        assert!(!compositor_takes_plans_within(viewport_past_the_limit));
        assert!(
            sent.layer_plan_for_scroll_state(&scroll_state, Some(viewport_past_the_limit))
                .is_none()
        );
    }
}

//! What a document publishes for the display list recording to read.
//!
//! A [`PublishedFrame`] is what one recording reads: [`PublishedRows`], one generation of a
//! document's layout tree shape, paintable rows and paint facts and of the columns read beside them,
//! with the paint generation and the paint state the recording reads. It is immutable: every column in
//! it is a [`ColumnSnapshot`] or an `Arc` the document shares with it, so the document writes its
//! live columns (copying a chunk a frame still shares) while it is read.

use crate::cow_column::ColumnSnapshot;
use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelPoint;
use crate::css::style::{HoverFrameLease, StyleRecordLease};
use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::layout::PublishedTextSlot;
use crate::layout::SLOTS_PER_CHUNK;
use crate::layout::fragment_tree::FragmentLink;
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeSlotId, PaintNode};
use crate::layout::tree_shape::PUBLISHED_ROWS_PER_CHUNK;
use crate::painting::layer_image_paint_facts::LayerImagePaintFactsTable;
use crate::painting::paint_state::{CustomHighlightPseudoStyles, PaintState, SelectionPseudoStyles};
use crate::painting::paintable_data::{CommittedSideData, PaintableData};
use crate::painting::paintable_rows::{CommittedFragmentLinkSlot, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK};
use crate::painting::record::change_ticks::{PaintChangeStamps, PaintGeneration};
use crate::painting::replaced_paint_facts::ReplacedPaintFactsTable;
use crate::painting::selection::{
    CustomHighlights, HighlightPseudoElement, SearchTextHighlights, SelectionRange, SpellingErrorHighlights,
};
use crate::painting::stacking_context::entries::StackingContextEntries;
use crate::painting::svg_paint_resources::SvgPaintResourceRows;
use crate::painting::visual_context::{BoxVisualContextNodeHandles, EMPTY_BOX_VISUAL_CONTEXT_NODE_HANDLES};
use crate::painting::visual_context::{VisualContextTree, WorldTransforms};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// The document's text rows and its replaced, layer image and SVG paint resource tables, as they
/// were when published.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct PublishedPaintFacts {
    pub(crate) text: ColumnSnapshot<PublishedTextSlot, SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(crate) replaced: Arc<ReplacedPaintFactsTable>,
    pub(crate) layer_images: Arc<LayerImagePaintFactsTable>,
    pub(crate) svg_paint_resources: Arc<SvgPaintResourceRows>,
    pub(crate) image_maps: Arc<crate::painting::image_map_areas::ImageMaps>,
}

/// One published generation of a document's layout tree shape and paintable rows, and of the
/// columns read beside them.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct PublishedRows {
    /// The epoch of the geometry the rows were published with, which the absolute rects a
    /// recording computes from them are stamped with.
    pub(super) geometry_epoch: u64,
    pub(super) ink_overflow: ColumnSnapshot<crate::painting::ink_overflow::InkOverflow, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(crate) ink_overflow_stamp: u64,
    pub(crate) hit_test_items_stamp: u64,
    pub(super) paint_change_stamps: ColumnSnapshot<PaintChangeStamps, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(super) nodes: ColumnSnapshot<PaintNode, PUBLISHED_ROWS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(super) paint_facts: PublishedPaintFacts,
    pub(super) rows: ColumnSnapshot<PaintableData, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(super) fragment_links: ColumnSnapshot<CommittedFragmentLinkSlot, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(super) side_data: ColumnSnapshot<CommittedSideData, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(super) stacking_context_entries: ColumnSnapshot<Option<Arc<StackingContextEntries>>, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
    pub(super) visual_context_node_handles:
        ColumnSnapshot<Option<Arc<BoxVisualContextNodeHandles>>, PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK>,
}

impl PublishedRows {
    /// The column of the nodes, as published.
    pub(crate) fn paint_nodes(&self) -> &ColumnSnapshot<PaintNode, PUBLISHED_ROWS_PER_CHUNK> {
        &self.nodes
    }

    /// What a live text row published.
    pub(crate) fn text(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> Option<&PublishedTextSlot> {
        self.node(id)?;
        self.paint_facts
            .text
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .filter(|text| text.generation == id.generation())
    }

    /// The node in slot `id`, if the slot holds it: a node freed or replaced since reads as gone.
    pub(crate) fn node(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> Option<&PaintNode> {
        if id.is_invalid() {
            return None;
        }
        self.nodes
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .filter(|node| node.generation != 0 && node.generation == id.generation())
    }

    /// The nodes the slots hold, with the slot of each.
    pub(crate) fn live_nodes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (NodeSlotId, &PaintNode)> {
        (0..self.nodes.slot_capacity()).filter_map(|index| {
            let node = self.nodes.get(index).filter(|node| node.generation != 0)?;
            Some((NodeSlotId::new(index as u32, node.generation), node))
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_data(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> &PaintableData {
        assert!(!id.is_invalid(), "invalid paintable arena slot ID");
        let data = self
            .rows
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .expect("invalid paintable arena slot ID");
        assert_eq!(
            data.slot_generation,
            id.generation(),
            "paintable arena read a stale or unused slot"
        );
        data
    }

    pub(crate) fn paintable_row_is_populated(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        if id.is_invalid() {
            return false;
        }
        self.rows
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .is_some_and(|data| data.slot_generation != 0 && data.slot_generation == id.generation())
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_committed_fragment_link<R>(
        &self,
        id: NodeSlotId,
        read: impl FnOnce(Option<&FragmentLink>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        read(
            self.fragment_links
                .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
                .and_then(|slot| slot.link_for(id.generation())),
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn paint_change_stamps(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> PaintChangeStamps {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(id) {
            return PaintChangeStamps::default();
        }
        self.paint_change_stamps
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub(crate) fn committed_side_data(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> &CommittedSideData {
        debug_assert!(self.paintable_row_is_populated(id));
        self.side_data
            .get(id.slot_index() as usize)
            .expect("a populated row has published side data")
    }

    pub(crate) fn visual_context_node_handles(&self, id: NodeSlotId) -> &BoxVisualContextNodeHandles {
        self.paintable_row_is_populated(id)
            .then(|| self.visual_context_node_handles.get(id.slot_index() as usize))
            .flatten()
            .and_then(|handles| handles.as_deref())
            .unwrap_or(&EMPTY_BOX_VISUAL_CONTEXT_NODE_HANDLES)
    }

    pub(crate) fn stacking_context_entries(&self, root: NodeSlotId) -> Option<&StackingContextEntries> {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(root) {
            return None;
        }
        self.stacking_context_entries
            .get(root.slot_index() as usize)
            .and_then(|table| table.as_deref())
    }
}

/// What a recording reads of the document's paint state, as it was when the frame was published.
pub(crate) struct PublishedPaintState {
    pub(crate) visual_context_tree: Option<Arc<VisualContextTree>>,
    unscrolled_world_transforms: std::sync::OnceLock<WorldTransforms>,
    /// Each scroll state slot's own scroll offset, shared with the document's scroll state.
    scroll_own_offsets: Arc<Vec<CssPixelPoint>>,
    pub(crate) has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate: bool,
    pub(crate) selection: Option<Arc<SelectionRange>>,
    pub(crate) selection_pseudo_styles: Arc<SelectionPseudoStyles>,
    pub(crate) search_text: Arc<SearchTextHighlights>,
    pub(crate) search_text_pseudo_styles: Arc<SelectionPseudoStyles>,
    pub(crate) search_text_current_pseudo_styles: Arc<SelectionPseudoStyles>,
    pub(crate) spelling_errors: Arc<SpellingErrorHighlights>,
    pub(crate) spelling_error_pseudo_styles: Arc<SelectionPseudoStyles>,
    pub(crate) custom_highlights: Arc<CustomHighlights>,
    pub(crate) custom_highlight_pseudo_styles: Arc<CustomHighlightPseudoStyles>,
}

impl PublishedPaintState {
    /// The tree's world transforms without scroll offsets, which is all that the scale of a space depends on.
    pub(crate) fn unscrolled_world_transforms(&self) -> &WorldTransforms {
        self.unscrolled_world_transforms.get_or_init(|| {
            let tree = self
                .visual_context_tree
                .as_deref()
                .expect("recording runs against a visual context tree");
            WorldTransforms::new(tree, &[], None)
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn highlight_pseudo_styles(&self, highlight: HighlightPseudoElement) -> &SelectionPseudoStyles {
        match highlight {
            HighlightPseudoElement::Selection => &self.selection_pseudo_styles,
            HighlightPseudoElement::SearchText => &self.search_text_pseudo_styles,
            HighlightPseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent => &self.search_text_current_pseudo_styles,
            HighlightPseudoElement::SpellingError => &self.spelling_error_pseudo_styles,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn new(paint_state: &PaintState) -> Self {
        let visual_context = &paint_state.visual_context;
        Self {
            visual_context_tree: visual_context.tree.clone(),
            unscrolled_world_transforms: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
            scroll_own_offsets: visual_context.scroll_state.own_offsets().clone(),
            has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate: visual_context
                .scroll_state
                .has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate,
            selection: paint_state.selection.clone(),
            selection_pseudo_styles: paint_state.selection_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            search_text: paint_state.search_text.clone(),
            search_text_pseudo_styles: paint_state.search_text_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            search_text_current_pseudo_styles: paint_state.search_text_current_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            spelling_errors: paint_state.spelling_errors.clone(),
            spelling_error_pseudo_styles: paint_state.spelling_error_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            custom_highlights: paint_state.custom_highlights.clone(),
            custom_highlight_pseudo_styles: paint_state.custom_highlight_pseudo_styles.clone(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn structural_epoch(&self) -> u64 {
        self.visual_context_tree
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(0, |tree| tree.structural_epoch)
    }

    pub(crate) fn scroll_own_offsets(&self) -> &[CssPixelPoint] {
        &self.scroll_own_offsets
    }

    fn with_scroll_own_offsets(&self, scroll_own_offsets: Arc<Vec<CssPixelPoint>>) -> Self {
        Self {
            visual_context_tree: self.visual_context_tree.clone(),
            unscrolled_world_transforms: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
            scroll_own_offsets,
            has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate: self.has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate,
            selection: self.selection.clone(),
            selection_pseudo_styles: self.selection_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            search_text: self.search_text.clone(),
            search_text_pseudo_styles: self.search_text_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            search_text_current_pseudo_styles: self.search_text_current_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            spelling_errors: self.spelling_errors.clone(),
            spelling_error_pseudo_styles: self.spelling_error_pseudo_styles.clone(),
            custom_highlights: self.custom_highlights.clone(),
            custom_highlight_pseudo_styles: self.custom_highlight_pseudo_styles.clone(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn scroll_own_offset(&self, slot: usize) -> CssPixelPoint {
        let offset = self.scroll_own_offsets.get(slot).copied();
        debug_assert!(offset.is_some(), "the tree's scroll node has a scroll state");
        offset.unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

/// What a document published for one recording to read: its rows, the paint generation it was published as of and the
/// paint state the recording reads, with a lease on the style records its rows name. [`LayoutNodeArena::freeze_frame`] is
/// its only constructor and it has no `Clone`: a recording takes a frame and drops it before it returns, and nothing
/// keeps one past the next write to the arena.
pub(crate) struct PublishedFrame {
    pub(super) rows: PublishedRows,
    paint_generation: PaintGeneration,
    everything_changed_at: PaintGeneration,
    paint_state: PublishedPaintState,
    _style_records: FrameStyleRecords,
}

enum FrameStyleRecords {
    Every(#[expect(dead_code, reason = "held for the payloads it keeps")] StyleRecordLease),
    NamedByItsRows(#[expect(dead_code, reason = "held for the payloads it keeps")] Arc<HoverFrameLease>),
}

/// A committed frame that a clock lane keeps until the next one, to record it again where the compositor scrolled to
/// while the host is busy. It shares the frame's rows and paint state, and holds only the style records its rows name,
/// so that the engine goes on reclaiming the others.
pub(crate) struct HeldFrame {
    rows: PublishedRows,
    paint_generation: PaintGeneration,
    everything_changed_at: PaintGeneration,
    paint_state: PublishedPaintState,
    style_records: Arc<HoverFrameLease>,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
}

impl HeldFrame {
    /// The row the frame's paint order starts at.
    pub(crate) fn viewport(&self) -> NodeSlotId {
        self.viewport
    }

    /// The frame with its scroll containers where `scrolled` says the compositor scrolled them to, by the identity of
    /// their nodes, and the others where the frame had them.
    pub(crate) fn frame_where_scrolled(&self, scrolled: &[(i64, CssPixelPoint)]) -> PublishedFrame {
        PublishedFrame {
            rows: self.rows.clone(),
            paint_generation: self.paint_generation,
            everything_changed_at: self.everything_changed_at,
            paint_state: paint_state_where_scrolled(&self.rows, &self.paint_state, scrolled),
            _style_records: FrameStyleRecords::NamedByItsRows(Arc::clone(&self.style_records)),
        }
    }
}

/// `paint_state`, the paint state of a frame of `rows`, with the frame's scroll containers where `scrolled` says the
/// compositor scrolled them to, by the identity of their nodes, and the others where the frame had them.
fn paint_state_where_scrolled(
    rows: &PublishedRows,
    paint_state: &PublishedPaintState,
    scrolled: &[(i64, CssPixelPoint)],
) -> PublishedPaintState {
    let mut scroll_own_offsets = paint_state.scroll_own_offsets.as_ref().clone();
    if let Some(tree) = paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_deref() {
        for node in &tree.spatial_nodes {
            let crate::painting::visual_context::SpatialData::Scroll(scroll) = &node.data else {
                continue;
            };
            if !rows.paintable_row_is_populated(scroll.owner_paintable) {
                continue;
            }
            let identity = rows.paintable_data(scroll.owner_paintable).node_identity;
            let Some(&(_, position)) = scrolled.iter().find(|(scroller, _)| *scroller == identity) else {
                continue;
            };
            if let Some(own_offset) = scroll_own_offsets.get_mut(scroll.state_slot) {
                *own_offset = CssPixelPoint::new(-position.x, -position.y);
            }
        }
    }
    paint_state.with_scroll_own_offsets(Arc::new(scroll_own_offsets))
}

// A frame is read on whichever thread paints it while the document writes its live columns: it
// holds no cell and no borrow of the document, and owns everything it reads but its nodes' styles.
// Those are `HostShared` pointers to style records, which stay valid because the engine frees no
// record's payloads while the frame holds its lease, even after the document has replaced them.
const _: () = {
    const fn assert_published<T: Send + Sync + 'static>() {}
    assert_published::<PublishedFrame>();
};

impl LayoutNodeArena {
    /// What the next recording reads of the document, as it is now.
    pub(crate) fn freeze_frame(&mut self) -> PublishedFrame {
        self.settle_ink_overflow();
        let rows = self.publish_rows();
        PublishedFrame {
            rows,
            paint_generation: self.take_paint_generation(),
            everything_changed_at: self.everything_changed_at(),
            paint_state: PublishedPaintState::new(self.paint_state()),
            _style_records: FrameStyleRecords::Every(self.with_style_store(|engine| engine.lease_style_records())),
        }
    }
}

impl PublishedFrame {
    /// Moves the frame's scroll containers to where `scrolled` says the compositor scrolled them to, by the identity of
    /// their nodes, and leaves the others where the frame had them.
    pub(crate) fn scroll_to_where_scrolled(&mut self, scrolled: &[(i64, CssPixelPoint)]) {
        self.paint_state = paint_state_where_scrolled(&self.rows, &self.paint_state, scrolled);
    }

    /// What the frame's recording reads of the document's paint state.
    pub(crate) fn paint_state(&self) -> &PublishedPaintState {
        &self.paint_state
    }

    /// The frame for a clock lane to keep, of which the row of `viewport` starts the paint order, under `style_records`,
    /// a lease on the records its rows name.
    pub(crate) fn held(&self, viewport: NodeSlotId, style_records: Arc<HoverFrameLease>) -> HeldFrame {
        HeldFrame {
            rows: self.rows.clone(),
            paint_generation: self.paint_generation,
            everything_changed_at: self.everything_changed_at,
            paint_state: self
                .paint_state
                .with_scroll_own_offsets(Arc::clone(&self.paint_state.scroll_own_offsets)),
            style_records,
            viewport,
        }
    }

    /// The column of the nodes the frame's rows name the style records of.
    pub(crate) fn paint_nodes(&self) -> &ColumnSnapshot<PaintNode, PUBLISHED_ROWS_PER_CHUNK> {
        self.rows.paint_nodes()
    }

    /// The generation the frame was published as of.
    pub(crate) fn paint_generation(&self) -> PaintGeneration {
        self.paint_generation
    }

    pub(crate) fn everything_paints_anew_since(&self, as_of: PaintGeneration) -> bool {
        self.everything_changed_at > as_of
    }

    /// The SVG paint resources the frame was published with.
    pub(crate) fn svg_paint_resources(&self) -> &Arc<SvgPaintResourceRows> {
        &self.rows.paint_facts.svg_paint_resources
    }

    /// How many paintable rows the frame has room for.
    pub(crate) fn paintable_row_capacity(&self) -> usize {
        self.rows.rows.slot_capacity()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels;
    use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
    use crate::layout::fragment_tree;
    use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeFlag, NodeKind};
    use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead, PaintRow, PaintSource};
    use crate::painting::record::recorder_state::AbsoluteRectMemo;
    use std::cell::RefCell;

    #[test]
    fn published_rows_keep_their_generation_after_a_later_write() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let node = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.populate_paintable_row(node);
        let mut link = fragment_tree::FragmentLink::for_test(node);
        link.placement.insets.left = CssPixels::from_integer(10);
        arena.set_committed_fragment_link(node, link.clone(), None);
        arena.paintable_rows_mut().paintable_data_mut(node).node_identity = 10;
        arena.committed_side_data_mut(node).inline_content = Some(Default::default());

        let published = arena.publish_rows();
        link.placement.insets.left = CssPixels::from_integer(20);
        arena.set_committed_fragment_link(node, link, None);
        arena.paintable_rows_mut().paintable_data_mut(node).node_identity = 20;
        arena.committed_side_data_mut(node).inline_content = None;

        assert_eq!(published.paintable_data(node).node_identity, 10);
        assert_eq!(
            published.with_committed_fragment_link(node, |link| link.map(|link| link.placement.insets.left)),
            Some(CssPixels::from_integer(10))
        );
        assert!(published.committed_side_data(node).inline_content.is_some());
        assert_eq!(arena.live_paintable_data(node).node_identity, 20);
        assert_eq!(
            arena.with_committed_fragment_link(node, |link| link.map(|link| link.placement.insets.left)),
            Some(CssPixels::from_integer(20))
        );
        assert!(arena.committed_side_data(node).inline_content.is_none());
    }

    fn derived_facts<'a>(row: Option<impl PaintRow<'a>>) -> Option<[bool; 5]> {
        row.map(|row| {
            [
                row.is_fragmented_inline(),
                row.is_out_of_flow(),
                row.is_atomic_inline(),
                row.is_positioned(),
                row.is_floating(),
            ]
        })
    }

    #[test]
    fn published_rows_answer_every_row_read_as_the_arena_does() {
        let mut engine = crate::css::style::StyleEngine::new();
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        arena.set_style_engine(crate::css::style::StyleEngineHandle::from_raw(&raw mut engine));
        let mut slots = Vec::new();
        for index in 0..PAINTABLE_SLOTS_PER_CHUNK + 3 {
            let node = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
            slots.push(node);
            if index % 3 == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            arena.populate_paintable_row(node);
            arena.paintable_rows_mut().paintable_data_mut(node).node_identity = index as i64;
            if index % 2 == 0 {
                let mut link = fragment_tree::FragmentLink::for_test(node);
                link.placement.insets.top = CssPixels::from_integer(index as i64);
                arena.set_committed_fragment_link(node, link, None);
            }
        }

        let root = slots[1];
        arena.write_shape(root).set_kind(NodeKind::BlockContainer);
        for &child in &slots[2..6] {
            arena.write_shape(child).set_kind(NodeKind::InlineNode);
            arena.insert_child(root, child, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        }
        arena.set_node_flag(slots[3], NodeFlag::Anonymous, true);
        arena.write_shape(slots[4]).set_generated_for(1);

        let frame = arena.freeze_frame();
        let absolute_rects = RefCell::new(AbsoluteRectMemo::default());
        let source = PaintSource::new(&frame, &absolute_rects);
        for &node in &slots {
            assert_eq!(source.slot_is_live(node), arena.slot_is_live(node));
            assert_eq!(source.node_kind_if_live(node), arena.node_kind_if_live(node));
            assert_eq!(source.node_flags_if_live(node), arena.node_flags_if_live(node));
            assert_eq!(source.node_parent_if_live(node), arena.node_parent_if_live(node));
            assert_eq!(
                source.node_first_child_if_live(node),
                arena.node_first_child_if_live(node)
            );
            assert_eq!(
                source.node_next_sibling_if_live(node),
                arena.node_next_sibling_if_live(node)
            );
            assert_eq!(source.node_generated_for(node), arena.node_generated_for(node));
            assert_eq!(source.node_is_dom_backed(node), arena.node_is_dom_backed(node));
            assert_eq!(derived_facts(source.node(node)), derived_facts(arena.node(node)));
            assert_eq!(
                source.node_style_if_live(node).is_some(),
                arena.node_style_if_live(node).is_some()
            );
            assert_eq!(
                source.text_fragments(node).as_slice(),
                arena.text_fragments(node).as_slice()
            );
            assert_eq!(source.rendered_text(node).is_some(), arena.text_content(node).is_some());
            assert_eq!(source.replaced_paint_facts(node), arena.replaced_paint_facts(node));
        }
        for node in slots {
            assert_eq!(
                source.paintable_row_is_populated(node),
                arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node)
            );
            if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
                continue;
            }
            assert_eq!(source.paintable_data(node), arena.live_paintable_data(node));
            assert_eq!(
                source.with_committed_fragment_link(node, |link| link.map(|link| link.placement.insets.top)),
                arena.with_committed_fragment_link(node, |link| link.map(|link| link.placement.insets.top))
            );
            assert!(*source.committed_side_data(node) == *arena.committed_side_data(node));
            assert_eq!(source.paint_change_stamps(node), arena.paint_change_stamps(node));
            assert!(source.stacking_context_entries(node).is_none() == arena.stacking_context_entries(node).is_none());
        }
    }
}
