use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead};
use crate::painting::record::trace::Observer;

use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixelSize};
use crate::layout::node_data::{DomPaintFact, NodeSlotId};
use crate::painting::chrome_geometry::{ChromeGeometry, maximum_scroll_offset, minimum_scroll_offset};
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::*;
use crate::painting::ffi::ScrollDirection;
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;
use crate::painting::record::PaintRecorder;
use crate::painting::style_queries;
use crate::painting::visual_context::compositor_scroll_table::css_point_to_device_point;
use libgfx_rust::{FloatRect, FloatSize};

fn css_size_to_device_size(size: CssPixelSize, device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64) -> FloatSize {
    let scale = device_pixels_per_css_pixel as f32;
    FloatSize {
        width: size.width.to_float() * scale,
        height: size.height.to_float() * scale,
    }
}

fn css_rect_to_device_rect(rect: CssPixelRect, device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64) -> FloatRect {
    let location = css_point_to_device_point(rect.location(), device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
    let size = css_size_to_device_size(rect.size(), device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
    FloatRect {
        x: location.x,
        y: location.y,
        width: size.width,
        height: size.height,
    }
}

impl<O: Observer> PaintRecorder<'_, O> {
    pub(crate) fn has_compositor_scroll_node(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        let index = self.data(paintable).own_scroll_node_index;
        self.paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_ref().is_some_and(|tree| {
            tree.compositor_scroll_table()
                .nodes
                .binary_search_by_key(&index, |node| node.scroll_node_index)
                .is_ok()
        })
    }

    fn wheel_hit_test_target_scroll_node_index_for(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> SpatialNodeIndex {
        let mut paintables_to_cache: Vec<NodeSlotId> = Vec::new();
        let mut target = VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX;
        let mut current = paintable;
        loop {
            if let Some(cached) = self.scratch.wheel_hit_test_target_cache.get(&current) {
                target = *cached;
                break;
            }

            paintables_to_cache.push(current);
            if self.has_compositor_scroll_node(current) {
                target = self.data(current).own_scroll_node_index;
                break;
            }

            let raw_containing_block = self.data(current).containing_block;
            let mut containing_block = (!raw_containing_block.is_invalid()
                && self.source.paintable_row_is_populated(raw_containing_block))
            .then_some(raw_containing_block);
            if let Some(block) = containing_block
                && style_queries::is_fixed_position(self.source, block)
            {
                if self.has_compositor_scroll_node(block) {
                    target = self.data(block).own_scroll_node_index;
                }
                if target != VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX {
                    break;
                }
                containing_block = None;
            }

            if let Some(block) = containing_block {
                current = block;
                continue;
            }

            let viewport = self.viewport;
            if viewport.is_invalid() || viewport == current {
                break;
            }
            current = viewport;
        }

        for slot in paintables_to_cache {
            self.scratch.wheel_hit_test_target_cache.insert(slot, target);
        }
        target
    }

    fn record_wheel_hit_test_target(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        // OPTIMIZATION: The compositor falls back to the viewport when there are no explicit
        // targets. Avoid generating redundant per-box targets when no non-viewport scroller
        // or nested context could need one.
        if !self.records_per_box_wheel_hit_test_targets {
            return;
        }
        if !self.is_visible(paintable) || !self.visible_for_hit_testing(paintable) {
            return;
        }
        let scale = self.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
        for (border_box_rect, border_radii) in self.border_boxes_of_fragments(paintable) {
            let rect = css_rect_to_device_rect(border_box_rect, scale);
            if rect.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let target_scroll_node_index = self.wheel_hit_test_target_scroll_node_index_for(paintable);
            let corner_radii = border_radii.as_corners(&self.converter);
            if corner_radii.has_any_radius() {
                self.recorder.compositor_wheel_hit_test_target_with_corner_radii(
                    CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii {
                        target_scroll_node_index,
                        rect,
                        corner_radii,
                    },
                );
                continue;
            }
            self.recorder
                .compositor_wheel_hit_test_target(CompositorWheelHitTestTarget {
                    target_scroll_node_index,
                    rect,
                });
        }
    }

    fn record_blocking_wheel_event_region(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        if self.inputs.uncaptured.has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport {
            return;
        }
        if !self.is_visible(paintable) || !self.visible_for_hit_testing(paintable) {
            return;
        }
        if !self
            .source
            .node_has_dom_paint_fact(paintable, DomPaintFact::InsideBlockingWheelEventHandler)
        {
            return;
        }
        for border_box_rect in paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rects_of_fragments(self.source, paintable) {
            let rect = css_rect_to_device_rect(border_box_rect, self.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
            if rect.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            self.blocking_wheel_event_region_count += 1;
            self.recorder
                .compositor_blocking_wheel_event_region(CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion { rect });
        }
    }

    fn record_main_thread_wheel_event_region(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        for border_box_rect in paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rects_of_fragments(self.source, paintable) {
            let rect = css_rect_to_device_rect(border_box_rect, self.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
            if rect.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            self.recorder
                .compositor_main_thread_wheel_event_region(CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion { rect });
        }
    }

    fn compositor_scrollbar_for(
        &self,
        paintable: NodeSlotId,
        direction: ScrollDirection,
    ) -> Option<CompositorScrollbar> {
        let chrome_geometry = ChromeGeometry::for_recording(self.source, self.inputs);
        let scrollbar = chrome_geometry.compute_scrollbar_data(paintable, direction, false)?;
        let expanded = chrome_geometry
            .compute_scrollbar_data(paintable, direction, true)
            .expect("an enlarged scrollbar must exist when the regular scrollbar exists");
        let scale = self.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
        let min_scroll_offset = css_point_to_device_point(minimum_scroll_offset(self.source, paintable), scale);
        let max_scroll_offset = css_point_to_device_point(maximum_scroll_offset(self.source, paintable), scale);
        let vertical = direction == ScrollDirection::Vertical;
        Some(CompositorScrollbar {
            scroll_node_index: self.data(paintable).own_scroll_node_index,
            thumb_rect: self.converter.rounded_device_rect(scrollbar.thumb_rect),
            track_rect: self.converter.rounded_device_rect(scrollbar.track_rect),
            expanded_gutter_rect: self.converter.rounded_device_rect(expanded.gutter_rect),
            expanded_thumb_rect: self.converter.rounded_device_rect(expanded.thumb_rect),
            scroll_size: scrollbar.thumb_travel_to_scroll_ratio.to_double(),
            expanded_scroll_size: expanded.thumb_travel_to_scroll_ratio.to_double(),
            min_scroll_offset: if vertical {
                min_scroll_offset.y
            } else {
                min_scroll_offset.x
            },
            max_scroll_offset: if vertical {
                max_scroll_offset.y
            } else {
                max_scroll_offset.x
            },
            vertical,
        })
    }

    // The compositor may drag a scrollbar only where the main thread would hit test that scrollbar, so
    // this mirrors the conditions its chrome widget hit test items are recorded under.
    pub(crate) fn record_compositor_scrollbar(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, direction: ScrollDirection) {
        if !self.has_compositor_scroll_node(paintable)
            || !self.visibility_is_visible(paintable)
            || !self.visible_for_hit_testing(paintable)
        {
            return;
        }
        let facts = self.hit_test_facts(paintable);
        let could_be_scrolled_along_direction = match direction {
            ScrollDirection::Horizontal => facts.could_be_scrolled_horizontally,
            ScrollDirection::Vertical => facts.could_be_scrolled_vertically,
        };
        if !could_be_scrolled_along_direction {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(scrollbar) = self.compositor_scrollbar_for(paintable, direction) {
            self.recorder.compositor_scrollbar(scrollbar);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_async_scrolling_metadata(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        self.record_wheel_hit_test_target(paintable);
        self.record_blocking_wheel_event_region(paintable);

        if self
            .source
            .node_has_dom_paint_fact(paintable, DomPaintFact::NestedNavigableContainer)
        {
            // A nested context the compositor can reach records a region of its own where its content is painted.
            let has_composited_context = self
                .source
                .replaced_paint_facts(paintable)
                .and_then(|facts| facts.navigable_container())
                .is_some_and(|facts| facts.has_composited_context);
            if !has_composited_context {
                self.record_main_thread_wheel_event_region(paintable);
            }
        }
    }
}

/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

//! When each row's paint output last had reason to change.
//!
//! A write to what a row paints stamps the row with the document's current paint generation, and stamps each paint
//! ancestor with it as something that changed below, up to the first one already stamped so in that generation. A
//! reader takes a generation as it reads the rows, and asks later whether a stamp is newer: a recording reuses what one
//! recorded as of an older generation where nothing it read was stamped since. Nothing is consumed or cleared, so each
//! reader keeps its own "as of", and a write stamped that changed nothing costs a recording that comes out the same.

use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::node_painting;
use crate::painting::paint_order;
use crate::painting::paint_read::GeometryRead;

pub(crate) type PaintGeneration = u64;

/// What a write changed of a row, which says what learns of it besides the recordings: what the row draws, what it
/// tells the compositor about scrolling, what it can be hit by, its place in paint order and how it places what it
/// holds, or where its boxes are.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct RowPaintChange(u8);

impl RowPaintChange {
    pub(crate) const NONE: Self = Self(0);
    pub(crate) const DRAWING: Self = Self(1 << 0);
    pub(crate) const SCROLL_METADATA: Self = Self(1 << 1);
    pub(crate) const HIT_TESTING: Self = Self(1 << 2);
    pub(crate) const ORDER: Self = Self(1 << 3);
    pub(crate) const PLACE: Self = Self(1 << 4);
    pub(crate) const EVERYTHING_IT_PAINTS: Self = Self(Self::DRAWING.0 | Self::SCROLL_METADATA.0 | Self::HIT_TESTING.0);

    pub(crate) const fn is_empty(self) -> bool {
        self.0 == 0
    }

    pub(crate) const fn intersects(self, other: Self) -> bool {
        self.0 & other.0 != 0
    }
}

impl std::ops::BitOr for RowPaintChange {
    type Output = Self;

    fn bitor(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        Self(self.0 | other.0)
    }
}

impl std::ops::BitOrAssign for RowPaintChange {
    fn bitor_assign(&mut self, other: Self) {
        self.0 |= other.0;
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for RowPaintChange {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        const NAMES: [(RowPaintChange, &str); 5] = [
            (RowPaintChange::DRAWING, "drawing"),
            (RowPaintChange::SCROLL_METADATA, "scroll-metadata"),
            (RowPaintChange::HIT_TESTING, "hit-testing"),
            (RowPaintChange::ORDER, "order"),
            (RowPaintChange::PLACE, "place"),
        ];
        let mut list = formatter.debug_set();
        for (change, name) in NAMES {
            if self.intersects(change) {
                list.entry(&format_args!("{name}"));
            }
        }
        list.finish()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct PaintChangeStamps {
    /// What the row's own producers read: its style, its geometry, its paint facts and where it is.
    pub(crate) inputs_changed_at: PaintGeneration,
    /// What the row tells the compositor about scrolling, which only its scroll metadata producer reads.
    pub(crate) scroll_metadata_changed_at: PaintGeneration,
    /// Its place in paint order, and how it places what it holds.
    pub(crate) order_changed_at: PaintGeneration,
    /// Anything in its paint subtree.
    pub(crate) changed_below_at: PaintGeneration,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct RowChanges {
    pub(crate) inputs: bool,
    pub(crate) scroll_metadata: bool,
    pub(crate) order: bool,
    pub(crate) below: bool,
}

impl RowChanges {
    pub(crate) const NONE: Self = Self {
        inputs: false,
        scroll_metadata: false,
        order: false,
        below: false,
    };

    pub(crate) fn any(self) -> bool {
        self.inputs || self.scroll_metadata || self.order || self.below
    }
}

impl PaintChangeStamps {
    pub(crate) fn of_a_row_new_to_the_document(generation_writes_stamp_with: PaintGeneration) -> Self {
        Self {
            inputs_changed_at: generation_writes_stamp_with,
            scroll_metadata_changed_at: generation_writes_stamp_with,
            order_changed_at: generation_writes_stamp_with,
            changed_below_at: 0,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn changes_since(&self, as_of: PaintGeneration) -> RowChanges {
        RowChanges {
            inputs: self.inputs_changed_at > as_of,
            scroll_metadata: self.scroll_metadata_changed_at > as_of,
            order: self.order_changed_at > as_of,
            below: self.changed_below_at > as_of,
        }
    }

    fn newest(&self) -> PaintGeneration {
        self.inputs_changed_at
            .max(self.scroll_metadata_changed_at)
            .max(self.order_changed_at)
            .max(self.changed_below_at)
    }

    pub(crate) fn row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(&self, as_of: PaintGeneration) -> bool {
        self.newest() > as_of
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct PaintGenerations {
    generation_writes_stamp_with: PaintGeneration,
    everything_changed_at: PaintGeneration,
}

impl Default for PaintGenerations {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            generation_writes_stamp_with: 1,
            everything_changed_at: 1,
        }
    }
}

impl PaintGenerations {
    pub(crate) fn generation_writes_stamp_with(&self) -> PaintGeneration {
        self.generation_writes_stamp_with
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum OwnInkOverflow {
    MayChange,
    Kept,
}

impl LayoutNodeArena {
    pub(crate) fn take_paint_generation(&mut self) -> PaintGeneration {
        let generations = &mut self.paintable_rows.paint_generations;
        let taken = generations.generation_writes_stamp_with;
        generations.generation_writes_stamp_with = taken.checked_add(1).expect("paint generations do not run out");
        taken
    }

    pub(crate) fn paint_change_stamps(&self, row: NodeSlotId) -> PaintChangeStamps {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(row) {
            return PaintChangeStamps::default();
        }
        self.paintable_rows
            .paint_change_stamps
            .get(row.slot_index() as usize)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub(crate) fn everything_paints_anew_since(&self, as_of: PaintGeneration) -> bool {
        self.paintable_rows.paint_generations.everything_changed_at > as_of
    }

    pub(crate) fn everything_changed_at(&self) -> PaintGeneration {
        self.paintable_rows.paint_generations.everything_changed_at
    }

    fn stamp(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId, stamp: impl FnOnce(&mut PaintChangeStamps, PaintGeneration)) {
        let current = self.paintable_rows.paint_generations.generation_writes_stamp_with;
        let index = row.slot_index() as usize;
        let mut stamps = self.paint_change_stamps(row);
        stamp(&mut stamps, current);
        self.paintable_rows
            .paint_change_stamps
            .set(index, stamps)
            .expect("a populated row has stamps");
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_paint_change(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId, change: RowPaintChange) {
        self.note_paint_change_to_row(row, change, OwnInkOverflow::MayChange);
    }

    /// Notes a change that leaves the ink overflow of the row itself, relative to its padding box, as it was.
    pub(crate) fn note_paint_change_keeping_own_ink_overflow(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId, change: RowPaintChange) {
        self.note_paint_change_to_row(row, change, OwnInkOverflow::Kept);
    }

    fn note_paint_change_to_row(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId, change: RowPaintChange, own_ink_overflow: OwnInkOverflow) {
        if change.is_empty() || !self.paintable_row_is_populated(row) {
            return;
        }
        if change.intersects(RowPaintChange::HIT_TESTING | RowPaintChange::PLACE | RowPaintChange::ORDER) {
            self.note_hit_test_items_changed();
        }
        if change.intersects(RowPaintChange::DRAWING | RowPaintChange::PLACE | RowPaintChange::ORDER) {
            if own_ink_overflow == OwnInkOverflow::MayChange {
                self.request_ink_overflow_recalculation(row);
            }
            self.request_inline_ink_overflow_recalculation(row);
            if change.intersects(RowPaintChange::PLACE) {
                self.request_containing_block_ink_overflow_recalculation(row);
            }
        }
        let changes_inputs = change.intersects(RowPaintChange::DRAWING | RowPaintChange::PLACE);
        let changes_scroll_metadata = change.intersects(RowPaintChange::SCROLL_METADATA);
        let changes_order = change.intersects(RowPaintChange::ORDER);
        if !changes_inputs && !changes_scroll_metadata && !changes_order {
            return;
        }
        self.stamp(row, |stamps, current| {
            if changes_inputs {
                stamps.inputs_changed_at = current;
            }
            if changes_scroll_metadata {
                stamps.scroll_metadata_changed_at = current;
            }
            if changes_order {
                stamps.order_changed_at = current;
            }
        });
        self.stamp_paint_ancestors_as_changed_below(row);
    }

    // Producers that read what is below them, such as an SVG root or a snap container's scroll metadata, learn of a
    // change below them from this stamp. The walk stops at the first ancestor stamped so in this generation.
    fn stamp_paint_ancestors_as_changed_below(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId) {
        let current = self.paintable_rows.paint_generations.generation_writes_stamp_with;
        let mut current_row = row;
        while let Some(ancestor) = self.paint_ancestor_for_change_stamps(current_row) {
            if self.paint_change_stamps(ancestor).changed_below_at == current {
                break;
            }
            self.stamp(ancestor, |stamps, current| stamps.changed_below_at = current);
            current_row = ancestor;
        }
    }

    // Resource subtrees (masks, clips, patterns) are not painted where they sit in the layout tree but by the element
    // referencing them; the stamp continues from the nearest painted layout ancestor so a change inside the resource
    // reaches the content painted around it.
    fn paint_ancestor_for_change_stamps(&self, row: NodeSlotId) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
        let rows = self.paintable_rows();
        if let Some(parent) = paint_order::paint_parent(&rows, row) {
            return Some(parent);
        }
        if !self
            .node_kind_if_live(row)
            .is_some_and(crate::layout::node_facts::kind_is_svg_resource_box)
        {
            return None;
        }
        let mut ancestor = self.node_parent_if_live(row);
        while let Some(node) = ancestor {
            if rows.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
                return Some(node);
            }
            ancestor = self.node_parent_if_live(node);
        }
        None
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_paint_change_in_paint_subtree(&mut self, root: NodeSlotId, change: RowPaintChange) {
        let mut subtree = Vec::new();
        paint_order::for_each_in_paint_subtree(&self.paintable_rows(), root, |row| subtree.push(row));
        for row in subtree {
            self.note_paint_change(row, change);
        }
    }

    /// The fan-out of a style repaint: the row, the anonymous boxes it generated, and for an inline the ancestors up to
    /// the line root that paints its pieces.
    pub(crate) fn note_paint_change_for_repaint(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId, change: RowPaintChange) {
        let mut repainted_rows = smallvec::SmallVec::<[NodeSlotId; 4]>::new();
        self.paintable_rows()
            .for_each_row_repainted_with(row, |repainted| repainted_rows.push(repainted));
        for repainted in repainted_rows {
            self.note_paint_change(repainted, change);
        }
    }

    /// The row's producers and scopes are listed by the plans of its nearest paint ancestor; resolved now, while the
    /// links are intact, for rows about to appear, disappear or move. The ancestor's content changed below it as well.
    pub(crate) fn note_enclosing_paint_order_change(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        if let Some(owner) = self.enclosing_paint_order_owner(node) {
            // A line's plan also places content nested inside ordinary inline boxes. Changes there must reach the
            // block or self-painting inline that owns it.
            let rows = self.paintable_rows();
            let line_owner = node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(&rows, owner)
                .then(|| {
                    crate::painting::fragment_ownership::nearest_self_painting_inline_box(&rows, node)
                        .unwrap_or(rows.paintable_data(owner).containing_block)
                })
                .filter(|line_owner| !line_owner.is_invalid());
            self.note_paint_change(owner, RowPaintChange::ORDER);
            if self.paintable_row_is_populated(owner) {
                self.stamp(owner, |stamps, current| stamps.changed_below_at = current);
            }
            if let Some(line_owner) = line_owner {
                self.note_paint_change(line_owner, RowPaintChange::ORDER);
            }
        }
    }

    fn enclosing_paint_order_owner(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
        let rows = self.paintable_rows();
        if rows.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
            return paint_order::paint_parent(&rows, node);
        }
        let mut ancestor = self.node_parent_if_live(node);
        while let Some(current) = ancestor {
            if rows.paintable_row_is_populated(current) {
                return Some(current);
            }
            ancestor = self.node_parent_if_live(current);
        }
        None
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_hit_test_items_changed(&mut self) {
        self.paintable_rows.hit_test_items_stamp = crate::cow_column::new_edit_token();
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_everything_paints_anew(&mut self) {
        self.note_hit_test_items_changed();
        let generations = &mut self.paintable_rows.paint_generations;
        generations.everything_changed_at = generations.generation_writes_stamp_with;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::layout::node_data::NodeKind;

    fn populated_child(arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena, parent: NodeSlotId) -> NodeSlotId {
        let row = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.write_shape(row).set_kind(NodeKind::Box);
        if !parent.is_invalid() {
            arena.insert_child(parent, row, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        }
        arena.populate_paintable_row(row);
        row
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_write_is_newer_than_every_generation_a_reader_took_before_it() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let child = populated_child(&mut arena, root);
        let unrelated = populated_child(&mut arena, root);
        let as_of = arena.take_paint_generation();

        arena.note_paint_change(child, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);

        assert_eq!(
            arena.paint_change_stamps(child).changes_since(as_of),
            RowChanges {
                inputs: true,
                ..RowChanges::NONE
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(
            arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(as_of),
            RowChanges {
                below: true,
                ..RowChanges::NONE
            }
        );
        assert!(
            !arena
                .paint_change_stamps(unrelated)
                .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(as_of)
        );
        // A reader that took its generation after the write finds nothing newer.
        let later = arena.take_paint_generation();
        assert!(
            !arena
                .paint_change_stamps(child)
                .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(later)
        );
        assert!(
            !arena
                .paint_change_stamps(root)
                .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(later)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn readers_keep_their_own_generation() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let first = arena.take_paint_generation();
        arena.note_paint_change(root, RowPaintChange::ORDER);
        let second = arena.take_paint_generation();
        assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(first).order);
        assert!(!arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(second).order);
        assert!(!arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(first).inputs);
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_changes_only_what_can_be_hit_stamps_nothing_a_recording_reads() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let as_of = arena.take_paint_generation();
        let hit_test_items_stamp = arena.paintable_rows.hit_test_items_stamp;
        arena.note_paint_change(root, RowPaintChange::HIT_TESTING);
        assert!(
            !arena
                .paint_change_stamps(root)
                .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(as_of)
        );
        assert_ne!(arena.paintable_rows.hit_test_items_stamp, hit_test_items_stamp);
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_changes_only_scroll_metadata_leaves_what_the_row_draws_as_it_was() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let scroller = populated_child(&mut arena, root);
        let as_of = arena.take_paint_generation();

        arena.note_paint_change(scroller, RowPaintChange::SCROLL_METADATA);

        assert_eq!(
            arena.paint_change_stamps(scroller).changes_since(as_of),
            RowChanges {
                scroll_metadata: true,
                ..RowChanges::NONE
            }
        );
        assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(as_of).below);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_change_below_a_row_new_to_the_document_reaches_the_rows_above_it() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let as_of = arena.take_paint_generation();
        let new_row = populated_child(&mut arena, root);
        let below_new_row = populated_child(&mut arena, new_row);

        arena.note_paint_change(below_new_row, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);

        assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(new_row).changes_since(as_of).inputs);
        assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(as_of).below);
    }

    #[test]
    fn order_changes_resolve_to_the_nearest_paint_ancestor_and_keep_siblings_clean() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let owner = populated_child(&mut arena, root);
        let sibling = populated_child(&mut arena, root);
        let unpopulated = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.write_shape(unpopulated).set_kind(NodeKind::InlineNode);
        arena.insert_child(owner, unpopulated, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let child = populated_child(&mut arena, unpopulated);
        let as_of = arena.take_paint_generation();

        arena.note_paint_order_changed(child);

        assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(child).changes_since(as_of).order);
        assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(owner).changes_since(as_of).order);
        assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(as_of).below);
        assert!(!arena.paint_change_stamps(root).changes_since(as_of).order);
        assert!(
            !arena
                .paint_change_stamps(sibling)
                .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(as_of)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn resource_subtrees_stamp_the_nearest_painted_layout_ancestor() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let svg_root = populated_child(&mut arena, root);
        let mask = populated_child(&mut arena, svg_root);
        arena.write_shape(mask).set_kind(NodeKind::SVGMaskBox);
        let mask_content = populated_child(&mut arena, mask);
        let as_of = arena.take_paint_generation();

        arena.note_paint_change(mask_content, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);

        for ancestor in [mask, svg_root, root] {
            assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(ancestor).changes_since(as_of).below);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn everything_paints_anew_for_readers_of_earlier_generations_only() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        let before = arena.take_paint_generation();
        arena.note_everything_paints_anew();
        let after = arena.take_paint_generation();
        assert!(arena.everything_paints_anew_since(before));
        assert!(!arena.everything_paints_anew_since(after));
    }

    #[test]
    fn repaint_fan_out_reaches_anonymous_boxes_and_the_line_root_of_an_inline() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let line_root = populated_child(&mut arena, NodeSlotId::INVALID);
        arena.write_shape(line_root).set_kind(NodeKind::BlockContainer);
        let inline = populated_child(&mut arena, line_root);
        arena.write_shape(inline).set_kind(NodeKind::InlineNode);
        let anonymous = populated_child(&mut arena, inline);
        arena.write_shape(anonymous).set_kind(NodeKind::BlockContainer);
        arena.set_node_flag(anonymous, crate::layout::node_data::NodeFlag::Anonymous, true);
        let as_of = arena.take_paint_generation();

        arena.note_paint_change_for_repaint(inline, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);

        for row in [inline, anonymous, line_root] {
            assert!(arena.paint_change_stamps(row).changes_since(as_of).inputs);
        }
    }
}

use super::RecordingInputs;

/// The recording inputs every producer may read. A frame copies from the published recording only
/// while they are unchanged; otherwise it records from scratch. They stay with the published
/// frame, which a read-only recording never replaces.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct FrameInputs {
    // A default-constructed source's 0.0 never matches a real recording scale.
    pub(crate) device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    pub(crate) force_dark_enabled: bool,
    pub(crate) force_dark_settings: ForceDarkSettings,
    pub(crate) should_show_line_box_borders: bool,
    pub(crate) should_paint_overlay: bool,
    records_in_finest_runs: bool,
    pub(crate) uncaptured: UncapturedContentInputs,
    // Whether any box but the viewport could take or keep a wheel event decides if the scroll metadata
    // inside subtree captures carries per-box wheel hit-test targets.
    pub(crate) has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate: bool,
    // The default selection colors come from the system palette, which changes with the system's highlight color.
    pub(crate) selection_colors: SelectionColors,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct SelectionColors {
    from_palette: Color,
    light: Color,
    dark: Color,
    inactive_from_palette: Color,
    inactive_light: Color,
    inactive_dark: Color,
    palette_is_dark: bool,
}

impl FrameInputs {
    pub(crate) fn from_recording_inputs(inputs: &RecordingInputs, paint_state: &PublishedPaintState) -> Self {
        Self {
            device_pixels_per_css_pixel: inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            force_dark_enabled: inputs.force_dark_enabled,
            force_dark_settings: inputs.force_dark_settings,
            should_show_line_box_borders: inputs.should_show_line_box_borders,
            should_paint_overlay: inputs.should_paint_overlay,
            records_in_finest_runs: inputs.records_in_finest_runs,
            uncaptured: inputs.uncaptured,
            has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate: paint_state.has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate,
            selection_colors: SelectionColors {
                from_palette: inputs.selection_background_from_palette,
                light: inputs.selection_background_light,
                dark: inputs.selection_background_dark,
                inactive_from_palette: inputs.inactive_selection_background_from_palette,
                inactive_light: inputs.inactive_selection_background_light,
                inactive_dark: inputs.inactive_selection_background_dark,
                palette_is_dark: inputs.palette_is_dark,
            },
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn records_per_box_wheel_hit_test_targets(&self) -> bool {
        self.has_non_viewport_wheel_scroll_target_candidate
            || self.uncaptured.has_navigable_container_with_composited_context
    }
}

pub(crate) struct Verification {
    pub(crate) enabled: bool,
    pub(crate) counts: bool,
    pub(crate) report: bool,
}

pub(crate) fn verification() -> &'static Verification {
    static VERIFICATION: OnceLock<Verification> = OnceLock::new();
    VERIFICATION.get_or_init(|| {
        let environment_enabled = std::env::var_os("LIBWEB_VERIFY_PAINT_INK_BOUNDS").is_some();
        Verification {
            enabled: cfg!(debug_assertions) || environment_enabled,
            counts: environment_enabled,
            report: std::env::var_os("LIBWEB_REPORT_PAINT_INK_BOUNDS").is_some(),
        }
    })
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Count {
    Producers,
    Checked,
    Unbounded,
    Svg,
    Preamble,
    Viewport,
    RootElement,
    FixedBackground,
    LocalBackground,
    OtherSpatialNode,
    MetadataOrCanvas,
    InputDriven,
    Empty,
    ScopesBounded,
    ScopesUnbounded,
    ScopesNotCovering,
    CheckedAgainstScopes,
}

const COUNT_NAMES: [&str; 17] = [
    "producers",
    "checked",
    "unbounded",
    "svg",
    "preamble",
    "viewport",
    "root-element",
    "fixed-background",
    "local-background",
    "other-spatial-node",
    "metadata-or-canvas",
    "input-driven",
    "empty",
    "scopes-bounded",
    "scopes-unbounded",
    "scopes-not-covering",
    "checked-against-scopes",
];

pub(super) const COMPARISON_SLACK_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS: i32 = 2;

struct AuditedScopeBound {
    css_rect: CssPixelRect,
    /// In the space of the owner's own box, with the comparison slack.
    device_rect: FloatRect,
    owner_space: SpatialNodeIndex,
    /// The clip of the owner's own box and the clips above it. They cut the scope from outside, and whoever
    /// skips the scope by its bound has not applied them, so a command stops gathering clips when it meets one.
    clips_outside_scope: SmallVec<[ClipNodeIndex; 8]>,
}

struct AuditedScope {
    scope: PaintScope,
    bound: Option<AuditedScopeBound>,
}

/// Where a command draws in the space of a scope's owner, after the clips it meets inside the scope. `None` when a
/// transform on the way is not a two-dimensional affine one. The spaces are the tree's with every scroller at rest:
/// where a scroller is scrolled to makes no difference to whether a bound holds, as what scrolls is cut to the
/// scrollport by a clip the comparison applies.
fn drawn_rect_in_scope_owner_space(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    spaces_at_rest: &WorldTransforms,
    rect: FloatRect,
    context: ContextRef,
    bound: &AuditedScopeBound,
) -> Option<FloatRect> {
    let mut rect = rect;
    let mut space = context.spatial;
    let mut clip = context.clip;
    while !clip.is_none() && !bound.clips_outside_scope.contains(&clip) {
        let node = &tree.clip_nodes[clip.0 as usize];
        let clip_rect = match &node.data {
            ClipNodeData::Rect(data) if data.mode == ClipMode::Intersect => Some(data.rect),
            ClipNodeData::Path(path) => Some(path.bounding_rect.to_float()),
            _ => None,
        };
        if let Some(clip_rect) = clip_rect {
            rect = spaces_at_rest
                .map_rect_between_spaces(rect, space, node.spatial)?
                .intersected(clip_rect);
            if rect.is_empty() {
                return Some(rect);
            }
            space = node.spatial;
        }
        clip = node.parent;
    }
    spaces_at_rest.map_rect_between_spaces(rect, space, bound.owner_space)
}

fn command_draws_inputs_driven_ink(
    inputs: &RecordingInputs,
    converter: DevicePixelConverter,
    owner: NodeSlotId,
    inputs_ink_in_device_pixels: Option<IntRect>,
    command_type: DisplayListCommandType,
    bounding_rect: IntRect,
) -> bool {
    inputs_ink_in_device_pixels.is_some_and(|rect| rect.contains_rect(bounding_rect))
        && (command_type == DisplayListCommandType::PaintCaret
            || (command_type == DisplayListCommandType::FillRect
                && inputs.caret.is_some_and(|caret| {
                    caret.target == CaretTarget::EmptyInline(owner)
                        && converter.rounded_device_rect(caret.rect) == bounding_rect
                })))
}

pub(super) struct InkBoundsAudit {
    pub enabled: bool,
    counts: Option<[u64; COUNT_NAMES.len()]>,
    estimates: FastMap<NodeSlotId, InkOverflow>,
    open_scopes: Vec<AuditedScope>,
    open_scopes_with_a_bound: usize,
}

impl InkBoundsAudit {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let verification = verification();
        Self {
            enabled: verification.enabled,
            counts: verification.counts.then_some([0; COUNT_NAMES.len()]),
            estimates: Default::default(),
            open_scopes: Vec::new(),
            open_scopes_with_a_bound: 0,
        }
    }

    fn count(&mut self, count: Count) {
        if let Some(counts) = &mut self.counts {
            counts[count as usize] += 1;
        }
    }

    pub fn report(&self) {
        if verification().report
            && let Some(counts) = self.counts
        {
            let summary: Vec<_> = COUNT_NAMES
                .iter()
                .zip(counts)
                .map(|(name, count)| format!("{name}={count}"))
                .collect();
            eprintln!("Paint ink bounds audit: {}", summary.join(" "));
        }
    }
}

/// Ink supplied by the host rather than by the row snapshot, in absolute layout CSS pixels.
pub(crate) fn inputs_driven_ink(
    inputs: &RecordingInputs,
    owner: NodeSlotId,
    is_viewport: bool,
) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
    let mut rect = inputs
        .caret
        .filter(|caret| match caret.target {
            CaretTarget::InBlock { block, owner: inline } => inline.unwrap_or(block) == owner,
            CaretTarget::EmptyInline(inline) => inline == owner,
        })
        .map(|caret| caret.rect);
    if is_viewport && let Some(origin) = inputs.uncaptured.middle_button_scroll_origin {
        let radius = CssPixels::nearest_value_for(17.0 / inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
        let indicator = CssPixelRect::new(origin.x - radius, origin.y - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2);
        rect = Some(rect.map_or(indicator, |mut rect| {
            rect.unite(indicator);
            rect
        }));
    }
    rect
}

impl<O: Observer> PaintRecorder<'_, O> {
    pub(super) fn verify_producer_ink(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, kind: ProducerKind, bytes: Range<usize>) {
        self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::Producers);
        let estimate = *self
            .ink_bounds_audit
            .estimates
            .entry(owner)
            .or_insert_with(|| own_ink_overflow(self.source, self.paint_state, owner));
        let stored = self.source.stored_ink_overflow(owner);
        let absolute = self.source.absolute_ink_overflow_rect(owner);
        assert!(
            absolute.is_none_or(|stored_rect| !estimate.unbounded && stored_rect.contains_rect(estimate.rect)),
            "Stored ink overflow misses own estimate: {:?} {owner:?}, stored {stored:?}, recomputed {estimate:?}, stamp {}",
            self.source.node_kind_if_live(owner),
            self.source.ink_overflow_stamp()
        );
        let is_viewport = self.source.node_kind_if_live(owner) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport);
        let exempt = match kind {
            ProducerKind::Svg => Some(Count::Svg),
            ProducerKind::ScopePreamble => Some(Count::Preamble),
            _ if is_viewport => Some(Count::Viewport),
            _ if style_queries::node_is_root_element(self.source, owner) => Some(Count::RootElement),
            _ => None,
        };
        if let Some(reason) = exempt {
            if is_viewport && kind == ProducerKind::DrawOverlay && inputs_driven_ink(self.inputs, owner, true).is_some()
            {
                self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::InputDriven);
            }
            self.ink_bounds_audit.count(reason);
            return;
        }
        if bytes.is_empty() {
            self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::Empty);
            return;
        }
        if let Some(reason) = self.background_placed_in_another_space(owner, kind) {
            self.ink_bounds_audit.count(reason);
            return;
        }
        if estimate.unbounded {
            self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::Unbounded);
            return;
        }
        let slack = COMPARISON_SLACK_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS;
        let estimate_device = self
            .converter
            .enclosing_device_rect(estimate.rect)
            .inflated_edges(slack, slack, slack, slack);
        let inputs_ink = self.inputs_driven_ink_in_device_pixels(owner, is_viewport);
        let own_spatial = self.own_context(owner).spatial;
        let descendants_spatial = self.for_descendants_context(owner).spatial;
        let runs = self.recorder.command_runs();
        let mut run_index = runs.partition_point(|run| (run.offset + run.size) as usize <= bytes.start);
        let mut counts = [false; COUNT_NAMES.len()];
        for_each_command(&self.recorder.bytes()[bytes.clone()], |header, offset, payload| {
            let absolute_offset = bytes.start + offset;
            while absolute_offset >= (runs[run_index].offset + runs[run_index].size) as usize {
                run_index += 1;
            }
            let spatial = runs[run_index].context.spatial;
            let bounding_rect = if header.command_type.is_compositor_metadata() {
                None
            } else {
                bounding_rect_computed_from_payload(header, payload)
            };
            let reason = match bounding_rect {
                None => Count::MetadataOrCanvas,
                Some(_) if spatial != own_spatial && spatial != descendants_spatial => Count::OtherSpatialNode,
                Some(bounding_rect)
                    if command_draws_inputs_driven_ink(
                        self.inputs,
                        self.converter,
                        owner,
                        inputs_ink,
                        header.command_type,
                        bounding_rect,
                    ) =>
                {
                    Count::InputDriven
                }
                Some(bounding_rect) if !bounding_rect.is_empty() && !estimate_device.contains_rect(bounding_rect) => {
                    panic!(
                        "Paint ink bounds violation: {kind:?} of {:?} {owner:?}, border box {:?}, recorded {} {:?} outside own estimate {:?} (device pixels, including 2px comparison slack; CSS estimate {:?})",
                        self.source.node_kind_if_live(owner),
                        crate::painting::paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(self.source, owner),
                        header.command_type.name(),
                        bounding_rect,
                        estimate_device,
                        estimate.rect
                    );
                }
                Some(_) => Count::Checked,
            };
            counts[reason as usize] = true;
        });
        for (index, present) in counts.into_iter().enumerate() {
            if present && let Some(counts) = &mut self.ink_bounds_audit.counts {
                counts[index] += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    /// A fixed background is placed against the viewport and a local one scrolls with the box's content, so
    /// neither is recorded where the box's own ink is.
    fn background_placed_in_another_space(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, kind: ProducerKind) -> Option<Count> {
        let node = match kind {
            ProducerKind::DrawBackground => owner,
            ProducerKind::InlinePiece(index) => {
                let root = if node_painting::has_lines(self.source, owner) {
                    owner
                } else {
                    self.data(owner).containing_block
                };
                self.source.committed_side_data(root).inline_box_pieces()[index as usize].node
            }
            _ => return None,
        };
        let facts = self.base_paint_facts(node);
        if facts.has_scroll_offset_dependent_background {
            Some(Count::LocalBackground)
        } else if facts.has_fixed_background {
            Some(Count::FixedBackground)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn inputs_driven_ink_in_device_pixels(&self, owner: NodeSlotId, is_viewport: bool) -> Option<IntRect> {
        let slack = COMPARISON_SLACK_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS;
        inputs_driven_ink(self.inputs, owner, is_viewport).map(|rect| {
            self.converter
                .enclosing_device_rect(rect)
                .inflated_edges(slack, slack, slack, slack)
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn audit_scope_event(&mut self, event: AssemblyEvent) {
        match event {
            AssemblyEvent::ScopeBegin(scope, action) => {
                let bound = if action == ScopeAction::Inactive || self.is_recording_svg_resource_content() {
                    None
                } else {
                    self.audited_scope_bound(scope)
                };
                self.ink_bounds_audit.open_scopes_with_a_bound += usize::from(bound.is_some());
                self.ink_bounds_audit.open_scopes.push(AuditedScope { scope, bound });
            }
            AssemblyEvent::ScopeEnd(scope) => {
                let closed = self
                    .ink_bounds_audit
                    .open_scopes
                    .pop()
                    .expect("a scope ends after it began");
                assert!(
                    closed.scope == scope,
                    "scopes end in the reverse of the order they began in"
                );
                self.ink_bounds_audit.open_scopes_with_a_bound -= usize::from(closed.bound.is_some());
            }
            AssemblyEvent::ScopeCopied(_)
            | AssemblyEvent::ProducerCopied(..)
            | AssemblyEvent::ScopeLeftOut(_)
            | AssemblyEvent::ProducerLeftOut(..) => {}
        }
    }

    fn audited_scope_bound(&mut self, scope: PaintScope) -> Option<AuditedScopeBound> {
        let css_rect = match scope_ink_bound(self.source, scope) {
            ScopeInkBound::Rect(rect) => rect,
            ScopeInkBound::Unbounded => {
                self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::ScopesUnbounded);
                return None;
            }
            ScopeInkBound::NotCovering => {
                self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::ScopesNotCovering);
                return None;
            }
        };
        self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::ScopesBounded);
        let tree = self.paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_ref()?;
        let own_context = self.own_context(scope.owner);
        let mut clips_outside_scope = SmallVec::new();
        let mut clip = own_context.clip;
        while !clip.is_none() {
            clips_outside_scope.push(clip);
            clip = tree.clip_nodes[clip.0 as usize].parent;
        }
        let slack = COMPARISON_SLACK_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS;
        Some(AuditedScopeBound {
            css_rect,
            device_rect: self
                .converter
                .enclosing_device_rect(css_rect)
                .inflated_edges(slack, slack, slack, slack)
                .to_float(),
            owner_space: own_context.spatial,
            clips_outside_scope,
        })
    }

    /// Requires every command the producer just recorded to lie inside the bound of each scope it was recorded in: a
    /// walk that skipped one of those scopes because its bound missed a region would otherwise have dropped something
    /// that draws there.
    pub(super) fn verify_producer_against_open_scopes(
        &mut self,
        owner: NodeSlotId,
        kind: ProducerKind,
        bytes: Range<usize>,
    ) {
        if self.ink_bounds_audit.open_scopes_with_a_bound == 0
            || bytes.is_empty()
            || kind == ProducerKind::ScopePreamble
            || self.background_placed_in_another_space(owner, kind).is_some()
        {
            return;
        }
        let Some(tree) = self.paint_state.visual_context_tree.clone() else {
            return;
        };
        let is_viewport = self.source.node_kind_if_live(owner) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport);
        let inputs_ink = self.inputs_driven_ink_in_device_pixels(owner, is_viewport);
        let owner_kind = self.source.node_kind_if_live(owner);
        let inputs = self.inputs;
        let converter = self.converter;
        let spaces_at_rest = self.paint_state.unscrolled_world_transforms();
        let open_scopes = &self.ink_bounds_audit.open_scopes;
        let mut checked = false;
        let mut require_inside_open_scopes = |what: &dyn std::fmt::Debug, rect: IntRect, context: ContextRef| {
            for audited in open_scopes {
                let Some(bound) = &audited.bound else {
                    continue;
                };
                let Some(placed) =
                    drawn_rect_in_scope_owner_space(&tree, spaces_at_rest, rect.to_float(), context, bound)
                else {
                    continue;
                };
                checked = true;
                assert!(
                    placed.is_empty() || bound.device_rect.contains_rect(placed),
                    "Paint scope ink bound violation: {kind:?} of {owner_kind:?} {owner:?} recorded {what:?} {rect:?} under {context:?}, which lies at {placed:?} in the space of {:?}, outside its bound {:?} (device pixels, including {COMPARISON_SLACK_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS}px comparison slack; CSS bound {:?})",
                    audited.scope,
                    bound.device_rect,
                    bound.css_rect
                );
            }
        };
        let runs = self.recorder.command_runs();
        let mut run_index = runs.partition_point(|run| (run.offset + run.size) as usize <= bytes.start);
        for_each_command(&self.recorder.bytes()[bytes.clone()], |header, offset, payload| {
            let absolute_offset = bytes.start + offset;
            while absolute_offset >= (runs[run_index].offset + runs[run_index].size) as usize {
                run_index += 1;
            }
            if header.command_type.is_compositor_metadata() {
                return;
            }
            let Some(bounding_rect) = bounding_rect_computed_from_payload(header, payload) else {
                return;
            };
            if bounding_rect.is_empty()
                || command_draws_inputs_driven_ink(
                    inputs,
                    converter,
                    owner,
                    inputs_ink,
                    header.command_type,
                    bounding_rect,
                )
            {
                return;
            }
            require_inside_open_scopes(&header.command_type.name(), bounding_rect, runs[run_index].context);
        });
        if checked {
            self.ink_bounds_audit.count(Count::CheckedAgainstScopes);
        }
    }
}

/*

use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixelRect};
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::ffi::FfiChromeMetrics;
use crate::painting::force_dark::ForceDarkSettings;
use crate::painting::host::{FfiFlexOverlayInput, FfiGridOverlayInput, RootBackgroundSource};
use libgfx_rust::font::FontHandle;
use libgfx_rust::{Color, IntRect, IntSize};

/// The inputs read by content that is recorded outside per-box captures: scroll metadata,
/// viewport scrollbars, the wheel-target facts of hit-test items. Reusing a subtree capture from
/// the previous tape requires this whole bundle to be unchanged, so every reader takes these
/// values from here and a new one is part of that check automatically.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct UncapturedContentInputs {
    pub root_background_source: RootBackgroundSource,
    // Scroll commands use a scrollport at the origin. Its position is compositor state.
    pub device_viewport_size: IntSize,
    pub has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport: bool,
    // The compositor hands a wheel over a nested context to it only where no box painted later covers it, which it can
    // tell only from the wheel hit test targets of every box.
    pub has_navigable_container_with_composited_context: bool,
    pub chrome_metrics: FfiChromeMetrics,
    pub paint_viewport_scrollbars: bool,
    pub middle_button_scroll_origin: Option<CssPixelPoint>,
    pub canvas_color: Color,
    pub background_color: Color,
}

/// The inputs of one recording but for what the frame it records decides, which only the frame frozen for the recording
/// fills in: the host makes them before the render owner freezes the frame.
pub(crate) struct UnframedRecordingInputs(pub(in crate::painting) RecordingInputs);

impl UnframedRecordingInputs {
    /// The inputs of the recording of a frame frozen with `tree_inputs`, whose canvas background `root_background_source`
    /// paints.
    pub(crate) fn for_frame(
        self,
        tree_inputs: crate::painting::host::FfiVisualContextTreeInputs,
        root_background_source: RootBackgroundSource,
    ) -> RecordingInputs {
        let Self(mut inputs) = self;
        inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel = tree_inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
        inputs.uncaptured.root_background_source = root_background_source;
        inputs
    }
}

/// The inputs of one recording, which own what they read, so that the recording may outlive the
/// call that started it. Recording results retain their own resources and never borrow these inputs.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct RecordingInputs {
    pub device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    pub uncaptured: UncapturedContentInputs,
    // Carried on the recording so the compositor can tell which listener state it saw; no
    // recorded content reads it.
    pub wheel_event_listener_state_generation: u64,
    pub css_viewport_rect: CssPixelRect,
    pub should_show_line_box_borders: bool,
    pub force_dark_enabled: bool,
    pub force_dark_settings: ForceDarkSettings,
    pub should_paint_overlay: bool,
    /// Cuts the plans a recording walks as finely as they go: every child scope with a bound is walked on its own,
    /// and a run holds only what starts in one pixel row. Tests ask for it to see which boxes a change records
    /// again on pages too small to span the rows a recording is otherwise cut along.
    pub records_in_finest_runs: bool,
    /// Records everything the document paints, wherever it is, and not just what shows in a window around the
    /// viewport: what a screenshot of more than the viewport and a dump of the display list read.
    pub records_whole_document: bool,
    /// Notes beside the records which box and phase recorded each and the text each glyph run draws, for the display
    /// list dump.
    pub notes_record_origins: bool,
    pub canvas_fill_rect: Option<IntRect>,
    pub opaque_canvas: bool,
    pub bitmap_rect: IntRect,
    pub publishes_recording: bool,
    /// What the compositor clears the surface with below the recording, for a top-level traversable.
    pub surface_clear_color: Option<Color>,
    /// What the recording's display list is stamped with for async scrolling, but for the keyboard scroll state.
    pub async_scrolling_metadata: Option<libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::Compositing_AsyncScrollingMetadata>,
    pub window_is_focused: bool,
    pub outline_auto_color: Color,
    pub selection_background_from_palette: Color,
    pub selection_background_light: Color,
    pub selection_background_dark: Color,
    pub inactive_selection_background_from_palette: Color,
    pub inactive_selection_background_light: Color,
    pub inactive_selection_background_dark: Color,
    pub palette_is_dark: bool,
    // Whether the document's supported color schemes name `light` or `dark`.
    pub document_supports_light_or_dark: bool,
    // The color scheme an SVG image renders in where neither the box that draws it nor its document opts into one.
    pub image_fallback_color_scheme: u8,
    // Whether the document is an SVG image's, whose records go into the tapes of the documents that draw the image: the
    // transforms, clips and effects of its boxes are recorded in the records, which name no visual context.
    pub records_without_visual_contexts: bool,
    // The paintable the assistive technology's browse-mode focus is on, which paints the AT focus ring.
    pub accessibility_focus_target: Option<NodeSlotId>,
    pub inspector_highlight: Option<InspectorHighlight>,
    pub tooltip_color: Color,
    pub tooltip_text_color: Color,
    pub tooltip_border_color: Color,
    pub grid_overlays: Option<GridOverlays>,
    // These array elements are already plain values without pointers or optional-value tags.
    pub flex_overlays: Box<[FfiFlexOverlayInput]>,
    pub caret_debug_rect: Option<CssPixelRect>,
    pub caret: Option<CaretPaint>,
    pub focused_text_control: Option<FocusedTextControlSelection>,
    pub focused_area_outline: Option<FocusedAreaOutline>,
    pub text_fragment_indications: Box<[crate::painting::host::FfiTextFragmentIndicationRange]>,
    pub mark_color: Color,
    pub mark_text_color: Color,
}

    const fn bit(self) -> u8 {
