#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct ShadowLayer {
    pub color: u32,
    pub offset_x: CssPixels,
    pub offset_y: CssPixels,
    pub blur_radius: CssPixels,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct HighlightShadowLayer {
    pub layer: ShadowLayer,
    pub color_is_current_color: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct SpanTextDecoration {
    pub lines: [u8; 8],
    pub line_count: u32,
    pub style: u8,
    pub color: u32,
    pub metrics: Option<HighlightDecorationMetrics>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct HighlightDecorationMetrics {
    pub thickness: Option<CssPixels>,
    pub underline_offset: CssPixels,
    pub underline_position_horizontal: u8,
    pub underline_position_vertical: u8,
    pub skip_ink: u8,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum HighlightLayer {
    Custom(u32),
    BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement),
    TextFragmentIndication,
}

impl HighlightLayer {
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-pseudo-4/#highlight-backgrounds
    // The ::selection overlay is drawn over the ::target-text overlay which is drawn over the ::spelling-error overlay
    // which is drawn over the ::grammar-error overlay which is drawn over the ::highlight overlays.
    // The ::search-text overlay is drawn directly over or below the ::selection overlay depending on the UA, and drawn
    // over all other overlays.
    fn stacking_order(self) -> (u8, u32) {
        match self {
            Self::Custom(layer) => (0, layer),
            Self::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::SpellingError) => (1, 0),
            Self::TextFragmentIndication => (2, 0),
            Self::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::Selection) => (3, 0),
            Self::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::SearchText) => (4, 0),
            Self::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent) => (5, 0),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) struct HighlightOverlay {
    pub highlight: HighlightLayer,
    pub background_color: u32,
    pub shadow_layers: Vec<ShadowLayer>,
    pub text_decoration: Option<SpanTextDecoration>,
}

pub(crate) struct RenderSpan {
    pub fragment_index: u32,
    pub start_code_unit: usize,
    pub end_code_unit: usize,
    pub text_color: u32,
    /// The text's own `text-shadow`, which a highlight overlay paints over.
    pub shadow_layers: Vec<ShadowLayer>,
    /// The highlight overlays over the span, from bottom to top.
    pub highlights: Vec<HighlightOverlay>,
    /// The highlight's color when it has one of its own, which its redraw of the text's original
    /// decorations takes as well.
    pub decoration_color: Option<u32>,
}

impl RenderSpan {
    fn has_same_highlights_as(&self, other: &RenderSpan) -> bool {
        self.highlights
            .iter()
            .map(|overlay| overlay.highlight)
            .eq(other.highlights.iter().map(|overlay| overlay.highlight))
            && self.text_color == other.text_color
    }
}

pub(crate) struct SelectionStyleAnswer {
    pub facts: crate::painting::host::FfiSelectionStyleFacts,
    pub shadows: Vec<HighlightShadowLayer>,
    pub decoration_metrics: Option<HighlightDecorationMetrics>,
}

const BUILT_IN_HIGHLIGHT_LAYERS: [HighlightLayer; 5] = [
    HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::SpellingError),
    HighlightLayer::TextFragmentIndication,
    HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::Selection),
    HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::SearchText),
    HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent),
];

fn highlight_layers_for_fragment<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
) -> Vec<HighlightLayer> {
    let mut layers: Vec<HighlightLayer> = recorder
        .paint_state
        .custom_highlights
        .text_runs
        .get(&fragment.layout_node)
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .map(|&(layer, ..)| HighlightLayer::Custom(layer))
        .collect();
    layers.dedup();
    layers.extend(BUILT_IN_HIGHLIGHT_LAYERS);
    layers
}

fn range_offsets_for_fragment<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    range: &SelectionRange,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
) -> Option<SelectionOffsets> {
    let selection_state = *range.text_states.get(&fragment.layout_node)?;
    text_fragment::compute_selection_offsets(
        recorder.source,
        fragment,
        selection_state,
        range.start_offset,
        range.end_offset,
    )
}

fn highlight_offsets_for_fragment<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    layer: HighlightLayer,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
) -> Vec<SelectionOffsets> {
    let highlight = match layer {
        HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(highlight) => highlight,
        HighlightLayer::Custom(layer) => {
            let Some(runs) = recorder
                .paint_state
                .custom_highlights
                .text_runs
                .get(&fragment.layout_node)
            else {
                return Vec::new();
            };
            return runs
                .iter()
                .filter(|&&(run_layer, start, end)| {
                    run_layer == layer
                        && end >= fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node
                        && start <= fragment.dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace
                })
                .filter_map(|&(_, start, end)| {
                    text_fragment::compute_selection_offsets(
                        recorder.source,
                        fragment,
                        SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END,
                        start,
                        end,
                    )
                })
                .map(|offsets| SelectionOffsets {
                    start: offsets.start.min(fragment.length_in_code_units),
                    end: offsets.end.min(fragment.length_in_code_units),
                })
                .filter(|offsets| offsets.start != offsets.end)
                .collect();
        }
        HighlightLayer::TextFragmentIndication => {
            let mut offsets: Vec<SelectionOffsets> = recorder
                .inputs
                .text_fragment_indications
                .iter()
                .filter(|range| range.text_node == fragment.layout_node)
                .filter_map(|range| {
                    text_fragment::selection_offsets_for_dom_range(recorder.source, fragment, range.start, range.end)
                })
                .filter(|offsets| offsets.start != offsets.end)
                .collect();
            offsets.sort_unstable_by_key(|offsets| offsets.start);
            let mut merged: Vec<SelectionOffsets> = Vec::with_capacity(offsets.len());
            for offsets in offsets {
                match merged.last_mut() {
                    Some(last) if offsets.start <= last.end => last.end = last.end.max(offsets.end),
                    _ => merged.push(offsets),
                }
            }
            return merged;
        }
    };
    let offsets: Vec<SelectionOffsets> = match highlight {
        HighlightPseudoElement::Selection => {
            let offsets = if let Some((start, end)) = recorder.text_control_selection(fragment.layout_node) {
                text_fragment::compute_selection_offsets(
                    recorder.source,
                    fragment,
                    SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END,
                    start,
                    end,
                )
            } else {
                recorder
                    .paint_state
                    .selection
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|range| range_offsets_for_fragment(recorder, range, fragment))
            };
            offsets.into_iter().collect()
        }
        HighlightPseudoElement::SpellingError => {
            let Some(runs) = recorder.paint_state.spelling_errors.by_node.get(&fragment.layout_node) else {
                return Vec::new();
            };
            // A run that ends before the fragment starts, or starts after it ends, has no part in it.
            runs.iter()
                .filter(|&&(start, end)| {
                    end >= fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node
                        && start <= fragment.dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace
                })
                .filter_map(|&(start, end)| {
                    text_fragment::compute_selection_offsets(
                        recorder.source,
                        fragment,
                        SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END,
                        start,
                        end,
                    )
                })
                .collect()
        }
        HighlightPseudoElement::SearchText | HighlightPseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent => {
            let is_current = highlight == HighlightPseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent;
            let highlights = &recorder.paint_state.search_text;
            let Some(touching) = highlights.by_node.get(&fragment.layout_node) else {
                return Vec::new();
            };
            let offsets_in_node =
                |&(match_index, state): &(u32, u8)| highlights.matches[match_index as usize].offsets_in_node(state);
            // A match that ends before the fragment starts, or starts after it ends, has no part in it.
            let first = touching.partition_point(|entry| offsets_in_node(entry).1 < fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node);
            let end = touching
                .partition_point(|entry| offsets_in_node(entry).0 <= fragment.dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace);
            touching[first..end.max(first)]
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|&(match_index, state)| {
                    let found = &highlights.matches[match_index as usize];
                    if found.is_current != is_current {
                        return None;
                    }
                    text_fragment::compute_selection_offsets(
                        recorder.source,
                        fragment,
                        state,
                        found.start_offset,
                        found.end_offset,
                    )
                })
                .collect()
        }
    };
    offsets
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|offsets| offsets.start != offsets.end)
        .collect()
}

fn highlight_style<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    layer: HighlightLayer,
    node: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>> {
    Some(match layer {
        HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::Selection) => recorder.selection_style(node),
        HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(
            highlight @ (HighlightPseudoElement::SearchText | HighlightPseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent),
        ) => recorder.search_text_style(node, highlight),
        HighlightLayer::BuiltIn(HighlightPseudoElement::SpellingError) => recorder.spelling_error_style(node),
        HighlightLayer::Custom(layer) => recorder.custom_highlight_style(node, layer)?,
        HighlightLayer::TextFragmentIndication => Arc::new(SelectionStyleAnswer {
            facts: crate::painting::host::FfiSelectionStyleFacts {
                colors_authored: true,
                background_color: recorder.inputs.mark_color,
                text_color: crate::painting::display_list::commands::OptionalColor::some(
                    recorder.inputs.mark_text_color,
                ),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            shadows: Vec::new(),
            decoration_metrics: None,
        }),
    })
}

fn compute_render_spans<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    block: NodeSlotId,
    owned_fragment_indices: &[u32],
) -> Vec<RenderSpan> {
    let arena = recorder.source;
    let layout_arena = recorder.source;
    let mut spans: Vec<RenderSpan> = Vec::new();
    for &fragment_index in owned_fragment_indices {
        let side = layout_arena.committed_side_data(block);
        let fragment = &side.fragments()[fragment_index as usize];
        if fragment.glyph_run.is_none() {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(parent_style) = arena.node_style_if_live(fragment.style_source) else {
            continue;
        };
        let parent_retains_animated_content =
            arena.node_flags_if_live(fragment.style_source) & NodeFlag::HasAnimatedOpacityOrTransform as u32 != 0;
        if parent_style.visibility() != crate::css::css_enums::visibility::VISIBLE
            || (parent_style.effects().opacity == 0.0 && !parent_retains_animated_content)
        {
            continue;
        }
        let inherited_text = parent_style.inherited_text();
        let text_color = inherited_text.webkit_text_fill_color;
        let base_shadows = || -> Vec<ShadowLayer> {
            inherited_text
                .text_shadow
                .as_slice()
                .iter()
                .map(|shadow| ShadowLayer {
                    color: shadow.color.resolve(parent_style.current_color()),
                    offset_x: CssPixels::from_raw(shadow.offset_x),
                    offset_y: CssPixels::from_raw(shadow.offset_y),
                    blur_radius: CssPixels::from_raw(shadow.blur_radius),
                })
                .collect()
        };

        let mut highlights = Vec::new();
        for layer in highlight_layers_for_fragment(recorder, fragment) {
            let ranges = highlight_offsets_for_fragment(recorder, layer, fragment);
            if ranges.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(answer) = highlight_style(recorder, layer, fragment.layout_node) {
                highlights.push((layer, ranges, answer));
            }
        }
        if highlights.is_empty() {
            spans.push(RenderSpan {
                fragment_index,
                start_code_unit: 0,
                end_code_unit: fragment.length_in_code_units,
                text_color,
                shadow_layers: base_shadows(),
                highlights: Vec::new(),
                decoration_color: None,
            });
            continue;
        }

        let mut boundaries = vec![0, fragment.length_in_code_units];
        for (_, ranges, _) in &highlights {
            boundaries.extend(ranges.iter().flat_map(|offsets| [offsets.start, offsets.end]));
        }
        boundaries.sort_unstable();
        boundaries.dedup();
        let first_span_of_fragment = spans.len();
        // The ranges of one highlight come in order without overlapping, and so do the pieces, so each highlight
        // only needs to look at the first of its ranges that does not end before the piece.
        let mut next_ranges = vec![0usize; highlights.len()];
        for piece in boundaries.windows(2) {
            let (start, end) = (piece[0], piece[1]);
            let mut span = RenderSpan {
                fragment_index,
                start_code_unit: start,
                end_code_unit: end,
                text_color,
                shadow_layers: base_shadows(),
                highlights: Vec::new(),
                decoration_color: None,
            };
            for ((highlight, ranges, answer), next_range) in highlights.iter().zip(&mut next_ranges) {
                while ranges.get(*next_range).is_some_and(|offsets| offsets.end <= start) {
                    *next_range += 1;
                }
                let Some(offsets) = ranges.get(*next_range) else {
                    continue;
                };
                if start < offsets.start || end > offsets.end {
                    continue;
                }
                let facts = &answer.facts;
                if facts.text_color.has_value {
                    span.text_color = facts.text_color.value.0;
                    span.decoration_color = Some(facts.text_color.value.0);
                }
                let current_color = span.text_color;
                let resolve_color = |color: u32, is_current_color: bool| {
                    if is_current_color { current_color } else { color }
                };
                span.highlights.push(HighlightOverlay {
                    highlight: *highlight,
                    background_color: resolve_color(facts.background_color.0, facts.background_color_is_current_color),
                    shadow_layers: if facts.has_text_shadow {
                        answer
                            .shadows
                            .iter()
                            .map(|shadow| ShadowLayer {
                                color: resolve_color(shadow.layer.color, shadow.color_is_current_color),
                                ..shadow.layer
                            })
                            .collect()
                    } else {
                        Vec::new()
                    },
                    text_decoration: facts.has_text_decoration.then_some(SpanTextDecoration {
                        lines: facts.text_decoration_lines,
                        line_count: facts.text_decoration_line_count,
                        style: facts.text_decoration_style,
                        color: resolve_color(
                            facts.text_decoration_color.0,
                            facts.text_decoration_color_is_current_color,
                        ),
                        metrics: answer.decoration_metrics,
                    }),
                });
            }
            if let Some(previous) = spans[first_span_of_fragment..].last_mut()
                && previous.has_same_highlights_as(&span)
            {
                previous.end_code_unit = end;
                continue;
            }
            spans.push(span);
        }
    }
    spans
}

pub(crate) struct GlyphRunEmission {
    pub baseline_start: FloatPoint,
    pub orientation: GlyphRunOrientation,
    pub glyph_bounding_rect: IntRect,
}

/// The player draws a vertical run by shifting the horizontal blob right by the fragment rect's
/// width and turning it a quarter turn clockwise about the rect's top-left corner, so the blob's
/// bounds follow the same mapping.
fn vertical_glyph_bounds(horizontal_bounds: IntRect, fragment_device_rect: IntRect) -> IntRect {
    let (bounds, fragment) = (WideRect::of(horizontal_bounds), WideRect::of(fragment_device_rect));
    IntRect::new(
        saturated(fragment.x + fragment.width - (bounds.y + bounds.height - fragment.y)),
        saturated(fragment.y + (bounds.x - fragment.x)),
        horizontal_bounds.height,
        horizontal_bounds.width,
    )
}

/// The player draws a counterclockwise run by turning the horizontal blob a quarter turn counterclockwise, so the
/// blob's start lands on the bottom-left corner of the fragment rect, and its bounds follow the same mapping.
fn counterclockwise_glyph_bounds(horizontal_bounds: IntRect, fragment_device_rect: IntRect) -> IntRect {
    let (bounds, fragment) = (WideRect::of(horizontal_bounds), WideRect::of(fragment_device_rect));
    IntRect::new(
        saturated(fragment.x + (bounds.y - fragment.y)),
        saturated(fragment.y + fragment.height - (bounds.x + bounds.width - fragment.x)),
        horizontal_bounds.height,
        horizontal_bounds.width,
    )
}

/// A device rect with room to add its coordinates to its sizes: Glyph bounds come from float coordinates that saturate
/// at the ends of the i32 range, so their sums can go past it.
struct WideRect {
    x: i64,
    y: i64,
    width: i64,
    height: i64,
}

impl WideRect {
    fn of(rect: IntRect) -> Self {
        Self {
            x: rect.x.into(),
            y: rect.y.into(),
            width: rect.width.into(),
            height: rect.height.into(),
        }
    }
}

fn saturated(value: i64) -> i32 {
    value.clamp(i32::MIN.into(), i32::MAX.into()) as i32
}

pub(crate) fn glyph_run_emission(
    fragment: &crate::painting::paintable_data::FragmentRecord,
    run: &crate::painting::paintable_data::GlyphRunRecord,
    fragment_absolute_rect: CssPixelRect,
    fragment_device_rect: IntRect,
    scale: f64,
) -> GlyphRunEmission {
    let bounds = run.bounding_box;
    let baseline_start = FloatPoint {
        x: (fragment_absolute_rect.x.to_float() as f64 * scale) as f32,
        y: ((fragment_absolute_rect.y.to_float() + fragment.baseline.to_float()) as f64 * scale) as f32,
    };
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-4/#valdef-writing-mode-sideways-lr
    // "... and all text is typeset sideways, with the glyphs' tops facing left (the line-over side)."
    let orientation = match fragment.writing_mode {
        crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB => GlyphRunOrientation::Horizontal,
        crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::SIDEWAYS_LR => GlyphRunOrientation::VerticalCounterclockwise,
        _ => GlyphRunOrientation::Vertical,
    };
    let horizontal_bounds = IntRect::new(
        (bounds.x * scale as f32 + baseline_start.x).round_ties_even() as i32,
        (bounds.y * scale as f32 + baseline_start.y).round_ties_even() as i32,
        (bounds.width * scale as f32).round_ties_even() as i32,
        (bounds.height * scale as f32).round_ties_even() as i32,
    );
    let glyph_bounding_rect = match orientation {
        GlyphRunOrientation::Horizontal => horizontal_bounds,
        GlyphRunOrientation::Vertical => vertical_glyph_bounds(horizontal_bounds, fragment_device_rect),
        GlyphRunOrientation::VerticalCounterclockwise => {
            counterclockwise_glyph_bounds(horizontal_bounds, fragment_device_rect)
        }
    };
    GlyphRunEmission {
        baseline_start,
        orientation,
        glyph_bounding_rect,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn paint_fragments_foreground<O: Observer>(recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>, block: NodeSlotId) {
    let filter = crate::painting::fragment_ownership::effective_filter(recorder.source, block);
    let fragment_count = recorder.source.committed_side_data(block).fragments().len();
    let mut indices = Vec::with_capacity(fragment_count);
    filter.for_each_owned_fragment_index(fragment_count, |index| indices.push(index as u32));
    paint_fragments(recorder, block, &indices);
}

pub(crate) fn paint_fragments<O: Observer>(recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>, block: NodeSlotId, indices: &[u32]) {
    let spans = compute_render_spans(recorder, block, indices);

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-pseudo-4/#highlight-painting
    // A highlight pseudo-element suppresses the normal drawing of any associated text, and the text
    // decorations (other than shadows) that had been applied to that text. Instead the topmost active
    // highlight overlay redraws that text (and those decorations) over all the highlight overlay
    // backgrounds using that highlight's own color.
    for span in &spans {
        paint_text_shadow(recorder, block, span, &span.shadow_layers, None);
    }
    // Glyph strokes can extend beyond a highlight rectangle. Keep the normal glyphs outside the highlights, then
    // let each overlay redraw the text inside its rectangle without a stroke.
    let mut stroked_highlights = HashSet::new();
    for fragment_spans in spans.chunk_by(|a, b| a.fragment_index == b.fragment_index) {
        let Some(span) = fragment_spans.iter().find(|span| !span.highlights.is_empty()) else {
            continue;
        };
        let side = recorder.source.committed_side_data(block);
        let fragment = &side.fragments()[span.fragment_index as usize];
        let style = recorder.source.node_style_if_live(fragment.style_source).unwrap();
        let text = style.inherited_text();
        if text.webkit_text_stroke_width <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let normal_span = RenderSpan {
            fragment_index: span.fragment_index,
            start_code_unit: 0,
            end_code_unit: fragment.length_in_code_units,
            text_color: text.webkit_text_fill_color,
            shadow_layers: Vec::new(),
            highlights: Vec::new(),
            decoration_color: None,
        };
        let mut highlight_path = Path::new();
        for rect in fragment_spans
            .iter()
            .filter(|other| !other.highlights.is_empty())
            .flat_map(|other| highlight_rects(recorder, block, other))
        {
            let rect = recorder.converter.rounded_device_rect(rect).to_float();
            highlight_path.move_to(FloatPoint { x: rect.x, y: rect.y });
            highlight_path.line_to(FloatPoint {
                x: rect.x + rect.width,
                y: rect.y,
            });
            highlight_path.line_to(FloatPoint {
                x: rect.x + rect.width,
                y: rect.y + rect.height,
            });
            highlight_path.line_to(FloatPoint {
                x: rect.x,
                y: rect.y + rect.height,
            });
            highlight_path.close();
        }
        let clip = PendingInlineClip::subtracting_path(&highlight_path, WindingRule::Nonzero);
        let clip_depth = recorder.recorder.ambient_inline_clip_depth();
        recorder.recorder.push_ambient_inline_clips(&[clip]);
        paint_text_fragment(recorder, block, &normal_span, &[], true);
        recorder.recorder.truncate_ambient_inline_clips(clip_depth);
        stroked_highlights.insert(span.fragment_index);
    }
    for span in spans.iter().filter(|span| span.highlights.is_empty()) {
        let sets =
            crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::decoration_sets_for_span(recorder.source, block, span);
        paint_text_fragment(
            recorder,
            block,
            span,
            &sets,
            !stroked_highlights.contains(&span.fragment_index),
        );
    }

    let highlight_backdrop = recorder
        .source
        .node_style_if_live(block)
        .map(|style| Color(style.background_color()));
    let mut layers: Vec<HighlightLayer> = spans
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|span| span.highlights.iter().map(|overlay| overlay.highlight))
        .collect();
    layers.sort_unstable_by_key(|layer| layer.stacking_order());
    layers.dedup();
    for highlight in layers {
        let overlays = || {
            spans.iter().flat_map(move |span| {
                span.highlights
                    .iter()
                    .filter(move |overlay| overlay.highlight == highlight)
                    .map(move |overlay| (span, overlay))
            })
        };

        // Each highlight pseudo-element draws its background over the corresponding portion of the
        // highlight overlay, painting it immediately below any positioned descendants.
        for (span, overlay) in overlays() {
            if Color(overlay.background_color).alpha() > 0 {
                let converter = recorder.converter;
                let previous = recorder.recorder.set_contrast_backdrop(highlight_backdrop);
                for highlight_rect in highlight_rects(recorder, block, span) {
                    recorder.recorder.fill_rect(
                        converter.rounded_device_rect(highlight_rect),
                        Color(overlay.background_color),
                        ForceDarkRole::Selection,
                    );
                }
                recorder.recorder.set_contrast_backdrop(previous);
            }
        }

        // Any text-shadow applying to a highlight pseudo-element is drawn over its corresponding
        // highlight overlay background.
        for (span, overlay) in overlays() {
            paint_text_shadow(recorder, block, span, &overlay.shadow_layers, Some(overlay));
        }
    }

    for span in spans.iter().filter(|span| !span.highlights.is_empty()) {
        let sets =
            crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::decoration_sets_for_span(recorder.source, block, span);
        paint_text_fragment(recorder, block, span, &sets, true);
    }
}

fn highlight_rects<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    block: NodeSlotId,
    span: &RenderSpan,
) -> Vec<CssPixelRect> {
    let side = recorder.source.committed_side_data(block);
    let fragment = &side.fragments()[span.fragment_index as usize];
    let offsets = SelectionOffsets {
        start: span.start_code_unit,
        end: span.end_code_unit,
    };
    text_fragment::rects_for_selection_offsets(recorder.source, fragment, offsets)
}

pub(crate) fn text_shadow_layers_and_bounds(
    shadow_layers: &[ShadowLayer],
    fragment_device_rect: IntRect,
    scale: f64,
) -> (Vec<TextShadowLayer>, IntRect) {
    let converter = crate::painting::display_list::device_pixels::DevicePixelConverter::new(scale);
    let mut shadows_bounding_rect = IntRect::default();
    let layers: Vec<TextShadowLayer> = shadow_layers
        .iter()
        .rev()
        .map(|layer| {
            let blur_radius = converter.rounded_device_pixels(layer.blur_radius);
            let offset = FloatPoint {
                x: layer.offset_x.to_float() * scale as f32,
                y: layer.offset_y.to_float() * scale as f32,
            };
            let rounded_offset = IntPoint {
                x: offset.x.round() as i32,
                y: offset.y.round() as i32,
            };
            // Space around the painted text to allow it to blur.
            let margin = blur_radius * 2;
            shadows_bounding_rect = shadows_bounding_rect.united(IntRect::new(
                fragment_device_rect.x + rounded_offset.x - margin,
                fragment_device_rect.y + rounded_offset.y - margin,
                fragment_device_rect.width + margin * 2,
                fragment_device_rect.height + margin * 2,
            ));
            TextShadowLayer {
                offset,
                rounded_offset,
                blur_radius,
                color: Color(layer.color),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    (layers, shadows_bounding_rect)
}

fn paint_text_shadow<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    block: NodeSlotId,
    span: &RenderSpan,
    shadow_layers: &[ShadowLayer],
    shadowed_highlight: Option<&HighlightOverlay>,
) {
    if shadow_layers.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let side = recorder.source.committed_side_data(block);
    let fragment = &side.fragments()[span.fragment_index as usize];
    let Some(run) = &fragment.glyph_run else {
        return;
    };
    if run.glyphs.is_empty() {
        return;
    }

    let converter = recorder.converter;
    let scale = recorder.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
    let fragment_absolute_rect = text_fragment::absolute_rect(recorder.source, fragment);
    let fragment_device_rect = converter.enclosing_device_rect(fragment_absolute_rect);
    let font_id = recorder.register_font(&run.font);
    let GlyphRunEmission {
        baseline_start,
        orientation,
        ..
    } = glyph_run_emission(fragment, run, fragment_absolute_rect, fragment_device_rect, scale);

    // If this is a partial span, slice the glyph run to only include the relevant glyphs.
    let mut span_glyphs = 0..run.glyphs.len();
    if span.start_code_unit != 0 || span.end_code_unit != fragment.length_in_code_units {
        let mut start_glyph = 0usize;
        let mut glyph_count = 0usize;
        let mut code_unit_offset = 0usize;
        for (i, glyph) in run.glyphs.iter().enumerate() {
            if code_unit_offset == span.start_code_unit {
                start_glyph = i;
            }
            code_unit_offset += glyph.length_in_code_units();
            if code_unit_offset == span.end_code_unit {
                glyph_count = i - start_glyph + 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if glyph_count > 0 {
            span_glyphs = start_glyph..start_glyph + glyph_count;
        }
    }

    let text = recorder
        .recorder
        .notes_record_origins()
        .then(|| fragment_text(recorder.source, fragment, span.start_code_unit..span.end_code_unit));
    recorder.recorder.set_glyph_run_text(text);

    // NB: Force-dark leaves text shadows alone. Light text keeps its color under force-dark, so inverting the dark
    // outline set behind it would put a light halo around light glyphs — which reads as blurred text. Blink doesn't
    // filter text shadows either: DarkModeFilter::ApplyToFlagsIfNeeded recolors only the paint flags, never the
    // shadow filter that TextShadowPainter puts on the text's layer.
    // Shadow layers are ordered front-to-back, so we paint them in reverse.
    let (layers, shadows_bounding_rect) = text_shadow_layers_and_bounds(shadow_layers, fragment_device_rect, scale);
    let font_smoothing = recorder
        .source
        .node_style_if_live(fragment.style_source)
        .unwrap()
        .inherited_text()
        .font_smoothing;
    let paint_glyph_shadows = |recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>, layers: &[TextShadowLayer]| {
        recorder.recorder.paint_text_shadow(
            layers,
            shadows_bounding_rect,
            fragment_device_rect,
            baseline_start,
            GlyphRunForRecording {
                font_smoothing,
                font_id: FontResourceId(font_id),
                glyphs: run
                    .glyphs
                    .placed()
                    .skip(span_glyphs.start)
                    .take(span_glyphs.len())
                    .filter(|placed| placed.glyph.should_paint())
                    .map(DisplayListGlyph::from),
            },
            scale,
            orientation,
            ForceDarkRole::None,
        );
    };

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text-decor-4/#text-shadow-property
    // Each layer shadows the element's text and all its text decorations (composited together). The shadow effects
    // are applied front-to-back: the first shadow is on top.
    // The decorations a highlight adds belong to its overlay, so only the overlay's own shadows shadow them, and the
    // text's own shadows shadow none of them.
    let shadowed_span = RenderSpan {
        fragment_index: span.fragment_index,
        start_code_unit: span.start_code_unit,
        end_code_unit: span.end_code_unit,
        text_color: span.text_color,
        shadow_layers: Vec::new(),
        highlights: shadowed_highlight
            .map(|overlay| HighlightOverlay {
                highlight: overlay.highlight,
                background_color: overlay.background_color,
                shadow_layers: Vec::new(),
                text_decoration: overlay.text_decoration,
            })
            .into_iter()
            .collect(),
        decoration_color: span.decoration_color,
    };
    let decoration_sets = crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::decoration_sets_for_span(
        recorder.source,
        block,
        &shadowed_span,
    );
    if decoration_sets.is_empty() {
        paint_glyph_shadows(recorder, &layers);
    } else {
        let decoration_box = span_decoration_box(recorder.source, fragment, span);
        for layer in &layers {
            paint_glyph_shadows(recorder, std::slice::from_ref(layer));
            paint_decoration_shadow(
                recorder,
                block,
                span.fragment_index,
                decoration_box,
                &decoration_sets,
                layer,
            );
        }
    }
    recorder.recorder.set_glyph_run_text(None);
}

/// Paints the shadow that `layer` casts from the decoration lines of `sets`: the lines in the shadow's color, moved by
/// its offset and blurred by its blur radius.
fn paint_decoration_shadow<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    block: NodeSlotId,
    fragment_index: u32,
    decoration_box: CssPixelRect,
    sets: &[crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::TextDecorationSet],
    layer: &TextShadowLayer,
) {
    let paint_lines = |recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>| {
        for set in sets {
            let mut set = *set;
            set.color = layer.color.0;
            crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::paint_decoration_lines(
                recorder,
                block,
                fragment_index,
                decoration_box,
                &set,
                layer.rounded_offset,
                ForceDarkRole::None,
            );
        }
    };
    if layer.blur_radius <= 0 {
        paint_lines(recorder);
        return;
    }

    let side = recorder.source.committed_side_data(block);
    let fragment = &side.fragments()[fragment_index as usize];
    let fragment_rect = text_fragment::absolute_rect(recorder.source, fragment);
    let mut ink_bounds = IntRect::default();
    for set in sets {
        let bounds =
            crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::decoration_ink_bounds(fragment, fragment_rect, set);
        ink_bounds = ink_bounds.united(recorder.converter.enclosing_device_rect(bounds));
    }
    // NB: A blur reaches about three standard deviations, which is one and a half blur radii.
    let margin = layer.blur_radius * 2;
    let clip_rect = IntRect::new(
        ink_bounds.x + layer.rounded_offset.x - margin,
        ink_bounds.y + layer.rounded_offset.y - margin,
        ink_bounds.width + margin * 2,
        ink_bounds.height + margin * 2,
    );
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-backgrounds-3/#shadow-blur
    // [...] the resulting shadow must approximate [...] the image that would be generated by applying to the shadow a
    // Gaussian blur with a standard deviation equal to half the blur radius.
    let standard_deviation = layer.blur_radius as f32 / 2.0;
    let group = recorder.recorder.begin_isolated_group();
    paint_lines(recorder);
    recorder.recorder.finish_group_with_effects(
        group,
        crate::painting::display_list::recorder::IsolatedGroupEffects {
            clip_rect: clip_rect.to_float(),
            opacity: 1.0,
            filter: Some(Arc::new(
                libgfx_rust::filter::Filter::gaussian_blur(standard_deviation, standard_deviation, None).serialize(),
            )),
            compositing_and_blending_operator: libgfx_rust::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
            mask_kind: libgfx_rust::MaskKind::Alpha,
        },
    );
}

/// The text a fragment holds between code unit offsets into it.
fn fragment_text(
    source: &crate::painting::paint_read::PaintSource<'_>,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    offsets: std::ops::Range<usize>,
) -> String {
    let Some(rendered_text) = source.rendered_text(fragment.layout_node) else {
        return String::new();
    };
    let end = (fragment.start + offsets.end.min(fragment.length_in_code_units)).min(rendered_text.text.len());
    let start = (fragment.start + offsets.start).min(end);
    String::from_utf16_lossy(&rendered_text.text[start..end])
}

fn paint_text_fragment<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    block: NodeSlotId,
    span: &RenderSpan,
    decoration_sets: &[crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::TextDecorationSet],
    draw_glyphs: bool,
) {
    if span.start_code_unit == span.end_code_unit {
        return;
    }
    let side = recorder.source.committed_side_data(block);
    let fragment = &side.fragments()[span.fragment_index as usize];
    if recorder.inputs.should_show_line_box_borders {
        let converter = recorder.converter;
        let fragment_absolute_rect = text_fragment::absolute_rect(recorder.source, fragment);
        let fragment_absolute_device_rect = converter.enclosing_device_rect(fragment_absolute_rect);
        recorder.recorder.draw_rect(
            fragment_absolute_device_rect,
            Color::from_rgb(0, 255, 0),
            false,
            ForceDarkRole::None,
        );
        let one = crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels::from_integer(1);
        let baseline_start = converter.rounded_device_point(
            fragment_absolute_rect
                .location()
                .translated(crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels::default(), fragment.baseline),
        );
        let baseline_end = converter.rounded_device_point(
            crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelPoint::new(fragment_absolute_rect.right(), fragment_absolute_rect.y)
                .translated(-one, fragment.baseline),
        );
        recorder.recorder.draw_line(
            baseline_start,
            baseline_end,
            Color::from_rgb(255, 0, 0),
            1,
            libgfx_rust::LineStyle::Solid,
            Color::TRANSPARENT,
            ForceDarkRole::None,
        );
    }
    let Some(run) = &fragment.glyph_run else {
        return;
    };
    let converter = recorder.converter;
    let scale = recorder.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
    let fragment_absolute_rect = text_fragment::absolute_rect(recorder.source, fragment);
    let fragment_device_rect = converter.enclosing_device_rect(fragment_absolute_rect);
    let font_id = recorder.register_font(&run.font);
    let GlyphRunEmission {
        baseline_start,
        orientation,
        glyph_bounding_rect,
    } = glyph_run_emission(fragment, run, fragment_absolute_rect, fragment_device_rect, scale);
    let style = recorder.source.node_style_if_live(fragment.style_source).unwrap();
    let text = style.inherited_text();
    let font_smoothing = text.font_smoothing;
    let stroke_width = if span.highlights.is_empty() {
        (text.webkit_text_stroke_width * scale) as f32
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    let stroke_color = Color(text.webkit_text_stroke_color.resolve(style.current_color()));
    let paint_order = style.inherited_svg().paint_order;
    let run_for_recording = || GlyphRunForRecording {
        font_smoothing,
        font_id: FontResourceId(font_id),
        glyphs: run
            .glyphs
            .placed()
            .filter(|placed| placed.glyph.should_paint())
            .map(DisplayListGlyph::from),
    };

    let paint_glyphs = |recorder: &mut crate::painting::display_list::recorder::DisplayListRecorder| {
        for operation in paint_order {
            let (color, width) = match operation {
                crate::css::css_enums::paint_order::FILL => (Color(span.text_color), 0.0),
                crate::css::css_enums::paint_order::STROKE if stroke_width > 0.0 => (stroke_color, stroke_width),
                _ => continue,
            };
            recorder.draw_glyph_run(
                baseline_start,
                run_for_recording(),
                color,
                width,
                fragment_device_rect,
                scale,
                orientation,
                glyph_bounding_rect,
                ForceDarkRole::Foreground,
            );
        }
    };
    let text = recorder
        .recorder
        .notes_record_origins()
        .then(|| fragment_text(recorder.source, fragment, span.start_code_unit..span.end_code_unit));
    recorder.recorder.set_glyph_run_text(text);
    // Paint text, clipped to span range if not full fragment.
    let is_full_fragment = span.start_code_unit == 0 && span.end_code_unit == fragment.length_in_code_units;
    if is_full_fragment {
        if draw_glyphs {
            paint_glyphs(&mut recorder.recorder);
        }
    } else if draw_glyphs {
        let offsets = SelectionOffsets {
            start: span.start_code_unit,
            end: span.end_code_unit,
        };
        for range_rect in text_fragment::rects_for_selection_offsets(recorder.source, fragment, offsets) {
            recorder
                .recorder
                .record_clipped_to(converter.rounded_device_rect(range_rect), paint_glyphs);
        }
    }

    recorder.recorder.set_glyph_run_text(None);

    let decoration_box = span_decoration_box(recorder.source, fragment, span);
    for set in decoration_sets {
        crate::painting::record::paint::text_decoration::paint_decoration_lines(
            recorder,
            block,
            span.fragment_index,
            decoration_box,
            set,
            IntPoint::default(),
            ForceDarkRole::Foreground,
        );
    }
}

/// The part of a fragment that the decorations of `span` run along: the whole fragment, or the span's range of it.
fn span_decoration_box(source: &impl PaintRead, fragment: &FragmentRecord, span: &RenderSpan) -> CssPixelRect {
    let mut decoration_box = text_fragment::absolute_rect(source, fragment);
    if span.start_code_unit == 0 && span.end_code_unit == fragment.length_in_code_units {
        return decoration_box;
    }
    let offsets = SelectionOffsets {
        start: span.start_code_unit,
        end: span.end_code_unit,
    };
    let range_rect = text_fragment::rect_for_selection_offsets(source, fragment, offsets);
    // NB: The span of vertical text runs down the fragment.
    if fragment.writing_mode == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB
        && !fragment.glyph_run.as_ref().is_some_and(|run| run.is_upright)
    {
        decoration_box.x = range_rect.x;
        decoration_box.width = range_rect.width;
    } else {
        decoration_box.y = range_rect.y;
        decoration_box.height = range_rect.height;
    }
    decoration_box
}

// Paints the caret when it sits in a fragment owned by `owner`; the block itself
// (owner == None) also handles blank lines and empty editable elements.
pub(crate) fn paint_cursor<O: Observer>(
    recorder: &mut PaintRecorder<'_, O>,
    block: NodeSlotId,
    owner: Option<NodeSlotId>,
) {
    let Some(caret) = recorder.inputs.caret else {
        return;
    };
    if caret.target != (CaretTarget::InBlock { block, owner }) || !recorder.window_is_focused() {
        return;
    }
    let color = caret.color;
    if color.alpha() == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let converter = recorder.converter;
    recorder.recorder.paint_caret(
        converter.rounded_device_rect(caret.rect),
        color,
        caret.blink_cycle_start_time_ns,
        caret.should_blink,
    );
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn vertical_glyph_bounds_follow_the_players_rotation() {
        let fragment = IntRect::new(100, 50, 20, 60);
        // A blob starting two pixels into the fragment, rising four pixels above its top.
        let horizontal = IntRect::new(102, 46, 40, 24);
        let vertical = vertical_glyph_bounds(horizontal, fragment);
        // Its advance runs down the fragment from two pixels in, and its ascent side ends up on the
        // right, four pixels short of the fragment's right edge.
        assert_eq!(vertical, IntRect::new(100, 52, 24, 40));
    }

    #[test]
    fn turned_glyph_bounds_saturate_rather_than_overflow() {
        let fragment = IntRect::new(16, 16, 20, 60);
        // A run so long that its width saturated when its float bounds were taken to device pixels.
        let horizontal = IntRect::new(16, 16, i32::MAX, 24);
        assert_eq!(vertical_glyph_bounds(horizontal, fragment).height, i32::MAX);
        assert_eq!(counterclockwise_glyph_bounds(horizontal, fragment).y, i32::MIN + 77);
    }
}

//! The producers of a frame: each records one kind of output for one row under the contexts it
//! needs, starting and ending at a closed group boundary with no ambient state, so the run of
//! producers a chunk holds can be drawn by a later frame as it is. The recorder implements the
//! assembly host with them.

use super::assemble::{AssemblyEvent, AssemblyHost, ItemCut, ProducerOutcome, ScopeAction, ScopePlan};
use super::order_tree::{ProducerKind, RecordedChunk, RowPlacement};
use super::trace::{Action, Observer, Operation};
use super::window::InkBound;
use super::{PaintPhase, PaintRecorder};
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::ContextRef;
use crate::painting::force_dark::ForceDarkRole;
use crate::painting::paint_order_plan::{PaintOrderItem, PaintProducer, PaintScope, PaintScopePlan};
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead, PaintSource};
use crate::painting::record::change_ticks::RowChanges;
use crate::painting::record::paint::background_resolution::root_paint_covers_canvas;
use crate::painting::record::svg_resources::MaskLayerSet;
use crate::painting::{node_painting, paintable_geometry};
use libgfx_rust::Color;
use smallvec::SmallVec;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// The height in CSS pixels of a row of the grid the plans of walked scopes are cut along. A child scope taller
/// than a row is walked on its own, and a run ends where the next item starts in another row, so a run records about
/// a row of the document.
const GRID_ROW_HEIGHT_IN_CSS_PIXELS: i64 = 512;

fn draw_phase(kind: ProducerKind) -> Option<PaintPhase> {
    match kind {
        ProducerKind::DrawBackground => Some(PaintPhase::Background),
        ProducerKind::DrawBorder => Some(PaintPhase::Border),
        ProducerKind::DrawTableCollapsedBorder => Some(PaintPhase::TableCollapsedBorder),
        ProducerKind::DrawForeground => Some(PaintPhase::Foreground),
        ProducerKind::DrawOutline => Some(PaintPhase::Outline),
        ProducerKind::DrawOverlay => Some(PaintPhase::Overlay),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn draw_kind(phase: PaintPhase) -> ProducerKind {
    match phase {
        PaintPhase::Background => ProducerKind::DrawBackground,
        PaintPhase::Border => ProducerKind::DrawBorder,
        PaintPhase::TableCollapsedBorder => ProducerKind::DrawTableCollapsedBorder,
        PaintPhase::Foreground => ProducerKind::DrawForeground,
        PaintPhase::Outline => ProducerKind::DrawOutline,
        PaintPhase::Overlay => ProducerKind::DrawOverlay,
    }
}

impl<O: Observer> PaintRecorder<'_, O> {
    pub(crate) fn record_canvas(&mut self) -> Color {
        let mut root_group_color = Color::TRANSPARENT;
        self.trace_paint(Operation::Named(None, "canvas"), |this| {
            let inputs = this.inputs;
            let canvas_color = this
                .recorder
                .resolve_color(inputs.uncaptured.canvas_color, ForceDarkRole::Background);
            if let Some(rect) = inputs.canvas_fill_rect {
                this.recorder
                    .fill_rect(rect, inputs.uncaptured.canvas_color, ForceDarkRole::Background);
                root_group_color = canvas_color;
            }
            // .. in the case of embedded documents typically rendered over a transparent canvas
            // (such as provided via an HTML iframe element), if the used color scheme of the element
            // and the used color scheme of the embedded document’s root element do not match,
            // then the UA must use an opaque canvas of the Canvas color appropriate to the
            // embedded document’s used color scheme instead of a transparent canvas.
            if inputs.opaque_canvas {
                this.recorder.fill_rect(
                    inputs.bitmap_rect,
                    inputs.uncaptured.canvas_color,
                    ForceDarkRole::Background,
                );
                root_group_color = canvas_color;
            }
            // The root element paints its background over the canvas as well, wherever its own paint covers the canvas.
            // So there, fill with it only when it's opaque, since painting it twice changes nothing: A translucent one
            // would otherwise be applied twice.
            if inputs.uncaptured.background_color.alpha() == 255
                || !root_paint_covers_canvas(this.source, inputs.uncaptured.root_background_source.root_layout_node)
            {
                this.recorder.fill_rect(
                    inputs.bitmap_rect,
                    inputs.uncaptured.background_color,
                    ForceDarkRole::Background,
                );
            }
            root_group_color = root_group_color.blend(
                this.recorder
                    .resolve_color(inputs.uncaptured.background_color, ForceDarkRole::Background),
            );
        });
        root_group_color
    }

    // The transparent fill that triggers a content-generating SVG filter, and the mask
    // contents of a stacking context, recorded before its content.
    fn record_scope_preamble(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId) {
        let context = self.own_context(owner);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);
        if let Some(svg_filter_bounds) = self.source.committed_side_data(owner).svg_filter_bounds {
            let device_rect = self
                .converter
                .enclosing_device_rect(CssPixelRect::from(svg_filter_bounds));
            self.recorder.fill_rect_transparent(device_rect);
        }
        self.declare_mask_contents(owner, MaskLayerSet::CssAndSvg);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(ContextRef::default());
    }

    fn record_scroll_metadata(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId) {
        let context = self.own_context(owner);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);
        self.record_async_scrolling_metadata(owner);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(ContextRef::default());
    }

    fn record_box_commands(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        let facts = self.base_paint_facts(owner);
        // Scrolling repaints without stamping any row, so output that depends on the scroll
        // offset records every frame.
        if facts.has_fixed_background
            || (facts.has_scroll_offset_dependent_background && phase == PaintPhase::Background)
        {
            self.mark_live_producer();
        }
        let context = self.context_for_phase(owner, phase);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);
        self.paint(owner, phase);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(ContextRef::default());
    }

    fn record_svg_box_foreground(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId) {
        self.paint_svg_box_impl(owner);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(ContextRef::default());
    }

    fn producer_is_skipped(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, kind: ProducerKind) -> bool {
        draw_phase(kind).is_some_and(|phase| self.base_paint_facts(owner).paint_phase_mask & phase.bit() == 0)
    }

    /// The commands of a box phase inside a resource walk, which records into the referencing
    /// producer rather than into an entry of its own.
    pub(crate) fn record_box_phase_inside_resource(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        debug_assert!(self.is_recording_svg_resource_content());
        let kind = draw_kind(phase);
        if self.producer_is_skipped(owner, kind) {
            self.observer
                .observe(|log| log.leaf(Operation::Producer(owner, kind), Action::Skip, true));
            return;
        }
        let context = self.context_for_phase(owner, phase);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);
        self.trace_paint(Operation::Producer(owner, kind), |this| this.paint(owner, phase));
    }
}

impl<O: Observer> AssemblyHost for PaintRecorder<'_, O> {
    fn plan_scope(&mut self, scope: PaintScope) -> ScopePlan {
        let plan = PaintScopePlan::build(self.source, scope, self.inputs.should_paint_overlay);
        let active = !plan.establishes_stacking_context
            || crate::painting::hit_test::walk::stacking_context_paints(self.source, scope.owner);
        ScopePlan {
            active,
            items: if active { plan.items } else { SmallVec::new() },
        }
    }

    fn record_producer(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, kind: ProducerKind) -> ProducerOutcome {
        debug_assert!(
            self.recorder.is_producer_boundary(),
            "a producer starts at a closed group boundary without ambient state"
        );
        if self.producer_is_skipped(owner, kind) {
            self.observer
                .observe(|log| log.leaf(Operation::Producer(owner, kind), Action::Skip, true));
            return ProducerOutcome::default();
        }
        self.live_producer = false;
        self.producer_reads_window_focus.set(false);
        self.producer_reads_accumulated_scale.set(false);
        self.recorder
            .begin_record_origin(owner, super::trace::producer_name(kind));
        let start = self.recorder.byte_size();
        let blocking_wheel_event_regions_before = self.blocking_wheel_event_region_count;
        self.observer
            .observe(|log| log.begin(Operation::Producer(owner, kind), Action::Record));
        match kind {
            ProducerKind::ScopePreamble => self.record_scope_preamble(owner),
            ProducerKind::ScrollMetadata => self.record_scroll_metadata(owner),
            ProducerKind::Svg => self.record_svg_box_foreground(owner),
            ProducerKind::InlinePiece(index) | ProducerKind::TextFragment(index) => {
                let root = if crate::painting::node_painting::has_lines(self.source, owner) {
                    owner
                } else {
                    self.data(owner).containing_block
                };
                if matches!(kind, ProducerKind::InlinePiece(_)) {
                    super::paint::inline_box::paint_piece(self, root, index);
                } else {
                    let context = self.context_for_phase(owner, PaintPhase::Foreground);
                    self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);
                    super::paint::text::paint_fragments(self, root, &[index]);
                    self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(ContextRef::default());
                }
            }
            _ => {
                if let Some(phase) = draw_phase(kind) {
                    self.record_box_commands(owner, phase);
                }
            }
        }
        let end = self.recorder.byte_size();
        self.recorder.end_record_origin();
        if self.ink_bounds_audit.enabled {
            self.verify_producer_ink(owner, kind, start..end);
            self.verify_producer_against_open_scopes(owner, kind, start..end);
        }
        self.observer.observe(|log| log.end(end == start));
        debug_assert!(
            self.recorder.is_producer_boundary(),
            "a producer ends at a closed group boundary without ambient state"
        );
        ProducerOutcome {
            live: self.live_producer,
            reads_window_focus: self.producer_reads_window_focus.get(),
            reads_accumulated_scale: self.producer_reads_accumulated_scale.get(),
            blocking_wheel_event_regions: self.blocking_wheel_event_region_count - blocking_wheel_event_regions_before,
        }
    }

    fn take_run_chunk(&mut self) -> Option<Arc<RecordedChunk>> {
        let chunk = self.recorder.take_chunk();
        let record_notes = self.recorder.take_record_notes();
        let draws_vector_image_placeholders = std::mem::take(&mut self.run_draws_vector_image_placeholders);
        if chunk.records.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let chunk = RecordedChunk::new(chunk, draws_vector_image_placeholders);
        if let Some(record_notes) = record_notes {
            self.record_notes_of_chunks.push((Arc::clone(&chunk), record_notes));
        }
        Some(chunk)
    }

    fn changes_of_row(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId) -> RowChanges {
        let Some(published) = &self.source_recording else {
            return RowChanges::NONE;
        };
        self.source
            .paint_change_stamps(row)
            .changes_since(published.recorded_as_of)
    }

    fn placement_of_row(&mut self, row: NodeSlotId) -> RowPlacement {
        use crate::painting::paintable_data::PaintableFlag;
        use std::hash::Hasher;
        // A fragmented inline is placed by the pieces its line root holds, and the offset of its own fragment is
        // the one layout left there last.
        let placed_with = if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(self.source, row) {
            self.source.inline_pieces_root(row).unwrap_or(row)
        } else {
            row
        };
        let mut later_fragments = 0;
        if self
            .source
            .paintable_data(placed_with)
            .has_flag(PaintableFlag::HasLaterBoxFragments)
        {
            let mut digest = crate::fast_hash::fast_hasher();
            for fragment in paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rects_of_fragments(self.source, placed_with)
                .iter()
                .skip(1)
            {
                for coordinate in [fragment.x, fragment.y, fragment.width, fragment.height] {
                    digest.write_i32(coordinate.raw_value());
                }
            }
            later_fragments = digest.finish();
        }
        RowPlacement {
            origin: paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(self.source, placed_with).location(),
            later_fragments,
        }
    }

    fn cut_at(&mut self, scope: PaintScope, item: PaintOrderItem) -> ItemCut {
        let rows = self.source;
        let grid_row_height = CssPixels::from_integer(if self.inputs.records_in_finest_runs {
            1
        } else {
            GRID_ROW_HEIGHT_IN_CSS_PIXELS
        });
        let grid_row_at = |block_start: CssPixels| {
            Some(i64::from(block_start.raw_value()).div_euclid(i64::from(grid_row_height.raw_value())) as i32)
        };
        let line_root = || {
            if node_painting::has_lines(rows, scope.owner) {
                scope.owner
            } else {
                rows.paintable_data(scope.owner).containing_block
            }
        };
        match item {
            PaintOrderItem::Scope(child) => {
                // The pieces of an inline box are spread over its line root's lines: it stays with what is next
                // to it in the plan.
                if node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(rows, child.owner) {
                    return ItemCut::InRun { grid_row: None };
                }
                if crate::painting::style_queries::is_scroll_container(rows, child.owner) {
                    return ItemCut::Walked;
                }
                match rows.absolute_ink_overflow_rect(child.owner) {
                    Some(ink) if ink.height <= grid_row_height => ItemCut::InRun {
                        grid_row: grid_row_at(ink.y),
                    },
                    _ => ItemCut::Walked,
                }
            }
            PaintOrderItem::Producer(PaintProducer::TextFragment(index)) => {
                let side = rows.committed_side_data(line_root());
                let fragment = &side.fragments()[index as usize];
                ItemCut::InRun {
                    grid_row: grid_row_at(crate::painting::text_fragment::absolute_rect(rows, fragment).y),
                }
            }
            PaintOrderItem::Producer(PaintProducer::InlinePiece(index)) => {
                let root = line_root();
                let positions = self.line_root_positions(root);
                let side = rows.committed_side_data(root);
                let piece = &side.inline_box_pieces()[index as usize];
                let line = positions.of_line(side.lines(), piece.line_index as usize);
                ItemCut::InRun {
                    grid_row: grid_row_at(piece.border_box_rect.y + line.y),
                }
            }
            PaintOrderItem::Producer(_) => ItemCut::InRun { grid_row: None },
        }
    }

    // A child scope is bounded by its owner's ink overflow, in the space its own box is painted in, unless a transform
    // below that box moves some of it, and the text fragments and inline box pieces of a line root by what each draws.
    // The other producers of the scope's owner are not bounded unless they paint nothing: the owner of a walked scope
    // is in the window when the scope is, and its own producers mostly cover it.
    fn bound_of_item(&mut self, scope: PaintScope, item: PaintOrderItem) -> Option<InkBound> {
        use crate::painting::ink_overflow::{ScopeInkBound, inline_piece_ink, scope_ink_bound, text_fragment_ink_rect};
        let line_root = |rows: &PaintSource<'_>| {
            if node_painting::has_lines(rows, scope.owner) {
                scope.owner
            } else {
                rows.paintable_data(scope.owner).containing_block
            }
        };
        let (rect, space) = match item {
            PaintOrderItem::Scope(child) => {
                let ScopeInkBound::Rect(bound) = scope_ink_bound(self.source, child) else {
                    return None;
                };
                // The bound says where a transform below the child's own box has put what it moves, and nothing records
                // again when the transform puts it elsewhere.
                if self
                    .source
                    .stored_ink_overflow(child.owner)
                    .holds_what_a_transform_moves
                {
                    return None;
                }
                (bound, self.own_context(child.owner).spatial)
            }
            PaintOrderItem::Producer(PaintProducer::TextFragment(index)) => {
                let rect = text_fragment_ink_rect(self.source, self.paint_state, line_root(self.source), index);
                if rect.is_empty() {
                    return None;
                }
                (
                    rect,
                    self.context_for_phase(scope.owner, PaintPhase::Foreground).spatial,
                )
            }
            PaintOrderItem::Producer(PaintProducer::InlinePiece(index)) => {
                let root = line_root(self.source);
                let positions = self.line_root_positions(root);
                let ink = inline_piece_ink(self.source, root, &positions, index);
                if ink.unbounded {
                    return None;
                }
                let piece_node = self.source.committed_side_data(root).inline_box_pieces()[index as usize].node;
                (
                    ink.rect,
                    self.context_for_phase(piece_node, PaintPhase::Background).spatial,
                )
            }
            PaintOrderItem::Producer(producer) => {
                let paints_nothing = crate::painting::record::assemble::producer_kinds(producer)
                    .into_iter()
                    .all(|kind| self.producer_is_skipped(scope.owner, kind));
                return paints_nothing.then(InkBound::nothing);
            }
        };
        let slack = super::ink_bounds::COMPARISON_SLACK_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS;
        Some(InkBound::in_space(
            space,
            self.converter
                .enclosing_device_rect(rect)
                .inflated_edges(slack, slack, slack, slack)
                .to_float(),
        ))
    }

    fn is_outside_window(&mut self, bound: &InkBound) -> bool {
        self.window_spaces
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|spaces| spaces.is_outside(bound))
    }

    fn is_wholly_inside_window(&mut self, bound: &InkBound) -> bool {
        self.window_spaces
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|spaces| spaces.is_wholly_inside(bound))
    }

    // Any box whose overflow is not visible, though not every one of them clips: saying so of a box that does not
    // only has its scopes ask what bounds their segments.
    fn cuts_off_what_it_holds(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        use crate::css::css_enums::overflow;
        self.source
            .node_style_if_live(owner)
            .is_some_and(|style| style.overflow_x() != overflow::VISIBLE || style.overflow_y() != overflow::VISIBLE)
    }

    // SVG content is recorded by its root.
    fn producer_reads_descendants(&mut self, owner: NodeSlotId, kind: ProducerKind) -> bool {
        match kind {
            ProducerKind::Svg => true,
            ProducerKind::ScopePreamble => self.paints_svg_mask_or_clip_resource_subtree(owner),
            ProducerKind::InlinePiece(_) | ProducerKind::TextFragment(_) => true,
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    fn observe(&mut self, event: AssemblyEvent) {
        if self.ink_bounds_audit.enabled {
            self.audit_scope_event(event);
        }
        if !O::ENABLED {
            return;
        }
        self.observer.observe(|log| match event {
            AssemblyEvent::ScopeBegin(scope, action) => log.begin(
                Operation::Scope(scope),
                match action {
                    ScopeAction::Assembled => Action::Assemble,
                    ScopeAction::Replanned => Action::Replan,
                    ScopeAction::Recorded => Action::Record,
                    ScopeAction::Inactive => Action::Skip,
                },
            ),
            AssemblyEvent::ScopeEnd(_) => log.end(false),
            AssemblyEvent::ScopeCopied(scope) => log.leaf(Operation::Scope(scope), Action::Copy, false),
            AssemblyEvent::ProducerCopied(owner, kind) => {
                log.leaf(Operation::Producer(owner, kind), Action::Copy, false);
            }
            AssemblyEvent::ScopeLeftOut(scope) => log.leaf(Operation::Scope(scope), Action::LeaveOut, false),
            AssemblyEvent::ProducerLeftOut(owner, kind) => {
                log.leaf(Operation::Producer(owner, kind), Action::LeaveOut, false);
            }
        });
    }
}

use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::painting::display_list::chunks::Chunk;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::{DisplayListCommandType, DisplayListResourceId, PaintVectorImage};
use crate::painting::display_list_resources::{DisplayListResources, summary_of};
use crate::painting::host::FfiRecordingPublishCallbacks;
use crate::painting::paint_state::PendingRecording;
use crate::painting::record::recorder_state::RecorderState;
use crate::painting::record::resources::RecordingResourceManifest;
use crate::painting::record::vector_images::{
    VectorImageRenderRequest, is_vector_image_placeholder, vector_image_placeholder_index,
};
use crate::painting::record::{RecordingOutput, RecordingResult};
