use std::sync::Arc;

fn resolve_vector_image_placeholders(
    output: &mut RecordingOutput,
    requests: &[VectorImageRenderRequest],
    main_thread: &MainThread,
    publish: &FfiRecordingPublishCallbacks,
) -> Vec<Arc<VectorImageRecords>> {
    if requests.is_empty() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let vector_images = render_vector_images(requests, main_thread, publish);
    patch_vector_image_placeholders(output, &vector_images);
    vector_images
}

/// Has the host render the SVG images of `requests`, and answers their records, one for each request: those the
/// image's document keeps for the request, or none where the image has nothing to show.
pub(crate) fn render_vector_images(
    requests: &[VectorImageRenderRequest],
    main_thread: &MainThread,
    publish: &FfiRecordingPublishCallbacks,
) -> Vec<Arc<VectorImageRecords>> {
    requests
        .iter()
        .map(|request| {
            let request = request.to_ffi();
            publish
                .render_vector_image(main_thread, &request)
                .and_then(|image_host| image_host.vector_image(&VectorImageKey::of_request(&request)))
                .unwrap_or_else(VectorImageRecords::empty)
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Patches the placeholders of SVG images in `output` with the ids of `vector_images`, one for each image: finishes
/// every chunk of the recording that draws one, and the display list's tape with it.
fn patch_vector_image_placeholders(output: &mut RecordingOutput, vector_images: &[Arc<VectorImageRecords>]) {
    let id_field_offset = std::mem::offset_of!(PaintVectorImage, vector_image_id);
    let chunks = Arc::clone(&output.chunks);
    let display_list = Arc::make_mut(&mut output.display_list);
    debug_assert_eq!(
        chunks.len(),
        display_list.chunks.len(),
        "a tape holds one chunk for each of the list's"
    );
    let mut chunk_start = 0;
    for (index, chunk) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
        let chunk_end = display_list.chunks[index].byte_end as usize;
        let records = chunk_start..chunk_end;
        chunk_start = chunk_end;
        if !chunk.draws_vector_image_placeholders() || chunk.finished().is_some() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut patch_offsets = Vec::new();
        crate::painting::display_list::nested_records::for_each_command_including_nested(
            &display_list.bytes[records.clone()],
            &mut |command_type, payload_offset, payload| {
                if command_type != DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage {
                    return;
                }
                let id =
                    crate::painting::display_list::builder::read_command::<PaintVectorImage>(payload).vector_image_id;
                if is_vector_image_placeholder(id) {
                    patch_offsets.push((
                        records.start + payload_offset + id_field_offset,
                        vector_images[vector_image_placeholder_index(id)].id(),
                    ));
                }
            },
        );
        for &(offset, resolved_id) in &patch_offsets {
            display_list.bytes[offset..offset + std::mem::size_of::<u64>()]
                .copy_from_slice(&DisplayListResourceId(resolved_id).0.to_ne_bytes());
        }
        let finished = chunk.finish(Chunk::named(
            display_list.bytes[records].to_vec(),
            chunk.recorded().runs.clone(),
        ));
        display_list.chunks[index].id = finished.id;
    }
}

/// Publishes a pending recording from the document: hands its resources to the host and takes
/// its output in.
pub(crate) fn publish_recording(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    publication: Publication<'_>,
    main_thread: &MainThread,
    publish: &FfiRecordingPublishCallbacks,
) {
    let Publication {
        pending,
        behind_rows,
        recorder,
        hit_test_items_on_screen,
    } = publication;
    let publishes_recording = pending.publishes_recording;
    let output = publish_to_host(pending, recorder, main_thread, publish);
    take_in_presented_output(
        recorder,
        hit_test_items_on_screen,
        Arc::new(output),
        publishes_recording,
        |output| {
            host.queue_change(crate::render_state::ArenaChange::Paint(
                crate::painting::paint_changes::PaintChange::TakeInRecording {
                    output,
                    publishes_recording,
                },
            ));
        },
    );
    // A recording that landed behind the rows leaves nothing hit testing reads, as the boxes it shows may be gone.
    if behind_rows {
        hit_test_items_on_screen.forget();
    }
}

/// Makes a recording's output, with the host rendering its SVG images, reading nothing but the recording and the
/// recorder state it recorded with: what a publication does before the document takes the output in.
pub(crate) fn publish_to_host(
    pending: PendingRecording,
    recorder: &RecorderState,
    main_thread: &MainThread,
    publish: &FfiRecordingPublishCallbacks,
) -> RecordingOutput {
    publish_resources(pending, recorder, |output, requests| {
        resolve_vector_image_placeholders(output, requests, main_thread, publish)
    })
}

/// Whether a recording renders an SVG image, which only the host renders, so that only the host publishes it.
pub(crate) fn renders_vector_images(pending: &PendingRecording) -> bool {
    !pending.recording.resources.vector_image_render_requests.is_empty()
}

/// Makes the output of a recording that renders no SVG image, beside the event loop.
pub(crate) fn publish_to_presenter(pending: PendingRecording, recorder: &RecorderState) -> RecordingOutput {
    debug_assert!(!renders_vector_images(&pending), "only the host renders an SVG image");
    publish_resources(pending, recorder, |_, _| Vec::new())
}

/// Makes the output of a recording that renders SVG images, beside the event loop, with `vector_images`, those the host
/// rendered them as, one for each of the images.
pub(crate) fn publish_with_vector_images(
    pending: PendingRecording,
    recorder: &RecorderState,
    vector_images: &[Arc<VectorImageRecords>],
) -> RecordingOutput {
    publish_resources(pending, recorder, |output, _| {
        patch_vector_image_placeholders(output, vector_images);
        vector_images.to_vec()
    })
}

/// The records the host rendered the SVG images of `pending` as for the recording published last with `recorder`, those
/// of each of the images, or none where one of the images is new to that recording.
pub(crate) fn published_vector_image_records(
    pending: &PendingRecording,
    recorder: &RecorderState,
) -> Option<Vec<Arc<VectorImageRecords>>> {
    let published = recorder.published_recording.as_ref()?;
    pending
        .recording
        .resources
        .vector_image_render_requests
        .iter()
        .map(|request| {
            let id = published
                .vector_image_ids_by_request
                .iter()
                .find_map(|(published_request, id)| (published_request == request).then_some(*id))?;
            published.resources.vector_images.get(&id).cloned()
        })
        .collect()
}

/// The SVG images `output` draws, with the ids of their records: those of `requests`, whose records are `resolved_ids`,
/// and those of `published`, the recording published last, that the clean output `output` copied from it still draws.
fn drawn_vector_image_ids(
    output: &RecordingOutput,
    requests: &[VectorImageRenderRequest],
    resolved_ids: &[u64],
    published: Option<&RecordingOutput>,
) -> Vec<(VectorImageRenderRequest, u64)> {
    let mut drawn: Vec<(VectorImageRenderRequest, u64)> =
        requests.iter().copied().zip(resolved_ids.iter().copied()).collect();
    let carried = published.map_or(&[][..], |published| &published.vector_image_ids_by_request[..]);
    if carried.is_empty() {
        return drawn;
    }
    let mut drawn_ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    crate::painting::display_list::nested_records::for_each_command_including_nested(
        &output.display_list.bytes,
        &mut |command_type, _, payload| {
            if command_type == DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage {
                drawn_ids.insert(
                    crate::painting::display_list::builder::read_command::<PaintVectorImage>(payload).vector_image_id,
                );
            }
        },
    );
    for &(request, id) in carried {
        if drawn_ids.contains(&DisplayListResourceId(id))
            && !drawn.iter().any(|(drawn_request, _)| *drawn_request == request)
        {
            drawn.push((request, id));
        }
    }
    drawn
}

/// Makes a recording's output: has `resolve_vector_images` patch in the SVG images it renders, and gathers everything
/// its display list draws besides its tape.
fn publish_resources(
    pending: PendingRecording,
    recorder: &RecorderState,
    resolve_vector_images: impl FnOnce(&mut RecordingOutput, &[VectorImageRenderRequest]) -> Vec<Arc<VectorImageRecords>>,
) -> RecordingOutput {
    let PendingRecording {
        recording: RecordingResult { mut output, resources },
        publishes_recording,
        svg_paint_resources,
    } = pending;
    let RecordingResourceManifest {
        fonts,
        image_frames,
        vector_image_render_requests,
        ..
    } = resources;
    let mut display_list_resources = DisplayListResources {
        fonts: fonts.into_iter().map(|(id, font)| (id.0, font)).collect(),
        image_frames,
        vector_images: HashMap::new(),
    };
    // The filters of the visual context tree's effects draw these.
    for frame in published_filter_image_frames_in(&svg_paint_resources) {
        display_list_resources.image_frames.entry(frame.id()).or_insert(frame);
    }
    let resolved = resolve_vector_images(&mut output, &vector_image_render_requests);
    let resolved_ids: Vec<u64> = resolved.iter().map(|vector_image| vector_image.id()).collect();
    for vector_image in resolved {
        display_list_resources
            .vector_images
            .insert(vector_image.id(), vector_image);
    }
    // What the recording copied from the one it read paint commands from draws what that one drew.
    if let Some(source) = recorder.published_recording.as_deref() {
        display_list_resources.complete_from(&summary_of(&output.display_list), &source.resources);
    }
    output.resources = display_list_resources;
    // Only a recording that publishes becomes the one the next recording copies from, so only it keeps the SVG images
    // it carried over from the one published last.
    let published = recorder.published_recording.as_deref().filter(|_| publishes_recording);
    output.vector_image_ids_by_request =
        drawn_vector_image_ids(&output, &vector_image_render_requests, &resolved_ids, published);
    output.is_identical_to_published_recording = recorder.published_recording.as_ref().is_some_and(|source| {
        Arc::ptr_eq(&output.display_list, &source.display_list)
            && output.hit_test_items_stamp == source.hit_test_items_stamp
            && output.recorded_structural_epoch == source.recorded_structural_epoch
            && output.wheel_event_listener_state_generation == source.wheel_event_listener_state_generation
            && output.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners == source.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners
    });
    // A recording that repeats the one published last publishes its display list again, under its id.
    output.display_list_id = match recorder.published_recording.as_deref() {
        Some(source) if output.is_identical_to_published_recording => source.display_list_id,
        _ => crate::painting::display_list::ids::allocate_display_list_id(),
    };
    output
}

/// What the hit-test items of the frame a document presented last are as of. Hit testing walks the rows, which place
/// other items once their hit-test items stamp or the visual context tree changes, and the host tells by a generation
/// whether the frame it hit tests is still the one on screen.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct HitTestItemsOnScreen {
    /// The rows' hit-test items stamp and the tree's structural epoch of the frame, while one stands.
    as_of: Option<(u64, u64)>,
    generation: u64,
}

impl HitTestItemsOnScreen {
    /// Takes in the frame `output` presented: the generation moves on where it places other items than the frame
    /// before it.
    pub(crate) fn take_in(&mut self, output: &RecordingOutput) {
        let as_of = Some((output.hit_test_items_stamp, output.recorded_structural_epoch));
        if self.as_of != as_of {
            self.as_of = as_of;
            self.generation += 1;
        }
    }

    /// Forgets the frame on screen, whose boxes may be gone.
    pub(crate) fn forget(&mut self) {
        self.as_of = None;
    }

    /// The generation of the frame on screen, or zero where none stands.
    pub(crate) fn generation(&self) -> u64 {
        match self.as_of {
            Some(_) => self.generation,
            None => 0,
        }
    }
}

/// Takes the output of a recording that presented itself in: what hit testing reads of the frame on screen, and for a
/// recording that publishes, the source the next recording reuses from. Resource callbacks and verification have
/// finished, so the new recording may become the source.
pub(crate) fn take_in_presented_output(
    recorder: &mut RecorderState,
    hit_test_items_on_screen: &mut HitTestItemsOnScreen,
    output: Arc<RecordingOutput>,
    publishes_recording: bool,
    take_in: impl FnOnce(Arc<RecordingOutput>),
) {
    hit_test_items_on_screen.take_in(&output);
    if publishes_recording {
        recorder.published_recording = Some(Arc::clone(&output));
    }
    take_in(output);
}

/// Takes the recording `output` the host published in as the document's last, where `arena` is the document's arena.
pub(crate) fn take_in_recording(arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena, output: Arc<RecordingOutput>, publishes_recording: bool) {
    let paint_state = arena.paint_state_mut();
    if publishes_recording {
        paint_state.visual_context.quarantined_slots_are_releasable = true;
        paint_state.window_of_published_recording = output.window.clone().zip(output.visual_context_tree.clone());
    }
    paint_state.last_recording = Some(output);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::painting::record::change_ticks::RowPaintChange;
    use std::sync::Arc;

    #[test]
    fn read_only_publication_keeps_the_source_recording_whose_generation_later_changes_are_newer_than() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let mut recorder = RecorderState::default();
        let mut hit_test_items_on_screen = HitTestItemsOnScreen::default();
        let row = arena.allocate_for_test().slot;
        arena.populate_paintable_row(row);
        let mut original_source = None;
        // Publish a source, a read-only recording, and then the frame after the change.
        for (structural_epoch, read_write) in [(1, true), (2, false), (3, true)] {
            // Each recording is of another tree, so that it places other hit-test items.
            let output = RecordingOutput {
                recorded_structural_epoch: structural_epoch,
                recorded_as_of: arena.take_paint_generation(),
                ..Default::default()
            };
            take_in_presented_output(
                &mut recorder,
                &mut hit_test_items_on_screen,
                Arc::new(output),
                read_write,
                |output| take_in_recording(&mut arena, output, read_write),
            );
            assert_eq!(hit_test_items_on_screen.generation(), structural_epoch);
            let source = recorder.published_recording.clone().unwrap();
            let changed_since_source = arena
                .paint_change_stamps(row)
                .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(source.recorded_as_of);
            match structural_epoch {
                1 => {
                    original_source = Some(source);
                    arena.note_paint_change(row, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
                }
                2 => {
                    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(original_source.as_ref().unwrap(), &source));
                    assert!(changed_since_source);
                }
                3 => {
                    assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(original_source.as_ref().unwrap(), &source));
                    assert!(!changed_since_source);
                }
                _ => unreachable!(),
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_a_take_in_that_publishes_releases_what_it_replaced() {
        let mut arena = LayoutNodeArena::new();
        let take_in = |arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena, publishes_recording| {
            take_in_recording(arena, Arc::new(RecordingOutput::default()), publishes_recording);
        };
        take_in(&mut arena, true);
        assert!(arena.paint_state().visual_context.quarantined_slots_are_releasable);
        arena.paint_state_mut().visual_context.quarantined_slots_are_releasable = false;
        take_in(&mut arena, false);
        assert!(!arena.paint_state().visual_context.quarantined_slots_are_releasable);
        assert!(arena.paint_state().last_recording.is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_frame_of_the_same_hit_test_items_keeps_the_generation_of_the_frame_on_screen() {
        let mut hit_test_items_on_screen = HitTestItemsOnScreen::default();
        assert_eq!(hit_test_items_on_screen.generation(), 0);
        let frame = |hit_test_items_stamp, recorded_structural_epoch| RecordingOutput {
            hit_test_items_stamp,
            recorded_structural_epoch,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        // Frames of rows that place the same items in one tree keep the generation, and another stamp or another
        // tree moves it on.
        for (stamp, structural_epoch, expected_generation) in [(4, 7, 1), (4, 7, 1), (5, 7, 2), (5, 8, 3)] {
            hit_test_items_on_screen.take_in(&frame(stamp, structural_epoch));
            assert_eq!(hit_test_items_on_screen.generation(), expected_generation);
        }
        // A frame behind the rows leaves none, and the same frame after it is another.
        hit_test_items_on_screen.forget();
        assert_eq!(hit_test_items_on_screen.generation(), 0);
        hit_test_items_on_screen.take_in(&frame(5, 8));
        assert_eq!(hit_test_items_on_screen.generation(), 4);
    }
}

/*

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::record::RecordingOutput;
use crate::painting::record::inputs::RecordingInputs;
use crate::painting::record::scratch::RecordingScratch;
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

/// Counts the recordings of a document's host that published. A fork of the recorder state copies from the
/// recording that was published when it forked, and tells by the count when the host has published another since.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct PublishedRecordingCount {
    shared: Arc<AtomicU64>,
    as_of_fork: Option<u64>,
}

impl PublishedRecordingCount {
    fn fork(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
            shared: Arc::clone(&self.shared),
            as_of_fork: Some(self.shared.load(Ordering::Acquire)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_of_a_fork(&self) -> bool {
        self.as_of_fork.is_some()
    }

    /// Whether the host published no recording since this fork was made. The host's own count is always current.
    pub(crate) fn is_current(&self) -> bool {
        self.as_of_fork
            .is_none_or(|count| count == self.shared.load(Ordering::Acquire))
    }

    /// Answers whether a recording that asks to publish does: only the host's recordings publish. Counts it where
    /// it does.
    pub(crate) fn note_recording(&self, asks_to_publish: bool) -> bool {
        let publishes = asks_to_publish && !self.is_of_a_fork();
        if publishes {
            self.shared.fetch_add(1, Ordering::AcqRel);
        }
        publishes
    }
}

/// What the display list recording keeps from one recording of a document to the next. Only the
/// recording and its publication write it, and nothing the document publishes for the paint side
/// is in it, so it moves with the recording rather than being shared with what it reads.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct RecorderState {
    /// The last recording that published, which the next one reuses clean output from.
    pub(crate) published_recording: Option<Arc<RecordingOutput>>,
    pub(crate) published_recording_count: PublishedRecordingCount,
    /// The recording's workspace, whose tables one recording leaves for the next to reuse.
    pub(crate) scratch: RecordingScratch,
    /// The absolute rects the recordings computed, which stay valid while the document's geometry
    /// does.
    pub(crate) absolute_rects: RefCell<AbsoluteRectMemo>,
    /// The inputs the last recording that publishes recorded with, which a clock lane's ticks record again with.
    pub(crate) published_inputs: Option<RecordingInputs>,
}

impl RecorderState {
    /// A fork of the recorder state, for a fork of the document's render state to record with: it copies clean output
    /// from the same recording, and keeps no scratch or memo of its own.
    pub(crate) fn fork(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
            published_recording: self.published_recording.clone(),
            published_recording_count: self.published_recording_count.fork(),
            scratch: Default::default(),
            absolute_rects: Default::default(),
            published_inputs: self.published_inputs.clone(),
        }
    }
}

const ABSOLUTE_RECTS_PER_PAGE: usize = 64;

type MemoizedAbsoluteRect = Option<(NodeSlotId, u64, CssPixelRect)>;

/// Each row's absolute rect, with the geometry epoch of the frame it was computed from, in pages of rows made as a rect
/// in them is memoized: a memo of a few rows costs their pages, wherever the rows are in the arena.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct AbsoluteRectMemo {
    pages: Vec<Option<Box<[MemoizedAbsoluteRect; ABSOLUTE_RECTS_PER_PAGE]>>>,
}

impl AbsoluteRectMemo {
    pub(crate) fn get(&self, id: NodeSlotId, epoch: u64) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
        let index = id.slot_index() as usize;
        let page = self.pages.get(index / ABSOLUTE_RECTS_PER_PAGE)?.as_deref()?;
        let (memoized_id, memoized_epoch, rect) = page[index % ABSOLUTE_RECTS_PER_PAGE]?;
        (memoized_id == id && memoized_epoch == epoch).then_some(rect)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set(&mut self, id: NodeSlotId, epoch: u64, rect: CssPixelRect) {
        let index = id.slot_index() as usize;
        let page_index = index / ABSOLUTE_RECTS_PER_PAGE;
        if self.pages.len() <= page_index {
            self.pages.resize_with(page_index + 1, || None);
        }
        let page = self.pages[page_index].get_or_insert_with(|| Box::new([None; ABSOLUTE_RECTS_PER_PAGE]));
        page[index % ABSOLUTE_RECTS_PER_PAGE] = Some((id, epoch, rect));
    }
}

const _: () = {
    const fn assert_send<T: Send>() {}
    assert_send::<RecorderState>();
};

impl RecorderState {
    /// Forgets the published recording: the next recording copies nothing and records from scratch.
    pub(crate) fn forget_published_recording(&mut self) {
        self.published_recording = None;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn a_fork_copies_from_its_recording_until_the_host_publishes_another() {
        let host = RecorderState::default();
        assert!(host.published_recording_count.note_recording(true));
        let fork = host.fork();
        assert!(fork.published_recording_count.is_of_a_fork());
        assert!(!host.published_recording_count.is_of_a_fork());

        // A recording of the host that publishes nothing leaves the fork's recording the published one.
        assert!(!host.published_recording_count.note_recording(false));
        assert!(fork.published_recording_count.is_current());

        // The fork never publishes, whatever its recording asks.
        assert!(!fork.published_recording_count.note_recording(true));
        assert!(fork.published_recording_count.is_current());

        assert!(host.published_recording_count.note_recording(true));
        assert!(!fork.published_recording_count.is_current());
        assert!(host.published_recording_count.is_current());
    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;

use crate::painting::display_list::commands::{DisplayListResourceId, ImageFrameResourceId};
use crate::painting::record::vector_images::{VECTOR_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_TAG, VectorImageRenderRequest};
use libgfx_rust::font::{FontHandle, FontId};
use libgfx_rust::image_frame::ImageFrameHandle;

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct RecordingResourceManifest {
    pub(crate) fonts: HashMap<FontId, FontHandle>,
    pub(crate) image_frames: HashMap<u64, ImageFrameHandle>,
    pub(crate) vector_image_render_requests: Vec<VectorImageRenderRequest>,
    vector_image_request_indices: HashMap<VectorImageRenderRequest, u32>,
}

impl RecordingResourceManifest {
    pub(crate) fn note_font(&mut self, font: &FontHandle) -> u64 {
        self.fonts.entry(font.id()).or_insert_with(|| font.clone());
        font.id().0
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_image_frame(&mut self, frame: &ImageFrameHandle) -> ImageFrameResourceId {
        self.image_frames.entry(frame.id()).or_insert_with(|| frame.clone());
        ImageFrameResourceId(frame.id())
    }

    pub(crate) fn vector_image_placeholder(&mut self, request: VectorImageRenderRequest) -> DisplayListResourceId {
        let next_index = self.vector_image_render_requests.len() as u32;
        let index = *self.vector_image_request_indices.entry(request).or_insert_with(|| {
            self.vector_image_render_requests.push(request);
            next_index
        });
        DisplayListResourceId(VECTOR_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_TAG | u64::from(index))
    }
}

use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::SpatialNodeIndex;
use crate::painting::record::hit_test_items::HitTestFacts;
use crate::painting::record::paint::inline_box::{InlineStrip, InlineStripKind};
use crate::painting::record::paint::text::SelectionStyleAnswer;
use crate::painting::record::{BasePaintFacts, PatternTileKey};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct StampedEntry<T> {
    recording_stamp: u32,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
    value: T,
}

impl<T: Default> Default for StampedEntry<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            recording_stamp: 0,
            paintable: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            value: T::default(),
        }
    }
}

/// Reusable workspace borrowed exclusively by one recording at a time. Its values are
/// temporary derived facts, never persistent paint-cache entries or recording output.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct RecordingScratch {
    recording_stamp: u32,
    base_paint_facts: Vec<StampedEntry<BasePaintFacts>>,
    hit_test_facts: Vec<StampedEntry<HitTestFacts>>,
    /// The records of each pattern tile, and whether they draw a placeholder for an SVG image.
    pub(super) pattern_tile_records: HashMap<PatternTileKey, (Arc<Vec<u8>>, bool)>,
    pub(super) selection_style_cache: HashMap<u32, Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>>,
    pub(super) search_text_style_cache: HashMap<u32, Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>>,
    pub(super) search_text_current_style_cache: HashMap<u32, Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>>,
    pub(super) spelling_error_style_cache: HashMap<u32, Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>>,
    pub(super) custom_highlight_style_cache:
        HashMap<(u32, crate::css::style::index::StyleAtomID), Option<Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>>>,
    pub(super) wheel_hit_test_target_cache: HashMap<NodeSlotId, SpatialNodeIndex>,
    /// The strip each inline box sliced across lines draws its background images or its box shadow over, measured
    /// once for all of its pieces.
    pub(crate) inline_strips: HashMap<(NodeSlotId, InlineStripKind), Option<Arc<InlineStrip>>>,
}

fn entry_if_stamped_for_current_recording<T: Copy>(
    table: &[StampedEntry<T>],
    recording_stamp: u32,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<T> {
    let entry = table.get(paintable.slot_index() as usize)?;
    (entry.recording_stamp == recording_stamp && entry.paintable == paintable).then_some(entry.value)
}

fn stamp_entry_for_current_recording<T>(
    table: &mut [StampedEntry<T>],
    recording_stamp: u32,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
    value: T,
) {
    if let Some(entry) = table.get_mut(paintable.slot_index() as usize) {
        *entry = StampedEntry {
            recording_stamp,
            paintable,
            value,
        };
    }
}

macro_rules! memo_table {
    ($get:ident, $set:ident, $table:ident, $type:ty) => {
        pub(crate) fn $get(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> Option<$type> {
            entry_if_stamped_for_current_recording(&self.$table, self.recording_stamp, paintable)
        }

        pub(crate) fn $set(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, value: $type) {
            stamp_entry_for_current_recording(&mut self.$table, self.recording_stamp, paintable, value)
        }
    };
}

impl RecordingScratch {
    pub(crate) fn begin_recording(&mut self, row_count: usize) {
        self.recording_stamp = match self.recording_stamp.checked_add(1) {
            Some(recording_stamp) => recording_stamp,
            None => {
                self.base_paint_facts.clear();
                self.hit_test_facts.clear();
                1
            }
        };
        if self.base_paint_facts.len() < row_count {
            self.base_paint_facts.resize(row_count, StampedEntry::default());
            self.hit_test_facts.resize(row_count, StampedEntry::default());
        }
        self.clear_temporary_caches();
    }

    // Retain the allocations, but release temporary records and styles before publication.
    pub(super) fn clear_temporary_caches(&mut self) {
        self.pattern_tile_records.clear();
        self.selection_style_cache.clear();
        self.search_text_style_cache.clear();
        self.search_text_current_style_cache.clear();
        self.spelling_error_style_cache.clear();
        self.custom_highlight_style_cache.clear();
        self.wheel_hit_test_target_cache.clear();
        self.inline_strips.clear();
    }

    memo_table!(base_paint_facts, set_base_paint_facts, base_paint_facts, BasePaintFacts);
    memo_table!(hit_test_facts, set_hit_test_facts, hit_test_facts, HitTestFacts);
}

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect;
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::painting::display_list::builder::PendingInlineClip;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::ContextRef;
use crate::painting::display_list::recorder::{IsolatedGroupEffects, OpenRecorderGroup};
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead};
use crate::painting::record::order_tree::ProducerKind;
use crate::painting::record::trace::{Action, Observer, Operation};
use crate::painting::record::{PaintPhase, PaintRecorder};
use crate::painting::visual_context::build::{
    BoxFacts, compute_svg_viewport_transform_data, svg_viewport_transform_of,
};
use crate::painting::visual_context::node_values::border_radii_data;
use crate::painting::visual_context::{ClipData, EffectNodeData, EffectNodeIndex, MaskData, MaskLayerOrigin};
use libgfx_rust::path::Path;
use libgfx_rust::{AffineTransform, CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatPoint, FloatRect, MaskKind, multiply_affine};
use smallvec::SmallVec;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum MaskLayerSet {
    CssAndSvg,
    SvgOnly,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct SvgResourceWalk {
    pub enclosing_context: ContextRef,
    pub draws_clip_path_geometry: bool,
    // The rect of the walk's recorded space that whatever consumes the resource clips it to: the mask
    // region or the pattern tile. Clipping the resource's groups to it bounds their ink, filters
    // included, without changing what they draw.
    pub consumer_clip_rect: FloatRect,
}

fn affine_of_matrix(matrix: libgfx_rust::FloatMatrix4x4) -> AffineTransform {
    matrix.extract_2d_affine()
}

fn transformed_rect_clip(transform: AffineTransform, rect: FloatRect, clip: &ClipData) -> PendingInlineClip {
    if transform.b() == 0.0 && transform.c() == 0.0 {
        let mapped = transform.map_rect(rect);
        let mut corner_radii = clip.corner_radii;
        let scale_x = transform.a().abs();
        let scale_y = transform.d().abs();
        let mut has_corner_radii = false;
        for corner in [
            &mut corner_radii.top_left,
            &mut corner_radii.top_right,
            &mut corner_radii.bottom_right,
            &mut corner_radii.bottom_left,
        ] {
            corner.horizontal_radius = (corner.horizontal_radius as f32 * scale_x).round() as i32;
            corner.vertical_radius = (corner.vertical_radius as f32 * scale_y).round() as i32;
            has_corner_radii |= corner.horizontal_radius != 0 || corner.vertical_radius != 0;
        }
        if !has_corner_radii {
            return PendingInlineClip::intersecting_float_rect(mapped);
        }
        return PendingInlineClip::intersecting_rounded_rect(mapped, corner_radii);
    }
    PendingInlineClip::intersecting_path(
        &transformed_rect_path(transform, rect),
        libgfx_rust::WindingRule::Nonzero,
    )
}

fn transformed_rect_path(transform: AffineTransform, rect: FloatRect) -> Path {
    let corners = [
        FloatPoint { x: rect.x, y: rect.y },
        FloatPoint {
            x: rect.x + rect.width,
            y: rect.y,
        },
        FloatPoint {
            x: rect.x + rect.width,
            y: rect.y + rect.height,
        },
        FloatPoint {
            x: rect.x,
            y: rect.y + rect.height,
        },
    ]
    .map(|corner| transform.map_point(corner));
    let mut path = Path::new();
    path.move_to(corners[0]);
    for corner in &corners[1..] {
        path.line_to(*corner);
    }
    path.close();
    path
}

fn transformed_int_rect_clip(transform: AffineTransform, rect: libgfx_rust::IntRect) -> PendingInlineClip {
    let rect = rect.to_float();
    if transform.b() == 0.0 && transform.c() == 0.0 {
        return PendingInlineClip::intersecting_float_rect(transform.map_rect(rect));
    }
    PendingInlineClip::intersecting_path(
        &transformed_rect_path(transform, rect),
        libgfx_rust::WindingRule::Nonzero,
    )
}

impl<O: Observer> PaintRecorder<'_, O> {
    /// The masks the visual context update gave `paintable` that are in `set`, each with the effect node that
    /// composites its content, outermost first.
    fn mask_effects_of(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId, set: MaskLayerSet) -> SmallVec<[(EffectNodeIndex, MaskData); 3]> {
        let Some(tree) = self.paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_deref() else {
            return SmallVec::new();
        };
        self.source
            .with_paintable_visual_context_node_handles(paintable, |handles| {
                handles
                    .effects
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|effect| match &tree.effect_nodes[effect.0 as usize].data {
                        EffectNodeData::Mask(mask)
                            if set == MaskLayerSet::CssAndSvg || mask.origin != MaskLayerOrigin::CssMaskLayers =>
                        {
                            Some((*effect, *mask))
                        }
                        _ => None,
                    })
                    .collect()
            })
    }

    /// Declares the content of the masks of `paintable` that are in `set`. Returns whether an SVG mask or clip path
    /// that covers no area leaves nothing of an SVG box, whose masks then declare no content.
    pub(crate) fn declare_mask_contents(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, set: MaskLayerSet) -> bool {
        let masks = self.mask_effects_of(paintable, set);
        if set == MaskLayerSet::SvgOnly && masks.iter().any(|(_, mask)| mask.rect.is_empty()) {
            return true;
        }
        for (effect, mask) in masks {
            let group = self.recorder.begin_mask_content();
            match mask.origin {
                MaskLayerOrigin::CssMaskLayers => {
                    let area = crate::painting::paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(self.source, paintable);
                    self.trace_paint(Operation::Named(Some(paintable), "css-mask"), |this| {
                        this.paint_css_mask_layers(paintable, area);
                    });
                }
                MaskLayerOrigin::SvgMask | MaskLayerOrigin::SvgClip => {
                    self.record_referenced_svg_mask_or_clip_content(
                        paintable,
                        mask.origin,
                        AffineTransform::identity(),
                        mask.rect.to_float(),
                    );
                }
            }
            self.recorder.finish_mask_content(group, effect, mask.rect);
        }
        false
    }

    // The referenced mask or clip path is laid out as a resource subtree below the element
    // referencing it, so a change inside it reaches the element as descendant damage.
    pub(crate) fn paints_svg_mask_or_clip_resource_subtree(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        self.first_child_paintable_of_kind(paintable, NodeKind::SVGMaskBox)
            .is_some()
            || self
                .first_child_paintable_of_kind(paintable, NodeKind::SVGClipBox)
                .is_some()
    }

    fn first_child_paintable_of_kind(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId, kind: NodeKind) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
        crate::painting::svg_masking::first_child_paintable_of_kind(self.source, paintable, kind)
    }

    fn record_referenced_svg_mask_or_clip_content(
        &mut self,
        target: NodeSlotId,
        origin: MaskLayerOrigin,
        target_to_enclosing_space: AffineTransform,
        consumer_clip_rect: FloatRect,
    ) {
        let (resource_kind, draws_clip_path_geometry, producer) = match origin {
            MaskLayerOrigin::SvgMask => (NodeKind::SVGMaskBox, false, "svg-mask"),
            MaskLayerOrigin::SvgClip => (NodeKind::SVGClipBox, true, "svg-clip"),
            MaskLayerOrigin::CssMaskLayers => unreachable!("CSS mask layers are painted, not walked"),
        };
        let Some(resource_box) = self.first_child_paintable_of_kind(target, resource_kind) else {
            return;
        };
        let content_units_object_bbox =
            crate::painting::paintable_geometry::committed_svg_resource_content_units_are_object_bounding_box(
                self.source,
                resource_box,
            );
        let mut content_units_transform_in_recorded_space = if content_units_object_bbox {
            crate::painting::svg_masking::object_bounding_box_content_units_transform(self.source, resource_box)
        } else {
            AffineTransform::identity()
        };
        let device_scale = self.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel as f32;
        content_units_transform_in_recorded_space.values[4] *= device_scale;
        content_units_transform_in_recorded_space.values[5] *= device_scale;
        let root_transform = multiply_affine(target_to_enclosing_space, content_units_transform_in_recorded_space);
        // A mask's output is coverage rather than color anyone sees, and a luminance mask's lightness is its alpha,
        // so force-dark stays out of it. Patterns keep it: they render as page content.
        let suspended_force_dark = self.recorder.suspend_force_dark();
        self.trace_paint(Operation::Named(Some(target), producer), |this| {
            this.walk_svg_resource(
                resource_box,
                root_transform,
                true,
                draws_clip_path_geometry,
                consumer_clip_rect,
            );
        });
        self.recorder.restore_force_dark(suspended_force_dark);
    }

    fn paint_css_mask_layers(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, area: CssPixelRect) {
        let layout_arena = self.source;
        let style = layout_arena
            .node_style_if_live(paintable)
            .expect("the mask recording target holds a live layout node");
        let is_root_element = crate::painting::style_queries::node_is_root_element(layout_arena, paintable);
        let resolved =
            crate::painting::record::paint::background_resolution::resolve_mask_layers(self, paintable, style, area);
        // A mask's output is coverage rather than color anyone sees, and a luminance mask's lightness is its alpha,
        // so force-dark stays out of it.
        let suspended_force_dark = self.recorder.suspend_force_dark();
        // FIXME: Respect `image-rendering` here.
        let inputs = crate::painting::record::paint::background_resolution::BackgroundPaintInputs {
            resolved,
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-backgrounds-3/#corner-clipping
            // Although border images are not affected by border-radius, other effects that clip painting or event
            // handling to the border, padding, or content edge must clip to their respective curves.
            border_radii: border_radii_data(style, layout_arena, paintable),
            image_rendering: crate::css::css_enums::image_rendering::AUTO,
            is_root_element,
            visible_device_rect: None,
        };
        crate::painting::record::paint::background::paint_resolved_background(self, paintable, &inputs);
        if crate::painting::style_queries::mask_border_has_image(style.mask()) {
            self.paint_mask_border(paintable, style);
        }
        self.recorder.restore_force_dark(suspended_force_dark);
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-masking-1/#masking-with-the-mask-border-image
    fn paint_mask_border(
        &mut self,
        paintable: NodeSlotId,
        style: crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'_>,
    ) {
        use crate::painting::record::paint::{border, border_image};
        // INTEROP: The spec masks the element by the mask layers and the mask border image one after the other, but
        //          engines that support a mask border paint it into the same mask as the mask layers, so content that
        //          either of them covers stays visible.
        // INTEROP: The spec has a mask border image that can't be displayed not mask the element, but engines that
        //          support a mask border mask the element by it as by an image that paints nothing, which also keeps
        //          an element whose mask border image is still loading from flashing unmasked.
        // INTEROP: The spec leaves the content under the middle part of a mask border image whose slice has no fill
        //          unmasked, but engines that support a mask border paint nothing there, like for a border image, so
        //          it masks that content out.
        // FIXME: Respect mask-border-mode: luminance.
        let border_widths = border::present_css_border_widths(
            style,
            crate::painting::paintable_geometry::committed_border(self.source, paintable),
            border::ALL_PIECE_EDGES,
        );
        let border_box_rect = crate::painting::paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(self.source, paintable);
        border_image::paint_nine_piece_image(
            self,
            paintable,
            style,
            border_image::mask_border_values(style),
            border_widths,
            border::ALL_PIECE_EDGES,
            border_box_rect,
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn walk_svg_resource(
        &mut self,
        root: NodeSlotId,
        root_transform: AffineTransform,
        include_root_element_transform: bool,
        draws_clip_path_geometry: bool,
        consumer_clip_rect: FloatRect,
    ) {
        let walk = SvgResourceWalk {
            enclosing_context: self.recorder.accumulated_visual_context(),
            draws_clip_path_geometry,
            consumer_clip_rect,
        };
        let enclosing_walk = self.svg_resource_walk.replace(walk);
        let enclosing_transform = self.recorder.set_ambient_inline_transform(Some(root_transform));
        self.record_box_phase_inside_resource(root, PaintPhase::Background);
        self.record_box_phase_inside_resource(root, PaintPhase::Border);
        self.paint_svg_box_inside_resource(root, root_transform, include_root_element_transform);
        self.recorder.set_ambient_inline_transform(enclosing_transform);
        self.svg_resource_walk = enclosing_walk;
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(walk.enclosing_context);
    }

    /// Records the document of an SVG image, whose viewport is `viewport`, as the content of an SVG resource is
    /// recorded: under no visual context, with the transforms, clips and effects of its boxes in the records.
    pub(crate) fn record_svg_image_document(&mut self, viewport: NodeSlotId) {
        let consumer_clip_rect = self.inputs.bitmap_rect.to_float();
        let walk = SvgResourceWalk {
            enclosing_context: self.recorder.accumulated_visual_context(),
            draws_clip_path_geometry: false,
            consumer_clip_rect,
        };
        // The viewport paints the background its root propagates to it.
        let enclosing_walk = self.svg_resource_walk.replace(walk);
        let enclosing_transform = self
            .recorder
            .set_ambient_inline_transform(Some(AffineTransform::identity()));
        self.record_box_phase_inside_resource(viewport, PaintPhase::Background);
        self.recorder.set_ambient_inline_transform(enclosing_transform);
        self.svg_resource_walk = enclosing_walk;
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(walk.enclosing_context);
        let mut child = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(self.source, viewport);
        while let Some(current) = child {
            child = crate::painting::paint_order::next_paint_sibling(self.source, current);
            self.walk_svg_resource(current, AffineTransform::identity(), true, false, consumer_clip_rect);
        }
    }

    fn paint_svg_box_inside_resource(
        &mut self,
        svg_box: NodeSlotId,
        parent_to_enclosing_space: AffineTransform,
        include_element_transform: bool,
    ) {
        self.trace_scope(Operation::Named(Some(svg_box), "svg"), Action::Record, |this| {
            this.paint_svg_box_inside_resource_impl(svg_box, parent_to_enclosing_space, include_element_transform);
        });
    }

    fn paint_svg_box_inside_resource_impl(
        &mut self,
        svg_box: NodeSlotId,
        parent_to_enclosing_space: AffineTransform,
        include_element_transform: bool,
    ) {
        let walk = self
            .svg_resource_walk
            .expect("resource content paints inside a resource walk");
        let (facts, svg_filter_bounds) =
            BoxFacts::gather_for_resource_content(self.source, svg_box, self.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
        if facts.is_hidden_by_empty_svg_mask_or_clip() {
            return;
        }
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(walk.enclosing_context);

        let effects_group = facts
            .effects_data()
            .map(|effects| (self.recorder.begin_isolated_group(), effects));

        let mut to_enclosing_space = parent_to_enclosing_space;
        if include_element_transform && let Some(transform) = facts.transform {
            to_enclosing_space = multiply_affine(
                to_enclosing_space,
                affine_of_matrix(transform.matrix_including_origin()),
            );
        }

        let mut mask_groups: Vec<(OpenRecorderGroup, MaskData, usize)> = Vec::new();
        for mask in facts
            .mask_layers
            .iter()
            .filter(|layer| layer.origin != MaskLayerOrigin::CssMaskLayers)
        {
            let clip_depth = self.recorder.ambient_inline_clip_depth();
            self.recorder
                .push_ambient_inline_clips(&[transformed_int_rect_clip(to_enclosing_space, mask.rect)]);
            mask_groups.push((self.recorder.begin_isolated_group(), *mask, clip_depth));
        }

        let enclosing_transform = self.recorder.set_ambient_inline_transform(Some(to_enclosing_space));
        self.paint_svg_box_own_content_inside_resource(svg_box, svg_filter_bounds);

        let clip_depth = self.recorder.ambient_inline_clip_depth();
        if facts.may_have_clip
            && let Some(clip) = facts.overflow_clip
        {
            self.recorder
                .push_ambient_inline_clips(&[transformed_rect_clip(to_enclosing_space, clip.rect, &clip)]);
        }
        let mut descendants_to_enclosing_space = to_enclosing_space;
        if let Some(svg_viewport_transform) = svg_viewport_transform_of(self.source, svg_box) {
            let viewport_transform_data = compute_svg_viewport_transform_data(
                self.source,
                svg_box,
                svg_viewport_transform,
                self.inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            );
            descendants_to_enclosing_space = multiply_affine(
                descendants_to_enclosing_space,
                affine_of_matrix(viewport_transform_data.matrix),
            );
        }
        self.recorder
            .set_ambient_inline_transform(Some(descendants_to_enclosing_space));
        let mut child = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(self.source, svg_box);
        let mut next_text_part = if matches!(
            self.source.node_kind_if_live(svg_box),
            Some(NodeKind::SVGTextBox | NodeKind::SVGTextPathBox)
        ) {
            crate::painting::record::paint::svg::text_parts_before_children(self, svg_box)
        } else {
            None
        };
        while let Some(current) = child {
            child = crate::painting::paint_order::next_paint_sibling(self.source, current);
            self.paint_svg_box_inside_resource(current, descendants_to_enclosing_space, true);
            if let Some(next_text_part) = &mut next_text_part {
                self.recorder.set_ambient_inline_transform(Some(to_enclosing_space));
                crate::painting::record::paint::svg::paint_text_after_child(self, svg_box, current, next_text_part);
                self.recorder
                    .set_ambient_inline_transform(Some(descendants_to_enclosing_space));
            }
        }
        if let Some(next_text_part) = next_text_part {
            self.recorder.set_ambient_inline_transform(Some(to_enclosing_space));
            crate::painting::record::paint::svg::paint_text_after_children(self, svg_box, next_text_part);
        }
        self.recorder.truncate_ambient_inline_clips(clip_depth);
        self.recorder.set_ambient_inline_transform(enclosing_transform);

        for (mut group, mask, clip_depth) in mask_groups.into_iter().rev() {
            self.recorder.begin_group_mask(&mut group);
            self.record_referenced_svg_mask_or_clip_content(
                svg_box,
                mask.origin,
                to_enclosing_space,
                walk.consumer_clip_rect,
            );
            self.recorder.finish_group_with_effects(
                group,
                IsolatedGroupEffects {
                    clip_rect: walk.consumer_clip_rect,
                    opacity: 1.0,
                    filter: None,
                    compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                    mask_kind: mask.kind,
                },
            );
            self.recorder.truncate_ambient_inline_clips(clip_depth);
        }
        if let Some((group, effects)) = effects_group {
            self.recorder.finish_group_with_effects(
                group,
                IsolatedGroupEffects {
                    clip_rect: walk.consumer_clip_rect,
                    opacity: effects.opacity,
                    filter: effects.filter,
                    compositing_and_blending_operator: effects.blend_mode,
                    mask_kind: MaskKind::Alpha,
                },
            );
        }
    }

    fn paint_svg_box_own_content_inside_resource(
        &mut self,
        svg_box: NodeSlotId,
        svg_filter_bounds: Option<crate::layout::used_values::FfiCssPixelRect>,
    ) {
        // For elements with SVG filters, emit a transparent FillRect to trigger filter application.
        // This ensures content-generating filters (feFlood, feImage) work even with empty source.
        if let Some(svg_filter_bounds) = svg_filter_bounds {
            let device_rect = self
                .converter
                .enclosing_device_rect(crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect::from(svg_filter_bounds));
            self.recorder.fill_rect_transparent(device_rect);
        }
        self.trace_paint(Operation::Producer(svg_box, ProducerKind::DrawForeground), |this| {
            crate::painting::record::paint::paint(this, svg_box, PaintPhase::Foreground);
        });
    }
}

/*

use super::order_tree::ProducerKind;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::paint_order_plan::{PaintScope, PaintScopeKind, StackingContextPaintPhase};
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::fmt::Write;
use std::rc::Rc;

/// What a traced recording did, in order.
#[derive(Default, Debug)]
pub struct CaptureLog {
    pub(crate) events: Vec<Event>,
    pub(crate) open_events: Vec<usize>,
}

// The normal recorder carries no observation state. Keeping the policy static also removes
// diagnostic argument construction and branches from its traversal and painter specializations.
pub trait Observer: Clone + Default {
    const ENABLED: bool;
    fn observe(&self, callback: impl FnOnce(&mut CaptureLog));
    fn finish(self) -> Option<CaptureLog>;
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct NoTrace;

impl Observer for NoTrace {
    const ENABLED: bool = false;
    #[inline(always)]
    fn observe(&self, _: impl FnOnce(&mut CaptureLog)) {}
    fn finish(self) -> Option<CaptureLog> {
        None
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct Trace(Rc<RefCell<CaptureLog>>);

impl Observer for Trace {
    const ENABLED: bool = true;
    fn observe(&self, callback: impl FnOnce(&mut CaptureLog)) {
        callback(&mut self.0.borrow_mut());
    }
    fn finish(self) -> Option<CaptureLog> {
        Some(
            Rc::try_unwrap(self.0)
                .expect("nested recording kept its trace alive")
                .into_inner(),
        )
    }
}

/// What a recording did with a scope or producer. A scope is assembled when its published child
/// list is walked, replanned when its plan is rebuilt, recorded when it has no published
/// counterpart and copied when it is clean. A producer is recorded, copied, or skipped when its
/// phase is masked off; an inactive stacking context is skipped as a whole. Either is left out when it lies outside
/// the window of the recording.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Action {
    Assemble,
    Replan,
    Record,
    Copy,
    Skip,
    LeaveOut,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) enum Operation {
    Scope(PaintScope),
    Producer(NodeSlotId, ProducerKind),
    // Content recorded inside a producer, or outside the tree: the canvas and inspector overlays.
    Named(Option<NodeSlotId>, &'static str),
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct Event {
    pub parent: Option<usize>,
    pub operation: Operation,
    pub action: Action,
    pub empty: bool,
}

impl<O: Observer> super::PaintRecorder<'_, O> {
    pub(crate) fn trace_scope<R>(
        &mut self,
        operation: Operation,
        action: Action,
        body: impl FnOnce(&mut Self) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        self.observer.observe(|log| log.begin(operation, action));
        let result = body(self);
        self.observer.observe(|log| log.end(false));
        result
    }

    pub(crate) fn trace_paint(&mut self, operation: Operation, body: impl FnOnce(&mut Self)) {
        self.observer.observe(|log| log.begin(operation, Action::Record));
        let before = if O::ENABLED { self.recorder.byte_size() } else { 0 };
        let outside_the_boxes = match operation {
            Operation::Named(None, name) => Some(name),
            _ => None,
        };
        if let Some(name) = outside_the_boxes {
            self.recorder.begin_record_origin(NodeSlotId::INVALID, name);
        }
        body(self);
        if outside_the_boxes.is_some() {
            self.recorder.end_record_origin();
        }
        self.observer
            .observe(|log| log.end(self.recorder.byte_size() == before));
    }
}

impl CaptureLog {
    pub(crate) fn begin(&mut self, operation: Operation, action: Action) {
        let index = self.events.len();
        self.events.push(Event {
            parent: self.open_events.last().copied(),
            operation,
            action,
            empty: false,
        });
        self.open_events.push(index);
    }

    pub(crate) fn end(&mut self, empty: bool) {
        let index = self.open_events.pop().expect("unbalanced recording trace");
        self.events[index].empty = empty;
    }

    pub(crate) fn leaf(&mut self, operation: Operation, action: Action, empty: bool) {
        self.begin(operation, action);
        self.end(empty);
    }

    pub(crate) fn format(&self, mut name: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId) -> String) -> String {
        assert!(self.open_events.is_empty(), "incomplete recording trace");
        let mut output = String::new();
        let mut depths = Vec::with_capacity(self.events.len());
        for event in &self.events {
            let depth = event.parent.map_or(0, |parent| depths[parent] + 1);
            depths.push(depth);
            let label = match event.operation {
                Operation::Scope(scope) => match scope.kind {
                    PaintScopeKind::PaintedAsStackingContext => name(scope.owner),
                    PaintScopeKind::Descendants(phase) => {
                        format!("{}/descendants({})", name(scope.owner), phase_name(phase))
                    }
                },
                Operation::Producer(owner, kind) => format!("{}/{}", name(owner), producer_name(kind)),
                Operation::Named(owner, label) => {
                    owner.map_or_else(|| format!("@{label}"), |owner| format!("{}/{label}", name(owner)))
                }
            };
            let action = match event.action {
                Action::Assemble => "ASSEMBLE",
                Action::Replan => "REPLAN",
                Action::Record => "RECORD",
                Action::Copy => "COPY",
                Action::Skip => "SKIP",
                Action::LeaveOut => "OUTSIDE",
            };
            let empty = if event.empty && event.action == Action::Record {
                " (empty)"
            } else {
                ""
            };
            writeln!(output, "{}{label} {action}{empty}", "  ".repeat(depth)).unwrap();
        }
        output
    }
}

pub(crate) fn producer_name(kind: ProducerKind) -> &'static str {
    match kind {
        ProducerKind::DrawBackground => "background",
        ProducerKind::DrawBorder => "border",
        ProducerKind::DrawTableCollapsedBorder => "table-collapsed-border",
        ProducerKind::DrawForeground => "foreground",
        ProducerKind::DrawOutline => "outline",
        ProducerKind::DrawOverlay => "overlay",
        ProducerKind::ScrollMetadata => "scroll-metadata",
        ProducerKind::ScopePreamble => "preamble",
        ProducerKind::Svg => "svg",
        ProducerKind::InlinePiece(_) => "inline-piece",
        ProducerKind::TextFragment(_) => "text-fragment",
    }
}

pub(crate) fn paint_phase_name(phase: super::PaintPhase) -> &'static str {
    use super::PaintPhase::*;
    match phase {
        Background => "background",
        Border => "border",
        TableCollapsedBorder => "table-collapsed-border",
        Foreground => "foreground",
        Outline => "outline",
        Overlay => "overlay",
    }
}

fn phase_name(phase: StackingContextPaintPhase) -> &'static str {
    use StackingContextPaintPhase::*;
    match phase {
        BackgroundAndBorders => "background-and-borders",
        Floats => "floats",
        BackgroundAndBordersForInlineLevelAndReplaced => "inline-background-and-borders",
        Foreground => "foreground",
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn disabled_observation_has_no_state_and_does_not_evaluate_the_callback() {
        assert_eq!(std::mem::size_of::<NoTrace>(), 0);
        NoTrace.observe(|_| panic!("disabled observation ran"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn nested_work_is_indented_and_only_recording_reports_emptiness() {
        let mut log = CaptureLog::default();
        let owner = NodeSlotId::new(0, 1);
        log.begin(Operation::Scope(PaintScope::stacking_context(owner)), Action::Assemble);
        log.leaf(
            Operation::Producer(owner, ProducerKind::DrawBackground),
            Action::Copy,
            true,
        );
        log.leaf(
            Operation::Producer(owner, ProducerKind::DrawForeground),
            Action::Record,
            true,
        );
        log.leaf(
            Operation::Producer(owner, ProducerKind::DrawOutline),
            Action::Skip,
            true,
        );
        log.end(false);
        let text = log.format(|_| "box".to_string());
        assert_eq!(
            text,
            "box ASSEMBLE\n  box/background COPY\n  box/foreground RECORD (empty)\n  box/outline SKIP\n"
        );
    }
}
