use crate::painting::record::trace::Observer;

use super::{PaintPhase, PaintRecorder};
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::display_list::builder::RecordedDisplayList;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::ContextRef;
use crate::painting::display_list::device_pixels::DevicePixelConverter;
use crate::painting::display_list::recorder::{DisplayListRecorder, RecordNotes};
use crate::painting::node_painting;
use crate::painting::paint_order_plan::PaintScope;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintSource};
use crate::painting::record::RecordingInputs;
use crate::painting::record::assemble::{Assembler, AssemblyHost, Coverage, frame_is_unchanged};
use crate::painting::record::frame_inputs::FrameInputs;
use crate::painting::record::order_tree::{ProducerKind, RecordedChunk};
use crate::painting::record::paint::background_resolution::root_background_canvas_rect;
use crate::painting::record::resources::RecordingResourceManifest;
use crate::painting::record::scratch::RecordingScratch;
use crate::painting::record::svg_resources::MaskLayerSet;
use crate::painting::record::trace::{Action, Operation};
use crate::painting::record::window::{RecordedWindow, WindowSpaces};
use crate::painting::record::{RecordingOutput, RecordingResult};
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::window::spaces_place_alike;
use std::sync::Arc;

pub(crate) fn record_display_list(
    source: &PaintSource<'_>,
    scratch: &mut RecordingScratch,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    inputs: &RecordingInputs,
    source_recording: Option<Arc<RecordingOutput>>,
    window: Option<Arc<RecordedWindow>>,
    trace: bool,
) -> RecordingResult {
    scratch.begin_recording(source.frame().paintable_row_capacity());
    macro_rules! record {
        ($observer:ty) => {
            record_display_list_impl::<$observer>(source, scratch, viewport, inputs, source_recording, window)
        };
    }
    let result = if trace {
        record!(super::trace::Trace)
    } else {
        record!(super::trace::NoTrace)
    };
    scratch.clear_temporary_caches();
    result
}

/// The tape of a display list of `chunks`, each as its recording or the publication of that recording left it.
fn tape_of(chunks: &[Arc<RecordedChunk>]) -> Arc<RecordedDisplayList> {
    Arc::new(RecordedDisplayList::of_chunks(
        chunks.iter().map(|chunk| &**chunk.latest()),
    ))
}

fn record_display_list_impl<O: Observer>(
    source: &PaintSource<'_>,
    scratch: &mut RecordingScratch,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    inputs: &RecordingInputs,
    source_recording: Option<Arc<RecordingOutput>>,
    window: Option<Arc<RecordedWindow>>,
) -> RecordingResult {
    let paint_state = source.frame().paint_state();
    let structural_epoch = paint_state.structural_epoch();
    let frame_inputs = FrameInputs::from_recording_inputs(inputs, paint_state);
    let root_background_canvas_rect = root_background_canvas_rect(
        source,
        inputs.uncaptured.root_background_source.root_layout_node,
        inputs.css_viewport_rect,
    );
    // The published recording is reused from while every input its producers read is unchanged and
    // nothing asked for everything to paint anew since; otherwise this frame records from scratch.
    let source_is_usable = source_recording.as_ref().is_some_and(|published| {
        published.frame_inputs == frame_inputs && !source.frame().everything_paints_anew_since(published.recorded_as_of)
    });
    let source_recording = source_recording.filter(|_| source_is_usable);
    let window_focus_changed = source_recording
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(|frame| frame.window_is_focused != inputs.window_is_focused);
    // Only output that read an accumulated scale depends on one, so only a published recording that holds such
    // output is asked which scales it read.
    let accumulated_scales_changed = source_recording
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|frame| frame.accumulated_scales)
        .is_some_and(|published_scales| accumulated_scales_of(paint_state) != Some(published_scales));
    let force_dark_settings = inputs.force_dark_enabled.then_some(inputs.force_dark_settings);
    // A recording of a frame without a visual context tree holds all of it.
    let window = window.filter(|_| paint_state.visual_context_tree.is_some());
    // The published recording left out what this one leaves out where it was made for the same window and every space
    // places what it holds where it did then.
    let published_holds_what_this_holds = |window: &RecordedWindow, published: &RecordingOutput| {
        published
            .window
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|published_window| **published_window == *window)
            && published
                .visual_context_tree
                .as_deref()
                .zip(paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_deref())
                .is_some_and(|(published_tree, tree)| spaces_place_alike(published_tree, tree))
    };
    let coverage = match (&window, source_recording.as_deref()) {
        (None, _) => Coverage::WholeDocument,
        (Some(window), Some(published)) if published_holds_what_this_holds(window, published) => {
            Coverage::PublishedWindow
        }
        (Some(_), _) => Coverage::AnotherWindow,
    };
    let window_spaces = window
        .clone()
        .zip(paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_deref())
        .map(|(window, tree)| WindowSpaces::new(window, tree));
    let mut recorder = PaintRecorder {
        source,
        paint_state,
        inputs,
        recorder: DisplayListRecorder::new(force_dark_settings),
        converter: DevicePixelConverter::new(inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel),
        svg_resource_walk: None,
        viewport,
        ink_bounds_audit: super::ink_bounds::InkBoundsAudit::new(),
        source_recording,
        run_draws_vector_image_placeholders: false,
        live_producer: false,
        producer_reads_window_focus: std::cell::Cell::new(false),
        producer_reads_accumulated_scale: std::cell::Cell::new(false),
        line_root_positions: None,
        blocking_wheel_event_region_count: 0,
        records_per_box_wheel_hit_test_targets: frame_inputs.records_per_box_wheel_hit_test_targets(),
        observer: O::default(),
        scratch,
        resources: RecordingResourceManifest::default(),
        window_spaces,
        record_notes_of_chunks: Vec::new(),
    };
    if inputs.notes_record_origins {
        recorder.recorder.note_record_origins();
    }
    let root_group_color = recorder.record_canvas();
    let prologue = recorder.take_run_chunk();
    let prologue_id = prologue.as_ref().map(|chunk| chunk.recorded().id);
    let has_inspector_overlays = inputs.inspector_highlight.is_some()
        || inputs.grid_overlays.is_some()
        || !inputs.flex_overlays.is_empty()
        || inputs.caret_debug_rect.is_some();
    let root_scope = PaintScope::stacking_context(viewport);
    // The scopes the published recording walked, where it can be reused from.
    let published_root = recorder
        .source_recording
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|frame| frame.recorded_root.clone());
    // Nothing changed and nothing records every frame: the published chunks are this frame's, which lets the
    // compositor skip its update as well.
    let unchanged_frame = recorder
        .source_recording
        .as_ref()
        .zip(published_root.as_ref())
        .filter(|(frame, root)| {
            let anything_changed = source
                .paint_change_stamps(viewport)
                .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(frame.recorded_as_of);
            frame_is_unchanged(
                root,
                anything_changed,
                window_focus_changed,
                accumulated_scales_changed,
                coverage,
            ) && !has_inspector_overlays
                && frame.prologue_id == prologue_id
        })
        .map(|(frame, root)| {
            (
                Arc::clone(&frame.chunks),
                Arc::clone(&frame.display_list),
                Arc::clone(root),
            )
        });
    let reuses_from_published_recording = published_root.is_some() && unchanged_frame.is_none();
    let (chunks, display_list, recorded_root) = match unchanged_frame {
        Some((chunks, display_list, root)) => {
            recorder
                .observer
                .observe(|log| log.leaf(Operation::Scope(root_scope), Action::Copy, false));
            (chunks, display_list, Some(root))
        }
        None if inputs.records_without_visual_contexts => {
            recorder.trace_paint(Operation::Named(None, "svg-image-document"), |recorder| {
                recorder.record_svg_image_document(viewport);
            });
            let chunks: Arc<[Arc<RecordedChunk>]> = prologue.into_iter().chain(recorder.take_run_chunk()).collect();
            let display_list = tape_of(&chunks);
            (chunks, display_list, None)
        }
        None => {
            let recorded_root = Assembler::new(
                &mut recorder,
                window_focus_changed,
                accumulated_scales_changed,
                coverage,
            )
            .assemble_root(root_scope, published_root.as_ref());
            let mut chunks: Vec<Arc<RecordedChunk>> = prologue.into_iter().collect();
            recorded_root.for_each_chunk(&mut |chunk| chunks.push(Arc::clone(chunk)));
            if has_inspector_overlays {
                recorder.trace_paint(
                    Operation::Named(None, "inspector-overlays"),
                    crate::painting::record::paint::inspector_overlay::record_inspector_overlays,
                );
                chunks.extend(recorder.take_run_chunk());
            }
            let chunks: Arc<[Arc<RecordedChunk>]> = chunks.into();
            let display_list = tape_of(&chunks);
            (chunks, display_list, Some(recorded_root))
        }
    };
    recorder.ink_bounds_audit.report();
    let has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners = match &recorded_root {
        Some(root) => root.facts.blocking_wheel_event_regions > 0,
        None => recorder.blocking_wheel_event_region_count > 0,
    };
    let record_notes = recorder
        .recorder
        .notes_record_origins()
        .then(|| Arc::new(record_notes_of_tape(&chunks, &mut recorder.record_notes_of_chunks)));
    let accumulated_scales = recorded_root
        .as_ref()
        .filter(|root| root.facts.reads_accumulated_scale)
        .and_then(|_| accumulated_scales_of(paint_state));
    let output = RecordingOutput {
        recorded_structural_epoch: structural_epoch,
        recorded_as_of: source.frame().paint_generation(),
        visual_context_tree: paint_state.visual_context_tree.clone(),
        frame_inputs,
        root_background_canvas_rect,
        prologue_id,
        root_group_color,
        hit_test_items_stamp: source.hit_test_items_stamp(),
        chunks,
        display_list,
        recorded_root,
        window: window.clone(),
        has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners,
        wheel_event_listener_state_generation: inputs.wheel_event_listener_state_generation,
        is_identical_to_published_recording: false,
        window_is_focused: inputs.window_is_focused,
        accumulated_scales,
        capture_log: recorder.observer.finish(),
        vector_image_ids_by_request: Vec::new(),
        resources: Default::default(),
        display_list_id: 0,
        surface_clear_color: None,
        async_scrolling_metadata: None,
        record_notes,
    };
    let resources = recorder.resources;
    let mut record_from_scratch = |window: Option<Arc<RecordedWindow>>| {
        record_display_list_impl::<super::trace::NoTrace>(source, scratch, viewport, inputs, None, window).output
    };
    let verifies_reused_output = reuses_from_published_recording && reused_output_is_verified();
    let window_to_verify = window
        .clone()
        .filter(|_| reuses_from_published_recording && left_out_content_is_verified());
    let from_scratch =
        (verifies_reused_output || window_to_verify.is_some()).then(|| record_from_scratch(window.clone()));
    if verifies_reused_output && let Some(from_scratch) = &from_scratch {
        require_same_recording(&output, from_scratch);
    }
    if let Some(window) = window_to_verify
        && let Some(tree) = paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_deref()
    {
        let of_whole_document = record_from_scratch(None);
        require_only_what_misses_the_window_is_left_out(
            from_scratch.as_ref().unwrap_or(&output),
            &of_whole_document,
            &WindowSpaces::new(window, tree),
        );
    }
    RecordingResult { output, resources }
}

/// The notes of the chunks of a tape, by the offsets of their records in it. A chunk the recording copied has none.
fn record_notes_of_tape(
    chunks: &[Arc<RecordedChunk>],
    record_notes_of_chunks: &mut Vec<(Arc<RecordedChunk>, RecordNotes)>,
) -> RecordNotes {
    let mut notes = RecordNotes::default();
    let mut chunk_start = 0;
    for chunk in chunks {
        let chunk_size = chunk.latest().records.len();
        if chunk_size == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(index) = record_notes_of_chunks
            .iter()
            .position(|(noted_chunk, _)| Arc::ptr_eq(noted_chunk, chunk))
        {
            let (_, chunk_notes) = record_notes_of_chunks.swap_remove(index);
            notes.append_shifted_by(
                chunk_notes,
                u32::try_from(chunk_start).expect("display list exceeds u32"),
            );
        }
        chunk_start += chunk_size;
    }
    notes
}

fn left_out_content_is_verified() -> bool {
    static VERIFIED: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *VERIFIED.get_or_init(|| cfg!(debug_assertions) || std::env::var_os("LIBWEB_VERIFY_PAINT_WINDOW").is_some())
}

/// Requires a recording of a window, made from scratch, to lack only what misses the window: its tape is the tape
/// of a recording of the whole document without some of its chunks, and no command in those draws where the window
/// reaches. The commands that only describe the document to the compositor draw nothing.
fn require_only_what_misses_the_window_is_left_out(
    of_window: &RecordingOutput,
    of_whole_document: &RecordingOutput,
    spaces: &WindowSpaces<'_>,
) {
    use crate::painting::display_list::builder::{bounding_rect_computed_from_payload, for_each_command};
    use crate::painting::display_list::chunks::chunks_of;
    let (windowed, whole) = (&of_window.display_list, &of_whole_document.display_list);
    let mut chunks_of_window = chunks_of(&windowed.bytes, &windowed.command_runs, &windowed.chunks).peekable();
    for (chunk, bytes, runs) in chunks_of(&whole.bytes, &whole.command_runs, &whole.chunks) {
        let is_the_same_chunk = chunks_of_window
            .next_if(|(kept, kept_bytes, kept_runs)| {
                kept.id == chunk.id
                    || (kept_bytes.len() == bytes.len()
                        && kept_runs.len() == runs.len()
                        && without_vector_image_ids(kept_bytes) == without_vector_image_ids(bytes))
            })
            .is_some();
        if is_the_same_chunk {
            continue;
        }
        let chunk_start = chunk.byte_end - bytes.len() as u32;
        for run in runs {
            let run_start = (run.offset - chunk_start) as usize;
            let run_bytes = &bytes[run_start..run_start + run.size as usize];
            for_each_command(run_bytes, |header, _, payload| {
                if header.command_type.is_compositor_metadata() {
                    return;
                }
                let Some(bounding_rect) = bounding_rect_computed_from_payload(header, payload) else {
                    return;
                };
                assert!(
                    spaces.shows_in_window(bounding_rect.to_float(), run.context) != Some(true),
                    "A recording of a window left out {} at {:?} under {:?}, which shows in the window",
                    header.command_type.name(),
                    bounding_rect,
                    run.context
                );
            });
        }
    }
    assert!(
        chunks_of_window.next().is_none(),
        "A recording of a window holds a chunk that a recording of the whole document lacks"
    );
}

/// The bytes of a tape without the ids of the SVG image records it draws. A command that paints an SVG image is
/// recorded with a placeholder for the image's records, which publication replaces with the id of the records the host
/// rendered, and the placeholder follows how many images the recording met before. A reused command names the records
/// already.
fn without_vector_image_ids(bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    use crate::painting::display_list::commands::{DisplayListCommandType, PaintVectorImage};
    let mut bytes = bytes.to_vec();
    let id_field = std::mem::offset_of!(PaintVectorImage, vector_image_id);
    let mut id_offsets = Vec::new();
    crate::painting::display_list::nested_records::for_each_command_including_nested(
        &bytes,
        &mut |command_type, payload_offset, _| {
            if command_type == DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage {
                id_offsets.push(payload_offset + id_field);
            }
        },
    );
    for offset in id_offsets {
        bytes[offset..offset + std::mem::size_of::<u64>()].fill(0);
    }
    bytes
}

/// A digest of the scale that each space of the tree accumulates, or none without a tree.
fn accumulated_scales_of(paint_state: &crate::painting::published_frame::PublishedPaintState) -> Option<u64> {
    use crate::painting::display_list::commands::SpatialNodeIndex;
    use crate::painting::visual_context::IncludeVisualViewportTransform;
    use std::hash::Hasher;
    let tree = paint_state.visual_context_tree.as_deref()?;
    let world_transforms = paint_state.unscrolled_world_transforms();
    let mut digest = crate::fast_hash::fast_hasher();
    for index in 0..tree.spatial_nodes.len() {
        let scale =
            world_transforms.accumulated_2d_scale(SpatialNodeIndex(index as u32), IncludeVisualViewportTransform::No);
        digest.write_u32(scale.width.to_bits());
        digest.write_u32(scale.height.to_bits());
    }
    Some(digest.finish())
}

fn reused_output_is_verified() -> bool {
    static VERIFIED: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *VERIFIED.get_or_init(|| cfg!(debug_assertions) || std::env::var_os("LIBWEB_VERIFY_PAINT_REUSE").is_some())
}

/// Requires a recording that reused clean output of the published one to be the recording the same frame gives when
/// everything is recorded: a difference is output that was reused though what it shows changed.
fn require_same_recording(assembled: &RecordingOutput, from_scratch: &RecordingOutput) {
    use crate::painting::display_list::builder::{bounding_rect_computed_from_payload, for_each_command};
    use crate::painting::display_list::chunks::{chunk_id, chunks_of};
    let (assembled_list, scratch_list) = (&assembled.display_list, &from_scratch.display_list);
    let assembled_bytes = without_vector_image_ids(&assembled_list.bytes);
    let scratch_bytes = without_vector_image_ids(&scratch_list.bytes);
    if assembled_bytes != scratch_bytes {
        let first_differing_byte = assembled_bytes
            .iter()
            .zip(&scratch_bytes)
            .position(|(copied, recorded)| copied != recorded)
            .unwrap_or(assembled_bytes.len().min(scratch_bytes.len()));
        let command_at = |bytes: &[u8]| {
            let mut found = None;
            for_each_command(bytes, |header, offset, payload| {
                if offset <= first_differing_byte {
                    found = Some((
                        offset,
                        header.command_type.name(),
                        bounding_rect_computed_from_payload(header, payload),
                    ));
                }
            });
            found
        };
        panic!(
            "A recording reused output that recording from scratch replaces: {} bytes against {}, differing from byte {first_differing_byte}, in {:?} where recording from scratch has {:?}",
            assembled_list.bytes.len(),
            scratch_list.bytes.len(),
            command_at(&assembled_list.bytes),
            command_at(&scratch_list.bytes)
        );
    }
    assert!(
        assembled_list.command_runs == scratch_list.command_runs,
        "A recording reused command runs that recording from scratch replaces"
    );
    let chunk_ends = |list: &RecordedDisplayList| -> Vec<(u32, u32)> {
        list.chunks
            .iter()
            .map(|chunk| (chunk.byte_end, chunk.run_end))
            .collect()
    };
    assert!(
        chunk_ends(assembled_list) == chunk_ends(scratch_list),
        "A recording cut its tape into other chunks than recording from scratch does"
    );
    for (chunk, bytes, runs) in chunks_of(
        &assembled_list.bytes,
        &assembled_list.command_runs,
        &assembled_list.chunks,
    ) {
        let chunk_start = chunk.byte_end - bytes.len() as u32;
        assert!(
            chunk.id == chunk_id(bytes, runs, chunk_start),
            "A recording reused a chunk under a name that is not the name of what it holds"
        );
    }
    assert!(
        assembled.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners == from_scratch.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners,
        "A recording reused wheel regions that recording from scratch replaces"
    );
}

impl<O: Observer> PaintRecorder<'_, O> {
    // SVG content below an SVG root is recorded by the root's producer; every box inside
    // shows up nested under it.
    fn paint_svg_box(&mut self, svg_box: NodeSlotId) {
        self.trace_scope(Operation::Named(Some(svg_box), "svg"), Action::Record, |this| {
            this.paint_svg_box_impl(svg_box);
        });
    }

    pub(crate) fn paint_svg_box_impl(&mut self, svg_box: NodeSlotId) {
        let context = self.own_context(svg_box);
        self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);

        // For elements with SVG filters, emit a transparent FillRect to trigger filter application.
        // This ensures content-generating filters (feFlood, feImage) work even with empty source.
        if let Some(svg_filter_bounds) = self.source.committed_side_data(svg_box).svg_filter_bounds {
            let device_rect = self
                .converter
                .enclosing_device_rect(crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect::from(svg_filter_bounds));
            self.recorder.fill_rect_transparent(device_rect);
        }

        if self.declare_mask_contents(svg_box, MaskLayerSet::SvgOnly) {
            return;
        }
        self.trace_paint(Operation::Producer(svg_box, ProducerKind::DrawForeground), |this| {
            crate::painting::record::paint::paint(this, svg_box, PaintPhase::Foreground);
        });
        self.svg_paint_descendants(svg_box);
    }

    fn svg_paint_descendants(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId) {
        // A text content element paints in document order: its text that follows a child element paints after that
        // child.
        // FIXME: Hit testing still tests all of the element's own text after its child elements.
        let is_text_box = matches!(
            self.source.node_kind_if_live(paintable),
            Some(crate::layout::node_data::NodeKind::SVGTextBox | crate::layout::node_data::NodeKind::SVGTextPathBox)
        );
        let mut next_text_part = if is_text_box {
            crate::painting::record::paint::svg::text_parts_before_children(self, paintable)
        } else {
            None
        };
        let mut next_child = crate::painting::paint_order::first_paint_child(self.source, paintable);
        while let Some(child) = next_child {
            next_child = crate::painting::paint_order::next_paint_sibling(self.source, child);
            // A child that establishes a stacking context is painted by that context.
            if !self.has_stacking_context(child) {
                self.paint_svg_box(child);
            }
            if let Some(next_text_part) = &mut next_text_part {
                let context = self.own_context(paintable);
                self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);
                crate::painting::record::paint::svg::paint_text_after_child(self, paintable, child, next_text_part);
            }
        }
        if let Some(next_text_part) = next_text_part {
            let context = self.own_context(paintable);
            self.recorder.set_accumulated_visual_context(context);
            crate::painting::record::paint::svg::paint_text_after_children(self, paintable, next_text_part);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn for_descendants_context(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId) -> ContextRef {
        self.data(paintable).accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants
    }

    pub(crate) fn context_for_phase(&self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) -> ContextRef {
        // Text fragments are content of the block container (or of a self-painting inline box).
        // They need the descendants' visual context, not the element's own visual context.
        let foreground_paints_descendant_content = node_painting::has_lines(self.source, paintable)
            || node_painting::is_fragmented_inline(self.source, paintable);
        if foreground_paints_descendant_content && phase == PaintPhase::Foreground {
            self.for_descendants_context(paintable)
        } else {
            self.own_context(paintable)
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn paint(&mut self, paintable: NodeSlotId, phase: PaintPhase) {
        crate::painting::record::paint::paint(self, paintable, phase);
    }
}

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::DisplayListResourceId;
use crate::painting::force_dark::ForceDarkSettings;
use crate::painting::host::{FfiLayerImageList, FfiVectorImageRenderRequest};
use libgfx_rust::{FloatRect, FloatSize, IntSize};

pub(crate) const VECTOR_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_TAG: u64 = 1 << 63;

pub(crate) fn is_vector_image_placeholder(id: DisplayListResourceId) -> bool {
    id.0 & VECTOR_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_TAG != 0
}

pub(crate) fn vector_image_placeholder_index(id: DisplayListResourceId) -> usize {
    (id.0 & !VECTOR_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_TAG) as usize
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(crate) enum VectorImageSource {
    Layer {
        owner: NodeSlotId,
        list: FfiLayerImageList,
        computed_index: u32,
    },
    ReplacedContent {
        owner: NodeSlotId,
    },
}

impl VectorImageSource {
    /// The box whose style the image is drawn with.
    pub(crate) fn owner(&self) -> NodeSlotId {
        match *self {
            Self::Layer { owner, .. } | Self::ReplacedContent { owner } => owner,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(crate) struct VectorImageRenderRequest {
    pub source: VectorImageSource,
    css_width_raw: i32,
    css_height_raw: i32,
    raster_scale_bits: u32,
    /// What the SVG image shows, which the host renders it from: a request with the same identity, size, scale, color
    /// scheme and force-dark settings renders the same display list.
    content_identity: u64,
    /// The color scheme the host renders the SVG image in.
    color_scheme: u8,
    /// The force-dark settings of the page that draws the image, which the host renders the image's content with.
    force_dark_enabled: bool,
    force_dark_foreground_threshold: i32,
    force_dark_background_threshold: i32,
}

impl VectorImageRenderRequest {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        source: VectorImageSource,
        css_width: CssPixels,
        css_height: CssPixels,
        raster_scale: f32,
        content_identity: u64,
        color_scheme: u8,
        force_dark: Option<ForceDarkSettings>,
    ) -> Self {
        let force_dark_settings = force_dark.unwrap_or_default();
        Self {
            source,
            css_width_raw: css_width.raw_value(),
            css_height_raw: css_height.raw_value(),
            raster_scale_bits: raster_scale.to_bits(),
            content_identity,
            color_scheme,
            force_dark_enabled: force_dark.is_some(),
            force_dark_foreground_threshold: force_dark_settings.foreground_brightness_threshold,
            force_dark_background_threshold: force_dark_settings.background_brightness_threshold,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn raster_scale(&self) -> f32 {
        f32::from_bits(self.raster_scale_bits)
    }

    pub(crate) fn to_ffi(self) -> FfiVectorImageRenderRequest {
        let (owner, is_replaced_content, list, computed_index) = match self.source {
            VectorImageSource::Layer {
                owner,
                list,
                computed_index,
            } => (owner, false, list, computed_index),
            VectorImageSource::ReplacedContent { owner } => (owner, true, FfiLayerImageList::Background, 0),
        };
        FfiVectorImageRenderRequest {
            owner,
            is_replaced_content,
            list,
            computed_index,
            css_width: CssPixels::from_raw(self.css_width_raw),
            css_height: CssPixels::from_raw(self.css_height_raw),
            raster_scale: self.raster_scale(),
            color_scheme: self.color_scheme,
            force_dark_enabled: self.force_dark_enabled,
            force_dark_foreground_threshold: self.force_dark_foreground_threshold,
            force_dark_background_threshold: self.force_dark_background_threshold,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) struct VectorImageRenderGeometry {
    pub css_width: CssPixels,
    pub css_height: CssPixels,
    pub raster_scale: f32,
    pub list_size: IntSize,
}

const MAXIMUM_RASTER_DIMENSION: i32 = 16384;

fn positive_scale_or_one(scale: f32) -> f32 {
    if scale.is_nan() || scale <= 0.0 { 1.0 } else { scale }
}

fn raster_dimension(local_size: f32, scale: f32) -> i32 {
    ((local_size * positive_scale_or_one(scale)).round() as i32).clamp(1, MAXIMUM_RASTER_DIMENSION)
}

/// The geometry to render a vector image with, for a destination in CSS pixels and the scale from those to the
/// raster's pixels, which includes the device pixel ratio.
pub(crate) fn vector_image_render_geometry(
    dest_rect: FloatRect,
    accumulated_scale: FloatSize,
    has_active_view_box: bool,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
) -> VectorImageRenderGeometry {
    if has_active_view_box {
        // The image is rendered at one scale in both axes, since a viewport of other proportions than those of its
        // destination can change how the image is laid out.
        let scale = positive_scale_or_one(accumulated_scale.width.max(accumulated_scale.height))
            .min(MAXIMUM_RASTER_DIMENSION as f32 / dest_rect.width.max(dest_rect.height));
        let raster_size = IntSize {
            width: raster_dimension(dest_rect.width, scale),
            height: raster_dimension(dest_rect.height, scale),
        };
        // NB: The image lays out at the raster's size, so that its content lands on the raster's pixel grid exactly,
        //     but in CSS pixels of the device pixel ratio, so that what it measures in CSS pixels, like a non-scaling
        //     stroke, keeps its size at any device pixel ratio.
        let device_scale = positive_scale_or_one(device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
        return VectorImageRenderGeometry {
            css_width: CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(raster_size.width as f32 / device_scale),
            css_height: CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(raster_size.height as f32 / device_scale),
            raster_scale: device_scale,
            list_size: raster_size,
        };
    }
    let smallest_positive = CssPixels::from_raw(1);
    let maximum = CssPixels::from_integer(i64::from(MAXIMUM_RASTER_DIMENSION));
    let css_width = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(dest_rect.width).clamp(smallest_positive, maximum);
    let css_height = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(dest_rect.height).clamp(smallest_positive, maximum);
    let raster_scale = positive_scale_or_one(accumulated_scale.width.max(accumulated_scale.height));
    let maximum_raster_scale = MAXIMUM_RASTER_DIMENSION as f32 / css_width.max(css_height).to_float();
    let raster_scale = raster_scale.min(maximum_raster_scale);
    VectorImageRenderGeometry {
        css_width,
        css_height,
        raster_scale,
        list_size: IntSize {
            width: ((css_width.to_float() * raster_scale).round() as i32).max(1),
            height: ((css_height.to_float() * raster_scale).round() as i32).max(1),
        },
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn list_size(width: f32, height: f32, scale_x: f32, scale_y: f32, has_active_view_box: bool) -> (i32, i32) {
        let geometry = vector_image_render_geometry(
            FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, width, height),
            FloatSize {
                width: scale_x,
                height: scale_y,
            },
            has_active_view_box,
            2.0,
        );
        (geometry.list_size.width, geometry.list_size.height)
    }

    #[test]
    fn vector_image_keeps_the_proportions_of_its_destination() {
        for has_active_view_box in [true, false] {
            assert_eq!(list_size(24.0, 12.0, 1.0, 1.0, has_active_view_box), (24, 12));
            assert_eq!(list_size(24.0, 12.0, 4.0, 4.0, has_active_view_box), (96, 48));
            assert_eq!(list_size(24.0, 12.0, 2.0, 3.0, has_active_view_box), (72, 36));
            assert_eq!(list_size(24.0, 12.0, 3.0, 0.5, has_active_view_box), (72, 36));
            assert_eq!(list_size(24.0, 12.0, 0.5, 0.25, has_active_view_box), (12, 6));
            assert_eq!(list_size(24.0, 12.0, f32::NAN, 2.0, has_active_view_box), (48, 24));
            assert_eq!(list_size(8192.0, 4096.0, 4.0, 4.0, has_active_view_box), (16384, 8192));
        }
    }
}

//! The window a recording is made for, and where the parts of the paint order lie against it (see [`RecordedWindow`]).
//!
//! A recording holds what shows in the viewport and for a margin around it, with every scroller where it is, instead
//! of the whole document. The window stays where it was placed while it still covers what the viewport shows with half
//! the margin to spare, so scrolling a little changes nothing a recording reads. Once it does not, the next recording
//! places the window again: what came into it is recorded, and what left it is dropped.

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelPoint;
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::{ClipMode, ContextRef, SpatialNodeIndex};
use crate::painting::visual_context::{ClipNodeData, ScrollData, SpatialData, VisualContextTree};
use libgfx_rust::{FloatPoint, FloatRect, FloatSize, IntSize};
use smallvec::SmallVec;
use std::sync::Arc;

pub(crate) use libcompositing_rust::display_list::window::{PlacedSpaces, RecordedWindow};

/// A bound keeps the rects of this many spaces apart before it gives up on bounding what it holds.
const MOST_SPACES_A_BOUND_KEEPS_APART: usize = 4;

/// Bounds what a part of a plan paints: rects in device pixels, each in the space of a node of the visual context
/// tree. What lies in one space is bounded by one rect.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct InkBound {
    rects: SmallVec<[(SpatialNodeIndex, FloatRect); 2]>,
}

impl InkBound {
    /// What bounds an item that paints nothing.
    pub(crate) fn nothing() -> Self {
        Self { rects: SmallVec::new() }
    }

    pub(crate) fn in_space(space: SpatialNodeIndex, rect: FloatRect) -> Self {
        Self {
            rects: smallvec::smallvec![(space, rect)],
        }
    }

    /// The rect of each space the bound has things in.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn rects(&self) -> &[(SpatialNodeIndex, FloatRect)] {
        &self.rects
    }

    /// One bound for what both bound, or none where they lie in more spaces than a bound keeps apart.
    pub(crate) fn united(mut self, other: &InkBound) -> Option<Self> {
        for &(space, rect) in &other.rects {
            if let Some((_, kept)) = self.rects.iter_mut().find(|(kept, _)| *kept == space) {
                *kept = kept.united(rect);
            } else if self.rects.len() < MOST_SPACES_A_BOUND_KEEPS_APART {
                self.rects.push((space, rect));
            } else {
                return None;
            }
        }
        Some(self)
    }
}

/// How far each scroller of `tree` had moved what it holds, as a window keeps it: in device pixels by the index of its
/// node, from `scroll_own_offsets`, by scroll state slot.
pub(crate) fn device_pixel_offsets(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    scroll_own_offsets: &[CssPixelPoint],
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
) -> Arc<[FloatPoint]> {
    let offset_of = scroll_offset_of_node(scroll_own_offsets, device_pixels_per_css_pixel);
    tree.spatial_nodes
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, node)| match &node.data {
            SpatialData::Scroll(scroll) => offset_of(SpatialNodeIndex(index as u32), scroll),
            _ => FloatPoint::default(),
        })
        .collect()
}

/// How far a scroller moves what it holds, in device pixels, from `scroll_own_offsets`, by scroll state slot.
fn scroll_offset_of_node(
    scroll_own_offsets: &[CssPixelPoint],
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
) -> impl Fn(SpatialNodeIndex, &ScrollData) -> FloatPoint + '_ {
    let scale = device_pixels_per_css_pixel as f32;
    move |_, scroll| {
        scroll_own_offsets
            .get(scroll.state_slot)
            .map_or_else(FloatPoint::default, |offset| FloatPoint {
                x: offset.x.to_float() * scale,
                y: offset.y.to_float() * scale,
            })
    }
}

/// What a window keeps ahead of what the viewport shows before a recording places it again.
pub(crate) fn kept_ahead(window: &RecordedWindow) -> FloatSize {
    let margin = window.margin();
    FloatSize {
        width: margin.width / 2.0,
        height: margin.height / 2.0,
    }
}

/// Whether `window`, of a recording made against `tree_of_recording`, still covers what a viewport of
/// `device_viewport_size` shows of `tree_now` with its scrollers at `scroll_own_offsets`, half the margin to spare.
pub(crate) fn still_covers(
    window: &RecordedWindow,
    tree_of_recording: &VisualContextTree,
    tree_now: &VisualContextTree,
    device_viewport_size: IntSize,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    scroll_own_offsets: &[CssPixelPoint],
) -> bool {
    window.still_covers(
        tree_of_recording,
        tree_now,
        device_viewport_size,
        device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
        scroll_offset_of_node(scroll_own_offsets, device_pixels_per_css_pixel),
        kept_ahead(window),
    )
}

/// The window a recording of a frame of `tree` is made for: the window of `published`, the recording published last
/// with the tree it was made against, where that still covers what the viewport shows with the scrollers at
/// `scroll_own_offsets`, or else one placed there.
pub(crate) fn window_of_frame(
    published: Option<(&Arc<RecordedWindow>, &VisualContextTree)>,
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    device_viewport_size: IntSize,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    scroll_own_offsets: &[CssPixelPoint],
) -> Arc<RecordedWindow> {
    if let Some((published, tree_of_recording)) = published
        && still_covers(
            published,
            tree_of_recording,
            tree,
            device_viewport_size,
            device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            scroll_own_offsets,
        )
    {
        return Arc::clone(published);
    }
    Arc::new(RecordedWindow::placed_at(
        device_viewport_size,
        device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
        device_pixel_offsets(tree, scroll_own_offsets, device_pixels_per_css_pixel),
    ))
}

/// The spaces of a frame's visual context tree against the window of its recording.
pub(crate) struct WindowSpaces<'a> {
    window: Arc<RecordedWindow>,
    spaces: PlacedSpaces<'a>,
}

impl<'a> WindowSpaces<'a> {
    pub(crate) fn new(window: Arc<RecordedWindow>, tree: &'a VisualContextTree) -> Self {
        let spaces = window.placed_spaces(tree);
        Self { window, spaces }
    }

    /// The rects of the bound in the space of the visual viewport, or none where one lies in a space that moves
    /// without a recording.
    fn rects_in_root(&self, bound: &InkBound) -> Option<SmallVec<[FloatRect; 2]>> {
        bound
            .rects
            .iter()
            .map(|&(space, rect)| self.spaces.to_root(space, rect))
            .collect()
    }

    /// Whether nothing inside the bound shows in the window. A bound that cannot be placed is not outside it.
    pub(crate) fn is_outside(&self, bound: &InkBound) -> bool {
        // What paints nothing is as cheap to keep as to leave out.
        if bound.rects.is_empty() {
            return false;
        }
        // One device pixel of slack keeps rounding from leaving out what touches the window's edge.
        self.rects_in_root(bound).is_some_and(|rects| {
            rects
                .iter()
                .all(|rect| rect.inflated(2.0, 2.0).intersected(self.window.rect).is_empty())
        })
    }

    /// Whether everything inside the bound shows in the window.
    pub(crate) fn is_wholly_inside(&self, bound: &InkBound) -> bool {
        self.rects_in_root(bound).is_some_and(|rects| {
            rects
                .iter()
                .all(|rect| self.window.rect.contains_rect(rect.inflated(2.0, 2.0)))
        })
    }

    /// Whether what a command draws in `rect` under `context` shows in the window as the tree stands, with the
    /// scrollers where the window was placed and the clips of the context applied, or none where a node on the way to
    /// the root moves what it holds without a recording. A recording of a window that lacks the command was right to
    /// leave it out where this is false.
    pub(crate) fn shows_in_window(&self, rect: FloatRect, context: ContextRef) -> Option<bool> {
        let tree = self.spaces.tree();
        let mut shown = self.spaces.to_root(context.spatial, rect)?;
        let mut clip = context.clip;
        while !clip.is_none() {
            let clip_node = &tree.clip_nodes[clip.0 as usize];
            let clip_rect = match &clip_node.data {
                ClipNodeData::Rect(data) if data.mode == ClipMode::Intersect => Some(data.rect),
                ClipNodeData::Path(path) => Some(path.bounding_rect.to_float()),
                _ => None,
            };
            if let Some(clip_rect) = clip_rect
                && let Some(clip_in_root) = self.spaces.to_root(clip_node.spatial, clip_rect)
            {
                shown = shown.intersected(clip_in_root);
            }
            clip = clip_node.parent;
        }
        Some(!shown.intersected(self.window.rect).is_empty())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels;
    use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
    use crate::painting::visual_context::{
        ScrollData, SpatialData, StickyData, TransformData, TransformDataRole, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
    };
    use libgfx_rust::FloatMatrix4x4;

    fn transform(matrix: FloatMatrix4x4) -> SpatialData {
        SpatialData::Transform(TransformData {
            matrix,
            origin: FloatPoint::default(),
            sorting_context_root_index: None,
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
            role: TransformDataRole::CssTransform,
            synthetic_plane: false,
            establishes_sorting_context: false,
            bounds: FloatRect::default(),
        })
    }

    fn scroller(state_slot: usize) -> SpatialData {
        SpatialData::Scroll(ScrollData {
            state_slot,
            owner_paintable: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        })
    }

    fn empty_tree() -> VisualContextTree {
        let SpatialData::Transform(identity) = transform(FloatMatrix4x4::identity()) else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        VisualContextTree::create(identity)
    }

    fn offsets(offsets: &[(i64, i64)]) -> Vec<CssPixelPoint> {
        offsets
            .iter()
            .map(|(x, y)| CssPixelPoint::new(CssPixels::from_integer(*x), CssPixels::from_integer(*y)))
            .collect()
    }

    const VIEWPORT: IntSize = IntSize {
        width: 800,
        height: 600,
    };

    // A window of an 800 by 600 viewport, which reaches 1200 pixels above and below it.
    fn window_at(tree: &VisualContextTree, placed_offsets: &[(i64, i64)]) -> Arc<RecordedWindow> {
        window_of_frame(None, tree, VIEWPORT, 1.0, &offsets(placed_offsets))
    }

    fn bound(space: SpatialNodeIndex, y: f32) -> InkBound {
        InkBound::in_space(space, FloatRect::new(0.0, y, 100.0, 100.0))
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_frame_keeps_the_published_window_while_it_covers_what_shows() {
        let mut tree = empty_tree();
        tree.append_spatial(scroller(0), VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX);
        let published = window_at(&tree, &[(0, -1000)]);
        let window_of =
            |placed: &[(i64, i64)]| window_of_frame(Some((&published, &tree)), &tree, VIEWPORT, 1.0, &offsets(placed));
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&window_of(&[(0, -1600)]), &published));
        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&window_of(&[(0, -1601)]), &published));
        assert_eq!(*window_of(&[(0, -1601)]), *window_at(&tree, &[(0, -1601)]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_a_scroller_holds_is_placed_where_the_scroller_was_when_the_window_was_placed() {
        let mut tree = empty_tree();
        let page = tree.append_spatial(scroller(0), VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX);
        // The page is scrolled down by 5000.
        let spaces = WindowSpaces::new(window_at(&tree, &[(0, -5000)]), &tree);

        // The window reaches from 3800 to 6800 down the page.
        assert!(spaces.is_outside(&bound(page, 0.0)));
        assert!(spaces.is_outside(&bound(page, 3600.0)));
        assert!(!spaces.is_outside(&bound(page, 3750.0)));
        assert!(spaces.is_wholly_inside(&bound(page, 5000.0)));
        assert!(!spaces.is_wholly_inside(&bound(page, 3750.0)));
        assert!(spaces.is_outside(&bound(page, 6900.0)));
        // What the page does not scroll stays where the viewport is.
        assert!(!spaces.is_outside(&bound(VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX, 0.0)));
        assert!(spaces.is_outside(&bound(VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX, 5000.0)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_a_static_transform_moves_is_placed_where_it_moves_it() {
        let mut tree = empty_tree();
        let page = tree.append_spatial(scroller(0), VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX);
        let pulled = tree.append_spatial(transform(libgfx_rust::translation_matrix(0.0, -4900.0, 0.0)), page);
        let spaces = WindowSpaces::new(window_at(&tree, &[(0, 0)]), &tree);
        assert!(!spaces.is_outside(&bound(pulled, 5000.0)));
        assert!(spaces.is_outside(&bound(page, 5000.0)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn nothing_below_a_node_that_moves_on_its_own_is_outside() {
        let mut tree = empty_tree();
        let page = tree.append_spatial(scroller(0), VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX);
        let sticky = tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Sticky(StickyData::unconstrained(page, None, 1, NodeSlotId::INVALID)),
            page,
        );
        let spaces = WindowSpaces::new(window_at(&tree, &[(0, 0), (0, 0)]), &tree);
        assert!(!spaces.is_outside(&bound(sticky, 100_000.0)));
        assert!(!spaces.is_wholly_inside(&bound(sticky, 0.0)));
        // A bound with a part that cannot be placed is not outside, wherever its other parts are.
        let mixed = bound(page, 100_000.0).united(&bound(sticky, 100_000.0)).unwrap();
        assert!(!spaces.is_outside(&mixed));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_bound_keeps_the_rects_of_a_few_spaces_apart() {
        let space = |index| SpatialNodeIndex(index);
        let united = bound(space(1), 0.0).united(&bound(space(1), 500.0)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            united,
            InkBound::in_space(space(1), FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 600.0))
        );
        let mut many = bound(space(1), 0.0);
        for index in 2..=MOST_SPACES_A_BOUND_KEEPS_APART as u32 {
            many = many.united(&bound(space(index), 0.0)).unwrap();
        }
        assert!(many.clone().united(&bound(space(1), 10.0)).is_some());
        assert!(many.united(&bound(space(99), 0.0)).is_none());
    }
}

//! What the scroll logic of the compositor makes of the recording a document published last, before the recording
//! reaches the compositor, for tests.

use crate::painting::display_list::storage::DisplayListStorage;
use crate::painting::presentation::display_list_properties_of;
use crate::painting::record::RecordingOutput;
use crate::render_state::DocumentHost;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::DisplayList;
use libgfx_rust::FloatPoint;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Where the first step of a wheel gesture goes: `Compositing::FirstWheelStepRouteForTesting`, with the routing decision
/// and the scroller's kind as their `Web::InputRoutingDecision` and `Web::AsyncScrollNodeKind` values.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct FfiRecordedFirstWheelStepRoute {
    pub decision: u8,
    pub has_scroller: bool,
    pub scroller_node_id: i64,
    pub scroller_kind: u8,
    pub scroller_pseudo_element_type: u8,
    pub has_document_id: bool,
    pub document_id: i64,
}

/// The display list `output` published, as the compositor takes it, and the tree it was recorded against.
fn display_list_of(
    output: &RecordingOutput,
) -> Option<(DisplayList, Arc<crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree>)> {
    let tree = output.visual_context_tree.clone()?;
    let properties = display_list_properties_of(output);
    let display_list = DisplayList::new(
        DisplayListStorage::recorded(&output.display_list, tree.clone()),
        properties.id,
        properties.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch,
        output.async_scrolling_metadata.clone(),
        properties.surface_clear_color,
        properties.root_group_color,
    );
    Some((display_list, tree))
}

/// The recording `host`'s document published last, as the compositor takes it.
fn published_display_list(
    host: &DocumentHost,
) -> Option<(DisplayList, Arc<crate::painting::visual_context::VisualContextTree>)> {
    let recording = host.recording().published_recording()?;
    display_list_of(&recording)
}

/// Hands `receive` the scrolling state of the recording `host`'s document published last, as JSON, or the empty one
/// where it published none.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `receive` must copy the UTF-8 bytes it keeps synchronously.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_recorded_async_scrolling_state_json(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    receiver: *mut c_void,
    receive: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const u8, usize),
) {
    let display_list = published_display_list(host);
    let json = libcompositing_rust::ffi::recorded_display_list_async_scrolling_state_json(
        display_list.as_ref().map(|(display_list, tree)| (display_list, tree)),
    );
    // SAFETY: The caller copies what it keeps of the JSON synchronously.
    unsafe { receive(receiver, json.as_ptr(), json.len()) };
}

/// Hands `receive` the scrolling state of no display list, the empty one, as JSON.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `receive` must copy the UTF-8 bytes it keeps synchronously.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_empty_async_scrolling_state_json(
    receiver: *mut c_void,
    receive: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const u8, usize),
) {
    let json = libcompositing_rust::ffi::recorded_display_list_async_scrolling_state_json(None);
    // SAFETY: The caller copies what it keeps of the JSON synchronously.
    unsafe { receive(receiver, json.as_ptr(), json.len()) };
}

/// Writes where the first step of a wheel gesture at `position` by `delta_in_css_pixels` goes through the recording
/// `host`'s document published last to `out`, and answers whether it published one.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_state_recorded_route_first_wheel_step(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    newest_wheel_event_listener_state_generation: u64,
    position: FloatPoint,
    delta_in_css_pixels: FloatPoint,
    out: &mut FfiRecordedFirstWheelStepRoute,
) -> bool {
    let Some((display_list, tree)) = published_display_list(host) else {
        return false;
    };
    let route = libcompositing_rust::ffi::recorded_display_list_route_first_wheel_step(
        &display_list,
        &tree,
        (*host.scroll_state()).clone(),
        newest_wheel_event_listener_state_generation,
        position,
        delta_in_css_pixels,
    );
    *out = FfiRecordedFirstWheelStepRoute {
        decision: route.decision as u8,
        has_scroller: route.has_scroller,
        scroller_node_id: route.scroller_node_id,
        scroller_kind: route.scroller_kind as u8,
        scroller_pseudo_element_type: route.scroller_pseudo_element_type,
        has_document_id: route.has_document_id,
        document_id: route.document_id,
    };
    true
}

/// Whether a box of the recording `host`'s document published last blocks a wheel event at `position`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_state_recorded_blocks_wheel_event_at(host: &DocumentHost, position: FloatPoint) -> bool {
    let Some((display_list, tree)) = published_display_list(host) else {
        return false;
    };
    libcompositing_rust::ffi::recorded_display_list_blocks_wheel_event_at(
        &display_list,
        &tree,
        (*host.scroll_state()).clone(),
        position,
    )
}

/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
