//! The geometry scroll snap position selection runs over, collected from the layout of a snap
//! container and of the snap areas it captures. The selection itself lives in
//! `libcompositing_rust::scrolling::scroll_snap_selection`, so that the main thread and the compositor process
//! select from the same geometry.

use crate::css::computed_value_types::ComputedLengthBox;
use crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView;
use crate::css::css_enums::{
    scroll_snap_align, scroll_snap_axis, scroll_snap_stop, scroll_snap_strictness, writing_mode,
};
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::layout::node_facts;
use crate::painting::chrome_geometry::{maximum_scroll_offset, minimum_scroll_offset};
use crate::painting::host::{
    FfiSnapAreaGeometry, FfiSnapAreaIdentity, FfiSnapAxes, FfiSnapContainerGeometry, FfiSnapSelectionStrategy,
};
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;
use crate::painting::style_queries;
use crate::painting::visual_context::node_values::compute_transform;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::UniqueNodeId;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::SnapAreaIdentity;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::scroll_snap_selection::{
    SnapAlign, SnapAreaGeometry, SnapAxes, SnapContainerGeometry, SnapSelectionStrategy, SnapStrictness,
};
use libgfx_rust::{FloatMatrix4x4, FloatPoint, FloatRect};

const _: () = {
    assert!(scroll_snap_align::NONE == SnapAlign::None as u8);
    assert!(scroll_snap_align::START == SnapAlign::Start as u8);
    assert!(scroll_snap_align::END == SnapAlign::End as u8);
    assert!(scroll_snap_align::CENTER == SnapAlign::Center as u8);
    assert!(scroll_snap_strictness::NONE == SnapStrictness::None as u8);
    assert!(scroll_snap_strictness::PROXIMITY == SnapStrictness::Proximity as u8);
    assert!(scroll_snap_strictness::MANDATORY == SnapStrictness::Mandatory as u8);
};

impl From<FfiSnapAreaIdentity> for SnapAreaIdentity {
    fn from(area: FfiSnapAreaIdentity) -> Self {
        Self {
            node_id: UniqueNodeId(area.node_id),
            pseudo_element_type: area.pseudo_element_type,
        }
    }
}

impl From<SnapAreaIdentity> for FfiSnapAreaIdentity {
    fn from(area: SnapAreaIdentity) -> Self {
        Self {
            node_id: area.node_id.0,
            pseudo_element_type: area.pseudo_element_type,
        }
    }
}

impl From<FfiSnapContainerGeometry> for SnapContainerGeometry {
    fn from(geometry: FfiSnapContainerGeometry) -> Self {
        Self {
            snapport: geometry.snapport.into(),
            min_scroll_offset: geometry.min_scroll_offset.into(),
            max_scroll_offset: geometry.max_scroll_offset.into(),
            strictness: match geometry.strictness {
                scroll_snap_strictness::NONE => SnapStrictness::None,
                scroll_snap_strictness::PROXIMITY => SnapStrictness::Proximity,
                scroll_snap_strictness::MANDATORY => SnapStrictness::Mandatory,
                _ => unreachable!("invalid snap strictness"),
            },
            axes: SnapAxes {
                x: geometry.axes.x,
                y: geometry.axes.y,
            },
            horizontal_writing_mode: geometry.horizontal_writing_mode,
        }
    }
}

impl From<FfiSnapAreaGeometry> for SnapAreaGeometry {
    fn from(area: FfiSnapAreaGeometry) -> Self {
        let align = |value| match value {
            scroll_snap_align::NONE => SnapAlign::None,
            scroll_snap_align::START => SnapAlign::Start,
            scroll_snap_align::END => SnapAlign::End,
            scroll_snap_align::CENTER => SnapAlign::Center,
            _ => unreachable!("invalid snap alignment"),
        };
        Self {
            identity: SnapAreaIdentity {
                node_id: UniqueNodeId(area.node_id),
                pseudo_element_type: area.pseudo_element_type,
            },
            rect: area.rect.into(),
            align_x: align(area.align_x),
            align_y: align(area.align_y),
            always_stop: area.always_stop,
        }
    }
}

impl From<&FfiSnapSelectionStrategy> for SnapSelectionStrategy {
    fn from(strategy: &FfiSnapSelectionStrategy) -> Self {
        Self {
            r#type: strategy.r#type,
            start_offset: strategy.has_start_offset.then(|| strategy.start_offset.into()),
            displacement: strategy.displacement.into(),
            starting_positions_boundary: strategy
                .has_starting_positions_boundary
                .then(|| strategy.starting_positions_boundary.into()),
        }
    }
}

/// The box whose style the snap properties of a scroll container come from. The properties
/// specified on the root element apply to the viewport rather than to its own box.
fn snap_style_source(arena: &impl PaintRead, snap_container: NodeSlotId) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    if arena.node_kind_if_live(snap_container) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport) {
        style_queries::document_element_box_under(arena, snap_container)
    } else {
        Some(snap_container)
    }
}

fn snap_style(arena: &impl PaintRead, snap_container: NodeSlotId) -> Option<ComputedValuesView<'_>> {
    arena.node_style_if_live(snap_style_source(arena, snap_container)?)
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#snap-axis
pub(crate) fn snap_axes_of_scroll_container(arena: &impl PaintRead, snap_container: NodeSlotId) -> FfiSnapAxes {
    snap_style(arena, snap_container).map_or_else(FfiSnapAxes::default, snap_axes_of_style)
}

fn snap_axes_of_style(style: ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> FfiSnapAxes {
    let snap_type = style.misc_interaction();
    if snap_type.scroll_snap_strictness == scroll_snap_strictness::NONE {
        return FfiSnapAxes::default();
    }
    let horizontal_writing_mode = style.writing_mode() == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB;
    match snap_type.scroll_snap_axis {
        scroll_snap_axis::X => FfiSnapAxes { x: true, y: false },
        scroll_snap_axis::Y => FfiSnapAxes { x: false, y: true },
        scroll_snap_axis::INLINE => FfiSnapAxes {
            x: horizontal_writing_mode,
            y: !horizontal_writing_mode,
        },
        scroll_snap_axis::BLOCK => FfiSnapAxes {
            x: !horizontal_writing_mode,
            y: horizontal_writing_mode,
        },
        _ => FfiSnapAxes { x: true, y: true },
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#scroll-padding
// For a scroll snap container this region also defines the scroll snapport, the area of the
// scrollport that is used as the alignment container for the scroll snap areas when calculating
// snap positions.
pub(crate) fn scroll_snapport_rect(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    snap_container: NodeSlotId,
    scrollport: CssPixelRect,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    let Some(style) = snap_style(arena, snap_container) else {
        return scrollport;
    };
    shrink_by_scroll_padding(scrollport, &style.misc_interaction().scroll_padding)
}

fn shrink_by_scroll_padding(scrollport: CssPixelRect, scroll_padding: &ComputedLengthBox) -> CssPixelRect {
    // Percentages refer to the corresponding dimension of the scroll container's scrollport.
    scrollport.shrunken(
        scroll_padding.top.to_px(scrollport.height),
        scroll_padding.right.to_px(scrollport.width),
        scroll_padding.bottom.to_px(scrollport.height),
        scroll_padding.left.to_px(scrollport.width),
    )
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#scroll-margin
fn inflate_by_scroll_margin(rect: CssPixelRect, scroll_margin: &ComputedLengthBox) -> CssPixelRect {
    let zero = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
    rect.inflated(
        scroll_margin.top.to_px(zero),
        scroll_margin.right.to_px(zero),
        scroll_margin.bottom.to_px(zero),
        scroll_margin.left.to_px(zero),
    )
}

/// The geometry of a snap container, or `None` for a scroll container that snaps in no axis.
pub(crate) fn snap_container_geometry(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    snap_container: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<FfiSnapContainerGeometry> {
    if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(snap_container) {
        return None;
    }
    let style = snap_style(arena, snap_container)?;
    let axes = snap_axes_of_style(style);
    if !axes.x && !axes.y {
        return None;
    }
    paintable_geometry::scrollable_overflow_rect(arena, snap_container)?;
    let scrollport = paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(arena, snap_container);
    Some(FfiSnapContainerGeometry {
        snapport: shrink_by_scroll_padding(scrollport, &style.misc_interaction().scroll_padding).into(),
        min_scroll_offset: minimum_scroll_offset(arena, snap_container).into(),
        max_scroll_offset: maximum_scroll_offset(arena, snap_container).into(),
        strictness: style.misc_interaction().scroll_snap_strictness,
        axes,
        horizontal_writing_mode: style.writing_mode() == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB,
    })
}

/// Calls back with the geometry of every snap area the snap container captures, in tree order.
pub(crate) fn for_each_snap_area(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    snap_container: NodeSlotId,
    mut callback: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId, FfiSnapAreaGeometry),
) {
    let Some(container_style) = snap_style(arena, snap_container) else {
        return;
    };
    let snapport = shrink_by_scroll_padding(
        paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(arena, snap_container),
        &container_style.misc_interaction().scroll_padding,
    );
    let container_writing_mode = WritingModeFacts::of(container_style);
    for_each_descendant_with_snap_alignment(arena, snap_container, &mut |snap_area, style| {
        if let Some(area) = snap_area_geometry(
            arena,
            snap_area,
            style,
            snap_container,
            snapport,
            container_writing_mode,
        ) {
            callback(snap_area, area);
        }
    });
}

fn for_each_descendant_with_snap_alignment<'a>(
    arena: &'a impl PaintRead,
    parent: NodeSlotId,
    callback: &mut impl FnMut(NodeSlotId, ComputedValuesView<'a>),
) {
    for slot in arena.children(parent) {
        if let Some(style) = snap_alignment_style(arena, slot) {
            callback(slot, style);
        }
        for_each_descendant_with_snap_alignment(arena, slot, callback);
    }
}

/// The style of a box with a snap alignment that has a committed paintable.
fn snap_alignment_style(arena: &impl PaintRead, slot: NodeSlotId) -> Option<ComputedValuesView<'_>> {
    let kind = arena.node_kind_if_live(slot)?;
    if node_facts::kind_is_text(kind) || !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
        return None;
    }
    arena
        .node_style_if_live(slot)
        .filter(|style| style.has_scroll_snap_alignment())
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#scroll-snap-area
fn snap_area_geometry(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    snap_area: NodeSlotId,
    style: ComputedValuesView<'_>,
    snap_container: NodeSlotId,
    snapport: CssPixelRect,
    container_writing_mode: WritingModeFacts,
) -> Option<FfiSnapAreaGeometry> {
    let misc = style.misc_interaction();
    let rect = inflate_by_scroll_margin(
        captured_snap_area_rect(arena, snap_area, snap_container)?,
        &misc.scroll_margin,
    );

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#scroll-snap-align
    // Start and end alignments are resolved with respect to the writing mode of the snap container
    // unless the scroll snap area is larger than the snapport, in which case they are resolved with
    // respect to the writing mode of the box itself.
    let area_writing_mode = WritingModeFacts::of(style);
    let alignment_writing_mode = if area_is_larger_than_snapport(rect, snapport, area_writing_mode.horizontal) {
        area_writing_mode
    } else {
        container_writing_mode
    };
    let (align_x, align_y) = physical_snap_alignment(
        misc.scroll_snap_align_block,
        misc.scroll_snap_align_inline,
        alignment_writing_mode,
    );

    Some(FfiSnapAreaGeometry {
        node_id: arena.paintable_data(snap_area).node_identity,
        pseudo_element_type: arena.node_generated_for(snap_area),
        rect: rect.into(),
        align_x,
        align_y,
        always_stop: misc.scroll_snap_stop == scroll_snap_stop::ALWAYS,
    })
}

// The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular
// bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified
// outsets.
/// `None` when the snap container does not capture the area.
fn captured_snap_area_rect(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    snap_area: NodeSlotId,
    snap_container: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
    // Snap areas are captured by the nearest scroll container in their containing block chain, so
    // areas inside a nested scroll container may still belong to an outer container when they are
    // positioned. The boxes between an area and its container contribute transforms only, and
    // mapping the border box through each of them in turn lands it in the container's coordinate
    // space.
    let mut rect = map_rect_through_node_transform(
        arena,
        snap_area,
        paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(arena, snap_area),
    );
    let mut containing_block = arena.node_containing_block_if_live(snap_area);
    while let Some(block) = containing_block {
        if block == snap_container {
            return Some(rect);
        }
        // The box whose overflow was propagated to the viewport is left with a used overflow of
        // visible, so it is not a scroll container and cannot capture snap areas of its own.
        if style_queries::is_scroll_container(arena, block) {
            return None;
        }
        rect = map_rect_through_node_transform(arena, block, rect);
        containing_block = arena.node_containing_block_if_live(block);
    }
    None
}

/// `rect` mapped through the CSS transform of `node`, or as it is when `node` has none.
pub(crate) fn map_rect_through_node_transform(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    node: NodeSlotId,
    rect: CssPixelRect,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
        return rect;
    }
    match compute_transform(arena, node, 1.0) {
        Some((transform, _is_invertible)) => map_rect_through_css_transform(transform.matrix, transform.origin, rect),
        None => rect,
    }
}

/// The axis-aligned bounding box of a rect mapped through a CSS transform about its origin.
pub(crate) fn map_rect_through_css_transform(
    matrix: FloatMatrix4x4,
    origin: FloatPoint,
    rect: CssPixelRect,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    let mapped = matrix
        .extract_2d_affine()
        .map_rect(
            FloatRect::new(
                rect.x.to_float(),
                rect.y.to_float(),
                rect.width.to_float(),
                rect.height.to_float(),
            )
            .translated(-origin.x, -origin.y),
        )
        .translated(origin.x, origin.y);
    CssPixelRect::new(
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.x),
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.y),
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.width),
        CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.height),
    )
}

/// The size an area is compared to the snapport in is the one it lays its content out along, so
/// that an area whose content no longer fits the snapport aligns the edge that content begins at.
/// This matches other engines.
pub(crate) fn area_is_larger_than_snapport(
    area: CssPixelRect,
    snapport: CssPixelRect,
    area_horizontal_writing_mode: bool,
) -> bool {
    if area_horizontal_writing_mode {
        area.width > snapport.width
    } else {
        area.height > snapport.height
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct WritingModeFacts {
    pub horizontal: bool,
    pub inline_axis_is_reverse: bool,
    pub block_axis_is_reverse: bool,
}

impl WritingModeFacts {
    fn of(style: ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> Self {
        Self {
            horizontal: style.writing_mode() == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB,
            inline_axis_is_reverse: style.inline_axis_is_reverse(),
            block_axis_is_reverse: style.block_axis_is_reverse(),
        }
    }
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#scroll-snap-align
// The two values specify the snapping alignment in the block axis and inline axis, respectively, as
// determined by the snap container's writing mode.
pub(crate) fn physical_snap_alignment(
    block_alignment: u8,
    inline_alignment: u8,
    writing_mode: WritingModeFacts,
) -> (u8, u8) {
    // start and end name the edges an axis begins and ends at, which are its lesser and greater
    // physical edges only while the axis runs in the same direction as the physical one.
    let alignment_along_axis = |axis_alignment: u8, axis_is_reverse: bool| {
        if !axis_is_reverse {
            return axis_alignment;
        }
        match axis_alignment {
            scroll_snap_align::START => scroll_snap_align::END,
            scroll_snap_align::END => scroll_snap_align::START,
            other => other,
        }
    };

    let (x_alignment, y_alignment, x_axis_is_reverse, y_axis_is_reverse) = if writing_mode.horizontal {
        (
            inline_alignment,
            block_alignment,
            writing_mode.inline_axis_is_reverse,
            writing_mode.block_axis_is_reverse,
        )
    } else {
        (
            block_alignment,
            inline_alignment,
            writing_mode.block_axis_is_reverse,
            writing_mode.inline_axis_is_reverse,
        )
    };
    (
        alignment_along_axis(x_alignment, x_axis_is_reverse),
        alignment_along_axis(y_alignment, y_axis_is_reverse),
    )
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use libgfx_rust::{scale_matrix, translation_matrix};

    fn px(value: i32) -> CssPixels {
        CssPixels::from_integer(i64::from(value))
    }

    fn rect(x: i32, y: i32, width: i32, height: i32) -> CssPixelRect {
        CssPixelRect::new(px(x), px(y), px(width), px(height))
    }

    const HORIZONTAL_LTR: WritingModeFacts = WritingModeFacts {
        horizontal: true,
        inline_axis_is_reverse: false,
        block_axis_is_reverse: false,
    };

    #[test]
    fn alignment_follows_the_physical_axes_of_the_writing_mode() {
        let (start, end) = (scroll_snap_align::START, scroll_snap_align::END);

        assert_eq!(physical_snap_alignment(start, end, HORIZONTAL_LTR), (end, start));

        let horizontal_rtl = WritingModeFacts {
            inline_axis_is_reverse: true,
            ..HORIZONTAL_LTR
        };
        assert_eq!(physical_snap_alignment(start, start, horizontal_rtl), (end, start));

        let vertical_rl = WritingModeFacts {
            horizontal: false,
            inline_axis_is_reverse: false,
            block_axis_is_reverse: true,
        };
        assert_eq!(physical_snap_alignment(start, start, vertical_rl), (end, start));

        let center = scroll_snap_align::CENTER;
        assert_eq!(physical_snap_alignment(center, center, vertical_rl), (center, center));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_area_is_compared_to_the_snapport_along_its_own_inline_axis() {
        let snapport = rect(0, 0, 200, 200);
        assert!(area_is_larger_than_snapport(rect(0, 0, 300, 100), snapport, true));
        assert!(!area_is_larger_than_snapport(rect(0, 0, 100, 300), snapport, true));
        assert!(area_is_larger_than_snapport(rect(0, 0, 100, 300), snapport, false));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_rect_is_mapped_through_a_transform_about_its_origin() {
        let translated = map_rect_through_css_transform(
            translation_matrix(0.0, -60.0, 0.0),
            FloatPoint { x: 100.0, y: 200.0 },
            rect(0, 100, 200, 200),
        );
        assert_eq!(translated, rect(0, 40, 200, 200));

        let scaled = map_rect_through_css_transform(
            scale_matrix(0.5, 0.5, 1.0),
            FloatPoint { x: 100.0, y: 200.0 },
            rect(0, 100, 200, 200),
        );
        assert_eq!(scaled, rect(50, 150, 100, 100));
    }
}

use crate::css::css_enums::{flex_direction, flex_wrap, writing_mode};
use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelPoint;
use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeFlag, NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::layout::node_facts;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead};
use crate::painting::visual_context::dirty::VisualContextBoxDirtyKind;

pub(crate) struct PhysicalOverflowDirections {
    pub(crate) horizontal_axis_is_positive: bool,
    pub(crate) vertical_axis_is_positive: bool,
}

impl Default for PhysicalOverflowDirections {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            horizontal_axis_is_positive: true,
            vertical_axis_is_positive: true,
        }
    }
}

struct AxisDirection {
    is_horizontal: bool,
    is_reverse: bool,
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#overflow-directions
pub(crate) fn physical_overflow_directions(
    layout_arena: &LayoutNodeArena,
    node: NodeSlotId,
) -> PhysicalOverflowDirections {
    layout_arena.node_style_if_live(node).map_or_else(
        PhysicalOverflowDirections::default,
        physical_overflow_directions_of_style,
    )
}

pub(crate) fn physical_overflow_directions_of_style(
    style: crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'_>,
) -> PhysicalOverflowDirections {
    // A scrolling box of a viewport or element has two overflow directions, which are the block-end and inline-end
    // directions for that viewport or element.
    let mut inline_axis = AxisDirection {
        is_horizontal: style.writing_mode() == writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB,
        is_reverse: style.inline_axis_is_reverse(),
    };
    let mut block_axis = AxisDirection {
        is_horizontal: !inline_axis.is_horizontal,
        is_reverse: style.block_axis_is_reverse(),
    };

    let display = style.display();
    if display.is_flex_inside() {
        let container_flex_direction = style.effective_flex_direction();
        let is_row_layout = matches!(
            container_flex_direction,
            flex_direction::ROW | flex_direction::ROW_REVERSE
        );
        let (main_axis, cross_axis) = if is_row_layout {
            (&mut inline_axis, &mut block_axis)
        } else {
            (&mut block_axis, &mut inline_axis)
        };

        if matches!(
            container_flex_direction,
            flex_direction::ROW_REVERSE | flex_direction::COLUMN_REVERSE
        ) {
            main_axis.is_reverse = !main_axis.is_reverse;
        }

        // AD-HOC: A legacy webkit box ignores `flex-wrap`, matching other engines.
        if !display.is_webkit_box_inside() && style.flex_wrap() == flex_wrap::WRAP_REVERSE {
            cross_axis.is_reverse = !cross_axis.is_reverse;
        }
    }

    let (horizontal_axis, vertical_axis) = if inline_axis.is_horizontal {
        (inline_axis, block_axis)
    } else {
        (block_axis, inline_axis)
    };
    PhysicalOverflowDirections {
        horizontal_axis_is_positive: !horizontal_axis.is_reverse,
        vertical_axis_is_positive: !vertical_axis.is_reverse,
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct ScrollableOverflowState {
    pub(crate) recalculation_requests: Vec<NodeSlotId>,
    pub(crate) scroll_offset_clamp_candidates: Vec<NodeSlotId>,
    pub(crate) geometry_changed: bool,
    pub(crate) scrollability_changed: bool,
}

impl ScrollableOverflowState {
    pub(crate) fn change_awaits_preparation(&self) -> bool {
        self.geometry_changed || self.scrollability_changed
    }
}

impl LayoutNodeArena {
    pub(crate) fn note_scrollable_overflow_change(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        had_scrollable_overflow: bool,
        has_scrollable_overflow: bool,
        changed_outside_layout: bool,
    ) {
        use crate::painting::record::change_ticks::RowPaintChange;
        if changed_outside_layout {
            self.scrollable_overflow.geometry_changed = true;
        }
        self.note_paint_change(
            node,
            RowPaintChange::SCROLL_METADATA | RowPaintChange::DRAWING | RowPaintChange::HIT_TESTING,
        );
        // The root background covers the viewport united with the overflow of the viewport box.
        if self.node_kind_if_live(node) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport)
            && let Some(source) = self.paint_state().root_background_source
        {
            self.note_paint_change(source.root_layout_node, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
        }
        if had_scrollable_overflow != has_scrollable_overflow {
            self.scrollable_overflow.scrollability_changed = true;
            self.note_paint_change(node, RowPaintChange::EVERYTHING_IT_PAINTS);
            self.paintable_rows_mut()
                .note_paint_change_in_paint_subtree(node, RowPaintChange::SCROLL_METADATA);
            self.note_visual_context_box_dirty(node, VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::ScrollableOverflowFlipped);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_scroll_offset_may_leave_range(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        if box_holds_scroll_state(self, node) {
            self.scrollable_overflow.scroll_offset_clamp_candidates.push(node);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn scrollable_overflow_is_settled(&self) -> bool {
        self.scrollable_overflow.recalculation_requests.is_empty()
    }

    pub(crate) fn settle_scrollable_overflow(&mut self) {
        self.recalculate_requested_fragment_overflow();
    }
}

/// Whether a box is a scroll container, or a box whose element or pseudo-element stores a scroll offset that new
/// overflow may have to clamp. The arena sets `NodeFlag::HasScrollOffset` whenever the offset a box holds changes and
/// whenever a box becomes an element's or pseudo-element's box, so the answer is one style query and one flag read.
fn box_holds_scroll_state(arena: &LayoutNodeArena, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    crate::painting::style_queries::is_scroll_container(arena, slot)
        || arena.node_flags_if_live(slot) & NodeFlag::HasScrollOffset as u32 != 0
}

/// Settles the requested overflow recalculation. Answers the scroll offsets new overflow moved out of range, each
/// clamped into it, for the document to store.
#[must_use = "the document stores the clamped scroll offsets"]
pub(crate) fn update_scrollable_overflow(arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena) -> Vec<(NodeSlotId, CssPixelPoint)> {
    arena.settle_scrollable_overflow();
    let mut clamped = Vec::new();
    let candidates = std::mem::take(&mut arena.scrollable_overflow.scroll_offset_clamp_candidates);
    let mut met = crate::fast_hash::FastSet::default();
    for slot in candidates {
        if !met.insert(slot) || !arena.slot_is_live(slot) || !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            continue;
        }
        let offset = arena.row_scroll_offset(slot);
        if offset == CssPixelPoint::default() {
            continue;
        }
        let Some((minimum, maximum)) =
            crate::painting::chrome_geometry::scroll_offset_bounds(&arena.paintable_rows(), slot)
        else {
            continue;
        };
        let offset_in_range = CssPixelPoint::new(
            offset.x.clamp(minimum.x, maximum.x),
            offset.y.clamp(minimum.y, maximum.y),
        );
        if offset_in_range != offset {
            clamped.push((slot, offset_in_range));
        }
    }
    clamped
}

/// Retain the last published transform group, overflow values and overflow directions so a style change can invalidate overflow
/// even after the DOM or an animation has released its previous style record. The snapshot owns
/// its reference to the group, as a style record does, and shares the immutable payload.
pub(crate) struct OverflowStyle {
    transform: crate::css::host_shared::HostShared<crate::css::computed_value_types::TransformValues>,
    overflow: (u8, u8),
    overflow_directions_are_positive: (bool, bool),
}

fn overflow_directions_are_positive(style: crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> (bool, bool) {
    let directions = physical_overflow_directions_of_style(style);
    (
        directions.horizontal_axis_is_positive,
        directions.vertical_axis_is_positive,
    )
}

impl OverflowStyle {
    pub(crate) fn new(style: crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> Self {
        let values = std::ptr::from_ref(style.transform());
        crate::css::computed_values::retain_group_payload(
            crate::css::computed_value_types::STYLE_GROUP_INDEX_TRANSFORM,
            values.cast(),
        );
        Self {
            transform: crate::css::host_shared::HostShared::new(values),
            overflow: (style.overflow_x(), style.overflow_y()),
            overflow_directions_are_positive: overflow_directions_are_positive(style),
        }
    }

    fn transform_matches(&self, style: crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> bool {
        let new = style.transform();
        if std::ptr::eq(self.transform.as_ptr().cast(), new) {
            return true;
        }
        // SAFETY: This snapshot retains the immutable group until it is replaced or dropped.
        let old = unsafe { self.transform.deref() };
        old.transformations == new.transformations
            && old.translate == new.translate
            && old.rotate == new.rotate
            && old.scale == new.scale
            && old.transform_box == new.transform_box
            && old.transform_origin_x == new.transform_origin_x
            && old.transform_origin_y == new.transform_origin_y
            && old.transform_origin_z == new.transform_origin_z
            && old.has_offset_path == new.has_offset_path
            && old.offset_path == new.offset_path
            && old.offset_distance == new.offset_distance
            && old.offset_position == new.offset_position
            && old.offset_anchor == new.offset_anchor
            && old.offset_rotate == new.offset_rotate
    }

    fn overflow_matches(&self, style: crate::css::computed_value_views::ComputedValuesView<'_>) -> bool {
        self.overflow == (style.overflow_x(), style.overflow_y())
            && self.overflow_directions_are_positive == overflow_directions_are_positive(style)
    }
}

/// A fork's snapshot holds its own reference to the group.
impl Clone for OverflowStyle {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        crate::css::computed_values::retain_group_payload(
            crate::css::computed_value_types::STYLE_GROUP_INDEX_TRANSFORM,
            self.transform.as_ptr().cast(),
        );
        Self {
            transform: self.transform,
            overflow: self.overflow,
            overflow_directions_are_positive: self.overflow_directions_are_positive,
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for OverflowStyle {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        crate::css::computed_values::release_group_payload(
            crate::css::computed_value_types::STYLE_GROUP_INDEX_TRANSFORM,
            self.transform.as_ptr().cast(),
        );
    }
}

impl LayoutNodeArena {
    pub(crate) fn invalidate_overflow_after_style_change(&mut self, slot: NodeSlotId) {
        if !self.paintable_row_is_populated(slot) {
            return;
        }
        self.request_ink_overflow_recalculation(slot);
        self.request_inline_ink_overflow_recalculation(slot);
        // A style decides whether a box can be hit, its corners, its writing mode and its stroke.
        self.note_hit_test_items_changed();
        let Some(style) = self.node_style_if_live(slot) else {
            return;
        };
        let (transform_changed, overflow_changed) = self
            .paintable_side_data(slot)
            .overflow_style
            .as_ref()
            .map_or((false, false), |previous| {
                (!previous.transform_matches(style), !previous.overflow_matches(style))
            });
        let overflow_style = OverflowStyle::new(style);
        self.paintable_side_data_mut(slot).overflow_style = Some(overflow_style);
        if transform_changed {
            self.request_containing_block_ink_overflow_recalculation(slot);
        }
        if !transform_changed && !overflow_changed {
            return;
        }
        if self.node_kind_if_live(slot).is_some_and(node_facts::kind_is_svg_box) {
            // SVG consumes transforms during layout, unlike CSS box overflow measurement.
            if transform_changed {
                self.set_needs_layout_update(slot, true);
            }
            return;
        }
        // NB: No cached layout of the box or its ancestors may hold the overflow the style change made stale.
        self.invalidate_fragments_of_self_and_ancestors_for_change_that_sizes_no_box(slot);
        if overflow_changed {
            self.request_fragment_overflow_recalculation(slot);
        }
        self.request_fragment_overflow_recalculation_of_containing_block(slot);
    }
}

/// A highlight pseudo-element whose overlay text paints.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum HighlightPseudoElement {
    Selection,
    SearchText,
    SearchTextCurrent,
    SpellingError,
}

impl HighlightPseudoElement {
    pub(crate) const ALL: [Self; 4] = [
        Self::Selection,
        Self::SearchText,
        Self::SearchTextCurrent,
        Self::SpellingError,
    ];

    /// The pseudo-element's kind, as the style engine numbers an element's pseudo-element records.
    pub(crate) fn pseudo_kind(self) -> u8 {
        match self {
            Self::Selection => SELECTION_PSEUDO_KIND,
            Self::SearchText => SEARCH_TEXT_PSEUDO_KIND,
            Self::SearchTextCurrent => SEARCH_TEXT_CURRENT_PSEUDO_KIND,
            Self::SpellingError => SPELLING_ERROR_PSEUDO_KIND,
        }
    }
}

/// The committed styles of each highlight pseudo-element, for an element's rows.
pub(crate) type HighlightStyleAnswers = [Option<Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>>; 4];

/// The records an element holds for each highlight pseudo-element, zero for none.
pub(crate) type HighlightStyleRecords = [u64; 4];

#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct SelectionRange {
    pub start_offset: usize,
    pub end_offset: usize,
    pub text_states: std::collections::HashMap<NodeSlotId, u8>,
    pub boxes_with_selection_state: Vec<NodeSlotId>,
}

fn invalidate_text_node(layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>, node: NodeSlotId) {
    if let Some(containing_block) = text_fragment::containing_block_paintable_of_node(layout_arena, node) {
        layout_arena.note_paint_change(containing_block, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
    }
    if let Some(inline_box) = fragment_ownership::nearest_self_painting_inline_box(layout_arena, node) {
        layout_arena.note_paint_change(inline_box, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
    }
}

pub(crate) fn clear(layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>) {
    let Some(previous) = layout_arena.paint_state_mut().selection.take() else {
        return;
    };
    for node in previous.text_states.keys() {
        invalidate_text_node(layout_arena, *node);
    }
    for &row in &previous.boxes_with_selection_state {
        if layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(row)
            && layout_arena.paintable_data(row).selection_state != SELECTION_STATE_NONE
        {
            layout_arena.paintable_data_mut(row).selection_state = SELECTION_STATE_NONE;
            layout_arena.note_paint_change(row, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn apply(
    layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>,
    entries: &[FfiSelectionEntry],
    start_offset: usize,
    end_offset: usize,
) -> SelectionRange {
    clear(layout_arena);
    let mut text_states = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    let mut boxes_with_selection_state = Vec::new();
    for entry in entries {
        if entry.is_text_node_entry {
            for &node in layout_arena.text_fragments(entry.layout_node).as_slice() {
                text_states.insert(node, entry.state);
                invalidate_text_node(layout_arena, node);
            }
        } else {
            if !layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(entry.layout_node) {
                continue;
            }
            if layout_arena.paintable_data(entry.layout_node).selection_state != entry.state {
                layout_arena.paintable_data_mut(entry.layout_node).selection_state = entry.state;
                layout_arena.note_paint_change(entry.layout_node, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
                boxes_with_selection_state.push(entry.layout_node);
            }
        }
    }
    SelectionRange {
        start_offset,
        end_offset,
        text_states,
        boxes_with_selection_state,
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct SearchTextMatch {
    pub start_offset: usize,
    pub end_offset: usize,
    pub is_current: bool,
}

impl SearchTextMatch {
    /// Where the match starts and ends in the text of a node it touches, given its selection state there.
    pub(crate) fn offsets_in_node(&self, state: u8) -> (usize, usize) {
        let starts_in_node = state == SELECTION_STATE_START || state == SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END;
        let ends_in_node = state == SELECTION_STATE_END || state == SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END;
        (
            if starts_in_node { self.start_offset } else { 0 },
            if ends_in_node { self.end_offset } else { usize::MAX },
        )
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct SearchTextHighlights {
    pub matches: Vec<SearchTextMatch>,
    /// For each node, the matches touching it with their selection states there, in the order they start in the
    /// node. Find-in-page matches do not overlap, so they also end in that order.
    pub by_node: std::collections::HashMap<NodeSlotId, Vec<(u32, u8)>>,
}

impl SearchTextHighlights {
    fn node_signature(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Vec<(u8, usize, usize, bool)> {
        let mut signature: Vec<_> = self
            .by_node
            .get(&node)
            .map(|touching| {
                touching
                    .iter()
                    .map(|&(match_index, state)| {
                        let found = &self.matches[match_index as usize];
                        (state, found.start_offset, found.end_offset, found.is_current)
                    })
                    .collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();
        signature.sort_unstable();
        signature
    }
}

pub(crate) fn clear_search_text(layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>) {
    let previous = std::mem::take(&mut layout_arena.paint_state_mut().search_text);
    for node in previous.by_node.keys() {
        invalidate_text_node(layout_arena, *node);
    }
}

pub(crate) fn apply_search_text(
    layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>,
    ranges: &[FfiSearchTextRange],
    entries: &[FfiSelectionEntry],
) {
    let mut highlights = SearchTextHighlights::default();
    for range in ranges {
        let match_index = highlights.matches.len() as u32;
        highlights.matches.push(SearchTextMatch {
            start_offset: range.start_offset,
            end_offset: range.end_offset,
            is_current: range.is_current,
        });
        let range_entries = entries
            .get(range.first_entry..range.first_entry + range.entry_count)
            .unwrap_or_default();
        for entry in range_entries.iter().filter(|entry| entry.is_text_node_entry) {
            for &node in layout_arena.text_fragments(entry.layout_node).as_slice() {
                highlights
                    .by_node
                    .entry(node)
                    .or_default()
                    .push((match_index, entry.state));
            }
        }
    }
    let matches = &highlights.matches;
    for touching in highlights.by_node.values_mut() {
        touching.sort_by_key(|&(match_index, state)| matches[match_index as usize].offsets_in_node(state));
    }
    let previous = std::mem::take(&mut layout_arena.paint_state_mut().search_text);
    for node in previous.by_node.keys().chain(highlights.by_node.keys()) {
        if previous.node_signature(*node) != highlights.node_signature(*node) {
            invalidate_text_node(layout_arena, *node);
        }
    }
    layout_arena.paint_state_mut().search_text = Arc::new(highlights);
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct SpellingErrorHighlights {
    /// For each text fragment row, the misspelled runs of its DOM text, as start and end offsets in order.
    pub by_node: std::collections::HashMap<NodeSlotId, Vec<(usize, usize)>>,
}

pub(crate) fn clear_spelling_errors(layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>) {
    let previous = std::mem::take(&mut layout_arena.paint_state_mut().spelling_errors);
    for node in previous.by_node.keys() {
        invalidate_text_node(layout_arena, *node);
    }
}

pub(crate) fn apply_spelling_errors(layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>, errors: &[FfiSpellingError]) {
    let mut highlights = SpellingErrorHighlights::default();
    for error in errors {
        for &node in layout_arena.text_fragments(error.layout_node).as_slice() {
            highlights
                .by_node
                .entry(node)
                .or_default()
                .push((error.start_offset, error.end_offset));
        }
    }
    for runs in highlights.by_node.values_mut() {
        runs.sort_unstable();
    }
    let previous = std::mem::take(&mut layout_arena.paint_state_mut().spelling_errors);
    for node in previous.by_node.keys().chain(highlights.by_node.keys()) {
        if previous.by_node.get(node) != highlights.by_node.get(node) {
            invalidate_text_node(layout_arena, *node);
        }
    }
    layout_arena.paint_state_mut().spelling_errors = Arc::new(highlights);
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct CustomHighlights {
    /// The custom highlight name of each layer, from bottom to top.
    pub layers: Vec<StyleAtomID>,
    /// For each text fragment row, the runs of its DOM text each layer covers, as layer and start and end offsets.
    pub text_runs: std::collections::HashMap<NodeSlotId, Vec<(u32, usize, usize)>>,
    /// For each replaced row, the layers whose ranges contain its element, from bottom to top.
    pub replaced: std::collections::HashMap<NodeSlotId, Vec<u32>>,
}

impl CustomHighlights {
    fn text_signature(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Vec<(StyleAtomID, usize, usize)> {
        self.text_runs
            .get(&node)
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .map(|&(layer, start, end)| (self.layers[layer as usize], start, end))
            .collect()
    }

    fn replaced_signature(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> Vec<StyleAtomID> {
        self.replaced
            .get(&node)
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .map(|&layer| self.layers[layer as usize])
            .collect()
    }

    pub(crate) fn forget_row(&mut self, node: NodeSlotId) {
        self.text_runs.remove(&node);
        self.replaced.remove(&node);
    }

    pub(crate) fn covers_row(&self, node: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
        self.text_runs.contains_key(&node) || self.replaced.contains_key(&node)
    }
}

fn damage_custom_highlight_changes(
    layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>,
    previous: &CustomHighlights,
    highlights: &CustomHighlights,
) {
    for node in previous.text_runs.keys().chain(highlights.text_runs.keys()) {
        if previous.text_signature(*node) != highlights.text_signature(*node) {
            invalidate_text_node(layout_arena, *node);
        }
    }
    for &node in previous.replaced.keys().chain(highlights.replaced.keys()) {
        if previous.replaced_signature(node) != highlights.replaced_signature(node)
            && layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node)
        {
            layout_arena.note_paint_change(node, RowPaintChange::DRAWING);
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn clear_custom_highlights(layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>) {
    let previous = std::mem::take(&mut layout_arena.paint_state_mut().custom_highlights);
    damage_custom_highlight_changes(layout_arena, &previous, &CustomHighlights::default());
}

pub(crate) fn apply_custom_highlights(
    layout_arena: &mut PaintableRowsMut<'_>,
    layers: &[StyleAtomID],
    text_entries: &[FfiCustomHighlightTextEntry],
    replaced_entries: &[FfiCustomHighlightReplacedEntry],
) {
    let mut highlights = CustomHighlights {
        layers: layers.to_vec(),
        ..CustomHighlights::default()
    };
    for entry in text_entries
        .iter()
        .filter(|entry| (entry.layer as usize) < layers.len())
    {
        for &node in layout_arena.text_fragments(entry.layout_node).as_slice() {
            highlights
                .text_runs
                .entry(node)
                .or_default()
                .push((entry.layer, entry.start_offset, entry.end_offset));
        }
    }
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#painting
    // Overlapping ranges within a single custom highlight are rendered as if a single range representing the union
    // of the overlapping ones had been specified.
    for runs in highlights.text_runs.values_mut() {
        runs.sort_unstable();
        let mut merged: Vec<(u32, usize, usize)> = Vec::with_capacity(runs.len());
        for &(layer, start, end) in runs.iter() {
            match merged.last_mut() {
                Some(last) if last.0 == layer && start <= last.2 => last.2 = last.2.max(end),
                _ => merged.push((layer, start, end)),
            }
        }
        *runs = merged;
    }
    for entry in replaced_entries
        .iter()
        .filter(|entry| (entry.layer as usize) < layers.len())
    {
        if layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(entry.layout_node) {
            highlights
                .replaced
                .entry(entry.layout_node)
                .or_default()
                .push(entry.layer);
        }
    }
    for layers in highlights.replaced.values_mut() {
        layers.sort_unstable();
        layers.dedup();
    }
    let previous = std::mem::take(&mut layout_arena.paint_state_mut().custom_highlights);
    damage_custom_highlight_changes(layout_arena, &previous, &highlights);
    layout_arena.paint_state_mut().custom_highlights = Arc::new(highlights);
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-pseudo-4/#highlight-styling
/// What text under `element` paints with inside a highlight pseudo-element, read from
/// `style_record`, the element's record for that pseudo-element (zero for none), or `None` when
/// that record styles nothing a highlight paints.
fn highlight_pseudo_style_of_record(
    engine: &crate::css::style::RetainedState,
    element: StyleNodeID,
    style_record: u64,
    takes_own_decoration_metrics: bool,
) -> Option<SelectionStyleAnswer> {
    use crate::css::computed_longhand_table::{HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_IS_CURRENT_COLOR, HIGHLIGHT_COLORS_AUTHORED};
    use crate::css::property_metadata::property_id;
    let style = engine.published_record_view(style_record)?;
    let dependency_flags = engine.published_record_dependency_flags(style_record).unwrap_or(0);
    let longhands = engine.published_record_longhands(style_record);
    let specified_as_current_color =
        |property_id: u16| longhands.is_some_and(|longhands| longhands.specified_value_is_current_color(property_id));
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-pseudo-4/#paired-defaults
    // Paired default highlight colors must only be used when neither 'color' nor 'background-color' yield a
    // cascaded value from the author origin (or inherit their value from the author origin).
    let mut facts = FfiSelectionStyleFacts {
        colors_authored: dependency_flags & HIGHLIGHT_COLORS_AUTHORED != 0,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    if facts.colors_authored {
        facts.background_color = Color(style.background_color());
        facts.background_color_is_current_color = specified_as_current_color(property_id::BACKGROUND_COLOR);
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-pseudo-4/#highlight-text
        // currentColor on a highlight pseudo-element's 'color' property represents the color of the next active
        // highlight pseudo-element layer below, falling back finally to the colors that would otherwise have been
        // used.
        if dependency_flags & HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_IS_CURRENT_COLOR == 0 {
            facts.text_color = OptionalColor::some(Color(style.inherited_text().color));
        }

        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-pseudo-4/#highlight-replaced
        // This wash should be of the specified 'background-color' if that is not 'transparent', else of the
        // specified 'color'; however the UA may adjust the alpha channel.
        let mut wash_color = facts.background_color;
        if wash_color.alpha() == 0 {
            wash_color = facts.text_color.get().unwrap_or_else(|| {
                Color(
                    engine
                        .published_style_view(element, None)
                        .map_or(0, |element_style| element_style.inherited_text().color),
                )
            });
        }
        facts.wash_color = transform_selection_background_color(wash_color);
    }

    let shadow_colors_are_current_color = longhands
        .map(|longhands| longhands.text_shadow_layer_colors_are_current_color())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let shadows: Vec<HighlightShadowLayer> = style
        .inherited_text()
        .text_shadow
        .as_slice()
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, shadow)| HighlightShadowLayer {
            layer: ShadowLayer {
                color: shadow.color.resolve(style.current_color()),
                offset_x: CssPixels::from_raw(shadow.offset_x),
                offset_y: CssPixels::from_raw(shadow.offset_y),
                blur_radius: CssPixels::from_raw(shadow.blur_radius),
            },
            color_is_current_color: shadow_colors_are_current_color.get(index).copied().unwrap_or(false),
        })
        .collect();
    facts.has_text_shadow = !shadows.is_empty();

    let text_reset = style.text_reset();
    let lines = text_reset.text_decoration_lines.as_slice();
    let mut decoration_metrics = None;
    if !lines.is_empty() && takes_own_decoration_metrics {
        let inherited_text = style.inherited_text();
        let element_font_size = engine
            .published_style_view(element, None)
            .map_or(CssPixels::from_raw(0), |element_style| element_style.font_size());
        decoration_metrics = Some(HighlightDecorationMetrics {
            thickness: (text_reset.text_decoration_thickness_kind == 2).then(|| {
                text_reset
                    .text_decoration_thickness
                    .length_percentage()
                    .map_or(CssPixels::from_integer(1), |value| value.to_px(element_font_size))
                    .max(CssPixels::from_integer(1))
            }),
            underline_offset: inherited_text.text_underline_offset.used_value,
            underline_position_horizontal: inherited_text.text_underline_position.horizontal,
            underline_position_vertical: inherited_text.text_underline_position.vertical,
            skip_ink: inherited_text.text_decoration_skip_ink,
        });
    }
    if !lines.is_empty() {
        facts.has_text_decoration = true;
        let count = lines.len().min(facts.text_decoration_lines.len());
        facts.text_decoration_lines[..count].copy_from_slice(&lines[..count]);
        facts.text_decoration_line_count = count as u32;
        facts.text_decoration_style = text_reset.text_decoration_style;
        facts.text_decoration_color = Color(style.text_decoration_color());
        facts.text_decoration_color_is_current_color = specified_as_current_color(property_id::TEXT_DECORATION_COLOR);
    }

    (facts.colors_authored || facts.has_text_shadow || facts.has_text_decoration).then_some(SelectionStyleAnswer {
        facts,
        shadows,
        decoration_metrics,
    })
}

/// The UA's adjustment of a selection wash's alpha channel: an opaque color becomes the most
/// transparent color that, over white, still looks the same.
fn transform_selection_background_color(color: Color) -> Color {
    if color.alpha() < 255 {
        return color;
    }

    const START_ALPHA: i32 = 153; // 60%
    const END_ALPHA: i32 = 204; // 80%
    const ALPHA_INCREMENT: i32 = 17;

    let blend_component = |component: u8, alpha: i32| (i32::from(component) - (255 - alpha)) * 255 / alpha;

    let mut result = Color::default();
    let mut alpha = START_ALPHA;
    while alpha <= END_ALPHA {
        let red = blend_component(color.red(), alpha);
        let green = blend_component(color.green(), alpha);
        let blue = blend_component(color.blue(), alpha);
        result = Color::from_rgba(
            red.clamp(0, 255) as u8,
            green.clamp(0, 255) as u8,
            blue.clamp(0, 255) as u8,
            alpha as u8,
        );
        if red >= 0 && green >= 0 && blue >= 0 {
            break;
        }
        alpha += ALPHA_INCREMENT;
    }
    result
}

fn highlight_pseudo_styles_of_records(
    arena: &LayoutNodeArena,
    element: StyleNodeID,
    style_records: HighlightStyleRecords,
) -> HighlightStyleAnswers {
    arena.with_style_store(|engine| {
        style_records
            .map(|style_record| highlight_pseudo_style_of_record(engine, element, style_record, false).map(Arc::new))
    })
}

/// Gives the rows that paint text under `element` what `style_records`, the highlight
/// pseudo-element records the host holds for it, say highlighted text paints with: the element's
/// own rows, or, while it has no box, the rows of its text children, which then have no element
/// row above them to find it on.
pub(crate) fn sync_highlight_pseudo_styles(
    arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena,
    element: StyleNodeID,
    style_records: HighlightStyleRecords,
) {
    let answers = highlight_pseudo_styles_of_records(arena, element, style_records);
    let element_row = arena.bound_row(element);
    let text_rows_answers = if element_row.is_invalid() {
        answers.clone()
    } else {
        HighlightStyleAnswers::default()
    };
    for row in text_child_rows(arena, element) {
        let rows: Vec<NodeSlotId> = arena.rows_sharing_dom_node_with(row).collect();
        set_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(arena, &rows, &text_rows_answers);
    }
    if !element_row.is_invalid() {
        let rows: Vec<NodeSlotId> = arena.rows_sharing_dom_node_with(element_row).collect();
        set_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(arena, &rows, &answers);
    }
}

/// Gives the rows that paint text under `element` `selection_record`, the record of its `::selection` a clock lane
/// styled, zero for none. The other highlight pseudo-elements stay as the host published them.
pub(crate) fn sync_selection_style(arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena, element: StyleNodeID, selection_record: u64) {
    let style_records = arena.with_style_store(|engine| {
        HighlightPseudoElement::ALL.map(|highlight| match highlight {
            HighlightPseudoElement::Selection => selection_record,
            _ => engine
                .pseudo_published_style_record(element, highlight.pseudo_kind())
                .unwrap_or(0),
        })
    });
    sync_highlight_pseudo_styles(arena, element, style_records);
}

fn text_child_rows(arena: &LayoutNodeArena, element: StyleNodeID) -> Vec<NodeSlotId> {
    arena.with_style_store(|engine| {
        engine
            .dom_children(element)
            .filter(|child| child.text_index().is_some())
            .map(|text| arena.bound_row(text))
            .filter(|row| !row.is_invalid())
            .collect()
    })
}

type CustomHighlightStyleAnswers = Vec<(StyleAtomID, Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>)>;

fn custom_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_records(
    arena: &LayoutNodeArena,
    element: StyleNodeID,
    style_records: &[(StyleAtomID, u64)],
) -> CustomHighlightStyleAnswers {
    arena.with_style_store(|engine| {
        style_records
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|&(name, style_record)| {
                // Custom highlights take their decoration metrics from their own style, matching other engines.
                Some((
                    name,
                    Arc::new(highlight_pseudo_style_of_record(engine, element, style_record, true)?),
                ))
            })
            .collect()
    })
}

pub(crate) fn sync_custom_highlight_pseudo_styles(
    arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena,
    element: StyleNodeID,
    style_records: &[(StyleAtomID, u64)],
) {
    let answers = custom_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_records(arena, element, style_records);
    let element_row = arena.bound_row(element);
    for row in text_child_rows(arena, element) {
        let rows: Vec<NodeSlotId> = arena.rows_sharing_dom_node_with(row).collect();
        let text_rows_answers = if element_row.is_invalid() { &answers[..] } else { &[] };
        set_custom_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(arena, &rows, text_rows_answers);
    }
    if !element_row.is_invalid() {
        let rows: Vec<NodeSlotId> = arena.rows_sharing_dom_node_with(element_row).collect();
        set_custom_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(arena, &rows, &answers);
    }
}

fn set_custom_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(
    arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena,
    rows: &[NodeSlotId],
    answers: &[(StyleAtomID, Arc<SelectionStyleAnswer>)],
) {
    let paint_state = arena.paint_state_mut();
    let unstyled: Vec<StyleAtomID> = paint_state
        .custom_highlight_pseudo_styles
        .iter()
        .filter(|(name, styles)| {
            !answers.iter().any(|(answered, _)| answered == *name) && rows.iter().any(|row| styles.contains_key(row))
        })
        .map(|(name, _)| *name)
        .collect();
    if unstyled.is_empty() && answers.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let table = Arc::make_mut(&mut paint_state.custom_highlight_pseudo_styles);
    for name in unstyled {
        if let Some(styles) = table.get_mut(&name) {
            let styles = Arc::make_mut(styles);
            for row in rows {
                styles.remove(row);
            }
            if styles.is_empty() {
                table.remove(&name);
            }
        }
    }
    for (name, answer) in answers {
        let styles = Arc::make_mut(table.entry(*name).or_default());
        for &row in rows {
            styles.insert(row, answer.clone());
        }
    }
    request_ink_for_highlight_style_rows(arena, rows);
}

/// Gives a row the tree build made what the published highlight pseudo-element records of
/// `element` say highlighted text paints with: `element`'s own row, or a text row whose parent
/// element has no box.
pub(crate) fn note_built_row_highlight_pseudo_styles(
    arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena,
    row: NodeSlotId,
    element: StyleNodeID,
) {
    let (style_records, custom_style_records) = arena.with_style_store(|engine| {
        (
            HighlightPseudoElement::ALL.map(|highlight| {
                engine
                    .pseudo_published_style_record(element, highlight.pseudo_kind())
                    .unwrap_or(0)
            }),
            engine.pseudo_published_custom_highlight_records(element),
        )
    });
    let answers = highlight_pseudo_styles_of_records(arena, element, style_records);
    let custom_answers = custom_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_records(arena, element, &custom_style_records);
    let rows: Vec<NodeSlotId> = arena.rows_sharing_dom_node_with(row).collect();
    set_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(arena, &rows, &answers);
    set_custom_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(arena, &rows, &custom_answers);
}

fn set_highlight_pseudo_styles_of_rows(
    arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena,
    rows: &[NodeSlotId],
    answers: &HighlightStyleAnswers,
) {
    let mut changed = false;
    let paint_state = arena.paint_state_mut();
    for (highlight, answer) in HighlightPseudoElement::ALL.into_iter().zip(answers) {
        let styles = paint_state.highlight_pseudo_styles_mut(highlight);
        for &row in rows {
            match answer {
                Some(answer) => {
                    changed = true;
                    Arc::make_mut(styles).insert(row, answer.clone());
                }
                None if styles.contains_key(&row) => {
                    changed = true;
                    Arc::make_mut(styles).remove(&row);
                }
                None => {}
            }
        }
    }
    if changed {
        request_ink_for_highlight_style_rows(arena, rows);
    }
}

fn request_ink_for_highlight_style_rows(arena: &mut LayoutNodeArena, rows: &[NodeSlotId]) {
    for &row in rows {
        arena.request_ink_overflow_recalculation(row);
        arena.request_inline_ink_overflow_recalculation(row);
        let source = arena.paintable_rows();
        let line_root = text_fragment::containing_block_paintable_of_node(&source, row);
        let inline = fragment_ownership::nearest_self_painting_inline_box(&source, row);
        if let Some(root) = line_root {
            arena.request_ink_overflow_recalculation(root);
        }
        if let Some(inline) = inline {
            arena.request_ink_overflow_recalculation(inline);
        }
    }
}

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect;
use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::dump::push_css_pixel_rect;
use crate::painting::paint_read::{GeometryRead, PaintRead};
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;
use crate::painting::style_queries;
use crate::stage::MainThread;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::fmt::Write;

/// What a stacking context dump asks the document. The fields are private: the callbacks are
/// reached only through the methods below, which take the main thread token.
///
/// NB: The callbacks are typed as safe functions because the table only comes from the host through an export
///     whose safety contract keeps them callable, and the private fields let nothing else call them.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiStackingContextDumpCallbacks {
    context: *mut c_void,
    /// Describes the row in the slot, as its layout node describes itself.
    debug_description: extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void, slot: NodeSlotId, description_sink: *mut c_void),
    append_text: extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void, bytes: *const u8, byte_count: usize),
}

crate::stage::main_thread_ffi_entries!();

impl FfiStackingContextDumpCallbacks {
    fn debug_description(&self, _: &MainThread, slot: NodeSlotId) -> String {
        let mut description = Vec::new();
        // The C++ host fills the description sink synchronously through the exported push
        // function.
        (self.debug_description)(self.context, slot, (&raw mut description).cast());
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&description).into_owned()
    }

    fn append_text(&self, _: &MainThread, text: &str) {
        // The C++ sink copies the completed dump synchronously.
        (self.append_text)(self.context, text.as_ptr(), text.len());
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread. `debug_description` is called synchronously with a `Vec<u8>` sink the host fills through
/// `layout_arena_paint_push_bytes`, and `append_text` copies the completed dump synchronously.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_dump_stacking_context_tree(
    host: &crate::render_state::DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    callbacks: FfiStackingContextDumpCallbacks,
) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let main_thread = unsafe { main_thread(host) };
    crate::painting::paint_passes::prepare_paint_properties(&main_thread, host, read);
    let lines = {
        crate::painting::ffi::read_arena(host, read, viewport, |arena, viewport| {
            let mut lines = Vec::new();
            if arena.stacking_context_entries(viewport).is_some() {
                visit(&mut lines, arena, viewport, 0);
            }
            lines
        })
    };
    if lines.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let mut output = String::new();
    for line in lines {
        output.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(' ', line.depth));
        match line.context {
            None => output.push_str("SC for (gone)\n"),
            Some(context) => push_line(
                &mut output,
                &callbacks.debug_description(&main_thread, context.slot),
                context.rect,
                context.effective_z_index,
                context.has_transform,
            ),
        }
    }
    callbacks.append_text(&main_thread, &output);
}

/// One line of a stacking context dump: how deep the context is, and what its row says of it, or none for a row that
/// is gone.
struct DumpLine {
    depth: usize,
    context: Option<DumpedContext>,
}

struct DumpedContext {
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    rect: CssPixelRect,
    effective_z_index: Option<i32>,
    has_transform: bool,
}

fn visit(lines: &mut Vec<DumpLine>, arena: &LayoutNodeArena, root: NodeSlotId, depth: usize) {
    lines.push(DumpLine {
        depth,
        context: arena.slot_is_live(root).then(|| DumpedContext {
            slot: root,
            rect: paintable_geometry::absolute_rect_or_default(&arena.paintable_rows(), root),
            effective_z_index: effective_z_index(arena, root),
            has_transform: has_css_transform(arena, root),
        }),
    });

    let Some(entries) = arena.stacking_context_entries(root) else {
        return;
    };
    for entry in entries.negative_z_index_child_contexts() {
        visit(lines, arena, entry.slot, depth + 1);
    }
    for &descendant in &entries.stack_level_zero_boxes {
        if arena.paintable_row_is_populated(descendant)
            && arena
                .paintable_rows()
                .paintable_data(descendant)
                .establishes_stacking_context
        {
            visit(lines, arena, descendant, depth + 1);
        }
    }
    for entry in entries.positive_z_index_child_contexts() {
        visit(lines, arena, entry.slot, depth + 1);
    }
}

fn push_line(
    output: &mut String,
    description: &str,
    rect: CssPixelRect,
    effective_z_index: Option<i32>,
    has_transform: bool,
) {
    let _ = write!(output, "SC for {description} ");
    push_css_pixel_rect(output, rect);
    output.push_str(" (z-index: ");
    if let Some(z_index) = effective_z_index {
        let _ = write!(output, "{z_index}");
    } else {
        output.push_str("auto");
    }
    output.push(')');
    if has_transform {
        output.push_str(", has_transform");
    }
    output.push('\n');
}

fn effective_z_index(arena: &LayoutNodeArena, slot: NodeSlotId) -> Option<i32> {
    arena
        .paintable_visual_context_record(slot)
        .and_then(|record| record.stacking_context.effective_z_index)
}

fn has_css_transform(arena: &LayoutNodeArena, slot: NodeSlotId) -> bool {
    arena.paintable_row_is_populated(slot)
        && arena
            .node_style_if_live(slot)
            .is_some_and(|style| style_queries::has_css_transform(arena, slot, style))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::push_line;
    use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelRect, CssPixels};

    #[test]
    fn stacking_context_lines_match_the_canonical_format() {
        let rect = CssPixelRect::new(
            CssPixels::from_integer(1),
            CssPixels::from_integer(2),
            CssPixels::from_integer(30),
            CssPixels::from_integer(40),
        );
        let mut output = String::new();
        push_line(&mut output, "Viewport<#document>", rect, None, false);
        push_line(&mut output, "BlockContainer<DIV>#target.a.b", rect, Some(-1), true);
        assert_eq!(
            output,
            concat!(
                "SC for Viewport<#document> [1,2 30x40] (z-index: auto)\n",
                "SC for BlockContainer<DIV>#target.a.b [1,2 30x40] (z-index: -1), has_transform\n",
            )
        );
    }
}

/*
