use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelRect;
use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::layout::node_facts;
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::paintable_data::FragmentRecord;
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;

pub(crate) fn containing_block_paintable_of_node(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    node: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    if layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
        let block = layout_arena.paintable_data(node).containing_block;
        return layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(block).then_some(block);
    }
    let block = layout_arena.node_containing_block_if_live(node)?;
    layout_arena.paintable_row_is_populated(block).then_some(block)
}

pub(crate) fn containing_block_paintable(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    containing_block_paintable_of_node(layout_arena, fragment.layout_node)
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_rect(layout_arena: &impl PaintRead, fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> CssPixelRect {
    let rect = rect_in_containing_block(fragment);
    match containing_block_paintable(layout_arena, fragment) {
        Some(block) => rect.translated_by(paintable_geometry::absolute_line_root_position(
            layout_arena,
            block,
            fragment.line_index as usize,
        )),
        None => rect,
    }
}

/// The fragment's rect relative to its containing block, which is the box whose line boxes hold it.
pub(crate) fn rect_in_containing_block(fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> CssPixelRect {
    let (x, y) = fragment.offset();
    let (width, height) = fragment.size();
    CssPixelRect {
        x: x + fragment.relpos_delta.x,
        y: y + fragment.relpos_delta.y,
        width,
        height,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn absolute_line_box_rect(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    owner: NodeSlotId,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    let side = layout_arena.committed_side_data(owner);
    let lines = &side.lines();
    let Some(line) = lines.get(fragment.line_index as usize) else {
        return CssPixelRect::default();
    };
    let mut rect = CssPixelRect::from(line.rect);
    if let Some(block) = containing_block_paintable(layout_arena, fragment) {
        rect = rect.translated_by(paintable_geometry::absolute_line_root_position(
            layout_arena,
            block,
            fragment.line_index as usize,
        ));
    }
    rect
}

pub(crate) fn is_horizontal(fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> bool {
    fragment.writing_mode == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::HORIZONTAL_TB
}

/// Whether the inline axis of a vertical fragment runs upwards, as in sideways-lr, whose glyphs are turned a quarter
/// turn counterclockwise: Its text starts at the bottom of the fragment, and the line-over side is on the left.
pub(crate) fn runs_upwards(fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> bool {
    fragment.writing_mode == crate::css::css_enums::writing_mode::SIDEWAYS_LR
}

fn primary_size(rect: CssPixelRect, horizontal: bool) -> CssPixels {
    if horizontal { rect.width } else { rect.height }
}

fn secondary_size(rect: CssPixelRect, horizontal: bool) -> CssPixels {
    if horizontal { rect.height } else { rect.width }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SelectionOffsets {
    pub start: usize,
    pub end: usize,
}

pub(crate) fn range_rect(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    selection_state: u8,
    start_offset_in_code_units: usize,
    end_offset_in_code_units: usize,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    match compute_selection_offsets(
        layout_arena,
        fragment,
        selection_state,
        start_offset_in_code_units,
        end_offset_in_code_units,
    ) {
        Some(offsets) => rect_for_selection_offsets(layout_arena, fragment, offsets),
        None => CssPixelRect::default(),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn compute_selection_offsets(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    selection_state: u8,
    start_offset_in_code_units: usize,
    end_offset_in_code_units: usize,
) -> Option<SelectionOffsets> {
    let length_with_trailing_whitespace =
        fragment.length_in_code_units + fragment.trimmed_trailing_whitespace.length_in_code_units;
    let dom_start = fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node;
    let dom_end = fragment.dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace;
    let rendered_offset_for_dom_offset = |dom_offset, boundary| {
        let rendered_offset =
            layout_arena.rendered_text_offset_for_dom_offset(fragment.layout_node, dom_offset, boundary);
        rendered_offset.clamp(fragment.start, fragment.start + length_with_trailing_whitespace) - fragment.start
    };
    match selection_state {
        crate::painting::paintable_data::SELECTION_STATE_NONE => None,
        crate::painting::paintable_data::SELECTION_STATE_FULL => Some(SelectionOffsets {
            start: 0,
            end: length_with_trailing_whitespace,
        }),
        crate::painting::paintable_data::SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END => selection_offsets_for_dom_range(
            layout_arena,
            fragment,
            start_offset_in_code_units,
            end_offset_in_code_units,
        ),
        crate::painting::paintable_data::SELECTION_STATE_START => {
            if dom_end < start_offset_in_code_units {
                return None;
            }
            Some(SelectionOffsets {
                start: rendered_offset_for_dom_offset(
                    start_offset_in_code_units,
                    crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::Start,
                ),
                end: length_with_trailing_whitespace,
            })
        }
        crate::painting::paintable_data::SELECTION_STATE_END => {
            if dom_start > end_offset_in_code_units {
                return None;
            }
            Some(SelectionOffsets {
                start: 0,
                end: rendered_offset_for_dom_offset(end_offset_in_code_units, crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::End),
            })
        }
        _ => unreachable!("invalid selection state"),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn for_each_fragment_of_nodes(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    node_slots: &[NodeSlotId],
    mut callback: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId, u32, &FragmentRecord) -> bool,
) {
    // OPTIMIZATION: Up to this many fragments, a scan costs less than building an index would.
    const MAX_FRAGMENTS_TO_SCAN: usize = 32;

    for &node in node_slots {
        let Some(block) = containing_block_paintable_of_node(layout_arena, node) else {
            continue;
        };
        let side_data = layout_arena.committed_side_data(block);
        let fragments = side_data.fragments();
        if fragments.len() <= MAX_FRAGMENTS_TO_SCAN {
            for (index, fragment) in fragments.iter().enumerate() {
                if fragment.layout_node == node && !callback(block, index as u32, fragment) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            continue;
        }
        for &index in side_data.fragment_indices_of(node) {
            if !callback(block, index, &fragments[index as usize]) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum CaretMatch {
    None,
    Direct,
    SoftWrapFallback,
}

pub(crate) fn caret_match(fragment: &FragmentRecord, offset: usize, affinity_is_downstream: bool) -> CaretMatch {
    let dom_start = fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node;
    let dom_end_with_trailing_whitespace = fragment.dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace;
    if offset < dom_start || offset > dom_end_with_trailing_whitespace {
        return CaretMatch::None;
    }
    if affinity_is_downstream && offset == dom_end_with_trailing_whitespace {
        return CaretMatch::SoftWrapFallback;
    }
    CaretMatch::Direct
}

pub(crate) fn selection_offsets_for_dom_range(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    start_offset_in_code_units: usize,
    end_offset_in_code_units: usize,
) -> Option<SelectionOffsets> {
    let length_with_trailing_whitespace =
        fragment.length_in_code_units + fragment.trimmed_trailing_whitespace.length_in_code_units;
    let dom_start = fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node;
    let dom_end = fragment.dom_end_offset_with_trailing_whitespace;
    if dom_start > end_offset_in_code_units || dom_end < start_offset_in_code_units {
        return None;
    }
    let rendered_start = layout_arena.rendered_text_offset_for_dom_offset(
        fragment.layout_node,
        start_offset_in_code_units,
        crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::Start,
    );
    let rendered_end = layout_arena.rendered_text_offset_for_dom_offset(
        fragment.layout_node,
        end_offset_in_code_units,
        crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::End,
    );
    Some(SelectionOffsets {
        start: rendered_start.clamp(fragment.start, fragment.start + length_with_trailing_whitespace) - fragment.start,
        end: rendered_end.clamp(fragment.start, fragment.start + length_with_trailing_whitespace) - fragment.start,
    })
}

/// Calls `callback` with each DOM offset (in UTF-16 code units) that the horizontal `fragment` renders, from its first
/// offset through the one past its last, along with the document-absolute x coordinate of the caret in front of that
/// offset's character (or, for the last one, where the fragment's text ends), read from the fragment's shaped glyphs.
pub(crate) fn for_each_dom_offset_x(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    mut callback: impl FnMut(usize, f32),
) {
    if !is_horizontal(fragment) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(run) = &fragment.glyph_run else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(rendered_text) = layout_arena.rendered_text(fragment.layout_node) else {
        return;
    };
    let geometry = run.cluster_geometry();
    let length = fragment.length_in_code_units;
    let x = absolute_rect(layout_arena, fragment).x.to_float();
    rendered_text.for_each_rendered_text_offset_of_dom_offsets(
        fragment.dom_start_offset_in_node,
        fragment.dom_end_offset_in_node,
        crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::End,
        |dom_offset, rendered_offset| {
            let offset_in_fragment = rendered_offset.clamp(fragment.start, fragment.start + length) - fragment.start;
            let inline_x = geometry
                .x_for_offset(offset_in_fragment, true)
                .unwrap_or_else(|| geometry.end_x(length));
            callback(dom_offset, x + inline_x);
        },
    );
}

pub(crate) fn rect_for_selection_offsets(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    offsets: SelectionOffsets,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    rect_for_selection_offsets_of_fragment_at(fragment, absolute_rect(layout_arena, fragment), offsets)
}

fn rect_for_selection_offsets_of_fragment_at(
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    mut rect: CssPixelRect,
    offsets: SelectionOffsets,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    let horizontal = is_horizontal(fragment);
    let length = fragment.length_in_code_units;

    let start_in_text = offsets.start.min(length);
    let end_in_text = offsets.end.min(length);

    let mut pixel_offset;
    let mut pixel_width;
    if start_in_text == 0 && end_in_text == length && length > 0 {
        pixel_offset = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
        pixel_width = primary_size(rect, horizontal);
    } else {
        let (left, right) = fragment.glyph_run.as_ref().map_or((0.0, 0.0), |run| {
            run.cluster_geometry().range_extent(start_in_text, end_in_text, length)
        });
        pixel_offset = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(left);
        pixel_width = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(right - left);
    }

    let trimmed = fragment.trimmed_trailing_whitespace;
    if trimmed.length_in_code_units > 0 {
        let trimmed_advance_of = |offset: usize| {
            let units = offset.saturating_sub(length).min(trimmed.length_in_code_units);
            CssPixels::from_raw(
                (i64::from(trimmed.inline_size.raw_value()) * units as i64 / trimmed.length_in_code_units as i64)
                    as i32,
            )
        };
        pixel_offset += trimmed_advance_of(offsets.start);
        pixel_width += trimmed_advance_of(offsets.end) - trimmed_advance_of(offsets.start);
    }

    if offsets.start == offsets.end {
        pixel_width = CssPixels::from_integer(1);
    }

    if horizontal {
        rect.x += pixel_offset;
        rect.width = pixel_width;
    } else if runs_upwards(fragment) {
        rect.y = rect.bottom() - pixel_offset - pixel_width;
        rect.height = pixel_width;
    } else {
        rect.y += pixel_offset;
        rect.height = pixel_width;
    }

    if let Some(run) = &fragment.glyph_run {
        let zero = CssPixels::from_raw(0);
        let overflow_top = (run.ascent - fragment.baseline).max(zero);
        let overflow_bottom = (run.descent - secondary_size(rect, horizontal) + fragment.baseline).max(zero);
        if horizontal {
            rect.inflate(overflow_top, zero, overflow_bottom, zero);
        } else {
            rect.inflate(zero, overflow_bottom, zero, overflow_top);
        }
    }
    rect
}

pub(crate) fn glyph_rect_of_fragment_at(
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    run: &crate::layout::inline_content::GlyphRunRecord,
    rect: CssPixelRect,
) -> CssPixelRect {
    let glyph = run.bounding_box;
    let pixel = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32;
    if is_horizontal(fragment) {
        CssPixelRect::new(
            rect.x + pixel(glyph.x),
            rect.y + fragment.baseline + pixel(glyph.y),
            pixel(glyph.width),
            pixel(glyph.height),
        )
    } else if runs_upwards(fragment) {
        CssPixelRect::new(
            rect.x + fragment.baseline + pixel(glyph.y),
            rect.bottom() - pixel(glyph.x + glyph.width),
            pixel(glyph.height),
            pixel(glyph.width),
        )
    } else {
        CssPixelRect::new(
            rect.right() - fragment.baseline - pixel(glyph.y + glyph.height),
            rect.y + pixel(glyph.x),
            pixel(glyph.height),
            pixel(glyph.width),
        )
    }
}

pub(crate) fn glyph_ink_rect_in_containing_block(fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> CssPixelRect {
    let Some(run) = &fragment.glyph_run else {
        return CssPixelRect::default();
    };
    let rect = rect_in_containing_block(fragment);
    let mut ink = rect;
    ink.unite(glyph_rect_of_fragment_at(fragment, run, rect));
    ink.unite(rect_for_selection_offsets_of_fragment_at(
        fragment,
        rect,
        SelectionOffsets {
            start: 0,
            end: fragment.length_in_code_units,
        },
    ));
    ink
}

/// Like `rect_for_selection_offsets()`, but with one rect for each visually separate piece of the range: Code units
/// that are adjacent in the text can be apart on the line when the fragment mixes directions.
pub(crate) fn rects_for_selection_offsets(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    offsets: SelectionOffsets,
) -> Vec<CssPixelRect> {
    let rect = rect_for_selection_offsets(layout_arena, fragment, offsets);
    let length = fragment.length_in_code_units;
    let extents = fragment.glyph_run.as_ref().map_or_else(Vec::new, |run| {
        run.cluster_geometry()
            .range_extents(offsets.start.min(length), offsets.end.min(length), length)
    });
    if extents.len() < 2 {
        return vec![rect];
    }
    let horizontal = is_horizontal(fragment);
    let origin = absolute_rect(layout_arena, fragment);
    extents
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(start, end)| {
            let mut piece = rect;
            let offset = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(start);
            let size = CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(end - start);
            if horizontal {
                piece.x = origin.x + offset;
                piece.width = size;
            } else if runs_upwards(fragment) {
                piece.y = origin.bottom() - offset - size;
                piece.height = size;
            } else {
                piece.y = origin.y + offset;
                piece.height = size;
            }
            piece
        })
        .collect()
}

pub(crate) fn is_block_level_box(layout_arena: &impl PaintRead, fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> bool {
    layout_arena
        .node_style_if_live(fragment.layout_node)
        .is_some_and(|style| style.display().is_block_outside())
}

pub(crate) fn style_source(_layout_arena: &impl PaintRead, fragment: &FragmentRecord) -> NodeSlotId {
    fragment.style_source
}

pub(crate) fn physical_edge_offset(
    arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    left: bool,
) -> Option<(usize, bool)> {
    let (boundary, at_cluster_end) = fragment.glyph_run.as_ref()?.cluster_geometry().edge_offset(left)?;
    Some((
        arena.dom_offset_for_rendered_text_offset(
            fragment.layout_node,
            fragment.start + boundary,
            crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::End,
        ),
        at_cluster_end,
    ))
}

pub(crate) fn index_in_node_for_point(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    fragment: &FragmentRecord,
    position: crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelPoint,
) -> usize {
    if !layout_arena
        .node_kind_if_live(fragment.layout_node)
        .is_some_and(node_facts::kind_is_text)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    // NB: A point on the text-overflow ellipsis is where the elided text starts.
    if fragment.is_text_overflow_ellipsis {
        return layout_arena.dom_offset_for_rendered_text_offset(
            fragment.layout_node,
            fragment.start,
            crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::End,
        );
    }
    let rect = absolute_rect(layout_arena, fragment);
    let x = if is_horizontal(fragment) {
        (position.x - rect.x).to_float()
    } else if runs_upwards(fragment) {
        (rect.bottom() - position.y).to_float()
    } else {
        (position.y - rect.y).to_float()
    };
    // NB: A point past the end of the text takes the offset in front of the whitespace the line trimmed.
    let offset = fragment.glyph_run.as_ref().map_or(0, |run| {
        layout_arena
            .with_grapheme_segmenter(fragment.layout_node, |segmenter| {
                run.cluster_geometry()
                    .offset_for_x(x, fragment.length_in_code_units, |offset| {
                        segmenter
                            .next_boundary(fragment.start + offset, false)
                            .map(|boundary| boundary - fragment.start)
                    })
            })
            .unwrap_or_default()
    });
    layout_arena.dom_offset_for_rendered_text_offset(
        fragment.layout_node,
        fragment.start + offset,
        crate::layout::RenderedTextBoundary::End,
    )
}

//! The records an SVG image's document was rendered as, which the document keeps for the sizes, scales, color
//! schemes and force-dark settings the pages that draw it asked for, until what it shows changes.

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixels;
use crate::painting::host::FfiVectorImageRenderRequest;
use crate::painting::vector_image_records::VectorImageRecords;
use crate::render_state::DocumentHost;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// What an SVG image is rendered for, as C++ names it.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct FfiVectorImageKey {
    pub css_width: CssPixels,
    pub css_height: CssPixels,
    pub raster_scale: f32,
    pub color_scheme: u8,
    pub force_dark_enabled: bool,
    pub force_dark_foreground_threshold: i32,
    pub force_dark_background_threshold: i32,
}

/// What an SVG image is rendered for: two renderings for one key show the same.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(crate) struct VectorImageKey {
    css_width_raw: i32,
    css_height_raw: i32,
    raster_scale_bits: u32,
    color_scheme: u8,
    force_dark_enabled: bool,
    force_dark_foreground_threshold: i32,
    force_dark_background_threshold: i32,
}

impl VectorImageKey {
    pub(crate) fn of_request(request: &FfiVectorImageRenderRequest) -> Self {
        Self::of(&FfiVectorImageKey {
            css_width: request.css_width,
            css_height: request.css_height,
            raster_scale: request.raster_scale,
            color_scheme: request.color_scheme,
            force_dark_enabled: request.force_dark_enabled,
            force_dark_foreground_threshold: request.force_dark_foreground_threshold,
            force_dark_background_threshold: request.force_dark_background_threshold,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn of(key: &FfiVectorImageKey) -> Self {
        Self {
            css_width_raw: key.css_width.raw_value(),
            css_height_raw: key.css_height.raw_value(),
            raster_scale_bits: key.raster_scale.to_bits(),
            color_scheme: key.color_scheme,
            force_dark_enabled: key.force_dark_enabled,
            force_dark_foreground_threshold: key.force_dark_foreground_threshold,
            force_dark_background_threshold: key.force_dark_background_threshold,
        }
    }
}

/// How many renderings an SVG image's document keeps: the oldest goes first.
const KEPT_RENDERINGS: usize = 10;

/// The renderings of an SVG image's document, oldest first.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct VectorImageCache {
    renderings: Vec<(VectorImageKey, Arc<VectorImageRecords>)>,
}

impl VectorImageCache {
    pub(crate) fn get(&self, key: &VectorImageKey) -> Option<Arc<VectorImageRecords>> {
        self.renderings
            .iter()
            .find_map(|(rendered_key, vector_image)| (rendered_key == key).then(|| vector_image.clone()))
    }

    fn keep(&mut self, key: VectorImageKey, vector_image: Arc<VectorImageRecords>) {
        self.renderings.retain(|(rendered_key, _)| *rendered_key != key);
        if self.renderings.len() >= KEPT_RENDERINGS {
            self.renderings.remove(0);
        }
        self.renderings.push((key, vector_image));
    }

    pub(crate) fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.renderings.clear();
    }
}

impl DocumentHost {
    /// The records this SVG image's document was rendered as for `key`, if it keeps them.
    pub(crate) fn vector_image(&self, key: &VectorImageKey) -> Option<Arc<VectorImageRecords>> {
        self.vector_images().get(key)
    }
}

/// Whether the SVG image document of `host` keeps a rendering for `key`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_state_has_vector_image(host: &DocumentHost, key: &FfiVectorImageKey) -> bool {
    host.vector_image(&VectorImageKey::of(key)).is_some()
}

/// Has the SVG image document of `host` keep the recording it took in last as its rendering for `key`.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_keep_last_recording_as_vector_image(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    key: &FfiVectorImageKey,
) {
    let vector_image = crate::painting::ffi::read_arena(host, read, (), |arena, ()| {
        let recording = arena.paint_state().last_recording.clone()?;
        Some(VectorImageRecords::recorded(
            &recording.display_list,
            &recording.resources,
        ))
    });
    host.vector_images().keep(
        VectorImageKey::of(key),
        vector_image.unwrap_or_else(VectorImageRecords::empty),
    );
}

/// Has the SVG image document of `host` keep `image_frame`, a `Gfx::DecodedImageFrame` of `size` that it was rasterized
/// into, as its rendering for `key`: the rendering of a document whose boxes are painted through visual contexts,
/// which the tapes of the pages that draw the image cannot take in.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread, and `image_frame` must be live for the call.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_keep_image_frame_as_vector_image(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    key: &FfiVectorImageKey,
    image_frame: *const std::ffi::c_void,
    size: libgfx_rust::IntSize,
) {
    // SAFETY: The caller keeps the frame live for the call.
    let frame = unsafe { libgfx_rust::image_frame::ImageFrameHandle::retain(image_frame) };
    host.vector_images().keep(
        VectorImageKey::of(key),
        VectorImageRecords::drawing_image_frame(frame, size),
    );
}

/// Has the SVG image document of `host` forget its renderings: what it shows changed.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_state_forget_vector_images(host: &DocumentHost) {
    host.vector_images().clear();
}

//! The records an SVG image's document was recorded as, and how a tape that names them takes them into the payloads
//! of the commands that paint them, which is the form the compositor replays a tape in.

use crate::painting::display_list::builder::{
    HEADER_SIZE, RecordedDisplayList, for_each_command, read_command, read_header,
};
use crate::painting::display_list::chunks::{Chunk, DisplayListChunk};
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::{
    DeclareMaskContent, DisplayListCommandHeader, DisplayListCommandRun, DisplayListCommandType, DisplayListDataSpan,
    DisplayListGradientColorStops, DisplayListGradientPaintStyle, DisplayListInlineClip, DisplayListPaintStyle,
    DrawIsolatedGroup, DrawRepeatedTile, EffectNodeIndex, FillPath, FillRect, FillRectWithRoundedCorners,
    INLINE_CLIP_ENTRY_SIZE, ImageFrameResourceId, PaintVectorImage, StrokePath,
};
use crate::painting::display_list::ffi_bytes::FfiBytes;
use crate::painting::display_list::ids::allocate_display_list_id;
use crate::painting::display_list::nested_records::for_each_nested_record_span;
use crate::painting::display_list::recorder::DisplayListRecorder;
use crate::painting::display_list::summary::vector_image_records_require_direct_replay;
use crate::painting::display_list_resources::DisplayListResources;
use crate::painting::force_dark::ForceDarkRole;
use libgfx_rust::image_frame::ImageFrameHandle;
use libgfx_rust::{CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatRect, IntSize, ScalingMode};
use smallvec::SmallVec;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::mem::{offset_of, size_of};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// The records an SVG image's document was recorded as, which name no visual context, and what they draw. They hold
/// the records of the SVG images that the image itself draws.
pub(crate) struct VectorImageRecords {
    id: u64,
    pub(crate) records: Vec<u8>,
    pub(crate) requires_direct_replay: bool,
    /// The fonts and image frames the records draw.
    pub(crate) resources: DisplayListResources,
}

impl VectorImageRecords {
    /// The records `display_list` holds, which its document recorded under no visual context, under a new id, drawing
    /// `resources`.
    pub(crate) fn recorded(display_list: &RecordedDisplayList, resources: &DisplayListResources) -> Arc<Self> {
        debug_assert!(
            display_list
                .command_runs
                .windows(2)
                .all(|runs| runs[0].context == runs[1].context),
            "the records of an SVG image are recorded under one visual context"
        );
        let mut records = display_list_holding_vector_image_records(display_list, &resources.vector_images).bytes;
        forget_visual_context_nodes_named_by(&mut records);
        let mut drawn = DisplayListResources::default();
        drawn.include_fonts_and_image_frames(&resources.with_vector_image_resources());
        Arc::new(Self {
            id: allocate_display_list_id(),
            requires_direct_replay: vector_image_records_require_direct_replay(&records),
            records,
            resources: drawn,
        })
    }

    /// Records that draw `frame`, the raster of an SVG image of `size`, under a new id.
    pub(crate) fn drawing_image_frame(frame: ImageFrameHandle, size: IntSize) -> Arc<Self> {
        let mut recorder = DisplayListRecorder::new(None);
        recorder.draw_scaled_decoded_image_frame(
            FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, size.width as f32, size.height as f32),
            None,
            ImageFrameResourceId(frame.id()),
            ScalingMode::Bilinear,
            CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
            None,
            ForceDarkRole::None,
        );
        let mut resources = DisplayListResources::default();
        resources.image_frames.insert(frame.id(), frame);
        Arc::new(Self {
            id: allocate_display_list_id(),
            records: recorder.into_builder().finish().bytes,
            // A raster of the records would hold the pixels the frame holds already.
            requires_direct_replay: true,
            resources,
        })
    }

    /// No records, which stand in for an SVG image that has nothing to show.
    pub(crate) fn empty() -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(Self {
            id: allocate_display_list_id(),
            records: Vec::new(),
            requires_direct_replay: false,
            resources: DisplayListResources::default(),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn id(&self) -> u64 {
        self.id
    }
}

// The records replay against the visual context tree of whatever tape takes them in, of which they name no node.
fn forget_visual_context_nodes_named_by(records: &mut [u8]) {
    let mut effect_field_offsets = Vec::new();
    crate::painting::display_list::nested_records::for_each_command_including_nested(
        records,
        &mut |command_type, payload_offset, _| match command_type {
            DisplayListCommandType::FillRect => {
                effect_field_offsets.push(payload_offset + offset_of!(FillRect, background_color_animation_effect));
            }
            DisplayListCommandType::FillRectWithRoundedCorners => effect_field_offsets
                .push(payload_offset + offset_of!(FillRectWithRoundedCorners, background_color_animation_effect)),
            _ => {}
        },
    );
    for offset in effect_field_offsets {
        EffectNodeIndex::NONE.write_ffi_bytes(&mut records[offset..offset + size_of::<EffectNodeIndex>()]);
    }
}

// Where a payload grows as the records nested in it take in the records of SVG images: at `position` in the payload as
// it was, by `growth` bytes.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct PayloadGrowth {
    position: u32,
    growth: u32,
}

fn offset_after_growth(offset: u32, growths: &[PayloadGrowth]) -> u32 {
    offset
        + growths
            .iter()
            .filter(|growth| growth.position <= offset)
            .map(|growth| growth.growth)
            .sum::<u32>()
}

// The offsets, in the payload of a command that can hold nested records, of every span its command struct holds.
fn span_field_offsets_of(command_type: DisplayListCommandType) -> SmallVec<[usize; 6]> {
    fn paint_style_span_field_offsets(paint_style: usize) -> [usize; 3] {
        let color_stops = paint_style
            + offset_of!(DisplayListPaintStyle, gradient)
            + offset_of!(DisplayListGradientPaintStyle, color_stops);
        [
            color_stops + offset_of!(DisplayListGradientColorStops, colors),
            color_stops + offset_of!(DisplayListGradientColorStops, positions),
            paint_style + offset_of!(DisplayListPaintStyle, pattern_tile),
        ]
    }
    let mut offsets = SmallVec::new();
    match command_type {
        DisplayListCommandType::DrawIsolatedGroup => offsets.extend([
            offset_of!(DrawIsolatedGroup, content),
            offset_of!(DrawIsolatedGroup, mask),
            offset_of!(DrawIsolatedGroup, filter),
        ]),
        DisplayListCommandType::DrawRepeatedTile => offsets.push(offset_of!(DrawRepeatedTile, tile)),
        DisplayListCommandType::DeclareMaskContent => offsets.push(offset_of!(DeclareMaskContent, content)),
        DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage => offsets.push(offset_of!(PaintVectorImage, records)),
        DisplayListCommandType::FillPath => {
            offsets.push(offset_of!(FillPath, path_data));
            offsets.extend(paint_style_span_field_offsets(offset_of!(FillPath, paint_style)));
        }
        DisplayListCommandType::StrokePath => {
            offsets.extend([offset_of!(StrokePath, dash_array), offset_of!(StrokePath, path_data)]);
            offsets.extend(paint_style_span_field_offsets(offset_of!(StrokePath, paint_style)));
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    offsets
}

fn read_span(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> DisplayListDataSpan {
    read_command::<DisplayListDataSpan>(&bytes[offset..])
}

fn write_span(bytes: &mut [u8], offset: usize, span: DisplayListDataSpan) {
    span.write_ffi_bytes(&mut bytes[offset..offset + size_of::<DisplayListDataSpan>()]);
}

// Appends the record `header` and `payload` make to `out`, with the records of the SVG images it paints, and of those
// the records nested in it paint, in the payloads of the commands that paint them.
fn append_record_holding_vector_image_records(
    header: &DisplayListCommandHeader,
    payload: &[u8],
    vector_images: &HashMap<u64, Arc<VectorImageRecords>>,
    out: &mut Vec<u8>,
) {
    let record_start = out.len();
    out.extend_from_slice(&[0; HEADER_SIZE]);
    let payload_start = out.len();

    let mut nested_spans: SmallVec<[DisplayListDataSpan; 2]> = SmallVec::new();
    for_each_nested_record_span(header.command_type, payload, |_, span| {
        if !span.is_empty() {
            nested_spans.push(span);
        }
    });
    nested_spans.sort_unstable_by_key(|span| span.offset);

    let mut growths: SmallVec<[PayloadGrowth; 2]> = SmallVec::new();
    // The sizes the nested spans grow to, by the offsets they had.
    let mut grown_span_sizes: SmallVec<[(u32, u32); 2]> = SmallVec::new();
    let mut copied_up_to = 0;
    let mut vector_image_records_span = None;
    if header.command_type == DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage {
        let command = read_command::<PaintVectorImage>(payload);
        if command.records.is_empty()
            && let Some(vector_image) = vector_images.get(&command.vector_image_id.0)
            && !vector_image.records.is_empty()
        {
            const { assert!(size_of::<PaintVectorImage>().is_multiple_of(8)) };
            let position = size_of::<PaintVectorImage>();
            out.extend_from_slice(&payload[..position]);
            out.extend_from_slice(&vector_image.records);
            copied_up_to = position;
            let growth = u32::try_from(vector_image.records.len()).expect("display list payload exceeds u32");
            growths.push(PayloadGrowth {
                position: position as u32,
                growth,
            });
            vector_image_records_span = Some((
                DisplayListDataSpan {
                    offset: position as u32,
                    size: growth,
                },
                vector_image.requires_direct_replay,
            ));
        }
    }
    for span in &nested_spans {
        let (start, end) = (span.offset as usize, (span.offset + span.size) as usize);
        out.extend_from_slice(&payload[copied_up_to..start]);
        let grown_start = out.len();
        append_records_holding_vector_image_records(&payload[start..end], vector_images, out);
        let grown_size = u32::try_from(out.len() - grown_start).expect("display list payload exceeds u32");
        copied_up_to = end;
        if grown_size != span.size {
            growths.push(PayloadGrowth {
                position: end as u32,
                growth: grown_size - span.size,
            });
            grown_span_sizes.push((span.offset, grown_size));
        }
    }
    out.extend_from_slice(&payload[copied_up_to..]);

    let mut grown_header = *header;
    if !growths.is_empty() {
        let total_growth: u32 = growths.iter().map(|growth| growth.growth).sum();
        grown_header.payload_size += total_growth;
        let grown_payload = &mut out[payload_start..];
        let mut span_field_offsets = span_field_offsets_of(header.command_type);
        // The paths of the inline clips sit after everything else the payload holds but the entries that name them.
        let clip_entries_start =
            payload.len() + total_growth as usize - usize::from(header.inline_clip_count) * INLINE_CLIP_ENTRY_SIZE;
        span_field_offsets.extend((0..usize::from(header.inline_clip_count)).map(|index| {
            clip_entries_start + index * INLINE_CLIP_ENTRY_SIZE + offset_of!(DisplayListInlineClip, path_data)
        }));
        for field_offset in span_field_offsets {
            let mut span = read_span(grown_payload, field_offset);
            if let Some(&(_, grown_size)) = grown_span_sizes.iter().find(|(offset, _)| *offset == span.offset)
                && !span.is_empty()
            {
                span.size = grown_size;
            }
            span.offset = offset_after_growth(span.offset, &growths);
            write_span(grown_payload, field_offset, span);
        }
        if let Some((records_span, requires_direct_replay)) = vector_image_records_span {
            write_span(grown_payload, offset_of!(PaintVectorImage, records), records_span);
            grown_payload[offset_of!(PaintVectorImage, requires_direct_replay)] = u8::from(requires_direct_replay);
        }
    }
    grown_header.write_ffi_bytes(&mut out[record_start..record_start + HEADER_SIZE]);
}

fn append_records_holding_vector_image_records(
    records: &[u8],
    vector_images: &HashMap<u64, Arc<VectorImageRecords>>,
    out: &mut Vec<u8>,
) {
    for_each_command(records, |header, _, payload| {
        append_record_holding_vector_image_records(header, payload, vector_images, out);
    });
}

/// The tape of `display_list` with the records of `vector_images`, the SVG images its commands name, in the payloads
/// of the commands that paint them, as the compositor replays it.
pub(crate) fn display_list_holding_vector_image_records(
    display_list: &RecordedDisplayList,
    vector_images: &HashMap<u64, Arc<VectorImageRecords>>,
) -> RecordedDisplayList {
    if vector_images.is_empty() {
        return display_list.clone();
    }
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(
        display_list.bytes.len()
            + vector_images
                .values()
                .map(|vector_image| vector_image.records.len())
                .sum::<usize>(),
    );
    let mut command_runs = Vec::with_capacity(display_list.command_runs.len());
    for run in &display_list.command_runs {
        let offset = u32::try_from(bytes.len()).expect("display list exceeds u32");
        let records = &display_list.bytes[run.offset as usize..(run.offset + run.size) as usize];
        append_records_holding_vector_image_records(records, vector_images, &mut bytes);
        command_runs.push(DisplayListCommandRun {
            offset,
            size: u32::try_from(bytes.len()).expect("display list exceeds u32") - offset,
            ..*run
        });
    }
    debug_assert!(
        display_list.command_runs.is_empty() || read_header(&bytes).payload_size as usize + HEADER_SIZE <= bytes.len()
    );
    let chunks = display_list
        .chunks
        .iter()
        .map(|chunk| DisplayListChunk {
            byte_end: chunk.run_end.checked_sub(1).map_or(0, |last_run| {
                let run = &command_runs[last_run as usize];
                run.offset + run.size
            }),
            ..*chunk
        })
        .collect();
    RecordedDisplayList {
        bytes,
        command_runs,
        chunks,
    }
}

/// `chunk` with the records of `vector_images`, the SVG images its commands name, in the payloads of the commands that
/// paint them, as the compositor replays it.
pub(crate) fn chunk_holding_vector_image_records(
    chunk: &Chunk,
    vector_images: &HashMap<u64, Arc<VectorImageRecords>>,
) -> Chunk {
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(chunk.records.len());
    let mut runs = Vec::with_capacity(chunk.runs.len());
    for run in &chunk.runs {
        let offset = u32::try_from(bytes.len()).expect("display list exceeds u32");
        let records = &chunk.records[run.offset as usize..(run.offset + run.size) as usize];
        append_records_holding_vector_image_records(records, vector_images, &mut bytes);
        runs.push(DisplayListCommandRun {
            offset,
            size: u32::try_from(bytes.len()).expect("display list exceeds u32") - offset,
            ..*run
        });
    }
    Chunk::named(bytes, runs)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::painting::display_list::builder::{DisplayListBuilder, PendingInlineClip, inline_clips_of};
    use crate::painting::display_list::commands::{ContextRef, DisplayListResourceId, Repeat};
    use crate::painting::display_list::nested_records::span_bytes;
    use crate::painting::display_list::storage::{
        PackedChunkSize, packed_size_of_chunks, receive_packed_chunks, write_packed_chunks,
    };
    use libgfx_rust::path::Path;
    use libgfx_rust::{
        Color, CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatPoint, FloatRect, FloatSize, IntRect, IntSize, MaskKind,
        ScalingMode, WindingRule,
    };

    fn fill(color: Color) -> FillRect {
        FillRect {
            rect: IntRect::new(0, 0, 10, 10),
            color,
            compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
            background_color_animation_effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
        }
    }

    fn reference_to(vector_image: &VectorImageRecords) -> PaintVectorImage {
        PaintVectorImage {
            vector_image_id: DisplayListResourceId(vector_image.id()),
            rect: FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
            recorded_size: IntSize { width: 10, height: 10 },
            records: DisplayListDataSpan::default(),
            requires_direct_replay: false,
        }
    }

    fn vector_image_of(fills: &[FillRect]) -> Arc<VectorImageRecords> {
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        for fill in fills {
            builder.append(fill, &[], ContextRef::default());
        }
        VectorImageRecords::recorded(&builder.finish(), &DisplayListResources::default())
    }

    fn triangle_clip() -> PendingInlineClip {
        let mut path = Path::new();
        path.move_to(FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 });
        path.line_to(FloatPoint { x: 10.0, y: 0.0 });
        path.line_to(FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 10.0 });
        path.close();
        debug_assert_eq!(path.serialize_to_bytes(), triangle_clip_path_bytes());
        PendingInlineClip::intersecting_path(&path, WindingRule::Nonzero)
    }

    fn triangle_clip_path_bytes() -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut path = Path::new();
        path.move_to(FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 });
        path.line_to(FloatPoint { x: 10.0, y: 0.0 });
        path.line_to(FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 10.0 });
        path.close();
        path.serialize_to_bytes()
    }

    // Checks the tape as the compositor does when it receives it, as one chunk.
    fn assert_is_valid_for_the_compositor(display_list: &RecordedDisplayList) {
        let chunk = Chunk::named(display_list.bytes.clone(), display_list.command_runs.clone());
        let mut packed = vec![0; packed_size_of_chunks(&[&chunk])];
        write_packed_chunks(&[&chunk], &mut packed);
        receive_packed_chunks(&packed, &[PackedChunkSize::of(&chunk)])
            .expect("the tape passes the compositor's validation");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_tape_takes_the_records_of_the_images_it_names_wherever_it_names_them() {
        let vector_image = vector_image_of(&[fill(Color::from_rgb(255, 0, 0)), fill(Color::from_rgb(0, 255, 0))]);
        let vector_images = HashMap::from([(vector_image.id(), vector_image.clone())]);

        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        let context = ContextRef::default();
        builder.append(&fill(Color::from_rgb(0, 0, 255)), &[], context);
        // A reference under a clip path, whose bytes sit after the command struct.
        builder.append_with_inline_clips(&reference_to(&vector_image), &[], context, &[triangle_clip()]);
        // A reference in a tile, in the content of a masked group whose filter bytes follow the nested records.
        let mut group = builder.begin_group::<DrawIsolatedGroup>(vec![triangle_clip()]);
        let tile = builder.begin_group::<DrawRepeatedTile>(Vec::new());
        builder.append(&reference_to(&vector_image), &[], context);
        let tile_span = builder.group_content_span(&tile);
        builder.finish_group(
            tile,
            &DrawRepeatedTile {
                dst_rect: FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
                clip_rect: IntRect::new(0, 0, 10, 10),
                tile_size: IntSize { width: 10, height: 10 },
                tile_step: FloatSize {
                    width: 10.0,
                    height: 10.0,
                },
                tile: tile_span,
                scaling_mode: ScalingMode::Bilinear,
                compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                repeat: Repeat { x: true, y: true },
            },
            context,
        );
        builder.begin_group_mask(&mut group);
        builder.append(&reference_to(&vector_image), &[], context);
        let filter_bytes = libgfx_rust::filter::Filter::blur(3.0, 3.0, None).serialize();
        let filter = builder.append_group_inline_data(&mut group, &filter_bytes);
        let (content, mask) = (builder.group_content_span(&group), builder.group_mask_span(&group));
        builder.finish_group(
            group,
            &DrawIsolatedGroup {
                clip_rect: FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
                content,
                mask,
                filter,
                opacity: 1.0,
                compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                mask_kind: MaskKind::Alpha,
            },
            context,
        );
        builder.append(&fill(Color::from_rgb(255, 255, 255)), &[], context);
        let display_list = builder.finish();

        let expanded = display_list_holding_vector_image_records(&display_list, &vector_images);
        assert_eq!(expanded.command_runs.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(expanded.command_runs[0].size as usize, expanded.bytes.len());
        assert_eq!(
            expanded.bytes.len(),
            display_list.bytes.len() + 3 * vector_image.records.len()
        );
        assert_is_valid_for_the_compositor(&expanded);

        let mut images_found = 0;
        let mut clip_paths_found = 0;
        let mut filters_found = 0;
        crate::painting::display_list::nested_records::for_each_command_including_nested(
            &expanded.bytes,
            &mut |command_type, _, payload| match command_type {
                DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage => {
                    let command = read_command::<PaintVectorImage>(payload);
                    assert_eq!(span_bytes(payload, command.records), &vector_image.records[..]);
                    images_found += 1;
                }
                DisplayListCommandType::DrawIsolatedGroup => {
                    let command = read_command::<DrawIsolatedGroup>(payload);
                    assert_eq!(span_bytes(payload, command.filter), filter_bytes);
                    filters_found += 1;
                }
                _ => {}
            },
        );
        assert_eq!((images_found, filters_found), (3, 1));
        for_each_command(&expanded.bytes, |header, _, payload| {
            for clip in inline_clips_of(header, payload) {
                assert_eq!(span_bytes(payload, clip.path_data), &triangle_clip_path_bytes()[..]);
                clip_paths_found += 1;
            }
        });
        assert_eq!(clip_paths_found, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_records_of_an_image_hold_those_of_the_images_it_draws() {
        let inner = vector_image_of(&[fill(Color::from_rgb(255, 0, 0))]);
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        builder.append(&reference_to(&inner), &[], ContextRef::default());
        let resources = DisplayListResources {
            vector_images: HashMap::from([(inner.id(), inner.clone())]),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let outer = VectorImageRecords::recorded(&builder.finish(), &resources);
        assert!(outer.resources.vector_images.is_empty());
        for_each_command(&outer.records, |header, _, payload| {
            assert_eq!(header.command_type, DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage);
            let command = read_command::<PaintVectorImage>(payload);
            assert_eq!(span_bytes(payload, command.records), &inner.records[..]);
        });
    }
}

//! Maps CSS-pixel geometry between the spaces of a document's boxes and its viewport through the world transforms replay
//! draws with, so that what script measures and hit testing finds is where the content is drawn.

use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixelRect, CssPixels, FfiCssPixelPoint, FfiCssPixelRect};
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::hit_test::to_css_point;
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::style_queries;
use crate::painting::visual_context::{
    ClipBehavior, ContextRef, IncludeVisualViewportTransform, SpatialNodeIndex, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
    VisualContextTree, WorldTransforms,
};
use crate::painting::visual_context::{basic_shapes, node_values};
use crate::render_state::DocumentHost;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::{AccumulatedVisualContextTree, ScrollStateSnapshot};
use libgfx_rust::{FloatMatrix4x4, FloatPoint, FloatRect};
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ViewportSpace {
    /// What client rects and IntersectionObserver report in, which a pinch zoom leaves as it is.
    LayoutViewport,
    /// Where input lands on the screen, which a pinch zoom scales and moves.
    VisualViewport,
}

impl From<ViewportSpace> for IncludeVisualViewportTransform {
    fn from(space: ViewportSpace) -> Self {
        match space {
            ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport => Self::No,
            ViewportSpace::VisualViewport => Self::Yes,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Transforms<'a> {
    tree: &'a VisualContextTree,
    world_transforms: &'a WorldTransforms,
    scroll_offsets: &'a [FloatPoint],
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
}

/// Maps through a document's visual context tree, or leaves geometry as it is for a document without one.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub(crate) struct ViewportMapping<'a> {
    transforms: Option<Transforms<'a>>,
}

impl<'a> ViewportMapping<'a> {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        tree: &'a VisualContextTree,
        world_transforms: &'a WorldTransforms,
        scroll_offsets: &'a [FloatPoint],
        device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            transforms: Some(Transforms {
                tree,
                world_transforms,
                scroll_offsets,
                device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            }),
        }
    }

    /// Maps `rect`, in the space `node` is painted in, into the viewport.
    pub(crate) fn rect_to_viewport(
        &self,
        arena: &impl PaintRead,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        rect: CssPixelRect,
        space: ViewportSpace,
    ) -> CssPixelRect {
        if self.transforms.is_none() {
            return rect;
        }
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
            return CssPixelRect::default();
        }
        let spatial = arena.paintable_data(node).accumulated_visual_context.spatial;
        self.rect_in_space_to_viewport(spatial, rect, space)
    }

    /// Maps `rect`, of the line content of `node` that the line root `root` lays out, into the viewport through the
    /// context that content is painted in: that of the nearest self-painting inline box around `node`, or else the one
    /// `root` paints its descendants in, which a scroll container moves by its scroll offset.
    pub(crate) fn line_content_rect_to_viewport(
        &self,
        arena: &impl PaintRead,
        root: NodeSlotId,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        rect: CssPixelRect,
        space: ViewportSpace,
    ) -> CssPixelRect {
        if self.transforms.is_none() {
            return rect;
        }
        let painter =
            crate::painting::fragment_ownership::nearest_self_painting_inline_box(arena, node).unwrap_or(root);
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(painter) {
            return CssPixelRect::default();
        }
        let context = arena.paintable_data(painter).accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants;
        self.rect_in_space_to_viewport(context.spatial, rect, space)
    }

    /// Maps `rect`, in the local space of `spatial`, into the viewport.
    pub(crate) fn rect_in_space_to_viewport(
        &self,
        spatial: SpatialNodeIndex,
        rect: CssPixelRect,
        space: ViewportSpace,
    ) -> CssPixelRect {
        let Some(transforms) = &self.transforms else {
            return rect;
        };
        let pixel_ratio = transforms.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
        let device_rect = FloatRect {
            x: rect.x.to_float() * pixel_ratio,
            y: rect.y.to_float() * pixel_ratio,
            width: rect.width.to_float() * pixel_ratio,
            height: rect.height.to_float() * pixel_ratio,
        };
        let mapped = transforms
            .world_transforms
            .transform_rect_to_viewport(spatial, device_rect, space.into());
        let inverse_pixel_ratio = 1.0 / pixel_ratio;
        CssPixelRect {
            x: CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.x * inverse_pixel_ratio),
            y: CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.y * inverse_pixel_ratio),
            width: CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.width * inverse_pixel_ratio),
            height: CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.height * inverse_pixel_ratio),
        }
    }

    /// The rect `node` clips its content to, in the viewport: its overflow clip and the bounding box of its clip-path.
    pub(crate) fn content_clip_rect(
        &self,
        arena: &impl PaintRead,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        space: ViewportSpace,
    ) -> Option<CssPixelRect> {
        let overflow_clip = node_values::overflow_clip_rect(arena, node);
        let clip_path_bounds =
            basic_shapes::compute_basic_shape_clip_path_data(arena, node, 1.0).map(|(_, bounds, _)| {
                CssPixelRect::new(
                    CssPixels::from_integer(bounds.x.into()),
                    CssPixels::from_integer(bounds.y.into()),
                    CssPixels::from_integer(bounds.width.into()),
                    CssPixels::from_integer(bounds.height.into()),
                )
            });
        let clip = match (overflow_clip, clip_path_bounds) {
            (Some(overflow_clip), Some(clip_path_bounds)) => overflow_clip.intersected(clip_path_bounds),
            (overflow_clip, clip_path_bounds) => overflow_clip.or(clip_path_bounds)?,
        };
        Some(self.rect_to_viewport(arena, node, clip, space))
    }

    /// `rect`, in the viewport, clipped by the content clip of every box on the containing block chain of `node` below
    /// `ancestor`, the clip of a scroll container passed through `inflate_scroll_container_clip` first.
    pub(crate) fn visible_rect_in_ancestor(
        &self,
        arena: &impl PaintRead,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        rect: CssPixelRect,
        ancestor: NodeSlotId,
        space: ViewportSpace,
        mut inflate_scroll_container_clip: impl FnMut(CssPixelRect) -> CssPixelRect,
    ) -> CssPixelRect {
        let mut visible = rect;
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
            return visible;
        }
        let mut container = arena.node_containing_block_if_live(node);
        while let Some(container_slot) =
            container.filter(|slot| *slot != ancestor && arena.paintable_row_is_populated(*slot))
        {
            if let Some(mut clip) = self.content_clip_rect(arena, container_slot, space) {
                if style_queries::is_scroll_container(arena, container_slot) {
                    clip = inflate_scroll_container_clip(clip);
                }
                visible = visible.intersected(clip);
            }
            container = arena.node_containing_block_if_live(container_slot);
        }
        visible
    }

    /// Maps `point`, in the viewport, into the local space of `context`, or gives none where a clip that
    /// `clip_behavior` respects leaves it out or the context's transforms hide it. The point stays unrounded, so that a
    /// space scaled down far, such as SVG user units under a small viewBox, keeps its precision.
    pub(crate) fn point_to_local(
        &self,
        context: ContextRef,
        point: CssPixelPoint,
        space: ViewportSpace,
        clip_behavior: ClipBehavior,
    ) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        let Some(transforms) = &self.transforms else {
            return Some(FloatPoint {
                x: point.x.to_float(),
                y: point.y.to_float(),
            });
        };
        let pixel_ratio = transforms.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
        let mut screen_point = FloatPoint {
            x: point.x.to_float() * pixel_ratio,
            y: point.y.to_float() * pixel_ratio,
        };
        if space == ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport {
            let visual_viewport_transform = transforms.world_transforms.local[VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX.0 as usize];
            screen_point = visual_viewport_transform.extract_2d_affine().map_point(screen_point);
        }
        let local = transforms.tree.transform_point_for_hit_test(
            transforms.world_transforms,
            context,
            screen_point,
            clip_behavior,
        )?;
        Some(FloatPoint {
            x: local.x / pixel_ratio,
            y: local.y / pixel_ratio,
        })
    }

    /// The matrix that takes the local space of `spatial` into the viewport, both in device pixels, or the identity for
    /// a document that has no visual context tree.
    pub(crate) fn matrix_to_viewport(&self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex, space: ViewportSpace) -> FloatMatrix4x4 {
        match &self.transforms {
            Some(transforms) => transforms.world_transforms.to_viewport_matrix(spatial, space.into()),
            None => FloatMatrix4x4::identity(),
        }
    }

    /// The offset by which sticky positioning moves `node`, as the sum of the offsets of the sticky positioned box and
    /// its sticky positioned ancestors.
    pub(crate) fn sticky_offset(&self, arena: &impl PaintRead, node: NodeSlotId) -> CssPixelPoint {
        self.offset_along_spatial_chain(arena, node, |transforms, spatial| {
            transforms
                .tree
                .accumulated_sticky_offset(spatial, transforms.scroll_offsets)
        })
    }

    /// The offset by which scrolling, sticky positioning and anchor scroll shifts move `node`, without its transforms.
    pub(crate) fn offset_to_viewport_ignoring_transforms(
        &self,
        arena: &impl PaintRead,
        node: NodeSlotId,
    ) -> CssPixelPoint {
        self.offset_along_spatial_chain(arena, node, |transforms, spatial| {
            transforms
                .world_transforms
                .offset_to_viewport_ignoring_transforms(transforms.tree, spatial)
        })
    }

    fn offset_along_spatial_chain(
        &self,
        arena: &impl PaintRead,
        node: NodeSlotId,
        device_offset_of_spatial_chain: impl Fn(&Transforms<'_>, SpatialNodeIndex) -> FloatPoint,
    ) -> CssPixelPoint {
        let Some(transforms) = &self.transforms else {
            return CssPixelPoint::default();
        };
        if !arena.paintable_row_is_populated(node) {
            return CssPixelPoint::default();
        }
        let spatial = arena.paintable_data(node).accumulated_visual_context.spatial;
        let offset = device_offset_of_spatial_chain(transforms, spatial);
        let inverse_pixel_ratio = 1.0 / transforms.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
        CssPixelPoint::new(
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(offset.x * inverse_pixel_ratio),
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(offset.y * inverse_pixel_ratio),
        )
    }
}

/// The visual context trees the viewport mappings of a document map through, which its host keeps for them: C++ carries
/// mappings, never trees.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct ViewportMappingTrees {
    /// The document's tree as it was prepared for the newest mapping.
    main: Option<Arc<VisualContextTree>>,
    /// The main tree with the compositor's animations sampled at a time, for the mappings that read them so.
    sampled: Option<(i64, Arc<VisualContextTree>)>,
}

impl ViewportMappingTrees {
    fn set_main(&mut self, tree: Arc<VisualContextTree>) {
        if !self.main.as_ref().is_some_and(|main| Arc::ptr_eq(main, &tree)) {
            self.sampled = None;
        }
        self.main = Some(tree);
    }

    /// The main tree, with the compositor's animations sampled at `visual_animation_sample_time_ns` where it is some.
    fn tree(&mut self, visual_animation_sample_time_ns: Option<i64>) -> Option<Arc<VisualContextTree>> {
        let main = self.main.clone()?;
        let Some(sample_time_ns) = visual_animation_sample_time_ns.filter(|_| main.has_visual_animations()) else {
            return Some(main);
        };
        if let Some((sampled_at, sampled)) = &self.sampled
            && *sampled_at == sample_time_ns
        {
            return Some(sampled.clone());
        }
        let sampled = Arc::new(main.with_visual_animation_samples(sample_time_ns));
        self.sampled = Some((sample_time_ns, sampled.clone()));
        Some(sampled)
    }
}

/// A [`ViewportMapping`] as C++ carries it for `'a`, which only [`render_state_viewport_mapping`] makes: C++ hands it
/// back as it got it, or one it left zeroed, which leaves geometry as it is. Where the document is scrolled to, the
/// tree the host keeps for its mappings, and the world transforms of that tree there, are read from `host` where the
/// mapping is used.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiViewportMapping<'a> {
    host: Option<&'a DocumentHost>,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
    samples_visual_animations: bool,
    visual_animation_sample_time_ns: i64,
}

impl FfiViewportMapping<'_> {
    fn visual_animation_sample_time_ns(&self) -> Option<i64> {
        self.samples_visual_animations
            .then_some(self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns)
    }

    /// What the mapping maps through as the host has it now, kept for as long as an entry point reads the mapping.
    pub(crate) fn resolve(&self) -> ResolvedViewportMapping {
        let Some(host) = self.host else {
            return ResolvedViewportMapping { transforms: None };
        };
        let Some(tree) = host
            .viewport_mapping_trees()
            .tree(self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns())
        else {
            return ResolvedViewportMapping { transforms: None };
        };
        let tree = AccumulatedVisualContextTree::from_arc(tree);
        let scroll_state = host.scroll_state();
        let world_transforms = scroll_state.world_transforms(&tree);
        ResolvedViewportMapping {
            transforms: Some(ResolvedTransforms {
                tree,
                scroll_state,
                world_transforms,
                device_pixels_per_css_pixel: self.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            }),
        }
    }
}

struct ResolvedTransforms {
    tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
    scroll_state: Rc<ScrollStateSnapshot>,
    world_transforms: Arc<WorldTransforms>,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
}

/// A mapping C++ carries, with a share of its own in everything it maps through: nothing another mapping or a refresh
/// of the host's scroll state does takes that away while an entry point reads it.
pub(crate) struct ResolvedViewportMapping {
    transforms: Option<ResolvedTransforms>,
}

impl ResolvedViewportMapping {
    pub(crate) fn mapping(&self) -> ViewportMapping<'_> {
        match &self.transforms {
            Some(transforms) => ViewportMapping::new(
                transforms.tree.as_arc(),
                &transforms.world_transforms,
                transforms.scroll_state.device_offsets(),
                transforms.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            ),
            None => ViewportMapping::default(),
        }
    }
}

/// The mapping between the viewport of `host`'s document and the spaces of `tree`, which the host keeps as the tree of
/// its mappings from here on, with the compositor's animations sampled at `visual_animation_sample_time_ns` where it is
/// some, where the document's boxes are scrolled to as the host has it when the mapping is used.
fn viewport_mapping_through(
    host: &DocumentHost,
    tree: Arc<VisualContextTree>,
    visual_animation_sample_time_ns: Option<i64>,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
) -> FfiViewportMapping<'_> {
    let mapped_tree = {
        let mut trees = host.viewport_mapping_trees();
        trees.set_main(tree);
        trees.tree(visual_animation_sample_time_ns)
    };
    if let Some(mapped_tree) = mapped_tree {
        host.scroll_state()
            .world_transforms(&AccumulatedVisualContextTree::from_arc(mapped_tree));
    }
    FfiViewportMapping {
        host: Some(host),
        device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
        samples_visual_animations: visual_animation_sample_time_ns.is_some(),
        visual_animation_sample_time_ns: visual_animation_sample_time_ns.unwrap_or_default(),
    }
}

/// The mapping between the viewport of `host`'s document and the spaces of its visual context tree, prepared up to date,
/// with the compositor's animations sampled at `visual_animation_sample_time_ns` where `samples_visual_animations` says
/// so, where the document's boxes are scrolled to as the host has it when the mapping is used. A document without a
/// tree leaves the mapping zeroed.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `host` must be a live document host, on its document's thread.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_state_viewport_mapping<'a>(
    host: &'a DocumentHost,
    read: &crate::render_state::BegunRead,
    samples_visual_animations: bool,
    visual_animation_sample_time_ns: i64,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32,
    out: &mut FfiViewportMapping<'a>,
) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let Some(tree) = (unsafe { crate::painting::ffi::main_visual_context_tree(host, read) }) else {
        return;
    };
    *out = viewport_mapping_through(
        host,
        tree,
        samples_visual_animations.then_some(visual_animation_sample_time_ns),
        device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
    );
}

/// The matrix that takes the local space of `spatial` into the viewport, both in device pixels.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn viewport_mapping_matrix_to_viewport(
    mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    spatial: SpatialNodeIndex,
    space: ViewportSpace,
    out: &mut FloatMatrix4x4,
) {
    *out = mapping.resolve().mapping().matrix_to_viewport(spatial, space);
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn viewport_mapping_rect_in_space_to_viewport(
    mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    spatial: SpatialNodeIndex,
    rect: FfiCssPixelRect,
    space: ViewportSpace,
    out: &mut FfiCssPixelRect,
) {
    *out = mapping
        .resolve()
        .mapping()
        .rect_in_space_to_viewport(spatial, rect.into(), space)
        .into();
}

/// Gives false where [`ViewportMapping::point_to_local`] gives none. Clips are ignored: C++ maps points over a box it hit
/// or captured, and the corners of a rect it clipped already.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn viewport_mapping_point_to_local(
    mapping: FfiViewportMapping<'_>,
    context: ContextRef,
    point: FfiCssPixelPoint,
    space: ViewportSpace,
    out: &mut FfiCssPixelPoint,
) -> bool {
    let Some(local) = mapping
        .resolve()
        .mapping()
        .point_to_local(context, point.into(), space, ClipBehavior::Ignore)
    else {
        return false;
    };
    *out = to_css_point(local).into();
    true
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use libcompositing_rust::node_slot_id::NodeSlotId;
    use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::scroll_state::NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT;
    use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::{ScrollData, SpatialData, TransformData, TransformDataRole};

    fn tree_with_scroller() -> (Arc<VisualContextTree>, SpatialNodeIndex) {
        let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create(TransformData {
            matrix: FloatMatrix4x4::identity(),
            origin: FloatPoint::default(),
            sorting_context_root_index: None,
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
            role: TransformDataRole::CssTransform,
            synthetic_plane: false,
            establishes_sorting_context: false,
            bounds: FloatRect::default(),
        });
        let scroller = tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Scroll(ScrollData {
                state_slot: NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
                owner_paintable: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            }),
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        );
        (Arc::new(tree), scroller)
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_mapping_stands_after_a_mapping_over_another_tree_and_a_scroll_state_refresh() {
        let host = DocumentHost::for_test();
        let (tree, scroller) = tree_with_scroller();
        let (other_tree, _) = tree_with_scroller();
        let scrolled_to = |y: f32| vec![FloatPoint::default(), FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y }];
        let mapping_over = |tree: &Arc<VisualContextTree>| viewport_mapping_through(&host, tree.clone(), None, 1.0);
        let ten = CssPixels::from_integer(10);
        let rect = CssPixelRect::new(CssPixels::default(), CssPixels::default(), ten, ten);
        let top_in_viewport = |mapping: &FfiViewportMapping<'_>| {
            mapping
                .resolve()
                .mapping()
                .rect_in_space_to_viewport(scroller, rect, ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport)
                .y
        };

        host.refresh_scroll_state(scrolled_to(-30.0));
        let mapping = mapping_over(&tree);
        assert_eq!(top_in_viewport(&mapping), CssPixels::from_integer(-30));

        // The scroll state keeps the world transforms of one tree, which are those of the other tree from here on.
        let other_mapping = mapping_over(&other_tree);
        assert_eq!(top_in_viewport(&other_mapping), CssPixels::from_integer(-30));
        assert_eq!(top_in_viewport(&mapping), CssPixels::from_integer(-30));

        host.refresh_scroll_state(scrolled_to(-50.0));
        assert_eq!(top_in_viewport(&mapping), CssPixels::from_integer(-50));
    }
}

//! Builds the compositor animations of a keyframe effect from its resolved keyframes: the lowering
//! of style values into the values the compositor interpolates, the per-effect cache of those
//! values, the animations an effect has built and published, and the document-wide list the visual
//! context tree receives.

use crate::animations::keyframes::{
