use super::box_build::PaintableVisualContextAssignment;
use super::scroll_state::NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT;
use super::*;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
use crate::painting::host::FfiVisualContextTreeInputs;
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::paintable_geometry;
use crate::painting::paintable_rows::PaintableRowsRead;
use libgfx_rust::CornerRadii;
use libgfx_rust::{
    AffineTransform, CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatPoint, IntRect, WindingRule, affine_to_matrix,
    scale_matrix_for_device_pixels, translated_then_multiplied,
};

// Content below a viewport node records in the viewport's user units scaled by the device pixel
// ratio, mirroring how ordinary content records in CSS pixels scaled by it; the node folds the
// viewport box's position in its own recorded space together with the viewBox transform.
pub(crate) fn compute_svg_viewport_transform_data(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
    viewbox_transform: AffineTransform,
    pixel_ratio: f64,
) -> TransformData {
    let location = paintable_geometry::absolute_rect(layout_arena, slot).location();
    let matrix = translated_then_multiplied(
        FloatPoint {
            x: location.x.to_float(),
            y: location.y.to_float(),
        },
        viewbox_transform,
    );
    TransformData {
        matrix: scale_matrix_for_device_pixels(affine_to_matrix(matrix), pixel_ratio as f32),
        origin: FloatPoint::default(),
        sorting_context_root_index: None,
        flattens_inherited_transform: false,
        role: TransformDataRole::SvgViewportTransform,
        synthetic_plane: false,
        establishes_sorting_context: false,
        bounds: libgfx_rust::FloatRect::default(),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn svg_viewport_transform_of(
    layout_arena: &impl crate::painting::paint_read::GeometryRead,
    slot: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<AffineTransform> {
    crate::painting::paintable_geometry::committed_svg_viewport_transform(layout_arena, slot).map(Into::into)
}

pub(crate) struct BoxFacts {
    pub needs_compositor_background_color_effect: bool,
    pub transform: Option<TransformData>,
    pub transform_is_invertible: bool,
    pub perspective: Option<PerspectiveData>,
    pub effects: Option<std::rc::Rc<EffectsData>>,
    pub overflow_clip: Option<ClipData>,
    /// The overflow clip's shape, when shaped corners make it a path rather than a rounded rectangle.
    pub overflow_clip_contour: Option<ClipPathData>,
    pub css_clip: Option<ClipData>,
    /// The clip that layout put on the box's link.
    pub clip_decided_by_parent: Option<ClipData>,
    pub clip_path: Option<(std::sync::Arc<libgfx_rust::path::Path>, IntRect, WindingRule)>,
    pub mask_layers: Vec<MaskData>,
    pub establishes_absolute_containing_block: bool,
    pub establishes_fixed_containing_block: bool,
    pub backface_hidden: bool,
    pub establishes_or_extends_3d_rendering_context: bool,
    pub may_have_clip: bool,
    pub default_scroll_shift_anchor: NodeSlotId,
    /// Whether the box's filter references an SVG `<filter>`, whose region and subregions are in the box's own
    /// coordinate system.
    pub filter_references_svg_filter: bool,
}

impl BoxFacts {
    pub(crate) fn effects_data(&self) -> Option<EffectsData> {
        self.effects.as_ref().map(|effects| EffectsData {
            isolation: effects.isolation,
            opacity: effects.opacity,
            blend_mode: effects.blend_mode,
            filter: effects.filter.clone(),
            backdrop_filter: effects.backdrop_filter.clone(),
        })
    }

    /// Whether an SVG mask or clip path of the box covers no area, which leaves nothing of the box.
    pub(crate) fn is_hidden_by_empty_svg_mask_or_clip(&self) -> bool {
        self.mask_layers
            .iter()
            .any(|mask| mask.origin != super::MaskLayerOrigin::CssMaskLayers && mask.rect.is_empty())
    }

    /// Whether the box's effects layer sits under its transform, clip and mask nodes, rather than above them: for a
    /// backdrop filter, and for a filter the box's clip-path, clip or mask has to apply to.
    pub(crate) fn effects_layer_is_inside_transform_and_clips(&self) -> bool {
        self.effects.as_ref().is_some_and(|effects| {
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1/#placement
            // "The compositing model follows the SVG compositing model: first any filter effect is applied, then any
            // clipping, masking and opacity."
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1/#FilterEffectsRegion
            // NB: An SVG filter's region and primitive subregions are rects in the box's local coordinate system, so
            //     its graph has to run under the box's transform.
            effects.backdrop_filter.is_some()
                || (effects.filter.is_some()
                    && (self.filter_references_svg_filter
                        || self.clip_path.is_some()
                        || self.css_clip.is_some()
                        || !self.mask_layers.is_empty()))
        })
    }

    /// Gathers a box's facts for the visual context update, with the bounds of the SVG filter the box references,
    /// which the update keeps on its row.
    pub(crate) fn gather(
        layout_arena: &impl PaintableRowsRead,
        slot: NodeSlotId,
        pixel_ratio: f64,
        consults_default_scroll_shift_anchors: bool,
    ) -> (Self, Option<crate::layout::used_values::FfiCssPixelRect>) {
        let default_scroll_shift_anchor = if consults_default_scroll_shift_anchors {
            layout_arena.default_scroll_shift_anchor(slot)
        } else {
            NodeSlotId::INVALID
        };
        let mut svg_filter_bounds = None;
        let facts = Self::gather_with_effects(
            layout_arena,
            slot,
            pixel_ratio,
            default_scroll_shift_anchor,
            |layout_arena| {
                let Some(resolved) = super::node_values::resolve_effects_data(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio) else {
                    return (None, false);
                };
                svg_filter_bounds = resolved.svg_filter_bounds;
                (resolved.effects, resolved.references_svg_filter)
            },
        );
        (facts, svg_filter_bounds)
    }

    /// Gathers the facts of a box painted inside an SVG resource, which the visual context update
    /// does not reach, along with the bounds of the SVG filter it references. Nothing is stored.
    pub(crate) fn gather_for_resource_content(
        layout_arena: &impl PaintRead,
        slot: NodeSlotId,
        pixel_ratio: f64,
    ) -> (Self, Option<crate::layout::used_values::FfiCssPixelRect>) {
        let mut svg_filter_bounds = None;
        let facts = Self::gather_with_effects(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio, NodeSlotId::INVALID, |layout_arena| {
            let Some(resolved) = super::node_values::resolve_effects_data(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio) else {
                return (None, false);
            };
            svg_filter_bounds = resolved.svg_filter_bounds;
            (resolved.effects, resolved.references_svg_filter)
        });
        (facts, svg_filter_bounds)
    }

    fn gather_with_effects<Arena: PaintRead>(
        layout_arena: &Arena,
        slot: NodeSlotId,
        pixel_ratio: f64,
        default_scroll_shift_anchor: NodeSlotId,
        effects: impl FnOnce(&Arena) -> (Option<EffectsData>, bool),
    ) -> Self {
        let mut facts = Self {
            needs_compositor_background_color_effect: layout_arena.node_has_compositor_animation_frame(
                slot,
                crate::layout::node_data::CompositorAnimationFrameKind::BackgroundColor,
            ),
            transform: None,
            transform_is_invertible: false,
            perspective: None,
            effects: None,
            overflow_clip: None,
            css_clip: None,
            clip_decided_by_parent: None,
            clip_path: None,
            mask_layers: Vec::new(),
            overflow_clip_contour: None,
            establishes_absolute_containing_block: false,
            establishes_fixed_containing_block: false,
            backface_hidden: false,
            establishes_or_extends_3d_rendering_context: false,
            may_have_clip: false,
            default_scroll_shift_anchor,
            filter_references_svg_filter: false,
        };
        if let Some((transform, transform_is_invertible)) =
            super::node_values::compute_transform(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio)
        {
            facts.transform = Some(transform);
            facts.transform_is_invertible = transform_is_invertible;
        }
        facts.perspective = super::node_values::compute_perspective_data(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio);
        let (effects, filter_references_svg_filter) = effects(layout_arena);
        facts.effects = effects.map(std::rc::Rc::new);
        facts.filter_references_svg_filter = filter_references_svg_filter;
        facts.backface_hidden = super::node_values::backface_hidden(layout_arena, slot);
        let node = slot;
        facts.establishes_or_extends_3d_rendering_context =
            crate::painting::style_queries::establishes_or_extends_a_3d_rendering_context(layout_arena, node);
        let (establishes_absolute, establishes_fixed) =
            crate::painting::style_queries::establishes_positioning_containing_blocks(layout_arena, node);
        facts.establishes_absolute_containing_block = establishes_absolute;
        facts.establishes_fixed_containing_block = establishes_fixed;
        facts.clip_path = super::basic_shapes::compute_basic_shape_clip_path_data(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio)
            .map(|(path, bounding_rect, fill_rule)| (std::sync::Arc::new(path), bounding_rect, fill_rule));
        let converter = crate::painting::display_list::device_pixels::DevicePixelConverter::new(pixel_ratio);
        let masks_backdrop = facts.effects_layer_is_inside_transform_and_clips();
        facts.mask_layers = super::node_values::mask_layer_presence(layout_arena, slot)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|layer| MaskData {
                rect: converter.enclosing_device_rect(layer.area),
                kind: layer.kind,
                origin: layer.origin,
                masks_backdrop,
            })
            .collect();
        facts.css_clip = super::node_values::compute_css_clip_data(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio);
        facts.clip_decided_by_parent = layout_arena
            .with_committed_fragment_link(slot, |link| {
                link.and_then(|link| link.placement.shown_as.facts.clip_decided_by_parent)
            })
            .map(|clip_relative_to_border_box| {
                let border_box =
                    crate::painting::paintable_geometry::first_fragment_border_box_rect(layout_arena, slot);
                let converter = crate::painting::display_list::device_pixels::DevicePixelConverter::new(pixel_ratio);
                ClipData {
                    rect: converter
                        .rounded_device_rect(clip_relative_to_border_box.translated_by(border_box.location()))
                        .to_float(),
                    corner_radii: CornerRadii::default(),
                    mode: ClipMode::Intersect,
                }
            });
        facts.may_have_clip = super::node_values::may_have_clip(layout_arena, slot);
        facts.overflow_clip = if facts.may_have_clip {
            super::node_values::compute_clip_data(layout_arena, slot, pixel_ratio)
        } else {
            None
        };
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-borders-4/#corner-shape-rendering
        // An element's overflow area is shaped by its inner contour.
        // NB: As with rounded corners, a clip in one axis only is not shaped.
        // FIXME: Shape an overflow clip edge that overflow-clip-margin moves off the padding box.
        if let Some(overflow_clip) = &mut facts.overflow_clip
            && super::node_values::overflow_clips_both_axes(layout_arena, slot)
            && let Some(border_shape) =
                crate::painting::border_shape::BorderShape::for_paintable(layout_arena, slot, &converter)
        {
            let (path, fill_rule) = border_shape.into_overflow_clip_path();
            facts.overflow_clip_contour = Some(ClipPathData {
                path: std::sync::Arc::new(path),
                bounding_rect: libgfx_rust::enclosing_int_rect(overflow_clip.rect),
                fill_rule,
            });
            overflow_clip.corner_radii = CornerRadii::default();
        } else if let Some(overflow_clip) = &mut facts.overflow_clip
            && overflow_clip.corner_radii.has_any_radius()
            && let Some(style) = layout_arena.node_style_if_live(slot)
        {
            let border_box = crate::painting::paintable_geometry::absolute_border_box_rect(layout_arena, slot);
            let border_box_rect = converter.rounded_device_rect(border_box).to_float();
            let border_radii = super::node_values::border_radii_data(style, layout_arena, slot).as_corners(&converter);
            let shapes = crate::painting::corner_shape::CornerShapes::of(style);
            if shapes.needs_contour(border_radii) {
                let insets = crate::painting::corner_shape::Insets {
                    top: f64::from(converter.rounded_device_pixels(style.border_top_width())),
                    right: f64::from(converter.rounded_device_pixels(style.border_right_width())),
                    bottom: f64::from(converter.rounded_device_pixels(style.border_bottom_width())),
                    left: f64::from(converter.rounded_device_pixels(style.border_left_width())),
                };
                let contour =
                    crate::painting::corner_shape::border_contour_path(border_box_rect, border_radii, shapes, insets);
                facts.overflow_clip_contour = Some(ClipPathData {
                    path: std::sync::Arc::new(contour),
                    bounding_rect: libgfx_rust::enclosing_int_rect(overflow_clip.rect),
                    fill_rule: WindingRule::Nonzero,
                });
                overflow_clip.corner_radii = CornerRadii::default();
            }
        }
        facts
    }

    pub(crate) fn clip_path_data(&self) -> Option<ClipPathData> {
        self.clip_path
            .as_ref()
            .map(|(path, bounding_rect, fill_rule)| ClipPathData {
                path: path.clone(),
                bounding_rect: *bounding_rect,
                fill_rule: *fill_rule,
            })
    }
}

pub(crate) struct FreshTree {
    pub tree: VisualContextTree,
    pub viewport_assignment: PaintableVisualContextAssignment,
}

pub(crate) fn create_fresh_tree_with_viewport_nodes(
    layout_arena: &impl PaintableRowsRead,
    viewport: NodeSlotId,
    inputs: &FfiVisualContextTreeInputs,
) -> FreshTree {
    let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create(super::node_values::visual_viewport_transform_data(inputs));
    let root_isolation_effect = tree.append_effect(
        EffectNodeData::layer_blending_with(CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal),
        EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
        VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
    );
    tree.root_isolation_effect = Some(root_isolation_effect);
    let root_context = ContextRef {
        spatial: VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        clip: ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
        effect: root_isolation_effect,
    };

    let viewport_scroll_node = tree.append_spatial(
        SpatialData::Scroll(ScrollData {
            state_slot: NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
            owner_paintable: viewport,
        }),
        VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
    );
    let viewport_state_for_descendants = ContextRef {
        spatial: viewport_scroll_node,
        clip: ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
        effect: root_isolation_effect,
    };

    let scrolled = PositioningContext {
        spatial: viewport_scroll_node,
        clip: ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
        nearest_scroll_like_node: viewport_scroll_node,
        plane_root: viewport_scroll_node,
    };
    let viewport_contexts = DescendantVisualContexts {
        effect: root_isolation_effect,
        normal: scrolled,
        absolute_position: scrolled,
        fixed_position: PositioningContext {
            spatial: VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
            plane_root: VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
            ..scrolled
        },
        flattens_inherited_transform: true,
        sorting_context_root: None,
        enclosing_stacking_context: viewport,
    };
    let mut viewport_assignment = PaintableVisualContextAssignment::from_data(
        viewport,
        layout_arena.paintable_data(viewport),
        PaintableVisualContextRecord {
            inherited_input: viewport_contexts,
            output_for_descendants: viewport_contexts,
            owns_geometry_dependent_nodes: false,
            subtree_may_own_geometry_dependent_nodes: false,
            stacking_context: crate::painting::stacking_context::StackingContextFacts::for_viewport(),
        },
    );
    viewport_assignment.own_scroll_node_index = viewport_scroll_node;
    viewport_assignment.has_accumulated_visual_context = true;
    viewport_assignment.accumulated_visual_context = root_context;
    viewport_assignment.accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants = viewport_state_for_descendants;
    FreshTree {
        tree,
        viewport_assignment,
    }
}

use crate::css::css_pixels::CssPixelPoint;
use crate::layout::node_data::{DomPaintFact, NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::painting::chrome_geometry::{PhysicalAxes, maximum_scroll_offset, minimum_scroll_offset};
use crate::painting::display_list::commands::UniqueNodeId;
use crate::painting::display_list::device_pixels::DevicePixelConverter;
use crate::painting::paint_passes::CompositorScrollRefreshOutcome;
use crate::painting::paint_read::PaintRead;
use crate::painting::{paintable_geometry, scroll_snap};
use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::{
    CompositorScrollNodeKind, CompositorScrollNodeRecord, CompositorSnapAreaRecord, CompositorSnapContainerRecord,
    SpatialData, SpatialNodeIndex, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
};
use libgfx_rust::{FloatPoint, IntRect, IntSize};

pub(crate) fn css_point_to_device_point(point: CssPixelPoint, device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64) -> FloatPoint {
    let scale = device_pixels_per_css_pixel as f32;
    FloatPoint {
        x: point.x.to_float() * scale,
        y: point.y.to_float() * scale,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn compositor_scroll_node_kind(
    source: &impl PaintRead,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
    mut wheel_scrollable_axes: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId) -> PhysicalAxes,
) -> Option<CompositorScrollNodeKind> {
    if source.node_has_dom_paint_fact(paintable, DomPaintFact::NestedNavigableContainer)
        || source.paintable_data(paintable).own_scroll_node_index == VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX
    {
        return None;
    }
    let is_viewport = source.node_kind_if_live(paintable) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport);
    let wheel_scrollable_axes = wheel_scrollable_axes(paintable);
    if !(wheel_scrollable_axes.horizontal
        || wheel_scrollable_axes.vertical
        || minimum_scroll_offset(source, paintable) != maximum_scroll_offset(source, paintable)
        || (!is_viewport && crate::painting::chrome_geometry::keeps_scrolls_along_some_axis(source, paintable)))
    {
        return None;
    }
    if is_viewport {
        Some(CompositorScrollNodeKind::Viewport)
    } else if source.node_generated_for(paintable) != 0 {
        Some(CompositorScrollNodeKind::PseudoElement)
    } else if source.node_is_element_backed(paintable) {
        Some(CompositorScrollNodeKind::Element)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) fn nearest_ancestor_with_compositor_scroll_node(
    source: &impl PaintRead,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
    mut wheel_scrollable_axes: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId) -> PhysicalAxes,
) -> Option<NodeSlotId> {
    let mut candidate = source.paintable_data(paintable).containing_block;
    while !candidate.is_invalid() && source.paintable_row_is_populated(candidate) {
        if compositor_scroll_node_kind(source, candidate, &mut wheel_scrollable_axes).is_some() {
            return Some(candidate);
        }
        candidate = source.paintable_data(candidate).containing_block;
    }
    None
}

pub(crate) fn compositor_scroll_node_record(
    source: &impl PaintRead,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
    scroll_node_kind: CompositorScrollNodeKind,
    device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    device_viewport_size: IntSize,
    mut wheel_scrollable_axes: impl FnMut(NodeSlotId) -> PhysicalAxes,
) -> CompositorScrollNodeRecord {
    let generated_for = source.node_generated_for(paintable);
    let node_identity = source.paintable_data(paintable).node_identity;
    debug_assert!(
        node_identity != 0,
        "a scroll node's identity is resolved by the visual context update"
    );
    let parent_scroll_node_index =
        match nearest_ancestor_with_compositor_scroll_node(source, paintable, &mut wheel_scrollable_axes) {
            Some(ancestor) => source.paintable_data(ancestor).own_scroll_node_index,
            None => VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        };
    let is_viewport = source.node_kind_if_live(paintable) == Some(NodeKind::Viewport);
    let scrollport_rect = if is_viewport {
        IntRect::new(0, 0, device_viewport_size.width, device_viewport_size.height)
    } else {
        DevicePixelConverter::new(device_pixels_per_css_pixel)
            .rounded_device_rect(paintable_geometry::absolute_padding_box_rect(source, paintable))
    };
    let scale = device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
    let wheel_scrollable_axes = wheel_scrollable_axes(paintable);
    let scroll_boundary_behavior = crate::painting::chrome_geometry::scroll_boundary_behavior(source, paintable);
    CompositorScrollNodeRecord {
        scrollable_node_id: UniqueNodeId(node_identity),
        scroll_node_index: source.paintable_data(paintable).own_scroll_node_index,
        parent_scroll_node_index,
        scrollport_rect,
        min_scroll_offset: css_point_to_device_point(minimum_scroll_offset(source, paintable), scale),
        max_scroll_offset: css_point_to_device_point(maximum_scroll_offset(source, paintable), scale),
        scroll_node_kind,
        pseudo_element_type: generated_for.saturating_sub(1),
        is_viewport,
        can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally: wheel_scrollable_axes.horizontal,
        can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically: wheel_scrollable_axes.vertical,
        chains_scroll_to_ancestors_horizontally: scroll_boundary_behavior.chains_to_ancestors.horizontal,
        chains_scroll_to_ancestors_vertically: scroll_boundary_behavior.chains_to_ancestors.vertical,
        shows_overscroll_effect_horizontally: scroll_boundary_behavior.shows_overscroll_effect.horizontal,
        shows_overscroll_effect_vertically: scroll_boundary_behavior.shows_overscroll_effect.vertical,
    }
}

// The compositor selects snap positions for the scrolls it performs from the same geometry the
// main thread selects from, kept in the tree beside the scroll node it belongs to.
pub(crate) fn compositor_snap_container_and_area_records(
    source: &impl PaintRead,
    paintable: NodeSlotId,
) -> Option<(CompositorSnapContainerRecord, Vec<CompositorSnapAreaRecord>)> {
    let geometry = scroll_snap::snap_container_geometry(source, paintable)?;
    let container = CompositorSnapContainerRecord {
        scroll_node_index: source.paintable_data(paintable).own_scroll_node_index,
        snapport: geometry.snapport,
        min_scroll_offset: geometry.min_scroll_offset,
        max_scroll_offset: geometry.max_scroll_offset,
        strictness: geometry.strictness,
        snaps_x: geometry.axes.x,
        snaps_y: geometry.axes.y,
        horizontal_writing_mode: geometry.horizontal_writing_mode,
        first_area_index: 0,
        area_count: 0,
    };
    let mut areas = Vec::new();
    scroll_snap::for_each_snap_area(source, paintable, |_, area| {
        areas.push(CompositorSnapAreaRecord {
            area_node_id: UniqueNodeId(area.node_id),
            pseudo_element_type: area.pseudo_element_type,
            rect: area.rect,
            align_x: area.align_x,
            align_y: area.align_y,
            always_stop: area.always_stop,
        });
    });
    Some((container, areas))
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct CompositorScrollInputs {
    pub(crate) device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
    pub(crate) device_viewport_size: IntSize,
}

pub(crate) fn refresh_compositor_scroll_table(
    arena: &mut crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena,
    state: &mut super::VisualContextState,
    inputs: CompositorScrollInputs,
) -> CompositorScrollRefreshOutcome {
    use crate::painting::record::change_ticks::RowPaintChange;
    use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::CompositorScrollTable;
    use std::sync::Arc;

    let Some(tree) = state.tree.as_mut() else {
        return CompositorScrollRefreshOutcome::default();
    };
    let previous = tree.compositor_scroll_table();
    let inputs_changed = state.last_compositor_scroll_inputs != Some(inputs);
    let snap_records_as_of = state.compositor_snap_records_as_of;
    let snap_records_are_stale = |owner: NodeSlotId| {
        snap_records_as_of.is_none_or(|as_of| {
            arena.everything_paints_anew_since(as_of)
                || arena
                    .paint_change_stamps(owner)
                    .row_or_anything_below_it_changed_since(as_of)
        })
    };
    let source = arena.paintable_rows();
    let wheel_axes = |slot| crate::painting::chrome_geometry::wheel_scrollable_axes(&source, slot);
    let mut nodes_with_owners = Vec::new();
    for (index, spatial_node) in tree.spatial_nodes.iter().enumerate() {
        let SpatialData::Scroll(scroll) = &spatial_node.data else {
            continue;
        };
        let owner = scroll.owner_paintable;
        if !source.paintable_row_is_populated(owner) {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(kind) = compositor_scroll_node_kind(&source, owner, wheel_axes) {
            let node = compositor_scroll_node_record(
                &source,
                owner,
                kind,
                inputs.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
                inputs.device_viewport_size,
                wheel_axes,
            );
            debug_assert_eq!(node.scroll_node_index, SpatialNodeIndex(index as u32));
            nodes_with_owners.push((node, owner));
        }
    }
    nodes_with_owners.sort_unstable_by_key(|(node, _)| node.scroll_node_index);
    let mut containers = Vec::new();
    let mut areas = Vec::new();
    let mut damaged_subtrees = Vec::new();
    for (node, owner) in &nodes_with_owners {
        let previous_node = previous
            .nodes
            .binary_search_by_key(&node.scroll_node_index, |node| node.scroll_node_index)
            .ok()
            .map(|index| &previous.nodes[index]);
        let same_identity = previous_node.is_some_and(|before| {
            before.scrollable_node_id == node.scrollable_node_id
                && before.scroll_node_kind == node.scroll_node_kind
                && before.pseudo_element_type == node.pseudo_element_type
        });
        if !same_identity
            || previous_node.is_some_and(|before| before.parent_scroll_node_index != node.parent_scroll_node_index)
        {
            damaged_subtrees.push(*owner);
        }
        let recompute = inputs_changed || !same_identity || snap_records_are_stale(*owner);
        let snap_records = if recompute {
            compositor_snap_container_and_area_records(&source, *owner)
        } else {
            previous
                .snap_containers
                .binary_search_by_key(&node.scroll_node_index, |container| container.scroll_node_index)
                .ok()
                .map(|index| {
                    let container = previous.snap_containers[index];
                    let first = container.first_area_index as usize;
                    let end = first + container.area_count as usize;
                    (container, previous.snap_areas[first..end].to_vec())
                })
        };
        if let Some((mut container, container_areas)) = snap_records {
            container.first_area_index = areas.len().try_into().expect("snap area index fits in u32");
            container.area_count = container_areas.len().try_into().expect("snap area count fits in u32");
            areas.extend(container_areas);
            containers.push(container);
        }
    }
    for (before, owner) in previous.nodes.iter().zip(&state.compositor_scroll_owners) {
        if !nodes_with_owners
            .binary_search_by_key(&before.scroll_node_index, |(node, _)| node.scroll_node_index)
            .is_ok_and(|index| nodes_with_owners[index].1 == *owner)
            && source.paintable_row_is_populated(*owner)
        {
            damaged_subtrees.push(*owner);
        }
    }
    state.compositor_scroll_owners = nodes_with_owners.iter().map(|(_, owner)| *owner).collect();
    let refreshed = CompositorScrollTable {
        nodes: nodes_with_owners
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(node, _)| node)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .into(),
        snap_containers: containers.into(),
        snap_areas: areas.into(),
    };
    let table_changed = *previous != refreshed;
    if table_changed {
        Arc::make_mut(tree).set_compositor_scroll_table(refreshed);
    }
    let requires_display_list_recording = !damaged_subtrees.is_empty();
    for owner in damaged_subtrees {
        arena.note_paint_change_in_paint_subtree(owner, RowPaintChange::SCROLL_METADATA);
    }
    state.last_compositor_scroll_inputs = Some(inputs);
    state.compositor_snap_records_as_of = Some(arena.take_paint_generation());
    CompositorScrollRefreshOutcome {
        table_changed,
        requires_display_list_recording,
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct VisualContextTreeDelta {
    pub structural_epoch_changed: bool,
    pub requires_display_list_recording: bool,
    pub tombstoned_any_node: bool,
}

impl VisualContextTreeDelta {
    pub fn note_tombstoned(&mut self) {
        self.tombstoned_any_node = true;
        self.structural_epoch_changed = true;
        self.requires_display_list_recording = true;
    }

    pub fn note_repurposed_in_place(&mut self) {
        self.structural_epoch_changed = true;
        self.requires_display_list_recording = true;
    }

    pub fn note_allocated(&mut self, reused_freed_slot: bool) {
        self.requires_display_list_recording = true;
        self.structural_epoch_changed |= reused_freed_slot;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn allocating_a_fresh_slot_requires_recording_without_an_epoch_change() {
        let mut delta = VisualContextTreeDelta::default();
        delta.note_allocated(false);
        assert!(!delta.structural_epoch_changed);
        assert!(delta.requires_display_list_recording);
    }

    #[test]
    fn reusing_a_freed_slot_changes_the_structural_epoch() {
        let mut delta = VisualContextTreeDelta::default();
        delta.note_allocated(true);
        assert!(delta.structural_epoch_changed);
        assert!(delta.requires_display_list_recording);
    }
}

/*

use super::BoxVisualContextNodeHandles;
use crate::layout::node_data::NodeSlotId;
pub use crate::painting::host::VisualContextUpdateScope;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum VisualContextBoxDirtyKind {
    NewRow = 0,
    RecommittedInPlace = 1,
    MovedWithDescendants = 2,
    ContainingBlockChanged = 3,
    InlineGeometryChanged = 4,
    StyleValueChange = 5,
    StyleStructuralChange = 6,
    ScrollableOverflowFlipped = 7,
    ReattachedInLayoutTree = 8,
    DefaultScrollShiftInputsChanged = 9,
    OffsetPathContainingBlockChanged = 10,
}

impl VisualContextBoxDirtyKind {
    const fn bit(self) -> u16 {
        1 << (self as u16)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct BoxDirtyBits(u16);

impl BoxDirtyBits {
    pub fn insert(&mut self, kind: VisualContextBoxDirtyKind) {
        self.0 |= kind.bit();
    }

    pub fn contains(&self, kind: VisualContextBoxDirtyKind) -> bool {
        self.0 & kind.bit() != 0
    }

    pub fn merge(&mut self, other: BoxDirtyBits) {
        self.0 |= other.0;
    }

    pub fn moves_descendants(&self) -> bool {
        self.contains(VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::MovedWithDescendants)
            || self.contains(VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::ContainingBlockChanged)
    }

    pub fn is_value_only(&self) -> bool {
        self.0 == VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange.bit()
    }

    /// Whether only the geometry of the box changed, with its style and its place in the tree as they were.
    pub fn changes_geometry_only(&self) -> bool {
        let geometry_kinds = VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::RecommittedInPlace.bit()
            | VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::MovedWithDescendants.bit()
            | VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::InlineGeometryChanged.bit();
        self.0 != 0 && self.0 & !geometry_kinds == 0
    }

    /// Whether the box only moved, with its style and content as they were.
    pub fn is_move_only(&self) -> bool {
        self.0 == VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::MovedWithDescendants.bit()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct RemovedBoxBlocks {
    pub slot: NodeSlotId,
    pub node_handles: BoxVisualContextNodeHandles,
    pub former_paint_parent: NodeSlotId,
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct VisualContextDirtySet {
    pub boxes: crate::fork::ForkShared<crate::fast_hash::FastMap<NodeSlotId, BoxDirtyBits>>,
    pub removed: Vec<RemovedBoxBlocks>,
    pub scope: VisualContextUpdateScope,
}

pub const MINIMUM_PENDING_DIRTY_BOX_LIMIT: usize = 1024;

impl VisualContextDirtySet {
    pub fn note_box(&mut self, slot: NodeSlotId, kind: VisualContextBoxDirtyKind, pending_box_limit: usize) {
        if slot.is_invalid() || self.scope.rebuilds_every_box() {
            return;
        }
        if self.boxes.len() >= pending_box_limit && !self.boxes.contains_key(&slot) {
            self.request_full_rebuild(VisualContextUpdateScope::EveryBox);
            return;
        }
        self.boxes.entry(slot).or_default().insert(kind);
    }

    pub fn forget_box(&mut self, slot: NodeSlotId) {
        self.boxes.remove(&slot);
    }

    pub fn note_removed(&mut self, removed: RemovedBoxBlocks) {
        self.boxes.remove(&removed.slot);
        self.removed.push(removed);
    }

    pub fn request_full_rebuild(&mut self, scope: VisualContextUpdateScope) {
        self.scope = self.scope.max(scope);
        self.forget_boxes();
    }

    /// Forgets the boxes, keeping the map's room where no fork shares it.
    fn forget_boxes(&mut self) {
        match self.boxes.unshared_mut() {
            Some(boxes) => boxes.clear(),
            None => self.boxes.assign(Default::default()),
        }
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.boxes.is_empty() && self.removed.is_empty() && self.scope == VisualContextUpdateScope::DirtyPath
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub fn is_value_only(&self) -> bool {
        self.scope == VisualContextUpdateScope::DirtyPath
            && self.removed.is_empty()
            && self.boxes.values().all(BoxDirtyBits::is_value_only)
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.forget_boxes();
        self.removed.clear();
        self.scope = VisualContextUpdateScope::DirtyPath;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn slot(index: u32, generation: u8) -> NodeSlotId {
        NodeSlotId::new(index, generation)
    }

    #[test]
    fn kinds_coalesce_per_box_and_generations_stay_distinct() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        dirty.note_box(slot(3, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange, usize::MAX);
        dirty.note_box(slot(3, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::MovedWithDescendants, usize::MAX);
        dirty.note_box(slot(3, 2), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::NewRow, usize::MAX);
        assert_eq!(dirty.boxes.len(), 2);
        let bits = dirty.boxes[&slot(3, 1)];
        assert!(bits.contains(VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange));
        assert!(bits.moves_descendants());
        assert!(!bits.is_value_only());
        assert!(dirty.boxes[&slot(3, 2)].contains(VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::NewRow));
        assert!(!dirty.is_value_only());
    }

    #[test]
    fn value_only_sets_are_recognized() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        assert!(dirty.is_empty());
        dirty.note_box(slot(1, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange, usize::MAX);
        assert!(dirty.is_value_only());
        dirty.note_removed(RemovedBoxBlocks {
            slot: slot(1, 1),
            node_handles: BoxVisualContextNodeHandles::default(),
            former_paint_parent: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        });
        assert!(!dirty.boxes.contains_key(&slot(1, 1)));
        assert!(!dirty.is_value_only());
    }

    #[test]
    fn requested_scopes_merge_to_the_widest() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        dirty.request_full_rebuild(VisualContextUpdateScope::FreshTree);
        dirty.request_full_rebuild(VisualContextUpdateScope::EveryBox);
        assert_eq!(dirty.scope, VisualContextUpdateScope::FreshTree);
        dirty.clear();
        assert!(dirty.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_slots_are_ignored() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        dirty.note_box(NodeSlotId::INVALID, VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::NewRow, usize::MAX);
        assert!(dirty.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn exceeding_the_pending_box_limit_coalesces_into_a_full_rebuild() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        dirty.note_box(slot(0, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange, 2);
        dirty.note_box(slot(1, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange, 2);
        dirty.note_box(slot(0, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::NewRow, 2);
        assert_eq!(dirty.boxes.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(dirty.scope, VisualContextUpdateScope::DirtyPath);
        dirty.note_removed(RemovedBoxBlocks {
            slot: slot(9, 1),
            node_handles: BoxVisualContextNodeHandles::default(),
            former_paint_parent: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        });
        dirty.note_box(slot(2, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange, 2);
        assert!(dirty.boxes.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(dirty.removed.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(dirty.scope, VisualContextUpdateScope::EveryBox);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_pending_full_rebuild_absorbs_per_box_notes_and_keeps_removed_blocks() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        dirty.note_box(slot(0, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::StyleValueChange, usize::MAX);
        dirty.request_full_rebuild(VisualContextUpdateScope::FreshTree);
        dirty.note_box(slot(1, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::NewRow, usize::MAX);
        dirty.note_removed(RemovedBoxBlocks {
            slot: slot(2, 1),
            node_handles: BoxVisualContextNodeHandles::default(),
            former_paint_parent: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        });
        assert!(dirty.boxes.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(dirty.removed.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(dirty.scope, VisualContextUpdateScope::FreshTree);
    }

    #[test]
    fn removed_blocks_survive_a_pending_full_rebuild() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        dirty.note_removed(RemovedBoxBlocks {
            slot: slot(1, 1),
            node_handles: BoxVisualContextNodeHandles::default(),
            former_paint_parent: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        });
        dirty.request_full_rebuild(VisualContextUpdateScope::EveryBox);
        dirty.note_removed(RemovedBoxBlocks {
            slot: slot(2, 1),
            node_handles: BoxVisualContextNodeHandles::default(),
            former_paint_parent: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        });
        assert_eq!(dirty.removed.len(), 2);
        assert!(!dirty.is_empty());
        dirty.clear();
        assert!(dirty.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn forgetting_a_box_drops_its_pending_entry() {
        let mut dirty = VisualContextDirtySet::default();
        dirty.note_box(slot(0, 1), VisualContextBoxDirtyKind::NewRow, usize::MAX);
        dirty.forget_box(slot(0, 1));
        assert!(dirty.is_empty());
    }
}
