//! Where the lanes of each document come together, on the render owner, which keeps them beside the document's render
//! state.
//!
//! The owner samples a frame of a document, and the frame's lane takes the place of the lane before it once its pieces
//! have come: the recorder state and the seal its ticks present with, from the Paint thread once it presented the
//! frame, and a plan, from the end of the frame's rendering update, or of a later one that presents no frame of its
//! own. The fork of the render state the lane writes is taken while no job of the host wrote the state since the frame
//! was sampled, which the state then still shows: as the first tick that needs it runs, or before the host first writes
//! the state, where the pointer moves over the document or a task runs the plan's animations. Until a lane comes
//! together, the one before it follows the pointer, whose frames the presenter drops once it presented the newer
//! frame. A rendering update that presents no frame of its own leaves the lane of the frame before it to go on from the
//! state as the update left it: a fork the update's writes passed goes, and the state is forked again.

use super::super::owner::{self, DocumentId};
use super::{
    ClockPlan, ClockRecorder, ClockTicks, FfiClockLaneState, Lane, LaneMove, LanePublication, LaneReport, LaneState,
    PendingPointer, TickPresented,
};
use crate::painting::recording_slot::RecordingAnswer;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;

/// What the render owner keeps of a document's lanes, beside its render state.
pub(crate) struct LaneSlot {
    ticks: Arc<ClockTicks>,
    /// How many frames of the document the owner sampled: the last one is the frame the next lane starts from.
    sampled: u64,
    lanes: Lanes,
    /// Whether a tick presented a frame, and the last pointer move a tick took, since a rendering update last took the
    /// lanes in.
    presented: bool,
    last_move: Option<LaneMove>,
    /// The compositor context of the same-process iframe the lanes' hover handed the pointer to last, until it left it:
    /// the hover of the next lane hands it that the pointer left as well.
    nested: Option<u64>,
    /// The serial number of the last rendering update that took in what the lanes did, until it, or an update after it,
    /// seals its plan, which follows the frame it presents: a lane presents nothing meanwhile, as the update's frame
    /// shows what it took in, which no frame of the lane goes back from. The plan of an update before it, which seals
    /// as the later update runs, leaves it standing. The take-in and the seal both run on the owner, in the order the
    /// host made them.
    taken_in: Option<u64>,
}

impl Drop for LaneSlot {
    /// A retired document has no lanes: the render clock hears no lane follows the pointer or ticks.
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        *self.ticks.published() = LanePublication::default();
    }
}

/// The lanes of a document.
#[derive(Default)]
#[expect(
    clippy::large_enum_variant,
    reason = "a document has one set of lanes, which a lane moves between without an allocation"
)]
enum Lanes {
    #[default]
    None,
    /// The lane of the frame sampled last.
    Newest(Lane),
    /// The pieces of the lane of the frame sampled last, until they come together with a plan, and the lane of an
    /// earlier frame, which follows the presented frame meanwhile, until the frame sampled last presents.
    Coming { pieces: LanePieces, earlier: Option<Lane> },
}

impl Lanes {
    /// The lane that follows the presented frame.
    fn current(&mut self) -> Option<&mut Lane> {
        match self {
            Self::None => None,
            Self::Newest(lane) => Some(lane),
            Self::Coming { earlier, .. } => earlier.as_mut(),
        }
    }

    fn current_ref(&self) -> Option<&Lane> {
        match self {
            Self::None => None,
            Self::Newest(lane) => Some(lane),
            Self::Coming { earlier, .. } => earlier.as_ref(),
        }
    }

    /// Whether the lane of the frame sampled last follows the pointer, or may once its pieces come together with the plan
    /// they wait for.
    fn newest_follows_pointer(&self) -> bool {
        match self {
            Self::None => false,
            Self::Newest(lane) => lane.needs_render_state() && lane.plan.follows_pointer() && !lane.hovered.is_parked(),
            Self::Coming { pieces, .. } => match &pieces.plan {
                FramePlan::Unsealed => true,
                FramePlan::None => false,
                FramePlan::Sealed(plan) => plan.needs_render_state() && plan.follows_pointer(),
            },
        }
    }

    /// What the lane of the frame sampled last writes, whether or not its pieces came together yet.
    fn newest_state(&mut self) -> Option<&mut LaneState> {
        match self {
            Self::None => None,
            Self::Newest(lane) => Some(&mut lane.state),
            Self::Coming { pieces, .. } => Some(&mut pieces.state),
        }
    }
}

/// The pieces of a lane, as they come.
#[derive(Default)]
struct LanePieces {
    state: LaneState,
    recorder: Option<ClockRecorder>,
    plan: FramePlan,
}

/// The plan of a lane's frame. A rendering update may leave the frame no plan, and a later one that presents no frame of
/// its own seal one for it.
#[derive(Default)]
#[expect(
    clippy::large_enum_variant,
    reason = "a document has the pieces of one lane at a time, which a plan moves into without an allocation"
)]
enum FramePlan {
    #[default]
    Unsealed,
    None,
    Sealed(ClockPlan),
}

/// Lets go of `lanes`, whose forks may take long to drop: they are dropped once the owner no longer holds the render
/// states, which the host may be waiting for.
fn retire(lanes: Lanes) {
    owner::drop_after_hold(lanes);
}

/// On the render owner: drops the slot of a retired document, whose lanes it lets go of.
pub(in crate::render_state) fn retire_slot(slot: Option<LaneSlot>) {
    if let Some(mut slot) = slot {
        retire(std::mem::take(&mut slot.lanes));
    }
}

/// What hands the lane of a frame the pieces the Paint thread makes, once it presented the frame.
pub(crate) struct LaneDelivery {
    ticks: Arc<ClockTicks>,
    frame: u64,
}

impl LaneDelivery {
    /// Hands the lane the recorder state and the seal its ticks present with, from what the recording of its frame
    /// answered. On the Paint thread, once the frame is presented.
    pub(crate) fn deliver(&self, answer: &mut RecordingAnswer) {
        let Some((recorder, presentation, output)) = answer.clock_lane_recorder() else {
            // No lane starts from the frame, and the presenter takes no frame of the lane of an earlier one after it:
            // the moves and the animations are the host's.
            let (ticks, frame) = (Arc::clone(&self.ticks), self.frame);
            super::super::post_to_render_side(move || {
                with_slot(ticks.document, |slot| slot.forget_coming_lane(frame));
            });
            return;
        };
        let presented = match output {
            Some(output) => TickPresented::Frame {
                output,
                publishes: true,
            },
            None => TickPresented::Nothing,
        };
        let structural_epoch_on_screen = recorder
            .published_recording
            .as_ref()
            .map(|published| published.recorded_structural_epoch);
        let recorder = ClockRecorder {
            recorder,
            presentation,
            presented,
            structural_epoch_on_screen,
            held_frame: answer.take_held_frame(),
        };
        let (ticks, frame) = (Arc::clone(&self.ticks), self.frame);
        super::super::post_to_render_side(move || {
            with_slot(ticks.document, |slot| slot.deliver_recorder(frame, recorder));
        });
    }
}

/// Runs `job` on the slot of `document`, where the owner sampled a frame of it, and publishes what the lanes do then.
fn with_slot<R>(document: DocumentId, job: impl FnOnce(&mut LaneSlot) -> R) -> Option<R> {
    owner::with_lanes(document, |slot| {
        let slot = slot.as_mut()?;
        let answer = job(slot);
        slot.publish();
        Some(answer)
    })
    .flatten()
}

/// The nodes the selection in the fork of the lane that follows the presented frame of `document` highlights. For a test.
pub(in crate::render_state) fn selection_shown_for_testing(
    document: DocumentId,
) -> Option<Vec<super::selection::SelectionRowForTesting>> {
    with_slot(document, |slot| {
        match slot.lanes.current_ref().map(|lane| &lane.state) {
            Some(super::LaneState::Forked { fork, .. }) => Some(super::selection::rows_for_testing(fork)),
            _ => None,
        }
    })
    .flatten()
}

/// On the render owner: notes that it sampled a frame of the document `ticks` belong to, whose lane starts once the
/// frame is presented, and answers what hands the lane its pieces then.
pub(in crate::render_state) fn note_sampled(ticks: &Arc<ClockTicks>) -> LaneDelivery {
    owner::with_lanes(ticks.document, |slot| {
        let slot = LaneSlot::of(slot, ticks);
        slot.sampled += 1;
        let earlier = match std::mem::take(&mut slot.lanes) {
            // The state shows the new frame, which the lane before it can no longer fork.
            Lanes::Newest(mut lane) => {
                lane.state.move_on();
                Some(lane)
            }
            Lanes::Coming { pieces, earlier } => {
                retire(Lanes::Coming { pieces, earlier: None });
                earlier
            }
            Lanes::None => None,
        };
        slot.lanes = Lanes::Coming {
            pieces: LanePieces::default(),
            earlier,
        };
        slot.publish();
        LaneDelivery {
            ticks: Arc::clone(ticks),
            frame: slot.sampled,
        }
    })
    .expect("the owner samples a frame of a render state it holds")
}

/// On the render owner: notes that a job of the host is about to write the render state of `document`, which then no
/// longer is the one the frame sampled last shows. A lane that may want it forks the state first.
pub(in crate::render_state) fn note_host_write(document: DocumentId) {
    with_slot(document, |slot| {
        // NB: The update has taken this lane in and holds it until its plan is sealed. If the lane sampled nothing,
        //     the update either replaces its frame or leaves the host showing the same frame. Do not copy the old
        //     state just to discard it when the update samples its replacement. A newly sampled frame's coming lane
        //     still needs its state preserved: a task may write it before its recorder and plan arrive.
        if slot.taken_in.is_some()
            && let Lanes::Newest(lane) = &mut slot.lanes
            && lane.samples_nothing()
        {
            lane.state.move_on();
            return;
        }
        // NB: Nor does a coming lane tick while the update holds it, and with no animations to sample, what it would show
        //     is what the update replaces or leaves showing, as above.
        if slot.taken_in.is_some()
            && let Lanes::Coming { pieces, .. } = &slot.lanes
            && matches!(&pieces.plan, FramePlan::Sealed(plan) if !plan.animates())
            && let Some(state) = slot.lanes.newest_state()
        {
            state.move_on();
            return;
        }
        // A lane that follows the pointer hovers beside the next task, which may begin as soon as this job is done,
        // whether or not its animations run beside the idle event loop.
        let needs_state = match &slot.lanes {
            Lanes::Newest(lane) => lane.needs_render_state(),
            Lanes::Coming { pieces, .. } => match &pieces.plan {
                FramePlan::Sealed(plan) => plan.needs_render_state(),
                _ => true,
            },
            Lanes::None => false,
        };
        let wants_fork = needs_state && (slot.ticks.wants_fork() || slot.lanes.newest_follows_pointer());
        if let Some(state) = slot.lanes.newest_state() {
            if wants_fork {
                state.fork(document);
            }
            state.move_on();
        }
    });
}

/// On the render owner: hands the lane of the frame of `document` sampled last `plan`, which the rendering update with
/// the serial number `update` that sampled it sealed, or none.
pub(in crate::render_state) fn seal_plan(document: DocumentId, plan: Option<ClockPlan>, update: u64) {
    with_slot(document, |slot| slot.deliver_plan(plan, update));
}

/// On the render owner: has the lanes of the document `ticks` belong to present nothing until the rendering update with
/// the serial number `update`, which takes them in now, seals its plan, and answers what their hover did so far. A
/// document whose owner sampled no frame yet gets its slot now, whose first lane waits for the update's plan too.
#[must_use]
pub(in crate::render_state) fn take_lanes_in(ticks: &Arc<ClockTicks>, update: u64) -> LaneReport {
    owner::with_lanes(ticks.document, |slot| {
        let slot = LaneSlot::of(slot, ticks);
        slot.taken_in = Some(update);
        let report = slot.take_report();
        slot.publish();
        report
    })
    .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// On the render owner: answers what the hover of the lanes of the document `ticks` belong to did so far, and leaves
/// them ticking, for the host to take in between two rendering updates.
#[must_use]
pub(in crate::render_state) fn take_lane_report(ticks: &Arc<ClockTicks>) -> LaneReport {
    with_slot(ticks.document, LaneSlot::take_report).unwrap_or_default()
}

/// On the render owner: has the lane of the presented frame of the document `ticks` belong to record it where the
/// compositor scrolled to past what the display list it shows holds.
pub(super) fn record_where_scrolled(ticks: &Arc<ClockTicks>) {
    with_slot(ticks.document, LaneSlot::record_where_scrolled);
}

/// On the render owner: runs the tick queued for the lanes `ticks` belong to.
pub(super) fn tick(ticks: &Arc<ClockTicks>) {
    ticks.queued.swap(false, Ordering::AcqRel);
    with_slot(ticks.document, LaneSlot::tick);
}

impl LaneSlot {
    /// The slot `slot` holds for the lanes of the document `ticks` belong to, which it makes where it holds none yet.
    fn of<'a>(slot: &'a mut Option<LaneSlot>, ticks: &Arc<ClockTicks>) -> &'a mut LaneSlot {
        slot.get_or_insert_with(|| LaneSlot {
            ticks: Arc::clone(ticks),
            sampled: 0,
            lanes: Lanes::None,
            presented: false,
            last_move: None,
            nested: None,
            taken_in: None,
        })
    }

    fn deliver_recorder(&mut self, frame: u64, recorder: ClockRecorder) {
        // The owner sampled a later frame since, whose lane takes this one's place.
        if frame != self.sampled {
            return;
        }
        if let Lanes::Coming { pieces, earlier } = &mut self.lanes {
            pieces.recorder = Some(recorder);
            // The frame presented, and the presenter takes no frame of the lane of an earlier one after it.
            if let Some(earlier) = earlier.take() {
                retire(Lanes::Newest(earlier));
            }
            self.come_together();
        }
    }

    /// Has the frame `frame`, from which no lane starts, end the lanes: a move waits for nothing more.
    fn forget_coming_lane(&mut self, frame: u64) {
        if frame == self.sampled && matches!(self.lanes, Lanes::Coming { .. }) {
            self.retire_lanes();
        }
    }

    fn deliver_plan(&mut self, plan: Option<ClockPlan>, update: u64) {
        self.taken_in = self.taken_in.filter(|taken_in| *taken_in > update);
        if super::hover::logs_hover() {
            eprintln!(
                "{} hover lane: plan sealed, lanes {}",
                super::hover::log_time(),
                match &self.lanes {
                    Lanes::None => "none",
                    Lanes::Newest(_) => "newest",
                    Lanes::Coming { earlier: Some(_), .. } => "coming beside an earlier",
                    Lanes::Coming { earlier: None, .. } => "coming",
                }
            );
        }
        match (&mut self.lanes, plan) {
            (Lanes::Coming { pieces, .. }, plan) => {
                // NB: The frame's own update sealed already, so this one presented no frame of its own.
                if self.taken_in.is_none() && !matches!(pieces.plan, FramePlan::Unsealed) {
                    pieces.state.rejoin_the_state();
                }
                pieces.plan = plan.map_or(FramePlan::None, FramePlan::Sealed);
                self.come_together();
            }
            // A rendering update that presented no frame of its own leaves its plan to the lane of the frame before it.
            (Lanes::Newest(lane), Some(plan)) => {
                // NB: With no replacement frame, the completed update left the host showing this lane's frame.
                //     Its next tick or the next task's first write can preserve that state then.
                if self.taken_in.is_none() {
                    lane.rejoin_the_state();
                }
                lane.replan(plan);
            }
            // One that seals no plan leaves a lane that showed no sample following nothing: a later update that presents
            // no frame of its own has it follow its plan again, which a lane that went away could not.
            (Lanes::Newest(lane), None) if lane.samples_nothing() => lane.unplan(),
            (_, _) => self.retire_lanes(),
        }
    }

    /// Lets go of the lanes.
    fn retire_lanes(&mut self) {
        retire(std::mem::take(&mut self.lanes));
    }

    /// Has the lane of the frame sampled last take the place of the lane before it, once its pieces have come with a
    /// plan. The lanes presented nothing since the rendering update that sampled the frame took them in, so the frame
    /// shows all they did, and a move that waits is the new lane's first tick's to hover.
    fn come_together(&mut self) {
        let lane = match std::mem::take(&mut self.lanes) {
            Lanes::Coming {
                pieces:
                    LanePieces {
                        state,
                        recorder: Some(recorder),
                        plan: FramePlan::Sealed(plan),
                    },
                earlier,
            } => {
                if let Some(earlier) = earlier {
                    retire(Lanes::Newest(earlier));
                }
                Lane::new(recorder, plan, state)
            }
            // A frame with no plan yet has no lane: the moves are the host's.
            Lanes::Coming {
                pieces:
                    pieces @ LanePieces {
                        recorder: Some(_),
                        plan: FramePlan::None,
                        ..
                    },
                earlier,
            } => {
                if let Some(earlier) = earlier {
                    retire(Lanes::Newest(earlier));
                }
                self.lanes = Lanes::Coming { pieces, earlier: None };
                return;
            }
            lanes => {
                self.lanes = lanes;
                return;
            }
        };
        self.lanes = Lanes::Newest(lane);
        if super::hover::logs_hover() {
            eprintln!("{} hover lane: lane came together", super::hover::log_time());
        }
        self.take_in_scroll_offsets();
    }

    /// Hands the current lane where the compositor scrolled to at the latest tick that said so. Where no lane came
    /// together yet, the offsets wait for the one that does.
    fn take_in_scroll_offsets(&mut self) {
        let Some(lane) = self.lanes.current() else {
            return;
        };
        if let Some(offsets) = self
            .ticks
            .scroll_offsets
            .lock()
            .expect("clock tick scroll offsets")
            .take()
        {
            lane.scroll_offsets = offsets;
        }
    }

    /// Shows the cursor of what is under the move that waits for a tick, if one waits, in the frame the screen shows,
    /// as a tick that presents nothing: the host hovers the move once it takes the lanes in.
    fn show_cursor_where_a_move_waits(&mut self) {
        let Some(pointer) = self.ticks.pointer_state().take() else {
            return;
        };
        self.show_cursor_for(pointer);
    }

    fn show_cursor_for(&mut self, pointer: PendingPointer) {
        let frame_time_nanoseconds = self.ticks.latest.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        let document = self.ticks.document;
        let nested = self.nested;
        let (hovered, nested) = match self.lanes.current() {
            // A lane that needs no render state hovers its read-only frame as it always does, which presents nothing.
            Some(lane) if !lane.needs_render_state() => {
                lane.hovered.go_on_from_nested(nested);
                let hovered = lane.hover_read_only(pointer, frame_time_nanoseconds);
                (Some(hovered), lane.hovered.nested())
            }
            // A lane without a fork, which the host's write let go of as the update took the lane in, hit tests the
            // state the host writes: what the frame the update presents next shows, which the cursor follows ahead of it.
            Some(lane) => {
                let hovered = lane
                    .show_cursor_on_fork(frame_time_nanoseconds, pointer)
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                        owner::with_state(document, None, |state| {
                            lane.show_cursor_only(state, pointer, frame_time_nanoseconds)
                        })
                    });
                (Some(hovered), nested)
            }
            None => (None, nested),
        };
        self.nested = nested;
        self.last_move = Some(hovered.unwrap_or(LaneMove {
            input_event_id: pointer.input_event_id,
            target: None,
            handed: false,
        }));
    }

    fn record_where_scrolled(&mut self) {
        let Some(scrolled) = self.ticks.take_scrolled_past_display_list() else {
            return;
        };
        // A rendering update that took in the lanes presents a frame of its own, which records for where the
        // compositor scrolled to.
        if self.taken_in.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        if let Lanes::Newest(lane) = &mut self.lanes {
            // The host records the document's frame again after a frame of the lane's fork, as after a tick's.
            self.presented |= lane.record_where_scrolled(self.ticks.document, scrolled);
        }
    }

    fn tick(&mut self) {
        self.take_in_scroll_offsets();
        // A rendering update took in what the lanes did, and the frame it presents shows that, at the time it took it
        // in: the lane of the frame before it presents nothing on from there, which the update's frame would go back
        // from, and the moves and animation times since wait for the lane of the update's frame.
        if self.taken_in.is_some() || matches!(self.lanes, Lanes::Coming { .. }) {
            if super::hover::logs_hover() && self.ticks.pointer_waits() {
                eprintln!(
                    "{} hover lane: a move waits for the update's frame",
                    super::hover::log_time()
                );
            }
            self.show_cursor_where_a_move_waits();
            return;
        }
        let samples_animations = !self.ticks.animations_held.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        // NB: Beside an idle event loop the host gets to the move of a drag at once, and paints it itself. The move waits
        //     until then, as a task that begins first keeps the host from it.
        let host_paints_the_drag = !samples_animations
            && self
                .lanes
                .current_ref()
                .is_some_and(|lane| lane.selection_drag().is_some())
            && self.ticks.pointer_state().holds_the_primary_button();
        let pointer = match host_paints_the_drag {
            true => None,
            false => self.ticks.pointer_state().take(),
        };
        if let Lanes::Newest(lane) = &mut self.lanes
            && !lane.needs_render_state()
        {
            if let Some(pointer) = pointer {
                lane.hovered.go_on_from_nested(self.nested);
                self.last_move = Some(lane.hover_read_only(pointer, self.ticks.latest.load(Ordering::Acquire)));
                self.nested = lane.hovered.nested();
            }
            return;
        }
        // The state still shows the frame sampled last, whose lane forks it now, whether or not it came together yet.
        if let Some(state) = self.lanes.newest_state() {
            state.fork(self.ticks.document);
        }
        let newest = matches!(self.lanes, Lanes::Newest(_));
        if let Some(lane) = self.lanes.current()
            && matches!(lane.state, LaneState::MovedOn)
        {
            // The host wrote the state before the lane of the frame sampled last forked it: the host shows what the
            // pointer and the animations move from now on. A lane of an earlier frame waits for the next one.
            if newest {
                lane.parked = true;
                lane.hovered.park();
            }
            if let Some(pointer) = pointer {
                self.show_cursor_for(pointer);
            }
            return;
        }
        self.run_tick(pointer, samples_animations);
    }

    /// Ticks the lane, which has a fork, with `pointer`, and sampling its animations where `samples_animations`.
    fn run_tick(&mut self, pointer: Option<PendingPointer>, samples_animations: bool) {
        let Some(lane) = self.lanes.current() else {
            return;
        };
        let animations_stand = lane.plan.animation_changes == self.ticks.animation_changes();
        if !animations_stand {
            lane.parked = true;
        }
        lane.hovered.go_on_from_nested(self.nested);
        let ticked = lane.tick_on_fork(
            self.ticks.latest.load(Ordering::Acquire),
            pointer,
            samples_animations && animations_stand,
        );
        self.nested = lane.hovered.nested();
        let Some(ticked) = ticked else {
            return;
        };
        if ticked.hover_move.is_some() {
            self.last_move = ticked.hover_move;
        }
        if ticked.presented {
            self.presented = true;
            *self.ticks.presented_boxes.lock().expect("presented boxes") = super::PresentedBoxes {
                border_boxes: lane.presented_border_boxes.clone(),
                scroll_offsets: lane.presented_scroll_offsets.clone(),
                colors: lane.presented_colors.clone(),
                compositor_animations: lane.presented_compositor_animations.clone(),
            };
            // The samples the tick showed may have moved a box under the pointer at rest, or away from under it: the
            // next tick hovers where the pointer rests again, in the frame this tick presented.
            if ticked.sampled {
                let _ = self.ticks.pointer_rests_on_moving_content();
            }
        }
    }

    /// Takes what the lanes did since a rendering update last took them in.
    fn take_report(&mut self) -> LaneReport {
        LaneReport {
            last_move: self.last_move.take(),
            transitions: self
                .lanes
                .current()
                .map_or_else(Vec::new, Lane::take_started_transitions),
            presented: std::mem::take(&mut self.presented),
        }
    }

    fn publish(&self) {
        let lane = self.lanes.current_ref();
        *self.ticks.published() = LanePublication {
            state: lane.map_or(FfiClockLaneState::None, Lane::state),
            planned_animation_changes: lane.map_or(0, |lane| lane.plan.animation_changes),
            transitions_run: lane.is_some_and(Lane::transitions_run),
            follows_pointer: lane.is_some_and(|lane| lane.plan.follows_pointer() && !lane.hovered.is_parked()),
            awaits_lane: matches!(self.lanes, Lanes::Coming { .. }),
        };
    }
}

//! What the render clock's thread keeps of the contexts it hands display ticks and pointer moves on for, and what it
//! makes of the messages of the render clock channel. `Web::Compositor::RenderClock` owns it, and only reaches it on
//! the clock thread.

use super::hover::{PendingPointer, PointerAnswer};
use super::{ClockTicks, FfiScrollOffset};
use crate::css::ffi_support::ArcRef;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::CompositorContextId;
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::{Web_AsyncScrollNodeKind, Web_CompositorScrollOffset};
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::{render_clock_client, render_clock_server};
use libgfx_rust::FloatPoint;
use libipc_rust::Misbehavior;
use libipc_rust::cpp_connection::{FfiThreadSafeMessagePoster, RawMessage, ThreadSafeMessagePoster};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

struct ArmedContext {
    maximum_frames_per_second: f64,
    ticks: Arc<ClockTicks>,
}

struct PointerLane {
    maximum_frames_per_second: f64,
    ticks: Arc<ClockTicks>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum LanesAreTicked {
    ByDisplayTicks,
    ByHandForATest,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct RenderClockLanes {
    channel_to_compositor: Option<ThreadSafeMessagePoster>,
    armed_contexts: HashMap<CompositorContextId, ArmedContext>,
    pointer_lanes: HashMap<CompositorContextId, PointerLane>,
}

impl RenderClockLanes {
    fn replace_channel(&mut self, channel_to_compositor: ThreadSafeMessagePoster) {
        // A new channel starts with nothing armed: the contexts armed on the previous one were armed for a Compositor
        // that is gone.
        self.drop_channel();
        self.channel_to_compositor = Some(channel_to_compositor);
    }

    fn drop_channel(&mut self) {
        self.armed_contexts.clear();
        self.pointer_lanes.clear();
        self.channel_to_compositor = None;
    }

    fn arm_lane(
        &mut self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        maximum_frames_per_second: f64,
        ticks: Arc<ClockTicks>,
        tick_now_at: Option<i64>,
    ) {
        // Another document of the context hears of the pointer no more, and a tick armed for it would hand its ticks to
        // this one's.
        if self
            .pointer_lanes
            .get(&context_id)
            .is_some_and(|lane| !Arc::ptr_eq(&lane.ticks, &ticks))
        {
            self.armed_contexts.remove(&context_id);
        }
        // The display ticks of an armed context drive its ticks at their rate, however many tasks begin meanwhile.
        if let Some(tick_now_at) = tick_now_at
            && !self.armed_contexts.contains_key(&context_id)
        {
            let _ = ticks.tick(tick_now_at, &[]);
            self.armed_contexts.insert(
                context_id,
                ArmedContext {
                    maximum_frames_per_second,
                    ticks: Arc::clone(&ticks),
                },
            );
            self.request_clock_tick(context_id, maximum_frames_per_second);
        }
        self.pointer_lanes.insert(
            context_id,
            PointerLane {
                maximum_frames_per_second,
                ticks,
            },
        );
    }

    fn forget_context(&mut self, context_id: CompositorContextId) {
        self.armed_contexts.remove(&context_id);
        self.pointer_lanes.remove(&context_id);
    }

    fn pointer_moved(
        &mut self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        pointer: PendingPointer,
        lanes_are_ticked: LanesAreTicked,
    ) {
        let Some(lane) = self.pointer_lanes.get(&context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        let answer = lane.ticks.pointer_moved(pointer);
        self.arm_lane_for_pointer_answer(context_id, answer, lanes_are_ticked);
    }

    fn pointer_rests_on_moving_content(&mut self, context_id: CompositorContextId, lanes_are_ticked: LanesAreTicked) {
        let Some(lane) = self.pointer_lanes.get(&context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        let answer = lane.ticks.pointer_rests_on_moving_content();
        self.arm_lane_for_pointer_answer(context_id, answer, lanes_are_ticked);
    }

    fn arm_lane_for_pointer_answer(
        &mut self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        answer: PointerAnswer,
        lanes_are_ticked: LanesAreTicked,
    ) {
        match answer {
            PointerAnswer::Moves => return,
            PointerAnswer::Ticks => {}
        }
        // A test ticks the lanes by hand.
        if lanes_are_ticked == LanesAreTicked::ByHandForATest {
            return;
        }
        // A context armed for ticks already asked for the next one.
        if self.armed_contexts.contains_key(&context_id) {
            return;
        }
        let Some(lane) = self.pointer_lanes.get(&context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        let maximum_frames_per_second = lane.maximum_frames_per_second;
        self.armed_contexts.insert(
            context_id,
            ArmedContext {
                maximum_frames_per_second,
                ticks: Arc::clone(&lane.ticks),
            },
        );
        self.request_clock_tick(context_id, maximum_frames_per_second);
    }

    fn request_clock_tick(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, maximum_frames_per_second: f64) {
        if let Some(channel_to_compositor) = &self.channel_to_compositor {
            let _ = channel_to_compositor.try_post(render_clock_server::messages::RequestClockTick {
                context_id,
                maximum_frames_per_second,
            });
        }
    }

    fn display_list_coverage_runs_out(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        scroll_offsets: &[Web_CompositorScrollOffset],
        lanes_are_ticked: LanesAreTicked,
    ) {
        if lanes_are_ticked == LanesAreTicked::ByHandForATest {
            return;
        }
        let Some(lane) = self.pointer_lanes.get(&context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        lane.ticks.display_list_coverage_runs_out(scrollers_of(scroll_offsets));
    }

    fn clock_tick(
        &mut self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        frame_time_nanoseconds: i64,
        scroll_offsets: &[Web_CompositorScrollOffset],
    ) {
        // A tick for a context disarmed after its request went out, or armed on an earlier channel.
        let Some(armed_context) = self.armed_contexts.get(&context_id) else {
            return;
        };

        let scrollers = scrollers_of(scroll_offsets);

        // Handing a tick on only queues it, so the next request goes out right after: however long this tick takes,
        // the next one is already on its way, and the Compositor's pacing is the only limit on the rate.
        if !armed_context.ticks.tick(frame_time_nanoseconds, &scrollers) {
            self.armed_contexts.remove(&context_id);
            return;
        }
        let maximum_frames_per_second = armed_context.maximum_frames_per_second;
        self.request_clock_tick(context_id, maximum_frames_per_second);
    }
}

/// Where the compositor scrolled the scroll nodes of elements and documents' viewports to, by the unique id of the node.
fn scrollers_of(scroll_offsets: &[Web_CompositorScrollOffset]) -> Vec<FfiScrollOffset> {
    scroll_offsets
        .iter()
        .filter(|scroll_offset| scroll_offset.scroll_node.kind != Web_AsyncScrollNodeKind::PseudoElement)
        .map(|scroll_offset| FfiScrollOffset {
            scroller: scroll_offset.scroll_node.node_id.0,
            x: scroll_offset.offset.x.to_double(),
            y: scroll_offset.offset.y.to_double(),
        })
        .collect()
}

struct MessagesFromCompositor<'a> {
    lanes: &'a mut RenderClockLanes,
    lanes_are_ticked: LanesAreTicked,
}

impl render_clock_client::Stub for MessagesFromCompositor<'_> {
    fn clock_tick(&mut self, tick: render_clock_client::messages::ClockTick) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.lanes
            .clock_tick(tick.context_id, tick.frame_time_nanoseconds, &tick.scroll_offsets);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn pointer_moved(&mut self, moved: render_clock_client::messages::PointerMoved) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.lanes.pointer_moved(
            moved.context_id,
            PendingPointer {
                position: Some(FloatPoint {
                    x: moved.position.x as f32,
                    y: moved.position.y as f32,
                }),
                buttons: moved.buttons,
                scrolled_since_frame: moved.scrolled_since_frame,
                input_event_id: moved.input_event_id,
            },
            self.lanes_are_ticked,
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    fn pointer_left(&mut self, left: render_clock_client::messages::PointerLeft) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.lanes.pointer_moved(
            left.context_id,
            PendingPointer {
                position: None,
                buttons: 0,
                scrolled_since_frame: false,
                input_event_id: left.input_event_id,
            },
            self.lanes_are_ticked,
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    fn pointer_rests_on_moving_content(
        &mut self,
        rests: render_clock_client::messages::PointerRestsOnMovingContent,
    ) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.lanes
            .pointer_rests_on_moving_content(rests.context_id, self.lanes_are_ticked);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn display_list_coverage_runs_out(
        &mut self,
        runs_out: render_clock_client::messages::DisplayListCoverageRunsOut,
    ) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.lanes
            .display_list_coverage_runs_out(runs_out.context_id, &runs_out.scroll_offsets, self.lanes_are_ticked);
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn lanes_are_ticked(by_hand_for_a_test: bool) -> LanesAreTicked {
    if by_hand_for_a_test {
        LanesAreTicked::ByHandForATest
    } else {
        LanesAreTicked::ByDisplayTicks
    }
}

/// The lanes of the process's render clock, which lives as long as the process.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_create() -> *mut RenderClockLanes {
    Box::into_raw(Box::default())
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `channel_to_compositor` must hold one reference to a live `IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster`, which the caller gives up.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_replace_channel(
    lanes: &mut RenderClockLanes,
    channel_to_compositor: FfiThreadSafeMessagePoster,
) {
    // SAFETY: The caller gives up the reference the poster holds.
    lanes.replace_channel(unsafe { ThreadSafeMessagePoster::adopt(channel_to_compositor) });
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_drop_channel(lanes: &mut RenderClockLanes) {
    lanes.drop_channel();
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_arm_lane(
    lanes: &mut RenderClockLanes,
    context_id: u64,
    maximum_frames_per_second: f64,
    ticks: ArcRef<'_, ClockTicks>,
    ticks_now: bool,
    tick_now_at: i64,
) {
    lanes.arm_lane(
        CompositorContextId(context_id),
        maximum_frames_per_second,
        ticks.to_arc(),
        ticks_now.then_some(tick_now_at),
    );
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_forget_context(lanes: &mut RenderClockLanes, context_id: u64) {
    lanes.forget_context(CompositorContextId(context_id));
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_disarm_all(lanes: &mut RenderClockLanes) {
    lanes.armed_contexts.clear();
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_pointer_moved(
    lanes: &mut RenderClockLanes,
    context_id: u64,
    has_position: bool,
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    buttons: u32,
    scrolled_since_frame: bool,
    input_event_id: u64,
    lanes_are_ticked_by_hand_for_a_test: bool,
) {
    lanes.pointer_moved(
        CompositorContextId(context_id),
        PendingPointer {
            position: has_position.then_some(FloatPoint { x, y }),
            buttons,
            scrolled_since_frame,
            input_event_id,
        },
        lanes_are_ticked(lanes_are_ticked_by_hand_for_a_test),
    );
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `message` must be one `IPC::RawMessage::hand_to_rust()` made.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn render_clock_lanes_handle_message(
    lanes: &mut RenderClockLanes,
    message: RawMessage<'_>,
    lanes_are_ticked_by_hand_for_a_test: bool,
) {
    let mut stub = MessagesFromCompositor {
        lanes,
        lanes_are_ticked: lanes_are_ticked(lanes_are_ticked_by_hand_for_a_test),
    };
    // SAFETY: The caller hands over a message of the render clock channel.
    unsafe { message.hand_to(|bytes, attachments| render_clock_client::dispatch(&mut stub, bytes, attachments)) };
}

//! A clock lane's drag selection: while the host runs a task, the highlight of a drag that selects text follows the
//! pointer in the frames the lane presents, so a busy page keeps up with the mouse.
//!
//! The press stays the host's, which alone knows whether the page lets the drag start, and a rendering update after it
//! seals where the selection is anchored with the plan. A mouse move has no default action, so nothing the page does
//! keeps the drag from going on, and a tick can show where it goes before the host gets to the move.
//!
//! The lane paints and decides nothing else. What a tick shows goes with the lane's fork, the selection stays the
//! host's, and the host makes its own selection as it handles the same moves, in the frame that takes over from the
//! lane's. What a tick shows includes the `::selection` styles of the elements it reaches, which it styles in the fork.
//! A move the host would treat in a way only it can, such as one that `user-select: all` widens, is left to it,
//! and the highlight waits where it was. A word or paragraph selection, and a selection in a text control or an editing
//! host, are the host's altogether.

use super::{Lane, RenderState, hover};
use crate::css::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixels};
use crate::css::style::StyleEngine;
use crate::css::style::drag_selection::{SelectionStyles, UsedUserSelect};
use crate::css::style::tree::StyleNodeID;
use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;
use crate::layout::node_data::{NodeFlag, NodeKind, NodeSlotId};
use crate::layout::svg_formatting_context::FfiFloatRect;
use crate::painting::hit_test::caret::caret_position_from_point;
use crate::painting::hit_test::resolve::row_dom_style_node;
use crate::painting::hit_test::walk::{PointQuery, topmost_hit};
use crate::painting::host::{FfiCaretBoundaryKind, FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks, FfiResolvedCaret};
use crate::painting::paint_read::GeometryRead;
use crate::painting::paintable_data::{
    FfiSelectionEntry, SELECTION_STATE_END, SELECTION_STATE_FULL, SELECTION_STATE_NONE, SELECTION_STATE_START,
    SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END,
};
use crate::painting::selection::sync_selection_style;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Where a drag selection the host started is anchored, sealed with the plan.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct SelectionDrag {
    anchor: Boundary,
    /// The scrollport the host's autoscroll keeps the pointer in as it selects, in CSS pixels of the viewport.
    scrollport: Option<FfiFloatRect>,
}

impl SelectionDrag {
    /// The drag anchored in the node `anchor` names, if it names one: `anchor_offset` code units into it where it is a
    /// text node, or right before its child `anchor_child` otherwise, or after its last child for 0. A `scrollport`
    /// without an area stands for none.
    pub(crate) fn new(anchor: u32, anchor_offset: usize, anchor_child: u32, scrollport: FfiFloatRect) -> Option<Self> {
        let node = StyleNodeID::from_raw(anchor)?;
        let anchor = match node.text_index() {
            Some(_) => Boundary::InText {
                node,
                offset: anchor_offset,
            },
            None => Boundary::InElement {
                container: node,
                child: StyleNodeID::from_raw(anchor_child),
            },
        };
        Some(Self {
            anchor,
            scrollport: (scrollport.width > 0.0 && scrollport.height > 0.0).then_some(scrollport),
        })
    }

    /// `point`, in CSS pixels of the viewport, as the host's `AutoScrollHandler::process` keeps it in the scrollport.
    fn constrained(self, x: f32, y: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
        let Some(scrollport) = self.scrollport else {
            return (x, y);
        };
        (
            x.clamp(scrollport.x, scrollport.x + scrollport.width - 1.0),
            y.clamp(scrollport.y, scrollport.y + scrollport.height - 1.0),
        )
    }
}

/// A boundary point in the DOM, among the nodes the style engine mirrors. Comments and processing instructions have no
/// place there, and no box to highlight.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Boundary {
    InText {
        node: StyleNodeID,
        offset: usize,
    },
    /// Right before `child`, or after the last of the children of `container` for none.
    InElement {
        container: StyleNodeID,
        child: Option<StyleNodeID>,
    },
}

impl Boundary {
    /// The boundary point right before `node`.
    fn before(engine: &StyleEngine, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<Self> {
        Some(Self::InElement {
            container: engine.drag_parent(node)?,
            child: Some(node),
        })
    }

    /// The boundary point right after `node`.
    fn after(engine: &StyleEngine, node: StyleNodeID) -> Option<Self> {
        Some(Self::InElement {
            container: engine.drag_parent(node)?,
            child: engine.drag_next_sibling(node),
        })
    }

    /// The node of the boundary point.
    fn container(self) -> StyleNodeID {
        match self {
            Self::InText { node, .. } => node,
            Self::InElement { container, .. } => container,
        }
    }

    /// Whether this boundary point comes before `other`, in the tree they share, as
    /// `position_of_boundary_point_relative_to_other_boundary_point` decides it.
    fn precedes(self, engine: &StyleEngine, other: Self) -> bool {
        let (container, other_container) = (self.container(), other.container());
        // The child of `ancestor` that holds `node`.
        let holder_of = |node, ancestor| {
            std::iter::successors(Some(node), |&node| engine.drag_parent(node))
                .find(|&node| engine.drag_parent(node) == Some(ancestor))
        };
        let child_of = |boundary| match boundary {
            Self::InText { .. } => None,
            Self::InElement { child, .. } => child,
        };
        match (self, other) {
            _ if container == other_container => match (self, other) {
                (
                    Self::InText { offset, .. },
                    Self::InText {
                        offset: other_offset, ..
                    },
                ) => offset < other_offset,
                (Self::InElement { child: Some(child), .. }, Self::InElement { child: other_child, .. }) => {
                    other_child.is_none_or(|other_child| engine.drag_precedes(child, other_child))
                }
                _ => false,
            },
            _ if engine.drag_is_inclusive_ancestor(container, other_container) => {
                let (Some(child), Some(holder)) = (child_of(self), holder_of(other_container, container)) else {
                    return false;
                };
                child == holder || engine.drag_precedes(child, holder)
            }
            _ if engine.drag_is_inclusive_ancestor(other_container, container) => {
                let (Some(other_child), Some(holder)) = (child_of(other), holder_of(container, other_container)) else {
                    return child_of(other).is_none();
                };
                engine.drag_precedes(holder, other_child)
            }
            _ => engine.drag_precedes(container, other_container),
        }
    }
}

/// A node a selection highlights: its style node, its selection state, where the selection starts and ends, and the
/// background and text colors its `::selection` styles give it, as ARGB, zero for none. For a test.
pub(in crate::render_state) type SelectionRowForTesting = (u32, u8, usize, usize, u32, u32);

/// The background and text colors the `::selection` styles of `row` give it, as ARGB, zero for none.
fn selection_colors_for_testing(arena: &LayoutNodeArena, row: NodeSlotId) -> (u32, u32) {
    let styles = &arena.paint_state().selection_pseudo_styles;
    let element_row = std::iter::successors(arena.node_parent_if_live(row), |&row| arena.node_parent_if_live(row))
        .find(|&row| arena.node_flags_if_live(row) & NodeFlag::Anonymous as u32 == 0);
    styles
        .get(&row)
        .or_else(|| element_row.and_then(|row| styles.get(&row)))
        .map_or((0, 0), |answer| {
            let text = answer.facts.text_color;
            (
                answer.facts.background_color.0,
                if text.has_value { text.value.0 } else { 0 },
            )
        })
}

/// The nodes the selection of `state` highlights, in the order of their style nodes. For a test.
pub(super) fn rows_for_testing(state: &RenderState) -> Vec<SelectionRowForTesting> {
    let arena = state.arena.arena();
    let Some(selection) = arena.paint_state().selection.clone() else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let texts = selection
        .text_states
        .iter()
        .map(|(&row, &state)| (row, row_dom_style_node(arena, row), state));
    let boxes = selection
        .boxes_with_selection_state
        .iter()
        .filter(|&&row| arena.paintable_row_is_populated(row))
        .map(|&row| {
            (
                row,
                row_dom_style_node(arena, row),
                arena.paintable_data(row).selection_state,
            )
        });
    let mut rows: Vec<_> = texts
        .chain(boxes)
        .filter(|&(_, node, state)| node != 0 && state != SELECTION_STATE_NONE)
        .map(|(row, node, state)| {
            let (background, text) = selection_colors_for_testing(arena, row);
            (
                node,
                state,
                selection.start_offset,
                selection.end_offset,
                background,
                text,
            )
        })
        .collect();
    rows.sort_unstable();
    rows.dedup();
    rows
}

/// Why a tick left a move of a drag to the host.
struct LeftToHost(&'static str);

/// The boundary point of the caret position `caret` as the focus of a drag anchored at `anchor`, with the node the caret
/// stands at, as `choose_caret_boundary_for_selection_focus` decides it: an atomic box has a caret position on both of
/// its sides, of which the focus takes the one away from the anchor.
fn focus_at(
    engine: &StyleEngine,
    caret: &FfiResolvedCaret,
    anchor: Boundary,
) -> Result<(Boundary, StyleNodeID), LeftToHost> {
    const OUTSIDE_OF_A_TREE: LeftToHost = LeftToHost("a boundary outside of a tree");
    if caret.node.is_document {
        return Err(LeftToHost("a boundary in the document"));
    }
    let node = StyleNodeID::from_raw(caret.node.style_node).ok_or(LeftToHost("a boundary in no node"))?;
    let focus = match caret.boundary {
        FfiCaretBoundaryKind::Offset if node.text_index().is_some() => Boundary::InText {
            node,
            offset: caret.offset,
        },
        // NB: The offset counts the comments the mirror does not hold.
        FfiCaretBoundaryKind::Offset => return Err(LeftToHost("a boundary among the children of an element")),
        FfiCaretBoundaryKind::IndexOfNodeInParent => Boundary::before(engine, node).ok_or(OUTSIDE_OF_A_TREE)?,
        FfiCaretBoundaryKind::BeforeNode | FfiCaretBoundaryKind::AfterNode => {
            let before = Boundary::before(engine, node).ok_or(OUTSIDE_OF_A_TREE)?;
            let after = Boundary::after(engine, node).ok_or(OUTSIDE_OF_A_TREE)?;
            if engine.drag_root(node) != engine.drag_root(anchor.container()) {
                match caret.boundary {
                    FfiCaretBoundaryKind::BeforeNode => before,
                    _ => after,
                }
            } else if anchor.precedes(engine, before) {
                after
            } else if after.precedes(engine, anchor) {
                before
            } else {
                match caret.boundary {
                    FfiCaretBoundaryKind::BeforeNode => before,
                    _ => after,
                }
            }
        }
    };
    Ok((focus, node))
}

/// The boundary point the host's `set_user_selection` leaves the focus `focus` at `node` of a drag anchored at `anchor`
/// on: a focus at a node whose `user-select` is `none` moves out of the outermost element of that value, to the side of it
/// that faces the anchor. What `all` and a `contain` element do to a selection stays with the host.
fn focus_after_user_select(
    engine: &StyleEngine,
    focus: Boundary,
    node: StyleNodeID,
    anchor: Boundary,
) -> Result<Boundary, LeftToHost> {
    let (container, anchor_container) = (focus.container(), anchor.container());
    if engine.drag_root(container) != engine.drag_root(anchor_container) {
        return Err(LeftToHost("a focus in another tree"));
    }
    let common = std::iter::successors(Some(anchor_container), |&node| engine.drag_parent(node))
        .find(|&node| engine.drag_is_inclusive_ancestor(node, container));
    for start in [anchor_container, container] {
        let contained = std::iter::successors(Some(start), |&node| engine.drag_parent(node))
            .take_while(|&node| Some(node) != common)
            .filter(|node| node.element_index().is_some())
            .any(|element| engine.drag_used_user_select(element) == UsedUserSelect::Contain);
        if contained {
            return Err(LeftToHost("a user-select: contain between the anchor and the focus"));
        }
    }
    // NB: The host asks the node of the boundary point, which for an atomic box is its parent, and the box where that
    //     node has no box of its own.
    let decides = match engine.drag_has_no_box_of_its_own(container) {
        true => node,
        false => container,
    };
    let used = engine
        .drag_style_element(decides)
        .map_or(UsedUserSelect::None, |element| engine.drag_used_user_select(element));
    match used {
        UsedUserSelect::All => Err(LeftToHost("a focus user-select: all widens")),
        UsedUserSelect::None if container == anchor_container => {
            Err(LeftToHost("a focus user-select: none keeps at the anchor"))
        }
        UsedUserSelect::None => {
            let is_none = |node: &StyleNodeID| {
                node.element_index().is_some() && engine.drag_used_user_select(*node) == UsedUserSelect::None
            };
            let outermost = std::iter::successors(engine.drag_parent(container), |&node| engine.drag_parent(node))
                .take_while(is_none)
                .last()
                .unwrap_or(container);
            match engine.drag_precedes(outermost, anchor_container) {
                true => Boundary::after(engine, outermost),
                false => Boundary::before(engine, outermost),
            }
            .ok_or(LeftToHost("a focus user-select: none moves out of the tree"))
        }
        UsedUserSelect::Text | UsedUserSelect::Contain => Ok(focus),
    }
}

/// The highlight of a range, as `DocumentPaintState::recompute_selection_states` makes it.
struct Highlight<'a> {
    engine: &'a StyleEngine,
    arena: &'a LayoutNodeArena,
    selection_styles: &'a SelectionStyles,
    used_user_select: HashMap<StyleNodeID, UsedUserSelect>,
    entries: Vec<FfiSelectionEntry>,
    /// The elements of the entries whose rows have yet to get their `::selection` styles.
    unstyled: HashSet<StyleNodeID>,
}

impl Highlight<'_> {
    /// Whether `node` is left out of the selection, as `user-select: none` and inertness do.
    fn excludes(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID) -> bool {
        if self.engine.drag_is_inert(node) {
            return true;
        }
        if self.arena.bound_row(node).is_invalid() {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(element) = self.engine.drag_style_element(node) else {
            return true;
        };
        let engine = self.engine;
        *self
            .used_user_select
            .entry(element)
            .or_insert_with(|| engine.drag_used_user_select(element))
            == UsedUserSelect::None
    }

    fn mark(&mut self, node: StyleNodeID, state: u8) {
        if self.excludes(node) {
            return;
        }
        let layout_node = self.arena.bound_row(node);
        if !layout_node.is_invalid() {
            self.entries.push(FfiSelectionEntry {
                is_text_node_entry: node.text_index().is_some(),
                layout_node,
                state,
            });
            if let Some(element) = self.engine.drag_style_element(node)
                && self.selection_styles.owes(element)
            {
                self.unstyled.insert(element);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Marks the nodes of the range from `start` to `end`, as `for_each_node_in_highlight_range` does.
    fn mark_range(&mut self, start: Boundary, end: Boundary) {
        let engine = self.engine;
        if start == end {
            return;
        }
        let (start_container, end_container) = (start.container(), end.container());
        if start_container == end_container && start_container.text_index().is_some() {
            self.mark(start_container, SELECTION_STATE_START_AND_END);
            return;
        }
        let start_at = match start {
            Boundary::InText { node, .. } => {
                self.mark(node, SELECTION_STATE_START);
                engine.drag_next_in_pre_order_within(node, end_container)
            }
            Boundary::InElement { container, child } => {
                self.mark(container, SELECTION_STATE_FULL);
                child.or_else(|| engine.drag_next_after_subtree(container, end_container))
            }
        };
        let stop_at = match end {
            Boundary::InText { .. } => None,
            Boundary::InElement { child, .. } => child,
        };
        let mut next = start_at;
        while let Some(node) = next {
            if Some(node) == stop_at || (node == end_container && !engine.drag_has_children(node)) {
                break;
            }
            self.mark(node, SELECTION_STATE_FULL);
            next = engine.drag_next_in_pre_order_within(node, end_container);
        }
        if let Boundary::InText { node, .. } = end {
            self.mark(node, SELECTION_STATE_END);
        }
    }
}

impl Lane {
    /// The drag selection the lane follows, if any.
    pub(super) fn selection_drag(&self) -> Option<SelectionDrag> {
        self.plan.hover.as_ref()?.selection_drag()
    }

    /// Has the highlight the ticks show follow nothing more: the button went up, and a press after it is the host's.
    pub(super) fn end_selection_drag(&mut self) {
        if let Some(plan) = &mut self.plan.hover {
            plan.end_selection_drag();
        }
        self.selection_styles = None;
    }

    /// Has the highlight of the drag follow `pointer`, in the frame as the screen shows it at `frame_time_nanoseconds`,
    /// and answers whether that moved anything to present.
    pub(super) fn extend_selection(
        &mut self,
        state: &mut RenderState,
        pointer: hover::PendingPointer,
        frame_time_nanoseconds: i64,
    ) -> bool {
        let Some(drag) = self.selection_drag() else {
            return false;
        };
        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
        let moved = self.show_selection_at(state, drag, pointer, frame_time_nanoseconds);
        if hover::logs_hover() {
            let outcome = match &moved {
                Ok(true) => "extended",
                Ok(false) => "unmoved",
                Err(LeftToHost(reason)) => reason,
            };
            eprintln!(
                "{} hover lane: drag to {:?}: {outcome} in {} us",
                hover::log_time(),
                pointer.position,
                started.elapsed().as_micros()
            );
        }
        moved.unwrap_or(false)
    }

    fn show_selection_at(
        &mut self,
        state: &mut RenderState,
        drag: SelectionDrag,
        pointer: hover::PendingPointer,
        frame_time_nanoseconds: i64,
    ) -> Result<bool, LeftToHost> {
        let plan = self.plan.hover.take().ok_or(LeftToHost("no plan"))?;
        let shown = self.show_selection_with(state, &plan, drag, pointer, frame_time_nanoseconds);
        self.plan.hover = Some(plan);
        shown
    }

    fn show_selection_with(
        &mut self,
        state: &mut RenderState,
        plan: &hover::HoverPlan,
        drag: SelectionDrag,
        pointer: hover::PendingPointer,
        frame_time_nanoseconds: i64,
    ) -> Result<bool, LeftToHost> {
        let position = pointer.position.ok_or(LeftToHost("the pointer left the document"))?;
        // A scroll of the compositor's since the frame moved what is under the pointer, which only a tick that said where
        // it scrolled to tells, and the scrollport the plan sealed along with it.
        if pointer.scrolled_since_frame && (self.scroll_offsets.is_empty() || drag.scrollport.is_some()) {
            return Err(LeftToHost("scrolled since the frame"));
        }
        let tree = self.tree_on_screen(state, frame_time_nanoseconds).map_err(LeftToHost)?;
        // The walk skips the boxes whose ink overflow the pointer misses.
        state.arena.arena_mut().settle_ink_overflow();
        let arena = state.arena.arena();
        let engine = state.engine_ref();
        let scroll_offsets = self.scroll_offsets_on_screen(arena, &arena.paint_state().visual_context, plan);
        let callbacks = FfiHitTestQueryCallbacks::sealed(
            plan.device_pixels_per_css_pixel(),
            &scroll_offsets,
            plan.chrome_metrics(),
        );
        let world = callbacks.build_world_transforms(&tree);
        let callbacks = callbacks.with_world_transforms(&world);
        let pixel_ratio = plan.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32;
        let query_at = |x, y| PointQuery {
            tree: &tree,
            callbacks: &callbacks,
            viewport: arena.layout_root(),
            paint_overlay: hover::FRAMES_PAINT_OVERLAYS,
            point: CssPixelPoint::new(CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(x), CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(y)),
        };
        let (x, y) = (position.x / pixel_ratio, position.y / pixel_ratio);
        // The host hands a move over the content of another navigable to it, and the selection here stays as it is.
        let over_a_frame = topmost_hit(arena, query_at(x, y))
            .and_then(|topmost| arena.node_kind_if_live(topmost.item.paintable))
            == Some(NodeKind::NavigableContainerViewport);
        if over_a_frame {
            return Err(LeftToHost("the content of another navigable"));
        }
        let (x, y) = drag.constrained(x, y);
        let caret = caret_position_from_point(arena, query_at(x, y), NodeSlotId::INVALID)
            .filter(|caret| caret.caret.has_position)
            .ok_or(LeftToHost("no caret position"))?;
        let (focus, focus_node) = focus_at(engine, &caret.caret, drag.anchor)?;
        let focus = focus_after_user_select(engine, focus, focus_node, drag.anchor)?;
        if self.selection_focus_shown == Some(focus) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        let (start, end) = match focus.precedes(engine, drag.anchor) {
            true => (focus, drag.anchor),
            false => (drag.anchor, focus),
        };
        let selection_styles = self.selection_styles.get_or_insert_with(|| SelectionStyles::of(engine));
        let mut highlight = Highlight {
            engine,
            arena,
            selection_styles,
            used_user_select: HashMap::new(),
            entries: Vec::new(),
            unstyled: HashSet::new(),
        };
        highlight.mark_range(start, end);
        let Highlight { entries, unstyled, .. } = highlight;
        let engine = state.engine_mut();
        let records = unstyled
            .into_iter()
            .map(|element| Some((element, engine.demand_selection_record(element)?)))
            .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()
            .ok_or(LeftToHost("a ::selection style the host resolves"))?;
        let offset_in = |boundary| match boundary {
            Boundary::InText { offset, .. } => offset,
            Boundary::InElement { .. } => 0,
        };
        let arena = state.arena.arena_mut();
        for (element, record) in records {
            sync_selection_style(arena, element, record);
            selection_styles.note_styled(element);
        }
        let selection = crate::painting::selection::apply(
            &mut arena.paintable_rows_mut(),
            &entries,
            offset_in(start),
            offset_in(end),
        );
        arena.paint_state_mut().selection = Some(Arc::new(selection));
        self.selection_focus_shown = Some(focus);
        Ok(true)
    }
}

//! The entries tests and the developer tools call to ask a document's render state about itself.

use super::{DocumentHost, ScriptForcedRead};
use crate::layout::LayoutNodeArena;

/// Mints the forced reads of this module's entries; only this module can make one.
pub(crate) struct DevtoolsEntry {
    _private: (),
}

const DEVTOOLS_ENTRY: DevtoolsEntry = DevtoolsEntry { _private: () };

/// Makes the render state of `host`'s document panic answering this call, which waits for it.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_state_panic_for_testing(host: &DocumentHost) {
    host.run(ScriptForcedRead::at_script_entry(&DEVTOOLS_ENTRY), false, |_| {
        panic!("the render state panicked for a test")
    });
}

/// Answers `read` of the layout arena of `host`'s document, spending the forced read of the call that reached the entry.
fn read_arena<R>(host: &DocumentHost, read: impl FnOnce(&mut LayoutNodeArena) -> R) -> R {
    host.ask(ScriptForcedRead::at_script_entry(&DEVTOOLS_ENTRY), |state| {
        read(state.arena_mut())
    })
}

/// How many rows the document's layout arena holds.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn render_state_live_slot_count(host: &DocumentHost) -> u64 {
    read_arena(host, |arena| arena.live_slot_count().into())
}

/// The boundary events a hover a rendering update kept owes: where the pointer was, in the context's device pixels, or
/// none where it left the context, and the element the lane's hover put the hover on there, or nothing, where the lane
/// took that move.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct HoverOwed {
    pub(super) pointer: Option<FloatPoint>,
    pub(super) target: Option<Option<StyleNodeID>>,
}

/// The host's side of one document's render state: the name the render owner holds the state by, the frame that may
/// fly beside the host, the host tables the host answers layout through, and what the document keeps of its display
/// list recordings, which are made on the host's thread from the frame the render state publishes. The host's document
/// owns it, and it lives on the host's thread.
///
/// The host's entries call into each other, so it is only ever shared: everything a call may change sits in a cell, and
/// the rows are handed out by reference count, so a call that publishes them again frees none an outer call still reads.
pub struct DocumentHost {
    /// The name the render owner holds the document's render state by.
    document: DocumentId,
    /// What the owner makes the state from, until the host's first job hands it over.
    seed: Cell<Option<StateSeed>>,
    /// The frame that flies beside the host, until the host takes it in.
    away: RefCell<Option<InFlight<Landing>>>,
    /// How deep the document's style tree may be once the frame in flight applied what it flies with, where the host
    /// takes the frame back to run it itself.
    away_tree_depth: Cell<u32>,
    /// Whether the host waits for the frame: it flies, or a layout round that flew with it is not paid yet. The host's
    /// scopes of a read and its document's layout read it where it is (see [`document_host_read_scope_view`]).
    waits_for_frame: Cell<bool>,
    host_tables: HostTables,
    recording: RefCell<RecordingSlot>,
    /// The rows the render state published last, which the host reads between its jobs.
    rows: RefCell<Option<Rc<RowSnapshot>>>,
    /// The reactions of the style update the host took last, which it reads until it ends the transaction.
    style_update: RefCell<Option<StyleJobAnswer>>,
    /// The first sample of the transitions a step the host read from the style update starts, by element, which
    /// the sample the host takes next reads.
    fresh_transition_sample: Cell<Option<(u32, crate::css::transition::FreshTransitionSample)>>,
    /// The absolute rects the host's reads of the rows computed, kept for as long as the geometry they were computed
    /// from stays.
    absolute_rects: RefCell<AbsoluteRectMemo>,
    /// What the render state shares with the host.
    shared: SharedWithHost,
    /// The compositor animations the document's effects published in the current update pass, which the host hands
    /// the render state as the pass ends.
    compositor_animations: RefCell<Vec<VisualAnimation>>,
    /// Where the document's boxes are scrolled to, as the host refreshed it last: what its queries map through, and its
    /// frames take to the compositor. It is handed out by reference count, as the rows are.
    scroll_state: RefCell<Rc<ScrollStateSnapshot>>,
    /// The visual context trees the viewport mappings the host hands C++ map through.
    viewport_mapping_trees: RefCell<crate::painting::viewport_mapping::ViewportMappingTrees>,
    /// The display lists the document was rendered as where it is an SVG image's.
    vector_images: RefCell<crate::painting::vector_image_cache::VectorImageCache>,
    /// What the host's scopes of a read lend the entries they call.
    begun_read: BegunRead,
    /// The writes the host queued that the render state has not applied yet, in the order the host made them.
    changes: ChangeQueue,
    /// The style update that flew with the frame, from its landing until the host has drained its reactions.
    flown_style: RefCell<Option<FlownStyle>>,
    /// Whether the paint and hit testing properties the document prepared last were prepared from the render state as it
    /// is: nothing was written to it since, queued, in place or by a job. Preparing them again would find nothing
    /// to do.
    paint_preparation_is_current: Cell<bool>,
    /// What the next preparation of the paint and hit testing properties owes, and what the ones before left for the
    /// document's frames.
    paint_preparation: crate::painting::paint_passes::PaintPreparationNotes,
    /// The layout round that flew with the frame, from its landing until the host's next layout update pays it.
    flown_round: RefCell<Option<FlownRound>>,
    /// Whether a job of the host runs, whose host callbacks see rows it freed and the host has not heard of yet.
    in_job: Cell<bool>,
    /// Whether the host streamed writes to the render state since its last job or frame, which bring back what they owe
    /// the host and the marks they made.
    streamed: Cell<bool>,
    /// The streams of writes the host posted to the render state that it may still take back, in the order it posted
    /// them.
    streams: RefCell<Vec<crate::stage_thread::Reclaimable<StreamedWrites>>>,
    /// The document's layout tree update marks, which the host lends the render owner's jobs.
    marks: RefCell<HostMarks>,
    /// The rules the host published to each of its document's style sheets.
    published_rules: PublishedRules,
    /// What the host learned of its document's style engine.
    engine_memo: crate::css::style::engine_calls::EngineMemo,
    /// The facts of the render state as the host's last job or frame left it, which a frame in flight forgets.
    facts: Cell<Option<StateFacts>>,
    /// The attribute names whose value text the engine's selectors read, as the host's last job or frame left them.
    selector_value_text_names: RefCell<crate::css::style::SelectorAttributeNames>,
    /// The attribute names the engine's selectors test in any way, as its last job left them.
    selector_tested_attribute_names: RefCell<crate::css::style::SelectorAttributeNames>,
    /// What an arrival has to carry to reach a `:has()` anchor, as its last job left it.
    relational_arrival_keys: RefCell<std::sync::Arc<crate::css::style::RelationalArrivalKeys>>,
    /// The keys the host was last told of, kept alive for as long as it reads them.
    lent_relational_arrival_keys: RefCell<std::sync::Arc<crate::css::style::RelationalArrivalKeys>>,
    /// The ticks the render clock hands the lanes of the document's presented frames.
    ticks: Arc<ClockTicks>,
    /// The steps the hover of the lanes decided that the last rendering update took in, which the host runs as the lanes
    /// do from then.
    lane_transitions: RefCell<Vec<Arc<HoverTransitions>>>,
    /// Whether the host is taking over transitions the hover of the lane started, as it changes the animations it runs.
    adopts_lane_transitions: Cell<bool>,
    /// Whether the frame in flight waits for a test to release it.
    frame_held_for_testing: Cell<bool>,
    /// The root and the sealed document computation inputs of the last style update the host took or let fly,
    /// which the hover of a lane takes its own transactions with.
    style_inputs: RefCell<Option<(StyleNodeID, Arc<SealedStyleInputs>)>>,
    /// The element the host asked the engine's hover to move to last: the one the events of the last mouse move it
    /// handled hovered, as the engine's hover follows it through tree changes.
    hover_target: Cell<Option<StyleNodeID>>,
    /// Where the compositor said the pointer went last as a rendering update took the lanes in, and the element a lane's
    /// hover put the hover on there, if one did: the boundary events of the move the host fires where it handles no
    /// mouse move first.
    hover_events_owed: Cell<Option<HoverOwed>>,
    /// The input event id of the newest pointer move the host knows of: the newest mouse event it handled, or the
    /// newest move the compositor told the render clock of as the host took in what the lanes did.
    newest_pointer_input_event: Cell<u64>,
    /// The last pointer move a tick of the lanes took that the last rendering update took in, which the mouse event of
    /// that move goes by: the host drops older moves' events.
    lane_move: Cell<Option<super::clock::LaneMove>>,
    /// The serial number of the last rendering update that took the lanes in, until it, or an update after it, seals its
    /// plan.
    lanes_taken_in: Cell<Option<u64>>,
    /// Whether the last plan the host sealed was one, which the lanes may still follow: with none, they do nothing.
    lanes_planned: Cell<bool>,
}

/// Writes the host streamed to the render state, with what the state is made from where they are the first.
struct StreamedWrites {
    changes: Vec<ArenaChange>,
    seed: Option<StateSeed>,
}

/// Pays what the writes a job applied owe the host, which only [`DocumentHost::pay`] makes.
pub(crate) struct OwedWorkPayment {
    _private: (),
}

const OWED_WORK_PAYMENT: OwedWorkPayment = OwedWorkPayment { _private: () };

/// The layout tree update marks of a host's document: here, between the render owner's jobs, or lent to a job.
struct HostMarks {
    /// The document's marks, unless a job or the frame in flight has them.
    here: Option<LayoutTreeUpdateMarks>,
    /// The marks the host made beside the frame in flight that has the document's, which answer the host's questions
    /// about marks meanwhile: a mark made before the frame flew reads as unset there, which at most makes a mark reach
    /// further than it had to.
    beside_flight: LayoutTreeUpdateMarks,
    /// The writes the host made beside the frame, which the document's marks take once it lands.
    written_beside_flight: Vec<LayoutTreeUpdateMarkWrite>,
}

/// A style update that flew with the frame and has landed, or whose reactions the host drains. The style writes the
/// host queued beside it reach the render state only behind its drain.
enum FlownStyle {
    /// What the transaction answered.
    Landed(Box<StyleJobAnswer>),
    /// The host drains the transaction's reactions.
    Draining,
}

impl DocumentHost {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let shared = SharedWithHost::new();
        let document = DocumentId::mint();
        Self {
            document,
            seed: Cell::new(Some(StateSeed { shared: shared.clone() })),
            shared,
            away: RefCell::default(),
            away_tree_depth: Cell::new(0),
            waits_for_frame: Cell::new(false),
            host_tables: HostTables::default(),
            recording: RefCell::default(),
            rows: RefCell::default(),
            style_update: RefCell::default(),
            fresh_transition_sample: Cell::default(),
            absolute_rects: RefCell::default(),
            compositor_animations: RefCell::default(),
            scroll_state: RefCell::default(),
            viewport_mapping_trees: RefCell::default(),
            vector_images: RefCell::default(),
            begun_read: BegunRead::of_host(),
            changes: ChangeQueue::default(),
            flown_style: RefCell::default(),
            paint_preparation_is_current: Cell::new(false),
            paint_preparation: Default::default(),
            flown_round: RefCell::default(),
            in_job: Cell::new(false),
            streamed: Cell::new(false),
            streams: RefCell::default(),
            marks: RefCell::new(HostMarks {
                here: Some(LayoutTreeUpdateMarks::default()),
                beside_flight: LayoutTreeUpdateMarks::default(),
                written_beside_flight: Vec::new(),
            }),
            published_rules: PublishedRules::default(),
            engine_memo: Default::default(),
            facts: Cell::new(None),
            selector_value_text_names: RefCell::default(),
            selector_tested_attribute_names: RefCell::default(),
            relational_arrival_keys: RefCell::default(),
            lent_relational_arrival_keys: RefCell::default(),
            ticks: ClockTicks::new(document),
            lane_transitions: RefCell::default(),
            adopts_lane_transitions: Cell::default(),
            frame_held_for_testing: Cell::default(),
            style_inputs: RefCell::default(),
            hover_target: Cell::default(),
            hover_events_owed: Cell::default(),
            newest_pointer_input_event: Cell::default(),
            lane_move: Cell::default(),
            lanes_taken_in: Cell::default(),
            lanes_planned: Cell::default(),
        }
    }

    /// A host with a render state, for a unit test.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn for_test() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }

    /// A read of the host's document the test begins, and never ends.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn read_for_test(&self) -> &BegunRead {
        &self.begun_read
    }

    pub(crate) fn host_tables(&self) -> &HostTables {
        &self.host_tables
