use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicPtr, AtomicU64, AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use ak::math;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum InsertResult {
    Success,
    EventContainedInValueCurve,
    ValueCurveOverlapsEvent,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct RampStart {
    set_target_event_id: usize,
    time: f64,
    value: f32,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
enum Parameterization {
    SetValue { value: f32 },
    LinearRamp { value: f32, start: Option<RampStart> },
    ExponentialRamp { value: f32, start: Option<RampStart> },
    SetTarget { target: f32, time_constant: f32 },
    SetValueCurve { values: Arc<[f32]>, duration: f64 },
    Hold { value: f32 },
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct AutomationEvent {
    time: f64,
    parameterization: Parameterization,
    id: usize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct ParameterizationCache {
    event_index: Option<usize>,
    minimum_time: Option<f64>,
    maximum_time: Option<f64>,
    starting_value: f32,
}

impl ParameterizationCache {
    fn contains(&self, time: f64) -> bool {
        self.minimum_time.is_none_or(|minimum_time| time >= minimum_time)
            && self.maximum_time.is_none_or(|maximum_time| time < maximum_time)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct TimelineState {
    generation: u32,
    fallback_value: f32,
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dfn-automation-event
    automation_events: Vec<AutomationEvent>,
    next_event_id: usize,
}

struct TimelineWriter {
    state: TimelineState,
    retired: Vec<RetiredSnapshot>,
}

struct RetiredSnapshot(*mut TimelineState);

// SAFETY: A retired snapshot is immutable and only the writer can reclaim it.
unsafe impl Send for RetiredSnapshot {}

impl Drop for RetiredSnapshot {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: The writer drops retired snapshots only after all readers of them have finished.
        drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(self.0) });
    }
}

struct Snapshot<'a> {
    readers: &'a AtomicUsize,
    state: *const TimelineState,
}

impl std::ops::Deref for Snapshot<'_> {
    type Target = TimelineState;

    fn deref(&self) -> &TimelineState {
        // SAFETY: The snapshot stays alive for the lifetime of this reader.
        unsafe { &*self.state }
    }
}

impl Drop for Snapshot<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.readers.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
    }
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dfn-automation-event
pub struct AudioParamTimeline {
    default_value: f32,
    writer: Mutex<TimelineWriter>,
    published: AtomicPtr<TimelineState>,
    readers: AtomicUsize,

    // The high bits identify the snapshot allowed to publish the low bits of [[current value]].
    current_value: AtomicU64,
}

impl Drop for AudioParamTimeline {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: No writer or reader can access the published snapshot once the timeline is dropped.
        drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(*self.published.get_mut()) });
    }
}

impl AudioParamTimeline {
    pub fn new(default_value: f32) -> Self {
        let state = TimelineState {
            generation: 0,
            fallback_value: default_value,
            automation_events: Vec::new(),
            next_event_id: 0,
        };
        let published = AtomicPtr::new(Box::into_raw(Box::new(state.clone())));
        Self {
            default_value,
            writer: Mutex::new(TimelineWriter {
                state,
                retired: Vec::new(),
            }),
            published,
            readers: AtomicUsize::new(0),
            current_value: AtomicU64::new(u64::from(default_value.to_bits())),
        }
    }

    pub fn default_value(&self) -> f32 {
        self.default_value
    }

    pub fn current_value(&self) -> f32 {
        f32::from_bits(self.current_value.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as u32)
    }

    fn edit<R>(&self, current_value: Option<f32>, edit: impl FnOnce(&mut TimelineState, f32) -> R) -> R {
        let mut writer = self.writer.lock().unwrap();
        let generation = writer.state.generation.wrapping_add(1);
        let version = u64::from(generation) << 32;
        let previous_value = self
            .current_value
            .fetch_update(Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst, |value| {
                Some(version | u64::from(current_value.map_or(value as u32, f32::to_bits)))
            })
            .unwrap();

        let result = edit(&mut writer.state, f32::from_bits(previous_value as u32));
        writer.state.generation = generation;
        let snapshot = Box::into_raw(Box::new(writer.state.clone()));
        let previous = self.published.swap(snapshot, Ordering::SeqCst);
        writer.retired.push(RetiredSnapshot(previous));
        // A reader entering after this check can only load the new publication.
        if self.readers.load(Ordering::SeqCst) == 0 {
            writer.retired.clear();
        }
        result
    }

    pub fn set_current_value(&self, value: f32) {
        self.edit(Some(value), |state, _| state.fallback_value = value);
    }

    fn snapshot(&self) -> Snapshot<'_> {
        // Register before loading so the writer cannot free the snapshot between the load and its first use.
        self.readers.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        Snapshot {
            readers: &self.readers,
            state: self.published.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
        }
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#computedvalue
    pub fn value_at_time(&self, time: f64) -> f32 {
        self.snapshot().value_at_time(time, time, &mut None)
    }

    pub fn sample(&self, start_time: f64, sample_period: f64, output: &mut [f32]) {
        let state = self.snapshot();
        let mut cache = None;
        for (frame, value) in output.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            let frame_time = start_time + frame as f64 * sample_period;
            *value = state.value_at_time(frame_time + sample_period / 2., frame_time, &mut cache);
        }
        let previous_value = self.current_value.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
        if (previous_value >> 32) as u32 == state.generation {
            let next_value = (previous_value & !u64::from(u32::MAX)) | u64::from(output[0].to_bits());
            let _ = self
                .current_value
                .compare_exchange(previous_value, next_value, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst);
        }
    }

    // All event times passed into these methods must already be clamped to the context's current time by the caller.
    pub fn set_value_at_time(&self, value: f32, start_time: f64) -> InsertResult {
        self.edit(None, |state, _| {
            state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                time: start_time,
                parameterization: Parameterization::SetValue { value },
                id: 0,
            })
        })
    }

    pub fn linear_ramp_to_value_at_time(
        &self,
        value: f32,
        end_time: f64,
        current_time: f64,
        current_value: f32,
    ) -> InsertResult {
        self.edit(None, |state, _| {
            // If there is no event preceding this event, the linear ramp behaves as if setValueAtTime(value, currentTime) were
            // called, where value is the current value of the attribute.
            let event_index = state.first_event_index_after(end_time);
            let ramp_start = state.ramp_start_for_insertion_index(state.fallback_value, event_index, current_time);
            if event_index == 0 {
                let result = state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                    time: current_time,
                    parameterization: Parameterization::SetValue { value: current_value },
                    id: 0,
                });
                assert_eq!(result, InsertResult::Success);
            }

            state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                time: end_time,
                parameterization: Parameterization::LinearRamp {
                    value,
                    start: ramp_start,
                },
                id: 0,
            })
        })
    }

    pub fn exponential_ramp_to_value_at_time(
        &self,
        value: f32,
        end_time: f64,
        current_time: f64,
        current_value: f32,
    ) -> InsertResult {
        self.edit(None, |state, _| {
            // If there is no event preceding this event, the exponential ramp behaves as if setValueAtTime(value, currentTime)
            // were called, where value is the current value of the attribute.
            let event_index = state.first_event_index_after(end_time);
            let ramp_start = state.ramp_start_for_insertion_index(state.fallback_value, event_index, current_time);
            if event_index == 0 {
                let result = state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                    time: current_time,
                    parameterization: Parameterization::SetValue { value: current_value },
                    id: 0,
                });
                assert_eq!(result, InsertResult::Success);
            }

            state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                time: end_time,
                parameterization: Parameterization::ExponentialRamp {
                    value,
                    start: ramp_start,
                },
                id: 0,
            })
        })
    }

    pub fn set_target_at_time(&self, target: f32, start_time: f64, time_constant: f32) -> InsertResult {
        self.edit(None, |state, _| {
            state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                time: start_time,
                parameterization: Parameterization::SetTarget { target, time_constant },
                id: 0,
            })
        })
    }

    pub fn set_value_curve_at_time(&self, values: Vec<f32>, start_time: f64, duration: f64) -> InsertResult {
        self.edit(None, |state, _| {
            // If there are any events with a time strictly greater than startTime but strictly less than startTime + duration,
            // a NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown.
            for event in &state.automation_events {
                if event.time > start_time && event.time < start_time + duration {
                    return InsertResult::ValueCurveOverlapsEvent;
                }
            }

            state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                time: start_time,
                parameterization: Parameterization::SetValueCurve {
                    values: values.into(),
                    duration,
                },
                id: 0,
            })
        })
    }

    pub fn cancel_scheduled_values(&self, cancel_time: f64) {
        self.edit(None, |state, previous_value| {
            // Cancel all scheduled parameter changes with times greater than or equal to cancelTime.
            let mut first_event_to_remove = state
                .automation_events
                .partition_point(|event| event.time < cancel_time);

            // Any active automations whose event time is less than cancelTime are also cancelled. A SetTarget remains active
            // until the next event, while a SetValueCurve is active through the end of its duration.
            if first_event_to_remove > 0 {
                let previous_event = &state.automation_events[first_event_to_remove - 1];
                let is_active_automation = match &previous_event.parameterization {
                    Parameterization::SetTarget { .. } => true,
                    Parameterization::SetValueCurve { duration, .. } => cancel_time <= previous_event.time + duration,
                    _ => false,
                };
                if is_active_automation {
                    first_event_to_remove -= 1;
                }
            }

            if first_event_to_remove < state.automation_events.len() {
                state.automation_events.truncate(first_event_to_remove);
                if state.automation_events.is_empty() {
                    state.fallback_value = previous_value;
                }
            }
        });
    }

    pub fn cancel_and_hold_at_time(&self, cancel_time: f64) {
        self.edit(None, |state, _| {
            let value_to_hold = state.value_at_time(cancel_time, cancel_time, &mut None);
            let event_index = state.first_event_index_after(cancel_time);

            // If the event immediately after cancelTime is a ramp, rewrite it to end at cancelTime with the value from the
            // original timeline. This takes precedence over holding the value of the event active at cancelTime.
            let mut rewrote_ramp = false;
            if event_index < state.automation_events.len() {
                let next_event = &mut state.automation_events[event_index];
                rewrote_ramp = match &mut next_event.parameterization {
                    Parameterization::LinearRamp { value, .. } | Parameterization::ExponentialRamp { value, .. } => {
                        next_event.time = cancel_time;
                        *value = value_to_hold;
                        true
                    }
                    _ => false,
                };
            }

            // Otherwise, decide which value (if any) to hold from cancelTime onward, based on the event active at cancelTime.
            let mut hold_value = None;
            let mut drop_active_curve = false;
            if !rewrote_ramp && event_index > 0 {
                let active_event = &state.automation_events[event_index - 1];
                hold_value = match &active_event.parameterization {
                    Parameterization::SetTarget { .. } => Some(value_to_hold),
                    Parameterization::SetValueCurve { duration, .. } => {
                        // Cancelling exactly at a curve's start truncates it to a zero-duration curve, which produces no
                        // output, so the value reverts to the value before the curve rather than the curve's first element.
                        if active_event.time == cancel_time {
                            drop_active_curve = true;
                            Some(if event_index >= 2 {
                                state.event_value_at_time(state.fallback_value, event_index - 2, cancel_time)
                            } else {
                                state.fallback_value
                            })
                        } else if cancel_time <= active_event.time + duration {
                            Some(value_to_hold)
                        } else {
                            None
                        }
                    }
                    _ => None,
                };
            }

            // Curve removal and hold insertion mutate the event list, so they run after the visit rather than inside it.
            if drop_active_curve {
                state.automation_events.remove(event_index - 1);
            }
            if let Some(hold_value) = hold_value {
                assert_eq!(
                    state.insert_event(AutomationEvent {
                        time: cancel_time,
                        parameterization: Parameterization::Hold { value: hold_value },
                        id: 0
                    }),
                    InsertResult::Success
                );
            }

            // Remove all events with times greater than cancelTime. The rewritten ramp or inserted hold remains at cancelTime.
            let first_event_to_remove = state.first_event_index_after(cancel_time);
            if first_event_to_remove < state.automation_events.len() {
                state.automation_events.truncate(first_event_to_remove);
            }
        });
    }
}

impl TimelineState {
    fn value_at_time(&self, selection_time: f64, time: f64, cache: &mut Option<ParameterizationCache>) -> f32 {
        // NB: The governing automation event is selected using selection_time, which render quantum sampling sets half a
        //     frame ahead of the evaluation time so events take effect at the nearest sample frame of their scheduled time
        //     rather than the next frame when floating-point rounding pushes them past the exact frame time.
        let fallback_value = self.fallback_value;
        if cache.is_none_or(|cache| !cache.contains(selection_time)) {
            *cache = Some(self.parameterization_for_time(fallback_value, selection_time));
        }
        let cache = cache.unwrap();
        let Some(event_index) = cache.event_index else {
            return cache.starting_value;
        };

        let event = &self.automation_events[event_index];
        match &event.parameterization {
            Parameterization::SetValue { value } | Parameterization::Hold { value } => *value,
            Parameterization::LinearRamp { value, .. } => {
                // NB: When a ramp ends between two sample frames, selection can consider the ramp completed while the
                //     evaluation time still lies just before its end time. The cached minimum time is then the ramp's own
                //     end time, so interpolating would divide by zero; the ramp's end value applies instead.
                let minimum_time = cache.minimum_time.unwrap();
                if time >= event.time || event.time <= minimum_time {
                    return *value;
                }

                let progress = ((time - minimum_time) / (event.time - minimum_time)) as f32;
                cache.starting_value + (value - cache.starting_value) * progress
            }
            Parameterization::ExponentialRamp { value, .. } => {
                let minimum_time = cache.minimum_time.unwrap();
                if time >= event.time || event.time <= minimum_time {
                    return *value;
                }

                if cache.starting_value == 0.
                    || (cache.starting_value < 0. && *value > 0.)
                    || (cache.starting_value > 0. && *value < 0.)
                {
                    return cache.starting_value;
                }

                let progress = ((time - minimum_time) / (event.time - minimum_time)) as f32;
                cache.starting_value * math::pow(value / cache.starting_value, progress)
            }
            Parameterization::SetTarget { target, time_constant } => {
                if *time_constant == 0. {
                    return *target;
                }
                target
                    + (cache.starting_value - target)
                        * math::exp(-(time - event.time) / f64::from(*time_constant)) as f32
            }
            Parameterization::SetValueCurve { .. } => self.event_value_at_time(fallback_value, event_index, time),
        }
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dfn-automation-event
    fn first_event_index_after(&self, time: f64) -> usize {
        self.automation_events.partition_point(|event| event.time <= time)
    }

    fn event_value_at_time(&self, default_value: f32, event_index: usize, time: f64) -> f32 {
        let mut first_event_index = event_index;
        while first_event_index > 0
            && matches!(
                self.automation_events[first_event_index].parameterization,
                Parameterization::SetTarget { .. }
            )
        {
            first_event_index -= 1;
        }

        let mut value = default_value;
        for current_event_index in first_event_index..=event_index {
            let event = &self.automation_events[current_event_index];
            let evaluation_time = if current_event_index == event_index {
                time
            } else {
                self.automation_events[current_event_index + 1].time
            };
            value = match &event.parameterization {
                Parameterization::SetValue { value }
                | Parameterization::LinearRamp { value, .. }
                | Parameterization::ExponentialRamp { value, .. }
                | Parameterization::Hold { value } => *value,
                Parameterization::SetTarget { target, time_constant } => {
                    if *time_constant == 0. {
                        *target
                    } else {
                        target
                            + (value - target)
                                * math::exp(-(evaluation_time - event.time) / f64::from(*time_constant)) as f32
                    }
                }
                Parameterization::SetValueCurve { values, duration } => {
                    if evaluation_time >= event.time + duration {
                        *values.last().unwrap()
                    } else {
                        let curve_position = (values.len() - 1) as f64 * (evaluation_time - event.time) / duration;

                        // NB: Floating-point rounding can push curve_position to size() - 1 even though evaluation_time is
                        //     still strictly less than the curve's end time, so value_index is clamped to keep value_index + 1 in bounds.
                        let value_index = (curve_position.floor() as usize).min(values.len() - 2);
                        let interpolation_factor = (curve_position - value_index as f64) as f32;
                        values[value_index] + (values[value_index + 1] - values[value_index]) * interpolation_factor
                    }
                }
            };
        }
        value
    }

    // A ramp after an already-started SetTarget begins at currentTime using the target's value at that time.
    fn ramp_start_for_insertion_index(
        &self,
        default_value: f32,
        event_index: usize,
        current_time: f64,
    ) -> Option<RampStart> {
        if event_index == 0 {
            return None;
        }

        let previous_event = &self.automation_events[event_index - 1];
        if previous_event.time >= current_time
            || !matches!(previous_event.parameterization, Parameterization::SetTarget { .. })
        {
            return None;
        }

        Some(RampStart {
            set_target_event_id: previous_event.id,
            time: current_time,
            value: self.event_value_at_time(default_value, event_index - 1, current_time),
        })
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#computedvalue
    fn parameterization_for_time(&self, default_value: f32, time: f64) -> ParameterizationCache {
        let event_index = self.first_event_index_after(time);
        if event_index == 0 {
            return ParameterizationCache {
                maximum_time: self.automation_events.first().map(|event| event.time),
                starting_value: default_value,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }

        // A following ramp parameterization owns the interval before its event time. Other parameterizations fall through
        // to caching the preceding event below.
        if event_index < self.automation_events.len() {
            let cache = match &self.automation_events[event_index].parameterization {
                Parameterization::SetValue { .. }
                | Parameterization::SetTarget { .. }
                | Parameterization::SetValueCurve { .. }
                | Parameterization::Hold { .. } => None,
                Parameterization::LinearRamp { start, .. } | Parameterization::ExponentialRamp { start, .. } => {
                    let previous_event = &self.automation_events[event_index - 1];
                    let (minimum_time, starting_value);
                    if let Some(start) = start
                        && start.set_target_event_id == previous_event.id
                    {
                        minimum_time = start.time;
                        starting_value = start.value;
                    } else {
                        minimum_time = match &previous_event.parameterization {
                            Parameterization::SetValueCurve { duration, .. } => previous_event.time + duration,
                            _ => previous_event.time,
                        };
                        starting_value = self.event_value_at_time(default_value, event_index - 1, minimum_time);
                    }

                    // NB: A ramp rewritten by cancelAndHoldAtTime() can end before a preceding value curve's original end.
                    //     In that case, the curve owns the interval before the ramp endpoint.
                    if time < minimum_time || minimum_time >= self.automation_events[event_index].time {
                        None
                    } else {
                        Some(ParameterizationCache {
                            event_index: Some(event_index),
                            minimum_time: Some(minimum_time),
                            maximum_time: Some(self.automation_events[event_index].time),
                            starting_value,
                        })
                    }
                }
            };
            if let Some(cache) = cache {
                return cache;
            }
        }

        let selected_event_index = event_index - 1;
        let selected_event = &self.automation_events[selected_event_index];
        let mut maximum_time = None;
        if event_index < self.automation_events.len() {
            let next_event = &self.automation_events[event_index];
            maximum_time = Some(match &next_event.parameterization {
                Parameterization::LinearRamp { start, .. } | Parameterization::ExponentialRamp { start, .. } => {
                    if let Some(start) = start
                        && start.set_target_event_id == selected_event.id
                    {
                        start.time
                    } else {
                        next_event.time
                    }
                }
                _ => next_event.time,
            });
        }
        ParameterizationCache {
            event_index: Some(selected_event_index),
            minimum_time: Some(selected_event.time),
            maximum_time,
            starting_value: self.event_value_at_time(default_value, selected_event_index, selected_event.time),
        }
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dfn-automation-event
    fn insert_event(&mut self, mut event: AutomationEvent) -> InsertResult {
        let insertion_index = self.first_event_index_after(event.time);

        // If any automation method is called at a time contained in a SetValueCurve event, a NotSupportedError exception
        // MUST be thrown.
        if insertion_index > 0 {
            let previous_event = &self.automation_events[insertion_index - 1];
            let is_contained_in_curve = match &previous_event.parameterization {
                Parameterization::SetValueCurve { duration, .. } => event.time < previous_event.time + duration,
                _ => false,
            };

            // NB: A hold event ends an active value curve without changing how the curve is sampled before the hold time.
            if is_contained_in_curve && !matches!(event.parameterization, Parameterization::Hold { .. }) {
                return InsertResult::EventContainedInValueCurve;
            }
        }

        // If an event is added at a time where there are already events, it is placed after them but before later events.
        event.id = self.next_event_id;
        self.next_event_id += 1;
        self.automation_events.insert(insertion_index, event);
        InsertResult::Success
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn render_reads_a_complete_snapshot_while_the_writer_is_busy() {
        let timeline = AudioParamTimeline::new(1.);
        assert_eq!(timeline.set_value_at_time(2., 0.), InsertResult::Success);
        std::thread::scope(|scope| {
            let (send, receive) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
            let writer = timeline.writer.lock().unwrap();
            let timeline = &timeline;
            scope.spawn(move || {
                let mut output = [0.; 128];
                timeline.sample(0., 1. / 48000., &mut output);
                send.send(output).unwrap();
            });
            let result = receive.recv_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5));
            drop(writer);
            assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), [2.; 128]);
        });

        let old_snapshot = timeline.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(timeline.set_value_at_time(3., 0.), InsertResult::Success);
        assert_eq!(old_snapshot.value_at_time(0., 0., &mut None), 2.);
        assert_eq!(timeline.value_at_time(0.), 3.);
    }
}

use std::sync::Mutex;

use super::control_message::ControlMessage;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#control-message-queue
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ControlMessageQueue {
    messages: Mutex<Vec<ControlMessage>>,
}

impl ControlMessageQueue {
    // Called by the control thread.
    pub fn enqueue(&self, message: ControlMessage) {
        let mut messages = self.messages.lock().unwrap();
        messages.push(message);
    }

    // Called by the rendering thread.
    pub fn drain(&self) -> Vec<ControlMessage> {
        let mut messages = self.messages.lock().unwrap();
        std::mem::take(&mut *messages)
    }
}

use std::ffi::c_void;

use super::rendering::node_message::{NodeMessage, SharedCppObject};
use super::rendering::render_node::{
    ChannelCountMode, ChannelInterpretation, NodeHandle, OutgoingNodeConnection, OutgoingParamConnection,
};

// Transfers a freshly constructed render node to the rendering thread.
pub struct AddNode {
    pub node: Box<NodeHandle>,
}

// Retires the render node of an AudioNode that is no longer alive on the control thread. The rendering loop only
// considers "the set of all nodes created by this BaseAudioContext, and still alive", so a node that was garbage
// collected must leave the render graph as well.
// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#rendering-loop
pub struct RemoveNode {
    pub node_id: u64,
}

// Replaces the source node's outgoing connections with a full snapshot taken after a connect() or disconnect() call.
pub struct ReplaceConnections {
    pub source: u64,
    pub node_connections: Vec<OutgoingNodeConnection>,
    pub param_connections: Vec<OutgoingParamConnection>,
}

pub struct SetChannelConfig {
    pub node_id: u64,
    pub channel_count: usize,
    pub channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode,
    pub channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation,
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#control-message
pub enum ControlMessage {
    AddNode(AddNode),
    RemoveNode(RemoveNode),
    ReplaceConnections(ReplaceConnections),
    SetChannelConfig(SetChannelConfig),
    NodeMessage(NodeMessage),
}

pub(crate) unsafe fn clone_arc<T>(pointer: *const T) -> Arc<T> {
    unsafe {
        Arc::increment_strong_count(pointer);
        Arc::from_raw(pointer)
    }
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct FfiSharedCppObject {
    pub pointer: *mut c_void,
    pub retain: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void),
    pub release: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void),
}

impl FfiSharedCppObject {
    pub(crate) unsafe fn acquire(self) -> Option<SharedCppObject> {
        if self.pointer.is_null() {
            return None;
        }
        unsafe {
            (self.retain)(self.pointer);
        }
        Some(SharedCppObject {
            pointer: self.pointer,
            retain: self.retain,
            release: self.release,
        })
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Rust/src/web_audio/control_thread.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::mem::ManuallyDrop;
use std::ptr::NonNull;
use std::thread::{self, ThreadId};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_audio_current_event_loop() -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_audio_deferred_invoke(event_loop: *mut c_void, task: *mut c_void, invoke: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void));
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct ControlThread {
    event_loop: NonNull<c_void>,
}

// SAFETY: Core::EventLoop::deferred_invoke() may be called from any thread, and the control thread's event loop
// outlives its audio contexts.
unsafe impl Send for ControlThread {}
unsafe impl Sync for ControlThread {}

impl ControlThread {
    pub fn current() -> Self {
        Self {
            event_loop: NonNull::new(unsafe { web_audio_current_event_loop() }).expect("the thread has an event loop"),
        }
    }

    pub fn post<F: FnOnce() + Send + 'static>(self, task: F) {
        unsafe extern "C" fn invoke<F: FnOnce()>(task: *mut c_void) {
            let task = unsafe { Box::from_raw(task.cast::<F>()) };
            task();
        }
        let task = Box::into_raw(Box::new(task));
        unsafe {
            web_audio_deferred_invoke(self.event_loop.as_ptr(), task.cast(), invoke::<F>);
        }
    }
}

pub struct ControlThreadCell<T> {
    thread: ThreadId,
    value: ManuallyDrop<RefCell<T>>,
}

// SAFETY: Every use of the value checks that it is on the thread that created the cell, and the value is only dropped
// there.
unsafe impl<T> Send for ControlThreadCell<T> {}
unsafe impl<T> Sync for ControlThreadCell<T> {}

impl<T> ControlThreadCell<T> {
    pub fn new(value: T) -> Self {
        Self {
            thread: thread::current().id(),
            value: ManuallyDrop::new(RefCell::new(value)),
        }
    }

    fn value(&self) -> &RefCell<T> {
        assert_eq!(
            thread::current().id(),
            self.thread,
            "only the control thread uses this state"
        );
        &self.value
    }

    pub fn replace(&self, value: T) -> T {
        self.value().replace(value)
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> ControlThreadCell<T> {
    pub fn get(&self) -> T {
        self.value().borrow().clone()
    }
}

impl<T> Drop for ControlThreadCell<T> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if thread::current().id() == self.thread {
            unsafe { ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut self.value) };
        }
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Rust/src/web_audio/rendering/analyser_render_node.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

use super::audio_bus::AudioBus;
use super::audio_frame_ring::{AudioFrameRing, AudioFrameRingCallbacks};
use super::render_graph::RenderGraph;
use super::render_node::*;
use super::render_nodes::{BusRef, NodeProcessor, node_handle};
use crate::web_audio::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS;
use crate::web_audio::control_message::FfiSharedCppObject;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AnalyserNode
struct AnalyserRenderNode {
    time_domain_ring: AudioFrameRing,
    mono_scratch: AudioBus,
    discard_scratch: Vec<f32>,
}

impl NodeProcessor for AnalyserRenderNode {
    unsafe fn process(&mut self, data: &RenderNodeData, graph: &RenderGraph, context: &RenderContext) {
        unsafe {
            let input = BusRef(data.pull_input(graph, context, 0).cast_mut());

            // The AnalyserNode passes its input through unprocessed.
            BusRef(data.output(0)).copy_from(&input);

            // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#current-time-domain-data
            // When the current time-domain data are computed, the input signal must be down-mixed to mono as if
            // channelCount is 1, channelCountMode is "max" and channelInterpretation is "speakers". This is independent
            // of the settings for the AnalyserNode itself.
            // AD-HOC: Down-mix the input as mixed by the AnalyserNode's own channel settings, like other engines.
            self.mono_scratch.zero();
            self.mono_scratch.sum_from(&*input.0, true);

            // The ring must always end up holding the most recent samples, so a full ring (the page
            // is not currently polling any of the analyser getters) drops its oldest quantum first.
            // NB: Popping from the producing side bends the SPSC discipline. It can only race with
            //     the control thread while the ring is simultaneously full and being drained by a
            //     getter, in which case the worst outcome is one repeated or skipped quantum in the
            //     analysis window; the ring's masked indices keep the race memory-safe.
            if self.time_domain_ring.frames_free() < context.quantum_size {
                self.time_domain_ring.try_pop(&mut self.discard_scratch);
            }
            self.time_domain_ring.try_push(self.mono_scratch.channel(0));
        }
    }
}

/// # Safety
/// The ring handle and callbacks must refer to the same live LibAudio ring.
pub unsafe fn create_analyser_render_node(
    node_id: u64,
    quantum_size: usize,
    ring: FfiSharedCppObject,
    callbacks: AudioFrameRingCallbacks,
) -> Box<NodeHandle> {
    let time_domain_ring = AudioFrameRing {
        owner: unsafe { ring.acquire() }.unwrap(),
        callbacks,
    };
    assert_eq!(time_domain_ring.channel_count(), 1);
    let mut data = RenderNodeData::new(node_id, 1, 1, quantum_size, 1);
    data.reserve_output_channels(0, MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS);

    // NB: The control thread queues SetChannelConfig before AddNode and messages addressed to
    //     unknown nodes are dropped, so the constructor must establish the node's channel
    //     configuration itself.
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AnalyserNode
    data.channel_count.set(2);
    data.channel_count_mode.set(ChannelCountMode::Max);
    data.channel_interpretation.set(ChannelInterpretation::Speakers);
    node_handle(
        data,
        AnalyserRenderNode {
            time_domain_ring,
            mono_scratch: AudioBus::new(1, quantum_size),
            discard_scratch: vec![0.; quantum_size],
        },
    )
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Rust/src/web_audio/rendering/audio_bus.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026, Jelle Raaijmakers <jelle@ladybird.org>
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#ChannelLayouts
// Speakers channel layouts exist for mono, stereo, quad and 5.1; all other channel counts use discrete mixing.
const LEFT: usize = 0;
const RIGHT: usize = 1;
const CENTER: usize = 2;
const SURROUND_LEFT: usize = 4;
const SURROUND_RIGHT: usize = 5;

// A block of planar audio samples for a single render quantum.
pub struct AudioBus {
    samples: Vec<f32>,
    channel_count: usize,
    frame_count: usize,
}

impl AudioBus {
    pub fn new(channel_count: usize, frame_count: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            samples: vec![0.; channel_count * frame_count],
            channel_count,
            frame_count,
        }
    }

    pub fn channel_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.channel_count
    }

    pub fn frame_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.frame_count
    }

    pub fn channel(&self, index: usize) -> &[f32] {
        assert!(index < self.channel_count);
        let start = index * self.frame_count;
        &self.samples[start..start + self.frame_count]
    }

    pub fn channel_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> &mut [f32] {
        assert!(index < self.channel_count);
        let start = index * self.frame_count;
        &mut self.samples[start..start + self.frame_count]
    }

    pub(crate) unsafe fn channel_pointer(bus: *mut Self, index: usize) -> (*mut f32, usize) {
        assert!(index < unsafe { (*bus).channel_count });
        let frame_count = unsafe { (*bus).frame_count };
        let samples = unsafe { &raw mut (*bus).samples };
        unsafe { ((*samples).as_mut_ptr().add(index * frame_count), frame_count) }
    }

    pub fn zero(&mut self) {
        self.samples.fill(0.);
    }

    pub fn is_silent(&self) -> bool {
        self.samples.iter().all(|&sample| sample == 0.)
    }

    pub(crate) fn reserve_channels(&mut self, channel_capacity: usize) {
        let extra_samples = (channel_capacity * self.frame_count).saturating_sub(self.samples.len());
        self.samples.reserve_exact(extra_samples);
    }

    // Preserve active channels' samples and zero newly added channels.
    pub fn set_channel_count(&mut self, channel_count: usize) {
        self.samples.resize(channel_count * self.frame_count, 0.);
        self.channel_count = channel_count;
    }

    pub fn copy_from(&mut self, source: &Self) {
        assert_eq!(source.frame_count(), self.frame_count());
        self.set_channel_count(source.channel_count());
        self.samples.copy_from_slice(&source.samples);
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#channel-up-mixing-and-down-mixing
    pub fn sum_from(&mut self, source: &Self, speakers: bool) {
        assert_eq!(source.frame_count(), self.frame_count());
        if speakers {
            self.sum_from_speakers(source);
        } else {
            self.sum_from_discrete(source);
        }
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#UpMix-sub and https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#down-mix
    fn sum_from_speakers(&mut self, source: &Self) {
        let source_channels = source.channel_count();
        let destination_channels = self.channel_count();

        let mut sum_channel = |destination_index: usize, source_index: usize, gain: f32| {
            let destination_span = self.channel_mut(destination_index);
            let source_span = source.channel(source_index);
            for (destination_sample, source_sample) in destination_span.iter_mut().zip(source_span) {
                *destination_sample += *source_sample * gain;
            }
        };

        if source_channels == destination_channels {
            for channel_index in 0..source_channels {
                sum_channel(channel_index, channel_index, 1.);
            }
            return;
        }

        // NB: Up-mixing: mono/stereo/quad sources into stereo, quad or 5.1 destinations.
        if source_channels == 1 && destination_channels == 2 {
            // 1 -> 2: output.L = input, output.R = input
            sum_channel(LEFT, 0, 1.);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, 0, 1.);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 1 && destination_channels == 4 {
            // 1 -> 4: output.L = input, output.R = input, output.SL = 0, output.SR = 0
            sum_channel(LEFT, 0, 1.);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, 0, 1.);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 1 && destination_channels == 6 {
            // 1 -> 5.1: output.C = input, all other channels silent
            sum_channel(CENTER, 0, 1.);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 2 && destination_channels == 4 {
            // 2 -> 4: output.L = input.L, output.R = input.R, surround channels silent
            sum_channel(LEFT, LEFT, 1.);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, RIGHT, 1.);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 2 && destination_channels == 6 {
            // 2 -> 5.1: output.L = input.L, output.R = input.R, all other channels silent
            sum_channel(LEFT, LEFT, 1.);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, RIGHT, 1.);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 4 && destination_channels == 6 {
            // 4 -> 5.1: output.L = input.L, output.R = input.R, output.SL = input.SL, output.SR = input.SR
            sum_channel(LEFT, LEFT, 1.);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, RIGHT, 1.);
            sum_channel(SURROUND_LEFT, 2, 1.);
            sum_channel(SURROUND_RIGHT, 3, 1.);
            return;
        }

        // NB: Down-mixing: stereo/quad/5.1 sources into mono, stereo or quad destinations.
        if source_channels == 2 && destination_channels == 1 {
            // 2 -> 1: output = 0.5 * (input.L + input.R)
            sum_channel(0, LEFT, 0.5);
            sum_channel(0, RIGHT, 0.5);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 4 && destination_channels == 1 {
            // 4 -> 1: output = 0.25 * (input.L + input.R + input.SL + input.SR)
            for channel_index in 0..4 {
                sum_channel(0, channel_index, 0.25);
            }
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 6 && destination_channels == 1 {
            // 5.1 -> 1: output = sqrt(0.5) * (input.L + input.R) + input.C + 0.5 * (input.SL + input.SR)
            sum_channel(0, LEFT, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            sum_channel(0, RIGHT, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            sum_channel(0, CENTER, 1.);
            sum_channel(0, SURROUND_LEFT, 0.5);
            sum_channel(0, SURROUND_RIGHT, 0.5);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 4 && destination_channels == 2 {
            // 4 -> 2: output.L = 0.5 * (input.L + input.SL), output.R = 0.5 * (input.R + input.SR)
            sum_channel(LEFT, LEFT, 0.5);
            sum_channel(LEFT, 2, 0.5);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, RIGHT, 0.5);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, 3, 0.5);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 6 && destination_channels == 2 {
            // 5.1 -> 2: output.L = input.L + sqrt(0.5) * (input.C + input.SL),
            //           output.R = input.R + sqrt(0.5) * (input.C + input.SR)
            sum_channel(LEFT, LEFT, 1.);
            sum_channel(LEFT, CENTER, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            sum_channel(LEFT, SURROUND_LEFT, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, RIGHT, 1.);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, CENTER, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, SURROUND_RIGHT, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            return;
        }
        if source_channels == 6 && destination_channels == 4 {
            // 5.1 -> 4: output.L = input.L + sqrt(0.5) * input.C, output.R = input.R + sqrt(0.5) * input.C,
            //           output.SL = input.SL, output.SR = input.SR
            sum_channel(LEFT, LEFT, 1.);
            sum_channel(LEFT, CENTER, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, RIGHT, 1.);
            sum_channel(RIGHT, CENTER, std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
            sum_channel(2, SURROUND_LEFT, 1.);
            sum_channel(3, SURROUND_RIGHT, 1.);
            return;
        }

        // NB: All other layout combinations fall back to discrete mixing.
        self.sum_from_discrete(source);
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-channelinterpretation-discrete
    fn sum_from_discrete(&mut self, source: &Self) {
        // Up-mix by filling channels until they run out then zero out remaining channels. Down-mix by filling as many
        // channels as possible, then dropping remaining channels.
        let channels_to_sum = source.channel_count().min(self.channel_count());
        for channel_index in 0..channels_to_sum {
            let destination_span = self.channel_mut(channel_index);
            let source_span = source.channel(channel_index);
            for (destination_sample, source_sample) in destination_span.iter_mut().zip(source_span) {
                *destination_sample += *source_sample;
            }
        }
    }
}

// An immutable snapshot of an AudioBuffer's sample data, created on the control thread when the buffer's content is
// acquired and shared with the rendering thread.
// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#acquire-the-content
pub struct AudioBufferContents {
    pub channels: Vec<Vec<f32>>,
    pub sample_rate: f32,
}

impl AudioBufferContents {
    pub fn length(&self) -> usize {
        self.channels.first().map_or(0, Vec::len)
    }

    pub fn duration(&self) -> f64 {
        self.length() as f64 / f64::from(self.sample_rate)
    }
}

// An immutable snapshot of a PeriodicWave's Fourier coefficients.
// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#PeriodicWave
pub struct PeriodicWaveData {
    pub real: Vec<f32>,
    pub imag: Vec<f32>,
    pub normalize: bool,
}

// An immutable copy of a WaveShaperNode's curve.
// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-waveshapernode-curve
pub struct WaveShaperCurve {
    pub values: Vec<f32>,
}

use std::ffi::c_void;

use super::node_message::SharedCppObject;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct AudioFrameRingCallbacks {
    pub channel_count: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void) -> u32,
    pub frames_available: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void) -> usize,
    pub frames_free: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void) -> usize,
    pub try_pop: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, ak::SpanMut<'_, f32>) -> usize,
    pub try_push: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, ak::Span<'_, f32>) -> usize,
}

pub struct AudioFrameRing {
    pub owner: SharedCppObject,
    pub callbacks: AudioFrameRingCallbacks,
}

impl AudioFrameRing {
    pub fn channel_count(&self) -> u32 {
        unsafe { (self.callbacks.channel_count)(self.owner.pointer) }
    }

    pub fn frames_available(&self) -> usize {
        unsafe { (self.callbacks.frames_available)(self.owner.pointer) }
    }

    pub fn frames_free(&self) -> usize {
        unsafe { (self.callbacks.frames_free)(self.owner.pointer) }
    }

    pub fn try_pop(&self, samples: &mut [f32]) -> usize {
        unsafe { (self.callbacks.try_pop)(self.owner.pointer, ak::SpanMut::new(samples)) }
    }

    pub fn try_push(&self, samples: &[f32]) -> usize {
        unsafe { (self.callbacks.try_push)(self.owner.pointer, ak::Span::new(samples)) }
    }
}

use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, Weak};
use std::thread;
use std::time::Duration;

use super::audio_worklet_pipe::{
    AudioWorkletPipe, AudioWorkletPipeClient, Config, WorkletPipeState, ring_sizing_for_device_latency,
};

const QUANTUM_SIZE: usize = 128;
const RING_CAPACITY: usize = 64;
const PRIME_LEVEL: usize = 48;
const BURST_QUANTA: usize = 38;

struct PostedTask {
    task: usize,
    invoke: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void),
}

type EventLoop = Mutex<VecDeque<PostedTask>>;

thread_local! {
    static EVENT_LOOP: &'static EventLoop = Box::leak(Box::default());
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
extern "C" fn web_audio_current_event_loop() -> *mut c_void {
    EVENT_LOOP.with(|event_loop| std::ptr::from_ref::<EventLoop>(event_loop).cast_mut().cast())
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
unsafe extern "C" fn web_audio_deferred_invoke(
    event_loop: *mut c_void,
    task: *mut c_void,
    invoke: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void),
) {
    let event_loop = unsafe { &*event_loop.cast::<EventLoop>() };
    event_loop.lock().unwrap().push_back(PostedTask {
        task: task as usize,
        invoke,
    });
}

fn run_posted_tasks() {
    loop {
        let task = EVENT_LOOP.with(|event_loop| event_loop.lock().unwrap().pop_front());
        let Some(task) = task else {
            return;
        };
        unsafe { (task.invoke)(task.task as *mut c_void) };
    }
}

fn test_pipe() -> Arc<AudioWorkletPipe> {
    AudioWorkletPipe::new(Config {
        quantum_size: QUANTUM_SIZE,
        input_count: 1,
        output_count: 1,
        input_channel_capacity: vec![2],
        output_channel_capacity: vec![2],
        output_channel_count_matches_input: false,
        param_count: 2,
        param_is_a_rate: vec![true, false],
        ring_capacity: RING_CAPACITY,
        prime_level: PRIME_LEVEL,
    })
}

struct InputSlotWriter<'a> {
    pipe: &'a AudioWorkletPipe,
    slot: *mut u8,
}

impl InputSlotWriter<'_> {
    fn set_start_frame(&mut self, frame: u64) {
        unsafe { AudioWorkletPipe::set_start_frame(self.slot, frame) };
    }

    fn set_had_gap(&mut self, had_gap: bool) {
        unsafe { AudioWorkletPipe::set_flag(self.slot, had_gap) };
    }

    fn set_actual_channel_count(&mut self, input: usize, channel_count: u32) {
        unsafe { *self.pipe.channel_count(self.slot, false, input) = channel_count };
    }

    fn input_channel(&mut self, input: usize, channel: usize) -> &mut [f32] {
        let (samples, length) = unsafe { self.pipe.channel(self.slot, false, input, channel) };
        unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts_mut(samples, length) }
    }

    fn param_block(&mut self, param: usize) -> &mut [f32] {
        let (samples, length) = unsafe { self.pipe.param_block(self.slot, param) };
        unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts_mut(samples, length) }
    }
}

struct OutputSlotReader<'a> {
    pipe: &'a AudioWorkletPipe,
    slot: *mut u8,
}

impl OutputSlotReader<'_> {
    fn start_frame(&self) -> u64 {
        unsafe { AudioWorkletPipe::start_frame(self.slot) }
    }

    fn processor_active(&self) -> bool {
        unsafe { AudioWorkletPipe::flag(self.slot) }
    }

    fn actual_channel_count(&self, output: usize) -> u32 {
        unsafe { *self.pipe.channel_count(self.slot, true, output) }
    }

    fn output_channel(&self, output: usize, channel: usize) -> &[f32] {
        let (samples, length) = unsafe { self.pipe.channel(self.slot, true, output, channel) };
        unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(samples, length) }
    }
}

fn try_push_input(pipe: &AudioWorkletPipe, fill: impl FnOnce(&mut InputSlotWriter<'_>)) -> bool {
    unsafe { pipe.try_push_input(|slot| fill(&mut InputSlotWriter { pipe, slot })) }
}

fn try_pop_output(pipe: &AudioWorkletPipe, read: impl FnOnce(&OutputSlotReader<'_>)) -> bool {
    unsafe { pipe.try_pop_output(|slot| read(&OutputSlotReader { pipe, slot })) }
}

fn random_sleep(state: &Cell<u32>) {
    let next = state.get().wrapping_mul(1_103_515_245).wrapping_add(12_345);
    state.set(next);
    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(u64::from((next >> 16) % 11)));
}

#[test]
fn ring_sizing_matches_renderer_defaults() {
    let sizing = ring_sizing_for_device_latency(100, 48000., 128);
    assert_eq!(sizing.ring_capacity, 64);
    assert_eq!(sizing.prime_level, 48);

    for latency_ms in [10_u32, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500] {
        let sizing = ring_sizing_for_device_latency(latency_ms, 48000., 128);
        let burst = (f64::from(latency_ms) / 1000. * 48000. / 128.).ceil() as usize;
        assert!(sizing.prime_level >= burst);
        assert!(sizing.ring_capacity > sizing.prime_level);
        assert!(sizing.ring_capacity.is_power_of_two());
    }
}

#[test]
fn pops_on_empty_rings_fail() {
    let pipe = test_pipe();

    assert!(!unsafe { pipe.try_read_input(|_| unreachable!()) });
    assert!(!try_pop_output(&pipe, |_| unreachable!()));

    // Only the audio thread's output pops count as underruns; an empty input ring just means the pump caught up.
    assert_eq!(pipe.underrun_count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(pipe.dropped_input_count(), 0);
    assert_eq!(pipe.output_occupancy(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn input_ring_roundtrip_fill_to_capacity_and_overrun() {
    let pipe = test_pipe();

    for i in 0..RING_CAPACITY {
        let pushed = try_push_input(&pipe, |slot| {
            slot.set_start_frame((i * QUANTUM_SIZE) as u64);
            if i == 3 {
                slot.set_had_gap(true);
            }
            slot.set_actual_channel_count(0, (i % 3) as u32);
            for channel in 0..i % 3 {
                let samples = slot.input_channel(0, channel);
                assert_eq!(samples.len(), QUANTUM_SIZE);
                for (frame, sample) in samples.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                    *sample = (i * 10 + channel) as f32 + frame as f32 * 0.25;
                }
            }
            assert_eq!(slot.param_block(0).len(), QUANTUM_SIZE);
            assert_eq!(slot.param_block(1).len(), 1);
            for (frame, sample) in slot.param_block(0).iter_mut().enumerate() {
                *sample = i as f32 + frame as f32 * 0.5;
            }
            slot.param_block(1)[0] = i as f32;
        });
        assert!(pushed);
    }

    assert!(!try_push_input(&pipe, |_| unreachable!()));
    assert_eq!(pipe.dropped_input_count(), 1);

    for i in 0..RING_CAPACITY {
        let popped = unsafe {
            pipe.try_read_input(|slot| {
                assert_eq!(slot.start_frame(), (i * QUANTUM_SIZE) as u64);
                assert_eq!(slot.had_gap(), i == 3);
                assert_eq!(slot.actual_channel_count(0), (i % 3) as u32);
                for channel in 0..i % 3 {
                    let samples = slot.input_channel(0, channel);
                    assert_eq!(samples[0], (i * 10 + channel) as f32);
                    assert_eq!(
                        samples[QUANTUM_SIZE - 1],
                        (i * 10 + channel) as f32 + (QUANTUM_SIZE - 1) as f32 * 0.25
                    );
                }
                assert_eq!(slot.param_block(0)[0], i as f32);
                assert_eq!(
                    slot.param_block(0)[QUANTUM_SIZE - 1],
                    i as f32 + (QUANTUM_SIZE - 1) as f32 * 0.5
                );
                assert_eq!(slot.param_block(1)[0], i as f32);
            })
        };
        assert!(popped);
    }
    assert!(!unsafe { pipe.try_read_input(|_| unreachable!()) });

    // Wrap around into the same storage: flags are cleared on push, so slot 3's gap flag must not leak through.
    for i in 0..RING_CAPACITY {
        assert!(try_push_input(&pipe, |slot| {
            slot.set_start_frame(((RING_CAPACITY + i) * QUANTUM_SIZE) as u64);
            slot.set_actual_channel_count(0, 0);
        }));
    }
    for i in 0..RING_CAPACITY {
        assert!(unsafe {
            pipe.try_read_input(|slot| {
                assert_eq!(slot.start_frame(), ((RING_CAPACITY + i) * QUANTUM_SIZE) as u64);
                assert!(!slot.had_gap());
            })
        });
    }

    assert_eq!(pipe.dropped_input_count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(pipe.underrun_count(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn output_ring_roundtrip() {
    let pipe = test_pipe();

    for i in 0..5 {
        assert!(unsafe {
            pipe.try_write_output(|slot| {
                slot.set_start_frame((i * QUANTUM_SIZE) as u64);
                slot.set_processor_active(i % 2 == 0);
                slot.set_actual_channel_count(0, 2);
                for channel in 0..2 {
                    slot.output_channel(0, channel).fill((i * 10 + channel) as f32);
                }
            })
        });
    }
    assert_eq!(pipe.output_occupancy(), 5);

    for i in 0..5 {
        assert!(try_pop_output(&pipe, |slot| {
            assert_eq!(slot.start_frame(), (i * QUANTUM_SIZE) as u64);
            assert_eq!(slot.processor_active(), i % 2 == 0);
            assert_eq!(slot.actual_channel_count(0), 2);
            for channel in 0..2 {
                assert_eq!(slot.output_channel(0, channel)[0], (i * 10 + channel) as f32);
                assert_eq!(
                    slot.output_channel(0, channel)[QUANTUM_SIZE - 1],
                    (i * 10 + channel) as f32
                );
            }
        }));
    }
    assert_eq!(pipe.underrun_count(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn priming_and_discard_down_to() {
    let pipe = test_pipe();

    unsafe { pipe.prime_outputs_with_silence(PRIME_LEVEL) };
    assert_eq!(pipe.output_occupancy(), PRIME_LEVEL);

    let popped = try_pop_output(&pipe, |slot| {
        assert_eq!(slot.start_frame(), 0);
        assert!(slot.processor_active());
        assert_eq!(slot.actual_channel_count(0), 2);
        for channel in 0..2 {
            assert!(slot.output_channel(0, channel).iter().all(|sample| *sample == 0.));
        }
    });
    assert!(popped);
    assert_eq!(pipe.output_occupancy(), PRIME_LEVEL - 1);

    pipe.discard_outputs_down_to(10);
    assert_eq!(pipe.output_occupancy(), 10);

    pipe.discard_outputs_down_to(20);
    assert_eq!(pipe.output_occupancy(), 10);

    pipe.discard_outputs_down_to(0);
    assert_eq!(pipe.output_occupancy(), 0);
    assert_eq!(pipe.underrun_count(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn state_transitions() {
    let pipe = test_pipe();

    assert_eq!(pipe.state(), WorkletPipeState::Running);
    pipe.set_state(WorkletPipeState::Failed);
    assert_eq!(pipe.state(), WorkletPipeState::Failed);
    pipe.set_state(WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
    assert_eq!(pipe.state(), WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
}

struct CountingClient {
    pump_runs: Cell<usize>,
}

impl AudioWorkletPipeClient for CountingClient {
    fn pump(&self) {
        self.pump_runs.set(self.pump_runs.get() + 1);
    }
}

#[test]
fn wakeup_coalescing() {
    let pipe = test_pipe();
    let client = Rc::new(CountingClient {
        pump_runs: Cell::new(0),
    });
    pipe.set_client(Some(client.clone()));

    pipe.request_wakeup();
    pipe.request_wakeup();
    pipe.request_wakeup();

    // Give any (incorrectly) duplicated wakeups a chance to run.
    run_posted_tasks();
    assert_eq!(client.pump_runs.get(), 1);

    pipe.clear_wakeup_flag();
    pipe.request_wakeup();
    run_posted_tasks();
    assert_eq!(client.pump_runs.get(), 2);

    pipe.clear_wakeup_flag();
    pipe.set_state(WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
    pipe.request_wakeup();
    run_posted_tasks();
    assert_eq!(client.pump_runs.get(), 2);

    pipe.set_client(None);
}

struct GainClient {
    pipe: Weak<AudioWorkletPipe>,
    random: Cell<u32>,
    quanta_processed: Cell<u64>,
}

impl AudioWorkletPipeClient for GainClient {
    fn pump(&self) {
        let pipe = self.pipe.upgrade().unwrap();
        pipe.clear_wakeup_flag();
        random_sleep(&self.random);
        while unsafe {
            pipe.try_read_input(|input| {
                let pushed = pipe.try_write_output(|output| {
                    output.set_start_frame(input.start_frame());
                    output.set_processor_active(true);
                    output.set_actual_channel_count(0, input.actual_channel_count(0));
                    let gain = input.param_block(1)[0];
                    for channel in 0..input.actual_channel_count(0) as usize {
                        let source = input.input_channel(0, channel);
                        for (destination, sample) in output.output_channel(0, channel).iter_mut().zip(source) {
                            *destination = sample * gain;
                        }
                    }
                });
                assert!(pushed);
                self.quanta_processed.set(self.quanta_processed.get() + 1);
            })
        } {}
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct ProducerResults {
    popped_stamps: Vec<u64>,
    sample_mismatches: u64,
    failed_output_pops: u64,
    successful_input_pushes: u64,
}

fn run_event_loop_until(done: &AtomicBool) {
    while !done.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
        run_posted_tasks();
        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
    run_posted_tasks();
}

#[test]
fn two_thread_stress() {
    const BURST_COUNT: usize = 20;

    // Primed slots are stamped 0; real quanta start one quantum in.
    const FIRST_STAMP: u64 = QUANTUM_SIZE as u64;

    let pipe = test_pipe();
    unsafe { pipe.prime_outputs_with_silence(PRIME_LEVEL) };
    let client = Rc::new(GainClient {
        pipe: Arc::downgrade(&pipe),
        random: Cell::new(1),
        quanta_processed: Cell::new(0),
    });
    pipe.set_client(Some(client.clone()));

    let producer_done = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let producer = {
        let pipe = Arc::clone(&pipe);
        let producer_done = Arc::clone(&producer_done);
        thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut results = ProducerResults::default();
            results.popped_stamps.reserve(BURST_COUNT * BURST_QUANTA + PRIME_LEVEL);
            let mut next_frame = FIRST_STAMP;
            for _ in 0..BURST_COUNT {
                for _ in 0..BURST_QUANTA {
                    let popped = try_pop_output(&pipe, |output| {
                        let stamp = output.start_frame();
                        results.popped_stamps.push(stamp);

                        // Primed slots are silent; processed ones echo the value the producer filled in below.
                        for channel in 0..output.actual_channel_count(0) as usize {
                            let expected = if stamp == 0 {
                                0.
                            } else {
                                (stamp / QUANTUM_SIZE as u64 + channel as u64) as f32
                            };
                            if output.output_channel(0, channel)[0] != expected {
                                results.sample_mismatches += 1;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    if !popped {
                        results.failed_output_pops += 1;
                    }
                    let pushed = try_push_input(&pipe, |input| {
                        input.set_start_frame(next_frame);
                        input.set_actual_channel_count(0, 2);
                        for channel in 0..2 {
                            input
                                .input_channel(0, channel)
                                .fill((next_frame / QUANTUM_SIZE as u64 + channel as u64) as f32);
                        }
                        input.param_block(0).fill(0.5);
                        input.param_block(1)[0] = 1.;
                    });
                    if pushed {
                        results.successful_input_pushes += 1;
                    }
                    next_frame += QUANTUM_SIZE as u64;
                }
                pipe.request_wakeup();
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
            }
            producer_done.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
            results
        })
    };

    run_event_loop_until(&producer_done);
    let results = producer.join().unwrap();

    let mut pending_input = 0_u64;
    while unsafe { pipe.try_read_input(|_| pending_input += 1) } {}

    assert_eq!(results.sample_mismatches, 0);
    assert_eq!(
        results.failed_output_pops + results.popped_stamps.len() as u64,
        (BURST_COUNT * BURST_QUANTA) as u64
    );
    assert_eq!(
        results.successful_input_pushes + pipe.dropped_input_count(),
        (BURST_COUNT * BURST_QUANTA) as u64
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client.quanta_processed.get() + pending_input,
        results.successful_input_pushes
    );

    // The FIFO order guarantees all primed (stamp 0) slots come out before any processed quantum, and processed
    // stamps are observed in increasing quantum order.
    let primed_popped = results.popped_stamps.iter().take_while(|stamp| **stamp == 0).count();
    assert!(primed_popped <= PRIME_LEVEL);
    let mut previous_stamp = None;
    for stamp in &results.popped_stamps[primed_popped..] {
        assert!(*stamp >= FIRST_STAMP);
        assert_eq!((stamp - FIRST_STAMP) % QUANTUM_SIZE as u64, 0);
        if let Some(previous_stamp) = previous_stamp {
            assert!(*stamp > previous_stamp);
        }
        previous_stamp = Some(*stamp);
    }

    pipe.set_client(None);
}

struct SilentClient {
    pipe: RefCell<Option<Arc<AudioWorkletPipe>>>,
    quanta_processed: Cell<u64>,
}

impl AudioWorkletPipeClient for SilentClient {
    fn pump(&self) {
        let pipe = self.pipe.borrow().clone().unwrap();
        pipe.clear_wakeup_flag();
        if pipe.state() != WorkletPipeState::Running {
            return;
        }
        while unsafe {
            pipe.try_read_input(|input| {
                let _ = pipe.try_write_output(|output| {
                    output.set_start_frame(input.start_frame());
                    output.set_processor_active(true);
                    output.set_actual_channel_count(0, 0);
                });
                self.quanta_processed.set(self.quanta_processed.get() + 1);
            })
        } {}
    }
}

#[test]
fn teardown_when_producer_drops_its_reference_mid_run() {
    let pipe = test_pipe();
    unsafe { pipe.prime_outputs_with_silence(PRIME_LEVEL) };
    let client = Rc::new(SilentClient {
        pipe: RefCell::new(Some(Arc::clone(&pipe))),
        quanta_processed: Cell::new(0),
    });
    pipe.set_client(Some(client.clone()));

    let producer_done = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let producer = {
        let mut producer_pipe = Some(Arc::clone(&pipe));
        let producer_done = Arc::clone(&producer_done);
        thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut next_frame = QUANTUM_SIZE as u64;
            for _ in 0..3 {
                let pipe = producer_pipe.as_ref().unwrap();
                for _ in 0..BURST_QUANTA {
                    try_pop_output(pipe, |_| {});
                    let _ = try_push_input(pipe, |input| {
                        input.set_start_frame(next_frame);
                        input.set_actual_channel_count(0, 0);
                    });
                    next_frame += QUANTUM_SIZE as u64;
                }
                pipe.request_wakeup();
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(30));
            }
            let pipe = producer_pipe.take().unwrap();
            pipe.set_state(WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
            drop(pipe);
            producer_done.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
        })
    };

    run_event_loop_until(&producer_done);
    producer.join().unwrap();

    assert_eq!(pipe.state(), WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
    assert_eq!(pipe.dropped_input_count(), 0);
    assert!(client.quanta_processed.get() > 0);

    pipe.set_client(None);
    client.pipe.replace(None);
}

/*
