use std::cell::Cell;

use super::audio_bus::AudioBus;
use super::node_message::node_message_target;
use super::render_node::{NodeHandle, RenderContext};
use crate::web_audio::control_message::ControlMessage;

// The rendering thread's mirror of the audio graph. Nodes and connections are added and updated exclusively through
// control messages, which are applied at the start of each render quantum.
// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#rendering-loop
pub struct RenderGraph {
    nodes: NodeMap,
    // Nodes whose AudioNode is gone, but which still have a tail to play. Each is removed once its tail has played out.
    nodes_finishing_tails: Vec<u64>,
    destination_id: u64,
    current_quantum: Cell<u64>,
    incoming_connections_dirty: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Default for RenderGraph {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            nodes: NodeMap::default(),
            nodes_finishing_tails: Vec::new(),
            destination_id: 0,
            current_quantum: Cell::new(0),
            incoming_connections_dirty: Cell::new(false),
        }
    }
}

impl RenderGraph {
    pub fn apply_control_messages(&mut self, messages: Vec<ControlMessage>) {
        self.remove_nodes_whose_tails_have_played_out();
        for message in messages {
            match message {
                ControlMessage::AddNode(add_node) => {
                    let node_id = add_node.node.data().node_id;
                    self.nodes.insert(node_id, add_node.node);
                    self.incoming_connections_dirty.set(true);
                }
                ControlMessage::RemoveNode(remove_node) => {
                    // A node that still has a tail keeps its connections and goes on rendering it, as nothing can
                    // reach its AudioNode to stop it.
                    let has_tail_remaining = self
                        .node(remove_node.node_id)
                        .is_some_and(|node| unsafe { node.node.has_tail_remaining() });
                    if has_tail_remaining {
                        self.nodes_finishing_tails.push(remove_node.node_id);
                    } else if self.nodes.remove(&remove_node.node_id).is_some() {
                        self.incoming_connections_dirty.set(true);
                    }
                }
                ControlMessage::ReplaceConnections(replace_connections) => {
                    if let Some(source_node) = self.node(replace_connections.source) {
                        unsafe {
                            source_node.data().set_outgoing_connections(
                                replace_connections.node_connections,
                                replace_connections.param_connections,
                            );
                        }
                        self.incoming_connections_dirty.set(true);
                    }
                }
                ControlMessage::SetChannelConfig(config) => {
                    if let Some(target_node) = self.node(config.node_id) {
                        target_node.data().channel_count.set(config.channel_count);
                        target_node.data().channel_count_mode.set(config.channel_count_mode);
                        target_node
                            .data()
                            .channel_interpretation
                            .set(config.channel_interpretation);
                    }
                }
                ControlMessage::NodeMessage(node_message) => {
                    if let Some(target_node) = self.node(node_message_target(&node_message)) {
                        unsafe {
                            target_node.node.handle_message(&node_message);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn remove_nodes_whose_tails_have_played_out(&mut self) {
        if self.nodes_finishing_tails.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let nodes = &mut self.nodes;
        let mut removed_any = false;
        self.nodes_finishing_tails.retain(|node_id| {
            let has_tail_remaining = nodes
                .get(node_id)
                .is_some_and(|node| unsafe { node.node.has_tail_remaining() });
            if !has_tail_remaining {
                removed_any |= nodes.remove(node_id).is_some();
            }
            has_tail_remaining
        });
        if removed_any {
            self.incoming_connections_dirty.set(true);
        }
    }

    // Renders a single quantum by pulling the destination node and any active source nodes.
    pub fn render_quantum(&self, context: &RenderContext) {
        self.current_quantum.set(self.current_quantum.get().wrapping_add(1));
        if self.incoming_connections_dirty.get() {
            unsafe {
                self.rebuild_incoming_connections();
            }
            self.incoming_connections_dirty.set(false);
        }

        // Process the destination first so the main graph is processed in dependency order.
        if let Some(destination_node) = self.destination() {
            self.process_node(destination_node, context);
        }
        // Advance unconnected sources and process sinks with no outputs.
        for graph_node in self.nodes.values() {
            self.process_node(graph_node, context);
        }
    }

    // Returns the source node's output bus, processing the node first if it has not been processed in this quantum.
    // Re-entrant pulls caused by cycles return the output rendered in the previous quantum.
    pub fn pull_output(&self, source: u64, output_index: usize, context: &RenderContext) -> *mut AudioBus {
        let Some(source_node) = self.node(source) else {
            return std::ptr::null_mut();
        };
        let data = source_node.data();
        if output_index >= data.output_count() {
            return std::ptr::null_mut();
        }
        self.process_node(source_node, context);
        unsafe { data.output(output_index) }
    }

    fn process_node(&self, node: &NodeHandle, context: &RenderContext) {
        let data = node.data();
        if data.processed_quantum.get() == self.current_quantum.get() || data.is_processing.get() {
            return;
        }
        data.is_processing.set(true);
        unsafe {
            node.node.process(self, context);
        }
        data.is_processing.set(false);
        data.processed_quantum.set(self.current_quantum.get());
    }

    pub fn node(&self, node_id: u64) -> Option<&NodeHandle> {
        self.nodes.get(&node_id)
    }

    pub fn set_destination(&mut self, node_id: u64) {
        self.destination_id = node_id;
    }

    pub fn destination(&self) -> Option<&NodeHandle> {
        self.node(self.destination_id)
    }

    // Drains the set of nodes that stopped playing since the last call and retires their permanently silent render nodes.
    pub fn take_ended_nodes(&mut self) -> Vec<u64> {
        let mut ended_nodes = Vec::new();
        for (&node_id, graph_node) in self.nodes.iter() {
            if unsafe { graph_node.node.take_ended_notification() } {
                ended_nodes.push(node_id);
            }
        }
        for node_id in &ended_nodes {
            self.nodes.remove(node_id);
        }
        if !ended_nodes.is_empty() {
            self.incoming_connections_dirty.set(true);
        }
        ended_nodes
    }

    unsafe fn rebuild_incoming_connections(&self) {
        for graph_node in self.nodes.values() {
            let data = graph_node.data();
            for input_index in 0..data.input_count() {
                (unsafe { &mut *data.input_connections.get() })[input_index].clear();
            }
            graph_node.node.for_each_param(&mut |param| unsafe {
                param.clear_inputs();
            });
        }
        for (&node_id, graph_node) in self.nodes.iter() {
            let data = graph_node.data();
            for connection in unsafe { &*data.outgoing_node_connections.get() } {
                if let Some(destination_node) = self.node(connection.destination)
                    && connection.input_index < destination_node.data().input_count()
                {
                    (unsafe { &mut *destination_node.data().input_connections.get() })[connection.input_index].push(
                        super::render_node::Connection {
                            source: node_id,
                            output_index: connection.output_index,
                        },
                    );
                }
            }
            for connection in unsafe { &*data.outgoing_param_connections.get() } {
                unsafe {
                    connection.destination.add_input(node_id, connection.output_index);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct NodeMap {
    buckets: Vec<Option<(u64, Box<NodeHandle>)>>,
    size: usize,
}

impl NodeMap {
    fn hash(mut key: u64) -> usize {
        key ^= key >> 33;
        key = key.wrapping_mul(0xff51afd7ed558ccd);
        key ^= key >> 33;
        key = key.wrapping_mul(0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53);
        key ^= key >> 33;
        key as u32 as usize
    }

    fn probe_length(&self, key: u64, index: usize) -> usize {
        index.wrapping_sub(Self::hash(key)) & (self.buckets.len() - 1)
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, key: u64, value: Box<NodeHandle>) {
        if (self.size + 1) * 100 >= self.buckets.len() * 70 {
            let capacity = (self.buckets.len() * 2).max(8);
            let old_buckets = std::mem::replace(&mut self.buckets, (0..capacity).map(|_| None).collect());
            self.size = 0;
            for (key, value) in old_buckets.into_iter().flatten() {
                self.write_value(key, value);
            }
        }
        self.write_value(key, value);
    }

    fn write_value(&mut self, mut key: u64, mut value: Box<NodeHandle>) {
        let mask = self.buckets.len() - 1;
        let mut index = Self::hash(key) & mask;
        let mut probe_length = 0;
        loop {
            let Some((target_key, _)) = &self.buckets[index] else {
                self.buckets[index] = Some((key, value));
                self.size += 1;
                return;
            };
            if *target_key == key {
                self.buckets[index] = Some((key, value));
                return;
            }
            let target_probe_length = self.probe_length(*target_key, index);
            if probe_length > target_probe_length {
                let displaced = self.buckets[index].replace((key, value)).unwrap();
                (key, value) = displaced;
                probe_length = target_probe_length;
            }
            index = (index + 1) & mask;
            probe_length += 1;
        }
    }

    fn index(&self, key: u64) -> Option<usize> {
        if self.size == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        let mask = self.buckets.len() - 1;
        let mut index = Self::hash(key) & mask;
        let mut probe_length = 0;
        loop {
            let (target_key, _) = self.buckets[index].as_ref()?;
            if *target_key == key {
                return Some(index);
            }
            if probe_length > self.probe_length(*target_key, index) {
                return None;
            }
            index = (index + 1) & mask;
            probe_length += 1;
        }
    }

    fn get(&self, key: &u64) -> Option<&NodeHandle> {
        self.index(*key)
            .map(|index| self.buckets[index].as_ref().unwrap().1.as_ref())
    }

    fn remove(&mut self, key: &u64) -> Option<Box<NodeHandle>> {
        let mut shift_to_index = self.index(*key)?;
        let (_, value) = self.buckets[shift_to_index].take().unwrap();
        self.size -= 1;
        let mask = self.buckets.len() - 1;
        loop {
            let shift_from_index = (shift_to_index + 1) & mask;
            let Some((next_key, _)) = self.buckets[shift_from_index].as_ref() else {
                break;
            };
            if self.probe_length(*next_key, shift_from_index) == 0 {
                break;
            }
            self.buckets[shift_to_index] = self.buckets[shift_from_index].take();
            shift_to_index = shift_from_index;
        }
        Some(value)
    }

    fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (&u64, &NodeHandle)> {
        self.buckets
            .iter()
            .filter_map(Option::as_ref)
            .map(|(key, value)| (key, value.as_ref()))
    }

    fn values(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &NodeHandle> {
        self.iter().map(|(_, value)| value)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::css::style::pipeline::allocation_count::count_allocations;
    use crate::web_audio::audio_param_timeline::AudioParamTimeline;
    use crate::web_audio::control_message::*;
    use crate::web_audio::control_message_queue::ControlMessageQueue;
    use crate::web_audio::rendering::node_message::{NodeMessage, StartSource, StopSource};
    use crate::web_audio::rendering::render_node::{
        AutomationRate, ChannelCountMode, ChannelInterpretation, OutgoingNodeConnection, OutgoingParamConnection,
        RenderAudioParam,
    };
    use crate::web_audio::rendering::render_nodes::{
        create_channel_merger_render_node, create_constant_source_render_node, create_destination_render_node,
        create_gain_render_node,
    };
    use std::sync::Arc;

    #[test]
    fn control_queue_rendering_and_ended_node_retirement() {
        let timeline = Arc::new(AudioParamTimeline::new(0.75));
        let param = Arc::new(RenderAudioParam::new(timeline, -1., 1., AutomationRate::ARate, 4));
        let queue = ControlMessageQueue::default();
        queue.enqueue(ControlMessage::SetChannelConfig(SetChannelConfig {
            node_id: 1,
            channel_count: 42,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Explicit,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Discrete,
        }));
        for id in [1, 3] {
            let node = create_constant_source_render_node(id, 4, Arc::clone(&param));
            queue.enqueue(ControlMessage::AddNode(AddNode { node }));
            queue.enqueue(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::StartSource(StartSource {
                node_id: id,
                when: 1. / 48000.,
            })));
            queue.enqueue(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::StopSource(StopSource {
                node_id: id,
                when: 3. / 48000.,
            })));
        }
        let destination = create_destination_render_node(2, 4, 2);
        queue.enqueue(ControlMessage::AddNode(AddNode { node: destination }));
        queue.enqueue(ControlMessage::ReplaceConnections(ReplaceConnections {
            source: 1,
            node_connections: vec![OutgoingNodeConnection {
                destination: 2,
                output_index: 0,
                input_index: 0,
            }],
            param_connections: Vec::new(),
        }));
        let mut graph = RenderGraph::default();
        graph.set_destination(2);
        graph.apply_control_messages(queue.drain());
        assert!(queue.drain().is_empty());
        assert_eq!(graph.node(1).unwrap().data().channel_count.get(), 2);
        assert_eq!(Arc::strong_count(&param), 3);
        let mut context = RenderContext {
            sample_rate: 48000.,
            quantum_size: 4,
            quantum_start_frame: 0,
        };
        graph.render_quantum(&context);
        let bus = unsafe { &*graph.destination().unwrap().data().output(0) };
        assert_eq!(bus.channel(0), &[0., 0.75, 0.75, 0.]);
        assert_eq!(bus.channel(1), &[0., 0.75, 0.75, 0.]);
        let mut ended = graph.take_ended_nodes();
        ended.sort();
        assert_eq!(ended, [1, 3]);
        assert_eq!(Arc::strong_count(&param), 1);
        context.quantum_start_frame = 4;
        graph.render_quantum(&context);
        assert!(unsafe { &*graph.destination().unwrap().data().output(0) }.is_silent());
        assert!(graph.take_ended_nodes().is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn connected_params_and_bus_layout_changes_do_not_allocate_during_processing() {
        let context = RenderContext {
            sample_rate: 48000.,
            quantum_size: 4,
            quantum_start_frame: 0,
        };
        let source_param = Arc::new(RenderAudioParam::new(
            Arc::new(AudioParamTimeline::new(0.5)),
            -1.,
            1.,
            AutomationRate::ARate,
            context.quantum_size,
        ));
        let gain_param = Arc::new(RenderAudioParam::new(
            Arc::new(AudioParamTimeline::new(1.)),
            f32::MIN,
            f32::MAX,
            AutomationRate::ARate,
            context.quantum_size,
        ));
        let mut graph = RenderGraph::default();
        graph.set_destination(3);
        graph.apply_control_messages(vec![
            ControlMessage::AddNode(AddNode {
                node: create_constant_source_render_node(1, context.quantum_size, source_param),
            }),
            ControlMessage::AddNode(AddNode {
                node: create_channel_merger_render_node(2, context.quantum_size, 6),
            }),
            ControlMessage::AddNode(AddNode {
                node: create_gain_render_node(3, context.quantum_size, Arc::clone(&gain_param)),
            }),
            ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::StartSource(StartSource { node_id: 1, when: 0. })),
        ]);
        for channel_count in [1, 6, 1, 6] {
            let input = if channel_count == 1 { 3 } else { 2 };
            graph.apply_control_messages(vec![
                ControlMessage::ReplaceConnections(ReplaceConnections {
                    source: 1,
                    node_connections: vec![OutgoingNodeConnection {
                        destination: input,
                        output_index: 0,
                        input_index: 0,
                    }],
                    param_connections: vec![OutgoingParamConnection {
                        destination: Arc::clone(&gain_param),
                        output_index: 0,
                    }],
                }),
                ControlMessage::ReplaceConnections(ReplaceConnections {
                    source: 2,
                    node_connections: if channel_count == 1 {
                        Vec::new()
                    } else {
                        vec![OutgoingNodeConnection {
                            destination: 3,
                            output_index: 0,
                            input_index: 0,
                        }]
                    },
                    param_connections: Vec::new(),
                }),
            ]);
            // Apply topology changes before counting DSP allocations.
            unsafe { graph.rebuild_incoming_connections() };
            graph.incoming_connections_dirty.set(false);
            let (_, allocations) = count_allocations(|| graph.render_quantum(&context));
            assert_eq!(allocations.everywhere, 0);
            let output = unsafe { &*graph.destination().unwrap().data().output(0) };
            assert_eq!(output.channel_count(), channel_count);
            assert_eq!(output.channel(0), &[0.75; 4]);
        }
    }
}

use std::cell::UnsafeCell;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU8, Ordering};

use super::audio_bus::AudioBus;
use crate::web_audio::{MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS, audio_param_timeline::AudioParamTimeline};

// State for a single render quantum that is passed to every node being processed.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct RenderContext {
    pub sample_rate: f64,
    pub quantum_size: usize,
    pub quantum_start_frame: u64,
}

impl RenderContext {
    pub fn quantum_start_time(&self) -> f64 {
        self.quantum_start_frame as f64 / self.sample_rate
    }

    pub fn sample_period(&self) -> f64 {
        1. / self.sample_rate
    }

    pub fn frame_time(&self, frame: usize) -> f64 {
        (self.quantum_start_frame + frame as u64) as f64 / self.sample_rate
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum AutomationRate {
    ARate,
    KRate,
}

struct Input {
    source: u64,
    output_index: usize,
}

struct RenderAudioParamState {
    inputs: Vec<Input>,
    input_scratch: AudioBus,
}

// The rendering thread's view of an AudioParam. The automation timeline is shared with the AudioParam on the control
// thread; input connections are only manipulated by the rendering thread.
// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#computedvalue
pub struct RenderAudioParam {
    timeline: Arc<AudioParamTimeline>,
    min_value: f32,
    max_value: f32,
    automation_rate: AtomicU8,
    state: UnsafeCell<RenderAudioParamState>,
}

// SAFETY: Only the rendering thread accesses state, and other threads use only the atomic automation rate.
unsafe impl Send for RenderAudioParam {}
unsafe impl Sync for RenderAudioParam {}

impl RenderAudioParam {
    pub fn new(
        timeline: Arc<AudioParamTimeline>,
        min_value: f32,
        max_value: f32,
        automation_rate: AutomationRate,
        quantum_size: usize,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            timeline,
            min_value,
            max_value,
            automation_rate: AtomicU8::new(automation_rate as u8),
            state: UnsafeCell::new(RenderAudioParamState {
                inputs: Vec::new(),
                input_scratch: AudioBus::new(1, quantum_size),
            }),
        }
    }

    pub fn set_automation_rate(&self, automation_rate: AutomationRate) {
        self.automation_rate.store(automation_rate as u8, Ordering::SeqCst);
    }

    pub(super) fn automation_rate(&self) -> AutomationRate {
        if self.automation_rate.load(Ordering::SeqCst) == AutomationRate::ARate as u8 {
            AutomationRate::ARate
        } else {
            AutomationRate::KRate
        }
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#computation-of-value
    pub(crate) unsafe fn compute(&self, graph: &dyn OutputGraph, context: &RenderContext, output: &mut [f32]) {
        let state = self.state.get();

        // 1. paramIntrinsicValue will be calculated at each time, which is either the value set directly to the value
        //    attribute, or, if there are any automation events with times before or at this time, the value as calculated
        //    from these events. If automation events are removed from a given time range, then the paramIntrinsicValue
        //    value will remain unchanged and stay at its previous value until either the value attribute is directly
        //    set, or automation events are added for the time range.
        // NB: A k-rate parameter uses the first sample frame for the entire quantum.
        let rate = self.automation_rate();
        if rate == AutomationRate::KRate {
            self.timeline.sample(context.quantum_start_time(), 0., &mut output[..1]);
            let value = output[0];
            output.fill(value);
        } else {
            self.timeline
                .sample(context.quantum_start_time(), context.sample_period(), output);
        }

        // 2. Set [[current value]] to the value of paramIntrinsicValue at the beginning of this render quantum.
        // NB: Sampling updates the slot for the snapshot it rendered.

        // 3. paramComputedValue is the sum of the paramIntrinsicValue value and the value of the input AudioParam
        //    buffer. If the sum is NaN, replace the sum with the defaultValue.
        for input in unsafe { &(*state).inputs } {
            let bus = graph.pull_output(input.source, input.output_index, context);
            let Some(bus) = (unsafe { bus.as_ref() }) else {
                continue;
            };

            // The AudioParam will take the rendered audio data from any AudioNode output connected to it and convert it to
            // mono by down-mixing if it is not already mono.
            let input_scratch = unsafe { &mut (*state).input_scratch };
            input_scratch.zero();
            input_scratch.sum_from(bus, true);

            let input_samples = input_scratch.channel(0);
            if rate == AutomationRate::KRate {
                for value in output.iter_mut() {
                    *value += input_samples[0];
                }
            } else {
                for frame in 0..output.len() {
                    output[frame] += input_samples[frame];
                }
            }
        }
        let default_value = self.timeline.default_value();
        for value in output.iter_mut() {
            if value.is_nan() {
                *value = default_value;
            }
        }

        // 4. If this AudioParam is a compound parameter, compute its final value with other AudioParams.
        // NB: None of the AudioParams backed by a render node are compound parameters.

        // 5. Set computedValue to paramComputedValue.

        // NB: The computedValue is clamped to the simple nominal range for this parameter.
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#simple-nominal-range
        for value in output {
            assert!(self.max_value >= self.min_value);
            *value = if *value > self.max_value {
                self.max_value
            } else if *value < self.min_value {
                self.min_value
            } else {
                *value
            };
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum ChannelCountMode {
    Max,
    ClampedMax,
    Explicit,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum ChannelInterpretation {
    Speakers,
    Discrete,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct Connection {
    pub source: u64,
    pub output_index: usize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct OutgoingNodeConnection {
    pub destination: u64,
    pub output_index: usize,
    pub input_index: usize,
}

pub struct OutgoingParamConnection {
    pub destination: Arc<RenderAudioParam>,
    pub output_index: usize,
}

pub struct RenderNodeData {
    pub node_id: u64,
    pub channel_count: std::cell::Cell<usize>,
    pub channel_count_mode: std::cell::Cell<ChannelCountMode>,
    pub channel_interpretation: std::cell::Cell<ChannelInterpretation>,
    pub input_connections: UnsafeCell<Vec<Vec<Connection>>>,
    input_buses: UnsafeCell<Vec<AudioBus>>,
    outputs: UnsafeCell<Vec<AudioBus>>,
    pub outgoing_node_connections: UnsafeCell<Vec<OutgoingNodeConnection>>,
    pub outgoing_param_connections: UnsafeCell<Vec<OutgoingParamConnection>>,

    // Bookkeeping used by RenderGraph to process every node at most once per render quantum.
    pub processed_quantum: std::cell::Cell<u64>,
    pub is_processing: std::cell::Cell<bool>,
}

// SAFETY: Render-node data is transferred to one rendering thread before it is accessed.
unsafe impl Send for RenderNodeData {}
impl RenderNodeData {
    pub fn new(
        node_id: u64,
        input_count: usize,
        output_count: usize,
        quantum_size: usize,
        output_channel_count: usize,
    ) -> Self {
        let input_connections = (0..input_count).map(|_| Vec::new()).collect();
        let mut input_buses = Vec::with_capacity(input_count);
        for _input_index in 0..input_count {
            let mut bus = AudioBus::new(1, quantum_size);
            bus.reserve_channels(MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS);
            input_buses.push(bus);
        }
        let mut outputs = Vec::with_capacity(output_count);
        for _output_index in 0..output_count {
            outputs.push(AudioBus::new(output_channel_count, quantum_size));
        }
        Self {
            node_id,
            channel_count: std::cell::Cell::new(2),
            channel_count_mode: std::cell::Cell::new(ChannelCountMode::Max),
            channel_interpretation: std::cell::Cell::new(ChannelInterpretation::Speakers),
            input_connections: UnsafeCell::new(input_connections),
            input_buses: UnsafeCell::new(input_buses),
            outputs: UnsafeCell::new(outputs),
            outgoing_node_connections: UnsafeCell::new(Vec::new()),
            outgoing_param_connections: UnsafeCell::new(Vec::new()),
            processed_quantum: std::cell::Cell::new(u64::MAX),
            is_processing: std::cell::Cell::new(false),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn reserve_output_channels(&mut self, output: usize, channel_capacity: usize) {
        self.outputs.get_mut()[output].reserve_channels(channel_capacity);
    }

    pub fn input_count(&self) -> usize {
        unsafe { &*self.input_connections.get() }.len()
    }

    pub fn output_count(&self) -> usize {
        unsafe { &*self.outputs.get() }.len()
    }

    pub(crate) unsafe fn output(&self, index: usize) -> *mut AudioBus {
        let outputs = self.outputs.get();
        assert!(index < unsafe { &*outputs }.len());
        unsafe { (*outputs).as_mut_ptr().add(index) }
    }

    pub(crate) unsafe fn set_outgoing_connections(
        &self,
        node_connections: Vec<OutgoingNodeConnection>,
        param_connections: Vec<OutgoingParamConnection>,
    ) {
        unsafe {
            *self.outgoing_node_connections.get() = node_connections;
            *self.outgoing_param_connections.get() = param_connections;
        }
    }

    // Pulls and mixes all connections to the given input into a single bus with the input's computed number of channels.
    // Unconnected inputs are mixed as a single channel of silence.
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#computednumberofchannels
    pub(crate) unsafe fn pull_input(
        &self,
        graph: &super::render_graph::RenderGraph,
        context: &RenderContext,
        input_index: usize,
    ) -> *const AudioBus {
        let connections = &unsafe { &*self.input_connections.get() }[input_index];
        let input_bus = unsafe { (*self.input_buses.get()).as_mut_ptr().add(input_index) };
        let mut maximum_source_channels = 0;
        for connection in connections {
            let bus = graph.pull_output(connection.source, connection.output_index, context);
            if let Some(bus) = unsafe { bus.as_ref() } {
                maximum_source_channels = maximum_source_channels.max(bus.channel_count());
            }
        }

        // AD-HOC: Treat a zero-channel ScriptProcessorNode buffer as a disconnected input.
        if maximum_source_channels == 0 {
            unsafe {
                (&mut *input_bus).set_channel_count(1);
                (&mut *input_bus).zero();
            }
            return input_bus;
        }

        let computed_number_of_channels = match self.channel_count_mode.get() {
            // "max": computedNumberOfChannels is the maximum of the number of channels of all connections to an input.
            //        In this mode channelCount is ignored.
            ChannelCountMode::Max => maximum_source_channels,
            // "clamped-max": computedNumberOfChannels is determined as for "max" and then clamped to a maximum value of
            //                the given channelCount.
            ChannelCountMode::ClampedMax => maximum_source_channels.min(self.channel_count.get()),
            // "explicit": computedNumberOfChannels is the exact value as specified by the channelCount.
            ChannelCountMode::Explicit => self.channel_count.get(),
        };
        let input_bus_mut = unsafe { &mut *input_bus };
        input_bus_mut.set_channel_count(computed_number_of_channels);
        input_bus_mut.zero();

        // The first pass already processed every dependency, including any re-entrant pulls.
        let speakers = self.channel_interpretation.get() == ChannelInterpretation::Speakers;
        for connection in connections {
            let bus = graph.pull_output(connection.source, connection.output_index, context);
            if let Some(bus) = unsafe { bus.as_ref() } {
                input_bus_mut.sum_from(bus, speakers);
            }
        }
        input_bus
    }
}

// Base class for the rendering thread's counterparts of AudioNodes. Render nodes are constructed on the control thread
// and transferred to the rendering thread through the control message queue; after that, all access happens on the
// rendering thread.
pub(crate) trait RenderNode: Send {
    fn data(&self) -> &RenderNodeData;

    unsafe fn process(&self, graph: &super::render_graph::RenderGraph, context: &RenderContext);

    unsafe fn handle_message(&self, _message: &super::node_message::NodeMessage) {}
    fn for_each_param(&self, _callback: &mut dyn FnMut(&RenderAudioParam)) {}

    // Returns true exactly once after this node has stopped playing, so the main thread can fire an ended event.
    unsafe fn take_ended_notification(&self) -> bool {
        false
    }

    // Whether this node may still produce output for input it has already received: the tail of a node whose tail-time
    // is yes. Such a node keeps playing after its AudioNode is gone, until the tail has played out.
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#tail-time
    unsafe fn has_tail_remaining(&self) -> bool {
        false
    }
}

pub struct NodeHandle {
    pub(crate) node: Box<dyn RenderNode>,
}

impl NodeHandle {
    pub fn data(&self) -> &RenderNodeData {
        self.node.data()
    }
}

pub(crate) trait OutputGraph {
    fn pull_output(&self, source: u64, output_index: usize, context: &RenderContext) -> *const AudioBus;
}

impl OutputGraph for super::render_graph::RenderGraph {
    fn pull_output(&self, source: u64, output_index: usize, context: &RenderContext) -> *const AudioBus {
        self.pull_output(source, output_index, context)
    }
}

impl RenderAudioParam {
    pub(crate) unsafe fn clear_inputs(&self) {
        unsafe { &mut (*self.state.get()).inputs }.clear();
    }

    pub(crate) unsafe fn add_input(&self, source: u64, output_index: usize) {
        unsafe { &mut (*self.state.get()).inputs }.push(Input { source, output_index });
    }
}

#![allow(
    clippy::needless_range_loop,
    clippy::manual_memcpy,
    clippy::mut_from_ref,
    clippy::needless_late_init,
    clippy::neg_cmp_op_on_partial_ord

use std::cell::UnsafeCell;
use std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};

use ak::math;

use super::audio_bus::AudioBus;
use super::biquad_coefficients::{BiquadFilterType, compute_biquad_coefficients};
use super::convolver_kernel::ConvolverKernel;
use super::fft::{FFT, FFTDirection};
