FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/SRI/IntegrityPolicy.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2025, Luke Wilde <luke@ladybird.org>
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibWeb/HTML/PolicyContainers.h>
#include <LibWeb/SRI/IntegrityPolicy.h>
#include <LibWeb/SRI/SRI.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Fetch/Infrastructure/URL.h>

namespace Web::SRI {

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#should-request-be-blocked-by-integrity-policy
ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result should_request_be_blocked_by_integrity_policy(NonnullRefPtr<Fetch::Infrastructure::Request> request)
{
    VERIFY(request->policy_container().has<NonnullRefPtr<HTML::PolicyContainer const>>());

    // 1. Let policyContainer be request’s policy container.
    auto const& policy_container = request->policy_container().get<NonnullRefPtr<HTML::PolicyContainer const>>();

    // 2. Let parsedMetadata be the result of calling parse metadata with request’s integrity metadata.
    auto parsed_metadata = MUST(parse_metadata(request->integrity_metadata().utf16_view()));

    // 3. If parsedMetadata is not the empty set and request’s mode is either "cors" or "same-origin", return "Allowed".
    if (!parsed_metadata.is_empty() && (request->mode() == Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::Mode::CORS || request->mode() == Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::Mode::SameOrigin))
        return ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result::Allowed;

    // 4. If request’s url is local, return "Allowed".
    if (Fetch::Infrastructure::is_local_url(request->url()))
        return ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result::Allowed;

    // 5. Let policy be policyContainer’s integrity policy.
    auto const& policy = policy_container->integrity_policy;

    // 6. Let reportPolicy be policyContainer’s report only integrity policy.
    auto const& report_policy = policy_container->report_only_integrity_policy;

    // 7. If both policy and reportPolicy are empty integrity policys, return "Allowed".
    if (policy.is_empty() && report_policy.is_empty())
        return ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result::Allowed;

    // 8. Let global be request’s client’s global object.
    auto global_kind = request->client_snapshot()->global_kind;

    // 9. If global is not a Window nor a WorkerGlobalScope, return "Allowed".
    if (global_kind != Fetch::Infrastructure::ClientContextSnapshot::GlobalKind::Window && global_kind != Fetch::Infrastructure::ClientContextSnapshot::GlobalKind::Worker)
        return ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result::Allowed;

    // 10. Let block be a boolean, initially false.
    bool block = false;

    // FIXME: 11. Let reportBlock be a boolean, initially false.
    [[maybe_unused]] auto report_block = false;

    // 12. If policy’s sources contains "inline" and policy’s blocked destinations contains request’s destination, set block to true.
    if (policy.sources.contains_slow(u"inline"sv)
        && request->destination().has_value()
        && policy.blocked_destinations.contains_slow(request->destination().value()))
        block = true;

    // 13. If reportPolicy’s sources contains "inline" and reportPolicy’s blocked destinations contains request’s destination, set reportBlock to true.
    if (report_policy.sources.contains_slow(u"inline"sv)
        && request->destination().has_value()
        && report_policy.blocked_destinations.contains_slow(request->destination().value()))
        report_block = true;

    // FIXME: 14. If block is true or reportBlock is true, then report violation with request, block, reportBlock, policy and reportPolicy.

    // 15. If block is true, then return "Blocked"; otherwise "Allowed".
    return block ? ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result::Blocked : ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result::Allowed;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>
#include <LibWeb/ContentSecurityPolicy/Directives/Directive.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Requests.h>

namespace Web::SRI {

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#integrity-policy
struct IntegrityPolicy {
    Vector<Utf16String> sources;
    Vector<Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::Destination> blocked_destinations;
    Vector<Utf16String> endpoints;

    bool is_empty() const { return sources.is_empty() && blocked_destinations.is_empty() && endpoints.is_empty(); }
};

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#should-request-be-blocked-by-integrity-policy
ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::Result should_request_be_blocked_by_integrity_policy(NonnullRefPtr<Fetch::Infrastructure::Request>);

}

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Base64.h>
#include <AK/CharacterTypes.h>
#include <AK/Find.h>
#include <AK/GenericLexer.h>
#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCrypto/Hash/Hash.h>
#include <LibWeb/SRI/SRI.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Infra/CharacterTypes.h>

namespace Web::SRI {

constexpr Array supported_hash_functions {
    // These are sorted by strength, low to high.
    // NOTE: We are specifically told to refuse MD5 and SHA1.
    //       https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#hash-functions
    "sha256"sv,
    "sha384"sv,
    "sha512"sv,
};

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#valid-sri-hash-algorithm-token
static bool is_valid_sri_hash_algorithm_token(Utf16View string)
{
    // A string is a valid SRI hash algorithm token if its ASCII lowercase is contained in the valid SRI hash algorithm
    // token set.
    for (auto supported_hash_function : supported_hash_functions) {
        if (string.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(supported_hash_function))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#getprioritizedhashfunction
static StringView get_prioritized_hash_function(StringView a, StringView b)
{
    if (a == b)
        return ""sv;

    auto a_priority = supported_hash_functions.first_index_of(a).value();
    auto b_priority = supported_hash_functions.first_index_of(b).value();
    if (a_priority > b_priority)
        return a;
    return b;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#apply-algorithm-to-response
ErrorOr<String> apply_algorithm_to_bytes(StringView algorithm, ByteBuffer const& bytes)
{
    auto hash_kind = [&] {
        if (algorithm == "sha256"sv)
            return Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256;
        if (algorithm == "sha384"sv)
            return Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA384;
        if (algorithm == "sha512"sv)
            return Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA512;
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }();

    // 1. Let result be the result of applying algorithm to bytes.
    auto result = Crypto::Hash::digest(hash_kind, bytes);

    // 2. Return the result of base64 encoding result.
    return encode_base64(result.bytes());
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#parse-metadata
ErrorOr<Vector<Metadata>> parse_metadata(Utf16View metadata)
{
    // 1. Let result be the empty set.
    Vector<Metadata> result;

    // 2. For each item returned by splitting metadata on spaces:
    // AD-HOC: "spaces" is undefined, so split on ASCII whitespace.
    //         https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-subresource-integrity/issues/84
    Utf16GenericLexer lexer { metadata };
    while (!lexer.is_eof()) {
        lexer.ignore_while(Infra::is_ascii_whitespace);
        auto item = lexer.consume_until(Infra::is_ascii_whitespace);
        if (item.is_empty())
            continue;

        // 1. Let expression-and-options be the result of splitting item on U+003F (?).
        // 2. Let algorithm-expression be expression-and-options[0].
        auto algorithm_expression = item.substring_view(0, item.find_code_unit_offset(u'?').value_or(item.length_in_code_units()));

        // 3. Let base64-value be the empty string.
        Utf16View base64_value;

        // 4. Let algorithm-and-value be the result of splitting algorithm-expression on U+002D (-).
        // 5. Let algorithm be algorithm-and-value[0].
        auto separator = algorithm_expression.find_code_unit_offset(u'-');
        auto algorithm = algorithm_expression.substring_view(0, separator.value_or(algorithm_expression.length_in_code_units()));

        // 6. If algorithm is not a valid SRI hash algorithm token, then continue.
        if (!is_valid_sri_hash_algorithm_token(algorithm))
            continue;

        // 7. If algorithm-and-value[1] exists, set base64-value to algorithm-and-value[1].
        // INTEROP: A base64url-encoded value contains "-" itself, so like other engines, take everything after the
        //          first "-" as the value.
        if (separator.has_value())
            base64_value = algorithm_expression.substring_view(*separator + 1);

        // NB: Integrity metadata uses CSP's base64-value grammar: at least one alphabet character and at most two
        //     trailing padding characters. https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#grammardef-base64-value
        // INTEROP: Firefox validates this grammar; Chromium only checks for an empty digest or invalid alphabet characters.
        auto base64_data = base64_value;
        for (size_t padding = 0; padding < 2 && base64_data.ends_with(u'='); ++padding)
            base64_data = base64_data.substring_view(0, base64_data.length_in_code_units() - 1);
        if (base64_data.is_empty() || !all_of(base64_data, [](u32 character) {
                return is_ascii_alphanumeric(character) || character == '+' || character == '/' || character == '-'
                    || character == '_';
            }))
            continue;

        // 8. Let metadata be the ordered map «["alg" → algorithm, "val" → base64-value]».
        //    Note: Since no options are defined (see the §3.1 Integrity metadata), a corresponding entry is not set in metadata.
        //    If options are defined in a future version, expression-and-options[1] can be utilized as options.
        // AD-HOC: Store algorithm in ASCII lowercase, since later steps look it up in the valid SRI hash algorithm token
        //         set, which only contains lowercase tokens.
        auto metadata = Metadata {
            .algorithm = algorithm.to_ascii_lowercase().to_utf8(),
            .base64_value = TRY(base64_value.to_utf8()),
            .options = {},
        };

        // 9. Append metadata to result.
        TRY(result.try_append(move(metadata)));
    }

    // 3. Return result.
    return result;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#get-the-strongest-metadata
ErrorOr<Vector<Metadata>> get_strongest_metadata_from_set(Vector<Metadata> const& set)
{
    // 1. Let result be the empty set and strongest be the empty string.
    Vector<Metadata> result;
    Optional<Metadata> strongest;

    // 2. For each item in set:
    for (auto const& item : set) {
        // 1. If result is the empty set, add item to result and set strongest to item, skip to the next item.
        if (result.is_empty()) {
            TRY(result.try_append(item));
            strongest = item;
            continue;
        }

        // 2. Let currentAlgorithm be the alg component of strongest.
        auto& current_algorithm = strongest->algorithm;

        // 3. Let newAlgorithm be the alg component of item.
        auto& new_algorithm = item.algorithm;

        // 4. If the result of getPrioritizedHashFunction(currentAlgorithm, newAlgorithm) is the empty string, add item to result.
        auto prioritized_hash_function = get_prioritized_hash_function(current_algorithm, new_algorithm);
        if (prioritized_hash_function.is_empty()) {
            TRY(result.try_append(item));
        }
        //    If the result is newAlgorithm, set strongest to item, set result to the empty set, and add item to result.
        else if (prioritized_hash_function == new_algorithm) {
            strongest = item;
            result.clear_with_capacity();
            TRY(result.try_append(item));
        }
    }

    // 3. Return result.
    return result;
}

// Converts a base64 or base64url-encoded value to base64 without padding, so values in either encoding compare equal.
static String normalize_base64_value(StringView value)
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    for (auto character : value.trim("="sv, TrimMode::Right)) {
        if (character == '-')
            builder.append('+');
        else if (character == '_')
            builder.append('/');
        else
            builder.append(character);
    }
    return builder.to_string_without_validation();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#does-response-match-metadatalist
ErrorOr<bool> do_bytes_match_metadata_list(ByteBuffer const& bytes, Utf16View metadata_list)
{
    // 1. Let parsedMetadata be the result of parsing metadataList.
    auto parsed_metadata = TRY(parse_metadata(metadata_list));

    // 2. If parsedMetadata is empty set, return true.
    if (parsed_metadata.is_empty())
        return true;

    // 3. Let metadata be the result of getting the strongest metadata from parsedMetadata.
    auto metadata = TRY(get_strongest_metadata_from_set(parsed_metadata));

    // 4. For each item in metadata:
    for (auto const& item : metadata) {
        // 1. Let algorithm be the item["alg"].
        auto& algorithm = item.algorithm;

        // 2. Let expectedValue be the item["val"].
        auto& expected_value = item.base64_value;

        // 3. Let actualValue be the result of applying algorithm to bytes.
        auto actual_value = TRY(apply_algorithm_to_bytes(algorithm, bytes));

        // 4. If actualValue is a case-sensitive match for expectedValue, return true.
        // INTEROP: Other engines also accept an expectedValue that is base64url-encoded or that lacks its padding.
        if (normalize_base64_value(actual_value) == normalize_base64_value(expected_value))
            return true;
    }

    // 5. Return false.
    return false;
}

}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#integrity-metadata
struct Metadata {

    String base64_value; // "val"
    String options {};   // "opt"

#include <LibJS/HostClassBuilder.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/MainThreadVM.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/Environments.h>
#include <LibWeb/StorageAPI/StorageAreaMirrorClient.h>

namespace Web::StorageAPI {

extern "C" {

// Defined in Bindings/Rust/src/storage_api/exports.rs.
void web_rust_storage_api_set_storage_area_mirror_client(StorageAreaMirrorClient*);
void web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_change(JSVM*, u64 id, FlatPtr key, FlatPtr old_value, FlatPtr new_value, ReadonlyBytes url);
void web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_acknowledge_write(u64 id);
void web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_refuse_write(JSVM*, u64 id, FlatPtr const* keys, FlatPtr const* values, size_t count);
void web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_reset(JSVM*, u64 id, FlatPtr const* keys, FlatPtr const* values, size_t count);

// Declared on the Rust side in Bindings/Rust/src/storage_api/exports.rs and storage_endpoint.rs.
void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_connect(StorageAreaMirrorClient*, u64 page_id, u8 endpoint_type, HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject*, void* ctx, void (*on_connection)(void*, bool has_id, u64 id, FlatPtr const* keys, FlatPtr const* values, size_t count, u64 usage));
void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_disconnect(StorageAreaMirrorClient*, u64 id);
void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_set_item(StorageAreaMirrorClient*, u64 id, FlatPtr key, FlatPtr value, ReadonlyBytes document_url);
void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_remove_item(StorageAreaMirrorClient*, u64 id, FlatPtr key, ReadonlyBytes document_url);
void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_clear(StorageAreaMirrorClient*, u64 id, ReadonlyBytes document_url);
void web_storage_api_for_each_registered_endpoint(void* ctx, void (*on_endpoint)(void*, u8 identifier, bool is_session, bool has_quota, u64 quota));
}

void set_storage_area_mirror_client(StorageAreaMirrorClient* client)
{
    web_rust_storage_api_set_storage_area_mirror_client(client);
}

static FlatPtr raw_or_zero(Optional<Utf16String> const& string)
{
    if (!string.has_value())
        return 0;
    return Utf16String { *string }.into_raw();
}

static Vector<FlatPtr> into_raw(Vector<Utf16String>&& strings)
{
    Vector<FlatPtr> raws;
    raws.ensure_capacity(strings.size());
    for (auto& string : strings)
        raws.unchecked_append(move(string).into_raw());
    return raws;
}

static JSVM* vm()
{
    return JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(Bindings::main_thread_vm());
}

void storage_area_did_change(StorageAreaId id, Optional<Utf16String> const& key, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& new_value, String const& url)
{
    web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_change(vm(), id.value(), raw_or_zero(key), raw_or_zero(old_value), raw_or_zero(new_value), url.bytes());
}

void storage_area_did_acknowledge_write(StorageAreaId id)
{
    web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_acknowledge_write(id.value());
}

void storage_area_did_refuse_write(StorageAreaId id, Vector<Utf16String> keys, Vector<Utf16String> values)
{
    VERIFY(keys.size() == values.size());
    auto raw_keys = into_raw(move(keys));
    auto raw_values = into_raw(move(values));
    web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_refuse_write(vm(), id.value(), raw_keys.data(), raw_values.data(), raw_keys.size());
}

void storage_area_did_reset(StorageAreaId id, Vector<Utf16String> keys, Vector<Utf16String> values)
{
    VERIFY(keys.size() == values.size());
    auto raw_keys = into_raw(move(keys));
    auto raw_values = into_raw(move(values));
    web_rust_storage_api_storage_area_did_reset(vm(), id.value(), raw_keys.data(), raw_values.data(), raw_keys.size());
}

void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_connect(StorageAreaMirrorClient* client, u64 page_id, u8 endpoint_type, HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject* environment, void* ctx, void (*on_connection)(void*, bool has_id, u64 id, FlatPtr const* keys, FlatPtr const* values, size_t count, u64 usage))
{
    auto connection = client->connect_to_storage_area(PageId { page_id }, static_cast<StorageEndpointType>(endpoint_type), environment->id);
    // The keys and the values cross with one count.
    VERIFY(connection.keys.size() == connection.values.size());
    auto keys = into_raw(move(connection.keys));
    auto values = into_raw(move(connection.values));
    on_connection(ctx, connection.id.has_value(), connection.id.has_value() ? connection.id->value() : 0, keys.data(), values.data(), keys.size(), connection.usage);
}

void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_disconnect(StorageAreaMirrorClient* client, u64 id)
{
    client->disconnect_from_storage_area(StorageAreaId { id });
}

void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_set_item(StorageAreaMirrorClient* client, u64 id, FlatPtr key, FlatPtr value, ReadonlyBytes document_url)
{
    client->set_storage_item(StorageAreaId { id }, Utf16String::from_raw(key), Utf16String::from_raw(value), MUST(String::from_utf8(document_url)));
}

void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_remove_item(StorageAreaMirrorClient* client, u64 id, FlatPtr key, ReadonlyBytes document_url)
{
    client->remove_storage_item(StorageAreaId { id }, Utf16String::from_raw(key), MUST(String::from_utf8(document_url)));
}

void web_storage_api_storage_area_mirror_client_clear(StorageAreaMirrorClient* client, u64 id, ReadonlyBytes document_url)
{
    client->clear_storage_area(StorageAreaId { id }, MUST(String::from_utf8(document_url)));
}

void web_storage_api_for_each_registered_endpoint(void* ctx, void (*on_endpoint)(void*, u8 identifier, bool is_session, bool has_quota, u64 quota))
{
    for (auto const& endpoint : StorageEndpoint::registered_endpoints())
        on_endpoint(ctx, to_underlying(endpoint.identifier), endpoint.type == StorageType::Session, endpoint.quota.has_value(), endpoint.quota.value_or(0));
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/HTML/Scripting/EnvironmentId.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/PageId.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/StorageAPI/StorageAreaId.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/StorageAPI/StorageEndpoint.h>

namespace Web::StorageAPI {

// What the process that owns the storage areas answers when this process connects to one: the area's id and
// everything the bottle holds. No id means the area couldn't be resolved, and the mirror stays detached.
struct StorageAreaConnection {
    Optional<StorageAreaId> id;
    Vector<Utf16String> keys;
    Vector<Utf16String> values;
    u64 usage { 0 };
};

// The process's one link to the storage areas' owner, for the mirrors of the storage bottles, which are implemented
// in Rust (Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/storage_api/storage_area_mirror.rs). WebContent connects it to the
// browser process; a process without one leaves every mirror detached.
class WEB_API StorageAreaMirrorClient {
public:
    virtual ~StorageAreaMirrorClient() = default;

    virtual StorageAreaConnection connect_to_storage_area(PageId, StorageEndpointType, HTML::EnvironmentId const&) = 0;
    virtual void disconnect_from_storage_area(StorageAreaId) = 0;
    virtual void set_storage_item(StorageAreaId, Utf16String const& key, Utf16String const& value, String const& document_url) = 0;
    virtual void remove_storage_item(StorageAreaId, Utf16String const& key, String const& document_url) = 0;
    virtual void clear_storage_area(StorageAreaId, String const& document_url) = 0;
};

WEB_API void set_storage_area_mirror_client(StorageAreaMirrorClient*);

// What the owner relays, found by area id. A change for an area this process no longer mirrors is dropped.
WEB_API void storage_area_did_change(StorageAreaId, Optional<Utf16String> const& key, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& new_value, String const& url);
WEB_API void storage_area_did_acknowledge_write(StorageAreaId);
WEB_API void storage_area_did_refuse_write(StorageAreaId, Vector<Utf16String> keys, Vector<Utf16String> values);
WEB_API void storage_area_did_reset(StorageAreaId, Vector<Utf16String> keys, Vector<Utf16String> values);

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/StorageAPI/StorageKey.cpp
/*

#include <LibURL/RustIntegration.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOMURL/DOMURL.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/Environments.h>
#include <LibWeb/StorageAPI/StorageKey.h>

namespace Web::StorageAPI {

// https://storage.spec.whatwg.org/#obtain-a-storage-key
Optional<StorageKey> obtain_a_storage_key(HTML::Environment const& environment)
{
    // 1. Let key be the result of running obtain a storage key for non-storage purposes with environment.
    auto key = obtain_a_storage_key_for_non_storage_purposes(environment);

    // 2-4. The rest is the same for every origin; see the overload taking one.
    return obtain_a_storage_key(key.origin);
}

// https://storage.spec.whatwg.org/#obtain-a-storage-key-for-non-storage-purposes
StorageKey obtain_a_storage_key_for_non_storage_purposes(HTML::Environment const& environment)
{
    // 1. Let origin be environment’s origin if environment is an environment settings object; otherwise environment’s creation URL’s origin.
    auto origin = [&]() {
        if (auto const* settings = as_if<HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject>(environment))
            return settings->origin();
        return environment.creation_url.origin();
    }();

    // 2. Return a tuple consisting of origin.
    return { move(origin) };
}

// Declared on the Rust side in Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/storage_api/storage_key.rs.
extern "C" {

bool web_storage_api_obtain_a_storage_key(HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject* environment, void* ctx, void (*on_origin)(void*, URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const*));
void web_storage_api_obtain_a_storage_key_for_non_storage_purposes(HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject* environment, void* ctx, void (*on_origin)(void*, URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const*));
}

bool web_storage_api_obtain_a_storage_key(HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject* environment, void* ctx, void (*on_origin)(void*, URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const*))
{
    auto storage_key = StorageAPI::obtain_a_storage_key(*environment);
    if (!storage_key.has_value())
        return false;
    URL::RustIntegration::lend_origin_to_ffi(storage_key->origin, [&](URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const& origin) {
        on_origin(ctx, &origin);
    });
    return true;
}

void web_storage_api_obtain_a_storage_key_for_non_storage_purposes(HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject* environment, void* ctx, void (*on_origin)(void*, URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const*))
{
    auto storage_key = StorageAPI::obtain_a_storage_key_for_non_storage_purposes(*environment);
    URL::RustIntegration::lend_origin_to_ffi(storage_key.origin, [&](URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const& origin) {
        on_origin(ctx, &origin);
    });
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/StorageAPI/StorageManager.idl
// https://storage.spec.whatwg.org/#storagemanager
[SecureContext, Exposed=(Window,Worker), ImplementedIn=Rust]
interface StorageManager {
    Promise<boolean> persisted();
    [Exposed=Window] Promise<boolean> persist();

    // FIXME: This should also be exposed to Workers
    [Exposed=Window] Promise<StorageEstimate> estimate();
};

// https://storage.spec.whatwg.org/#dictdef-storageestimate
dictionary StorageEstimate {
    unsigned long long usage;
    unsigned long long quota;
};

static JSVM* vm_abi()
{
    return JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the());
}

static JS::Realm& realm_of(void* realm)
{
    return *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
}

static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> exception_or_void(JSCompletion completion)
{
    auto result = JS::HostABI::completion_from_abi<JS::Value>(completion);
    if (result.is_error())
        return result.release_error();
    return {};
}

GC::Ref<ReadableStream> ReadableStream::create(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<ReadableStream*>(web_rust_readable_stream_create(vm_abi(), &realm)) };
}

void ReadableStream::set_up_with_byte_reading_support(JS::Realm& realm, GC::Ptr<PullAlgorithm> pull_algorithm, GC::Ptr<CancelAlgorithm> cancel_algorithm, double high_water_mark)
{
    web_rust_readable_stream_set_up_with_byte_reading_support(vm_abi(), &realm, this, pull_algorithm.ptr(), cancel_algorithm.ptr(), high_water_mark);
}

bool ReadableStream::is_readable_byte_stream() const
{
    return web_rust_readable_stream_is_readable_byte_stream(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this));
}

bool ReadableStream::is_readable() const
{
    return web_rust_readable_stream_state(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this)) == 0;
}

bool ReadableStream::is_closed() const
{
    return web_rust_readable_stream_state(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this)) == 1;
}

bool ReadableStream::is_errored() const
{
    return web_rust_readable_stream_state(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this)) == 2;
}

bool ReadableStream::is_locked() const
{
    return web_rust_readable_stream_is_locked(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this));
}

bool ReadableStream::is_disturbed() const
{
    return web_rust_readable_stream_is_disturbed(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this));
}

bool ReadableStream::close_requested() const
{
    return web_rust_readable_stream_close_requested(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this));
}

Optional<double> ReadableStream::desired_size() const
{
    double desired_size = 0;
    if (!web_rust_readable_stream_desired_size(const_cast<ReadableStream*>(this), &desired_size))
        return {};
    return desired_size;
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> ReadableStream::enqueue(JS::Value chunk)
{
    return exception_or_void(web_rust_readable_stream_enqueue(vm_abi(), this, JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(chunk)));
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> ReadableStream::enqueue_bytes(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    return exception_or_void(web_rust_readable_stream_enqueue_native_bytes(vm_abi(), this, bytes));
}

Optional<u64> ReadableStream::current_byob_request_view_byte_length()
{
    u64 byte_length = 0;
    if (!web_rust_readable_stream_current_byob_request_view_byte_length(vm_abi(), this, &byte_length))
        return {};
    return byte_length;
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> ReadableStream::pull_from_bytes(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    return exception_or_void(web_rust_readable_stream_pull_from_bytes(vm_abi(), this, bytes));
}

void ReadableStream::close()
{
    web_rust_readable_stream_close(vm_abi(), this);
}

void ReadableStream::error(JS::Value error)
{
    web_rust_readable_stream_error(vm_abi(), this, JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(error));
}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> ReadableStream::cancel(JS::Value reason)
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<WebIDL::Promise*>(web_rust_readable_stream_cancel(vm_abi(), this, JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(reason))) };
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<ReadableStreamPair> ReadableStream::tee()
{
    void* branch1 = nullptr;
    void* branch2 = nullptr;
    TRY(exception_or_void(web_rust_readable_stream_tee(vm_abi(), this, &branch1, &branch2)));
    return ReadableStreamPair { *static_cast<ReadableStream*>(branch1), *static_cast<ReadableStream*>(branch2) };
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>> ReadableStream::get_a_reader()
{
    void* reader = nullptr;
    TRY(exception_or_void(web_rust_readable_stream_get_a_reader(vm_abi(), this, &reader)));
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<ReadableStreamDefaultReader*>(reader) };
}

GC::Ref<ReadableStream> ReadableStream::piped_through(GC::Ref<TransformStream> transform, bool prevent_close, bool prevent_abort, bool prevent_cancel)
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<ReadableStream*>(web_rust_readable_stream_piped_through(vm_abi(), this, transform.ptr(), prevent_close, prevent_abort, prevent_cancel)) };
}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> ReadableStreamDefaultReader::read()
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<WebIDL::Promise*>(web_rust_readable_stream_default_reader_read(vm_abi(), this)) };
}

void ReadableStreamDefaultReader::read_a_chunk(ReadRequest& read_request)
{
    web_rust_readable_stream_default_reader_read_a_chunk(vm_abi(), this, &read_request);
}

void ReadableStreamDefaultReader::read_all_bytes(GC::Ref<SuccessSteps> success_steps, GC::Ref<FailureSteps> failure_steps)
{
    web_rust_readable_stream_default_reader_read_all_bytes(vm_abi(), this, success_steps.ptr(), failure_steps.ptr());
}

// FIXME: This function is a promise-based wrapper around "read all bytes". The spec changed this function to not use promises
//        in https://github.com/whatwg/streams/commit/f894acdd417926a2121710803cef593e15127964 - however, it seems that the
//        FileAPI blob specification has not been updated to match, see: https://github.com/w3c/FileAPI/issues/187.
GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> ReadableStreamDefaultReader::read_all_bytes_deprecated()
{
    auto& realm = closed_promise_realm();

    auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise(realm);

    auto success_steps = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(promise, realm), [](auto& promise, auto& realm, ByteBuffer bytes) {
        auto buffer = JS::ArrayBuffer::create(realm, move(bytes));
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(promise, buffer);
    });

    auto failure_steps = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(promise), [](auto& promise, JS::Value error) {
        WebIDL::reject_promise(promise, error);
    });

    read_all_bytes(success_steps, failure_steps);

    return promise;
}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> ReadableStreamDefaultReader::cancel(JS::Value reason)
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<WebIDL::Promise*>(web_rust_readable_stream_default_reader_cancel(vm_abi(), this, JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(reason))) };
}

JS::Realm& ReadableStreamDefaultReader::closed_promise_realm() const
{
    return realm_of(web_rust_readable_stream_default_reader_closed_promise_realm(const_cast<ReadableStreamDefaultReader*>(this)));
}

void* web_streams_call_promise_algorithm(GC::Function<GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise>()>* algorithm)
{
    return algorithm->function()().ptr();
}

void* web_streams_call_promise_algorithm_with_argument(GC::Function<GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise>(JS::Value)>* algorithm, JSValue argument)
{
    return algorithm->function()(JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(argument)).ptr();
}

void web_streams_read_request_chunk_steps(ReadRequest* read_request, JSValue chunk)
{
    read_request->on_chunk(JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(chunk));
}

void web_streams_read_request_close_steps(ReadRequest* read_request)
{
    read_request->on_close();
}

void web_streams_read_request_error_steps(ReadRequest* read_request, JSValue error)
{
    read_request->on_error(JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(error));
}

void web_streams_call_bytes_steps(ReadableStreamDefaultReader::SuccessSteps* steps, ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    steps->function()(MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(bytes)));
}

void web_streams_call_value_steps(ReadableStreamDefaultReader::FailureSteps* steps, JSValue value)
{
    steps->function()(JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(value));
}

void web_streams_complete_rendering_pending_stream(ReadableStream* stream)
{
    complete_rendering_pending_stream(*stream);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Forward.h>
#include <LibJS/Forward.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/ReadableStream.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/RustInterface.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>
#include <LibWeb/Streams/Algorithms.h>
#include <LibWeb/WebIDL/ExceptionOr.h>

namespace Web::Streams {

struct ReadableStreamPair {
    GC::Ref<ReadableStream> first;
    GC::Ref<ReadableStream> second;
};

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream
// The C++ side of a ReadableStream, which is implemented in Rust (Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/streams): what
// the specifications that LibWeb implements in C++ use to set up and read streams,
// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#other-specs-rs
class WEB_API ReadableStream : public Bindings::RustInterfaceCell {
    WEB_RUST_INTERFACE(ReadableStream, readable_stream)

public:
    // A new ReadableStream in the realm, which set_up_with_byte_reading_support() then sets up.
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<ReadableStream> create(JS::Realm&);

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-set-up-with-byte-reading-support
    void set_up_with_byte_reading_support(JS::Realm&, GC::Ptr<PullAlgorithm> = {}, GC::Ptr<CancelAlgorithm> = {}, double high_water_mark = 0);

    // Whether the stream's controller is a ReadableByteStreamController.
    bool is_readable_byte_stream() const;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-readable
    bool is_readable() const;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-closed
    bool is_closed() const;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-errored
    bool is_errored() const;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-locked
    bool is_locked() const;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#is-readable-stream-disturbed
    bool is_disturbed() const;

    // Whether the stream's controller has been asked to close.
    bool close_requested() const;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-get-the-desired-size
    Optional<double> desired_size() const;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-enqueue
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> enqueue(JS::Value chunk);

    // ReadableByteStreamControllerEnqueue on the stream's controller, a ReadableByteStreamController, with a chunk of
    // the bytes.
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> enqueue_bytes(ReadonlyBytes);

    // The byte length of https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-current-byob-request-view, if the stream,
    // which is set up with byte reading support, has one.
    Optional<u64> current_byob_request_view_byte_length();

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-pull-from-bytes
    // NB: The stream is set up with byte reading support, and the caller removes the pulled bytes from its own buffer,
    //     having sized them by the current BYOB request view.
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> pull_from_bytes(ReadonlyBytes);

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-close
    void close();

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-error
    void error(JS::Value);

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-cancel
    GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> cancel(JS::Value reason);

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-tee
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<ReadableStreamPair> tee();

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-get-a-reader
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>> get_a_reader();

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream-pipe-through
    GC::Ref<ReadableStream> piped_through(GC::Ref<TransformStream>, bool prevent_close = false, bool prevent_abort = false, bool prevent_cancel = false);
};

}

dictionary ReadableWritablePair {
    required ReadableStream readable;
    required WritableStream writable;
};

dictionary StreamPipeOptions {
    boolean preventClose = false;
    boolean preventAbort = false;
    boolean preventCancel = false;
    AbortSignal signal;
};

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#enumdef-readablestreamreadermode
enum ReadableStreamReaderMode { "byob" };

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#dictdef-readablestreamgetreaderoptions
dictionary ReadableStreamGetReaderOptions {
    ReadableStreamReaderMode mode;
};

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#dictdef-readablestreamiteratoroptions
dictionary ReadableStreamIteratorOptions {
    boolean preventCancel = false;
};

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestream
[Exposed=*, Transferable, DefinesAsyncIteratorReturn, ImplementedIn=Rust]
interface ReadableStream {
    constructor(optional object underlyingSource, optional QueuingStrategy strategy = {});

    // FIXME: asyncIterable should be a async_sequence<any>.
    [NeedsCallerRealm] static ReadableStream from(any asyncIterable);

    readonly attribute boolean locked;

    Promise<undefined> cancel(optional any reason);
    ReadableStreamReader getReader(optional ReadableStreamGetReaderOptions options = {});
    ReadableStream pipeThrough(ReadableWritablePair transform, optional StreamPipeOptions options = {});
    Promise<undefined> pipeTo(WritableStream destination, optional StreamPipeOptions options = {});
    sequence<ReadableStream> tee();

    async iterable<any>(optional ReadableStreamIteratorOptions options = {});
};

typedef (ReadableStreamDefaultReader or ReadableStreamBYOBReader) ReadableStreamReader;

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <LibGC/Function.h>
#include <LibJS/Heap/Cell.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Value.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/ReadableStreamDefaultReader.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/RustInterface.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>
#include <LibWeb/WebIDL/Promise.h>

namespace Web::Streams {

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#read-request
class WEB_API ReadRequest : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(ReadRequest, JS::Cell);

public:
    virtual ~ReadRequest() override = default;

    virtual void on_chunk(JS::Value chunk) = 0;
    virtual void on_close() = 0;
    virtual void on_error(JS::Value error) = 0;
};

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamdefaultreader
// The C++ side of a ReadableStreamDefaultReader, which is implemented in Rust (Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/streams):
// what the specifications that LibWeb implements in C++ use to read streams.
class WEB_API ReadableStreamDefaultReader : public Bindings::RustInterfaceCell {
    WEB_RUST_INTERFACE(ReadableStreamDefaultReader, readable_stream_default_reader)

public:
    using SuccessSteps = GC::Function<void(ByteBuffer)>;
    using FailureSteps = GC::Function<void(JS::Value error)>;

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-reader-read
    GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> read();

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamdefaultreader-read-a-chunk
    void read_a_chunk(ReadRequest&);

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamdefaultreader-read-all-bytes
    void read_all_bytes(GC::Ref<SuccessSteps>, GC::Ref<FailureSteps>);

    // FIXME: This function is a promise-based wrapper around "read all bytes". The spec changed this function to not use promises
    //        in https://github.com/whatwg/streams/commit/f894acdd417926a2121710803cef593e15127964 - however, it seems that the
    //        FileAPI blob specification has not been updated to match, see: https://github.com/w3c/FileAPI/issues/187.
    GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> read_all_bytes_deprecated();

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#generic-reader-cancel
    GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> cancel(JS::Value reason);

    // The realm of the reader's [[closedPromise]].
    JS::Realm& closed_promise_realm() const;
};

}

#include <LibJS/HostClassBuilder.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/VM.h>
#include <LibWeb/Streams/ReadableStream.h>
#include <LibWeb/Streams/TransformStream.h>
#include <LibWeb/Streams/WritableStream.h>

namespace Web::Streams {

extern "C" {

// Defined in Bindings/Rust/src/streams/exports.rs.
void* web_rust_transform_stream_create(JSVM*, void* realm);
void web_rust_transform_stream_set_up(JSVM*, void* realm, void* stream, TransformAlgorithm* transform_algorithm, FlushAlgorithm* flush_algorithm, CancelAlgorithm* cancel_algorithm);
JSCompletion web_rust_transform_stream_enqueue(JSVM*, void* stream, JSValue chunk);
void* web_rust_transform_stream_readable(void* stream);
void* web_rust_transform_stream_writable(void* stream);
}

GC::Ref<TransformStream> TransformStream::create(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<TransformStream*>(web_rust_transform_stream_create(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm)) };
}

void TransformStream::set_up(JS::Realm& realm, GC::Ref<TransformAlgorithm> transform_algorithm, GC::Ptr<FlushAlgorithm> flush_algorithm, GC::Ptr<CancelAlgorithm> cancel_algorithm)
{
    web_rust_transform_stream_set_up(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm, this, transform_algorithm.ptr(), flush_algorithm.ptr(), cancel_algorithm.ptr());
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> TransformStream::enqueue(JS::Value chunk)
{
    auto result = JS::HostABI::completion_from_abi<JS::Value>(web_rust_transform_stream_enqueue(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), this, JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(chunk)));
    if (result.is_error())
        return result.release_error();
    return {};
}

GC::Ref<ReadableStream> TransformStream::readable()
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<ReadableStream*>(web_rust_transform_stream_readable(this)) };
}

GC::Ref<WritableStream> TransformStream::writable()
{
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<WritableStream*>(web_rust_transform_stream_writable(this)) };
}

}

// the specifications that LibWeb implements in C++ use to set up transform streams,

    WEB_RUST_INTERFACE(TransformStream, transform_stream)

    void set_up(JS::Realm&, GC::Ref<TransformAlgorithm>, GC::Ptr<FlushAlgorithm> = {}, GC::Ptr<CancelAlgorithm> = {});

    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> enqueue(JS::Value chunk);

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-readable
    GC::Ref<ReadableStream> readable();

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-writable
    GC::Ref<WritableStream> writable();
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/SVG/AttributeParsing.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2020, Matthew Olsson <mattco@serenityos.org>
 * Copyright (c) 2022, Sam Atkins <atkinssj@serenityos.org>
 * Copyright (c) 2023, MacDue <macdue@dueutil.tech>
 * Copyright (c) 2024, Tim Ledbetter <timledbetter@gmail.com>
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Utf16View.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeParsing.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/ParserRustFFI.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

static RustFFI::FfiUtf16View ffi_svg_input(Utf16View input)
{
    return {
        .latin1 = input.has_latin1_storage() ? input.latin1_span().data() : nullptr,
        .utf16 = input.has_latin1_storage() ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<u16 const*>(input.utf16_span().data()),
        .length = input.length_in_code_units(),
    };
}

Optional<i32> parse_integer(Utf16View input)
{
    i32 value;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_integer(ffi_svg_input(input), &value))
        return {};
    return value;
}

Optional<float> parse_number(Utf16View input)
{
    float value;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_number(ffi_svg_input(input), &value))
        return {};
    return value;
}

Optional<NumberOptionalNumber> parse_number_optional_number(Utf16View input)
{
    float first;
    float second;
    bool has_second;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_number_optional_number(ffi_svg_input(input), &first, &second, &has_second))
        return {};
    return NumberOptionalNumber { first, has_second ? Optional<float> { second } : OptionalNone {} };
}

Optional<NumberPercentage> parse_number_percentage(Utf16View input)
{
    float value;
    bool is_percentage;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_number_percentage(ffi_svg_input(input), &value, &is_percentage))
        return {};
    return NumberPercentage { value, is_percentage };
}

Vector<Gfx::FloatPoint> parse_points(Utf16View input)
{
    Vector<Gfx::FloatPoint> points;
    RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_points(ffi_svg_input(input), &points, [](void* context, RustFFI::FfiSvgPoint const* data, size_t length) {
        auto& points = *static_cast<Vector<Gfx::FloatPoint>*>(context);
        points.ensure_capacity(length);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i)
            points.unchecked_append({ data[i].x, data[i].y });
    });
    return points;
}

Optional<Vector<Transform>> parse_transform(Utf16View input)
{
    Vector<Transform> transforms;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_transform(ffi_svg_input(input), &transforms, [](void* context, RustFFI::FfiSvgTransform const* data, size_t length) {
            auto& transforms = *static_cast<Vector<Transform>*>(context);
            transforms.ensure_capacity(length);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
                auto const& transform = data[i];
                switch (transform.kind) {
                case RustFFI::TRANSFORM_TRANSLATE:
                    transforms.unchecked_append({ Transform::Translate { transform.values[0], transform.values[1] } });
                    break;
                case RustFFI::TRANSFORM_SCALE:
                    transforms.unchecked_append({ Transform::Scale { transform.values[0], transform.values[1] } });
                    break;
                case RustFFI::TRANSFORM_ROTATE:
                    transforms.unchecked_append({ Transform::Rotate { transform.values[0], transform.values[1], transform.values[2] } });
                    break;
                case RustFFI::TRANSFORM_SKEW_X:
                    transforms.unchecked_append({ Transform::SkewX { transform.values[0] } });
                    break;
                case RustFFI::TRANSFORM_SKEW_Y:
                    transforms.unchecked_append({ Transform::SkewY { transform.values[0] } });
                    break;
                case RustFFI::TRANSFORM_MATRIX:
                    transforms.unchecked_append({ Transform::Matrix {
                        transform.values[0],
                        transform.values[1],
                        transform.values[2],
                        transform.values[3],
                        transform.values[4],
                        transform.values[5],
                    } });
                    break;
                default:
                    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
                }
            }
        })) {
        return {};
    }
    return transforms;
}

Optional<PreserveAspectRatio> parse_preserve_aspect_ratio(Utf16View input)
{
    u8 align;
    u8 meet_or_slice;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_preserve_aspect_ratio(ffi_svg_input(input), &align, &meet_or_slice))
        return {};
    VERIFY(align <= to_underlying(PreserveAspectRatio::Align::xMaxYMax));
    VERIFY(meet_or_slice <= to_underlying(PreserveAspectRatio::MeetOrSlice::Slice));
    return PreserveAspectRatio {
        static_cast<PreserveAspectRatio::Align>(align),
        static_cast<PreserveAspectRatio::MeetOrSlice>(meet_or_slice),
    };
}

Optional<SVGUnits> parse_units(Utf16View input)
{
    u8 value;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_units(ffi_svg_input(input), &value))
        return {};
    VERIFY(value <= to_underlying(SVGUnits::UserSpaceOnUse));
    return static_cast<SVGUnits>(value);
}

Vector<float> parse_table_values(Utf16View input)
{
    Vector<float> values;
    RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_table_values(ffi_svg_input(input), &values, [](void* context, float const* data, size_t length) {
        auto& values = *static_cast<Vector<float>*>(context);
        values.ensure_capacity(length);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i)
            values.unchecked_append(data[i]);
    });
    return values;
}

Optional<SpreadMethod> parse_spread_method(Utf16View input)
{
    u8 value;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_spread_method(ffi_svg_input(input), &value))
        return {};
    VERIFY(value <= to_underlying(SpreadMethod::Reflect));
    return static_cast<SpreadMethod>(value);
}

Optional<ViewBox> parse_viewbox(Utf16View input)
{
    double min_x;
    double min_y;
    double width;
    double height;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_view_box(ffi_svg_input(input), &min_x, &min_y, &width, &height))
        return {};
    return ViewBox { min_x, min_y, width, height };
}

Optional<double> parse_clock_value_in_milliseconds(Utf16View input)
{
    double value;
    if (!RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_clock_value_in_milliseconds(ffi_svg_input(input), &value))
        return {};
    return value;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

inline Utf16String decode_fragment_identifier(StringView fragment)
{
    return Utf16String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(URL::percent_decode(fragment), Utf16String::WithBOMHandling::No);
}

inline Utf16String decode_fragment_identifier(Utf16View fragment)
{
    if (!fragment.contains('%'))
        return Utf16String::from_utf16(fragment);
    if (fragment.has_ascii_storage())
        return decode_fragment_identifier(fragment.ascii_bytes());
    return decode_fragment_identifier(URL::percent_encode(fragment, URL::PercentEncodeSet::C0Control));
}

}

#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/LayoutRustFFI.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/ParserRustFFI.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/Path.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

static RustFFI::FfiUtf16View ffi_svg_input(Utf16View input)
{
    return {
        .latin1 = input.has_latin1_storage() ? input.latin1_span().data() : nullptr,
        .utf16 = input.has_latin1_storage() ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<u16 const*>(input.utf16_span().data()),
        .length = input.length_in_code_units(),
    };
}

void append_path_vertices(void* context, Layout::RustFFI::FfiPathVertex const* vertices, size_t count)
{
    auto& path_vertices = *static_cast<Vector<PathVertex>*>(context);
    path_vertices.ensure_capacity(path_vertices.size() + count);
    for (auto const& vertex : ReadonlySpan<Layout::RustFFI::FfiPathVertex> { vertices, count })
        path_vertices.unchecked_append({ { vertex.point.x, vertex.point.y }, vertex.distance, { vertex.direction.x, vertex.direction.y } });
}

Path parse_path_data(Utf16View input)
{
    auto* path = RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_path_data(ffi_svg_input(input));
    return path ? Path { path } : Path {};
}

Path::Path()
    : m_rust_path(RustFFI::rust_parse_svg_path_data({}))
{
    VERIFY(m_rust_path);
}

Path::Path(Path const& other)
    : m_rust_path(RustFFI::rust_svg_path_clone(other.m_rust_path))
{
}

Path::Path(Path&& other)
    : Path()
{
    swap(m_rust_path, other.m_rust_path);
}

Path::~Path()
{
    if (m_rust_path)
        RustFFI::rust_svg_path_destroy(m_rust_path);
}

Path& Path::operator=(Path const& other)
{
    if (this == &other)
        return *this;
    auto* new_path = RustFFI::rust_svg_path_clone(other.m_rust_path);
    if (m_rust_path)
        RustFFI::rust_svg_path_destroy(m_rust_path);
    m_rust_path = new_path;
    return *this;
}

Path& Path::operator=(Path&& other)
{
    if (this == &other)
        return *this;
    Path moved_path { move(other) };
    swap(m_rust_path, moved_path.m_rust_path);
    return *this;
}

Vector<PathVertex> Path::vertices() const
{
    Vector<PathVertex> vertices;
    Layout::RustFFI::svg_path_data_vertices(m_rust_path, &vertices, append_path_vertices);
    return vertices;
}

String Path::serialize() const
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    auto append = [](void* context, u8 const* bytes, size_t length) {
        static_cast<StringBuilder*>(context)->append(StringView { reinterpret_cast<char const*>(bytes), length });
    };
    RustFFI::rust_svg_path_serialize(m_rust_path, &builder, append);
    return builder.to_string_without_validation();
}

bool Path::operator==(Path const& other) const
{
    return RustFFI::rust_svg_path_equals(m_rust_path, other.m_rust_path);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/SVG/SMILTimeContainer.cpp
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibWeb/Animations/RecordHandles.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/TemporaryExecutionContext.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SMILTimeContainer.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SMILTimeContainer);

GC::Ref<SMILTimeContainer> SMILTimeContainer::create(DOM::Document& document)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SMILTimeContainer>(document);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#SVGElementTimelinebeginAttribute
// The outermost svg element of an SVG document fragment defines a timeline. Absolute times used by animation elements
// in an SVG document fragment are relative to the document fragment's timeline.
// NB: The animations of the timeline play on the document timeline, with their current time kept equal to the
//     timeline's: while the timeline runs, they start at the time on the document timeline at which its current time
//     is zero, and while it is paused, they are held at the time it was paused at. Until the timeline begins, they
//     stay idle.
SMILTimeContainer::SMILTimeContainer(DOM::Document& document)
    : m_document(document)
{
}

void SMILTimeContainer::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_document);
    for (auto const& animation : m_animations)
        animation.visit_edges(visitor);
}

double SMILTimeContainer::document_timeline_time() const
{
    auto time = m_document->timeline().current_time();
    return time.has_value() ? time->value : 0.;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#SVGElementTimelinebeginAttribute
void SMILTimeContainer::begin()
{
    // 'loadend'
    //     The document fragment's timeline starts the moment the load event for the outermost svg element is
    //     triggered.
    // NB: The caller decides when that moment is.
    VERIFY(!m_has_begun);
    m_has_begun = true;

    // NB: Seek to the time that setCurrentTime() recorded before the timeline began, if any.
    auto time = m_time_to_seek_to_once_begun.value_or(0.);
    m_time_to_seek_to_once_begun.clear();
    if (m_is_paused)
        m_paused_time = time;
    else
        m_zero_time = document_timeline_time() - time;
    synchronize_animations();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__pauseAnimations
void SMILTimeContainer::pause()
{
    // The pauseAnimations and unpauseAnimations methods are used to pause and unpause all of the animations within
    // the SVG document fragment.
    if (m_is_paused)
        return;
    if (m_has_begun)
        m_paused_time = current_time_in_milliseconds();
    m_is_paused = true;
    synchronize_animations();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__unpauseAnimations
void SMILTimeContainer::unpause()
{
    // The pauseAnimations and unpauseAnimations methods are used to pause and unpause all of the animations within
    // the SVG document fragment.
    if (!m_is_paused)
        return;
    m_is_paused = false;
    if (m_has_begun)
        m_zero_time = document_timeline_time() - m_paused_time;
    synchronize_animations();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__getCurrentTime
double SMILTimeContainer::current_time_in_milliseconds() const
{
    // Return the current time in seconds relative to the start time of the timeline.
    // NB: This returns it in milliseconds, the unit of the document timeline.
    VERIFY(m_has_begun);
    if (m_is_paused)
        return m_paused_time;
    return document_timeline_time() - m_zero_time;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__setCurrentTime
void SMILTimeContainer::seek_to_time_in_milliseconds(double time)
{
    // If the timeline for the current SVG document fragment has begun, then the timeline's current time (in seconds,
    // relative to the start time of the timeline) is set to seconds.
    VERIFY(m_has_begun);

    // NB: Like other engines, clamp a negative time to the start of the timeline, as SVG Tiny 1.2 does.
    time = max(time, 0.);
    if (m_is_paused)
        m_paused_time = time;
    else
        m_zero_time = document_timeline_time() - time;
    synchronize_animations();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__setCurrentTime
void SMILTimeContainer::record_time_to_seek_to_once_begun_in_milliseconds(double time)
{
    // Otherwise, the timeline has not begun. seconds is recorded on the current SVG document fragment as the time to be
    // seeked to once the timeline has begun.
    VERIFY(!m_has_begun);
    m_time_to_seek_to_once_begun = max(time, 0.);
}

void SMILTimeContainer::add_animation(Animations::AnimationRef const& animation)
{
    m_animations.append(animation);
    synchronize_animation(animation);
}

void SMILTimeContainer::remove_animation(Animations::AnimationRef const& animation)
{
    m_animations.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry == animation; });
}

void SMILTimeContainer::synchronize_animations()
{
    for (auto& animation : m_animations)
        synchronize_animation(animation);
}

void SMILTimeContainer::synchronize_animation(Animations::AnimationRef const& animation)
{
    if (!m_has_begun)
        return;

    // NB: The record sets the start time or the current time of the animation. The animation has no promises to
    //     settle, but the microtask checkpoint as the execution context ends stays where it was.
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { m_document->relevant_settings_object() };
    Animations::RustFFI::animations_smil_animation_synchronize(&animation.record(), m_zero_time, m_is_paused, m_paused_time, Animations::web_animation_perform_host_effect);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGC/Cell.h>
#include <LibGC/CellAllocator.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>
#include <LibWeb/Animations/RecordHandles.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#SVGElementTimelinebeginAttribute
class SMILTimeContainer final : public GC::Cell {
    GC_CELL(SMILTimeContainer, GC::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SMILTimeContainer);

public:
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<SMILTimeContainer> create(DOM::Document&);

    void begin();
    bool has_begun() const { return m_has_begun; }

    void pause();
    void unpause();
    bool is_paused() const { return m_is_paused; }

    double current_time_in_milliseconds() const;

    void record_time_to_seek_to_once_begun_in_milliseconds(double);

    void add_animation(Animations::AnimationRef const&);
    void remove_animation(Animations::AnimationRef const&);

private:
    explicit SMILTimeContainer(DOM::Document&);

    virtual void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&) override;

    double document_timeline_time() const;
    void synchronize_animations();
    void synchronize_animation(Animations::AnimationRef const&);

    GC::Ref<DOM::Document> m_document;
    // NB: The animations of the animation elements of the timeline, which this traces as their animation elements hold
    //     them.
    Vector<Animations::AnimationRef> m_animations;

    bool m_has_begun { false };
    bool m_is_paused { false };
    Optional<double> m_time_to_seek_to_once_begun;
    double m_paused_time { 0 };
    double m_zero_time { 0 };
};

}

{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGURIReferenceMixin::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_rel_list);
    visitor.visit(m_target);

void SVGAElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::href && (!namespace_.has_value() || namespace_ == Namespace::XLink))
        href_content_attribute_changed();
    if (!namespace_.has_value() && name == HTML::AttributeNames::rel) {
        if (m_rel_list)
            m_rel_list->associated_attribute_changed(value);
    }
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#dom-tabindex
i32 SVGAElement::default_tab_index_value() const
{
    // See the base function for the spec comments.
    return 0;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/interact.html#Focus
bool SVGAElement::is_focusable() const
{
    // In addition, all ‘a’ elements that are valid links are focusable, and their tabindex focus flag must be set
    // unless the user agent normally provides an alternative method of keyboard traversal of links.
    auto forms_link = [](DOM::Element const& element) {
        if (element.is_svg_a_element())
            return element.has_attribute(SVG::AttributeNames::href) || element.has_attribute_ns(Namespace::XLink, SVG::AttributeNames::href);
        return (element.is_html_anchor_element() || element.is_html_area_element()) && element.has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::href);
    };

    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#AElement
    // Links may not be nested; if an ‘a’ element is a descendent of another hyperlink element (whether in the SVG
    // namespace or another namespace), user agents must ignore its href attribute and treat it as inactive.
    auto is_valid_link = forms_link(*this);
    for (auto ancestor = parent_element(); is_valid_link && ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->parent_element()) {
        if (forms_link(*ancestor))
            is_valid_link = false;
    }
    return Base::is_focusable() || (is_valid_link && !is_in_never_rendered_subtree() && meets_focusable_area_rendering_requirements());
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#__svg__SVGAElement__target
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedString> SVGAElement::target()
{
    if (!m_target)
        m_target = SVGAnimatedString::create(*this, DOM::QualifiedName { HTML::AttributeNames::target, OptionalNone {}, OptionalNone {} });
    return *m_target;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#__svg__SVGAElement__relList
GC::Ref<DOM::DOMTokenList> SVGAElement::rel_list()
{
    // The relList IDL attribute reflects the ‘rel’ content attribute.
    if (!m_rel_list)
        m_rel_list = DOM::DOMTokenList::create(*this, HTML::AttributeNames::rel);
    return *m_rel_list;
}

CSS::ElementBoxKind SVGAElement::box_kind() const
{
    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/text.html#TextLayoutAlgorithm
    // The 'text' element is treated as a block element and its descendant 'tspan', 'textPath' and 'a' elements are
    // treated as inline elements.
    // NB: So, an <a> inside a text content element renders its text as a <tspan> does.
    if (first_flat_tree_ancestor_of_type<SVGTextContentElement>())
        return CSS::ElementBoxKind::SvgText;
    return CSS::ElementBoxKind::SvgGraphics;
}

void SVGAElement::activation_behavior(DOM::Event const& event)
{
    activate_the_hyperlink(event);
}

// AD-HOC: The URL of an SVG a element comes from its href attribute, or from the deprecated xlink:href attribute if
//         href is absent, so that the HyperlinkElementUtils members agree with the link the element follows.
// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#concept-hyperlink-url-set
void SVGAElement::set_the_url()
{
    auto should_invalidate_style = m_should_invalidate_style_after_url_change;
    m_should_invalidate_style_after_url_change = true;
    ScopeGuard invalidate_style_if_needed = [old_url = m_url, should_invalidate_style, this] {
        if (should_invalidate_style && m_url != old_url)
            CSS::Invalidation::invalidate_style_after_hyperlink_state_change(*this);
    };

    // 1. Set this element's url to null.
    m_url = {};

    // 2. If this element's href content attribute is absent, then return.
    auto href = get_attribute_ns({}, AttributeNames::href);
    if (!href.has_value())
        href = get_attribute_ns(Namespace::XLink, AttributeNames::href);
    if (!href.has_value())
        return;

    // 3. Let url be the result of encoding-parsing a URL given this element's href content attribute's value, relative
    //    to this element's node document.
    auto url = document().encoding_parse_url(*href);

    // 4. If url is not failure, then set this element's url to url.
    if (url.has_value())
        m_url = url.release_value();
}

// AD-HOC: Updating the href of an SVG a element writes to the href attribute, unless only the deprecated xlink:href
//         attribute is present, in which case that attribute is written instead.
// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#update-href
void SVGAElement::update_href()
{
    auto serialized_url = utf16_string_from_url_ascii(m_url->serialize());
    if (!has_attribute(AttributeNames::href) && has_attribute_ns(Namespace::XLink, AttributeNames::href)) {
        set_attribute_value(AttributeNames::href, move(serialized_url), "xlink"_utf16_fly_string, Namespace::XLink);
        return;
    }
    set_attribute_value(AttributeNames::href, move(serialized_url));
}

}

#include <AK/Utf16StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Angle.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Parser/Parser.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Serialize.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/StyleValues/AngleStyleValue.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/StyleValues/NumberStyleValue.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGAngle.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGElement.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGAngle);

GC::Ref<SVGAngle> SVGAngle::create_detached(Value value, ReadOnly read_only)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SVGAngle>(DetachedSource { value }, read_only);
}

GC::Ref<SVGAngle> SVGAngle::create_reflected_attribute(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString name, ReadOnly read_only)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SVGAngle>(ReflectedAttributeSource { element, move(name) }, read_only);
}

SVGAngle::SVGAngle(Source source, ReadOnly read_only)
    : m_source(move(source))
    , m_read_only(read_only)
{
}

SVGAngle::~SVGAngle() = default;

void SVGAngle::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    if (auto* source = m_source.get_pointer<ReflectedAttributeSource>())
        visitor.visit(source->element);
}

// Parses a value using the CSS syntax [ <number> | <angle> ].
Optional<SVGAngle::Value> SVGAngle::parse(Utf16View input)
{
    CSS::Parser::ParsingParams parsing_params { CSS::Parser::ParsingMode::SVGPresentationAttribute };
    if (auto number = parse_css_type(parsing_params, input, CSS::ValueType::Number); number && number->is_number())
        return Value { static_cast<float>(number->as_number().number()), {} };
    // FIXME: Support math functions, which do not parse to a literal number or angle.
    if (auto angle = parse_css_type(parsing_params, input, CSS::ValueType::Angle); angle && angle->is_angle()) {
        auto value = angle->as_angle().angle();
        return Value { static_cast<float>(value.raw_value()), value.unit() };
    }
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__valueAsString
Utf16String SVGAngle::serialize(Value value)
{
    // 2. Let string be an empty string.
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;

    // 3. Let factor be value's numeric factor, if it is an <angle>, or value itself it is a <number>.
    // 4. Append to string an implementation specific string that, if parsed as a <number> using CSS syntax, would
    //    return the number value closest to factor, given the implementation's supported real number precision.
    CSS::serialize_a_number(builder, value.factor);

    // 5. If value is an <angle>, then append to string the canonical spelling of value's unit.
    if (value.unit.has_value())
        builder.append(CSS::to_string(*value.unit));

    // 6. Return string.
    return builder.to_string();
}

SVGAngle::Value SVGAngle::internal_value() const
{
    return m_source.visit(
        [](ReflectedAttributeSource const& source) {
            // NB: The value of a reflected attribute that is not present or invalid is its initial value. The only
            //     attribute reflected by an SVGAngle is orient, whose initial value is 0.
            return parse(source.element->get_attribute_value(source.name)).value_or({});
        },
        [](DetachedSource const& source) { return source.value; });
}

void SVGAngle::set_internal_value(Value value)
{
    m_source.visit(
        [&](ReflectedAttributeSource const& source) {
            // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermReserialize
            source.element->set_attribute_value(source.name, serialize(value));
        },
        [&](DetachedSource& source) { source.value = value; });
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGAngle::ensure_not_read_only() const
{
    if (m_read_only == ReadOnly::Yes)
        return WebIDL::NoModificationAllowedError::create("Cannot modify a read-only SVGAngle"_utf16);
    return {};
}

static Optional<CSS::AngleUnit> angle_unit_for_unit_type(u16 unit_type)
{
    switch (unit_type) {
    case SVGAngle::SVG_ANGLETYPE_DEG:
        return CSS::AngleUnit::Deg;
    case SVGAngle::SVG_ANGLETYPE_RAD:
        return CSS::AngleUnit::Rad;
    case SVGAngle::SVG_ANGLETYPE_GRAD:
        return CSS::AngleUnit::Grad;
    default:
        return {};
    }
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__unitType
u16 SVGAngle::unit_type() const
{
    // 1. If the SVGAngle's value is a unitless <number> or a <length> with a deg, rad or grad unit, then return the
    //    corresponding constant value from the angle unit type table above.
    auto value = internal_value();
    if (!value.unit.has_value())
        return SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNSPECIFIED;
    switch (*value.unit) {
    case CSS::AngleUnit::Deg:
        return SVG_ANGLETYPE_DEG;
    case CSS::AngleUnit::Rad:
        return SVG_ANGLETYPE_RAD;
    case CSS::AngleUnit::Grad:
        return SVG_ANGLETYPE_GRAD;
    default:
        // 2. Otherwise, return SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNKNOWN.
        return SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNKNOWN;
    }
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__value
float SVGAngle::value() const
{
    // 1. Let value be the SVGAngle's value.
    auto value = internal_value();

    // 2. If value is a <number>, return that number.
    if (!value.unit.has_value())
        return value.factor;

    // 3. Return the result of converting value to an angle in degrees.
    return static_cast<float>(CSS::Angle { value.factor, *value.unit }.to_degrees());
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__value
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGAngle::set_value(float value)
{
    // 1. If the SVGAngle object is read only, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError.
    TRY(ensure_not_read_only());

    // 2. Let value be the value being assigned to value.
    // 3. Set the SVGAngle's value to a <number> whose value is value.
    // 4. If the SVGAngle reflects the base value of a reflected attribute, then reserialize the reflected attribute.
    set_internal_value({ value, {} });
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__valueInSpecifiedUnits
float SVGAngle::value_in_specified_units() const
{
    // 1. Let value be the SVGAngle's value.
    // 2. If value is a <number>, return that number.
    // 3. Otherwise, value is an <angle> value. Return the numeric factor before its unit.
    return internal_value().factor;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__valueInSpecifiedUnits
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGAngle::set_value_in_specified_units(float value)
{
    // 1. If the SVGAngle object is read only, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError.
    TRY(ensure_not_read_only());

    // 2. Let value be the value being assigned to valueInSpecifiedUnits.
    // 3. If the SVGAngle's value is a <number>, then update its value to value.
    // 4. Otherwise, if the SVGAngle's value is an <angle>, then update its numeric factor to value.
    auto new_value = internal_value();
    new_value.factor = value;

    // 5. If the SVGAngle reflects the base value of a reflected attribute or reflects an element of the base value of
    //    a reflected attribute, then reserialize the reflected attribute.
    set_internal_value(new_value);
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__valueAsString
Utf16String SVGAngle::value_as_string() const
{
    // 1. Let value be the SVGAngle's value.
    return serialize(internal_value());
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__valueAsString
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGAngle::set_value_as_string(Utf16String const& value)
{
    // 1. If the SVGAngle object is read only, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError.
    TRY(ensure_not_read_only());

    // 2. Let value be the value being assigned to valueAsString.
    // 3. Parse value using the CSS syntax [ <number> | <angle> ].
    auto parsed_value = parse(value);

    // 4. If parsing failed, then throw a SyntaxError.
    if (!parsed_value.has_value())
        return WebIDL::SyntaxError::create("Failed to parse value as a <number> or <angle>"_utf16);

    // 5. Otherwise, parsing succeeded. Set SVGAngle's value to the parsed value.
    // 6. If the SVGAngle reflects the base value of a reflected attribute or reflects an element of the base value of
    //    a reflected attribute, then reserialize the reflected attribute.
    set_internal_value(*parsed_value);
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__newValueSpecifiedUnits
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGAngle::new_value_specified_units(u16 unit_type, float value_in_specified_units)
{
    // 1. If the SVGAngle object is read only, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError.
    TRY(ensure_not_read_only());

    // 2. If unitType is SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNKNOWN or is a value that does not appear in the angle unit type table above,
    //    then throw a NotSupportedError.
    if (unit_type == SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNKNOWN || unit_type > SVG_ANGLETYPE_GRAD)
        return WebIDL::NotSupportedError::create("Unsupported angle unit type"_utf16);

    // 3. Set SVGAngle's value depending on the value of unitType:
    //    SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNSPECIFIED: a <number> whose value is valueInSpecifiedUnits
    //    anything else: an <angle> whose numeric factor is valueInSpecifiedUnits and whose unit is as indicated by the
    //    angle unit type table above
    // 4. If the SVGAngle reflects the base value of a reflected attribute or reflects an element of the base value of
    //    a reflected attribute, then reserialize the reflected attribute.
    set_internal_value({ value_in_specified_units, angle_unit_for_unit_type(unit_type) });
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAngle__convertToSpecifiedUnits
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGAngle::convert_to_specified_units(u16 unit_type)
{
    // 1. If the SVGAngle object is read only, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError.
    TRY(ensure_not_read_only());

    // 2. If unitType is SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNKNOWN or is a value that does not appear in the angle unit type table above,
    //    then throw a NotSupportedError.
    if (unit_type == SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNKNOWN || unit_type > SVG_ANGLETYPE_GRAD)
        return WebIDL::NotSupportedError::create("Unsupported angle unit type"_utf16);

    // 3. Let degrees be the value that would be returned from the value member.
    auto degrees = value();

    // 4. If unitType is SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNSPECIFIED, then:
    if (unit_type == SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNSPECIFIED) {
        // 1. Set the SVGAngle's value to a <number> whose value is degrees.
        set_internal_value({ degrees, {} });
    }
    // 5. Otherwise:
    else {
        // 1. Set the SVGAngle's value to the result of converting degrees to an <angle> with the unit found by looking
        //    up unitType in the angle unit type table above.
        auto unit = *angle_unit_for_unit_type(unit_type);
        set_internal_value({ static_cast<float>(degrees * CSS::ratio_between_units(CSS::AngleUnit::Deg, unit)), unit });
    }

    // 6. If the SVGAngle reflects the base value of a reflected attribute or reflects an element of the base value of
    //    a reflected attribute, then reserialize the reflected attribute.
    // NB: This happens as part of setting the value above.
    return {};
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Utf16FlyString.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#InterfaceSVGAngle
class SVGAngle final : public Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGAngle, Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGAngle);

public:
    static constexpr u16 SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_ANGLETYPE_UNSPECIFIED = 1;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_ANGLETYPE_DEG = 2;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_ANGLETYPE_RAD = 3;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_ANGLETYPE_GRAD = 4;

    enum class ReadOnly : u8 {
        Yes,
        No,
    };

    // An <angle> or <number> value. A number has no unit.
    struct Value {
        float factor { 0 };
        Optional<CSS::AngleUnit> unit;
    };

    static Optional<Value> parse(Utf16View);
    static Utf16String serialize(Value);

    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<SVGAngle> create_detached(Value, ReadOnly);
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<SVGAngle> create_reflected_attribute(GC::Ref<SVGElement>, Utf16FlyString name, ReadOnly);

    virtual ~SVGAngle() override;

    u16 unit_type() const;

    float value() const;
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_value(float);

    float value_in_specified_units() const;
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_value_in_specified_units(float);

    Utf16String value_as_string() const;
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_value_as_string(Utf16String const&);

    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> new_value_specified_units(u16 unit_type, float value_in_specified_units);
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> convert_to_specified_units(u16 unit_type);

    Value internal_value() const;

private:
    // Every SVGAngle object operates in one of two modes. It can:
    // 1. reflect the base value of a reflected animatable attribute (being exposed through the baseVal member of an
    //    SVGAnimatedAngle),
    struct ReflectedAttributeSource {
        GC::Ref<SVGElement> element;
        Utf16FlyString name;
    };

    // 2. be detached, which is the case for SVGAngle objects created with createSVGAngle.
    struct DetachedSource {
        Value value;
    };

    using Source = Variant<ReflectedAttributeSource, DetachedSource>;

    SVGAngle(Source, ReadOnly);

    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> ensure_not_read_only() const;
    void set_internal_value(Value);

    Source m_source;

    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#ReadOnlyAngle
    ReadOnly m_read_only;
};

}
