SVGAnimatedBoolean::SVGAnimatedBoolean(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, bool initial_value)
    : m_element(element)
    , m_reflected_attribute(move(reflected_attribute))
    , m_initial_value(initial_value)
{
}

SVGAnimatedBoolean::~SVGAnimatedBoolean() = default;

void SVGAnimatedBoolean::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_element);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedBoolean__baseVal
bool SVGAnimatedBoolean::base_or_anim_value() const
{
    // 1. Let value be the value of the reflected attribute, or the empty string if it is not present.
    auto value = m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute);

    // 2. If value is not "true" or "false", then set value to the reflected attribute's initial value.
    if (value != "true"sv && value != "false"sv)
        return m_initial_value;

    // 3. Return true if value is "true", and false otherwise.
    return value == "true"sv;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedBoolean__baseVal
void SVGAnimatedBoolean::set_base_val(bool value)
{
    // On setting baseVal, the reflected attribute is set to "true" if the value is true, and "false" otherwise.
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute, value ? "true"_utf16 : "false"_utf16);
}

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>

#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGAnimatedEnumeration.h>

{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SVGAnimatedEnumeration>(element, move(reflected_attribute), keywords, initial_value, reflects_orient_type);

SVGAnimatedEnumeration::SVGAnimatedEnumeration(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, ReadonlySpan<Keyword> keywords, u16 initial_value, ReflectsOrientType reflects_orient_type)
    : m_element(element)
    , m_reflected_attribute(move(reflected_attribute))
    , m_keywords(keywords)
    , m_initial_value(initial_value)
    , m_reflects_orient_type(reflects_orient_type)
{
}

SVGAnimatedEnumeration::~SVGAnimatedEnumeration() = default;

{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_element);

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedEnumeration__baseVal
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGAnimatedEnumeration::set_base_val(u16 base_val)
{
    // 1. Let value be the value being assigned to baseVal.
    auto value = base_val;

    // 2. If value is 0 or is not the numeric type value for any value of the reflected attribute, then throw a
    //    TypeError.
    auto keyword = [&] -> Optional<StringView> {
        if (value == 0)
            return {};
        for (auto const& mapping : m_keywords) {
            if (mapping.value == value)
                return mapping.keyword;
        }
        return {};
    }();
    auto is_orient_angle = m_reflects_orient_type == ReflectsOrientType::Yes && value == SVGMarkerElement::SVG_MARKER_ORIENT_ANGLE;
    if (!keyword.has_value() && !is_orient_angle)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Invalid value for baseVal"_utf16 };

    // 3. Otherwise, if the reflecting IDL attribute is orientType and value is SVG_MARKER_ORIENT_ANGLE, then set the
    //    reflected attribute to the string "0".
    if (is_orient_angle) {
        m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute, "0"_utf16);
        return {};
    }

    // 4. Otherwise, value is the numeric type value for a specific, single keyword value for the reflected attribute.
    //    Set the reflected attribute to that value.
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute, Utf16String::from_utf8(*keyword));
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedEnumeration__baseVal
u16 SVGAnimatedEnumeration::base_or_anim_value() const
{
    // 1. Let value be the value of the reflected attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is not present or
    //    invalid).
    auto value = m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute);

    // 2. Return the numeric type value for value, according to the reflecting IDL attribute's definition.
    // NB: Keywords are matched case-sensitively, and any other value is invalid.
    for (auto const& mapping : m_keywords) {
        if (value.utf16_view() == mapping.keyword)
            return mapping.value;
    }
    // NB: For orientType, an <angle> or <number> value maps to SVG_MARKER_ORIENT_ANGLE.
    if (m_reflects_orient_type == ReflectsOrientType::Yes && SVGAngle::parse(value).has_value())
        return SVGMarkerElement::SVG_MARKER_ORIENT_ANGLE;
    return m_initial_value;
}

}

private:
    SVGAnimatedEnumeration(GC::Ref<SVGElement>, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, ReadonlySpan<Keyword> keywords, u16 initial_value, ReflectsOrientType);

    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

    u16 base_or_anim_value() const;

    GC::Ref<SVGElement> m_element;
    Utf16FlyString m_reflected_attribute;
    ReadonlySpan<Keyword> m_keywords;
    u16 m_initial_value { 0 };
    ReflectsOrientType m_reflects_orient_type { ReflectsOrientType::No };

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedInteger__baseVal
WebIDL::Long SVGAnimatedInteger::base_val() const
{
    // On getting baseVal or animVal, the following steps are run:
    return get_base_or_anim_value();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedInteger__baseVal
void SVGAnimatedInteger::set_base_val(WebIDL::Long new_value)
{
    // 1. Let value be the value being assigned to baseVal.
    auto value = new_value;

    // 2. Let new be a list of integers.
    Vector<WebIDL::Long, 2> new_;

    // 3. If the reflected attribute is defined to take an integer followed by an optional second integer, then:
    if (m_supports_second_value == SupportsSecondValue::Yes) {
        // 1. Let current be the value of the reflected attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is not
        //    present or invalid).
        auto current = m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute.local_name(), m_reflected_attribute.namespace_());
        auto current_values = current.split_view(' ', SplitBehavior::Nothing);

        // 2. Let first be the first integer in current.
        auto first = current_values.size() > 0 ? parse_value_or_initial(current_values[0]) : m_initial_value;

        // 3. Let second be the second integer in current if it has been explicitly specified, and if not, the implicit
        //    value as described in the definition of the attribute.
        // NB: All known usages of <number-optional-number> specify that a missing second number defaults to the value
        //     of the first number.
        auto second = current_values.size() > 1 && !current_values[1].is_empty()
            ? parse_value_or_initial(current_values[1])
            : first;

        // 4. If this SVGAnimatedInteger object reflects the first integer, then set first to value. Otherwise, set second
        //    to value.
        if (m_value_represented == ValueRepresented::First)
            first = value;
        else
            second = value;

        // 5. Append first to new.
        new_.unchecked_append(first);

        // 6. Append second to new.
        new_.unchecked_append(second);
    }

    // 4. Otherwise, the reflected attribute is defined to take a single integer value. Append value to new.
    else {
        new_.unchecked_append(value);
    }

    // 5. Set the content attribute to a string consisting of each integer in new serialized to an implementation
    //    specific string that, if parsed as an <number> using CSS syntax, would return that integer,
    //    joined and separated by a single U+0020 SPACE character.
    auto new_attribute_value = Utf16String::join(' ', new_);
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute.local_name(), new_attribute_value, m_reflected_attribute.prefix(), m_reflected_attribute.namespace_());
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedInteger__animVal
WebIDL::Long SVGAnimatedInteger::anim_val() const
{
    // On getting baseVal or animVal, the following steps are run:
    return get_base_or_anim_value();
}

WebIDL::Long SVGAnimatedInteger::parse_value_or_initial(Utf16View number_value) const
{
    auto value = parse_integer(number_value);
    if (!value.has_value())
        return m_initial_value;
    return value.release_value();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedInteger__baseVal
WebIDL::Long SVGAnimatedInteger::get_base_or_anim_value() const
{
    // 1. Let value be the value of the reflected attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is not present or
    //    invalid).
    auto value = m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute.local_name(), m_reflected_attribute.namespace_());

    // 2. If the reflected attribute is defined to take an integer followed by an optional second integer, then:
    if (m_supports_second_value == SupportsSecondValue::Yes) {
        // 1. If this SVGAnimatedInteger object reflects the first integer, then return the first value in value.
        auto values = value.split_view(' ', SplitBehavior::Nothing);
        if (values.is_empty())
            return m_initial_value;
        if (m_value_represented == ValueRepresented::First)
            return parse_value_or_initial(values[0]);

        // 2. Otherwise, this SVGAnimatedInteger object reflects the second integer. Return the second value in value if
        //    it has been explicitly specified, and if not, return the implicit value as described in the definition of
        //    the attribute.
        // NB: All known usages of <number-optional-number> specify that a missing second number defaults to the value
        //     of the first number.
        VERIFY(m_value_represented == ValueRepresented::Second);
        if (values.size() > 1 && !values[1].is_empty())
            return parse_value_or_initial(values[1]);
        return parse_value_or_initial(values[0]);
    }

    // 3. Otherwise, the reflected attribute is defined to take a single integer value. Return value.
    return parse_value_or_initial(value);
}

void SVGAnimatedInteger::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_element);
}

}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedNumber__baseVal
float SVGAnimatedNumber::base_val() const
{
    // On getting baseVal or animVal, the following steps are run:
    return get_base_or_anim_value();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedNumber__baseVal
void SVGAnimatedNumber::set_base_val(float new_value)
{
    // 1. Let value be the value being assigned to baseVal.
    auto value = new_value;

    // 2. Let new be a list of numbers.
    Vector<float, 2> new_;

    // 3. If the reflected attribute is defined to take an number followed by an optional second number, then:
    if (m_supports_second_value == SupportsSecondValue::Yes) {
        // 1. Let current be the value of the reflected attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is not
        //    present or invalid).
        auto current = parse_number_optional_number(m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute.local_name(), m_reflected_attribute.namespace_()))
                           .value_or({ m_initial_value, {} });

        // 2. Let first be the first number in current.
        auto first = current.first;

        // 3. Let second be the second number in current if it has been explicitly specified, and if not, the implicit
        //    value as described in the definition of the attribute.
        // NB: All known usages of <number-optional-number> specify that a missing second number defaults to the value
        //     of the first number.
        auto second = current.second.value_or(first);

        // 4. If this SVGAnimatedNumber object reflects the first number, then set first to value. Otherwise, set second
        //    to value.
        if (m_value_represented == ValueRepresented::First)
            first = value;
        else
            second = value;

        // 5. Append first to new.
        new_.unchecked_append(first);

        // 6. Append second to new.
        new_.unchecked_append(second);
    }

    // 4. Otherwise, the reflected attribute is defined to take a single number value. Append value to new.
    else {
        new_.unchecked_append(value);
    }

    // 5. Set the content attribute to a string consisting of each number in new serialized to an implementation
    //    specific string that, if parsed as an <number> using CSS syntax, would return the value closest to the number
    //    (given the implementation's supported Precisionreal number precision), joined and separated by a single U+0020
    //    SPACE character.
    auto new_attribute_value = Utf16String::join(' ', new_);
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute.local_name(), new_attribute_value, m_reflected_attribute.prefix(), m_reflected_attribute.namespace_());
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedNumber__animVal
float SVGAnimatedNumber::anim_val() const
{
    // On getting baseVal or animVal, the following steps are run:
    return get_base_or_anim_value();
}

float SVGAnimatedNumber::parse_value_or_initial(Utf16View number_value) const
{
    if (m_accepts_percentage == AcceptsPercentage::Yes) {
        if (auto value = parse_number_percentage(number_value); value.has_value())
            return value->value();
        return m_initial_value;
    }
    return parse_number(number_value).value_or(m_initial_value);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedNumber__baseVal
float SVGAnimatedNumber::get_base_or_anim_value() const
{
    // 1. Let value be the value of the reflected attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is not present or
    //    invalid).
    auto value = m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute.local_name(), m_reflected_attribute.namespace_());

    // 2. If the reflected attribute is defined to take an number followed by an optional second number, then:
    if (m_supports_second_value == SupportsSecondValue::Yes) {
        // NB: A value that does not parse as a whole is invalid, so both numbers take the initial value.
        auto values = parse_number_optional_number(value);
        if (!values.has_value())
            return m_initial_value;

        // 1. If this SVGAnimatedNumber object reflects the first number, then return the first value in value.
        if (m_value_represented == ValueRepresented::First)
            return values->first;

        // 2. Otherwise, this SVGAnimatedNumber object reflects the second number. Return the second value in value if
        //    it has been explicitly specified, and if not, return the implicit value as described in the definition of
        //    the attribute.
        // NB: All known usages of <number-optional-number> specify that a missing second number defaults to the value
        //     of the first number.
        VERIFY(m_value_represented == ValueRepresented::Second);
        return values->second.value_or(values->first);
    }

    // 3. Otherwise, the reflected attribute is defined to take a single number value. Return value.
    return parse_value_or_initial(value);
}

void SVGAnimatedNumber::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_element);
}

}

    : m_element(element)

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedString__baseVal
Utf16String SVGAnimatedString::base_val() const
{
    // On getting baseVal or animVal, the following steps are run:
    // 1. If the reflected attribute is not present, then:
    if (!m_element->has_attribute_ns(m_reflected_attribute.namespace_(), m_reflected_attribute.local_name())) {
        // 1. If the SVGAnimatedString object is defined to additionally reflect a second, deprecated attribute,
        //    and that attribute is present, then return its value.
        if (m_deprecated_reflected_attribute.has_value()) {
            if (auto attribute = m_element->get_attribute_ns(m_deprecated_reflected_attribute->namespace_(), m_deprecated_reflected_attribute->local_name()); attribute.has_value())
                return attribute.release_value();
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, if the reflected attribute has an initial value, then return it.
        if (m_initial_value.has_value())
            return m_initial_value.value();

        // 3. Otherwise, return the empty string.
        return {};
    }

    // 2. Otherwise, the reflected attribute is present. Return its value.
    return m_element->get_attribute_ns(m_reflected_attribute.namespace_(), m_reflected_attribute.local_name()).value();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedString__baseVal
void SVGAnimatedString::set_base_val(Utf16String const& base_val)
{
    // 1. If the reflected attribute is not present, the SVGAnimatedString object is defined to additionally reflect
    //    a second, deprecated attribute, and that deprecated attribute is present, then set that deprecated attribute
    //    to the specified value.
    if (!m_element->has_attribute_ns(m_reflected_attribute.namespace_(), m_reflected_attribute.local_name())
        && m_deprecated_reflected_attribute.has_value()
        && m_element->has_attribute_ns(m_deprecated_reflected_attribute->namespace_(), m_deprecated_reflected_attribute->local_name())) {
        m_element->set_attribute_value(m_deprecated_reflected_attribute->local_name(), base_val, m_deprecated_reflected_attribute->prefix(), m_deprecated_reflected_attribute->namespace_());
        return;
    }

    // 2. Otherwise, set the reflected attribute to the specified value.
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute.local_name(), base_val, m_reflected_attribute.prefix(), m_reflected_attribute.namespace_());
}

}

GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedTransformList> SVGAnimatedTransformList::create(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute)
{
    // On getting baseVal or animVal, an SVGTransformList object is returned that reflects the given presentation
    // attribute.
    // NB: List interface objects reflected through the animVal IDL attribute are always read only.
    auto base_val = SVGTransformList::create(element, reflected_attribute, ReadOnlyList::No);
    auto anim_val = SVGTransformList::create(element, move(reflected_attribute), ReadOnlyList::Yes);
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SVGAnimatedTransformList>(base_val, anim_val);
}

SVGAnimatedTransformList::SVGAnimatedTransformList(GC::Ref<SVGTransformList> base_val, GC::Ref<SVGTransformList> anim_val)
    : m_base_val(base_val)
    , m_anim_val(anim_val)
{
}

void SVGAnimatedTransformList::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_base_val);
    visitor.visit(m_anim_val);
}

void SVGAnimatedTransformList::synchronize()
{
    m_base_val->synchronize();
    m_anim_val->synchronize();
}

void SVGAnimateElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);
    if (first_is_one_of(name, AttributeNames::calcMode, AttributeNames::from, AttributeNames::keySplines, AttributeNames::keyTimes, AttributeNames::to, AttributeNames::values) && !namespace_.has_value())
        update_animation();
}

enum class CalcMode : u8 {
    Discrete,
    Linear,
    Paced,
    Spline,
};

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#CalcModeAttribute
static CalcMode calc_mode(SVGAnimateElement const& element)
{
    // The default mode is 'linear', however if the attribute does not support linear interpolation (e.g. for strings),
    // the ‘calcMode’ attribute is ignored and discrete interpolation is used.
    // NB: SMIL Animation ignores a value with any error in its syntax, which leaves the default mode.
    auto calc_mode = element.get_attribute(AttributeNames::calcMode);
    if (!calc_mode.has_value())
        return CalcMode::Linear;
    if (*calc_mode == "discrete"sv)
        return CalcMode::Discrete;
    if (*calc_mode == "paced"sv)
        return CalcMode::Paced;
    if (*calc_mode == "spline"sv)
        return CalcMode::Spline;
    return CalcMode::Linear;
}

// NB: The values, keyTimes and keySplines attributes are lists separated by semicolons, which may end in one.
static Vector<Utf16View> split_semicolon_separated_list(Utf16View list)
{
    // Let values be a list of strings formed by splitting attribute at each U+003B SEMICOLON character.
    auto items = list.split_view(';', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty);

    // Strip any leading and trailing white space characters from each value of values.
    for (auto& item : items)
        item = item.trim_ascii_whitespace();

    // Remove the final value in values if it is the empty string.
    if (!items.is_empty() && items.last().is_empty())
        items.take_last();
    return items;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#KeyTimesAttribute
static Optional<Vector<double>> parse_key_times(Utf16View attribute, size_t value_count, CalcMode calc_mode)
{
    // For animations specified with a ‘values’ list, the ‘keyTimes’ attribute if specified must have exactly as many
    // values as there are in the ‘values’ attribute. For from/to/by animations, the ‘keyTimes’ attribute if specified
    // must have two values.
    auto items = split_semicolon_separated_list(attribute);
    if (items.size() != value_count)
        return {};

    Vector<double> key_times;
    key_times.ensure_capacity(items.size());
    for (auto item : items) {
        // Each time value in the ‘keyTimes’ list is specified as a floating point value between 0 and 1 (inclusive),
        // representing a proportional offset into the simple duration of the animation element.
        auto key_time = parse_number(item);
        if (!key_time.has_value() || *key_time < 0 || *key_time > 1)
            return {};

        // Each successive time value must be greater than or equal to the preceding time value.
        if (!key_times.is_empty() && *key_time < key_times.last())
            return {};
        key_times.unchecked_append(*key_time);
    }

    // For linear and spline animation, the first time value in the list must be 0, and the last time value in the
    // list must be 1.
    // For discrete animation, the first time value in the list must be 0.
    if (key_times.first() != 0)
        return {};
    if (calc_mode != CalcMode::Discrete && key_times.last() != 1)
        return {};
    return key_times;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#KeySplinesAttribute
static Optional<Vector<CSS::EasingFunction>> parse_key_splines(Utf16View attribute, size_t interval_count)
{
    // Thus, there must be one fewer sets of control points than there are ‘keyTimes’.
    auto items = split_semicolon_separated_list(attribute);
    if (items.size() != interval_count)
        return {};

    Vector<CSS::EasingFunction> key_splines;
    key_splines.ensure_capacity(items.size());
    for (auto item : items) {
        // Each control point description is a set of four values: x1 y1 x2 y2, describing the Bézier control points
        // for one time segment.
        // The values must all be in the range 0 to 1.
        auto control_points = parse_table_values(item);
        if (control_points.size() != 4 || any_of(control_points, [](float value) { return value < 0 || value > 1; }))
            return {};

        // NB: The keyTimes values are the anchor points of a segment, so its control points describe a cubic-bezier()
        //     easing function across it.
        auto easing = CSS::EasingFunction::parse(Utf16String::formatted("cubic-bezier({}, {}, {}, {})", control_points[0], control_points[1], control_points[2], control_points[3]));
        if (!easing.has_value())
            return {};
        key_splines.unchecked_append(easing.release_value());
    }
    return key_splines;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#AnimateElement
Vector<SVGKeyframe> SVGAnimateElement::keyframes(SVGElement const& target, CSS::PropertyID property_id) const
{
    // NB: A missing value stands for the underlying value of the attribute or property, which the keyframe effect
    //     takes as its missing start keyframe.
    Vector<RefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const>> values;

    // If a list of ‘values’ is specified, any ‘from’, ‘to’ and ‘by’ attribute values are ignored.
    if (auto values_attribute = get_attribute(AttributeNames::values); values_attribute.has_value()) {
        // Parse each value in values using the rules for parsing the attribute identified by the ‘href’, and
        // ‘attributeName’ attributes.
        // NB: If any values are not legal, the document fragment is in error, so the animation does not apply.
        for (auto item : split_semicolon_separated_list(*values_attribute)) {
            auto value = target.parse_presentation_attribute(property_id, item);
            if (!value)
                return {};
            values.append(move(value));
        }
    } else {
        // FIXME: Support by animations.
        auto to = get_attribute(AttributeNames::to);
        auto to_value = to.has_value() ? target.parse_presentation_attribute(property_id, to->utf16_view()) : nullptr;
        if (!to_value)
            return {};

        // NB: Without a from value, this is a to animation, which animates from the underlying value.
        RefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> from_value;
        if (auto from = get_attribute(AttributeNames::from); from.has_value()) {
            from_value = target.parse_presentation_attribute(property_id, from->utf16_view());
            if (!from_value)
                return {};
        }
        values = { move(from_value), move(to_value) };
    }
    if (values.is_empty())
        return {};

    // NB: A single value holds for the entire duration, as with a set element.
    if (values.size() == 1)
        return { keyframe(0, property_id, *values.first()), keyframe(1, property_id, *values.first()) };

    auto calc_mode = ::Web::SVG::calc_mode(*this);

    // If the interpolation mode is 'paced', the ‘keyTimes’ attribute is ignored.
    // If the simple duration is indefinite, any ‘keyTimes’ specification will be ignored.
    // FIXME: Pace paced animations evenly rather than interpolating them linearly.
    Optional<Vector<double>> key_times;
    if (auto key_times_attribute = get_attribute(AttributeNames::keyTimes);
        key_times_attribute.has_value() && calc_mode != CalcMode::Paced && !isinf(simple_duration())) {
        // If there are any errors in the ‘keyTimes’ specification (bad values, too many or too few values), the
        // document fragment is in error (see error processing).
        key_times = parse_key_times(*key_times_attribute, values.size(), calc_mode);
        if (!key_times.has_value())
            return {};
    }

    // spline
    //     Interpolates from one value in the ‘values’ list to the next according to a time function defined by a cubic
    //     Bézier spline. The points of the spline are defined in the ‘keyTimes’ attribute, and the control points for
    //     each interval are defined in the ‘keySplines’ attribute.
    Optional<Vector<CSS::EasingFunction>> key_splines;
    if (calc_mode == CalcMode::Spline) {
        // If there are any errors in the ‘keySplines’ specification (bad values, too many or too few values), the
        // document fragment is in error (see error processing).
        // NB: A missing keySplines attribute is an error too, since there must be one set of control points for each
        //     interval.
        auto key_splines_attribute = get_attribute(AttributeNames::keySplines);
        if (key_splines_attribute.has_value())
            key_splines = parse_key_splines(*key_splines_attribute, values.size() - 1);
        if (!key_splines.has_value())
            return {};
    }

    // discrete
    //     This specifies that the animation function will jump from one value to the next without any interpolation.
    // NB: Without keyTimes, the values of a discrete animation divide the simple duration evenly, each holding for its
    //     part of it. Each keyframe steps to the next one only at its end, and a closing keyframe holds the last value
    //     until the end of the simple duration.
    // FIXME: Hold the underlying value of a discrete to animation for the first half of the simple duration.
    auto offset_of_value = [&](size_t index) -> double {
        if (key_times.has_value())
            return (*key_times)[index];
        if (calc_mode == CalcMode::Discrete)
            return static_cast<double>(index) / static_cast<double>(values.size());
        return static_cast<double>(index) / static_cast<double>(values.size() - 1);
    };

    Vector<SVGKeyframe> keyframes;
    keyframes.ensure_capacity(values.size() + 1);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < values.size(); ++i) {
        if (!values[i])
            continue;
        auto value_keyframe = keyframe(offset_of_value(i), property_id, *values[i]);
        if (calc_mode == CalcMode::Discrete)
            value_keyframe.easing = CSS::EasingFunction::parse("step-end"_utf16).release_value();
        else if (key_splines.has_value() && i < key_splines->size())
            value_keyframe.easing = (*key_splines)[i];
        else
            value_keyframe.easing = CSS::EasingFunction::linear();
        keyframes.unchecked_append(move(value_keyframe));
    }
    if (calc_mode == CalcMode::Discrete && keyframes.last().offset != 1)
        keyframes.unchecked_append(keyframe(1, property_id, *values.last()));
    return keyframes;
}

}

#include <AK/CharacterTypes.h>

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#AnimateMotionElement
void SVGAnimateMotionElement::update_referenced_motion_path()
{
    // If the ‘mpath’ sub-element refers to a shape element, the motion path is defined by the equivalent path of the
    // shape element.
    // NB: Only the first mpath child counts, as the content model allows one. Without a shape element that it refers to,
    //     the attributes of this element define the motion path.
    // FIXME: Follow changes to the geometry of the referenced element.
    m_referenced_motion_path_vertices.clear();
    if (auto* mpath_element = is_connected() ? first_child_of_type<SVGMPathElement>() : nullptr) {
        if (auto* geometry_element = as_if<SVGGeometryElement>(mpath_element->referenced_element().ptr()))
            m_referenced_motion_path_vertices = geometry_element->equivalent_path_vertices();
    }
    update_animation();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#AnimateMotionElementPathAttribute
Optional<CSS::PropertyID> SVGAnimateMotionElement::target_property() const
{
    // The effect of a motion path animation is to add a supplemental transformation matrix onto the CTM for the
    // referenced object which causes a translation along the x- and y-axes of the current user coordinate system by the
    // computed X and Y values computed over time.
    // AD-HOC: Animate the translate property instead, which translates the target in the coordinate system of its
    //         parent, outside of its own transform, like the supplemental transformation matrix does. Unlike that
    //         matrix, it replaces any translate property of the target.
    return CSS::PropertyID::Translate;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#AnimateMotionElement
static RefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> parse_coordinate_pair_as_translation(SVGElement const& target, Utf16View coordinate_pair)
{
    // For ‘animateMotion’, the specified values for ‘from’, ‘by’, ‘to’ and ‘values’ consists of x, y coordinate pairs,
    // with a single comma and/or white space separating the x coordinate from the y coordinate.
    auto is_separator = [](char16_t code_unit) { return code_unit == ',' || is_ascii_space(code_unit); };
    coordinate_pair = coordinate_pair.trim_ascii_whitespace();
    size_t x_length = 0;
    while (x_length < coordinate_pair.length_in_code_units() && !is_separator(coordinate_pair.code_unit_at(x_length)))
        ++x_length;
    auto x = coordinate_pair.substring_view(0, x_length);
    auto y = coordinate_pair.substring_view(x_length).trim_ascii_whitespace(TrimMode::Left);
    if (!y.is_empty() && y.code_unit_at(0) == ',')
        y = y.substring_view(1).trim_ascii_whitespace(TrimMode::Left);
    if (x.is_empty() || y.is_empty())
        return {};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < y.length_in_code_units(); ++i) {
        if (is_separator(y.code_unit_at(i)))
            return {};
    }

    // Each coordinate represents a <length>.
    // NB: Parse the coordinates as a translate value the way a presentation attribute is parsed, which takes a number
    //     as a length in user units.
    return target.parse_presentation_attribute(CSS::PropertyID::Translate, Utf16String::formatted("{} {}", x, y));
}

static NonnullRefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> translation(Gfx::FloatPoint point)
{
    return CSS::TransformationStyleValue::create(CSS::PropertyID::Translate, CSS::TransformFunction::Translate,
        { CSS::LengthStyleValue::create(CSS::Length::make_px(point.x())), CSS::LengthStyleValue::create(CSS::Length::make_px(point.y())) });
}

static Optional<Gfx::FloatPoint> translation_in_pixels(CSS::StyleValue const& translation)
{
    if (!translation.is_transformation())
        return {};
    auto values = translation.as_transformation().values();
    if (values.size() != 2 || !values[0]->is_length() || !values[1]->is_length())
        return {};
    auto x = values[0]->as_length().length();
    auto y = values[1]->as_length().length();
    if (!x.is_absolute() || !y.is_absolute())
        return {};
    return Gfx::FloatPoint { x.absolute_length_to_px_without_rounding(), y.absolute_length_to_px_without_rounding() };
}

namespace {

struct MotionRotation {
    bool follows_direction { false };
    double degrees { 0 };

    bool is_none() const { return !follows_direction && degrees == 0; }
};

// Rotations along the motion path, each within half a turn of the previous one so that the target turns the short way
// between them.
class MotionRotations {
public:
    explicit MotionRotations(MotionRotation rotation)
        : m_rotation(rotation)
    {
    }

    NonnullRefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> rotation_for(Gfx::FloatVector2 direction)
    {
        auto degrees = m_rotation.degrees;
        if (m_rotation.follows_direction)
            degrees += AK::to_degrees(AK::atan2(static_cast<double>(direction.y()), static_cast<double>(direction.x())));
        if (m_previous_degrees.has_value())
            degrees -= 360 * AK::round((degrees - *m_previous_degrees) / 360);
        m_previous_degrees = degrees;
        return CSS::TransformationStyleValue::create(CSS::PropertyID::Rotate, CSS::TransformFunction::Rotate,
            { CSS::AngleStyleValue::create(CSS::Angle::make_degrees(degrees)) });
    }

private:
    MotionRotation m_rotation;
    Optional<double> m_previous_degrees;
};

}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#RotateAttribute
static MotionRotation motion_rotation(DOM::Element const& element)
{
    // The ‘rotate’ attribute post-multiplies a supplemental transformation matrix onto the CTM of the target element to
    // apply a rotation transformation about the origin of the current user coordinate system. The rotation
    // transformation is applied after the supplemental translation transformation that is computed due to the ‘path’
    // attribute.
    // AD-HOC: Animate the rotate property for this, which applies after the translate property. Unlike the supplemental
    //         transformation matrix, it rotates about the transform origin of the target, which is the origin of its
    //         user coordinate system unless the transform-origin property says otherwise, and it replaces any rotate
    //         property of the target.
    auto rotate = element.get_attribute(AttributeNames::rotate);
    if (!rotate.has_value())
        return {};

    // auto
    //     Indicates that the object is rotated over time by the angle of the direction (i.e., directional tangent
    //     vector) of the motion path.
    if (*rotate == "auto"sv)
        return { .follows_direction = true, .degrees = 0 };

    // auto-reverse
    //     Indicates that the object is rotated over time by the angle of the direction (i.e., directional tangent
    //     vector) of the motion path plus 180 degrees.
    if (*rotate == "auto-reverse"sv)
        return { .follows_direction = true, .degrees = 180 };

    // <number>
    //     Indicates that the target element has a constant rotation transformation applied to it, where the rotation
    //     angle is the specified number of degrees.
    if (auto number = parse_number_percentage(*rotate); number.has_value() && !number->is_percentage() && isfinite(number->value()))
        return { .follows_direction = false, .degrees = number->value() };

    // NB: SMIL Animation ignores a value with any error in its syntax, which leaves the initial value of 0.
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#AnimateMotionElement
Vector<SVGKeyframe> SVGAnimateMotionElement::keyframes_along_motion_path(ReadonlySpan<PathVertex> vertices, CSS::PropertyID property_id) const
{
    // NB: Follow polylines through the motion path, with enough points along its curves to stay as close to them as the
    //     length of the motion path is measured.
    // FIXME: Animate a position along the motion path rather than points along it, so that the target follows its curves
    //        exactly, as other engines do.
    if (vertices.is_empty())
        return {};

    // At any time t within a motion path animation of duration dur, the computed coordinate (x,y) along the motion path
    // is determined by finding the point (x,y) which is t/dur distance along the motion path using the user agent's
    // distance along the path algorithm.
    // NB: Each vertex gets the fraction of the length of the motion path it is along as its offset, between which the
    //     target moves in straight lines. A motion path without length keeps the target at its initial point.
    auto rotation = motion_rotation(*this);
    MotionRotations rotations { rotation };
    auto length = vertices.last().distance;
    if (length == 0) {
        Vector<SVGKeyframe> keyframes { keyframe(0, property_id, translation(vertices.first().point)), keyframe(1, property_id, translation(vertices.first().point)) };
        if (!rotation.is_none()) {
            for (auto& keyframe : keyframes)
                set_keyframe_property(keyframe, CSS::PropertyID::Rotate, rotations.rotation_for(vertices.first().direction));
        }
        return keyframes;
    }

    // When a path is combined with a "paced" ‘calcMode’ setting, all "move to" commands are considered to have 0 length
    // (i.e. they always happen instantaneously), and is not considered in computing the pacing.
    // NB: The vertices where a subpath ends and where the next one starts are at the same distance, so the target jumps
    //     between them.
    // FIXME: Divide the duration between the points of the path for the other calcMode values.
    // NB: Where the motion path changes direction at once, its vertex appears twice, so the target turns at once.
    Vector<SVGKeyframe> keyframes;
    keyframes.ensure_capacity(vertices.size());
    for (auto const& vertex : vertices) {
        auto vertex_keyframe = keyframe(vertex.distance / length, property_id, translation(vertex.point));
        if (!rotation.is_none())
            set_keyframe_property(vertex_keyframe, CSS::PropertyID::Rotate, rotations.rotation_for(vertex.direction));
        keyframes.unchecked_append(move(vertex_keyframe));
    }
    return keyframes;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#AnimateMotionElement
Vector<SVGKeyframe> SVGAnimateMotionElement::keyframes(SVGElement const& target, CSS::PropertyID property_id) const
{
    // Regarding the definition of the motion path, the ‘mpath’ element overrides the ‘path’ attribute, which overrides
    // ‘values’, which overrides ‘from’, ‘by’ and ‘to’.
    // FIXME: Take the motion path from the values and by attributes.
    // FIXME: Apply the keyPoints attribute.
    if (m_referenced_motion_path_vertices.has_value())
        return keyframes_along_motion_path(*m_referenced_motion_path_vertices, property_id);
    if (auto path = get_attribute(AttributeNames::path); path.has_value())
        return keyframes_along_motion_path(parse_path_data(*path).vertices(), property_id);

    auto to = get_attribute(AttributeNames::to);
    auto to_translation = to.has_value() ? parse_coordinate_pair_as_translation(target, *to) : nullptr;
    if (!to_translation)
        return {};

    auto from = get_attribute(AttributeNames::from);
    RefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> from_translation;
    if (from.has_value()) {
        from_translation = parse_coordinate_pair_as_translation(target, *from);
        if (!from_translation)
            return {};
    }

    // NB: Without a from value, this is a to animation, which animates from the underlying value. The keyframe effect
    //     takes its missing start keyframe from that value.
    Vector<SVGKeyframe> keyframes;
    if (from_translation)
        keyframes.append(keyframe(0, property_id, *from_translation));
    keyframes.append(keyframe(1, property_id, *to_translation));

    auto rotation = motion_rotation(*this);
    if (rotation.is_none())
        return keyframes;

    // NB: The underlying value of a motion is no translation at all, so a to animation moves from the origin. Only
    //     coordinates in absolute lengths give the motion a known direction. Rotations do not come from the underlying
    //     value, so a to animation gets a start keyframe for its rotation alone.
    auto from_point = from_translation ? translation_in_pixels(*from_translation) : Gfx::FloatPoint {};
    auto to_point = translation_in_pixels(*to_translation);
    Gfx::FloatVector2 direction;
    if (from_point.has_value() && to_point.has_value())
        direction = { to_point->x() - from_point->x(), to_point->y() - from_point->y() };
    if (!from_translation) {
        SVGKeyframe rotation_keyframe;
        rotation_keyframe.offset = 0;
        keyframes.prepend(move(rotation_keyframe));
    }
    MotionRotations rotations { rotation };
    for (auto& keyframe : keyframes)
        set_keyframe_property(keyframe, CSS::PropertyID::Rotate, rotations.rotation_for(direction));
    return keyframes;
}

}

    if (first_is_one_of(name, AttributeNames::attributeName, AttributeNames::begin, AttributeNames::dur, AttributeNames::fill, AttributeNames::repeatCount) && !namespace_.has_value())
        update_animation();
}

GC::Ptr<SMILTimeContainer> SVGAnimationElement::time_container()
{
    auto outermost_svg_element = this->outermost_svg_element();
    return outermost_svg_element ? outermost_svg_element->time_container() : nullptr;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#HrefAttribute
GC::Ptr<SVGElement> SVGAnimationElement::target_element()
{
    // FIXME: A URL reference to the element which is the target of this animation element and which therefore will be
    //        modified over time.
    // If the ‘href’ attribute or the deprecated ‘xlink:href’ attribute is not provided, then the target element will
    // be the immediate parent element of the current animation element.
    return as_if<SVGElement>(parent_element().ptr());
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#AttributeNameAttribute
Optional<CSS::PropertyID> SVGAnimationElement::target_property() const
{
    auto attribute_name = get_attribute(AttributeNames::attributeName);
    if (!attribute_name.has_value())
        return {};

    // That is, when determining if ‘attributeName’ corresponds to an attribute name or a CSS property name, the
    // implementation must first search through the list of CSS properties for a matching property name.
    // NB: Neither custom properties nor properties that cannot be animated have an animation.
    auto property_id = CSS::property_id_from_string(*attribute_name);
    if (!property_id.has_value() || property_id == CSS::PropertyID::Custom || !CSS::is_animatable_property(*property_id))
        return {};

    // FIXME: If no matching property is found, the implementation must search for a matching attribute on the target
    //        element.
    return property_id;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#DurAttribute
double SVGAnimationElement::simple_duration() const
{
    // If the animation does not have a ‘dur’ attribute, the simple duration is indefinite.
    auto dur = get_attribute(AttributeNames::dur);
    if (!dur.has_value())
        return AK::Infinity<double>;

    // Clock-value
    //     Specifies the length of the simple duration in presentation time. Value must be greater than 0.
    if (auto duration = parse_clock_value_in_milliseconds(*dur); duration.has_value() && *duration > 0)
        return *duration;

    // NB: An "indefinite" value specifies an indefinite simple duration, SVG ignores a "media" value, and SMIL
    //     Animation ignores a value with any error in its syntax. Each leaves the simple duration indefinite.
    return AK::Infinity<double>;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#RepeatCountAttribute
double SVGAnimationElement::repeat_count() const
{
    // Specifies the number of iterations of the animation function. It can have the following attribute values:
    auto repeat_count = get_attribute(AttributeNames::repeatCount);
    if (!repeat_count.has_value())
        return 1;

    // <number>
    //     This is a (base 10) "floating point" numeric value that specifies the number of iterations. It can include
    //     partial iterations expressed as fraction values. A fractional value describes a portion of the simple
    //     duration. Values must be greater than 0.
    if (auto count = parse_number_percentage(*repeat_count); count.has_value() && !count->is_percentage()
        && count->value() > 0 && isfinite(count->value())) {
        return count->value();
    }

    // indefinite
    //     The animation is defined to repeat indefinitely (i.e. until the document ends).
    if (*repeat_count == "indefinite"sv)
        return AK::Infinity<double>;

    // NB: SMIL Animation ignores a value with any error in its syntax, which leaves a single iteration.
    return 1;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#FillAttribute
Animations::RustFFI::FillMode SVGAnimationElement::fill_mode() const
{
    // freeze
    //     The animation effect F(t) is defined to freeze the effect value at the last value of the active duration.
    if (auto fill = get_attribute(AttributeNames::fill); fill.has_value() && *fill == "freeze"sv)
        return Animations::RustFFI::FillMode::Forwards;

    // remove
    //     The animation effect is removed (no longer applied) when the active duration of the animation is over.
    return Animations::RustFFI::FillMode::None;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#RestartAttribute
SVGAnimationElement::Restart SVGAnimationElement::restart() const
{
    // NB: SMIL Animation ignores a value with any error in its syntax, which leaves the default value of always.
    auto restart = get_attribute(AttributeNames::restart);
    if (restart == "whenNotActive"sv)
        return Restart::WhenNotActive;
    if (restart == "never"sv)
        return Restart::Never;
    return Restart::Always;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#BeginValueListSyntax
static Optional<double> parse_offset_value_in_milliseconds(Utf16View value)
{
    // offset-value ::= ( S? "+" | "-" S? )? ( Clock-value )
    auto sign = 1.;
    if (value.starts_with(u"+"sv) || value.starts_with(u"-"sv)) {
        if (value.starts_with(u"-"sv))
            sign = -1.;
        value = value.substring_view(1).trim_ascii_whitespace(TrimMode::Left);
    }
    auto clock_value = parse_clock_value_in_milliseconds(value);
    if (!clock_value.has_value())
        return {};
    return sign * *clock_value;
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#BeginAttribute
Optional<double> SVGAnimationElement::begin_time_from_begin_attribute() const
{
    // NB: The initial value is 0s.
    auto begin = get_attribute(AttributeNames::begin);
    if (!begin.has_value())
        return 0;

    // The attribute value is a semicolon separated list of values.
    // The interpretation of a list of begin times is detailed in SMIL Animation's section on "Evaluation of begin and
    // end time lists".
    // offset-value
    //     For SVG, the implicit syncbase begin is defined to be relative to the document begin.
    // "indefinite"
    //     The begin of the animation will be determined by a "beginElement()" method call or a hyperlink targeted to
    //     the element.
    // NB: The current interval begins at the earliest of the offset values, and without any, it has no begin time.
    // FIXME: Begin a new interval at each of the later offset values.
    // FIXME: Support the syncbase, event, repeat, accessKey and wallclock-sync values.
    Optional<double> earliest_begin_time;
    begin->utf16_view().for_each_split_view(';', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty, [&](Utf16View item) {
        auto begin_time = parse_offset_value_in_milliseconds(item.trim_ascii_whitespace());
        if (begin_time.has_value() && (!earliest_begin_time.has_value() || *begin_time < *earliest_begin_time))
            earliest_begin_time = begin_time;
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    return earliest_begin_time;
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/smil-animation/#Timing-EvaluationOfBeginEndTimeLists
Optional<double> SVGAnimationElement::interval_begin_time() const
{
    // NB: An instance time that a DOM method created replaces the begin times of the begin attribute, as it was only
    //     kept if it begins the current interval.
    if (m_begin_instance_time_from_dom.has_value())
        return m_begin_instance_time_from_dom;
    return begin_time_from_begin_attribute();
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/smil-animation/#Timing-EvaluationOfBeginEndTimeLists
Optional<double> SVGAnimationElement::interval_end_time() const
{
    // NB: An end time before the begin time of the interval does not end it.
    // FIXME: Support the end attribute.
    auto begin_time = interval_begin_time();
    if (!begin_time.has_value() || !m_end_instance_time_from_dom.has_value() || *m_end_instance_time_from_dom < *begin_time)
        return {};
    return m_end_instance_time_from_dom;
}

bool SVGAnimationElement::is_active_at(double time) const
{
    auto begin_time = interval_begin_time();
    if (!begin_time.has_value() || time < *begin_time)
        return false;
    auto active_end = *begin_time + simple_duration() * repeat_count();
    if (auto end_time = interval_end_time(); end_time.has_value())
        active_end = min(active_end, *end_time);
    return time < active_end;
}

double SVGAnimationElement::current_presentation_time()
{
    // NB: Like SVGSVGElement.getCurrentTime(), the time is 0 until the timeline has begun.
    auto time_container = this->time_container();
    if (!time_container || !time_container->has_begun())
        return 0;
    return time_container->current_time_in_milliseconds();
}

SVGKeyframe SVGAnimationElement::keyframe(double offset, CSS::PropertyID property_id, CSS::StyleValue const& value)
{
    SVGKeyframe keyframe;
    keyframe.offset = offset;
    set_keyframe_property(keyframe, property_id, value);
    return keyframe;
}

void SVGAnimationElement::set_keyframe_property(SVGKeyframe& keyframe, CSS::PropertyID property_id, CSS::StyleValue const& value)
{
    keyframe.properties.set(CSS::PropertyNameAndID::from_id(property_id), CSS::RustStyleValueHandle::retained(value.rust_style_value_data()));
}

// The keyframe set of the keyframes, in their order.
static Animations::KeyframeSetHandle keyframe_set_of(Vector<SVGKeyframe> const& keyframes)
{
    Vector<Animations::RustFFI::FfiProcessedKeyframe> processed_keyframes;
    Vector<Animations::RustFFI::FfiProcessedKeyframeProperty> properties;
    processed_keyframes.ensure_capacity(keyframes.size());
    for (auto const& keyframe : keyframes) {
        Animations::RustFFI::FfiProcessedKeyframe processed_keyframe {};
        processed_keyframe.offset = keyframe.offset;
        processed_keyframe.composite = Animations::RustFFI::CompositeOperationOrAuto::Auto;
        if (keyframe.easing.has_value()) {
            processed_keyframe.has_easing = true;
            processed_keyframe.easing = keyframe.easing->descriptor();
        }
        processed_keyframe.first_property = static_cast<u32>(properties.size());
        for (auto const& [property, property_value] : keyframe.properties) {
            properties.append({
                .property_id = to_underlying(property.id()),
                .custom_name = property.is_custom_property() ? property.name().raw_identity() : 0,
                .value = property_value.data(),
            });
        }
        processed_keyframe.property_count = static_cast<u32>(properties.size()) - processed_keyframe.first_property;
        processed_keyframes.unchecked_append(processed_keyframe);
    }
    return Animations::KeyframeSetHandle::adopt(Animations::RustFFI::animations_keyframe_set_from_processed_keyframes(processed_keyframes.span(), properties.span()));
}

void SVGAnimationElement::update_animation()
{
    if (auto animation = exchange(m_animation, {}); animation.has_value()) {
        exchange(m_animation_time_container, nullptr)->remove_animation(*animation);
        // NB: Canceling an animation that is not idle runs in an execution context, as an Animation's does.
        Optional<HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext> execution_context;
        if (animation->play_state() != Animations::RustFFI::AnimationPlayState::Idle)
            execution_context.emplace(document().relevant_settings_object());
        Animations::RustFFI::animations_animation_cancel(&animation->record(), true, Animations::web_animation_perform_host_effect);
        execution_context.clear();
        Animations::RustFFI::animations_smil_animation_let_go(&animation->record());
    }

    if (!is_connected())
        return;
    auto time_container = this->time_container();
    if (!time_container)
        return;
    auto target = target_element();
    if (!target)
        return;
    auto property_id = target_property();
    if (!property_id.has_value())
        return;
    auto keyframes = this->keyframes(*target, *property_id);
    if (keyframes.is_empty())
        return;
    auto begin_time = interval_begin_time();
    if (!begin_time.has_value())
        return;

    // NB: The animation's current time is kept equal to the time of the timeline of the SVG document fragment, so the
    //     interval begins after a delay of its begin time.
    // FIXME: Resolve the interval from the other timing attributes.
    // FIXME: A running animation requests a rendering update on every frame, even when its output cannot change, as
    //        with an indefinite one. This keeps the rendering loop running for as long as such an animation is active.
    Animations::RustFFI::SpecifiedEffectTiming timing {
        .start_delay = *begin_time,
        .end_delay = 0,
        .iteration_duration = { .is_auto = false, .milliseconds = simple_duration() },
        .iteration_start = 0,
        .iteration_count = repeat_count(),
        .fill_mode = static_cast<Animations::RustFFI::FillMode>(to_underlying(fill_mode())),
        .playback_direction = Animations::RustFFI::PlaybackDirection::Normal,
    };
    Optional<CSS::EasingFunction> timing_function;

    // NB: An end time cuts the active duration short. With an indefinite simple duration, the animation holds the
    //     value at its start for the active duration that remains.
    if (auto end_time = interval_end_time(); end_time.has_value()) {
        auto active_duration = *end_time - *begin_time;
        if (isinf(timing.iteration_duration.milliseconds)) {
            timing.iteration_duration.milliseconds = active_duration;
            timing.iteration_count = 1;
            timing_function = CSS::EasingFunction::parse("linear(0, 0)"_utf16);
        } else {
            timing.iteration_count = min(timing.iteration_count, active_duration / timing.iteration_duration.milliseconds);
        }
    }

    auto keyframe_set = keyframe_set_of(keyframes);
    auto timing_function_descriptor = timing_function.has_value() ? timing_function->descriptor() : CSS::EasingFunction::Descriptor {};
    Utf16FlyString timing_function_serialization = timing_function.has_value() ? Utf16FlyString { timing_function->to_utf16_string() } : Utf16FlyString {};
    Animations::RustFFI::FfiSmilAnimation description {
        .animation_element = this,
        .target = target.ptr(),
        .keyframes = keyframe_set.ptr(),
        .timing = timing,
        .timing_function = timing_function.has_value() ? &timing_function_descriptor : nullptr,
        .timing_function_serialization = timing_function_serialization.raw_identity(),
        .begin_time = *begin_time,
    };
    m_animation = Animations::AnimationRef::adopt(*Animations::RustFFI::animations_smil_animation_create(&description, Animations::web_animation_perform_host_effect));
    CSS::record_attr_names_read_by_keyframes(*target, keyframe_set);
    m_animation_time_container = time_container;
    time_container->add_animation(*m_animation);

    // NB: Time events are raised for intervals that begin from now on.
    if (!m_time_events_last_checked_time.has_value())
        m_time_events_last_checked_time = current_presentation_time();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGAnimationElement__getStartTime
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<float> SVGAnimationElement::get_start_time()
{
    // Returns the begin time, in seconds, for this animation element's current interval, if it exists, regardless of
    // whether the interval has begun yet. If there is no current interval, then a DOMException with code
    // INVALID_STATE_ERR is thrown.
    auto begin_time = is_connected() && time_container() ? interval_begin_time() : Optional<double> {};
    if (!begin_time.has_value())
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create(HTML::relevant_realm(*this), "The animation element has no current interval"_utf16);
    return static_cast<float>(*begin_time / 1000.);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGAnimationElement__getCurrentTime
float SVGAnimationElement::get_current_time()
{
    // Returns the current time in seconds relative to time zero for the given time container.
    // NB: Like SVGSVGElement.getCurrentTime(), return 0 until the timeline has begun, and for an animation element
    //     outside of an SVG document fragment.
    auto time_container = is_connected() ? this->time_container() : nullptr;
    if (!time_container || !time_container->has_begun())
        return 0;
    return static_cast<float>(time_container->current_time_in_milliseconds() / 1000.);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGAnimationElement__getSimpleDuration
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<float> SVGAnimationElement::get_simple_duration()
{
    // Returns the number of seconds for the simple duration for this animation. If the simple duration is undefined
    // (e.g., the end time is indefinite), then an exception is raised.
    // NB: The exception is a DOMException with code NOT_SUPPORTED_ERR.
    auto duration = simple_duration();
    if (isinf(duration))
        return WebIDL::NotSupportedError::create(HTML::relevant_realm(*this), "The simple duration is indefinite"_utf16);
    return static_cast<float>(duration / 1000.);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGAnimationElement__beginElement
void SVGAnimationElement::begin_element()
{
    // Creates a begin instance time for the current time. The new instance time is added to the begin instance times
    // list. The behavior of this method is equivalent to beginElementAt(0).
    begin_element_at(0);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGAnimationElement__beginElementAt
void SVGAnimationElement::begin_element_at(float offset)
{
    // NB: An animation element outside of an SVG document fragment has no timeline to create an instance time on.
    if (!is_connected() || !time_container())
        return;

    // Creates a begin instance time for the current time plus the specified offset. The new instance time is added to
    // the begin instance times list.
    // The instance time associated with a beginElementAt() or endElementAt() call is the current presentation time at
    // the time of the DOM method call, plus or minus the specified offset.
    auto current_time = current_presentation_time();
    auto instance_time = current_time + static_cast<double>(offset) * 1000.;

    // Note that beginElement() is subject to the ‘restart’ attribute in the same manner that event-based begin timing
    // is.
    switch (restart()) {
    case Restart::Always:
        // The animation can be restarted at any time.
        break;
    case Restart::WhenNotActive:
        // The animation can only be restarted when it is not active (i.e. after the active end). Attempts to restart
        // the animation during its active duration are ignored.
        if (is_active_at(current_time))
            return;
        break;
    case Restart::Never:
        // The element cannot be restarted for the remainder of the current simple duration of the parent time
        // container.
        if (auto begin_time = interval_begin_time(); begin_time.has_value() && *begin_time <= current_time)
            return;
        break;
    }

    // NB: An instance time that is still to come does not replace the begin of a current interval that begins
    //     before it, and that has not ended.
    // FIXME: Begin a new interval at such an instance time once it is reached.
    if (instance_time > current_time) {
        if (auto begin_time = interval_begin_time(); begin_time.has_value() && *begin_time <= instance_time
            && (current_time < *begin_time || is_active_at(current_time))) {
            return;
        }
    }

    // NB: The new interval ends only at an end instance time after its begin, so that one created at the same time
    //     by an earlier endElement() call does not end it at once.
    m_begin_instance_time_from_dom = instance_time;
    if (m_end_instance_time_from_dom.has_value() && *m_end_instance_time_from_dom <= instance_time)
        m_end_instance_time_from_dom.clear();
    update_animation();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGAnimationElement__endElement
void SVGAnimationElement::end_element()
{
    // Creates an end instance time for the current time. The new instance time is added to the end instance times
    // list. The behavior of this method is equivalent to endElementAt(0).
    end_element_at(0);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGAnimationElement__endElementAt
void SVGAnimationElement::end_element_at(float offset)
{
    // NB: An animation element outside of an SVG document fragment has no timeline to create an instance time on.
    if (!is_connected() || !time_container())
        return;

    // Creates a end instance time for the current time plus the specified offset. The new instance time is added to
    // the end instance times list.
    // The instance time associated with a beginElementAt() or endElementAt() call is the current presentation time at
    // the time of the DOM method call, plus or minus the specified offset.
    m_end_instance_time_from_dom = current_presentation_time() + static_cast<double>(offset) * 1000.;
    update_animation();
}

void SVGAnimationElement::queue_time_event(Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType type, i32 detail)
{
    // NB: Time events are dispatched along with the other animation events of the document, which creates each as it
    //     dispatches it, with the time stamp of now, and schedules each at the time of the animation's timeline.
    document().append_pending_animation_event(*m_animation, {
                                                                .kind = Animations::RustFFI::PendingAnimationEventKind::Time,
                                                                .css_event_type = {},
                                                                .playback_event_type = {},
                                                                .time_event_type = type,
                                                                .detail = detail,
                                                                .elapsed_time = 0,
                                                                .current_time = {},
                                                                .timeline_time = {},
                                                                .scheduled_event_time = {},
                                                                .time_stamp = HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(HTML::relevant_global_object(*this)),
                                                            });
}

void SVGAnimationElement::dispatch_pending_time_event(Animations::RustFFI::FfiPendingAnimationEvent const& pending_event)
{
    auto const& type = [&] -> Utf16FlyString const& {
        switch (pending_event.time_event_type) {
        case Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::Begin:
            return HTML::EventNames::beginEvent;
        case Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::End:
            return HTML::EventNames::endEvent;
        case Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::Repeat:
            return HTML::EventNames::repeatEvent;
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }();
    auto& document = this->document();
    auto event = create_time_event(HTML::relevant_realm(*this), type, document.window() ? document.window()->window().ptr() : nullptr, pending_event.detail, pending_event.time_stamp);
    dispatch_event(event);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#InterfaceTimeEvent
void SVGAnimationElement::queue_time_events_if_necessary()
{
    // FIXME: Raise time events for an animation element without a target or animated property too.
    auto time_container = is_connected() ? this->time_container() : nullptr;
    if (!m_animation.has_value() || !time_container || !time_container->has_begun())
        return;

    auto current_time = time_container->current_time_in_milliseconds();
    auto last_checked_time = exchange(m_time_events_last_checked_time, current_time);
    auto begin_time = interval_begin_time();
    auto is_active = is_active_at(current_time);

    // endEvent
    //     This event is raised at the active end of the element. Note that this event is not raised at the simple end
    //     of each repeat.
    //     Note that if an element is restarted while it is currently playing, the element will raise an end event and
    //     another begin event, as the element restarts.
    if (m_time_events_reported_active && (!is_active || begin_time != m_time_events_begin_time)) {
        m_time_events_reported_active = false;
        queue_time_event(Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::End);
    }

    // beginEvent
    //     This event is raised when the element local timeline begins to play. It will be raised each time the element
    //     begins the active duration (i.e. when it restarts, but not when it repeats).
    if (is_active && !m_time_events_reported_active) {
        m_time_events_reported_active = true;
        m_time_events_begin_time = begin_time;
        m_time_events_iteration = isinf(simple_duration()) ? 0 : floor((current_time - *begin_time) / simple_duration());
        queue_time_event(Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::Begin);
        return;
    }

    // NB: An interval that began and ended since the time events were last checked raises both events.
    if (!is_active && begin_time.has_value() && begin_time != m_time_events_begin_time && last_checked_time.has_value()
        && *begin_time >= *last_checked_time && *begin_time <= current_time) {
        m_time_events_begin_time = begin_time;
        queue_time_event(Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::Begin);
        queue_time_event(Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::End);
        return;
    }

    // repeatEvent
    //     This event is raised when an element local timeline repeats. It will be raised each time the element
    //     repeats, after the first iteration. The event provides a numerical indication of which repeat iteration is
    //     beginning. The value is a 0-based integer, but the repeat event is not raised for the first iteration and
    //     so the observed values of the detail attribute will be >= 1.
    if (is_active && !isinf(simple_duration())) {
        auto iteration = floor((current_time - *begin_time) / simple_duration());
        auto previous_iteration = exchange(m_time_events_iteration, iteration);
        if (iteration > previous_iteration)
            queue_time_event(Animations::RustFFI::TimeEventType::Repeat, static_cast<i32>(min(iteration, static_cast<double>(NumericLimits<i32>::max()))));
    }
}

}

    //     timeline it plays on.
    Optional<Animations::AnimationRef> m_animation;
    GC::Ptr<SMILTimeContainer> m_animation_time_container;

    //     fragment.
    Optional<double> m_begin_instance_time_from_dom;
    Optional<double> m_end_instance_time_from_dom;

    // NB: What the time events that were last queued said about the interval, and when they were queued.
    bool m_time_events_reported_active { false };
    Optional<double> m_time_events_begin_time;
    double m_time_events_iteration { 0 };
    Optional<double> m_time_events_last_checked_time;
};

    : SVGElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects-1/#element-attrdef-fecomponenttransfer-type
static SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type parse_type(Optional<Utf16String> const& value)
{
    if (value == "identity"sv)
        return SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type::Identity;
    if (value == "table"sv)
        return SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type::Table;
    if (value == "discrete"sv)
        return SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type::Discrete;
    if (value == "linear"sv)
        return SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type::Linear;
    if (value == "gamma"sv)
        return SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type::Gamma;

    return SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type::Unknown;
}

void SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value,
    Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    if (name == AttributeNames::tableValues && m_table_values)
        m_table_values->synchronize();

    // Clear our cached color table on any attribute change.
    m_cached_color_table.clear();
}

void SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_table_values);
    visitor.visit(m_slope);
    visitor.visit(m_intercept);
    visitor.visit(m_amplitude);
    visitor.visit(m_exponent);
    visitor.visit(m_offset);
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/filter-effects-1/#dom-svgcomponenttransferfunctionelement-type
// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects-1/#element-attrdef-fecomponenttransfer-type
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::type()
{
    static constexpr Array keywords {
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "identity"sv, to_underlying(Type::Identity) },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "table"sv, to_underlying(Type::Table) },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "discrete"sv, to_underlying(Type::Discrete) },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "linear"sv, to_underlying(Type::Linear) },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "gamma"sv, to_underlying(Type::Gamma) },
    };
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::type, keywords, to_underlying(Type::Identity));
}

SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::Type SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::type_from_attribute() const
{
    return parse_type(get_attribute_value(AttributeNames::type));
}

Vector<float> SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::table_float_values()
{
    Vector<float> values;
    auto table_numbers = table_values()->base_val()->items();
    values.ensure_capacity(table_numbers.size());
    for (auto& svg_number : table_numbers)
        values.unchecked_append(svg_number->value());
    return values;
}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#element-attrdef-fecomponenttransfer-type
ReadonlyBytes SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement::color_table()
{
    if (m_cached_color_table.has_value())
        return m_cached_color_table.value();

    ByteBuffer result;
    result.resize(256);

    auto set_identity = [&result] {
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i)
            result.data()[i] = i;
    };
    auto to_u8 = [](float value) {
        return AK::clamp_to<u8>(value * 255.f);
    };

    switch (type_from_attribute()) {
    // https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#attr-valuedef-type-identity
    case Type::Unknown:
    case Type::Identity:
        set_identity();
        break;

    // https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#attr-valuedef-type-table
    case Type::Table: {
        auto table_values = table_float_values();

        // An empty list results in an identity transfer function.
        if (table_values.is_empty()) {
            set_identity();
            break;
        }

        // For a value C < 1 find k such that: k/n <= C < (k+1)/n
        // The result C' is given by: C' = vk + (C - k/n)*n * (vk+1 - vk)
        auto const segments = table_values.size() - 1.f;
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
            // If C = 1 then: C' = vn.
            if (i == 255 || segments == 0.f) {
                result.data()[i] = to_u8(table_values.last());
                continue;
            }

            auto offset = i / 255.f;
            auto segment_index = static_cast<size_t>(offset * segments);
            auto segment_start = segment_index / segments;
            auto offset_in_segment = offset - segment_start;
            auto segment_length = 1.f / segments;
            auto progress_in_segment = offset_in_segment / segment_length;

            auto segment_value = mix(table_values[segment_index], table_values[segment_index + 1], progress_in_segment);
            result.data()[i] = to_u8(segment_value);
        }
        break;
    }

    // https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#attr-valuedef-type-discrete
    case Type::Discrete: {
        auto table_values = table_float_values();

        // An empty list results in an identity transfer function.
        if (table_values.is_empty()) {
            set_identity();
            break;
        }

        // For a value C < 1 find k such that: k/n <= C < (k+1)/n
        // The result C' is given by: C' = vk + (C - k/n)*n * (vk+1 - vk)
        for (int i = 0; i < 255; ++i) {
            auto index = static_cast<size_t>(i / 255.f * table_values.size());
            result.data()[i] = to_u8(table_values[index]);
        }

        // If C = 1 then: C' = vn.
        result.data()[255] = to_u8(table_values.last());
        break;
    }

    // https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#attr-valuedef-type-linear
    case Type::Linear: {
        auto slope = this->slope()->base_val();
        auto intercept = this->intercept()->base_val();
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i)
            result.data()[i] = to_u8(slope * i / 255.f + intercept);
        break;
    }

    // https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#attr-valuedef-type-gamma
    case Type::Gamma: {
        auto amplitude = this->amplitude()->base_val();
        auto exponent = this->exponent()->base_val();
        auto offset = this->offset()->base_val();
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i)
            result.data()[i] = to_u8(amplitude * AK::pow<float>(i / 255.f, exponent) + offset);
        break;
    }
    }

    m_cached_color_table = move(result);
    return m_cached_color_table.value();
}

}

class SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement
    : public SVGElement {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement, SVGElement);

public:
    enum class Type : u8 {
        Unknown = 0,
        Identity = 1,
        Table = 2,
        Discrete = 3,
        Linear = 4,
        Gamma = 5,
    };

    virtual ~SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement() override = default;

    virtual void attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_) override;

    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> type();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumberList> table_values();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> slope();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> intercept();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> amplitude();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> exponent();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> offset();

    Vector<float> table_float_values();
    ReadonlyBytes color_table();

protected:
    SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement(DOM::Document&, DOM::QualifiedName);

private:
    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

    Type type_from_attribute() const;

    GC::Ptr<SVGAnimatedNumberList> m_table_values;
    GC::Ptr<SVGAnimatedNumber> m_slope;
    GC::Ptr<SVGAnimatedNumber> m_intercept;
    GC::Ptr<SVGAnimatedNumber> m_amplitude;
    GC::Ptr<SVGAnimatedNumber> m_exponent;
    GC::Ptr<SVGAnimatedNumber> m_offset;

    Optional<ByteBuffer> m_cached_color_table;
};
