FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/SVG/SVGFEMorphologyElement.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2025, Tim Ledbetter <tim.ledbetter@ladybird.org>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeNames.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGFEMorphologyElement.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGFEMorphologyElement);

SVGFEMorphologyElement::SVGFEMorphologyElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : SVGElement(document, qualified_name)
{
}

void SVGFEMorphologyElement::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGFilterPrimitiveStandardAttributes::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_in1);
    visitor.visit(m_radius_x);
    visitor.visit(m_radius_y);
}

void SVGFEMorphologyElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& new_value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, new_value, namespace_);

    if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::operator_) {
        if (!new_value.has_value()) {
            m_morphology_operator = Gfx::MorphologyOperator::Dilate;
            return;
        }
        if (new_value->equals_ignoring_ascii_case("erode"sv)) {
            m_morphology_operator = Gfx::MorphologyOperator::Erode;
        } else if (new_value->equals_ignoring_ascii_case("dilate"sv)) {
            m_morphology_operator = Gfx::MorphologyOperator::Dilate;
        } else {
            m_morphology_operator = Gfx::MorphologyOperator::Dilate;
        }
    }
}

GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedString> SVGFEMorphologyElement::in1()
{
    if (!m_in1)
        m_in1 = SVGAnimatedString::create(*this, DOM::QualifiedName { AttributeNames::in, OptionalNone {}, OptionalNone {} });

    return *m_in1;
}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#dom-svgfemorphologyelement-operator
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGFEMorphologyElement::operator_for_bindings()
{
    static constexpr Array keywords {
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "erode"sv, SVG_MORPHOLOGY_OPERATOR_ERODE },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "dilate"sv, SVG_MORPHOLOGY_OPERATOR_DILATE },
    };
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::operator_, keywords, SVG_MORPHOLOGY_OPERATOR_ERODE);
}

GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> SVGFEMorphologyElement::radius_x()
{
    if (!m_radius_x)

GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> SVGFETurbulenceElement::seed()
{
    if (!m_seed)
        m_seed = SVGAnimatedNumber::create(*this, DOM::QualifiedName { AttributeNames::seed, OptionalNone {}, OptionalNone {} }, 0);

    return *m_seed;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#element-attrdef-feturbulence-stitchtiles
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGFETurbulenceElement::stitch_tiles()
{
    static constexpr Array keywords {
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "stitch"sv, to_underlying(StitchType::Stitch) },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "noStitch"sv, to_underlying(StitchType::NoStitch) },
    };
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::stitchTiles, keywords, to_underlying(StitchType::NoStitch));
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#dom-svgfeturbulenceelement-type
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGFETurbulenceElement::type()
{
    static constexpr Array keywords {
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "fractalNoise"sv, to_underlying(TurbulenceType::FractalNoise) },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "turbulence"sv, to_underlying(TurbulenceType::Turbulence) },
    };
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::type, keywords, to_underlying(TurbulenceType::Turbulence));
}

// A view of a string's code units for the Rust graph builder, valid for as long as the string is.
Layout::RustFFI::FfiUtf16View view_of(Utf16View view)
{
    return {
        .latin1 = view.has_latin1_storage() ? view.latin1_span().data() : nullptr,
        .utf16 = view.has_latin1_storage() ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<u16 const*>(view.utf16_span().data()),
        .length = view.length_in_code_units(),
    };
}

}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects-1/#ColorInterpolationFiltersProperty
void SVGFilterElement::push_primitives(void* sink, Gfx::IntSize dest_size)
{
    using PrimitiveKind = Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgFilterPrimitiveKind;

    auto operating_color_space = [](DOM::Element const& element) {
        // linearRGB performs color operations in the linear-light sRGB color space; auto and sRGB use gamma-encoded sRGB.
        auto const* svg_values = element.style_group<CSS::ComputedValues::InheritedSVGValues>();
        auto color_interpolation_filters = svg_values ? svg_values->color_interpolation_filters_value() : CSS::ColorInterpolation::Linearrgb;
        return CSS::to_interpolation_color_space(color_interpolation_filters);
    };

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1/#FilterEffectsRegion
    // A coordinate or length attribute, as a number of user units or a percentage.
    // FIXME: Resolve font-relative lengths and math functions too.
    auto parsed_attribute = [](DOM::Element const& element, Utf16FlyString const& name) -> Optional<NumberPercentage> {
        auto value = element.get_attribute(name);
        if (!value.has_value())
            return {};
        auto parsed = SVGLength::parse_scalar_value(*value);
        if (!parsed.has_value())
            return {};
        switch (parsed->kind()) {
        case SVGLengthValue::Kind::Number:
            return NumberPercentage::create_number(parsed->value());
        case SVGLengthValue::Kind::Percentage:
            return NumberPercentage::create_percentage(parsed->value());
        case SVGLengthValue::Kind::Length: {
            auto length = parsed->to_length();
            // A zero length is zero in any unit, so it resolves even where its unit doesn't yet.
            if (length.raw_value() == 0)
                return NumberPercentage::create_number(0);
            if (!length.is_absolute())
                return {};
            return NumberPercentage::create_number(length.absolute_length_to_px_without_rounding());
        }
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    };
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgFilterRegion region {
        .filter_units_are_object_bounding_box = filter_units()->base_val() == to_underlying(SVGUnitType::ObjectBoundingBox),
        .primitive_units_are_object_bounding_box = primitive_units()->base_val() == to_underlying(SVGUnitType::ObjectBoundingBox),
        // If the attribute is not specified, the effect is as if a value of -10% (x, y) or 120% (width, height) were
        // specified.
        .x = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(parsed_attribute(*this, AttributeNames::x).value_or(NumberPercentage::create_percentage(-10))),
        .y = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(parsed_attribute(*this, AttributeNames::y).value_or(NumberPercentage::create_percentage(-10))),
        .width = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(parsed_attribute(*this, AttributeNames::width).value_or(NumberPercentage::create_percentage(120))),
        .height = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(parsed_attribute(*this, AttributeNames::height).value_or(NumberPercentage::create_percentage(120))),
    };
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_arena_paint_set_svg_filter_region(sink, &region);

    for_each_child_of_type<DOM::Element>([&](auto& node) {
        Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgFilterPrimitive primitive {};
        auto& values = primitive.values;
        values.operating_color_space = operating_color_space(node);

        // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1/#FilterPrimitiveSubRegion
        // An attribute the primitive doesn't specify takes its value from the default subregion, which depends on the
        // primitive's inputs, so the builder resolves that.
        auto set_subregion_attribute = [&](Utf16FlyString const& name, auto& field, u8 specified_bit) {
            if (auto value = parsed_attribute(node, name); value.has_value()) {
                field = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(*value);
                values.subregion_specified |= specified_bit;
            }
        };
        set_subregion_attribute(AttributeNames::x, values.subregion_x, 1 << 0);
        set_subregion_attribute(AttributeNames::y, values.subregion_y, 1 << 1);
        set_subregion_attribute(AttributeNames::width, values.subregion_width, 1 << 2);
        set_subregion_attribute(AttributeNames::height, values.subregion_height, 1 << 3);

        // The builder copies what the primitive's views point at while it is pushed, so this
        // storage only has to outlive the push.
        Utf16String in1;
        Utf16String in2;
        Utf16String result;
        Vector<Utf16String> merge_input_names;
        Vector<Layout::RustFFI::FfiUtf16View> merge_inputs;
        Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> image_frame;
        Vector<float> color_matrix_values;

        auto set_in1 = [&](auto& filter_primitive) { in1 = filter_primitive.in1()->base_val(); };
        auto set_in2 = [&](auto& filter_primitive) { in2 = filter_primitive.in2()->base_val(); };
        auto set_result = [&](auto& filter_primitive) { result = filter_primitive.result()->base_val(); };

        if (auto* flood_primitive = as_if<SVGFEFloodElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Flood;
            values.flood_color = flood_primitive->flood_color();
            values.flood_opacity = flood_primitive->flood_opacity();
            set_result(*flood_primitive);
        } else if (auto* blend_primitive = as_if<SVGFEBlendElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Blend;
            values.blend_mode = blend_primitive->mode();
            set_in1(*blend_primitive);
            set_in2(*blend_primitive);
            set_result(*blend_primitive);
        } else if (auto* component_transfer = as_if<SVGFEComponentTransferElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::ComponentTransfer;
            // https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#feComponentTransferElement
            // * If more than one transfer function element of the same kind is specified, the last occurrence is to be
            //   used.
            // * If any of the transfer function elements are unspecified, the feComponentTransfer must be processed as
            //   if those transfer function elements were specified with their type attributes set to identity.
            Array<GC::Ptr<SVGComponentTransferFunctionElement>, 4> argb_function_elements;
            node.for_each_child([&](auto& child) {
                if (auto* func_a = as_if<SVGFEFuncAElement>(child))
                    argb_function_elements[0] = func_a;
                else if (auto* func_r = as_if<SVGFEFuncRElement>(child))
                    argb_function_elements[1] = func_r;
                else if (auto* func_g = as_if<SVGFEFuncGElement>(child))
                    argb_function_elements[2] = func_g;
                else if (auto* func_b = as_if<SVGFEFuncBElement>(child))
                    argb_function_elements[3] = func_b;
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            });
            for (size_t channel = 0; channel < argb_function_elements.size(); ++channel) {
                if (argb_function_elements[channel])
                    primitive.component_transfer_tables[channel] = argb_function_elements[channel]->color_table().data();
            }
            set_in1(*component_transfer);
            set_result(*component_transfer);
        } else if (auto* composite_primitive = as_if<SVGFECompositeElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Composite;
            values.composite_operator = to_underlying(composite_primitive->operator_());
            values.k1 = composite_primitive->k1()->base_val();
            values.k2 = composite_primitive->k2()->base_val();
            values.k3 = composite_primitive->k3()->base_val();
            values.k4 = composite_primitive->k4()->base_val();
            set_in1(*composite_primitive);
            set_in2(*composite_primitive);
            set_result(*composite_primitive);
        } else if (auto* blur_primitive = as_if<SVGFEGaussianBlurElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::GaussianBlur;
            values.std_deviation_x = blur_primitive->std_deviation_x()->base_val();
            values.std_deviation_y = blur_primitive->std_deviation_y()->base_val();
            set_in1(*blur_primitive);
            set_result(*blur_primitive);
        } else if (auto* colormatrix_primitive = as_if<SVGFEColorMatrixElement>(node)) {
            auto type = colormatrix_primitive->type()->base_val();
            if (type == SVGFEColorMatrixElement::SVG_FECOLORMATRIX_TYPE_UNKNOWN) {
                dbgln("SVGFEColorMatrixElement: Unknown type '{}' — skipping filter primitive", colormatrix_primitive->attribute(AttributeNames::type).value_or({}));
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            }
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::ColorMatrix;
            values.color_matrix_type = type;
            color_matrix_values = parse_table_values(colormatrix_primitive->attribute(AttributeNames::values).value_or({}));
            primitive.color_matrix_values = color_matrix_values.data();
            primitive.color_matrix_value_count = color_matrix_values.size();
            set_in1(*colormatrix_primitive);
            set_result(*colormatrix_primitive);
        } else if (auto* image_primitive = as_if<SVGFEImageElement>(node)) {
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1/#feImageElement
            // An feImage whose image can't be rendered produces transparent black, which the builder makes of an Image
            // primitive without a frame.
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Image;
            set_result(*image_primitive);
            auto image_data = image_primitive->image_data();
            // A vector image draws at whatever size it's asked for, letterboxing itself into a size of another aspect
            // ratio. So ask for a frame of the image's own aspect ratio, large enough to cover the filtered element,
            // but no larger along either axis than the largest frame that size would ask for anyway.
            auto natural_width = image_data ? image_data->intrinsic_width().map([](auto width) { return width.to_float(); }).value_or(0) : 0;
            auto natural_height = image_data ? image_data->intrinsic_height().map([](auto height) { return height.to_float(); }).value_or(0) : 0;
            // An image missing a width or a height (an SVG with only a viewBox, e.g.) still has an aspect ratio, which
            // the missing dimensions follow — so it fits the subregion at that ratio.
            if (image_data && (natural_width <= 0 || natural_height <= 0)) {
                if (auto aspect_ratio = image_data->intrinsic_aspect_ratio(); aspect_ratio.has_value() && aspect_ratio->to_float() > 0) {
                    auto ratio = aspect_ratio->to_float();
                    if (natural_width > 0) {
                        natural_height = natural_width / ratio;
                    } else if (natural_height > 0) {
                        natural_width = natural_height * ratio;
                    } else {
                        natural_width = ratio;
                        natural_height = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            auto frame_size = dest_size;
            if (natural_width > 0 && natural_height > 0 && !dest_size.is_empty()) {
                auto largest_side = static_cast<float>(max(dest_size.width(), dest_size.height()));
                auto scale = max(dest_size.width() / natural_width, dest_size.height() / natural_height);
                scale = min(scale, largest_side / max(natural_width, natural_height));
                frame_size = { max(1, static_cast<int>(ceilf(natural_width * scale))), max(1, static_cast<int>(ceilf(natural_height * scale))) };
            }
            if (image_data)
                image_frame = image_data->default_frame(frame_size);
            if (!image_frame.has_value()) {
                primitive.in1 = view_of(in1);
                primitive.in2 = view_of(in2);
                primitive.result = view_of(result);
                Layout::RustFFI::layout_arena_paint_push_svg_filter_primitive(sink, &primitive);
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            }

            values.image_src_rect = { 0, 0, image_frame->width(), image_frame->height() };
            values.image_natural_width = natural_width;
            values.image_natural_height = natural_height;
            PreserveAspectRatio preserve_aspect_ratio {};
            if (auto value = image_primitive->get_attribute(AttributeNames::preserveAspectRatio); value.has_value())
                preserve_aspect_ratio = parse_preserve_aspect_ratio(*value).value_or({});
            values.image_preserve_aspect_ratio_align = to_underlying(preserve_aspect_ratio.align);
            values.image_preserve_aspect_ratio_meet_or_slice = to_underlying(preserve_aspect_ratio.meet_or_slice);
            primitive.image_frame = &image_frame.value();
        } else if (auto* merge_primitive = as_if<SVGFEMergeElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Merge;
            merge_primitive->template for_each_child_of_type<SVGFEMergeNodeElement>([&](auto& merge_node) {
                merge_input_names.append(merge_node.in1()->base_val());
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            });
            for (auto const& merge_input_name : merge_input_names)
                merge_inputs.append(view_of(merge_input_name));
            primitive.merge_inputs = merge_inputs.data();
            primitive.merge_input_count = merge_inputs.size();
            set_result(*merge_primitive);
        } else if (auto* morphology_primitive = as_if<SVGFEMorphologyElement>(node)) {
            auto morphology_operator = morphology_primitive->morphology_operator();
            if (morphology_operator == Gfx::MorphologyOperator::Unknown) {
                dbgln("SVGFEMorphologyElement: Unknown operator — skipping filter primitive");
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            }
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Morphology;
            values.morphology_operator = to_underlying(morphology_operator);
            values.radius_x = morphology_primitive->radius_x()->base_val();
            values.radius_y = morphology_primitive->radius_y()->base_val();
            set_in1(*morphology_primitive);
            set_result(*morphology_primitive);
        } else if (auto* offset_primitive = as_if<SVGFEOffsetElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Offset;
            values.dx = offset_primitive->dx()->base_val();
            values.dy = offset_primitive->dy()->base_val();
            set_in1(*offset_primitive);
            set_result(*offset_primitive);
        } else if (auto* drop_shadow = as_if<SVGFEDropShadowElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::DropShadow;
            values.std_deviation_x = drop_shadow->std_deviation_x()->base_val();
            values.std_deviation_y = drop_shadow->std_deviation_y()->base_val();
            values.dx = drop_shadow->dx()->base_val();
            values.dy = drop_shadow->dy()->base_val();
            values.flood_color = drop_shadow->flood_color();
            values.flood_opacity = drop_shadow->flood_opacity();
            set_in1(*drop_shadow);
            set_result(*drop_shadow);
        } else if (auto* turbulence = as_if<SVGFETurbulenceElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::Turbulence;
            values.turbulence_type = turbulence->type()->base_val();
            values.base_frequency_x = turbulence->base_frequency_x()->base_val();
            values.base_frequency_y = turbulence->base_frequency_y()->base_val();
            values.num_octaves = turbulence->num_octaves()->base_val();
            values.seed = turbulence->seed()->base_val();
            values.turbulence_stitches_tiles = turbulence->stitch_tiles()->base_val() == to_underlying(SVGFETurbulenceElement::StitchType::Stitch);
            if (values.turbulence_stitches_tiles) {
                // FIXME: Use the correct width and height
                auto maybe_width = turbulence->width()->base_val()->value();
                auto maybe_height = turbulence->height()->base_val()->value();
                values.stitch_tile_width = maybe_width.is_exception() ? 0 : maybe_width.release_value();
                values.stitch_tile_height = maybe_height.is_exception() ? 0 : maybe_height.release_value();
            }
            set_result(*turbulence);
        } else if (auto* displacement_map = as_if<SVGFEDisplacementMapElement>(node)) {
            values.kind = PrimitiveKind::DisplacementMap;
            values.scale = displacement_map->scale()->base_val();
            values.x_channel_selector = displacement_map->x_channel_selector()->base_val();
            values.y_channel_selector = displacement_map->y_channel_selector()->base_val();
            set_in1(*displacement_map);
            set_in2(*displacement_map);
            set_result(*displacement_map);
        } else {
            dbgln("SVGFilterElement::push_primitives(): Unknown or unsupported filter element '{}'", node.debug_description());
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        }

        primitive.in1 = view_of(in1);
        primitive.in2 = view_of(in2);
        primitive.result = view_of(result);
        Layout::RustFFI::layout_arena_paint_push_svg_filter_primitive(sink, &primitive);
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#element-attrdef-filter-filterunits
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGFilterElement::filter_units()
{
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::filterUnits, svg_unit_type_keywords, to_underlying(SVGUnitType::ObjectBoundingBox));
}

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#element-attrdef-filter-primitiveunits
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGFilterElement::primitive_units()
{
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::primitiveUnits, svg_unit_type_keywords, to_underlying(SVGUnitType::UserSpaceOnUse));
}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeParsing.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGAnimatedEnumeration.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGURIReference.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

// https://drafts.fxtf.org/filter-effects/#elementdef-filter
class SVGFilterElement final
    : public SVGElement
    , public SVGURIReferenceMixin<SupportsXLinkHref::No> {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGFilterElement, SVGElement);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGFilterElement);

public:
    virtual ~SVGFilterElement() override = default;

    virtual bool is_svg_filter_element() const final { return true; }

    // Hands every supported child primitive to the Rust primitive list behind `sink` as attribute
    // facts, with the frame an feImage draws for the list to retain.
    void push_primitives(void* sink, Gfx::IntSize dest_size);

    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> filter_units();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> primitive_units();

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1#dom-svgfilterelement-x

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1#dom-svgfilterelement-y
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(y, Vertical, SVGLengthValue::percentage(-10));

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1#dom-svgfilterelement-width
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(width, Horizontal, SVGLengthValue::percentage(120));

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects-1#dom-svgfilterelement-height
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(height, Vertical, SVGLengthValue::percentage(120));

private:
    SVGFilterElement(DOM::Document&, DOM::QualifiedName);
    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;
};

/*

 */

#include <LibWeb/DOM/Element.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/Node.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeNames.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGAnimatedRect.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGFitToViewBox.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

void SVGFitToViewBox::initialize_fit_to_view_box(SVGElement& element)
{
    m_view_box_for_bindings = SVGAnimatedRect::create();
    m_preserve_aspect_ratio_for_bindings = SVGAnimatedPreserveAspectRatio::create(element);
}

void SVGFitToViewBox::visit_edges(JS::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    visitor.visit(m_view_box_for_bindings);
    visitor.visit(m_preserve_aspect_ratio_for_bindings);
}

void SVGFitToViewBox::attribute_changed(DOM::Element& element, Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& value)
{
    if (name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(SVG::AttributeNames::viewBox)) {
        // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#InterfaceSVGAnimatedRect
        // 1. Let value be the value of the reflected attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is not present or invalid).
        m_view_box = parse_viewbox(value.value_or({}));

        // 2. Let x, y, width and height be those corresponding components of value.
        auto rect = m_view_box.has_value()
            ? Gfx::DoubleRect { m_view_box->min_x, m_view_box->min_y, m_view_box->width, m_view_box->height }
            : Gfx::DoubleRect {};

        // 3. Set the DOMRect object's x coordinate, y coordinate, width and height to x, y, width and height, respectively.
        m_view_box_for_bindings->set_base_val(rect);
        m_view_box_for_bindings->set_anim_val(rect);
        element.set_needs_layout_update(DOM::SetNeedsLayoutReason::SVGViewBoxChange);
    } else if (name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(SVG::AttributeNames::preserveAspectRatio)) {
        m_preserve_aspect_ratio = parse_preserve_aspect_ratio(value.value_or({}));
        element.set_needs_layout_update(DOM::SetNeedsLayoutReason::SVGViewBoxChange);
    }
}

}

// The style of an element outside the document, where no rule reaches it: the style engine cascades its own
// presentation attributes and inline style over the initial values, or none where the engine computes none.
static CSS::InstalledStyle declared_only_style(Layout::BegunRead const& read, CSS::StyleComputer& style_computer, DOM::Document const& document, SVGGeometryElement& element)
{
    auto hints = CSS::StyleComputer::collect_presentational_hint_properties({ element });
    Vector<CSS::Parser::ValueParserFFI::FfiDeclaredProperty> declarations;
    declarations.ensure_capacity(hints.size());
    for (auto const& hint : hints) {
        declarations.unchecked_append({
            .property_id = to_underlying(hint.property_id),
            .important = hint.important == CSS::Important::Yes,
            .value = hint.value->rust_style_value_data(),
            .name = {},
        });
    }
    return CSS::InstalledStyle::adopt(CSS::StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_declared_only_record(
        style_computer.style_engine().host(),
        &read, document.style_node_id().value(),
        CSS::element_box_type_adjustment_facts(element),
        CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiElementDeclarationKind::SvgPresentationAttribute,
        declarations.data(),
        declarations.size(),
        element.inline_style_declarations()));
}

// The geometry of the element in user units, which the geometry queries such as getTotalLength() measure. It is empty
// for an element without style.
bool SVGGeometryElement::with_computed_values(Function<void(CSSPixelSize viewport_size, CSS::ComputedValues const&)> const& callback)
{
    // NB: Update layout so that the viewport size is resolved correctly
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document() };
    document().update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::SVGPathLength);

    auto viewport_size = viewport_size_for_percentage_resolution(read);

    // NB: Update style for the element so that the correct computed values are used to generate the path - this is done
    //     separately from the layout update above since it may have been skipped if the element was display: none.
    document().update_style_for_element(*this);

    if (auto computed_values = computed_style()) {
        callback({ viewport_size.width(), viewport_size.height() }, *computed_values);
        return true;
    }

    // NB: An element with no style is either in a subtree that is not rendered, which the style engine answers
    //     without installing anything, or outside the document, where no rule reaches it. The engine of the window's
    //     document computes the latter, as an element's own document may never have been styled, like the one
    //     holding a template's contents, whose elements have no style even where they are connected.
    auto const computes_in_own_document = style_node_id() != CSS::StyleNodeID {} && !document().created_for_appropriate_template_contents();
    auto& style_document = computes_in_own_document ? document() : HTML::relevant_window(*this).associated_document();
    // NB: The engine of the window's document owns that document from its first style update, which may not have run.
    if (!computes_in_own_document)
        style_document.update_style();
    auto& style_computer = style_document.style_computer();
    // The style comes from the engine of the document that computes it, as that document's read.
    Layout::ForcedReadScope style_read { style_document };
    auto style = computes_in_own_document
        ? CSS::InstalledStyle { style_computer.style_engine().answer_record_demand(style_read, style_node_id(), CSS::StyleEngine::RecordDemand::ElementRead).record.host_record }
        : declared_only_style(style_read, style_computer, style_document, *this);
    if (!style)
        return false;
    auto view = style_computer.computed_style_record_view(style);
    callback({ viewport_size.width(), viewport_size.height() }, *view);
    return true;
}

// The shape element whose geometry `measure` measures, with what the element parses and the given computed values,
// which Rust builds the geometry from with the same shape builders layout uses.
template<typename Measure>
static auto measure_geometry(SVGGeometryElement const& element, CSSPixelSize viewport_size, CSS::ComputedValues const& computed_values, Measure measure)
{
    // NB: The groups are laid out as a style record's are, so the shape reads them as the element's style.
    Array<void const*, to_underlying(CSS::StyleGroupIndex::Count)> payloads;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < payloads.size(); ++index)
        payloads[index] = computed_values.style_group_payload(static_cast<CSS::StyleGroupIndex>(index));
    CSS::StyleRecordGroupsOverPayloads groups { payloads, computed_values.inherited_set_values(), computed_values.reset_bits() };
    auto points = Layout::svg_shape_points(element);
    static_assert(sizeof(Gfx::FloatPoint) == sizeof(Layout::RustFFI::FfiFloatPoint));
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGeometryElementShape shape {
        .geometry = Layout::svg_geometry_facts(element),
        .style = &groups,
        .points = reinterpret_cast<Layout::RustFFI::FfiFloatPoint const*>(points.data()),
        .point_count = points.size(),
        .viewport_size = viewport_size,
    };
    return measure(shape);
}

Vector<PathVertex> SVGGeometryElement::equivalent_path_vertices()
{
    Vector<PathVertex> vertices;
    with_computed_values([&](CSSPixelSize viewport_size, CSS::ComputedValues const& computed_values) {
        measure_geometry(*this, viewport_size, computed_values, [&](auto const& shape) {
            Layout::RustFFI::svg_geometry_element_vertices(&shape, &vertices, append_path_vertices);
        });
    });
    return vertices;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGeometryElement__isPointInFill
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<bool> SVGGeometryElement::is_point_in_fill(Bindings::DOMPointInit const& point)
{
    // The isPointInFill method, when invoked, must return true if the point given by point passed to the method, in
    // the coordinate space of an element, is inside the intended path as determined by the winding rule indicated by
    // the fill-rule property of an element; and must return false otherwise. Open subpaths must be implicitly closed
    // when computing the area inside the path, without affecting the actual subpaths. Points on the path itself must be
    // considered to be inside the path.
    // NB: svg_geometry_element_fill_contains() closes open subpaths and counts points on the path as inside.

    // The returned value is independent of any visual CSS property but fill-rule
    // If either of the x or y properties on point are infinite or NaN, then the method must return false.
    if (!isfinite(point.x) || !isfinite(point.y))
        return false;

    // If current element is a non-rendered element, and the UA is not able to compute the geometry of the element,
    // then throw an InvalidStateError.
    bool is_point_in_fill = false;
    auto has_geometry = with_computed_values([&](CSSPixelSize viewport_size, CSS::ComputedValues const& computed_values) {
        is_point_in_fill = measure_geometry(*this, viewport_size, computed_values, [&](auto const& shape) {
            return Layout::RustFFI::svg_geometry_element_fill_contains(&shape, static_cast<float>(point.x), static_cast<float>(point.y));
        });
    });
    if (!has_geometry)
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create(HTML::relevant_realm(*this), "The element's geometry cannot be computed"_utf16);
    return is_point_in_fill;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGeometryElement__isPointInStroke
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<bool> SVGGeometryElement::is_point_in_stroke(Bindings::DOMPointInit const& point)
{
    // The isPointInStroke method, when invoked, must return true if the point given by point passed to the method, in
    // the coordinate space of an element, is in or on the outline path of an applied stroke on an element; and must
    // return false otherwise.
    // The outline path must take the stroke properties stroke-width, stroke-linecap, stroke-linejoin,
    // stroke-miterlimit, stroke-dasharray, stroke-dashoffset and vector-effect of an element into account.
    // The returned value is independent of any visual CSS property but the listed stroke properties.
    // If either of the x or y properties on point are infinite or NaN, then the method must return false.
    if (!isfinite(point.x) || !isfinite(point.y))
        return false;

    // NB: The host coordinate space of a non-scaling stroke is the coordinate space of the element's viewport.
    // FIXME: A single scale factor is only right for a uniform scale. Stroke a non-scaling stroke in the host
    //        coordinate space instead, so that a non-uniform scale or a skew is accounted for.
    float host_scale = 1;
    if (auto ctm = get_ctm()) {
        auto elements = ctm->elements();
        host_scale = AK::sqrt(AK::fabs(static_cast<float>((elements[0] * elements[5]) - (elements[1] * elements[4]))));
    }

    // If current element is a non-rendered element, and the UA is not able to compute the geometry of the element,
    // then throw an InvalidStateError.
    bool is_point_in_stroke = false;
    auto has_geometry = with_computed_values([&](CSSPixelSize viewport_size, CSS::ComputedValues const& computed_values) {
        is_point_in_stroke = measure_geometry(*this, viewport_size, computed_values, [&](auto const& shape) {
            // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/paths.html#PathLengthAttribute
            // The user agent will scale all distance-along-a-path computations by the ratio of ‘pathLength’ to the
            // user agent's own computed value for total path length.
            // A value of zero is valid and must be treated as a scaling factor of infinity.
            float dash_scale = 1;
            if (auto path_length = author_path_length(); path_length.has_value() && *path_length == 0)
                dash_scale = AK::Infinity<float>;
            else if (path_length.has_value() && *path_length > 0)
                dash_scale = Layout::RustFFI::svg_geometry_element_total_length(&shape) / *path_length;
            return Layout::RustFFI::svg_geometry_element_stroke_contains(&shape, dash_scale, host_scale, static_cast<float>(point.x), static_cast<float>(point.y));
        });
    });
    if (!has_geometry)
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create(HTML::relevant_realm(*this), "The element's geometry cannot be computed"_utf16);
    return is_point_in_stroke;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGeometryElement__getTotalLength
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<float> SVGGeometryElement::get_total_length()
{
    // When getTotalLength() is called, the user agent's computed value for the total length of the path, in user units,
    // is returned.
    float total_length = 0;
    with_computed_values([&](CSSPixelSize viewport_size, CSS::ComputedValues const& computed_values) {
        total_length = measure_geometry(*this, viewport_size, computed_values, [](auto const& shape) {
            return Layout::RustFFI::svg_geometry_element_total_length(&shape);
        });
    });
    return total_length;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGeometryElement__getPointAtLength
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMPoint>> SVGGeometryElement::get_point_at_length(float distance)
{
    // When getPointAtLength(distance) is called, the following steps are run:
    // 1. If current element is a non-rendered element, and the UA is not able to compute the total length of the path,
    //    then throw an InvalidStateError.
    // NB: Like other engines, throw for an empty path whether or not the element is rendered.
    Optional<Gfx::FloatPoint> point_along_path;
    with_computed_values([&](CSSPixelSize viewport_size, CSS::ComputedValues const& computed_values) {
        measure_geometry(*this, viewport_size, computed_values, [&](auto const& shape) {
            Layout::RustFFI::FfiFloatPoint point;
            if (Layout::RustFFI::svg_geometry_element_point_at_length(&shape, distance, &point))
                point_along_path = Gfx::FloatPoint { point.x, point.y };
        });
    });
    if (!point_along_path.has_value())
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create(HTML::relevant_realm(*this), "The element's path is empty"_utf16);

    // 2. Let length be the user agent's computed value for the total length of the path, in user units.
    // 3. Clamp distance to [0, length].
    // 4. Let (x, y) be the point on the path at distance distance.
    // NB: svg_geometry_element_point_at_length() clamps the distance to the ends of the path.

    // 5. Return a newly created, detached DOMPoint object representing the point (x, y).
    return Geometry::DOMPoint::create(point_along_path->x(), point_along_path->y(), 0, 1);
}

void SVGGeometryElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    // The pathLength scales the dashes of the stroke, which layout reads with the element's geometry.
    if (name == AttributeNames::pathLength && !namespace_.has_value() && old_value != value)
        set_needs_layout_update(DOM::SetNeedsLayoutReason::StyleChange);
}

Optional<float> SVGGeometryElement::author_path_length() const
{
    return parse_number(get_attribute_value(AttributeNames::pathLength));
}

GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedNumber> SVGGeometryElement::path_length()
{
    if (!m_path_length)
        m_path_length = SVGAnimatedNumber::create(*this, DOM::QualifiedName { AttributeNames::pathLength, OptionalNone {}, OptionalNone {} }, 0.f);
    return *m_path_length;
}

SVGGradientElement::SVGGradientElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : SVGElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

void SVGGradientElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    if (name == AttributeNames::gradientUnits) {
        m_gradient_units = parse_units(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::spreadMethod) {
        m_spread_method = parse_spread_method(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::gradientTransform) {
        if (auto transform_list = parse_transform(value.value_or({})); transform_list.has_value()) {
            m_gradient_transform = transform_from_transform_list(*transform_list);
        } else {
            m_gradient_transform = {};
        }
        if (m_gradient_transform_for_bindings)
            m_gradient_transform_for_bindings->synchronize();
    }
}

GradientUnits SVGGradientElement::gradient_units() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return gradient_units_impl(seen_gradients);
}

GradientUnits SVGGradientElement::gradient_units_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    if (m_gradient_units.has_value())
        return *m_gradient_units;
    if (auto gradient = linked_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->gradient_units_impl(seen_gradients);
    return GradientUnits::ObjectBoundingBox;
}

SpreadMethod SVGGradientElement::spread_method() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return spread_method_impl(seen_gradients);
}

SpreadMethod SVGGradientElement::spread_method_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    if (m_spread_method.has_value())
        return *m_spread_method;
    if (auto gradient = linked_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->spread_method_impl(seen_gradients);
    return SpreadMethod::Pad;
}

Gfx::InterpolationColorSpace SVGGradientElement::color_space() const
{
    auto style = computed_style();
    VERIFY(style);
    return CSS::to_interpolation_color_space(style->color_interpolation());
}

Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform> SVGGradientElement::gradient_transform() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return gradient_transform_impl(seen_gradients);
}

Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform> SVGGradientElement::gradient_transform_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    if (m_gradient_transform.has_value())
        return m_gradient_transform;
    if (auto gradient = linked_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->gradient_transform_impl(seen_gradients);
    return {};
}

// The gradient transform, appropriately scaled and combined with the paint transform.
void SVGGradientElement::push_color_stops(void* sink) const
{
    auto largest_offset = 0.0f;
    for_each_color_stop([&](auto& stop) {
        // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#StopNotes
        // Gradient offset values less than 0 (or less than 0%) are rounded up to 0%.
        // Gradient offset values greater than 1 (or greater than 100%) are rounded down to 100%.
        float stop_offset = AK::clamp(stop.stop_offset(), 0.0f, 1.0f);

        // Each gradient offset value is required to be equal to or greater than the previous gradient
        // stop's offset value. If a given gradient stop's offset value is not equal to or greater than all
        // previous offset values, then the offset value is adjusted to be equal to the largest of all previous
        // offset values.
        stop_offset = AK::max(stop_offset, largest_offset);
        largest_offset = stop_offset;

        Layout::RustFFI::layout_arena_paint_push_color_stop(sink, stop.stop_color().with_opacity(stop.stop_opacity()), stop_offset);
    });
}

Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGradientDescription SVGGradientElement::base_paint_server_description(Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGradientKind kind) const
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGradientDescription description {};
    description.kind = kind;
    description.units_are_object_bounding_box = gradient_units() == GradientUnits::ObjectBoundingBox;
    description.spread_method = static_cast<Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGradientSpreadMethod>(to_underlying(spread_method()));
    description.color_space = color_space();
    description.gradient_transform = gradient_transform();
    return description;
}

GC::Ptr<SVGGradientElement const> SVGGradientElement::linked_gradient(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    // FIXME: This entire function is an ad-hoc hack!

    auto link = has_attribute(AttributeNames::href) ? get_attribute(AttributeNames::href) : get_attribute(AttributeNames::xlink_href);
    if (auto href = link; href.has_value() && !link->is_empty()) {
        auto url = document().encoding_parse_url(*href);
        if (!url.has_value())
            return {};
        auto id = url->fragment();
        if (!id.has_value() || id->is_empty())
            return {};
        auto id_as_utf16 = decode_fragment_identifier(id.value());
        GC::Ptr<DOM::Element> element;
        if (auto containing_shadow = containing_shadow_root())
            element = containing_shadow->get_element_by_id(id_as_utf16);
        if (!element)
            element = document().get_element_by_id(id_as_utf16);
        if (!element)
            return {};
        if (element == GC::Ref { *this })
            return {};
        if (!is<SVGGradientElement>(*element))
            return {};
        if (seen_gradients.set(&as<SVGGradientElement>(*element)) != AK::HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
            return {};
        return &as<SVGGradientElement>(*element);
    }
    return {};
}

void SVGGradientElement::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGURIReferenceMixin::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_gradient_transform_for_bindings);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGGradientElement__gradientTransform
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedTransformList> SVGGradientElement::gradient_transform_for_bindings()
{
    // The gradientTransform IDL attribute reflects the computed value of the transform property and the
    // 'gradientTransform' presentation attribute for ‘linearGradient’ and ‘radialGradient’ elements.
    // FIXME: Reflect the computed value of the transform property rather than only the presentation attribute.
    if (!m_gradient_transform_for_bindings)
        m_gradient_transform_for_bindings = SVGAnimatedTransformList::create(*this, AttributeNames::gradientTransform);
    return *m_gradient_transform_for_bindings;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGGradientElement__gradientUnits
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGGradientElement::gradient_units_for_bindings()
{
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::gradientUnits, svg_unit_type_keywords, to_underlying(SVGUnitType::ObjectBoundingBox));
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGGradientElement__spreadMethod
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGGradientElement::spread_method_for_bindings()
{
    static constexpr Array keywords {
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "pad"sv, SVG_SPREADMETHOD_PAD },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "reflect"sv, SVG_SPREADMETHOD_REFLECT },
        SVGAnimatedEnumeration::Keyword { "repeat"sv, SVG_SPREADMETHOD_REPEAT },
    };
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::spreadMethod, keywords, SVG_SPREADMETHOD_PAD);
}

#pragma once

#include <AK/IterationDecision.h>
#include <LibGC/RootHashTable.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/LayoutRustFFI.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeParsing.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGStopElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGURIReference.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

class SVGAnimatedTransformList;

class SVGGradientElement
    : public SVGElement
    , public SVGURIReferenceMixin<SupportsXLinkHref::Yes> {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGGradientElement, SVGElement);

public:
    virtual ~SVGGradientElement() override = default;

    virtual void attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_) override;

    virtual void push_paint_server_description(void* sink) const = 0;

    GradientUnits gradient_units() const;

    SpreadMethod spread_method() const;

    Gfx::InterpolationColorSpace color_space() const;

    Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform> gradient_transform() const;

    static constexpr u16 SVG_SPREADMETHOD_UNKNOWN = 0;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_SPREADMETHOD_PAD = 1;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_SPREADMETHOD_REFLECT = 2;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_SPREADMETHOD_REPEAT = 3;

    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> gradient_units_for_bindings();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> spread_method_for_bindings();
    GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedTransformList> gradient_transform_for_bindings();

protected:
    SVGGradientElement(DOM::Document&, DOM::QualifiedName);

    Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGradientDescription base_paint_server_description(Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGradientKind) const;
    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

    GC::Ptr<SVGGradientElement const> linked_gradient(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;

    template<VoidFunction<SVGStopElement> Callback>
    void for_each_color_stop(Callback const& callback) const
    {
        GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
        return for_each_color_stop_impl(callback, seen_gradients);
    }

    void push_color_stops(void* sink) const;

private:
    virtual bool is_svg_gradient_element() const final { return true; }

    template<VoidFunction<SVGStopElement> Callback>
    void for_each_color_stop_impl(Callback const& callback, GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
    {
        bool color_stops_found = false;
        for_each_child_of_type<SVG::SVGStopElement>([&](auto& stop) {
            color_stops_found = true;
            callback(stop);
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        });
        if (!color_stops_found) {
            if (auto gradient = linked_gradient(seen_gradients))
                gradient->for_each_color_stop_impl(callback, seen_gradients);
        }
    }

    GradientUnits gradient_units_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;
    SpreadMethod spread_method_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;
    Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform> gradient_transform_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;

    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#LinearGradientAttributes
    Optional<GradientUnits> m_gradient_units = {};

    Optional<SpreadMethod> m_spread_method = {};
    Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform> m_gradient_transform = {};
    GC::Ptr<SVGAnimatedTransformList> m_gradient_transform_for_bindings;
};

}

SVGGraphicsElement::SVGGraphicsElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : SVGElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

void SVGGraphicsElement::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_required_extensions);
    visitor.visit(m_system_language);
    visitor.visit(m_transform);
}

void SVGGraphicsElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#SynchronizingReflectedValues
    // Whenever a reflected content attribute's base value changes, then the reflecting object must be synchronized,
    // immediately after the value changed.
    if (namespace_.has_value())
        return;
    if (name == AttributeNames::requiredExtensions || name == AttributeNames::systemLanguage) {
        if (name == AttributeNames::requiredExtensions && m_required_extensions)
            m_required_extensions->synchronize();
        else if (name == AttributeNames::systemLanguage && m_system_language)
            m_system_language->synchronize();

        // NB: Whether the conditional processing attributes evaluate to true decides whether the element has a box.
        CSS::record_element_box_kind(*this);
        set_needs_layout_tree_update(true, DOM::SetNeedsLayoutTreeUpdateReason::StyleChange);
        return;
    }
    if (name == AttributeNames::transform && m_transform)
        m_transform->synchronize();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/struct.html#ConditionalProcessingRequiredExtensionsAttribute
static bool required_extensions_evaluate_to_true(Utf16View value)
{
    // The value is a list of URL references which identify the required extensions, with the individual values
    // separated by white space. Determines whether all of the named extensions are supported by the user agent. If all
    // of the given extensions are supported, then the attribute evaluates to true; otherwise, the current element and
    // its children are skipped and thus will not be rendered.
    // If a null string or empty string value is given to attribute ‘requiredExtensions’, the attribute evaluates to
    // "false".
    auto extensions = SVGStringList::parse(value, SVGStringList::Separator::Whitespace);
    if (extensions.is_empty())
        return false;

    // INTEROP: Other browsers treat the HTML and MathML namespaces as supported extensions, since their content can be
    //          embedded with foreignObject.
    return all_of(extensions, [](auto const& extension) {
        return extension == Namespace::HTML || extension == Namespace::MathML;
    });
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/struct.html#ConditionalProcessingSystemLanguageAttribute
static bool system_language_evaluates_to_true(Utf16View value)
{
    // If a null string or empty string value is given to attribute ‘systemLanguage’, the attribute evaluates to
    // "false".
    if (value.is_empty())
        return false;

    // Evaluates to "true" if one of the language tags indicated by user preferences is a case-insensitive match of one
    // of the language tags given in the value of this parameter, or if one of the language tags indicated by user
    // preferences is a case-insensitive prefix of one of the language tags given in the value of this parameter such
    // that the first tag character following the prefix is "-".
    auto language_tags = SVGStringList::parse(value, SVGStringList::Separator::Comma);
    auto loader_config = current_loader_config();
    for (auto const& preferred_language : loader_config->config.preferred_languages) {
        auto preferred_tag = Utf16String::from_utf8(preferred_language);
        for (auto const& language_tag : language_tags) {
            if (language_tag.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(preferred_tag))
                return true;
            if (language_tag.length_in_code_units() > preferred_tag.length_in_code_units()
                && language_tag.code_unit_at(preferred_tag.length_in_code_units()) == '-'
                && language_tag.utf16_view().substring_view(0, preferred_tag.length_in_code_units()).equals_ignoring_ascii_case(preferred_tag))
                return true;
        }
    }

    // Evaluates to "false" otherwise.
    return false;
}

bool SVGGraphicsElement::conditional_processing_attributes_evaluate_to_true() const
{
    // If the attribute is not present, then it implicitly evaluates to "true".
    if (auto required_extensions = attribute(AttributeNames::requiredExtensions); required_extensions.has_value() && !required_extensions_evaluate_to_true(*required_extensions))
        return false;
    if (auto system_language = attribute(AttributeNames::systemLanguage); system_language.has_value() && !system_language_evaluates_to_true(*system_language))
        return false;
    return true;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGTests__requiredExtensions
GC::Ref<SVGStringList> SVGGraphicsElement::required_extensions_for_bindings()
{
    // The requiredExtensions IDL attribute reflects the ‘requiredExtensions’ content attribute.
    // NB: The attribute's value is a set of space-separated tokens.
    if (!m_required_extensions)
        m_required_extensions = SVGStringList::create(*this, AttributeNames::requiredExtensions, SVGStringList::Separator::Whitespace);
    return *m_required_extensions;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGTests__systemLanguage
GC::Ref<SVGStringList> SVGGraphicsElement::system_language_for_bindings()
{
    // The systemLanguage IDL attribute reflects the ‘systemLanguage’ content attribute.
    // NB: The attribute's value is a set of comma-separated tokens.
    if (!m_system_language)
        m_system_language = SVGStringList::create(*this, AttributeNames::systemLanguage, SVGStringList::Separator::Comma);
    return *m_system_language;
}

GC::Ptr<DOM::Element> SVGGraphicsElement::resolve_url_to_element(CSS::URL const& url) const
{
    // FIXME: Complete and use the entire URL, not just the fragment.
    if (auto fragment_offset = Utf16View { url.url() }.find_code_unit_offset('#'); fragment_offset.has_value()) {
        auto fragment_string = url.url().substring_view(fragment_offset.value() + 1);
        return resolve_fragment_identifier_to_element(decode_fragment_identifier(fragment_string));
    }

    return {};
}

GC::Ptr<DOM::Element> SVGGraphicsElement::resolve_fragment_identifier_to_element(Utf16String const& fragment) const
{
    if (auto element = document().get_element_by_id(fragment))
        return element;

    auto containing_shadow = containing_shadow_root();
    if (containing_shadow) {
        if (auto element = containing_shadow->get_element_by_id(fragment))
            return element;
    }

    return {};
}

Gfx::AffineTransform transform_from_transform_list(ReadonlySpan<Transform> transform_list)
{
    Gfx::AffineTransform affine_transform;
    for (auto& transform : transform_list) {
        transform.operation.visit(
            [&](Transform::Translate const& translate) {
                affine_transform.multiply(Gfx::AffineTransform {}.translate({ translate.x, translate.y }));
            },
            [&](Transform::Scale const& scale) {
                affine_transform.multiply(Gfx::AffineTransform {}.scale({ scale.x, scale.y }));
            },
            [&](Transform::Rotate const& rotate) {
                Gfx::AffineTransform translate_transform;
                affine_transform.multiply(
                    Gfx::AffineTransform {}
                        .translate({ rotate.x, rotate.y })
                        .rotate_radians(AK::to_radians(rotate.a))
                        .translate({ -rotate.x, -rotate.y }));
            },
            [&](Transform::SkewX const& skew_x) {
                affine_transform.multiply(Gfx::AffineTransform {}.skew_radians(AK::to_radians(skew_x.a), 0));
            },
            [&](Transform::SkewY const& skew_y) {
                affine_transform.multiply(Gfx::AffineTransform {}.skew_radians(0, AK::to_radians(skew_y.a)));
            },
            [&](Transform::Matrix const& matrix) {
                affine_transform.multiply(Gfx::AffineTransform {
                    matrix.a, matrix.b, matrix.c, matrix.d, matrix.e, matrix.f });
            });
    }
    return affine_transform;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGraphicsElement__getBBox
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMRect>> SVGGraphicsElement::get_b_box(Bindings::SVGBoundingBoxOptions const&)
{
    // The getBBox method is used to compute the bounding box of the current element.  When the getBBox(options) method
    // is called, the bounding box algorithm is invoked for the current element, with fill, stroke, markers and clipped
    // members of the options dictionary argument used to control which parts of the element are included in the
    // bounding box, using the element's user coordinate system as the coordinate system to return the bounding box in.
    // A newly created DOMRect object that defines the computed bounding box is returned.
    // If the element's geometric attributes are missing or have invalid values (e.g. negative width or height), such
    // that the element is not rendered, then a DOMRect with x, y, width and height all set to 0 is returned.

    // FIXME: It should be possible to compute this without layout updates. The bounding box is within the
    //        SVG coordinate space (before any viewbox or other transformations), so it should be possible to
    //        calculate this from SVG geometry without a full layout tree (at least for simple cases).
    //        See: https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#BoundingBoxes
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document() };
    document().update_layout_if_needed_for_node(*this, DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::SVGGraphicsElementGetBBox);
    auto const* self_layout_node = layout_node(read);
    if (!self_layout_node)
        return Geometry::DOMRect::create();

    auto owner_svg_element = this->owner_svg_element();
    if (owner_svg_element) {
        auto const* owner_layout_node = owner_svg_element->layout_node(read);
        if (!owner_layout_node || !Painting::has_committed_box(*owner_layout_node) || !Painting::has_committed_box(*self_layout_node)) {
            // Throw only for non-rendered *graphics* elements where geometry isn't computable
            // (e.g. elements inside <marker>, <pattern>, etc.).
            if (is<SVGSVGElement>(*this))
                return Geometry::DOMRect::create();
            return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create(
                HTML::relevant_realm(*this),
                "Element is not rendered and geometry is not computable"_utf16);
        }
    } else if (!is<SVGSVGElement>(*this)) {
        return Geometry::DOMRect::create();
    }

    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#BoundingBoxes
    // NB: Layout commits each element's object bounding box in its user coordinate system: a shape's path, the glyph
    //     cells of text, and for a container, including the outermost svg element, the union of its children's, each
    //     through the child's own transform. A foreign object's box comes from a layout of its own, which commits no SVG
    //     geometry; the box is its bounding box.
    auto geometry = Painting::svg_geometry(*self_layout_node);
    if (!geometry.has_value() && !owner_svg_element)
        return Geometry::DOMRect::create();
    auto bounding_box = geometry.has_value() ? geometry->object_bounding_box : Painting::absolute_rect(*self_layout_node).to_type<float>();
    // An element other than a shape or a container with a non-positive geometry dimension is not rendered and
    // therefore contributes an empty bounding box, regardless of its positioning rectangle's origin.
    auto kind = self_layout_node->kind();
    if (kind != Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::SVGGeometryBox && kind != Layout::RustFFI::NodeKind::SVGGraphicsBox && bounding_box.is_empty())
        return Geometry::DOMRect::create();
    return Geometry::DOMRect::create(bounding_box);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGraphicsElement__transform
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedTransformList> SVGGraphicsElement::transform()
{
    // The transform IDL attribute reflects the computed value of the transform property and its corresponding
    // ‘transform’ presentation attribute.
    // FIXME: Reflect the computed value of the transform property rather than only the presentation attribute.
    if (!m_transform)
        m_transform = SVGAnimatedTransformList::create(*this, AttributeNames::transform);
    return *m_transform;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGraphicsElement__getScreenCTM
GC::Ptr<Geometry::DOMMatrix> SVGGraphicsElement::get_screen_ctm()
{
    // 1. If the current element is not in the document, then return null.
    if (!is_connected())
        return {};

    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document() };
    document().update_layout_if_needed_for_node(*this, DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::SVGGraphicsElementGetScreenCTM);

    // 2. If the current element is a non-rendered element, and the UA is not able to resolve the style of the element,
    //    then return null.
    //
    // NB: We currently require committed box data connected to the document's visual-context tree to compute this matrix.
    //     This also excludes geometry in resource-only subtrees such as masks, clip paths, and patterns.
    auto const* layout_node = this->layout_node(read);
    if (!layout_node || !Painting::has_committed_box(*layout_node) || !document().has_committed_viewport_box())
        return {};

    // 3. Let ctm be a matrix that transforms the coordinate space of the current element (including its transform
    //    property) to the coordinate space of the document's viewport.
    //
    // NB: An SVG viewport's current user coordinate system is the space produced by its viewBox transform, which is the
    //     coordinate system recorded for its descendants. Other graphics elements use their own accumulated context so
    //     their transform property is included exactly once.
    auto viewport_mapping = Painting::viewport_mapping(document());
    if (!Painting::has_accumulated_visual_context(*layout_node))
        return {};

    auto visual_context = Painting::svg_viewport_transform(*layout_node).has_value()
        ? Painting::accumulated_visual_context_for_descendants(*layout_node)
        : Painting::accumulated_visual_context(*layout_node);
    Gfx::FloatMatrix4x4 ctm;
    Layout::RustFFI::viewport_mapping_matrix_to_viewport(viewport_mapping, visual_context.spatial, Layout::RustFFI::ViewportSpace::LayoutViewport, &ctm);

    // NB: Accumulated visual-context matrices operate in device-pixel space. Conjugate the matrix by the device scale
    //     to expose CSS-pixel coordinates through the DOM API, then project any 3D transform onto the SVG plane.
    auto device_scale = static_cast<float>(document().page().client().device_pixels_per_css_pixel());
    auto css_to_device_scale = Gfx::scale_matrix(Vector3 { device_scale, device_scale, device_scale });
    auto device_to_css_scale = Gfx::scale_matrix(Vector3 { 1 / device_scale, 1 / device_scale, 1 / device_scale });
    ctm = device_to_css_scale * ctm * css_to_device_scale;
    ctm = Gfx::extract_2d_affine_transform(Gfx::flattened(ctm)).to_matrix();

    // 4. Return a newly created, detached DOMMatrix object that represents the same matrix as ctm.
    return Geometry::DOMMatrix::create(ctm);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#__svg__SVGGraphicsElement__getCTM
GC::Ptr<Geometry::DOMMatrix> SVGGraphicsElement::get_ctm()
{
    // 1. If the current element is not in the document, then return null.
    if (!is_connected())
        return {};

    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document() };
    document().update_layout_if_needed_for_node(*this, DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::SVGGraphicsElementGetCTM);

    // 2. If the current element is a non-rendered element, and the UA is not able to resolve the style of the element,
    //    then return null.
    // NB: We require committed box data for the current element and each of its ancestors up to the element ctm
    //     transforms to, which also excludes geometry in resource-only subtrees such as masks, clip paths, and patterns.
    auto const* layout_node = this->layout_node(read);
    if (!layout_node || !Painting::has_committed_box(*layout_node))
        return {};

    // 3. Let ctm be a matrix determined based on what the current element is:
    // -> the current element is the outermost svg element
    //    ctm is a matrix that transforms the coordinate space of the ‘svg’ (including its transform property) to the
    //    coordinate space of the document's viewport. The matrix includes the transforms produced by the ‘viewBox’ and
    //    ‘preserveAspectRatio’ attributes, the transform property, and any transform due to currentScale and
    //    currentTranslate properties on the SVGSVGElement.
    // AD-HOC: Like Blink and WebKit, transform to the coordinate space of the svg element's SVG viewport instead, which
    //         leaves only the transform produced by the viewBox and preserveAspectRatio attributes. Gecko returns null.
    // -> any other element
    //    ctm is a matrix that transforms the coordinate space of the current element (including its transform property)
    //    to the coordinate space of its closest ancestor viewport-establishing element (also including its transform
    //    property).
    // NB: Like Blink and WebKit, the coordinate space of an svg element includes the transforms produced by its position
    //     and its viewBox attribute.
    auto outermost_svg_element = this->outermost_svg_element();
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Node const> target = this;
    if (outermost_svg_element.ptr() != this)
        target = viewport_element();
    if (!target)
        return {};

    Gfx::AffineTransform ctm;
    for (auto const* node = layout_node;; node = node->parent()) {
        if (!node || !Painting::has_committed_box(*node))
            return {};

        Gfx::AffineTransform local_transform;
        auto viewport_transform = Painting::svg_viewport_transform(*node);
        if (node->dom_node() == outermost_svg_element.ptr()) {
            local_transform = viewport_transform.value_or({});
        } else {
            local_transform = Painting::svg_element_transform(*node);
            if (viewport_transform.has_value()) {
                local_transform.translate(Painting::absolute_rect(*node).location().to_type<float>());
                local_transform.multiply(*viewport_transform);
            }
        }
        ctm = local_transform.multiply(ctm);

        if (node->dom_node() == target.ptr())
            break;
    }

    // 4. Return a newly created, detached DOMMatrix object that represents the same matrix as ctm.
    return Geometry::DOMMatrix::create(ctm.to_matrix());
}

}

    : SVGGraphicsElement(document, move(qualified_name))

void SVGImageElement::finalize()
{
    Base::finalize();
    unregister_with_decoded_image_data_if_needed();
}

void SVGImageElement::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGURIReferenceMixin::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_resource_request);
    visitor.visit(m_preserve_aspect_ratio);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/embedded.html#__svg__SVGImageElement__preserveAspectRatio
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedPreserveAspectRatio> SVGImageElement::preserve_aspect_ratio_for_bindings()
{
    if (!m_preserve_aspect_ratio)
        m_preserve_aspect_ratio = SVGAnimatedPreserveAspectRatio::create(*this);
    return *m_preserve_aspect_ratio;
}

void SVGImageElement::adopted_from(DOM::Document& old_document)
{
    Base::adopted_from(old_document);

    if (m_load_event_delayer.has_value())
        m_load_event_delayer.emplace(document());

    // NB: See process_the_url().
    if (old_document.is_temporary_document_for_fragment_parsing()) {
        auto href = get_attribute_ns(Optional<Utf16FlyString> {}, SVG::AttributeNames::href);
        if (!href.has_value())
            href = get_attribute_ns(Namespace::XLink, SVG::AttributeNames::href);
        process_the_url(href);
    }
}

void SVGImageElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::href) {
        // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#XLinkRefAttrs
        // For backwards compatibility, elements with an ‘href’ attribute also recognize an ‘href’ attribute in the
        // XLink namespace. If the element is in the XLink namespace, it does not recognize an ‘href’ attribute in the
        // SVG namespace. When the ‘href’ attribute is present in both the XLink namespace and without a namespace, the
        // value of the attribute without a namespace shall be used. The attribute in the XLink namespace shall be ignored.
        if (namespace_ == Namespace::XLink && has_attribute_ns(Optional<Utf16FlyString> {}, name))
            return;

        auto href = value;
        if (!namespace_.has_value() && !href.has_value())
            href = get_attribute_ns(Namespace::XLink, SVG::AttributeNames::href);

        process_the_url(href);
    }

    if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::preserveAspectRatio)
        Painting::push_replaced_image_paint_facts(*this, *this);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/embedded.html#ImageElement
SVG::PreserveAspectRatio SVGImageElement::preserve_aspect_ratio() const
{
    // An unparseable value is the initial value, xMidYMid meet.
    auto value = get_attribute(SVG::AttributeNames::preserveAspectRatio);
    if (!value.has_value())
        return {};
    return parse_preserve_aspect_ratio(*value).value_or({});
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG2/linking.html#processingURL
void SVGImageElement::process_the_url(Optional<Utf16String> const& href)
{
    // AD-HOC: An element in a temporary document for fragment parsing does not fetch anything, so that markup parsed
    //         into such a document, for example by the Sanitizer API, causes no network requests for elements that
    //         are never inserted anywhere. The URL is processed once the element is adopted into another document.
    if (document().is_temporary_document_for_fragment_parsing())
        return;

    if (!href.has_value()) {
        m_href = {};
        abandon_the_current_fetch();
        return;
    }

    m_href = document().encoding_parse_url(*href);
    if (!m_href.has_value()) {
        abandon_the_current_fetch();
        return;
    }

    fetch_the_document(*m_href);
}

void SVGImageElement::abandon_the_current_fetch()
{
    // AD-HOC: Without a URL to fetch, the element has no image request. An earlier request that is still loading must
    //         not fire events or keep delaying the load event, and an image that has already loaded is no longer the
    //         element's image.
    ++m_current_fetch_id;
    m_load_event_delayer.clear();
    if (!m_resource_request)
        return;
    unregister_with_decoded_image_data_if_needed();
    m_resource_request = nullptr;
    CSS::record_element_replaced_content_input(*this);
    Painting::push_replaced_image_paint_facts(*this, *this);
    set_needs_layout_update(DOM::SetNeedsLayoutReason::SVGImageElementFetchTheDocument);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#processingURL-fetch
void SVGImageElement::fetch_the_document(URL::URL const& url)
{
    // NB: Replacing the delayer releases the one held for the previous request, so the document only waits for the
    //     current request.
    m_load_event_delayer.emplace(document());
    unregister_with_decoded_image_data_if_needed();
    auto resource_request = HTML::SharedResourceRequest::get_or_create(document(), url, HTML::CORSSettingAttribute::NoCORS);
    m_resource_request = resource_request;
    auto fetch_id = ++m_current_fetch_id;
    CSS::record_element_replaced_content_input(*this);

    // AD-HOC: A request that finishes after href has changed is no longer the element's image request. Its completion
    //         must not fire events or release the load event delayer of the current request. Shared resource requests
    //         are shared per URL and CORS mode, so each fetch gets its own ID instead of comparing requests.
    resource_request->add_callbacks(
        GC::create_function<void()>(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this, fetch_id), [](SVGImageElement& self, auto& fetch_id) {
            if (fetch_id != self.m_current_fetch_id)
                return;

            self.m_load_event_delayer.clear();
            self.register_with_decoded_image_data_if_needed();
            CSS::record_element_replaced_content_input(self);
            Painting::push_replaced_image_paint_facts(self, self);
            self.set_needs_layout_update(DOM::SetNeedsLayoutReason::SVGImageElementFetchTheDocument);

            // https://w3c.github.io/paint-timing/#sec-modifications-dom
            // When an Element element's associated image request has become completely available, run the algorithm
            // to process an image that finished loading passing in element and its associated image request as
            // inputs.
            PaintTiming::process_an_image_that_finished_loading(self, PaintTiming::image_request_info(Utf16String::from_utf8(self.m_resource_request->url().serialize()), self.m_resource_request->image_data()));

            self.dispatch_event(DOM::Event::create(HTML::EventNames::load,
                HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(HTML::relevant_global_object(self))));
        }),
        GC::create_function<void()>(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this, fetch_id), [](SVGImageElement& self, auto& fetch_id) {
            if (fetch_id != self.m_current_fetch_id)
                return;

            self.m_load_event_delayer.clear();

            self.dispatch_event(DOM::Event::create(HTML::EventNames::error,
                HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(HTML::relevant_global_object(self))));
        }),
        GC::create_function<void()>(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this, fetch_id), [](SVGImageElement& self, auto& fetch_id) {
            if (fetch_id != self.m_current_fetch_id)
                return;

            self.m_load_event_delayer.clear();
        }));

    // NB: A request that has already completed runs its callbacks right away, and an event handler can change href.
    //     Then this fetch is no longer the current one.
    if (fetch_id != m_current_fetch_id)
        return;

    if (resource_request->needs_fetching()) {
        auto request = HTML::create_potential_CORS_request(url, Fetch::Infrastructure::Request::Destination::Image, HTML::CORSSettingAttribute::NoCORS);
        request->set_client(document().relevant_settings_object().address());
        resource_request->fetch_resource(request);
    }
}

CSS::ElementBoxKind SVGImageElement::box_kind() const
{
    return CSS::ElementBoxKind::SvgImage;
}

GC::Ptr<HTML::DecodedImageData> SVGImageElement::decoded_image_data() const
{
    if (!m_resource_request)
        return nullptr;
    return m_resource_request->image_data();
}

void SVGImageElement::decoded_image_data_did_update()
{
    // An SVG image works out its natural size again after it redraws itself or changes color scheme.
    CSS::record_element_replaced_content_input(*this);
    Painting::push_replaced_image_paint_facts(*this, *this);
}

GC::Ref<SVGLength> SVGLength::create_detached(JS::Realm& realm, SVGLengthValue value, ReadOnly read_only)

    return realm.create<SVGLength>(realm, nullptr, Directionality::Unspecified, DetachedSource { .value = value }, read_only);
}

GC::Ref<SVGLength> SVGLength::create_detached_copy() const
{
    auto value = internal_value().visit(
        [](SVGLengthValue const& scalar) -> Variant<SVGLengthValue, Utf16String> { return scalar; },
        [](NonnullRefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> const& style_value) -> Variant<SVGLengthValue, Utf16String> {
            return style_value->to_utf16_string(CSS::SerializationMode::Normal);
        });
    return m_realm->create<SVGLength>(*m_realm, nullptr, Directionality::Unspecified, DetachedSource { .value = move(value) }, ReadOnly::No);
}

    return realm.create<SVGLength>(realm, element, directionality, ReflectedAttributeSource { .name = move(name), .type = type, .default_value = default_value }, read_only);
}

    : Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable()
    , m_element(associated_element)
    , m_realm(realm)
    , m_directionality(directionality)
    , m_source(move(source))
    , m_read_only(read_only)
