#pragma once

#include <LibWeb/Bindings/Wrappable.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>
#include <LibWeb/WebIDL/ExceptionOr.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

// https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG2/types.html#InterfaceSVGNumber
class SVGNumber final : public Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGNumber, Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGNumber);

public:
    enum class ReadOnly : u8 {
        Yes,
        No,
    };

    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<SVGNumber> create(float value, ReadOnly);
    virtual ~SVGNumber() override = default;

    float value() const { return m_value; }
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_value(float value);

    ReadOnly read_only() const { return m_read_only; }

    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermAttach
    void attach(GC::Ref<SVGNumberList>, ReadOnly);

    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermDetach
    void detach();

    bool is_detached() const { return !m_list; }

    // Sets the value when the list this number belongs to is synchronized with its reflected attribute.
    void set_value_from_reflected_attribute(float value) { m_value = value; }

private:
    SVGNumber(float value, ReadOnly);

    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

    float m_value { 0 };

    // The list this number is an element of, if it reflects an element of the base value of a reflected attribute.
    GC::Ptr<SVGNumberList> m_list;

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG2/types.html#ReadOnlyNumber
    ReadOnly m_read_only;
};

}

#include <AK/TemporaryChange.h>
#include <AK/Utf16StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Serialize.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeParsing.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGNumber.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGNumberList.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGNumberList);

GC::Ref<SVGNumberList> SVGNumberList::create(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, ReadOnlyList read_only)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SVGNumberList>(element, move(reflected_attribute), read_only);
}

SVGNumberList::SVGNumberList(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, ReadOnlyList read_only)
    : SVGList(read_only)
    , m_element(element)
    , m_reflected_attribute(move(reflected_attribute))
{
    synchronize();
}

void SVGNumberList::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGList::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_element);
}

void SVGNumberList::attach(GC::Ref<SVGNumber> const& number)
{
    number->attach(*this, read_only() == ReadOnlyList::Yes ? SVGNumber::ReadOnly::Yes : SVGNumber::ReadOnly::No);
}

void SVGNumberList::detach(GC::Ref<SVGNumber> const& number)
{
    number->detach();
}

GC::Ref<SVGNumber> SVGNumberList::copy_if_not_detached(GC::Ref<SVGNumber> number)
{
    if (number->is_detached())
        return number;
    return SVGNumber::create(number->value(), SVGNumber::ReadOnly::No);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermSynchronizeList
void SVGNumberList::synchronize()
{
    // NB: The list does not need to be synchronized with a value that it has just reserialized itself.
    if (m_is_reserializing)
        return;

    // 1. Let value be the base value of the reflected content attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is
    //    not present or invalid).
    // NB: The initial value of every attribute reflected by an SVGNumberList is the empty list, which is also what an
    //     invalid list of numbers parses to.
    auto value = parse_table_values(m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute));

    synchronize_items(value, [] { return SVGNumber::create(0, SVGNumber::ReadOnly::No); }, [](GC::Ref<SVGNumber> const& item, float number) { item->set_value_from_reflected_attribute(number); });
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermReserialize
void SVGNumberList::reserialize_reflected_attribute()
{
    // 1. Let elements be the list of values in value.
    // 2. Let serialized elements be a list of strings, where each string is formed based on the corresponding value in
    //    elements and its type:
    //    an SVGNumber object: The string is an implementation specific string that, if parsed as a <number> using CSS
    //    syntax, would return the number value closest to the SVGNumber object's value member, given the
    //    implementation's supported real number precision.
    // 3. Set the content attribute to a string consisting of the strings in serialized elements joined and separated by
    //    single U+0020 SPACE characters.
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < items().size(); ++index) {
        if (index > 0)
            builder.append_code_unit(' ');
        CSS::serialize_a_number(builder, items()[index]->value());
    }

    TemporaryChange change { m_is_reserializing, true };
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute, builder.to_string());
}

}

/*

#include <LibGfx/Matrix4x4.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/Box.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/LayoutRustBridge.h>
#include <LibWeb/Layout/Node.h>
#include <LibWeb/Painting/BoxViews.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeNames.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeParsing.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/FragmentIdentifier.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGAnimatedTransformList.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGGraphicsElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGPatternElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGUnitTypes.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGPatternElement);

SVGPatternElement::SVGPatternElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : SVGElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

void SVGPatternElement::initialize_element()
{
    SVGFitToViewBox::initialize_fit_to_view_box(*this);
}

void SVGPatternElement::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGURIReferenceMixin::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGFitToViewBox::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_pattern_transform_for_bindings);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGPatternElement__patternTransform
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedTransformList> SVGPatternElement::pattern_transform_for_bindings()
{
    // The patternTransform IDL attribute reflects the computed value of the transform property and the
    // ‘patternTransform’ presentation attribute.
    // FIXME: Reflect the computed value of the transform property rather than only the presentation attribute.
    if (!m_pattern_transform_for_bindings)
        m_pattern_transform_for_bindings = SVGAnimatedTransformList::create(*this, AttributeNames::patternTransform);
    return *m_pattern_transform_for_bindings;
}

void SVGPatternElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);
    SVGFitToViewBox::attribute_changed(*this, name, value);

    if (name == AttributeNames::patternUnits) {
        m_pattern_units = parse_units(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::patternContentUnits) {
        m_pattern_content_units = parse_units(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::patternTransform) {
        if (auto transform_list = parse_transform(value.value_or({})); transform_list.has_value()) {
            m_pattern_transform = transform_from_transform_list(*transform_list);
        } else {
            m_pattern_transform = {};
        }
        if (m_pattern_transform_for_bindings)
            m_pattern_transform_for_bindings->synchronize();
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::x) {
        m_x = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::y) {
        m_y = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::width) {
        m_width = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == AttributeNames::height) {
        m_height = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    }

    // A pattern that names this one inherits the attributes it does not carry, so a change here is a change to every
    // pattern whose chain passes through this one.
    if (auto id = this->id(); id.has_value() && m_list_node.is_in_list())
        document().republish_svg_patterns_inheriting_from(*id);
}

void SVGPatternElement::inserted()
{
    Base::inserted();
    update_document_pattern_list_membership();
}

void SVGPatternElement::removed_from(IsSubtreeRoot is_subtree_root, Node* old_ancestor, Node& old_root)
{
    Base::removed_from(is_subtree_root, old_ancestor, old_root);
    update_document_pattern_list_membership();
}

void SVGPatternElement::moved_from(IsSubtreeRoot is_subtree_root, GC::Ptr<Node> old_ancestor)
{
    Base::moved_from(is_subtree_root, old_ancestor);
    update_document_pattern_list_membership();
}

void SVGPatternElement::finalize()
{
    Base::finalize();

    // A collected pattern may never run its removal steps, so unlink it here rather than leave the document's list
    // holding a destroyed node. Nothing is republished: this runs during a collection, which may already have finalized
    // the other patterns and the document.
    if (m_list_node.is_in_list())
        m_list_node.remove();
}

// Every connected pattern takes part, shadow trees included: a pattern's `href` resolves in the document scope, so a
// pattern inside a <use> shadow tree can still inherit from a template in the document.
void SVGPatternElement::update_document_pattern_list_membership()
{
    if (is_connected() == m_list_node.is_in_list())
        return;
    if (is_connected())
        document().register_svg_pattern_element({}, *this);
    else
        document().unregister_svg_pattern_element({}, *this);
}

Optional<Utf16String> SVGPatternElement::href_attribute_value() const
{
    if (has_attribute(AttributeNames::href))
        return get_attribute(AttributeNames::href);
    return get_attribute(AttributeNames::xlink_href);
}

Optional<Utf16String> SVGPatternElement::linked_id() const
{
    // FIXME: This can only resolve same-document references. The spec allows cross-document references.
    auto link = href_attribute_value();
    if (!link.has_value() || link->is_empty())
        return {};

    auto url = document().encoding_parse_url(*link);
    if (!url.has_value())
        return {};

    auto id = url->fragment();
    if (!id.has_value() || id->is_empty())
        return {};

    return decode_fragment_identifier(id.value());
}

GC::Ptr<SVGPatternElement const> SVGPatternElement::linked_pattern(GC::RootHashTable<SVGPatternElement const*>& seen_patterns) const
{
    auto id = linked_id();
    if (!id.has_value())
        return {};

    auto element = document().get_element_by_id(*id);
    if (!element)
        return {};

    if (element == GC::Ref { *this })
        return {};
    auto* pattern = as_if<SVGPatternElement>(*element);
    if (!pattern)
        return {};

    // Detect circular references in the template chain.
    if (seen_patterns.set(pattern) != AK::HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
        return {};

    return pattern;
}

GC::Ptr<SVGPatternElement const> SVGPatternElement::pattern_content_element() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGPatternElement const*> seen_patterns;
    return pattern_content_element_impl(seen_patterns);
}

void SVGPatternElement::push_paint_server_description(void* sink, Layout::Node const& target_layout_node) const
{
    auto content_element = pattern_content_element();
    if (!content_element)
        return;

    Layout::Box const* pattern_box = nullptr;
    target_layout_node.for_each_child_of_type<Layout::Box>([&](auto const& candidate) {
        if (candidate.is_svg_pattern_box() && candidate.dom_node() == content_element.ptr()) {
            pattern_box = &candidate;
            return IterationDecision::Break;
        }
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    if (!pattern_box)
        return;

    Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgPatternDescription description {};
    description.pattern_box = Layout::Node::slot_id(pattern_box);
    description.units_are_object_bounding_box = pattern_units() == SVGUnits::ObjectBoundingBox;
    description.content_units_are_object_bounding_box = pattern_content_units() == SVGUnits::ObjectBoundingBox;
    description.has_view_box = view_box().has_value();
    description.x = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(pattern_x());
    description.y = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(pattern_y());
    description.width = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(pattern_width());
    description.height = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(pattern_height());
    description.pattern_transform_attribute = pattern_transform();
    auto const* transform_values = style_group<CSS::ComputedValues::TransformValues>();
    auto const* css_transform_entries = transform_values ? transform_values->resolved_transforms.pointer : nullptr;
    auto css_transform_count = transform_values ? transform_values->resolved_transforms.length : 0;
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_arena_svg_paint_resources_push_pattern(sink, &description, css_transform_entries, css_transform_count);
}

// Reflected length accessors are generated by SVGElement's reflection macro.

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGPatternElement__patternUnits
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGPatternElement::pattern_units_for_bindings()
{
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::patternUnits, svg_unit_type_keywords, to_underlying(SVGUnitType::ObjectBoundingBox));
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGPatternElement__patternContentUnits
GC::Ref<SVGAnimatedEnumeration> SVGPatternElement::pattern_content_units_for_bindings()
{
    return svg_animated_enumeration_for_attribute(AttributeNames::patternContentUnits, svg_unit_type_keywords, to_underlying(SVGUnitType::UserSpaceOnUse));
}

#include <AK/TemporaryChange.h>
#include <AK/Utf16StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Serialize.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGPointList);

GC::Ref<SVGPointList> SVGPointList::create(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, ReadOnlyList read_only)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SVGPointList>(element, move(reflected_attribute), read_only);
}

SVGPointList::SVGPointList(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, ReadOnlyList read_only)
    : SVGList(read_only)
    , m_element(element)
    , m_reflected_attribute(move(reflected_attribute))
{
    synchronize();
}

void SVGPointList::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGList::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_element);
}

GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMPoint> SVGPointList::copy_if_not_detached(GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMPoint> point)
{
    // FIXME: A DOMPoint does not know which list it is an element of, so only a point that is an element of this list
    //        is known not to be detached. Also copy a point that is an element of another list.
    if (!items().contains_slow(point))
        return point;

    // NB: The value of a point in a list is its x and y coordinates.
    return Geometry::DOMPoint::create(point->x(), point->y());
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermSynchronizeList
void SVGPointList::synchronize()
{
    // NB: The list does not need to be synchronized with a value that it has just reserialized itself.
    if (m_is_reserializing)
        return;

    // 1. Let value be the base value of the reflected content attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is
    //    not present or invalid).
    auto value = parse_points(m_element->get_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute));

    // FIXME: DOMPoint objects are not associated with the list they are an element of, so modifying one does not
    //        reserialize the reflected attribute, and a point of a list that is read only can still be modified.
    synchronize_items(value, [] { return Geometry::DOMPoint::create(); }, [](GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMPoint> const& item, Gfx::FloatPoint const& point) { item->set_x_and_y(point.x(), point.y()); });
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermReserialize
void SVGPointList::reserialize_reflected_attribute()
{
    // 1. Let elements be the list of values in value.
    // 2. Let serialized elements be a list of strings, where each string is formed based on the corresponding value in
    //    elements and its type:
    //    a DOMPoint object: The string value is computed as follows:
    //    1. Let string be an empty string.
    //    2. Let x and y be the values of the DOMPoint object's x and y coordinates, respectively.
    //    3. Append to string an implementation specific string that, if parsed as <number> using CSS syntax, would
    //       return the number value closest to x, given the implementation's supported real number precision.
    //    4. Append a single U+002C COMMA character to string.
    //    5. Append to string an implementation specific string that, if parsed as <number> using CSS syntax, would
    //       return the number value closest to y, given the implementation's supported real number precision.
    //    6. The string is string.
    // 3. Set the content attribute to a string consisting of the strings in serialized elements joined and separated by
    //    single U+0020 SPACE characters.
    // FIXME: The spec does not say how to serialize a coordinate that is not finite.
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < items().size(); ++index) {
        if (index > 0)
            builder.append_code_unit(' ');
        CSS::serialize_a_number(builder, items()[index]->x());
        builder.append_code_unit(',');
        CSS::serialize_a_number(builder, items()[index]->y());
    }

    TemporaryChange change { m_is_reserializing, true };
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute, builder.to_string());
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedPoints__points
GC::Ref<SVGPointList> SVGAnimatedPoints::points_for_bindings()
{
    // On getting points, an SVGPointList object is returned that reflects the base value of the reflected attribute.
    if (!m_points_list)
        m_points_list = SVGPointList::create(svg_animated_points_element(), AttributeNames::points, ReadOnlyList::No);
    return *m_points_list;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGAnimatedPoints__animatedPoints
GC::Ref<SVGPointList> SVGAnimatedPoints::animated_points()
{
    // On getting animatedPoints, an SVGPointList object is returned that reflects the animated value of the reflected
    // attribute.
    // NB: List interface objects reflected through the animVal IDL attribute are always read only.
    // FIXME: Reflect the animated value once SMIL animation can affect it.
    if (!m_animated_points_list)
        m_animated_points_list = SVGPointList::create(svg_animated_points_element(), AttributeNames::points, ReadOnlyList::Yes);
    return *m_animated_points_list;
}

void SVGAnimatedPoints::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    visitor.visit(m_points_list);
    visitor.visit(m_animated_points_list);
}

void SVGAnimatedPoints::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#SynchronizingReflectedValues
    if (namespace_.has_value() || name != AttributeNames::points)
        return;
    if (m_points_list)
        m_points_list->synchronize();
    if (m_animated_points_list)
        m_animated_points_list->synchronize();
}

    }
}

#include <LibWeb/Layout/Node.h>

#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGPolylineElement.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGPolylineElement);

SVGPolylineElement::SVGPolylineElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : SVGGeometryElement(document, qualified_name)
{
}

void SVGPolylineElement::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGAnimatedPoints::visit_edges(visitor);
}

void SVGPolylineElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);
    SVGAnimatedPoints::attribute_changed(name, namespace_);

    if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::points) {
        m_points = parse_points(value.value_or({}));
        set_needs_layout_update(DOM::SetNeedsLayoutReason::StyleChange);
    }
}

}

/*

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeNames.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGPreserveAspectRatio.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGPreserveAspectRatio);

static constexpr Array<StringView, 10> align_keywords {
    "none"sv,
    "xMinYMin"sv,
    "xMidYMin"sv,
    "xMaxYMin"sv,
    "xMinYMid"sv,
    "xMidYMid"sv,
    "xMaxYMid"sv,
    "xMinYMax"sv,
    "xMidYMax"sv,
    "xMaxYMax"sv,
};

static StringView meet_or_slice_keyword(u16 meet_or_slice)
{
    return meet_or_slice == SVGPreserveAspectRatio::SVG_MEETORSLICE_SLICE ? "slice"sv : "meet"sv;
}

GC::Ref<SVGPreserveAspectRatio> SVGPreserveAspectRatio::create(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, ReadOnly read_only)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<SVGPreserveAspectRatio>(element, read_only);
}

SVGPreserveAspectRatio::SVGPreserveAspectRatio(GC::Ref<SVGElement> element, ReadOnly read_only)
    : m_element(element)
    , m_read_only(read_only)
{
}

SVGPreserveAspectRatio::~SVGPreserveAspectRatio() = default;

void SVGPreserveAspectRatio::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_element);
}

PreserveAspectRatio SVGPreserveAspectRatio::value() const
{
    // NB: An attribute that is not present or invalid takes its initial value, which is "xMidYMid meet".
    return parse_preserve_aspect_ratio(m_element->get_attribute_value(AttributeNames::preserveAspectRatio)).value_or({});
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#__svg__SVGPreserveAspectRatio__align
u16 SVGPreserveAspectRatio::align() const
{
    // 1. Let value reflect the base value of a ‘preserveAspectRatio’ attribute. value is the current non-animated value
    //    of the attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is not present or invalid).
    auto value = this->value();

    // 2. Return the constant value as specified in the alignment constant table above for the alignment keyword in
    //    value.
    return to_underlying(value.align) + SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_NONE;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#__svg__SVGPreserveAspectRatio__align
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGPreserveAspectRatio::set_align(u16 value)
{
    // 1. If the SVGPreserveAspectRatio is read only, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError.
    if (m_read_only == ReadOnly::Yes)
        return WebIDL::NoModificationAllowedError::create("Cannot modify a read-only SVGPreserveAspectRatio"_utf16);

    // 2. If value is SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_UNKNOWN or does not have a corresponding entry in the alignment keyword
    //    table above, then throw a TypeError.
    if (value == SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_UNKNOWN || value > SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMAXYMAX)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Invalid alignment value"_utf16 };

    // 3. Let string be the corresponding keyword in the alignment keyword table above for value.
    StringBuilder string;
    string.append(align_keywords[value - SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_NONE]);

    // 4. Append a single U+0020 SPACE character to string.
    string.append(' ');

    // 5. Let meet or slice be the value that would be returned from the meetOrSlice member on this
    //    SVGPreserveAspectRatio.
    auto meet_or_slice = this->meet_or_slice();

    // 6. Append to string the corresponding keyword in the meet-or-slice keyword table above for meet or slice.
    string.append(meet_or_slice_keyword(meet_or_slice));

    // 7. Set the reflected ‘preserveAspectRatio’ attribute to string.
    m_element->set_attribute_value(AttributeNames::preserveAspectRatio, Utf16String::from_utf8(string.string_view()));
    return {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#__svg__SVGPreserveAspectRatio__meetOrSlice
u16 SVGPreserveAspectRatio::meet_or_slice() const
{
    // 1. Let value be a ‘preserveAspectRatio’ value that reflects the base value of a ‘preserveAspectRatio’ attribute
    //    value is the current non-animated value of the attribute.
    auto value = this->value();

    // 2. If the meet-or-slice value is not present in value, then return SVG_MEETORSLICE_MEET.
    // 3. Otherwise, the meet-or-slice value is present. Return the constant value as specified in the meet-or-slice
    //    constant table above for the meet-or-slice keyword in value.
    // NB: A missing meet-or-slice value parses as meet.
    return value.meet_or_slice == PreserveAspectRatio::MeetOrSlice::Slice ? SVG_MEETORSLICE_SLICE : SVG_MEETORSLICE_MEET;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#__svg__SVGPreserveAspectRatio__meetOrSlice
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> SVGPreserveAspectRatio::set_meet_or_slice(u16 value)
{
    // 1. If the SVGPreserveAspectRatio is read only, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError.
    if (m_read_only == ReadOnly::Yes)
        return WebIDL::NoModificationAllowedError::create("Cannot modify a read-only SVGPreserveAspectRatio"_utf16);

    // 2. If value is SVG_MEETORSLICE_UNKNOWN or does not have a corresponding entry in the meet-or-slice keyword table
    //    above, then throw a TypeError.
    if (value == SVG_MEETORSLICE_UNKNOWN || value > SVG_MEETORSLICE_SLICE)
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Invalid meet-or-slice value"_utf16 };

    // 3. Let align be the value that would be returned from the align member on this SVGPreserveAspectRatio.
    auto align = this->align();

    // 4. Let string be the corresponding keyword in the alignment keyword table above for align.
    StringBuilder string;
    string.append(align_keywords[align - SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_NONE]);

    // 5. Append a single U+0020 SPACE character to string.
    string.append(' ');

    // 6. Append to string the corresponding keyword in the meet-or-slice keyword table above for value.
    string.append(meet_or_slice_keyword(value));

    // 7. Set the reflected ‘preserveAspectRatio’ attribute to string.
    m_element->set_attribute_value(AttributeNames::preserveAspectRatio, Utf16String::from_utf8(string.string_view()));
    return {};
}

}

#pragma once

#include <LibWeb/Bindings/Wrappable.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#InterfaceSVGPreserveAspectRatio
class SVGPreserveAspectRatio final : public Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGPreserveAspectRatio, Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGPreserveAspectRatio);

public:
    static constexpr u16 SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_UNKNOWN = 0;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_NONE = 1;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMAXYMAX = 10;

    static constexpr u16 SVG_MEETORSLICE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_MEETORSLICE_MEET = 1;
    static constexpr u16 SVG_MEETORSLICE_SLICE = 2;

    enum class ReadOnly : u8 {
        Yes,
        No,
    };

    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<SVGPreserveAspectRatio> create(GC::Ref<SVGElement>, ReadOnly);
    virtual ~SVGPreserveAspectRatio() override;

    u16 align() const;
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_align(u16);

    u16 meet_or_slice() const;
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_meet_or_slice(u16);

private:
    SVGPreserveAspectRatio(GC::Ref<SVGElement>, ReadOnly);

    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

    PreserveAspectRatio value() const;

    GC::Ref<SVGElement> m_element;
    ReadOnly m_read_only;
};

}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#InterfaceSVGPreserveAspectRatio
[Exposed=Window]
interface SVGPreserveAspectRatio {

    // Alignment Types
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_UNKNOWN = 0;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_NONE = 1;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMINYMIN = 2;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMIDYMIN = 3;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMAXYMIN = 4;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMINYMID = 5;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMIDYMID = 6;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMAXYMID = 7;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMINYMAX = 8;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMIDYMAX = 9;
    const unsigned short SVG_PRESERVEASPECTRATIO_XMAXYMAX = 10;

    // Meet-or-slice Types
    const unsigned short SVG_MEETORSLICE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    const unsigned short SVG_MEETORSLICE_MEET = 1;
    const unsigned short SVG_MEETORSLICE_SLICE = 2;

    attribute unsigned short align;
    attribute unsigned short meetOrSlice;
};

/*

#include <LibWeb/Layout/LayoutRustBridge.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/AttributeNames.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGRadialGradientElement.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGRadialGradientElement);

SVGRadialGradientElement::SVGRadialGradientElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : SVGGradientElement(document, qualified_name)
{
}

void SVGRadialGradientElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    // FIXME: These are <length> or <coordinate> in the spec, but all examples seem to allow percentages
    // and unitless values.
    if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::cx) {
        m_cx = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::cy) {
        m_cy = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::fx) {
        m_fx = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::fy) {
        m_fy = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::fr) {
        m_fr = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    } else if (name == SVG::AttributeNames::r) {
        m_r = parse_number_percentage(value.value_or({}));
    }
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#RadialGradientElementFXAttribute
NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::start_circle_x() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return start_circle_x_impl(seen_gradients);
}

NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::start_circle_x_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    if (m_fx.has_value())
        return *m_fx;
    // If the element references an element that specifies a value for 'fx', then the value of 'fx' is
    // inherited from the referenced element.
    if (auto gradient = linked_radial_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->start_circle_x_impl(seen_gradients);
    // If attribute ‘fx’ is not specified, ‘fx’ will coincide with the presentational value of ‘cx’ for
    // the element whether the value for 'cx' was inherited or not.
    return end_circle_x();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#RadialGradientElementFYAttribute
NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::start_circle_y() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return start_circle_y_impl(seen_gradients);
}

NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::start_circle_y_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    if (m_fy.has_value())
        return *m_fy;
    // If the element references an element that specifies a value for 'fy', then the value of 'fy' is
    // inherited from the referenced element.
    if (auto gradient = linked_radial_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->start_circle_y_impl(seen_gradients);
    // If attribute ‘fy’ is not specified, ‘fy’ will coincide with the presentational value of ‘cy’ for
    // the element whether the value for 'cy' was inherited or not.
    return end_circle_y();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#RadialGradientElementFRAttribute
NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::start_circle_radius() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return start_circle_radius_impl(seen_gradients);
}

NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::start_circle_radius_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    // Note: A negative value is an error.
    if (m_fr.has_value() && m_fr->value() >= 0)
        return *m_fr;
    // if the element references an element that specifies a value for 'fr', then the value of
    // 'fr' is inherited from the referenced element.
    if (auto gradient = linked_radial_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->start_circle_radius_impl(seen_gradients);
    // If the attribute is not specified, the effect is as if a value of '0%' were specified.
    return NumberPercentage::create_percentage(0);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#RadialGradientElementCXAttribute
NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::end_circle_x() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return end_circle_x_impl(seen_gradients);
}

NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::end_circle_x_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    if (m_cx.has_value())
        return *m_cx;
    if (auto gradient = linked_radial_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->end_circle_x_impl(seen_gradients);
    return NumberPercentage::create_percentage(50);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#RadialGradientElementCYAttribute
NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::end_circle_y() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return end_circle_y_impl(seen_gradients);
}

NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::end_circle_y_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    if (m_cy.has_value())
        return *m_cy;
    if (auto gradient = linked_radial_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->end_circle_y_impl(seen_gradients);
    return NumberPercentage::create_percentage(50);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/pservers.html#RadialGradientElementRAttribute
NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::end_circle_radius() const
{
    GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*> seen_gradients;
    return end_circle_radius_impl(seen_gradients);
}

NumberPercentage SVGRadialGradientElement::end_circle_radius_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
{
    // Note: A negative value is an error.
    if (m_r.has_value() && m_r->value() >= 0)
        return *m_r;
    if (auto gradient = linked_radial_gradient(seen_gradients))
        return gradient->end_circle_radius_impl(seen_gradients);
    return NumberPercentage::create_percentage(50);
}

void SVGRadialGradientElement::push_paint_server_description(void* sink) const
{
    auto description = base_paint_server_description(Layout::RustFFI::FfiSvgGradientKind::Radial);
    description.cx = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(end_circle_x());
    description.cy = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(end_circle_y());
    description.r = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(end_circle_radius());
    description.fx = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(start_circle_x());
    description.fy = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(start_circle_y());
    description.fr = Layout::to_ffi_number_percentage(start_circle_radius());
    Layout::RustFFI::layout_arena_svg_paint_resources_push_gradient(sink, &description);
    push_color_stops(sink);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGGradientElement.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

class SVGRadialGradientElement : public SVGGradientElement {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGRadialGradientElement, SVGGradientElement);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGRadialGradientElement);

public:
    virtual ~SVGRadialGradientElement() override = default;

    virtual void attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_) override;

    virtual void push_paint_server_description(void* sink) const override;

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGRadialGradientElement__cx
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(cx, Horizontal, SVGLengthValue::percentage(50));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGRadialGradientElement__cy
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(cy, Vertical, SVGLengthValue::percentage(50));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGRadialGradientElement__fx
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(fx, Horizontal, SVGLengthValue::percentage(50));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGRadialGradientElement__fy
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(fy, Vertical, SVGLengthValue::percentage(50));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGRadialGradientElement__fr
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(fr, Unspecified, SVGLengthValue::percentage(0));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/pservers.html#__svg__SVGRadialGradientElement__r
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(r, Unspecified, SVGLengthValue::percentage(50));

protected:
    SVGRadialGradientElement(DOM::Document&, DOM::QualifiedName);

private:
    GC::Ptr<SVGRadialGradientElement const> linked_radial_gradient(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const
    {
        if (auto gradient = linked_gradient(seen_gradients); gradient && is<SVGRadialGradientElement>(*gradient))
            return &as<SVGRadialGradientElement>(*gradient);
        return {};
    }

    NumberPercentage start_circle_x() const;
    NumberPercentage start_circle_y() const;
    NumberPercentage start_circle_radius() const;
    NumberPercentage end_circle_x() const;
    NumberPercentage end_circle_y() const;
    NumberPercentage end_circle_radius() const;

    NumberPercentage start_circle_x_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;
    NumberPercentage start_circle_y_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;
    NumberPercentage start_circle_radius_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;
    NumberPercentage end_circle_x_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;
    NumberPercentage end_circle_y_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;
    NumberPercentage end_circle_radius_impl(GC::RootHashTable<SVGGradientElement const*>& seen_gradients) const;

    Optional<NumberPercentage> m_cx;
    Optional<NumberPercentage> m_cy;
    Optional<NumberPercentage> m_fx;
    Optional<NumberPercentage> m_fy;
    Optional<NumberPercentage> m_fr;
    Optional<NumberPercentage> m_r;
};

}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG11/shapes.html#RectElement
class SVGRectElement final : public SVGGeometryElement {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(SVGRectElement, SVGGeometryElement);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGRectElement);

public:
    virtual ~SVGRectElement() override = default;

    // AD-HOC: The spec states that the x, y, width, height, rx and ry IDL attributes reflect the respective computed values
    //         and their corresponding presentation attributes but other browsers reflect the attribute values instead - see
    //         https://github.com/w3c/svgwg/issues/1153

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGRectElement__x
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(x, Horizontal, SVGLengthValue::number(0));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGRectElement__y
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(y, Vertical, SVGLengthValue::number(0));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGRectElement__width
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(width, Horizontal, SVGLengthValue::number(0));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGRectElement__height
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(height, Vertical, SVGLengthValue::number(0));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGRectElement__rx
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(rx, Horizontal, SVGLengthValue::number(0));

    // https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/shapes.html#__svg__SVGRectElement__ry
    REFLECT_ANIMATED_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTE(ry, Vertical, SVGLengthValue::number(0));

private:
    virtual bool is_svg_rect_element() const final { return true; }

    SVGRectElement(DOM::Document&, DOM::QualifiedName);
};

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibGC/Weak.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Fetching/Fetching.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchAlgorithms.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchController.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Bodies.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Requests.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/ResponseView.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/Environments.h>
#include <LibWeb/Loader/ResourceLoader.h>
#include <LibWeb/SVG/SVGResourceDocument.h>
#include <LibWeb/XML/XMLDocumentBuilder.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Statuses.h>
#include <LibXML/Parser/Parser.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(SVGResourceDocument);

GC::Ref<SVGResourceDocument> SVGResourceDocument::get_or_create(DOM::Document& document, URL::URL const& url)
{
    // A resource document's own use elements share the cache of the document that loaded it, so every URL loads once
    // per page, and documents that refer to each other find each other there rather than loading each other anew.
    auto& owner = document.svg_resource_document_owner() ? *document.svg_resource_document_owner() : document;
    auto& resource_documents = owner.svg_resource_documents();
    if (auto it = resource_documents.find(url); it != resource_documents.end())
        return *it->value;
    auto resource_document = document.heap().allocate<SVGResourceDocument>(owner, url);
    resource_documents.set(url, resource_document);
    return resource_document;
}

SVGResourceDocument::SVGResourceDocument(DOM::Document& document, URL::URL url)
    : m_document(document)
    , m_url(move(url))
{
}

void SVGResourceDocument::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_document);
    visitor.visit(m_resource_document);
    visitor.visit(m_fetch_controller);
    for (auto const& callback : m_callbacks)
        visitor.visit(callback.on_done);
}

void SVGResourceDocument::fetch(NonnullRefPtr<Fetch::Infrastructure::Request> request)
{
    VERIFY(needs_fetching());
    m_state = State::Fetching;

    if (!ResourceLoader::is_initialized()) {
        finish(nullptr);
        return;
    }

    auto& realm = HTML::relevant_realm(*m_document);
    GC::Weak weak_this { *this };
    Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchAlgorithms::Input fetch_algorithms_input { Fetch::Engine::BodyIntent::DeliverStreamToConsumerAgent };
    fetch_algorithms_input.process_response = GC::create_function<void(GC::Ref<Fetch::Infrastructure::ResponseView>)>(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(weak_this, realm), [](auto& weak_this, auto& realm, GC::Ref<Fetch::Infrastructure::ResponseView> response) {
        auto self = weak_this.ptr();
        if (!self)
            return;
        if (!response->body()) {
            self->finish(nullptr);
            return;
        }
        if (!Fetch::Infrastructure::is_ok_status(response->status())) {
            // NB: The body of an error response still has to be read, or its transport stays paused until the network
            //     gives up on it.
            auto ignore_chunk = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), [](ByteBuffer) { });
            auto ignore_end_of_body = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), [] { });
            auto ignore_body_error = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), [](JS::Value) { });
            (void)response->body()->incrementally_read(realm, ignore_chunk, ignore_end_of_body, ignore_body_error, GC::Ref { realm.global_object() });
            self->finish(nullptr);
            return;
        }
        auto url = response->url().value_or(self->m_url);
        auto process_body = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(weak_this, url), [](auto& weak_this, auto& url, ByteBuffer data) {
            auto self = weak_this.ptr();
            if (!self)
                return;

            // The document is parsed with scripting disabled, like an image's, and only lends elements to the shadow
            // trees of use elements, so it needs no browsing context of its own.
            auto& document = *self->m_document;
            auto resource_document = DOM::Document::create(document.page(), document.relevant_global_event_target(), url);
            resource_document->set_content_type("image/svg+xml"_utf16_fly_string);
            resource_document->set_document_type(DOM::Document::Type::XML);
            resource_document->set_origin(document.origin());
            resource_document->set_svg_resource_document_owner(document);

            XML::Parser parser(StringView { data.bytes() }, { .resolve_named_html_entity = resolve_named_html_entity });
            XMLDocumentBuilder builder { *resource_document, XMLScriptingSupport::Disabled };
            auto result = parser.parse_with_listener(builder);
            if (result.is_error() || builder.has_error()) {
                dbgln("SVGResourceDocument: Failed to parse {}", url);
                self->finish(nullptr);
                return;
            }
            self->finish(resource_document);
        });
        auto process_body_error = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(weak_this), [](auto& weak_this, JS::Value) {
            if (auto self = weak_this.ptr())
                self->finish(nullptr);
        });
        response->body()->fully_read(realm, process_body, process_body_error, GC::Ref { realm.global_object() });
    });

    m_fetch_controller = Fetch::Fetching::fetch(realm, request, Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchAlgorithms::create(move(fetch_algorithms_input)));
    m_fetch_controller->set_stop_steps(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(weak_this), [](auto& weak_this) {
        if (auto self = weak_this.ptr())
            self->stop();
    }));
}

Optional<u64> SVGResourceDocument::add_callback(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void()>> on_done)
{
    if (m_state == State::Done) {
        on_done->function()();
        return {};
    }
    auto id = m_next_callback_id++;
    m_callbacks.append({ id, on_done });
    return id;
}

void SVGResourceDocument::remove_callback(u64 id)
{
    // NB: A callback that is being called can get here, while finish() goes on over m_callbacks, so a finished
    //     resource only marks the entry as no longer waiting.
    if (m_state != State::Done) {
        m_callbacks.remove_first_matching([id](auto const& callback) { return callback.id == id; });
        return;
    }
    for (auto& callback : m_callbacks) {
        if (callback.id == id)
            callback.id = 0;
    }
}

void SVGResourceDocument::finish(GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> resource_document)
{
    if (m_state == State::Done)
        return;
    m_state = State::Done;
    m_resource_document = resource_document;
    m_fetch_controller = nullptr;
    for (auto const& callback : m_callbacks) {
        if (callback.id != 0)
            callback.on_done->function()();
    }
    m_callbacks.clear();
}

// NB: A stopped fetch never responds, so its waiters end without a document, and a later reference to the URL fetches
//     it again.
void SVGResourceDocument::stop()
{
    if (m_state != State::Fetching)
        return;
    auto& resource_documents = m_document->svg_resource_documents();
    if (auto it = resource_documents.find(m_url); it != resource_documents.end() && it->value.ptr() == this)
        resource_documents.remove(it);
    finish(nullptr);
}

}

/*

 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#pragma once

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGC/Function.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>
#include <LibJS/Heap/Cell.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>

namespace Web::SVG {

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#processingURL-fetch
// The document that a use element's reference to another document fetches. It's a resource document, not an image: Any
// well-formed XML document will do, whatever its root element, since a use element only looks up an element in it by
// its ID. Every use element of a document that refers to the same URL shares one.
class SVGResourceDocument final : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(SVGResourceDocument, JS::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGResourceDocument);

public:
    static GC::Ref<SVGResourceDocument> get_or_create(DOM::Document&, URL::URL const&);

    // The parsed document, once the fetch has finished; null until then, and after a failed fetch or parse.
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> document() const { return m_resource_document; }

    bool needs_fetching() const { return m_state == State::New; }
    void fetch(NonnullRefPtr<Fetch::Infrastructure::Request>);

    // Calls on_done once the fetch has ended, whether it gave a document or not. If it has already ended, calls it at
    // once and returns no ID.
    Optional<u64> add_callback(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void()>> on_done);
    void remove_callback(u64 id);

private:
    SVGResourceDocument(DOM::Document&, URL::URL);

    virtual void visit_edges(Visitor&) override;

    void finish(GC::Ptr<DOM::Document>);
    void stop();

    enum class State {
        New,
        Fetching,
        Done,
    };

    struct Callback {
        u64 id { 0 };
        GC::Ref<GC::Function<void()>> on_done;
    };

    GC::Ref<DOM::Document> m_document;
    URL::URL m_url;
    State m_state { State::New };
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> m_resource_document;
    GC::Ptr<Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchController> m_fetch_controller;
    Vector<Callback> m_callbacks;
    u64 m_next_callback_id { 1 };
};

}

HTML::ScriptElementFetchAttributes SVGScriptElement::fetch_attributes() const

    auto referrer_policy_attribute = get_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::referrerpolicy).value_or({});
    return {
        .crossorigin = HTML::cors_setting_attribute_from_keyword(crossorigin.map([](auto const& value) { return value.utf16_view(); })),
        .cryptographic_nonce = nonce(),
        .referrer_policy = ReferrerPolicy::from_string(referrer_policy_attribute).value_or(ReferrerPolicy::ReferrerPolicy::EmptyString),
        .parser_inserted = is_parser_inserted(),
    };
}

    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);
    if (name == AttributeNames::to && !namespace_.has_value())
        update_animation();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#SetElementToAttribute
Vector<SVGKeyframe> SVGSetElement::keyframes(SVGElement const& target, CSS::PropertyID property_id) const
{
    // Specifies the value for the attribute during the duration of the ‘set’ element. The argument value must match the
    // attribute type.
    auto to = get_attribute(AttributeNames::to);
    if (!to.has_value())
        return {};
    auto value = target.parse_presentation_attribute(property_id, to->utf16_view());
    if (!value)
        return {};

    // NB: The value holds for the entire duration, so the effect starts and ends on it.
    return { keyframe(0, property_id, *value), keyframe(1, property_id, *value) };
}

}

Vector<Utf16String> SVGStringList::parse(Utf16View input, Separator separator)
{
    Vector<Utf16String> strings;
    if (separator == Separator::Whitespace) {
        // https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace
        size_t position = 0;
        auto length = input.length_in_code_units();
        auto is_ascii_whitespace = [&](size_t index) { return Infra::ASCII_WHITESPACE.contains(static_cast<u32>(input.code_unit_at(index))); };
        while (position < length) {
            while (position < length && is_ascii_whitespace(position))
                ++position;
            auto start = position;
            while (position < length && !is_ascii_whitespace(position))
                ++position;
            if (position > start)
                strings.append(Utf16String::from_utf16(input.substring_view(start, position - start)));
        }
        return strings;
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/common-microsyntaxes.html#comma-separated-tokens
    // A set of comma-separated tokens is a string containing zero or more tokens each separated from the next by a
    // single U+002C COMMA character (,), where tokens consist of any string of zero or more characters, neither
    // beginning nor ending with ASCII whitespace, nor containing any U+002C COMMA characters (,), and optionally
    // surrounded by ASCII whitespace.
    // NB: This strictly splits the string on commas, and strips the ASCII whitespace around each token.
    size_t token_start = 0;
    for (size_t position = 0; position <= input.length_in_code_units(); ++position) {
        if (position < input.length_in_code_units() && input.code_unit_at(position) != ',')
            continue;
        strings.append(Utf16String::from_utf16(input.substring_view(token_start, position - token_start).trim(Infra::ASCII_WHITESPACE)));
        token_start = position + 1;
    }
    return strings;
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermSynchronizeList
void SVGStringList::synchronize()
{
    // NB: The list does not need to be synchronized with a value that it has just reserialized itself.
    if (m_is_reserializing)
        return;

    // 1. Let value be the base value of the reflected content attribute (using the attribute's initial value if it is
    //    not present or invalid).
    // NB: The initial value of every attribute reflected by an SVGStringList is the empty list.
    auto value = m_element->attribute(m_reflected_attribute);

    // 5. Otherwise, the list element type is DOMString:
    //    1. Replace the list with a new list consisting of the values in value.
    mutable_items() = value.has_value() ? parse(*value, m_separator) : Vector<Utf16String> {};
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/types.html#TermReserialize
void SVGStringList::reserialize_reflected_attribute()
{
    // 1. Let elements be the list of values in value.
    // 2. Let serialized elements be a list of strings, where each string is formed based on the corresponding value in
    //    elements and its type:
    //    a DOMString: The string is the DOMString's value itself.
    // 3. Set the content attribute to a string consisting of the strings in serialized elements joined and separated by
    //    single U+0020 SPACE characters.
    // AD-HOC: Strings of an attribute that is a set of comma-separated tokens are joined with commas instead, so that
    //         parsing the attribute again returns the same list.
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    bool first = true;
    for (auto const& item : items()) {
        if (!first)
            builder.append_ascii(m_separator == Separator::Comma ? ", "sv : " "sv);
        first = false;
        builder.append(item);
    }

    TemporaryChange change { m_is_reserializing, true };
    m_element->set_attribute_value(m_reflected_attribute, builder.to_string());
}

}

class SVGStringList final
    : public Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable
    , public SVGList<Utf16String> {

    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(SVGStringList);

        Comma,
        Whitespace,
    };

    SVGStringList(GC::Ref<SVGElement>, Utf16FlyString reflected_attribute, Separator);

    virtual void visit_edges(Visitor&) override;

    virtual void reserialize_reflected_attribute() override;

    GC::Ref<SVGElement> m_element;
    Utf16FlyString m_reflected_attribute;
    Separator m_separator;

};

    SVGFitToViewBox::initialize_fit_to_view_box(*this);
}

    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    SVGFitToViewBox::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_current_translate);
    visitor.visit(m_active_view_element);
    visitor.visit(m_time_container);

    Base::inserted();
    create_time_container_if_outermost();

    Base::adopted_from(old_document);

    // A time container follows the document timeline of the document it was created for, so an adopted svg element
    // creates a new one once it is inserted.
    m_time_container = nullptr;
}

{
    Base::moved_from(is_subtree_root, old_ancestor);
    create_time_container_if_outermost();
}

void SVGSVGElement::create_time_container_if_outermost()
{
    // The outermost svg element of an SVG document fragment defines its timeline, which it keeps when it is removed or
    // moved and inserted again. The animations inside it update after it, as it comes first in tree order.
    if (m_time_container || !is_connected() || owner_svg_element())
        return;
    m_time_container = SMILTimeContainer::create(document());
    document().begin_smil_time_container_once_loaded(*m_time_container);
}

CSS::ElementBoxKind SVGSVGElement::box_kind() const
{
    return CSS::ElementBoxKind::SvgSvg;
}

Optional<CSS::Length> SVGSVGElement::width_attribute_length() const
{
    if (m_cached_width_attribute_length.has_value())
        return *m_cached_width_attribute_length;

    auto parsing_context = CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { document(), CSS::Parser::ParsingMode::SVGPresentationAttribute };
    auto width_attribute = attribute(SVG::AttributeNames::width);

    // NB: If the `width` attribute is an empty string, WebKit and Blink treat it as 100% while Firefox does not (the
    //     spec is unclear); a percentage never contributes here either way, so nothing distinguishes it from any other
    //     non-<length> value.
    Optional<CSS::Length> result;
    if (auto width_value = parse_css_value(parsing_context, width_attribute.value_or({}), CSS::PropertyID::Width)) {
        if (width_value->is_length())
            result = width_value->as_length().length();
    }

    m_cached_width_attribute_length = result;
    return result;
}

Optional<CSS::Length> SVGSVGElement::height_attribute_length() const
{
    if (m_cached_height_attribute_length.has_value())
        return *m_cached_height_attribute_length;

    auto parsing_context = CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { document(), CSS::Parser::ParsingMode::SVGPresentationAttribute };
    auto height_attribute = attribute(SVG::AttributeNames::height);

    // NB: See the `width` note above; an empty string `height` likewise never contributes a <length>.
    Optional<CSS::Length> result;
    if (auto height_value = parse_css_value(parsing_context, height_attribute.value_or({}), CSS::PropertyID::Height)) {
        if (height_value->is_length())
            result = height_value->as_length().length();
    }

    m_cached_height_attribute_length = result;
    return result;
}

void SVGSVGElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(name, old_value, value, namespace_);
    SVGFitToViewBox::attribute_changed(*this, name, value);

    if (name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(SVG::AttributeNames::width)) {
        m_cached_width_attribute_length = {};
        update_fallback_view_box_for_svg_as_image();
    }
    if (name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(SVG::AttributeNames::height)) {
        m_cached_height_attribute_length = {};
        update_fallback_view_box_for_svg_as_image();
    }
}

// The view box an SVG view specification gives, if fragment is one: the fragment is no view specification at all
// when it doesn't follow the grammar, names an attribute more than once, or holds an attribute value that doesn't parse.
// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#SVGFragmentIdentifiersDefinitions
static Optional<Optional<ViewBox>> view_box_of_view_specification(Utf16View fragment)
{
    // "SVGViewSpec ::= 'svgView(' SVGViewAttributes ')'"
    constexpr auto prefix = u"svgView("sv;
    if (!fragment.starts_with(prefix) || !fragment.ends_with(u")"sv))
        return {};
    // "Spaces are allowed in fragment specifications."
    auto attributes = fragment.substring_view(prefix.length_in_code_units(), fragment.length_in_code_units() - prefix.length_in_code_units() - 1)
                          .trim_ascii_whitespace();
    if (attributes.is_empty())
        return {};

    // "SVGViewAttributes ::= SVGViewAttribute | SVGViewAttribute ';' SVGViewAttributes"
    // "SVGViewAttribute ::= viewBoxSpec | preserveAspectRatioSpec | transformSpec | zoomAndPanSpec"
    Optional<ViewBox> view_box;
    bool has_view_box = false;
    bool has_preserve_aspect_ratio = false;
    bool has_transform = false;
    bool has_zoom_and_pan = false;
    bool is_valid = true;
    attributes.for_each_split_view(';', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty, [&](Utf16View attribute) {
        attribute = attribute.trim_ascii_whitespace();
        auto open_paren = attribute.find_code_unit_offset('(');
        if (!open_paren.has_value() || *open_paren == 0 || !attribute.ends_with(u")"sv)) {
            is_valid = false;
            return IterationDecision::Break;
        }
        auto name = attribute.substring_view(0, *open_paren).trim_ascii_whitespace();
        auto value = attribute.substring_view(*open_paren + 1, attribute.length_in_code_units() - *open_paren - 2);
        auto take = [&](bool& seen, bool value_parses) {
            if (seen || !value_parses)
                is_valid = false;
            seen = true;
        };
        if (name == u"viewBox"sv) {
            view_box = parse_viewbox(value);
            take(has_view_box, view_box.has_value());
        } else if (name == u"preserveAspectRatio"sv) {
            take(has_preserve_aspect_ratio, parse_preserve_aspect_ratio(value).has_value());
        } else if (name == u"transform"sv) {
            take(has_transform, parse_transform(value).has_value());
        } else if (name == u"zoomAndPan"sv) {
            auto keyword = value.trim_ascii_whitespace();
            take(has_zoom_and_pan, keyword == u"disable"sv || keyword == u"magnify"sv);
        } else {
            is_valid = false;
        }
        return is_valid ? IterationDecision::Continue : IterationDecision::Break;
    });
    if (!is_valid)
        return {};
    return view_box;
}

void SVGSVGElement::children_changed(ChildrenChangedMetadata const&)
{
    // FIXME: Add support for the other types of SVG fragment identifier, and for the preserveAspectRatio, transform
    //        and zoomAndPan of a view specification.
    //        See: https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/linking.html#LinksIntoSVG
    if (auto url = document().url(); url.fragment().has_value()) {
        auto fragment = decode_fragment_identifier(*url.fragment());
        if (auto view_box = view_box_of_view_specification(fragment); view_box.has_value()) {
            set_active_view({}, *view_box);
            return;
        }
        if (auto referenced_element = get_element_by_id(fragment)) {
            if (auto* view_element = as_if<SVGViewElement>(*referenced_element)) {
                set_active_view(*view_element, {});
                return;
            }
        }
        set_active_view({}, {});
    }
}

void SVGSVGElement::update_fallback_view_box_for_svg_as_image()
{
    // AD-HOC: This creates a fallback viewBox for SVGs used as images.
    //         If the <svg> element has width and height, but no viewBox,
    //         we fall back to a synthetic viewBox="0 0 width height".

    Optional<double> width;
    Optional<double> height;

    auto resolution_context = CSS::Length::ResolutionContext::for_document(document());

    if (auto width_length = width_attribute_length(); width_length.has_value())
        width = width_length->to_px(resolution_context).to_double();

    if (auto height_length = height_attribute_length(); height_length.has_value())
        height = height_length->to_px(resolution_context).to_double();

    if (width.has_value() && width.value() > 0 && height.has_value() && height.value() > 0) {
        m_fallback_view_box_for_svg_as_image = ViewBox { 0, 0, width.value(), height.value() };
    } else {
        m_fallback_view_box_for_svg_as_image = {};
    }
}

// The active view is the one input to the published attribute facts that no attribute of this element names, so
// changing it republishes them.
void SVGSVGElement::set_active_view(GC::Ptr<SVGViewElement> view_element, Optional<ViewBox> view_specification_view_box)
{
    auto same_view_box = [](Optional<ViewBox> const& a, Optional<ViewBox> const& b) {
        if (a.has_value() != b.has_value())
            return false;
        return !a.has_value()
            || (a->min_x == b->min_x && a->min_y == b->min_y && a->width == b->width && a->height == b->height);
    };
    if (m_active_view_element == view_element
        && same_view_box(m_view_specification_view_box, view_specification_view_box))
        return;
    m_active_view_element = view_element;
    m_view_specification_view_box = view_specification_view_box;
    publish_svg_attribute_facts();
}

Optional<ViewBox> SVGSVGElement::active_view_box_of_svg_view() const
{
    if (m_view_specification_view_box.has_value())
        return m_view_specification_view_box;
    if (m_active_view_element)
        return m_active_view_element->view_box();
    return {};
}

Optional<ViewBox> SVGSVGElement::active_view_box() const
{
    if (auto view_box = active_view_box_of_svg_view(); view_box.has_value())
        return view_box;

    if (auto view_box = SVGFitToViewBox::view_box(); view_box.has_value())
        return view_box;

    // NOTE: If the parent is a document, we're an <svg> element used as an image.
    if (parent() && parent()->is_document() && m_fallback_view_box_for_svg_as_image.has_value())
        return m_fallback_view_box_for_svg_as_image;

    return {};
}

void SVGSVGElement::deselect_all() const
{
    // This is equivalent to calling document.getSelection().removeAllRanges() on the document that this ‘svg’ element is in.
    if (auto selection = document().get_selection())
        selection->remove_all_ranges();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__pauseAnimations
void SVGSVGElement::pause_animations()
{
    // When pauseAnimations() is called, the following steps are run:
    // 1. If the current ‘svg’ element is not the outermost svg element, then return.
    if (owner_svg_element())
        return;

    // 2. Pause the timeline that controls SVG animations for the SVG document fragment that the ‘svg’ element is in.
    // NB: An svg element that has never been connected has no timeline.
    if (m_time_container)
        m_time_container->pause();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__unpauseAnimations
void SVGSVGElement::unpause_animations()
{
    // When unpauseAnimations() is called, the following steps are run:
    // 1. If the current ‘svg’ element is not the outermost svg element, then return.
    if (owner_svg_element())
        return;

    // 2. Unpause the timeline that controls SVG animations for the SVG document fragment that the ‘svg’ element is in.
    if (m_time_container)
        m_time_container->unpause();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__animationsPaused
bool SVGSVGElement::animations_paused()
{
    // When animationsPaused() is called, true is returned if the timeline that controls SVG animations for the SVG
    // document fragment that the ‘svg’ element in has been paused by pauseAnimations; otherwise, false is returned.
    auto time_container = outermost_svg_element()->time_container();
    return time_container && time_container->is_paused();
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__getCurrentTime
float SVGSVGElement::get_current_time()
{
    // When getCurrentTime() is called, the following steps are run:
    // 1. If the timeline for the current SVG document fragment has not yet begun, then return 0.
    auto time_container = outermost_svg_element()->time_container();
    if (!time_container || !time_container->has_begun())
        return 0;

    // 2. Otherwise, the timeline for the current SVG document fragment has begun. Return the current time in seconds
    //    relative to the start time of the timeline.
    return static_cast<float>(time_container->current_time_in_milliseconds() / 1000.);
}

// https://svgwg.org/specs/animations/#__svg__SVGSVGElement__setCurrentTime
void SVGSVGElement::set_current_time(float seconds)
{
    // When setCurrentTime(seconds) is called, the following steps are run:
    // 1. If the current ‘svg’ element is not the outermost svg element, then return.
    if (owner_svg_element() || !m_time_container)
        return;

    // 2. If the timeline for the current SVG document fragment has begun, then the timeline's current time (in seconds,
    //    relative to the start time of the timeline) is set to seconds.
    auto milliseconds = static_cast<double>(seconds) * 1000.;
    if (m_time_container->has_begun()) {
        m_time_container->seek_to_time_in_milliseconds(milliseconds);
        return;
    }

    // 3. Otherwise, the timeline has not begun. seconds is recorded on the current SVG document fragment as the time to
    //    be seeked to once the timeline has begun. If multiple calls to setCurrentTime are made before the timeline has
    //    begun, the most recent call's time will be used to seek the timeline once it begins.
    m_time_container->record_time_to_seek_to_once_begun_in_milliseconds(milliseconds);
}

// https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#__svg__SVGSVGElement__createSVGNumber
GC::Ref<SVGNumber> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_number() const
{
    return SVGNumber::create(0, SVGNumber::ReadOnly::No);
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/struct.html#__svg__SVGSVGElement__createSVGAngle
GC::Ref<SVGAngle> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_angle() const
{
    // A new, detached SVGAngle object whose value is the unitless <number> 0.
    return SVGAngle::create_detached({}, SVGAngle::ReadOnly::No);
}

GC::Ref<SVGLength> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_length() const
{
    // A new, detached SVGLength object whose value is the unitless <number> 0.
    return SVGLength::create_detached(document().relevant_settings_object().realm(), SVGLengthValue::number(0), SVGLength::ReadOnly::No);
}

GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMPoint> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_point() const
{
    // A new, detached DOMPoint object whose coordinates are all 0.
    return Geometry::DOMPoint::create();
}

GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMMatrix> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_matrix() const
{
    // A new, detached DOMMatrix object representing the identity matrix.
    return Geometry::DOMMatrix::create();
}

GC::Ref<Geometry::DOMRect> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_rect() const
{
    // A new, DOMRect object whose x, y, width and height are all 0.
    return Geometry::DOMRect::create(0, 0, 0, 0);
}

GC::Ref<SVGTransform> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_transform() const
{
    // A new, detached SVGTransform object whose value is matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0).
    return SVGTransform::create();
}

// https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/struct.html#__svg__SVGSVGElement__createSVGTransformFromMatrix
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<SVGTransform>> SVGSVGElement::create_svg_transform_from_matrix(Bindings::DOMMatrix2DInit const& matrix) const
{
    // Its behavior is the same as the createSVGTransformFromMatrix method on SVGTransformList.
    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/coords.html#__svg__SVGTransformList__createSVGTransformFromMatrix
    // 1. Let transform be a newly created SVGTransform object that is detached.
    auto transform = SVGTransform::create();

    // 2. Follow the steps that would be run if the setMatrix method on transform were called, passing matrix as its
    //    argument.
    TRY(transform->set_matrix(matrix));

    // 3. Return transform.
    return transform;
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG2/coords.html#SizingSVGInCSS
Optional<CSSPixelFraction> SVGSVGElement::view_box_natural_aspect_ratio(SVGSVGElement const& svg_root)
{
    // 2. If an SVG View is active:
    if (auto active_view_box = svg_root.active_view_box_of_svg_view(); active_view_box.has_value()) {
        // 1. let viewbox be the viewbox defined by the active SVG View
        auto view_box = active_view_box.value();

        // 2. return viewbox.width / viewbox.height
        if (view_box.width != 0 && view_box.height != 0)
            return view_box.width / view_box.height;

        return {};
    }

    // 3. If the ‘viewBox’ on the ‘svg’ element is correctly specified:
    if (svg_root.view_box().has_value()) {
        // 1. let viewbox be the viewbox defined by the ‘viewBox’ attribute on the ‘svg’ element
        auto const& viewbox = svg_root.view_box().value();

        // 2. return viewbox.width / viewbox.height
        auto viewbox_width = CSSPixels::nearest_value_for(viewbox.width);
        auto viewbox_height = CSSPixels::nearest_value_for(viewbox.height);
        if (viewbox_width != 0 && viewbox_height != 0)
            return viewbox_width / viewbox_height;

        return {};
    }

    // 4. return null
    return {};
}

}

bool SVGSymbolElement::is_direct_child_of_use_shadow_tree() const
{
    auto maybe_shadow_root = parent();
    if (!is<DOM::ShadowRoot>(maybe_shadow_root)) {
        return false;
    }

    auto host = static_cast<DOM::ShadowRoot const&>(*maybe_shadow_root).host();
    return is<SVGUseElement>(host);
}

CSS::ElementBoxKind SVGSymbolElement::box_kind() const
{
    // https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/render.html#TermNeverRenderedElement
    // [..] it also includes a ‘symbol’ element that is not the instance root of a use-element shadow tree.
    if (!is_direct_child_of_use_shadow_tree())
        return CSS::ElementBoxKind::NoBox;
    return CSS::ElementBoxKind::SvgGraphics;
}
