GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(PointerEvent);

// https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-screenx
// For untrusted PointerEvents, coordinates are floored for click, auxclick, and
// contextmenu events (via the MouseEvent base class). For all other pointer
// event types, fractional coordinates are preserved.
bool PointerEvent::should_have_fractional_coordinates() const
{
    if (is_trusted())
        return true;
    return type() != HTML::EventNames::click
        && type() != UIEvents::EventNames::auxclick
        && type() != HTML::EventNames::contextmenu;
}

double PointerEvent::screen_x() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_screen_x : MouseEvent::screen_x(); }
double PointerEvent::screen_y() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_screen_y : MouseEvent::screen_y(); }
double PointerEvent::page_x() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_page_x : MouseEvent::page_x(); }
double PointerEvent::page_y() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_page_y : MouseEvent::page_y(); }
double PointerEvent::client_x() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_client_x : MouseEvent::client_x(); }
double PointerEvent::client_y() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_client_y : MouseEvent::client_y(); }
double PointerEvent::offset_x() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_offset_x : MouseEvent::offset_x(); }
double PointerEvent::offset_y() const { return should_have_fractional_coordinates() ? m_offset_y : MouseEvent::offset_y(); }

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> PointerEvent::create_from_platform_event(JS::Object const& relevant_global_object, GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy> window_proxy, FlyString const& event_name, CSSPixelPoint screen, CSSPixelPoint page, CSSPixelPoint client, CSSPixelPoint offset, Optional<CSSPixelPoint> movement, unsigned button, unsigned buttons, unsigned modifiers, int detail)
{
    PointerEventOptions event_options;
    event_options.detail = detail;
    event_options.ctrl_key = modifiers & Mod_Ctrl;
    event_options.shift_key = modifiers & Mod_Shift;
    event_options.alt_key = modifiers & Mod_Alt;
    event_options.meta_key = modifiers & Mod_Super;
    event_options.screen_x = screen.x().to_double();
    event_options.screen_y = screen.y().to_double();
    event_options.client_x = client.x().to_double();
    event_options.client_y = client.y().to_double();
    event_options.view = window_proxy;
    event_options.pointer_id = mouse_pointer_id;
    event_options.pointer_type = PointerTypes::Mouse;
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#click
    // For these events, all PointerEvent specific attributes (defined in this spec) other than pointerId and
    // pointerType MUST have their default values.
    if (event_name != EventNames::click && event_name != EventNames::auxclick && event_name != EventNames::contextmenu) {
        event_options.is_primary = true;
        event_options.pressure = event_name != EventNames::pointerup && buttons ? ACTIVE_PRESSURE_DEFAULT_IN_ACTIVE_BUTTON_STATE : 0;
    }
    if (movement.has_value()) {
        event_options.movement_x = movement.value().x().to_double();
        event_options.movement_y = movement.value().y().to_double();
    }
    event_options.button = mouse_button_to_button_code(static_cast<MouseButton>(button));
    event_options.buttons = buttons;
    auto event = PointerEvent::create(event_name, move(event_options), page.x().to_double(), page.y().to_double(), offset.x().to_double(), offset.y().to_double(), HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(relevant_global_object));
    event->set_bubbles(true);
    event->set_cancelable(true);
    event->set_composed(true);
    return event;
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> PointerEvent::create_from_platform_event(JS::Object const& relevant_global_object, GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy> window_proxy, Utf16FlyString const& event_name, CSSPixelPoint screen, CSSPixelPoint page, CSSPixelPoint client, CSSPixelPoint offset, Optional<CSSPixelPoint> movement, unsigned button, unsigned buttons, unsigned modifiers, int detail)
{
    PointerEventOptions event_options;
    event_options.detail = detail;
    event_options.ctrl_key = modifiers & Mod_Ctrl;
    event_options.shift_key = modifiers & Mod_Shift;
    event_options.alt_key = modifiers & Mod_Alt;
    event_options.meta_key = modifiers & Mod_Super;
    event_options.screen_x = screen.x().to_double();
    event_options.screen_y = screen.y().to_double();
    event_options.client_x = client.x().to_double();
    event_options.client_y = client.y().to_double();
    event_options.view = window_proxy;
    event_options.pointer_id = mouse_pointer_id;
    event_options.pointer_type = PointerTypes::Mouse;
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#click
    // For these events, all PointerEvent specific attributes (defined in this spec) other than pointerId and
    // pointerType MUST have their default values.
    if (event_name != EventNames::click && event_name != EventNames::auxclick && event_name != EventNames::contextmenu) {
        event_options.is_primary = true;
        event_options.pressure = event_name != EventNames::pointerup && buttons ? ACTIVE_PRESSURE_DEFAULT_IN_ACTIVE_BUTTON_STATE : 0;
    }
    if (movement.has_value()) {
        event_options.movement_x = movement->x().to_double();
        event_options.movement_y = movement->y().to_double();
    }
    event_options.button = mouse_button_to_button_code(static_cast<MouseButton>(button));
    event_options.buttons = buttons;
    event_options.bubbles = true;
    event_options.cancelable = true;
    event_options.composed = true;
    return create_with_coalesced_events(event_name, move(event_options), page.x().to_double(), page.y().to_double(), offset.x().to_double(), offset.y().to_double(), HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(relevant_global_object));
}

PointerEvent::PointerEvent(FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&& options, double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
    : MouseEvent(type, options, page_x, page_y, offset_x, offset_y, time_stamp)
    , m_pointer_id(options.pointer_id)
    , m_width(options.width)
    , m_height(options.height)
    , m_pressure(options.pressure)
    , m_tangential_pressure(options.tangential_pressure)
    , m_tilt_x(options.tilt_x)
    , m_tilt_y(options.tilt_y)
    , m_twist(options.twist)
    , m_altitude_angle(options.altitude_angle)
    , m_azimuth_angle(options.azimuth_angle)
    , m_pointer_type(move(options.pointer_type))
    , m_is_primary(options.is_primary)
    , m_persistent_device_id(options.persistent_device_id)
    , m_coalesced_events(move(options.coalesced_events))
    , m_predicted_events(move(options.predicted_events))
{
}

PointerEvent::PointerEvent(Utf16FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&& options, double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
    : MouseEvent(type, options, page_x, page_y, offset_x, offset_y, time_stamp)
    , m_pointer_id(options.pointer_id)
    , m_width(options.width)
    , m_height(options.height)
    , m_pressure(options.pressure)
    , m_tangential_pressure(options.tangential_pressure)
    , m_tilt_x(options.tilt_x)
    , m_tilt_y(options.tilt_y)
    , m_twist(options.twist)
    , m_altitude_angle(options.altitude_angle)
    , m_azimuth_angle(options.azimuth_angle)
    , m_pointer_type(options.pointer_type)
    , m_is_primary(options.is_primary)
    , m_persistent_device_id(options.persistent_device_id)
    , m_coalesced_events(move(options.coalesced_events))
    , m_predicted_events(move(options.predicted_events))
{
}

GC::Ref<PointerEvent> PointerEvent::create(Utf16FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&& options, double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<PointerEvent>(type, move(options), page_x, page_y, offset_x, offset_y, time_stamp);
}

GC::Ref<PointerEvent> PointerEvent::create_with_coalesced_events(Utf16FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&& options, double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#coalesced-events
    // For trusted pointermove and pointerrawupdate events, the list is a sequence of all PointerEvents that were
    // coalesced into this event. [...] As a result, the coalesced events lists for these events always contain at
    // least one event. For all other trusted event types, it is an empty list.
    // NB: We do not coalesce platform events, so the only coalesced event is a copy of the dispatched event itself.
    if (type == EventNames::pointermove || type == EventNames::pointerrawupdate) {
        PointerEventOptions coalesced_options = options;
        coalesced_options.bubbles = false;
        coalesced_options.cancelable = false;
        coalesced_options.coalesced_events.clear();
        coalesced_options.predicted_events.clear();
        auto coalesced_event = create(type, move(coalesced_options), page_x, page_y, offset_x, offset_y, time_stamp);
        options.coalesced_events.append(coalesced_event);
    }

    return create(type, move(options), page_x, page_y, offset_x, offset_y, time_stamp);
}

PointerEvent::~PointerEvent() = default;

void PointerEvent::set_target_of_coalesced_events(GC::Ptr<DOM::EventTarget> target)
{
    for (auto& coalesced_event : m_coalesced_events)
        coalesced_event->set_target(target.ptr());
}

void PointerEvent::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_coalesced_events);
    visitor.visit(m_predicted_events);
}

GC::Ref<PointerEvent> PointerEvent::create(
    FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&& options,
    double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y,
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<PointerEvent>(type, move(options), page_x, page_y, offset_x, offset_y, time_stamp);
}

struct Tilt {
    i32 tilt_x { 0 };
    i32 tilt_y { 0 };
};

// https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#converting-between-tiltx-tilty-and-altitudeangle-azimuthangle
// User agents MUST use the following algorithm for converting these values.
static Tilt spherical2tilt(double altitude_angle, double azimuth_angle)
{
    constexpr auto pi = AK::Pi<double>;

    double tilt_x_radians = 0;
    double tilt_y_radians = 0;

    if (altitude_angle == 0) {
        // the pen is in the X-Y plane
        if (azimuth_angle == 0 || azimuth_angle == 2 * pi) {
            // pen is on positive X axis
            tilt_x_radians = pi / 2;
        }
        if (azimuth_angle == pi / 2) {
            // pen is on positive Y axis
            tilt_y_radians = pi / 2;
        }
        if (azimuth_angle == pi) {
            // pen is on negative X axis
            tilt_x_radians = -pi / 2;
        }
        if (azimuth_angle == 3 * pi / 2) {
            // pen is on negative Y axis
            tilt_y_radians = -pi / 2;
        }
        if (azimuth_angle > 0 && azimuth_angle < pi / 2) {
            tilt_x_radians = pi / 2;
            tilt_y_radians = pi / 2;
        }
        if (azimuth_angle > pi / 2 && azimuth_angle < pi) {
            tilt_x_radians = -pi / 2;
            tilt_y_radians = pi / 2;
        }
        if (azimuth_angle > pi && azimuth_angle < 3 * pi / 2) {
            tilt_x_radians = -pi / 2;
            tilt_y_radians = -pi / 2;
        }
        if (azimuth_angle > 3 * pi / 2 && azimuth_angle < 2 * pi) {
            tilt_x_radians = pi / 2;
            tilt_y_radians = -pi / 2;
        }
    }

    if (altitude_angle != 0) {
        auto tan_altitude = AK::tan(altitude_angle);

        tilt_x_radians = AK::atan(AK::cos(azimuth_angle) / tan_altitude);
        tilt_y_radians = AK::atan(AK::sin(azimuth_angle) / tan_altitude);
    }

    // When the user agent calculates tiltX / tiltY from azimuthAngle / altitudeAngle it SHOULD round the final
    // integer values using Math.round [ECMASCRIPT] rules.
    auto round = [](double value) { return static_cast<i32>(AK::floor(value + 0.5)); };
    return { round(AK::to_degrees(tilt_x_radians)), round(AK::to_degrees(tilt_y_radians)) };
}

struct SphericalAngles {
    double altitude_angle { 0 };
    double azimuth_angle { 0 };
};

// https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#converting-between-tiltx-tilty-and-altitudeangle-azimuthangle
static SphericalAngles tilt2spherical(i32 tilt_x, i32 tilt_y)
{
    constexpr auto pi = AK::Pi<double>;

    auto tilt_x_radians = AK::to_radians(static_cast<double>(tilt_x));
    auto tilt_y_radians = AK::to_radians(static_cast<double>(tilt_y));

    // calculate azimuth angle
    double azimuth_angle = 0;

    if (tilt_x == 0) {
        if (tilt_y > 0)
            azimuth_angle = pi / 2;
        else if (tilt_y < 0)
            azimuth_angle = 3 * pi / 2;
    } else if (tilt_y == 0) {
        if (tilt_x < 0)
            azimuth_angle = pi;
    } else if (AK::abs(tilt_x) == 90 || AK::abs(tilt_y) == 90) {
        // not enough information to calculate azimuth
        azimuth_angle = 0;
    } else {
        // Non-boundary case: neither tiltX nor tiltY is equal to 0 or +-90
        auto tan_x = AK::tan(tilt_x_radians);
        auto tan_y = AK::tan(tilt_y_radians);

        azimuth_angle = AK::atan2(tan_y, tan_x);
        if (azimuth_angle < 0)
            azimuth_angle += 2 * pi;
    }

    // calculate altitude angle
    double altitude_angle = 0;

    if (AK::abs(tilt_x) == 90 || AK::abs(tilt_y) == 90) {
        altitude_angle = 0;
    } else if (tilt_x == 0) {
        altitude_angle = pi / 2 - AK::fabs(tilt_y_radians);
    } else if (tilt_y == 0) {
        altitude_angle = pi / 2 - AK::fabs(tilt_x_radians);
    } else {
        // Non-boundary case: neither tiltX nor tiltY is equal to 0 or +-90
        auto tan_x = AK::tan(tilt_x_radians);
        auto tan_y = AK::tan(tilt_y_radians);
        altitude_angle = AK::atan(1.0 / AK::sqrt(tan_x * tan_x + tan_y * tan_y));
    }

    return { altitude_angle, azimuth_angle };
}

static void initialize_orientation(PointerEventOptions& options, Bindings::PointerEventInit const& event_init)
{
    constexpr auto pi = AK::Pi<double>;

    options.tilt_x = event_init.tilt_x.value_or(0);
    options.tilt_y = event_init.tilt_y.value_or(0);
    options.altitude_angle = event_init.altitude_angle.value_or(pi / 2);
    options.azimuth_angle = event_init.azimuth_angle.value_or(0);

    auto has_tilt = event_init.tilt_x.has_value() || event_init.tilt_y.has_value();
    auto has_spherical_angles = event_init.altitude_angle.has_value() || event_init.azimuth_angle.has_value();

    // NB: Only one representation can be derived from the other. When both or neither are supplied, the values are
    //     used as given.
    if (has_tilt == has_spherical_angles)
        return;

    if (has_tilt) {
        // INTEROP: Other browsers reduce tilt values to [-90, 90] before converting them, without changing the
        //          tiltX and tiltY attributes.
        auto normalize_tilt = [](i32 tilt) {
            auto normalized = tilt % 180;
            if (normalized > 90)
                normalized -= 180;
            else if (normalized < -90)
                normalized += 180;
            return normalized;
        };
        auto spherical_angles = tilt2spherical(normalize_tilt(options.tilt_x), normalize_tilt(options.tilt_y));
        options.altitude_angle = spherical_angles.altitude_angle;
        options.azimuth_angle = spherical_angles.azimuth_angle;
        return;
    }

    // INTEROP: Other browsers reduce azimuthAngle to [0, 2π] before converting it, without changing the
    //          azimuthAngle attribute.
    auto azimuth_angle = options.azimuth_angle;
    if (azimuth_angle < 0 || azimuth_angle > 2 * pi) {
        azimuth_angle = AK::fmod(azimuth_angle, 2 * pi);
        if (azimuth_angle < 0)
            azimuth_angle += 2 * pi;
    }
    auto tilt = spherical2tilt(options.altitude_angle, azimuth_angle);
    options.tilt_x = tilt.tilt_x;
    options.tilt_y = tilt.tilt_y;
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> PointerEvent::create_for_constructor(FlyString const& event_name, Bindings::PointerEventInit const& event_init, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    PointerEventOptions options;
    static_cast<MouseEventOptions&>(options) = mouse_event_options_from_bindings(event_init);
    options.pointer_id = event_init.pointer_id;
    options.width = event_init.width;
    options.height = event_init.height;
    options.pressure = event_init.pressure;
    options.tangential_pressure = event_init.tangential_pressure;
    options.twist = event_init.twist;
    initialize_orientation(options, event_init);
    options.pointer_type = event_init.pointer_type;
    options.is_primary = event_init.is_primary;
    options.persistent_device_id = event_init.persistent_device_id;

    options.coalesced_events.ensure_capacity(event_init.coalesced_events.size());
    for (auto const& coalesced_event : event_init.coalesced_events)
        options.coalesced_events.unchecked_append(*coalesced_event);

    options.predicted_events.ensure_capacity(event_init.predicted_events.size());
    for (auto const& predicted_event : event_init.predicted_events)
        options.predicted_events.unchecked_append(*predicted_event);

    return create(event_name, move(options), event_init.client_x, event_init.client_y, event_init.client_x, event_init.client_y, time_stamp);
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> PointerEvent::create_for_constructor(Utf16String const& event_name, Bindings::PointerEventInit const& event_init, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    PointerEventOptions options;
    static_cast<MouseEventOptions&>(options) = mouse_event_options_from_bindings(event_init);
    options.pointer_id = event_init.pointer_id;
    options.width = event_init.width;
    options.height = event_init.height;
    options.pressure = event_init.pressure;
    options.tangential_pressure = event_init.tangential_pressure;
    options.twist = event_init.twist;
    initialize_orientation(options, event_init);
    options.pointer_type = event_init.pointer_type;
    options.is_primary = event_init.is_primary;
    options.persistent_device_id = event_init.persistent_device_id;
    options.coalesced_events.ensure_capacity(event_init.coalesced_events.size());
    for (auto const& coalesced_event : event_init.coalesced_events)
        options.coalesced_events.unchecked_append(*coalesced_event);
    options.predicted_events.ensure_capacity(event_init.predicted_events.size());
    for (auto const& predicted_event : event_init.predicted_events)
        options.predicted_events.unchecked_append(*predicted_event);
    return create(Utf16FlyString::from_utf16(event_name.utf16_view()), move(options), event_init.client_x, event_init.client_y, event_init.client_x, event_init.client_y, time_stamp);
}

extern "C" {
PointerEvent const* web_ui_events_pointer_event_from_event(DOM::Event const*);
WebIDL::Long web_ui_events_pointer_event_pointer_id(PointerEvent const*);

PointerEvent const* web_ui_events_pointer_event_from_event(DOM::Event const* event)
{
    return as_if<PointerEvent>(event);
}

WebIDL::Long web_ui_events_pointer_event_pointer_id(PointerEvent const* event)
{
    return event->pointer_id();
}
}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Utf16FlyString.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <LibWeb/UIEvents/MouseEvent.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/HighResolutionTime/DOMHighResTimeStamp.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/WebIDL/Types.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

class Window;

}

namespace Web::Bindings {

struct PointerEventInit;

}

namespace Web::UIEvents {

class PointerEvent;

// https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-pointerid
// The mouse is the one pointer there is, and this is its id in every pointer event of it.
constexpr WebIDL::Long mouse_pointer_id = 0;

struct PointerEventOptions : public MouseEventOptions {
    WebIDL::Long pointer_id { mouse_pointer_id };
    double width { 1 };
    double height { 1 };
    float pressure { 0 };
    float tangential_pressure { 0 };
    WebIDL::Long tilt_x { 0 };
    WebIDL::Long tilt_y { 0 };
    WebIDL::Long twist { 0 };
    double altitude_angle { AK::Pi<double> / 2 };
    double azimuth_angle { 0 };
    Utf16FlyString pointer_type {};
    bool is_primary { false };
    WebIDL::Long persistent_device_id { 0 };
    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> coalesced_events;
    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> predicted_events;
};

// https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#pointerevent-interface
class PointerEvent : public MouseEvent {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(PointerEvent, MouseEvent);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(PointerEvent);

public:
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<PointerEvent> create(
        FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&&,
        double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y,
        HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<PointerEvent> create(
        Utf16FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&&,
        double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y,
        HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<PointerEvent> create_with_coalesced_events(
        Utf16FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&&,
        double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y,
        HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    [[nodiscard]] static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> create_for_constructor(FlyString const&, Bindings::PointerEventInit const&, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    [[nodiscard]] static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> create_for_constructor(Utf16String const&, Bindings::PointerEventInit const&, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    [[nodiscard]] static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> create_from_platform_event(JS::Object const& relevant_global_object, GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy>, FlyString const& event_name, CSSPixelPoint screen, CSSPixelPoint page, CSSPixelPoint client, CSSPixelPoint offset, Optional<CSSPixelPoint> movement, unsigned button, unsigned buttons, unsigned modifiers, int detail = 0);
    [[nodiscard]] static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> create_from_platform_event(JS::Object const& relevant_global_object, GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy>, Utf16FlyString const& event_name, CSSPixelPoint screen, CSSPixelPoint page, CSSPixelPoint client, CSSPixelPoint offset, Optional<CSSPixelPoint> movement, unsigned button, unsigned buttons, unsigned modifiers, int detail = 0);

    virtual ~PointerEvent() override;

    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-screenx
    // PointerEvent preserves fractional coordinates for all types except click, auxclick, and contextmenu.
    double screen_x() const override;
    double screen_y() const override;
    double page_x() const override;
    double page_y() const override;
    double client_x() const override;
    double client_y() const override;
    double offset_x() const override;
    double offset_y() const override;

    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#attributes-and-default-actions
    // Many user agents expose non-standard attributes fromElement and toElement in MouseEvents to support legacy content.
    // We encourage those user agents to set the values of those (inherited) attributes in PointerEvents to null to
    // transition authors to the use of standardized alternates (target and relatedTarget).
    virtual GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> from_element() const override { return nullptr; }
    virtual GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> to_element() const override { return nullptr; }

    WebIDL::Long pointer_id() const { return m_pointer_id; }
    double width() const { return m_width; }
    double height() const { return m_height; }
    float pressure() const { return m_pressure; }
    float tangential_pressure() const { return m_tangential_pressure; }
    WebIDL::Long tilt_x() const { return m_tilt_x; }
    WebIDL::Long tilt_y() const { return m_tilt_y; }
    WebIDL::Long twist() const { return m_twist; }
    double altitude_angle() const { return m_altitude_angle; }
    double azimuth_angle() const { return m_azimuth_angle; }
    Utf16FlyString const& pointer_type() const { return m_pointer_type; }
    bool is_primary() const { return m_is_primary; }
    WebIDL::Long persistent_device_id() const { return m_persistent_device_id; }
    AK::ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> get_coalesced_events() const { return m_coalesced_events; }
    void set_target_of_coalesced_events(GC::Ptr<DOM::EventTarget>);
    AK::ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> get_predicted_events() const { return m_predicted_events; }

    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-pressure
    // For hardware and platforms that do not support pressure, the value MUST be 0.5 when in the active buttons state and 0 otherwise.
    static constexpr float ACTIVE_PRESSURE_DEFAULT_IN_ACTIVE_BUTTON_STATE { 0.5 };

protected:
    PointerEvent(FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&&, double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    PointerEvent(Utf16FlyString const& type, PointerEventOptions&&, double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);

    virtual void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&) override;

private:
    bool should_have_fractional_coordinates() const;

    virtual bool is_pointer_event() const final { return true; }

    // A unique identifier for the pointer causing the event.
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-pointerid
    WebIDL::Long m_pointer_id { 0 };

    // The width (magnitude on the X axis), in CSS pixels (see [CSS21]), of the contact geometry of the pointer
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-width
    double m_width { 1 };

    // The height (magnitude on the Y axis), in CSS pixels (see [CSS21]), of the contact geometry of the pointer.
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-width
    double m_height { 1 };

    // The normalized pressure of the pointer input in the range of [0,1], where 0 and 1 represent the minimum and
    // maximum pressure the hardware is capable of detecting, respectively
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-pressure
    float m_pressure { 0 };

    // The normalized tangential pressure (also known as barrel pressure), typically set by an additional control
    // (e.g. a finger wheel on an airbrush stylus), of the pointer input in the range of [-1,1], where 0 is the
    // neutral position of the control
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-tangentialpressure
    float m_tangential_pressure { 0 };

    // The plane angle (in degrees, in the range of [-90,90]) between the Y-Z plane and the plane containing both the
    // transducer (e.g. pen/stylus) axis and the Y axis
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-tiltx
    WebIDL::Long m_tilt_x { 0 };

    // The plane angle (in degrees, in the range of [-90,90]) between the X-Z plane and the plane containing both the
    // transducer (e.g. pen/stylus) axis and the X axis
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-tilty
    WebIDL::Long m_tilt_y { 0 };

    // The clockwise rotation (in degrees, in the range of [0,359]) of a transducer (e.g. pen/stylus) around its own major axis
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-twist
    WebIDL::Long m_twist { 0 };

    // The altitude (in radians) of the transducer (e.g. pen/stylus), in the range [0,π/2] — where 0 is parallel to the surface
    // (X-Y plane), and π/2 is perpendicular to the surface
    // For hardware and platforms that do not report tilt or angle, the value MUST be π/2.
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-altitudeangle
    static constexpr double DEFAULT_ALTITUDE_ANGLE { AK::Pi<double> / 2 };
    double m_altitude_angle { DEFAULT_ALTITUDE_ANGLE };

    // The azimuth angle (in radians) of the transducer (e.g. pen/stylus), in the range [0, 2π] — where 0 represents a transducer
    // whose cap is pointing in the direction of increasing X values (point to "3 o'clock" if looking straight down) on the X-Y
    // plane, and the values progressively increase when going clockwise (π/2 at "6 o'clock", π at "9 o'clock", 3π/2 at "12 o'clock").
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-azimuthangle
    double m_azimuth_angle { 0 };

    // Indicates the device type that caused the event (mouse, pen, touch, etc.)
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-pointertype
    Utf16FlyString m_pointer_type;

    // Indicates if the pointer represents the primary pointer of this pointer type
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-isprimary
    bool m_is_primary { false };

    // A unique identifier for the pointing device.
    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-persistentdeviceid
    WebIDL::Long m_persistent_device_id { 0 };

    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-getcoalescedevents
    AK::Vector<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> m_coalesced_events;

    // https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-pointerevent-getpredictedevents
    AK::Vector<GC::Ref<PointerEvent>> m_predicted_events;
};

}

// https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#dom-textevent-inittextevent
void TextEvent::init_text_event(Utf16FlyString const& type, bool bubbles, bool cancelable, GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy> view, Utf16String const& data)
{
    // Initializes attributes of a TextEvent object. This method has the same behavior as UIEvent.initUIEvent().
    // The value of detail remains undefined.

    // 1. If this’s dispatch flag is set, then return.
    if (dispatched())
        return;

    // 2. Initialize this with type, bubbles, and cancelable.
    initialize_event(type, bubbles, cancelable);

    // Implementation Defined: Initialise other values.
    m_view = view;
    m_data = data;
}

/*

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibGC/RootHashMap.h>
#include <LibGC/RootVector.h>
#include <LibWeb/UIEvents/TouchEvent.h>

namespace Web::UIEvents {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(TouchEvent);

GC::Ref<TouchEvent> TouchEvent::create(Utf16String const& type, Bindings::TouchEventInit const& init, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<TouchEvent>(Utf16FlyString::from_utf16(type.utf16_view()), init, time_stamp);
}

GC::Ref<TouchEvent> TouchEvent::create(FlyString const& type, Bindings::TouchEventInit const& init, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<TouchEvent>(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8(type.to_string()), init, time_stamp);
}

TouchEvent::TouchEvent(Utf16FlyString const& type, Bindings::TouchEventInit const& init, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
    : UIEvent(type, init, time_stamp)
    , m_touches(TouchList::create(init.touches))
    , m_target_touches(TouchList::create(init.target_touches))
    , m_changed_touches(TouchList::create(init.changed_touches))
    , m_original_touches(m_touches)
    , m_original_target_touches(m_target_touches)
    , m_original_changed_touches(m_changed_touches)
    , m_alt_key(init.alt_key)
    , m_meta_key(init.meta_key)
    , m_ctrl_key(init.ctrl_key)
    , m_shift_key(init.shift_key)
{
    for (auto list : { m_touches, m_target_touches, m_changed_touches }) {
        for (u32 index = 0; index < list->length(); ++index)
            touch_target_list().append(list->item(index)->target());
    }
    m_last_touch_targets = touch_target_list();
}

// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-dispatch
// NB: Each event path entry has retargeted touch targets. Clone changed Touch objects so that snapshots retained by
//     another listener remain immutable, and reuse each clone across the three lists.
void TouchEvent::retarget_touch_lists()
{
    auto const& targets = touch_target_list();
    if (targets == m_last_touch_targets)
        return;
    m_last_touch_targets = targets;
    GC::RootHashMap<Touch*, GC::Ref<Touch>> clones;
    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<Touch>> cloned_touches;
    size_t offset = 0;
    auto retarget = [&](GC::Ref<TouchList> original) {
        GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<Touch>> touches;
        bool changed = false;
        for (u32 index = 0; index < original->length(); ++index) {
            auto touch = original->item(index);
            auto target = targets[offset++];
            if (target == touch->target()) {
                touches.append(*touch);
                continue;
            }
            changed = true;
            auto clone = clones.ensure(touch.ptr(), [&] {
                auto clone = touch->clone_with_target(*target);
                cloned_touches.append(clone);
                return clone;
            });
            touches.append(clone);
        }
        return changed ? TouchList::create(move(touches)) : original;
    };
    m_touches = retarget(m_original_touches);
    m_target_touches = retarget(m_original_target_touches);
    m_changed_touches = retarget(m_original_changed_touches);
}

void TouchEvent::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_touches);
    visitor.visit(m_target_touches);
    visitor.visit(m_changed_touches);
    visitor.visit(m_original_touches);
    visitor.visit(m_original_target_touches);
    visitor.visit(m_original_changed_touches);
    visitor.visit(m_last_touch_targets);
}

}

    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(UIEvent);

    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<UIEvent> create(FlyString const& type, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<UIEvent> create(FlyString const& type, UIEventInit const&, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<UIEvent> create(Utf16String const& type, UIEventInit const&, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);

    GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy> const view() const { return m_view; }

    virtual u32 which() const { return 0; }

    void init_ui_event(Utf16FlyString const& type, bool bubbles, bool cancelable, GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy> view, int detail)
    {
        // Initializes attributes of an UIEvent object. This method has the same behavior as initEvent().

        // 1. If this’s dispatch flag is set, then return.
        if (dispatched())
            return;

        // 2. Initialize this with type, bubbles, and cancelable.
        initialize_event(type, bubbles, cancelable);

        // Implementation Defined: Initialise other values.
        m_view = view;
        m_detail = detail;
    }

    UIEvent(FlyString const& event_name, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);
    UIEvent(Utf16FlyString const& event_name, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);

static WebIDL::Long legacy_wheel_delta_from_delta(double delta)
{
    return AK::clamp_to<WebIDL::Long>(-delta);
}

static WebIDL::Long legacy_wheel_delta_from_wheel_tick_120ths(double wheel_tick_120ths)
{
    return legacy_wheel_delta_from_delta(AK::trunc(wheel_tick_120ths));
}

WheelEvent::WheelEvent(FlyString const& event_name, WheelEventOptions const& options, double page_x, double page_y, double offset_x, double offset_y, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
    : MouseEvent(event_name, options, page_x, page_y, offset_x, offset_y, time_stamp)
    , m_delta_x(options.delta_x)
    , m_delta_y(options.delta_y)
    , m_delta_z(options.delta_z)
    , m_delta_mode(options.delta_mode)
    , m_wheel_delta_x(options.wheel_delta_x ? options.wheel_delta_x : legacy_wheel_delta_from_delta(options.delta_x))
    , m_wheel_delta_y(options.wheel_delta_y ? options.wheel_delta_y : legacy_wheel_delta_from_delta(options.delta_y))
{
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<WheelEvent>> WheelEvent::create_from_platform_event(JS::Object const& relevant_global_object, GC::Ptr<HTML::WindowProxy> window_proxy, FlyString const& event_name, CSSPixelPoint screen, CSSPixelPoint page, CSSPixelPoint client, CSSPixelPoint offset, double delta_x, double delta_y, double wheel_tick_120ths_x, double wheel_tick_120ths_y, unsigned button, unsigned buttons, unsigned modifiers, WheelEventIsCancelable is_cancelable)
{
    WheelEventOptions event_options;
    event_options.ctrl_key = modifiers & Mod_Ctrl;
    event_options.shift_key = modifiers & Mod_Shift;
    event_options.alt_key = modifiers & Mod_Alt;
    event_options.meta_key = modifiers & Mod_Super;
    event_options.screen_x = screen.x().to_double();
    event_options.screen_y = screen.y().to_double();
    event_options.client_x = client.x().to_double();
    event_options.client_y = client.y().to_double();
    event_options.button = button;
    event_options.buttons = buttons;
    event_options.delta_x = delta_x;
    event_options.delta_y = delta_y;
    event_options.delta_mode = WheelDeltaMode::DOM_DELTA_PIXEL;
    event_options.wheel_delta_x = legacy_wheel_delta_from_wheel_tick_120ths(wheel_tick_120ths_x);
    event_options.wheel_delta_y = legacy_wheel_delta_from_wheel_tick_120ths(wheel_tick_120ths_y);
    event_options.view = window_proxy;
    auto event = WheelEvent::create(event_name, event_options, page.x().to_double(), page.y().to_double(), offset.x().to_double(), offset.y().to_double(), HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(relevant_global_object));
    event->set_bubbles(true);
    event->set_cancelable(is_cancelable == WheelEventIsCancelable::Yes);
    event->set_composed(true);
    return event;
}

    event_options.screen_y = screen.y().to_double();
    event_options.client_x = client.x().to_double();
    event_options.client_y = client.y().to_double();
    event_options.button = button;
    event_options.buttons = buttons;
    event_options.delta_x = delta_x;
    event_options.delta_y = delta_y;

    event_options.wheel_delta_x = legacy_wheel_delta_from_wheel_tick_120ths(wheel_tick_120ths_x);

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Requests.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/PolicyContainers.h>
#include <LibWeb/UpgradeInsecureRequests/AbstractOperations.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/SecureContexts/AbstractOperations.h>

namespace Web::UpgradeInsecureRequests {

// AD-HOC: Upgrade Insecure Requests reads request's client's target browsing context, but means the browsing context
//         being navigated, which request's reserved client names.
static bool target_browsing_context_is_nested(Fetch::Infrastructure::Request const& request)
{
    using Context = Fetch::Infrastructure::ReservedClientContext;
    auto const& reserved_client = request.reserved_client_snapshot();
    auto const* environment = reserved_client ? reserved_client->kind.get_pointer<Context::Environment>() : nullptr;
    return environment && environment->target_browsing_context == Context::TargetBrowsingContext::Nested;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-upgrade-insecure-requests/#upgrade-request
void upgrade_request_to_a_potentially_trustworthy_url_if_appropriate(Fetch::Infrastructure::Request& request)
{
    // AD-HOC: This algorithm predates request's URL list. It notes that it upgrades insecurely-redirected requests as
    //         well as insecure initial requests, which needs it to operate on request's current URL.
    auto& url = request.current_url();

    // AD-HOC: Request's policy container holds the insecure requests policy and upgrade insecure navigations set of
    //         request's client as captured for this fetch, which the steps below read in place of client's.
    auto const& policy_container = *request.policy_container().get<NonnullRefPtr<HTML::PolicyContainer const>>();

    // 1. If request is a navigation request, append a header named Upgrade-Insecure-Requests with a value of 1 to
    //    request's header list if any of the following criteria are met:
    //    1. request's URL is not a potentially trustworthy URL
    //    2. request's URL's host is not a preloadable HSTS host
    // NB: We have no preloaded HSTS hosts, so the second criterion is always met.
    // AD-HOC: Main fetch runs this algorithm again for every redirect, so only append the header once.
    if (request.is_navigation_request() && !request.header_list()->contains("Upgrade-Insecure-Requests"sv))
        request.header_list()->append(HTTP::Header::isomorphic_encode("Upgrade-Insecure-Requests"sv, "1"sv));

    // 2. If request is a navigation request, then:
    if (request.is_navigation_request()) {
        // 1. If request is a form submission, skip the remaining substeps, and continue upgrading request.
        // 2. If request's client's target browsing context is a nested browsing context, skip the remaining substeps
        //    and continue upgrading request.
        if (!request.is_form_submission() && !target_browsing_context_is_nested(request)) {
            // 3. Let tuple be a tuple of request's URL's host and port.
            // 4. If tuple is contained in client's upgrade insecure navigations set, then skip the remaining
            //    substeps, and continue upgrading request.
            auto const& host = url.host();
            if (!host.has_value() || !policy_container.upgrade_insecure_navigations_set().contains({ *host, url.port() })) {
                // 5. Return without further modifying request.
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    // 3. Let upgrade state be the result of executing § 4.2 Should insecure requests be upgraded for client? upon
    //    request's client.
    // AD-HOC: § 4.2 reads client's responsible document or browsing context, which HTML no longer has. Request's policy
    //         container holds what client inherited, and its CSP list the policies client enforces. See
    //         https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-upgrade-insecure-requests/issues/27.
    auto upgrade_state = policy_container.insecure_requests_policy();

    // 4. If upgrade state is Do Not Upgrade, return without modifying request.
    if (upgrade_state == InsecureRequestsPolicy::DoNotUpgrade)
        return;

    // 5. If request's URL's scheme is "http", set request's URL's scheme to "https", and return.
    if (url.scheme() == "http"sv) {
        url.set_scheme("https"sv);

        // NB: Unlike the URL parser, setting the scheme does not remove a port that is the new scheme's default port.
        if (url.port() == 443)
            url.set_port({});
    }
}

}

    [ImplementedAs=construct_with_base_url] constructor(URLPatternInput input, USVString baseURL, optional URLPatternOptions options = {});
    [ImplementedAs=construct] constructor(optional URLPatternInput input = {}, optional URLPatternOptions options = {});

    boolean test(optional URLPatternInput input = {}, optional USVString baseURL);

    URLPatternResult? exec(optional URLPatternInput input = {}, optional USVString baseURL);

    readonly attribute USVString protocol;
    readonly attribute USVString username;
    readonly attribute USVString password;
    readonly attribute USVString hostname;
    readonly attribute USVString port;
    readonly attribute USVString pathname;
    readonly attribute USVString search;
    readonly attribute USVString hash;

    readonly attribute boolean hasRegExpGroups;
};

    USVString password;
    USVString hostname;

    USVString pathname;
    USVString search;
    USVString hash;
    USVString baseURL;
};

};

    sequence<URLPatternInput> inputs;

    URLPatternComponentResult protocol;
    URLPatternComponentResult username;
    URLPatternComponentResult password;
    URLPatternComponentResult hostname;
    URLPatternComponentResult port;
    URLPatternComponentResult pathname;
    URLPatternComponentResult search;
    URLPatternComponentResult hash;
};

    USVString input;
    record<USVString, (USVString or undefined)> groups;
};
