#define BROWSER_NAME "Ladybird"

// NB: Some web servers treat us very badly unless we pretend to be one of the major browsers.
//     This token is appended to the User-Agent string to improve compatibility.
//     We will need to update this periodically to match a somewhat recent version.
#define SAD_COMPATIBILITY_HACK "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/153.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"

// NB: Servers sniff the parenthesized platform token of the User-Agent string and only recognize
//     the frozen tokens sent by major browsers. Reporting the actual OS and CPU here gets us
//     served degraded or broken content (e.g. the Instagram login page), so the platform token is
//     frozen per OS and decoupled from the real platform.
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
#    define UA_PLATFORM_STRING "Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7"
#elif defined(AK_OS_IOS)
#    define UA_PLATFORM_STRING "iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 27_2 like Mac OS X"
#elif defined(AK_OS_ANDROID)
#    define UA_PLATFORM_STRING "Linux; Android 10; K"
#elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    define UA_PLATFORM_STRING "Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64"
#else
#    define UA_PLATFORM_STRING "X11; Linux x86_64"
#endif

constexpr auto default_user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (" UA_PLATFORM_STRING ") " BROWSER_NAME "/" BROWSER_VERSION " " SAD_COMPATIBILITY_HACK ""sv;
// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/system-state.html#dom-navigator-platform
// "Must return either the empty string or a string representing the platform on which the browser is executing, e.g.
// "MacIntel", "Win32", "Linux x86_64", "Linux armv81"."
// Browsers on macOS report MacIntel whatever the CPU is, and browsers on Windows report Win32; elsewhere, the platform
// is what uname() reports as the system name and the machine, spelled the way the kernel spells them.
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
#    define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_STRING "MacIntel"
#elif defined(AK_OS_IOS)
#    define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_STRING "iPhone"
#elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_STRING "Win32"
#else
#    if defined(AK_OS_ANDROID) || defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_SYSTEM_NAME "Linux"
#    else
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_SYSTEM_NAME OS_STRING
#    endif
#    if ARCH(X86_64)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE "x86_64"
#    elif ARCH(AARCH64)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE "aarch64"
#    elif ARCH(I386)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE "i686"
#    elif ARCH(RISCV64)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE "riscv64"
#    elif ARCH(PPC64LE)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE "ppc64le"
#    elif ARCH(PPC64)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE "ppc64"
#    elif ARCH(PPC)
#        define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE "ppc"
#    else
#        error Unknown architecture
#    endif
#    define NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_STRING NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_SYSTEM_NAME " " NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_MACHINE
#endif

constexpr auto default_platform = NAVIGATOR_PLATFORM_STRING ""sv;
constexpr auto default_navigator_compatibility_mode = NavigatorCompatibilityMode::Chrome;

// The languages a navigator reports, and the Accept-Language header carries, until the user's own list arrives.
inline Vector<String> default_preferred_languages()
{
    return { "en-US"_string, "en"_string };
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/MediaSession/MediaSessionState.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibGfx/ShareableBitmap.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/MediaSession/MediaSessionState.h>

namespace IPC {

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::MediaSession::MediaSessionPositionState const& state)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.duration));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.playback_rate));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.position));
    // Every process on the machine reads the same monotonic clock, so the timestamp means the same to the receiver.
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.last_position_updated_time.nanoseconds()));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::MediaSession::MediaSessionPositionState> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto duration = TRY(decoder.decode<double>());
    auto playback_rate = TRY(decoder.decode<double>());
    auto position = TRY(decoder.decode<double>());
    auto last_position_updated_time = TRY(decoder.decode<i64>());
    return Web::MediaSession::MediaSessionPositionState {
        duration, playback_rate, position, MonotonicTime {} + AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(last_position_updated_time)
    };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::MediaSession::MediaSessionState const& state)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.activation_counter));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.title));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.artist));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.album));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.playback_state));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.position));
    TRY(encoder.encode(state.supported_actions));
    Optional<Gfx::ShareableBitmap> artwork;
    if (state.artwork)
        artwork = state.artwork->to_shareable_bitmap();
    TRY(encoder.encode(artwork));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::MediaSession::MediaSessionState> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    Web::MediaSession::MediaSessionState state;
    state.activation_counter = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
    state.title = TRY(decoder.decode<String>());
    state.artist = TRY(decoder.decode<String>());
    state.album = TRY(decoder.decode<String>());
    state.playback_state = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState>());
    if (state.playback_state != Web::Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::None
        && state.playback_state != Web::Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Paused
        && state.playback_state != Web::Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Playing)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid media session playback state");
    state.position = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<Web::MediaSession::MediaSessionPositionState>>());
    state.supported_actions = TRY(decoder.decode<Vector<Web::Bindings::MediaSessionAction>>());
    for (auto action : state.supported_actions) {
        if (to_underlying(action) > to_underlying(Web::Bindings::MediaSessionAction::Voiceactivity))
            return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid media session action");
    }
    auto artwork = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<Gfx::ShareableBitmap>>());
    if (artwork.has_value())
        state.artwork = artwork->bitmap();
    if (state.artwork && (state.artwork->width() > Web::MediaSession::artwork_maximum_side || state.artwork->height() > Web::MediaSession::artwork_maximum_side))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Media session artwork exceeds the maximum dimensions");
    return state;
}

}

/*

 * Copyright (c) 2022, networkException <networkexception@serenityos.org>

#include <AK/CharacterTypes.h>
#include <AK/GenericLexer.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Utf8View.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/MimeSniff/MimeType.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/RustFFI.h>

namespace Web::MimeSniff {

static FFI::FfiStringInput ffi_string_input(StringView string)
{
    return { reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(string.characters_without_null_termination()), nullptr, nullptr, string.length() };
}

static FFI::FfiStringInput ffi_string_input(Utf16View string)
{
    if (string.has_ascii_storage())
        return { string.ascii_bytes().data(), nullptr, nullptr, string.length_in_code_units() };
    if (string.has_latin1_storage())
        return { nullptr, string.latin1_span().data(), nullptr, string.length_in_code_units() };
    return { nullptr, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<u16 const*>(string.utf16_span().data()), string.length_in_code_units() };
}

static String string_from_ffi(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    return String::from_utf8_without_validation(bytes);
}

static void set_string_from_ffi(void* ctx, ReadonlyBytes string)
{
    *static_cast<String*>(ctx) = string_from_ffi(string);
}

bool is_javascript_mime_type_essence_match(Utf16View string)
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_is_javascript_mime_type_essence_match(ffi_string_input(string));
}

static bool contains_only_http_quoted_string_token_code_points(StringView string)
{
    // https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#http-quoted-string-token-code-point
    // An HTTP quoted-string token code point is U+0009 TAB, a code point in the range U+0020 SPACE to U+007E (~), inclusive,
    // or a code point in the range U+0080 through U+00FF (ÿ), inclusive.
    for (auto ch : Utf8View(string)) {
        if (!(ch == '\t' || (ch >= 0x20 && ch <= 0x7E) || (ch >= 0x80 && ch <= 0xFF)))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool contains_only_http_token_code_points(StringView string)
{
    // https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#http-token-code-point
    // An HTTP token code point is U+0021 (!), U+0023 (#), U+0024 ($), U+0025 (%), U+0026 (&), U+0027 ('), U+002A (*),
    // U+002B (+), U+002D (-), U+002E (.), U+005E (^), U+005F (_), U+0060 (`), U+007C (|), U+007E (~), or an ASCII alphanumeric.
    constexpr auto is_certain_non_ascii_alphanumeric = is_any_of("!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~"sv);
    for (char ch : string) {
        if (!is_certain_non_ascii_alphanumeric(ch) && !is_ascii_alphanumeric(ch))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

MimeType::MimeType(String type, String subtype)
    : m_type(move(type))
    , m_subtype(move(subtype))
{
    // NOTE: type and subtype are expected to be non-empty and contain only
    // http token code points in the MIME type parsing algorithm. That's
    // why we are performing the same checks here.
    VERIFY(!m_type.is_empty() && contains_only_http_token_code_points(m_type));
    VERIFY(!m_subtype.is_empty() && contains_only_http_token_code_points(m_subtype));
}

MimeType::MimeType(MimeType const& other) = default;
MimeType& MimeType::operator=(MimeType const& other) = default;

MimeType::MimeType(MimeType&& other) = default;
MimeType& MimeType::operator=(MimeType&& other) = default;

MimeType::~MimeType() = default;

MimeType MimeType::create(String type, String subtype)
{
    auto mime_type = MimeType { move(type), move(subtype) };
    mime_type.m_cached_essence = MUST(String::formatted("{}/{}", mime_type.m_type, mime_type.m_subtype));
    return mime_type;
}

MimeType MimeType::from_ffi(FFI::FfiMimeType const& ffi_mime_type)
{
    auto mime_type = create(string_from_ffi(ffi_mime_type.type_), string_from_ffi(ffi_mime_type.subtype));
    for (auto const& parameter : ffi_mime_type.parameters)
        mime_type.m_parameters.set(string_from_ffi(parameter.name), string_from_ffi(parameter.value));
    return mime_type;
}

void MimeType::lend_to_ffi(Function<void(FFI::FfiMimeType const&)> const& callback) const
{
    Vector<FFI::FfiMimeTypeParameter> parameters;
    parameters.ensure_capacity(m_parameters.size());
    for (auto const& [name, value] : m_parameters)
        parameters.unchecked_append({ name.bytes(), value.bytes() });
    callback({ m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes(), parameters.span() });
}

static void set_mime_type_from_ffi(void* ctx, FFI::FfiMimeType const* ffi_mime_type)
{
    *static_cast<Optional<MimeType>*>(ctx) = MimeType::from_ffi(*ffi_mime_type);
}

static Optional<MimeType> parse_mime_type(FFI::FfiStringInput input)
{
    Optional<MimeType> mime_type;
    FFI::mime_sniff_parse_mime_type(input, &mime_type, set_mime_type_from_ffi);
    return mime_type;
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#parse-a-mime-type
Optional<MimeType> MimeType::parse(StringView string)
{
    return parse_mime_type(ffi_string_input(string));
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#parse-a-mime-type
Optional<MimeType> MimeType::parse(Utf16View string)
{
    return parse_mime_type(ffi_string_input(string));
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type-essence
String const& MimeType::essence() const
{
    // The essence of a MIME type mimeType is mimeType’s type, followed by U+002F (/), followed by mimeType’s subtype.
    return m_cached_essence;
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#serialize-a-mime-type
String MimeType::serialized() const
{
    String serialization;
    lend_to_ffi([&](FFI::FfiMimeType const& ffi_mime_type) {
        FFI::mime_sniff_serialize_mime_type(&ffi_mime_type, &serialization, set_string_from_ffi);
    });
    return serialization;
}

void MimeType::set_parameter(String name, String value)
{
    // https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#parameters
    // A MIME type’s parameters is an ordered map whose keys are ASCII strings and values are strings limited to HTTP quoted-string token code points.
    VERIFY(contains_only_http_quoted_string_token_code_points(name));
    VERIFY(contains_only_http_quoted_string_token_code_points(value));
    m_parameters.set(move(name), move(value));
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#image-mime-type
bool MimeType::is_image() const
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_mime_type_is_in_group(FFI::MimeTypeGroup::Image, m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes());
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#audio-or-video-mime-type
bool MimeType::is_audio_or_video() const
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_mime_type_is_in_group(FFI::MimeTypeGroup::AudioOrVideo, m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes());
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#font-mime-type
bool MimeType::is_font() const
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_mime_type_is_in_group(FFI::MimeTypeGroup::Font, m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes());
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type
bool MimeType::is_xml() const
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_mime_type_is_in_group(FFI::MimeTypeGroup::Xml, m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes());
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#html-mime-type
bool MimeType::is_html() const
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_mime_type_is_in_group(FFI::MimeTypeGroup::Html, m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes());
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type
bool MimeType::is_javascript() const
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_mime_type_is_in_group(FFI::MimeTypeGroup::JavaScript, m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes());
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#json-mime-type
bool MimeType::is_json() const
{
    return FFI::mime_sniff_mime_type_is_in_group(FFI::MimeTypeGroup::Json, m_type.bytes(), m_subtype.bytes());
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#minimize-a-supported-mime-type
String minimise_a_supported_mime_type(MimeType const& mime_type, bool is_supported_by_the_user_agent)
{
    String minimized;
    FFI::mime_sniff_minimize_a_supported_mime_type(mime_type.type().bytes(), mime_type.subtype().bytes(), is_supported_by_the_user_agent, &minimized, set_string_from_ffi);
    return minimized;
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type
class WEBCOMMON_API MimeType {
public:
    [[nodiscard]] static MimeType create(String type, String subtype);
    [[nodiscard]] static Optional<MimeType> parse(StringView);
    [[nodiscard]] static Optional<MimeType> parse(Utf16View);

    MimeType(MimeType const&);
    MimeType& operator=(MimeType const&);

    MimeType(MimeType&&);
    MimeType& operator=(MimeType&&);

    ~MimeType();

    String const& type() const { return m_type; }
    String const& subtype() const { return m_subtype; }
    OrderedHashMap<String, String> const& parameters() const { return m_parameters; }

    bool is_image() const;
    bool is_audio_or_video() const;
    bool is_font() const;
    bool is_xml() const;
    bool is_html() const;
    bool is_javascript() const;
    bool is_json() const;

    void set_parameter(String name, String value);

    String const& essence() const;
    [[nodiscard]] String serialized() const;
    static MimeType from_ffi(FFI::FfiMimeType const&);
    void lend_to_ffi(Function<void(FFI::FfiMimeType const&)> const&) const;

private:
    MimeType(String type, String subtype);

    // https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#type
    // A MIME type’s type is a non-empty ASCII string.
    String m_type;

    // https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#subtype
    // A MIME type’s subtype is a non-empty ASCII string.
    String m_subtype;

    // https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#parameters
    // A MIME type’s parameters is an ordered map whose keys are ASCII strings and values are strings limited to HTTP quoted-string token code points. It is initially empty.
    OrderedHashMap<String, String> m_parameters;

    // Non-standard, but computed once upfront.
    String m_cached_essence;
};

WEBCOMMON_API String minimise_a_supported_mime_type(MimeType const&, bool is_supported_by_the_user_agent);

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/MimeSniff/Resource.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2023-2024, Kemal Zebari <kemalzebra@gmail.com>.
 * Copyright (c) 2025, Ben Eidson <b.e.eidson@gmail.com>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibWebCommon/MimeSniff/Resource.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/RustFFI.h>

namespace Web::MimeSniff {

static FFI::SniffingContext to_ffi(SniffingContext sniffing_context)
{
    switch (sniffing_context) {
    case SniffingContext::None:
        return FFI::SniffingContext::None;
    case SniffingContext::Browsing:
        return FFI::SniffingContext::Browsing;
    case SniffingContext::Image:
        return FFI::SniffingContext::Image;
    case SniffingContext::AudioOrVideo:
        return FFI::SniffingContext::AudioOrVideo;
    case SniffingContext::Font:
        return FFI::SniffingContext::Font;
    case SniffingContext::TextOrBinary:
        return FFI::SniffingContext::TextOrBinary;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

MimeType Resource::sniff(ReadonlyBytes data, SniffingConfiguration configuration)
{
    Optional<MimeType> computed_mime_type;
    auto sniff = [&](FFI::FfiMimeType const* supplied_type) {
        FFI::mime_sniff_sniff(data, to_ffi(configuration.sniffing_context), configuration.scheme.bytes(), supplied_type, configuration.no_sniff, &computed_mime_type, [](void* ctx, FFI::FfiMimeType const* mime_type) {
            *static_cast<Optional<MimeType>*>(ctx) = MimeType::from_ffi(*mime_type);
        });
    };

    if (configuration.supplied_type.has_value())
        configuration.supplied_type->lend_to_ffi([&](FFI::FfiMimeType const& supplied_type) { sniff(&supplied_type); });
    else
        sniff(nullptr);

    return computed_mime_type.release_value();
}

}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> IPC::encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::NotificationsAPI::NotificationData const& data)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.title));
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.body));
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.tag));
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.language));
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.direction));
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.silent));
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.require_interaction));
    TRY(encoder.encode(data.renotify));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::NotificationsAPI::NotificationData> IPC::decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    Web::NotificationsAPI::NotificationData data;
    data.title = TRY(decoder.decode<Utf16String>());
    data.body = TRY(decoder.decode<Utf16String>());
    data.tag = TRY(decoder.decode<Utf16String>());
    data.language = TRY(decoder.decode<Utf16String>());
    data.direction = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::Bindings::NotificationDirection>());
    data.silent = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<bool>>());
    data.require_interaction = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>());
    data.renotify = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>());
    return data;
}

enum class AsyncScrollNodeKind : u8 {
    Viewport,
    Element,
    PseudoElement,
    VisualViewport,
};

// Stable identity for reconciling compositor-side scroll offsets after the paint snapshot has been rebuilt.
struct AsyncScrollNodeStableID {
    UniqueNodeID node_id;
    AsyncScrollNodeKind kind { AsyncScrollNodeKind::Element };
    u8 pseudo_element_type { 0 };

    bool operator==(AsyncScrollNodeStableID const&) const = default;
};

// Where the compositor has scrolled a scroll node to, in CSS pixels.
struct CompositorScrollOffset {
    AsyncScrollNodeStableID scroll_node;
    CSSPixelPoint offset;

    bool operator==(CompositorScrollOffset const&) const = default;
};

// The compositor drags the thumb of a scrollbar the display list paints, while the mouse events of that drag still
// reach the main thread so that everything but the scrolling stays there.
struct ScrollbarDraggedByCompositor {
    // The context of the document the scroller is in, which may be nested in the one the event is dispatched to. Only
    // the process that owns that context can tell which node the scroller's id names.
    CompositorContextId context_id;
    AsyncScrollNodeStableID scroller_stable_node_id;

    bool operator==(ScrollbarDraggedByCompositor const&) const = default;
};

// Whether an overlay scrollbar that the compositor fades has faded out, so that it takes no pointer input.
struct OverlayScrollbarVisibility {
    AsyncScrollNodeStableID scroller_stable_node_id;
    bool vertical { false };
    bool hidden { false };

    bool operator==(OverlayScrollbarVisibility const&) const = default;
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Traits<Web::AsyncScrollNodeStableID> : DefaultTraits<Web::AsyncScrollNodeStableID> {
    static unsigned hash(Web::AsyncScrollNodeStableID const& stable_node_id)
    {
        return pair_int_hash(u64_hash(static_cast<u64>(stable_node_id.node_id.value())),
            pair_int_hash(to_underlying(stable_node_id.kind), stable_node_id.pseudo_element_type));
    }
};

#pragma once

#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/DragEvent.h>

namespace Web {

DragEvent DragEvent::clone_without_browser_data() const
{
    return { type, position, screen_position, button, buttons, modifiers, {}, nullptr, id };
}

}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> IPC::encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::DragEvent const& event)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.type));
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.position));
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.screen_position));
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.button));
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.buttons));
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.modifiers));
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.files));
    TRY(encoder.encode(event.id));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::DragEvent> IPC::decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto type = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::DragEvent::Type>());
    auto position = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::DevicePixelPoint>());
    auto screen_position = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::DevicePixelPoint>());
    auto button = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::UIEvents::MouseButton>());
    auto buttons = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::UIEvents::MouseButton>());
    auto modifiers = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier>());
    auto files = TRY(decoder.decode<Vector<Web::HTML::SelectedFile>>());
    auto id = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());

    return Web::DragEvent { type, position, screen_position, button, buttons, modifiers, move(files), nullptr, id };
}

#pragma once

namespace Web {

enum class EventResult {
    // The event is allowed to continue. It was not cancelled by the page, nor handled explicitly by the WebContent
    // process. The UI process is allowed to further process the event.
    Accepted,

    // The event was accepted, and was handled explicitly by the WebContent process. The UI process should not further
    // process the event.
    Handled,

    // The event was not accepted by the WebContent process (e.g. because the document is no longer active, or a
    // drag-and-drop is active).
    Dropped,

    // The event was cancelled by the page (e.g. by way of e.preventDefault()).
    Cancelled,
};

}

struct WEBCOMMON_API KeyEvent {
    enum class Type : u8 {
        KeyDown,
        KeyUp,
    };

    KeyEvent clone_without_browser_data() const;

    Type type;
    Web::UIEvents::KeyCode key { Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Invalid };
    Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier modifiers { Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier::Mod_None };

    bool should_insert_text { false };

    bool async_scroll_performed_default_action { false };

    Optional<u64> user_input_scroll_count_with_nothing_to_scroll {};

inline bool is_keyboard_scroll_key(Web::UIEvents::KeyCode key, u32 modifiers)
{
    switch (key) {
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Space:
        return (modifiers & ~(Web::UIEvents::Mod_Shift | Web::UIEvents::Mod_Keypad)) == Web::UIEvents::Mod_None;
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Up:
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Down:
        return first_is_one_of(modifiers & ~Web::UIEvents::Mod_Keypad, Web::UIEvents::Mod_None, Web::UIEvents::Mod_PlatformCtrl);
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_PageUp:
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_PageDown:
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Left:
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Right:
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Home:
    case Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_End:
        return (modifiers & ~Web::UIEvents::Mod_Keypad) == Web::UIEvents::Mod_None;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

// Discrete wheel deltas come from stepwise input such as mouse wheel notches; precise wheel deltas come from input
// that reports exact pixel distances, such as touchpad panning gestures.
enum class WheelDeltaPrecision : u8 {
    Discrete,
    Precise,
};

// Besides its pixel delta, wheel input counts how far the wheel turned in 120ths of a tick, the unit of the legacy
// wheelDelta. A tick is a wheel notch, or one line on platforms that accelerate the wheel by whole lines. Input that
// reports only a pixel delta counts its ticks from that: a notch scrolls three 40-pixel lines, and precise input has
// no notches, so it counts one tick per 40-pixel line step.
// INTEROP: For macOS touchpad scrolling, Blink, WebKit, and Gecko all report 3 units per pixel; Blink and WebKit
//          truncate, Gecko rounds. For the ctrl-wheel events of a pinch, WebKit and Gecko also report 3 units per
//          pixel, while Blink reports 120 units per event.
constexpr double wheel_tick_120ths_from_pixel_delta(double pixel_delta, WheelDeltaPrecision precision)
{
    constexpr double tick_120ths_per_tick = 120;
    constexpr double pixels_per_notch = 3 * 40;
    constexpr double pixels_per_precise_tick = 40;
    if (precision == WheelDeltaPrecision::Precise)
        return pixel_delta * (tick_120ths_per_tick / pixels_per_precise_tick);
    return pixel_delta * (tick_120ths_per_tick / pixels_per_notch);
}

// Input that scrolls with a gesture, such as a touchpad, reports whether the user is still making that gesture,
// whether a flick has handed the scrolling over to momentum, and when it ends.
enum class ScrollGesturePhase : u8 {
    None,
    Ongoing,
    Momentum,
    Ended,
};

enum class PointerType : u8 {
    Mouse,
    Pen,
    Touch,
};

// https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#pointerevent-interface
struct PointerProperties {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    i32 pointer_id { 0 };
    PointerType pointer_type { PointerType::Mouse };
    double width { 1 };
    double height { 1 };
    double pressure { 0 };
    double tangential_pressure { 0 };
    i32 tilt_x { 0 };
    i32 tilt_y { 0 };
    i32 twist { 0 };
    double altitude_angle { AK::Pi<double> / 2 };
    double azimuth_angle { 0 };
};

// NB: Native mouse input leaves this empty, avoiding an allocation and keeping the input event small.
class WEBCOMMON_API PointerInputData {
public:
    PointerInputData() = default;
    explicit PointerInputData(Optional<PointerProperties>);
    PointerInputData(PointerInputData const&);
    PointerInputData(PointerInputData&&) = default;
    PointerInputData& operator=(PointerInputData&&) = default;

    Optional<PointerProperties> properties() const;
    PointerProperties const* ptr() const { return m_properties.ptr(); }

private:
    OwnPtr<PointerProperties> m_properties;
};

// What the compositor found of a wheel event's gesture as it passed the event on, which WebContent follows rather
// than deciding again.
struct WheelGestureMark {
    // The gesture the event is in. The events of one gesture carry the same id, and no other gesture has it.
    u64 gesture_id { 0 };
    // Whether the gesture goes on for as long as its fingers rest on the touchpad, which the platform reports the lift
    // of, rather than until its events pause.
    bool lasts_until_fingers_lift { false };
    u64 step_number { 0 };
};

struct WEBCOMMON_API MouseEvent {
    enum class Type : u8 {
        MouseDown,
        MouseUp,
        MouseMove,
        MouseLeave,
        MouseCancel,
        MouseWheel,
    };

    MouseEvent clone_without_browser_data() const;

    Type type;

    Web::UIEvents::MouseButton buttons { Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None };
    Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier modifiers { Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier::Mod_None };
    double wheel_delta_x { 0 };
    double wheel_delta_y { 0 };
    double wheel_tick_120ths_x { 0 };
    double wheel_tick_120ths_y { 0 };
    WheelDeltaPrecision wheel_delta_precision { WheelDeltaPrecision::Discrete };
    ScrollGesturePhase scroll_gesture_phase { ScrollGesturePhase::None };
    int click_count { 0 };

    OwnPtr<BrowserInputData> browser_data {};
    bool async_scroll_performed_default_action { false };
    u64 id { 0 };
    Optional<Web::ScrollbarDraggedByCompositor> scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor {};
    PointerInputData pointer_data {};
    Optional<WheelGestureMark> wheel_gesture_mark {};
};

struct WEBCOMMON_API PinchEvent {
    Web::DevicePixelPoint position;
    Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier modifiers { Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier::Mod_None };
    double scale_delta;
    bool async_zoom_performed_default_action { false };
    // The page dispatched the pinch's ctrl+wheel event and did not cancel it, which leaves only the zoom of the page's
    // visual viewport to do.
    bool wheel_event_was_dispatched { false };
    // The fingers have not left the touchpad since an earlier step of the pinch.
    bool continues_gesture { false };
    u64 id { 0 };
};

/*

#include <AK/Assertions.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/InputRoutingDecision.h>

namespace Web {

// NB: Rust has the decisions without their strings, and makes each string from the name.
static consteval bool is_kebab_case_of(StringView string, StringView name)
{
    size_t string_index = 0;
    for (size_t name_index = 0; name_index < name.length(); ++name_index) {
        auto character = name[name_index];
        auto is_upper_case = character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z';
        if (is_upper_case && name_index > 0 && (string_index >= string.length() || string[string_index++] != '-'))
            return false;
        auto lower_case_character = is_upper_case ? static_cast<char>(character - 'A' + 'a') : character;
        if (string_index >= string.length() || string[string_index++] != lower_case_character)
            return false;
    }
    return string_index == string.length();
}

#define __ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISION(name, string) static_assert(is_kebab_case_of(string##sv, #name##sv));
ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISIONS(__ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISION)
#undef __ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISION

StringView input_routing_decision_name(InputRoutingDecision decision)
{
    switch (decision) {
#define __ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISION(name, string) \
    case InputRoutingDecision::name:                     \
        return string##sv;
        ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISIONS(__ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISION)
#undef __ENUMERATE_INPUT_ROUTING_DECISION
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/InputTrace.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibWebCommon/Page/InputTrace.h>

namespace Web {

// A test that never takes its trace must not grow it without bound.
static constexpr size_t maximum_input_trace_record_count = 10'000;

StringView input_trace_stage_name(InputTraceStage stage)
{
    switch (stage) {
    case InputTraceStage::Compositor:
        return "compositor"sv;
    case InputTraceStage::CompositorForMainThread:
        return "compositor-for-main-thread"sv;
    case InputTraceStage::WebContent:
        return "web-content"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void InputTraceRecorder::record(InputTraceRecord record)
{
    if (!m_records.has_value() || m_records->size() >= maximum_input_trace_record_count)
        return;
    m_records->append(move(record));
}

Vector<InputTraceRecord> InputTraceRecorder::take()
{
    if (!m_records.has_value())
        return {};
    return m_records.release_value();
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/InputTrace.h

#pragma once

namespace Web {

enum class InputTraceStage : u8 {
    // The compositor, as it takes an input event from the UI.
    Compositor,
    // The compositor, as WebContent's main thread asks it to scroll for an input event.
    CompositorForMainThread,
    WebContent,
};

WEBCOMMON_API StringView input_trace_stage_name(InputTraceStage);

struct InputTraceRecord {
    // The id the UI gave the input event, or 0 for input that did not come from the UI.
    u64 input_event_id { 0 };
    InputTraceStage stage { InputTraceStage::WebContent };
    InputRoutingDecision decision { InputRoutingDecision::NoAnswerFromCompositor };
    Optional<AsyncScrollNodeStableID> scroller {};
    Optional<UniqueNodeID> dom_target {};
};

// Collects the routing decisions of input events while a test asks for them.
class WEBCOMMON_API InputTraceRecorder {
public:
    void begin() { m_records = Vector<InputTraceRecord> {}; }
    bool is_recording() const { return m_records.has_value(); }
    void record(InputTraceRecord);
    // Returns what was recorded since the trace began, and stops recording.
    Vector<InputTraceRecord> take();

private:
    Optional<Vector<InputTraceRecord>> m_records;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/PageId.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Concepts.h>
#include <AK/DistinctNumeric.h>
#include <LibIPC/SenderClaim.h>

namespace Web {

// Identifies a page within one WebContent process. The UI process hands out page IDs and tracks which
// connection each one belongs to, so a page ID in a message from a helper process is a claim about the
// sender. The distinct type keeps that claim from being mistaken for an ordinary number.
AK_TYPEDEF_DISTINCT_ORDERED_ID(u64, PageId);

// A page ID in a message is checked against the receiver's own record of which pages the sender may act
// for.
template<typename Stub>
bool verify_sender_claim(Stub& stub, PageId const& page_id)
{
    if constexpr (requires {
                      { stub.may_act_for_page(page_id) } -> SameAs<bool>;
                  })
        return stub.may_act_for_page(page_id);
    else
        return true;
}

}

namespace IPC {

template<>
class SenderClaimReceiver<Web::PageId> {
public:
    // True when the connection a message came from was given the page the message names. A receiver
    // that hands out no page IDs is not the party the claim is made to, so it accepts every page ID.
    virtual bool may_act_for_page(Web::PageId) const { return true; }

protected:
    ~SenderClaimReceiver() = default;
};

}

using InputEvent = Variant<Web::KeyEvent, Web::MouseEvent, DragEvent, Web::PinchEvent>;

inline u64 input_event_id(InputEvent const& event)
{
    return event.visit([](auto const& event) { return event.id; });
}

inline void set_input_event_id(InputEvent& event, u64 id)
{
    event.visit([&](auto& event) { event.id = id; });
}

struct QueuedInputEvent {
    Web::PageId page_id { 0 };
    InputEvent event;
    // The events coalesced into this one, which finish when it does.
    Vector<u64> coalesced_event_ids;
    // The local root the event targets when it is not the page's traversable: a navigable whose parent's document
    // another process hosts, which the UI process addresses by id.
    Optional<HTML::CrossProcessId> navigable_id;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/Translation.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Export.h>

namespace Web {

// A stretch of a translation unit's text that comes from one place in the document. The translator carries each
// run's token over to the words that translate it, so the translated text can be put back where it came from, even
// when the translation reorders those words.
struct TranslationRun {
    Utf16String text;
    u32 token { 0 };
    // Text the translator must leave exactly as it is, e.g. the text of an element whose translation mode is
    // no-translate, inside a paragraph that's otherwise translated.
    bool keep_as_is { false };

    bool operator==(TranslationRun const&) const = default;
};

// A piece of a document's text that's translated as a whole, e.g. a paragraph.
struct TranslationUnit {
    u64 id { 0 };
    Vector<TranslationRun> runs;
};

// A unit's translation; nothing if the translator couldn't translate it.
struct TranslatedUnit {
    u64 id { 0 };
    Optional<Vector<TranslationRun>> runs;
};

// What a page offers for working out which language it's in.
struct TranslationLanguageSample {
    // The language of the document element, from its lang attribute or the Content-Language header.
    Optional<String> declared_language;
    Utf16String text;
};

}

namespace IPC {

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Web::TranslationRun const&);

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<Web::TranslationRun> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Web::TranslationUnit const&);

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<Web::TranslationUnit> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Web::TranslatedUnit const&);

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<Web::TranslatedUnit> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Web::TranslationLanguageSample const&);

template<>
WEBCOMMON_API ErrorOr<Web::TranslationLanguageSample> decode(Decoder&);

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/Permissions/Permissions.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Permissions/Permissions.h>

namespace Web::Permissions {

Optional<PermissionName> permission_name_from_string(StringView name)
{
    if (name == "geolocation"sv)
        return PermissionName::Geolocation;
    if (name == "microphone"sv)
        return PermissionName::Microphone;
    if (name == "notifications"sv)
        return PermissionName::Notifications;
    return {};
}

StringView to_string(PermissionName name)
{
    switch (name) {
    case PermissionName::Geolocation:
        return "geolocation"sv;
    case PermissionName::Microphone:
        return "microphone"sv;
    case PermissionName::Notifications:
        return "notifications"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> IPC::encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshotEntry const& entry)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(entry.top_level_origin));
    TRY(encoder.encode(entry.name));
    TRY(encoder.encode(entry.state));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshotEntry> IPC::decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto top_level_origin = TRY(decoder.decode<URL::Origin>());
    auto name = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::Permissions::PermissionName>());
    auto state = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::Permissions::EffectiveState>());
    return Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshotEntry { move(top_level_origin), name, state };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> IPC::encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot const& snapshot)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(snapshot.revision));
    TRY(encoder.encode(snapshot.origins));
    TRY(encoder.encode(snapshot.entries));
    TRY(encoder.encode(snapshot.geolocation_default));
    TRY(encoder.encode(snapshot.microphone_default));
    TRY(encoder.encode(snapshot.notifications_default));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot> IPC::decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto revision = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
    auto origins = TRY(decoder.decode<Vector<URL::Origin>>());
    auto entries = TRY(decoder.decode<Vector<Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshotEntry>>());
    auto geolocation_default = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::Permissions::EffectiveState>());
    auto microphone_default = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::Permissions::EffectiveState>());
    auto notifications_default = TRY(decoder.decode<Web::Permissions::EffectiveState>());
    return Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot { revision, move(origins), move(entries), geolocation_default, microphone_default, notifications_default };
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebCommon/Permissions/Permissions.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibURL/Origin.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Export.h>

namespace Web::Permissions {

// The powerful features whose permission the UI process asks the user for.
enum class PermissionName : u8 {
    Geolocation,
    Microphone,
    Notifications,
};

constexpr inline Array PERMISSION_NAMES {
    PermissionName::Geolocation,
    PermissionName::Microphone,
    PermissionName::Notifications,
};

WEBCOMMON_API Optional<PermissionName> permission_name_from_string(StringView);
WEBCOMMON_API StringView to_string(PermissionName);

// What a site gets for a permission once every input is applied: the stored decision, an embargo, the global setting,
// and for location, the operating system's own authorization.
enum class EffectiveState : u8 {
    Granted,
    Denied,
    Prompt,
};

// How the user answered a permission prompt. Dismissed and Ignored leave the permission undecided; Cancelled means the
// prompt went away without the user seeing it through, and counts for nothing.
enum class PromptOutcome : u8 {
    AllowAlways,
    AllowOnce,
    Block,
    Dismissed,
    Ignored,
    Cancelled,
};

struct WEBCOMMON_API PermissionSnapshotEntry {
    URL::Origin top_level_origin;
    PermissionName name;
    EffectiveState state;
};

// The effective states of some of a browsing session's sites, as the UI process sends them to a process that reads them:
// only the sites that process shows, listed in origins. Of those, a site with no entry gets the default for the
// permission's name.
struct WEBCOMMON_API PermissionSnapshot {
    u64 revision { 0 };
    Vector<URL::Origin> origins;
    Vector<PermissionSnapshotEntry> entries;
    EffectiveState geolocation_default { EffectiveState::Prompt };
    EffectiveState microphone_default { EffectiveState::Prompt };
    EffectiveState notifications_default { EffectiveState::Prompt };
};

}

StringView policy_controlled_feature_token(PolicyControlledFeature feature)
{
    switch (feature) {
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Autoplay:
        return "autoplay"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Camera:
        return "camera"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::CrossOriginIsolated:
        return "cross-origin-isolated"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::EncryptedMedia:
        return "encrypted-media"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::FocusWithoutUserActivation:
        return "focus-without-user-activation"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Fullscreen:
        return "fullscreen"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Gamepad:
        return "gamepad"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Geolocation:
        return "geolocation"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Microphone:
        return "microphone"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::PictureInPicture:
        return "picture-in-picture"sv;
    case PolicyControlledFeature::WindowManagement:
        return "window-management"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Optional<PolicyControlledFeature> policy_controlled_feature_from_token(StringView token)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < supported_feature_count; i++) {
        auto feature = static_cast<PolicyControlledFeature>(i);
        if (policy_controlled_feature_token(feature) == token)
            return feature;
    }
    return {};
}

DefaultAllowlist default_allowlist(PolicyControlledFeature feature)
{
    switch (feature) {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#autoplay-feature
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Autoplay:
    // https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/#permissions-policy-integration
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Camera:
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#cross-origin-isolated-feature
    case PolicyControlledFeature::CrossOriginIsolated:
    // https://w3c.github.io/encrypted-media/#permissions-policy-integration
    case PolicyControlledFeature::EncryptedMedia:
    // https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#permissions-policy-integration
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Fullscreen:
    // https://w3c.github.io/geolocation/#permissions-policy
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Geolocation:
    // https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/#permissions-policy-integration
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Microphone:
    // https://w3c.github.io/window-management/#api-permission-policy-integration
    case PolicyControlledFeature::WindowManagement:
        return DefaultAllowlist::Self;
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#focus-without-user-activation-feature
    // AD-HOC: Allow cross-origin script focus as in Chromium and Firefox; the specification's default is "self".
    case PolicyControlledFeature::FocusWithoutUserActivation:
    // https://w3c.github.io/gamepad/#permission-policy
    case PolicyControlledFeature::Gamepad:
    // https://w3c.github.io/picture-in-picture/#permissions-policy
    case PolicyControlledFeature::PictureInPicture:
        return DefaultAllowlist::Star;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#matches
bool Allowlist::matches(URL::Origin const& origin) const
{
    // 1. If the allowlist is the special value *, then return true.
    if (is_the_special_value_star)
        return true;

    // 2. If the allowlist's self-origin is not null and it is same origin-domain with origin, then return true.
    if (self_origin.has_value() && self_origin->is_same_origin_domain(origin))
        return true;

    // 3. If the allowlist's src-origin is not null and it is same origin-domain with origin, then return true.
    if (src_origin.has_value() && src_origin->is_same_origin_domain(origin))
        return true;

    // 4. If origin is an opaque origin, return false.
    if (origin.is_opaque())
        return false;

    // 5. Let url be the result of calling the url parser on the serialization of origin.
    // 6. For each permissions-source-expression item in the allowlist's expressions:
    //    1. If the result of running Does url match expression in origin with redirect count? on url, item, origin,
    //       and 0 is true then return true.
    // FIXME: Match expressions as Content Security Policy source expressions, including wildcard hosts. Only an
    //        expression naming exactly this origin matches for now.
    for (auto const& expression : expressions) {
        auto expression_url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(expression);
        if (expression_url.has_value() && expression_url->origin().is_same_origin(origin))
            return true;
    }

    // 7. Return false.
    return false;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#empty-permissions-policy
PermissionsPolicy PermissionsPolicy::empty_permissions_policy()
{
    // An empty permissions policy is a permissions policy that has an inherited policy which contains "Enabled" for
    // every supported feature, a declared policy whose declarations and reporting configuration are both empty ordered
    // maps.
    PermissionsPolicy policy;
    policy.inherited_policy.fill(FeatureValue::Enabled);
    return policy;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-parse-policy-directive
PolicyDirective parse_policy_directive(StringView value, URL::Origin const& container_origin, Optional<URL::Origin> const& target_origin)
{
    // 1. Let directive be an empty ordered map.
    PolicyDirective directive;

    // 2. For each serialized-declaration returned by strictly splitting value on the delimiter U+003B (;):
    for (auto serialized_declaration : value.split_view(';', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty)) {
        // 1. Let tokens be the result of splitting serialized-declaration on ASCII whitespace.
        auto tokens = serialized_declaration.split_view_if(is_ascii_space);

        // 2. If tokens is an empty list, then continue.
        if (tokens.is_empty())
            continue;

        // 3. Let feature-name be the first element of tokens.
        auto feature_name = tokens.first();

        // 4. If feature-name does not identify any recognized policy-controlled feature, then continue.
        // 5. Let feature be the policy-controlled feature identified by feature-name.
        auto feature = policy_controlled_feature_from_token(feature_name);
        if (!feature.has_value())
            continue;

        // 6. Let targetlist be the remaining elements, if any, of tokens.
        auto targetlist = tokens.span().slice(1);

        // 7. Let allowlist be a new allowlist.
        Allowlist allowlist;

        // 8. If any element of targetlist is the string "*", set allowlist to the special value *.
        if (any_of(targetlist, [](auto element) { return element == "*"sv; })) {
            allowlist.is_the_special_value_star = true;
        }
        // 9. Otherwise:
        else {
            // 1. If targetlist is empty and target origin is given, let allowlist's src-origin be target origin.
            if (targetlist.is_empty() && target_origin.has_value())
                allowlist.src_origin = target_origin;

            // 2. For each element in targetlist:
            for (auto element : targetlist) {
                // 1. If element is an ASCII case-insensitive match for "'self'":
                if (element.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("'self'"sv)) {
                    // 1. Let allowlist's self-origin be container origin.
                    allowlist.self_origin = container_origin;

                    // 2. Continue to the next element.
                    continue;
                }

                // 2. If target origin is given, and element is an ASCII case-insensitive match for "'src'":
                if (target_origin.has_value() && element.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("'src'"sv)) {
                    // 1. Let allowlist's src-origin be target origin.
                    allowlist.src_origin = target_origin;

                    // 2. Continue to the next element.
                    continue;
                }

                // 3. Let result be the result of executing the URL parser on element.
                auto result = URL::Parser::basic_parse(element);

                // 4. If result is not failure:
                if (result.has_value()) {
                    // 1. Let target be the origin of result.
                    auto target = result->origin();

                    // 2. If target is not an opaque origin, append the serialization of target to allowlist's
                    //    expressions.
                    if (!target.is_opaque())
                        allowlist.expressions.append(target.serialize());
                }
            }
        }

        // 10. Set directive[feature] to allowlist.
        directive.set(*feature, move(allowlist));
    }

    // 3. Return directive
    return directive;
}

static bool is_the_token(HTTP::StructuredFields::BareItem const& item, StringView token)
{
    auto const* item_token = item.get_pointer<HTTP::StructuredFields::Token>();
    return item_token && item_token->value == token;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-construct-policy
static DeclaredPolicy construct_policy_from_dictionary_and_origin(HTTP::StructuredFields::Dictionary const& dictionary, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    // 1. Let declarations be an empty ordered map.
    DeclaredPolicy policy;

    // FIXME: 2. Let reporting-config be an empty ordered map.

    // 3. For each feature-name → (value, params) of dictionary:
    for (auto const& [feature_name, value] : dictionary) {
        // 1. If feature-name does not identify any recognized policy-controlled feature, then continue.
        // 2. Let feature be the policy-controlled feature identified by feature-name.
        auto feature = policy_controlled_feature_from_token(feature_name);
        if (!feature.has_value())
            continue;

        // FIXME: 3. If params["report-to"] exists, and is a token, then set reporting-config[feature] to
        //           params["report-to"].

        // 4. Let allowlist be a new allowlist.
        Allowlist allowlist;

        // 5. If value is the token *, or if value is a list which contains the token *, set allowlist to the special
        //    value *.
        auto is_the_token_star = value.visit(
            [](HTTP::StructuredFields::Item const& item) { return is_the_token(item.bare_item, "*"sv); },
            [](HTTP::StructuredFields::InnerList const& list) {
                return any_of(list.items, [](auto const& element) { return is_the_token(element.bare_item, "*"sv); });
            });
        if (is_the_token_star) {
            allowlist.is_the_special_value_star = true;
        }
        // 6. Otherwise:
        else {
            value.visit(
                // 1. If value is the token self, let allowlist's self-origin be origin.
                [&](HTTP::StructuredFields::Item const& item) {
                    if (is_the_token(item.bare_item, "self"sv))
                        allowlist.self_origin = origin;
                },
                // 2. Otherwise if value is a list, then for each element in value:
                [&](HTTP::StructuredFields::InnerList const& list) {
                    for (auto const& element : list.items) {
                        // 1. If element is the token self, let allowlist's self-origin be origin.
                        if (is_the_token(element.bare_item, "self"sv))
                            allowlist.self_origin = origin;

                        // 2. If element is a valid permissions-source-expression, append element to allowlist's
                        //    expressions.
                        // FIXME: Check that the string is a valid permissions-source-expression. Allowlist::matches()
                        //        only matches an expression that parses as a URL.
                        if (auto const* string = element.bare_item.get_pointer<ByteString>()) {
                            if (auto expression = String::from_byte_string(*string); !expression.is_error())
                                allowlist.expressions.append(expression.release_value());
                        }
                    }
                });
        }

        // 7. Set declarations[feature] to allowlist.
        policy.declarations.set(*feature, move(allowlist));
    }

    // 4. Return «declarations, reporting-config».
    return policy;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-process-response-policy
// NB: response is given as its header list, which is all these steps read of it. Report-only policies are not
//     supported.
static DeclaredPolicy process_response_policy(HTTP::HeaderList const& response_header_list, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    // 1. Let header name be "Permissions-Policy-Report-Only" if report-only is True, or "Permissions-Policy" otherwise.
    // 2. Let parsed header be the result of executing get a structured field value given header name and "dictionary"
    //    from response's header list.
    auto parsed_header = response_header_list.get_structured_field_value<HTTP::StructuredFields::Dictionary>("Permissions-Policy"sv);

    // 3. If parsed header is null, return an empty ordered map.
    if (!parsed_header.has_value())
        return {};

    // 4. Let policy be the result of executing Construct policy from dictionary and origin on parsed header and origin.
    // 5. Return policy.
    return construct_policy_from_dictionary_and_origin(*parsed_header, origin);
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-get-feature-value-for-origin
// NB: document is given as its permissions policy, which is all these steps read of it. Report-only policies are not
//     supported.
static FeatureValue get_feature_value_for_origin(PolicyControlledFeature feature, PermissionsPolicy const& document_permissions_policy, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    // 1. Let policy be document's report-only permissions policy if report-only is True, or document's permissions
    //    policy otherwise.
    auto const& policy = document_permissions_policy;

    // 2. If policy's inherited policy for feature is "Disabled", return "Disabled".
    if (policy.inherited_policy_for_a_feature(feature) == FeatureValue::Disabled)
        return FeatureValue::Disabled;

    // 3. If feature is present in policy's declared policy:
    if (auto allowlist = policy.declared_policy.declarations.get(feature); allowlist.has_value()) {
        // 1. If policy's declared policy's declarations[feature] matches origin, then return "Enabled".
        if (allowlist->matches(origin))
            return FeatureValue::Enabled;

        // 2. Otherwise return "Disabled".
        return FeatureValue::Disabled;
    }

    // 4. Return "Enabled".
    return FeatureValue::Enabled;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-define-inherited-policy-in-container
static FeatureValue define_an_inherited_policy_for_feature_in_container_at_origin(PolicyControlledFeature feature, Optional<NavigableContainerPolicyInputs> const& container, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    // 1. If container is null, return "Enabled".
    if (!container.has_value())
        return FeatureValue::Enabled;

    // 2. If the result of executing Get feature value for origin on feature, container's node document, container's
    //    node document's origin, and report-only is "Disabled", return "Disabled".
    if (get_feature_value_for_origin(feature, container->node_document_permissions_policy, container->node_document_origin) == FeatureValue::Disabled)
        return FeatureValue::Disabled;

    // 3. If the result of executing Get feature value for origin on feature, container's node document, origin, and
    //    report-only is "Disabled", return "Disabled".
    if (get_feature_value_for_origin(feature, container->node_document_permissions_policy, origin) == FeatureValue::Disabled)
        return FeatureValue::Disabled;

    // 4. Let container policy be the result of running Process permissions policy attributes on container.
    auto const& container_policy = container->container_policy;

    // 5. If feature exists in container policy:
    if (auto allowlist = container_policy.get(feature); allowlist.has_value()) {
        // 1. If the allowlist for feature in container policy matches origin, return "Enabled".
        if (allowlist->matches(origin))
            return FeatureValue::Enabled;

        // 2. Otherwise return "Disabled".
        return FeatureValue::Disabled;
    }

    // 6. If feature's default allowlist is *, return "Enabled".
    if (default_allowlist(feature) == DefaultAllowlist::Star)
        return FeatureValue::Enabled;

    // 7. If feature's default allowlist is 'self', and origin is same origin with container's node document's origin,
    //    return "Enabled".
    if (default_allowlist(feature) == DefaultAllowlist::Self && origin.is_same_origin(container->node_document_origin))
        return FeatureValue::Enabled;

    // 8. Otherwise return "Disabled".
    return FeatureValue::Disabled;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-create-for-navigable
PermissionsPolicy create_a_permissions_policy_for_a_navigable(Optional<NavigableContainerPolicyInputs> const& container, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    // 1. Assert: If not null, container is a navigable container.

    // 2. Let inherited policy be a new ordered map.
    // 4. Let policy be a new permissions policy, with inherited policy inherited policy and declared policy «[], []».
    PermissionsPolicy policy;

    // 3. For each feature supported,
    for (size_t i = 0; i < supported_feature_count; i++) {
        auto feature = static_cast<PolicyControlledFeature>(i);

        // 1. Let isInherited be the result of running Define an inherited policy for feature in container at origin on
        //    feature, container and origin.
        // 2. Set inherited policy[feature] to isInherited.
        policy.inherited_policy[i] = define_an_inherited_policy_for_feature_in_container_at_origin(feature, container, origin);
    }

    // 5. Return policy.
    return policy;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-create-from-response
// NB: response is given as its header list, which is all these steps read of it.
PermissionsPolicy create_a_permissions_policy_for_a_navigable_from_response(Optional<NavigableContainerPolicyInputs> const& container, URL::Origin const& origin, HTTP::HeaderList const& response_header_list)
{
    // 1. Let policy be the result of running Create a Permissions Policy for a navigable given container and origin.
    auto policy = create_a_permissions_policy_for_a_navigable(container, origin);

    // 2. Let d be the result of running Process response policy given response, origin and report-only.
    auto d = process_response_policy(response_header_list, origin);

    // 3. For each feature → allowlist of d's declarations:
    for (auto& [feature, allowlist] : d.declarations) {
        // 1. If policy's inherited policy[feature] is true, then set policy's declared policy's declarations[feature]
        //    to allowlist.
        if (policy.inherited_policy_for_a_feature(feature) == FeatureValue::Enabled)
            policy.declared_policy.declarations.set(feature, move(allowlist));
    }

    // FIXME: 4. Set policy's declared policy[feature]'s reporting configuration to d's reporting configuration.

    // 5. Return policy.
    return policy;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-check-permissions-policy
FeatureValue check_permissions_policy(PermissionsPolicy const& policy, PolicyControlledFeature feature, URL::Origin const& origin, URL::Origin const& document_origin)
{
    // 1. If policy's inherited policy for feature is "Disabled", return "Disabled".
    if (policy.inherited_policy_for_a_feature(feature) == FeatureValue::Disabled)
        return FeatureValue::Disabled;

    // 2. If feature is present in policy's declared policy:
    if (auto allowlist = policy.declared_policy.declarations.get(feature); allowlist.has_value()) {
        // 1. If policy's declared policy's declarations[feature] matches origin, then return "Enabled".
        if (allowlist->matches(origin))
            return FeatureValue::Enabled;

        // 2. Otherwise return "Disabled".
        return FeatureValue::Disabled;
    }

    // 3. If feature's default allowlist is *, return "Enabled".
    if (default_allowlist(feature) == DefaultAllowlist::Star)
        return FeatureValue::Enabled;

    // 4. If feature's default allowlist is 'self', and origin is same origin with document origin, return "Enabled".
    if (default_allowlist(feature) == DefaultAllowlist::Self && origin.is_same_origin(document_origin))
        return FeatureValue::Enabled;

    // 5. Return "Disabled".
    return FeatureValue::Disabled;
}

}

namespace Web::PermissionsPolicy {

ErrorOr<void> encode_policy_directive(IPC::Encoder& encoder, PolicyDirective const& directive)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(directive.size()));
    for (auto const& [feature, allowlist] : directive) {
        TRY(encoder.encode(to_underlying(feature)));
        TRY(encoder.encode(allowlist));
    }
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<PolicyDirective> decode_policy_directive(IPC::Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto size = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    if (size > supported_feature_count)
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Too many policy directive entries");
    PolicyDirective directive;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        auto feature = TRY(decoder.decode<u8>());
        if (feature >= supported_feature_count)
            return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Invalid policy-controlled feature");
        directive.set(static_cast<PolicyControlledFeature>(feature), TRY(decoder.decode<Allowlist>()));
    }
    return directive;
}

}

namespace IPC {

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::PermissionsPolicy::Allowlist const& allowlist)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(allowlist.is_the_special_value_star));
    TRY(encoder.encode(allowlist.expressions));
    TRY(encoder.encode(allowlist.self_origin));
    TRY(encoder.encode(allowlist.src_origin));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::PermissionsPolicy::Allowlist> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    return Web::PermissionsPolicy::Allowlist {
        .is_the_special_value_star = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>()),
        .expressions = TRY(decoder.decode<Vector<String>>()),
        .self_origin = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<URL::Origin>>()),
        .src_origin = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<URL::Origin>>()),
    };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::PermissionsPolicy::PermissionsPolicy const& policy)
{
    for (auto value : policy.inherited_policy)
        TRY(encoder.encode(value == Web::PermissionsPolicy::FeatureValue::Enabled));
    TRY(Web::PermissionsPolicy::encode_policy_directive(encoder, policy.declared_policy.declarations));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::PermissionsPolicy::PermissionsPolicy> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    Web::PermissionsPolicy::PermissionsPolicy policy;
    for (auto& value : policy.inherited_policy)
        value = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>()) ? Web::PermissionsPolicy::FeatureValue::Enabled : Web::PermissionsPolicy::FeatureValue::Disabled;
    policy.declared_policy.declarations = TRY(Web::PermissionsPolicy::decode_policy_directive(decoder));
    return policy;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibHTTP/Forward.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibURL/Origin.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Export.h>

namespace Web::PermissionsPolicy {

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#policy-controlled-feature
// NB: These are the supported features.
enum class PolicyControlledFeature : u8 {
    Autoplay,
    Camera,
    CrossOriginIsolated,
    EncryptedMedia,
    FocusWithoutUserActivation,
    Fullscreen,
    Gamepad,
    Geolocation,
    Microphone,
    PictureInPicture,
    WindowManagement,
};

static constexpr size_t supported_feature_count = to_underlying(PolicyControlledFeature::WindowManagement) + 1;

WEBCOMMON_API StringView policy_controlled_feature_token(PolicyControlledFeature);
WEBCOMMON_API Optional<PolicyControlledFeature> policy_controlled_feature_from_token(StringView);

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#default-allowlist
enum class DefaultAllowlist : u8 {
    Star,
    Self,
};

WEBCOMMON_API DefaultAllowlist default_allowlist(PolicyControlledFeature);

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#allowlist
struct WEBCOMMON_API Allowlist {
    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#the-special-value
    bool is_the_special_value_star { false };

    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#expressions
    Vector<String> expressions;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#self-origin
    Optional<URL::Origin> self_origin;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#src-origin
    Optional<URL::Origin> src_origin;

    bool matches(URL::Origin const&) const;
};

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#policy-directive
using PolicyDirective = OrderedHashMap<PolicyControlledFeature, Allowlist>;

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#declared-policy
struct DeclaredPolicy {
    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#declared-policy-declarations
    OrderedHashMap<PolicyControlledFeature, Allowlist> declarations;

    // FIXME: reporting configuration, an ordered map from features to strings.
};

enum class FeatureValue : u8 {
    Disabled,
    Enabled,
};

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#permissions-policy
struct WEBCOMMON_API PermissionsPolicy {
    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#permissions-policy-inherited-policy
    Array<FeatureValue, supported_feature_count> inherited_policy;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#permissions-policy-declared-policy
    DeclaredPolicy declared_policy;

    FeatureValue inherited_policy_for_a_feature(PolicyControlledFeature feature) const { return inherited_policy[to_underlying(feature)]; }

    static PermissionsPolicy empty_permissions_policy();
};

// What the algorithms below read of a navigable container: its node document's permissions policy and origin, and the
// container policy that processing its permissions policy attributes gives.
struct NavigableContainerPolicyInputs {
    PermissionsPolicy const& node_document_permissions_policy;
    URL::Origin const& node_document_origin;
    PolicyDirective const& container_policy;
};

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Web::CSSPixelPoint const& value)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(value.x().raw_value()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(value.y().raw_value()));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Web::CSSPixelPoint> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto x = TRY(decoder.decode<i32>());
    auto y = TRY(decoder.decode<i32>());
    return Web::CSSPixelPoint { Web::CSSPixels::from_raw(x), Web::CSSPixels::from_raw(y) };
}

/// DevicePixels: A position or length on the physical display.
AK_TYPEDEF_DISTINCT_NUMERIC_GENERAL(int, DevicePixels, Arithmetic, CastToUnderlying, Comparison, Increment);

constexpr bool operator<(DevicePixels left, T right) { return left.value() < right; }

constexpr bool operator>=(DevicePixels left, T right) { return left.value() >= right; }
